sanskrit_iast:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ
śrīrāmacandrāya namaḥ
meaning:
श्रीगणेशाय नमः
श्रीसरस्वत्यै नमः
श्रीरामचन्द्राय नमः
text_mt: Homage to holy Rāmacandra.

sanskrit_iast:
atha brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇaṃ pūrvabhāgaprārambhaḥ /
namonamaḥ kṣaye sṛṣṭau sthitau sattvamayāya vā /
namo rajastamaḥsattvatrirūpāya svayaṃbhuve //
meaning:
अथ ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणं पूर्वभागप्रारम्भः /
नमोनमः क्षये सृष्टौ स्थितौ सत्त्वमयाय वा /
नमो रजस्तमःसत्त्वत्रिरूपाय स्वयंभुवे //
text_mt:
Now begins the first part of the Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.
Repeated homage to the one who consists of sattva in dissolution, creation, and preservation,
homage to Svayambhū who possesses the three forms of rajas, tamas, and sattva.

sanskrit_iast:
jitaṃ bhagavatā tena hariṇā lokadhāriṇā /
ajena viśvarūpeṇa nirguṇena guṇātmanā //
meaning:
जितं भगवता तेन हरिणा लोकधारिणा /
अजेन विश्वरूपेण निर्गुणेन गुणात्मना //
text_mt:
Victory has been won by that Lord Hari, the bearer of the worlds,
unborn, of universal form, devoid of qualities yet the soul of the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ lokakarttāraṃ sarvajñamaparājitam /
prabhuṃbhūtabhaviṣyasya sāmpratasya ca satpatim //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं लोककर्त्तारं सर्वज्ञमपराजितम् /
प्रभुंभूतभविष्यस्य साम्प्रतस्य च सत्पतिम् //
text_mt:
To Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, omniscient, unconquered,
lord of the past, future, and present, and protector of the good—

sanskrit_iast:
jñānamabratimaṃ tasya vairāgyaṃ ca jagatpateḥ /
aiśvaryyaṃ caiva dharmaśca sadbhiḥ sevyaṃ catuṣṭayam //
meaning:
ज्ञानमब्रतिमं तस्य वैराग्यं च जगत्पतेः /
ऐश्वर्य्यं चैव धर्मश्च सद्भिः सेव्यं चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
incomparable knowledge belongs to him, and detachment to the lord of the world,
sovereignty and dharma: this fourfold set to be cultivated by the good.

sanskrit_iast:
imānnarasya vai bhāvānnityaṃ sadasadātmakān /
aviṃśakaḥ punastānvai kriyābhāvārthamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
इमान्नरस्य वै भावान्नित्यं सदसदात्मकान् /
अविंशकः पुनस्तान्वै क्रियाभावार्थमीश्वरः //
text_mt:
These states of man, ever consisting of existence and non-existence—
the Lord, unattached, [assumes] them for the sake of the condition of activity.

sanskrit_iast:
lokakṛllokatattvajño yogamāsthāya yogavit /
asṛjatsarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca //
meaning:
लोककृल्लोकतत्त्वज्ञो योगमास्थाय योगवित् /
असृजत्सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च //
text_mt:
The maker of the world, knower of cosmic principles, resorting to yoga as a knower of yoga,
created all beings, both stationary and moving.

sanskrit_iast:
tasahaṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ satpatiṃ lokasākṣiṇam /
purāṇākhyānajijñāsurgacchāmi śaraṇaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
तसहं विश्वकर्माणं सत्पतिं लोकसाक्षिणम् /
पुराणाख्यानजिज्ञासुर्गच्छामि शरणं विभुम् //
text_mt:
Desiring to know the purāṇic lore, I go for refuge to him, the all-pervading,
the maker of all, the protector of the good, the witness of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaṃ lokatattvārthamaśilaṃ vedasaṃmitam /
praśaśaṃsa sa bhagavān vasiṣṭhāya prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
पुराणं लोकतत्त्वार्थमशिलं वेदसंमितम् /
प्रशशंस स भगवान् वसिष्ठाय प्रजापतिः //
text_mt:
The Purāṇa, conveying the truth of the world, complete and equal to the Veda,
that Lord Prajāpati recited to Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñānāmṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
pautramadhyāpayāmāsa śakteḥ putraṃ parāśaram //
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञानामृतं पुण्यं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः /
पौत्रमध्यापयामास शक्तेः पुत्रं पराशरम् //
text_mt:
The holy sage Vasiṣṭha taught that sacred nectar of true knowledge
to his grandson Parāśara, the son of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśaraśca bhagavān jātūkarṇyamṛṣiṃ purā /
tamadhyāpitavāndivyaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam //
meaning:
पराशरश्च भगवान् जातूकर्ण्यमृषिं पुरा /
तमध्यापितवान्दिव्यं पुराणं वेदसंमितम् //
text_mt:
And the holy Parāśara formerly taught that divine Purāṇa,
equal to the Veda, to the sage Jātūkarṇya.

sanskrit_iast:
adhigamya purāṇaṃ tu jātūkarṇyo viśeṣavit /
dvaipāyanāya pradadau paraṃ brahma sanātanam //
meaning:
अधिगम्य पुराणं तु जातूकर्ण्यो विशेषवित् /
द्वैपायनाय प्रददौ परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् //
text_mt:
Having obtained the Purāṇa, Jātūkarṇya, discerning distinctions,
imparted the supreme, eternal Brahman to Dvaipāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaipāyanastataḥ prītaḥśaṣyebhyaḥpradadauvaśī /
lokatattvavidhānārthaṃ pañcabhyaḥ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
द्वैपायनस्ततः प्रीतःशष्येभ्यःप्रददौवशी /
लोकतत्त्वविधानार्थं पञ्चभ्यः परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt:
Then Dvaipāyana, pleased and self-controlled, imparted that exceedingly wonderful [lore]
to five disciples for the establishment of cosmic principles:

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyāpanārthaṃ lokeṣu bahvarthaṃ śrutisaṃmatam /
jaiminiñca sumantuṃ ca vaiśaṃpāyanamevaca //
meaning:
विख्यापनार्थं लोकेषु बह्वर्थं श्रुतिसंमतम् /
जैमिनिञ्च सुमन्तुं च वैशंपायनमेवच //
text_mt:
for proclamation among the worlds, rich in meaning and agreeable to the Vedas:
to Jaimini, to Sumantu, and to Vaiśampāyana,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthaṃ pailavaṃ teṣāṃ pañcamaṃ lomaharṣaṇam /
sūtamadbhutavṛttāntaṃ vinītaṃ dhārmikaṃ śrucim //
meaning:
चतुर्थं पैलवं तेषां पञ्चमं लोमहर्षणम् /
सूतमद्भुतवृत्तान्तं विनीतं धार्मिकं श्रुचिम् //
text_mt:
Paila as the fourth of them, and Lomaharṣaṇa as the fifth,
the bard of wonderful narrations, well-trained, righteous, and pure.

sanskrit_iast:
adhītya ca purāṇaṃ ca vinīto lomaharṣaṇaḥ /
ṛṣiṇā ca tvayā pṛṣṭaḥ kṛtaprajñaḥ sudhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
अधीत्य च पुराणं च विनीतो लोमहर्षणः /
ऋषिणा च त्वया पृष्टः कृतप्रज्ञः सुधार्मिकः //
text_mt:
Having studied the Purāṇa, the disciplined Lomaharṣaṇa,
wise and very righteous, was questioned by you, the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhaścāpi munibhiḥ praṇāmya śirasā munīn /
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठश्चापि मुनिभिः प्रणाम्य शिरसा मुनीन् /
भक्त्या परमया युक्तः कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt:
Bowing his head to the sages along with the descendants of Vasiṣṭha,
endowed with supreme devotion, and circumambulating [them],

sanskrit_iast:
avāptavidyaḥ sartuṣṭaḥ kurukṣetramupāgamat /
satre savitate yatra yajamānānṛṣīñśucīn //
meaning:
अवाप्तविद्यः सर्तुष्टः कुरुक्षेत्रमुपागमत् /
सत्रे सवितते यत्र यजमानानृषीञ्शुचीन् //
text_mt:
having attained knowledge and content, he came to Kurukṣetra,
where a long sacrificial session was underway, to the pure sages officiating as sacrificers.

sanskrit_iast:
vinayenopasaṃgamya satrriṇo romaharṣaṇam /
vidhānato yathāśāstraṃ prajñayātijagāma ha //
meaning:
विनयेनोपसंगम्य सत्र्रिणो रोमहर्षणम् /
विधानतो यथाशास्त्रं प्रज्ञयातिजगाम ह //
text_mt:
Approaching with modesty the performers of the sacrifice,
Romaharṣaṇa surpassed them in wisdom, in accordance with rule and scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaścāpi te sarve tadānīṃ romaharṣaṇam /
dṛṣṭvā paramasaṃhṛṣṭāḥ prītāḥ sumanasastathā //
meaning:
ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे तदानीं रोमहर्षणम् /
दृष्ट्वा परमसंहृष्टाः प्रीताः सुमनसस्तथा //
text_mt:
And all those sages then, seeing Romaharṣaṇa,
were exceedingly thrilled, delighted, and well-disposed.

sanskrit_iast:
satkārairarccayāmāsurarghyapādyādibhistataḥ /
abhivādya munīnsarvān rājājñāmabhigamya ca //
meaning:
सत्कारैरर्च्चयामासुरर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिस्ततः /
अभिवाद्य मुनीन्सर्वान् राजाज्ञामभिगम्य च //
text_mt:
They worshipped him with respectful offerings, water for the feet, and the like;
then, having greeted all the sages and received the permission of the king,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣibhistairanujñātaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sarvamanāmayam /
abhigamya munīnsarvāṃstejo brahma sanātanam /
sadasyānumate ramye svāstīrṇe samupāviśat //
meaning:
ऋषिभिस्तैरनुज्ञातः पृष्टः सर्वमनामयम् /
अभिगम्य मुनीन्सर्वांस्तेजो ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
सदस्यानुमते रम्ये स्वास्तीर्णे समुपाविशत् //
text_mt:
permitted by those sages and asked if all was well,
approaching all the sages, that eternal Brahman-splendour
sat down on a well-strewn, pleasant seat with the consent of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
upaviṣṭe tadā tasminmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ /
mudānvitā yathānyāyaṃ vinayasthāḥ samāhitāḥ //
meaning:
उपविष्टे तदा तस्मिन्मुनयः शंसितव्रताः /
मुदान्विता यथान्यायं विनयस्थाः समाहिताः //
text_mt:
When he had sat down, the sages of fulfilled vows,
filled with joy, rightly established in modesty and composed,

sanskrit_iast:
sarve te ṛṣayaścainaṃ parivārya mahāvratam /
paramaprītisaṃyuktā ityūcuḥ sūtanandanam //
meaning:
सर्वे ते ऋषयश्चैनं परिवार्य महाव्रतम् /
परमप्रीतिसंयुक्ता इत्यूचुः सूतनन्दनम् //
text_mt:
all those sages, surrounding him of great vows
with extreme affection, spoke thus to the bard’s son:

sanskrit_iast:
svāgataṃ te mahābhāga diṣṭyā ca tvāṃnirāmayam /
paśyāma dhīmannatrasthāḥ subrataṃ munisattamam //
meaning:
स्वागतं ते महाभाग दिष्ट्या च त्वांनिरामयम् /
पश्याम धीमन्नत्रस्थाः सुब्रतं मुनिसत्तमम् //
text_mt:
“Welcome to you, highly fortunate one! By good fortune we see you free from affliction
as we remain here, wise one of good vows, best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
aśūnyā me rasādyaiva bhavataḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ /
bhavāṃstasya muneḥ sūta vyāsasyāpi mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अशून्या मे रसाद्यैव भवतः पुण्यकर्मणः /
भवांस्तस्य मुनेः सूत व्यासस्यापि महात्मनः //
text_mt:
My earth is today indeed not empty because of you of meritorious deeds;
you, O bard, are the disciple of that sage Vyāsa, the great-souled,

sanskrit_iast:
anugrāhyaḥ sadā dhīmātr śiṣyaḥ śiṣyaguṇānvitaḥ /
kṛtabuddhiśca te tattvamanugrāhyatayā prabho //
meaning:
अनुग्राह्यः सदा धीमात्र् शिष्यः शिष्यगुणान्वितः /
कृतबुद्धिश्च ते तत्त्वमनुग्राह्यतया प्रभो //
text_mt:
ever worthy of favour, wise, endowed with the qualities of a disciple;
and your mind is fixed upon truth by virtue of being favoured, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
avāpya vipulaṃ jñānaṃ sarvataśchinnasaṃśayaḥ /
pṛccatāṃ naḥ sadā prājña sarvamākhyātumarhasi //
meaning:
अवाप्य विपुलं ज्ञानं सर्वतश्छिन्नसंशयः /
पृच्चतां नः सदा प्राज्ञ सर्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Having obtained vast knowledge, with doubts cut away on all sides,
you ought to narrate everything to us who are continually asking, O wise one.

sanskrit_iast:
tadicchāmaḥ kathāṃ divyāṃ paurāṇīṃ śrutisaṃmitām /
śrotuṃ dharmārthayuktāṃ tu etavdyāsācchrutaṃ tvayā //
meaning:
तदिच्छामः कथां दिव्यां पौराणीं श्रुतिसंमिताम् /
श्रोतुं धर्मार्थयुक्तां तु एतव्द्यासाच्छ्रुतं त्वया //
text_mt:
Therefore we wish to hear the divine purāṇic account, equal to the Vedas,
joined with dharma and purpose, which was heard by you from Vyāsa.”

sanskrit_iast:
evasuktastadā sūtastvṛṣibhirvinayānvitaḥ /
uvāca paramāprākjño vinītottara muttamam //
meaning:
एवसुक्तस्तदा सूतस्त्वृषिभिर्विनयान्वितः /
उवाच परमाप्राक्ज्ञो विनीतोत्तर मुत्तमम् //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by the sages, the bard, endowed with modesty
and exceedingly wise, spoke an excellent, humble reply:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣeḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ yacca tasmātprajñā ca yā mama /
yasmācchuśūṣaṇārthaṃ ca tatsatyamiti niścayaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषेः शुश्रूषणं यच्च तस्मात्प्रज्ञा च या मम /
यस्माच्छुशूषणार्थं च तत्सत्यमिति निश्चयः //
text_mt:
“Service to the sage is [proper], and whatever wisdom is mine comes from that;
since it is for the sake of service, this is a firm conviction: that it is true.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ gater'the yacchakyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ dvijottamāḥ /
jijñāsā yatra yuṣmākaṃ tadājñātumihārhatha //
meaning:
एवं गतेर्ऽथे यच्छक्यं मया वक्तुं द्विजोत्तमाः /
जिज्ञासा यत्र युष्माकं तदाज्ञातुमिहार्हथ //
text_mt:
Such being the matter, whatever can be spoken by me, O best of the twice-born,
wherever your desire to know lies, you ought to learn that here.”

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu munayo madhuraṃ tasya bhāṣitam /
pratyūcuste punaḥ sūtaṃ bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇam //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु मुनयो मधुरं तस्य भाषितम् /
प्रत्यूचुस्ते पुनः सूतं बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणम् //
text_mt:
Hearing that sweet utterance of his, the sages
spoke once again to the bard, whose eyes were filled with tears [of joy]:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavān viśeṣakuśalo vyāsaṃ sākṣāttu dṛṣṭavān /
tasmāttvaṃ saṃbhavaṃ kṛtsnaṃ lokasyemaṃ vidarśaya //
meaning:
भवान् विशेषकुशलो व्यासं साक्षात्तु दृष्टवान् /
तस्मात्त्वं संभवं कृत्स्नं लोकस्येमं विदर्शय //
text_mt:
“You are exceptionally skilled, having seen Vyāsa directly;
therefore, reveal this entire origin of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yasyānvaye ye ye tāṃstānicchāma veditum /
teṣāṃ pūrvavisṛṣṭiṃ ca vicitrāṃ tvaṃ prajāpateḥ /
satkṛtya paripṛṣṭaḥ sa mahātmā romaharṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
यस्य यस्यान्वये ये ये तांस्तानिच्छाम वेदितुम् /
तेषां पूर्वविसृष्टिं च विचित्रां त्वं प्रजापतेः /
सत्कृत्य परिपृष्टः स महात्मा रोमहर्षणः //
text_mt:
In whichever lineage whoever was born, those we wish to know,
as well as their diverse primary creation by Prajāpati.”
Having been respectfully questioned, that great-souled Romaharṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca kathayāmāsa sattamaḥ /
sūta uvāca
yo me dvaipāyanaprītaḥ kathāṃ vai dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च कथयामास सत्तमः /
सूत उवाच
यो मे द्वैपायनप्रीतः कथां वै द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt:
the best of men, narrated in detail and in proper order.
The bard said:
“The story which Dvaipāyana, being pleased, told to me, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyāmākhyātavānviprāstāṃ vai vakṣyāmyanukramāt /
purāṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ mātariśvanā //
meaning:
पुण्यामाख्यातवान्विप्रास्तां वै वक्ष्याम्यनुक्रमात् /
पुराणं संप्रवक्ष्यामि यदुक्तं मातरिश्वना //
text_mt:
the sacred [story] he related, O brāhmans, that I shall recount in due order;
I shall proclaim the Purāṇa as spoken by Mātariśvan,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭena munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ naimiṣīyairma hātmabhiḥ /
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca //
meaning:
पृष्टेन मुनिभिः पूर्वं नैमिषीयैर्म हात्मभिः /
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च //
text_mt:
when formerly questioned by the great-souled sages, the inhabitants of Naimiṣa.
Primary creation, secondary creation, genealogy, the manvantaras,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśyānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam /
prakriyā prathamaḥ pādaḥ kathāyāṃ syātparigrahaḥ //
meaning:
वंश्यानुचरितं चैव पुराणं पञ्चलक्षणम् /
प्रक्रिया प्रथमः पादः कथायां स्यात्परिग्रहः //
text_mt:
and dynastic history—such is a Purāṇa with its five defining characteristics.
Prakriyā is the first pāda, providing the setting for the story;

sanskrit_iast:
anuṣaṅga utpoddhāta upasaṃhāra eva ca /
evaṃ pādāstu catvāraḥ samāsātkīṃrtitā mayā //
meaning:
अनुषङ्ग उत्पोद्धात उपसंहार एव च /
एवं पादास्तु चत्वारः समासात्कींर्तिता मया //
text_mt:
then Anuṣaṅga, Upoddhāta, and Upasaṃhāra.
Thus the four pādas have been declared by me in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmi tānpurastāttu vistareṇa yathākramam /
prathamaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā śrutam //
meaning:
वक्ष्यामि तान्पुरस्तात्तु विस्तरेण यथाक्रमम् /
प्रथमं सर्वशास्त्राणां पुराणं ब्रह्मणा श्रुतम् //
text_mt:
I shall state them in front, in full and in proper order.
First of all sacred scriptures, the Purāṇa was heard by Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedāstasya viniḥsṛtāḥ /
aṅgāni dharmaśāstraṃ ca vratāni niyamāstathā //
meaning:
अनन्तरं च वक्त्रेभ्यो वेदास्तस्य विनिःसृताः /
अङ्गानि धर्मशास्त्रं च व्रतानि नियमास्तथा //
text_mt:
thereafter the Vedas issued from his mouths,
as well as the auxiliary limbs, the legal treatises, vows, and observances.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam /
mahadādiviśeṣāntaṃ sṛjāmīti viniścayaḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् /
महदादिविशेषान्तं सृजामीति विनिश्चयः //
text_mt:
That which is the unmanifest cause, eternal, consisting of existence and non-existence—
‘I create from the cosmic intellect down to the gross elements,’ such was the resolve.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ caiva brahmaṇaḥsūtiruttamā /
aḍasyāvaraṇaṃ vārdhirapāmapi ca tejasā //
meaning:
अण्डं हिरण्मयं चैव ब्रह्मणःसूतिरुत्तमा /
अडस्यावरणं वार्धिरपामपि च तेजसा //
text_mt:
And the golden egg was the excellent birthplace of Brahmā.
The covering of the egg is water, and that of water is fire,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyunā tasya vāyośca khena bhūtādinā tataḥ /
bhūtādirmahatā caiva avyaktenāvṛto mahān //
meaning:
वायुना तस्य वायोश्च खेन भूतादिना ततः /
भूतादिर्महता चैव अव्यक्तेनावृतो महान् //
text_mt:
its [covering] is wind, and that of wind is space, then the origin of the elements;
the origin of the elements is covered by the cosmic intellect, and the cosmic intellect is covered by the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
antarvarti ca bhūtānāmaṇḍamevopavarṇitam /
nadīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca prādurbhāvo 'tra paṭhyate //
meaning:
अन्तर्वर्ति च भूतानामण्डमेवोपवर्णितम् /
नदीनां पर्वतानां च प्रादुर्भावो ऽत्र पठ्यते //
text_mt:
The egg is described as having beings dwelling within;
the appearance of rivers and mountains is recited here.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kalpānāṃ caiva varṇanam /
kīrttanaṃ brahmavṛkṣasya brahmajanma prakīrtyate //
meaning:
मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषां कल्पानां चैव वर्णनम् /
कीर्त्तनं ब्रह्मवृक्षस्य ब्रह्मजन्म प्रकीर्त्यते //
text_mt:
as well as a description of all manvantaras and aeons,
the recitation of the tree of Brahman, and the birth of Brahmā is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ brahmaṇaśca prajāsargopavarṇanam /
avasthāścātra kīrtyante brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
अतः परं ब्रह्मणश्च प्रजासर्गोपवर्णनम् /
अवस्थाश्चात्र कीर्त्यन्ते ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः //
text_mt:
After this, the creation of offspring by Brahmā is described,
and the states of Brahmā, born from the unmanifest, are celebrated here.”

sanskrit_iast:
kalpānāṃ saṃbhavaśceva jagataḥ sthāpanaṃ tathā /
śayanaṃ ca harerapsu pṛthivyuddharaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कल्पानां संभवश्चेव जगतः स्थापनं तथा /
शयनं च हरेरप्सु पृथिव्युद्धरणं तथा //
text_mt: The arising of the kalpas and the establishment of the universe, / as well as Hari's sleeping on the waters and the lifting up of the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
saviśeṣaḥ purādīnāṃ varṇāśramavibhājanam /
ṛkṣāṇāṃ grahasaṃsthānāṃ siddhānāṃ ca niveśanam //
meaning:
सविशेषः पुरादीनां वर्णाश्रमविभाजनम् /
ऋक्षाणां ग्रहसंस्थानां सिद्धानां च निवेशनम् //
text_mt: The distinctive division of cities and the like, the division of classes and life stages, / and the setting in place of the constellations, the planets, and the Siddhas;

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ yathā cava saṃcaro bahuvistaraḥ /
svargasthānavibhāgaśca sartyānāṃ śubhacāriṇām //
meaning:
योजनानां यथा चव संचरो बहुविस्तरः /
स्वर्गस्थानविभागश्च सर्त्यानां शुभचारिणाम् //
text_mt: How the extensive movement of yojanas takes place, / and the division of celestial realms for mortals who act auspiciously;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāṇāmauṣadhīnāṃ ca vīrudhāṃ ca prakīrttanam /
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca dve sṛtī parikīrtite //
meaning:
वृक्षाणामौषधीनां च वीरुधां च प्रकीर्त्तनम् /
देवतानामृषीणां च द्वे सृती परिकीर्तिते //
text_mt: The account of trees, herbs, and climbing plants, / and the two paths described for deities and sages;

sanskrit_iast:
āmlādīnāṃ tarūṇāṃ ca sarjanaṃ vyañjanaṃ tathā /
paśūnāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ parikīrttitaḥ //
meaning:
आम्लादीनां तरूणां च सर्जनं व्यञ्जनं तथा /
पशूनां पुरुषाणां च संभवः परिकीर्त्तितः //
text_mt: The creation and manifest display of sour trees and the rest, / and the origination of beasts and humans is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā nirvacanaṃ proktaṃ kalpasya ca parigrahaḥ /
nava sargāḥ punaḥ proktā brahmaṇo buddhipūrvakāḥ //
meaning:
तथा निर्वचनं प्रोक्तं कल्पस्य च परिग्रहः /
नव सर्गाः पुनः प्रोक्ता ब्रह्मणो बुद्धिपूर्वकाः //
text_mt: Likewise the definition and the commencement of the kalpa are stated; / moreover, the nine creations of Brahmā that proceed with intention are recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
trayo ye buddhipūrvāstu tathā yallokakalpanam /
brahmaṇo 'vayavebhyaśca dharmādīnāṃ samudbhavaḥ //
meaning:
त्रयो ये बुद्धिपूर्वास्तु तथा यल्लोककल्पनम् /
ब्रह्मणो ऽवयवेभ्यश्च धर्मादीनां समुद्भवः //
text_mt: The three that proceed without intention, and the fashioning of the worlds; / and the emergence of Dharma and the others from the limbs of Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
ye dvādaśa prasūyante prajākalpe punaḥ punaḥ /
kalpayorantare proktaṃ pratisaṃdhiśca yastayoḥ //
meaning:
ये द्वादश प्रसूयन्ते प्रजाकल्पे पुनः पुनः /
कल्पयोरन्तरे प्रोक्तं प्रतिसंधिश्च यस्तयोः //
text_mt: The twelve who are born again and again in the kalpa of progeny; / what is declared regarding the interval between two kalpas, and their transitional juncture;

sanskrit_iast:
tamomātrā vṛtatvāttu brahmaṇo 'dharmasaṃbhavaḥ /
sattvodriktācca dehācca puruṣasya ca saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
तमोमात्रा वृतत्वात्तु ब्रह्मणो ऽधर्मसंभवः /
सत्त्वोद्रिक्ताच्च देहाच्च पुरुषस्य च संभवः //
text_mt: The arising of Adharma from Brahmā because of his being enveloped only by tamas, / and the arising of Puruṣa from his body swollen with sattva;

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva śatarūpāyāṃ tayoḥ putrāstataḥ param /
priyavratottānapādau prasūtyākṛtayaḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
तथैव शतरूपायां तयोः पुत्रास्ततः परम् /
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ प्रसूत्याकृतयः शुभाः //
text_mt: Likewise, in Śatarūpā, the two sons born to them thereafter, / Priyavrata and Uttānapāda, and the auspicious daughters Prasūti and Ākūti;

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyante dhūtapāpmānastrailokye ye pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
ruceḥ prajāpateścorddhamākūtyāṃ mithunodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
कीर्त्यन्ते धूतपाप्मानस्त्रैलोक्ये ये प्रतिष्ठिताः /
रुचेः प्रजापतेश्चोर्द्धमाकूत्यां मिथुनोद्भवः //
text_mt: Those whose sins have been shaken off, who are established in the three worlds, are praised; / and subsequently, from the Prajāpati Ruci, the birth of twins in Ākūti;

sanskrit_iast:
prasūtyamapi dakṣasya kanyānāmudbhavaḥ śubhaḥ /
dākṣāyaṇīṣu vāpyūrdhvaṃśabdādyāsu mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसूत्यमपि दक्षस्य कन्यानामुद्भवः शुभः /
दाक्षायणीषु वाप्यूर्ध्वंशब्दाद्यासु महात्मनः //
text_mt: Also the auspicious birth of daughters to Dakṣa from Prasūti; / and subsequently in the daughters of Dakṣa, Śraddhā and the others, of the great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasya kīrtyate sargaḥ sāttvikastu sukhodayaḥ /
tathādharmasya hiṃsāyāṃ tamaso 'śubhalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मस्य कीर्त्यते सर्गः सात्त्विकस्तु सुखोदयः /
तथाधर्मस्य हिंसायां तमसो ऽशुभलक्षणः //
text_mt: The creation of Dharma, consisting of sattva and leading to happiness, is recounted; / and likewise that of Adharma, marked by inauspiciousness, arising from tamas in Hiṃsā;

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca prajāsargopavarṇanam /
brahmarṣeśca vasiṣṭhasya yatra gotrānukīrttanam //
meaning:
भृग्वादीनामृषीणां च प्रजासर्गोपवर्णनम् /
ब्रह्मर्षेश्च वसिष्ठस्य यत्र गोत्रानुकीर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: The description of the creation of offspring by the sages Bhṛgu and the others, / wherein is recounted the lineage of the brahmin sage Vasiṣṭha;

sanskrit_iast:
agneḥ prajāyāḥ saṃbhūtiḥ svāhāyāṃ yatra kīrtyate /
pitṝṇāṃ dviprakārāṇāṃ svadhāyāṃ tadanantaram //
meaning:
अग्नेः प्रजायाः संभूतिः स्वाहायां यत्र कीर्त्यते /
पितॄणां द्विप्रकाराणां स्वधायां तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Wherein the generation of Agni's offspring in Svāhā is proclaimed, / and immediately thereafter of the two kinds of Ancestors in Svadhā;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛvaṃśaprasaṃgena kīrtyate ca maheśvarāt /
dakṣasya śāpaḥ satyāśca bhṛgvādīnāṃ ca dhīmatām //
meaning:
पितृवंशप्रसंगेन कीर्त्यते च महेश्वरात् /
दक्षस्य शापः सत्याश्च भृग्वादीनां च धीमताम् //
text_mt: In connection with the lineage of the Ancestors is recounted the curse / from Maheśvara upon Dakṣa, upon Satī, and upon the wise Bhṛgu and the others;

sanskrit_iast:
pratiśāpaśca dakṣasya rudrādadbhutakarmaṇaḥ /
pratiṣedhaśca vairasya kīrtyate doṣadarśanāt //
meaning:
प्रतिशापश्च दक्षस्य रुद्रादद्भुतकर्मणः /
प्रतिषेधश्च वैरस्य कीर्त्यते दोषदर्शनात् //
text_mt: And the counter-curse upon Dakṣa from Rudra of marvelous deeds, / and the cessation of enmity is recounted due to perceiving its defect;

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaraprasaṃgena kālākhyānaṃ ca kīrtyate /
prajāpateḥ karddamasya kanyāyāḥ śubhalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरप्रसंगेन कालाख्यानं च कीर्त्यते /
प्रजापतेः कर्द्दमस्य कन्यायाः शुभलक्षणम् //
text_mt: In connection with the manvantara, the narration of time is also proclaimed, / and the auspicious characteristics of the daughters of the Prajāpati Kardama;

sanskrit_iast:
priyavratasya putrāṇāṃ kīrtyate yatra vistaraḥ /
teṣāṃ niyogo dvīpeṣu deśeṣu ca pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
प्रियव्रतस्य पुत्राणां कीर्त्यते यत्र विस्तरः /
तेषां नियोगो द्वीपेषु देशेषु च पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Wherein the extensive lineage of Priyavrata's sons is recounted, / and their appointment individually over the continents and countries;

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvasya sargasya tataścāpyanukīrttanam /
varṣāṇāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca tadbhedānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवस्य सर्गस्य ततश्चाप्यनुकीर्त्तनम् /
वर्षाणां च नदीनां च तद्भेदानां च सर्वशः //
text_mt: And thereafter the narration of the creation of Svāyambhuva, / and the realms, rivers, and all their subdivisions in full;

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpabhedasahasrāṇā mantarbhāvaśca saptasu /
vistarānmaṇḍalaṃ caiva jaṃbūdvīpasamudrayoḥ //
meaning:
द्वीपभेदसहस्राणा मन्तर्भावश्च सप्तसु /
विस्तरान्मण्डलं चैव जंबूद्वीपसमुद्रयोः //
text_mt: The inclusion of thousands of different continents within the seven, / and the circumference and extent of Jambūdvīpa and its ocean;

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇaṃ yojanāgreṇa kīrtyante parvataiḥ saha /
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho merureva ca /
nīlaḥ śvetaśca śṛṅgī ca kīrtyante sapta parvatāḥ //
meaning:
प्रमाणं योजनाग्रेण कीर्त्यन्ते पर्वतैः सह /
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो मेरुरेव च /
नीलः श्वेतश्च शृङ्गी च कीर्त्यन्ते सप्त पर्वताः //
text_mt: Their measure by the number of yojanas is recounted along with their mountains; / Himavat, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Meru, / Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgin are recounted as the seven mountains;

sanskrit_iast: teṣāmantaraviṣkaṃbhā ucchrāyāyāmavistarāḥ //
meaning: तेषामन्तरविष्कंभा उच्छ्रायायामविस्तराः //
text_mt: Their intermediate widths, heights, lengths, and breadths

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyante yojanāgreṇa ye ca tatra nivāsinaḥ /
bhāratādīni varṣāṇi nadībhiḥ parvataistathā //
meaning:
कीर्त्यन्ते योजनाग्रेण ये च तत्र निवासिनः /
भारतादीनि वर्षाणि नदीभिः पर्वतैस्तथा //
text_mt: Are recounted by the number of yojanas, as well as those who dwell there; / and the realms, Bhārata and the rest, along with their rivers and mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaiścopaniviṣṭāni gatimadbhirdhuvai stathā /
jaṃbūdvīpādayo dvīpāḥ samudraiḥ saptabhirvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
भूतैश्चोपनिविष्टानि गतिमद्भिर्धुवै स्तथा /
जंबूद्वीपादयो द्वीपाः समुद्रैः सप्तभिर्वृताः //
text_mt: Settled by living beings, both moving and fixed; / and the continents, Jambūdvīpa and the rest, surrounded by seven oceans;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svarṇamayī bhūmirlokālokaśca kīrtyate /
sapramāṇā ime lokāḥ saptadvīpā ca medinī //
meaning:
ततः स्वर्णमयी भूमिर्लोकालोकश्च कीर्त्यते /
सप्रमाणा इमे लोकाः सप्तद्वीपा च मेदिनी //
text_mt: Thereupon the golden land and Mount Lokāloka are recounted; / these worlds with their measurements, and the earth with its seven continents;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpādayaḥ prakīrtyante karaṇātprākṛtaiḥ saha /
sarvaṃ caitatpradhānasya pariṇāmaikadeśikam //
meaning:
रूपादयः प्रकीर्त्यन्ते करणात्प्राकृतैः सह /
सर्वं चैतत्प्रधानस्य परिणामैकदेशिकम् //
text_mt: Form and the rest are recounted together with the material organs from the source; / and all this is a partial modification of Pradhāna;

sanskrit_iast:
paryāyaparimāṇaṃ ca saṃkṣepeṇātra kīrtyate /
sūryācandramasoścaiva pṛthivyāścāpyaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
पर्यायपरिमाणं च संक्षेपेणात्र कीर्त्यते /
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोश्चैव पृथिव्याश्चाप्यशेषतः //
text_mt: The duration of the cycles and the measure are recounted here in brief, / of the sun and the moon, and of the earth without remainder;

sanskrit_iast:
pramāṇaṃ yojanāgreṇa sāṃpratairabhimānibhiḥ /
mahendrādyāḥ śubhāḥ puṇyā mānasottaramūrdhani //
meaning:
प्रमाणं योजनाग्रेण सांप्रतैरभिमानिभिः /
महेन्द्राद्याः शुभाः पुण्या मानसोत्तरमूर्धनि //
text_mt: The measure by the number of yojanas, with their presiding deities of the present; / the auspicious and sacred [cities] of Mahendra and the rest upon the summit of Mānasottara;

sanskrit_iast:
ata ūrdhdagatiścoktā sūryasyālātayakravat /
nāgavīthyakṣavīthyośca lakṣaṇaṃ ca prakīrtyate //
meaning:
अत ऊर्ध्दगतिश्चोक्ता सूर्यस्यालातयक्रवत् /
नागवीथ्यक्षवीथ्योश्च लक्षणं च प्रकीर्त्यते //
text_mt: Hence the upward movement of the sun is described like a whirling firebrand; / and the characteristics of the Nāgavīthī and the Ajavīthī are proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭhayorlekhayoścaiva maṇḍalānāṃ ca yojanaiḥ /
lokālokasya sandhyāyā ahno viṣuvatastathā //
meaning:
कोष्ठयोर्लेखयोश्चैव मण्डलानां च योजनैः /
लोकालोकस्य सन्ध्याया अह्नो विषुवतस्तथा //
text_mt: In terms of the yojanas of the divisions, paths, and orbits, / and of Lokāloka, the twilight, the day, and the equinox;

sanskrit_iast:
lokapālāḥ sthitāścorddhaṃ kīrtyante te caturddiśam /
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca panthānau dakṣiṇottarau //
meaning:
लोकपालाः स्थिताश्चोर्द्धं कीर्त्यन्ते ते चतुर्द्दिशम् /
पितॄणां देवतानां च पन्थानौ दक्षिणोत्तरौ //
text_mt: The guardians of the worlds who stand above are recounted in the four directions; / and the two paths, the southern and the northern, of the Ancestors and of the deities;

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhiṇāṃ nyāsināṃ cokto rajaḥsattvasamāśrayaḥ /
kīrtyate ca padaṃ viṣṇordharmādyā yatra ca sthitāḥ //
meaning:
गृहिणां न्यासिनां चोक्तो रजःसत्त्वसमाश्रयः /
कीर्त्यते च पदं विष्णोर्धर्माद्या यत्र च स्थिताः //
text_mt: For householders and renunciants, based respectively on rajas and sattva, is described; / and the abode of Viṣṇu is proclaimed, where Dharma and the others dwell;

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramasoścāro grahāṇāṃ jyotiṣāṃ tathā /
kīrtyate dhṛtasāmarthyātprajānāṃ ca śubhāśubham //
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसोश्चारो ग्रहाणां ज्योतिषां तथा /
कीर्त्यते धृतसामर्थ्यात्प्रजानां च शुभाशुभम् //
text_mt: The course of the sun and the moon, and likewise of the planets and stars, / is recounted, as well as the good and evil fortune of beings resulting from their exerted power;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā nirmitaḥ sauraḥ sādanārthaṃ ca sa svayam /
kīrtyate bhagavānyena prasarppati divaḥ kṣayam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितः सौरः सादनार्थं च स स्वयम् /
कीर्त्यते भगवान्येन प्रसर्प्पति दिवः क्षयम् //
text_mt: The solar chariot fashioned by Brahmā himself for [the sun's] abode, / by which the blessed lord moves forward toward the termination of the sky, is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
sa ratho 'dhiṣṭhito devair ādityai ṛṣibhistathā /
gandharvairapsarobhiśca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ //
meaning:
स रथो ऽधिष्ठितो देवैर् आदित्यै ऋषिभिस्तथा /
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः //
text_mt: That chariot is presided over by the gods, the Ādityas, and the sages, / by Gandharvas, Apsarases, troop-leaders, serpents, and rākṣasas;

sanskrit_iast:
apāṃ sāramayātsyandātkathyate ca rasastathā /
vṛddhikṣayau ca somasya kīrtyete somakāritau //
meaning:
अपां सारमयात्स्यन्दात्कथ्यते च रसस्तथा /
वृद्धिक्षयौ च सोमस्य कीर्त्येते सोमकारितौ //
text_mt: And the sap from the flowing stream consisting of the essence of water is described; / and the waxing and waning of Soma caused by Soma are recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
sūryādīnāṃ syandanānāṃ dhruvādeva pravarttanam /
kīrtyate śiśumārasya yasya pucche dhruvaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यादीनां स्यन्दनानां ध्रुवादेव प्रवर्त्तनम् /
कीर्त्यते शिशुमारस्य यस्य पुच्छे ध्रुवः स्थितः //
text_mt: The movement of the chariots of the sun and the rest from Dhruva alone, / and the celestial porpoise upon whose tail Dhruva is situated, are recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
tārārūpāṇi sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi grahaiḥ saha /
nivāsā yatra kīrtyante devānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām //
meaning:
तारारूपाणि सर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि ग्रहैः सह /
निवासा यत्र कीर्त्यन्ते देवानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: All the constellations in the form of stars together with the planets, / wherein are recounted the abodes of the deities of meritorious deeds;

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaraśmisahasraṃ ca varṣaśītoṣṇaviśravaḥ /
pravibhāgaścaraśmīnāṃ nāmataḥ karmatīrthataḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यरश्मिसहस्रं च वर्षशीतोष्णविश्रवः /
प्रविभागश्चरश्मीनां नामतः कर्मतीर्थतः //
text_mt: The thousand rays of the sun, and the distribution of rain, cold, and heat; / the classification of the rays by name, function, and sacred source;

sanskrit_iast:
parimāṇaṃ gatiścoktā grahāṇāṃ sūryasaṃśrayāt /
veśyārūpātpradhānasya parimāṇo mahādbhavaḥ //
meaning:
परिमाणं गतिश्चोक्ता ग्रहाणां सूर्यसंश्रयात् /
वेश्यारूपात्प्रधानस्य परिमाणो महाद्भवः //
text_mt: The extent and the motion of the planets dependent on the sun are stated; / the vast extent of Pradhāna in the form of space is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
purūravasa ailasya māhātmyasyānukīrttanam /
pitṝṇāṃ dviprakārāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ vā mṛtasya ca //
meaning:
पुरूरवस ऐलस्य माहात्म्यस्यानुकीर्त्तनम् /
पितॄणां द्विप्रकाराणां माहात्म्यं वा मृतस्य च //
text_mt: The recitation of the majesty of Purūravas, the son of Ilā; / and the majesty of the two classes of Ancestors, and of the deceased;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ parvāṇi kīrtyante parvaṇāṃ caiva saṃdhayaḥ /
svargalokagatānāñca prāptānāñcāpyadhogatim //
meaning:
ततः पर्वाणि कीर्त्यन्ते पर्वणां चैव संधयः /
स्वर्गलोकगतानाञ्च प्राप्तानाञ्चाप्यधोगतिम् //
text_mt: Thereupon the new and full moons are recounted, and the junctures of these phases; / and of those who have attained heaven and also those who have reached a low destination;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ dviprakārāṇāṃ śrāddhenānugraho mahān /
yugasaṃkhyāpramāṇaṃ ca kīrtyate ca kṛtaṃ yugam //
meaning:
पितॄणां द्विप्रकाराणां श्राद्धेनानुग्रहो महान् /
युगसंख्याप्रमाणं च कीर्त्यते च कृतं युगम् //
text_mt: The great favor bestowed upon the two kinds of Ancestors through the ancestral offering; / the duration and measure of the yugas, and the Kṛta Yuga is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyuge cāpakarṣādvār ttāyāḥ saṃpravarttanam /
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca saṃsthitirdharmatastathā //
meaning:
त्रेतायुगे चापकर्षाद्वार् त्तायाः संप्रवर्त्तनम् /
वर्णानामाश्रमाणां च संस्थितिर्धर्मतस्तथा //
text_mt: And in the Tretā Yuga, the inauguration of livelihood due to decline; / and the establishment of the classes and life stages in accordance with duty;

sanskrit_iast:
vajrapravarttanaṃ caiva saṃvādo yatra kīrtyate /
ṛṣīṇāṃ vasunā sārddhaṃ vasoścādhaḥ punargatiḥ /
śabdatvaṃ ca pradhānāttu svāyambhuvamṛte manum //
meaning:
वज्रप्रवर्त्तनं चैव संवादो यत्र कीर्त्यते /
ऋषीणां वसुना सार्द्धं वसोश्चाधः पुनर्गतिः /
शब्दत्वं च प्रधानात्तु स्वायम्भुवमृते मनुम् //
text_mt: The wielding of the thunderbolt, and the dialogue wherein is recounted / between the sages and King Vasu, and Vasu's subsequent descent downwards; / and the manifestation of sound from Pradhāna, except during the time of Manu Svāyambhuva.

sanskrit_iast:
praśaṃsā tapasaścoktā yugāvasthāśca kṛtsnaśaḥ /
dvāparasya kaleścāpi saṃkṣepeṇa prakīrttanam //
meaning:
प्रशंसा तपसश्चोक्ता युगावस्थाश्च कृत्स्नशः /
द्वापरस्य कलेश्चापि संक्षेपेण प्रकीर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: And praise of asceticism is told, and the conditions of the yugas in full, / as well as an abridged proclamation of Dvāpara and Kali;

sanskrit_iast:
manvantaraṃ ca saṃkhyā ca mānuṣeṇa prakīrttitā /
manvantarāṇāṃ sarveṣāmetadeva ca lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरं च संख्या च मानुषेण प्रकीर्त्तिता /
मन्वन्तराणां सर्वेषामेतदेव च लक्षणम् //
text_mt: and the manvantara and its computation are proclaimed in human reckoning; / and this very definition applies to all manvantaras;

sanskrit_iast:
atītānāgatānāṃ ca varttamānaṃ ca kīrtyate /
tathā manvantarāṇāṃ ca pratisaṃdhānalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
अतीतानागतानां च वर्त्तमानं च कीर्त्यते /
तथा मन्वन्तराणां च प्रतिसंधानलक्षणम् //
text_mt: and those of the past, future, and the present are proclaimed, / as well as the defining characteristic of the transitions between manvantaras;

sanskrit_iast:
atītānā gatānāṃ ca proktaṃ svāyambhuve tataḥ /
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gatiḥ proktā kālajñānagatistathā //
meaning:
अतीताना गतानां च प्रोक्तं स्वायम्भुवे ततः /
ऋषीणां च गतिः प्रोक्ता कालज्ञानगतिस्तथा //
text_mt: and what relates to the past and future was then stated under the Svāyambhuva [manvantara]; / and the path of the ṛṣis is stated, as well as the path of the knowledge of time;

sanskrit_iast:
durgasaṃkhyāpramāṇaṃ ca yugavārtā pravarttanam /
tretāyāṃ cakravartīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ janma caiva hi //
meaning:
दुर्गसंख्याप्रमाणं च युगवार्ता प्रवर्त्तनम् /
त्रेतायां चक्रवर्तीनां लक्षणं जन्म चैव हि //
text_mt: and the count and measure of fortresses, the commencement of livelihood in the yugas, / and indeed the marks and births of the universal emperors in Tretā;

sanskrit_iast:
pramateśca tathā janma atho kaliyugasya vai /
aṅgulairhāsanaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ yacca cocyate //
meaning:
प्रमतेश्च तथा जन्म अथो कलियुगस्य वै /
अङ्गुलैर्हासनं चैव भूतानां यच्च चोच्यते //
text_mt: and likewise the birth of Pramati, and then indeed of the Kaliyuga, / and what is said concerning the diminution of living beings in digits of measure;

sanskrit_iast:
śāśānāṃ parisaṃkhyānaṃ śiṣyaprādhānyameva ca /
vākyaṃ saptavidhaṃ caiva ṛṣigotrānukīrtanam //
meaning:
शाशानां परिसंख्यानं शिष्यप्राधान्यमेव च /
वाक्यं सप्तविधं चैव ऋषिगोत्रानुकीर्तनम् //
text_mt: the enumeration of branches [of the Vedas] and the preeminence of disciples, / and sevenfold speech, and the recitation of the lineages of ṛṣis;

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ sūtaputrāṇāṃ brahmaṇāsya ca kṛtsnaśaḥ /
dedānāṃ vyasanaṃ caiva vedavyāsairmahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
लक्षणं सूतपुत्राणां ब्रह्मणास्य च कृत्स्नशः /
देदानां व्यसनं चैव वेदव्यासैर्महात्मभिः //
text_mt: the characteristics of the sons of the sūta, and of this Brahmā in full, / and the division of the Vedas by the great-souled Vedavyāsas;

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu devānāṃ prajeśānāṃ ca kīrttanam /
manvantarakramaścaiva kālajñānaṃ ca kīrtyate //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु देवानां प्रजेशानां च कीर्त्तनम् /
मन्वन्तरक्रमश्चैव कालज्ञानं च कीर्त्यते //
text_mt: the proclamation of the gods and lords of creatures in the manvantaras; / and the order of the manvantaras and the knowledge of time are proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣasya cāpi dauhitrāḥ priyāyā duhituḥ śubhāḥ /
brahmādibhistejanitā dakṣeṇaiva ca dhīmatā //
meaning:
दक्षस्य चापि दौहित्राः प्रियाया दुहितुः शुभाः /
ब्रह्मादिभिस्तेजनिता दक्षेणैव च धीमता //
text_mt: and the auspicious grandsons of Dakṣa through his beloved daughter, / begotten by Brahmā and the others, and by the wise Dakṣa himself;

sanskrit_iast:
sāvarṇāścātra kīrtyante manavo merumāśritāḥ /
dhruvasyauttānapādasya prajāsargopavarṇanam //
meaning:
सावर्णाश्चात्र कीर्त्यन्ते मनवो मेरुमाश्रिताः /
ध्रुवस्यौत्तानपादस्य प्रजासर्गोपवर्णनम् //
text_mt: and here are proclaimed the Sāvarṇa Manus who dwell on Mount Meru, / the description of the creation of creatures by Dhruva, son of Uttānapāda;

sanskrit_iast:
cākṣuṣasya manoḥ sargaḥ prajānāṃ vīryavarmanam /
prabhuṇā caiva vainyena bhūmidohapravartatā //
meaning:
चाक्षुषस्य मनोः सर्गः प्रजानां वीर्यवर्मनम् /
प्रभुणा चैव वैन्येन भूमिदोहप्रवर्तता //
text_mt: the creation of Cākṣuṣa Manu, the armor of valor among creatures, / and the commencement of the milking of the earth by the lord Vainya;

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇāṃ payasāṃ caiva vatsānāṃ ca viśeṣaṇam /
brahmādibhiḥ pūrvameva dugdhā caiyaṃ vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
पात्राणां पयसां चैव वत्सानां च विशेषणम् /
ब्रह्मादिभिः पूर्वमेव दुग्धा चैयं वसुंधरा //
text_mt: the distinct description of the vessels, the milks, and the calves; / and how this earth was milked previously by Brahmā and the others;

sanskrit_iast:
daśabhyaścaṃ pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpateḥ /
dakṣasya kīrtyata janma samasyāṃśena dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
दशभ्यश्चं प्रचेतोभ्यो मारिषायां प्रजापतेः /
दक्षस्य कीर्त्यत जन्म समस्यांशेन धीमतः //
text_mt: and the birth of the wise Prajāpati Dakṣa from the ten Pracetases / upon Māriṣā is proclaimed, through a portion of the whole;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhaveśatvaṃ mahendrāṇāṃ ca kīrtyate /
manvādikā bhaviṣyanti ākhyānaibarhubhirvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवेशत्वं महेन्द्राणां च कीर्त्यते /
मन्वादिका भविष्यन्ति आख्यानैबर्हुभिर्वृताः //
text_mt: and the sovereignty of the great Indras over past, present, and future is proclaimed; / and the Manus and their successors will come to pass, accompanied by many narratives;

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatasya ca manoḥ kīrtyate sargavistaraḥ /
brahmādikośa utpattirbhṛgvadīnāṃ ca kīrtyate //
meaning:
वैवस्वतस्य च मनोः कीर्त्यते सर्गविस्तरः /
ब्रह्मादिकोश उत्पत्तिर्भृग्वदीनां च कीर्त्यते //
text_mt: and the detail of the creation of Vaivasvata Manu is proclaimed, / and the origin of Bhṛgu and the others from the receptacle of Brahmā is told;

sanskrit_iast:
viniṣkṛṣya prajāsarge cākṣuṣasya manoḥśubhe /
dakṣasya kīrtyate sargo dhyānādvaivasvatāntare //
meaning:
विनिष्कृष्य प्रजासर्गे चाक्षुषस्य मनोःशुभे /
दक्षस्य कीर्त्यते सर्गो ध्यानाद्वैवस्वतान्तरे //
text_mt: having distinguished it from the auspicious creation of creatures of Cākṣuṣa Manu, / the creation of Dakṣa through meditation in the Vaivasvata interval is proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaḥ kṛtasaṃvādo dakṣaputrānmahābalān /
nāśayāmāsa śāpāya mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
नारदः कृतसंवादो दक्षपुत्रान्महाबलान् /
नाशयामास शापाय मानसो ब्रह्मणः सुतः //
text_mt: conversing [with them], Nārada, the mind-born son of Brahmā, / brought about the destruction of the mighty sons of Dakṣa by his curse;

sanskrit_iast:
tato dakṣo 'sṛjatkanyā vairiṇā nāma viśrutāḥ /
marutpravāhe maruto dityāṃ devyāṃ ca saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दक्षो ऽसृजत्कन्या वैरिणा नाम विश्रुताः /
मरुत्प्रवाहे मरुतो दित्यां देव्यां च संभवः //
text_mt: then Dakṣa begot daughters renowned by name as Vairiṇī[s]; / in the stream of the wind, the origin of the Maruts upon goddess Diti;

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyate marutāṃ cātragaṇāste saptasaptakāḥ /
devatvamindravāsena vāyuskandheṣu cāśramaḥ //
meaning:
कीर्त्यते मरुतां चात्रगणास्ते सप्तसप्तकाः /
देवत्वमिन्द्रवासेन वायुस्कन्धेषु चाश्रमः //
text_mt: and here are proclaimed those seven groups of seven of the Maruts, / their attainment of godhood by dwelling with Indra, and their abode on the wind-shoulders;

sanskrit_iast:
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣagandharvarakṣasām /
sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ yakṣaṇāṃ pakṣivīrudhām //
meaning:
दैत्यानां दानवानां च यक्षगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् /
सर्वभूतपिशाचानां यक्षणां पक्षिवीरुधाम् //
text_mt: of Daityas, Dānavas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Rākṣasas, / of all beings, Piśācas, Yakṣas, birds, and plants;

sanskrit_iast:
utpattayaścāpsarasāṃ kīrtyante bahuvistarāt /
mārtaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ janmairāvatahastinaḥ //
meaning:
उत्पत्तयश्चाप्सरसां कीर्त्यन्ते बहुविस्तरात् /
मार्तण्डमण्डलं कृत्स्नं जन्मैरावतहस्तिनः //
text_mt: and the origins of the Apsarases are proclaimed in great detail, / the whole orb of the sun, and the birth of the elephant Airāvata;

sanskrit_iast:
vainateyasamutpattistathā rājyā bhiṣecanam /
bhṛgūṇāṃ vistaraścoktastathā cāṅgirasāmapi //
meaning:
वैनतेयसमुत्पत्तिस्तथा राज्या भिषेचनम् /
भृगूणां विस्तरश्चोक्तस्तथा चाङ्गिरसामपि //
text_mt: the birth of Garuḍa and his consecration to sovereignty, / and the expanse of the Bhṛgus is told, as well as of the Aṅgirases;

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapasya pulastyasya tathaivātrermahātmanaḥ /
parāśarasya ca muneḥ prajānāṃ yatra vistaraḥ //
meaning:
कश्यपस्य पुलस्त्यस्य तथैवात्रेर्महात्मनः /
पराशरस्य च मुनेः प्रजानां यत्र विस्तरः //
text_mt: of Kaśyapa, of Pulastya, and likewise of the great-souled Atri, / and of the sage Parāśara, wherein is the expanse of creatures;

sanskrit_iast:
tisraḥ kanyāḥ sukīrtyante yāsulokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
icchāyā vistaraścokta ādityasya tataḥ param //
meaning:
तिस्रः कन्याः सुकीर्त्यन्ते यासुलोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः /
इच्छाया विस्तरश्चोक्त आदित्यस्य ततः परम् //
text_mt: the three daughters are well proclaimed in whom the worlds are established; / and next after that the expansion of the desire of Āditya is told;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkuviccaritaṃ proktaṃ dhruvasyaiva nibarhaṇam /
bṛhadbalānāṃ saṃkṣepādikṣvākvādyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
किङ्कुविच्चरितं प्रोक्तं ध्रुवस्यैव निबर्हणम् /
बृहद्बलानां संक्षेपादिक्ष्वाक्वाद्याः प्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: the deed of Kinki is told, and the destruction of Dhruva, / and in brief the rulers of great strength beginning with Ikṣvāku are proclaimed;

sanskrit_iast:
niśyādīnāṃ kṣitīśānāṃ palāṇḍu haraṇādibhiḥ /
kīrtyate vistarātsarge yayāterapi bhūpateḥ //
meaning:
निश्यादीनां क्षितीशानां पलाण्डु हरणादिभिः /
कीर्त्यते विस्तरात्सर्गे ययातेरपि भूपतेः //
text_mt: of the kings beginning with Niśa through the theft of garlic and other deeds; / in creation it is proclaimed at length, as well as of king Yayāti;

sanskrit_iast:
yaduvaṃśasamuddeśo haihayasya ca vistaraḥ /
krodhādanantaraṃ coktastathā vaṃśasya vistaraḥ //
meaning:
यदुवंशसमुद्देशो हैहयस्य च विस्तरः /
क्रोधादनन्तरं चोक्तस्तथा वंशस्य विस्तरः //
text_mt: the specification of the lineage of Yadu, and the expanse of the Haihaya; / and after anger, the expanse of the lineage is told;

sanskrit_iast:
jyāmaghasya ca māhātmyaṃ prajāsargaśca kīrtyate /
devāvṛdhasyāndhakasya dhṛṣṭeścapi mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ज्यामघस्य च माहात्म्यं प्रजासर्गश्च कीर्त्यते /
देवावृधस्यान्धकस्य धृष्टेश्चपि महात्मनः //
text_mt: and the greatness of Jyāmagha and his creation of offspring are proclaimed, / as well as of Devāvṛdha, Andhaka, and the great-souled Dhṛṣṭi;

sanskrit_iast:
animitrānvayaścaiva viśormithyābhiśaṃsanam /
viśodhamanusaṃprāptirmaṇiratnasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
अनिमित्रान्वयश्चैव विशोर्मिथ्याभिशंसनम् /
विशोधमनुसंप्राप्तिर्मणिरत्नस्य धीमतः //
text_mt: and the lineage of Anamitra, and the false accusation of Viśru, / and the attainment of the jewel-gem by the wise Viśodhamana;

sanskrit_iast:
satrājitaḥ prajāsarge rājarṣerdevamīḍhuṣaḥ /
śūrasya janma cāpyuktaṃ caritaṃ ca māhātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सत्राजितः प्रजासर्गे राजर्षेर्देवमीढुषः /
शूरस्य जन्म चाप्युक्तं चरितं च माहात्मनः //
text_mt: in the procreation of Satrājit, of the royal sage Devamīḍhuṣa, / and the birth of Śūra is told, as well as the deeds of that great-souled one;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃsasyāpi ca daurātmyamekīvaṃśyātsamudbhavaḥ /
vāsudevasya deva kyāṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
कंसस्यापि च दौरात्म्यमेकीवंश्यात्समुद्भवः /
वासुदेवस्य देव क्यां विष्णोरमिततेजसः //
text_mt: and also the wickedness of Kaṃsa, and the appearance from the same lineage / of Vāsudeva Viṣṇu of boundless splendor upon Devakī;

sanskrit_iast:
anantaramṛṣeḥ sargaḥ prajāsargopavarṇanam /
devāsure samutpanne viṣṇunā strīvadhe kṛte //
meaning:
अनन्तरमृषेः सर्गः प्रजासर्गोपवर्णनम् /
देवासुरे समुत्पन्ने विष्णुना स्त्रीवधे कृते //
text_mt: thereafter the creation of the sage and the description of the procreation of creatures; / when the war of gods and asuras arose, when the slaying of a woman was committed by Viṣṇu;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrakṣatā śakravadhaṃ śāpaḥ prāptaḥ purā bhṛgoḥ /
bhṛguścotthāpayāmāsa divyāṃ śukrasya mātaram //
meaning:
संरक्षता शक्रवधं शापः प्राप्तः पुरा भृगोः /
भृगुश्चोत्थापयामास दिव्यां शुक्रस्य मातरम् //
text_mt: while protecting from the slaying of Indra, a curse was formerly received from Bhṛgu, / and Bhṛgu revived the divine mother of Śukra;

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṃkramā dvādaśātdṛtāḥ /
nārasihaprabhṛtayaḥ kīrtyante pāpanāśanāḥ //
meaning:
देवानां च ऋषीणां च संक्रमा द्वादशात्दृताः /
नारसिहप्रभृतयः कीर्त्यन्ते पापनाशनाः //
text_mt: and the twelve honored descents of gods and sages, / beginning with the Man-Lion, are proclaimed as destroyers of sin;

sanskrit_iast:
śukeṇārādhanaṃ sthāṇorghoreṇa tapasā tathā /
varapradāna kṛttena yatra śarvastavaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शुकेणाराधनं स्थाणोर्घोरेण तपसा तथा /
वरप्रदान कृत्तेन यत्र शर्वस्तवः कृतः //
text_mt: the propitiation of Sthāṇu by Śukra through terrible asceticism, / wherein a praise of Śarva was made when a boon was granted;

sanskrit_iast:
anantaraṃ ca nirdiṣṭaṃ devāsuraviceṣṭitam /
jayantyā saha śakreṇa yatra śuko mahātmani //
meaning:
अनन्तरं च निर्दिष्टं देवासुरविचेष्टितम् /
जयन्त्या सह शक्रेण यत्र शुको महात्मनि //
text_mt: and next is indicated the conduct of the gods and asuras, / where the wise Śukra, together with Jayantī and Indra, in that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
asurānmohayāmāsa śakrarūpeṇa buddhimān /
bṛhaspatiśca taṃ śukaṃ śaśāpa sa mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
असुरान्मोहयामास शक्ररूपेण बुद्धिमान् /
बृहस्पतिश्च तं शुकं शशाप स महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: deluded the asuras in the form of Indra, / and the highly luminous Bṛhaspati cursed that Śukra;

sanskrit_iast:
ukta ca viṣṇormāhātmyaṃ viṣṇorjanmani śabdyate /
turvasuścātra dauhitro yavīyānyo yadorabhūt //
meaning:
उक्त च विष्णोर्माहात्म्यं विष्णोर्जन्मनि शब्द्यते /
तुर्वसुश्चात्र दौहित्रो यवीयान्यो यदोरभूत् //
text_mt: and the greatness of Viṣṇu was told, and is celebrated in the birth of Viṣṇu; / and Turvasu was a grandson here, who was younger than Yadu;

sanskrit_iast:
anurdruhyādayaḥ sarve tathā tattanayā nṛpāḥ /
anuvaṃśyāmahātmānasteṣāṃ pārthivasattamāḥ //
meaning:
अनुर्द्रुह्यादयः सर्वे तथा तत्तनया नृपाः /
अनुवंश्यामहात्मानस्तेषां पार्थिवसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Anu, Druhyu, and all the rest, likewise the kings who were their sons; / their great-souled descendants, the best of earthly rulers,

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyante yatra kārtsnyena bhūridraviṇatejasaḥ /
ātithyasya tu vibrarṣeḥ saptadhā dharmasaṃśrayāt //
meaning:
कीर्त्यन्ते यत्र कार्त्स्न्येन भूरिद्रविणतेजसः /
आतिथ्यस्य तु विब्रर्षेः सप्तधा धर्मसंश्रयात् //
text_mt: are proclaimed where in full, possessing abundant wealth and splendor; / and of the brahmin sage Atithi sevenfold, based upon righteousness;

sanskrit_iast:
bārhasvatyaṃ sūribhiśca yatra śāpamupāvṛtam /
haravaṃśayaśaḥsparśaḥ śantanorvīryaśabdanam //
meaning:
बार्हस्वत्यं सूरिभिश्च यत्र शापमुपावृतम् /
हरवंशयशःस्पर्शः शन्तनोर्वीर्यशब्दनम् //
text_mt: where the curse was averted by the learned followers of Bṛhaspati; / the touch of the fame of the Hari dynasty, and the declaration of the valor of Śantanu;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyatāṃ tathā rājñāmupasaṃhāraśabdanam /
anāgatānāṃsaṃghānāṃ prabhūṇāṃ copavarṇanam //
meaning:
भविष्यतां तथा राज्ञामुपसंहारशब्दनम् /
अनागतानांसंघानां प्रभूणां चोपवर्णनम् //
text_mt: the declaration of the dissolution of future kings, / and the description of assemblies of future lords;

sanskrit_iast:
bhautyasyānte kaliyuge kṣīṇe saṃhāravarṇanam /
naimittikāḥ prākṛtikā yathaivātyantikāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
भौत्यस्यान्ते कलियुगे क्षीणे संहारवर्णनम् /
नैमित्तिकाः प्राकृतिका यथैवात्यन्तिकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: at the end of the Bhautya [manvantara], when the Kaliyuga has waned, the description of destruction; / just as the occasional, elemental, and absolute [dissolutions] are traditionally remembered;

sanskrit_iast:
vividhaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kīrtyate pratisaṃcaraḥ /
anādṛṣṭirbhāskarasya ghoraḥ saṃvarttakānalaḥ //
meaning:
विविधः सर्वभूतानां कीर्त्यते प्रतिसंचरः /
अनादृष्टिर्भास्करस्य घोरः संवर्त्तकानलः //
text_mt: the diverse dissolution of all living beings is proclaimed, / the absence of rain from the sun, and the terrible Saṃvartaka fire;

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhye lakṣaṇamuddiṣṭaṃ tato brahma viśeṣataḥ /
bhuvādīnāṃ ca lokānāṃ saptānāṃ copavarṇanam //
meaning:
सांख्ये लक्षणमुद्दिष्टं ततो ब्रह्म विशेषतः /
भुवादीनां च लोकानां सप्तानां चोपवर्णनम् //
text_mt: the characteristic indicated in Sāṅkhya, and then Brahman especially; / and the description of the seven worlds beginning with Bhuvar;

sanskrit_iast:
aparārddhāparaiścaiva lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtyate /
brahmaṇoyojanāgreṇa parimāṇavinirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
अपरार्द्धापरैश्चैव लक्षणं परिकीर्त्यते /
ब्रह्मणोयोजनाग्रेण परिमाणविनिर्णयः //
text_mt:
The characteristics [of the world] are described further by other [measures] of the second half,
and the determination of the dimensions of the universe is given by measures of yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyante cātra nirayāḥ pāpānāṃ rauravādayaḥ /
sarveṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ pariṇāmavinirṇayaḥ //
meaning:
कीर्त्यन्ते चात्र निरयाः पापानां रौरवादयः /
सर्वेषां चैव सत्त्वानां परिणामविनिर्णयः //
text_mt:
And here the hells of the sinners, Raurava and others, are described,
and the determination of the transformations of all living beings;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaḥ pratisaṃsargātsarva saṃsāravarṇanam /
gatirūrddhamadhaścoktā dharmādharmasamāśrayā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणः प्रतिसंसर्गात्सर्व संसारवर्णनम् /
गतिरूर्द्धमधश्चोक्ता धर्माधर्मसमाश्रया //
text_mt:
The description of the entire cycle of existence arising from contact with Brahman,
and the higher and lower course based on virtue and non-virtue is spoken of;

sanskrit_iast:
kalpe kalpe ca bhūtānāṃ mahatāmapi saṃkṣayam /
asaṃkhyayā ca duḥkhāni brahmaṇaścāpyanityatā //
meaning:
कल्पे कल्पे च भूतानां महतामपि संक्षयम् /
असंख्यया च दुःखानि ब्रह्मणश्चाप्यनित्यता //
text_mt:
And the destruction of creatures, even the great ones, in kalpa after kalpa,
and the countless sorrows, and also the impermanence of Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast:
daurātmyaṃ caiva bhogānāṃ saṃhārasya ca kaṣṭatā /
durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vairāgyāddoṣadarśanāt //
meaning:
दौरात्म्यं चैव भोगानां संहारस्य च कष्टता /
दुर्लभत्वं च मोक्षस्य वैराग्याद्दोषदर्शनात् //
text_mt:
The worthlessness of worldly enjoyments, the misery of dissolution,
and the difficulty of obtaining liberation through dispassion born from seeing faults;

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāvyaktaṃ parityajya sattvaṃ brahmaṇi saṃsthitam /
nānātvadarśanācchuddhastavastatra nivarttate //
meaning:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तं परित्यज्य सत्त्वं ब्रह्मणि संस्थितम् /
नानात्वदर्शनाच्छुद्धस्तवस्तत्र निवर्त्तते //
text_mt:
Abandoning the manifest and the unmanifest, the pure reality situated in Brahman,
purified through the insight of diversity, turns back there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastāpatrayād bhīto rūpārthohi nirañjanaḥ /
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya na bibheti kutaścana //
meaning:
ततस्तापत्रयाद् भीतो रूपार्थोहि निरञ्जनः /
आनन्दं ब्रह्मणः प्राप्य न बिभेति कुतश्चन //
text_mt:
Then, terrified of the threefold suffering, spotless, attaining the purpose of forms,
upon attaining the bliss of Brahman, he fears nothing from any quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtyate ca punaḥ sargo brahmaṇo 'nyasya pūrvavat /
kīrtyate jagataścatra sargapralayavikriyāḥ //
meaning:
कीर्त्यते च पुनः सर्गो ब्रह्मणो ऽन्यस्य पूर्ववत् /
कीर्त्यते जगतश्चत्र सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः //
text_mt:
And again the creation of another Brahmā is described as before,
and the transformations of creation and dissolution of the universe are described here;

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttayaśca bhūtānāṃ prasutānāṃ phalāni ca /
kīrtyate ṛṣivargasya sargaḥ pāpapraṇāśanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तयश्च भूतानां प्रसुतानां फलानि च /
कीर्त्यते ऋषिवर्गस्य सर्गः पापप्रणाशनः //
text_mt:
The activities of living beings and the fruits of those born,
and the sin-destroying lineage of the host of ṛṣis is recounted;

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhāvo vasiṣṭhasya śakterjanma tathaiva ca /
saudāsāsthigrahaścāsya viśvāmitrakṛtena tu //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भावो वसिष्ठस्य शक्तेर्जन्म तथैव च /
सौदासास्थिग्रहश्चास्य विश्वामित्रकृतेन तु //
text_mt:
The manifestation of Vasiṣṭha and likewise the birth of Śakti,
and the seizure of his bones by Saudāsa caused by Viśvāmitra;

sanskrit_iast:
parāśarasya cotpattiradṛśyantyāṃ tathā vibhoḥ /
saṃjajñe pitṛkanyāyāṃ vyāsaścāpi mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
पराशरस्य चोत्पत्तिरदृश्यन्त्यां तथा विभोः /
संजज्ञे पितृकन्यायां व्यासश्चापि महामुनिः //
text_mt:
And the origin of the lord Parāśara in Adṛśyantī;
and the great sage Vyāsa was born of the daughter of the Pitṛs;

sanskrit_iast:
śukasya ca tathā janma saha putrasya dhīmaptaḥ /
parāśarasya pradvepo viśvāmitra ṛṣiṃ prati //
meaning:
शुकस्य च तथा जन्म सह पुत्रस्य धीमप्तः /
पराशरस्य प्रद्वेपो विश्वामित्र ऋषिं प्रति //
text_mt:
And likewise the birth of the wise son Śuka,
and Parāśara's enmity toward the sage Viśvāmitra;

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhasaṃbhṛtiścāgnerviśvāmitrajighāṃsayā /
devena vidhinā vipra viśvāmitrahitaiṣiṇā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठसंभृतिश्चाग्नेर्विश्वामित्रजिघांसया /
देवेन विधिना विप्र विश्वामित्रहितैषिणा //
text_mt:
And Vasiṣṭha's gathering of the fire desiring to kill Viśvāmitra,
[prevented] by divine arrangement, O brahmin, wishing what was beneficial for Viśvāmitra;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtānahetorvibhunā gīrṇaskandhena dhīmatā /
ekaṃ vedaṃ catuṣpādaṃ caturddhā punarīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
संतानहेतोर्विभुना गीर्णस्कन्धेन धीमता /
एकं वेदं चतुष्पादं चतुर्द्धा पुनरीश्वरः //
text_mt:
For the sake of continuity, the lord, wise and swallowing the chapters,
the powerful lord divided the one Veda of four quarters into four parts again;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bibheda bhāgavān vyāsaḥ śārvādanugrahāt /
tasya śiṣyapraśiṣyaiśca śākhā vedāyutāḥ kṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तथा बिभेद भागवान् व्यासः शार्वादनुग्रहात् /
तस्य शिष्यप्रशिष्यैश्च शाखा वेदायुताः कृताः //
text_mt:
Thus the blessed Vyāsa divided it by the grace of Śarva,
and ten thousand Vedic branches were made by his disciples and grand-disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
prayoge prahvalā naiva yathā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā /
pṛṣṭa vanto viśiṣṭāste munayo dharmakāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रयोगे प्रह्वला नैव यथा दृष्टः स्वयंभुवा /
पृष्ट वन्तो विशिष्टास्ते मुनयो धर्मकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt:
Not faltering in application as seen by Svayambhū,
those distinguished sages, desiring righteousness, inquired:

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ puṇyamabhīpsato vibhunā taddhitaiṣiṇā /
sunābhaṃ divyarūpābhaṃ saptāṅgaṃ śubhaśaṃsanam //
meaning:
देशं पुण्यमभीप्सतो विभुना तद्धितैषिणा /
सुनाभं दिव्यरूपाभं सप्ताङ्गं शुभशंसनम् //
text_mt:
Desiring a holy land, by the lord who wished their benefit
[was shown this wheel] possessing an auspicious hub, divine in appearance, of seven limbs, proclaiming good fortune:

sanskrit_iast:
ānaupamyamidaṃ cakraṃ varttamānamatandritāḥ /
pṛṣṭhato yāta niyatāstataḥ prāpsyatha pāṭitam //
meaning:
आनौपम्यमिदं चक्रं वर्त्तमानमतन्द्रिताः /
पृष्ठतो यात नियतास्ततः प्राप्स्यथ पाटितम् //
text_mt:
"Follow with restraint and without indolence behind this peerless wheel
as it rolls; then you will reach [the land] determined [for you].

sanskrit_iast:
gacchatastasya cakrasya yatra nemirviśīryate /
puṇyaḥ sa deśo mantavyaḥ pratyuvāca tadā prabhuḥ //
meaning:
गच्छतस्तस्य चक्रस्य यत्र नेमिर्विशीर्यते /
पुण्यः स देशो मन्तव्यः प्रत्युवाच तदा प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Where the rim of that wheel breaks as it rolls,
that land is to be considered sacred," the lord replied then.

sanskrit_iast:
uktvā caivamṛṣīnsarvānadṛśyatvamupāgamat /
gaṅgā garbha yavāhārā naimiṣeyāstathaiva ca //
meaning:
उक्त्वा चैवमृषीन्सर्वानदृश्यत्वमुपागमत् /
गङ्गा गर्भ यवाहारा नैमिषेयास्तथैव च //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus to all the sages, he vanished;
and the inhabitants of Naimiṣa, subsisting on barley in the bed of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast: īśire caiva satreṇa munayo naimiṣe tadā //
meaning: ईशिरे चैव सत्रेण मुनयो नैमिषे तदा //
text_mt: And then the sages officiated at the sacrificial session at Naimiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛteśaradvatitathā tasya cotthāpanaṅkṛtam /
ṛṣayo naimiṣeyāśca dayayā parayā yutāḥ //
meaning:
मृतेशरद्वतितथा तस्य चोत्थापनङ्कृतम् /
ऋषयो नैमिषेयाश्च दयया परया युताः //
text_mt:
And when Śaradvant had died, his restoration was performed
by the sages, the inhabitants of Naimiṣa, endowed with supreme compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsīmāṃ gāmimāṃ kṛtvā kṛṣaṇaṃ rājānamāharat /
prītiṃ caiva kṛtātithyaṃ rājānaṃ vidhivattadā //
meaning:
निःसीमां गामिमां कृत्वा कृषणं राजानमाहरत् /
प्रीतिं चैव कृतातिथ्यं राजानं विधिवत्तदा //
text_mt:
Having made this earth borderless, Kṛṣaṇa brought the king,
and offered hospitality with affection to the king duly at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ sargagataḥ krūraḥ svarbhānurasuro haran /
drute rājani rājānu madrate munayastataḥ //
meaning:
अन्तः सर्गगतः क्रूरः स्वर्भानुरसुरो हरन् /
द्रुते राजनि राजानु मद्रते मुनयस्ततः //
text_mt:
The cruel asura Svarbhānu, having entered within creation, carried him off;
when the king had fled, following the king, the sages then,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvarakṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kalāpagrāmaketanam /
sannipātaḥ punastasya tathā yajñe maharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वरक्षितं दृष्ट्वा कलापग्रामकेतनम् /
सन्निपातः पुनस्तस्य तथा यज्ञे महर्षिभिः //
text_mt:
Seeing the abode at Kalāpagrāma protected by Gandharvas,
had an assembly again with him at the sacrifice with the great sages.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā hiraṇmayaṃ sarvaṃ vivādastasya tairabhūt /
tadā vai naimiṣeyānāṃ satre dvādaśavārṣike //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा हिरण्मयं सर्वं विवादस्तस्य तैरभूत् /
तदा वै नैमिषेयानां सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके //
text_mt:
Seeing everything golden, an argument arose between him and them
then at the twelve-year sacrificial session of the inhabitants of Naimiṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vivadamānaiśca yaduḥ saṃsthāpitaśca taiḥ /
janayitvā tvaraṇyaṃ vai yaduputramathāyutam //
meaning:
तथा विवदमानैश्च यदुः संस्थापितश्च तैः /
जनयित्वा त्वरण्यं वै यदुपुत्रमथायुतम् //
text_mt:
And while they were thus debating, Yadu was installed by them;
having quickly begotten a myriad of sons of Yadu in the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpayitvā tatsatraṃ vāyuṃ te paryupāsata /
iti kṛtyasamuddeśaḥ purāṇāṃśopavarṇitaḥ //
meaning:
समापयित्वा तत्सत्रं वायुं ते पर्युपासत /
इति कृत्यसमुद्देशः पुराणांशोपवर्णितः //
text_mt:
Having completed that sacrificial session, they worshipped Vāyu.
Thus the summary of duties and the contents of the Purāṇa have been described.

sanskrit_iast:
anenānukrameṇaiva purāṇaṃ saṃprakāśate /
sukhamarthaḥ samāsena mahānapyupalakṣyate //
meaning:
अनेनानुक्रमेणैव पुराणं संप्रकाशते /
सुखमर्थः समासेन महानप्युपलक्ष्यते //
text_mt:
In this very order the Purāṇa is illuminated;
even a great subject is easily grasped when treated in summary.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsamāsamuddiśya vakṣyāmi tava vistaram /
pādamādyamidaṃ samyag yo 'dhīte vijitedriyaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्समासमुद्दिश्य वक्ष्यामि तव विस्तरम् /
पादमाद्यमिदं सम्यग् यो ऽधीते विजितेद्रियः //
text_mt:
Therefore, having given the summary, I shall tell you the details.
He who, with senses conquered, properly studies this first quarter,

sanskrit_iast:
tenādhītaṃ purāṇaṃ syātsarvaṃ nāstyatrasaṃśayaḥ /
yo vidyāccaturo vedān sāṃgopaniṣadān dvijāḥ //
meaning:
तेनाधीतं पुराणं स्यात्सर्वं नास्त्यत्रसंशयः /
यो विद्याच्चतुरो वेदान् सांगोपनिषदान् द्विजाः //
text_mt:
The entire Purāṇa would be studied by him, there is no doubt here.
He who knows the four Vedas along with their aṅgas and Upaniṣads, O twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet /
bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ prahariṣyati //
meaning:
इतिहासपुराणाभ्यां वेदं समुपबृंहयेत् /
बिभेत्यल्पश्रुताद्वेदो मामयं प्रहरिष्यति //
text_mt:
Should amplify the Veda with the Itihāsas and Purāṇas.
The Veda fears a person of little learning, thinking: 'He will strike me.'

sanskrit_iast:
abhyasannimamadhyāyaṃ sākṣātproktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā /
nāpadaṃ prāpya muhyeta yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyādgatim //
meaning:
अभ्यसन्निममध्यायं साक्षात्प्रोक्तं स्वयंभुवा /
नापदं प्राप्य मुह्येत यथेष्टां प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम् //
text_mt:
Practicing this chapter spoken directly by Svayambhū,
one will not be bewildered upon meeting misfortune and will attain whatever state one desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātpurā hyabhūccaitatpurāṇaṃ tena tatsmṛtam /
niruktamasya yo veda sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
यस्मात्पुरा ह्यभूच्चैतत्पुराणं तेन तत्स्मृतम् /
निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Because it existed anciently (purā), therefore it is recalled as Purāṇa;
he who knows its etymology is liberated from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ataśca saṃkṣepamimaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sarvamidaṃ purāṇam /
saṃsargakāle 'pi karoti marga saṃhāra kāle ca na vāsti bhūyaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde kṛtyasamuddeśo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अतश्च संक्षेपमिमं शृणुध्वं नारायणः सर्वमिदं पुराणम् /
संसर्गकाले ऽपि करोति मर्ग संहार काले च न वास्ति भूयः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे कृत्यसमुद्देशो नाम प्रथमो ऽध्यायः

sanskrit_iast:
pratyavocanpunaḥ sūtamṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ /
kutra satraṃ samabhattevaṣāmadbhutakarmaṇām //
meaning:
प्रत्यवोचन्पुनः सूतमृषयस्ते तपोधनाः /
कुत्र सत्रं समभत्तेवषामद्भुतकर्मणाम् //
text_mt:
Those sages whose wealth is austerity spoke again to the bard:
"Where did the sacrificial session of those of wondrous deeds take place?

sanskrit_iast:
kiyantaṃ caiva tatkālaṃ kathaṃ ca samavarttata /
ācacakṣe purāṇaṃ ca kathaṃ tatsaprabhañjanaḥ //
meaning:
कियन्तं चैव तत्कालं कथं च समवर्त्तत /
आचचक्षे पुराणं च कथं तत्सप्रभञ्जनः //
text_mt:
And for how long a time, and how did it proceed?
And how did Prabhañjana relate that Purāṇa?

sanskrit_iast:
ācakhyau vistareṇaiva para kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ /
iti saṃcoditaḥ sūtaḥ pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
आचख्यौ विस्तरेणैव पर कौतूहलं हि नः /
इति संचोदितः सूतः प्रत्युवाच शुभं वचः //
text_mt:
Relate it at full length, for our curiosity is great."
Thus urged, the bard spoke these auspicious words:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇudhvaṃ yatra te dhīrā menire mantramuttamam /
yāvantaṃ cābhavatkālaṃ yathā ca samavartata //
meaning:
शृणुध्वं यत्र ते धीरा मेनिरे मन्त्रमुत्तमम् /
यावन्तं चाभवत्कालं यथा च समवर्तत //
text_mt:
"Listen to where those wise ones considered the supreme formula,
and for how long a time it lasted, and how it took place.

sanskrit_iast:
sisṛkṣamāṇo viśvaṃ hi yajate visṛjatpurā /
satraṃ hi te 'tipuṇyaṃ ca sahasraparivatsarān //
meaning:
सिसृक्षमाणो विश्वं हि यजते विसृजत्पुरा /
सत्रं हि ते ऽतिपुण्यं च सहस्रपरिवत्सरान् //
text_mt:
Desiring to create the universe, he sacrificed while emitting it formerly,
in that most holy sacrificial session lasting a thousand years,

sanskrit_iast:
tapogṛhapateryatra brahmā caivābhavatsvayam /
iḍāyā yatra patnītvaṃ śāmitraṃ yatra buddhimān //
meaning:
तपोगृहपतेर्यत्र ब्रह्मा चैवाभवत्स्वयम् /
इडाया यत्र पत्नीत्वं शामित्रं यत्र बुद्धिमान् //
text_mt:
Where Brahmā himself was the householder through his austerities,
where Iḍā had the role of the wife, where the wise one [served as immolator],

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyuścake mahātejāstasminsatre mahātmanām /
vibudhāścoṣire tatra sahasraparivatsarān //
meaning:
मृत्युश्चके महातेजास्तस्मिन्सत्रे महात्मनाम् /
विबुधाश्चोषिरे तत्र सहस्रपरिवत्सरान् //
text_mt:
And Death of great splendor performed the immolation at that sacrifice of the great-souled ones;
and the gods dwelt there for a thousand years.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramato dharmacakrasya yatra nemiraśīryata /
karmaṇā tena vikhyātaṃ naimiṣaṃ munipūjitam //
meaning:
भ्रमतो धर्मचक्रस्य यत्र नेमिरशीर्यत /
कर्मणा तेन विख्यातं नैमिषं मुनिपूजितम् //
text_mt:
Where the rim of the wheel of dharma shattered as it revolved,
by that act it is renowned as Naimiṣa, honored by sages;

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sā gomatī puṇyā siddhacāraṇasevitā /
rohiṇī sa sutā tatra gomatī sābhavat kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
यत्र सा गोमती पुण्या सिद्धचारणसेविता /
रोहिणी स सुता तत्र गोमती साभवत् क्षणात् //
text_mt:
Where that holy Gomatī flows, visited by Siddhas and Cāraṇas;
there Rohiṇī with her calf became that Gomatī in an instant;

sanskrit_iast:
śaktirjyeṣṭhā samabhavadvasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ /
rundhatyāḥ sutāyātrādānamuttamatejasaḥ //
meaning:
शक्तिर्ज्येष्ठा समभवद्वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः /
रुन्धत्याः सुतायात्रादानमुत्तमतेजसः //
text_mt:
Where Śakti was born as the eldest son of the great-souled Vasiṣṭha
from Arundhatī, endowed with supreme splendor;

sanskrit_iast:
kalmāṣapādo nṛpatiryatra śakraśca śaktinā /
yatra vairaṃ samabhavadviśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ //
meaning:
कल्माषपादो नृपतिर्यत्र शक्रश्च शक्तिना /
यत्र वैरं समभवद्विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठयोः //
text_mt:
Where King Kalmāṣapāda was cursed by Śakti,
and where enmity arose between Viśvāmitra and Vasiṣṭha;

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyantyāṃ samabhavanmuniryatra parāśaraḥ /
parābhavo vasiṣṭhasya yasya jñāne hyavarttayat //
meaning:
अदृश्यन्त्यां समभवन्मुनिर्यत्र पराशरः /
पराभवो वसिष्ठस्य यस्य ज्ञाने ह्यवर्त्तयत् //
text_mt:
Where the sage Parāśara was born in Adṛśyantī,
in whose knowledge the defeat of Vasiṣṭha was averted."

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te menire śailaṃ naimiṣe brahmavādinaḥ /
naimiṣaṃ jajñire yasmānnaimiṣīyāstataḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र ते मेनिरे शैलं नैमिषे ब्रह्मवादिनः /
नैमिषं जज्ञिरे यस्मान्नैमिषीयास्ततः स्मृताः //
text_mt: there those teachers of Brahman considered the mountain at Naimiṣa; / because they were born at Naimiṣa, they are traditionally known as the inhabitants of Naimiṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
tatsatramabhavatteṣāṃ samā dvādaśa dhīmatām /
purūravasi vikrānte praśāsati vasuṃdharām //
meaning:
तत्सत्रमभवत्तेषां समा द्वादश धीमताम् /
पुरूरवसि विक्रान्ते प्रशासति वसुंधराम् //
text_mt: that sacrificial session of those wise ones lasted twelve years, / while the valiant Purūravas was ruling the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭādaśa samudrasya dvīpānaśran purūravāḥ /
tutoṣa naiva ratnānāṃ lobhāditi hi naḥ śrutam //
meaning:
अष्टादश समुद्रस्य द्वीपानश्रन् पुरूरवाः /
तुतोष नैव रत्नानां लोभादिति हि नः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: Purūravas enjoyed eighteen islands of the ocean; / he was not at all satisfied, out of greed for gems—so indeed have we heard.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī cakame taṃ ca devadūtapracoditā /
ājahāra ca tatsatramurvaśyā saha saṃgataḥ //
meaning:
उर्वशी चकमे तं च देवदूतप्रचोदिता /
आजहार च तत्सत्रमुर्वश्या सह संगतः //
text_mt: And Urvaśī, urged on by the gods' messenger, desired him; / and joined with Urvaśī, he undertook that sacrificial session.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnarapatau satre naimiṣīyāḥ pracakrire /
yaṃ garbhaṃ suṣuve gaṅgā pāvakāddīptatejasam //
meaning:
तस्मिन्नरपतौ सत्रे नैमिषीयाः प्रचक्रिरे /
यं गर्भं सुषुवे गङ्गा पावकाद्दीप्ततेजसम् //
text_mt: While that king [ruled], the inhabitants of Naimiṣa performed the sacrificial session, / [at the place where] the embryo of radiant splendor was born to Gaṅgā from the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
tattulyaṃ parvate nyastaṃ hiraṇyaṃ samapadyata /
hiraṇmayaṃ tataścake yajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
तत्तुल्यं पर्वते न्यस्तं हिरण्यं समपद्यत /
हिरण्मयं ततश्चके यज्ञवाटं महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Gold equal to that was placed on the mountain; / then he made a golden sacrificial enclosure for the great-souled ones.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmā svayandevo bhāvano lokabhāvanaḥ /
sa praviśya tataḥ satre teṣāmamitatejasām //
meaning:
विश्वकर्मा स्वयन्देवो भावनो लोकभावनः /
स प्रविश्य ततः सत्रे तेषाममिततेजसाम् //
text_mt: The god Viśvakarman himself, the creator and author of the worlds, / having entered their sacrificial session of boundless splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
aiḍaḥ purūravā bheje taṃ deśaṃ mṛgayāṃ caran /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahādāśvaryaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ hiraṇmayam //
meaning:
ऐडः पुरूरवा भेजे तं देशं मृगयां चरन् /
तं दृष्ट्वा महादाश्वर्यं यज्ञवाटं हिरण्मयम् //
text_mt: Purūravas, son of Iḷā, reached that place while wandering on a hunt. / Seeing that golden sacrificial enclosure, a great wonder,

sanskrit_iast:
lobhena hatavijñānastadādātumupākramat /
naimiṣeyāstatastasya cukrudhurnṛpatiṃ bhṛśam //
meaning:
लोभेन हतविज्ञानस्तदादातुमुपाक्रमत् /
नैमिषेयास्ततस्तस्य चुक्रुधुर्नृपतिं भृशम् //
text_mt: with his discernment destroyed by greed, he set about taking it. / Thereupon the inhabitants of Naimiṣa became greatly enraged at the king,

sanskrit_iast:
nijaghnuścāpi taṃ kruddhāḥ kuśavajrairmanīṣiṇaḥ /
taponiṣṭhāśca rājānaṃ munayo devacoditāḥ //
meaning:
निजघ्नुश्चापि तं क्रुद्धाः कुशवज्रैर्मनीषिणः /
तपोनिष्ठाश्च राजानं मुनयो देवचोदिताः //
text_mt: and enraged, those wise sages, established in asceticism / and prompted by the gods, struck down the king with kuśa-grass thunderbolts.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśavajraurviniṣpiṣṭaḥ sa rājā vyajahāttanum /
aurvaśeyaistatastasya yuddhaṃ cakre nṛpo bhuvi //
meaning:
कुशवज्रौर्विनिष्पिष्टः स राजा व्यजहात्तनुम् /
और्वशेयैस्ततस्तस्य युद्धं चक्रे नृपो भुवि //
text_mt: Crushed by the kuśa-grass thunderbolts, the king gave up his body. / Then a king, with the descendants of Urvaśī, fought a war on earth;

sanskrit_iast:
nahuṣasya mahātmānaṃ pitaraṃ yaṃ pracakṣate /
sa teṣvavabhṛtheṣveva dharmmaśīlo mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
नहुषस्य महात्मानं पितरं यं प्रचक्षते /
स तेष्ववभृथेष्वेव धर्म्मशीलो महीपतिः //
text_mt: the great-souled one whom they call the father of Nahuṣa, / that righteous ruler of the earth, during those very purificatory baths [performed the rite].

sanskrit_iast:
āyurāyabhavāyāgryamasmin satre narottamaḥ /
śāntayitvā tu rājānaṃ tadā brahmavidastathā //
meaning:
आयुरायभवायाग्र्यमस्मिन् सत्रे नरोत्तमः /
शान्तयित्वा तु राजानं तदा ब्रह्मविदस्तथा //
text_mt: Āyu, the best of men, [became king] for prime prosperity in this sacrificial session. / But having pacified the king, the knowers of Brahman then,

sanskrit_iast:
satramārebhire karttuṃ pṛthvīvatsā tmamūrtayaḥ /
babhūva satre teṣāṃ tu brahmacaryaṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
सत्रमारेभिरे कर्त्तुं पृथ्वीवत्सा त्ममूर्तयः /
बभूव सत्रे तेषां तु ब्रह्मचर्यं महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: whose forms were like calves of the earth, undertook to perform the sacrificial session. / In that sacrificial session of those great-souled ones, there was a vow of studenthood,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ sisṛkṣamāṇānāṃ purā visvasṛjāmiva /
vaikhānasaiḥ priyasakhairvāla khilyairmarīcibhiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वं सिसृक्षमाणानां पुरा विस्वसृजामिव /
वैखानसैः प्रियसखैर्वाल खिल्यैर्मरीचिभिः //
text_mt: like that of the creators of the universe long ago when wishing to create the universe. / With the Vaikhānasa ascetics, dear friends, the Vālakhilyas, the Marīcipas,

sanskrit_iast:
ajaiśca munibhirjātaṃ sūryavaiśvānaraprabhaḥ /
vitṛdevāpsaraḥsiddhairgandharvoragacāraṇaiḥ //
meaning:
अजैश्च मुनिभिर्जातं सूर्यवैश्वानरप्रभः /
वितृदेवाप्सरःसिद्धैर्गन्धर्वोरगचारणैः //
text_mt: and the unborn sages born with the luster of the sun and fire, / with Pitṛs, gods, apsarases, siddhas, gandharvas, serpents, and cāraṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhārataiḥ śuśubhe rājā devairindrasamo yathā /
stotraśastrairgṛhairdevānpitṝnpitryaiśca karmabhiḥ //
meaning:
भारतैः शुशुभे राजा देवैरिन्द्रसमो यथा /
स्तोत्रशस्त्रैर्गृहैर्देवान्पितॄन्पित्र्यैश्च कर्मभिः //
text_mt: and with the Bhāratas, the king shone like Indra with the gods. / With hymns of praise, recitation, and oblations, [they worshipped] the gods, and the Pitṛs with ancestral rites;

sanskrit_iast:
ānarcuḥsma yathājāti gandharvādīn yathāvidhi /
ārādhane sa sasmāra tataḥ karmāntareṣu ca //
meaning:
आनर्चुःस्म यथाजाति गन्धर्वादीन् यथाविधि /
आराधने स सस्मार ततः कर्मान्तरेषु च //
text_mt: they duly worshipped the gandharvas and others according to their class. / In their worship, he then remembered during the intervals between rites:

sanskrit_iast:
jaguḥ sāmāni gandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ /
vyājahrurmunayo vācaṃ citrākṣarapadāṃ śubhām //
meaning:
जगुः सामानि गन्धर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः /
व्याजह्रुर्मुनयो वाचं चित्राक्षरपदां शुभाम् //
text_mt: The gandharvas sang Sāman chants, and the hosts of apsarases danced; / the sages uttered auspicious speech with wonderful syllables and words.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrādi tatra vidvāṃso jajapuśca parasparam /
vitaṇḍāvacanaiścaiva nijaghnuḥ prativādinaḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रादि तत्र विद्वांसो जजपुश्च परस्परम् /
वितण्डावचनैश्चैव निजघ्नुः प्रतिवादिनः //
text_mt: The learned ones recited mantras and the like there among themselves, / and with contentious arguments they refuted their opponents.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaścaiva vidvāṃsaḥ śabdārthanyāyakovidāḥ /
na tatra hāritaṃ kiñcidviviśurbrahmarākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषयश्चैव विद्वांसः शब्दार्थन्यायकोविदाः /
न तत्र हारितं किञ्चिद्विविशुर्ब्रह्मराक्षसाः //
text_mt: The sages were wise and skilled in word, meaning, and logic. / No loss was suffered there, nor did Brahmarākṣasas enter;

sanskrit_iast:
naiva yajñaharā daityā naiva vājamukhāstriṇaḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ daridraṃ ca na tatra samajāyata //
meaning:
नैव यज्ञहरा दैत्या नैव वाजमुखास्त्रिणः /
प्रायश्चित्तं दरिद्रं च न तत्र समजायत //
text_mt: nor did Daityas who steal sacrifices, nor horse-faced three-[footed creatures]; / neither an expiation nor poverty arose there.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiprajñākriyāyegairvidhirāśīṣvanuṣṭitaḥ /
evaṃ ca vavṛdhe satraṃ dvādaśābdaṃ manīṣiṇām //
meaning:
शक्तिप्रज्ञाक्रियायेगैर्विधिराशीष्वनुष्टितः /
एवं च ववृधे सत्रं द्वादशाब्दं मनीषिणाम् //
text_mt: The rite was performed amidst blessings through combinations of power, wisdom, and action; / and thus the twelve-year sacrificial session of the wise sages flourished.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ naimiṣīyāṇāṃ tadabhūdiva vajriṇaḥ /
vṛddhādyā ṛtvijo vīrā jyotiṣṭomān pṛthakpṛthak //
meaning:
ऋषीणां नैमिषीयाणां तदभूदिव वज्रिणः /
वृद्धाद्या ऋत्विजो वीरा ज्योतिष्टोमान् पृथक्पृथक् //
text_mt: For the sages who were inhabitants of Naimiṣa, it was like that of the wielder of the vajra. / The noble priests, led by the elders, separately [performed] the Jyotiṣṭoma rites,

sanskrit_iast:
cakrire pṛṣṭhagamanāḥ sarvānayutadakṣiṇān /
samāptayajño yatrāste vāsudevaṃ mahādhipam //
meaning:
चक्रिरे पृष्ठगमनाः सर्वानयुतदक्षिणान् /
समाप्तयज्ञो यत्रास्ते वासुदेवं महाधिपम् //
text_mt: following behind, all with fees of ten thousand cows. / Where the sacrificial session was concluded, there sat Vāsudeva, the great sovereign;

sanskrit_iast:
papracchuramitātmānaṃ bhavadbhiryadahaṃ dvijaḥ /
pracoditaḥ svavaṃśārthaṃ sa ca tānabravītprabhuḥ //
meaning:
पप्रच्छुरमितात्मानं भवद्भिर्यदहं द्विजः /
प्रचोदितः स्ववंशार्थं स च तानब्रवीत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: they questioned that boundless-souled one, about which I, a twice-born, / have been prompted by you regarding the matter of his lineage; and the lord said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaḥsvayaṃbhuvo devaḥ sarvaṃ pratyakṣadṛgvaśī /
aṇimādibhiraṣṭābhiḥ sūkṣmairaṅgaiḥ samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
शिष्यःस्वयंभुवो देवः सर्वं प्रत्यक्षदृग्वशी /
अणिमादिभिरष्टाभिः सूक्ष्मैरङ्गैः समन्वितः //
text_mt: "The disciple of Svayambhū is the lord who perceives everything directly, self-controlled, / endowed with the eight subtle limbs beginning with the power of becoming atomic,

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagvātādibhirvarṣaiḥ sarvāṃ llokānbibharti yaḥ /
saptaskandhā bhṛtāḥ śākhāḥ sarvatoyājarājarān //
meaning:
तिर्यग्वातादिभिर्वर्षैः सर्वां ल्लोकान्बिभर्ति यः /
सप्तस्कन्धा भृताः शाखाः सर्वतोयाजराजरान् //
text_mt: who supports all the worlds with the crosswinds and other rains, / whose branches, the seven atmospheric realms, are supported, unaging amidst all waters,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayair maruto yasya saṃsthitāḥ saptasaptakāḥ /
vyūhatrayāṇāṃ sūtānāṃ kurvan satraṃ mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
विषयैर् मरुतो यस्य संस्थिताः सप्तसप्तकाः /
व्यूहत्रयाणां सूतानां कुर्वन् सत्रं महाबलः //
text_mt: in whose realms the forty-nine Maruts reside. / Performing the sacrificial session of the three arrays of bards, of great power,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasaśvāpyupāyānāṃ dadhātīha śarīriṇaḥ /
prāṇādyā vṛttayaḥ pañca dhāraṇānāṃ svavṛttibhiḥ //
meaning:
तेजसश्वाप्युपायानां दधातीह शरीरिणः /
प्राणाद्या वृत्तयः पञ्च धारणानां स्ववृत्तिभिः //
text_mt: he sustains here the embodied beings with energy and means; / the five vital functions, beginning with prāṇa, by their own operations sustain the dhāraṇās,

sanskrit_iast:
pūryamāmaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ dhāraṇaṃ yasya kurvate /
ākāśayonirdviguṇaḥ śābdasparśasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्यमामः शरीराणां धारणं यस्य कुर्वते /
आकाशयोनिर्द्विगुणः शाब्दस्पर्शसमन्वितः //
text_mt: by which the filling and sustenance of bodies are accomplished. / Originating in space, possessing two qualities, accompanied by sound and touch,

sanskrit_iast:
vācoraṇiḥ samākhyātā śabdaśāstravicakṣaṇaiḥ /
bhāratyārḥ ślakṣṇayā sarvānmunīnprahlādayanniva //
meaning:
वाचोरणिः समाख्याता शब्दशास्त्रविचक्षणैः /
भारत्यार्ः श्लक्ष्णया सर्वान्मुनीन्प्रह्लादयन्निव //
text_mt: declared by those skilled in the science of sound to be the fire-churning stick of speech— / as if delighting all the sages with smooth speech,

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇajñāḥ sumanasaḥ purāṇāśrayayuktayā /
purāma niyatā viprāḥ kathāmakathayadvibhuḥ //
meaning:
पुराणज्ञाः सुमनसः पुराणाश्रययुक्तया /
पुराम नियता विप्राः कथामकथयद्विभुः //
text_mt: well-disposed, knowers of the Purāṇa, endowed with reliance on the Purāṇa, / the lord recounted the ancient narrative to the restrained twice-born."

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ yathāvṛttamākhyānaṃ dvijasattamāḥ /
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca paraṃ caitallokatattvamanuttamam //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्यानं द्विजसत्तमाः /
ऋषीणां च परं चैतल्लोकतत्त्वमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: "This is the entire narrative as it happened, O best of the twice-born, / and this is the supreme, unsurpassed reality of the world for the sages,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā yatpurā proktaṃ purāṇaṃ jñānamuttamam /
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca sarvapāpapramocanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा यत्पुरा प्रोक्तं पुराणं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् /
देवतानामृषीणां च सर्वपापप्रमोचनम् //
text_mt: the highest knowledge, the Purāṇa, which was spoken long ago by Brahmā / to the deities and sages, which frees from all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca tasya vakṣyāmyanukramam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde naimiṣākhyānakathanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च तस्य वक्ष्याम्यनुक्रमम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे नैमिषाख्यानकथनं नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
I shall relate its sequence in detail and in proper order."

Thus ends the second chapter, called 'Recounting the Narrative of Naimiṣa,' in the first [part], the Prakriyāpāda, in the first section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śṛṇu teṣāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvapāpapramocanīm /
kathyamānāṃ mayā citrāṃ bahvarthāṃ śrutisaṃmatām //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
