शृणु तेषां कथां दिव्यां सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम् /
कथ्यमानां मया चित्रां बह्वर्थां श्रुतिसंमताम् //
text_mt: The bard said: / "Listen to their divine narrative, which frees from all sin, / as it is recounted by me, wonderful, full of meaning, and conforming to Vedic revelation.

sanskrit_iast:
ya imāṃ dhārayennityaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ /
svavaṃśaṃ dhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
य इमां धारयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाद्वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः /
स्ववंशं धारणं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt: Whoever retains this constantly, or hears it repeatedly, / having sustained his own lineage, is exalted in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvatārā yā ca pañca yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam /
kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhārthaṃ pūrveṣāṃ kīrttivarddhanam //
meaning:
विश्वतारा या च पञ्च यथावृत्तं यथाश्रुतम् /
कीर्त्यमानं निबोधार्थं पूर्वेषां कीर्त्तिवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: Understand, for the sake of comprehension, what happened and what was heard, / which increases the fame of the ancestors and illuminates the universe in five [parts],

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ śatrughnameva ca /
kīrttanaṃ sthirakīrtīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām //
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं शत्रुघ्नमेव च /
कीर्त्तनं स्थिरकीर्तीनां सर्वेषां पुण्यकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: bringing fortune, renown, longevity, heaven, and the destruction of enemies— / the celebration of all those of enduring fame and virtuous deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātkalpāyate kalpaḥ samagraṃ śucaye śuciḥ /
tasmai hiraṇyagarbhāya puruṣāyeśvarāya ca //
meaning:
यस्मात्कल्पायते कल्पः समग्रं शुचये शुचिः /
तस्मै हिरण्यगर्भाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च //
text_mt: From whom an eon becomes an eon, the pure one for the pure in full, / to that Hiraṇyagarbha, the Puruṣa, and the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
ajāya prathamāyaiva variṣṭhāya prajāsṛje /
brahmaṇe lokatantrāya namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve //
meaning:
अजाय प्रथमायैव वरिष्ठाय प्रजासृजे /
ब्रह्मणे लोकतन्त्राय नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवे //
text_mt: to the unborn, the very first, the most excellent creator of creatures, / to Brahmā, the support of the world, having bowed to Svayambhū,

sanskrit_iast:
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ savairūpyaṃ salakṣaṇam /
pañcapramāṇaṃ ṣadśrāntaḥ puruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
महदाद्यं विशेषान्तं सवैरूप्यं सलक्षणम् /
पञ्चप्रमाणं षद्श्रान्तः पुरुषाधिष्ठितं च यत् //
text_mt: from the cosmic intellect down to the gross elements, diversified and endowed with characteristics, / possessing five measures, terminating in six, and presided over by the Puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
āsaṃyamātpravakṣyāmi bhūtasargamanuttamam /
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yattannityaṃ sadasadātmakam //
meaning:
आसंयमात्प्रवक्ष्यामि भूतसर्गमनुत्तमम् /
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तन्नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् //
text_mt: I shall explain the peerless creation of beings up to cosmic dissolution. / That unmanifest cause, which is eternal, having the nature of being and non-being,

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva yamāhustattvacintakāḥ /
gandharūparasairhīnaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam //
meaning:
प्रधानं प्रकृतिं चैव यमाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः /
गन्धरूपरसैर्हीनं शब्दस्पर्शविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: which thinkers on reality call Pradhāna and Prakṛti, / devoid of smell, form, and taste, free from sound and touch,

sanskrit_iast:
jagadyonimmahābhūtaṃ paraṃ brahmasanātanam /
vigrahaṃ sarvabhūtānāmavyaktamabhavatkila //
meaning:
जगद्योनिम्महाभूतं परं ब्रह्मसनातनम् /
विग्रहं सर्वभूतानामव्यक्तमभवत्किल //
text_mt: the womb of the universe, the great being, the supreme, eternal Brahman, / became indeed the bodily form of all beings, unmanifest,

sanskrit_iast:
anādyantamajaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇaṃ prabhavāpyayam /
asāṃpratikamajñeyaṃ brahma yatsadasatparam //
meaning:
अनाद्यन्तमजं सूक्ष्मं त्रिगुणं प्रभवाप्ययम् /
असांप्रतिकमज्ञेयं ब्रह्म यत्सदसत्परम् //
text_mt: without beginning or end, unborn, subtle, consisting of the three guṇas, the source of origination and dissolution, / not present to perception, unknowable, the Brahman that is beyond being and non-being.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyātmanā sarvamidaṃ vyāptamāsīttamomayam /
guṇasāmye tadā tasminnavibhātaṃ tamomayam //
meaning:
तस्यात्मना सर्वमिदं व्याप्तमासीत्तमोमयम् /
गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन्नविभातं तमोमयम् //
text_mt: All this was pervaded by its self, composed of darkness; / in that state of equilibrium of the guṇas, it was unilluminated, composed of darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
sargakāle pradhānasya kṣatrajñādhiṣṭhitasya vai /
guṇabhāvādbhāsamāne mahātattva babhūva ha //
meaning:
सर्गकाले प्रधानस्य क्षत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितस्य वै /
गुणभावाद्भासमाने महातत्त्व बभूव ह //
text_mt: At the time of creation, as Pradhāna was presided over by the Knower of the Field, / when it shone forth through the transformation of the guṇas, the principle of the cosmic intellect arose."

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmaḥ sa tu mahānagre avyaktena samāvṛtaḥ /
sattvodreko mahānagre sattvamātraprakāśakaḥ //
meaning:
सूक्ष्मः स तु महानग्रे अव्यक्तेन समावृतः /
सत्त्वोद्रेको महानग्रे सत्त्वमात्रप्रकाशकः //
text_mt: Subtle indeed is that cosmic intellect in the beginning, covered by the unmanifest; / an upsurge of sattva, the cosmic intellect in the beginning illuminates sattva alone.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvānmahānsa vijñeya ekastatkāraṇaḥ samṛtaḥ /
niṅgamātraṃ samutpannaṃ kṣetrajñādhiṣṭitaṃ mahat //
meaning:
सत्त्वान्महान्स विज्ञेय एकस्तत्कारणः समृतः /
निङ्गमात्रं समुत्पन्नं क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्टितं महत् //
text_mt: From sattva, the cosmic intellect is to be known, spoken of as one, having that as its cause; / arisen as the mere sign, the cosmic intellect is presided over by the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpo 'dhyavasāyaśca tasya vṛttidvayaṃ smṛtam /
mahāsṛṣṭiṃ ca kurute vītamānaḥ sisṛkṣayā //
meaning:
संकल्पो ऽध्यवसायश्च तस्य वृत्तिद्वयं स्मृतम् /
महासृष्टिं च कुरुते वीतमानः सिसृक्षया //
text_mt: Intention and resolve are considered its two functions; / and freed from pride, through the desire to create, it brings forth the great creation.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādīni ca bhūtāni lokatattvārthahetavaḥ /
mano mahātmani brahma durbuddhikhyātirīśvarāt //
meaning:
धर्मादीनि च भूतानि लोकतत्त्वार्थहेतवः /
मनो महात्मनि ब्रह्म दुर्बुद्धिख्यातिरीश्वरात् //
text_mt: And righteousness and the other [qualities] are the elements, the causes of the true principles of the world; / mind in the great Self is Brahman, the cognition opposed to ignorance, arisen from the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
prajñāsaṃdhiśca sarvasvaṃ saṃkhyāyatanaraśmibhiḥ /
manute sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmācceṣṭaphalo vibhuḥ //
meaning:
प्रज्ञासंधिश्च सर्वस्वं संख्यायतनरश्मिभिः /
मनुते सर्वभूतानां तस्माच्चेष्टफलो विभुः //
text_mt: The conjunction of wisdom is all, through the rays of the seats of enumeration; / it conceives of all beings, and from that, the all-pervading lord yields the fruit of action.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktā trātā vibhaktātmā varttanaṃ mana ucyate /
tattvānāṃ saṃgrahe yasmānmahāṃśca parimāṇataḥ //
meaning:
भोक्ता त्राता विभक्तात्मा वर्त्तनं मन उच्यते /
तत्त्वानां संग्रहे यस्मान्महांश्च परिमाणतः //
text_mt: The experiencer, the protector, the differentiated Self—its operation is called the mind; / because it comprehends the principles, and because of its greatness in extent,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣebhyo guṇātattvebhyo mahāniva tanuḥ smṛtaḥ /
vibhaktimānaṃ manute vibhāgaṃ manyate 'pi vā //
meaning:
शेषेभ्यो गुणातत्त्वेभ्यो महानिव तनुः स्मृतः /
विभक्तिमानं मनुते विभागं मन्यते ऽपि वा //
text_mt: and compared to the remaining principles of qualities, the cosmic intellect is considered [great] like a body; / possessing differentiation, it conceives, or it considers distinction.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣo bhogasaṃbandhāttena cāsau sati smṛtaḥ /
bṛhattvādvṛṃhaṇatvācca bhāvānāmakhilāśrayāt //
meaning:
पुरुषो भोगसंबन्धात्तेन चासौ सति स्मृतः /
बृहत्त्वाद्वृंहणत्वाच्च भावानामखिलाश्रयात् //
text_mt: Through its connection to experience, it is considered the person; and through that, it is known as existing; / because of its vastness and because of causing growth, being the resting place of all states,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādvṛṃhayata bhāvān brahmā tena nirucyate /
āpūrayati yasmācca sarvān dehānanugrahaiḥ //
meaning:
यस्माद्वृंहयत भावान् ब्रह्मा तेन निरुच्यते /
आपूरयति यस्माच्च सर्वान् देहाननुग्रहैः //
text_mt: because it causes states to grow, for that reason it is explained as Brahmā; / and because it fills all bodies with its graces,

sanskrit_iast:
budhyate puruṣaścātra sarvān bhāvānpṛthak pṛthak /
tasmiṃstu kāryakaraṇaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ purā //
meaning:
बुध्यते पुरुषश्चात्र सर्वान् भावान्पृथक् पृथक् /
तस्मिंस्तु कार्यकरणं संसिद्धं ब्रह्मणः पुरा //
text_mt: and here the person perceives all states individually; / and within it, the body and organs were perfected formerly for Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtaṃ devi vartaṃ māṃ kṣetrajño brahmasaṃmitaḥ /
sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ purā puruṣa ucyate //
meaning:
प्राकृतं देवि वर्तं मां क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंमितः /
स वै शरीरी प्रथमः पुरा पुरुष उच्यते //
text_mt: Originating from nature, O goddess, moving towards me, the knower of the field is equal to Brahman; / he is indeed the first embodied being, spoken of formerly as the person.

sanskrit_iast: ādikarttā sa bhūtānāṃ brahmāgre samavarttinām //
meaning: आदिकर्त्ता स भूतानां ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्त्तिनाम् //
text_mt: He is the first creator of beings, Brahmā who was present in the beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagabhaḥ so 'ṇḍe 'sminprādurbhūtaścaturmukhaḥ /
sarge ca pratisarge ca kṣetrajño brahma saṃsitaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगभः सो ऽण्डे ऽस्मिन्प्रादुर्भूतश्चतुर्मुखः /
सर्गे च प्रतिसर्गे च क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्म संसितः //
text_mt: He appeared in this egg as the four-faced Hiraṇyagarbha; / in primary creation and in secondary creation, the knower of the field is declared to be Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇaiḥ saha pṛcchante pratyāhārestyajanti ca /
bhajante ca punardehāṃste samāhārasaṃdhisu //
meaning:
करणैः सह पृच्छन्ते प्रत्याहारेस्त्यजन्ति च /
भजन्ते च पुनर्देहांस्ते समाहारसंधिसु //
text_mt: Along with the sense organs, they are dissolved and abandon [them] through withdrawal; / and again they resort to bodies in the junctures of aggregation.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇmayastu yo merustasyoddharturmahātmanaḥ /
gartodakaṃ sabudāstu hareyuścāpi pañcatāḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्मयस्तु यो मेरुस्तस्योद्धर्तुर्महात्मनः /
गर्तोदकं सबुदास्तु हरेयुश्चापि पञ्चताः //
text_mt: As for the golden Meru of that great-souled lifter, / the water of the cavity with its bubbles would dissolve [it] into the five elements.

sanskrit_iast:
yasminnaṇḍa ime lokāḥ sapta vai saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ /
pṛthivī saptabhirdvīpaiḥ samudraiḥ saha saptabhiḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिन्नण्ड इमे लोकाः सप्त वै संप्रतिष्ठिताः /
पृथिवी सप्तभिर्द्वीपैः समुद्रैः सह सप्तभिः //
text_mt: In which egg these seven worlds are firmly established: / the earth together with seven continents and seven oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
parvataiḥ sumahadbhiśca nadībhiśca sahasraśaḥ /
antaḥsthasya tvime lokā antarviśvamidaṃ jagat //
meaning:
पर्वतैः सुमहद्भिश्च नदीभिश्च सहस्रशः /
अन्तःस्थस्य त्विमे लोका अन्तर्विश्वमिदं जगत् //
text_mt: along with immense mountains and rivers by the thousands; / indeed, these worlds are situated within him, this entire universe within;

sanskrit_iast:
candrādityau sanakṣatau saṃgrahaḥ saha vāyunā /
lokālokaṃ ca yat kiñcidaṇḍe tasminpratiṣṭitam //
meaning:
चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षतौ संग्रहः सह वायुना /
लोकालोकं च यत् किञ्चिदण्डे तस्मिन्प्रतिष्टितम् //
text_mt: the moon and the sun with the constellations, the planetary assembly together with the wind, / and Lokāloka, whatever there is, is established within that egg.

sanskrit_iast:
āpo daśaguṇe naiva tejasā bāhyato vṛtāḥ /
tejo daśaguṇenaiva bāhyato vāyunā vṛtam //
meaning:
आपो दशगुणे नैव तेजसा बाह्यतो वृताः /
तेजो दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतो वायुना वृतम् //
text_mt: The waters are enclosed externally by fire tenfold in size; / the fire is enclosed externally by wind tenfold in size;

sanskrit_iast:
vāyurdaśaguṇenaiva bāhyato nabhasā vṛtaḥ /
ākāśamāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bahirbhūtādinā tathā //
meaning:
वायुर्दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतो नभसा वृतः /
आकाशमावृतं सर्वं बहिर्भूतादिना तथा //
text_mt: the wind is enclosed externally by space tenfold in size; / all of space is likewise enclosed on the outside by the origin of the elements;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādirmahatā caiva pradhānenāvṛto mahān /
ebhirāvaraṇairaṇḍaṃ saptabhiḥ prākṛtairvṛtam //
meaning:
भूतादिर्महता चैव प्रधानेनावृतो महान् /
एभिरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिः प्राकृतैर्वृतम् //
text_mt: the origin of the elements is enclosed by the cosmic intellect, and the cosmic intellect by pradhāna; / the egg is enclosed by these seven natural envelopes.

sanskrit_iast:
icchayā vṛtya cānyonyamaraṇe prakṛtayaḥ sthitaḥ /
prasargakāle sthitvā ca grasaṃtasca parasparam //
meaning:
इच्छया वृत्य चान्योन्यमरणे प्रकृतयः स्थितः /
प्रसर्गकाले स्थित्वा च ग्रसंतस्च परस्परम् //
text_mt: Having surrounded one another by will, the material principles abide in the unmanifest; / and having endured during creation, they swallow one another [at dissolution].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ parasparaiścaiva dhārayanti parasparam /
ādhārādheyabhāvena vikārāste vikāriṣu //
meaning:
एवं परस्परैश्चैव धारयन्ति परस्परम् /
आधाराधेयभावेन विकारास्ते विकारिषु //
text_mt: Thus they sustain one another mutually; / through the relation of container and contained, those modifications exist within the modified.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kṣetramityuktaṃ brahma kṣetrajñamucyate /
ityevaṃ prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitastu saḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमित्युक्तं ब्रह्म क्षेत्रज्ञमुच्यते /
इत्येवं प्राकृतः सर्गः क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितस्तु सः //
text_mt: The unmanifest is called the field; Brahman is called the knower of the field; / thus is the natural creation, presided over by the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
abuddhipūrvaḥ prathamaḥ prādurbhūtastaḍidyathā /
etaddhiraṇyagarbhasya canma yo vetti tattvataḥ /
āyuṣmānkīrtimāndhanyaḥ prajñāvāṃśca na saṃśayaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde hiraṇyagarbhotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāya
meaning:
अबुद्धिपूर्वः प्रथमः प्रादुर्भूतस्तडिद्यथा /
एतद्धिरण्यगर्भस्य चन्म यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः /
आयुष्मान्कीर्तिमान्धन्यः प्रज्ञावांश्च न संशयः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे हिरण्यगर्भोत्पत्तिवर्णनं नाम तृतीयो ऽध्याय
text_mt:
The first [creation], devoid of intellect, appeared like lightning; / he who knows this birth of Hiraṇyagarbha in truth / becomes long-lived, renowned, fortunate, and wise, without doubt.

Thus ends the third chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Hiraṇyagarbha', in the first [section], the Prakriyāpāda, in the first part of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmāṇḍa, proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
suta uvāca
ātmanyavasthite vyakte vikāre pratisaṃhate /
sādharmyeṇāvatiṣṭhete pradhānapuruṣau tadā //
meaning:
सुत उवाच
आत्मन्यवस्थिते व्यक्ते विकारे प्रतिसंहते /
साधर्म्येणावतिष्ठेते प्रधानपुरुषौ तदा //
text_mt: The bard said: / When the manifest modification has dissolved, resting within the Self, / pradhāna and the person then abide by virtue of their common nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tamaḥsattva guṇāvetau samatvena vyavasthitau /
anudriktāvanucarau tena proktau parasparam //
meaning:
तमःसत्त्व गुणावेतौ समत्वेन व्यवस्थितौ /
अनुद्रिक्तावनुचरौ तेन प्रोक्तौ परस्परम् //
text_mt: These two qualities, tamas and sattva, abide in equality; / unexcited and coexistent, they are therefore said to be mutual.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇasāmye layo jñeya ādhikye sṛṣṭirucyate /
sattvavṛddhau sthitirabhūd dhruvaṃ padma śikhāsthitam //
meaning:
गुणसाम्ये लयो ज्ञेय आधिक्ये सृष्टिरुच्यते /
सत्त्ववृद्धौ स्थितिरभूद् ध्रुवं पद्म शिखास्थितम् //
text_mt: Dissolution is to be known when the qualities are in equilibrium; creation is said to occur in their excess; / maintenance occurred in the increase of sattva, firmly fixed upon the lotus apex.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tamasi sattve ca rajopyanugataṃ sthitam /
rajaḥ pravartakaṃ tacca bījeṣviva yathā jalam //
meaning:
यदा तमसि सत्त्वे च रजोप्यनुगतं स्थितम् /
रजः प्रवर्तकं तच्च बीजेष्विव यथा जलम् //
text_mt: When rajas also abides closely attendant upon tamas and sattva, / that rajas is the activator, just like water among seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇā vaiṣamyamāsādya prasaṃgena pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
guṇebhyaḥ kṣobhyamāṇebhyastrayo jñeyā hi sādare //
meaning:
गुणा वैषम्यमासाद्य प्रसंगेन प्रतिष्ठिताः /
गुणेभ्यः क्षोभ्यमाणेभ्यस्त्रयो ज्ञेया हि सादरे //
text_mt: The qualities, having attained imbalance, are established by connection; / indeed, from the agitated qualities, three are to be known with respect:

sanskrit_iast:
śāśvatāḥ paramā guhyāḥ sarvātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ /
sattvaṃ viṣṇū rajo brahmā tamo rudraḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
शाश्वताः परमा गुह्याः सर्वात्मानः शरीरिणः /
सत्त्वं विष्णू रजो ब्रह्मा तमो रुद्रः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: eternal, supreme, secret, the Self of all, embodied; / sattva is Viṣṇu, rajas is Brahmā, tamas is Rudra Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
rajaḥprakāśakoviṣṇurbrahmasraṣṭṛtvamāpnuyāt /
jāyate ca yataścatrā lokasṛṣṭirmahojasaḥ //
meaning:
रजःप्रकाशकोविष्णुर्ब्रह्मस्रष्टृत्वमाप्नुयात् /
जायते च यतश्चत्रा लोकसृष्टिर्महोजसः //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, illuminator of rajas, would attain the role of Brahmā, the creator; / and because creation of the world by the mighty one is born from it,

sanskrit_iast:
tamaḥprakāśako viṣṇuḥ kālatvena vyavasthitaḥ /
sattvaprakāśako viṣṇuḥ sthititvena vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
तमःप्रकाशको विष्णुः कालत्वेन व्यवस्थितः /
सत्त्वप्रकाशको विष्णुः स्थितित्वेन व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, illuminator of tamas, is established as Time; / Viṣṇu, illuminator of sattva, is established as maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
eta eva trayo lokā eta eva trayo guṇāḥ /
eta eva trayo vedā eta eva trajo 'gnayaḥ //
meaning:
एत एव त्रयो लोका एत एव त्रयो गुणाः /
एत एव त्रयो वेदा एत एव त्रजो ऽग्नयः //
text_mt: These very ones are the three worlds; these very ones are the three qualities; / these very ones are the three Vedas; these very ones are the three fires.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparānvayā hyete parasparamanuvratāḥ /
paraspareṇa vartante prerayanti parasparam //
meaning:
परस्परान्वया ह्येते परस्परमनुव्रताः /
परस्परेण वर्तन्ते प्रेरयन्ति परस्परम् //
text_mt: For they are mutually connected, mutually compliant; / they function with one another, they impel one another.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyaṃ mithunaṃ hyete anyonyamupajīvinaḥ /
kṣaṇaṃ viyogo na hyeṣāṃ na tyajanti parasparam //
meaning:
अन्योन्यं मिथुनं ह्येते अन्योन्यमुपजीविनः /
क्षणं वियोगो न ह्येषां न त्यजन्ति परस्परम् //
text_mt: For they are a mutual pair, mutually interdependent; / there is indeed no separation of them for a moment; they do not abandon one another.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānaguṇavaiṣamyātsargakāle pravarttate /
adṛṣṭādhiṣṭhitātpūrve tasmātsadasadātmakāt //
meaning:
प्रधानगुणवैषम्यात्सर्गकाले प्रवर्त्तते /
अदृष्टाधिष्ठितात्पूर्वे तस्मात्सदसदात्मकात् //
text_mt: Through the imbalance of the qualities of pradhāna, it begins at the time of creation, / from that which previously presided over the unseen, consisting of being and non-being.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā buddhitvamithunaṃ yugapatsaṃbabhūva ha /
tasmāttamovyaktamayaṃ kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñakaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा बुद्धित्वमिथुनं युगपत्संबभूव ह /
तस्मात्तमोव्यक्तमयं क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञकः //
text_mt: Brahmā and the intellect, a pair, arose simultaneously; / from that consisting of tamas and the unmanifest, the knower of the field is designated as Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇo brahmagre samavarttata /
tejasāpratimo dhīmānavyaktaḥ saṃprakāśakaḥ //
meaning:
संसिद्धकार्यकरणो ब्रह्मग्रे समवर्त्तत /
तेजसाप्रतिमो धीमानव्यक्तः संप्रकाशकः //
text_mt: With body and organs fully accomplished, Brahmā came forth in the beginning; / peerless in splendor, wise, unmanifest, illuminating.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vai śarīraprathamo dhāraṇatvavyavasthitaḥ /
jñānenāpratimeneha vairāgyeṇa ca saptatiḥ //
meaning:
स वै शरीरप्रथमो धारणत्वव्यवस्थितः /
ज्ञानेनाप्रतिमेनेह वैराग्येण च सप्ततिः //
text_mt: He is indeed the first embodied one, established in firmness; / with peerless knowledge here, and with detachment [...];

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktatvāya tenāsya manasā yadyadicchati /
vaśīkṛtatvāttraiguṇyātsāpekṣatvācca bhāvataḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तत्वाय तेनास्य मनसा यद्यदिच्छति /
वशीकृतत्वात्त्रैगुण्यात्सापेक्षत्वाच्च भावतः //
text_mt: because of unmanifestness, by his mind he brings about whatever he wishes, / on account of subduing the three qualities, and through expectancy of being.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhastu brahmatve kālatve cāntakṛdbhavaḥ /
sahasramūrdhā puruṣastisro 'vasthāḥsvayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्मुखस्तु ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चान्तकृद्भवः /
सहस्रमूर्धा पुरुषस्तिस्रो ऽवस्थाःस्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: The four-faced one in the state of Brahmā, Bhava the end-maker in the state of Time, / the thousand-headed person: these are the three states of Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ rajaśca brahmatve kālatve carajastamaḥ /
sāttvikaḥ puruṣatve ca guṇavṛtaṃ svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वं रजश्च ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चरजस्तमः /
सात्त्विकः पुरुषत्वे च गुणवृतं स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: All rajas in the state of Brahmā, and both rajas and tamas in the state of Time, / and full of sattva in the state of the person—such is the deployment of qualities of Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmatve sṛjate lokān kālatve saṃkṣayatyapi /
puruṣatve udāsīnastisro 'vasthāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मत्वे सृजते लोकान् कालत्वे संक्षयत्यपि /
पुरुषत्वे उदासीनस्तिस्रो ऽवस्थाः स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: In the state of Brahmā he creates the worlds; in the state of Time he destroys [them]; / in the state of the person he is indifferent: these are the three states of Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā kamala patrākṣaḥ kālo jātyañjanaprabhaḥ /
puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo rūpeṇa paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा कमल पत्राक्षः कालो जात्यञ्जनप्रभः /
पुरुषः पुण्डरीकाक्षो रूपेण परमात्मनः //
text_mt: Brahmā has eyes like lotus petals; Time has the luster of pure collyrium; / the person has eyes like white lotuses, according to the form of the supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ /
yogīśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikarotica //
meaning:
एकधा स द्विधा चैव त्रिधा च बहुधा पुनः /
योगीश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोतिच //
text_mt: In one way, in two ways, in three ways, and again in many ways, / the lord of yogins makes and unnakes bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
nānākṛtikriyārūpamāśrayantisvalīlayā /
tridhā yadvartate loke tasmātrriguṇa ucyate //
meaning:
नानाकृतिक्रियारूपमाश्रयन्तिस्वलीलया /
त्रिधा यद्वर्तते लोके तस्मात्र्रिगुण उच्यते //
text_mt: By their own sport they take on varied forms of action and appearance; / because he exists threefold in the world, he is therefore spoken of as three-qualitied.

sanskrit_iast:
caturddhā pravibhaktatvāccaturvyūhaḥ prakīrttitaḥ /
yadā śete tadārdhāte yadbhuṅkte viṣayānprabhuḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्द्धा प्रविभक्तत्वाच्चतुर्व्यूहः प्रकीर्त्तितः /
यदा शेते तदार्धाते यद्भुङ्क्ते विषयान्प्रभुः //
text_mt: Because he is divided into four, he is proclaimed as the Fourfold Manifestation. / Because the Lord lies down, because he is half-manifested, because he experiences sense-objects,

sanskrit_iast:
yatsvasthāḥ satataṃ bhāvastasmādātmā nirūcyate /
ṛṣiḥ sarvagataścātra śarīre so 'bhyayātprabhuḥ //
meaning:
यत्स्वस्थाः सततं भावस्तस्मादात्मा निरूच्यते /
ऋषिः सर्वगतश्चात्र शरीरे सो ऽभ्ययात्प्रभुः //
text_mt: and because existences continually abide in him, he is described as the Self. / He is the seer, all-pervading in this body; because he approached it, he is the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmī sarvasya yatsarvaṃviṣṇuḥ sarvapraveśanāt /
bhagavānagrasadbhāvānnāgo nāgasvasaṃśrayāt //
meaning:
स्वामी सर्वस्य यत्सर्वंविष्णुः सर्वप्रवेशनात् /
भगवानग्रसद्भावान्नागो नागस्वसंश्रयात् //
text_mt: Because he is master of all, he is All; he is Viṣṇu because he enters all; / he is Bhagavān because he existed in the beginning; he is Nāga because he rests upon the serpent;

sanskrit_iast:
paramaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatvāddevatādomiti smṛtiḥ /
sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānātsarvaḥsarvaṃyatastataḥ //
meaning:
परमः संप्रहृष्टत्वाद्देवतादोमिति स्मृतिः /
सर्वज्ञः सर्वविज्ञानात्सर्वःसर्वंयतस्ततः //
text_mt: he is supreme because he is greatly rejoiced; he is recorded as the deity Om; / he is all-knowing through omniscience, and all because all comes from him.

sanskrit_iast:
narāṇāṃ svāpanaṃ brahmā tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ sakalaḥ saṃpravarttate //
meaning:
नराणां स्वापनं ब्रह्मा तस्मान्नारायणः स्मृतः /
त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं सकलः संप्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Brahmā is the place of repose for humans, therefore he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa. / Dividing himself threefold, he proceeds in all his completeness.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjate grasate caiva pālyate ca tribhiḥ svayam /
so 'gre hiraṇyagarbhaḥ san prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
सृजते ग्रसते चैव पाल्यते च त्रिभिः स्वयम् /
सो ऽग्रे हिरण्यगर्भः सन् प्रादुर्भूतः स्वयं प्रभुः //
text_mt: He himself creates, swallows, and protects with the three [forms]. / At first, having become Hiraṇyagarbha, the Lord manifested himself.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyo hi svavaśaścaiva ajātatvādajaḥ smṛtaḥ /
tasmāddhiraṇyagarbhaśca purāṇeṣu nirucyate //
meaning:
आद्यो हि स्ववशश्चैव अजातत्वादजः स्मृतः /
तस्माद्धिरण्यगर्भश्च पुराणेषु निरुच्यते //
text_mt: He is the first and self-mastered; because he was not born, he is remembered as the Unborn; / and for that reason he is spoken of in the Purāṇas as Hiraṇyagarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhuvo nivṛttasya kālo varṇāgratastu yaḥ /
na śakyaḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ manuvarṣaśatairapi //
meaning:
स्वयंभुवो निवृत्तस्य कालो वर्णाग्रतस्तु यः /
न शक्यः परिसंख्यातुं मनुवर्षशतैरपि //
text_mt: The time that elapsed before the beginning of the castes for the self-existent Svayambhū / cannot be calculated even in hundreds of years of Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpasaṃkhyānivṛttastu parārdho brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
tāvattve so 'sya kālo 'nyastasyānte pratibuddhyate //
meaning:
कल्पसंख्यानिवृत्तस्तु परार्धो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः /
तावत्त्वे सो ऽस्य कालो ऽन्यस्तस्यान्ते प्रतिबुद्ध्यते //
text_mt: The end of the calculation of kalpas is remembered as a parārdha of Brahmā. / For that duration is his other time; at its end he awakens.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭivarṣasahasrāṇi gṛhabhūtāni yāni ca /
samatītāni kalpānāṃ tāvaccheṣātparetu ye //
meaning:
कोटिवर्षसहस्राणि गृहभूतानि यानि च /
समतीतानि कल्पानां तावच्छेषात्परेतु ये //
text_mt: Thousands of crores of years have become dwelling places [for kalpas]; / those [kalpas] that have passed are equal in number to those that remain beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
yatsvayaṃ varttate kalpo vārāhastannibodhata /
prathamaṃ sāṃpratasteṣāṃ kalpo vai varttate ca yaḥ //
meaning:
यत्स्वयं वर्त्तते कल्पो वाराहस्तन्निबोधत /
प्रथमं सांप्रतस्तेषां कल्पो वै वर्त्तते च यः //
text_mt: Understand that kalpa which is now present to be the Vārāha [kalpa]; / it is the first among those kalpas that are present now.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe yugasahasre tu paripālyaṃ nareśvaraiḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpade lokakalpanaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु परिपाल्यं नरेश्वरैः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापदे लोककल्पनं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
At the completion of a thousand yugas, it must be protected by the lords of men.

Thus ends the fourth chapter, named "Arrangement of the Worlds," in the first Prakriyāpāda of the first part in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūta uvāca
āpo 'gre sarvagā āsannenasimanpṛthivītale /
śāntavātaiḥ pralīne 'sminna prājñāyata kiñcana //
meaning:
श्रीसूत उवाच
आपो ऽग्रे सर्वगा आसन्नेनसिमन्पृथिवीतले /
शान्तवातैः प्रलीने ऽस्मिन्न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन //
text_mt: The auspicious Sūta said: / In the beginning, waters pervaded everywhere upon the surface of this earth. / When everything was dissolved, the winds calmed, nothing at all could be perceived.

sanskrit_iast:
ekārṇave tadā tasminnaṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame /
vibhurbhavati sa brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt //
meaning:
एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे /
विभुर्भवति स ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् //
text_mt: When there was one vast ocean then, and the moving and unmoving had perished, / Brahmā became the all-pervading Puruṣa, thousand-eyed and thousand-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ /
brahma nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णो ह्यतीन्द्रियः /
ब्रह्म नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा //
text_mt: thousand-headed, golden-hued, and beyond the senses. / The Brahman named Nārāyaṇa then slept on the water.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvodrekānniṣiddhastu śūnyaṃ lokamavaikṣata /
imaṃ codāharantyatrar ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati //
meaning:
सत्त्वोद्रेकान्निषिद्धस्तु शून्यं लोकमवैक्षत /
इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्रर् श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति //
text_mt: Awakened by the surge of sattva, he looked upon the empty world. / In this connection, they cite this verse regarding Nārāyaṇa:

sanskrit_iast:
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ /
ayana tasya tāḥproktāstena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः /
अयन तस्य ताःप्रोक्तास्तेन नारायणः स्मृतः //
text_mt: "The waters are called nārāḥ; the waters indeed are the sons of Nara. / They were declared to be his abode, therefore he is remembered as Nārāyaṇa."

sanskrit_iast:
tulya yugasahasrasya vasankālamupāsyataḥ /
svarṇapatreprakurute brahmatvādarśakāraṇāt //
meaning:
तुल्य युगसहस्रस्य वसन्कालमुपास्यतः /
स्वर्णपत्रेप्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वादर्शकारणात् //
text_mt: Abiding for an amount of time equal to a thousand yugas, serving [creation], / he acts upon a golden leaf to manifest the state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
brahma tu salile tasminnavāg bhūtvā tadā caran /
niśāyāmiva khadyotaḥ prāpṛṭkāle tatastataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्म तु सलिले तस्मिन्नवाग् भूत्वा तदा चरन् /
निशायामिव खद्योतः प्रापृट्काले ततस्ततः //
text_mt: Then Brahmā, turned downwards in that water, moving about here and there / like a firefly in the night during the rainy season,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargate mahat /
anumānādasaṃmūḍho bhūmeraddharaṇaṃ prati //
meaning:
ततस्तु सलिले तस्मिन् विज्ञायान्तर्गते महत् /
अनुमानादसंमूढो भूमेरद्धरणं प्रति //
text_mt: perceived the vast [earth] gone within that water, / and being unconfounded, formed an inference regarding the raising of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkārāṣṛtanuṃ tvanyāṃ kalpādiṣu yathā purā /
tato mahātmā manasā divyarūpama cintayat //
meaning:
ओङ्काराषृतनुं त्वन्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा /
ततो महात्मा मनसा दिव्यरूपम चिन्तयत् //
text_mt: [He assumed] another body formed of the sound Om, as formerly at the beginning of the kalpas; / then the great-souled one meditated in his mind upon a divine form.

sanskrit_iast:
salile 'vaplutāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa samacintayat /
kiṃ tu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā salilāduddhare mahīm //
meaning:
सलिले ऽवप्लुतां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा स समचिन्तयत् /
किं तु रूपमहं कृत्वा सलिलादुद्धरे महीम् //
text_mt: Seeing the earth submerged in water, he reflected: / "What form shall I assume to raise the earth from the water?"

sanskrit_iast:
jalakrīḍāsamucitaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamasmarat /
udṛśyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
जलक्रीडासमुचितं वाराहं रूपमस्मरत् /
उदृश्यं सर्वभूतानां वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: He remembered the boar form suitable for sporting in the water, / invisible to all creatures, consisting of sacred speech, designated as Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
daśayojanavistīrṇamāyataṃśatayojanam /
nīlameghapratīkāśaṃ meghastanitaniḥsvanam //
meaning:
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णमायतंशतयोजनम् /
नीलमेघप्रतीकाशं मेघस्तनितनिःस्वनम् //
text_mt: ten yojanas broad and a hundred yojanas long, / resembling a dark blue cloud, with a roar like the rumbling of thunderclouds,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāparvatavarṣmāṇaṃ śvetatīkṣṇogradaṃṣṭriṇām /
vidyudagnipratikāśamādityasamatejasam //
meaning:
महापर्वतवर्ष्माणं श्वेततीक्ष्णोग्रदंष्ट्रिणाम् /
विद्युदग्निप्रतिकाशमादित्यसमतेजसम् //
text_mt: having the bulk of a great mountain, with white, sharp, and fierce tusks, / resembling lightning and fire, with splendour equal to the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
pīnavṛttāyataskandhaṃ viṣṇuvikramagāmi ca /
pīnonnatakaṭīdeśaṃ vṛṣalakṣaṇapūjitam //
meaning:
पीनवृत्तायतस्कन्धं विष्णुविक्रमगामि च /
पीनोन्नतकटीदेशं वृषलक्षणपूजितम् //
text_mt: with plump, round, and broad shoulders, striding with the stride of Viṣṇu, / with a fleshy, elevated hip region, marked with the auspicious signs of a bull.

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāya rūpamatulaṃ vārāhamamitaṃ hariḥ /
pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviveśa rasātalam //
meaning:
आस्थाय रूपमतुलं वाराहममितं हरिः /
पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविवेश रसातलम् //
text_mt: Assuming an incomparable, measureless boar form, Hari / entered Rasātala in order to uplift the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāsamāptīṣṭidaṃṣṭraḥkratudanto juhūsukhaḥ /
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
दीक्षासमाप्तीष्टिदंष्ट्रःक्रतुदन्तो जुहूसुखः /
अग्निजिह्वो दर्भरोमा ब्रह्मशीर्षो महातपाः //
text_mt: His tusks were the sacrificial offerings at the end of initiation; his teeth the sacrifices; his mouth the ladles; / his tongue was the sacrificial fire; his body hair the darbha grass; his head the Vedas; great in ascetic power;

sanskrit_iast:
vedaskandho havirgandhirhavyakavyādivegavān /
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimān nānādīkṣābhiranvitaḥ //
meaning:
वेदस्कन्धो हविर्गन्धिर्हव्यकव्यादिवेगवान् /
प्राग्वंशकायो द्युतिमान् नानादीक्षाभिरन्वितः //
text_mt: the Vedas were his shoulders; having the fragrance of oblations; having the speed of food for gods and ancestors; / his body was the hall of the sacrificer; full of splendour, endowed with various initiations;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇā tdṛdayo yogī śraddhāsattvamayo vibhuḥ /
upākarmaruciścaiva pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणा त्दृदयो योगी श्रद्धासत्त्वमयो विभुः /
उपाकर्मरुचिश्चैव प्रवर्ग्यावर्तभूषणः //
text_mt: the sacrificial fee was his heart; a yogin consisting of faith and sattva, the all-pervading lord; / his delight was the preliminary rite; his ornament was the Pravargya circle;

sanskrit_iast:
nānāchandogatipatho guhyopaniṣadāsanaḥ /
māyāpatnīsahāyo vai giriśṛṅgamivocchrayaḥ //
meaning:
नानाछन्दोगतिपथो गुह्योपनिषदासनः /
मायापत्नीसहायो वै गिरिशृङ्गमिवोच्छ्रयः //
text_mt: his gait was the path of the various metres; his seat was the secret Upaniṣads; / accompanied by Māyā as his wife, tall as a mountain peak;

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātrekṣaṇādharo vedāṅgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ /
ājyagandhaḥ sruvastuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān //
meaning:
अहोरात्रेक्षणाधरो वेदाङ्गश्रुतिभूषणः /
आज्यगन्धः स्रुवस्तुण्डः सामघोषस्वनो महान् //
text_mt: his eyes and lips were day and night; his ornaments were the Vedāṅgas and the scriptures; / possessing the fragrance of clarified butter; his snout the offering spoon; his great roar the chanting of the Sāma Veda;

sanskrit_iast:
satyadharmamayaḥ śrīmān karmavikramasatkṛtaḥ /
prāyaścittanakho ghoraḥ paśujānurmahāmakhaḥ //
meaning:
सत्यधर्ममयः श्रीमान् कर्मविक्रमसत्कृतः /
प्रायश्चित्तनखो घोरः पशुजानुर्महामखः //
text_mt: consisting of truth and righteousness, glorious, honoured for the strides of his ritual action; / his fierce claws were expiations; his knees the sacrificial victims; he was the great sacrifice itself;

sanskrit_iast:
udgātātro homaliṅgaḥ phalabījamahoṣadhīḥ /
vādyantarātmasatrasya nāsmikāso maśoṇitaḥ //
meaning:
उद्गातात्रो होमलिङ्गः फलबीजमहोषधीः /
वाद्यन्तरात्मसत्रस्य नास्मिकासो मशोणितः //
text_mt: his entrails were the Udgātṛ priest; his phallus the fire oblation; his fruits, seeds, and great medicinal herbs; / his inner self was the altar of the sacrificial session; his blood the sacrificial soma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktā yajñavarāhāntāścāpaḥ saṃprāviśatpunaḥ /
agnisaṃchāditāṃ bhūmiṃ samāmicchanprajāpatim //
meaning:
भक्ता यज्ञवराहान्ताश्चापः संप्राविशत्पुनः /
अग्निसंछादितां भूमिं समामिच्छन्प्रजापतिम् //
text_mt: Having partaken of [these], the Sacrificial Boar entered the waters again; / wishing to level the earth covered with fire, Prajāpati

sanskrit_iast:
upagamyā juhāvaitā madyaścādyasamanyasat /
māmudrāśca samudreṣu nādeyāśca nadīṣu ca /
pṛthak tāstu samīkṛtya pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinodgirīn //
meaning:
उपगम्या जुहावैता मद्यश्चाद्यसमन्यसत् /
मामुद्राश्च समुद्रेषु नादेयाश्च नदीषु च /
पृथक् तास्तु समीकृत्य पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद्गिरीन् //
text_mt: approached, gathered these [waters], and deposited them in their original place: / the oceanic waters in the oceans and the river waters in the rivers; / having separated and levelled them on the earth, he piled up the mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
prāksarge dahyamānāstu tadā saṃvartakāgninā /
denāgninā vilīnāste parvatā bhuvi sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
प्राक्सर्गे दह्यमानास्तु तदा संवर्तकाग्निना /
देनाग्निना विलीनास्ते पर्वता भुवि सर्वशः //
text_mt: In the previous creation, burned by the fire of universal destruction, / the mountains had dissolved everywhere on the earth due to that fire.

sanskrit_iast:
satyādekārṇave tasmin vāyunā yattu saṃhitāḥ /
niṣiktā yatrayatrāsaṃstatratatrācalo 'bhavat //
meaning:
सत्यादेकार्णवे तस्मिन् वायुना यत्तु संहिताः /
निषिक्ता यत्रयत्रासंस्तत्रतत्राचलो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: When there was that single ocean, brought together by the wind, / wherever they were scattered and settled, there a mountain arose.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣu prakīrṇeṣu lokodadhigirīṃstathā /
viśvakarmā vibhajate kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तेषु प्रकीर्णेषु लोकोदधिगिरींस्तथा /
विश्वकर्मा विभजते कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Then, when these were dispersed, Viśvakarman / divided the worlds, oceans, and mountains again and again at the beginnings of the kalpas.

sanskrit_iast:
sasamudrāmimāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām /
bhūrādyāṃścaturo lokānpunaḥpunarakalpayat //
meaning:
ससमुद्रामिमां पृथ्वीं सप्तद्वीपां सपर्वताम् /
भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान्पुनःपुनरकल्पयत् //
text_mt: He fashioned this earth along with its oceans, seven continents, and mountains, / and fashioned again and again the four worlds beginning with Bhūḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
lākānprakalpayitvā ca prajāsarga sasarja ha /
brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavām sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
लाकान्प्रकल्पयित्वा च प्रजासर्ग ससर्ज ह /
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवाम् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः //
text_mt: Having fashioned the worlds, Lord Brahmā Svayambhū / produced the creation of beings, desiring to create diverse creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
sasarja sṛṣṭaṃ tadrūpaṃ kalpādiṣu yathā purā /
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ tadā vai buddhipūrvakam //
meaning:
ससर्ज सृष्टं तद्रूपं कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा /
तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गं तदा वै बुद्धिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: He created that form of creation as formerly at the beginnings of the kalpas; / as he was then meditating upon creation with intellect beforehand,

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānasamakāle ca prādurbhūtastamo mayaḥ /
tamo moho mahāmohastāmisro hyandhasaṃjñitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रधानसमकाले च प्रादुर्भूतस्तमो मयः /
तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रो ह्यन्धसंज्ञितः //
text_mt: at the same time as the primary material, darkness manifested: / tamas, delusion, great delusion, darkness, and blindness.

sanskrit_iast:
avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ /
pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyata sābhimāninaḥ //
meaning:
अविद्या पञ्चपर्वैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः /
पञ्चधावस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायत साभिमानिनः //
text_mt: This fivefold ignorance appeared from that great-souled one; / as he meditated, conscious of self, creation stood in a fivefold manner:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatastamasā caiva bījakuṃbhalatāvṛtāḥ /
bahirantaścāprakāśastathāniḥsaṃjña eva ca //
meaning:
सर्वतस्तमसा चैव बीजकुंभलतावृताः /
बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशस्तथानिःसंज्ञ एव च //
text_mt: everywhere enveloped by tamas, like pots filled with seeds or crept over by creepers, / without light internally and externally, and utterly devoid of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātteṣāṃ kṛtā buddhir duḥkhāni karaṇāni ca /
tasmācca saṃvṛtātmāno nagā mukhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मात्तेषां कृता बुद्धिर् दुःखानि करणानि च /
तस्माच्च संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Because their intellect is shrouded and their organs are full of suffering, / therefore these immobile entities, whose selves are concealed, are proclaimed as the principal creation.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyasarge tadodbhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmātmasaṃbhavaḥ /
apratī tamanāḥ sotha tadotpattimamanyata //
meaning:
मुख्यसर्गे तदोद्भूतं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मसंभवः /
अप्रती तमनाः सोथ तदोत्पत्तिममन्यत //
text_mt: Seeing that which had arisen in the primary creation [of immovables], Brahmā, born from himself, / was dissatisfied in mind, and then thought of another creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhidhyāyataścānyastiryaksroto 'bhyavartata /
yasmāttiryagvivartteta tiryakasrotastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याभिध्यायतश्चान्यस्तिर्यक्स्रोतो ऽभ्यवर्तत /
यस्मात्तिर्यग्विवर्त्तेत तिर्यकस्रोतस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt: As he meditated, another [creation] of horizontal currents (tiryaksrotas) came forth. / Because it moved horizontally (tiryak), it is called tiryaksrotas [the animal kingdom].

sanskrit_iast:
tamobahutvātte sarve hyajñānabahulāḥ smṛtāḥ /
utpādyagrāhimaścaiva te 'jñāne jñānamāninaḥ //
meaning:
तमोबहुत्वात्ते सर्वे ह्यज्ञानबहुलाः स्मृताः /
उत्पाद्यग्राहिमश्चैव ते ऽज्ञाने ज्ञानमानिनः //
text_mt: Because tamas abounds in them, they are all remembered as filled with ignorance; / they seize upon what is before them, and in their ignorance they think themselves knowing.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkṛtā ahaṃmānā aṣṭāviṃśaddvidhātmikāḥ /
ekādaśandriyavidhā navadhātmādayastathā //
meaning:
अहङ्कृता अहंमाना अष्टाविंशद्द्विधात्मिकाः /
एकादशन्द्रियविधा नवधात्मादयस्तथा //
text_mt: Egoistic and full of self-conceit, they possess twenty-eight forms: / the eleven sense faculties, and likewise the nine forms of satisfaction, and so on,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau tu tārakādyāśca teṣāṃ śaktivadhāḥ smṛtāḥ /
antaḥ prakāśāste sarve āvṛtāśca bahiḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टौ तु तारकाद्याश्च तेषां शक्तिवधाः स्मृताः /
अन्तः प्रकाशास्ते सर्वे आवृताश्च बहिः पुनः //
text_mt: and the eight [perfections] beginning with Tārā; these are remembered as their functional impairments. / They are all illumined within, but enveloped on the outside.

sanskrit_iast: tiryak srotasa ucyante vaśyātmānastrisaṃjñakāḥ //
meaning: तिर्यक् स्रोतस उच्यन्ते वश्यात्मानस्त्रिसंज्ञकाः //
text_mt: The beings of horizontal currents are called subjugated in nature, having threefold designations.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryak srotastu sṛṣṭvā vai dvitīyaṃ viśvamīśvaraḥ /
abhiprāyamathodbhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sargaṃ tathāvidham //
meaning:
तिर्यक् स्रोतस्तु सृष्ट्वा वै द्वितीयं विश्वमीश्वरः /
अभिप्रायमथोद्भूतं दृष्ट्वा सर्गं तथाविधम् //
text_mt: Having created the second universe consisting of horizontal currents, the Lord, / seeing that creation arisen according to that intention,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhidhyāyato yontyaḥ sāttvikaḥ samajāyata /
ūrddhasrotastṛtīyastu tadvai corddhaṃ vyavasthitam //
meaning:
तस्याभिध्यायतो योन्त्यः सात्त्विकः समजायत /
ऊर्द्धस्रोतस्तृतीयस्तु तद्वै चोर्द्धं व्यवस्थितम् //
text_mt: as he meditated, another [creation], consisting of sattva, was born. / The third is the upward current (ūrdhvasrotas), and that is indeed situated above.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādūrddhaṃ nyavartanta tadūrddhasrotasaṃjñakam /
tāḥ sukhaṃ prītibahulā bahirantaśca vāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मादूर्द्धं न्यवर्तन्त तदूर्द्धस्रोतसंज्ञकम् /
ताः सुखं प्रीतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च वावृताः //
text_mt: Because they moved upward, it is designated as upward currents. / They abound in happiness and pleasure, both enveloped within and without,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśā bahirantaśca ūrddhasrotaḥprajāḥ smṛtāḥ /
navadhātādayaste vai tuṣṭātmāno budhāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च ऊर्द्धस्रोतःप्रजाः स्मृताः /
नवधातादयस्ते वै तुष्टात्मानो बुधाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: and illumined within and without; they are remembered as the creatures of upward currents. / Beginning with the ninefold [satisfactions], they are remembered as contented and wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhasrota stutīyo yaḥ smṛtaḥ sarvaḥ sadaivikaḥ /
ūrddhasrotaḥsu sṛṣṭeṣu deveṣu sa tadā prabhuḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्द्धस्रोत स्तुतीयो यः स्मृतः सर्वः सदैविकः /
ऊर्द्धस्रोतःसु सृष्टेषु देवेषु स तदा प्रभुः //
text_mt: That third one of upward currents is remembered as entirely divine. / When the gods of upward currents had been created, then the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
prītimānabhavadbrahmā tato 'nyaṃ nābhimanyata /
sargamanyaṃ simṛkṣustaṃ sādhakaṃ punarīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रीतिमानभवद्ब्रह्मा ततो ऽन्यं नाभिमन्यत /
सर्गमन्यं सिमृक्षुस्तं साधकं पुनरीश्वरः //
text_mt: Brahmā, was pleased, but he did not regard it as complete. / Desiring to create another creation that would be productive, the Lord once more [meditated].

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā /
prādurbabhau bhautasargaḥ sorvāk srotastu sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा /
प्रादुर्बभौ भौतसर्गः सोर्वाक् स्रोतस्तु साधकः //
text_mt: As he meditated on creation, he whose meditation is true, / the elemental creation then manifested, the downward current (arvāksrotas), which accomplishes goals.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttervākpravartante tatorvākūsrotasastu te /
te ca prakāśabahulāstamaspṛṣṭarajodhikāḥ //
meaning:
यस्मात्तेर्वाक्प्रवर्तन्ते ततोर्वाकूस्रोतसस्तु ते /
ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमस्पृष्टरजोधिकाः //
text_mt: Because they proceed downward (arvāk), they are of downward currents. / They abound in illumination, but are touched by tamas and have an excess of rajas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātte duḥkhabahulā bhūyobhūyaśca kārimaḥ /
prakāśā bahirantaśca manuṣyāḥ sādhakāśca te //
meaning:
तस्मात्ते दुःखबहुला भूयोभूयश्च कारिमः /
प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च मनुष्याः साधकाश्च ते //
text_mt: Therefore they abound in suffering and act again and again. / They are illumined within and without; these humans are the ones who accomplish [actions].

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇairnārakādyaistairaṣṭadhā ca vyavasthitāḥ /
siddhātmāno manuṣyāste gandharvaiḥ saha dharmiṇaḥ //
meaning:
लक्षणैर्नारकाद्यैस्तैरष्टधा च व्यवस्थिताः /
सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्ते गन्धर्वैः सह धर्मिणः //
text_mt: They are arranged eightfold by characteristics such as hellish and the like. / These humans of accomplished natures share common qualities with the Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamo 'nugrahaḥ sargaścaturddhā sa vyavasthitaḥ /
viparyayeṇa śaktyā ca siddha mukhyāstathaiva ca //
meaning:
पञ्चमो ऽनुग्रहः सर्गश्चतुर्द्धा स व्यवस्थितः /
विपर्ययेण शक्त्या च सिद्ध मुख्यास्तथैव च //
text_mt: The fifth creation is grace (anugraha); it is arranged fourfold: / by misconception, disability, perfection, and the primary ones.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttā vartamānāśca prajāyante punaḥpunaḥ /
bhūtādikānāṃ sattvānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ sa ucyate //
meaning:
निवृत्ता वर्तमानाश्च प्रजायन्ते पुनःपुनः /
भूतादिकानां सत्त्वानां षष्ठः सर्गः स उच्यते //
text_mt: Ceased and continuing, they are born again and again. / The creation of beings beginning with the bhūtādis is called the sixth.

sanskrit_iast:
svādanāścāpyaśīlāśca jñeyā bhūtādikāśca te /
prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ //
meaning:
स्वादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च ज्ञेया भूतादिकाश्च ते /
प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः //
text_mt: Beings beginning with the bhūtādis are to be known as tasting and devoid of good conduct. / The first creation of Brahmā is to be known as that of the cosmic intellect;

sanskrit_iast:
tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūta sargaḥ sa ucyate /
vaikārikastṛtīyastu caidriyaḥ sarga ucyate //
meaning:
तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूत सर्गः स उच्यते /
वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु चैद्रियः सर्ग उच्यते //
text_mt: the second is called the bhūtasarga, the creation of subtle elements (tanmātras); / the third is vaikārika, the creation of the sense faculties.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeta prākṛtāḥ sargā utpannā buddhipūrvakāḥ /
mukhyasargaśca turthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येत प्राकृताः सर्गा उत्पन्ना बुद्धिपूर्वकाः /
मुख्यसर्गश्च तुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः //
text_mt: These are the elemental creations (prākṛta), arisen preceded by intellect. / The fourth is the primary creation (mukhyasarga); the immovables are indeed considered primary.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryaksrotaḥsasargastu tairyagyonyastu pañcamaḥ /
tathorddhasrotasāṃ sargaḥ ṣaṣṭho devata ucyate //
meaning:
तिर्यक्स्रोतःससर्गस्तु तैर्यग्योन्यस्तु पञ्चमः /
तथोर्द्धस्रोतसां सर्गः षष्ठो देवत उच्यते //
text_mt: The fifth is the creation of horizontal currents, belonging to animal wombs; / likewise, the sixth creation, of upward currents, is called divine;

sanskrit_iast:
tatrorddhasrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ /
aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaḥ sāttvikastāmasaśca saḥ //
meaning:
तत्रोर्द्धस्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः /
अष्टमोनुग्रहः सर्गः सात्त्विकस्तामसश्च सः //
text_mt: the seventh creation there, of downward currents, is human; / the eighth creation is grace, consisting of sattva and tamas.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtādyāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva kaumāro navamaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चैते वैकृताः सर्गाः प्राकृताद्यास्त्रयः स्मृताः /
प्राकृतो वैकृतश्चैव कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः //
text_mt: These five are the modified creations (vaikṛta), and the first three are remembered as prākṛta. / The ninth is remembered as the Kaumāra, both prākṛta and vaikṛta.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtā buddhipūrvāstu trayaḥ sargāstu vaikṛtāḥ /
duddhiburvāḥ pravarteyustadvargā brāhmaṇāstu vai //
meaning:
प्रकृता बुद्धिपूर्वास्तु त्रयः सर्गास्तु वैकृताः /
दुद्धिबुर्वाः प्रवर्तेयुस्तद्वर्गा ब्राह्मणास्तु वै //
text_mt: The three prākṛta creations were preceded by intellect; the vaikṛta creations, / preceded by intellect, proceeded—their classes, O brāhmaṇas!

sanskrit_iast:
vistarācca yathā sarve kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhata /
caturddhā ca sthitasso 'pi sarvabhūteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
विस्तराच्च यथा सर्वे कीर्त्यमानं निबोधत /
चतुर्द्धा च स्थितस्सो ऽपि सर्वभूतेषु कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: Listen to this in detail as it is all proclaimed: / that [grace] also resides entirely fourfold among all beings,

sanskrit_iast:
viparyayoṇa śattyā ca buddhyā siddhyā tathaiva ca /
sthāvareṣu viparyāsastiryagyoniṣu śaktitaḥ //
meaning:
विपर्ययोण शत्त्या च बुद्ध्या सिद्ध्या तथैव च /
स्थावरेषु विपर्यासस्तिर्यग्योनिषु शक्तितः //
text_mt: by misconception, disability, intellect, and perfection: / misconception among immovables; disability in animal wombs;

sanskrit_iast:
siddhātmāno manuṣyāstu puṣṭirdeveṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ /
atho sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān //
meaning:
सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्तु पुष्टिर्देवेषु कृत्स्नशः /
अथो ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् //
text_mt: perfection in humans; and complete nourishment among the gods. / Then Brahmā created mind-born sons equal to himself.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivartyena tu jñānena nivṛttāste mahau jasaḥ /
saṃbuddhya caiva nāmātho apavṛttāstrayastu te //
meaning:
वैवर्त्येन तु ज्ञानेन निवृत्तास्ते महौ जसः /
संबुद्ध्य चैव नामाथो अपवृत्तास्त्रयस्तु ते //
text_mt: By virtue of knowledge of non-evolution, those of great splendor turned away. / Realizing the true nature, the three turned away,

sanskrit_iast:
asṛṣṭvaiva prajāsargaṃpratisargaṃ tatastataḥ /
brahmā teṣu vyarakteṣu tato 'nyānsā dhakānsṛjan //
meaning:
असृष्ट्वैव प्रजासर्गंप्रतिसर्गं ततस्ततः /
ब्रह्मा तेषु व्यरक्तेषु ततो ऽन्यान्सा धकान्सृजन् //
text_mt: without producing the creation and secondary creation of progeny. When they became detached, / Brahmā then created others who would accomplish goals.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānābhimānino devāḥ punarbrahmānuśāsanam /
abhūtasṛṣṭyavasthā ce sthāninastānnibodha me //
meaning:
स्थानाभिमानिनो देवाः पुनर्ब्रह्मानुशासनम् /
अभूतसृष्ट्यवस्था चे स्थानिनस्तान्निबोध मे //
text_mt: The deities presiding over abodes [arose] by the command of Brahmā; / hear from me those deities presiding over the state of non-elemental creation:

sanskrit_iast:
āpo 'gniḥ pṛthivī vāyurantarikṣo divaṃ tathā /
svargo diśaḥ samudrāśca nadyaścaiva vanaspatīn //
meaning:
आपो ऽग्निः पृथिवी वायुरन्तरिक्षो दिवं तथा /
स्वर्गो दिशः समुद्राश्च नद्यश्चैव वनस्पतीन् //
text_mt: waters, fire, earth, wind, atmosphere, and sky, / heaven, directions, oceans, rivers, and lordly trees;

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno hyātmano vṛkṣavīrudhām /
latāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtāḥ saṃdhirātryahāḥ //
meaning:
औषधीनां तथात्मानो ह्यात्मनो वृक्षवीरुधाम् /
लताः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ताः संधिरात्र्यहाः //
text_mt: likewise the presiding spirits of herbs, and the spirits of trees, shrubs, / creepers, kāṣṭhās, kalās, muhūrtas, twilights, nights and days,

sanskrit_iast:
arddhamāsāśca māsāśca ayanābdayugāni ca /
sthāne srotaḥsvabhīmānāḥ sthānākhyāścaiva te smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अर्द्धमासाश्च मासाश्च अयनाब्दयुगानि च /
स्थाने स्रोतःस्वभीमानाः स्थानाख्याश्चैव ते स्मृताः //
text_mt: half-months, months, ayanas, years, and yugas; / they who preside over currents in their respective abodes are called presiding deities.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānātmanaḥ sa sṛṣṭvā tu tato 'nyānsa tadāsṛjat /
devāṃścaiva pitṝṃścaiva yaurimā varddhitāḥ prajāḥ //
meaning:
स्थानात्मनः स सृष्ट्वा तु ततो ऽन्यान्स तदासृजत् /
देवांश्चैव पितॄंश्चैव यौरिमा वर्द्धिताः प्रजाः //
text_mt: Having created those presiding spirits, he then created others: / the gods and the Pitṛs by whom these progeny are multiplied.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvaṅgirā marīciśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ /
dakṣo 'triśca vasiṣṭhaśca sāsṛjannava mānasān //
meaning:
भृग्वङ्गिरा मरीचिश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः /
दक्षो ऽत्रिश्च वसिष्ठश्च सासृजन्नव मानसान् //
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Marīci, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Dakṣa, Atri, and Vasiṣṭha—he created nine mind-born sons.

sanskrit_iast:
nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ /
brahmā yathātmakānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brahmayoginām //
meaning:
नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः /
ब्रह्मा यथात्मकानां तु सर्वेषां ब्रह्मयोगिनाम् //
text_mt: These are determined in the Purāṇa as the nine Brahmās, / sharing the nature of Brahmā, for all practitioners of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sṛjatpunarbrahmā rudraṃ roṣatmasaṃbhavam /
saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharma ca sarveṣāmeva parvatau //
meaning:
ततो ऽसृजत्पुनर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रं रोषत्मसंभवम् /
संकल्पं चैव धर्म च सर्वेषामेव पर्वतौ //
text_mt: Then Brahmā again created Rudra, born of his anger, / and intention (saṃkalpa) and righteousness (dharma), the foremost among all.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'sṛjadvyavasāyaṃ tu brahmā bhūtaṃ sukhātmakam /
saṃkalpāccaiva saṃkalpo jajñe so 'vyaktayoninaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽसृजद्व्यवसायं तु ब्रह्मा भूतं सुखात्मकम् /
संकल्पाच्चैव संकल्पो जज्ञे सो ऽव्यक्तयोनिनः //
text_mt: That Brahmā created resolution (vyavasāya), a being whose nature is joy. / From intention was born intention itself, springing from the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāddakṣo 'sṛjadvācaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ ca marīcinam /
bhṛguśca hṛdayājjajñe ṛṣiḥ salilayoninaḥ //
meaning:
प्राणाद्दक्षो ऽसृजद्वाचं चक्षुर्भ्यां च मरीचिनम् /
भृगुश्च हृदयाज्जज्ञे ऋषिः सलिलयोनिनः //
text_mt: From his breath [Brahmā] created Dakṣa; speech [and] Marīci from his two eyes; / Bhṛgu, the seer born of water, was born from his heart;

sanskrit_iast:
śirasaścāṅgirāścaiva śrotrādatristathaiva ca /
pulastyaśca tathodānādvyānāttu pulahastathā //
meaning:
शिरसश्चाङ्गिराश्चैव श्रोत्रादत्रिस्तथैव च /
पुलस्त्यश्च तथोदानाद्व्यानात्तु पुलहस्तथा //
text_mt: Aṅgiras from his head, and Atri from his ear; / Pulastya from his udāna breath, and Pulaha from his vyāna;

sanskrit_iast:
samānato vasiṣṭhaśca hyapānānnirmame kratum /
ityete brahmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ putrā vai dvādaśa smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
समानतो वसिष्ठश्च ह्यपानान्निर्ममे क्रतुम् /
इत्येते ब्रह्मणः श्रेष्ठाः पुत्रा वै द्वादश स्मृताः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha from his samāna, and from his apāna he created Kratu. / These are remembered as the twelve foremost sons of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādayaḥ prathamajā vijñeyā brahmamaḥ smṛtāḥ /
bhṛgvādayastu ye sṛṣṭā na ca te brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मादयः प्रथमजा विज्ञेया ब्रह्ममः स्मृताः /
भृग्वादयस्तु ये सृष्टा न च ते ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: Those beginning with Dharma are to be known as the first-born sons of Brahmā; / but those beginning with Bhṛgu who were created were not knowers of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhamedhipurāṇāste vijñeyā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ /
dvādaśaite prasūyante saha rūdreṇa ca dvijāḥ //
meaning:
गृहमेधिपुराणास्ते विज्ञेया ब्रह्मणः सुताः /
द्वादशैते प्रसूयन्ते सह रूद्रेण च द्विजाः //
text_mt: They are to be known as ancient householder sons of Brahmā. / These twelve, born together with Rudra, are the twice-born [sons].

sanskrit_iast:
kratuḥ sanatkumāraśca dvāvetāvūrddharetasau /
pūrvotpattau purā hyetau sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau //
meaning:
क्रतुः सनत्कुमारश्च द्वावेतावूर्द्धरेतसौ /
पूर्वोत्पत्तौ पुरा ह्येतौ सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजौ //
text_mt: Kratu and Sanatkumāra—these two are celibates of drawn-up seed; / these two were born first long ago, the elder brothers of all.

sanskrit_iast:
vyatītau saptame kalpe purāṇau lokasādhakau /
virajete 'tra vai loke tejasākṣipya cātmanaḥ //
meaning:
व्यतीतौ सप्तमे कल्पे पुराणौ लोकसाधकौ /
विरजेते ऽत्र वै लोके तेजसाक्षिप्य चात्मनः //
text_mt: Having passed away in the seventh kalpa, these two ancient accompliders of the worlds / shine in this world, eclipsing [all] with their splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
tāpubhau yogadharmāṇāvāropyātmānamātmanā /
prajādharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vartayete mahaujasau //
meaning:
तापुभौ योगधर्माणावारोप्यात्मानमात्मना /
प्रजाधर्मं च कामं च वर्तयेते महौजसौ //
text_mt: Having established yoga and virtue in the self by the self, / both of great splendor sustain the duty of progeny and desire.

sanskrit_iast:
yathotpannastathaiveha kumāra iti cocyate /
tataḥ sanatkumāreti nāma tasya pratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
यथोत्पन्नस्तथैवेह कुमार इति चोच्यते /
ततः सनत्कुमारेति नाम तस्य प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Just as he was born, so he is called Kumāra ('the youth'); / therefore his name Sanatkumāra became established.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ dvādaśa te vaṃśā divyā devagāṇānvitāḥ /
kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhiralaṅkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तेषां द्वादश ते वंशा दिव्या देवगाणान्विताः /
क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्षिभिरलङ्कृताः //
text_mt: Their twelve divine lineages were accompanied by hosts of gods, / ritualistic, endowed with offspring, and adorned by great seers.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇajāṃstu sa dṛṣṭvā vai brahmā dvādaśa sāttvikān /
tato 'surānpitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃścāsṛjatprabhuḥ //
meaning:
प्राणजांस्तु स दृष्ट्वा वै ब्रह्मा द्वादश सात्त्विकान् /
ततो ऽसुरान्पितॄन्देवान्मनुष्यांश्चासृजत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: Having seen the twelve born of his vital breath, who were consisting of sattva, / the lord Brahmā then created asuras, ancestors, gods, and humans.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhāddevānajanayat pitṝṃścaivātha vakṣasaḥ /
prajananānmanuṣyānvai jaghanānnirmame 'surān //
meaning:
मुखाद्देवानजनयत् पितॄंश्चैवाथ वक्षसः /
प्रजननान्मनुष्यान्वै जघनान्निर्ममे ऽसुरान् //
text_mt: From his mouth he brought forth the gods, and from his chest the ancestors; / from his organ of generation [he brought forth] humans, and from his buttocks he fashioned the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
naktaṃ sṛjanpunarbrahmā jyotsnāyā mānuṣātmanaḥ /
sudhāyāśca pitṝṃścaiva devadevaḥ sasarjaha //
meaning:
नक्तं सृजन्पुनर्ब्रह्मा ज्योत्स्नाया मानुषात्मनः /
सुधायाश्च पितॄंश्चैव देवदेवः ससर्जह //
text_mt: Creating again at night, Brahmā, the god of gods, / created human souls from moonlight, and ancestors from nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyāmukhyān mṛjandevānasurāṃśca tataḥ punaḥ /
sanasaśca manuṣyāṃśca pitṛvanmahataḥ pitṝn //
meaning:
मुख्यामुख्यान् मृजन्देवानसुरांश्च ततः पुनः /
सनसश्च मनुष्यांश्च पितृवन्महतः पितॄन् //
text_mt: Then, bringing forth the gods as primary, and the asuras as secondary, / and eternally [generating] humans, [he brought forth] the great ancestors like fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyuto 'śanimeghāṃśca lohitendradhanūṃṣi ca /
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni nirmame yajñasiddhaye //
meaning:
विद्युतो ऽशनिमेघांश्च लोहितेन्द्रधनूंषि च /
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि निर्ममे यज्ञसिद्धये //
text_mt: He fashioned lightning bolts, thunders, clouds, and red rainbows, / and the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma [verses] for the accomplishment of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāvacāni bhūtāni mahasastasya jajñire /
brahmaṇastu prajāsargaṃ devārṣipitṛmānavam //
meaning:
उच्चावचानि भूतानि महसस्तस्य जज्ञिरे /
ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रजासर्गं देवार्षिपितृमानवम् //
text_mt: High and low beings were born from that splendor of his; / and Brahmā's creation of offspring [consisted of] gods, seers, ancestors, and humans.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca /
yakṣānpiśācān gandharvānsarvaśo 'psarasastathā //
meaning:
पुनः सृजति भूतानि चराणि स्थावराणि च /
यक्षान्पिशाचान् गन्धर्वान्सर्वशो ऽप्सरसस्तथा //
text_mt: He again creates beings, moving and unmoving: / yakṣas, piśācas, gandharvas, and all apsarases likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
narakinnararakṣāṃsi vayaḥ paśumṛgoragān /
avyayaṃ vā vyayañcaiva dvayaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयः पशुमृगोरगान् /
अव्ययं वा व्ययञ्चैव द्वयं स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: Men, kinnaras, rākṣasas, birds, domestic animals, wild beasts, and serpents; / both the imperishable and the perishable, the twofold: unmoving and moving.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ te yānti karmāṇi prāk sṛṣṭāni svayaṃbhuvā /
tānyeva pratipadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तेषां ते यान्ति कर्माणि प्राक् सृष्टानि स्वयंभुवा /
तान्येव प्रतिपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: They follow those deeds previously created by Svayambhū; / being created again and again, they take up those very deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukrūre dharmādharmauṃ kṛtākṛte /
teṣāmeva pṛthak sūtamavibhaktaṃ trayaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्माधर्मौं कृताकृते /
तेषामेव पृथक् सूतमविभक्तं त्रयं विदुः //
text_mt: Violent and non-violent, gentle and cruel, righteous and unrighteous, done and undone: / they know this triad brought forth individually for them, undivided.

sanskrit_iast:
etadevaṃ ca naivaṃ ca na cobhe nānubhe tathā /
karma svaviṣayaṃ prāhuḥ sattvasthāḥ samadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
एतदेवं च नैवं च न चोभे नानुभे तथा /
कर्म स्वविषयं प्राहुः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शिनः //
text_mt: Those abiding in sattva, endowed with equal vision, say that action has its own sphere: / 'It is thus, and it is not thus; it is neither both, nor neither.'

sanskrit_iast:
nāmātmapañcabhūtānāṃ kṛtānāṃ ca prapañcatām /
divaśabdena pañcaite nirmame samaheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
नामात्मपञ्चभूतानां कृतानां च प्रपञ्चताम् /
दिवशब्देन पञ्चैते निर्ममे समहेश्वरः //
text_mt: The diversification of the names and identities of the five elements that were made / —these five the great lord fashioned by the sound of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣāṇi caiva nāmāni yāśca deveṣu sṛṣṭayaḥ /
śarvaryāṃ na prasūyante punastebhyodadhatprabhuḥ //
meaning:
आर्षाणि चैव नामानि याश्च देवेषु सृष्टयः /
शर्वर्यां न प्रसूयन्ते पुनस्तेभ्योदधत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: The names of the seers and the creations among the gods / that are not brought forth in the night, the lord establishes again for them.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kāraṇādbhūto lokasargaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ /
mahadādyā viśeṣāntā vikārāḥ prākṛtāḥ svayam //
meaning:
इत्येवं कारणाद्भूतो लोकसर्गः स्वयंभुवः /
महदाद्या विशेषान्ता विकाराः प्राकृताः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Thus the creation of the world from Svayambhū arose from a cause; / the natural evolutes themselves beginning with the cosmic intellect and ending with the gross elements.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryaprabho loko grahanakṣatramaṇḍitaḥ /
nadībhiśca samudraiśca parvataiśca sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यप्रभो लोको ग्रहनक्षत्रमण्डितः /
नदीभिश्च समुद्रैश्च पर्वतैश्च सहस्रशः //
text_mt: The world is illuminated by the moon and sun, adorned with planets and constellations, / and with rivers, oceans, and mountains by the thousands,

sanskrit_iast:
puraiśca vividhai ramyaiḥ sphītairjanapadaistathā /
asmin brahmavane 'vyakto brahmā carati sarvavit //
meaning:
पुरैश्च विविधै रम्यैः स्फीतैर्जनपदैस्तथा /
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मवने ऽव्यक्तो ब्रह्मा चरति सर्ववित् //
text_mt: And with varied, delightful cities and flourishing provinces. / In this forest of Brahman, the unmanifest, omniscient Brahmā roams.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktabījaprabhavastasyaivānugrahe sthitaḥ /
buddhiskandhamayaścaiva indriyāntarakoṭaraḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तबीजप्रभवस्तस्यैवानुग्रहे स्थितः /
बुद्धिस्कन्धमयश्चैव इन्द्रियान्तरकोटरः //
text_mt: It originates from the unmanifest seed, rests upon his grace alone, / has the cosmic intellect for its trunk, and has hollows within the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūtaprakāśaśca viśeṣaiḥ patravāṃstu saḥ /
dharmādharmasupuṣpastu sukhaduḥkhaphalodayaḥ //
meaning:
महाभूतप्रकाशश्च विशेषैः पत्रवांस्तु सः /
धर्माधर्मसुपुष्पस्तु सुखदुःखफलोदयः //
text_mt: It has the manifestation of the great elements, and it has the gross elements for leaves; / its fine flowers are virtue and vice, and its arising fruit is pleasure and pain.

sanskrit_iast:
ājīvaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmavṛkṣaḥ sanātanaḥ /
etadbrahmavanaṃ caiva brahmavṛkṣasya tasya tat //
meaning:
आजीवः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मवृक्षः सनातनः /
एतद्ब्रह्मवनं चैव ब्रह्मवृक्षस्य तस्य तत् //
text_mt: The eternal tree of Brahman is the livelihood of all beings; / and this forest of Brahman belongs to that tree of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kāraṇaṃ yatra nityaṃ sadasadātmakam /
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiṃmāyāṃ caivāhustattvacintakāḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्र नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् /
प्रधानं प्रकृतिंमायां चैवाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः //
text_mt: Where the unmanifest cause is eternal, consisting of being and non-being, / the knowers of truth call it pradhāna, prakṛti, and māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣo 'nugrahaḥmargo brahmanaimittikaḥ smṛtaḥ /
abuddhipūrvakāḥ sargā brahmaṇaḥ prākṛtāstrayaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येषो ऽनुग्रहःमर्गो ब्रह्मनैमित्तिकः स्मृतः /
अबुद्धिपूर्वकाः सर्गा ब्रह्मणः प्राकृतास्त्रयः //
text_mt: Thus this path of grace of Brahman is remembered as occasional; / the primary creations of Brahmā, preceding intellect, are three.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhyādayastu ṣaṭ sargā vaikṛtā buddhipūrvakāḥ /
vaikalpātsaṃpravartante brahmaṇastebhimanyavaḥ //
meaning:
सुख्यादयस्तु षट् सर्गा वैकृता बुद्धिपूर्वकाः /
वैकल्पात्संप्रवर्तन्ते ब्रह्मणस्तेभिमन्यवः //
text_mt: The six creations beginning with the senses, on the other hand, are secondary evolutes, preceded by intellect; / they proceed from alternative conception, bringing self-consciousness to Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete prākṛtāścaiva vaikṛtāśca nava smṛtāḥ /
sargāḥ parasparotpannāḥ kāraṇaṃ tu budhaiḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
इत्येते प्राकृताश्चैव वैकृताश्च नव स्मृताः /
सर्गाः परस्परोत्पन्नाः कारणं तु बुधैः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Thus these primary and secondary creations are remembered as nine; / mutually produced, their cause is remembered by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrddhānaṃ vai yasya vedā vadanti viyannābhiścandrasūryauṃ ca netre /
diśaḥ śrotre viddhi pādau kṣitiṃ ca so 'cintyātmā sarvabhūtapraṇetā //
meaning:
मूर्द्धानं वै यस्य वेदा वदन्ति वियन्नाभिश्चन्द्रसूर्यौं च नेत्रे /
दिशः श्रोत्रे विद्धि पादौ क्षितिं च सो ऽचिन्त्यात्मा सर्वभूतप्रणेता //
text_mt: Know him whose head the Vedas say is the sky, whose navel is space, whose eyes are the sun and moon, / whose ears are the quarters, and whose feet are the earth: he is the inconceivable self, the leader of all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktrādyasya brāhmaṇāḥ saṃprasūtā vakṣasaścaiva kṣatriyāḥ pūrvabhāge /
vaiśyā ūrubhyāṃ yasya padbhyāṃ ca śūdrāḥsarvevarṇā gātrataḥ saṃprasūtāḥ //
meaning:
वक्त्राद्यस्य ब्राह्मणाः संप्रसूता वक्षसश्चैव क्षत्रियाः पूर्वभागे /
वैश्या ऊरुभ्यां यस्य पद्भ्यां च शूद्राःसर्वेवर्णा गात्रतः संप्रसूताः //
text_mt: From whose mouth the brāhmaṇas were born, and the kṣatriyas from the front part of his chest, / the vaiśyas from his thighs, and from his feet the śūdras: all classes were produced from his limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇātparovyaktādaṇḍamavyaktasaṃjñitam /
aṇḍajastu svayaṃ brahmā lokāstena kṛtāḥ svayam //
meaning:
नारायणात्परोव्यक्तादण्डमव्यक्तसंज्ञितम् /
अण्डजस्तु स्वयं ब्रह्मा लोकास्तेन कृताः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Beyond Nārāyaṇa, beyond the unmanifest, is the egg known as the unmanifest; / Brahmā himself was born of the egg, and the worlds were made by him himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kalpān daśasthitvā satyaṃ gacchanti te punaḥ /
te lokā brahmalokaṃ vai aparāvartinīṃ gatim //
meaning:
तत्र कल्पान् दशस्थित्वा सत्यं गच्छन्ति ते पुनः /
ते लोका ब्रह्मलोकं वै अपरावर्तिनीं गतिम् //
text_mt: Having remained there for ten kalpas, they go to the world of truth; / those worlds [go] to the world of Brahmā, a path of non-return.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhipatyaṃ vinā te vai aiśvaryeṇa tu tatsamāḥ /
bhavanti brahmaṇā tulyā rūpeṇa viṣayeṇa ca //
meaning:
आधिपत्यं विना ते वै ऐश्वर्येण तु तत्समाः /
भवन्ति ब्रह्मणा तुल्या रूपेण विषयेण च //
text_mt: Except for supreme sovereignty, they are equal to him in lordly power; / they become equal to Brahmā in form and in their sphere of action.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te hyavatiṣṭhante prītiyuktāḥ svasaṃyutāḥ /
avaśyaṃbhāvinārthena prākṛtaṃ tanute svayam //
meaning:
तत्र ते ह्यवतिष्ठन्ते प्रीतियुक्ताः स्वसंयुताः /
अवश्यंभाविनार्थेन प्राकृतं तनुते स्वयम् //
text_mt: There they dwell full of joy and accompanied by their kin; / by an inevitably necessary purpose, he unfolds the natural [creation] himself.

sanskrit_iast:
nānātvanābhisaṃbadhyāstadā tatkālabhāvitāḥ /
svapato 'buddhipūrva hi bodho bhavati vai yathā //
meaning:
नानात्वनाभिसंबध्यास्तदा तत्कालभाविताः /
स्वपतो ऽबुद्धिपूर्व हि बोधो भवति वै यथा //
text_mt: They are not to be bound by diversity then, being imbued with the nature of that time; / just as waking occurs without prior thought for one who is asleep,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālabhāvite teṣāṃ tathā jñānaṃ pravarttate /
pratyāhāraistu bhedānāṃ teṣāṃ hi na tu śuṣmiṇām //
meaning:
तत्कालभाविते तेषां तथा ज्ञानं प्रवर्त्तते /
प्रत्याहारैस्तु भेदानां तेषां हि न तु शुष्मिणाम् //
text_mt: So knowledge arises for them, being imbued with the nature of that time; / through the withdrawal of differences, indeed, [it arises] for them, not for the impetuous.

sanskrit_iast:
taiśva sārdhaṃ pravartante kāryāṇi kāraṇāni ca /
nānātvadarśināṃ teṣāṃ brahmalokanivāsinām //
meaning:
तैश्व सार्धं प्रवर्तन्ते कार्याणि कारणानि च /
नानात्वदर्शिनां तेषां ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिनाम् //
text_mt: Together with them, effects and causes proceed / for those dwellers in the world of Brahmā who perceive diversity.

sanskrit_iast:
vinivṛttavikārāṇāṃ svena dharmeṇa tiṣṭhatām /
tulyalakṣaṇa siddhāstu śubhātmāno nirañjanāḥ //
meaning:
विनिवृत्तविकाराणां स्वेन धर्मेण तिष्ठताम् /
तुल्यलक्षण सिद्धास्तु शुभात्मानो निरञ्जनाः //
text_mt: For those whose modifications have ceased, who abide in their own nature, / perfected with equal attributes, pure in soul and free from stain,

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛte karaṇopetāḥ svātmanyeva vyavasthitāḥ /
prasthāpayitvā cātmānaṃ prakṛtistveṣa tattavataḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृते करणोपेताः स्वात्मन्येव व्यवस्थिताः /
प्रस्थापयित्वा चात्मानं प्रकृतिस्त्वेष तत्तवतः //
text_mt: Endowed with instruments in the natural [realm], yet abiding in their own self; / having set forth the soul, prakṛti truly does not proceed,

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣānyabahutvena pratītā na pravartate /
pravartate punaḥ sargasteṣāṃ sākāraṇātmanām //
meaning:
पुरुषान्यबहुत्वेन प्रतीता न प्रवर्तते /
प्रवर्तते पुनः सर्गस्तेषां साकारणात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Acknowledged through the multiplicity of puruṣas; / the creation of those embodied beings possessing causal nature proceeds again.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyogaḥ prakṛtirjñeyā yaktānāṃ tattvadarśinām /
tatropavargiṇī teṣāmapunarbhāragāminām //
meaning:
संयोगः प्रकृतिर्ज्ञेया यक्तानां तत्त्वदर्शिनाम् /
तत्रोपवर्गिणी तेषामपुनर्भारगामिनाम् //
text_mt: The conjunction should be known as prakṛti for the united knowers of truth; / there she brings liberation to those destined for non-rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
abhāvataḥ punaḥ satyaṃ śāntānāmarciṣāmiva /
tatarateṣu gateṣūrddhaṃ trailokyāttu mudātmasu //
meaning:
अभावतः पुनः सत्यं शान्तानामर्चिषामिव /
ततरतेषु गतेषूर्द्धं त्रैलोक्यात्तु मुदात्मसु //
text_mt: Through non-existence, [they go] to the truth again, like extinguished flames; / when those joyful souls have gone above the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
te sārddhaṃ cairmaharllokastadānāsāditastu vai /
tacchiṣyā ye ha tiṣṭhanti kalpadāha upasthite //
meaning:
ते सार्द्धं चैर्महर्ल्लोकस्तदानासादितस्तु वै /
तच्छिष्या ये ह तिष्ठन्ति कल्पदाह उपस्थिते //
text_mt: Maharloka was not reached by them along with the others at that time; / when the burning of the kalpa approaches, those disciples of his who remain here—

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvādyāḥ piśācāścamānuṣā brahmaṇādayaḥ /
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva sthāvarāḥ sasarīsṛpāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाद्याः पिशाचाश्चमानुषा ब्रह्मणादयः /
पशवः पक्षिणश्चैव स्थावराः ससरीसृपाः //
text_mt: Gandharvas and others, piśācas, humans, Brahmā and the rest, / domestic animals, birds, unmoving beings, and crawling creatures—

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhatsuteṣu tatkālaṃ pṛthivītalavasiṣu /
sahasraṃyattu raśmīnāṃ sūryasyeha vinaśyati //
meaning:
तिष्ठत्सुतेषु तत्कालं पृथिवीतलवसिषु /
सहस्रंयत्तु रश्मीनां सूर्यस्येह विनश्यति //
text_mt: While those dwellers on the surface of the earth are abiding at that time, / that which is the thousand rays of the sun here perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
te sapta raśmayo bhūtvā ekaiko jāyate raviḥ /
krameṇa śatamānāste trīṃllokānpradahantyuta //
meaning:
ते सप्त रश्मयो भूत्वा एकैको जायते रविः /
क्रमेण शतमानास्ते त्रींल्लोकान्प्रदहन्त्युत //
text_mt: Becoming seven rays, each one becomes a sun; / measuring a hundred [times], they gradually scorch the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅgamānsthāvarāṃścaiva nadīḥ sarvāśca parvatān /
śuṣke pūrvamanāvṛṣṭyā caistaiśacaiva pratāpitāḥ //
meaning:
जङ्गमान्स्थावरांश्चैव नदीः सर्वाश्च पर्वतान् /
शुष्के पूर्वमनावृष्ट्या चैस्तैशचैव प्रतापिताः //
text_mt: The moving and unmoving, and all rivers and mountains; / having been dried up earlier by drought, they are scorched by those [suns].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā te vivaśāḥ sarve nirdagdhāḥ sūryaraśmibhiḥ /
jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāścaiva dharmādharmādikāstu vai //
meaning:
तदा ते विवशाः सर्वे निर्दग्धाः सूर्यरश्मिभिः /
जङ्गमाः स्थावराश्चैव धर्माधर्मादिकास्तु वै //
text_mt: Then, all of them helpless, burnt by the rays of the sun— / the moving and unmoving, [the bearers of] virtue, vice, and the rest—

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhadehāstadā te tu dhūtapāpā yugātyaye /
khyātātapā vinirmuktāḥ śubhayā cātibandhayā //
meaning:
दग्धदेहास्तदा ते तु धूतपापा युगात्यये /
ख्यातातपा विनिर्मुक्ताः शुभया चातिबन्धया //
text_mt: With their bodies burnt at the end of the yuga, their sins shaken off, / with their austerities renowned, they are freed from the auspicious and intense bond.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste hyupapadyante tulyarūpairjanairjanāḥ /
uṣitvā rajanīṃ te ca brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते ह्युपपद्यन्ते तुल्यरूपैर्जनैर्जनाः /
उषित्वा रजनीं ते च ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः //
text_mt: Then, having dwelt [through] the night of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, / those people are reborn among people of similar form.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ sarge bhavantīha mānasyo brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ /
tatasteṣu prapanneṣu janaistrailokyavāsiṣu //
meaning:
पुनः सर्गे भवन्तीह मानस्यो ब्रह्मणः प्रजाः /
ततस्तेषु प्रपन्नेषु जनैस्त्रैलोक्यवासिषु //
text_mt: At the new creation, they become mind-born offspring of Brahmā here; / then, when those inhabitants of the three worlds have reached Janaloka,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdheṣu ca lokeṣu tadā sūryaistu saptabhiḥ /
vṛṣṭyā kṣitau plāvitāyāṃ vijaneṣvarṇaveṣu vā //
meaning:
निर्दग्धेषु च लोकेषु तदा सूर्यैस्तु सप्तभिः /
वृष्ट्या क्षितौ प्लावितायां विजनेष्वर्णवेषु वा //
text_mt: and when the worlds have been consumed by the seven suns, / when the earth is flooded by rain, in the deserted oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
samudrāścaiva meghāśca āpaścaivātha pārthivāḥ /
śaramāṇā vrajantyeva salilākhyāstathācalāḥ //
meaning:
समुद्राश्चैव मेघाश्च आपश्चैवाथ पार्थिवाः /
शरमाणा व्रजन्त्येव सलिलाख्यास्तथाचलाः //
text_mt: the seas, the clouds, the waters, and terrestrial [streams], / flowing, move along, named 'waters', and so too the mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatāgatikaṃ caiva yadā tu salilaṃ bahu /
saṃchādyemāṃ sthitāṃ bhūmimarṇavākhyaṃ tadābhavata //
meaning:
आगतागतिकं चैव यदा तु सलिलं बहु /
संछाद्येमां स्थितां भूमिमर्णवाख्यं तदाभवत //
text_mt: And when the abundant water came and went, / covering this stationary earth, it was then called an ocean (arṇava).

sanskrit_iast:
ābhāti yasmāccābhāsādbhāśabdaḥ kāntidīptiṣu /
sa sarvaḥ samanuprāptā māsāṃ bhābhyo vibhāvyate //
meaning:
आभाति यस्माच्चाभासाद्भाशब्दः कान्तिदीप्तिषु /
स सर्वः समनुप्राप्ता मासां भाभ्यो विभाव्यते //
text_mt: Because it shines (ābhāti) from radiance (ābhāsa)—the word 'bhā' signifies splendour and light— / all that has arrived is conceived from the lights of those [waters].

sanskrit_iast:
tadantastanute yasmātsarvāṃ pṛthvīṃ samatataḥ /
dhātustanoti vistāraṃ tatopatanavaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तदन्तस्तनुते यस्मात्सर्वां पृथ्वीं समततः /
धातुस्तनोति विस्तारं ततोपतनवः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Because its interior extends (tanute) entirely around the whole earth— / the root tan- means extension—therefore they are remembered as spreading waters.

sanskrit_iast:
śāra ityeva śīrṇe tu nānārtho dhātu rucyate /
ekārṇave bhavantyāpo na śīrṇāstena tā narāḥ //
meaning:
शार इत्येव शीर्णे तु नानार्थो धातु रुच्यते /
एकार्णवे भवन्त्यापो न शीर्णास्तेन ता नराः //
text_mt: 'Śāra' is said of what is shattered, a root with various meanings; / the waters in the single ocean are not shattered (na śīrṇāḥ), and therefore they are called 'nāra'.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmin yugasahasrānte saṃsthite brahmaṇo 'hani /
tāvatkālaṃ rajanyāṃ ca vartantyāṃ salilātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन् युगसहस्रान्ते संस्थिते ब्रह्मणो ऽहनि /
तावत्कालं रजन्यां च वर्तन्त्यां सलिलात्मनः //
text_mt: At the end of that thousand-yuga period, when the day of Brahmā has ended, / and as the night of the watery one lasts for that same length of time,

sanskrit_iast:
tataste salile tasmin naṣṭāgnau pṛthivītale /
praśāntavāte 'ndhakāre nirāloke samantataḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते सलिले तस्मिन् नष्टाग्नौ पृथिवीतले /
प्रशान्तवाते ऽन्धकारे निरालोके समन्ततः //
text_mt: then, in that water, when fire has perished on the surface of the earth, / when the wind has subsided, in complete darkness, devoid of light on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
yenaivādhiṣṭhitaṃ hīdaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ /
vibhāgamasya lokasya prakartuṃ punaraicchata //
meaning:
येनैवाधिष्ठितं हीदं ब्रह्मणः पुरुषः प्रभुः /
विभागमस्य लोकस्य प्रकर्तुं पुनरैच्छत //
text_mt: by whom this [universe] was indeed presided over, the Lord, the Puruṣa of Brahman, / desired once again to effect the division of this world.

sanskrit_iast:
śāra ityeva śīrṇe tu nānārtho dhātu rucyate /
ekarṇave tatastasminnaṣṭe sthāvara jaṅgame /
tadā bhavati sa brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt //
meaning:
शार इत्येव शीर्णे तु नानार्थो धातु रुच्यते /
एकर्णवे ततस्तस्मिन्नष्टे स्थावर जङ्गमे /
तदा भवति स ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् //
text_mt: 'Śāra' is said of what is shattered, a root with various meanings; / then, when the moving and unmoving had perished in that single ocean, / that Brahmā becomes thousand-eyed and thousand-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ /
brahmā nārāyaṇā khyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णो ह्यतीन्द्रियः /
ब्रह्मा नारायणा ख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा //
text_mt: a thousand-headed Puruṣa, gold-hued and beyond the senses; / called Brahmā and Nārāyaṇa, he then slept upon the water.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvodrekātprabuddhastu sa śūnyaṃ lokamaikṣata /
anenādyena pādena purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge prathame prakriyāpāde lokakalpanaṃ nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सत्त्वोद्रेकात्प्रबुद्धस्तु स शून्यं लोकमैक्षत /
अनेनाद्येन पादेन पुराणं परिकीर्तितम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे प्रथमे प्रक्रियापादे लोककल्पनं नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Awakened by an excess of sattva, he beheld the empty world. / Through this first quarter the Purāṇa has been proclaimed.

Thus ends the fifth chapter, named 'The Formation of the World', in the first [part], the Prakriyāpāda, in the first section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ityevaṃ prathamaṃ pādaṃ prakṛtyarthaṃ prakīrtitam /
śrutvā tu saṃhṛṣṭamanāḥ kāpeyaḥ saṃśayāyati //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
इत्येवं प्रथमं पादं प्रकृत्यर्थं प्रकीर्तितम् /
श्रुत्वा तु संहृष्टमनाः कापेयः संशयायति //
text_mt: The bard said: / "Thus the first quarter, dealing with the fundamental matter (prakṛti), has been proclaimed. / Having heard it, Kāpeya, glad at heart, was filled with doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya vacasā sūtaṃ tasyārtha tvaparāṃ kathām /
atha prabṛti kalpajñaḥ pratisaṃdhiḥ pracakṣate //
meaning:
आराध्य वचसा सूतं तस्यार्थ त्वपरां कथाम् /
अथ प्रबृति कल्पज्ञः प्रतिसंधिः प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: Propitiating the bard with words [to hear] another discourse for its sake: / 'Now, O knower of kalpas, they declare a transition (pratisaṃdhi)

sanskrit_iast:
