text_mt: Of the thousand rays of the sun that were previously mentioned by me, / seven rays are supreme, as the sources of the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumṇo harikeśaśca viśvakarmā tathaiva ca /
viśvaśravāḥ punaścānyaḥ saṃpadvasurataḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
सुषुम्णो हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथैव च /
विश्वश्रवाः पुनश्चान्यः संपद्वसुरतः परः //
text_mt: Suṣumṇa and Harikeśa, and likewise Viśvakarman; / Viśvaśravas is another, and after that Saṃpadvasu;

sanskrit_iast:
arvāvasuḥ punaścānyaḥ svarāḍanyaḥ prakīrttitaḥ /
suṣumṇaḥ sūryaraśmistu kṣīṇa śaśinamedhayet //
meaning:
अर्वावसुः पुनश्चान्यः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्त्तितः /
सुषुम्णः सूर्यरश्मिस्तु क्षीण शशिनमेधयेत् //
text_mt: Arvāvasu is another, and Svarāj is proclaimed as another. / The solar ray Suṣumṇa nourishes the waning moon;

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagūrdhvapracāro 'sau suṣumṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥ /
hari keśaḥ purastādya ṛkṣayoniḥ sa kītyate //
meaning:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वप्रचारो ऽसौ सुषुम्णः परिकीर्त्तितः /
हरि केशः पुरस्ताद्य ऋक्षयोनिः स कीत्यते //
text_mt: that Suṣumṇa is proclaimed to move obliquely and upward. / That which is in the east, Harikeśa, is declared to be the source of the asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe viśvakarmā tu raśminvarddhayate vudham /
viśvaśravāstu yaḥ paścacchukrayoniḥ smṛto budhaiḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा तु रश्मिन्वर्द्धयते वुधम् /
विश्वश्रवास्तु यः पश्चच्छुक्रयोनिः स्मृतो बुधैः //
text_mt: In the south, the ray Viśvakarman fosters Mercury. / Viśvaśravas, in the west, is remembered by the wise as the source of Venus.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpadvasustu yo raśmiḥ sa yonirlohitasya tu /
ṣaṣṭhastvarvvāvasū raśmiryonistu sa bṛhaspateḥ //
meaning:
संपद्वसुस्तु यो रश्मिः स योनिर्लोहितस्य तु /
षष्ठस्त्वर्व्वावसू रश्मिर्योनिस्तु स बृहस्पतेः //
text_mt: The ray Saṃpadvasu is the source of Mars; / and the sixth ray, Arvāvasu, is the source of Jupiter.

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaraṃpuna ścāpi raśmirāpyāyate svarāṭ /
evaṃ sūryaprabhāveṇa grahanakṣatratārakāḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरंपुन श्चापि रश्मिराप्यायते स्वराट् /
एवं सूर्यप्रभावेण ग्रहनक्षत्रतारकाः //
text_mt: The ray Svarāj nourishes Saturn. / Thus by the majesty of the sun, all the planets, asterisms, and stars

sanskrit_iast:
vartnte divi tāḥ sarvā viśvaṃ caidaṃ punarjagat /
nakṣīyante yatastāni tasmānnakṣatrasaṃjñitāḥ //
meaning:
वर्त्न्ते दिवि ताः सर्वा विश्वं चैदं पुनर्जगत् /
नक्षीयन्ते यतस्तानि तस्मान्नक्षत्रसंज्ञिताः //
text_mt: abide in the sky, as well as this entire universe. / Because they do not perish (na kṣīyante), they are called asterisms (nakṣatra).

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrāṇyetāni vai pūrvamāpatanti gabhastibhiḥ /
teṣāṃ kṣetrāṇyathādatte sūryo nakṣatrakārakāḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्राण्येतानि वै पूर्वमापतन्ति गभस्तिभिः /
तेषां क्षेत्राण्यथादत्ते सूर्यो नक्षत्रकारकाः //
text_mt: These fields indeed formerly fall down with rays. / The sun, the maker of the asterisms, takes up their fields.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrṇānāṃ sukṛteneha sukṛtānte grahāśrayāt /
tāraṇāttārakā hyetāḥ śuklatvāccaiva tārakāḥ //
meaning:
तीर्णानां सुकृतेनेह सुकृतान्ते ग्रहाश्रयात् /
तारणात्तारका ह्येताः शुक्लत्वाच्चैव तारकाः //
text_mt: For those who have crossed over by virtue of good deeds here, at the end of their merit, on account of their resort to the planets, / because they cause crossing over (tāraṇa) and because of their brightness, these are called stars (tārakā).

sanskrit_iast:
divyānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca naiśānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ /
ādānānnityamādityastejasā tapasāmapi //
meaning:
दिव्यानां पार्थिवानां च नैशानां चैव सर्वशः /
आदानान्नित्यमादित्यस्तेजसा तपसामपि //
text_mt: Because he constantly takes away from the celestial, terrestrial, and nocturnal [entities] in every way, / [and takes away] from the luminaries and their austerities, he is Āditya.

sanskrit_iast:
svanaṃ syandanārthe cu dhātureṣu vibhāvyate /
svanāttejaso 'pāṃ ca tenāsau savitā mataḥ //
meaning:
स्वनं स्यन्दनार्थे चु धातुरेषु विभाव्यते /
स्वनात्तेजसो ऽपां च तेनासौ सविता मतः //
text_mt: The verbal root *svan* is considered among these in the sense of flowing. / From the flowing of brilliance and water, he is therefore considered Savitṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
bahvarthaścadirityeṣa hlādane dhāturucyate /
śuklatve cāmṛtatve ca śītatve ca vibhāvyate //
meaning:
बह्वर्थश्चदिरित्येष ह्लादने धातुरुच्यते /
शुक्लत्वे चामृतत्वे च शीतत्वे च विभाव्यते //
text_mt: The root *cand*, having many meanings, is said to be in the sense of gladdening; / and it is recognized in whiteness, in nectar-like nature, and in coolness.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryācandramaso rdivye maṇḍale bhāsvare khage /
jalatecaumaye śukle vṛttakuṃbhanibhe śubhe //
meaning:
सूर्याचन्द्रमसो र्दिव्ये मण्डले भास्वरे खगे /
जलतेचौमये शुक्ले वृत्तकुंभनिभे शुभे //
text_mt: The divine, luminous discs of the sun and the moon move in the sky; / they are composed of water and fire, white, resembling round water-jars, and auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
ghanatoyātmakaṃ tatra maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam /
ghanatejomayaṃ śuklaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhāskarasya tu //
meaning:
घनतोयात्मकं तत्र मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम् /
घनतेजोमयं शुक्लं मण्डलं भास्करस्य तु //
text_mt: The disc of the moon is remembered there as consisting of concentrated water; / but the disc of the sun is white, consisting of concentrated fire.

sanskrit_iast:
viśanti sarvadevāstu sthānānyetāni sarvaśaḥ /
manvantareṣu sarveṣu ṛkṣasūryagrahāśrayāḥ //
meaning:
विशन्ति सर्वदेवास्तु स्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः /
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु ऋक्षसूर्यग्रहाश्रयाः //
text_mt: All the gods enter into these abodes everywhere, / taking resort in the asterisms, the sun, and the planets in all manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni devagṛhāṇyeva tadākhyāste bhavanti ca /
sauraṃ sūryo viśetsthānaṃ saumyaṃ somastathaiva ca //
meaning:
तानि देवगृहाण्येव तदाख्यास्ते भवन्ति च /
सौरं सूर्यो विशेत्स्थानं सौम्यं सोमस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Those are indeed the houses of the gods, and they bear those names: / the sun enters the solar abode, and Soma enters the lunar [abode] likewise;

sanskrit_iast:
śaukraṃ śukro viśetsthānaṃ ṣoḍa śārciḥ prabhāsvaram /
jaivaṃ bṛhaspatiścaiva lauhitaṃ caiva lohitaḥ //
meaning:
शौक्रं शुक्रो विशेत्स्थानं षोड शार्चिः प्रभास्वरम् /
जैवं बृहस्पतिश्चैव लौहितं चैव लोहितः //
text_mt: Venus enters the luminous abode of Venus possessing sixteen rays; / Jupiter [enters] the Jovian abode, and Mars [enters] the Martian;

sanskrit_iast:
śanaiścaro rviśetsthānaṃ devaḥ śānaiscaraṃ tathā /
baudhaṃ budho 'tha svarbhānuḥ svarbhānusthānamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
शनैश्चरो र्विशेत्स्थानं देवः शानैस्चरं तथा /
बौधं बुधो ऽथ स्वर्भानुः स्वर्भानुस्थानमास्थितः //
text_mt: the god Saturn enters the Saturnian abode; / Mercury [enters] the Mercurial, and Svarbhānu stays in the abode of Svarbhānu;

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi viśantyuta /
gṛhāṇyetāni sarvāṇi jyotīṃṣi sukṛtātma nām //
meaning:
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि विशन्त्युत /
गृहाण्येतानि सर्वाणि ज्योतींषि सुकृतात्म नाम् //
text_mt: and all the asterisms enter the asterisms. / All these luminaries are houses for the virtuous-souled [beings].

sanskrit_iast:
kalpādau saṃpravṛttāni nirmitāni svayaṃbhuvā /
sthānānyetāni tiṣṭhanti yāvadātrūtasaṃplavam //
meaning:
कल्पादौ संप्रवृत्तानि निर्मितानि स्वयंभुवा /
स्थानान्येतानि तिष्ठन्ति यावदात्रूतसंप्लवम् //
text_mt: Brought forth at the beginning of the kalpa, created by Svayambhū, / these abodes remain until the dissolution of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu sarveṣu devasthānāni tāni vai /
abhimānino 'vatiṣṭhante devasthānāni vai punaḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवस्थानानि तानि वै /
अभिमानिनो ऽवतिष्ठन्ते देवस्थानानि वै पुनः //
text_mt: In all manvantaras, those are the abodes of the gods; / and again the presiding deities abide in the abodes of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
atītaistu sahātītā bhāvyā bhāvyaiḥ suraiḥ saha /
varttante varttamānaiśca sthānibhistaiḥ suraiḥ saha /
asminmanvantare caiva grahā vaitānikāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अतीतैस्तु सहातीता भाव्या भाव्यैः सुरैः सह /
वर्त्तन्ते वर्त्तमानैश्च स्थानिभिस्तैः सुरैः सह /
अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे चैव ग्रहा वैतानिकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Past with past, future with future gods, / and present with present occupants of the abodes, the gods abide. / And in this manvantara, the planets are remembered as sacrifical [deities].

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvānaditeḥ putraḥ sūryo vaivasvate 'ntare /
tviṣināmā dharmasutaḥ somo devo vasuḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे /
त्विषिनामा धर्मसुतः सोमो देवो वसुः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The sun is Vivasvat, son of Aditi, in the Vaivasvata interval; / the god Soma is remembered as the Vasu named Tviṣi, son of Dharma;

sanskrit_iast:
śukro devastu vijñeyo bhārgavo 'surayājakaḥ /
bṛhattejāḥ smṛto devo devācāryo 'gi rassutaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्रो देवस्तु विज्ञेयो भार्गवो ऽसुरयाजकः /
बृहत्तेजाः स्मृतो देवो देवाचार्यो ऽगि रस्सुतः //
text_mt: the god Venus is to be known as Bhārgava, priest of the Asuras; / the god of great radiance, preceptor of the gods, is remembered as the son of Aṅgiras;

sanskrit_iast:
budho manoharaścaiva tviṣiputrastu sa smṛtaḥ /
śanaiścaro virūpastu saṃjñāputro vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
बुधो मनोहरश्चैव त्विषिपुत्रस्तु स स्मृतः /
शनैश्चरो विरूपस्तु संज्ञापुत्रो विवस्वतः //
text_mt: Mercury, the charming one, is remembered as the son of Tviṣi; / Saturn, of deformed appearance, is the son of Vivasvat by Saṃjñā;

sanskrit_iast:
agnervikeśyāṃ jajñe tu yuvāsau lohitādhipaḥ /
nakṣatrāṇyṛkṣanāmāno dākṣāyaṇyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अग्नेर्विकेश्यां जज्ञे तु युवासौ लोहिताधिपः /
नक्षत्राण्यृक्षनामानो दाक्षायण्यस्तु ताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: and that youth, the ruler of Mars, was born to Agni in Vikeśī; / the asterisms, having the names of stars, are remembered as the daughters of Dakṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
svarbhānuḥ siṃhikāputro bhūtasaṃtāpano 'suraḥ /
somarkṣagrahasūryeṣu kīrttitā hyabhimāninaḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्भानुः सिंहिकापुत्रो भूतसंतापनो ऽसुरः /
सोमर्क्षग्रहसूर्येषु कीर्त्तिता ह्यभिमानिनः //
text_mt: Svarbhānu is the Asura, son of Siṃhikā, tormentor of creatures. / These are proclaimed as the presiding deities in the moon, the asterisms, the planets, and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānānyetāni coktāni sthāninaścātha devatāḥ /
śuklamagnimayaṃ sthānaṃ sahasrāṃśorvivasvataḥ //
meaning:
स्थानान्येतानि चोक्तानि स्थानिनश्चाथ देवताः /
शुक्लमग्निमयं स्थानं सहस्रांशोर्विवस्वतः //
text_mt: These abodes have been declared, as well as the deities who occupy them: / the white abode of the thousand-rayed Vivasvat consists of fire;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṃśostviṣeḥ sthānamammayaṃ śuklameva ca /
āpyaṃ śyāmaṃ manojñasya pañcaraśmergṛhaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
सहस्रांशोस्त्विषेः स्थानमम्मयं शुक्लमेव च /
आप्यं श्यामं मनोज्ञस्य पञ्चरश्मेर्गृहं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: the white abode of the thousand-rayed Tviṣi consists of water; / the watery, dark abode of the attractive five-rayed one is remembered as his home;

sanskrit_iast:
śukrasyāpyammayaṃ śuklaṃ padmaṃ ṣauḍaḥśaraśmiṣu /
navaraśmestu bhaumasya lauhitaṃ sthānamammayam //
meaning:
शुक्रस्याप्यम्मयं शुक्लं पद्मं षौडःशरश्मिषु /
नवरश्मेस्तु भौमस्य लौहितं स्थानमम्मयम् //
text_mt: the white lotus-abode among the sixteen-rayed ones belonging to Venus also consists of water; / and the Martian abode of the nine-rayed Mars consists of water;

sanskrit_iast:
haridāpyaṃ bṛhatsthānaṃ dvādaśāṃśairbṛhaspateḥ /
aṣṛ raśmigṛhaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mandasya cāmmayam //
meaning:
हरिदाप्यं बृहत्स्थानं द्वादशांशैर्बृहस्पतेः /
अषृ रश्मिगृहं प्रोक्तं कृष्णं मन्दस्य चाम्मयम् //
text_mt: the large, yellowish-green watery abode of Jupiter has twelve rays; / the watery black abode of Saturn is said to possess eight rays;

sanskrit_iast:
svarbhānostāmasaṃ sthānaṃ bhūtasaṃtāpanālayam /
vijñeyāstārakāḥ sarvā ammayāsttve karaśmayaḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्भानोस्तामसं स्थानं भूतसंतापनालयम् /
विज्ञेयास्तारकाः सर्वा अम्मयास्त्त्वे करश्मयः //
text_mt: the dark abode of Svarbhānu is the residence of the tormentor of creatures. / All the stars are to be known as watery, having one ray each,

sanskrit_iast:
āśrayāḥ puṇyakīrtīnāṃ suśuklāścāpi varṇataḥ /
ghanatoyātmikā jñeyāḥ kalpādāveva nirmitāḥ //
meaning:
आश्रयाः पुण्यकीर्तीनां सुशुक्लाश्चापि वर्णतः /
घनतोयात्मिका ज्ञेयाः कल्पादावेव निर्मिताः //
text_mt: abodes of those of virtuous fame, very white in color, / known to consist of concentrated water, fashioned at the very beginning of the kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaraśmisaṃyogātsaṃprakāśātmikāḥ smṛtāḥ /
navayojanasāhasro viṣkaṃbhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आदित्यरश्मिसंयोगात्संप्रकाशात्मिकाः स्मृताः /
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कंभः सवितुः स्मृतः //
text_mt: By conjunction with the rays of the sun, they are remembered as possessing light. / The diameter of the sun is remembered as nine thousand yojanas;

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇāstasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ /
dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārādvistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिगुणास्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः /
द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद्विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः //
text_mt: in measurement, the circumference of its disc is three times that. / The extent of the moon is remembered as twice the extent of the sun;

sanskrit_iast:
tulyastayostu svarbhānurbhūtvādhastātprasarpati /
uddhṛtya pṛthivīchāyāṃ nirmito maṇḍalākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर्भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति /
उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितो मण्डलाकृतिः //
text_mt: equal to them, Svarbhānu moves underneath; / fashioned in circular shape, taking up the shadow of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
svarbhānostu bṛhatsthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yattamomayam /
ādityāttacca niṣkramya somaṃ gacchati parvasu //
meaning:
स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत्तमोमयम् /
आदित्यात्तच्च निष्क्रम्य सोमं गच्छति पर्वसु //
text_mt: The third large abode, which consists of darkness, belongs to Svarbhānu; / emerging from the sun, it goes to the moon at the syzygies;

sanskrit_iast:
ādityameti somācca punaḥ saureṣu parvasu /
svarbhāsā nudate yasmāttasmātsvarbhānurucyate //
meaning:
आदित्यमेति सोमाच्च पुनः सौरेषु पर्वसु /
स्वर्भासा नुदते यस्मात्तस्मात्स्वर्भानुरुच्यते //
text_mt: and from the moon it goes to the sun again at the solar eclipses. / Because it covers [the sun] with its own radiance, it is called Svarbhānu.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavastu vidhīyate /
viṣkaṃbhānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanāgrātpramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्तु विधीयते /
विष्कंभान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाग्रात्प्रमाणतः //
text_mt: The diameter, disc, and measurement in yojanas of Venus / is determined to be the sixteenth part of the moon;

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ /
bṛhaspateḥ pāda hīnau bhaumasaurāvubhau smṛtau //
meaning:
भार्गवात्पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः /
बृहस्पतेः पाद हीनौ भौमसौरावुभौ स्मृतौ //
text_mt: Jupiter is to be known as reduced by a quarter from Venus; / Mars and Saturn are both remembered as reduced by a quarter from Jupiter;

sanskrit_iast:
vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ /
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmanti ca yāni vai //
meaning:
विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः /
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्ति च यानि वै //
text_mt: in diameter and disc, Mercury is reduced by a quarter from those two. / As for the forms of the asterisms and stars, which are corporeal,

sanskrit_iast:
budhena samarūpāṇi vistārānmaṇḍalācca vai /
prāyaśaścandrayogīni vidyādṛkṣāṇi tattvavit //
meaning:
बुधेन समरूपाणि विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्च वै /
प्रायशश्चन्द्रयोगीनि विद्यादृक्षाणि तत्त्ववित् //
text_mt: they are equal in form to Mercury in diameter and disc; / the knower of truth should know the asterisms as generally conjoined with the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparāt /
śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane //
meaning:
तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परात् /
शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने //
text_mt: The forms of the asterisms and stars decrease relative to one another / by five hundred, four [hundred], three, and two yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāparanikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni ca /
yojanādyarddhamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
पूर्वापरनिकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि च /
योजनाद्यर्द्धमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते //
text_mt: The eastern and western lower limits of the star clusters / are measured at half a yojana; none smaller than these is known.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭāttrayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ /
sauroṅgirāśca vakraśca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
उपरिष्टात्त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्पिणः /
सौरोङ्गिराश्च वक्रश्च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः //
text_mt: Above them are three planets that move far afield: / Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars, who are known to be slow movers.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'dha stāttu catvāraḥ punareva mahāgrahāḥ /
sūryasomau budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽध स्तात्तु चत्वारः पुनरेव महाग्रहाः /
सूर्यसोमौ बुधश्चैव भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रगाः //
text_mt: Below them, however, are four other great planets: / the Sun, the Moon, Mercury, and Venus, which move swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatyastārakākoṭyo yāvadṛkṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ /
vidhinā niyamāccaiṣāmṛkṣacaryā vyavasthitā //
meaning:
तावत्यस्तारकाकोट्यो यावदृक्षाणि सर्वशः /
विधिना नियमाच्चैषामृक्षचर्या व्यवस्थिता //
text_mt: There are as many crores of stars as there are lunar mansions in every respect; / and the movement of the lunar mansions is fixed according to rule and law.

sanskrit_iast:
gatistāsu ca sūryasya nīcaucce tvayanakramāt /
uttarāyaṇamārgastho yadā parvasu candramāḥ //
meaning:
गतिस्तासु च सूर्यस्य नीचौच्चे त्वयनक्रमात् /
उत्तरायणमार्गस्थो यदा पर्वसु चन्द्रमाः //
text_mt: And the course of the Sun among them is low and high according to the succession of the solstices. / When the Moon is on the northern course at the parvan days,

sanskrit_iast:
uccatvāddṛśyate śīghraṃ nītivyaktairgabhastibhiḥ /
tadā dakṣiṇamārgasyo nīyāṃ vithīmupāśritaḥ //
meaning:
उच्चत्वाद्दृश्यते शीघ्रं नीतिव्यक्तैर्गभस्तिभिः /
तदा दक्षिणमार्गस्यो नीयां विथीमुपाश्रितः //
text_mt: it is seen swiftly because of its height, with its rays clearly brought forth. / Then [the Sun], on the southern course, occupying the lower path,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmi lekhāvṛtaḥ sūryaḥ pūrṇāmāvāsyayoḥ sadā /
na dṛśyate yathākālaṃ śīghramastamupaiti ca //
meaning:
भूमि लेखावृतः सूर्यः पूर्णामावास्ययोः सदा /
न दृश्यते यथाकालं शीघ्रमस्तमुपैति च //
text_mt: covered by the horizon of the earth at the full and new moons, / is not seen at the usual time and quickly goes to its setting.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttaramārgastho hyamāvasyāṃ niśākaraḥ /
dṛśyate dakṣiṇe mārge niyamāddṛśyate na ca //
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तरमार्गस्थो ह्यमावस्यां निशाकरः /
दृश्यते दक्षिणे मार्गे नियमाद्दृश्यते न च //
text_mt: Therefore, when the night-maker [Moon] is on the northern path at the new moon, / it is seen, and on the southern path it is regularly not seen.

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣāṃ gatiyogena sūryācandramasāvṛtaḥ /
samānakālāstamayau viṣuvatsu samodayau //
meaning:
ज्योतिषां गतियोगेन सूर्याचन्द्रमसावृतः /
समानकालास्तमयौ विषुवत्सु समोदयौ //
text_mt: Due to the movement and conjunction of the luminaries, enveloped by the Sun and the Moon, / they have equal time of setting and equal time of rising at the equinoxes.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāsu ca vīthīṣu vyantarāstamanodayau /
pūrṇāmavāsyayorjñoyau jyotiścakrānuvartinau //
meaning:
उत्तरासु च वीथीषु व्यन्तरास्तमनोदयौ /
पूर्णामवास्ययोर्ज्ञोयौ ज्योतिश्चक्रानुवर्तिनौ //
text_mt: And on the northern paths, intermediate setting and rising / on the full and new moon days should be known as following the wheel of the stars.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmivān /
tadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ ca sūryo 'dhastātprasarpati //
meaning:
दक्षिणायनमार्गस्थो यदा चरति रश्मिवान् /
तदा सर्वग्रहाणां च सूर्यो ऽधस्तात्प्रसर्पति //
text_mt: When the ray-bearing [Sun] moves along the path of the southern solstice, / then the Sun glides below all the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
vistīrṇa maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyorddhva carate śaśī /
nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrddhva prasarpati //
meaning:
विस्तीर्ण मण्डलं कृत्वा तस्योर्द्ध्व चरते शशी /
नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं सोमादूर्द्ध्व प्रसर्पति //
text_mt: Making an expanded disc, the Moon moves above it; / the entire circle of asterisms glides above the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrebhyo budhaścorddhra budhādūrddhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ /
vakrastu bhārgavādūrddhva vakrādūrddhvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रेभ्यो बुधश्चोर्द्ध्र बुधादूर्द्ध्वं तु भार्गवः /
वक्रस्तु भार्गवादूर्द्ध्व वक्रादूर्द्ध्वं बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: Mercury is above the asterisms, and Venus is above Mercury; / Mars is above Venus, and Jupiter is above Mars.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchanaiścaraścorddhvaṃ tasmātsaptarṣimaṇḍalam /
ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi saptānāṃ dhruva ūrddhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्छनैश्चरश्चोर्द्ध्वं तस्मात्सप्तर्षिमण्डलम् /
ऋषीणां चापि सप्तानां ध्रुव ऊर्द्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: Saturn is above him, and above that is the circle of the Seven Sages; / and above the seven sages Dhruva is stationed.

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇeṣu sahasreṣu yojanānāṃ śateṣu ca /
tārāgrahāntarāṇi syurupariṣṭādyathākramam //
meaning:
द्विगुणेषु सहस्रेषु योजनानां शतेषु च /
ताराग्रहान्तराणि स्युरुपरिष्टाद्यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: In doubled thousands and hundreds of yojanas / are the intervals between the star-planets above, in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
grahāśca candrasūryauṃ ca divi divyena teja sā /
nityamṛkṣeṣu yujyante gacchanto niyatāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
ग्रहाश्च चन्द्रसूर्यौं च दिवि दिव्येन तेज सा /
नित्यमृक्षेषु युज्यन्ते गच्छन्तो नियताः क्रमात् //
text_mt: The planets and the Moon and the Sun in the sky, endowed with divine splendor, / always join with the asterisms as they travel in fixed order.

sanskrit_iast:
grahanakṣatrasūryāstu nīcoccamṛjavastathā /
samāgame ca bhede ca paśyanti yugapatprajāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहनक्षत्रसूर्यास्तु नीचोच्चमृजवस्तथा /
समागमे च भेदे च पश्यन्ति युगपत्प्रजाः //
text_mt: Planets, asterisms, and the Sun—low, high, and direct— / beings see them all at once in conjunction and separation.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparasthitā hyete yujyante ca parasparam /
asaṃkareṇa vijñeyasteṣāṃ yogastu vai budhaiḥ //
meaning:
परस्परस्थिता ह्येते युज्यन्ते च परस्परम् /
असंकरेण विज्ञेयस्तेषां योगस्तु वै बुधैः //
text_mt: Stationed mutually, they unite with one another; / their conjunction is to be understood without confusion by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ sanniveśo vai vṛthivyā jyautiṣasya ca /
dvipānāmudadhīnāṃ ca parvatānāṃ tthaiva ca //
meaning:
इत्येवं सन्निवेशो वै वृथिव्या ज्यौतिषस्य च /
द्विपानामुदधीनां च पर्वतानां त्थैव च //
text_mt: Such indeed is the arrangement of the earth and the luminaries, / and likewise of the continents, oceans, and mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca ye ca teṣu vasaṃti vai /
eteṣveva grahāḥ sarve nakṣatreṣu samutthitāḥ //
meaning:
वर्षाणां च नदीनां च ये च तेषु वसंति वै /
एतेष्वेव ग्रहाः सर्वे नक्षत्रेषु समुत्थिताः //
text_mt: and of the realms and the rivers, and of those who dwell in them; / in these very lunar mansions all the planets arose.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvānaditeḥ putraḥ sūryo vai cākṣuṣeṃ'tare /
viśākhāsu samutpanno grahāṇāṃ prathamo grahaḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वै चाक्षुषेंऽतरे /
विशाखासु समुत्पन्नो ग्रहाणां प्रथमो ग्रहः //
text_mt: Vivasvat, the son of Aditi, the Sun in the Cākṣuṣa manvantara, / was born in the Viśākhās, the first planet among the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tviṣimān dharmaputrastu somo devo vasossutaḥ /
śītaraśmiḥ samutpannaḥ kṛttikāsu niśākaraḥ //
meaning:
त्विषिमान् धर्मपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसोस्सुतः /
शीतरश्मिः समुत्पन्नः कृत्तिकासु निशाकरः //
text_mt: The radiant Moon, the god who is the son of Dharma, the child of Vasu, / the cool-rayed night-maker, was born in the Kṛttikās.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśārcirbhṛgoḥ putraḥ śukraḥ sūryādanantaram /
tārāgrahāṇāṃ pravarastiṣyaṛkṣe samutthitaḥ //
meaning:
षोडशार्चिर्भृगोः पुत्रः शुक्रः सूर्यादनन्तरम् /
ताराग्रहाणां प्रवरस्तिष्यऋक्षे समुत्थितः //
text_mt: Venus, the son of Bhṛgu, possessing sixteen rays, immediately after the Sun, / the best among the star-planets, arose in the asterism Tiṣya.

sanskrit_iast:
grahaścāṅgirasaḥ putro dvādaśārcirbṛhaspatiḥ /
phālgunīṣu samutpannaḥ pūrvāsu ca jagadguruḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहश्चाङ्गिरसः पुत्रो द्वादशार्चिर्बृहस्पतिः /
फाल्गुनीषु समुत्पन्नः पूर्वासु च जगद्गुरुः //
text_mt: The planet Jupiter, the son of Aṅgiras, possessing twelve rays, / the teacher of the world, was born in Pūrvaphālgunī.

sanskrit_iast:
navārcirlohitāṅgaśca prajāpatisuto grahaḥ /
āṣāḍhāsviha pūrvāsu samutpanna iti śrutiḥ //
meaning:
नवार्चिर्लोहिताङ्गश्च प्रजापतिसुतो ग्रहः /
आषाढास्विह पूर्वासु समुत्पन्न इति श्रुतिः //
text_mt: Mars, the red-bodied planet with nine rays, the son of Prajāpati, / was born here in Pūrvāṣāḍhā—such is the sacred tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
revatīṣveva saptārcistathā sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ /
saumyo budho dhaniṣṭhāsu pañcārcirudito grahaḥ //
meaning:
रेवतीष्वेव सप्तार्चिस्तथा सौरिः शनैश्चरः /
सौम्यो बुधो धनिष्ठासु पञ्चार्चिरुदितो ग्रहः //
text_mt: Saturn, the son of the Sun, possessing seven rays, [was born] in Revatī; / the gentle Mercury, possessing five rays, arose as a planet in Dhaniṣṭhā.

sanskrit_iast:
tamomayo mṛtyusutaḥ prajākṣayakaraḥ śikhī /
ārśleṣāsu samutpannaḥ sarvahārī mahāgrahaḥ //
meaning:
तमोमयो मृत्युसुतः प्रजाक्षयकरः शिखी /
आर्श्लेषासु समुत्पन्नः सर्वहारी महाग्रहः //
text_mt: The great planet Ketu, composed of darkness, son of Death, causing the destruction of creatures, / taking away everything, was born in Āśleṣā.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā svanāmadheyeṣu dākṣāyaṇyaḥ samuchritāḥ /
tamovīryamayo rāhuḥ prakṛtyā kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
तथा स्वनामधेयेषु दाक्षायण्यः समुछ्रिताः /
तमोवीर्यमयो राहुः प्रकृत्या कृष्णमण्डलः //
text_mt: Likewise, in those [asterisms] having their own names, the daughters of Dakṣa were established; / Rāhu, consisting of dark energy, is by nature a black disc.

sanskrit_iast:
bharaṇīṣu samutpanno grahaścandrārkamarddanaḥ /
ete tārā grahāścāpi boddhavyā bhārgavādayaḥ //
meaning:
भरणीषु समुत्पन्नो ग्रहश्चन्द्रार्कमर्द्दनः /
एते तारा ग्रहाश्चापि बोद्धव्या भार्गवादयः //
text_mt: The planet that crushes the Moon and Sun was born in Bharaṇī; / and these star-planets too, Venus and the rest, should be understood.

sanskrit_iast:
janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu yānti vaiguṇyatāṃ yataḥ /
spṛśyante tena doṣeṇa tatastadgrahabhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
जन्मनक्षत्रपीडासु यान्ति वैगुण्यतां यतः /
स्पृश्यन्ते तेन दोषेण ततस्तद्ग्रहभक्तितः //
text_mt: Since they go into deficiency in afflictions of the birth-asterism, / creatures are touched by that fault from their devotion to that planet.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagrahāṇāmeteṣāmādirāditya ucyate /
tārāgrahāṇāṃ śukrastu ketūnāmapi dhūmavān //
meaning:
सर्वग्रहाणामेतेषामादिरादित्य उच्यते /
ताराग्रहाणां शुक्रस्तु केतूनामपि धूमवान् //
text_mt: The Sun is called the first of all these planets, / Venus of the star-planets, and the smoky one [Dhūmaketu] of the comets.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaḥ kīlo grahāṇāṃ tu vibhaktānāṃ caturddiśam /
nakṣatrāṇāṃ śraviṣṭhā syādayanānāṃ tathottaram //
meaning:
ध्रुवः कीलो ग्रहाणां तु विभक्तानां चतुर्द्दिशम् /
नक्षत्राणां श्रविष्ठा स्यादयनानां तथोत्तरम् //
text_mt: Dhruva is the pivot for the planets distributed in the four directions; / Śraviṣṭhā is the first of the asterisms, and the northern is the first of the solstices.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣāṇāṃ cāpi pañcānāmādyaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ /
ṛtūnāṃ śiśiraścāpi māsānāṃ māgha eva ca //
meaning:
वर्षाणां चापि पञ्चानामाद्यः संवत्सरः स्मृतः /
ऋतूनां शिशिरश्चापि मासानां माघ एव च //
text_mt: Saṃvatsara is remembered as the first of the five years; / Śiśira of the seasons, and Māgha of the months.

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣāṇāṃ śuklapakṣaśca tithīnāṃ pratipattathā /
ahorātravibhāgānāmahaścāpi prakīrtitam //
meaning:
पक्षाणां शुक्लपक्षश्च तिथीनां प्रतिपत्तथा /
अहोरात्रविभागानामहश्चापि प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The bright fortnight of the fortnights, and Pratipat of the lunar days; / and of the divisions of day and night, the day is proclaimed [the first].

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrttānāṃ tathaivādirmuhūrtto rudradaivataḥ /
kṣaṇaścāpi nimeṣādiḥ kālaḥ kālavidāṃ varāḥ //
meaning:
मुहूर्त्तानां तथैवादिर्मुहूर्त्तो रुद्रदैवतः /
क्षणश्चापि निमेषादिः कालः कालविदां वराः //
text_mt: Likewise, the first of muhūrtas is the muhūrta whose deity is Rudra; / and kṣaṇa, beginning with the twinkling of an eye, is time, O best of the knowers of time.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇāntaṃ dhaniṣṭhādi yugaṃ syātpañcavārṣikam /
bhānorgativiśeṣeṇa cakravatparivarttate //
meaning:
श्रवणान्तं धनिष्ठादि युगं स्यात्पञ्चवार्षिकम् /
भानोर्गतिविशेषेण चक्रवत्परिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: The five-year cycle begins with Dhaniṣṭhā and ends with Śravaṇa; / it revolves like a wheel by the special motion of the Sun.

sanskrit_iast:
divākaraḥ smṛtastasmātkālastadvidbhirīśvaraḥ /
caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ pravarttakanivarttakaḥ //
meaning:
दिवाकरः स्मृतस्तस्मात्कालस्तद्विद्भिरीश्वरः /
चतुर्विधानां भूतानां प्रवर्त्तकनिवर्त्तकः //
text_mt: Therefore the Sun is remembered as the lord of time by those who know it, / the promoter and withdrawer of the four kinds of living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi bhagavānrudraḥ sākṣāddevaḥ pravarttakaḥ /
ityeṣa jyotiṣāmeva saṃniveśor'thaniścayāt //
meaning:
तस्यापि भगवान्रुद्रः साक्षाद्देवः प्रवर्त्तकः /
इत्येष ज्योतिषामेव संनिवेशोर्ऽथनिश्चयात् //
text_mt: Even of him, the blessed Rudra, the manifest god, is the instigator. / This arrangement of the luminaries, determined by its purpose,

sanskrit_iast:
lokasaṃvyavahārārtha mīśvareṇa vinirmitaḥ /
uttarāśravaṇenāsau saṃkṣiptaśca dhruve tathā //
meaning:
लोकसंव्यवहारार्थ मीश्वरेण विनिर्मितः /
उत्तराश्रवणेनासौ संक्षिप्तश्च ध्रुवे तथा //
text_mt: was fashioned by the Lord for the sake of worldly activity; / it was drawn together by the northern Śravaṇa and thus in Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatasteṣu vistīrṇo vṛttākāra iva sthitaḥ /
buddhibūrvaṃ bhāgavatā kalpadau saṃpravarttitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वतस्तेषु विस्तीर्णो वृत्ताकार इव स्थितः /
बुद्धिबूर्वं भागवता कल्पदौ संप्रवर्त्तितः //
text_mt: Expanded among them on all sides, standing as if circular in form, / it was set in motion deliberately by the Lord at the beginning of the kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
sāśrayaḥ so 'bhimānī ca sarvasya jyotiṣātmakaḥ /
vaiśvarūpapradhānasya pariṇāmo 'yamadbhutaḥ //
meaning:
साश्रयः सो ऽभिमानी च सर्वस्य ज्योतिषात्मकः /
वैश्वरूपप्रधानस्य परिणामो ऽयमद्भुतः //
text_mt: Having a support, possessing self-consciousness, of the nature of luminaries for everything, / this is the wondrous transformation of the primordial matter having all forms.

sanskrit_iast:
naitacchakyaṃ prasaṃkhyātuṃ yāthātathyena kenacit /
gatāgataṃ manuṣyeṇa jyotiṣāṃ sāṃsacakṣuṣā //
meaning:
नैतच्छक्यं प्रसंख्यातुं याथातथ्येन केनचित् /
गतागतं मनुष्येण ज्योतिषां सांसचक्षुषा //
text_mt: This coming and going of the luminaries cannot be properly calculated / in its true nature by any human being with the physical eye.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamādanumā nācca pratyakṣadupapattitaḥ /
parikṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā śraddhātavyaṃ vipaścitā //
meaning:
आगमादनुमा नाच्च प्रत्यक्षदुपपत्तितः /
परिक्ष्य निपुणं बुद्ध्या श्रद्धातव्यं विपश्चिता //
text_mt: From tradition, from inference, from direct perception, and from logical proof, / examining it skillfully with intellect, the wise person should have faith.

sanskrit_iast:
cakṣuḥ śāstraṃ jalaṃ lekhyaṃ gaṇitaṃ buddhivittamāḥ /
pañcaite hetavo viprā jyotirgaṇavivecane //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde jyotiṣāṃ sanniveśaṃnaṃ nāma caturviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
चक्षुः शास्त्रं जलं लेख्यं गणितं बुद्धिवित्तमाः /
पञ्चैते हेतवो विप्रा ज्योतिर्गणविवेचने //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे ज्योतिषां सन्निवेशंनं नाम चतुर्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The eye, the treatise, water, the diagram, and calculation, O best of the intelligent— / these five are the means, O brāhmaṇas, for discerning the host of luminaries.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, called 'The Arrangement of the Luminaries', in the second part, the Anuṣaṅgapāda, of the earlier half of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etadukvā mahābuddhirvāyurllokahite rataḥ /
jjāpa japyaṃ bhagavānmadhyaṃ prāpte divākare //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतदुक्वा महाबुद्धिर्वायुर्ल्लोकहिते रतः /
ज्जाप जप्यं भगवान्मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे //
text_mt:
The bard said:
Having spoken this, the very wise Vāyu, intent on the welfare of the world, / recited the sacred prayer when the Sun reached the zenith.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayaścāpi te sarve ye tatrāsansamāgatāḥ /
te sarve niyatātmānastasthuḥ prāñjalayastathā //
meaning:
ऋषयश्चापि ते सर्वे ये तत्रासन्समागताः /
ते सर्वे नियतात्मानस्तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयस्तथा //
text_mt: And all those sages who were assembled there, / with controlled minds, all stood with joined palms.

sanskrit_iast:
ya ijyo niyamasyānte prāṇināṃ jīvanaḥ prabhuḥ /
nīlakaṇṭha namaste 'stu ityuvāca sadāgatiḥ //
meaning:
य इज्यो नियमस्यान्ते प्राणिनां जीवनः प्रभुः /
नीलकण्ठ नमस्ते ऽस्तु इत्युवाच सदागतिः //
text_mt: "He who is to be worshipped at the conclusion of restraint, the lord who is the life of living beings: / Salutations to you, O Nīlakaṇṭha!"—thus spoke the Wind-god (Sadāgati).

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu bhāvitātmāno munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ /
vālakhilyeti vikhyātāḥ pataṅgasahacāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु भावितात्मानो मुनयः शंसितव्रताः /
वालखिल्येति विख्याताः पतङ्गसहचारिणः //
text_mt: Having heard this, the self-controlled sages of renowned vows, / celebrated as the Vālakhilyas, who accompany the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāmi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām /
te sma pṛcchanti vāyu ca vāyuparṇāṃbu bhojanāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्रामि ऋषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् /
ते स्म पृच्छन्ति वायु च वायुपर्णांबु भोजनाः //
text_mt: Eighty-eight thousand sages of upward-drawn semen, / who fed on wind, fallen leaves, and water, questioned the Wind:

sanskrit_iast:
nīlakaṇṭheti yatproktaṃ tvayā pavanasattama /
etadguhyaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ puṣṇaṃ puṇyavidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
नीलकण्ठेति यत्प्रोक्तं त्वया पवनसत्तम /
एतद्गुह्यं पवित्राणां पुष्णं पुण्यविदां वरः //
text_mt: "That which was spoken by you, O best of winds, as 'Nīlakaṇṭha', / this secret of purifying secrets nourishes the best of those who know merit.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvayaṃ śrotumicchāma stanno nigada sattama /
tatsarva śrotumicchāmastvatprasādātprabhañjana //
meaning:
तद्वयं श्रोतुमिच्छाम स्तन्नो निगद सत्तम /
तत्सर्व श्रोतुमिच्छामस्त्वत्प्रसादात्प्रभञ्जन //
text_mt: We wish to hear that; declare it to us, O best one! / We wish to hear all of that through your grace, O Prabhañjana!

sanskrit_iast:
nīlatā yena kaṇṭhasya kāraṇenāṃvikāpateḥ /
śrotumicchāmahe deva tava vaktrādviśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
नीलता येन कण्ठस्य कारणेनांविकापतेः /
श्रोतुमिच्छामहे देव तव वक्त्राद्विशेषतः //
text_mt: The reason why the throat of Ambikā's lord is blue— / we wish to hear this, O divine one, specifically from your mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadvācaḥ pravarttante sarvāstāḥ preritastvayā /
varṇasthānagate vāyo vāgvidhiḥ saṃpravarttate //
meaning:
यावद्वाचः प्रवर्त्तन्ते सर्वास्ताः प्रेरितस्त्वया /
वर्णस्थानगते वायो वाग्विधिः संप्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: As far as utterances proceed, all of them are impelled by you; / when air reaches the points of articulation, the function of speech begins.

sanskrit_iast:
jñāna pūrvamathotsāhastvatto vāyo pravarttate /
tvayi niṣpūyamāne tu śeṣā varṇapravṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञान पूर्वमथोत्साहस्त्वत्तो वायो प्रवर्त्तते /
त्वयि निष्पूयमाने तु शेषा वर्णप्रवृत्तयः //
text_mt: Determination preceded by knowledge arises from you, O Wind; / and when you are directed outward, the other actions of phonemes proceed.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra vāco nivarttante dehavarṇāśca durlabhāḥ /
tvatto hi varṇasadbhāvaḥ sarvagastvaṃ sadānila //
meaning:
यत्र वाचो निवर्त्तन्ते देहवर्णाश्च दुर्लभाः /
त्वत्तो हि वर्णसद्भावः सर्वगस्त्वं सदानिल //
text_mt: Where speech ceases and the body's complexion is lost, / the existence of syllables indeed comes from you; you are all-pervading, O constant wind!

sanskrit_iast:
nānyaḥ sarvagato devastvadṛte 'sti samīraṇa /
eṣa vai jīvalokaste pratyakṣaḥ sarvato 'nila //
meaning:
नान्यः सर्वगतो देवस्त्वदृते ऽस्ति समीरण /
एष वै जीवलोकस्ते प्रत्यक्षः सर्वतो ऽनिल //
text_mt: No other deity is all-pervading besides you, O Samīraṇa; / this world of living beings is directly evident to you on every side, O wind!

sanskrit_iast:
vettha vācaspatiṃ devaṃ manonāyakamīśvaram /
brūhi tatkaṇṭhadeśe tu kiṃ kṛtvā rūpavikriyā //
meaning:
वेत्थ वाचस्पतिं देवं मनोनायकमीश्वरम् /
ब्रूहि तत्कण्ठदेशे तु किं कृत्वा रूपविक्रिया //
text_mt: You know the god who is the lord of speech, the lord of the mind, the sovereign ruler. / Tell us what caused the transformation of color in his throat region?"

sanskrit_iast:
vacaḥ śrutvā tatasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanāma /
pratyuvāca mahātejā vāyurllokanamaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
वचः श्रुत्वा ततस्तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम /
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा वायुर्ल्लोकनमस्कृतः //
text_mt: Having heard that speech of those self-controlled sages, / the glorious Wind, revered by all the worlds, replied:

sanskrit_iast:
purā kṛtayuge vipro vedanirṇayatatparaḥ /
vasiṣṭho nāma dharmātmā mānaso vai prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
पुरा कृतयुगे विप्रो वेदनिर्णयतत्परः /
वसिष्ठो नाम धर्मात्मा मानसो वै प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: "Long ago in the Kṛtayuga, a brāhmaṇa devoted to the ascertainment of the Vedas, / the righteous Vasiṣṭha by name, a mind-born Prajāpati,

sanskrit_iast:
papraccha kārttikeyaṃ vai mayūravaravāhanam /
mahiṣāsuranārīṇāṃ nayanāñjanataskaram //
meaning:
पप्रच्छ कार्त्तिकेयं वै मयूरवरवाहनम् /
महिषासुरनारीणां नयनाञ्जनतस्करम् //
text_mt: Questioned Kārttikeya, who rides the excellent peacock, / who stole the eye-collyrium from the wives of the demon Mahiṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsenaṃ mahātmanaṃ meghastanitanisvanam /
umāmanaḥ praharṣāṇāṃ bārakacchadmarūpiṇam //
meaning:
महासेनं महात्मनं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम् /
उमामनः प्रहर्षाणां बारकच्छद्मरूपिणम् //
text_mt: Mahāsena of great soul, whose voice is like the rumbling of a cloud, / who delights the mind of Umā, appearing under the guise of a boy,

sanskrit_iast:
kraiñcajīvitahartāraṃ gaurīhṛdayanandanam /
yadetaddṛśyate varya śubhraṃ śubhrāñjanopamam //
meaning:
क्रैञ्चजीवितहर्तारं गौरीहृदयनन्दनम् /
यदेतद्दृश्यते वर्य शुभ्रं शुभ्राञ्जनोपमम् //
text_mt: The slayer of Krauñca, the joy of Gaurī's heart: / 'That which is seen, O excellent one, dark like white collyrium [mixed with black],

sanskrit_iast:
tatkimarthaṃ samutpannaṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhekundendusaprabhe /
etaddīptāṃya dāntāya bhaktāya brūhi pṛcchate //
meaning:
तत्किमर्थं समुत्पन्नं कण्ठे कण्ठेकुन्देन्दुसप्रभे /
एतद्दीप्तांय दान्ताय भक्ताय ब्रूहि पृच्छते //
text_mt: For what reason did that arise on the throat that is radiant like jasmine and the moon? / Tell this to me, who am ardent, self-subdued, devoted, and asking.

sanskrit_iast:
kathāṃ maṅgalasaṃyuktāṃ pavitrāṃ pāpanāśinīm /
matpriyārthaṃmahābhāga vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
कथां मङ्गलसंयुक्तां पवित्रां पापनाशिनीम् /
मत्प्रियार्थंमहाभाग वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः //
text_mt: A story joined with auspiciousness, purifying and destroying sin: / you ought to tell it completely for my pleasure, O fortunate one!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasya vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ /
pratyuvāca mahātejā devāribalasūdanaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्य वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः /
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा देवारिबलसूदनः //
text_mt: Having heard those words of that great-souled Vasiṣṭha, / the glorious slayer of the armies of the gods' enemies replied:

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇuṣva vadatāṃ śreṣṭakathyamānaṃ vaco mama /
umotsaṃgopaviṣṭena yathāpūrvaṃ mayā śrutam //
meaning:
शृणुष्व वदतां श्रेष्टकथ्यमानं वचो मम /
उमोत्संगोपविष्टेन यथापूर्वं मया श्रुतम् //
text_mt: 'Listen to my words being spoken, O best of speakers, / just as it was formerly heard by me while sitting on Umā's lap:

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyā saha saṃvādaḥ śarvasya ca mahātmanaḥ /
tamahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvatpriyārthaṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
पार्वत्या सह संवादः शर्वस्य च महात्मनः /
तमहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि त्वत्प्रियार्थं महामुने //
text_mt: The conversation between Pārvatī and the great-souled Śarva; / I shall relate that to you for your pleasure, O great sage!

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite /
taruṇādityasaṃkāśe taptacāmīkaraprabhe //
meaning:
कैलासशिखरे रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते /
तरुणादित्यसंकाशे तप्तचामीकरप्रभे //
text_mt: On the delightful peak of Kailāsa, variegated with various minerals, / resembling the morning sun and glowing like molten gold,

sanskrit_iast:
vajrasphaṭikasopāne citrapādaśilātale /
jāṃbūnadamaye divye nānādhātu vicitrite //
meaning:
वज्रस्फटिकसोपाने चित्रपादशिलातले /
जांबूनदमये दिव्ये नानाधातु विचित्रिते //
text_mt: With stairs of diamond and crystal, with a variegated stone slab at its foot, / made of gold from the Jambu river, divine, variegated with various minerals,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpaphalopage /
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇe cakravākopaśobhite //
meaning:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णे नानापुष्पफलोपगे /
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णे चक्रवाकोपशोभिते //
text_mt: Filled with various trees and creepers, endowed with various flowers and fruits, / crowded with swans and kāraṇḍava ducks, adorned with cakravāka birds,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭpadodgītabahule dhārāsaṃpātanādite /
mattakraiñcamayūrāṇāṃ nādairvikruṣṭakandare //
meaning:
षट्पदोद्गीतबहुले धारासंपातनादिते /
मत्तक्रैञ्चमयूराणां नादैर्विक्रुष्टकन्दरे //
text_mt: Resounding with the loud singing of bees, made noisy by the rushing of streams, / its caves echoing with the cries of intoxicated cranes and peacocks,

sanskrit_iast:
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe kinnarairupaśobhite /
jīvaṃ jīvakajātīnāṃ virāvairupakūjite //
meaning:
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे किन्नरैरुपशोभिते /
जीवं जीवकजातीनां विरावैरुपकूजिते //
text_mt: Crowded with hosts of apsarases, adorned by kinnaras, / chirped around with the calls of flocks of jīvañjīvaka birds,

sanskrit_iast:
kokilārāvabahule siddhacāraṇasevite /
saurabheyaninādāḍhyaṃ meghastanitanisvane //
meaning:
कोकिलारावबहुले सिद्धचारणसेविते /
सौरभेयनिनादाढ्यं मेघस्तनितनिस्वने //
text_mt: Filled with the calls of cuckoos, frequented by siddhas and cāraṇas, / rich in the lowing of Surabhi's offspring, echoing like the rumbling of clouds,

sanskrit_iast:
vināyakabhayodvignakuṃ jarairmuktakandaraiḥ /
vīṇāvāditranirgheṣaiḥ śrotrendriyamanoramaiḥ //
meaning:
विनायकभयोद्विग्नकुं जरैर्मुक्तकन्दरैः /
वीणावादित्रनिर्घेषैः श्रोत्रेन्द्रियमनोरमैः //
text_mt: With caves abandoned by elephants agitated by fear of Vināyaka, / with sounds of the vīṇā and musical instruments delightful to the ear,

sanskrit_iast:
dolālaṃbitasaṃghāte vanitāsaṃghasevite /
dhvajālaṃbitadolānāṃ ghaṇṭānāṃ ninadākule //
meaning:
दोलालंबितसंघाते वनितासंघसेविते /
ध्वजालंबितदोलानां घण्टानां निनदाकुले //
text_mt: Where swings were suspended, frequented by groups of women, / noisy with the ringing of bells hung upon banners and swings,

sanskrit_iast:
vallakīveṇubahule triṃśadbarhiṇasaṃkule /
mukhamarddalavāditrairvalitāsphoṭitaistathā //
meaning:
वल्लकीवेणुबहुले त्रिंशद्बर्हिणसंकुले /
मुखमर्द्दलवादित्रैर्वलितास्फोटितैस्तथा //
text_mt: Abounding in lutes and flutes, crowded with peacocks, / with clapping, leaping, and musical instruments like mardalas played by hand,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāvegavivādānāṃ nirghoṣaiḥ pūrṇakandare /
haṃsaiḥ parāvataiścaiva bakarājaiḥ sukhasthite //
meaning:
क्रीडावेगविवादानां निर्घोषैः पूर्णकन्दरे /
हंसैः परावतैश्चैव बकराजैः सुखस्थिते //
text_mt: Its caves filled with the sounds of sporting, shouting, and disputations, / pleasant with swans, pigeons, and excellent herons,

sanskrit_iast:
dehabandhairvicitraiścaprakrīḍitagaṇeśvare /
siṃhavyāghramukhairghoravāśitaiścaṇḍavegitaiḥ //
meaning:
देहबन्धैर्विचित्रैश्चप्रक्रीडितगणेश्वरे /
सिंहव्याघ्रमुखैर्घोरवाशितैश्चण्डवेगितैः //
text_mt: Where the lord of the gaṇas sported in various bodily postures, / with those having faces of lions and tigers, roaring terribly with violent speed,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgamaṣamukhaiścānyairgajavājimukhaistathā /
biḍālavadanaiścograiḥ kroṣṭukākārasūrttibhiḥ //
meaning:
मृगमषमुखैश्चान्यैर्गजवाजिमुखैस्तथा /
बिडालवदनैश्चोग्रैः क्रोष्टुकाकारसूर्त्तिभिः //
text_mt: And others with faces of deer and rams, and those with faces of elephants and horses, / with fierce cat-like faces, and forms shaped like jackals,

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvairdīrghaiśca sukṛśairlaṃbodaramahīdaraiḥ /
hrasvajaṅghaiḥ praleboṣṭhaistālajaṅghaistathāparaiḥ //
meaning:
ह्रस्वैर्दीर्घैश्च सुकृशैर्लंबोदरमहीदरैः /
ह्रस्वजङ्घैः प्रलेबोष्ठैस्तालजङ्घैस्तथापरैः //
text_mt: With short and tall ones, extremely emaciated ones, and pot-bellied giants, / with short shanks, hanging lips, and others with shanks like palm trees,

sanskrit_iast:
gokarṇairekakarṇaiśca mahākarṇairakarṇakaiḥ /
bahupādairmahāpādairekapādairapādakaiḥ //
meaning:
गोकर्णैरेककर्णैश्च महाकर्णैरकर्णकैः /
बहुपादैर्महापादैरेकपादैरपादकैः //
text_mt: With cow-ears, single ears, huge ears, and earless ones, / with many feet, huge feet, single feet, and footless ones,

sanskrit_iast:
bahunetrairmahānetrairekanetrairanetrakaiḥ /
ekadaṃṣṭrairmahādaṃṣṭrairbahudaṃṣṭrairadaṃṣṭrakaiḥ //
meaning:
बहुनेत्रैर्महानेत्रैरेकनेत्रैरनेत्रकैः /
एकदंष्ट्रैर्महादंष्ट्रैर्बहुदंष्ट्रैरदंष्ट्रकैः //
text_mt: With many eyes, huge eyes, single eyes, and eyeless ones, / with single tusks, huge tusks, many tusks, and tuskless ones,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaśīrṣairmahāśīrṣabahuśīrṣairaśīrṣakaiḥ /
ekajihvairmahājihvairbahujihvairajihvakaiḥ /
evaṃrūpairmahāyogaibhūtarbhūtapatirvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एकशीर्षैर्महाशीर्षबहुशीर्षैरशीर्षकैः /
एकजिह्वैर्महाजिह्वैर्बहुजिह्वैरजिह्वकैः /
एवंरूपैर्महायोगैभूतर्भूतपतिर्वृतः //
text_mt: With single heads, huge heads, many heads, and headless ones, / with single tongues, huge tongues, many tongues, and tongueless ones— / surrounded by such great yogins and spirits, the Lord of Spirits

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhamuktāmaṇiratnabhūṣite śilātale svarṇamaye suramyake /
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ madanāganāśanaṃ provāca vākyaṃ girirājaputrī //
meaning:
विशुद्धमुक्तामणिरत्नभूषिते शिलातले स्वर्णमये सुरम्यके /
सुखोपविष्टं मदनागनाशनं प्रोवाच वाक्यं गिरिराजपुत्री //
text_mt: Was seated at ease on a delightful golden rock-slab adorned with pure pearls and gems, / when the daughter of the mountain king addressed words to that destroyer of Madana's body:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa govṛṣāṅkitaśāsana /
tava kaṇṭhe mahādeva bhrājateṃbudasannibham //
meaning:
भगवन्भूतभव्येश गोवृषाङ्कितशासन /
तव कण्ठे महादेव भ्राजतेंबुदसन्निभम् //
text_mt: "O Blessed Lord, ruler of past and future, whose authority is marked by the bull! / On your neck, O Mahādeva, there shines [a mark] resembling a cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
nātyulbaṇaṃ śubhaṃśubhre nīlābujacayopamam /
kimidaṃ dīpyate deva kaṇṭhe kāmāṅganāśana //
meaning:
नात्युल्बणं शुभंशुभ्रे नीलाबुजचयोपमम् /
किमिदं दीप्यते देव कण्ठे कामाङ्गनाशन //
text_mt: Not too conspicuous, beautiful on what is fair, like a cluster of blue lotuses. / What is this shining on your throat, O god, O destroyer of Kāma's body?

sanskrit_iast:
ko hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ vā kaṇṭhe nīlasttvamīśvara /
etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ būhi kautūhalaṃ hi me //
meaning:
को हेतुः कारणं किं वा कण्ठे नीलस्त्त्वमीश्वर /
एतत्सर्वं यथान्यायं बूहि कौतूहलं हि मे //
text_mt: What is the reason, or what is the cause, that you are blue on the throat, O Lord? / Tell all this in proper order, for great indeed is my curiosity."

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasyāḥ pārvatyāḥ pāvatīpriyaḥ /
kathāṃ maṅgalasaṃyuktāṃ kathayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्याः पार्वत्याः पावतीप्रियः /
कथां मङ्गलसंयुक्तां कथयामास शङ्करः //
text_mt: Having heard those words of Pārvatī, Śaṅkara, who is dear to Pārvatī, / related the auspicious story:

sanskrit_iast:
maheśvara uvāca
mathyamāne 'mṛte pūrvaṃ kṣīrode suradānavaiḥ /
agre samutthitaṃ ghoraṃ viṣaṅkālānalaprabham //
meaning:
महेश्वर उवाच
मथ्यमाने ऽमृते पूर्वं क्षीरोदे सुरदानवैः /
अग्रे समुत्थितं घोरं विषङ्कालानलप्रभम् //
text_mt: Maheśvara said: / "Formerly, when the nectar was being churned in the Ocean of Milk by the gods and Dānavas, / a terrible poison arose first, blazing like the fire of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā surasaṃghasca daityāścaiva varānane /
viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve gatāste brahmaṇo 'ntakam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा सुरसंघस्च दैत्याश्चैव वरानने /
विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे गतास्ते ब्रह्मणो ऽन्तकम् //
text_mt: Seeing it, O fair-faced one, the hosts of the gods and the Daityas, / all with dejected faces, went to the presence of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā suragaṇānbhītānbrahmovāca mahādyutiḥ /
kimarthaṃ vai mahābhāgā bhītā udvignacetanāḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सुरगणान्भीतान्ब्रह्मोवाच महाद्युतिः /
किमर्थं वै महाभागा भीता उद्विग्नचेतनाः //
text_mt: Seeing the frightened hosts of gods, the intensely radiant Brahmā said: / 'For what reason, O fortunate ones, are you frightened and troubled in mind?

sanskrit_iast:
mayā triguṇamaiśvaryaṃ bhavatāṃ saṃprakalpitam /
tena vyāvarttitaiśvaryā yūyaṃ bho surasattamāḥ //
meaning:
मया त्रिगुणमैश्वर्यं भवतां संप्रकल्पितम् /
तेन व्यावर्त्तितैश्वर्या यूयं भो सुरसत्तमाः //
text_mt: By me threefold sovereign power was established for you; / through that your sovereignty was turned into reality, O best of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
tralokyasyeśvarā yūyaṃ sarve vai vigatajvarāḥ /
prajāsarge na so 'stīha yaścājñāṃ me 'tivartayet //
meaning:
त्रलोक्यस्येश्वरा यूयं सर्वे वै विगतज्वराः /
प्रजासर्गे न सो ऽस्तीह यश्चाज्ञां मे ऽतिवर्तयेत् //
text_mt: You are the rulers of the three worlds, all free from distress; / in the creation of creatures, there is none here who can transgress my command.

sanskrit_iast:
vimānacāriṇa sarve sarve svacchandagāminaḥ /
ādhyātmike cādhibhūte adhidaive ca nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
विमानचारिण सर्वे सर्वे स्वच्छन्दगामिनः /
आध्यात्मिके चाधिभूते अधिदैवे च नित्यशः //
text_mt: All of you move in celestial chariots, all moving according to your own will, / eternally over the spiritual, the elemental, and the divine realms.'

sanskrit_iast:
prajāḥ karmavipākena śaktā yūyaṃ pravarttitum /
tatkimarthaṃ bhayodvignā mṛgāḥ siṃhārditā iva //
meaning:
प्रजाः कर्मविपाकेन शक्ता यूयं प्रवर्त्तितुम् /
तत्किमर्थं भयोद्विग्ना मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव //
text_mt: You are capable of impelling creatures through the ripening of their deeds. / Why then are you agitated by fear, like deer tormented by a lion?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ duḥśaṃ ko 'nusaṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayamāgatam /
etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śīghramākhyā tumarhatha //
meaning:
किं दुःशं को ऽनुसंतापः कुतो वा भयमागतम् /
एतत्सर्वं यथान्यायं शीघ्रमाख्या तुमर्हथ //
text_mt: What is the sorrow, what is this distress, or whence has fear arisen? / You ought to explain all this swiftly, in accordance with the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ tatastasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ /
ūcuste ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ suradaityendradānavāḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततस्तस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः /
ऊचुस्ते ऋषिभिः सार्द्धं सुरदैत्येन्द्रदानवाः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of Brahmā, the Supreme Self, / the gods, chiefs of Daityas, and Dānavas spoke together with the sages:

sanskrit_iast:
surāsurairmathyamāne pajorāśau pitamāha /
bhujaṅgabhṛṅgasaṃkāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham //
meaning:
सुरासुरैर्मथ्यमाने पजोराशौ पितमाह /
भुजङ्गभृङ्गसंकाशं नीलजीमूतसन्निभम् //
text_mt: “O Grandfather, as the ocean of milk was being churned by the gods and asuras, / [a substance] resembling a serpent or a bee, like a dark-blue raincloud,

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ saṃvartāgnisamaprabham /
kālamṛtyurivodbhūtaṃ yugāntādityavarcasam //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भूतं विषं घोरं संवर्ताग्निसमप्रभम् /
कालमृत्युरिवोद्भूतं युगान्तादित्यवर्चसम् //
text_mt: a dreadful poison appeared, possessing splendour equal to the fire of cosmic dissolution, / risen like death and time, with the lustre of the sun at the end of the yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyotsādasūryābhaṃ visphurattat samantataḥ /
viṣeṇottiṣṭhamānena kālānalasamatviṣā //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्योत्सादसूर्याभं विस्फुरत्तत् समन्ततः /
विषेणोत्तिष्ठमानेन कालानलसमत्विषा //
text_mt: Resembling the sun of the destruction of the three worlds, flashing all around— / by this poison rising up, having the radiance of the fire of time,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdho raktagaurāṅgo kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo janārddanaḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā raktagaurāṅgaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ janārddanam //
meaning:
निर्दग्धो रक्तगौराङ्गो कृतः कृष्णो जनार्द्दनः /
तं दृष्ट्वा रक्तगौराङ्गं कृतं कृष्णं जनार्द्दनम् //
text_mt: Janārdana, whose limbs were reddish-fair, was scorched and turned dark-black. / Seeing that Janārdana, whose limbs were reddish-fair, had been turned dark-black,

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sarve vayaṃ bhītāstvā meva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ /
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca śrutvā vākyaṃ bhayāvaham //
meaning:
ततः सर्वे वयं भीतास्त्वा मेव शरणं गताः /
सुराणामसुराणां च श्रुत्वा वाक्यं भयावहम् //
text_mt: we have all fled to you for refuge, overcome with terror.” / Hearing the fear-filled words of the gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyuvāca mahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
śṛṇvantu devatāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्युवाच महातेजा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
शृण्वन्तु देवताः सर्वे ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः //
text_mt: Brahmā of great majesty, the grandfather of the worlds, replied: / “Let all the deities and the ascetics rich in penance hear!

sanskrit_iast:
yattadagre samutpannaṃ mathyamāne mahodadhau /
viṣaṃ kālānalaprakhyaṃ kālakūṭamiti śrutam //
meaning:
यत्तदग्रे समुत्पन्नं मथ्यमाने महोदधौ /
विषं कालानलप्रख्यं कालकूटमिति श्रुतम् //
text_mt: That which has arisen first as the great ocean is churned, / the poison like the fire of time, is known as the Kālakūṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
yena prodbhūtamātreṇa na vyarājanta devatāḥ /
tasya viṣṇurahaṃ vāpi sarve vā surapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
येन प्रोद्भूतमात्रेण न व्यराजन्त देवताः /
तस्य विष्णुरहं वापि सर्वे वा सुरपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: As soon as it arose, the gods lost their radiance. / Neither Viṣṇu, nor I, nor all the foremost among the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
na śaknuvanti vai soḍhuṃ vegamanyatra śaṅkarāt /
ityuktvā padmagarbhābhaḥ padmāyonirayonijaḥ //
meaning:
न शक्नुवन्ति वै सोढुं वेगमन्यत्र शङ्करात् /
इत्युक्त्वा पद्मगर्भाभः पद्मायोनिरयोनिजः //
text_mt: are able to endure its force, except for Śaṅkara.” / Having spoken thus, he whose lustre is like the lotus-womb, the lotus-born, who was not born from a womb,

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkāraṃ samanusmṛtya dhyāyañjayotiḥ samantataḥ /
tataḥ stotuṃ samārabdho brahmā veda vidāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्कारं समनुस्मृत्य ध्यायञ्जयोतिः समन्ततः /
ततः स्तोतुं समारब्धो ब्रह्मा वेद विदां वरः //
text_mt: remembering the syllable Oṃ and meditating on the light on every side, / Brahmā, the best of the knowers of the Veda, then began to praise [him]:

sanskrit_iast:
namastubhyaṃ virūpākṣa namaste divyacakṣuṣe /
namaḥ pinākahastāya vajrahastāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्तुभ्यं विरूपाक्ष नमस्ते दिव्यचक्षुषे /
नमः पिनाकहस्ताय वज्रहस्ताय वै नमः //
text_mt: “Obeisance to you, O odd-eyed one; obeisance to you who possess divine vision! / Obeisance to the one holding the Pināka in hand; obeisance indeed to the thunderbolt-bearer!

sanskrit_iast:
namastrailokya nāthāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ /
namaḥ surārihantre ca somasūryāgnicakṣuṣe //
meaning:
नमस्त्रैलोक्य नाथाय भूतानां पतये नमः /
नमः सुरारिहन्त्रे च सोमसूर्याग्निचक्षुषे //
text_mt: Obeisance to the lord of the three worlds, obeisance to the master of beings! / Obeisance to the slayer of the foes of the gods, whose eyes are the moon, the sun, and fire!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇe caiva rudrāya viṣṇave caiva te namaḥ /
sāṃkhyāya caiva yogāya bhūtagrāmāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणे चैव रुद्राय विष्णवे चैव ते नमः /
सांख्याय चैव योगाय भूतग्रामाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Obeisance to you who are Brahmā, Rudra, and Viṣṇu! / Obeisance to Sāṃkhya and Yoga, and to the collection of elements!

sanskrit_iast:
manmathāṅgavināśāya kālapṛṣṭhāya vai namaḥ /
suretase 'tha rudrāya devadevāya raṃhase //
meaning:
मन्मथाङ्गविनाशाय कालपृष्ठाय वै नमः /
सुरेतसे ऽथ रुद्राय देवदेवाय रंहसे //
text_mt: Obeisance to the destroyer of the body of Love, to Kālapṛṣṭha! / To the pure seed, to Rudra, to the God of gods, to Swiftness!

sanskrit_iast:
kapardine karālāya śaṅkarāya harāya ca /
kapāline virūpāya śivāya varadāya ca //
meaning:
कपर्दिने करालाय शङ्कराय हराय च /
कपालिने विरूपाय शिवाय वरदाय च //
text_mt: To the one with matted hair, to the terrifying one, to Śaṅkara and Hara! / To the bearer of the skull, to the multiform one, to Śiva, and to the granter of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
tripuraghnamakhaghnāya mātṝṇāṃ pataye namaḥ /
vṛddhāya caiva śuddhāya muktāyaiva balāya ca //
meaning:
त्रिपुरघ्नमखघ्नाय मातॄणां पतये नमः /
वृद्धाय चैव शुद्धाय मुक्तायैव बलाय च //
text_mt: Obeisance to the destroyer of Tripura, the destroyer of sacrifice, to the master of the Mothers! / To the ancient, the pure, the liberated, and the mighty!

sanskrit_iast:
lokatrayaikavīrāya candrāya varuṇāya ca /
agrāya caiva cogrāya viprāyānekacakṣuṣe //
meaning:
लोकत्रयैकवीराय चन्द्राय वरुणाय च /
अग्राय चैव चोग्राय विप्रायानेकचक्षुषे //
text_mt: To the sole hero of the three worlds, to the Moon and Varuṇa! / To the foremost, the fierce, the inspired poet, the many-eyed one!

sanskrit_iast:
rajase caiva sattvāya namaste 'vyaktayonaye /
nityāya caivānityāya nityānityāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
रजसे चैव सत्त्वाय नमस्ते ऽव्यक्तयोनये /
नित्याय चैवानित्याय नित्यानित्याय वै नमः //
text_mt: To rajas and to sattva, obeisance to you, the source of the unmanifest! / To the eternal, to the non-eternal, obeisance to the eternal and non-eternal!

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāya caivāvyaktāya vyaktāvyaktāya vai namaḥ /
cintyāya caivācintyāya cintyācintyāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
व्यक्ताय चैवाव्यक्ताय व्यक्ताव्यक्ताय वै नमः /
चिन्त्याय चैवाचिन्त्याय चिन्त्याचिन्त्याय वै नमः //
text_mt: To the manifest and to the unmanifest, obeisance to the manifest-unmanifest! / To the conceivable and to the inconceivable, obeisance to the conceivable-inconceivable!

sanskrit_iast:
jagatāmārttināśāya priyanārāyaṇāya ca /
umāpriyāya śarvāya nandivaktrāṅkitāya ca //
meaning:
जगतामार्त्तिनाशाय प्रियनारायणाय च /
उमाप्रियाय शर्वाय नन्दिवक्त्राङ्किताय च //
text_mt: To the destroyer of the afflictions of the worlds, to whom Nārāyaṇa is dear! / To the beloved of Umā, to Śarva, to the one marked with the face of Nandin!

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣamāsāhddhamāsāya ṛtusaṃvatsarāya ca /
bahurūpāya muṇḍāya daṇḍine ca varūthine //
meaning:
पक्षमासाह्द्धमासाय ऋतुसंवत्सराय च /
बहुरूपाय मुण्डाय दण्डिने च वरूथिने //
text_mt: To the fortnight, the month, the half-month, the season, and the year! / To the multiform, the shaved-headed, the staff-bearer, and the warrior with an armour-clad chariot!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kapālahastāya digvāsāya śikhaṇḍine /
dhanvine rathine caiva yamine brahmacāriṇe //
meaning:
नमः कपालहस्ताय दिग्वासाय शिखण्डिने /
धन्विने रथिने चैव यमिने ब्रह्मचारिणे //
text_mt: Obeisance to the one with a skull in hand, clad in the directions, wearing a crest of hair! / To the archer, the charioteer, the self-controlled, the celibate student!

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgyajuḥ sāmavedāya puruṣāyeśvarāya ca /
ityeva mādicaritaiḥ stotraiḥ stutya namī'stu te /
evaṃ stutvā tato brahmā praṇipatya varānane //
meaning:
ऋग्यजुः सामवेदाय पुरुषायेश्वराय च /
इत्येव मादिचरितैः स्तोत्रैः स्तुत्य नमीऽस्तु ते /
एवं स्तुत्वा ततो ब्रह्मा प्रणिपत्य वरानने //
text_mt: To the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāmaveda, to the Puruṣa and to the Lord!” / Praising thus through hymns of such acts: “Obeisance be to you!” / Having thus praised and bowed down, O fair-faced woman,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā tu bhaktiṃ mama devatānāṃ gaṅgājalā sphālitamuktakeśaḥ /
sūkṣmo 'si yogātiśayādacintyo na hi prabho vyaktimuphaiṣi rudraḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा तु भक्तिं मम देवतानां गङ्गाजला स्फालितमुक्तकेशः /
सूक्ष्मो ऽसि योगातिशयादचिन्त्यो न हि प्रभो व्यक्तिमुफैषि रुद्रः //
text_mt: having recognized my devotion and that of the deities, his loose hair washed by the waters of the Gaṅgā, [Brahmā said:] / “You are subtle, inconceivable through the excellence of yoga; for you do not manifest, O Lord Rudra.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā /
stuto 'haṃ vividhaiḥ stotrairvedavedāṅgasaṃbhavaiḥ //
meaning:
एवं भगवता पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा /
स्तुतो ऽहं विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्वेदवेदाङ्गसंभवैः //
text_mt: Thus of old was I praised by the Lord Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, / with diverse hymns arising from the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ mukhyayā vācā pitāmahamathābravam /
bhūtabhavyabhavannātha lokanātha jagatpate //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं मुख्यया वाचा पितामहमथाब्रवम् /
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथ लोकनाथ जगत्पते //
text_mt: Then I addressed the Grandfather in paramount speech: / “O Lord of past, future, and present, O Lord of the world, O Master of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ kāryaṃ te mayā brahmankarttavyaṃ vada suvrata /
śrutvā vākyaṃ tato brahmā pratyuvācāṃbujekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
किं कार्यं ते मया ब्रह्मन्कर्त्तव्यं वद सुव्रत /
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं ततो ब्रह्मा प्रत्युवाचांबुजेक्षणः //
text_mt: What deed must I perform for you, O Brahmā? Speak, O one of good vows!” / Hearing those words, the lotus-eyed Brahmā replied:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhavannātha śrūyatāṃ kāraṇeśvara /
surāsurairmathyamāne payodhau paṅkajekṣaṇa //
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथ श्रूयतां कारणेश्वर /
सुरासुरैर्मथ्यमाने पयोधौ पङ्कजेक्षण //
text_mt: “O Lord of past, future, and present, hear, O Lord of causes! / As the ocean of milk was being churned by the gods and asuras, O lotus-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavanmeghasaṃkāśaṃ nīlajīmūtasannibham /
prādurbhūtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ saṃvarttāgnisamaprabham //
meaning:
भगवन्मेघसंकाशं नीलजीमूतसन्निभम् /
प्रादुर्भूतं विषं घोरं संवर्त्ताग्निसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: a dreadful poison appeared, O Lord, resembling a cloud, like a dark-blue raincloud, / having the splendour of the fire of cosmic dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vayaṃ sarve bhītāḥ saṃbhrāntacetasaḥ /
tatpibasva mahādeva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा च वयं सर्वे भीताः संभ्रान्तचेतसः /
तत्पिबस्व महादेव लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: And seeing it, we are all terrified, our minds confounded. / Therefore, drink it, O Mahādeva, out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāñchaktaśca bhoktā vai bhavāndevavaraḥ prabho /
tvadṛte 'nyo mahādeva vegaṃ soḍhuṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
भवाञ्छक्तश्च भोक्ता वै भवान्देववरः प्रभो /
त्वदृते ऽन्यो महादेव वेगं सोढुं न विद्यते //
text_mt: You are capable, and you indeed are the consumer; you are the best among gods, O Lord! / Apart from you, O Mahādeva, none is found capable of enduring its force.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
bāḍha mityeva tadvākyaṃ pratigṛhya varānane //
meaning:
एवं तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः /
बाढ मित्येव तद्वाक्यं प्रतिगृह्य वरानने //
text_mt: Having heard those words of Parameṣṭhin Brahmā, / accepting his statement with ‘So be it!’, O fair-faced woman,

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'haṃ pātumārabdho viṣamantakasannibham /
pibato me mahāghoraṃ viṣaṃ surabhayapradam //
meaning:
ततो ऽहं पातुमारब्धो विषमन्तकसन्निभम् /
पिबतो मे महाघोरं विषं सुरभयप्रदम् //
text_mt: I then began to drink the poison resembling Death. / As I drank that exceedingly terrible poison that brought fear to the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhaḥ samabhavattūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇo vai varavarṇini /
taṃ dṛṣṭvotpalapatrābhaṃ kaṇṭhasaktamivoragam //
meaning:
कण्ठः समभवत्तूर्णं कृष्णो वै वरवर्णिनि /
तं दृष्ट्वोत्पलपत्राभं कण्ठसक्तमिवोरगम् //
text_mt: my throat swiftly became dark-black, O woman of excellent complexion! / Seeing it resembling the petal of a blue lotus, like a snake clinging to the neck,

sanskrit_iast:
takṣakaṃ nāgarājānaṃ lelihānamivotthitam /
athovāca mahātejā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
तक्षकं नागराजानं लेलिहानमिवोत्थितम् /
अथोवाच महातेजा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः //
text_mt: like the king of snakes, Takṣaka, arisen and darting his tongue, / Brahmā of great majesty, the grandfather of the worlds, then spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śobhase tvaṃ mahādeva kaṇṭhenānena suvrata /
tatastasya vacaḥśrutvā mayā girivarātmaje //
meaning:
शोभसे त्वं महादेव कण्ठेनानेन सुव्रत /
ततस्तस्य वचःश्रुत्वा मया गिरिवरात्मजे //
text_mt: “You shine, O Mahādeva, with this throat, O one of good vows!” / Then, having heard his words, O daughter of the best of mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe dhṛtaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ nīlakaṇṭhastato 'smyaham /
paśyatāṃ surasaṃghānāṃ daityānāṃ ca varānane /
yakṣagandharvabhūtānāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām //
meaning:
कण्ठे धृतं विषं घोरं नीलकण्ठस्ततो ऽस्म्यहम् /
पश्यतां सुरसंघानां दैत्यानां च वरानने /
यक्षगन्धर्वभूतानां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् //
text_mt: the terrible poison was held in my throat, and from that I became Nīlakaṇṭha (the blue-throated one), / before the eyes of the hosts of gods and daityas, O fair-faced woman, / and of the yakṣas, gandharvas, bhūtas, piśācas, serpents, and rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālakūṭaṃ viṣamugravegaṃ kaṇṭhe dhṛtaṃ parvatarājaputri /
niveśyamānaṃ suradaityasaṃgho dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamājagāma //
meaning:
तत्कालकूटं विषमुग्रवेगं कण्ठे धृतं पर्वतराजपुत्रि /
निवेश्यमानं सुरदैत्यसंघो दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमाजगाम //
text_mt: When that Kālakūṭa poison of ferocious force was held in the throat, O daughter of the king of mountains, / the host of gods and daityas, seeing it stationed there, was filled with supreme astonishment.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ muragaṇāḥ sarve sadaityoragarākṣasāḥ /
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā mattamātaṅgagāmini //
meaning:
ततः मुरगणाः सर्वे सदैत्योरगराक्षसाः /
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि //
text_mt: Then all the hosts of gods, together with daityas, uragas, and rākṣasas, / folding their hands in reverence, spoke, O woman who walks like an elephant in rut:

sanskrit_iast: ahobalaṃ vīryaparākramaste tvaho vapuryogabalaṃ taveśa //
meaning: अहोबलं वीर्यपराक्रमस्ते त्वहो वपुर्योगबलं तवेश //
text_mt: “Ah, your strength, valorous prowess, and ah, your body, O Lord, and the power of your yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
aho prabhutvaṃ tava devadeva mahādbhutaṃ manmathadehanāśana /
tvameva viṣṇuścaturānanastvaṃ tvameva mṛtyurvaradastvameva //
meaning:
अहो प्रभुत्वं तव देवदेव महाद्भुतं मन्मथदेहनाशन /
त्वमेव विष्णुश्चतुराननस्त्वं त्वमेव मृत्युर्वरदस्त्वमेव //
text_mt: Ah, your lordship, O God of gods, is exceedingly wonderful, O destroyer of the body of Love! / You alone are Viṣṇu, you are the four-faced [Brahmā], you alone are Death, and you alone are the granter of boons!

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva sūryo rajanīkaraśca vyaktistvamevāsya carācarasya /
tvameva vahniḥ pavanastvameva tvameva bhūmiḥ salilaṃ tvameva //
meaning:
त्वमेव सूर्यो रजनीकरश्च व्यक्तिस्त्वमेवास्य चराचरस्य /
त्वमेव वह्निः पवनस्त्वमेव त्वमेव भूमिः सलिलं त्वमेव //
text_mt: You alone are the sun and the maker of the night; you alone are the manifestation of this moving and unmoving [universe]! / You alone are fire, you alone are wind, you alone are earth, and you alone are water!”

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva sarvasya carācarasya dhātā vidhātā pralayastvameva /
ityeva muktvā vacanaṃ suredrāḥ pragṛhya somaṃ praṇipatya mūrdhrā /
gatā vimānairanilopavegairmahānagaṃ merumupetya sarve //
meaning:
त्वमेव सर्वस्य चराचरस्य धाता विधाता प्रलयस्त्वमेव /
इत्येव मुक्त्वा वचनं सुरेद्राः प्रगृह्य सोमं प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्रा /
गता विमानैरनिलोपवेगैर्महानगं मेरुमुपेत्य सर्वे //
text_mt:
You alone are the creator and ordainer of all that moves and does not move; you alone are dissolution."
Having spoken these words, the chiefs of the gods took the soma, bowed down with their heads,
and all went in their aerial chariots with the speed of the wind, approaching the great mountain Meru.

sanskrit_iast: ityetatparamaṃ guhyaṃ puṇyātpuṇyatamaṃ mahat //
meaning: इत्येतत्परमं गुह्यं पुण्यात्पुण्यतमं महत् //
text_mt: Thus this is the supreme secret, the purest of the pure, and great.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlakaṇṭha iti proktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam /
svayaṃbhuvā svayaṃ proktā kathā pāpapraṇāśinī //
meaning:
नीलकण्ठ इति प्रोक्तं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् /
स्वयंभुवा स्वयं प्रोक्ता कथा पापप्रणाशिनी //
text_mt:
It is proclaimed as 'Nīlakaṇṭha,' renowned in the three worlds.
This narrative, which destroys sins, was spoken by Svayambhū himself.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu dhārayate nityaṃ brahmodgītāmimāṃ śubhām /
tasyāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi phalaṃ suvipulaṃ mahat //
meaning:
यस्तु धारयते नित्यं ब्रह्मोद्गीतामिमां शुभाम् /
तस्याहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि फलं सुविपुलं महत् //
text_mt:
Whoever constantly retains this auspicious [hymn] sung by Brahmā,
to him I shall proclaim the very vast, great fruit:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṃ tasya varārohe sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā /
gātraṃ prāpya tu suśroṇi kṣapraṃ tatpratihanyate //
meaning:
विषं तस्य वरारोहे स्थावरं जङ्गमं तथा /
गात्रं प्राप्य तु सुश्रोणि क्षप्रं तत्प्रतिहन्यते //
text_mt:
O fair-hipped lady, poison—both stationary and mobile—
having reached his body, O beautiful-hipped one, is swiftly repelled.

sanskrit_iast:
śamāyatyaśubhaṃ ghoraṃ duḥkhapnaṃ cāpakarṣati /
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti sabhāyāṃ pārthivasya ca //
meaning:
शमायत्यशुभं घोरं दुःखप्नं चापकर्षति /
स्त्रीषु वल्लभतां याति सभायां पार्थिवस्य च //
text_mt:
It appeases terrible misfortune and drives away bad dreams;
he becomes beloved among women and in the assembly of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāde jayamāpnoti yuddhe vijayameva ca /
gacchati kṣemamadhvānaṃ gṛhebhyo nityasaṃpadā //
meaning:
विवादे जयमाप्नोति युद्धे विजयमेव च /
गच्छति क्षेममध्वानं गृहेभ्यो नित्यसंपदा //
text_mt:
He attains victory in dispute and triumph in battle;
he journeys along his path in safety, endowed with continual prosperity for his household.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrasyeha vakṣyāmi gatiṃ tasya varānane /
hariśmaśrurnīlakaṇṭhaḥ śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrddhajaḥ //
meaning:
शरीरस्येह वक्ष्यामि गतिं तस्य वरानने /
हरिश्मश्रुर्नीलकण्ठः शशाङ्काङ्कितमूर्द्धजः //
text_mt:
I shall speak here of the destiny of his body, O fair-faced lady:
[He becomes] one with tawny beard, a blue throat, hair marked by the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
tryakṣastriśūlapāṇiśca vṛṣa cānaḥ pinākadhṛk /
nanditulyabalaḥ śrīmānnanditulyaparākramaḥ //
meaning:
त्र्यक्षस्त्रिशूलपाणिश्च वृष चानः पिनाकधृक् /
नन्दितुल्यबलः श्रीमान्नन्दितुल्यपराक्रमः //
text_mt:
three-eyed, holding a trident in his hand, riding a bull, wielding the Pināka,
having strength equal to Nandin, glorious, possessing prowess equal to Nandin.

sanskrit_iast:
vicaratyakhilāṃllokāmsaptalokānmamājñayā /
na hanyate gati stasya anilasya yathāṃbare //
meaning:
विचरत्यखिलांल्लोकाम्सप्तलोकान्ममाज्ञया /
न हन्यते गति स्तस्य अनिलस्य यथांबरे //
text_mt:
He roams through all the worlds, the seven worlds, by my command;
his movement is not impeded, like that of the wind in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
mama tulyabalo bhūtvā tiṣṭhatyābhūtasaṃplavāt /
mama bhaktayā varārohe ye ca śṛmvanti mānavāḥ //
meaning:
मम तुल्यबलो भूत्वा तिष्ठत्याभूतसंप्लवात् /
मम भक्तया वरारोहे ये च शृम्वन्ति मानवाः //
text_mt:
Becoming equal in strength to me, he abides until the dissolution of all beings.
And those human beings who hear [it] with devotion to me, O fair-hipped lady,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ gatiṃ pravakṣyāmi tviha loke paratra ca /
brāhmaṇo vedamāpnoti kṣatriyo vindate mahīm //
meaning:
तेषां गतिं प्रवक्ष्यामि त्विह लोके परत्र च /
ब्राह्मणो वेदमाप्नोति क्षत्रियो विन्दते महीम् //
text_mt:
I shall proclaim their destiny both in this world and the next:
A brāhmaṇa attains the Veda, a kṣatriya wins the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyastu labhate lābhaṃ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt /
vyādhito mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt //
meaning:
वैश्यस्तु लभते लाभं शूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात् /
व्याधितो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् //
text_mt:
a vaiśya obtains profit, and a śūdra attains happiness.
A sick man is freed from illness, a bound man is freed from bondage,

sanskrit_iast:
gurviṇī labhate putraṃ kanyā vidati satpatim /
naṣṭaṃ ca labhate dravyamiha loke paratra ca //
meaning:
गुर्विणी लभते पुत्रं कन्या विदति सत्पतिम् /
नष्टं च लभते द्रव्यमिह लोके परत्र च //
text_mt:
a pregnant woman obtains a son, a maiden finds a good husband,
and one recovers lost wealth both in this world and in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
gavāṃ śatasahasrasya samyagdattasya yatphalam /
tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ śrutvā divyā mimāṃ kathām //
meaning:
गवां शतसहस्रस्य सम्यग्दत्तस्य यत्फलम् /
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः श्रुत्वा दिव्या मिमां कथाम् //
text_mt:
Whatever fruit is attained from giving a hundred thousand cows properly,
that fruit a mortal obtains after hearing this divine narrative.

sanskrit_iast:
pādaṃ vāthārddhapādaṃ vār ślokarṃ ślokārddhameva vā /
yastu dhārayate nityaṃ rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
meaning:
पादं वाथार्द्धपादं वार् श्लोकर्ं श्लोकार्द्धमेव वा /
यस्तु धारयते नित्यं रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
text_mt:
Whoever constantly retains a quarter-verse or half a quarter-verse, a verse or half a verse,
he goes to the world of Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā sarvamevedaṃ devabrāhmaṇasannidhau /
yaḥ paṭhenmānavo nityaṃ madgatenāntarātmanā //
meaning:
अथवा सर्वमेवेदं देवब्राह्मणसन्निधौ /
यः पठेन्मानवो नित्यं मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना //
text_mt:
Or whatever human being always recites all of this in the presence of gods and brāhmaṇas,
with his inner self fixed on me,

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhadhānaḥ sadā bhakto rūdralokaṃ sa gacchati /
paṭhecca devi bhaktyā ca pāṭhayecca naraḥ sadā //
meaning:
श्रद्धधानः सदा भक्तो रूद्रलोकं स गच्छति /
पठेच्च देवि भक्त्या च पाठयेच्च नरः सदा //
text_mt:
faithful and ever devoted, he goes to the world of Rudra.
A man should always recite it with devotion, O goddess, and cause it to be recited.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
nāpi yakṣāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ /
kuryurvighnaṃ gṛhe tasya yatrāyaṃ tiṣṭhati stavaḥ //
meaning:
अतः परतरं स्तोत्रं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
नापि यक्षाः पिशाचा वा न भूता न विनायकाः /
कुर्युर्विघ्नं गृहे तस्य यत्रायं तिष्ठति स्तवः //
text_mt:
There has been no hymn greater than this, nor will there ever be.
Neither yakṣas nor piśācas, neither bhūtas nor vināyakas,
would cause obstruction in his house where this hymn is present.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā nu tuṣṭena tavāṃbujekṣaṇe stavasya māhātmyama ghaughanāśanam /
niveditaṃ puṇyaphalādiyuktaṃ svayaṃ ca kītaṃ caturānanena //
meaning:
मया नु तुष्टेन तवांबुजेक्षणे स्तवस्य माहात्म्यम घौघनाशनम् /
निवेदितं पुण्यफलादियुक्तं स्वयं च कीतं चतुराननेन //
text_mt:
Being pleased, O lotus-eyed lady, the greatness of the hymn, which destroys multitudes of sins
and is endowed with holy fruits and more, has been revealed by me and was recited by the four-faced [Brahmā] himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kathāmimāṃ puṇyaphalādiyuktāṃ nivedya devyai śaśibaddhamūrddhajaḥ /
vṛṣasya pṛṣṭhena sahomayā prabhujagāma kailāsaguhāṃ guhapriyaḥ //
meaning:
कथामिमां पुण्यफलादियुक्तां निवेद्य देव्यै शशिबद्धमूर्द्धजः /
वृषस्य पृष्ठेन सहोमया प्रभुजगाम कैलासगुहां गुहप्रियः //
text_mt: Having revealed to the goddess this narrative endowed with holy fruits and more, the lord who has the moon bound in his hair, / who is fond of Guha, mounted on the back of the bull together with Umā, went to the cave of Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutaṃ mayā pāpaharaṃ tadantike niveditaṃ te 'tha mayā prajāpateḥ /
adhītya sarvaṃ tvakhilaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ prayāti cādityapadaṃ dvijottamaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrva bhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde nīlakaṇṭhanāmotpattikathanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
श्रुतं मया पापहरं तदन्तिके निवेदितं ते ऽथ मया प्रजापतेः /
अधीत्य सर्वं त्वखिलं सलक्षणं प्रयाति चादित्यपदं द्विजोत्तमः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्व भागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे नीलकण्ठनामोत्पत्तिकथनं नाम पञ्चविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
It was heard by me near him, destroying sins, and has now been revealed to you, [the son] of Prajāpati.
Having studied all of it in full with its characteristics, the best of the twice-born goes to the realm of the sun.

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter in the second Anuṣaṅgapāda of the first part in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu, titled 'The Account of the Origin of the Name Nīlakaṇṭha.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
mahādevasya mahātmyaṃ prabhutvaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ /
śrotumicchāmahe samyagaiśvaryaguṇavistaram //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
महादेवस्य महात्म्यं प्रभुत्वं च महात्मनः /
श्रोतुमिच्छामहे सम्यगैश्वर्यगुणविस्तरम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
We wish to hear fully the greatness of Mahādeva and the sovereignty of that great soul, / the extensive details of his divine powers and qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
pūrvaṃ trailokyavijaye viṣṇunā samudātdṛ tam /
baliṃ baddhvā mahāvīryaṃ trailokyādhipatiṃ purā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पूर्वं त्रैलोक्यविजये विष्णुना समुदात्दृ तम् /
बलिं बद्ध्वा महावीर्यं त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं पुरा //
text_mt:
The bard said:
Formerly, during the conquest of the three worlds, after binding the very heroic Bali, / formerly the sovereign of the three worlds, it was declared by Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭeṣu tu daityeṣu prahṛṣṭe tu śacīpatau /
athājagmuḥ prabhuṃ draṣṭuṃ sarve devāḥ sanātanam //
meaning:
प्रनष्टेषु तु दैत्येषु प्रहृष्टे तु शचीपतौ /
अथाजग्मुः प्रभुं द्रष्टुं सर्वे देवाः सनातनम् //
text_mt:
When the Daityas had perished and the lord of Śacī rejoiced,
all the gods then came to behold the eternal lord,

sanskrit_iast:
yatrāste viśvarūpātmā kṣīrodasya masīpataḥ /
siddhā brahmarṣayo yakṣā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
यत्रास्ते विश्वरूपात्मा क्षीरोदस्य मसीपतः /
सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्षयो यक्षा गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः //
text_mt:
where the Universal-Formed soul resides, near the Ocean of Milk—
siddhas, brahmarṣis, yakṣas, and groups of gandharvas and apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgā devarṣayaścaiva nadyaḥ sarve ca parvatāḥ /
abhigamya mahātmānaṃ stuvanti puruṣaṃ harim //
meaning:
नागा देवर्षयश्चैव नद्यः सर्वे च पर्वताः /
अभिगम्य महात्मानं स्तुवन्ति पुरुषं हरिम् //
text_mt:
nāgas, devarṣis, rivers, and all the mountains—
having approached the great-souled Puruṣa Hari, they praised [him]:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ ca kartāsi tvaṃ lokānsṛjasi prabho /
tvatprasādācca kalyāṇaṃ prāptaṃ trailokyamavyayam //
meaning:
त्वं धाता त्वं च कर्तासि त्वं लोकान्सृजसि प्रभो /
त्वत्प्रसादाच्च कल्याणं प्राप्तं त्रैलोक्यमव्ययम् //
text_mt:
"You are the ordainer and you are the maker; you create the worlds, O lord.
And by your grace, the imperishable three worlds have attained welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
asurāśca jitāḥ sarve balirbaddhaśca vai tvayā /
evamuktaḥ surairviṣṇaḥ siddhaiśca paramarṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
असुराश्च जिताः सर्वे बलिर्बद्धश्च वै त्वया /
एवमुक्तः सुरैर्विष्णः सिद्धैश्च परमर्षिभिः //
text_mt:
All the asuras have been conquered, and Bali has indeed been bound by you."
Thus addressed by the gods, the siddhas, and the supreme sages, Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyuvāca tadā devān sarvāṃstānpuruṣottamaḥ /
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi kāraṇaṃ surasattamāḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्युवाच तदा देवान् सर्वांस्तान्पुरुषोत्तमः /
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि कारणं सुरसत्तमाः //
text_mt:
the Supreme Person, then replied to all those gods:
"Let it be heard, O best of gods; I will explain the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ kālaḥ kālakaraḥ prabhuḥ /
yenāhaṃ brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ sṛṣṭā lokāśca māyayā //
meaning:
यः स्रष्टा सर्वभूतानां कालः कालकरः प्रभुः /
येनाहं ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं सृष्टा लोकाश्च मायया //
text_mt:
He who is the creator of all beings, time, the maker of time, the lord,
by whom, through his creative power, the worlds along with Brahmā and myself were created,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva ca prasādena ādau siddhatvamāgataḥ /
purā tamasi cāvyakte trailokye grasite mayā //
meaning:
तस्यैव च प्रसादेन आदौ सिद्धत्वमागतः /
पुरा तमसि चाव्यक्ते त्रैलोक्ये ग्रसिते मया //
text_mt:
by his grace alone did I attain perfection in the beginning.
Formerly, when the three worlds were swallowed up by me in unmanifest darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
udarastheṣu bhūteṣu tveko 'haṃ śayita stadā /
sahasraśīrṣā bhūtvā ca sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt //
meaning:
उदरस्थेषु भूतेषु त्वेको ऽहं शयित स्तदा /
सहस्रशीर्षा भूत्वा च सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् //
text_mt:
and all beings were residing within my belly, I alone was lying asleep at that time,
having become thousand-headed, thousand-eyed, and thousand-footed,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śayito vimaleṃ'bhasi /
etasminnantare dūrātpaśyāmi hyamitaprabham //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिः शयितो विमलेंऽभसि /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूरात्पश्यामि ह्यमितप्रभम् //
text_mt:
holding the conch, discus, and mace in hand, lying in the pure water.
In the meantime, I saw from afar one of immeasurable splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
śatasūryapratīkāśaṃ jvalantaṃ svena tejasā /
caturvaktraṃ mahāyogaṃ puruṣaṃ kāñcanaprabham //
meaning:
शतसूर्यप्रतीकाशं ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा /
चतुर्वक्त्रं महायोगं पुरुषं काञ्चनप्रभम् //
text_mt:
resembling a hundred suns, blazing with his own brilliance,
four-faced, of great yoga, a person with a golden radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ devaṃ kamaṇḍaluvibhūṣitam /
nimeṣāntaramātreṇa prāpto 'sau puruṣottamaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनधरं देवं कमण्डलुविभूषितम् /
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण प्राप्तो ऽसौ पुरुषोत्तमः //
text_mt:
a god wearing a black antelope skin, adorned with a water pot.
