In mere twinkling of an eye, that supreme person arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
tato māmabravīdbrahmā sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ /
kastvaṃ kuto vā ki ceha tiṣṭhase vada me vibho //
meaning:
ततो मामब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः /
कस्त्वं कुतो वा कि चेह तिष्ठसे वद मे विभो //
text_mt:
Then Brahmā, who is bowed to by all the worlds, spoke to me:
'Who are you, whence [have you come], and why do you stay here? Tell me, O omnipresent one.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ kartāsmi lokānāṃ svayaṃbhūrviśvatomukhaḥ /
evamuktastadā tena brahmaṇāhamuvāca tam //
meaning:
अहं कर्तास्मि लोकानां स्वयंभूर्विश्वतोमुखः /
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणाहमुवाच तम् //
text_mt:
I am the maker of the worlds, Svayambhū, facing in all directions.'
Thus addressed by Brahmā at that time, I spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ karttā hi lokānāṃ saṃhartā ca punaḥ punaḥ /
evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇau tu parasparajayaiṣiṇau //
meaning:
अहं कर्त्ता हि लोकानां संहर्ता च पुनः पुनः /
एवं संभाषमाणौ तु परस्परजयैषिणौ //
text_mt:
'I am indeed the maker of the worlds, and the destroyer again and again.'
While we two were conversing in this manner, each desiring victory over the other,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarāṃ diśamāsthāya jvālāmadrākṣva viṣṭhitām /
jvālāṃ tatastāmālokya vismitau ca tadānaghāḥ //
meaning:
उत्तरां दिशमास्थाय ज्वालामद्राक्ष्व विष्ठिताम् /
ज्वालां ततस्तामालोक्य विस्मितौ च तदानघाः //
text_mt:
we saw a flame standing, situated in the northern direction.
Then, beholding that flame, we were astonished, O sinless ones.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā ca balenātha śārvaṃ jyotiḥ kṛtāñjalī /
varddhamānāṃ tadā jvālāmatyantaparamādbhutām //
meaning:
तेजसा च बलेनाथ शार्वं ज्योतिः कृताञ्जली /
वर्द्धमानां तदा ज्वालामत्यन्तपरमाद्भुताम् //
text_mt: With hands folded in reverence toward that light of Śarva, blazing with splendor and power, / that flame was then expanding, exceedingly and supremely wondrous.

sanskrit_iast:
abhidudrāva tāṃ jvālāṃ brahmā cāhaṃ ca satvarau /
divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirbhidya tiṣṭhantaṃ javālamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
अभिदुद्राव तां ज्वालां ब्रह्मा चाहं च सत्वरौ /
दिवं भूमिं च निर्भिद्य तिष्ठन्तं जवालमण्डलम् //
text_mt:
Brahmā and I ran swiftly toward that flame,
the circle of flames standing there, piercing heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā jvālasya madhye tu paśyāvo vipulaprabham /
prādeśamātramavyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ paramadīptimat //
meaning:
तस्या ज्वालस्य मध्ये तु पश्यावो विपुलप्रभम् /
प्रादेशमात्रमव्यक्तं लिङ्गं परमदीप्तिमत् //
text_mt:
In the middle of that flame we both saw, endowed with vast radiance,
an unmanifest liṅga, a span in measure, supremely brilliant.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca tatkāñcanaṃ madhye naśailaṃ na ca rājatam /
anirdeśyamacintyaṃ ca lakṣyālakṣyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
न च तत्काञ्चनं मध्ये नशैलं न च राजतम् /
अनिर्देश्यमचिन्त्यं च लक्ष्यालक्ष्यं पुनः पुनः //
text_mt:
And in the middle it was neither golden, nor of stone, nor of silver,
indescribable and inconceivable, visible and invisible again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ vismayaṃ paramadbhutam /
mahatā tejasāyuktaṃ vardabhamānaṃbhṛśantathā //
meaning:
ज्वालामालासहस्राढ्यं विस्मयं परमद्भुतम् /
महता तेजसायुक्तं वर्दभमानंभृशन्तथा //
text_mt:
abounding with thousands of wreaths of flame, a wondrous supreme marvel,
endowed with great splendour, and growing exceedingly;

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālātataṃ nyastaṃ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaram /
ghorarūpiṇamatyarthaṃ bhindaṃ tamiva rodasī //
meaning:
ज्वालामालाततं न्यस्तं सर्वभूतभयङ्करम् /
घोररूपिणमत्यर्थं भिन्दं तमिव रोदसी //
text_mt:
extended by wreaths of flames, standing firm, causing fear to all beings,
exceedingly terrible in form, as if splitting heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tato māmabravīdbrahmā adho gaccha tvamāśu vai /
antamasya vijānīvo liṅgasya tu mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ततो मामब्रवीद्ब्रह्मा अधो गच्छ त्वमाशु वै /
अन्तमस्य विजानीवो लिङ्गस्य तु महात्मनः //
text_mt:
Then Brahmā said to me: ‘Go swiftly downwards indeed;
let us find the end of this great-souled liṅga.’

sanskrit_iast:
ahamūrdhvaṃ gamiṣyāmi yāvadanto 'sya dṛśyate /
tadā tu samayaṃ kṛtvā gata urddhvamadhaśca hi //
meaning:
अहमूर्ध्वं गमिष्यामि यावदन्तो ऽस्य दृश्यते /
तदा तु समयं कृत्वा गत उर्द्ध्वमधश्च हि //
text_mt:
‘I shall go upwards as far as its end is seen.’
Having made an agreement then, he went upward and [I] downward.

sanskrit_iast:
tato varṣasahasraṃ tu hyahaṃ punaradho gataḥ /
na paśyāmi ca tasyāntaṃ bhītaścāhaṃ tato 'bhavam //
meaning:
ततो वर्षसहस्रं तु ह्यहं पुनरधो गतः /
न पश्यामि च तस्यान्तं भीतश्चाहं ततो ऽभवम् //
text_mt:
Then indeed for a thousand years I went downwards,
and I did not see its end, and I became afraid then.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva brahmā hyūdhva ca na cāntaṃ tasya labdhavān /
samāgato mayā sārddha tatraiva ca mahābhasi //
meaning:
तथैव ब्रह्मा ह्यूध्व च न चान्तं तस्य लब्धवान् /
समागतो मया सार्द्ध तत्रैव च महाभसि //
text_mt:
Likewise Brahmā went upwards and did not reach its end;
he met together with me right there in the great water.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vismayamāpannau bhītau tasya mahātmanaḥ /
māyayā mohitau tena naṣṭasaṃjñai vyavasthitau //
meaning:
ततो विस्मयमापन्नौ भीतौ तस्य महात्मनः /
मायया मोहितौ तेन नष्टसंज्ञै व्यवस्थितौ //
text_mt:
Then struck with wonder, afraid of that great soul,
deluded by his māyā, they stood with their senses confounded.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhyānaratau tatra ceśvaraṃ sarvatomukham /
prabhavaṃ nidhanaṃ caiva laukānāṃ prabhumavyayam //
meaning:
ततो ध्यानरतौ तत्र चेश्वरं सर्वतोमुखम् /
प्रभवं निधनं चैव लौकानां प्रभुमव्ययम् //
text_mt:
Then engaged in meditation there upon the Lord facing everywhere,
the origin and dissolution of the worlds, the imperishable Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
prahvāñjalipuṭau bhūtvā tasmai śarvāya śūline /
mahābhairavanādāya bhīmarūpāya daṃṣṭriṇe /
avyaktāyātha mahate namaskāraṃ prakurvahe //
meaning:
प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटौ भूत्वा तस्मै शर्वाय शूलिने /
महाभैरवनादाय भीमरूपाय दंष्ट्रिणे /
अव्यक्तायाथ महते नमस्कारं प्रकुर्वहे //
text_mt:
having bowed with cupped hands, to that Śarva bearing the trident,
roaring with a great Bhairava cry, of terrible form, fanged,
to the unmanifest and the great, we make obeisance:

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te lokasureśa deva namo 'stu te bhūtapate mahātman /
namo 'stu te śāśvatasiddhayogine namostu te sarvajagatpratiṣṭhita //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते लोकसुरेश देव नमो ऽस्तु ते भूतपते महात्मन् /
नमो ऽस्तु ते शाश्वतसिद्धयोगिने नमोस्तु ते सर्वजगत्प्रतिष्ठित //
text_mt:
‘Obeisance be to you, Lord of the worlds and gods, O god; obeisance be to you, Lord of beings, great soul!
Obeisance be to you, eternal perfected yogin; obeisance be to you, grounded in the entire world!

sanskrit_iast:
parameṣṭhī paraṃ brahma tvakṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam /
jyeṣṭhastvaṃ vāmadevaśca rudraḥ skandaḥ śivaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
परमेष्ठी परं ब्रह्म त्वक्षरं परमं पदम् /
ज्येष्ठस्त्वं वामदेवश्च रुद्रः स्कन्दः शिवः प्रभुः //
text_mt:
You are the Supreme Lord, the supreme Brahman, the imperishable, the supreme state;
you are the Eldest, Vāmadeva, Rudra, Skanda, Śiva, the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ya5stvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṅkāraḥ parantapaḥ /
svāhākāro namaskāraḥ saṃskāraḥ sarvakarmaṇām //
meaning:
त्वं य5स्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमोङ्कारः परन्तपः /
स्वाहाकारो नमस्कारः संस्कारः सर्वकर्मणाम् //
text_mt:
You are the sacrifice, you are the vaṣaṭ-call, you are the syllable Oṃ, tormentor of foes;
you are the svāhā-call, the greeting of obeisance, the sacred rite of all actions.

sanskrit_iast:
svadhākāraśca yajñaśca vratāni niyamāstathā /
vedā lokāśca devāśca bhagavāneva sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
स्वधाकारश्च यज्ञश्च व्रतानि नियमास्तथा /
वेदा लोकाश्च देवाश्च भगवानेव सर्वशः //
text_mt:
You are the svadhā-call and the sacrifice, the vows and the observances;
the Vedas, the worlds, and the gods—you are the Blessed One entirely.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśasya ca śabdastvaṃbhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ /
bhūmau gandho rasaścāpsu tejorūpaṃ maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
आकाशस्य च शब्दस्त्वंभूतानां प्रभवाप्ययः /
भूमौ गन्धो रसश्चाप्सु तेजोरूपं महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
You are the sound of space, the origin and dissolution of beings,
the fragrance in earth, the taste in water, the form in light, Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast: vāyoḥ sparśaśca deveśa vapuścandramasastathā //
meaning: वायोः स्पर्शश्च देवेश वपुश्चन्द्रमसस्तथा //
text_mt: and the touch in air, O Lord of gods, and the beauty of the moon;

sanskrit_iast: buddhau jñānaṃ ca deveśa prakṛterbījameva ca //
meaning: बुद्धौ ज्ञानं च देवेश प्रकृतेर्बीजमेव च //
text_mt: and the knowledge in intellect, O Lord of gods, and the seed of prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃharttā sarvalokānāṃ kālo mṛtyumayoṃ'takaḥ /
tvaṃ dhārayasi lokāṃstrīṃstvameva sṛjasi prabho //
meaning:
संहर्त्ता सर्वलोकानां कालो मृत्युमयोंऽतकः /
त्वं धारयसि लोकांस्त्रींस्त्वमेव सृजसि प्रभो //
text_mt:
You are the destroyer of all worlds, Time consisting of death, the End-maker;
you uphold the three worlds; you alone create them, O Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrveṇa vadanena tvamindratvaṃ prakaroṣi vai /
dakṣiṇena tu vaktreṇa lokānsaṃkṣipase punaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वेण वदनेन त्वमिन्द्रत्वं प्रकरोषि वै /
दक्षिणेन तु वक्त्रेण लोकान्संक्षिपसे पुनः //
text_mt:
With your eastern face you indeed exercise Indra’s sovereignty;
with your southern face you withdraw the worlds again.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimena tu vaktreṇa varuṇastho na saṃśayaḥ /
uttareṇa tu vaktreṇa somastvaṃ devasattamaḥ //
meaning:
पश्चिमेन तु वक्त्रेण वरुणस्थो न संशयः /
उत्तरेण तु वक्त्रेण सोमस्त्वं देवसत्तमः //
text_mt:
With your western face you abide as Varuṇa, without doubt;
with your northern face you are Soma, best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadhā bahudhā deva lokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ /
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaśca sahāśvinaḥ //
meaning:
एकधा बहुधा देव लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययः /
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतश्च सहाश्विनः //
text_mt:
You are the origin and dissolution of the worlds, singly and manifoldly, O god:
the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Maruts together with the Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyā vidyādharā nāgāścāraṇāśca tapodhanāḥ /
vālakhilyā mahātmānastapaḥ siddhāśca suvratāḥ //
meaning:
साध्या विद्याधरा नागाश्चारणाश्च तपोधनाः /
वालखिल्या महात्मानस्तपः सिद्धाश्च सुव्रताः //
text_mt:
the Sādhyas, Vidyādharas, Nāgas, Cāraṇas, and those whose wealth is asceticism,
the great-souled Vālakhilyas, and those perfected through asceticism, of virtuous vows,

sanskrit_iast:
tvattaḥ prasūtā deveśa ye cānye niyatavratāḥ /
umā sītā sinīvālī kuhūrgāyatrya eva ca //
meaning:
त्वत्तः प्रसूता देवेश ये चान्ये नियतव्रताः /
उमा सीता सिनीवाली कुहूर्गायत्र्य एव च //
text_mt:
and whatever others of fixed vows—they are born from you, O Lord of gods;
Umā, Sītā, Sinīvālī, Kuhū, and Gāyatrī,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ kīrttirdhṛtirmedhā lajjā kāntirvapuḥ svadhā /
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyā caiva vācāṃ devī sarasvatī /
tvattaḥ prasūtā deveśa saṃdhyā rātristathaiva ca //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः कीर्त्तिर्धृतिर्मेधा लज्जा कान्तिर्वपुः स्वधा /
तुष्टिः पुष्टिः क्रिया चैव वाचां देवी सरस्वती /
त्वत्तः प्रसूता देवेश संध्या रात्रिस्तथैव च //
text_mt:
Lakṣmī, Kīrti, Dhṛti, Medhā, Lajjā, Kānti, Vapus, Svadhā,
Tuṣṭi, Puṣṭi, Kriyā, and Sarasvatī the goddess of speech—
they are born from you, O Lord of gods, as well as twilight and night.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāyutānāmayutaprabhāva namo 'stu te candrasahasragaura /
namo 'stu te vajrapinākadhāriṇe namostu te deva hiraṇyavāsase //
meaning:
सूर्यायुतानामयुतप्रभाव नमो ऽस्तु ते चन्द्रसहस्रगौर /
नमो ऽस्तु ते वज्रपिनाकधारिणे नमोस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवाससे //
text_mt:
You whose majesty equals ten thousand suns, obeisance be to you, white as a thousand moons!
Obeisance be to you, bearer of the thunderbolt and the Pināka; obeisance be to you, O god clad in gold!

sanskrit_iast:
namostu te bhasmavibhūṣitāṅga namo 'stu te kāmaśarīranāśana /
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyaretase namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavāsase //
meaning:
नमोस्तु ते भस्मविभूषिताङ्ग नमो ऽस्तु ते कामशरीरनाशन /
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यरेतसे नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवाससे //
text_mt:
Obeisance be to you whose limbs are adorned with ashes; obeisance be to you, destroyer of Kāma’s body!
Obeisance be to you, O god of golden seed; obeisance be to you, O god clad in gold!

Obeisance be to you, O god, source of gold; obeisance be to you, O god of golden navel!
Obeisance be to you, O god of golden seed; obeisance be to you, wondrous with a thousand eyes!

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyayone namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyanābha /
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyaretase namo 'stu te netrasahasracitra //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्ययोने नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यनाभ /
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यरेतसे नमो ऽस्तु ते नेत्रसहस्रचित्र //
text_mt:
Obeisance be to you, O god of golden hue; obeisance be to you, O god of golden hair!
Obeisance be to you, O god of golden hero[ic power]; obeisance be to you, O god who bestows gold!

Obeisance be to you, O god, lord of gold; obeisance be to you, O god of golden sound!
Obeisance be to you, O god with Pināka in hand; obeisance be to you, O Śaṅkara, blue-throated one!’

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavarṇa namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyakeśa /
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyavīra namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyadāyine //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवर्ण नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यकेश /
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यवीर नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यदायिने //

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu te deva hiraṇyanātha namo 'śtute deva hiraṇyanāda /
namo 'stu te deva pinākapāṇe namo 'śtute te śaṅkara nīlakaṇṭha //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव हिरण्यनाथ नमो ऽश्तुते देव हिरण्यनाद /
नमो ऽस्तु ते देव पिनाकपाणे नमो ऽश्तुते ते शङ्कर नीलकण्ठ //

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu vyakto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ /
devadevo jagadyoniḥ sūrya koṭisamaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु व्यक्तो भूत्वा महामतिः /
देवदेवो जगद्योनिः सूर्य कोटिसमप्रभः //
text_mt:
Being praised thus, having become manifest, the highly intelligent one,
the god of gods, the womb of the universe, possessing splendour equal to ten million suns,

sanskrit_iast:
ābabhāṣe kṛpāviṣṭo mahādevo mahādyutiḥ /
vaktrakoṭisahasreṇa grasamāna ivāṃbaram //
meaning:
आबभाषे कृपाविष्टो महादेवो महाद्युतिः /
वक्त्रकोटिसहस्रेण ग्रसमान इवांबरम् //
text_mt:
filled with compassion, Mahādeva of great brilliance spoke,
as if devouring the sky with thousands of ten millions of faces,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃbugrīvaḥ suja ṭharo nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ /
nānāratnavicitrāṅgo nānāmālyānulepanaḥ //
meaning:
कंबुग्रीवः सुज ठरो नानाभूषणभूषितः /
नानारत्नविचित्राङ्गो नानामाल्यानुलेपनः //
text_mt:
conch-necked, broad-chested, adorned with various ornaments,
his limbs decorated with various gems, with various garlands and ointments,

sanskrit_iast:
pinākapāṇirbhagavānsurapūjyastriśūladhṛk /
vyālaya jñopavītī ca surāṇāmabhayaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान्सुरपूज्यस्त्रिशूलधृक् /
व्यालय ज्ञोपवीती च सुराणामभयङ्करः //
text_mt:
the Blessed One holding the Pināka in his hand, worshipped by gods, trident-bearer,
wearing a serpent as a sacred thread, granting fearlessness to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dundubhisvaranirghoṣaḥ parjanyaninadopamaḥ /
mukto hāsastadā tena sarvamāpūrayañjagat //
meaning:
दुन्दुभिस्वरनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः /
मुक्तो हासस्तदा तेन सर्वमापूरयञ्जगत् //
text_mt:
With the sound like the resonance of kettle-drums, like the roar of rain-clouds,
a laugh was then released by him, filling the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tena śabdena mahatā cāvāṃ bhītau mahātmanaḥ /
athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau //
meaning:
तेन शब्देन महता चावां भीतौ महात्मनः /
अथोवाच महादेवः प्रीतो ऽहं सुरसत्तमौ //
text_mt:
At that great sound, both of us were terrified of that great soul.
Then Mahādeva said: ‘I am pleased, O two best of gods;

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatāṃ ca mahāyogaṃ bhayaṃ sarva pramucyatām /
yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrebhyo mama pūrvaṃ sanātanau //
meaning:
पश्यतां च महायोगं भयं सर्व प्रमुच्यताम् /
युवां प्रसूतौ गात्रेभ्यो मम पूर्वं सनातनौ //
text_mt:
behold my great yoga, let all fear be cast away!
You two, eternal ones, were born from my limbs formerly:

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ me dakṣiṇo bāhurbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
vāmo bāhuśca me viṣṇurnityaṃ yuddheṣvanirjitaḥ //
meaning:
यं मे दक्षिणो बाहुर्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
वामो बाहुश्च मे विष्णुर्नित्यं युद्धेष्वनिर्जितः //
text_mt:
Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, is my right arm,
and Viṣṇu, ever unconquered in battles, is my left arm.

sanskrit_iast:
prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyagvaraṃ dadyāṃ yathaipsitam /
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasau praṇatau pādayoḥ prabhoḥ //
meaning:
प्रीतो ऽहं युवयोः सम्यग्वरं दद्यां यथैप्सितम् /
ततः प्रहृष्टमनसौ प्रणतौ पादयोः प्रभोः //
text_mt:
I am truly pleased with you two; I shall grant a boon as desired.’
Then, with delighted minds, the two bowed at the feet of the Lord

sanskrit_iast:
abrūtāṃ ca mahādevaṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ sthitam /
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaśca te /
bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi deva sureśvara //
meaning:
अब्रूतां च महादेवं प्रसादाभिमुखं स्थितम् /
यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो वरश्च ते /
भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि देव सुरेश्वर //
text_mt:
and spoke to Mahādeva, who stood turned towards showing grace:
‘If pleasure has arisen in you, and if a boon is to be given by you,
let devotion to you be ours always, O god, Lord of gods!’

sanskrit_iast:
devadeva uvāca
evamastu mahābhāgau sṛjatāṃ vipulāḥ prajāḥ /
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivātaradhādvibhuḥ //
meaning:
देवदेव उवाच
एवमस्तु महाभागौ सृजतां विपुलाः प्रजाः /
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवातरधाद्विभुः //
text_mt:
The god of gods said:
‘So be it, O fortunate ones; create abundant offspring!’
Having spoken thus, the all-pervading Blessed One vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva mayokto vaḥ prabhāvastasya dhīmataḥ /
etaddhi paramaṃ jñānamavyaktaṃ śivasaṃjñitam //
meaning:
एष एव मयोक्तो वः प्रभावस्तस्य धीमतः /
एतद्धि परमं ज्ञानमव्यक्तं शिवसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt:
This very power of that wise one has been related to you by me;
for this is the supreme unmanifest knowledge called Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsūkṣmamacintyaṃ ca paśyanti jña3nacakṣuṣaḥ /
tasmai devādhidevāya namaskāraṃ prakurmahe /
mahādeva namaste 'stu maheśvara namo 'stu te //
meaning:
एतत्सूक्ष्ममचिन्त्यं च पश्यन्ति ज्ञ3नचक्षुषः /
तस्मै देवाधिदेवाय नमस्कारं प्रकुर्महे /
महादेव नमस्ते ऽस्तु महेश्वर नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
This subtle and inconceivable [truth] those with the eye of knowledge see.
To that god above gods we make obeisance:
O Mahādeva, obeisance be to you; O Maheśvara, obeisance be to you!”

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
etacchrutvā gatāḥ sarve surāḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam /
namaskāraṃ prakurvāṇāḥ śaṅkarāya mahātmane //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा गताः सर्वे सुराः स्वं स्वं निवेशनम् /
नमस्कारं प्रकुर्वाणाः शङ्कराय महात्मने //
text_mt:
The bard said:
Having heard this, all the gods went to their respective abodes,
making obeisance to the great-souled Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ stavaṃ paṭhidyastu ceśvarasya mahātmanaḥ /
kāmāṃśca labhate sarvān pāpebhyaśca pramucyate //
meaning:
इमं स्तवं पठिद्यस्तु चेश्वरस्य महात्मनः /
कामांश्च लभते सर्वान् पापेभ्यश्च प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Whoever recites this hymn of praise to the great-souled Lord
obtains all desires and is freed from sins.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ tadā tena na viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā /
mahādevaprasādena hyuktaṃ brahma sanātanam /
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mayā māheśvaraṃ balam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde liṅgotpattikathanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं तदा तेन न विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना /
महादेवप्रसादेन ह्युक्तं ब्रह्म सनातनम् /
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं मया माहेश्वरं बलम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे लिङ्गोत्पत्तिकथनं नाम षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
All this eternal Brahman was then declared by the mighty Viṣṇu / through the grace of Mahādeva. / Thus all this might of Maheśvara has been told to you by me.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, entitled “The Account of the Origin of the Liṅga”, in the second [part], the Anuṣaṅgapāda, of the first section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
bhūya ṣuta mahābuddhe kathayasva mahātmanaḥ /
mahādevasya māhātmyaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ ca naḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
भूय षुत महाबुद्धे कथयस्व महात्मनः /
महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुं कौतूहलं च नः //
text_mt: The sages said: / Speak again, O bard of great intellect, of the greatness of high-souled / Mahādeva; we are eager to hear.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ dāruvaṇe deva-ṛṣisaṃghaniṣevite /
cakāra veṣaṃ vikṛtaṃ yena buddhā maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
कथं दारुवणे देव-ऋषिसंघनिषेविते /
चकार वेषं विकृतं येन बुद्धा महर्षयः //
text_mt: Why did he assume a deformed guise in the Dāruvana, frequented by hosts of gods and sages, / by which the great sages were perplexed?

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā ca te mahādevaṃ tato bhrāntā hyacetasaḥ /
ārādhayanprasādārthaṃ naiṣāṃ tuṣṭaḥ punarbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा च ते महादेवं ततो भ्रान्ता ह्यचेतसः /
आराधयन्प्रसादार्थं नैषां तुष्टः पुनर्भवः //
text_mt: And when they recognized Mahādeva, they were bewildered and senseless; / they worshipped him to obtain his grace, yet Bhava was not pleased with them.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ devadevena ceṣṭitam /
tatsarvaṃ kathayasveha tvaṃ no buddhimatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं यथावृत्तं देवदेवेन चेष्टितम् /
तत्सर्वं कथयस्वेह त्वं नो बुद्धिमतां वरः //
text_mt: All this that happened, the deed performed by the God of gods— / tell us all of that here; you are the best among the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi dharmametamatandritāḥ /
nirmmitaṃ devadevena bhaktānāmanukaṃpayā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि धर्ममेतमतन्द्रिताः /
निर्म्मितं देवदेवेन भक्तानामनुकंपया //
text_mt: The bard said: / Listen alertly; I shall declare this sacred duty / ordained by the God of gods out of compassion for his devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ śṛṅge himavataḥ śubhe /
devadāruvanaṃ ramyaṃ nānādrumalatākulam //
meaning:
पुरा कृतयुगे विप्राः शृङ्गे हिमवतः शुभे /
देवदारुवनं रम्यं नानाद्रुमलताकुलम् //
text_mt: Formerly, O brahmins, in the Kṛta age, on an auspicious peak of the Himālaya, / there was the delightful Devadāruvana, crowded with various trees and creepers.

sanskrit_iast:
bahavo munayastatra tapasyanto munivratāḥ /
śaivāla bhojanāḥ kecitkecidantarjaleśayāḥ //
meaning:
बहवो मुनयस्तत्र तपस्यन्तो मुनिव्रताः /
शैवाल भोजनाः केचित्केचिदन्तर्जलेशयाः //
text_mt: Many sages were performing austerities there, observing the vows of hermits: / some eating moss, some lying inside the water,

sanskrit_iast:
kecidabhrāvakāśāstu pādāṅguṣṭhāgradhiṣṭhitāḥ /
dantolūkhalinaścānye tvaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare //
meaning:
केचिदभ्रावकाशास्तु पादाङ्गुष्ठाग्रधिष्ठिताः /
दन्तोलूखलिनश्चान्ये त्वश्मकुट्टास्तथा परे //
text_mt: some exposed to the clouds and standing on the tips of their big toes, / others using their teeth as mortars, and still others crushing [food] with stones;

sanskrit_iast:
sthānavīrāsanāścānye mṛgayaryāratāstathā /
kālaṃ nayanti tapasā tīvreṇa ca mahādhiyaḥ //
meaning:
स्थानवीरासनाश्चान्ये मृगयर्यारतास्तथा /
कालं नयन्ति तपसा तीव्रेण च महाधियः //
text_mt: others standing or practicing the vīrāsana posture, and likewise devoted to the deer-vow; / those of great intellect passed their time in severe austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣāṃ prasādārtha devastadvanamāgataḥ /
bhasmapāṇḍuradigdhāṅgo nagno vikṛtalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तेषां प्रसादार्थ देवस्तद्वनमागतः /
भस्मपाण्डुरदिग्धाङ्गो नग्नो विकृतलक्षणः //
text_mt: Then, to bestow grace upon them, the god came to that forest, / his body smeared white with ash, naked, with deformed characteristics,

sanskrit_iast:
vikṛtasrastakeśaśca karāladaśanastathā /
ulmukavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ //
meaning:
विकृतस्रस्तकेशश्च करालदशनस्तथा /
उल्मुकव्यग्रहस्तश्च रक्तपिङ्गललोचनः //
text_mt: with disheveled, bristling hair, terrible fangs, / a firebrand grasped in his hand, and reddish-tawny eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ tasya raktagairikasannibham /
mukhamaṅgāravarṇena śuklena ca vibhūṣitam //
meaning:
शिश्नं सवृषणं तस्य रक्तगैरिकसन्निभम् /
मुखमङ्गारवर्णेन शुक्लेन च विभूषितम् //
text_mt: His penis and testicles resembled red chalk; / his face was adorned with the color of charcoal and with white.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitsa hasate raudraṃ kvacidgāyati vismi taḥ /
kvacinnṛtyati śṛṅgārī kvacidrauti muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
क्वचित्स हसते रौद्रं क्वचिद्गायति विस्मि तः /
क्वचिन्नृत्यति शृङ्गारी क्वचिद्रौति मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: Sometimes he laughed fiercely, sometimes he sang with amazement, / sometimes he danced amorously, sometimes he cried out again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyanta rurudhustūrṇaṃ patnyasteṣāṃ vimohitāḥ /
āśrame 'bhyāgato 'bhīkṣṇaṃ yā cate ca punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
नृत्यन्त रुरुधुस्तूर्णं पत्न्यस्तेषां विमोहिताः /
आश्रमे ऽभ्यागतो ऽभीक्ष्णं या चते च पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Their wives, utterly infatuated, quickly thronged around him as he danced; / he repeatedly approached the hermitage and begged again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryā kṛtā tathārūpā tṛṇābharaṇabhūṣitā /
vṛṣanādaṃ pragarjanvai kharanādaṃ nanāda ca //
meaning:
भार्या कृता तथारूपा तृणाभरणभूषिता /
वृषनादं प्रगर्जन्वै खरनादं ननाद च //
text_mt: His wife assumed the same form, adorned with grass ornaments; / he roared with the roar of a bull and brayed with the bray of a donkey.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vañcitumā rabdho hāsayansarvadehinaḥ /
tataste munayaḥ kruddhāḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तथा वञ्चितुमा रब्धो हासयन्सर्वदेहिनः /
ततस्ते मुनयः क्रुद्धाः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृताः //
text_mt: Thus he began to beguile them, making all embodied beings laugh; / then those sages grew furious, defiled by wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
mohitā māyayā sarve śapituṃ samupasthitāḥ /
karavadgāyase yasmātkharastasmādbhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
मोहिता मायया सर्वे शपितुं समुपस्थिताः /
करवद्गायसे यस्मात्खरस्तस्माद्भविष्यसि //
text_mt: All of them, deluded by his māyā, came forward to curse him: / “Because you sing like an ass, you shall become an ass!

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣaso vā piśāco vā dānavo vātha vā tathā /
yathā vaicchaṃstathā sarve kruddhāste munayaḥ samam //
meaning:
राक्षसो वा पिशाचो वा दानवो वाथ वा तथा /
यथा वैच्छंस्तथा सर्वे क्रुद्धास्ते मुनयः समम् //
text_mt: Or a rākṣasa, a piśāca, or a dānava!” / Thus, as they wished, all those enraged sages together

sanskrit_iast:
śepuḥ śāsaistu vividhaistaṃ devaṃ bhuvaneśvaram /
tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare //
meaning:
शेपुः शासैस्तु विविधैस्तं देवं भुवनेश्वरम् /
तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शङ्करे //
text_mt: cursed that god, the lord of the world, with various curses; / but all their austerities were repelled by Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ /
na dyotante prakāśena tadvattejāṃsi śaṅkare //
meaning:
यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः /
न द्योतन्ते प्रकाशेन तद्वत्तेजांसि शङ्करे //
text_mt: Just as the stars standing in the sky, in the presence of the sun’s light, / do not shine with their light, so their fiery energies [failed] against Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate ṛṣiśāpena brahmaṇaḥ sumahātmanaḥ /
samṛddhaḥ śreyasāṃ yauniryajño vai nāśamāptavān //
meaning:
श्रूयते ऋषिशापेन ब्रह्मणः सुमहात्मनः /
समृद्धः श्रेयसां यौनिर्यज्ञो वै नाशमाप्तवान् //
text_mt: It is heard that through the curse of a sage, the prosperous sacrifice of high-souled / Brahmā, the source of welfare, met with destruction;

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgorapi ca śāpena viṣṇuḥ paramaviyavān /
prādurbhāvāndaśa prāpto duḥkhitaśca sadā kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
भृगोरपि च शापेन विष्णुः परमवियवान् /
प्रादुर्भावान्दश प्राप्तो दुःखितश्च सदा कृतः //
text_mt: and by the curse of Bhṛgu, Viṣṇu of supreme power / underwent ten incarnations and was constantly afflicted with suffering;

sanskrit_iast:
indrasyāpi hi dharmajñaḥ śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ purā /
ṛṣiṇā gautamenorvyāṃ kruddhena vinipātitam //
meaning:
इन्द्रस्यापि हि धर्मज्ञः शिश्नं सवृषणं पुरा /
ऋषिणा गौतमेनोर्व्यां क्रुद्धेन विनिपातितम् //
text_mt: and formerly Indra’s penis and testicles, O knower of dharma, / were struck down onto the earth by the enraged sage Gautama;

sanskrit_iast:
garbhavāso vasūnāṃ ca śāpena vihita stathā /
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva śāpena nahuṣaḥ sarpatāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
गर्भवासो वसूनां च शापेन विहित स्तथा /
ऋषीणां चैव शापेन नहुषः सर्पतां गतः //
text_mt: and residence in the womb was ordained for the Vasus by a curse, / and Nahuṣa became a serpent through the curse of the sages;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodaśca samudraśca hyapeyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ /
dharmaścātra praśapto vai māṇḍavyena mahātmanā //
meaning:
क्षीरोदश्च समुद्रश्च ह्यपेयो ब्राह्मणैः कृतः /
धर्मश्चात्र प्रशप्तो वै माण्डव्येन महात्मना //
text_mt: and the ocean of milk was made undrinkable by the brahmins, / and Dharma himself was cursed here by high-souled Māṇḍavya;

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānye ca bahavo yātanāṃ ca samāgatāḥ /
varjayitvā virūpākṣaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
एते चान्ये च बहवो यातनां च समागताः /
वर्जयित्वा विरूपाक्षं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: these and many others suffered torment, / with the exception of the odd-eyed Maheśvara, the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi mohitāstena na cābuddhyanta śaṅkaram /
tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve parasparamathābruvan //
meaning:
एवं हि मोहितास्तेन न चाबुद्ध्यन्त शङ्करम् /
ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे परस्परमथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Thus deluded by him, they did not recognize Śaṅkara. / Then all those sages spoke to one another:

sanskrit_iast:
na cāyaṃ vidhirasmākaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ vidhīyate /
brahmacarya ratānāṃ ca vane vā vanavāsinām //
meaning:
न चायं विधिरस्माकं गृहस्थानां विधीयते /
ब्रह्मचर्य रतानां च वने वा वनवासिनाम् //
text_mt: “This rule is not prescribed for us householders, / nor for those devoted to celibacy, nor for forest-dwellers in the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
yatīnāṃ vā tathā dharmo nāyaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ kathañcana /
anayastu mahāneṣa yenāyaṃ mohito dvijāḥ //
meaning:
यतीनां वा तथा धर्मो नायं दृष्टः कथञ्चन /
अनयस्तु महानेष येनायं मोहितो द्विजाः //
text_mt: nor is this duty ever seen for ascetics. / This is a great misdeed by which this man is deluded, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgaṃ prapātayasvaitannāyaṃ dharmastapasvinām /
vadasva vācā madhuraṃ vastramekaṃ samāśraya //
meaning:
लिङ्गं प्रपातयस्वैतन्नायं धर्मस्तपस्विनाम् /
वदस्व वाचा मधुरं वस्त्रमेकं समाश्रय //
text_mt: Cast down this liṅga! This is not the practice of ascetics; / speak with a sweet voice, and take resort to a single garment!

sanskrit_iast:
tyājite ca tvayā liṅge tataḥ pūjāmavāpsyasi /
ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānbhaganetrahā //
meaning:
त्याजिते च त्वया लिङ्गे ततः पूजामवाप्स्यसि /
ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्भगनेत्रहा //
text_mt: When the liṅga is discarded by you, you will then receive worship.” / Hearing those words of the sages, the blessed one, the destroyer of Bhaga’s eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ /
na śakyamidamasmā kaṃ liṅgaṃ pātayituṃ balāt //
meaning:
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा प्रहसन्निव शङ्करः /
न शक्यमिदमस्मा कं लिङ्गं पातयितुं बलात् //
text_mt: Śaṅkara, spoke with smooth words as if laughing: / “It is not possible for our liṅga to be thrown down by force

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādidaivataiḥ sarvaiḥ kimutānyaistapodhanaiḥ /
pātayeyamahaṃ caitalliṅgaṃ bho dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिदैवतैः सर्वैः किमुतान्यैस्तपोधनैः /
पातयेयमहं चैतल्लिङ्गं भो द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: by all the deities beginning with Brahmā, let alone by other ascetics! / Yet I myself will drop this liṅga, O best of the twice-born!”

sanskrit_iast:
āśrame tiṣṭha vā gaccha vākyamityeva te 'bruvan /
evamukto mahādevaḥ pratdṛṣṭendriyaceṣṭitaḥ //
meaning:
आश्रमे तिष्ठ वा गच्छ वाक्यमित्येव ते ऽब्रुवन् /
एवमुक्तो महादेवः प्रत्दृष्टेन्द्रियचेष्टितः //
text_mt: They said these words: “Stay in the hermitage or go!” / Thus addressed, Mahādeva, whose sensory actions were concealed,

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmeva tatraivāntardadhe prabhuḥ /
antarhite bhagavati tathā liṅge kṛte bhave //
meaning:
सर्वेषां पश्यतामेव तत्रैवान्तर्दधे प्रभुः /
अन्तर्हिते भगवति तथा लिङ्गे कृते भवे //
text_mt: vanished right there while everyone was watching. / When the blessed one had vanished and the liṅga had been discarded by Bhava,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ prādurbhāvo na jāyate /
vyākulaṃ ca tadā sarvaṃ na prakāśeta kiñcana //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां प्रादुर्भावो न जायते /
व्याकुलं च तदा सर्वं न प्रकाशेत किञ्चन //
text_mt: no manifestation of all beings occurred in the three worlds, / and everything was perturbed then; nothing shone.

sanskrit_iast:
tapate caiva nādityo niṣprabhaḥ pāvakastathā /
nakṣatrāṇi grahāścaiva viparītā vijajñire //
meaning:
तपते चैव नादित्यो निष्प्रभः पावकस्तथा /
नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्चैव विपरीता विजज्ञिरे //
text_mt: The sun did not shine, and fire was bereft of brilliance; / the lunar mansions and the planets became anomalous.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtānārtha pravṛttānāmṛṣīṇāṃ vibhavātmanām /
kratavo na vyavarttanta ṛtukālābhigāminām //
meaning:
संतानार्थ प्रवृत्तानामृषीणां विभवात्मनाम् /
क्रतवो न व्यवर्त्तन्त ऋतुकालाभिगामिनाम् //
text_mt: The sacrifices of the glorious sages engaged in procreation, / who approached their wives at the proper season, did not proceed.

sanskrit_iast:
te carati punarddharmmaṃ nirmamā nirahaṅkṛtāḥ /
naṣṭaprabhāvavīryāśca naṣṭatejasa eva ca //
meaning:
ते चरति पुनर्द्धर्म्मं निर्ममा निरहङ्कृताः /
नष्टप्रभाववीर्याश्च नष्टतेजस एव च //
text_mt: Free from mineness and free from egoism, / bereft of power and valor, and deprived of their fiery energy, they still practiced dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
dharme caiva matisteṣāṃ tadā na vyavatiṣṭhate /
te tusarve samāgamya brahmalokamupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मे चैव मतिस्तेषां तदा न व्यवतिष्ठते /
ते तुसर्वे समागम्य ब्रह्मलोकमुपागताः //
text_mt: And their mind did not remain firm in sacred duty. / Then all of them assembled and went to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā puṣpakasaṃbhavam /
pādayoḥ patitāḥ sarve śivavṛttāntamūcire //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणो भवनं गत्वा दृष्ट्वा पुष्पकसंभवम् /
पादयोः पतिताः सर्वे शिववृत्तान्तमूचिरे //
text_mt: Going to the abode of Brahmā and seeing the one born of the lotus, / they all fell at his feet and told him of the incident with Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
vikaṭaḥ stabdhakeśaśca karāladaśanastathā /
ulūkavyagrahastaśca raktapiṅgalalocanaḥ //
meaning:
विकटः स्तब्धकेशश्च करालदशनस्तथा /
उलूकव्यग्रहस्तश्च रक्तपिङ्गललोचनः //
text_mt: “Hideous, with bristling hair, terrible fangs, / with an owl grasped in his hand, and reddish-tawny eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
śiśnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ tasya raktaṃ gairikamaṇḍitam /
snuṣāṇāṃ ca duhitṝṇāṃ putrīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
शिश्नं सवृषणं तस्य रक्तं गैरिकमण्डितम् /
स्नुषाणां च दुहितॄणां पुत्रीणां च विशेषतः //
text_mt: his penis and testicles red and adorned with red chalk, / especially around our daughters-in-law and daughters,

sanskrit_iast:
vartamānastataḥ pārśve viparītābhilāṣataḥ /
unmatta iti vijñāya so 'smābhiravamānitaḥ //
meaning:
वर्तमानस्ततः पार्श्वे विपरीताभिलाषतः /
उन्मत्त इति विज्ञाय सो ऽस्माभिरवमानितः //
text_mt: staying beside them with contrary desire— / knowing him to be mad, he was insulted by us,

sanskrit_iast:
ākruṣṭastāḍitaścāpi liṅgaṃ cāpyasya coddhṛtam /
tasya krodhaprasādārthaṃ vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
आक्रुष्टस्ताडितश्चापि लिङ्गं चाप्यस्य चोद्धृतम् /
तस्य क्रोधप्रसादार्थं वयं ते शरणं गताः //
text_mt: berated and struck, and his liṅga was pulled down. / In order to pacify his anger, we have come to you for refuge.”

sanskrit_iast:
etatkāryaṃ na jānīmastanno brūhi pitāmaha /
ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dhyānādvijñāya ceśvaram //
meaning:
एतत्कार्यं न जानीमस्तन्नो ब्रूहि पितामह /
ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा ध्यानाद्विज्ञाय चेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
"We do not know what must be done here; therefore tell us, Grandfather!"
Having heard those words of the sages, and knowing the Lord through meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyuvāca tato brahmā vākyaṃ ca susamā hitaḥ /
eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्युवाच ततो ब्रह्मा वाक्यं च सुसमा हितः /
एष देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
Brahmā then, intensely concentrated, spoke these words in reply:
"This god is Mahādeva, who must be known as the Great Lord (Maheśvara).

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya paramaṃ kiñcitpadaṃ samadhigamyate /
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ caiva sa prabhuḥ //
meaning:
न तस्य परमं किञ्चित्पदं समधिगम्यते /
देवानां च ऋषीणां च पितृणां चैव स प्रभुः //
text_mt:
No state higher than him is ever reached.
He is the master of gods, sages, and the ancestors (pitṛs).

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinām /
saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ते प्रलये सर्वदेहिनाम् /
संहरत्येष भगवान् कालो भूत्वा महेश्वरः //
text_mt:
At the end of a thousand yugas, in the dissolution of all embodied beings,
this blessed one, the Great Lord, dissolves [all things], having become Time (Kāla).

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā /
eṣa cikrī ca vakṣojaśrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
एष चैव प्रजाः सर्वाः सृजत्येकः स्वतेजसा /
एष चिक्री च वक्षोजश्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः //
text_mt:
He alone creates all beings by his own radiance;
he is the bearer of the disc, marked with the Śrīvatsa on his chest.

sanskrit_iast:
yegī kṛtayuge caiva tretāyāṃ kraturucyate /
dvāpare caiva kālāgnirdharmaketuḥ kalau smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
येगी कृतयुगे चैव त्रेतायां क्रतुरुच्यते /
द्वापरे चैव कालाग्निर्धर्मकेतुः कलौ स्मृतः //
text_mt:
He is said to be a yogin in the Kṛta yuga, and sacrifice in the Tretā,
the Fire of Time in the Dvāpara, and the Banner of Dharma in the Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasya mūrttayastisro vijñeyāścāpi paṇḍitaiḥ /
tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuḥ prakāśakaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रस्य मूर्त्तयस्तिस्रो विज्ञेयाश्चापि पण्डितैः /
तमो ह्यग्नी रजो ब्रह्मा सत्त्वं विष्णुः प्रकाशकः //
text_mt:
The three forms of Rudra are also to be recognized by the wise:
tamas is Agni, rajas is Brahmā, and sattva is Viṣṇu the illuminator.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrttirekā smṛtā yasya digvāsāśca śivāhvayā /
yatra tiṣṭhanti tadbrahmayogena tu samanvitam //
meaning:
मूर्त्तिरेका स्मृता यस्य दिग्वासाश्च शिवाह्वया /
यत्र तिष्ठन्ति तद्ब्रह्मयोगेन तु समन्वितम् //
text_mt:
One form of his is celebrated as clothed in space (digvāsas) and named Śiva,
in which they remain united with that Brahman through yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddevaṃ devadevamī śānaṃ prabhumavyayam /
ārādhayata viprendrā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्देवं देवदेवमी शानं प्रभुमव्ययम् /
आराधयत विप्रेन्द्रा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः //
text_mt:
Therefore, O best of Brahmins, with anger conquered and senses mastered,
worship that god, the God of gods, Īśāna, the imperishable Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭaṃ vai yādṛśaṃ tasya liṅgamāsīnmahātmanaḥ /
tādṛkpratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śūlapāṇiṃ prapadyata //
meaning:
दृष्टं वै यादृशं तस्य लिङ्गमासीन्महात्मनः /
तादृक्प्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा शूलपाणिं प्रपद्यत //
text_mt:
Having made a replica resembling that linga
which was seen of that great soul, take refuge in the trident-handed [Lord].

sanskrit_iast:
tato drakṣyatha deveśaṃ durdarśamakṛtātmabhiḥ /
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvamajñānamadharmaśca pramaśyati //
meaning:
ततो द्रक्ष्यथ देवेशं दुर्दर्शमकृतात्मभिः /
यं दृष्ट्वा सर्वमज्ञानमधर्मश्च प्रमश्यति //
text_mt:
Then you will behold the Lord of gods, difficult to see for those of unformed self,
upon seeing whom all ignorance and unrighteousness vanish."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇamamitaujasam /
āsthitā vītaśokāste devadāruvane tataḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् /
आस्थिता वीतशोकास्ते देवदारुवने ततः //
text_mt:
Then, having circumambulated Brahmā of immeasurable splendor,
and being freed from grief, they stayed in the Devadāru forest.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayitumārabdhā brahmaṇā kathitaṃ yathā /
sthaṇḍileṣu vicitreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca //
meaning:
आराधयितुमारब्धा ब्रह्मणा कथितं यथा /
स्थण्डिलेषु विचित्रेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च //
text_mt:
They began to worship as was instructed by Brahmā,
on diverse bare altars, on mountains, and in caves,

sanskrit_iast:
nadīnāṃ ca vicitreṣu pulineṣu śubheṣu ca /
evaṃ saṃvatsare pūrṇe vasaṃte samupasthite /
tadeva rūpamāsthāya devastadvanamāgataḥ //
meaning:
नदीनां च विचित्रेषु पुलिनेषु शुभेषु च /
एवं संवत्सरे पूर्णे वसंते समुपस्थिते /
तदेव रूपमास्थाय देवस्तद्वनमागतः //
text_mt:
and on the diverse, auspicious sandbanks of rivers.
Thus, when a full year had passed and spring arrived,
the god, having assumed that very form, came to that forest.

sanskrit_iast:
kusumitabahupādapālatākaṃ bhramaragaṇai rupagīyamānakhaṇḍam /
parabhṛtaparipūrṇacāruśabdaṃ praviśati tadvanamāśramaṃ maheśaḥ //
meaning:
कुसुमितबहुपादपालताकं भ्रमरगणै रुपगीयमानखण्डम् /
परभृतपरिपूर्णचारुशब्दं प्रविशति तद्वनमाश्रमं महेशः //
text_mt:
With many flowering trees and creepers, its bowers sung around by swarms of bees,
filled with the charming notes of cuckoos—into that forest hermitage the Great Lord entered.

sanskrit_iast: tatastaṃ munayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ susamāhitāḥ //
meaning: ततस्तं मुनयः सर्वे तुष्टुवुः सुसमाहिताः //
text_mt: Then all the sages, deeply concentrated, praised him.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhirvivadhamālyaiśca dhūpamandhaistathaiva ca /
sapatnīkā mahābhāgāḥ saputrāḥ saparicchadāḥ //
meaning:
अद्भिर्विवधमाल्यैश्च धूपमन्धैस्तथैव च /
सपत्नीका महाभागाः सपुत्राः सपरिच्छदाः //
text_mt:
With water, various garlands, and incense and perfumes,
the fortunate [sages], with their wives, sons, and entourages,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdu bhaste tadā vāgbhirgirīśamidamabruvan /
ajñānāddevadevasya yadasmābhignuṣṭhitam //
meaning:
मृदु भस्ते तदा वाग्भिर्गिरीशमिदमब्रुवन् /
अज्ञानाद्देवदेवस्य यदस्माभिग्नुष्ठितम् //
text_mt:
spoke then to Girīśa with gentle voices:
"Whatever was done by us through ignorance toward the God of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhasi /
caritāni vicitrāṇi guhyāni gahanāni ca //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तत्सर्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि /
चरितानि विचित्राणि गुह्यानि गहनानि च //
text_mt:
in deed, thought, or word, you should forgive all of that.
Your manifold deeds are secret and deep,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ durvijñeyāni śaṅkara /
svāgataṃ te na jānīmo gatiṃ naiva ca naiva ca //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनां च देवानां दुर्विज्ञेयानि शङ्कर /
स्वागतं ते न जानीमो गतिं नैव च नैव च //
text_mt:
and hard to discern even for the gods led by Brahmā, O Śaṅkara!
Welcome to you! We do not comprehend your path at all!

sanskrit_iast:
viśveśvara mahādeva yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te /
stuvanti tvāṃ mahātmāno devadevaṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
विश्वेश्वर महादेव यो ऽसि सो ऽसि नमो ऽस्तु ते /
स्तुवन्ति त्वां महात्मानो देवदेवं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt:
O Lord of the Universe, O Mahādeva, whoever you are, homage to you!
The great-souled praise you, the God of gods, the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhavāya bhavyāya bhāvanāyodbhavāya ca /
anantabalavīryāya bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
नमो भवाय भव्याय भावनायोद्भवाय च /
अनन्तबलवीर्याय भूतानां पतये नमः //
text_mt:
Homage to Bhava, to the future, to the cause of existence, and to the origin,
to the one of infinite strength and valor, homage to the Lord of beings!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhartre kapiśāṅgāya avyayāya vyayāya ca /
gaṅgā saliladhārāya cādhārāya guṇātmane //
meaning:
संहर्त्रे कपिशाङ्गाय अव्ययाय व्ययाय च /
गङ्गा सलिलधाराय चाधाराय गुणात्मने //
text_mt:
To the destroyer, whose limbs are brown, to the imperishable and the perishable,
to the bearer of the waters of the Gaṅgā, to the support, whose self consists of the guṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃbakāya trinetrāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe /
kandarpāya namastubhyaṃ namo 'stu paramātmane //
meaning:
त्र्यंबकाय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिशूलवरधारिणे /
कन्दर्पाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमो ऽस्तु परमात्मने //
text_mt:
to Tryambaka, the three-eyed one, the bearer of the excellent trident,
to Kandarpa, homage to you; homage to the Supreme Self!

sanskrit_iast:
śakarāya vṛṣāṅkāya gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ /
daṇḍahastāya kālāya pāśahastāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
शकराय वृषाङ्काय गणानां पतये नमः /
दण्डहस्ताय कालाय पाशहस्ताय वै नमः //
text_mt:
To Śaṅkara, whose banner is the bull, homage to the Lord of the gaṇas,
to Time (Kāla) with a staff in hand, homage to the one with a noose in hand!

sanskrit_iast:
vedamantrapradhānāya śatajihvāya te namaḥ /
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sthāvaraṃ caṅgamaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
वेदमन्त्रप्रधानाय शतजिह्वाय ते नमः /
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च स्थावरं चङ्गमं च यत् //
text_mt:
To the highest of Vedic mantras, to the hundred-tongued one, homage to you!
Whatever was, is, and will be, stationary and moving,

sanskrit_iast:
tava dehātsamutpannaṃ deva sarvamidaṃ jagat /
śebho pāhi ca bhadraṃ te prasīda bhagavaṃstataḥ //
meaning:
तव देहात्समुत्पन्नं देव सर्वमिदं जगत् /
शेभो पाहि च भद्रं ते प्रसीद भगवंस्ततः //
text_mt:
all this world has arisen from your body, O god!
O Śambhu, protect us, may good fortune be yours; be gracious, therefore, O Blessed One!

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānādyadi vā jñānādyatkiñcitkurute naraḥ /
tatsarvaṃ bhagavāneva kurute yogamāyayā //
meaning:
अज्ञानाद्यदि वा ज्ञानाद्यत्किञ्चित्कुरुते नरः /
तत्सर्वं भगवानेव कुरुते योगमायया //
text_mt:
Whatever a person does, whether from ignorance or from knowledge,
the Blessed One alone performs all of that through yogamāyā."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stutvā tu munayaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā /
yācante tapasā yuktāḥ paśyāmasttvāṃ yathā purā //
meaning:
एवं स्तुत्वा तु मुनयः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना /
याचन्ते तपसा युक्ताः पश्यामस्त्त्वां यथा पुरा //
text_mt:
Having praised him thus with delighted hearts,
the [sages], engaged in austerities, pleaded: "May we see you as before,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtisthaṃ ca te liṅgaṃ tathaivāstu yathā purā /
namo digvāsase nityaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamāline //
meaning:
प्रकृतिस्थं च ते लिङ्गं तथैवास्तु यथा पुरा /
नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यं किङ्किणीजालमालिने //
text_mt:
and may your linga be restored to its natural state, just as before!
Homage always to the one clothed in space, garlanded with clusters of tinkling bells,

sanskrit_iast:
vikaṭāya karālāya karālavadanāya ca /
arūpāya surūpāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
विकटाय करालाय करालवदनाय च /
अरूपाय सुरूपाय विश्वरूपाय ते नमः //
text_mt:
to the monstrous, the terrifying, and the one of terrifying mouth,
to the formless, the beautifully formed, homage to you whose form is the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭaṅkaṭāya rūdrāya svāhākārāya vai namaḥ /
sarvaprāṇātmane tubhyaṃ guṇadehāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
कटङ्कटाय रूद्राय स्वाहाकाराय वै नमः /
सर्वप्राणात्मने तुभ्यं गुणदेहाय वै नमः //
text_mt:
To Kaṭaṅkaṭa, to Rudra, homage indeed to the exclamation Svāhā!
To you, the soul of all life, homage indeed to the one whose body is the guṇas!

sanskrit_iast:
durggandhāya sugandhāya śūlahastāya vai namaḥ /
svayaṃ nīlaśikhaṇḍāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namo namaḥ /
nīlakaṇṭhāya devāya citābhasmāṅgarāgiṇe //
meaning:
दुर्ग्गन्धाय सुगन्धाय शूलहस्ताय वै नमः /
स्वयं नीलशिखण्डाय श्रीकण्ठाय नमो नमः /
नीलकण्ठाय देवाय चिताभस्माङ्गरागिणे //
text_mt:
To the foul-smelling, to the sweet-smelling, homage indeed to the trident-bearer!
To the one who himself has a blue tuft, to Śrīkaṇṭha, homage, homage!
To the blue-throated god, who smears his limbs with ashes from funeral pyres!

sanskrit_iast:
guṇatrayātmane tubhyaṃ namo viśvāya vedhase /
śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ pretarūpāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
गुणत्रयात्मने तुभ्यं नमो विश्वाय वेधसे /
श्मशानवासिने नित्यं प्रेतरूपाय वै नमः //
text_mt:
To you, whose self is the three guṇas, homage to the universal creator!
Homage to the eternal dweller in cremation grounds, whose form is a ghost (preta)!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ /
ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṃkhyaiḥ puruṣa ucyate //
meaning:
त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रुद्राणां नीललोहितः /
आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां सांख्यैः पुरुष उच्यते //
text_mt:
You are Brahmā among all gods, and Nīlalohita among the Rudras;
you are the Self of all beings, called the puruṣa by the Sāṃkhyas.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāṃ mahāmerurnakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ /
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhastvaṃ devānāṃ vāsavastathā //
meaning:
पर्वतानां महामेरुर्नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः /
ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस्त्वं देवानां वासवस्तथा //
text_mt:
You are great Meru among mountains, and the moon among the constellations;
you are Vasiṣṭha among sages, and Vāsava among the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
oṅkaraḥ sarvavedānāṃ jyeṣṭhasāma ca sāmasu /
āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ siṃhastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ओङ्करः सर्ववेदानां ज्येष्ठसाम च सामसु /
आरण्यानां च सर्वेषां सिंहस्त्वं परमेश्वरः //
text_mt:
You are the syllable Om among all Vedas, and the Jyeṣṭhasāman among Sāmans;
and among all wild beasts, you are the lion, O Supreme Lord!

sanskrit_iast:
grāmyāṇāmṛṣabhaścāpi bhagavāṃllokapūjitaḥ /
sarvathā varttamāno 'pi yoyo bhāvo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
ग्राम्याणामृषभश्चापि भगवांल्लोकपूजितः /
सर्वथा वर्त्तमानो ऽपि योयो भावो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
Among domestic animals, [you are] the bull, O Blessed One worshipped by the world.
Existing in every way, whatever state there shall be,

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmeva tatra paśyāmo brahmaṇā kathitaṃ yathā /
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca viṣādo mada eva ca //
meaning:
त्वामेव तत्र पश्यामो ब्रह्मणा कथितं यथा /
कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च विषादो मद एव च //
text_mt:
we see you alone there, as was spoken by Brahmā.
Desire, anger, greed, despondency, and arrogance—

sanskrit_iast:
etadicchāma vai roddhuṃ prasīda parameśvara /
mahāsaṃharaṇe prāpte tvayā deva kṛtātmanā //
meaning:
एतदिच्छाम वै रोद्धुं प्रसीद परमेश्वर /
महासंहरणे प्राप्ते त्वया देव कृतात्मना //
text_mt:
we wish to restrain these; be gracious, O Supreme Lord!
When the great dissolution arrived, by you, O god of cultivated self,

sanskrit_iast:
karaṃ lalāṭe saṃpīḍya vahnirutpāditastvayā /
tenāgninā tadā lokā arcirbhiḥ sarvato vṛtāḥ //
meaning:
करं ललाटे संपीड्य वह्निरुत्पादितस्त्वया /
तेनाग्निना तदा लोका अर्चिर्भिः सर्वतो वृताः //
text_mt:
having pressed your hand upon your forehead, fire was produced;
by that fire then the worlds were encompassed on all sides by flames.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādagnisamā hyete bahavo vikṛtāgnayaḥ /
yāni cānyānibhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca //
meaning:
तस्मादग्निसमा ह्येते बहवो विकृताग्नयः /
यानि चान्यानिभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च //
text_mt:
Therefore these many modified fires are equal to that fire;
and whatever other beings there are, moving and unmoving,

sanskrit_iast:
dahyante prāṇinaste tu tvatsamutthena vāhninā /
asmākaṃ dahyamānānāṃ trātā bhava sureśvara //
meaning:
दह्यन्ते प्राणिनस्ते तु त्वत्समुत्थेन वाह्निना /
अस्माकं दह्यमानानां त्राता भव सुरेश्वर //
text_mt:
those living beings are burned by the fire that arose from you.
Be the protector of us who are being burned, O Lord of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca lokahitārthāya bhūtāni pariṣiñcasi /
maheśvara mahābhāga prabho śubhanirīkṣaka //
meaning:
त्वं च लोकहितार्थाय भूतानि परिषिञ्चसि /
महेश्वर महाभाग प्रभो शुभनिरीक्षक //
text_mt:
And for the welfare of the world, you sprinkle living beings,
O Great Lord of great fortune, O Lord who looks upon what is auspicious!

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāpaya vayaṃ nātha karttāro vacanaṃ tava /
rūpakoṭisahasreṣu rūpakoṭiśateṣu ca //
meaning:
आज्ञापय वयं नाथ कर्त्तारो वचनं तव /
रूपकोटिसहस्रेषु रूपकोटिशतेषु च //
text_mt:
Command us, O master, and we will carry out your word!
Among thousands of crores of forms, and hundreds of crores of forms,

sanskrit_iast:
antaṃ gantuṃ na śaktāḥ sma tava deva namo 'stu te /
tatastu bhagavānīśa idaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
अन्तं गन्तुं न शक्ताः स्म तव देव नमो ऽस्तु ते /
ततस्तु भगवानीश इदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
we are not able to reach the end of you, O god; homage to you!"
Then the blessed Lord spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
ye hi me bhasmaniratā bhasmanā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ /
yathoktakāriṇo dāntā viprā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
ये हि मे भस्मनिरता भस्मना दग्धकिल्बिषाः /
यथोक्तकारिणो दान्ता विप्रा ध्यानपरायणाः //
text_mt:
"Those who are devoted to my ashes, whose sins have been burned away by ashes,
who act as instructed, restrained, Brahmins intent on meditation—

sanskrit_iast:
na tānparivadedvidvān na ca tānatilaṅghayet /
na cemānapriyaṃ brūyādamutreha hitārthavān //
meaning:
न तान्परिवदेद्विद्वान् न च तानतिलङ्घयेत् /
न चेमानप्रियं ब्रूयादमुत्रेह हितार्थवान् //
text_mt:
a wise person should not censure them, nor should he transgress against them,
nor should he say what is unpleasing to them, if he desires what is beneficial in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
yastānnindati mūḍhātmā mahādevaṃsa nindati /
yastvetānpūjayennityaṃ sa pūjayati śaṅkaram /
evaṃ caratha bhadraṃ vo mattaḥ siddhimavāpsyatha //
meaning:
यस्तान्निन्दति मूढात्मा महादेवंस निन्दति /
यस्त्वेतान्पूजयेन्नित्यं स पूजयति शङ्करम् /
एवं चरथ भद्रं वो मत्तः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ //
text_mt: The foolish-minded one who reviles them reviles Mahādeva. / But he who always honours them honours Śaṅkara. / Practice thus; may you have auspiciousness; you will attain perfection from me."

sanskrit_iast:
atulamiha mahātamaḥ praṇāśaṃśivakathitaṃ paramaṃ vidhiṃ viditvā /
apagatabhayalobhamohacintāḥ saha patitāḥ mahasā śirobhirūhuḥ //
meaning:
अतुलमिह महातमः प्रणाशंशिवकथितं परमं विधिं विदित्वा /
अपगतभयलोभमोहचिन्ताः सह पतिताः महसा शिरोभिरूहुः //
text_mt: Having understood this supreme rule proclaimed by Śiva, which brings an unequalled destruction of great darkness, / freed from fear, greed, delusion, and anxiety, they fell together and carried [his command] upon their heads with glory.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste muditā viprāḥ prakṛtisthe maheśvare /
gandhodakaiḥ suśuddhaiśca kuśapuṣpavimiśritaiḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते मुदिता विप्राः प्रकृतिस्थे महेश्वरे /
गन्धोदकैः सुशुद्धैश्च कुशपुष्पविमिश्रितैः //
text_mt: Then those joyful Brahmins, when Maheśvara was restored to his normal state, / with very pure fragrant waters mixed with kuśa grass and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayanti mahākumbhairadbhirdevaṃ maheśvaram /
gāyanti vividhairguhyair huṃkāraiścāpi susvaraiḥ //
meaning:
स्नापयन्ति महाकुम्भैरद्भिर्देवं महेश्वरम् /
गायन्ति विविधैर्गुह्यैर् हुंकारैश्चापि सुस्वरैः //
text_mt: bathed the god Maheśvara with water from great pitchers, / and sang with various secret, sweet-toned hum sounds:

sanskrit_iast:
namo digvāsase deva kiṅkiṇīdhrāya vai namaḥ /
arddha nārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravarttine //
meaning:
नमो दिग्वाससे देव किङ्किणीध्राय वै नमः /
अर्द्ध नारीशरीराय सांख्ययोगप्रवर्त्तिने //
text_mt: "Homage to you clad in space! O god, homage indeed to the bearer of tinkling bells! / To the one whose body is half-woman, the promoter of Sāṃkhya and Yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
ghanavāhanakṛṣṇāya gajacarmanivāsine /
kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine //
meaning:
घनवाहनकृष्णाय गजचर्मनिवासिने /
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयाय व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने //
text_mt: To the dark one who rides the clouds, whose garment is elephant skin, / whose upper garment is a black antelope skin, whose sacred thread is a serpent!

sanskrit_iast:
suracitacitravicitrakuṇḍalāya suracitamālyavibhūṣaṇāya tubhyam /
mṛgapativaracarmavāsase te pṛthuparaśo ca namostu śaṅkarāya //
meaning:
सुरचितचित्रविचित्रकुण्डलाय सुरचितमाल्यविभूषणाय तुभ्यम् /
मृगपतिवरचर्मवाससे ते पृथुपरशो च नमोस्तु शङ्कराय //
text_mt: To you adorned with beautifully made, wondrous and varied ear-rings, whose ornaments are well-fashioned garlands, / whose garment is the excellent hide of a lion, who wields a broad battle-axe: homage to Śaṅkara!"

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyaśca sthāpite liṅge lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā /
varṇadharmaparāścaiva ceruste munisattamāḥ //
meaning:
भूयश्च स्थापिते लिङ्गे लोकानां हितकाम्यया /
वर्णधर्मपराश्चैव चेरुस्ते मुनिसत्तमाः //
text_mt: And after the liṅga was installed once more with the desire for the welfare of the worlds, / those best of sages wandered about, dedicated to the duties of their social orders.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastānsa munīnprītaḥ pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ /
prītosmi yuṣmattapasā varaṃ vṛṇuta muvratāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तान्स मुनीन्प्रीतः प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरः /
प्रीतोस्मि युष्मत्तपसा वरं वृणुत मुव्रताः //
text_mt: Then, pleased, Maheśvara addressed those sages: / "I am pleased with your ascetic heat; choose a boon, O observers of good vows!"

sanskrit_iast:
tataste munayassarve praṇipatya maheśvaram /
bhṛgvaṅgirā vasiṣṭhaśca viśvāmitrastathaiva ca //
meaning:
ततस्ते मुनयस्सर्वे प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् /
भृग्वङ्गिरा वसिष्ठश्च विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Then all those sages, having bowed low before Maheśvara— / Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, Vasiṣṭha, and likewise Viśvāmitra,

sanskrit_iast:
gautamo 'triḥ sukeśaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ /
marīciḥ kaśyapaścāpi saṃvartaśca mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
गौतमो ऽत्रिः सुकेशश्च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः /
मरीचिः कश्यपश्चापि संवर्तश्च महातपाः //
text_mt: Gautama, Atri, Sukeśa, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Marīci, Kaśyapa, and Saṃvarta of great ascetic heat—

sanskrit_iast:
te praṇamya mahādevamidaṃ vacanamabruvan /
bhasmasnānaṃ ca nagnatvaṃ vāmatvaṃ pratilomatā /
sevyāsevyatvaṃ tu vibho etadicchāma veditum //
meaning:
ते प्रणम्य महादेवमिदं वचनमब्रुवन् /
भस्मस्नानं च नग्नत्वं वामत्वं प्रतिलोमता /
सेव्यासेव्यत्वं तु विभो एतदिच्छाम वेदितुम् //
text_mt: having bowed to Mahādeva, spoke these words: / "The bath in ashes, nakedness, left-handed conduct, reverse behaviour, / and what is to be cultivated and not cultivated: this, O all-pervading lord, we wish to know."

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
etadvaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kathāsarvasvamadya vai /
agnirhyahaṃ somayutaḥ somaścāgnimupaśritaḥ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
एतद्वः संप्रवक्ष्यामि कथासर्वस्वमद्य वै /
अग्निर्ह्यहं सोमयुतः सोमश्चाग्निमुपश्रितः //
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / "I shall now tell you the whole essence of this teaching. / For I am Agni united with Soma, and Soma depends upon Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtākṛtaṃ vadantyagniṃ bhūyo lokāḥ samāśritāḥ /
asakṛccāgninā dagdhaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam //
meaning:
कृताकृतं वदन्त्यग्निं भूयो लोकाः समाश्रिताः /
असकृच्चाग्निना दग्धं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् //
text_mt: People continually taking refuge [in me] speak of Agni as made and unmade; / and the world, unmoving and moving, has repeatedly been burnt by Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmasādhyaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ pavitramida muttamam /
bhasmanā vīryamāsthāya bhūtāni pariṣiñcati //
meaning:
भस्मसाध्यं हि तत्सर्वं पवित्रमिद मुत्तमम् /
भस्मना वीर्यमास्थाय भूतानि परिषिञ्चति //
text_mt: For all that is accomplished by ashes; this is the highest purifier. / Taking his stand upon his virile power by means of ashes, he sprinkles the beings.

sanskrit_iast:
agnikāryaṃ ca yatkṛtvā kariṣyati ca tryāyuṣam /
bhasmanā mama vīryeṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ //
meaning:
अग्निकार्यं च यत्कृत्वा करिष्यति च त्र्यायुषम् /
भस्मना मम वीर्येण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः //
text_mt: And whatever fire rite one performs, and [when] he makes the tryāyuṣa [mark] / with ashes, my virile power, he is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsayatyeva yadbhasma śubhaṃ vāsayate ca yat /
tatkṣaṇātsarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtyate //
meaning:
भासयत्येव यद्भस्म शुभं वासयते च यत् /
तत्क्षणात्सर्वपापानां भस्मेति परिकीर्त्यते //
text_mt: Because it illuminates (bhāsayati), and because it causes good to dwell (vāsayate), / therefore, on account of [destroying] all sins in that instant, it is proclaimed as 'bhasman' (ashes).

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣmapāḥ pitaro jñeyā devā vai somasaṃbhavāḥ /
agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃ gamam //
meaning:
ऊष्मपाः पितरो ज्ञेया देवा वै सोमसंभवाः /
अग्नीषोमात्मकं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजं गमम् //
text_mt: The ancestors are to be known as steam-drinkers, while the gods are born of Soma; / the entire universe, moving and unmoving, consists of Agni and Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamagnirmahātejāḥ somaścaiṣā mamāṃbikā /
ahamagniśca somaśca prakṛtyā puruṣaḥ svayam //
meaning:
अहमग्निर्महातेजाः सोमश्चैषा ममांबिका /
अहमग्निश्च सोमश्च प्रकृत्या पुरुषः स्वयम् //
text_mt: I am Agni of great splendour, and this Ambikā of mine is Soma. / I am both Agni and Soma, and by nature Puruṣa himself.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbhasma mahābhāgā madvīryamiti cocyate /
svavīryaṃ vapuṣā caiva dhārayāmīti vai sthitiḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्भस्म महाभागा मद्वीर्यमिति चोच्यते /
स्ववीर्यं वपुषा चैव धारयामीति वै स्थितिः //
text_mt: Therefore, O fortunate ones, ashes are called my virile power; / and thus the established rule is that I bear my own virile power upon my body.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prabhṛti lokeṣu rakṣārthamaśubheṣu ca /
bhasmanā kriyate rakṣā sūtikānāṃ gṛheṣu ca //
meaning:
तदा प्रभृति लोकेषु रक्षार्थमशुभेषु च /
भस्मना क्रियते रक्षा सूतिकानां गृहेषु च //
text_mt: From that time forth, protection is made with ashes in the worlds / for the sake of warding off inauspicious things and in the houses of women in childbed.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmasnānaviśuddhātmā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ /
matsamīpasupāgamya na bhūyo vinivartate //
meaning:
भस्मस्नानविशुद्धात्मा जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः /
मत्समीपसुपागम्य न भूयो विनिवर्तते //
text_mt: He whose self is purified by bathing in ashes, whose anger is conquered, whose senses are restrained, / having come near to me, does not return again [to mundane existence].

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ kāpālaṃ yoganirmitam /
pūrvaṃ pāśupataṃ hyetannirmitaṃ tadanuttamam //
meaning:
व्रतं पाशुपतं योगं कापालं योगनिर्मितम् /
पूर्वं पाशुपतं ह्येतन्निर्मितं तदनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The Pāśupata observance, Yoga, and the Kāpāla created by Yoga— / this supreme Pāśupata was fashioned first of all.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāścāśramiṇaḥ sarve paścātsṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā /
sṛṣṭireṣā mayā sṛṣṭā lajjāmohabhayātmikā //
meaning:
शेषाश्चाश्रमिणः सर्वे पश्चात्सृष्टाः स्वयंभुवा /
सृष्टिरेषा मया सृष्टा लज्जामोहभयात्मिका //
text_mt: All the other stages of life were created later by Svayambhū; / this creation, consisting of shame, delusion, and fear, was created by me.

sanskrit_iast:
nagnā eva hi jāyante devatā munayastathā /
ye cānyemānavā loke sarve jāyantyavāsasaḥ //
meaning:
नग्ना एव हि जायन्ते देवता मुनयस्तथा /
ये चान्येमानवा लोके सर्वे जायन्त्यवाससः //
text_mt: For gods are born naked, and likewise sages; / and whatever other human beings are in the world, all are born unclothed.

sanskrit_iast:
indriyairajitairnagnā dukūlenāpi saṃvṛtāḥ /
taireva saṃvṛto guptona vastraṃ kāraṇaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
इन्द्रियैरजितैर्नग्ना दुकूलेनापि संवृताः /
तैरेव संवृतो गुप्तोन वस्त्रं कारणं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: They are naked whose senses are unconquered, even if covered in fine cloth; / he who is veiled and guarded by them (the restrained senses) alone—clothing is not considered the cause.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā dhṛtirahiṃsā ca vairāgyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ /
tulyau mānāpamānau ca tatprāvaraṇamuttamam //
meaning:
क्षमा धृतिरहिंसा च वैराग्यं चैव सर्वशः /
तुल्यौ मानापमानौ च तत्प्रावरणमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Forbearance, steadfastness, non-violence, and complete dispassion in every way, / and holding honour and dishonour as equal: that is the supreme covering.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmapāṇḍuradigdhāṅgo dhyāyate manasā bhavam /
yadyakāryasahasrāṇi kṛtvā snāyati bhasmanā //
meaning:
भस्मपाण्डुरदिग्धाङ्गो ध्यायते मनसा भवम् /
यद्यकार्यसहस्राणि कृत्वा स्नायति भस्मना //
text_mt: His limbs smeared pale with ashes, he meditates in mind upon Bhava. / Even if one has committed a thousand misdeeds, if he bathes with ashes,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarvaṃ dahate bhasma yathāgnistejasā vanam /
tasmā dyatnaparo bhūtvā trikālamapi yaḥ sadā //
meaning:
तत्सर्वं दहते भस्म यथाग्निस्तेजसा वनम् /
तस्मा द्यत्नपरो भूत्वा त्रिकालमपि यः सदा //
text_mt: the ashes burn it all, just as fire burns a forest with its heat. / Therefore, striving diligently, he who constantly, even at the three junctures of the day,

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmanā kurute snānaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ sa gacchati /
saṃhṛtya ca kratūnsarvāngṛhītvāmṛtamutta mam //
meaning:
भस्मना कुरुते स्नानं गाणपत्यं स गच्छति /
संहृत्य च क्रतून्सर्वान्गृहीत्वामृतमुत्त मम् //
text_mt: bathes with ashes, attains the status of leader of the Gaṇas. / And having gathered all sacrifices and taken the highest nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyanti ye mahādevaṃ līnāstadbhāvabhāvitāḥ /
uttareṇātha panthānaṃ te 'mṛtatvamavāpnuyuḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायन्ति ये महादेवं लीनास्तद्भावभाविताः /
उत्तरेणाथ पन्थानं ते ऽमृतत्वमवाप्नुयुः //
text_mt: those who meditate on Mahādeva, absorbed, imbued with his nature, / would attain immortality by the northern path.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇenātha panthānaṃ ye śmaśānāni bhejire /
aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā prāptireva ca //
meaning:
दक्षिणेनाथ पन्थानं ये श्मशानानि भेजिरे /
अणिमा महिमा चैव लघिमा प्राप्तिरेव च //
text_mt: While those who have taken to cremation grounds by the southern path / [attain] atomicity, lightness, magnitude, and reach,

sanskrit_iast:
garimā pañcamī caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ prākāmyameva ca /
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca hyamaratvaṃ ca te gatāḥ //
meaning:
गरिमा पञ्चमी चैव षष्ठं प्राकाम्यमेव च /
ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च ह्यमरत्वं च ते गताः //
text_mt: heaviness as the fifth, irresistible will as the sixth, / mastery and control; and indeed they attain immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādayastathā devāḥ kāmikaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ /
aiśvaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sarve prathitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादयस्तथा देवाः कामिकं व्रतमास्थिताः /
ऐश्वर्यं परमं प्राप्य सर्वे प्रथिततेजसः //
text_mt: Likewise Indra and the gods, undertaking this vow granting all desires, / having obtained supreme sovereignty, all became renowned in splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
vyapagatamadamohamuktarāgāstamerahajadoṣavivarjitasvabhāvāḥ /
paribhavamidamuttamaṃ viditvā paśupatidayitamidaṃ vrataṃ caradhvam //
meaning:
व्यपगतमदमोहमुक्तरागास्तमेरहजदोषविवर्जितस्वभावाः /
परिभवमिदमुत्तमं विदित्वा पशुपतिदयितमिदं व्रतं चरध्वम् //
text_mt: Free from arrogance and delusion, freed from passion, their nature devoid of the defects born of darkness and passion, / understanding this supreme transcendence, observe this vow beloved of Paśupati!"

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paṭhedvai śucirbhūtvā śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ /
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā rudralokaṃ sa gacchati //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāda dāruvanapraveśabhasmasnānavidhirnāma saptaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यः पठेद्वै शुचिर्भूत्वा श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः /
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपाद दारुवनप्रवेशभस्मस्नानविधिर्नाम सप्तविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
He who recites this, having become pure, full of faith, with conquered senses, / his self purified of all sins, goes to the world of Rudra.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Entering the Pine Forest and the Rule of Bathing in Ashes', in the Anuṣaṅgapāda, the second [part] of the first section in the Mahāpurāṇa, the glorious Brahmāṇḍa, proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca
agātkathamamāvasyāṃ māsi māsi divaṃ nṛpaḥ /
ailaḥ purūravāḥ sūta kathaṃ vātarpayatpitṝn //
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच
अगात्कथममावस्यां मासि मासि दिवं नृपः /
ऐलः पुरूरवाः सूत कथं वातर्पयत्पितॄन् //
text_mt: The sage said: / "How did the king, Purūravas the son of Ilā, go to heaven / month after month on the new moon, O bard, or how did he satisfy the ancestors?"

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tasya te 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi prabhāvaṃ śāṃśapāyane /
ailasyādityasaṃyogaṃ somasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
तस्य ते ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रभावं शांशपायने /
ऐलस्यादित्यसंयोगं सोमस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt: The bard said: / "I shall explain to you his power, O Śāṃśapāyana, / and the union of that great-souled son of Ilā with the sun and the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥsāramayasyendoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ /
hrāsavṛddhī pidṛmataḥ pitryasya ca vinirṇayam //
meaning:
अन्तःसारमयस्येन्दोः पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः /
ह्रासवृद्धी पिदृमतः पित्र्यस्य च विनिर्णयम् //
text_mt: and the waxing and waning of the moon, which consists of inner essence, in the bright and dark fortnights, / along with the determination of what pertains to the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
somāccaivāmṛtaprāptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarvaṇaṃ tathā /
kāvyāgniṣvāttamaumyānāṃ pitṝṇāñcaiva darśanam //
meaning:
सोमाच्चैवामृतप्राप्तिं पितॄणां तर्वणं तथा /
काव्याग्निष्वात्तमौम्यानां पितॄणाञ्चैव दर्शनम् //
text_mt: and the obtaining of nectar from the moon and the satiation of the ancestors, / and the vision of the ancestors, the Kāvyas, the Agniṣvāttas, and the Saumyas,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā purūravāścaiva tarpayāmāsa vai pitṝn /
etatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi parvāṇi ca yathākramam //
meaning:
यथा पुरूरवाश्चैव तर्पयामास वै पितॄन् /
एतत्सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि पर्वाणि च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: and how Purūravas indeed satisfied the ancestors. / I will proclaim all of this, and the nodes of the moon in proper sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu candrasūryauṃ vai nakṣatreṇa samāgatau /
amāvasyāṃ nivasata ekarātraikamaṇḍalau //
meaning:
यदा तु चन्द्रसूर्यौं वै नक्षत्रेण समागतौ /
अमावस्यां निवसत एकरात्रैकमण्डलौ //
text_mt: When the moon and the sun have indeed met at an asterism, / they dwell together on the new moon night in a single orb for one night.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchati tadā draṣṭuṃ divākaraniśākarau /
amāvasyāmamāvāsyāṃ mātāmahapitāmahau //
meaning:
स गच्छति तदा द्रष्टुं दिवाकरनिशाकरौ /
अमावस्याममावास्यां मातामहपितामहौ //
text_mt: Then he goes to see the sun and the moon, / his maternal grandfather and paternal grandfather, on each new moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
abhivādya sa tau tatra kālāpekṣaḥ pratīkṣate /
prasyandamānātsomāttu pitrarthaṃ tu pariśravān //
meaning:
अभिवाद्य स तौ तत्र कालापेक्षः प्रतीक्षते /
प्रस्यन्दमानात्सोमात्तु पित्रर्थं तु परिश्रवान् //
text_mt: Having greeted them both there, waiting for the proper time, he awaits / the trickling streams flowing from the moon for the sake of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
ailaḥ purūravā vidvānmāsaśrāddhacikīrṣayā /
upāste pitṛmantaṃ taṃ somaṃ divi samāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
ऐलः पुरूरवा विद्वान्मासश्राद्धचिकीर्षया /
उपास्ते पितृमन्तं तं सोमं दिवि समास्थितः //
text_mt: The wise Purūravas, son of Ilā, desiring to perform the monthly śrāddha, / stands in heaven and worships Soma who is accompanied by the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
dvilavāṃ kuhūmātrāṃ ca te ubhe tu vicārya saḥ /
sinīvālīpramāṇebhyaḥ sinīvālīmupāsya saḥ //
meaning:
द्विलवां कुहूमात्रां च ते उभे तु विचार्य सः /
सिनीवालीप्रमाणेभ्यः सिनीवालीमुपास्य सः //
text_mt: Having deliberated upon both the two-lava [phase] and that which is merely Kuhū, / and having worshiped Sinīvālī according to the standard measures of Sinīvālī,

sanskrit_iast:
kuhūmātraḥ kalāṃ caiva jñātvopāste kuhūṃ tathā /
sa tadā tāmupāsīnaḥ kālāpekṣaḥ prapaśyati //
meaning:
कुहूमात्रः कलां चैव ज्ञात्वोपास्ते कुहूं तथा /
स तदा तामुपासीनः कालापेक्षः प्रपश्यति //
text_mt: and having recognized [the phase] consisting only of Kuhū and its digit, he likewise worships Kuhū. / Worshiping her at that time, waiting for the proper moment, he observes

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāmṛtaṃ tu tatsomātsravadvai māsatṛptaye /
daśabhiḥ pañcabhiścaiva sudhāmṛtaparisravaiḥ //
meaning:
सुधामृतं तु तत्सोमात्स्रवद्वै मासतृप्तये /
दशभिः पञ्चभिश्चैव सुधामृतपरिस्रवैः //
text_mt: the immortal nectar indeed flowing from that Soma for the monthly gratification, / through the fifteen trickling flows of immortal nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhujāṃ prītyā dahyamānāṃ tathāṃśubhiḥ /
sadyaḥ prakṣaratā tena saumyena madhunā tu saḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे भुजां प्रीत्या दह्यमानां तथांशुभिः /
सद्यः प्रक्षरता तेन सौम्येन मधुना तु सः //
text_mt: With joy [he observes Soma] whose arm is burned by the rays during the dark fortnight, / and by means of that immediately flowing sweet honey belonging to Soma,

sanskrit_iast:
nirvāteṣtratha pakṣeṣu pitryeṇa vidhinā divi /
sudhāmṛtena rājaindrastarpa yāmāsa vai pitṝn //
meaning:
निर्वातेष्त्रथ पक्षेषु पित्र्येण विधिना दिवि /
सुधामृतेन राजैन्द्रस्तर्प यामास वै पितॄन् //
text_mt: at the close of the fortnights, according to the ancestral rite in heaven, / that king, foremost of rulers, gratified the ancestors with the immortal nectar:

sanskrit_iast:
saumyānbarhiṣadaḥ kāvyānagniṣvāttāṃstathaiva ca /
ṛtamagnistu yaḥ proktaḥ sa tu saṃvatsaro mataḥ //
meaning:
सौम्यान्बर्हिषदः काव्यानग्निष्वात्तांस्तथैव च /
ऋतमग्निस्तु यः प्रोक्तः स तु संवत्सरो मतः //
text_mt: the Saumyas, the Barhiṣads, the Kāvyas, and likewise the Agniṣvāttas. / Now the fire which is called Ṛta is considered to be the year (saṃvatsara).

sanskrit_iast:
jajñire hyṛtavastasmāddhyṛtubhyaścārttavāstathā /
ārtavā hyarddhamāsākhyāḥ pitaro hyṛtusūnavaḥ //
meaning:
जज्ञिरे ह्यृतवस्तस्माद्ध्यृतुभ्यश्चार्त्तवास्तथा /
आर्तवा ह्यर्द्धमासाख्याः पितरो ह्यृतुसूनवः //
text_mt: From him the seasons were born, and from the seasons the seasonal half-months. / The seasonal ones are called the half-months, and the ancestors are indeed the sons of the seasons.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtavaḥ pitāmahā māsā ayanāhyabdasūnavaḥ /
prapitāmahāstu vai devāḥ pañcābdā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
ऋतवः पितामहा मासा अयनाह्यब्दसूनवः /
प्रपितामहास्तु वै देवाः पञ्चाब्दा ब्रह्मणः सुताः //
text_mt: The seasons are the grandfathers; the months and solstices are the sons of the year. / The great-grandfathers are the five-year gods, the sons of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāstu somajā jñeyāḥ kāvyā jñeyāḥ kaveḥ sutāḥ /
upahūtāḥ smṛtā devāḥ somajāḥ somapāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सौम्यास्तु सोमजा ज्ञेयाः काव्या ज्ञेयाः कवेः सुताः /
उपहूताः स्मृता देवाः सोमजाः सोमपाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The Saumyas are known to be born of Soma; the Kāvyas are known to be the sons of Kavi. / The gods are known as the Upahūtas, and those born of Soma are known as Soma-drinkers (somapa).

sanskrit_iast:
ājyapāstu smṛtāḥ kāvyāstisrastāḥ pitṛjātayaḥ /
kāvyā barhiṣada ścaiva agniṣvāttāśca tāstridhā //
meaning:
आज्यपास्तु स्मृताः काव्यास्तिस्रस्ताः पितृजातयः /
काव्या बर्हिषद श्चैव अग्निष्वात्ताश्च तास्त्रिधा //
text_mt: The Kāvyas are remembered as the ghee-drinkers (ājyapa). These are the three classes of ancestors: / the Kāvyas, the Barhiṣads, and the Agniṣvāttas; they are threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthā ye ca yajvāna ṛturbarhiṣado dhruvam /
gṛhasthāścāpyayajvāna agniṣvāttāstathārttavāḥ //
meaning:
गृहस्था ये च यज्वान ऋतुर्बर्हिषदो ध्रुवम् /
गृहस्थाश्चाप्ययज्वान अग्निष्वात्तास्तथार्त्तवाः //
text_mt: Those householders who performed sacrifices are certainly the season-dwelling Barhiṣads; / and those householders who did not perform sacrifices are the Agniṣvāttas, associated with the seasons.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭakāpatayaḥ kāvyāḥ pañcābdāstānnibodhata /
teṣāṃ saṃvatsaro hyagniḥ sūyastu parivatsaraḥ //
meaning:
अष्टकापतयः काव्याः पञ्चाब्दास्तान्निबोधत /
तेषां संवत्सरो ह्यग्निः सूयस्तु परिवत्सरः //
text_mt: The lords of the Aṣṭakās are the Kāvyas; know them to be the five-year [cycle]. / Of them, Agni is the saṃvatsara, and the sun is the parivatsara;

sanskrit_iast:
soma iḍvatsaraḥ prokto vāyuścaivānuvatsaraḥ /
rudrastu vatsarasteṣāṃ pañcābdāste yugātmakāḥ //
meaning:
सोम इड्वत्सरः प्रोक्तो वायुश्चैवानुवत्सरः /
रुद्रस्तु वत्सरस्तेषां पञ्चाब्दास्ते युगात्मकाः //
text_mt: Soma is declared to be the iḍvatsara, and Vāyu the anuvatsara; / Rudra is their vatsara. These are the five-year [cycles] that constitute a yuga.

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyāścaivoṣmapāścaiva divākīrtyāśca te smṛtāḥ /
ye te pibantyamāvasyāṃ māsimāsi sudhāṃ divi //
meaning:
काव्याश्चैवोष्मपाश्चैव दिवाकीर्त्याश्च ते स्मृताः /
ये ते पिबन्त्यमावस्यां मासिमासि सुधां दिवि //
text_mt: They are remembered as the Kāvyas, the Uṣmapas, and the Divākīrtyas, / who drink the nectar in heaven month after month on the new-moon day.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃstena tarpayāmāsa yāvadāsītpurūravāḥ /
yasmātprasravate somānmāsi māsi dhinoti ca //
meaning:
तांस्तेन तर्पयामास यावदासीत्पुरूरवाः /
यस्मात्प्रस्रवते सोमान्मासि मासि धिनोति च //
text_mt: Purūravas gratified them with it as long as he lived. / Since it flows from Soma month after month and satisfies [them],

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsudhāmṛtaṃ tadvai pitṝṇāṃ somapāyinām /
evaṃ tadamṛtaṃ saumyaṃ sudhā ca madu caiva ha //
meaning:
तस्मात्सुधामृतं तद्वै पितॄणां सोमपायिनाम् /
एवं तदमृतं सौम्यं सुधा च मदु चैव ह //
text_mt: therefore that is the immortal nectar for the ancestors who drink Soma. / Thus that nectar is of Soma, both ambrosia and sweet honey.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā vendoḥ kalāḥ pañcadaśa kramāt /
pibantyaṃbumayaṃ devāstrayastriṃśattu chandanāḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे यथा वेन्दोः कलाः पञ्चदश क्रमात् /
पिबन्त्यंबुमयं देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु छन्दनाः //
text_mt: Just as in the dark fortnight the thirty-three gods according to their pleasure / drink in succession the fifteen watery digits of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvārddhamāsaṃ gacchanti caturdaśyāṃ sudhāmṛtam /
ityevaṃ pīyamānaistu devaiḥ sarvairniśākaraḥ //
meaning:
पीत्वार्द्धमासं गच्छन्ति चतुर्दश्यां सुधामृतम् /
इत्येवं पीयमानैस्तु देवैः सर्वैर्निशाकरः //
text_mt: having drunk the immortal nectar for half a month, they depart on the fourteenth day. / In this way, as he is drunk by all the gods, the moon

sanskrit_iast:
samāgacchatyamāvasyāṃ bhāge pañcadaśe sthitaḥ /
suṣumṇāpyāyitaṃ caiva hyamāvasyāṃ yathā kramam //
meaning:
समागच्छत्यमावस्यां भागे पञ्चदशे स्थितः /
सुषुम्णाप्यायितं चैव ह्यमावस्यां यथा क्रमम् //
text_mt: arrives at the new-moon day, stationed in his fifteenth part. / And nourished in succession by the Suṣumṇa [ray] on the new-moon day,

sanskrit_iast:
pibanti dvilavaṃ kālaṃ pitaraste sudhāmṛtam /
pītakṣayaṃ tataḥ somaṃ sūryo 'sāvekaraśminā //
meaning:
पिबन्ति द्विलवं कालं पितरस्ते सुधामृतम् /
पीतक्षयं ततः सोमं सूर्यो ऽसावेकरश्मिना //
text_mt: those ancestors drink the immortal nectar for a period of two lavas. / Then, with a single ray, that sun from Suṣumṇa

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyayatsuṣumṇātaḥ punastānsomapāyinaḥ /
niḥ śeṣāyāṃ kalāyāṃ tu somamāpyāyayatpunaḥ //
meaning:
आप्याययत्सुषुम्णातः पुनस्तान्सोमपायिनः /
निः शेषायां कलायां तु सोममाप्याययत्पुनः //
text_mt: nourishes again that Soma which was exhausted from being drunk [for the sake of] those Soma-drinkers; / when only a digit remains, he nourishes Soma once more.

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumṇāpyāyamānasya bhāgaṃ bhāgamahaḥ kramāt /
kalāḥ kṣīyanti tāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śuklā cāpyāyayanti tam //
meaning:
सुषुम्णाप्यायमानस्य भागं भागमहः क्रमात् /
कलाः क्षीयन्ति ताः कृष्णाः शुक्ला चाप्याययन्ति तम् //
text_mt: As he is being filled by Suṣumṇa part by part, day by day in order, / the dark digits wane and the bright digits replenish him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sūryasya vīryeṇa candrasyāpyāyitā tanuḥ /
dṛśyate paurṇamāsyāṃ vai śuklaḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
एवं सूर्यस्य वीर्येण चन्द्रस्याप्यायिता तनुः /
दृश्यते पौर्णमास्यां वै शुक्लः संपूर्णमण्डलः //
text_mt: Thus, nourished by the power of the sun, the body of the moon / is seen on the full-moon day as a bright, complete orb.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsiddhirevaṃ somasya pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ /
ityevaṃ pitṛmānsomaḥ smṛta iḍvatsarātmakaḥ //
meaning:
संसिद्धिरेवं सोमस्य पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः /
इत्येवं पितृमान्सोमः स्मृत इड्वत्सरात्मकः //
text_mt: Such is the completion of Soma in the bright and dark fortnights. / Thus Soma accompanied by the ancestors is remembered as identical with the iḍvatsara,

sanskrit_iast:
krāntaḥ pañcadaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ sudhāmṛtaparisravaiḥ /
ataḥ parvāṇi vakṣyāmi varvaṇāṃ saṃdhayaśca ye //
meaning:
क्रान्तः पञ्चदशैः सार्द्धं सुधामृतपरिस्रवैः /
अतः पर्वाणि वक्ष्यामि वर्वणां संधयश्च ये //
text_mt: pervaded along with the fifteen trickling flows of immortal nectar. / Next I shall explain the conjunctions (parvan) and what the junctions of the conjunctions are.

sanskrit_iast:
granthimanti yathā parvāṇīkṣuve ṇvorbhavantyuta /
tathārddhamāsi parvāṇi śuklakṛṣṇāni caiva hi //
meaning:
ग्रन्थिमन्ति यथा पर्वाणीक्षुवे ण्वोर्भवन्त्युत /
तथार्द्धमासि पर्वाणि शुक्लकृष्णानि चैव हि //
text_mt: Just as there are knotted joints in sugarcane and bamboo, / so indeed are there conjunctions in the bright and dark half-months.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāmāvasyayorbhedau granthayaḥ saṃdhayaśca vai /
arddhamāsaṃ tu parvāṇi dvitīyāprabhṛtīni tu //
meaning:
पूर्णामावस्ययोर्भेदौ ग्रन्थयः संधयश्च वै /
अर्द्धमासं तु पर्वाणि द्वितीयाप्रभृतीनि तु //
text_mt: The distinctions of the full moon and new moon are the knots and the joints; / the half-months, beginning with the second lunar day, are the joints (parvan).

sanskrit_iast:
anvādhānakriyā yasmātkriyate parvasaṃdhiṣu /
tasmāttu parvaṇāmādau pratipatsarvasaṃdhiṣu //
meaning:
अन्वाधानक्रिया यस्मात्क्रियते पर्वसंधिषु /
तस्मात्तु पर्वणामादौ प्रतिपत्सर्वसंधिषु //
text_mt: Because the ritual of adding fuel to the sacrificial fire is performed at the junctions of the parvans, / therefore the first lunar day (pratipad) is at the beginning of the parvans at every junction.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyāhne 'hyanumatyādau kālo dvilava ucyate /
lavau dvāveva rākāyāṃ kālo jñeyo 'parāhṇakaḥ //
meaning:
सायाह्ने ऽह्यनुमत्यादौ कालो द्विलव उच्यते /
लवौ द्वावेव राकायां कालो ज्ञेयो ऽपराह्णकः //
text_mt: In the evening, at the beginning of Anumati and the like, the time is said to be two lavas; / on Rākā, the time is known to be precisely two lavas in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatkṛṣṇapakṣasya kāle 'tīte 'parāhṇake /
sāyāhne pratipanne ca sa kālaḥ paurṇamāsikaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिपत्कृष्णपक्षस्य काले ऽतीते ऽपराह्णके /
सायाह्ने प्रतिपन्ने च स कालः पौर्णमासिकः //
text_mt: When the afternoon has passed and evening has arrived on the first lunar day of the dark fortnight, / that is the time of the full moon.
