sanskrit_iast:
vyatīpāte sthite sūrye lekhārddhe tu yugāntare /
yugāntarodite caiva leśārddhe śaśinaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
व्यतीपाते स्थिते सूर्ये लेखार्द्धे तु युगान्तरे /
युगान्तरोदिते चैव लेशार्द्धे शशिनः क्रमात् //
text_mt: When the sun stands in opposition (vyatīpāta) at half a line in the other yuga, / and when half a fraction of the moon has risen in succession at the end of the yuga,

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsī vyatīpāte yadīkṣetāṃ parasparam /
yasminkāle samau syātāṃ tau vyatīpāta eva saḥ //
meaning:
पौर्णमासी व्यतीपाते यदीक्षेतां परस्परम् /
यस्मिन्काले समौ स्यातां तौ व्यतीपात एव सः //
text_mt: if [the sun and the moon] should gaze at each other at the full moon in opposition, / the moment when both are equal is indeed the opposition (vyatīpāta).

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ kālaṃ sūryanirddeśyaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkhyāṃ tu sarpati /
sa vai vaṣaṭākriyākālaḥ sadyaḥ kālaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
तं कालं सूर्यनिर्द्देश्यं दृष्ट्वा संख्यां तु सर्पति /
स वै वषटाक्रियाकालः सद्यः कालं विधीयते //
text_mt: Seeing that time indicated by the sun, one proceeds to the calculation; / that is indeed the time for the vaṣaṭ-call, prescribed as an immediate time.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇandoḥ pūrṇapakṣe tu rātrisaṃdhiśca pūrṇimā /
tato virajyate naktaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ niśākaraḥ //
meaning:
पूर्णन्दोः पूर्णपक्षे तु रात्रिसंधिश्च पूर्णिमा /
ततो विरज्यते नक्तं पौर्णमास्यां निशाकरः //
text_mt: At the full fortnight of the full moon, the junction of the night is Pūrṇimā; / then at night, on the full-moon day, the moon shines bright.

sanskrit_iast:
yadīkṣete vyatīpāte divā pūrṇe parasparam /
candrārkāvaparāhṇe tu pūrṇātmānau tu pūrṇimā //
meaning:
यदीक्षेते व्यतीपाते दिवा पूर्णे परस्परम् /
चन्द्रार्कावपराह्णे तु पूर्णात्मानौ तु पूर्णिमा //
text_mt: If by day, when full, the sun and the moon should gaze at each other in opposition / in the afternoon, having their full forms, that is Pūrṇimā.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttāmanumanyante pitaro daivataiḥ saha /
tasmādanumatirnāma pūrṇimā prathamā smṛtā //
meaning:
यस्मात्तामनुमन्यन्ते पितरो दैवतैः सह /
तस्मादनुमतिर्नाम पूर्णिमा प्रथमा स्मृता //
text_mt: Because the ancestors along with the deities approve (anumanyante) of her, / therefore the first full-moon day is known by the name Anumati.

sanskrit_iast:
atyarthaṃ bhrājate yasmādvyomnyasyāṃ vai niśākaraḥ /
rañjanāccaiva candrasya rāketi kavayo 'bruvan //
meaning:
अत्यर्थं भ्राजते यस्माद्व्योम्न्यस्यां वै निशाकरः /
रञ्जनाच्चैव चन्द्रस्य राकेति कवयो ऽब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Because on this [night] the moon shines exceedingly in the sky, / and because of the brightening (rañjana) of the moon, the poets called her Rākā.

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasetāmṛkṣe tu yadā candradivākarau /
rākā pañcadaśī rātriramāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā //
meaning:
अमावसेतामृक्षे तु यदा चन्द्रदिवाकरौ /
राका पञ्चदशी रात्रिरमावास्या ततः स्मृता //
text_mt: When the moon and the sun dwell together (amā vasatām) in an asterism, / the fifteenth night is Rākā, and it is thence called Amāvāsyā.

sanskrit_iast:
vyucchidya tamamāvasyāṃ paśyatastau samāgatau /
anyonyaṃ candrasūryauṃ tau yadā tadvarśa ucyate //
meaning:
व्युच्छिद्य तममावस्यां पश्यतस्तौ समागतौ /
अन्योन्यं चन्द्रसूर्यौं तौ यदा तद्वर्श उच्यते //
text_mt: When, dispelling darkness on the new-moon day, both the sun and the moon / gaze upon each other as they have come together, that is called Darśa.

sanskrit_iast:
dvau dvau lavāvamāvāsyā sa kālaḥ parvasaṃdhiṣu /
dvyakṣara kuhumātraśca parvakālāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
द्वौ द्वौ लवावमावास्या स कालः पर्वसंधिषु /
द्व्यक्षर कुहुमात्रश्च पर्वकालास्त्रयः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Amāvāsyā is of two lavas each; that is the time at the junctions of the parvans. / The parvan times are remembered as three: consisting of two syllables, and consisting only of Kuhū.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭacandrā tvamāvasyā yā madhyāṅnātpravarttate /
divasārddhena rātryā ca sūryaṃ prāpya tu candramāḥ //
meaning:
नष्टचन्द्रा त्वमावस्या या मध्याङ्नात्प्रवर्त्तते /
दिवसार्द्धेन रात्र्या च सूर्यं प्राप्य तु चन्द्रमाः //
text_mt: Amāvāsyā is that [phase] wherein the moon is lost, which begins from midday; / having reached the sun with half a day and a night, the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryeṇa saha sāmudraṃ gatvā prātastanātsa vai /
dvau kālau saṃgamaṃ caiva madhyāhne niyataṃ raviḥ //
meaning:
सूर्येण सह सामुद्रं गत्वा प्रातस्तनात्स वै /
द्वौ कालौ संगमं चैव मध्याह्ने नियतं रविः //
text_mt: going with the sun towards the ocean from the morning, / the sun regularly [effects] their conjunction at two times, and at midday.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipacchuklapakṣasya candramāḥ sūrya maṇḍalāt /
vimucyamānayormadhye tayormaṇḍalayostu vai //
meaning:
प्रतिपच्छुक्लपक्षस्य चन्द्रमाः सूर्य मण्डलात् /
विमुच्यमानयोर्मध्ये तयोर्मण्डलयोस्तु वै //
text_mt: On the first lunar day of the bright fortnight, as the moon is being released / from the solar disc, between those two discs,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadā hyāhuteḥ kālo darśasya tu vaṣaṭkriyā /
etadṛtumukhaṃ jñeyamamā vāsyāsya parvaṇaḥ //
meaning:
स तदा ह्याहुतेः कालो दर्शस्य तु वषट्क्रिया /
एतदृतुमुखं ज्ञेयममा वास्यास्य पर्वणः //
text_mt: that is then the time for offering the oblation, the vaṣaṭ-utterance of the Darśa [sacrifice]. / This is to be known as the beginning of the season for this parvan of Amāvāsyā.

sanskrit_iast:
divāparva hyamāvāsyā kṣīṇendau bahule tu vai /
tasmāddivā hyamāvāsyāṃ gṛhyate 'sau divākaraḥ //
meaning:
दिवापर्व ह्यमावास्या क्षीणेन्दौ बहुले तु वै /
तस्माद्दिवा ह्यमावास्यां गृह्यते ऽसौ दिवाकरः //
text_mt: Amāvāsyā is indeed a daytime parvan when the moon has waned in the dark fortnight; / therefore on Amāvāsyā the sun is eclipsed by day.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhyate tu divā tasmādamāvāsyāṃ divi kṣayām /
kalānāmapi caitāsāṃ vṛddhihānyā jalātmanaḥ //
meaning:
गृह्यते तु दिवा तस्मादमावास्यां दिवि क्षयाम् /
कलानामपि चैतासां वृद्धिहान्या जलात्मनः //
text_mt: Therefore it is eclipsed by day, on Amāvāsyā at the time of waning in heaven, / through the increase and decrease of these watery digits.

sanskrit_iast:
tithīnāṃ nāmadheyāni vidvadbhiḥ saṃjñitāni vai /
darśayetāmathātmānaṃ sūryācandramasāvubhau //
meaning:
तिथीनां नामधेयानि विद्वद्भिः संज्ञितानि वै /
दर्शयेतामथात्मानं सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभौ //
text_mt: The names of the lunar days have indeed been designated by the learned. / Then both the sun and the moon show themselves;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkrāmatyatha tenaiva kramaśaḥ sūryamaṇḍalāt /
dvilavonamahorātraṃ bhāskaraṃ spṛśate śaśī //
meaning:
निष्क्रामत्यथ तेनैव क्रमशः सूर्यमण्डलात् /
द्विलवोनमहोरात्रं भास्करं स्पृशते शशी //
text_mt: And gradually, through that very [path], [the moon] emerges from the solar orb. / For a day and night less by two lavas, the moon touches the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadā hyāhuteḥ kālodarśasya tu vaṣaṭkriyā /
kuheti kokilenokto yaḥ sa kālaḥ samāpyate //
meaning:
स तदा ह्याहुतेः कालोदर्शस्य तु वषट्क्रिया /
कुहेति कोकिलेनोक्तो यः स कालः समाप्यते //
text_mt: That is then the time for offering, the utterance of 'vaṣaṭ' for the new-moon sacrifice. / When the cuckoo calls 'kuhū', that time comes to an end;

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālasaṃmitā yasmādamāvāsyā kuhūḥ smṛtā /
sinīvālīpramāṇastu kṣīṇaśeṣo niśākaraḥ //
meaning:
तत्कालसंमिता यस्मादमावास्या कुहूः स्मृता /
सिनीवालीप्रमाणस्तु क्षीणशेषो निशाकरः //
text_mt: Because it is measured by that time, the new moon is known as Kuhū. / The remainder of the waning moon has the measure of Sinīvālī;

sanskrit_iast:
āmāvasyāṃ viśatyarkassinī vālītataḥ smṛtā /
anumatyāścarākāyāḥ sinīvālyāḥ kuhūṃvinā //
meaning:
आमावस्यां विशत्यर्कस्सिनी वालीततः स्मृता /
अनुमत्याश्चराकायाः सिनीवाल्याः कुहूंविना //
text_mt: On the new-moon day it enters the sun, hence it is known as Sinīvālī. / Of Anumati and Rākā, and of Sinīvālī without Kuhū,

sanskrit_iast:
etāsāṃ dvilavaḥ kālaḥ kuhūmātraṅkuhūḥsmṛtāḥ /
candrasūryavyatīpāte saṃgate pūrṇimāntare //
meaning:
एतासां द्विलवः कालः कुहूमात्रङ्कुहूःस्मृताः /
चन्द्रसूर्यव्यतीपाते संगते पूर्णिमान्तरे //
text_mt: The duration of these is two lavas; the measure of Kuhū is regarded as Kuhū. / When the conjunction of the sun and moon occurs at the interval of the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatpratipadyeta parvakālo dvimātrakaḥ /
kālaḥ kahūsinīvālyoḥ sāmudrasya tu madhyataḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिपत्प्रतिपद्येत पर्वकालो द्विमात्रकः /
कालः कहूसिनीवाल्योः सामुद्रस्य तु मध्यतः //
text_mt: The first lunar day begins; the period of the parvan is two mātrās. / The time of Kuhū and Sinīvālī is from the middle of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
arkāgni maṇḍale some parvakālaḥ kalāsamaḥ /
evaṃ sa śuklapakṣe vai rajanyāṃ parvasaṃdhiṣu //
meaning:
अर्काग्नि मण्डले सोमे पर्वकालः कलासमः /
एवं स शुक्लपक्षे वै रजन्यां पर्वसंधिषु //
text_mt: When Soma is in the sphere of the sun and fire, the parvan-time equals a digit. / Thus, in the bright fortnight, during the night at the junctures of the parvan,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrmamaṇḍalaḥ śrīmāṃścandramā uparajyate /
yasmādā dāpyāyate somaḥ pañcadaśyāṃ tu pūrṇimā //
meaning:
संपूर्ममण्डलः श्रीमांश्चन्द्रमा उपरज्यते /
यस्मादा दाप्यायते सोमः पञ्चदश्यां तु पूर्णिमा //
text_mt: The glorious moon, its orb complete, is eclipsed. / Because Soma is nourished on the fifteenth day, it is the full moon.

sanskrit_iast:
daśabhiḥ pañcabhiścaiva kalābhirdivasakramāt /
tasmātkalāḥ pañcadaśa somenāsya tu ṣoḍaśī //
meaning:
दशभिः पञ्चभिश्चैव कलाभिर्दिवसक्रमात् /
तस्मात्कलाः पञ्चदश सोमेनास्य तु षोडशी //
text_mt: With fifteen digits according to the sequence of days, / Therefore fifteen digits belong to Soma, and its sixteenth,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsomasya bhavati pañcadaśyāprapāṃ kṣayaḥ /
ityete pitaro devāḥ somapāḥ somavarddhanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्सोमस्य भवति पञ्चदश्याप्रपां क्षयः /
इत्येते पितरो देवाः सोमपाः सोमवर्द्धनाः //
text_mt: Because of that, the exhaustion of the waters takes place for Soma on the fifteenth day. / These very gods are the Pitṛs, the soma-drinkers, the nourishers of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
ārtavā ṛtavo hyṛddhā devāstānbhāvayanti vai /
ataḥ pitṝnpravakṣyāmi māsaśrāddhabhujastu ye //
meaning:
आर्तवा ऋतवो ह्यृद्धा देवास्तान्भावयन्ति वै /
अतः पितॄन्प्रवक्ष्यामि मासश्राद्धभुजस्तु ये //
text_mt: Pertaining to the seasons, the prosperous seasons, the gods indeed sustain them. / Henceforth I shall proclaim the Pitṛs who enjoy the monthly śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ gatiṃ satattvāṃ ca prāptiṃ śrāddhasya caiva hi /
na mṛtānāṃ gatiḥ śakyā jñātuṃ na punarāgatiḥ //
meaning:
तेषां गतिं सतत्त्वां च प्राप्तिं श्राद्धस्य चैव हि /
न मृतानां गतिः शक्या ज्ञातुं न पुनरागतिः //
text_mt: Their true course and the receipt of the śrāddha. / The departure of the dead cannot be known, nor their return,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasāpi prasiddhena kiṃpunarmāsacakṣuṣā /
anudevapitṝnete pitaro laukikāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तपसापि प्रसिद्धेन किंपुनर्मासचक्षुषा /
अनुदेवपितॄनेते पितरो लौकिकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Even by perfected asceticism, much less with the physical eye. / These Pitṛs who follow the divine Pitṛs are known as worldly.

sanskrit_iast:
devāḥ saumyāśca kāvyāśca ayajvāno hyaconijāḥ /
devāste pitaraḥ sarve devāstānvādayantyuta //
meaning:
देवाः सौम्याश्च काव्याश्च अयज्वानो ह्यचोनिजाः /
देवास्ते पितरः सर्वे देवास्तान्वादयन्त्युत //
text_mt: They are divine, Saumyas, and Kāvyas, non-sacrificers, born without a womb; / All those Pitṛs are gods, and the gods invoke them.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyapitaraścaiva tebhyo 'nye laukikāḥ smṛtāḥ /
pitā pitāmahaścāpi tathā yaḥ prapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
मनुष्यपितरश्चैव तेभ्यो ऽन्ये लौकिकाः स्मृताः /
पिता पितामहश्चापि तथा यः प्रपितामहः //
text_mt: The human Pitṛs, different from them, are known as worldly: / The father, the grandfather, and also the great-grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
yajvāno ye tu sāmena somavantastu te smṛtāḥ /
ye yajvāno haviryajñe te vai barhiṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
यज्वानो ये तु सामेन सोमवन्तस्तु ते स्मृताः /
ये यज्वानो हविर्यज्ञे ते वै बर्हिषदः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Those who sacrificed with soma are known as Somavants; / Those who sacrificed with havis-offerings are known as Barhiṣads;

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāsteṣāṃ homino 'yājyayājinaḥ /
teṣāṃ tu dharmasādharmyātsmṛtāḥ sāyujyagā dvijaiḥ //
meaning:
अग्निष्वात्ताः स्मृतास्तेषां होमिनो ऽयाज्ययाजिनः /
तेषां तु धर्मसाधर्म्यात्स्मृताः सायुज्यगा द्विजैः //
text_mt: The Agniṣvāttas among them are regarded as those who offered homa, sacrificing for those not entitled to sacrifice; / Because of their common virtue, they are regarded by the twice-born as attaining union with them.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cāpyāśramadharmāṇāṃ prasthāneṣu vyavasthitāḥ /
ante tu nāvasīdanti śraddhāyuktāstu karmasu //
meaning:
ये चाप्याश्रमधर्माणां प्रस्थानेषु व्यवस्थिताः /
अन्ते तु नावसीदन्ति श्रद्धायुक्तास्तु कर्मसु //
text_mt: And those who abide in the observances of the duties of the stages of life, / Do not despair at the end, endowed with faith in their rites.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa yajñena prajayā ca vai /
śrāddhena vidyayā caiva pradānena ca saptadhā //
meaning:
तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञेन प्रजया च वै /
श्राद्धेन विद्यया चैव प्रदानेन च सप्तधा //
text_mt: Through asceticism, celibacy, sacrifice, offspring, / Śrāddha, sacred knowledge, and giving—in seven ways—

sanskrit_iast:
karmasveteṣu ye yuktā bhavantyādehapātanāt /
daivaistaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ sūkṣmajaiḥ somayājanaiḥ //
meaning:
कर्मस्वेतेषु ये युक्ता भवन्त्यादेहपातनात् /
दैवैस्तैः पितृभिः सार्द्धं सूक्ष्मजैः सोमयाजनैः //
text_mt: Those who are engaged in these rites until the fall of the body, / Along with those divine Pitṛs, subtle-born soma-sacrificers,

sanskrit_iast:
svargatā divi modante pitṛvatta upāsate /
teṣāṃ nivāpe datte tu tatkulīnaiśca bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
स्वर्गता दिवि मोदन्ते पितृवत्त उपासते /
तेषां निवापे दत्ते तु तत्कुलीनैश्च बन्धुभिः //
text_mt: Having gone to heaven, rejoice in the sky; like the Pitṛs, they are worshipped. / And when the funeral offering is given to them by kinsmen and family members,

sanskrit_iast:
māsaśrāddhabhujastṛptiṃ labhante somalaukikāḥ /
ete manuṣyapitaro māsaśrāddhabhujastu ye //
meaning:
मासश्राद्धभुजस्तृप्तिं लभन्ते सोमलौकिकाः /
एते मनुष्यपितरो मासश्राद्धभुजस्तु ये //
text_mt: Those worldly eaters of the monthly śrāddha attain satisfaction through Soma. / These are the human Pitṛs, who enjoy the monthly śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'pare tu ye 'pyanye saṃkīrṇāḥ karmayoniṣu /
bhraṣṭāścāśramadharmebhyaḥ svadhāsvāhāvivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽपरे तु ये ऽप्यन्ये संकीर्णाः कर्मयोनिषु /
भ्रष्टाश्चाश्रमधर्मेभ्यः स्वधास्वाहाविवर्जिताः //
text_mt: Others different from them, commingled in wombs born of their deeds, / Fallen from the duties of the stages of life, devoid of the calls of svadhā and svāhā,

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnadehā durātmānaḥ pretabhūtā yamakṣaye /
svakarmāṇya nuśocanto yātanāsthānamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
भिन्नदेहा दुरात्मानः प्रेतभूता यमक्षये /
स्वकर्माण्य नुशोचन्तो यातनास्थानमागताः //
text_mt: With broken bodies, wicked-minded, having become spirits in the realm of Yama, / Grieving over their own deeds, have arrived at the place of torment.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāyuṣo 'tiśuṣkāśca śmaśrulāśca vivāsasaḥ /
kṣutpipāsāparītāśca vidravantastatastataḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घायुषो ऽतिशुष्काश्च श्मश्रुलाश्च विवाससः /
क्षुत्पिपासापरीताश्च विद्रवन्तस्ततस्ततः //
text_mt: Long-lived, exceedingly emaciated, bearded, and naked, / Overcome by hunger and thirst, running about here and there,

sanskrit_iast:
saritsarastaḍāgāni vāpīścāpyupalipsavaḥ /
parānnāni ca lipsaṃtaḥ kālyamānāstatastataḥ //
meaning:
सरित्सरस्तडागानि वापीश्चाप्युपलिप्सवः /
परान्नानि च लिप्संतः काल्यमानास्ततस्ततः //
text_mt: Seeking to reach rivers, lakes, ponds, and wells, / And longing for the food of others, driven from place to place,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāneṣu pātyamānāśca yātanāśca punaḥ punaḥ /
śālmale vaitaraṇyāṃ ca kuṃbhīpāke tathaiva ca //
meaning:
स्थानेषु पात्यमानाश्च यातनाश्च पुनः पुनः /
शाल्मले वैतरण्यां च कुंभीपाके तथैव च //
text_mt: Cast into places of torment again and again, / In the Śālmala hell, in the Vaitaraṇī river, and likewise in Kumbhīpāka,

sanskrit_iast:
karaṃbhavālukāyāṃ ca asipatravane tathā /
śilā saṃpeṣaṇe caiva pātyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
करंभवालुकायां च असिपत्रवने तथा /
शिला संपेषणे चैव पात्यमानाः स्वकर्मभिः //
text_mt: And in Karambhavālukā, as well as in the forest of sword-leaves, / And crushed upon stones, cast down by their own deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthānāṃ hi teṣāṃ vai duḥ khitānāmanāśinām /
teṣāṃ lokāntarasthānāṃ bāndhavairnāma gotrataḥ //
meaning:
तत्रस्थानां हि तेषां वै दुः खितानामनाशिनाम् /
तेषां लोकान्तरस्थानां बान्धवैर्नाम गोत्रतः //
text_mt: For those stationed there, suffering and without food, / Stationed in another world, when by relatives using their name and lineage,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmāvasavyaṃ darbheṣu dattāḥ piṇḍāstrayastu vai /
yānti tāstarpayante ca pretasthāneṣvadhiṣṭhitān //
meaning:
भूमावसव्यं दर्भेषु दत्ताः पिण्डास्त्रयस्तु वै /
यान्ति तास्तर्पयन्ते च प्रेतस्थानेष्वधिष्ठितान् //
text_mt: Three balls of food are offered on the earth to the left upon kuśa grass, / They reach and satisfy those residing in the ghostly states.

sanskrit_iast:
aprāptā yātanāsthānaṃ prabhraṣṭā ya ca pañcadhā /
paścādye sthāvarānte vai jātā nīcaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
अप्राप्ता यातनास्थानं प्रभ्रष्टा य च पञ्चधा /
पश्चाद्ये स्थावरान्ते वै जाता नीचैः स्वकर्मभिः //
text_mt: Those who have not reached the place of torment, fallen fivefold, / And who afterwards are born as lowest among the immobile things by their own deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
nānārūpāsu jāyante tiryagyoniṣvayoniṣu /
yadāhārā bhavantyete tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu //
meaning:
नानारूपासु जायन्ते तिर्यग्योनिष्वयोनिषु /
यदाहारा भवन्त्येते तासु तास्विह योनिषु //
text_mt: Are born in diverse forms, in animal wombs and non-wombs. / Whatever nourishment they have in those respective wombs here,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiṃstasmiṃstadāhāre śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ pratiṣṭhate /
kāle nyāyāgataṃ pātre vidhinā pratipāditam //
meaning:
तस्मिंस्तस्मिंस्तदाहारे श्राद्धं दत्तं प्रतिष्ठते /
काले न्यायागतं पात्रे विधिना प्रतिपादितम् //
text_mt: In that very nourishment the offered śrāddha is established. / Acquired legitimately at the proper time, given to a worthy recipient according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnotyannaṃ yathādattaṃ janturyatrāvatiṣṭhate /
yathā goṣu pranaṣṭāmu vatso vindati mātaram //
meaning:
प्राप्नोत्यन्नं यथादत्तं जन्तुर्यत्रावतिष्ठते /
यथा गोषु प्रनष्टामु वत्सो विन्दति मातरम् //
text_mt: The creature receives the food just as it was offered, wherever it abides, / Just as a calf finds its mother among lost cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śrāddheṣu dattānnaṃ mantraḥ prāpayate pitṝn /
evaṃ hyaviphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ śraddhādattaṃ tu mantrataḥ //
meaning:
तथा श्राद्धेषु दत्तान्नं मन्त्रः प्रापयते पितॄन् /
एवं ह्यविफलं श्राद्धं श्रद्धादत्तं तु मन्त्रतः //
text_mt: So does the mantra deliver the food given in śrāddhas to the Pitṛs. / Thus, indeed, a śrāddha offered with faith and mantras is never fruitless.

sanskrit_iast:
tattatkumāraḥ provāca paśyandivyena cakṣuṣā /
gatāgatajñaḥ pretānāṃ prāptiṃ śrāddhasya taiḥ saha //
meaning:
तत्तत्कुमारः प्रोवाच पश्यन्दिव्येन चक्षुषा /
गतागतज्ञः प्रेतानां प्राप्तिं श्राद्धस्य तैः सह //
text_mt: All that Kumāra proclaimed, seeing with his divine eye, / Knowing the departure and return of the deceased spirits, along with the receipt of the śrāddha by them.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhlīkāścoṣmapāścaiva divākīrtyāśca te smṛtāḥ /
kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī //
meaning:
बाह्लीकाश्चोष्मपाश्चैव दिवाकीर्त्याश्च ते स्मृताः /
कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी //
text_mt: They are known as Bāhlīkas, Uṣmapās, and Divākīrtyas; / The dark fortnight is their day, and the bright fortnight is their night for sleeping.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete pitaro devā devāśca pitaraśca vai /
ṛtvartavārddhamāsāstu anyonyaṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरश्च वै /
ऋत्वर्तवार्द्धमासास्तु अन्योन्यं पितरः स्मृताः //
text_mt: These gods are the Pitṛs, and the Pitṛs are gods; / The seasons and fortnights are considered Pitṛs mutually.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeta pitaro devā manuṣyapitaraśca ye /
prīteṣu teṣu prīyante śrāddhayukteṣu karmasu //
meaning:
इत्येत पितरो देवा मनुष्यपितरश्च ये /
प्रीतेषु तेषु प्रीयन्ते श्राद्धयुक्तेषु कर्मसु //
text_mt: These are the divine Pitṛs, and those are the human Pitṛs; / When they are pleased, they are pleased in the rites performed with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa vicayaḥ proktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ somapāyinām /
evaṃ pitṛsatattvaṃ hi purāṇe niścayaṃ gatam //
meaning:
इत्येष विचयः प्रोक्तः पितॄणां सोमपायिनाम् /
एवं पितृसतत्त्वं हि पुराणे निश्चयं गतम् //
text_mt: Thus this investigation of the soma-drinking Pitṛs has been declared. / Thus the true nature of the Pitṛs is settled in the Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ityarkapitṛsomānāmailasya ca samāgamaḥ /
sudhāmṛtasya ca prāptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarppaṇam //
meaning:
इत्यर्कपितृसोमानामैलस्य च समागमः /
सुधामृतस्य च प्राप्तिः पितॄणां चैव तर्प्पणम् //
text_mt: Thus the union of the sun, the Pitṛs, and Soma, and of Aila, / And the obtaining of nectar, and the offering of water to the Pitṛs,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇā māvāsyayoḥ kālo yātanāsthānameva ca /
samāsātkīrtitastubhyameṣa sargaḥ manātanaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्णा मावास्ययोः कालो यातनास्थानमेव च /
समासात्कीर्तितस्तुभ्यमेष सर्गः मनातनः //
text_mt: The time of full moon and new moon, and the place of torment / Have been declared in brief to you. This is the eternal creation.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvarūpyaṃ tu sargasya kathitaṃ hyekadaiśikam /
na śakyaṃ parisaṃkhyātuṃ śraddheyaṃ bhūtimicchatā //
meaning:
वैश्वरूप्यं तु सर्गस्य कथितं ह्येकदैशिकम् /
न शक्यं परिसंख्यातुं श्रद्धेयं भूतिमिच्छता //
text_mt: The multiformity of creation has been told only in part; / It cannot be completely calculated; it must be believed by one desiring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvasya hi hyeṣa sargaḥ krānto mayā tu vai /
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bhūyaḥ kiṃ varṇayāmyaham //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde amāvasyāśrāddhe pitṛvicayonāmāṣṭāviṃśati tamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
स्वायंभुवस्य हि ह्येष सर्गः क्रान्तो मया तु वै /
विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च भूयः किं वर्णयाम्यहम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे अमावस्याश्राद्धे पितृविचयोनामाष्टाविंशति तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Indeed, this creation of Svāyambhuva has been traversed by me / In full detail and in proper order; what more shall I describe?

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Investigation of the Pitṛs in the New-Moon Śrāddha', in the second Anuṣaṅgapāda of the first part in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca
caturyugāni yānyāsanpūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare /
teṣāṃ nisargaṃ tattvaṃ ca śrotumicchāmi vistarāt //
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच
चतुर्युगानि यान्यासन्पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे /
तेषां निसर्गं तत्त्वं च श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरात् //
text_mt: The sage said: / The four yugas that existed formerly in the interval of Svāyambhuva, / I desire to hear in detail their origination and reality.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
pṛthivyādiprasaṃgena yanmayā prāgudīritam /
teṣāṃ caturyugaṃ hyetattadvakṣyāmi nibodhata //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पृथिव्यादिप्रसंगेन यन्मया प्रागुदीरितम् /
तेषां चतुर्युगं ह्येतत्तद्वक्ष्यामि निबोधत //
text_mt: The bard said: / What was mentioned by me before in connection with the earth and other [matters], / of these, indeed, is this four-age cycle: listen to it as I declare it.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyayeha prasaṃkhyāya vistarāccaiva sarvaśaḥ /
yugaṃ ca yugabhedaśca yugadharmastathaiva ca //
meaning:
संख्ययेह प्रसंख्याय विस्तराच्चैव सर्वशः /
युगं च युगभेदश्च युगधर्मस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Calculating [it] here by number and in full detail in every respect: / the age, the distinction among the ages, and likewise the dharma of the age,

sanskrit_iast:
yugasaṃdhyāṃśakaścaiva yugasaṃdhānameva ca /
ṣaṭprakāśayugākhyaiṣā tā pravakṣyāmi tattvataḥ //
meaning:
युगसंध्यांशकश्चैव युगसंधानमेव च /
षट्प्रकाशयुगाख्यैषा ता प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: the junction and twilight portion of the age, and the conjunction of the ages— / this is known as the sixfold division of the ages: I shall declare them in accordance with reality.

sanskrit_iast:
laukikena pramāṇena niṣpādyābdaṃ tu mānuṣam /
tenābdena prasaṃkhyāyai vakṣyāmīha vaturyugam /
nimeṣakāla tulyaṃ hi vidyāllaghvakṣaraṃ ca yat //
meaning:
लौकिकेन प्रमाणेन निष्पाद्याब्दं तु मानुषम् /
तेनाब्देन प्रसंख्यायै वक्ष्यामीह वतुर्युगम् /
निमेषकाल तुल्यं हि विद्याल्लघ्वक्षरं च यत् //
text_mt: Computing a human year by worldly measure, / by that year I will declare here the four-age cycle through calculation. / One should know a short syllable to be equal to the duration of an eye-blink.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṣṭhā nimeṣā daśa pañca caiva triśacca kāṣṭhā gaṇayetkalāṃ tu /
triṃśatkalāścāpi bhavenmuhūrttastai striṃśatā rātryahanī same te //
meaning:
काष्ठा निमेषा दश पञ्च चैव त्रिशच्च काष्ठा गणयेत्कलां तु /
त्रिंशत्कलाश्चापि भवेन्मुहूर्त्तस्तै स्त्रिंशता रात्र्यहनी समे ते //
text_mt: Fifteen blinks are a kāṣṭhā, and one should count thirty kāṣṭhās as a kalā; / thirty kalās make a muhūrta, and by thirty of those [is made] a day and night of equal length.

sanskrit_iast: ahorātrau vibhajate sūryo mānuṣalaukikau //
meaning: अहोरात्रौ विभजते सूर्यो मानुषलौकिकौ //
text_mt: The sun divides the human, worldly day and night.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāhaḥ karmaceṣṭāyāṃ rātriḥ svapnāya kalpate /
pitrye rātryahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तत्राहः कर्मचेष्टायां रात्रिः स्वप्नाय कल्पते /
पित्र्ये रात्र्यहनी मासः प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः //
text_mt: There, the day is ordained for action and exertion, the night for sleep. / The day and night of the ancestors is a month, and the division between the two [is as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī /
triṃśadye mānuṣā māsāḥ pitryo māsastu saḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी /
त्रिंशद्ये मानुषा मासाः पित्र्यो मासस्तु सः स्मृतः //
text_mt: the dark fortnight is their day, and the light [fortnight] is the night for sleep. / Thirty human months are remembered as a month of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
śatāni trīṇi māsānāṃ ṣaṣṭyā cāpyadhikāni vai /
pitryaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa vibhāvyate //
meaning:
शतानि त्रीणि मासानां षष्ट्या चाप्यधिकानि वै /
पित्र्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण विभाव्यते //
text_mt: Three hundred months, plus sixty more, / are indeed reckoned by human [measure] as a year of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣe ṇaiva mānena varṣāṇāṃ yacchataṃ bhavet /
pitṝṇāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi saṃkhyātānīha tāni vai //
meaning:
मानुषे णैव मानेन वर्षाणां यच्छतं भवेत् /
पितॄणां त्रीणि वर्षाणि संख्यातानीह तानि वै //
text_mt: What would be a hundred years by human measure, / those are calculated here as three years of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
daśa caivādhikā māsāḥ pitṛsaṃkhyeha saṃjñitāḥ /
laukikenaiva mānena hṛbdo yo mānuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दश चैवाधिका मासाः पितृसंख्येह संज्ञिताः /
लौकिकेनैव मानेन हृब्दो यो मानुषः स्मृतः //
text_mt: and ten additional months in the calculation of the ancestors. / By worldly measure, what is remembered as a human year,

sanskrit_iast:
etaddivyamahorātraṃ śāstre syānniścayo gataḥ /
divye rātryahanī varṣa pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
एतद्दिव्यमहोरात्रं शास्त्रे स्यान्निश्चयो गतः /
दिव्ये रात्र्यहनी वर्ष प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः //
text_mt: that is a divine day and night; such is the conclusion found in the scriptures. / The day and night of the gods is a year; and the division between the two [is as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
ahastatrodagayanaṃ rātriḥ syāddakṣiṇāyanam /
ye te rātryahanī divye prasaṃkhyānaṃ tayoḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अहस्तत्रोदगयनं रात्रिः स्याद्दक्षिणायनम् /
ये ते रात्र्यहनी दिव्ये प्रसंख्यानं तयोः पुनः //
text_mt: the day is the northern course [of the sun], the night the southern course. / As for that divine day and night, their calculation further [is as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
triṃśadyāni tu varṣāṇi dipyo māsastu sa smṛtaḥ /
yanmānuṣaṃ śataṃ viddhi divyā māsāstrayastu te //
meaning:
त्रिंशद्यानि तु वर्षाणि दिप्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः /
यन्मानुषं शतं विद्धि दिव्या मासास्त्रयस्तु ते //
text_mt: thirty years are remembered as a divine month. / What is a human century, know that to be three divine months

sanskrit_iast:
daśa caiva tathāhāni divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
trīṇi varṣaśatānyeva ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi yāni tu /
divyaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa prakīrttitaḥ //
meaning:
दश चैव तथाहानि दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः /
त्रीणि वर्षशतान्येव षष्टिवर्षाणि यानि तु /
दिव्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण प्रकीर्त्तितः //
text_mt: and ten days; such is remembered as the divine rule. / Three hundred years, plus sixty years, / are proclaimed as a divine year by human [measure].

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi varṣa sahasrāṇi mānuṣāṇi pramāṇataḥ /
triṃśadanyāni varṣāṇi mataḥ saptarṣivatsaraḥ //
meaning:
त्रीणि वर्ष सहस्राणि मानुषाणि प्रमाणतः /
त्रिंशदन्यानि वर्षाणि मतः सप्तर्षिवत्सरः //
text_mt: Three thousand years by human measure, / plus thirty other years, is considered a year of the seven sages.

sanskrit_iast:
nava yāni sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu /
anyāni navatiścaiva dhruvaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
नव यानि सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु /
अन्यानि नवतिश्चैव ध्रुवः संवत्सरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Nine thousand human years, / and ninety others, are remembered as a Dhruva year.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi mānuṣāṇi tu /
varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ jñeyaṃ divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
षड्विंशतिसहस्राणि वर्षाणि मानुषाणि तु /
वर्षाणां तु शतं ज्ञेयं दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Twenty-six thousand human years / should be known as a hundred [divine] years; such is the divine rule remembered.

sanskrit_iast: trīṇyeva niyutānyāhurvarṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu //
meaning: त्रीण्येव नियुतान्याहुर्वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु //
text_mt: They say three hundred thousand human years,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi saṃkhyātāni tu saṃkhyāyā /
divyavarṣasahasra tu prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ //
meaning:
षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि संख्यातानि तु संख्याया /
दिव्यवर्षसहस्र तु प्राहुः संख्याविदो जनाः //
text_mt: and sixty thousand reckoned in the count, / those who know numbers call a thousand divine years.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamṛṣibhirgītaṃ divyayā saṃkhyāyā tviha /
divyenaiva pramāṇena yugasaṃkhyāprakalpanam //
meaning:
इत्येवमृषिभिर्गीतं दिव्यया संख्याया त्विह /
दिव्येनैव प्रमाणेन युगसंख्याप्रकल्पनम् //
text_mt: Thus has it been sung by the sages through the divine count here; / the arrangement of the number of the ages is [made] by this very divine measure.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri bhārate varṣe yugāni kavayo 'buvan /
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti catuṣṭayam //
meaning:
चत्वारि भारते वर्षे युगानि कवयो ऽबुवन् /
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चेति चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: Wise poets have spoken of four ages in the realm of Bhārata: / Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali—a quartet.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrva kṛtayukaṃ nāma tatastretī vidhīyate /
dvāparaṃ ca kaliścaiva yugānyetāni kalpayet //
meaning:
पूर्व कृतयुकं नाम ततस्त्रेती विधीयते /
द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव युगान्येतानि कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: First is that named the Kṛta age; after that Tretā is ordained; / and Dvāpara and Kali: one should calculate these ages.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāryāhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ ca kṛta yugam /
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaḥ saṃdhyāyā samaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वार्याहुः सहस्राणि वर्षाणां च कृत युगम् /
तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशः संध्याया समः //
text_mt: They say the Kṛta age consists of four thousand [divine] years; / its dawn is as many hundreds, and its twilight portion is equal to its dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
itareṣu sasaṃdhyeṣu sasaṃdhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu /
ekanyāyena vartante sahasrāṇi śatāni ca //
meaning:
इतरेषु ससंध्येषु ससंध्यांशेषु च त्रिषु /
एकन्यायेन वर्तन्ते सहस्राणि शतानि च //
text_mt: In the other three, along with their dawns and along with their twilight portions, / the thousands and the hundreds proceed by the same rule:

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi dve ca sahasrāṇi tretādvāparayoḥ kramāt /
triśatī dviśatī saṃdhye saṃdhyāṃśau cāpi tatsamau //
meaning:
त्रीणि द्वे च सहस्राणि त्रेताद्वापरयोः क्रमात् /
त्रिशती द्विशती संध्ये संध्यांशौ चापि तत्समौ //
text_mt: three and two thousand in the Tretā and Dvāpara respectively, / their dawns of three hundred and two hundred, and both twilight portions equal to them.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliṃ varṣasarasraṃ tu yugamāhurdvijottamāḥ /
tasyaikaśatikā saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaḥ saṃdhyayā samaḥ //
meaning:
कलिं वर्षसरस्रं तु युगमाहुर्द्विजोत्तमाः /
तस्यैकशतिका संध्या संध्यांशः संध्यया समः //
text_mt: The best of the twice-born say Kali is an age of one thousand years; / its dawn is one hundred, and its twilight portion is equal to its dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ dvādaśasāhasrī yugasaṃkhyā prakīrttitā /
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliścaiva catuṣṭayam //
meaning:
तेषां द्वादशसाहस्री युगसंख्या प्रकीर्त्तिता /
कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: The reckoning of their ages is proclaimed as twelve thousand [years]: / Kṛta, Tretā, Dvāpara, and Kali—a quartet.

sanskrit_iast:
atra saṃvatsarā dṛṣṭā mānuṣeṇa pramāṇataḥ /
kṛtasya tāvadvakṣyāmi varṣāṇi ca nibodhata //
meaning:
अत्र संवत्सरा दृष्टा मानुषेण प्रमाणतः /
कृतस्य तावद्वक्ष्यामि वर्षाणि च निबोधत //
text_mt: Here the years are seen by human measure; / I shall declare those of Kṛta: understand them.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇāṃ śatānyāhuścaturdaśa hi saṃkhyāyā /
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathānyāni kṛtaṃ yugam //
meaning:
सहस्राणां शतान्याहुश्चतुर्दश हि संख्याया /
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि तथान्यानि कृतं युगम् //
text_mt: They say the Kṛta age is, in count, fourteen hundred thousand / and forty thousand others.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śatasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi daśasaṃkhyāyā /
aśītiśca sahasrāṇi kālastretāyugasya saḥ //
meaning:
तथा शतसहस्राणि वर्षाणि दशसंख्याया /
अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि कालस्त्रेतायुगस्य सः //
text_mt: Likewise, ten hundred thousand years in number, / and eighty thousand, is that duration of the Tretā age.

sanskrit_iast:
saptaiva niyutānyāhurvarṣāṇāṃ mānuṣeṇa tu /
viṃśatiśca sahasrāmi kālaḥ sa dvāparasya ca //
meaning:
सप्तैव नियुतान्याहुर्वर्षाणां मानुषेण तु /
विंशतिश्च सहस्रामि कालः स द्वापरस्य च //
text_mt: They say the duration of Dvāpara is seven hundred thousand / and twenty thousand years by human [reckoning].

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śatasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi saṃkhyayā /
ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi kālaḥ kaliyugasya tu //
meaning:
तथा शतसहस्राणि वर्षाणां त्रीणि संख्यया /
षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि कालः कलियुगस्य तु //
text_mt: Likewise, three hundred thousand years in number, / and sixty thousand, is the duration of the Kali age.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ caturyuge kāla ṛtaiḥ saṃdhyāṃśakaiḥ smṛtaḥ /
niyutānyeva ṣaḍiṃśānnirasāni yugāni vai //
meaning:
एवं चतुर्युगे काल ऋतैः संध्यांशकैः स्मृतः /
नियुतान्येव षडिंशान्निरसानि युगानि वै //
text_mt: Thus the duration in the four-age cycle is remembered, excluding the twilight portions; / the ages without the fractions are thirty-six hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattathā trīṇi niyutā nīha saṃkhyayā /
viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi sa saṃdhyāṃśaścaturyugaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्तथा त्रीणि नियुता नीह संख्यया /
विंशतिश्च सहस्राणि स संध्यांशश्चतुर्युगः //
text_mt: And forty-three hundred thousand in count / and twenty thousand, is the four-age cycle with its twilight portions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ caturyugākhyānāṃ sādhikā hyekasaptatiḥ /
kṛtatretādiyuktānāṃ manorantaramucyate //
meaning:
एवं चतुर्युगाख्यानां साधिका ह्येकसप्ततिः /
कृतत्रेतादियुक्तानां मनोरन्तरमुच्यते //
text_mt: Thus, seventy-one [cycles] called the four ages, / consisting of Kṛta, Tretā, and the rest, with a fraction, is called a manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarasya saṃkhyāṃ tu varṣāgreṇa nibodhata /
triṃśatkoṭyastu varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣeṇa prakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरस्य संख्यां तु वर्षाग्रेण निबोधत /
त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तु वर्षाणां मानुषेण प्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: Understand the count of a manvantara by the total of years: / thirty crores of years are proclaimed by human [measure],

sanskrit_iast:
sapta ṣaṣṭistathānyāni niyutānyadhikāni tu /
viśatiśca sahasrāṇi kālo 'yaṃ sādhikaṃ vinā //
meaning:
सप्त षष्टिस्तथान्यानि नियुतान्यधिकानि तु /
विशतिश्च सहस्राणि कालो ऽयं साधिकं विना //
text_mt: and sixty-seven hundred thousand additional, / and twenty thousand: this duration is without the fraction.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantarasya saṃkhyaiṣā saṃkhyā vidbhirdvijaiḥ smṛtā /
manvantarasya kālo 'yaṃ yugaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca kīrttitaḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरस्य संख्यैषा संख्या विद्भिर्द्विजैः स्मृता /
मन्वन्तरस्य कालो ऽयं युगैः सार्द्धं च कीर्त्तितः //
text_mt: This is the calculation of a manvantara remembered by twice-born who know numbers; / this duration of a manvantara has been proclaimed together with the ages.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥ sāhasrayuktaṃ vai prākṛtaṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam /
tretāśiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvāparaṃ kalimeva ca //
meaning:
चतुः साहस्रयुक्तं वै प्राकृतं तत्कृतं युगम् /
त्रेताशिष्टं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वापरं कलिमेव च //
text_mt: That primal Kṛta age was indeed endowed with four thousand [years]; / I shall describe what remains of Tretā, and Dvāpara, and Kali.

sanskrit_iast:
yugapatsamayenārtho dvidhā vaktuṃ na śakyate /
kramāgataṃ mayā hyetattubhyaṃ nokta yuga dvayam //
meaning:
युगपत्समयेनार्थो द्विधा वक्तुं न शक्यते /
क्रमागतं मया ह्येतत्तुभ्यं नोक्त युग द्वयम् //
text_mt: A matter cannot be stated simultaneously in two ways at once; / therefore these two ages that follow in sequence have not been told to you by me,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣivaṃśaprasaṃgena vyākulatvāttathaiva ca /
atra tretāyugasyādau manuḥ saptarṣayaśca ye //
meaning:
ऋषिवंशप्रसंगेन व्याकुलत्वात्तथैव च /
अत्र त्रेतायुगस्यादौ मनुः सप्तर्षयश्च ये //
text_mt: owing to the connection with the lineage of the sages and because of complexity. / Here, at the beginning of the Tretā age, Manu and the seven sages [proclaimed]

sanskrit_iast:
śrauta smārtta ca te dharma brahmaṇānupracauditam /
dārāgnihotrasaṃbandhamṛgyajuḥ sāmasaṃhitam //
meaning:
श्रौत स्मार्त्त च ते धर्म ब्रह्मणानुप्रचौदितम् /
दाराग्निहोत्रसंबन्धमृग्यजुः सामसंहितम् //
text_mt: dharma based on revelation and dharma based on tradition, impelled by Brahmā, / associated with wives and the sacred fire, united with the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma Saṃhitās.

sanskrit_iast:
ityādilakṣaṇaṃ śrautaṃ dharma saptarṣayo 'bruvan /
paraṃparāgataṃ dharma smārttaṃ cācāralakṣaṇam //
meaning:
इत्यादिलक्षणं श्रौतं धर्म सप्तर्षयो ऽब्रुवन् /
परंपरागतं धर्म स्मार्त्तं चाचारलक्षणम् //
text_mt: The seven sages proclaimed dharma based on revelation, characterised by these [rites] and the like; / and dharma based on tradition, transmitted through succession, characterised by conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramācārayutaṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo 'bravīt /
satyena brahmacaryeṇa śrutena tapasā ca vai //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाचारयुतं मनुः स्वायंभुवो ऽब्रवीत् /
सत्येन ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन तपसा च वै //
text_mt: associated with the conduct of the classes and stages of life, Svāyambhuva Manu declared. / Through truth, celibate studenthood, sacred learning, and austerity indeed,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tu taptatapasā ārṣeṇopakrameṇa tu /
saptarṣīṇāṃ manoścaiva hyādye tretāyuge tathā //
meaning:
तेषां तु तप्ततपसा आर्षेणोपक्रमेण तु /
सप्तर्षीणां मनोश्चैव ह्याद्ये त्रेतायुगे तथा //
text_mt: by them through their performed austerities, through the sages' procedure, / of the seven sages and of Manu, in the first Tretā age likewise,

sanskrit_iast:
abuddhipūrvakaṃ teṣāmakriyāpūrvameva ca /
abhivyaktāstu te mantrāstārakādyairnidarśanaiḥ //
meaning:
अबुद्धिपूर्वकं तेषामक्रियापूर्वमेव च /
अभिव्यक्तास्तु ते मन्त्रास्तारकाद्यैर्निदर्शनैः //
text_mt: without premeditation and without previous action, / those mantras were revealed through pointers such as stars.

sanskrit_iast:
ādikalpe tu devānāṃ prādurbhūtāstu yāḥ svayam /
prāṇāśeṣvatha siddhīnāmanyāsāṃ ca pravarttanam //
meaning:
आदिकल्पे तु देवानां प्रादुर्भूतास्तु याः स्वयम् /
प्राणाशेष्वथ सिद्धीनामन्यासां च प्रवर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: In the primal kalpa, those which appeared spontaneously among the gods / brought about living faculties and the functioning of other accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanmantrā vyatīteṣu ye kalpeṣu sahasraśaḥ /
te mantrā vai punasteṣāṃ pratibhāyāmupasthitāḥ //
meaning:
आसन्मन्त्रा व्यतीतेषु ये कल्पेषु सहस्रशः /
ते मन्त्रा वै पुनस्तेषां प्रतिभायामुपस्थिताः //
text_mt: The thousands of mantras that had existed in bygone kalpas / once again presented themselves to their intuitive vision.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni mantraścātharvaṇāni tu /
saptarṣibhistu te proktāḥ smārttaṃ dharmaṃ manurjagau //
meaning:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि मन्त्रश्चाथर्वणानि तु /
सप्तर्षिभिस्तु ते प्रोक्ताः स्मार्त्तं धर्मं मनुर्जगौ //
text_mt: The verses of the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda formulas, the Sāmaveda chants, and the mantras of the Atharvaveda / were proclaimed by the seven sages, while Manu taught the traditional duty.

sanskrit_iast:
tretādau saṃhitā vedāḥ kevalā dharmasetavaḥ /
saṃrodhādāyuṣaścaiva vartsyante dvāpareṣu vai //
meaning:
त्रेतादौ संहिता वेदाः केवला धर्मसेतवः /
संरोधादायुषश्चैव वर्त्स्यन्ते द्वापरेषु वै //
text_mt: At the beginning of the Tretā[yuga], the Vedas were unified collections, sole bridges of righteousness; / on account of the curtailment of life, they will become [divided] in the Dvāpara[yuga]s.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayastapasā vedāndvāparādiṣvadhīyate /
anādinidhinā divyāḥ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā //
meaning:
ऋषयस्तपसा वेदान्द्वापरादिष्वधीयते /
अनादिनिधिना दिव्याः पूर्वं सृष्टाः स्वयंभुवा //
text_mt: Through ascetic heat, the sages study the Vedas at the beginnings of Dvāpara[yuga]s; / eternal and beginningless, divine, they were previously created by Svayambhū.

sanskrit_iast:
sadharmāḥ savratāḥ sāṃgā yathādharmaṃ yugeyuge /
vikriyante samānārthā vedavādā yathāyugam //
meaning:
सधर्माः सव्रताः सांगा यथाधर्मं युगेयुगे /
विक्रियन्ते समानार्था वेदवादा यथायुगम् //
text_mt: With their duties, observances, and ancillary branches, according to righteousness in age after age, / the statements of the Vedas, identical in sense, undergo changes according to the age.

sanskrit_iast:
āraṃbhayajñāḥ kṣatrāśca haviryajñā viśastathā /
paricārayajñāḥ śūdrāstu japayajñā dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
आरंभयज्ञाः क्षत्राश्च हविर्यज्ञा विशस्तथा /
परिचारयज्ञाः शूद्रास्तु जपयज्ञा द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The kṣatriyas perform sacrifices of undertaking, the vaiśyas sacrifices of oblations, / the śūdras sacrifices of service, and the best of the twice-born sacrifices of recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pramuditā varṇāstretāyāṃ dharmapālitāḥ /
kriyāvantaḥ prajāvantaḥ samṛddhāḥ sukhinastathā //
meaning:
तदा प्रमुदिता वर्णास्त्रेतायां धर्मपालिताः /
क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तः समृद्धाः सुखिनस्तथा //
text_mt: Then the castes were joyful in the Tretā[yuga], protected by righteousness, / active in rites, blessed with offspring, prosperous, and happy.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānanurttante kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyānviśaḥ /
vaiśyānuvarttinaḥ śudrāḥ parasparamanuvratāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाननुर्त्तन्ते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियान्विशः /
वैश्यानुवर्त्तिनः शुद्राः परस्परमनुव्रताः //
text_mt: The kṣatriyas follow the brāhmaṇas, the vaiśyas the kṣatriyas, / and the śūdras follow the vaiśyas, mutually devoted to each other.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāḥ pravṛttayasteṣāṃ dharmā varṇāśramāstathā /
saṃkalpitena manasā vācoktena svakarmaṇā //
meaning:
शुभाः प्रवृत्तयस्तेषां धर्मा वर्णाश्रमास्तथा /
संकल्पितेन मनसा वाचोक्तेन स्वकर्मणा //
text_mt: Auspicious were their activities, their duties, and their stages of life according to caste, / performed through their own action, directed by resolved thought and spoken word.

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyuge ca viphalaḥ karmāraṃbhaḥ prasiddhyati /
āyurmedhā balaṃ rūpamārogyaṃ dharmaśīlatā //
meaning:
त्रेतायुगे च विफलः कर्मारंभः प्रसिद्ध्यति /
आयुर्मेधा बलं रूपमारोग्यं धर्मशीलता //
text_mt: And in the Tretāyuga, undertakings of action bear fruit without failing; / lifespan, intelligence, strength, beauty, health, and dedication to righteousness—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasādhāraṇā hyete tretāyāṃ vai bhavaṃ tyuta /
varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā tadākarot //
meaning:
सर्वसाधारणा ह्येते त्रेतायां वै भवं त्युत /
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थानं तेषां ब्रह्मा तदाकरोत् //
text_mt: all these are indeed common to everyone in the Tretā[yuga]. / Then Brahmā established the system of castes and stages of life for them.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prajāstu tā mohāddharmā stānapyapālayan /
parasparavirodhena manuṃ tāḥ punarabhyayuḥ //
meaning:
पुनः प्रजास्तु ता मोहाद्धर्मा स्तानप्यपालयन् /
परस्परविरोधेन मनुं ताः पुनरभ्ययुः //
text_mt: Yet out of delusion the subjects neglected those duties; / conflicting with one another, they approached Manu once again.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ svāyaṃbhuvo dṛṣṭvā yāthātathyaṃ prajāpatiḥ /
dhyātvā tu śatarūpāyāṃ putrau sa udapādayat //
meaning:
पुनः स्वायंभुवो दृष्ट्वा याथातथ्यं प्रजापतिः /
ध्यात्वा तु शतरूपायां पुत्रौ स उदपादयत् //
text_mt: Seeing the situation as it truly was, the lord of creatures, the son of Svayambhū, / meditated and begot two sons upon Śatarūpā:

sanskrit_iast:
priyavrato ttānapādau prathamau tau mohīkṣitau /
tataḥ prabhṛti rājāna utpannā daṇḍadhāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रियव्रतो त्तानपादौ प्रथमौ तौ मोहीक्षितौ /
ततः प्रभृति राजान उत्पन्ना दण्डधारिणः //
text_mt: Priyavrata and Uttānapāda, the two first rulers of the earth. / From that time onward, kings arose, wielding the rod of punishment.

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ rañjanāccaiva rājānaste 'bhavannṛpāḥ /
pracchanna pāpāstairye ca na śakyāstu narādhipaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रजानां रञ्जनाच्चैव राजानस्ते ऽभवन्नृपाः /
प्रच्छन्न पापास्तैर्ये च न शक्यास्तु नराधिपैः //
text_mt: And because they pleased their subjects, they were called kings; / but those hidden sinners who could not be [punished] by the lords of men—

sanskrit_iast:
dharmarājaḥ smṛtasteṣāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ /
varṇānāṃ pravibhāgāśca tretāyāṃ saṃprakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
धर्मराजः स्मृतस्तेषां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः /
वर्णानां प्रविभागाश्च त्रेतायां संप्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: Yama, son of Vivasvat, the King of Justice, is remembered as their chastiser. / And the divisions of castes have been fully recounted in the Tretā[yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhṛtācca tadā mantrā ṛṣibhirbrahmaṇaḥ sutaiḥ /
yajñāḥ pravarttitāścaiva tadā hyeva tu daivataiḥ //
meaning:
संभृताच्च तदा मन्त्रा ऋषिभिर्ब्रह्मणः सुतैः /
यज्ञाः प्रवर्त्तिताश्चैव तदा ह्येव तु दैवतैः //
text_mt: Then mantras were collected by the sages, the sons of Brahmā, / and sacrifices were set in motion at that time by the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
yāmaśukrārjitaiścaiva sarvasādhana saṃbhṛtaiḥ /
sārddhaṃ viśvabhujā caiva devendreṇa mahaujasā //
meaning:
यामशुक्रार्जितैश्चैव सर्वसाधन संभृतैः /
सार्द्धं विश्वभुजा चैव देवेन्द्रेण महौजसा //
text_mt: together with [gods] born of Yāma and Śukra, equipped with all requisites, / and alongside Viśvabhuj, the Indra of gods of great majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare devairyajñastaiḥ prākpravarttitaḥ /
satyaṃ japastapo dānaṃ tretāyā dharma ucyate //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवेंऽतरे देवैर्यज्ञस्तैः प्राक्प्रवर्त्तितः /
सत्यं जपस्तपो दानं त्रेताया धर्म उच्यते //
text_mt: In the Svāyambhuva manvantara, sacrifice was first set in motion by those gods. / Truth, recitation, ascetic heat, and charity are declared to be the duty of the Tretā[yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā dharmmasahasrānte 'hiṃsādharmaḥ pravarttate /
jāyante ca tadā śūrā āyuṣmanto mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
तदा धर्म्मसहस्रान्ते ऽहिंसाधर्मः प्रवर्त्तते /
जायन्ते च तदा शूरा आयुष्मन्तो महाबलाः //
text_mt: Then, at the end of a thousand duties, the duty of non-violence prevails; / and then heroes are born, long-lived and endowed with great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
vyastadaṇḍā mahābhāgā dharmiṣṭhā brahmavādinaḥ /
padmapatrāyatākṣāśca pṛthūraskāḥ susaṃhatāḥ //
meaning:
व्यस्तदण्डा महाभागा धर्मिष्ठा ब्रह्मवादिनः /
पद्मपत्रायताक्षाश्च पृथूरस्काः सुसंहताः //
text_mt: with the rod of punishment laid aside, fortunate, most righteous, proclaimers of the Veda, / with eyes long as lotus petals, broad-chested, firmly knit,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhātaṅkā mahāsattvā mattamātaṅgagaminaḥ /
mahādhanurddharāścaiva tretāyāṃ cakravarttinaḥ //
meaning:
सिंहातङ्का महासत्त्वा मत्तमातङ्गगमिनः /
महाधनुर्द्धराश्चैव त्रेतायां चक्रवर्त्तिनः //
text_mt: feared like lions, of great courage, striding like rutting elephants, / great archers, and universal emperors in the Tretā[yuga],

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalāḥ /
nyagrodhau tu smṛtau bāhū vyāmo nyagrodha ucyate //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्मा न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डलाः /
न्यग्रोधौ तु स्मृतौ बाहू व्यामो न्यग्रोध उच्यते //
text_mt: endowed with all marks, symmetrical like the banyan tree. / The two arms are considered like banyan trees; the span of the outstretched arms is called a nyagrodha.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāme naivochrayo yasya sama ūrddhaṃ tu dehinaḥ /
samochrayaparīṇāho jñeyo nyagrodhamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
व्यामे नैवोछ्रयो यस्य सम ऊर्द्धं तु देहिनः /
समोछ्रयपरीणाहो ज्ञेयो न्यग्रोधमण्डलः //
text_mt: One whose height upwards is equal to the span of his outstretched arms, / having equal height and girth, is to be known as symmetrical like the banyan tree.

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ ratho maṇirbhāryā nidhiraśvo gajastathā /
saptaitāni ca ratnāni sarveṣāṃ cakravartināma //
meaning:
चक्रं रथो मणिर्भार्या निधिरश्वो गजस्तथा /
सप्तैतानि च रत्नानि सर्वेषां चक्रवर्तिनाम //
text_mt: The discus, the chariot, the jewel, the wife, the treasure, the horse, and the elephant— / these are the seven jewels of all universal emperors.

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ ratho maṇiḥ khaḍgaścarmaratnaṃ ca pañcamam /
keturnidhiśca saptaiva prāṇahīnāni cakṣate //
meaning:
चक्रं रथो मणिः खड्गश्चर्मरत्नं च पञ्चमम् /
केतुर्निधिश्च सप्तैव प्राणहीनानि चक्षते //
text_mt: The discus, the chariot, the jewel, the sword, the jewel of a shield as the fifth, / the banner, and the treasure—these seven are declared to be inanimate.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryā purohitaścaiva senānī rathakṛcca yaḥ /
mantryaśvaḥ kalabhaścaiva prāṇinaḥ sapta kīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
भार्या पुरोहितश्चैव सेनानी रथकृच्च यः /
मन्त्र्यश्वः कलभश्चैव प्राणिनः सप्त कीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: The wife, the family priest, the general, the chariot-maker, / the minister, the horse, and the young elephant—these are proclaimed as the seven animate [jewels].

sanskrit_iast:
ratnānyetāni divyāni saṃsiddhāni mahātmanām /
caturdaśa vidheyāni sarveṣāṃ cakravarttinām //
meaning:
रत्नान्येतानि दिव्यानि संसिद्धानि महात्मनाम् /
चतुर्दश विधेयानि सर्वेषां चक्रवर्त्तिनाम् //
text_mt: These fourteen divine jewels, attained by the great-souled, / are subject to the command of all universal emperors.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoraṃśena jāyante pṛthivyāṃ cakravarttinaḥ /
manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣviha //
meaning:
विष्णोरंशेन जायन्ते पृथिव्यां चक्रवर्त्तिनः /
मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह //
text_mt: Universal emperors are born on earth as a portion of Viṣṇu / in all the manvantaras here, both past and future.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyāni yānīha varttamānāni yāni ca /
tretāyuge ca tānyatra jāyante cakravarttinaḥ //
meaning:
भूतभव्यानि यानीह वर्त्तमानानि यानि च /
त्रेतायुगे च तान्यत्र जायन्ते चक्रवर्त्तिनः //
text_mt: Those that were in the past, those that are to be, and those that are present here— / they are born here as universal emperors in the Tretāyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāṇīmāni teṣāṃ vai bhavantīha mahīkṣitām /
atyadbhutāni catvāri balaṃ dharmaḥ sukhaṃ dhanam //
meaning:
भद्राणीमानि तेषां वै भवन्तीह महीक्षिताम् /
अत्यद्भुतानि चत्वारि बलं धर्मः सुखं धनम् //
text_mt: These blessings belong to these rulers of the earth: / four exceedingly wonderful things—strength, righteousness, happiness, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyasyāvirodhena prāpyante tu nṛpaiḥ samam /
artho dharmaśca kāmaśca yaśo vijaya eva ca //
meaning:
अन्योन्यस्याविरोधेन प्राप्यन्ते तु नृपैः समम् /
अर्थो धर्मश्च कामश्च यशो विजय एव च //
text_mt: Without conflict with one another, these are obtained equally by the kings: / wealth, righteousness, pleasure, fame, and victory.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśvaryeṇāṇimādyena prabhuśaktyā tathaiva ca /
śrutena tapasā caiva munīnabhibhavanti vai //
meaning:
ऐश्वर्येणाणिमाद्येन प्रभुशक्त्या तथैव च /
श्रुतेन तपसा चैव मुनीनभिभवन्ति वै //
text_mt: Through sovereign power beginning with minuteness, and likewise through royal power, / through sacred learning and ascetic heat, they surpass the sages;

sanskrit_iast:
balena tapasā caiva devadānavamānavān /
lakṣaṇaiścaiva jāyante śarīrasthairamānuṣaiḥ //
meaning:
बलेन तपसा चैव देवदानवमानवान् /
लक्षणैश्चैव जायन्ते शरीरस्थैरमानुषैः //
text_mt: and through strength and ascetic heat, [they surpass] gods, dānavas, and men; / they are born with superhuman marks present on their bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
keśāḥsnigdhā lalāṭoccā jihvā cāsya pramārjinī /
tāmraprabhoṣṭanetrāśca śrīvatsāścaiddhvaromaśāḥ //
meaning:
केशाःस्निग्धा ललाटोच्चा जिह्वा चास्य प्रमार्जिनी /
ताम्रप्रभोष्टनेत्राश्च श्रीवत्साश्चैद्ध्वरोमशाः //
text_mt: Their hair is glossy, their foreheads high, their tongues broad and sweeping, / their lips and eyes shine like copper, and they have the Śrīvatsa mark and upward-pointing body hair.

sanskrit_iast:
ājānubāhavaschaiva tadāmrahastāḥ kaṭau kṛśāḥ /
nyagrodhapariṇāhāśca siṃhaskandhāstu mehanāḥ //
meaning:
आजानुबाहवस्छैव तदाम्रहस्ताः कटौ कृशाः /
न्यग्रोधपरिणाहाश्च सिंहस्कन्धास्तु मेहनाः //
text_mt: Their arms reach to their knees, their palms are copper-colored, their waists slender, / their girth symmetrical like a banyan tree, their shoulders like a lion's, and their private parts concealed.

sanskrit_iast:
gajedragatayaścaiva mahāhanava eva ca /
pādayoścakramatsyontu śaṅkhapadmau tuhastayoḥ //
meaning:
गजेद्रगतयश्चैव महाहनव एव च /
पादयोश्चक्रमत्स्योन्तु शङ्खपद्मौ तुहस्तयोः //
text_mt: Their gait is like a lordly elephant's, their jaws are large, / with a discus and fish on their feet, and a conch and lotus on their hands.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśītisahasrāṇi te rājantyajarā nṛpāḥ /
asaṃgagatayasteṣāṃ catasraścakravarttinām //
meaning:
पञ्चाशीतिसहस्राणि ते राजन्त्यजरा नृपाः /
असंगगतयस्तेषां चतस्रश्चक्रवर्त्तिनाम् //
text_mt: Those kings reign for eighty-five thousand [years], free from old age; / these universal emperors have four unhindered paths of movement:

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣe samudri ca pātāle parvateṣu ca /
ijyā dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ tretāyāṃ dharma ucyate //
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षे समुद्रि च पाताले पर्वतेषु च /
इज्या दानं तपः सत्यं त्रेतायां धर्म उच्यते //
text_mt: in the sky, in the ocean, in the netherworld, and on the mountains. / Sacrifice, charity, ascetic heat, and truth are declared to be the duty in the Tretā[yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pravarttate dharmo varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ /
maryādāsthāpanārthaṃ ca daṇḍanītiḥ pravarttate //
meaning:
तदा प्रवर्त्तते धर्मो वर्णाश्रमविभागशः /
मर्यादास्थापनार्थं च दण्डनीतिः प्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Then duty is set in motion according to the division of castes and stages of life, / and royal justice is applied for the establishment of proper boundaries.

sanskrit_iast:
tdṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ prajāḥ sarvā arogāḥ pūrṇamānasāḥ /
eko vedaścatuṣpādastretāyugavidhausmṛtaḥ //
meaning:
त्दृष्टपुष्टाः प्रजाः सर्वा अरोगाः पूर्णमानसाः /
एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस्त्रेतायुगविधौस्मृतः //
text_mt: All the subjects are cheerful and well-nourished, free of disease, their minds content; / the single Veda is remembered as having four quarters in the rule of the Tretāyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tadā jīvanti mānavāḥ /
putrapautrasamākīrṇā mriyante ca krameṇa tu //
meaning:
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि तदा जीवन्ति मानवाः /
पुत्रपौत्रसमाकीर्णा म्रियन्ते च क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: Human beings live for three thousand years at that time; / surrounded by sons and grandsons, they pass away in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa tretāyuge dharmastretāsaṃdhyāṃ nibodhata /
tretāyugasvabhāvānāṃ saṃdhyā pādena varttate /
saṃdhyāpādaḥ svabhāvastu soṃ'śapadena tiṣṭhati //
iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde saṃkhyāvartto nāmaikonatriśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एष त्रेतायुगे धर्मस्त्रेतासंध्यां निबोधत /
त्रेतायुगस्वभावानां संध्या पादेन वर्त्तते /
संध्यापादः स्वभावस्तु सोंऽशपदेन तिष्ठति //
इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे संख्यावर्त्तो नामैकोनत्रिशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This is the duty in the Tretāyuga; understand now the twilight of the Tretā[yuga]: / of the natures of the Tretāyuga, the twilight proceeds by a quarter; / the quarter of twilight is its nature, and it stands as a portion.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, named "The Revolution of Numbers," in the second [section], the Anuṣaṅgapāda, in the first part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃśāpāyaniruvāca
kathaṃ tretāyugamukhe yajñasya syātpravarttanam /
pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve sarge yathāvattacca brūhi me //
meaning:
शांशापायनिरुवाच
कथं त्रेतायुगमुखे यज्ञस्य स्यात्प्रवर्त्तनम् /
पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे सर्गे यथावत्तच्च ब्रूहि मे //
text_mt:
Śāṃśapāyani said:
How did the inauguration of sacrifice take place at the start of the Tretāyuga / formerly in the Svāyambhuva creation? Explain that to me as it truly was.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhitāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ sārddhaṃ kṛtayugena vai /
kālākhyāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ prāpte tretāyuge tadā //
meaning:
अन्तर्हितायां संध्यायां सार्द्धं कृतयुगेन वै /
कालाख्यायां प्रवृत्तायां प्राप्ते त्रेतायुगे तदा //
text_mt: When the twilight [period] had disappeared along with the Kṛtayuga, / and what is called Time had commenced, upon the arrival of the Tretāyuga then,

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhīṣu ca jātāsu pravṛtte vṛṣṭisarjane /
pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārttāyāṃ gṛhāśramapare punaḥ //
meaning:
औषधीषु च जातासु प्रवृत्ते वृष्टिसर्जने /
प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्त्तायां गृहाश्रमपरे पुनः //
text_mt: and when plants had arisen, the discharge of rain had commenced, / and livelihood was established, while [men] were devoted to the householder stage of life,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kṛtavantaśca saṃkhyayā /
saṃbhārāṃstāṃstu maṃbhṛtya kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravarttitaḥ //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थानं कृतवन्तश्च संख्यया /
संभारांस्तांस्तु मंभृत्य कथं यज्ञः प्रवर्त्तितः //
text_mt: and they had made the orderly system of castes and stages of life, / how was the sacrifice instituted, having gathered those materials?

sanskrit_iast:
etacchutvābravītsūtaḥ śrūyatāṃ śāṃśapāyane /
yathā tretāyugamukhe yajñasya syātpravartanam //
meaning:
एतच्छुत्वाब्रवीत्सूतः श्रूयतां शांशपायने /
यथा त्रेतायुगमुखे यज्ञस्य स्यात्प्रवर्तनम् //
text_mt: Hearing this, the bard said: Listen, O Śāṃśapāyana, / to how the institution of sacrifice occurred at the beginning of the Tretāyuga

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve sarge tadvakṣyāmyānupūrvyataḥ /
antarhitāyāṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ sārddhaṃ kṛtayugena tu //
meaning:
पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे सर्गे तद्वक्ष्याम्यानुपूर्व्यतः /
अन्तर्हितायां संध्यायां सार्द्धं कृतयुगेन तु //
text_mt: in the primary creation of Svayambhū formerly; I will tell that in due order. / When the twilight [period] had disappeared along with the Kṛtayuga,

sanskrit_iast:
kālākhyāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ prapte tretāyuge tadā /
auṣadhīṣu ca jātāsu pravṛtte vṛṣṭisarjane //
meaning:
कालाख्यायां प्रवृत्तायां प्रप्ते त्रेतायुगे तदा /
औषधीषु च जातासु प्रवृत्ते वृष्टिसर्जने //
text_mt: and what is called Time had commenced, upon the arrival of the Tretāyuga then, / and when plants had arisen, the discharge of rain had commenced,

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhitāyāṃ vārttāyāṃ gṛhaśramapareṣu ca /
varṇāśramavyavasthānaṃ kṛtvā mantrāṃstu saṃhatān //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठितायां वार्त्तायां गृहश्रमपरेषु च /
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थानं कृत्वा मन्त्रांस्तु संहतान् //
text_mt: and livelihood was established, while [men] were devoted to the householder stage of life, / having established the orderly system of castes and stages of life, assembling the mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāṃstānyojayitvātha ihāmutra ca karmasu /
tadā viśvabhugindraśca yajñaṃ prāvarttayatprabhuḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रांस्तान्योजयित्वाथ इहामुत्र च कर्मसु /
तदा विश्वभुगिन्द्रश्च यज्ञं प्रावर्त्तयत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: and then applying those mantras to rites in this world and the next, / the lord Indra, Viśvabhuj, instituted the sacrifice then.

sanskrit_iast:
daivataiḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaiḥ /
tasyāśvamedhe vitate samājagmurmaharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
दैवतैः सहितैः सर्वैः सर्वसंभारसंभृतैः /
तस्याश्वमेधे वितते समाजग्मुर्महर्षयः //
text_mt: Along with all the gods, having collected all the provisions, / when his horse sacrifice was underway, the great sages assembled.

sanskrit_iast:
yajantaṃ paśubhirme dhyairūcuḥ sarve samāgatāḥ /
karmavyagreṣu ṛtvikṣu saṃtate yajñakarmaṇi //
meaning:
यजन्तं पशुभिर्मे ध्यैरूचुः सर्वे समागताः /
कर्मव्यग्रेषु ऋत्विक्षु संतते यज्ञकर्मणि //
text_mt: To him who was sacrificing with sacrificial animals, all who had assembled spoke, / while the priests were occupied with their duties and the ritual of sacrifice proceeded,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpragītheṣu sarveṣu sāmageṣvatha susvagm /
parikrānteṣu laghuṣu hyadhvaryuvṛṣabheṣu ca //
meaning:
संप्रगीथेषु सर्वेषु सामगेष्वथ सुस्वग्म् /
परिक्रान्तेषु लघुषु ह्यध्वर्युवृषभेषु च //
text_mt: while the Sāman-singers were all chanting melodiously in sweet tones, / and while the foremost Adhvaryus were moving swiftly around,

sanskrit_iast:
ālabdheṣu ca medhyeṣu tathā paśugaṇeṣu ca /
haviṣyagnau hūyamāne brāhmaṇaiścāgnihotribhiḥ //
meaning:
आलब्धेषु च मेध्येषु तथा पशुगणेषु च /
हविष्यग्नौ हूयमाने ब्राह्मणैश्चाग्निहोत्रिभिः //
text_mt: and while the consecrated victims and herds of sacrificial animals were seized, / and the oblation was offered into the fire by the Agnihotrin Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
āhūteṣu ca sarveṣu yajñabhākṣu kramāttadā /
ya indriyātmakā devāstadā te yajñabhāginaḥ //
meaning:
आहूतेषु च सर्वेषु यज्ञभाक्षु क्रमात्तदा /
य इन्द्रियात्मका देवास्तदा ते यज्ञभागिनः //
text_mt: and when all those who partake of the sacrifice were summoned in order then, / the gods whose nature is the sense-faculties were the sharers of the sacrifice then.

sanskrit_iast:
tadyacante tadā devānkalpādiṣu bhavanti ye /
adhvaryavaḥ praiṣakāle vyatthitā vai maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
तद्यचन्ते तदा देवान्कल्पादिषु भवन्ति ये /
अध्वर्यवः प्रैषकाले व्यत्थिता वै महर्षयः //
text_mt: Then they invoked those gods who exist at the beginning of a kalpa; / at the time of the call, the great sages became distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣayastu tāndṛṣṭvā dīnānpaśugaṇāṃstadā /
prapacchuridraṃ saṃbhūya ko 'yaṃ yajña vidhistava //
meaning:
महर्षयस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा दीनान्पशुगणांस्तदा /
प्रपच्छुरिद्रं संभूय को ऽयं यज्ञ विधिस्तव //
text_mt: Seeing those pitiable herds of animals then, the great sages, / gathering together, asked Indra: "What is this sacrificial rule of yours?

sanskrit_iast:
adharmo balavāneṣa hiṃsādharmepsayā tataḥ /
tataḥ paśuvadhaścaiṣa tava yajñe surottama //
meaning:
अधर्मो बलवानेष हिंसाधर्मेप्सया ततः /
ततः पशुवधश्चैष तव यज्ञे सुरोत्तम //
text_mt: This is a great unrighteousness, for violence has arisen from a desire for righteousness; / hence this slaughter of animals is [seen] in your sacrifice, O best of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmo dharmaghātāya prārabdhaḥ paśuhisayā /
nāyaṃ dharmo hyadharmo 'yaṃ na hiṃsā dharma ucyate //
meaning:
अधर्मो धर्मघाताय प्रारब्धः पशुहिसया /
नायं धर्मो ह्यधर्मो ऽयं न हिंसा धर्म उच्यते //
text_mt: Unrighteousness has been undertaken through the slaughter of animals, to the destruction of righteousness; / this is not righteousness, this is unrighteousness; violence is never called righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamena bhavānyajñaṃ karotu yadihecchati /
vidhidṛṣṭena yajñena dharmeṇāvyapasetunā //
meaning:
आगमेन भवान्यज्ञं करोतु यदिहेच्छति /
विधिदृष्टेन यज्ञेन धर्मेणाव्यपसेतुना //
text_mt: Let your honor perform the sacrifice according to the traditional revelation, if you desire [it] here, / with a sacrifice seen in the rules, through righteousness as an unbreached dam,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñabīcaiḥ sureśraṣṭha yeṣu hiṃsā na vidyate /
trivarṣaṃ paramaṃ kālamuṣitairaprarohibhiḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञबीचैः सुरेश्रष्ठ येषु हिंसा न विद्यते /
त्रिवर्षं परमं कालमुषितैरप्ररोहिभिः //
text_mt: with sacrificial grains, O best of gods, in which there is no violence, / having stayed for a maximum time of three years so that they do not sprout.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dharmo mahāprājña virañcivihitaḥ purā /
evaṃ viśvabhugindrastu ṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ //
meaning:
एष धर्मो महाप्राज्ञ विरञ्चिविहितः पुरा /
एवं विश्वभुगिन्द्रस्तु ऋषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः //
text_mt: This is righteousness, O highly wise one, ordained by Brahmā of old." / Thus [was addressed] Indra, Viśvabhuj, by the seers who perceived the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vivādaḥ sumahānindrasyāsīnmaharṣibhiḥ /
jaṅgamasthāvaraiḥ kairhi yaṣṭavyamiti cocyate //
meaning:
तदा विवादः सुमहानिन्द्रस्यासीन्महर्षिभिः /
जङ्गमस्थावरैः कैर्हि यष्टव्यमिति चोच्यते //
text_mt: Then there arose a very great dispute between Indra and the great sages: / "With what should one sacrifice—with mobile or immobile [offerings]?"

sanskrit_iast:
te tu khinnā vivādena tattvamuttvā maharṣayaḥ /
sandhāya vākyamindreṇa papracchuḥ khecaraṃ vasum //
meaning:
ते तु खिन्ना विवादेन तत्त्वमुत्त्वा महर्षयः /
सन्धाय वाक्यमिन्द्रेण पप्रच्छुः खेचरं वसुम् //
text_mt: Exhausted by the dispute, having spoken the truth, the great sages, / making an agreement with Indra, questioned Vasu, who roamed the sky:

sanskrit_iast:
sahāprājña kathaṃ dṛṣṭastvayā yajñavidhirnṛpa /
auttānapāde prabrūhi saṃśayaṃ no nuda prabho //
meaning:
सहाप्राज्ञ कथं दृष्टस्त्वया यज्ञविधिर्नृप /
औत्तानपादे प्रब्रूहि संशयं नो नुद प्रभो //
text_mt: "O highly wise one, how was the sacrificial rule seen by you, O king? / Speak, O son of Uttānapāda; dispel our doubt, O lord!"

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vākyaṃ vasusteṣāma vicārya balābalam /
vedaśāstramanusmṛtya yajñatattvamuvāca ha //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा वाक्यं वसुस्तेषाम विचार्य बलाबलम् /
वेदशास्त्रमनुस्मृत्य यज्ञतत्त्वमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Hearing their words, without weighing the relative strength, / Vasu, recollecting the Vedic scripture, declared the truth of the sacrifice:

sanskrit_iast:
yathopanīrtairyaṣṭavyamiti hovāca pārthivaḥ /
yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirme dhyairatha bījaiḥ phalairapi //
meaning:
यथोपनीर्तैर्यष्टव्यमिति होवाच पार्थिवः /
यष्टव्यं पशुभिर्मे ध्यैरथ बीजैः फलैरपि //
text_mt: "One should sacrifice according to what is brought near," said the king; / "one should sacrifice with sacrificial beasts, or else with grains and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsāsvabhāvo yajñasya iti me darśanāgamau /
yatheha devatā mantrā hiṃsāliṅgā maharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
हिंसास्वभावो यज्ञस्य इति मे दर्शनागमौ /
यथेह देवता मन्त्रा हिंसालिङ्गा महर्षिभिः //
text_mt: The nature of sacrifice is violent; this is my perception and scriptural tradition, / since the deities and the mantras here possess the marks of violence, according to the great sages,

sanskrit_iast:
dīrgheṇa tapasā yuktairdarśanaistārakādibhiḥ /
tatprāmāṇyānmayā coktaṃ tasmātsa prāptumarhatha //
meaning:
दीर्घेण तपसा युक्तैर्दर्शनैस्तारकादिभिः /
तत्प्रामाण्यान्मया चोक्तं तस्मात्स प्राप्तुमर्हथ //
text_mt: who were endowed with long asceticism and perceptions such as [the wisdom of] the stars and so forth; / through their authority, I have spoken, and therefore you ought to accept it.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi pramāṇaṃ tānyeva mantravākyāni vai dvijāḥ /
tathā pravatatāṃ yajño hyanyathā vo 'nṛtaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
यदि प्रमाणं तान्येव मन्त्रवाक्यानि वै द्विजाः /
तथा प्रवततां यज्ञो ह्यन्यथा वो ऽनृतं वचः //
text_mt: If those very statements of the mantras are authoritative, O twice-born, / let the sacrifice proceed accordingly; otherwise your word is false."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtottarāste vai yuktātmānastapodhanāḥ /
avaśyabhāvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamatho vāgyatābhavan //
meaning:
एवं कृतोत्तरास्ते वै युक्तात्मानस्तपोधनाः /
अवश्यभावितं दृष्ट्वा तमथो वाग्यताभवन् //
text_mt: Being thus answered, those self-controlled ascetics, / seeing what was inevitable, then restrained their speech.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktamātre nṛpatiḥ praviveśa rasātalam /
ūrdhvacārī vasurbhūtvā rasātalacaro 'bhavat //
meaning:
इत्युक्तमात्रे नृपतिः प्रविवेश रसातलम् /
ऊर्ध्वचारी वसुर्भूत्वा रसातलचरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: As soon as this was spoken, the king entered the netherworld; / though having moved in the heights, Vasu became a dweller of the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
vasudhā talavāsī tu tena vākyena so 'bhavat /
dharmāṇāṃ saṃśayacchettā rājā vasuradhogataḥ //
meaning:
वसुधा तलवासी तु तेन वाक्येन सो ऽभवत् /
धर्माणां संशयच्छेत्ता राजा वसुरधोगतः //
text_mt: By virtue of that word, he became a resident beneath the surface of the earth; / King Vasu, the resolver of doubts regarding duties, fell downward.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna vācyamekena bahujñenāpi saṃśaye /
bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmā dūratarā gatiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्न वाच्यमेकेन बहुज्ञेनापि संशये /
बहुद्वारस्य धर्मस्य सूक्ष्मा दूरतरा गतिः //
text_mt: Therefore, even by one of much knowledge, [a judgment] must not be spoken alone in case of a doubt; / the course of righteousness, which has many doors, is subtle and very remote.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna niścayādvaktuṃ dharmaḥ śakyastu kenacit /
devānṛṣīnupādāya svāyaṃbhuvamṛte manum //
meaning:
तस्मान्न निश्चयाद्वक्तुं धर्मः शक्यस्तु केनचित् /
देवानृषीनुपादाय स्वायंभुवमृते मनुम् //
text_mt: Therefore, no one is able to pronounce righteousness with absolute certainty, / taking into account gods and sages, except for Manu Svāyambhuva.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādahiṃsā dharmasya dvāramuktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ /
ṛṣikoṭisahasrāṇi svatapobhirdivaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादहिंसा धर्मस्य द्वारमुक्तं महर्षिभिः /
ऋषिकोटिसहस्राणि स्वतपोभिर्दिवं ययुः //
text_mt: Therefore non-violence is declared by the great sages to be the gate of righteousness; / thousands of tens of millions of sages have gone to heaven by their own asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna dānaṃ yajñaṃ vā praśaṃsaṃti maharṣayaḥ /
uñchamūlaphalaṃ śākamudapātraṃ tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्न दानं यज्ञं वा प्रशंसंति महर्षयः /
उञ्छमूलफलं शाकमुदपात्रं तपोधनाः //
text_mt: Therefore the great sages do not praise giving or sacrifice; / ascetics [content with] gleanings, roots, fruits, herbs, and a pot of water,

sanskrit_iast:
etaddatvā vibhavataḥ svarge loke pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
adrohaścāpya lobhaśca tapo bhutadayā damaḥ //
meaning:
एतद्दत्वा विभवतः स्वर्गे लोके प्रतिष्ठिताः /
अद्रोहश्चाप्य लोभश्च तपो भुतदया दमः //
text_mt: having given this according to their ability, are established in the heavenly world. / Absence of malice, absence of greed, asceticism, compassion for beings, self-restraint,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmacaryaṃ tathā satyamanukrośaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ /
sanātanasya dharmasya mūlametaddurāsadam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मचर्यं तथा सत्यमनुक्रोशः क्षमा धृतिः /
सनातनस्य धर्मस्य मूलमेतद्दुरासदम् //
text_mt: chastity, truth, sympathy, patience, and steadfastness— / this is the unassailable root of the eternal righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyante hi tapaḥsiddhā brahmakṣatrādayo 'naghāḥ /
priyavratottānapādau dhruvo medhātithirvasuḥ //
meaning:
श्रूयन्ते हि तपःसिद्धा ब्रह्मक्षत्रादयो ऽनघाः /
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ ध्रुवो मेधातिथिर्वसुः //
text_mt: For sinless Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and others are heard of as perfected through asceticism: / Priyavrata, Uttānapāda, Dhruva, Medhātithi, Vasu,

sanskrit_iast:
sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhaḥ pāṇḍyaja eva ca /
prājīnabarhiḥ parjanyo havirdhānādayo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खः पाण्ड्यज एव च /
प्राजीनबर्हिः पर्जन्यो हविर्धानादयो नृपः //
text_mt: Sudhāman, Virajas, Śaṅkha, the son of Pāṇḍya, / Prācīnabarhis, Parjanya, and kings such as Havirdhāna.

sanskrit_iast:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ svaistapobhirdivaṃ gatāḥ /
rājarṣayo mahāsattvā yeṣāṃ kīrttiḥ pratiṣṭhitā //
meaning:
एते चान्ये च बहवः स्वैस्तपोभिर्दिवं गताः /
राजर्षयो महासत्त्वा येषां कीर्त्तिः प्रतिष्ठिता //
text_mt: These and many other royal sages of noble nature / have gone to heaven through their own austerities, and their fame is established.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviśiṣyate yajñāttapaḥ sarvaistu kāraṇaḥ /
brahmaṇā tapasā sṛṣṭaṃ jagadviśvamidaṃ purā //
meaning:
तस्माद्विशिष्यते यज्ञात्तपः सर्वैस्तु कारणः /
ब्रह्मणा तपसा सृष्टं जगद्विश्वमिदं पुरा //
text_mt: Therefore asceticism is superior to sacrifice by all reasons; / by asceticism this whole world was created by Brahmā of old.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnānveti tadyajñastapomūlamidaṃ smṛtam /
dravyamantrātmako yajñastapastvanaśanātmakam //
meaning:
तस्मान्नान्वेति तद्यज्ञस्तपोमूलमिदं स्मृतम् /
द्रव्यमन्त्रात्मको यज्ञस्तपस्त्वनशनात्मकम् //
text_mt: Therefore sacrifice does not equal that; this [universe] is remembered as rooted in asceticism; / sacrifice consists of materials and mantras, whereas asceticism consists of fasting.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñena devānāpnoti vairājaṃ tapasā punaḥ /
brāhmaṃ tu karma saṃnyāsādvairāgyātprakṛterjayam //
meaning:
यज्ञेन देवानाप्नोति वैराजं तपसा पुनः /
ब्राह्मं तु कर्म संन्यासाद्वैराग्यात्प्रकृतेर्जयम् //
text_mt: Through sacrifice one attains the gods, but through asceticism the Vairāja state; / through renunciation of action, the realm of Brahmā; through dispassion, mastery over material nature;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānātprāpnoti kaivalyaṃ pañcaitāgatayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
evaṃ vivādaḥ sumahānya jñasyāsītpravarttane //
meaning:
ज्ञानात्प्राप्नोति कैवल्यं पञ्चैतागतयः स्मृताः /
एवं विवादः सुमहान्य ज्ञस्यासीत्प्रवर्त्तने //
text_mt: through knowledge one attains isolation: these are remembered as the five destinations. / Thus there was a great dispute at the inauguration of the sacrifice

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca pūrva svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare /
tatastamṛṣayo dṛṣṭvā hataṃ dharmabalena tu //
meaning:
देवतानामृषीणां च पूर्व स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे /
ततस्तमृषयो दृष्ट्वा हतं धर्मबलेन तु //
text_mt: between the deities and the sages in the earlier Svāyambhuva manvantara. / Then the sages, seeing him struck down by the power of righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
vasorvākyamanā dṛtya jagamuḥ sarve yathāgatam /
gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu devā yajñaṃ samāpnuvan //
meaning:
वसोर्वाक्यमना दृत्य जगमुः सर्वे यथागतम् /
गतेषु मुनिसंघेषु देवा यज्ञं समाप्नुवन् //
text_mt: disregarding Vasu's word, all went away as they had come. / When the hosts of sages had departed, the gods completed the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñapravarttanaṃ hyevamāsītsvāyaṃbhuve 'ntare /
tataḥ prabhṛti yajño 'yaṃ yugaiḥ saha vivarttitaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde yajñapravarttanaṃ nāma triśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यज्ञप्रवर्त्तनं ह्येवमासीत्स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे /
ततः प्रभृति यज्ञो ऽयं युगैः सह विवर्त्तितः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे यज्ञप्रवर्त्तनं नाम त्रिशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus indeed was the institution of the sacrifice in the Svāyambhuva manvantara; / from that time forward, this sacrifice has evolved along with the yugas.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named “The Instituting of Sacrifice”, in the second Anuṣaṅgapāda of the first part in the glorious Mahāpurāṇa composed by Brahmāṇḍa and proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ata ūrddhaṃ pravakṣyāmi dvāparasya vidhiṃ punaḥ /
tatra tretāyuge kṣīṇe dvāparaṃ pratipadyate //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अत ऊर्द्धं प्रवक्ष्यामि द्वापरस्य विधिं पुनः /
तत्र त्रेतायुगे क्षीणे द्वापरं प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: The bard said: / “Henceforth I shall describe again the ordinance of the Dvāparayuga. / When the Tretāyuga has waned, the Dvāpara sets in.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāparādau prajānāṃ tu siddhistretāyuge tu yā /
parivṛtte yuge tasmiṃstatastābhiḥ praṇaśyati //
meaning:
द्वापरादौ प्रजानां तु सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे तु या /
परिवृत्ते युगे तस्मिंस्ततस्ताभिः प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: The perfection that belonged to creatures in the Tretāyuga / perishes for them at the start of the Dvāpara, once that age has turned.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravarttate tāsāṃ prajānāṃ dvāpare punaḥ /
saṃbhedaścaiva varṇānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ ca viparyayaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रवर्त्तते तासां प्रजानां द्वापरे पुनः /
संभेदश्चैव वर्णानां कार्याणां च विपर्ययः //
text_mt: Then, among those creatures in the Dvāpara, there arises once again / confusion of the castes and inversion of duties.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñāvadhāraṇaṃ daṇḍo mado daṃbhaḥ kṣamā balam /
eṣā rajastamoyuktā pravṛttirdvāpare smṛtā //
meaning:
यज्ञावधारणं दण्डो मदो दंभः क्षमा बलम् /
एषा रजस्तमोयुक्ता प्रवृत्तिर्द्वापरे स्मृता //
text_mt: Resolution to sacrifice, punishment, arrogance, hypocrisy, forgiveness, power: / this conduct, conjoined with rajas and tamas, is traditionally remembered in the Dvāpara.

sanskrit_iast:
ādye kṛte yo dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravarttate /
dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge //
meaning:
आद्ये कृते यो धर्मो ऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्त्तते /
द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे //
text_mt: The dharma that exists in the first, Kṛtayuga, continues in the Tretā; / becoming disordered in the Dvāpara, it perishes in the Kaliyuga.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇānāṃ viparidhvaṃsaḥ saṃkīyata tathāśramāḥ /
dvaividhyaṃ pratipadyeteyuge tasmiñchruti smṛtī //
meaning:
वर्णानां विपरिध्वंसः संकीयत तथाश्रमाः /
द्वैविध्यं प्रतिपद्येतेयुगे तस्मिञ्छ्रुति स्मृती //
text_mt: Castes are ruined, and likewise the stages of life become intermixed; / in that age, revelation and tradition arrive at a duality.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaidhāttathā śrutismṛtyorniścayo nādhigamyate /
aniścayādhigamanāddharmatattvaṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
द्वैधात्तथा श्रुतिस्मृत्योर्निश्चयो नाधिगम्यते /
अनिश्चयाधिगमनाद्धर्मतत्त्वं न विद्यते //
text_mt: Because of the duality between revelation and tradition, no certainty is reached; / from failure to reach certainty, the truth of dharma is not known.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmāsattvena mitrāṇāṃ matibhedo bhavennṛṇām /
parasparavibhinnaistaidṛṣṭīnāṃ vibhrameṇa ca //
meaning:
धर्मासत्त्वेन मित्राणां मतिभेदो भवेन्नृणाम् /
परस्परविभिन्नैस्तैदृष्टीनां विभ्रमेण च //
text_mt: Due to the absence of dharma, disagreement arises even among friends, / through views that are mutually divided and erroneous.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ dharmo hyayaṃ neti niścayo nādhigamyate /
kāraṇānāṃ ca vaikalpyātkāryāṇāṃ cāpyaniścayāt //
meaning:
अयं धर्मो ह्ययं नेति निश्चयो नाधिगम्यते /
कारणानां च वैकल्प्यात्कार्याणां चाप्यनिश्चयात् //
text_mt: ‘This is dharma; this is not’—no certain conviction is reached, / both from the deficiency of reasons and from the uncertainty of duties.

sanskrit_iast:
matibhedena teṣāṃ vai dṛṣṭīnāṃ vibhramo bhavet /
tato dṛṣṭivibhannaistu kṛtaṃ śāstrākulaṃ tvidam //
meaning:
मतिभेदेन तेषां वै दृष्टीनां विभ्रमो भवेत् /
ततो दृष्टिविभन्नैस्तु कृतं शास्त्राकुलं त्विदम् //
text_mt: Through their diversity of thought, confusion of views arises; / then, by those of divided views, this collection of scriptures is thrown into disorder.

sanskrit_iast:
eko vedaścatuṣpāddhi tretāsviha vidhīyate /
saṃkṣayādāyupaścaiva vyasyate dvāpareṣu ca //
meaning:
एको वेदश्चतुष्पाद्धि त्रेतास्विह विधीयते /
संक्षयादायुपश्चैव व्यस्यते द्वापरेषु च //
text_mt: For in the Tretā ages, one single Veda of four quarters is prescribed; / and through the decline of life span, it is divided in the Dvāpara ages.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣimantrātpunarbhedādbhidyate dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ /
mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिमन्त्रात्पुनर्भेदाद्भिद्यते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः /
मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः //
text_mt: Through the divisions of seers’ mantras and the confusion of views, it is divided, / by arrangements of mantras and brāhmaṇas, and inversions of accents and syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ saṃpaṭhyante maharṣibhiḥ /
sāmānyā vaikṛtāścaiva dṛṣṭibhinne kvacitkvacit //
meaning:
संहिता ऋग्यजुःसाम्नां संपठ्यन्ते महर्षिभिः /
सामान्या वैकृताश्चैव दृष्टिभिन्ने क्वचित्क्वचित् //
text_mt: The collections of Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman are recited by great seers / in their common forms as well as altered ones, here and there divided by different views.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca /
anye 'pi prasthitāstānvai kecittānpratyavasthitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणं कल्पसूत्राणि मन्त्रप्रवचनानि च /
अन्ये ऽपि प्रस्थितास्तान्वै केचित्तान्प्रत्यवस्थिताः //
text_mt: Some set forth the brāhmaṇa portions, the ritual sutras, and the expositions of mantras; / others indeed have opposed them.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāpareṣu pravarttante nivarttante kalau yuge /
ekamādhvaryavaṃ tvāsītpunardvaidhamajāyata //
meaning:
द्वापरेषु प्रवर्त्तन्ते निवर्त्तन्ते कलौ युगे /
एकमाध्वर्यवं त्वासीत्पुनर्द्वैधमजायत //
text_mt: These arise in the Dvāpara ages and cease in the Kaliyuga. / The duties of the adhvaryu were once one, but then became twofold.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyaviparītārthaiḥ kṛtaśāstrākulaṃ tvidam /
ādhvaryavasya prasthānairbahudhā vyākulīkṛtaiḥ //
meaning:
सामान्यविपरीतार्थैः कृतशास्त्राकुलं त्विदम् /
आध्वर्यवस्य प्रस्थानैर्बहुधा व्याकुलीकृतैः //
