text_mt: From Dhruva, the earth gave birth to two kings, Sṛṣṭi and Bhavya. / Sṛṣṭi, the powerful lord, said to his shadow: 'Become a woman!'

sanskrit_iast:
satyābhivyahṛtestasya sadyaḥ strī sābhavattadā /
divyasaṃhananā chāyā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā //
meaning:
सत्याभिव्यहृतेस्तस्य सद्यः स्त्री साभवत्तदा /
दिव्यसंहनना छाया दिव्याभरणभूषिता //
text_mt: Because his utterance was true, she immediately became a woman at that time— / Chāyā, of celestial form, adorned with celestial ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāyāṃ sṛṣṭirādhatta pañca putrānakalmaṣān /
prājīnagarbhaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vṛkañca vṛkalaṃ dhṛtim //
meaning:
छायायां सृष्टिराधत्त पञ्च पुत्रानकल्मषान् /
प्राजीनगर्भं वृषभं वृकञ्च वृकलं धृतिम् //
text_mt: In Chāyā, Sṛṣṭi begot five sinless sons: / Prācīnagarbha, Vṛṣabha, Vṛka, Vṛkala, and Dhṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
patnī prācīnagarbhasya suvarcā suṣuve nupam /
nāmnodāradhiyaṃ putramindro yaḥ pūrvajanmani //
meaning:
पत्नी प्राचीनगर्भस्य सुवर्चा सुषुवे नुपम् /
नाम्नोदारधियं पुत्रमिन्द्रो यः पूर्वजन्मनि //
text_mt: Suvarcas, the wife of Prācīnagarbha, gave birth to a king, / a son named Udāradhī, who in a previous birth was Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarasahasrānte sakṛdāhāramāharan /
evaṃ manvantaraṃ yukta indratvaṃ prāptavānprabhuḥ //
meaning:
संवत्सरसहस्रान्ते सकृदाहारमाहरन् /
एवं मन्वन्तरं युक्त इन्द्रत्वं प्राप्तवान्प्रभुः //
text_mt: Taking food only once at the end of a thousand years, / thus disciplined throughout a manvantara, that powerful one attained the status of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
udāradheḥ sutaṃ bhadrājanayatsā divañjayam /
ripuṃ ripuñjayājjajñe varāṅgī tu divañjayāt //
meaning:
उदारधेः सुतं भद्राजनयत्सा दिवञ्जयम् /
रिपुं रिपुञ्जयाज्जज्ञे वराङ्गी तु दिवञ्जयात् //
text_mt: Bhadrā gave birth to Udāradhī's son, Divañjaya; / and from Divañjaya, Varāṅgī gave birth to Ripu through Ripuñjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
riporādhatta bṛhatī vakṣuṣaṃ sarvatejasam /
tasya putro manurvidvān brahmakṣattrapravattakaḥ /
vyajījanatpuṣkariṇī vāruṇī cākṣuṣaṃ manum //
meaning:
रिपोराधत्त बृहती वक्षुषं सर्वतेजसम् /
तस्य पुत्रो मनुर्विद्वान् ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रप्रवत्तकः /
व्यजीजनत्पुष्करिणी वारुणी चाक्षुषं मनुम् //
text_mt: In Bṛhatī, Ripu begot Cākṣuṣa, endowed with all splendor. / His son was the wise Manu, the initiator of the Brahmins and Kṣatriyas; / Puṣkariṇī, born of Varuṇa, gave birth to the Manu Cākṣuṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
prajāpateḥ sutā kasmādvāruṇī procyate 'nagha /
etadācakṣva tatvena kuśalo hyasi vistare //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
प्रजापतेः सुता कस्माद्वारुणी प्रोच्यते ऽनघ /
एतदाचक्ष्व तत्वेन कुशलो ह्यसि विस्तरे //
text_mt: The sages said: / Why is the daughter of Prajāpati called Vāruṇī, O sinless one? / Tell us this according to the truth, for you are skilled in detailed exposition.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
araṇyasyodakaḥ putro varuṇatvamupāgataḥ /
tena sā vāruṇī jñeyā bhrātrā khyātimupāgatā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अरण्यस्योदकः पुत्रो वरुणत्वमुपागतः /
तेन सा वारुणी ज्ञेया भ्रात्रा ख्यातिमुपागता //
text_mt: The bard said: / Araṇya's son Udaka attained the status of Varuṇa; / therefore she is to be known as Vāruṇī, having attained renown through her brother.

sanskrit_iast:
manorajāyanta daśa naḍvalāyāṃ sutāḥ śubhāḥ /
kanyāyāṃ sumahāvīryā virajasya prajāpateḥ //
meaning:
मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां सुताः शुभाः /
कन्यायां सुमहावीर्या विरजस्य प्रजापतेः //
text_mt: Ten auspicious and exceedingly powerful sons were born to Manu / in Naḍvalā, the daughter of the Prajāpati Virajas:

sanskrit_iast:
ūruḥ puruḥ śatadyumnastapasvī satyavākkṛtiḥ /
agniṣṭudatirātraśca sudyumnaśceti vai nava //
meaning:
ऊरुः पुरुः शतद्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवाक्कृतिः /
अग्निष्टुदतिरात्रश्च सुद्युम्नश्चेति वै नव //
text_mt: Ūru, Pūru, Śatadyumna, Tapasvin, Satyavāc, Kṛti, / Agniṣṭut, Atirātra, and Sudyumna—these nine,

sanskrit_iast:
abhimanyuśca daśamo naḍvalāyāṃ manoḥ sutāḥ /
ūrorajanayatputrānṣaḍāgneyī mahāprabhān //
meaning:
अभिमन्युश्च दशमो नड्वलायां मनोः सुताः /
ऊरोरजनयत्पुत्रान्षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान् //
text_mt: and Abhimanyu the tenth, sons of Manu born of Naḍvalā. / Āgneyī bore to Ūru six sons of great splendor:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgaṃ sumanasaṃ khyātiṅgayaṃ śukraṃ vrajājinau /
aṅgātsunīthāpatyaṃvai venamekaṃ vyajāyata //
meaning:
अङ्गं सुमनसं ख्यातिङ्गयं शुक्रं व्रजाजिनौ /
अङ्गात्सुनीथापत्यंवै वेनमेकं व्यजायत //
text_mt: Aṅga, Sumanas, Khyāti, Gaya, Śukra, and Vrajājin. / From Aṅga, Sunīthā bore an only offspring, Vena.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāparādhādvenasya prakopastu mahānabhūt /
prajārthamṛṣayo yasyamamanthurdakṣiṇāṃ karam //
meaning:
तस्यापराधाद्वेनस्य प्रकोपस्तु महानभूत् /
प्रजार्थमृषयो यस्यममन्थुर्दक्षिणां करम् //
text_mt: Because of the transgression of that Vena, there arose great fury; / for the sake of offspring, the sages churned his right arm.

sanskrit_iast:
janitastasya pāṇau tu mathite rūpavānpṛthuḥ /
janayitvā sutaṃ tasya pṛthuṃ prathitapauruṣam //
meaning:
जनितस्तस्य पाणौ तु मथिते रूपवान्पृथुः /
जनयित्वा सुतं तस्य पृथुं प्रथितपौरुषम् //
text_mt: When his hand was churned, the handsome Pṛthu was produced. / Having brought forth his son Pṛthu of celebrated prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
abru vaṃstveṣa vo rājā ṛṣayo muditāḥ prajāḥ /
sa dhanvī kavacī jajñe tejasā nirdahanniva //
meaning:
अब्रु वंस्त्वेष वो राजा ऋषयो मुदिताः प्रजाः /
स धन्वी कवची जज्ञे तेजसा निर्दहन्निव //
text_mt: The sages said to the joyful subjects, “This is your king!” / He was born armed with a bow and clad in armor, as if burning with splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttīnāmeṣa vo dātā bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ /
pṛthurvainyastadā lokānrarakṣa kṣatrapūrvajaḥ //
meaning:
वृत्तीनामेष वो दाता भविष्यति नराधिपः /
पृथुर्वैन्यस्तदा लोकान्ररक्ष क्षत्रपूर्वजः //
text_mt: “This king will be the giver of your livelihoods.” / Then Pṛthu, son of Vena, the first of the kṣatriyas, protected the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
rājasūyābhiṣiktānāmādyassa vasudhādhipaḥ /
tasya stavārthamutpannau nipuṇau sūtamāgadhau //
meaning:
राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यस्स वसुधाधिपः /
तस्य स्तवार्थमुत्पन्नौ निपुणौ सूतमागधौ //
text_mt: He was the first of the rulers of the earth to be consecrated by the Rājasūya. / For the purpose of praising him, the skilled sūta and māgadha were brought forth.

sanskrit_iast:
teneyaṃ gaurmahārājñā dugdhā sasyāni dhīmatā /
prajānāṃ vṛttikāmānāṃ devaiścarṣigaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
तेनेयं गौर्महाराज्ञा दुग्धा सस्यानि धीमता /
प्रजानां वृत्तिकामानां देवैश्चर्षिगणैः सह //
text_mt: By that wise great king, this earth was milked for crops / together with the gods and hosts of sages, for the sake of the subjects desiring livelihood,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhir dānavaiścaiva gandharvaiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ /
sarpaiḥ puṇyajanaiścaiva parvatairvṛkṣavīrudhaiḥ //
meaning:
पितृभिर् दानवैश्चैव गन्धर्वैश्चाप्सरोगणैः /
सर्पैः पुण्यजनैश्चैव पर्वतैर्वृक्षवीरुधैः //
text_mt: along with the ancestors, the Dānavas, the Gandharvas, hosts of Apsarases, / the serpents, the PuṇyScrolling people, the mountains, trees, and climbing plants.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu teṣu tu pātreṣu duhyamānā vasuṃdharā /
prādādyathepsi taṃ kṣīraṃ tena prāṇānadhārayan //
meaning:
तेषु तेषु तु पात्रेषु दुह्यमाना वसुंधरा /
प्रादाद्यथेप्सि तं क्षीरं तेन प्राणानधारयन् //
text_mt: Being milked into those various vessels, the earth / yielded the desired milk, and by that they sustained their life-breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃśapāyana uvāca
vistareṇa pṛthorjanma kīrttayasva mahāvrata /
yathā mahātmanā tena pūrvaṃ dugdhā vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
शांशपायन उवाच
विस्तरेण पृथोर्जन्म कीर्त्तयस्व महाव्रत /
यथा महात्मना तेन पूर्वं दुग्धा वसुंधरा //
text_mt: Śāṃśapāyana said: / Tell in detail of the birth of Pṛthu, O you of great vows, / and how the earth was milked of old by that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā devaiśca nāgaiśca yathā brahmarṣibhiḥ saha /
yakṣai rākṣasagandharvairapsarobhiryathā purā //
meaning:
यथा देवैश्च नागैश्च यथा ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह /
यक्षै राक्षसगन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिर्यथा पुरा //
text_mt: and how [it was milked] together with the gods, the serpents, the brahmarṣis, / the Yakṣas, the Rākṣasas, the Gandharvas, and the Apsarases of old,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā ca vai sūta vidhinā yena yena ca /
teṣāṃ pātraviśeṣāṃśca dogdhāraṃ kṣīrameva ca //
meaning:
यथा यथा च वै सूत विधिना येन येन च /
तेषां पात्रविशेषांश्च दोग्धारं क्षीरमेव च //
text_mt: and how, O sūta, by what rule, / and the particular vessels of theirs, the milkman, and the milk,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vatsaviśeṣāṃśca tvaṃnaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām /
yathā kṣīraviśeṣāṃśca sarvānevānupūrvaśaḥ //
meaning:
तथा वत्सविशेषांश्च त्वंनः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम् /
यथा क्षीरविशेषांश्च सर्वानेवानुपूर्वशः //
text_mt: and likewise tell us who ask of the specific calves, / and the different kinds of milk, all in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃśca kāraṇe pāṇirvanasya mathitaḥ purā /
kuddhairmaharṣibhiḥ pūrvaiḥ kāraṇaṃ brūhi taddhi naḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिंश्च कारणे पाणिर्वनस्य मथितः पुरा /
कुद्धैर्महर्षिभिः पूर्वैः कारणं ब्रूहि तद्धि नः //
text_mt: and for what reason the hand of Vena was churned of old / by the enraged ancient great sages—do tell us that reason!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kathayiṣyāmi vo viprāḥ pṛthorvainyasya saṃbhavam /
ekāgrāḥ prayatāścaiva śuśrūṣadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
कथयिष्यामि वो विप्राः पृथोर्वैन्यस्य संभवम् /
एकाग्राः प्रयताश्चैव शुश्रूषध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The sūta said: / I will recount to you, O brāhmaṇas, the origin of Pṛthu, son of Vena. / One-pointed and concentrated, listen, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
nāśuddhāya na pāpāya nāśiṣyāyāhitāya ca /
varttanīyamidaṃ brahma nāvratāya kathañcana //
meaning:
नाशुद्धाय न पापाय नाशिष्यायाहिताय च /
वर्त्तनीयमिदं ब्रह्म नाव्रताय कथञ्चन //
text_mt: This sacred knowledge should not be imparted to the impure, nor to the wicked, / nor to a non-disciple, nor to the hostile, nor ever to one without vows.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiśca saṃmitam /
rahasyamṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ śṛṇuyādyo 'nasūyakaḥ //
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं वेदैश्च संमितम् /
रहस्यमृषिभिः प्रोक्तं शृणुयाद्यो ऽनसूयकः //
text_mt: Auspicous, glorious, granting long life, holy, and equal to the Vedas / is this secret proclaimed by the sages, which one should hear without malice.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaivaṃ śrāvayenmartyaḥ pṛthorvainyasya saṃbhavam /
brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtya na sa śocetkṛtākṛtam //
meaning:
यश्चैवं श्रावयेन्मर्त्यः पृथोर्वैन्यस्य संभवम् /
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य न स शोचेत्कृताकृतम् //
text_mt: And the mortal who relates in this way the origin of Pṛthu, son of Vena, / having paid homage to the brāhmaṇas, does not grieve over deeds done or left undone.

sanskrit_iast:
goptā dharmasya rājāsau babhūvātrisamaḥ prabhuḥ /
atrivaṃśasamutpanno hyaṅgo nāma prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
गोप्ता धर्मस्य राजासौ बभूवात्रिसमः प्रभुः /
अत्रिवंशसमुत्पन्नो ह्यङ्गो नाम प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: A protector of dharma, this king, a lord equal to Atri, / was the Prajāpati named Aṅga, born in the lineage of Atri.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putro 'bhavadveno nātyarthaṃ dhārmikastathā /
jāto mṛtyusutāyāṃ vai sunīthāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद्वेनो नात्यर्थं धार्मिकस्तथा /
जातो मृत्युसुतायां वै सुनीथायां प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: His son was Vena, who was not very righteous. / The Prajāpati was born of Sunīthā, the daughter of Mṛtyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa venaḥ kālātma jātmajaḥ /
sa dharmaṃ vṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā kāmāllokeṣvartata //
meaning:
स मातामहदोषेण वेनः कालात्म जात्मजः /
स धर्मं वृष्ठतः कृत्वा कामाल्लोकेष्वर्तत //
text_mt: Vena, the son of the daughter of Kāla, through the fault of his maternal grandfather, / cast dharma behind his back and acted in the worlds out of desire.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpanāṃ sthāpayāmāsa dharmāyetāṃ sa pārthivaḥ /
vedaśāstrāṇyatikramya so 'dharme nirato 'bhavat //
meaning:
स्थापनां स्थापयामास धर्मायेतां स पार्थिवः /
वेदशास्त्राण्यतिक्रम्य सो ऽधर्मे निरतो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: That king established an ordinance against dharma: / transgressing the Vedas and sacred treatises, he became devoted to unrighteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣṭkāre tasminrājyaṃ praśāsati /
na pibanti tadā somaṃ mahāyajñeṣu devatāḥ //
meaning:
निःस्वाध्यायवष्ट्कारे तस्मिन्राज्यं प्रशासति /
न पिबन्ति तदा सोमं महायज्ञेषु देवताः //
text_mt: While he was ruling the kingdom, devoid of Veda-study and the vaṣaṭ-call, / the deities did not drink soma in great sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
na yaṣṭavyaṃ na dātavyamiti tasya prajāpateḥ /
āsītpratijñā krūreyaṃ vināśe pratyupasthite //
meaning:
न यष्टव्यं न दातव्यमिति तस्य प्रजापतेः /
आसीत्प्रतिज्ञा क्रूरेयं विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते //
text_mt: “No sacrifice is to be offered, no gift is to be given”—such was this cruel / pledge of that Prajāpati when his destruction was imminent:

sanskrit_iast:
ahamījyaśca pūjyaśca yajñe devadvijātibhiḥ /
mayi yajñā vidhātavyā mayi hotavyamityapi //
meaning:
अहमीज्यश्च पूज्यश्च यज्ञे देवद्विजातिभिः /
मयि यज्ञा विधातव्या मयि होतव्यमित्यपि //
text_mt: “I am to be sacrificed to, and I am to be worshipped in sacrifice by the gods and the twice-born! / Sacrifices are to be performed unto me; offerings are to be poured unto me!”

sanskrit_iast:
tamatikrāntamaryādamavadānasusaṃvṛtam /
ūcurmaharṣayaḥ sarve marīcipramukhāstadā //
meaning:
तमतिक्रान्तमर्यादमवदानसुसंवृतम् /
ऊचुर्महर्षयः सर्वे मरीचिप्रमुखास्तदा //
text_mt: To him who had transgressed bounds and was entirely covered by arrogance, / all the great sages headed by Marīci then spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ dīkṣāṃ pravekṣyāmaḥ saṃvatsaraśataṃ nṛpa /
tvaṃ mā kārṣīradharmaṃ vai naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
वयं दीक्षां प्रवेक्ष्यामः संवत्सरशतं नृप /
त्वं मा कार्षीरधर्मं वै नैष धर्मः सनातनः //
text_mt: “We are about to enter upon an initiation for a hundred years, O king. / Do not practice unrighteousness; this is not the eternal dharma!

sanskrit_iast:
nidhane saṃprasūtastvaṃ prajāpatirasaṃśayaḥ /
pālayiṣye prajāśceti pūrvaṃ te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
निधने संप्रसूतस्त्वं प्रजापतिरसंशयः /
पालयिष्ये प्रजाश्चेति पूर्वं ते समयः कृतः //
text_mt: You were born in the lineage [of kings], a Prajāpati beyond doubt, / and your earlier agreement was made: ‘I will protect the subjects!’”

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ stathā vādinaḥ sarvānbrahmarṣīnabravīttadā /
venaḥ prahasya durbuddhirviditena ca kovidaḥ //
meaning:
तां स्तथा वादिनः सर्वान्ब्रह्मर्षीनब्रवीत्तदा /
वेनः प्रहस्य दुर्बुद्धिर्विदितेन च कोविदः //
text_mt: Then Vena, wicked-minded and arrogant with knowledge, / laughed and spoke to all those brahmarṣis who were speaking thus:

sanskrit_iast:
sraṣṭā dharmasya kaścānyaḥ śrotavyaṃ kasya vā mayā /
vīryaṇa tapasā satyairmayā vā kaḥ samo bhuvi //
meaning:
स्रष्टा धर्मस्य कश्चान्यः श्रोतव्यं कस्य वा मया /
वीर्यण तपसा सत्यैर्मया वा कः समो भुवि //
text_mt: “Who else is the creator of dharma, or whom am I to listen to? / Who on earth is equal to me in valor, ascetic power, and truth?

sanskrit_iast:
mandātmāno na nūnaṃ māṃ yūyaṃ jānīta tattvataḥ /
prabhavaṃ sarvalokānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
मन्दात्मानो न नूनं मां यूयं जानीत तत्त्वतः /
प्रभवं सर्वलोकानां धर्माणां च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Slow-witted ones, surely you do not know me in truth, / the origin of all worlds, and of dharmas especially!

sanskrit_iast:
icchandaheyaṃ pṛthivīṃ plāvayeyaṃ jalena vā /
sṛjeyaṃ vā graseyaṃ vā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
इच्छन्दहेयं पृथिवीं प्लावयेयं जलेन वा /
सृजेयं वा ग्रसेयं वा नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: If I wish, I could burn the earth, or flood it with water, / or create or devour [it]—there should be no doubt about this!”

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na śakyate staṃbhādānāryyabhṛśasaṃhitaḥ /
anunetuṃ tadā venastataḥ kruddhā maharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
यदा न शक्यते स्तंभादानार्य्यभृशसंहितः /
अनुनेतुं तदा वेनस्ततः क्रुद्धा महर्षयः //
text_mt: When, out of obstinacy, Vena, completely attached to ignobility, / could not be conciliated, the great sages were enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
nigṛhya taṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ visphurantaṃ mahā balam /
tato 'sya vāmahastaṃ te mamanthurbhṛśakopitāḥ //
meaning:
निगृह्य तं च बाहुभ्यां विस्फुरन्तं महा बलम् /
ततो ऽस्य वामहस्तं ते ममन्थुर्भृशकोपिताः //
text_mt: Restraining by their arms that very powerful one as he quivered, / they, exceedingly furious, then churned his left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpramathyamānādvai jajña pūrvamiti śrutiḥ /
hrasvo 'timātraṃ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇaścāpi babhūva ha //
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रमथ्यमानाद्वै जज्ञ पूर्वमिति श्रुतिः /
ह्रस्वो ऽतिमात्रं पुरुषः कृष्णश्चापि बभूव ह //
text_mt: From that [hand] being churned, as tradition relates, there first arose / an exceedingly short man, and he was also black.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhītaḥ prāñjaliścaiva tasthivānākulendriyaḥ /
tamārttaṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā niṣīdetyabruvankila //
meaning:
स भीतः प्राञ्जलिश्चैव तस्थिवानाकुलेन्द्रियः /
तमार्त्तं विह्वलं दृष्ट्वा निषीदेत्यब्रुवन्किल //
text_mt: Terrified, with folded hands, his senses agitated, he stood; / seeing him afflicted and trembling, they said: “Sit down (niṣīda)!”

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādavaṃśakartāsau babhūvānantavikramaḥ /
dhīvarānasṛjaccāpi venakalmaṣasaṃbhavān //
meaning:
निषादवंशकर्तासौ बभूवानन्तविक्रमः /
धीवरानसृजच्चापि वेनकल्मषसंभवान् //
text_mt: He became the founder of the Niṣāda race, of endless valor; / and he produced the fishermen, born from the sin of Vena.

sanskrit_iast:
ye cānye vindhyanilayāstaṃburāstuburāḥ khaśāḥ /
adharmarucayaścāpi viddhi tānvenakalmaṣān //
meaning:
ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलयास्तंबुरास्तुबुराः खशाः /
अधर्मरुचयश्चापि विद्धि तान्वेनकल्मषान् //
text_mt: And the others who dwell in the Vindhyas—the Tamburas, Tuburas, and Khaśas, / who delight in unrighteousness—know them also to be the sins of Vena.

sanskrit_iast:
punarmaharṣayastasya pāṇiṃ venasya dakṣiṇam /
araṇīmiva saṃrabdhā mamanthurjātamanyavaḥ //
meaning:
पुनर्महर्षयस्तस्य पाणिं वेनस्य दक्षिणम् /
अरणीमिव संरब्धा ममन्थुर्जातमन्यवः //
text_mt: Again the great sages, impassioned with anger, / churned the right hand of that Vena like a fire-drill.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthustasmātsamutpannaḥ karājjalajasannibhāt /
pṛthoḥ karatalādvāpi yasmājjātaḥ pṛṣustataḥ //
meaning:
पृथुस्तस्मात्समुत्पन्नः कराज्जलजसन्निभात् /
पृथोः करतलाद्वापि यस्माज्जातः पृषुस्ततः //
text_mt: Pṛthu arose from that lotus-like hand; / and because he was born from the broad (pṛthu) palm of the hand, he was called Pṛthu.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpyamānaśca vapuṣā sākṣādagniriva jvalan /
ādyamājagavaṃ nāma dhanurgṛhya mahāravam //
meaning:
दीप्यमानश्च वपुषा साक्षादग्निरिव ज्वलन् /
आद्यमाजगवं नाम धनुर्गृह्य महारवम् //
text_mt: Blazing in body like blazing fire itself, / seizing the primeval, loud-sounding bow named Ājagava,

sanskrit_iast:
śārāṃśca bibhradrakṣārtha kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham /
tasmiñjā te 'tha bhūtāni saṃprahṛṣṭāni sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
शारांश्च बिभ्रद्रक्षार्थ कवचं च महाप्रभम् /
तस्मिञ्जा ते ऽथ भूतानि संप्रहृष्टानि सर्वशः //
text_mt: and holding arrows and a brilliant armor for protection. / When he was born, all beings were exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpeturmahārājaṃ venaśca tridivaṃ gataḥ /
samutpannena rājarṣiḥ satputreṇa mahātmanā //
meaning:
समापेतुर्महाराजं वेनश्च त्रिदिवं गतः /
समुत्पन्नेन राजर्षिः सत्पुत्रेण महात्मना //
text_mt: They approached the great king, and Vena went to heaven; / the royal sage was delivered by the noble and true son who had arisen,

sanskrit_iast:
trātaḥ sa puruṣavyāghraḥ punnāmno narakāttadā /
taṃ nadyaśca samudrāśca ratnānyādāya sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
त्रातः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्तदा /
तं नद्यश्च समुद्राश्च रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः //
text_mt: that tiger among men was then saved from the hell named Put. / Rivers and oceans, taking gems from every quarter,

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣekāya toyaṃ ca sarva evopata sthire /
pitāmahaśca bhagavānaṅgirobhiḥ sahāmaraiḥ //
meaning:
अभिषेकाय तोयं च सर्व एवोपत स्थिरे /
पितामहश्च भगवानङ्गिरोभिः सहामरैः //
text_mt: and all the waters for the consecration, attended upon him; / and the venerable Grandfather [Brahmā] together with the Aṅgirases and the immortals,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṅgamāni ca sarvaśaḥ /
samāgamya tadā vainyamabhya ṣiñcannarādhipam //
meaning:
स्थावराणि च भूतानि जङ्गमानि च सर्वशः /
समागम्य तदा वैन्यमभ्य षिञ्चन्नराधिपम् //
text_mt: and stationary and moving beings from every quarter, / having assembled, then consecrated the son of Vena as ruler of men

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā rājarājena prajāpālaṃ mahādyutim /
so 'bhiṣikto mahārājo devairaṅgirasaḥ sutaiḥ //
meaning:
महता राजराजेन प्रजापालं महाद्युतिम् /
सो ऽभिषिक्तो महाराजो देवैरङ्गिरसः सुतैः //
text_mt: with the great royal consecration, as the protector of subjects, of great splendor. / He was consecrated as great king by the gods, the sons of Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
ādi rājo mahābhāgaḥ pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān /
pitrāparañjitāstasya prajāstenānurañjitāḥ //
meaning:
आदि राजो महाभागः पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान् /
पित्रापरञ्जितास्तस्य प्रजास्तेनानुरञ्जिताः //
text_mt: the first king, highly fortunate, Pṛthu, son of Vena, endowed with majesty. / The subjects alienated by his father were delighted by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rājeti nāmāsya hyanurāgādajāyata /
āpastastaṃbhire tasya samudramabhiyāsyataḥ //
meaning:
ततो राजेति नामास्य ह्यनुरागादजायत /
आपस्तस्तंभिरे तस्य समुद्रमभियास्यतः //
text_mt: Then the name ‘rājā’ was given to him because of that delight (anurāga). / The waters solidified when he advanced toward the ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
parvatāścāvadīryanta dhvajabhaṅgaśca nābhavat /
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī siddhyantyannāni cintayā //
meaning:
पर्वताश्चावदीर्यन्त ध्वजभङ्गश्च नाभवत् /
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिद्ध्यन्त्यन्नानि चिन्तया //
text_mt: and mountains broke apart, and there was no breaking of his banner. / The earth yielded crops without being plowed, and foods were produced merely by thought.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmadughā gāvaḥ pṛṭake puṭake madhu /
etasminneva kāle tu yajatastasya vai makhe //
meaning:
सर्वकामदुघा गावः पृटके पुटके मधु /
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यजतस्तस्य वै मखे //
text_mt: Cows yielded all desires; honey was in every fold of leaves. / At that very time, as he was offering sacrifice in his rite,

sanskrit_iast:
some sute samu tpannaḥ sūtaḥ sautye tadāhani /
tasminnevaṃ samutpanne punarjajñe 'tha māgadhaḥ //
meaning:
सोमे सुते समु त्पन्नः सूतः सौत्ये तदाहनि /
तस्मिन्नेवं समुत्पन्ने पुनर्जज्ञे ऽथ मागधः //
text_mt: and the Soma was being pressed on that day of Soma-pressing, the bard was born. / And when he was thus born, then the panegyrist was born.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmageṣu ca gāyatsu śubhāṇḍe vaiśvadevike /
samāgate samutpannastasmānmāgadha ucyate //
meaning:
सामगेषु च गायत्सु शुभाण्डे वैश्वदेविके /
समागते समुत्पन्नस्तस्मान्मागध उच्यते //
text_mt: And while the Sāman-singers were singing at the auspicious vessel of the Vaiśvadeva [rite], / he was born upon its arrival, therefore he is called a panegyrist.

sanskrit_iast:
aindreṇa haviṣā cāpi haviḥ pṛktaṃ bṛhaspateḥ /
juhāvendrāya daivena tataḥ sūto vyajāyata //
meaning:
ऐन्द्रेण हविषा चापि हविः पृक्तं बृहस्पतेः /
जुहावेन्द्राय दैवेन ततः सूतो व्यजायत //
text_mt: And the oblation belonging to Indra was mixed with the oblation of Bṛhaspati; / he offered it to Indra as divine, and from that the bard was born.

sanskrit_iast:
pramādastatra saṃjajña prāyaścittaṃ ca karmasu /
śiṣyahavyena yatpṛktamabhibhūtaṃ gurorhaviḥ //
meaning:
प्रमादस्तत्र संजज्ञ प्रायश्चित्तं च कर्मसु /
शिष्यहव्येन यत्पृक्तमभिभूतं गुरोर्हविः //
text_mt: An oversight arose there, and an expiation in the rites, / because the guru's oblation was overpowered, being mixed with the disciple's oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
adharottaracāreṇa jajñe tadvarṇavaikṛtam /
yacca kṣatrātsamabhavadbrāhmaṇyāṃ hīnayonitaḥ //
meaning:
अधरोत्तरचारेण जज्ञे तद्वर्णवैकृतम् /
यच्च क्षत्रात्समभवद्ब्राह्मण्यां हीनयोनितः //
text_mt: By an inversion of high and low arose that corruption of class, / and because he was born from a kṣatriya on a brāhmaṇa woman, from an inferior womb,

sanskrit_iast:
sūtaḥ pūrveṇa sādharmyāttulyadharmaḥ prakīrttitaḥ /
madhyamo hyeṣa sūtasya dharmaḥ kṣetropajīvanam //
meaning:
सूतः पूर्वेण साधर्म्यात्तुल्यधर्मः प्रकीर्त्तितः /
मध्यमो ह्येष सूतस्य धर्मः क्षेत्रोपजीवनम् //
text_mt: the bard is proclaimed to share the same duty by virtue of similarity with the former. / Indeed, this intermediate duty of the bard is living by agriculture,

sanskrit_iast:
rathanāgāśvacaritaṃ jaghanyaṃ ca cikitsitam /
pṛthustavārthaṃ tau tatra samāhūtau maharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
रथनागाश्वचरितं जघन्यं च चिकित्सितम् /
पृथुस्तवार्थं तौ तत्र समाहूतौ महर्षिभिः //
text_mt: the management of chariots, elephants, and horses, and, as the lowest, medicine. / For the purpose of praising Pṛthu, the two were summoned there by the great sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvūcurmunayaḥ sarve stūyatāmeṣa pārthivaḥ /
karmaitadanurūpaṃ ca pātraṃ cāyaṃ narādhipaḥ //
meaning:
तावूचुर्मुनयः सर्वे स्तूयतामेष पार्थिवः /
कर्मैतदनुरूपं च पात्रं चायं नराधिपः //
text_mt: All the sages said to them: "Let this king be praised! / For this action is suitable, and this ruler of men is a worthy recipient."

sanskrit_iast:
tāvūcatustataḥ sarvāṃstānṛṣīnsūtamāgadhau /
āvāṃ devānṛṣīṃścaiva prīṇayāvaḥ svakarmataḥ //
meaning:
तावूचतुस्ततः सर्वांस्तानृषीन्सूतमागधौ /
आवां देवानृषींश्चैव प्रीणयावः स्वकर्मतः //
text_mt: The bard and the panegyrist then said to all those sages: / "We two please the gods and the sages by our own duty.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāsya vidvo vai karma na tathā lakṣaṇaṃ yaśaḥ /
stotraṃ yenāsya kuryāva procustejasvino dvijāḥ //
meaning:
न चास्य विद्वो वै कर्म न तथा लक्षणं यशः /
स्तोत्रं येनास्य कुर्याव प्रोचुस्तेजस्विनो द्विजाः //
text_mt: And we do not know his deed, nor likewise his characteristics or fame, / by which we might compose his praise." The radiant twice-born said:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa karmarato nityaṃ satyavāksaṃyatendriyaḥ /
jñānaśīlo vadānyaśca saṃgrāmeṣvaparajitaḥ //
meaning:
एष कर्मरतो नित्यं सत्यवाक्संयतेन्द्रियः /
ज्ञानशीलो वदान्यश्च संग्रामेष्वपरजितः //
text_mt: "He is ever devoted to duty, truthful in speech, with senses subdued, / endowed with knowledge, generous, and undefeated in battles."

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣibhistau niyuktau tu bhaviṣyaiḥ stūyatāmiti /
yāni karmāṇi kṛtavān pṛthuḥ paścānmahābalaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिभिस्तौ नियुक्तौ तु भविष्यैः स्तूयतामिति /
यानि कर्माणि कृतवान् पृथुः पश्चान्महाबलः //
text_mt: Injoined thus by the sages, "Let him be praised with [deeds] that are to be," / the deeds which the mighty Pṛthu performed afterwards,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni gītanibaddhāni hyastutāṃ sūtamāgadhau /
tatastavānte suprītaḥ pṛthuḥ prādātprajeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तानि गीतनिबद्धानि ह्यस्तुतां सूतमागधौ /
ततस्तवान्ते सुप्रीतः पृथुः प्रादात्प्रजेश्वरः //
text_mt: composed into songs, the bard and the panegyrist praised. / Then, at the end of the praise, highly pleased, Pṛthu, the lord of subjects, gave

sanskrit_iast:
anūpadeśaṃ sūtāya magadhaṃ māgadhāya ca /
tadādi pṛthivīpālāḥ stūyante sūtamāgadhaiḥ //
meaning:
अनूपदेशं सूताय मगधं मागधाय च /
तदादि पृथिवीपालाः स्तूयन्ते सूतमागधैः //
text_mt: the coastal country to the bard, and Magadha to the panegyrist. / From then on, rulers of the earth are praised by bards and panegyrists;

sanskrit_iast:
āśīrvādaiḥ prabodhyante sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāḥ prajā ūcurmaharṣayaḥ //
meaning:
आशीर्वादैः प्रबोध्यन्ते सूतमागधबन्दिभिः /
तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीताः प्रजा ऊचुर्महर्षयः //
text_mt: they are awakened with benedictions by bards, panegyrists, and heralds. / Having seen him, the great sages, exceedingly pleased, said to the subjects:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vṛttiprado vainyo bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ /
tato vainyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ prajāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ //
meaning:
एष वृत्तिप्रदो वैन्यो भविष्यति नराधिपः /
ततो वैन्यं महाभागं प्रजाः समभिदुद्रुवुः //
text_mt: "This ruler of men, the son of Vena, will be a provider of livelihood." / Then the subjects rushed toward the illustrious son of Vena:

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ no vṛttiṃ vidhatsveti mahārṣivaca nāttadā /
so 'bhidrutaḥ prajābhistu prajāhitacikīrṣayā //
meaning:
त्वं नो वृत्तिं विधत्स्वेति महार्षिवच नात्तदा /
सो ऽभिद्रुतः प्रजाभिस्तु प्रजाहितचिकीर्षया //
text_mt: "Provide our livelihood!" at the word of the great sages at that time. / Being thus approached by the subjects, wishing to act for the subjects' welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurgṛhītvā bāṇāṃśca vasudhāmādravadbalī /
tato vainyabhayatrastā gaurbhūtvā prādravanmahī //
meaning:
धनुर्गृहीत्वा बाणांश्च वसुधामाद्रवद्बली /
ततो वैन्यभयत्रस्ता गौर्भूत्वा प्राद्रवन्मही //
text_mt: the mighty one took his bow and arrows and rushed toward the earth. / Then, terrified by fear of the son of Vena, the earth became a cow and fled.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ pṛthurdhanurādāya dravantīmanvadhāvata /
sā lokānbrahmalokādīngatvā vainyabhayāttadā //
meaning:
तां पृथुर्धनुरादाय द्रवन्तीमन्वधावत /
सा लोकान्ब्रह्मलोकादीन्गत्वा वैन्यभयात्तदा //
text_mt: Taking his bow, Pṛthu pursued her as she fled. / Going to the worlds beginning with the world of Brahmā in fear of the son of Vena at that time,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdadarśāgrato vainyaṃ kārmukodyatapāṇikam /
jvaladbhirniśitairbāṇairdīptatejasamacyutam //
meaning:
संददर्शाग्रतो वैन्यं कार्मुकोद्यतपाणिकम् /
ज्वलद्भिर्निशितैर्बाणैर्दीप्ततेजसमच्युतम् //
text_mt: she saw the son of Vena before her, with his hand raising the bow, / with burning, sharp arrows, of blazing splendor, unfailing,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāyogaṃ mahātmānaṃ durddharṣamamarairapi /
alabantī tu sā trāṇaṃ vainyamevānvapadyata //
meaning:
महायोगं महात्मानं दुर्द्धर्षममरैरपि /
अलबन्ती तु सा त्राणं वैन्यमेवान्वपद्यत //
text_mt: endowed with great yoga, high-minded, unassailable even by the immortals. / Finding no protection, she surrendered to the son of Vena alone.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī pūjyā lokaistribhiḥ sādā /
uvāca vainaṃ nādharmaḥ strīvadhe paripaśyati //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटा देवी पूज्या लोकैस्त्रिभिः सादा /
उवाच वैनं नाधर्मः स्त्रीवधे परिपश्यति //
text_mt: With folded hands, the goddess, ever worthy of worship by the three worlds, / spoke to the son of Vena: "Do you not see unrighteousness in killing a woman?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi prajā yā varddhitā mayā /
mayi lokāḥ sthitā rājanmayedaṃ dhāryate jagat //
meaning:
कथं धारयिता चासि प्रजा या वर्द्धिता मया /
मयि लोकाः स्थिता राजन्मयेदं धार्यते जगत् //
text_mt: And how will you support the subjects that have been sustained by me? / The worlds rest upon me, O King; this universe is borne by me.

sanskrit_iast:
matkṛte na vinaśyeyuḥ prajāḥ pārthiva varddhitāḥ /
sa māṃ narhasi vai hantuṃ śreyastvaṃ ca cikīrṣasi //
meaning:
मत्कृते न विनश्येयुः प्रजाः पार्थिव वर्द्धिताः /
स मां नर्हसि वै हन्तुं श्रेयस्त्वं च चिकीर्षसि //
text_mt: Let not the subjects nurtured by me perish on my account, O ruler of the earth! / Therefore you ought not to kill me, if you wish to act for the good.

sanskrit_iast:
prajānāṃ pṛthivīpāla śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama /
upāyataḥ samārabdhā sarve siddhyantyupakramāḥ //
meaning:
प्रजानां पृथिवीपाल शृणु चेदं वचो मम /
उपायतः समारब्धा सर्वे सिद्ध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः //
text_mt: Hear these words of mine, O protector of the earth, for the sake of the subjects: / Undertaken with proper means, all undertakings succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvāpi māṃ na śaktastvaṃ prajānāṃ pālane nṛpa /
antarbhūtā bhaviṣyāmi jahi kopaṃ mahādyute //
meaning:
हत्वापि मां न शक्तस्त्वं प्रजानां पालने नृप /
अन्तर्भूता भविष्यामि जहि कोपं महाद्युते //
text_mt: Even by killing me, you will not be able to protect the subjects, O king. / I shall be contained within; cast away your anger, O you of great splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
avadhyaśca striyaḥ prāhustiryagyonigateṣvapi /
sattvaṣu pṛthivīpāla dhama na tyaktumarhasi //
meaning:
अवध्यश्च स्त्रियः प्राहुस्तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि /
सत्त्वषु पृथिवीपाल धम न त्यक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: And they declare women to be unslayable, even among creatures born in an animal womb, / O protector of the earth; you ought not to abandon righteousness."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā tasyā mahāmanāḥ /
krodhaṃ nigṛhya dharmātmā vasudhāmidamabravīt //
meaning:
एवं बहुविधं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तस्या महामनाः /
क्रोधं निगृह्य धर्मात्मा वसुधामिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having heard her speech of many kinds, the high-minded one, / righteous in nature, controlled his anger and spoke thus to the earth:

sanskrit_iast:
ekasyārthāya yo hanyādātmano vā parasya ca /
ekaṃ prāṇī bahūnvāpi karma tasyāsti pātakam //
meaning:
एकस्यार्थाय यो हन्यादात्मनो वा परस्य च /
एकं प्राणी बहून्वापि कर्म तस्यास्ति पातकम् //
text_mt: "He who would kill for the sake of one, whether oneself or another, / a single living being or many, has a sin attached to that deed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃstu nihate bhadre jīvante bahavaḥ sukham /
tasminhate nāsti śubhe pātakaṃ copapātakam //
meaning:
यस्मिंस्तु निहते भद्रे जीवन्ते बहवः सुखम् /
तस्मिन्हते नास्ति शुभे पातकं चोपपातकम् //
text_mt: When, however, upon one being slain, O blessed one, many live happily, / in that one being slain, O auspicious one, there is neither major sin nor minor sin.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ prajānimittaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi vasundhare /
yadi me vacanaṃ nādya kariṣyasi jagaddhitam //
meaning:
सो ऽहं प्रजानिमित्तं त्वां हनिष्यामि वसुन्धरे /
यदि मे वचनं नाद्य करिष्यसि जगद्धितम् //
text_mt: So I shall kill you for the sake of the subjects, O earth, / if today you do not obey my word, which is for the benefit of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ nihatyāśu bāṇena macchāsanaparāṅmukhīm /
ātmānaṃ prathayitveha prajā dhārayitā svayam //
meaning:
त्वां निहत्याशु बाणेन मच्छासनपराङ्मुखीम् /
आत्मानं प्रथयित्वेह प्रजा धारयिता स्वयम् //
text_mt: Having swiftly slain you with an arrow as you turn away from my command, / and having extended myself here, I shall support the subjects myself.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvaṃ vacanamāsthāya mama dharmabhṛtāṃ vare /
saṃjīvaya prajā nityaṃ śaktā hyasi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सा त्वं वचनमास्थाय मम धर्मभृतां वरे /
संजीवय प्रजा नित्यं शक्ता ह्यसि न संशयः //
text_mt: Abiding by my word, O best among upholders of duty, / revive the subjects constantly, for you are surely capable, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
duhitṛtvaṃ ca me gaccha caivametamahaṃ śaram /
niyaccheyaṃ tvadvadhārthamudyantaṃ ghoradarśanam //
meaning:
दुहितृत्वं च मे गच्छ चैवमेतमहं शरम् /
नियच्छेयं त्वद्वधार्थमुद्यन्तं घोरदर्शनम् //
text_mt: And become my daughter, and then I will draw back this arrow / of dreadful appearance that has been raised for the sake of killing you."

sanskrit_iast:
pratyuvāca tato vainyamevamuktā satī mahī /
sarvametadahaṃ rājanvidhāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्युवाच ततो वैन्यमेवमुक्ता सती मही /
सर्वमेतदहं राजन्विधास्यामि न संशयः //
text_mt: Being thus addressed, the noble earth replied to the son of Vena: / "All this I will accomplish, O King, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaṃ tu mama taṃ paśya kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā /
samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra māṃ tvaṃ dharmmabhṛtāṃ vara /
yathā vispandamānaṃ me kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvayet //
meaning:
वत्सं तु मम तं पश्य क्षरेयं येन वत्सला /
समां च कुरु सर्वत्र मां त्वं धर्म्मभृतां वर /
यथा विस्पन्दमानं मे क्षीरं सर्वत्र भावयेत् //
text_mt: Behold that calf for me, through which I, full of affection, may yield milk; / and make me level everywhere, O best among upholders of duty, / so that my streaming milk may pervade everywhere."

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tata utsārayāmāsa śilājālani sarvaśaḥ /
dhanuṣkoṭyā tathā vainyastena śailā vivarddhitāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
तत उत्सारयामास शिलाजालनि सर्वशः /
धनुष्कोट्या तथा वैन्यस्तेन शैला विवर्द्धिताः //
text_mt: The bard said: / Then the son of Vena pushed aside the masses of stones on all sides / with the tip of his bow; by that the mountains were raised up.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣvatīteṣu viṣamāsīdvasundharā /
svabhāvenā bhavattasyāḥ samāni viṣamāṇi ca //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु विषमासीद्वसुन्धरा /
स्वभावेना भवत्तस्याः समानि विषमाणि च //
text_mt: In the past manvantaras, the earth was uneven; / naturally there were level and uneven parts of it.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi pūrvanisarge vai viṣame pṛthivītale /
pravibhāgaḥ purāṇāṃ vā grāmāṇāṃ vāpi vidyate //
meaning:
न हि पूर्वनिसर्गे वै विषमे पृथिवीतले /
प्रविभागः पुराणां वा ग्रामाणां वापि विद्यते //
text_mt: Indeed, in the previous creation, on the uneven surface of the earth, / no division of cities or villages was known,

sanskrit_iast:
na sasyāni na gorakṣaṃ na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ /
cākṣuṣasyāntare pūrvamāsīdetatpurā kila //
meaning:
न सस्यानि न गोरक्षं न कृषिर्न वणिक्पथः /
चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वमासीदेतत्पुरा किल //
text_mt: nor crops, nor cattle-rearing, nor agriculture, nor trade route. / Formerly, in the interval of Cākṣuṣa, this was indeed the case, so it is said.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvateṃ'tare tasminsarva syaitasya saṃbhavaḥ /
samatvaṃ yatra yatrāsīdbhūmeḥ kasmiṃścideva hi //
meaning:
वैवस्वतेंऽतरे तस्मिन्सर्व स्यैतस्य संभवः /
समत्वं यत्र यत्रासीद्भूमेः कस्मिंश्चिदेव हि //
text_mt: In that interval of Vaivasvata, the origin of all this took place. / Wherever there was evenness of the earth in any place,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatra prajāstā vai nivasaṃti ca sarvaśaḥ /
āhāraḥ phala mūle tu prajānāmabhavatkila //
meaning:
तत्र तत्र प्रजास्ता वै निवसंति च सर्वशः /
आहारः फल मूले तु प्रजानामभवत्किल //
text_mt: there those subjects dwelt on all sides. / The food of the subjects consisted of fruits and roots, so it is said,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchreṇaiva tadā tāsāmityevamanuśuśruma /
vainyātprabhṛti loke 'sminsarvasyaitasya saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रेणैव तदा तासामित्येवमनुशुश्रुम /
वैन्यात्प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन्सर्वस्यैतस्य संभवः //
text_mt: and that with great difficulty at that time—thus have we heard tradition say. / Beginning from the son of Vena, the origin of all this occurred in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kalpayitvā vatsaṃ tu cākṣuṣaṃ manumīśvaraḥ /
pṛthurdudoha sasyāni sve tale pṛthivīṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
स कल्पयित्वा वत्सं तु चाक्षुषं मनुमीश्वरः /
पृथुर्दुदोह सस्यानि स्वे तले पृथिवीं ततः //
text_mt: Having arranged Cākṣuṣa Manu as the calf, the lord / Pṛthu then milked the crops from the earth onto his own surface.

sanskrit_iast:
tenānnena tatastā vai varttayanti śubhāḥ prajāḥ /
ṛṣibhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
तेनान्नेन ततस्ता वै वर्त्तयन्ति शुभाः प्रजाः /
ऋषिभिः श्रूयते चापि पुनर्दुग्धा वसुंधरा //
text_mt: By means of that food, then, those auspicious subjects subsist. / And it is heard that the earth was milked again by the sages:

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaḥ somastvabhūtteṣāṃ dogdhā cāpi bṛhaspatiḥ /
chandāsipātramāsīttu gāyatryādīni sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
वत्सः सोमस्त्वभूत्तेषां दोग्धा चापि बृहस्पतिः /
छन्दासिपात्रमासीत्तु गायत्र्यादीनि सर्वशः //
text_mt: Soma was their calf, and Bṛhaspati was the milker, / while the meters, Gāyatrī and the rest, were the vessel in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīramāsīttadā teṣāṃ tapo brahma ca śāśvatam /
punastato devagaṇaiḥ purandarapurogamaiḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरमासीत्तदा तेषां तपो ब्रह्म च शाश्वतम् /
पुनस्ततो देवगणैः पुरन्दरपुरोगमैः //
text_mt: Their milk was then ascetic penance and the eternal Veda. / Then, furthermore, by the hosts of gods headed by Purandara,

sanskrit_iast:
sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya dugdhā saṃśrūyate mahī /
vatsastu maghavānāsīddogdhā ca savitā vibhuḥ //
meaning:
सौवर्णं पात्रमादाय दुग्धा संश्रूयते मही /
वत्सस्तु मघवानासीद्दोग्धा च सविता विभुः //
text_mt: taking a golden vessel, the earth is heard to have been milked: / Maghavat was the calf, and all-pervading Savitṛ was the milker;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīramūrjaṃ ca madhu ca varttante tena devatāḥ /
pitṛbhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasundharā //
meaning:
क्षीरमूर्जं च मधु च वर्त्तन्ते तेन देवताः /
पितृभिः श्रूयते चापि पुनर्दुग्धा वसुन्धरा //
text_mt: the milk was vigor and nectar; upon that the deities subsist. / And it is heard that the earth was milked again by the ancestors:

sanskrit_iast:
rājataṃ pātramādāya svadhāmāśu vitṛptaye /
vaivasvato yamastvāsītteṣāṃ vatsaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
राजतं पात्रमादाय स्वधामाशु वितृप्तये /
वैवस्वतो यमस्त्वासीत्तेषां वत्सः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: taking a silver vessel, [they milked] the svadhā for quick satisfaction. / Yama Vaivasvata, full of majesty, was their calf;

sanskrit_iast:
antakaścābhavaddogdhā pitṝṇāṃ balavānprabhuḥ /
asuraiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasundharā //
meaning:
अन्तकश्चाभवद्दोग्धा पितॄणां बलवान्प्रभुः /
असुरैः श्रूयते चापि पुनर्दुग्धा वसुन्धरा //
text_mt: and Antaka, the mighty lord, was the milker of the ancestors. / And it is heard that the earth was milked again by the asuras:

sanskrit_iast:
āyasaṃ pātramādāya kila māyaśca sarvaśaḥ /
virocanastu prāhrādirvatsasteṣāṃ mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
आयसं पात्रमादाय किल मायश्च सर्वशः /
विरोचनस्तु प्राह्रादिर्वत्सस्तेषां महायशाः //
text_mt: taking an iron vessel, [they milked] illusion indeed in every form. / Virocana, son of Prahrāda, renowned for great fame, was their calf;

sanskrit_iast:
tratvigdvimūrddhā daityānāṃ dogdhābhūdditinandanaḥ /
pāyasā te ca māyābhiḥ sarve māyāvino 'surāḥ //
meaning:
त्रत्विग्द्विमूर्द्धा दैत्यानां दोग्धाभूद्दितिनन्दनः /
पायसा ते च मायाभिः सर्वे मायाविनो ऽसुराः //
text_mt: and Dvimūrdhan, the delight of Diti, was the milker of the daityas. / By that milk and through illusions, all those illusion-wielding asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
varttayanti mahāvīryāstadeṣāṃ paramaṃ balam /
nāgaistu śrūyate dugdhā vatsaṃ kṛtvā tu takṣakam //
meaning:
वर्त्तयन्ति महावीर्यास्तदेषां परमं बलम् /
नागैस्तु श्रूयते दुग्धा वत्सं कृत्वा तु तक्षकम् //
text_mt: of great prowess, sustain themselves; that is their ultimate strength. / And it is heard that [the earth] was milked by the nāgas, making Takṣaka the calf:

sanskrit_iast:
alāba5pātramādāya viṣaṃ kṣīraṃ tadā mahī /
teṣāṃ vai vāsukirdegdhā kādraveyaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
अलाब5पात्रमादाय विषं क्षीरं तदा मही /
तेषां वै वासुकिर्देग्धा काद्रवेयः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: taking a gourd vessel, the earth [yielded] poison as milk at that time. / Mighty Vāsuki, son of Kadrū, milked it for them,

sanskrit_iast:
nāgānāṃ vai dvijaśreṣṭha sarpāṇāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ /
tenaiva varttayantyugrā mahākāyā viṣolbaṇāḥ //
meaning:
नागानां वै द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्पाणां चैव सर्वशः /
तेनैव वर्त्तयन्त्युग्रा महाकाया विषोल्बणाः //
text_mt: indeed for all the nāgas and serpents, O best of the twice-born. / By that alone do those fierce, large-bodied creatures, virulent with poison, subsist,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāhārāstadācārāsta dvīryāstadupāśrayāḥ /
āmapātre punardugdhā tvantardhānapriyaṃ mahī //
meaning:
तदाहारास्तदाचारास्त द्वीर्यास्तदुपाश्रयाः /
आमपात्रे पुनर्दुग्धा त्वन्तर्धानप्रियं मही //
text_mt: having that as their food, their conduct, their strength, and their resort. / Taking an unbaked clay vessel, the earth, fond of invisibility, was milked again,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā yakṣaiḥ puṇyajanaistathā /
dogdhā rajatanābhastu pitā maṇidharasya yaḥ //
meaning:
वत्सं वैश्रवणं कृत्वा यक्षैः पुण्यजनैस्तथा /
दोग्धा रजतनाभस्तु पिता मणिधरस्य यः //
text_mt: making Vaiśravaṇa the calf, by the yakṣas and puṇyajanas. / The milker was Rajatanābha, who is the father of Maṇidhara,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñātmajo mahātejā vaśī ca sumahāyaśāḥ /
tena te varttayantīti paramarthatayā ca ha //
meaning:
यज्ञात्मजो महातेजा वशी च सुमहायशाः /
तेन ते वर्त्तयन्तीति परमर्थतया च ह //
text_mt: son of Yajña, endowed with great splendor, self-controlled and highly renowned. / By that do they subsist indeed in the truest sense.

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasaiśca piśācaiśca punardugdhā vasundharā /
brahmā brāhyāstu vai dogadhā teṣāmāsītkuberakaḥ //
meaning:
राक्षसैश्च पिशाचैश्च पुनर्दुग्धा वसुन्धरा /
ब्रह्मा ब्राह्यास्तु वै दोगधा तेषामासीत्कुबेरकः //
text_mt: And the earth was milked again by the rākṣasas and piśācas. / Kubera was their milker […]

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaḥ sumālī balavānkṣīraṃ rudhirameva ca /
kapālapātre nirdugdhā hyantarddhanaṃ ca rākṣasaiḥ //
meaning:
वत्सः सुमाली बलवान्क्षीरं रुधिरमेव च /
कपालपात्रे निर्दुग्धा ह्यन्तर्द्धनं च राक्षसैः //
text_mt: the calf was mighty Sumālī; and the milk was blood itself. / In a skull-vessel [the power of] invisibility was milked by the rākṣasas;

sanskrit_iast:
tena kṣīreṇa rakṣāṃsi varttayantīha sarvaśaḥ /
padmapātre punardugdhā gandharvaiścāpsa rogaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
तेन क्षीरेण रक्षांसि वर्त्तयन्तीह सर्वशः /
पद्मपात्रे पुनर्दुग्धा गन्धर्वैश्चाप्स रोगणैः //
text_mt: by that milk the rakṣases subsist here in every way. / Milked again in a lotus vessel by gandharvas and hosts of apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaṃ citrarathaṃ kṛtvā śucīngandhāmahī tadā /
teṣāṃ vasurucistvāsīddogdhā putro muneḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
वत्सं चित्ररथं कृत्वा शुचीन्गन्धामही तदा /
तेषां वसुरुचिस्त्वासीद्दोग्धा पुत्रो मुनेः शुभः //
text_mt: having made Citraratha the calf, the earth then [yielded] pure fragrances. / Their milker was auspicious Vasuruci, the son of the sage,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvarājo 'tibalo mahātmā sūryasannibhaḥ /
śailaiśca śrūyate dugdhā punardevī vasundharā //
meaning:
गन्धर्वराजो ऽतिबलो महात्मा सूर्यसन्निभः /
शैलैश्च श्रूयते दुग्धा पुनर्देवी वसुन्धरा //
text_mt: the king of gandharvas, immensely strong, noble-souled, like the sun. / And it is heard that the divine earth was milked again by the mountains:

sanskrit_iast:
tadauṣadhīrmūrtimatī ratnāni vividhāni ca /
vatsastu himavānāsīddogdhā merurmahāgiriḥ //
meaning:
तदौषधीर्मूर्तिमती रत्नानि विविधानि च /
वत्सस्तु हिमवानासीद्दोग्धा मेरुर्महागिरिः //
text_mt: embodied medicinal herbs and various gems [she yielded]; / the calf was Himavat, and the great mountain Meru was the milker;

sanskrit_iast:
pātraṃ tu śailamevāsīttena śailāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
śrūyate vṛkṣavīrudbhiḥ punardugdhā vasundharā //
meaning:
पात्रं तु शैलमेवासीत्तेन शैलाः प्रतिष्ठिताः /
श्रूयते वृक्षवीरुद्भिः पुनर्दुग्धा वसुन्धरा //
text_mt: the vessel was a rock itself; by that the mountains are established. / It is heard that the earth was milked again by trees and creepers:

sanskrit_iast:
pālāśaṃ pātramādāya chinnadagdhaprarohaṇam /
kāmadhuk puṣpitaḥ śālaḥ plakṣo vatso yaśasvinām //
meaning:
पालाशं पात्रमादाय छिन्नदग्धप्ररोहणम् /
कामधुक् पुष्पितः शालः प्लक्षो वत्सो यशस्विनाम् //
text_mt: taking a palāśa-leaf vessel, [they milked] the regrowth of what is cut down or burned. / The wish-yielding blossoming śāla tree [milked], and the plakṣa was the calf for those renowned ones.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmadughā dogdhrī pṛthivī bhūtabhāvinī /
saiva dhātrī vidhātrī ca dhāraṇī ca vasundharā //
meaning:
सर्वकामदुघा दोग्ध्री पृथिवी भूतभाविनी /
सैव धात्री विधात्री च धारणी च वसुन्धरा //
text_mt: Yielding every desire, a source of abundance, the earth brings forth all creatures. / She alone is the supporter, the ordainer, the sustainer, and the vessel of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhā hitārthaṃ lokānāṃ pṛthuneti hi naḥ śrutam /
carācarasya lokasya pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅga pāde śeṣamanvantarāśyānaṃ pṛthivīdohanaṃ ca nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
दुग्धा हितार्थं लोकानां पृथुनेति हि नः श्रुतम् /
चराचरस्य लोकस्य प्रतिष्ठा योनिरेव च //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्ग पादे शेषमन्वन्तराश्यानं पृथिवीदोहनं च नाम षट्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
milked for the benefit of the worlds by Pṛthu, as has been heard by us— / the foundation and the womb of the moving and unmoving world.

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Account of the Remaining Manvantaras and the Milking of the Earth,' in the second part, the Anuṣaṅgapāda, in the first section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
āsīdiha samudrāntā vasudheti yathā śrutam /
vasu dhatte yatastasmādvasudhā seti gīyate //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
आसीदिह समुद्रान्ता वसुधेति यथा श्रुतम् /
वसु धत्ते यतस्तस्माद्वसुधा सेति गीयते //
text_mt: The Sūta said: / Here, extending to the ocean, was the earth, known as Vasudhā as has been heard; / because she bears wealth (vasu), therefore she is sung of as Vasudhā.

sanskrit_iast:
madhukaiṭabhayoḥ pūrvaṃ medasā saṃpariplutā /
teneyaṃ medinītyuktā niruktyā brahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
मधुकैटभयोः पूर्वं मेदसा संपरिप्लुता /
तेनेयं मेदिनीत्युक्ता निरुक्त्या ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: Having formerly been flooded with the fat (medas) of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, / therefore she is called Medinī by the expounders of the Veda according to etymology.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bhyupagamādrājñaḥ pṛthorvainyasya dhīmataḥ /
duhitṛtvamanuprāptā pṛthivī paṭhyate tataḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽभ्युपगमाद्राज्ञः पृथोर्वैन्यस्य धीमतः /
दुहितृत्वमनुप्राप्ता पृथिवी पठ्यते ततः //
text_mt: Then, from coming under the care of the wise King Pṛthu, son of Vena, / she attained daughterhood; hence she is designated Pṛthivī.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthunā pravibhāgaścadharāyāḥ sādhitaḥ purā /
tasyākaravatī rājñaḥ pattanākaramālinī //
meaning:
पृथुना प्रविभागश्चधरायाः साधितः पुरा /
तस्याकरवती राज्ञः पत्तनाकरमालिनी //
text_mt: The division of the earth was formerly accomplished by Pṛthu; / by that king she was endowed with mines and garlanded with cities and mines,

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvarṇamayasamākīrṇā rakṣitā tena dhīmatā /
evaṃprabhāvorājāsīdvainyaḥ sadvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
चातुर्वर्णमयसमाकीर्णा रक्षिता तेन धीमता /
एवंप्रभावोराजासीद्वैन्यः सद्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: thronged with the four social classes, and protected by that wise one. / Of such majesty was King Vainya, O best of good twice-born ones;

sanskrit_iast:
namasyaścaiva pūcyaśca bhūtagrāmeṇa sarvaśaḥ /
brāhmaṇaiśca mahābhāgairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ //
meaning:
नमस्यश्चैव पूच्यश्च भूतग्रामेण सर्वशः /
ब्राह्मणैश्च महाभागैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः //
text_mt: he is to be saluted and revered by the entire assemblage of beings, / and by the blessed brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthureva namaskāryo brahmayoniḥ sanātanaḥ /
pārthivaiśca mahābhāgaiḥ prārthayadbhirmahadyaśaḥ //
meaning:
पृथुरेव नमस्कार्यो ब्रह्मयोनिः सनातनः /
पार्थिवैश्च महाभागैः प्रार्थयद्भिर्महद्यशः //
text_mt: Pṛthu alone, whose origin is Brahman, the eternal, is to be bowed to, / and by blessed kings desiring great fame,

sanskrit_iast:
ādirājo namaskāryaḥ pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān /
yodhairapi ca saṃgrāme prāptukāmairjayaṃ yudhi //
meaning:
आदिराजो नमस्कार्यः पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान् /
योधैरपि च संग्रामे प्राप्तुकामैर्जयं युधि //
text_mt: the first king, Pṛthu son of Vena, full of prowess, is to be saluted; / also by warriors in battle seeking to attain victory in fight,

sanskrit_iast:
ādikarttāraṇānāṃ vai namasyaḥ pṛthureva hi /
yo hi yoddhā raṇaṃ yāti kīrttayitvā pṛthuṃ nṛpam //
meaning:
आदिकर्त्तारणानां वै नमस्यः पृथुरेव हि /
यो हि योद्धा रणं याति कीर्त्तयित्वा पृथुं नृपम् //
text_mt: the first creator of battles, Pṛthu alone, is indeed to be bowed to. / For that warrior who goes into battle having praised King Pṛthu

sanskrit_iast:
sa ghorarūpātsaṃgrāmātkṣemī tarati kīrttimān /
vaiśyairapi ca rājarṣirveśyavṛttimihāsthitaiḥ //
meaning:
स घोररूपात्संग्रामात्क्षेमी तरति कीर्त्तिमान् /
वैश्यैरपि च राजर्षिर्वेश्यवृत्तिमिहास्थितैः //
text_mt: crosses safely through terrible combat, renowned; / and by vaiśyas following the merchant's livelihood in this world,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthureva namaskāryo vṛttidānānmahāyaśāḥ /
ete vatsaviśeṣāśca dogdhāraḥ kṣīrameva ca //
meaning:
पृथुरेव नमस्कार्यो वृत्तिदानान्महायशाः /
एते वत्सविशेषाश्च दोग्धारः क्षीरमेव च //
text_mt: Pṛthu alone of great fame is to be saluted, as he granted livelihoods. / These particular calves, milkers, milk,

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇi ca mayoktāni sarvāṇyeva yathākramam /
brahmaṇā prathamaṃ dugdhā purā pṛthvī mahātmanā //
meaning:
पात्राणि च मयोक्तानि सर्वाण्येव यथाक्रमम् /
ब्रह्मणा प्रथमं दुग्धा पुरा पृथ्वी महात्मना //
text_mt: and vessels have all been related by me in due order. / First, the earth was milked in ancient times by the great-souled Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuṃ kṛtvā tathā vatsaṃ bījāni vasudhātale /
tataḥ svāyaṃbhuve pūrvaṃ tadā manvantare punaḥ //
meaning:
वायुं कृत्वा तथा वत्सं बीजानि वसुधातले /
ततः स्वायंभुवे पूर्वं तदा मन्वन्तरे पुनः //
text_mt: making Vāyu the calf, [milking] the seeds onto the surface of the earth. / Then, in the Svāyambhuva manvantara previously,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ kṛtvā sarvasasyāni caiva hi /
tataḥ svārociṣe vāpi prāpte manvantare 'dhunā //
meaning:
वत्सं स्वायंभुवं कृत्वा सर्वसस्यानि चैव हि /
ततः स्वारोचिषे वापि प्राप्ते मन्वन्तरे ऽधुना //
text_mt: making Svāyambhuva the calf, all crops [were milked]. / Then, when the Svārociṣa manvantara had arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
vatsaṃ svārociṣaṃ kṛtvā dugdhā sasyāni medinī /
uttamena tu tenāpi dugdhā devānu jena tu //
meaning:
वत्सं स्वारोचिषं कृत्वा दुग्धा सस्यानि मेदिनी /
उत्तमेन तु तेनापि दुग्धा देवानु जेन तु //
text_mt: making Svārociṣa the calf, the crops were milked from the earth. / And by Uttama, the younger brother of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
manuṃ kṛtvottamaṃ vatsaṃ sarvasasyāni dhīmatā /
punaśca pañcame pṛthvī tāmasasyāntare manoḥ //
meaning:
मनुं कृत्वोत्तमं वत्सं सर्वसस्यानि धीमता /
पुनश्च पञ्चमे पृथ्वी तामसस्यान्तरे मनोः //
text_mt: all crops [were milked] by the wise one, having made Manu Uttama the calf. / Again, in the fifth interval of Manu Tāmasa,

sanskrit_iast:
dugdheyaṃ tāmasaṃ vatsaṃ kṛtvā vai balabandhunā /
cāriṣṭavasya vai ṣaṣṭhe saṃprāpte cāntare manoḥ //
meaning:
दुग्धेयं तामसं वत्सं कृत्वा वै बलबन्धुना /
चारिष्टवस्य वै षष्ठे संप्राप्ते चान्तरे मनोः //
text_mt: this [earth] was milked by Balabandhu, making Tāmasa the calf. / And when the sixth interval of Manu Cāriṣṇu had arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhā mahī purāṇena vatsaṃ cāriṣṭavaṃ prati /
cākṣuṣe cāpi saṃprāpte tadā manvantare punaḥ //
meaning:
दुग्धा मही पुराणेन वत्सं चारिष्टवं प्रति /
चाक्षुषे चापि संप्राप्ते तदा मन्वन्तरे पुनः //
text_mt: the earth was milked by the ancient one, with respect to the calf Cāriṣṇu. / And when the Cākṣuṣa manvantara had arrived then,

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhā mahī purāṇena vatsaṃ kṛtvā tu cākṣuṣam /
cākṣuṣasyāntare 'tīte prāpte vaivasvate punaḥ //
meaning:
दुग्धा मही पुराणेन वत्सं कृत्वा तु चाक्षुषम् /
चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे ऽतीते प्राप्ते वैवस्वते पुनः //
text_mt: the earth was milked again by the ancient one, having made Cākṣuṣa the calf. / When the interval of Cākṣuṣa had passed and the Vaivasvata [manvantara] had arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
vainyeneyaṃ purā dugdhā yathā te kathitaṃ mayā /
etairdugdhā purā pṛthvī vyatīteṣvantareṣu vai //
meaning:
वैन्येनेयं पुरा दुग्धा यथा ते कथितं मया /
एतैर्दुग्धा पुरा पृथ्वी व्यतीतेष्वन्तरेषु वै //
text_mt: she was milked in ancient times by Vainya, as was told to you by me. / By these was the earth formerly milked in the past manvantaras,

sanskrit_iast:
devādibhirmanuṣyaiśca tato bhūtādibhiśca ha /
evaṃ sarveṣu vijñeyā atītānāgateṣviha //
meaning:
देवादिभिर्मनुष्यैश्च ततो भूतादिभिश्च ह /
एवं सर्वेषु विज्ञेया अतीतानागतेष्विह //
text_mt: by the gods and others, by men, and then by the beings and so forth. / Thus it is to be understood in all past and future [manvantaras] here.

sanskrit_iast:
devā manvantare svasthāḥ pṛthostu śṛṇuta prajāḥ /
pṛthostu putrau vikrāntau jajñāte 'ntarddhipāṣanau //
meaning:
देवा मन्वन्तरे स्वस्थाः पृथोस्तु शृणुत प्रजाः /
पृथोस्तु पुत्रौ विक्रान्तौ जज्ञाते ऽन्तर्द्धिपाषनौ //
text_mt: The gods are established in the manvantara; now hear of the progeny of Pṛthu. / Two valiant sons were born to Pṛthu: Antardhi and Pāṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhaṇḍinī havirdhānamantarddhānāvdyajāyata /
havirdhānātṣaḍāgneyī dhiṣaṇājanayatsutān //
meaning:
शिखण्डिनी हविर्धानमन्तर्द्धानाव्द्यजायत /
हविर्धानात्षडाग्नेयी धिषणाजनयत्सुतान् //
text_mt: Śikhaṇḍinī gave birth to Havirdhāna from Antardhāna. / From Havirdhāna, Dhiṣaṇā, daughter of Agni, gave birth to six sons.

sanskrit_iast:
prācīnabarhiṣaṃ śuklaṃ gayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prajācinau /
prācīnabarhirbhagavānmahānāsītprajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
प्राचीनबर्हिषं शुक्लं गयं कृष्णं प्रजाचिनौ /
प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवान्महानासीत्प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: [Namely] Prācīnabarhis, Śukla, Gaya, Kṛṣṇa, and Prajācīna. / The venerable Prācīnabarhis was a great Prajāpati;

sanskrit_iast:
balaśrutatapovīryaiḥ pṛthivyāmekarāḍasau /
prācīnāgrāḥ kuśāstasya tasmātprācīnabarhyasau //
meaning:
बलश्रुततपोवीर्यैः पृथिव्यामेकराडसौ /
प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य तस्मात्प्राचीनबर्ह्यसौ //
text_mt: through strength, sacred learning, asceticism, and valour, he was the sole ruler on earth. / His kuśa grasses had their tips turned eastward; therefore he was called Prācīnabarhis.

sanskrit_iast:
samudratanayāyāṃ tu kṛtadāraḥ sa vai prabhuḥ /
mahatastapasaḥ pāre savarṇāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
समुद्रतनयायां तु कृतदारः स वै प्रभुः /
महतस्तपसः पारे सवर्णायां प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: That lord, the Prajāpati, took a wife in Savarṇā, / the daughter of the Ocean, beyond [the completion of] great ascetic penance.

sanskrit_iast:
savarṇādhatta sāmudrī daśa prācīnabarhiṣaḥ /
sarvānpracetaso nāma dhanurvedasya pāragān //
meaning:
सवर्णाधत्त सामुद्री दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः /
सर्वान्प्रचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगान् //
text_mt: From Savarṇā, daughter of the Ocean, Prācīnabarhis begot ten sons, / all known by the name of Pracetases, masters of the science of archery.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāste 'tapyanta mahāttapaḥ /
daśavarṣa sahasrāṇi samudrasalileśayāḥ //
meaning:
अपृथग्धर्मचरणास्ते ऽतप्यन्त महात्तपः /
दशवर्ष सहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयाः //
text_mt: Practicing the same religious duty together, they performed great penance / for ten thousand years, lying submerged in the waters of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaścateṣu pṛthivīṃ tapyatsvatha mahīruhāḥ /
arakṣyamāṇāmāvabrurbabhūvātha prajākṣayaḥ //
meaning:
तपश्चतेषु पृथिवीं तप्यत्स्वथ महीरुहाः /
अरक्ष्यमाणामावब्रुर्बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः //
text_mt: While they were performing penance, trees covered the earth / which was left unprotected; then destruction of living beings occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyāhṛte tadā tasmiñcākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ /
nāśakanmāruto vātuṃ vṛttaṃ khamabhavaddrumaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्याहृते तदा तस्मिञ्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः /
नाशकन्मारुतो वातुं वृत्तं खमभवद्द्रुमैः //
text_mt: When it was withdrawn then, during the period of Manu Cākṣuṣa, / the wind could not blow; the sky was enclosed by trees.

sanskrit_iast:
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi na śekuśceṣṭituṃ prajāḥ /
tadupaśrutya tapasā sarve yuktāḥ pracetasaḥ //
meaning:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि न शेकुश्चेष्टितुं प्रजाः /
तदुपश्रुत्य तपसा सर्वे युक्ताः प्रचेतसः //
text_mt: For ten thousand years creatures were unable to move about. / Hearing of that, all the Pracetases, endowed with ascetic power,

sanskrit_iast:
mukhebhyo vāyumagniṃ ca sasṛjurjātamanyavaḥ /
unmūlānatha vṛkṣāṃstānkṛtvā vāyuraśoṣayat //
meaning:
मुखेभ्यो वायुमग्निं च ससृजुर्जातमन्यवः /
उन्मूलानथ वृक्षांस्तान्कृत्वा वायुरशोषयत् //
text_mt: emitted wind and fire from their mouths, filled with wrath. / The wind uprooted those trees and dried them up;

sanskrit_iast:
tānagniradahaddhora evamāsīddumakṣayaḥ /
drumakṣayamatho buddhvā kiñcicchiṣṭeṣu śākhiṣu //
meaning:
तानग्निरदहद्धोर एवमासीद्दुमक्षयः /
द्रुमक्षयमथो बुद्ध्वा किञ्चिच्छिष्टेषु शाखिषु //
text_mt: the dreadful fire burnt them down. Thus occurred the destruction of trees. / Then, observing the destruction of trees, when only a few trees remained,

sanskrit_iast:
upagamyābravī detānrājā somaḥ pracetasaḥ /
dṛṣṭvā prayojanaṃ satyaṃ lokasaṃtānakāraṇāt //
meaning:
उपगम्याब्रवी देतान्राजा सोमः प्रचेतसः /
दृष्ट्वा प्रयोजनं सत्यं लोकसंतानकारणात् //
text_mt: King Soma approached those Pracetases and said to them, / seeing the true purpose for the sake of the continuation of the world:

sanskrit_iast:
kopaṃ tyajata rājānaḥ sarve prācīnabarhiṣaḥ /
vṛkṣāḥ kṣityāṃ janiṣyanti śāmyatāmagnimārutau //
meaning:
कोपं त्यजत राजानः सर्वे प्राचीनबर्हिषः /
वृक्षाः क्षित्यां जनिष्यन्ति शाम्यतामग्निमारुतौ //
text_mt: “Relinquish your anger, O kings, all sons of Prācīnabarhis! / Trees will grow upon the earth; let the fire and the wind be calmed.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnabhūtā ca kanyeyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinīḥ /
bhaviṣyajjanatā hyeṣā dhṛtā garbheṇa vai mayā //
meaning:
रत्नभूता च कन्येयं वृक्षाणां वरवर्णिनीः /
भविष्यज्जनता ह्येषा धृता गर्भेण वै मया //
text_mt: And this girl, a jewel of the trees, possessing excellent beauty, / will indeed give birth to future offspring; she has been borne in the womb by me.

sanskrit_iast:
māriṣā nāma nāmnaiṣā vṛkṣaireva vinirmitā /
bhāryā bhavatu vo hyeṣā somagarbhā vivarddhitā //
meaning:
मारिषा नाम नाम्नैषा वृक्षैरेव विनिर्मिता /
भार्या भवतु वो ह्येषा सोमगर्भा विवर्द्धिता //
text_mt: Known by the name of Māriṣā, she was brought forth by the trees themselves. / Let her become your wife, nourished as the embryo of Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmākaṃ tejasārddhena mama cārdhena tejasā /
asyāmutpatsyate vidvāndakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
युष्माकं तेजसार्द्धेन मम चार्धेन तेजसा /
अस्यामुत्पत्स्यते विद्वान्दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: From half of your fiery energy and half of my fiery energy, / in her will be born the wise Prajāpati named Dakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa imāṃ dagdhabhūyiṣṭhāṃ yuṣmattejomayena vai /
agnināgnisamo bhūyaḥ prajāḥ saṃvarddhayiṣyati //
meaning:
स इमां दग्धभूयिष्ठां युष्मत्तेजोमयेन वै /
अग्निनाग्निसमो भूयः प्रजाः संवर्द्धयिष्यति //
text_mt: Equal to fire, he will once again multiply creatures / on this [earth], which has been largely burned by the fire made of your energy.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ somasya vacanājjagṛhuste pracetasaḥ /
saṃtdṛtya kopaṃ vṛkṣebhyaḥ patnīṃ dharmeṇa māriṣām //
meaning:
ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगृहुस्ते प्रचेतसः /
संत्दृत्य कोपं वृक्षेभ्यः पत्नीं धर्मेण मारिषाम् //
text_mt: Then, at the word of Soma, the Pracetases / withdrew their anger from the trees and lawfully accepted Māriṣā as their wife.

sanskrit_iast:
māriṣāyāṃ tataste vai manasā garbhamādadhuḥ /
daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
मारिषायां ततस्ते वै मनसा गर्भमादधुः /
दशभ्यस्तु प्रचेतोभ्यो मारिषायां प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Then they deposited an embryo into Māriṣā through the mind. / From the ten Pracetases, the Prajāpati Dakṣa

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣo jajñe mahātejāḥ somasyāṃśena vīryavān /
asṛjanmanasā tvādau prajā dakṣo 'tha maithunāt //
meaning:
दक्षो जज्ञे महातेजाः सोमस्यांशेन वीर्यवान् /
असृजन्मनसा त्वादौ प्रजा दक्षो ऽथ मैथुनात् //
text_mt: was born in Māriṣā, possessed of great fiery energy and mighty through a portion of Soma. / At first Dakṣa created creatures through the mind, and then through sexual union;

sanskrit_iast:
acarāṃśca carāṃścaiva dvipado 'tha catuṣpadaḥ /
visṛjya manasā dakṣaḥ paścādasṛjata striyaḥ //
meaning:
अचरांश्च चरांश्चैव द्विपदो ऽथ चतुष्पदः /
विसृज्य मनसा दक्षः पश्चादसृजत स्त्रियः //
text_mt: having created the unmoving and the moving, bipeds and quadrupeds through the mind, / Dakṣa afterward created women.

sanskrit_iast:
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayāṃ daśa /
kālasya nayane yuktāḥ saptaviṃśatimindave //
meaning:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयां दश /
कालस्य नयने युक्ताः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे //
text_mt: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / and twenty-seven, engaged in guiding time, to the Moon.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhyo dattvā tato 'nyā vai catasro 'riṣṭanemine /
dve caiva bahuputrāya dve caivāṅgirase tathā //
meaning:
एभ्यो दत्त्वा ततो ऽन्या वै चतस्रो ऽरिष्टनेमिने /
द्वे चैव बहुपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तथा //
text_mt: Having given [these daughters] to them, he then gave four to Ariṣṭanemi, / two to Bahuputra, and two to Aṅgiras,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāmekāṃ kṛśāśvāya tebhyo 'patyaṃ babhūva ha /
antaraṃ cākṣuṣasyātha manoḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu gīyate //
meaning:
कन्यामेकां कृशाश्वाय तेभ्यो ऽपत्यं बभूव ह /
अन्तरं चाक्षुषस्याथ मनोः षष्ठं तु गीयते //
text_mt: and one maiden to Kṛśāśva; offspring were indeed born to them. / And this is sung as the sixth period, that of Manu Cākṣuṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
manorvaivasvatasyāpi saptamasya prajāpateḥ /
vasudevāḥ khagā gāvo nāgā ditijadānavāḥ //
meaning:
मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यापि सप्तमस्य प्रजापतेः /
वसुदेवाः खगा गावो नागा दितिजदानवाः //
text_mt: From [the creation of] the Prajāpati, the seventh Manu Vaivasvata, / gods, Vasus, birds, cows, snakes, sons of Diti, and Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāpsarasaścaiva jajñire 'nyāśca jātayaḥ /
tataḥ prabhṛti loke 'sminprajā maithunasaṃbhavāḥ /
saṃkalpāddarśanātsparśātpūrvāsāṃ sṛṣṭirucyate //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव जज्ञिरे ऽन्याश्च जातयः /
ततः प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रजा मैथुनसंभवाः /
संकल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्पूर्वासां सृष्टिरुच्यते //
text_mt: as well as Gandharvas, Apsarases, and other classes of beings were born. / From that time onward in this world, creatures are born of sexual union; / the creation of earlier ones is said to have occurred through volition, sight, and touch.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣiruvāca
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca devarṣiṇāṃ ca te śubhaḥ /
saṃbhavaḥ kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषिरुवाच
देवानां दानवानां च देवर्षिणां च ते शुभः /
संभवः कथितः पूर्वं दक्षस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt: The sage said: / The auspicious origin of the gods, the Dānavas, and the divine sages, / and of the great-souled Dakṣa, was recounted by you before.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇātprajāpaterjanma dakṣasya kathitaṃ tvayā /
kathaṃ prāce tastvaṃ ca punarlebhe mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
प्राणात्प्रजापतेर्जन्म दक्षस्य कथितं त्वया /
कथं प्राचे तस्त्वं च पुनर्लेभे महातपाः //
text_mt: The birth of the Prajāpati Dakṣa from the breath was recounted by you. / How then did that performer of great austerities obtain the state of a son of Pracetas again?

sanskrit_iast:
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ sūta vyākhyātuṃ tvamihārhasi /
dauhitraścaiva somasya kathaṃ śrvaśuratāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
एतं नः संशयं सूत व्याख्यातुं त्वमिहार्हसि /
दौहित्रश्चैव सोमस्य कथं श्र्वशुरतां गतः //
text_mt: You ought to resolve this doubt of ours here, O sūta: / And how did the daughter’s son of Soma attain the status of being [Soma’s] father-in-law?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
utpattiśca nirodhaśca nityaṃ bhūteṣu sattamāḥ /
ṛṣayo 'tra na suhyanti vidyāvantaśca ye janāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
उत्पत्तिश्च निरोधश्च नित्यं भूतेषु सत्तमाः /
ऋषयो ऽत्र न सुह्यन्ति विद्यावन्तश्च ये जनाः //
text_mt: The sūta said: / Origin and cessation occur continually among living beings, O best among the virtuous; / the sages and people endowed with knowledge are not confused concerning this.

sanskrit_iast:
yuge yuge bhavantyete sarve dakṣādayo dvijāḥ /
punaścaiva nirudhyante vidvāṃstatra na muhyati //
meaning:
युगे युगे भवन्त्येते सर्वे दक्षादयो द्विजाः /
पुनश्चैव निरुध्यन्ते विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति //
text_mt: In age after age, all these [beings], Dakṣa and others, are born, O twice-born ones, / and they are dissolved again; the wise man is not bewildered thereby.

sanskrit_iast:
jyaiṣṭhyakāniṣṭhyamapyeṣāṃ pūrvamāsīddvijottamāḥ /
tapa eva garīyo 'bhūtprabhāvaścaiva kāraṇam //
meaning:
ज्यैष्ठ्यकानिष्ठ्यमप्येषां पूर्वमासीद्द्विजोत्तमाः /
तप एव गरीयो ऽभूत्प्रभावश्चैव कारणम् //
text_mt: Seniority and juniority among them were also present formerly, O best of the twice-born; / asceticism alone was superior, and spiritual power was the determining cause.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ visṛṣṭiṃ yo veda cākṣuṣasya carācaram /
prajāvānāyuṣastīrṇaḥ svargaloke mahīyate //
meaning:
इमां विसृष्टिं यो वेद चाक्षुषस्य चराचरम् /
प्रजावानायुषस्तीर्णः स्वर्गलोके महीयते //
text_mt: He who knows this creation of the moving and unmoving in the time of Cākṣuṣa, / endowed with offspring and having crossed over a full lifespan, is honoured in the heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sargaḥ samākhyātaścākṣuṣasya samāsataḥ /
ityete ṣaṭ nisargāśca krāntā manvantarātmakāḥ //
meaning:
एवं सर्गः समाख्यातश्चाक्षुषस्य समासतः /
इत्येते षट् निसर्गाश्च क्रान्ता मन्वन्तरात्मकाः //
text_mt: Thus the primary creation belonging to Cākṣuṣa has been recounted in brief. / In this way, these six creations, consisting of manvantaras, have passed,

sanskrit_iast:
svāyaṃbhuvādyāḥ saṃkṣepāccāśuṣāntā yathākramam /
ete sargā yathā prājñaiḥ proktā ye dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
स्वायंभुवाद्याः संक्षेपाच्चाशुषान्ता यथाक्रमम् /
एते सर्गा यथा प्राज्ञैः प्रोक्ता ये द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: beginning with Svāyambhuva and ending with Cākṣuṣa in regular succession, in brief. / As these creations have been spoken of by the wise, O best of the twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatanisargeṇa teṣāṃ jñeyastu vistaraḥ /
anyūnānatiriktāste sarve sargā vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
वैवस्वतनिसर्गेण तेषां ज्ञेयस्तु विस्तरः /
अन्यूनानतिरिक्तास्ते सर्वे सर्गा विवस्वतः //
text_mt: their detailed explanation is to be understood through the creation of Vaivasvata. / Neither less nor more are all those creations than the creation of Vivasvat['s son].

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyāyuḥ pramāṇebhyo dharmataḥ kāmator'thataḥ /
etāneva guṇāneti yaḥ paṭhannanasūyakaḥ //
meaning:
आरोग्यायुः प्रमाणेभ्यो धर्मतः कामतोर्ऽथतः /
एतानेव गुणानेति यः पठन्ननसूयकः //
text_mt: With respect to health, lifespan, measurements, righteousness, desire, and wealth, / whoever recites this without malice attains these very virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatasya vakṣyāmi sāṃpratasya mahātmanaḥ /
samāsavyāsataḥ sargaṃ bruvato me nibodhata //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte pūrvabhāge dvitīye 'nuṣaṅgapāde cākṣuṣasargavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
वैवस्वतस्य वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतस्य महात्मनः /
समासव्यासतः सर्गं ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते पूर्वभागे द्वितीये ऽनुषङ्गपादे चाक्षुषसर्गवर्णनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
I shall recount the creation of the great-souled Vaivasvata, the present [Manu], / both in brief and in detail; listen to me as I speak.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, called the Description of the Creation of Cākṣuṣa, in the second section, the Anuṣaṅgapāda, of the first part in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
saptama tvatha paryāye manorvaivasvatasya ha /
mārīcātkaśyapāddevā jajñire paramarṣayaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
सप्तम त्वथ पर्याये मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह /
मारीचात्कश्यपाद्देवा जज्ञिरे परमर्षयः //
text_mt: The sūta said: / In the seventh period, that of Manu Vaivasvata, / the gods and the supreme sages were born from Kaśyapa, son of Marīci:

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā vasavī rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ /
bhṛgavoṃ'girasaścaiva te 'ṣṭhau devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
आदित्या वसवी रुद्राः साध्या विश्वे मरुद्गणाः /
भृगवोंऽगिरसश्चैव ते ऽष्ठौ देवगणाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Sādhyas, Viśvedevas, and troops of Maruts, / the Bhṛgus, and the Aṅgirases—these are remembered as the eight groups of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityā maruto rudrā vijñeyāḥ kaśyapātmajāḥ /
sādhyāśya vasavo viśve dharmaputrāstrayo gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
आदित्या मरुतो रुद्रा विज्ञेयाः कश्यपात्मजाः /
साध्याश्य वसवो विश्वे धर्मपुत्रास्त्रयो गणाः //
text_mt: The Ādityas, Maruts, and Rudras are to be known as the sons of Kaśyapa; / the Sādhyas, Vasus, and Viśvedevas are the three groups that are the sons of Dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgostu bhṛgavo devā hyaṅgirasoṃ'giraḥ sutāḥ /
vaivasvateṃ'tare hyasminnitye te chandajā matāḥ //
meaning:
भृगोस्तु भृगवो देवा ह्यङ्गिरसोंऽगिरः सुताः /
वैवस्वतेंऽतरे ह्यस्मिन्नित्ये ते छन्दजा मताः //
text_mt: The Bhṛgu gods are [the offspring] of Bhṛgu, and the Aṅgirases are the sons of Aṅgiras. / In this present period of Vaivasvata, these are considered born of their own will.

sanskrit_iast:
ete 'pi ca gamiṣyanti mahāntaṃ kālaparyayāt /
evaṃ sargastu mārīco vijñeyaḥ sāṃprataḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
एते ऽपि च गमिष्यन्ति महान्तं कालपर्ययात् /
एवं सर्गस्तु मारीचो विज्ञेयः सांप्रतः शुभः //
text_mt: These too will pass away into the great [dissolution] through the lapse of time. / Thus the present, auspicious creation of [Kaśyapa] son of Marīci is to be understood.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasvī sāṃpratasteṣāmindro nāmnā mahābalaḥ /
atītānāgatā ye ca varttante sāṃprataṃ ca ye //
meaning:
तेजस्वी सांप्रतस्तेषामिन्द्रो नाम्ना महाबलः /
अतीतानागता ये च वर्त्तन्ते सांप्रतं च ये //
text_mt: The Indra of these [gods] at present is radiant and possessed of great strength. / Those [Indras] who are past, those who are future, and those who exist at present—

sanskrit_iast:
sarve manvantaredrāste vijñeyāstulyalakṣaṇāḥ /
bhūtabhavyabhavannāthāḥ sahasrākṣāḥ purandarāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे मन्वन्तरेद्रास्ते विज्ञेयास्तुल्यलक्षणाः /
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथाः सहस्राक्षाः पुरन्दराः //
text_mt: all those Indras of the manvantaras are to be understood as having similar characteristics: / lords of the past, future, and present, thousand-eyed destroyers of strongholds,

sanskrit_iast:
saghavantaścate sarve śṛṅgiṇo vajrapāṇayaḥ /
sarvaiḥ kratuśateneṣṭaṃ pṛthakchataguṇena tu //
meaning:
सघवन्तश्चते सर्वे शृङ्गिणो वज्रपाणयः /
सर्वैः क्रतुशतेनेष्टं पृथक्छतगुणेन तु //
text_mt: all of them powerful, bearing diadems, holding the thunderbolt in their hands; / all of them have sacrificed with a hundred sacrifices, each multiplied a hundredfold.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye yāni sattvāni gatimanti dhruvāṇi ca /
abhibhūyāvatiṣṭhanti dharmādyaiḥ kāraṇairapi //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि सत्त्वानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च /
अभिभूयावतिष्ठन्ति धर्माद्यैः कारणैरपि //
text_mt: Surpassing whatever beings there are in the three worlds, mobile and immobile, / they abide even by causes such as dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā tapasā buddhyā balaśrutaparākramaiḥ /
bhūtabhavyabhavannāthā yathā te prabhaviṣṇavaḥ //
meaning:
तेजसा तपसा बुद्ध्या बलश्रुतपराक्रमैः /
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथा यथा ते प्रभविष्णवः //
text_mt: by splendor, ascetic power, intellect, strength, sacred learning, and valor, / as powerful lords of past, future, and present.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi bruvato me nibodhata /
bhūtabhavyabhavaddhyeta tsamṛtaṃ lokatrayaṃ dvijaiḥ //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत /
भूतभव्यभवद्ध्येत त्समृतं लोकत्रयं द्विजैः //
text_mt: All this I shall explain; understand it from me as I speak. / For this triad of worlds is remembered by the twice-born as past, future, and present.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūrloko 'yaṃ smṛto bhūtamantarikṣaṃ bhavatsmṛtam /
bhavyaṃ smṛtaṃ divaṃ hyetatteṣāṃ vakṣyāmi sādhanam //
meaning:
भूर्लोको ऽयं स्मृतो भूतमन्तरिक्षं भवत्स्मृतम् /
भव्यं स्मृतं दिवं ह्येतत्तेषां वक्ष्यामि साधनम् //
text_mt: This world Bhūḥ is remembered as the past, the atmosphere is remembered as the present, / and heaven is remembered as the future; I shall explain their derivation.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyatā lokanāmāni brahmaṇāgre vibhāṣitam /
bhūriti vyāhṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūrloko 'yamabhūttadā //
meaning:
ध्यायता लोकनामानि ब्रह्मणाग्रे विभाषितम् /
भूरिति व्याहृतं पूर्वं भूर्लोको ऽयमभूत्तदा //
text_mt: As Brahmā was meditating on the names of the worlds, it was spoken at first: / 'Bhūḥ' was uttered previously, and then this world Bhūḥ came to be.

sanskrit_iast:
bhū sattāyāṃ smṛto dhātustathāsau lokadarśane /
bhūtatvāddarśanāccaiva bhūrloko 'yamabhūttataḥ //
meaning:
भू सत्तायां स्मृतो धातुस्तथासौ लोकदर्शने /
भूतत्वाद्दर्शनाच्चैव भूर्लोको ऽयमभूत्ततः //
text_mt: The verbal root *bhū* is remembered in the sense of existence, and likewise in the manifestation of worlds; / because of having existed and being visible, this world Bhūḥ then came to be.

sanskrit_iast:
ato 'yaṃ prathamo loko bhūtatvādbhūrdvajaiḥ smṛtaḥ /
bhūte 'sminbhavadityuktaṃ dvitīyaṃ brahmaṇā punaḥ //
meaning:
अतो ऽयं प्रथमो लोको भूतत्वाद्भूर्द्वजैः स्मृतः /
भूते ऽस्मिन्भवदित्युक्तं द्वितीयं ब्रह्मणा पुनः //
text_mt: Therefore this first world, because of having existed, is remembered by the twice-born as Bhūḥ. / When this came to be, 'Bhavat' ('becoming') was spoken by Brahmā again as the second.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadityatpadyamāne kāle śabdo 'yamucyate /
bhavanāttu bhuvalloko niruttayā hi nirucyate //
meaning:
भवदित्यत्पद्यमाने काले शब्दो ऽयमुच्यते /
भवनात्तु भुवल्लोको निरुत्तया हि निरुच्यते //
text_mt: This word 'Bhavat' is spoken of the time that is presently arising; / and by etymology the world Bhuvaḥ is explained as derived from 'becoming' (*bhavana*).

sanskrit_iast:
antarikṣaṃ bhavattasmāddvitīyo loka ucyate /
utpanne tu tathā loke dvitīye brahmaṇā punaḥ //
meaning:
अन्तरिक्षं भवत्तस्माद्द्वितीयो लोक उच्यते /
उत्पन्ने तु तथा लोके द्वितीये ब्रह्मणा पुनः //
text_mt: Therefore the atmosphere is called 'Bhavat', the second world. / And when the second world was thus produced, by Brahmā again

sanskrit_iast:
bhavyeti vyāhṛtaṃ paścādbhavyo lokastato 'bhavat /
anāgate bhavya ita śabda eṣa vibhāvyate //
meaning:
भव्येति व्याहृतं पश्चाद्भव्यो लोकस्ततो ऽभवत् /
अनागते भव्य इत शब्द एष विभाव्यते //
text_mt: 'Bhavya' was uttered afterward, and thence the world Bhavya arose. / In the sense of what is yet to come, this word 'Bhavya' is conceived.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādbhavyo hyasau loko nāmatastridivaṃ smṛtam /
bhūritīyaṃ smṛtā bhūmirantarikṣaṃ bhuvaḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
तस्माद्भव्यो ह्यसौ लोको नामतस्त्रिदिवं स्मृतम् /
भूरितीयं स्मृता भूमिरन्तरिक्षं भुवः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Therefore that world is Bhavya, remembered by name as heaven. / This earth is remembered as 'Bhūḥ', the atmosphere is remembered as 'Bhuvaḥ',

sanskrit_iast:
divaṃ smṛtaṃ tathā bhavyaṃ tralokyasyaiṣa nirṇayaḥ /
trailokyayuktairvyāhāraistisro vyāhṛtayo 'bhavan //
meaning:
दिवं स्मृतं तथा भव्यं त्रलोक्यस्यैष निर्णयः /
त्रैलोक्ययुक्तैर्व्याहारैस्तिस्रो व्याहृतयो ऽभवन् //
text_mt: and heaven likewise is remembered as 'Bhavya'; this is the determination regarding the three worlds. / Through the utterances connected with the three worlds, the three mystical utterances came to be.

sanskrit_iast:
nātha ityeṣa dhāturvai dhātujñaiḥ pālane smṛtaḥ /
yasmādbhūtasya lokasya bhavyasya bhavatastathā //
meaning:
नाथ इत्येष धातुर्वै धातुज्ञैः पालने स्मृतः /
यस्माद्भूतस्य लोकस्य भव्यस्य भवतस्तथा //
text_mt: The root *nāth* is indeed remembered by knowers of verbal roots in the sense of protecting. / Because they are the lords (*nātha*) of the world past, future, and present,

sanskrit_iast:
lokatrayasya nāthāste tasmādindrādvijaiḥ smṛtāḥ /
pradhānabhūtā devendrā guṇabhūtāstathaiva ca //
meaning:
लोकत्रयस्य नाथास्ते तस्मादिन्द्राद्विजैः स्मृताः /
प्रधानभूता देवेन्द्रा गुणभूतास्तथैव च //
text_mt: they are the lords of the triad of worlds, and therefore they are remembered by the twice-born as Indras. / The Indras of the gods are primary, and they are also secondary.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareṣu ye devā yajñabhājo bhavanti hi /
yajñagandharvarakṣāṃsi piśāco ragamānuṣāḥ //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेषु ये देवा यज्ञभाजो भवन्ति हि /
यज्ञगन्धर्वरक्षांसि पिशाचो रगमानुषाः //
text_mt: The gods who share in sacrifices in the manvantaras, / as well as sacrifices, Gandharvas, Rākṣasas, Piśācas, Uragas, and humans,

sanskrit_iast:
mahimānaḥ smṛtā hyete devendrāṇāṃ tu sarvaśaḥ /
devendrā guravo nāthā rājānaḥ pitaro hi te //
meaning:
महिमानः स्मृता ह्येते देवेन्द्राणां तु सर्वशः /
देवेन्द्रा गुरवो नाथा राजानः पितरो हि ते //
text_mt: these are remembered in every respect as the glories of the Indras of the gods. / For the Indras of the gods are their preceptors, lords, kings, and fathers.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣantīmāḥ prajā hyete dharmeṇeha surottamāḥ /
ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ devendrāṇāṃ samāsataḥ //
meaning:
रक्षन्तीमाः प्रजा ह्येते धर्मेणेह सुरोत्तमाः /
इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं देवेन्द्राणां समासतः //
text_mt: These best of gods protect these creatures with dharma here. / Thus this characteristic of the Indras of the gods has been declared in brief.

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣīnsaṃpravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ ye divaṃ śritāḥ /
gādhijaḥ kauśiko dhīmānviśvāmitro mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
सप्तर्षीन्संप्रवक्ष्यामि सांप्रतं ये दिवं श्रिताः /
गाधिजः कौशिको धीमान्विश्वामित्रो महातपाः //
text_mt: I shall declare the seven sages who at present dwell in heaven: / the son of Gādhi, Kauśika, the wise Viśvāmitra of great ascetic power;

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavo jamadagniśca hyaurvaputraḥ pratāpavān /
bṛhaspatisutaścāpi bharadvājo mahā yaśāḥ //
meaning:
भार्गवो जमदग्निश्च ह्यौर्वपुत्रः प्रतापवान् /
बृहस्पतिसुतश्चापि भरद्वाजो महा यशाः //
text_mt: and the Bhārgava Jamadagni, the glorious son of Ūrva; / and Bharadvāja of great renown, the son of Bṛhaspati;

sanskrit_iast:
autathyo gautamo vidvāñśaradvānnāma dhārmikaḥ /
svāyaṃbhuvo 'trirbhagavānbrahmakośaḥ sapañcamaḥ //
meaning:
औतथ्यो गौतमो विद्वाञ्शरद्वान्नाम धार्मिकः /
स्वायंभुवो ऽत्रिर्भगवान्ब्रह्मकोशः सपञ्चमः //
text_mt: the son of Utathya, the learned and righteous Gautama named Śaradvant; / the divine Atri, son of Svayambhū, the repository of sacred knowledge, as the fifth;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭho vasiṣṭhaputrastu vasumāṃllokaviśrutaḥ /
vatsaraḥ kāśyapaśyaiva saptaite sādhusaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठो वसिष्ठपुत्रस्तु वसुमांल्लोकविश्रुतः /
वत्सरः काश्यपश्यैव सप्तैते साधुसंमताः //
text_mt: the sixth is Vasumān, renowned in the world, son of Vasiṣṭha; / and Vatsara, descendant of Kaśyapa—these seven are approved by the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
ete saptarṣayaśyoktā varttante sāṃprateṃ'tare /
ikṣvākuśca nṛgaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātireba ca //
meaning:
एते सप्तर्षयश्योक्ता वर्त्तन्ते सांप्रतेंऽतरे /
इक्ष्वाकुश्च नृगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेब च //
text_mt: These seven sages are declared to exist in the present interval. / And Ikṣvāku, Nṛga, Dhṛṣṭa, and Śaryāti,

sanskrit_iast:
