rudrāṇī sā tu pravarā svairguṇairatiricyate /
anyonyaprītamanasorumāśaṅkarayoratha //
meaning:
रुद्राणी सा तु प्रवरा स्वैर्गुणैरतिरिच्यते /
अन्योन्यप्रीतमनसोरुमाशङ्करयोरथ //
text_mt:
Rudrāṇī, however, being superior, excelled by her own qualities.
Then, when Umā and Śaṅkara were mutually delighted in mind,

sanskrit_iast:
śleṣaṃ saṃsaktayorjñātvā śaṅkitaḥ kila vṛtrahā /
tābhyāṃ maithunaśaktābhyāmapatyodbhavabhīruṇā //
meaning:
श्लेषं संसक्तयोर्ज्ञात्वा शङ्कितः किल वृत्रहा /
ताभ्यां मैथुनशक्ताभ्यामपत्योद्भवभीरुणा //
text_mt:
knowing the embrace of the two who were clinging together, the slayer of Vṛtra was alarmed,
fearful of the arising of offspring from the two capable of union.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ sakāśamindreṇa preṣito havyavāhanaḥ /
anāyo rativighnaṃ ca tvamācara hutāśana //
meaning:
तयोः सकाशमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो हव्यवाहनः /
अनायो रतिविघ्नं च त्वमाचर हुताशन //
text_mt: The bearer of oblations was sent to the two of them by Indra: / 'Bring an end to their dalliance, O fire-eater!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra gata eva tvaṃ na doṣo vidyate tava /
ityevamukte tu tadā vahninā ca tathā kṛtam //
meaning:
सर्वत्र गत एव त्वं न दोषो विद्यते तव /
इत्येवमुक्ते तु तदा वह्निना च तथा कृतम् //
text_mt: You go everywhere indeed; no fault attaches to you.' / When it was thus spoken, fire then acted accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
umāṃ devaḥ samutsṛjya śukraṃ bhūmau vyasarjayat /
tato ruṣitayā sadyaḥ śapto 'gnirumayā tayā //
meaning:
उमां देवः समुत्सृज्य शुक्रं भूमौ व्यसर्जयत् /
ततो रुषितया सद्यः शप्तो ऽग्निरुमया तया //
text_mt: Letting go of Umā, the god discharged his semen upon the earth. / Then, enraged immediately, she, Umā, cursed Agni:

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ coktavatī vahniṃ roṣagadgadayā girā /
yasmānnāvavitṛptābhyāṃ rativighnaṃ hutāśana //
meaning:
इदं चोक्तवती वह्निं रोषगद्गदया गिरा /
यस्मान्नाववितृप्ताभ्यां रतिविघ्नं हुताशन //
text_mt: And in a voice faltering with anger, she spoke this to fire: / 'Because you made an obstacle to our dalliance when we were unsated, O fire-eater,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtavānasya karttavyaṃ tasmāttvamasi durmatiḥ /
yadevaṃ vigataṃ garbhaṃ raudraṃ śukraṃ mahāprabham //
meaning:
कृतवानस्य कर्त्तव्यं तस्मात्त्वमसि दुर्मतिः /
यदेवं विगतं गर्भं रौद्रं शुक्रं महाप्रभम् //
text_mt: and performed what was not to be done, therefore you are evil-minded. / Because this fetus has departed—the semen of Rudra of great splendour—

sanskrit_iast:
garbhe tvaṃ dhārayasvaivameṣā te daṇḍadhāraṇā /
sa śāpadoṣādrudrāṇyā antargarbho hutāśanaḥ //
meaning:
गर्भे त्वं धारयस्वैवमेषा ते दण्डधारणा /
स शापदोषाद्रुद्राण्या अन्तर्गर्भो हुताशनः //
text_mt: you yourself shall bear it in your womb; this is your punishment.' / By the fault of the curse of Rudra's wife, the fire-eater had a fetus within him.

sanskrit_iast:
bahūnvarṣagaṇāngarbhaṃ dhārayāmāsa vai dvija /
sa gaṅgāmabhigamyāha śrūyatāṃ sariduttame //
meaning:
बहून्वर्षगणान्गर्भं धारयामास वै द्विज /
स गङ्गामभिगम्याह श्रूयतां सरिदुत्तमे //
text_mt: He bore the fetus for many groups of years, O twice-born. / Approaching the Gaṅgā, he said: 'Listen, best of rivers!

sanskrit_iast:
sumahānparikhedo me jāyate garbhadhāraṇāt /
maddhitārtha matho garbhamimaṃ dhāraya nimnage //
meaning:
सुमहान्परिखेदो मे जायते गर्भधारणात् /
मद्धितार्थ मथो गर्भमिमं धारय निम्नगे //
text_mt: A very great exhaustion arises in me from bearing the fetus. / Now, for my welfare, bear this fetus, O river!

sanskrit_iast:
matprasādācca tanayo varadaste bhaviṣyati /
tathetyuktvā tadā sā tu saṃpratdṛṣṭā mahānadī //
meaning:
मत्प्रसादाच्च तनयो वरदस्ते भविष्यति /
तथेत्युक्त्वा तदा सा तु संप्रत्दृष्टा महानदी //
text_mt: And by my grace, the son will become a granter of boons to you.' / Saying 'So be it', that great river, delighted then,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ garbhaṃ dhārayāmāsa dahyamānena cetasā /
sāpi kṛcchreṇa mahatā khidyamānā mahānadī //
meaning:
तं गर्भं धारयामास दह्यमानेन चेतसा /
सापि कृच्छ्रेण महता खिद्यमाना महानदी //
text_mt: bore that fetus with a burning mind. / She too, the great river, troubled with great distress,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛṣṭaṃ vyasṛjadgarbhaṃ dīpyamāna mivānalam /
rudrāgnigaṅgātanayastatra jāto 'ruṇaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकृष्टं व्यसृजद्गर्भं दीप्यमान मिवानलम् /
रुद्राग्निगङ्गातनयस्तत्र जातो ऽरुणप्रभः //
text_mt: cast out the mature fetus, blazing like fire. / There the son of Rudra, Agni, and Gaṅgā was born, shining like the dawn,

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaśatasaṃkāśo mahātejāḥ pratāpavān /
tasmiñjāte mahābhāge kumāre jāhnavīsute //
meaning:
आदित्यशतसंकाशो महातेजाः प्रतापवान् /
तस्मिञ्जाते महाभागे कुमारे जाह्नवीसुते //
text_mt: resembling a hundred suns, endowed with great splendor and valour. / When that fortunate youth, the son of the Gaṅgā, was born,

sanskrit_iast:
vimānayānairākāśaṃ patatrribhirivāvṛtam /
devadundubhayo nedurākāśe madhurasvanāḥ //
meaning:
विमानयानैराकाशं पतत्र्रिभिरिवावृतम् /
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुराकाशे मधुरस्वनाः //
text_mt: the sky was covered with celestial chariots as if with birds. / Divine drums sounded sweet tones in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ ca khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ /
jagurgandharvamukhyāśca sarvaśastatra tatra ha //
meaning:
मुमुचुः पुष्पवर्षं च खेचराः सिद्धचारणाः /
जगुर्गन्धर्वमुख्याश्च सर्वशस्तत्र तत्र ह //
text_mt: Sky-goers, Siddhas, and Cāraṇas released a shower of flowers, / and chief Gandharvas sang everywhere in that place.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhāḥ kinnarāścaiva sarvaśaḥ /
mahānāgasahasrāṇi pravarāśca patatrriṇaḥ //
meaning:
यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धाः किन्नराश्चैव सर्वशः /
महानागसहस्राणि प्रवराश्च पतत्र्रिणः //
text_mt: Yakṣas, Vidyādharas, Siddhas, and Kinnaras on every side, / thousands of great serpents, and excellent birds

sanskrit_iast:
upatasthurmahābhāgamāgneyaṃ śaṅkarātmajam /
prabhāveṇa hatāstena daityavānararākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
उपतस्थुर्महाभागमाग्नेयं शङ्करात्मजम् /
प्रभावेण हतास्तेन दैत्यवानरराक्षसाः //
text_mt: attended upon the fortunate offspring of Agni, the son of Śaṅkara. / By his splendour, Daityas, monkeys, and Rākṣasas were slain.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi saptarṣibhāryābhirārādevāgnisaṃbhavaḥ /
abhiṣekaprayātābhirdṛṣṭo varjya tvarundhatīm //
meaning:
स हि सप्तर्षिभार्याभिरारादेवाग्निसंभवः /
अभिषेकप्रयाताभिर्दृष्टो वर्ज्य त्वरुन्धतीम् //
text_mt: Indeed, born of Agni, he was seen from near at hand by the wives of the Seven Sages / who had gone for an ablution, Arundhatī alone excepted.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiḥ sa bālārkanibho raudraḥ parivṛtaḥ prabhuḥ /
snihyamānābhiratyarthaṃ svakabhiriva mātṛbhiḥ //
meaning:
ताभिः स बालार्कनिभो रौद्रः परिवृतः प्रभुः /
स्निह्यमानाभिरत्यर्थं स्वकभिरिव मातृभिः //
text_mt: He, the lord, resembling the morning sun and fierce, was surrounded by them / who felt excessive affection for him, as if they were his own mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
yugapatsarvadevībhirdidhitsurjāhnavīṃ sutaḥ /
ṣaṇmukhānyasṛjacchrīmāṃstenāyaṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
युगपत्सर्वदेवीभिर्दिधित्सुर्जाह्नवीं सुतः /
षण्मुखान्यसृजच्छ्रीमांस्तेनायं षण्मुखः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Wishing to nurse from all the goddesses simultaneously, the glorious son of Gaṅgā / brought forth six faces; therefore he is remembered as the Six-Faced One (Ṣaṇmukha).

sanskrit_iast:
tena jātena mahātā devānāmasahiṣṇavaḥ /
skanditā dānavagaṇāstasmātskandaḥ pratāpavān //
meaning:
तेन जातेन महाता देवानामसहिष्णवः /
स्कन्दिता दानवगणास्तस्मात्स्कन्दः प्रतापवान् //
text_mt: When he was born, the hordes of Dānavas who could not tolerate the gods / were shattered (skandita) by the great one; therefore he is the valiant Skanda.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikābhistu yasmātsa varddhito hi purātanaḥ /
kārttikeya iti khyātastasmādasurasūdanaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्तिकाभिस्तु यस्मात्स वर्द्धितो हि पुरातनः /
कार्त्तिकेय इति ख्यातस्तस्मादसुरसूदनः //
text_mt: Because he, the ancient one, was nourished by the Kṛttikās, / he was renowned as Kārttikeya, the slayer of the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
jṛṃbhatastasya daityārerjvālā mālākulā tadā /
mukhādvinirgatā tasya svaśaktiraparājitā //
meaning:
जृंभतस्तस्य दैत्यारेर्ज्वाला मालाकुला तदा /
मुखाद्विनिर्गता तस्य स्वशक्तिरपराजिता //
text_mt: As the enemy of the Daityas yawned, then, filled with a garland of flames, / his own invincible spear (śakti) issued forth from his mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍārthaṃ caiva skandasya viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā /
garuḍādatisṛṣṭau hi pakṣiṇau dvau prabhadrakau //
meaning:
क्रीडार्थं चैव स्कन्दस्य विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना /
गरुडादतिसृष्टौ हि पक्षिणौ द्वौ प्रभद्रकौ //
text_mt: And for the play of Skanda, two very auspicious birds / were given by powerful Viṣṇu from Garuḍa:

sanskrit_iast:
mayūraḥ kukkuṭaścaiva patākā caiva vāyunā /
yasya dattā sarasvatyā mahāvīṇā mahāsvanā //
meaning:
मयूरः कुक्कुटश्चैव पताका चैव वायुना /
यस्य दत्ता सरस्वत्या महावीणा महास्वना //
text_mt: a peacock and a rooster; and a banner by Vāyu; / by Sarasvatī was given a great lute of great sound;

sanskrit_iast:
ajaḥ svayaṃbhuvā datto meṣo dattaśca śaṃbhunā /
māyāviharaṇe vipra girau kraiñce nipātite //
meaning:
अजः स्वयंभुवा दत्तो मेषो दत्तश्च शंभुना /
मायाविहरणे विप्र गिरौ क्रैञ्चे निपातिते //
text_mt: a goat was given by Svayambhū, and a ram was given by Śambhu. / When mountain Krauñca was brought down during the play of illusion, O brāhmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
tārake cāsuravare samudīrṇe nipātite /
seṃdropendrairmahābhāgairdevairagnisutaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
तारके चासुरवरे समुदीर्णे निपातिते /
सेंद्रोपेन्द्रैर्महाभागैर्देवैरग्निसुतः प्रभुः //
text_mt: and the arrogant Tāraka, best of Asuras, was overthrown, / the lord, the son of Agni, was consecrated to the generalship

sanskrit_iast:
senāpatyena daityārirabhiṣiktaḥ pratāpavān /
devasenāpatistveṣa paṭhyate suranāyakaḥ //
meaning:
सेनापत्येन दैत्यारिरभिषिक्तः प्रतापवान् /
देवसेनापतिस्त्वेष पठ्यते सुरनायकः //
text_mt: by the fortunate gods led by Indra and Upendra. / This valiant enemy of the Daityas, leader of the gods, is recited as the general of the army of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
devāriskandanaḥ skandaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ /
pramathairvidhairdevastathā bhūtagaṇairapi //
meaning:
देवारिस्कन्दनः स्कन्दः सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः /
प्रमथैर्विधैर्देवस्तथा भूतगणैरपि //
text_mt: he is Skanda, the slayer of the enemies of the gods, the lord and ruler of all worlds. / [Surrounded] by various Pramathas, gods, and hordes of spirits,

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛbhirvividhābhiśca vināyakagaṇaistataḥ /
lokāḥ somapadā nāma marīceryatra vai sutāḥ //
meaning:
मातृभिर्विविधाभिश्च विनायकगणैस्ततः /
लोकाः सोमपदा नाम मरीचेर्यत्र वै सुताः //
text_mt: and by various mothers, and then by hosts of Vināyakas. / There are worlds named Somapadā, where indeed the sons of Marīci [dwell].

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te divi varttante devāstānpūjayantyuta /
śrutā barhiṣado nāma pitaraḥ somapāstu te //
meaning:
तत्र ते दिवि वर्त्तन्ते देवास्तान्पूजयन्त्युत /
श्रुता बर्हिषदो नाम पितरः सोमपास्तु ते //
text_mt: There in heaven they reside, and the gods worship them too; / they are renowned as the Barhiṣads, ancestors (pitaraḥ) who drink soma.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā acchodā nāma nimnagā /
acchaudaṃ nāma taddivyaṃ saro yasmātsamutthitā //
meaning:
एतेषां मानसी कन्या अच्छोदा नाम निम्नगा /
अच्छौदं नाम तद्दिव्यं सरो यस्मात्समुत्थिता //
text_mt: Their mind-born daughter was the river named Acchodā, / because she arose from that divine lake named Acchoda.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā na dṛṣṭapūrvāstu vitaraste kadācana /
saṃbhūtā mānasī teṣāṃ pitṝnsvānnābhijānatī //
meaning:
तथा न दृष्टपूर्वास्तु वितरस्ते कदाचन /
संभूता मानसी तेषां पितॄन्स्वान्नाभिजानती //
text_mt: Yet she had never before seen those ancestors; / being mind-born of them, she did not recognise her own ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tvanyaṃ pitaraṃ vavre tānatikramya vai pitṝn /
amāvasumiti khyātamailaputraṃ nabhaścaram //
meaning:
सा त्वन्यं पितरं वव्रे तानतिक्रम्य वै पितॄन् /
अमावसुमिति ख्यातमैलपुत्रं नभश्चरम् //
text_mt: Passing over those ancestors, she chose another father, / the sky-traveller celebrated as Amāvasu, son of Ilā,

sanskrit_iast:
adrikāpsarasā yuktaṃ vimānādhiṣṭhitaṃ divi /
sā tena vyabhicāreṇa gagane nāprajāriṇī //
meaning:
अद्रिकाप्सरसा युक्तं विमानाधिष्ठितं दिवि /
सा तेन व्यभिचारेण गगने नाप्रजारिणी //
text_mt: who was accompanied by the apsaras Adrikā and seated in a celestial chariot in the sky. / By that transgression, she, not propagating in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ prārthayitvānyaṃ yogabhraṣṭā papāta ha /
trīṇyavaśyadvimānāni patantī sā divaścyutā //
meaning:
पितरं प्रार्थयित्वान्यं योगभ्रष्टा पपात ह /
त्रीण्यवश्यद्विमानानि पतन्ती सा दिवश्च्युता //
text_mt: having solicited another as father, fell down, fallen from yoga. / Falling, dropped from heaven, she saw three celestial chariots

sanskrit_iast:
trasareṇupramāṇāni teṣu cāvasthitānpitṝn /
susūkṣmānaparivyaktānagnīnagniṣvivāhitān //
meaning:
त्रसरेणुप्रमाणानि तेषु चावस्थितान्पितॄन् /
सुसूक्ष्मानपरिव्यक्तानग्नीनग्निष्विवाहितान् //
text_mt: the size of motes of dust, and the ancestors stationed in them, / extremely subtle, unmanifest, like fires laid into fires.

sanskrit_iast:
trāyadhvamityuvācārtā patatī cāpyavākśirāḥ /
tairukā sā tu mā bhaiṣī rityato 'dhiṣṭhitābhavat //
meaning:
त्रायध्वमित्युवाचार्ता पतती चाप्यवाक्शिराः /
तैरुका सा तु मा भैषी रित्यतो ऽधिष्ठिताभवत् //
text_mt: Distressed and falling headlong, she cried out: 'Protect me!' / Addressed by them with 'Do not fear!', she became steady.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasādayatsā vai sīdantī tvanayā girā /
ūcuste pitaraḥ kanyāṃ bhraṣṭaiśvaryāṃ vyatikramāt //
meaning:
ततः प्रसादयत्सा वै सीदन्ती त्वनया गिरा /
ऊचुस्ते पितरः कन्यां भ्रष्टैश्वर्यां व्यतिक्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, sinking down, she propitiated them with this speech. / Those ancestors spoke to the maiden who had fallen from her sovereignty through transgression:

sanskrit_iast:
bhraṣṭaiśvaryāṃ svadoṣeṇa patasi tvaṃ śucismite /
yairācaranti karmaṇi śarīrairiha devatāḥ //
meaning:
भ्रष्टैश्वर्यां स्वदोषेण पतसि त्वं शुचिस्मिते /
यैराचरन्ति कर्मणि शरीरैरिह देवताः //
text_mt: 'Fallen from your sovereignty by your own fault, you fall, O sweet-smiling one! / By whatever bodies deities perform actions here,

sanskrit_iast:
taireva tatkarmabhalaṃ prāpnuvanti sadā sma ha /
sadyaḥ phalanti karmāṇi devatve pretya mānuṣe //
meaning:
तैरेव तत्कर्मभलं प्राप्नुवन्ति सदा स्म ह /
सद्यः फलन्ति कर्माणि देवत्वे प्रेत्य मानुषे //
text_mt: by those very bodies they constantly attain the fruit of that action. / In godhead, actions bear fruit immediately; in human state, after death.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsvatapasaḥ putri pretya saṃprāpsyase phalam /
ityuktayā tu pitaraḥ punaste tu prasāditāḥ //
dhyātvā prasādaṃ te cakrustasyāstadanukaṃpayā /
avaśyaṃ bhāvinaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyarthamūcustadā tu tām //
meaning:
तस्मात्स्वतपसः पुत्रि प्रेत्य संप्राप्स्यसे फलम् /
इत्युक्तया तु पितरः पुनस्ते तु प्रसादिताः //
ध्यात्वा प्रसादं ते चक्रुस्तस्यास्तदनुकंपया /
अवश्यं भाविनं दृष्ट्वा ह्यर्थमूचुस्तदा तु ताम् //
text_mt:
Therefore, O daughter, you will attain the fruit of your own austerity after death.' / When she was thus addressed, those ancestors were propitiated by her again.

Having meditated, out of compassion for her they granted favour to her; / seeing the inevitable matter, they then said to her:

sanskrit_iast:
somapāḥ pitaraḥ kanyāṃ rajño 'syaiva tvamāvasoḥ /
utpannasya pṛthivyāṃ tu mānuṣeṣu mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सोमपाः पितरः कन्यां रज्ञो ऽस्यैव त्वमावसोः /
उत्पन्नस्य पृथिव्यां तु मानुषेषु महात्मनः //
text_mt: The soma-drinking ancestors [said]: 'Becoming a maiden of this very king Amāvasu, / the great-souled one born on earth among humans,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā bhūtvā tvimāṃllokānpunaḥ prāpsyasi bhāmini /
aṣṭāviṃśe bhavitrī tvaṃ dvāpare matsyayonijā //
meaning:
कन्या भूत्वा त्विमांल्लोकान्पुनः प्राप्स्यसि भामिनि /
अष्टाविंशे भवित्री त्वं द्वापरे मत्स्ययोनिजा //
text_mt: you will attain these worlds again, O splendid woman! / In the twenty-eighth Dvāpara [yuga], you will be born from a fish's womb,

sanskrit_iast:
asyaiva rājño duhitā hyadrikāyāmamāvasoḥ /
parāśarasya dāyādamṛṣiṃ tvaṃ janayiṣyasi //
meaning:
अस्यैव राज्ञो दुहिता ह्यद्रिकायाममावसोः /
पराशरस्य दायादमृषिं त्वं जनयिष्यसि //
text_mt: the daughter of this very king Amāvasu by Adrikā. / You will give birth to a sage, the heir of Parāśara;

sanskrit_iast:
sa vedamekaṃ brahmarṣi ścaturddhā vibhajiṣyati /
mahābhiṣasya putrau dvau śantanoḥ kīrttivarddhanau //
meaning:
स वेदमेकं ब्रह्मर्षि श्चतुर्द्धा विभजिष्यति /
महाभिषस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ शन्तनोः कीर्त्तिवर्द्धनौ //
text_mt: he, the brāhmaṇa sage, will divide the single Veda into four. / You will give birth to the two sons of Śantanu, son of Mahābhiṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitravīryaṃ dharmajñaṃ tvamevotpādayiṣyasi /
citrāṅgadaṃ ca rājānaṃ sarvasattvabalānvitam //
meaning:
विचित्रवीर्यं धर्मज्ञं त्वमेवोत्पादयिष्यसि /
चित्राङ्गदं च राजानं सर्वसत्त्वबलान्वितम् //
text_mt: who increase his fame: Vicitravīrya, knower of dharma, / and King Citrāṅgada, endowed with the strength of all creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
etānutpādayitvātha punarlokānavā psyasi /
vyabhicārātpitṝṇāṃ tvaṃ prāpsyase janma kutsitam //
meaning:
एतानुत्पादयित्वाथ पुनर्लोकानवा प्स्यसि /
व्यभिचारात्पितॄणां त्वं प्राप्स्यसे जन्म कुत्सितम् //
text_mt: Having brought them forth, you will then reach [these] worlds again. / Because of transgression against the ancestors, you will attain a despised birth.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva rājñastvaṃ kanyā adrikāyāṃ bhaviṣyasi /
kanyā bhūtvā tataśca tvamimāṃllokānavāpsyasi //
meaning:
तस्यैव राज्ञस्त्वं कन्या अद्रिकायां भविष्यसि /
कन्या भूत्वा ततश्च त्वमिमांल्लोकानवाप्स्यसि //
text_mt: "You shall become the daughter of that very king, [born] of Adrikā. / Having become a daughter, you shall then attain these worlds."

sanskrit_iast:
evamukatvā tu dāśeyī jātā satyavatī tu sā /
adrikāyāḥ sutā matsyā sutā jātā hyamāvasoḥ //
meaning:
एवमुकत्वा तु दाशेयी जाता सत्यवती तु सा /
अद्रिकायाः सुता मत्स्या सुता जाता ह्यमावसोः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, she was born as a fisherman's daughter, namely Satyavatī; / born of Adrikā as a fish, she was indeed the daughter of Amāvasu.

sanskrit_iast:
adikāmatsyasaṃbhūtā gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame /
tasyā rājño hi sā kanyā rājño vīryeṇa caiva hi //
meaning:
अदिकामत्स्यसंभूता गङ्गायमुनसंगमे /
तस्या राज्ञो हि सा कन्या राज्ञो वीर्येण चैव हि //
text_mt: She was born of the fish Adrikā at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā; / she was indeed that king's daughter, [born] through the semen of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
virajānāma te lokā divi rocanti te gaṇāḥ /
agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāstatra pitaro bhāskaraprabhāḥ pulahasya prajāpateḥ /
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā pīvarī nāma viśrutā //
meaning:
विरजानाम ते लोका दिवि रोचन्ति ते गणाः /
अग्निष्वात्ताः स्मृतास्तत्र पितरो भास्करप्रभाः पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः /
एतेषां मानसी कन्या पीवरी नाम विश्रुता //
text_mt: Virajā is the name of their worlds; those hosts shine in heaven. / The Agniṣvāttas are remembered as the Pitṛs there, radiant as the sun, [sons] of Prajāpati Pulaha. / Their mind-born daughter is renowned by the name Pīvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginī yogapatnī ca yogamātā tathaiva ca /
bhavitā dvāparaṃ prāpya aṣṭāviṃśatimeva tu //
meaning:
योगिनी योगपत्नी च योगमाता तथैव च /
भविता द्वापरं प्राप्य अष्टाविंशतिमेव तु //
text_mt: She will be a yoginī, the wife of a yogin, and likewise the mother of yoga, / having reached the twenty-eighth Dvāpara [yuga].

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmānvyāso mahāyogī yogastasmindvijottamāḥ /
vyāsādaraṇyāṃ saṃbhūto vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीमान्व्यासो महायोगी योगस्तस्मिन्द्विजोत्तमाः /
व्यासादरण्यां संभूतो विधूम इव पावकः //
text_mt: The glorious Vyāsa is a great yogin; yoga abides in him, O best of Brahmins. / Born from Vyāsa upon the fire-stick, like fire without smoke,

sanskrit_iast:
parāśarakulodbhūtaḥ śuko nāma mahātapāḥ /
sa tasyāṃ pitṛkanyāyāṃ pīvaryāṃ janayadvibhuḥ //
meaning:
पराशरकुलोद्भूतः शुको नाम महातपाः /
स तस्यां पितृकन्यायां पीवर्यां जनयद्विभुः //
text_mt: is Śuka of great austerities, born in the family of Parāśara. / That lord begot upon that daughter of the Pitṛs, Pīvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
putrānpañca yogacaryāpariburṇānpariśrutān /
kṛṣṇā gauraṃ prabhuṃ śaṃbhuṃ tathā bhūriśrutaṃ ca vai //
meaning:
पुत्रान्पञ्च योगचर्यापरिबुर्णान्परिश्रुतान् /
कृष्णा गौरं प्रभुं शंभुं तथा भूरिश्रुतं च वै //
text_mt: five sons, celebrated and accomplished in the practice of yoga: / Kṛṣṇa, Gaura, Prabhu, Śambhu, and indeed Bhūriśruta,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ kīrtimatīṃ caiva yoginīṃ yogamātaram /
brahmadattasya cananī mahiṣī tvaṇuhasya sā //
meaning:
कन्यां कीर्तिमतीं चैव योगिनीं योगमातरम् /
ब्रह्मदत्तस्य चननी महिषी त्वणुहस्य सा //
text_mt: and also a daughter, Kīrtimatī, a yoginī and mother of yoga; / she was the mother of Brahmadatta and the queen of Aṇuha.

sanskrit_iast:
ādityakiraṇopetamapunarmārgamāsthitaḥ /
sarvavyāpī vinirmukto bhaviṣyati mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
आदित्यकिरणोपेतमपुनर्मार्गमास्थितः /
सर्वव्यापी विनिर्मुक्तो भविष्यति महामुनिः //
text_mt: Resting upon the path of no-return along with the sun's rays, / all-pervading and fully liberated, that great sage will abide.

sanskrit_iast:
traya ete gāṇāḥ proktāścatuḥ śeṣānnibodhata /
tānvakṣyāmi dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prabhāmūrttimato gaṇān //
meaning:
त्रय एते गाणाः प्रोक्ताश्चतुः शेषान्निबोधत /
तान्वक्ष्यामि द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रभामूर्त्तिमतो गणान् //
text_mt: These three hosts have been declared; learn now of the remaining four. / I shall speak to you, O best of Brahmins, of those hosts possessing form and radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
utpannāstu svadhāyāṃ te kāvyā hyagneḥ kaveḥ sutāḥ /
pitaro devalokeṣu jyotirbhāsiṣu bhāsvarāḥ //
meaning:
उत्पन्नास्तु स्वधायां ते काव्या ह्यग्नेः कवेः सुताः /
पितरो देवलोकेषु ज्योतिर्भासिषु भास्वराः //
text_mt: Born of Svadhā, they are the Kāvyas, the sons of the fire Kavi; / they are radiant Pitṛs in the worlds of the gods shining with light.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddheṣu dvijāstānbhāvayantyuta /
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yogotpattiritiśrutā //
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु द्विजास्तान्भावयन्त्युत /
एतेषां मानसी कन्या योगोत्पत्तिरितिश्रुता //
text_mt: In worlds rich with all desires, Brahmins meditate upon them. / Their mind-born daughter is famed as Yogotpatti.

sanskrit_iast:
dattā sanatkumāreṇa śukrasya mahiṣī tu yā /
ekaśṛṅgeti vikhyātā bhṛgūṇāṃ kīrtivarddhinī //
meaning:
दत्ता सनत्कुमारेण शुक्रस्य महिषी तु या /
एकशृङ्गेति विख्याता भृगूणां कीर्तिवर्द्धिनी //
text_mt: Given by Sanatkumāra, she was the chief queen of Śukra; / renowned as Ekaśṛṅgā, she enhanced the fame of the Bhṛgus.

sanskrit_iast:
marīci garbhāste lokāḥ samāvṛtya divi sthitāḥ /
ete hyaṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ sādhyaiḥ saṃvarddhitāḥ purā //
meaning:
मरीचि गर्भास्ते लोकाः समावृत्य दिवि स्थिताः /
एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पुत्राः साध्यैः संवर्द्धिताः पुरा //
text_mt: Their worlds are the Marīcigarbhas, encompassing and situated in heaven. / These were the sons of Aṅgiras, nurtured by the Sādhyas in former times.

sanskrit_iast:
upahūtāḥ smṛtāste vai pitaro bhāsvarā divi /
tānkṣatriyagaṇāḥ sapta bhāvayanti phalārthinaḥ //
meaning:
उपहूताः स्मृतास्ते वै पितरो भास्वरा दिवि /
तान्क्षत्रियगणाः सप्त भावयन्ति फलार्थिनः //
text_mt: They are remembered as the Upahūtas, shining Pitṛs in heaven. / The seven classes of Kṣatriyas, desiring fruits, meditate upon them.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā yaśodā nāma viśrutā /
matā yā jananī devī khaṭvāṅgasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
एतेषां मानसी कन्या यशोदा नाम विश्रुता /
मता या जननी देवी खट्वाङ्गस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: Their mind-born daughter is renowned by the name Yaśodā; / that goddess is considered the mother of the great-souled Khaṭvāṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñe yasya purā gītā gāthāgītairmaharṣibhiḥ /
agnerjanma tadā dṛṣṭvā śāṇḍilyasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञे यस्य पुरा गीता गाथागीतैर्महर्षिभिः /
अग्नेर्जन्म तदा दृष्ट्वा शाण्डिल्यस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: at whose sacrifice a song was formerly sung by great ṛṣis singing verses, / having then witnessed the birth of the fire of the great-souled Śāṇḍilya:

sanskrit_iast:
yajamānaṃ dilīpaṃ ye paśyantyatra samāhitāḥ /
satyavrataṃ mahātmānaṃ te 'pi svargajito narāḥ //
meaning:
यजमानं दिलीपं ये पश्यन्त्यत्र समाहिताः /
सत्यव्रतं महात्मानं ते ऽपि स्वर्गजितो नराः //
text_mt: "Those men who, with concentrated minds, behold here Dilīpa as the sacrificer, / the great-souled one of true vow, they too have conquered heaven."

sanskrit_iast:
ājyapā nāma pitaraḥ kardamasya prajā pateḥ /
samutpannasya pulahādutpannāstasya te sutāḥ //
meaning:
आज्यपा नाम पितरः कर्दमस्य प्रजा पतेः /
समुत्पन्नस्य पुलहादुत्पन्नास्तस्य ते सुताः //
text_mt: The Pitṛs named Ājyapas belong to Prajāpati Kardama; / born of Pulaha, they are his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
lakiṣu teṣu vaivartāḥ kāmagoṣu vihaṅgamāḥ /
etānvaiśyagaṇāḥ śrāddhe bhāva yanti phalārthinaḥ //
meaning:
लकिषु तेषु वैवर्ताः कामगोषु विहङ्गमाः /
एतान्वैश्यगणाः श्राद्धे भाव यन्ति फलार्थिनः //
text_mt: In those worlds they are the Vaivartas, moving at will as winged ones. / The classes of Vaiśyas, desiring fruits, meditate upon them at a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā virajā nāma viśrutā /
yayāterjananī sādhvī patnī sā nahuṣasya ca //
meaning:
एतेषां मानसी कन्या विरजा नाम विश्रुता /
ययातेर्जननी साध्वी पत्नी सा नहुषस्य च //
text_mt: Their mind-born daughter is renowned by the name Virajā; / that virtuous woman was the mother of Yayāti and the wife of Nahuṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sukālā nāma pitaro vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ /
hairaṇyagarbhasya sutāḥ śūdrāstāṃ bhāvayantyuta //
meaning:
सुकाला नाम पितरो वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः /
हैरण्यगर्भस्य सुताः शूद्रास्तां भावयन्त्युत //
text_mt: The Pitṛs named Sukālas are [the sons] of the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, / sons of Hiraṇyagarbha; Śūdras meditate upon them.

sanskrit_iast:
mānasā nāma te lokā vartante yatra te divi /
eteṣāṃ mānasī kanyā narmadā saritāṃ varā //
meaning:
मानसा नाम ते लोका वर्तन्ते यत्र ते दिवि /
एतेषां मानसी कन्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा //
text_mt: Mānasas is the name of those worlds where they abide in heaven. / Their mind-born daughter is Narmadā, the best of rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
sā bhāvayati bhūtāni dakṣiṇāpathagāminī /
jananī sātrasaddasyoḥ purukutsaparigrahaḥ //
meaning:
सा भावयति भूतानि दक्षिणापथगामिनी /
जननी सात्रसद्दस्योः पुरुकुत्सपरिग्रहः //
text_mt: Flowing to the southern region, she nourishes living beings; / she is the mother of Trasadasyu and the wife of Purukutsa.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmabhyupagamānmanurmanvantareśvaraḥ /
manvantarādau śrāddhāni pravartayati sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
एतेषामभ्युपगमान्मनुर्मन्वन्तरेश्वरः /
मन्वन्तरादौ श्राद्धानि प्रवर्तयति सर्वशः //
text_mt: By virtue of their agreement, Manu, the lord of the manvantara, / institutes śrāddhas in every way at the beginning of a manvantara.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāmānupūrvyeṇa sarveṣāṃ dvijasattamāḥ /
tasmādetatsvadharmeṇa deyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca śraddhayā //
meaning:
पितॄणामानुपूर्व्येण सर्वेषां द्विजसत्तमाः /
तस्मादेतत्स्वधर्मेण देयं श्राद्धं च श्रद्धया //
text_mt: In proper order for all the Pitṛs, O best of Brahmins, / therefore, a śrāddha should be offered according to one's own duty and with faith.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ rājataiḥ pātrairapi vā rajatānvitaiḥ /
dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya śrāddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn //
meaning:
सर्वेषां राजतैः पात्रैरपि वा रजतान्वितैः /
दत्तं स्वधां पुरोधाय श्राद्धं प्रीणाति वै पितॄन् //
text_mt: For all of them, [offerings] given in silver vessels or vessels accompanied with silver, / with Svadhā placed first, a śrāddha indeed propitiates the Pitṛs.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāyane vāgrayaṇe hyaśvamedhaṃ tadapnuyāt /
somaścāpyāyanaṃ kṛtvā hyaganervevasvatasya ca //
meaning:
सौम्यायने वाग्रयणे ह्यश्वमेधं तदप्नुयात् /
सोमश्चाप्यायनं कृत्वा ह्यगनेर्वेवस्वतस्य च //
text_mt: During the southern transit of the sun or at the Āgrayaṇa, one obtains [the fruit of] an Aśvamedha; / having brought about the satiation of Soma, of Agni, and of Vaivasvata,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnprīṇāti yo vaṃśyaḥ pitaraḥ prīṇayanti tam /
pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya prajākāmasya vā punaḥ //
meaning:
पितॄन्प्रीणाति यो वंश्यः पितरः प्रीणयन्ति तम् /
पितरः पुष्टिकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य वा पुनः //
text_mt: whichever descendant propitiates the Pitṛs, the Pitṛs propitiate him. / For one desiring nourishment or one desiring offspring, the Pitṛs

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭiṃ prajāstathā svargaṃ prayacchanti na saṃśayaḥ /
devakāryādapi sadā pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate //
meaning:
पुष्टिं प्रजास्तथा स्वर्गं प्रयच्छन्ति न संशयः /
देवकार्यादपि सदा पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते //
text_mt: grant nourishment, offspring, and likewise heaven, without doubt. / An act for the Pitṛs is always superior even to an act for the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devatābhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ hi pūrvamāpyāyanaṃ smṛtam /
na hi yoga gatiḥ sūkṣmā pitṝṇāṃ na pitṛkṣayaḥ //
meaning:
देवताभ्यः पितॄणां हि पूर्वमाप्यायनं स्मृतम् /
न हि योग गतिः सूक्ष्मा पितॄणां न पितृक्षयः //
text_mt: For the satiation of the Pitṛs is remembered to precede that of the deities; / subtle is the path of yoga, not that of the Pitṛs, nor is there destruction of the Pitṛs.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā viprasiddhena dṛśyate māsacakṣuṣā /
ityete pitaraścaiva lokā duhitaraśca vai //
meaning:
तपसा विप्रसिद्धेन दृश्यते मासचक्षुषा /
इत्येते पितरश्चैव लोका दुहितरश्च वै //
text_mt: Through austerity accomplished by Brahmins, it is seen with the eye of flesh. / Thus these Pitṛs, their worlds, and their daughters,

sanskrit_iast:
dauhitrā yajamānāśca proktā ye bhāvayanti yān /
catvāro mūrtimantastu trayasteṣāmamūrtayaḥ //
meaning:
दौहित्रा यजमानाश्च प्रोक्ता ये भावयन्ति यान् /
चत्वारो मूर्तिमन्तस्तु त्रयस्तेषाममूर्तयः //
text_mt: their daughters' sons, and the sacrificers who meditate upon them, have been declared. / Four of them have form, while three are formless.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ śrāddhāni satkṛtya devāḥ kurvanti yatnataḥ /
bhaktyā prāñjalayaḥ sarveseṃdrāstadgatamānasāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यः श्राद्धानि सत्कृत्य देवाः कुर्वन्ति यत्नतः /
भक्त्या प्राञ्जलयः सर्वेसेंद्रास्तद्गतमानसाः //
text_mt: Having honoured them, the gods perform śrāddhas for them with diligence; / with devotion, with joined palms, all of them along with Indra, their minds fixed on them,

sanskrit_iast:
viśve ca sikatāścaiva pṛśnijāḥ śṛṅgiṇastathā /
kṛṣṇāḥ śvetāṃbujāścaiva vidhiva tpūjayantyuta //
meaning:
विश्वे च सिकताश्चैव पृश्निजाः शृङ्गिणस्तथा /
कृष्णाः श्वेतांबुजाश्चैव विधिव त्पूजयन्त्युत //
text_mt: the Viśvedevas, the Sikatas, the Pṛśnijas, the horned ones, / the black lotuses and white lotuses worship them according to rule;

sanskrit_iast:
praśastā vātarasanā divākṛtyāstathaiva ca /
meghāśca marutaścaiva brahmādyāśca divaukasaḥ //
meaning:
प्रशस्ता वातरसना दिवाकृत्यास्तथैव च /
मेघाश्च मरुतश्चैव ब्रह्माद्याश्च दिवौकसः //
text_mt: the praiseworthy Vātaraśanas, the Divākṛtyas likewise, / the clouds, the Maruts, and the celestial dwellers beginning with Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
atribhṛgvaṅgirādyāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te /
yakṣā nāgāḥ suparṇāśca kinnarā rākṣasaiḥ saha //
meaning:
अत्रिभृग्वङ्गिराद्याश्च ऋषयः सर्व एव ते /
यक्षा नागाः सुपर्णाश्च किन्नरा राक्षसैः सह //
text_mt: and all the ṛṣis beginning with Atri, Bhṛgu, and Aṅgiras, / the Yakṣas, Nāgas, Suparṇas, and Kinnaras together with Rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṃste 'pūjayansarve nityameva phalārthinaḥ /
evamete mahātmānaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya pūjitāḥ //
meaning:
पितॄंस्ते ऽपूजयन्सर्वे नित्यमेव फलार्थिनः /
एवमेते महात्मानः श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य पूजिताः //
text_mt: Desiring fruits, they all worshipped the Pitṛs constantly. / Thus, when honoured and worshipped at a śrāddha, these great-souled ones

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānkāmānprayacchanti śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ /
hitvā trailokyasaṃsāraṃ jarāmṛtyumayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छन्ति शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः /
हित्वा त्रैलोक्यसंसारं जरामृत्युमयं तथा //
text_mt: grant all desires by the hundreds and thousands. / Leaving behind the saṃsāra of the three worlds consisting of old age and death,

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaṃ yogamathaiśvaryaṃ sūkṣmadehamadehinām /
kṛtsnaṃ vairāgyamānantyaṃ prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
मोक्षं योगमथैश्वर्यं सूक्ष्मदेहमदेहिनाम् /
कृत्स्नं वैराग्यमानन्त्यं प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः //
text_mt: liberation, yoga, lordship, a subtle body for the bodiless, / complete dispassion, and infinity, the ancestral fathers bestow.

sanskrit_iast:
eśvaryaṃ vihitaṃ yogameśvaryaṃ yoga ucyate /
yogaiśvaryamṛte mokṣaḥ kathañcinnopapadyate //
meaning:
एश्वर्यं विहितं योगमेश्वर्यं योग उच्यते /
योगैश्वर्यमृते मोक्षः कथञ्चिन्नोपपद्यते //
text_mt: Lordship is enjoined through yoga; lordship is called yoga. / Without the lordship of yoga, liberation is in no way possible,

sanskrit_iast:
apakṣasyeva gamanaṃ gagane pakṣiṇo yathā /
variṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ mokṣadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अपक्षस्येव गमनं गगने पक्षिणो यथा /
वरिष्ठः सर्वधर्माणां मोक्षधर्मः सनातनः //
text_mt: just like the movement in the sky of a bird without wings. / The eternal dharma of liberation is the supreme among all dharmas;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ hi prasādena prāpyate sa mahātmanām /
muktāvaiḍūryavāsāṃsi vājināgāyutāni ca //
meaning:
पितॄणां हि प्रसादेन प्राप्यते स महात्मनाम् /
मुक्तावैडूर्यवासांसि वाजिनागायुतानि च //
text_mt: it is attained indeed through the grace of the great-souled Pitṛs. / Garments of pearls and lapis lazuli, tens of thousands of horses and elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiśaścāpi ratnāniprayacchanti pitāmahāḥ /
haṃsabarhiṇayuktani muktāvaiḍhūryavanti ca //
meaning:
कोटिशश्चापि रत्नानिप्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः /
हंसबर्हिणयुक्तनि मुक्तावैढूर्यवन्ति च //
text_mt: and millions of jewels the ancestral fathers bestow; / [aerial chariots] harnessed with swans and peacocks, adorned with pearls and lapis lazuli,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṅkiṇījālanaddhāni sadā puṣpaphalāni ca /
vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇi yuktānyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
किङ्किणीजालनद्धानि सदा पुष्पफलानि च /
विमानानां सहस्राणि युक्तान्यप्सरसां गणैः //
text_mt: strung with networks of small bells, bearing flowers and fruits at all times, / thousands of aerial chariots accompanied by hosts of Apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmasamṛddhāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ /
prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ rājyamārogyameva ca /
prītā nityaṃ prayacchanti mānuṣāṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde pitṛrājya kalpo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 10//
meaning:
सर्वकामसमृद्धानि प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः /
प्रजां पुष्टिं स्मृतिं मेधां राज्यमारोग्यमेव च /
प्रीता नित्यं प्रयच्छन्ति मानुषाणां पितामहाः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे पितृराज्य कल्पो नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः // 10//
text_mt:
abundant in all desirable things, the ancestral fathers bestow. / Offspring, nourishment, memory, intellect, kingdom, and freedom from disease— / pleased, the ancestral fathers continually bestow these upon mortals.

Thus ends the tenth chapter, named "The Procedure Concerning the Realm of the Pitṛs", in the third Upoddhātapāda, the middle part spoken by Vāyu, in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
rājataṃ rājatāktaṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ pātramucyate /
rājatasya kathāvāpi darśanaṃ dāna meva vā //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
राजतं राजताक्तं वा पितॄणां पात्रमुच्यते /
राजतस्य कथावापि दर्शनं दान मेव वा //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
A vessel made of silver or smeared with silver is spoken of for the Pitṛs, / or indeed talk of silver, the sight [of it], or the gift [of it].

sanskrit_iast:
anantamakṣayaṃ svarge rājate dānamucyate /
pitṝnetena dānena satputrāstārayantyuta //
meaning:
अनन्तमक्षयं स्वर्गे राजते दानमुच्यते /
पितॄनेतेन दानेन सत्पुत्रास्तारयन्त्युत //
text_mt: A gift in silver is declared to be endless and imperishable in heaven. / Moreover, virtuous sons deliver the Pitṛs through this gift.

sanskrit_iast:
rājate hi svadhā dugdhā pātre taiḥ pṛthivī purā /
svadhāṃ vā pārthibhistāta tasmin dattaṃ tadakṣayam //
meaning:
राजते हि स्वधा दुग्धा पात्रे तैः पृथिवी पुरा /
स्वधां वा पार्थिभिस्तात तस्मिन् दत्तं तदक्षयम् //
text_mt: For in ancient times, the Svadhā was milked by them into a silver vessel from the earth, / or, dear one, whatever was offered into it as Svadhā by kings became imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇājinasya sāṃnidhyaṃ darśanaṃ dānameva ca /
rakṣoghnaṃ brahma varcasyaṃ paśūnputrāṃśca tārayet //
meaning:
कृष्णाजिनस्य सांनिध्यं दर्शनं दानमेव च /
रक्षोघ्नं ब्रह्म वर्चस्यं पशून्पुत्रांश्च तारयेत् //
text_mt: The presence, sight, and indeed the gift of a black buck's skin / destroys demons, brings the splendor of sacred knowledge, and delivers cattle and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
kanakaṃ rājataṃ pātraṃ dauhitraṃ kutupastilāḥ /
vastūni pāvanīyāni tridaṇḍīyoga eva vā //
meaning:
कनकं राजतं पात्रं दौहित्रं कुतुपस्तिलाः /
वस्तूनि पावनीयानि त्रिदण्डीयोग एव वा //
text_mt: Gold, a silver vessel, a daughter's son, a kutapa blanket, sesamum seeds, / or the arrangement of the triple staff—these are purifying objects.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakarmaṇyayaṃ śreṣṭho vidhirbrāhmaḥ sanātanaḥ /
āyuḥkīrtiprajaiśvaryaprajñāsaṃtativarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धकर्मण्ययं श्रेष्ठो विधिर्ब्राह्मः सनातनः /
आयुःकीर्तिप्रजैश्वर्यप्रज्ञासंततिवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: In the rite of śrāddha, this eternal Vedic rule is the best, / increasing life span, fame, offspring, sovereignty, wisdom, and lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
diśidakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ vedisthānaṃ nivedayet /
sarvato 'ratnimātraṃ ca caturasraṃ susaṃsthitam //
meaning:
दिशिदक्षिणपूर्वस्यां वेदिस्थानं निवेदयेत् /
सर्वतो ऽरत्निमात्रं च चतुरस्रं सुसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: One should prepare the place for the altar in the south-eastern direction, / measuring an aratni on all sides, four-cornered and well-situated.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyāmi vidhivatsthānaṃ pitṝṇāmanuśāsitam /
dhanyamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ balavarṇavivarddhanamā //
meaning:
वक्ष्यामि विधिवत्स्थानं पितॄणामनुशासितम् /
धन्यमायुष्यमारोग्यं बलवर्णविवर्द्धनमा //
text_mt: I shall describe the place prescribed according to rule for the Pitṛs, / which brings prosperity, long life, health, and increases strength and complexion.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gartāstrayaḥ kāyārstrayo daṇḍāśca khādirāḥ /
aratnimātrāste kāryā rajataiḥ pravibhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र गर्तास्त्रयः कायार्स्त्रयो दण्डाश्च खादिराः /
अरत्निमात्रास्ते कार्या रजतैः प्रविभूषिताः //
text_mt: Three pits are to be made there, and three khadira staffs; / they should be made an aratni in size and decorated with silver.

sanskrit_iast:
te vitastyāyatā garttāḥ sarvataścaturaṅgulāḥ /
prāgdakṣiṇamukhānkuryātsthirānaśuṣirāṃstathā //
meaning:
ते वितस्त्यायता गर्त्ताः सर्वतश्चतुरङ्गुलाः /
प्राग्दक्षिणमुखान्कुर्यात्स्थिरानशुषिरांस्तथा //
text_mt: Those pits should be a span long and four aṅgulas wide on all sides; / one should make them facing south-east, firm and without cavities.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhiḥ pavitrayuktābhiḥ pāvayetsatataṃ śuciḥ /
payasā hyāja gavyena śodhanaṃ cādbhireva ca //
meaning:
अद्भिः पवित्रयुक्ताभिः पावयेत्सततं शुचिः /
पयसा ह्याज गव्येन शोधनं चाद्भिरेव च //
text_mt: Being pure, one should constantly purify [them] with water combined with pavitra grass, / and purification [is performed] with milk from goats and cows, and indeed with water.

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ tarpaṇaṃ hyetattṛptirbhavati śāsvatī /
iha vāmutra ya vaśī sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
सततं तर्पणं ह्येतत्तृप्तिर्भवति शास्वती /
इह वामुत्र य वशी सर्वकामसमन्वितः //
text_mt: This is indeed a continuous libation, and there is everlasting satisfaction. / Here or hereafter, self-controlled, one is endowed with all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ triṣavaṇasnāto yor'cayetprayataḥ pitṝn /
mantreṇa vidhivatsamyagaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
एवं त्रिषवणस्नातो योर्ऽचयेत्प्रयतः पितॄन् /
मन्त्रेण विधिवत्सम्यगश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Thus, one who has bathed at the three junctures of the day, who, restrained, worships the Pitṛs / duly and properly with the mantra, obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tānsthāpayedamāvāsyāṃ garttānvai caturaṅgulān /
triḥsaptasaṃsthāste yajñāstrailokyaṃ dhāryate tu yaḥ //
meaning:
तान्स्थापयेदमावास्यां गर्त्तान्वै चतुरङ्गुलान् /
त्रिःसप्तसंस्थास्ते यज्ञास्त्रैलोक्यं धार्यते तु यः //
text_mt: One should establish those four-aṅgula pits on the new-moon day; / those sacrifices are arranged in three sets of seven, by which the three worlds are sustained.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya puṣṭistathaiśvaryamāyuḥ saṃtatireva ca /
divi ca bhrājatelakṣmyā mokṣaṃ ca labhate kramāt //
meaning:
तस्य पुष्टिस्तथैश्वर्यमायुः संततिरेव च /
दिवि च भ्राजतेलक्ष्म्या मोक्षं च लभते क्रमात् //
text_mt: His is nourishment, sovereignty, life span, and lineage; / he shines in heaven with glory and gradually attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpmāpahaṃ pāvanīyaṃ hyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet /
aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyettaddvijaiḥ saṃskṛtya pūjitam //
meaning:
पाप्मापहं पावनीयं ह्यश्वमेधफलं लभेत् /
अश्वमेधफलं ह्येत्तद्द्विजैः संस्कृत्य पूजितम् //
text_mt: Purifying and removing sin, he obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice; / this fruit of the horse sacrifice is honored when consecrated by the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraṃ vakṣyāmyahaṃ tasmādamṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam /
deṃvatebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca //
meaning:
मन्त्रं वक्ष्याम्यहं तस्मादमृतं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् /
देंवतेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च महायोगिभ्य एव च //
text_mt: Therefore, I shall proclaim the immortal mantra created by Brahman: / "To the deities and the Pitṛs, and to the great yogins,

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ svāhayai svadhāyai nityameva bhavatyuta /
āddhe 'vasāne śrāddhasya trirāvṛttaṃ japetsadā //
meaning:
नमः स्वाहयै स्वधायै नित्यमेव भवत्युत /
आद्धे ऽवसाने श्राद्धस्य त्रिरावृत्तं जपेत्सदा //
text_mt: salutations, to Svāhā, to Svadhā, ever and ever indeed." / At the beginning and at the end of the śrāddha, one should always recite it repeated three times.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍanirvapaṇe vāpi japedetaṃ samāhitaḥ /
kṣipramāyānti pitaro rakṣāṃsi pradravanti ca //
meaning:
पिण्डनिर्वपणे वापि जपेदेतं समाहितः /
क्षिप्रमायान्ति पितरो रक्षांसि प्रद्रवन्ति च //
text_mt: Or concentrated in mind, one should recite this during the offering of rice-balls; / quickly the Pitṛs arrive and demons flee away.

sanskrit_iast:
pitryaṃ tu triṣu kāleṣu mantro 'yaṃ tārayatyuta /
paṭhyamānaḥ sadā śrāddhe niyatairbrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
पित्र्यं तु त्रिषु कालेषु मन्त्रो ऽयं तारयत्युत /
पठ्यमानः सदा श्राद्धे नियतैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: This mantra rescues what relates to the ancestors at the three times, / being constantly recited at the śrāddha by self-controlled expounders of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyakāmo japedetaṃ sadā mantramatandritaḥ /
vīryaśauryārthasattvāśīrāyurbuddhivivarddhanam //
meaning:
राज्यकामो जपेदेतं सदा मन्त्रमतन्द्रितः /
वीर्यशौर्यार्थसत्त्वाशीरायुर्बुद्धिविवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt: Desiring kingship, unwearied, one should constantly recite this mantra, / which increases vigor, heroism, wealth, bodily strength, life, and intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
prīyante pitaro yena japena niyamena ca /
saptarciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham //
meaning:
प्रीयन्ते पितरो येन जपेन नियमेन च /
सप्तर्चिषं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वकामप्रदं शुभम् //
text_mt: By which recitation and observance the Pitṛs are pleased, / that auspicious Saptārcis hymn, which bestows all desires, I shall declare:

sanskrit_iast:
amūrttīnāṃ samūrttināṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām /
namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyānināṃ yogacakṣuṣām //
meaning:
अमूर्त्तीनां समूर्त्तिनां पितॄणां दीप्ततेजसाम् /
नमस्यामि सदा तेषां ध्यानिनां योगचक्षुषाम् //
text_mt: "I ever bow to those formless and embodied Pitṛs of radiant splendor, / who are contemplators endowed with the eye of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādīnāṃ ca netāro daśamārīcayostathā /
saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān //
meaning:
इन्द्रादीनां च नेतारो दशमारीचयोस्तथा /
सप्तर्षीणां पितॄणां च तान्नमस्यामि कामदान् //
text_mt: And to the leaders of Indra and the others, the ten Marīcis, / and the Pitṛs of the Seven Sages—to those grantors of desires I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
manvādināṃ ca netāraḥ sūryācandramasostathā /
tānnamaskṛtya sarvānvai pitṛmatsu vidhiṣvapi //
meaning:
मन्वादिनां च नेतारः सूर्याचन्द्रमसोस्तथा /
तान्नमस्कृत्य सर्वान्वै पितृमत्सु विधिष्वपि //
text_mt: And to the leaders of Manu and the rest, and of the sun and moon, / having bowed to all those in the rites concerning the Pitṛs,

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vāyvagnyośca pitṝnatha /
dyāvāpṛthivyośca sadā nāmasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
नक्षत्राणां ग्रहाणां च वाय्वग्न्योश्च पितॄनथ /
द्यावापृथिव्योश्च सदा नामस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: and to the Pitṛs of the lunar mansions, the planets, wind and fire, / and of heaven and earth, I always bow with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣīṇāṃ ca netāraḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ /
trātāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ namasyāmi pitāmahān //
meaning:
देवर्षीणां च नेतारः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः /
त्रातारः सर्वभूतानां नमस्यामि पितामहान् //
text_mt: The leaders of the divine sages, honored by all worlds, / the protectors of all beings—I bow to the grandfathers.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatergavāṃ vahneḥ somāya ca yamāya ca /
yogeśvarebhyaśca sadā namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
प्रजापतेर्गवां वह्नेः सोमाय च यमाय च /
योगेश्वरेभ्यश्च सदा नमस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: To Prajāpati, to the cows, to fire, and to Soma and Yama, / and to the lords of yoga, I always bow with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu /
svayaṃbhuve namaścaiva brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe //
etaduktaṃ ca saptārcirbrahmarṣigaṇasevitam /
pavitraṃ paramaṃ hyetacchrīmadrogavināśanam //
meaning:
पितृगणेभ्यः सप्तभ्यो नमो लोकेषु सप्तसु /
स्वयंभुवे नमश्चैव ब्रह्मणे योगचक्षुषे //
एतदुक्तं च सप्तार्चिर्ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम् /
पवित्रं परमं ह्येतच्छ्रीमद्रोगविनाशनम् //
text_mt:
Salutations to the seven groups of Pitṛs in the seven worlds; / and salutations to Svayambhū, to Brahmā, whose eye is yoga."

This Saptārcis hymn, frequented by hosts of brahmin sages, has been spoken; / it is supremely purifying, glorious, and destroys diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
etena vidhinā yuktastrīnvarāṃllabhate naraḥ /
annamāyuḥ sutāścaiva dadate pitaro bhuvi //
meaning:
एतेन विधिना युक्तस्त्रीन्वरांल्लभते नरः /
अन्नमायुः सुताश्चैव ददते पितरो भुवि //
text_mt: Endowed with this rule, a person obtains three boons; / the Pitṛs bestow food, life span, and sons on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddhadhāno jitendriyaḥ /
saptārci ṣaṃ japedyastu nityameva samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
भक्त्या परमया युक्तः श्रद्धधानो जितेन्द्रियः /
सप्तार्चि षं जपेद्यस्तु नित्यमेव समाहितः //
text_mt: Endowed with supreme devotion, faithful, possessing controlled senses, / he who constantly recites the Saptārcis hymn with a concentrated mind

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpasamudrāyāṃ pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet /
yatkiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyameva vā //
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रायां पृथिव्यामेकराड् भवेत् /
यत्किञ्चित्पच्यते गेहे भक्ष्यं वा भोज्यमेव वा //
text_mt: becomes the sole monarch over the earth with its seven continents and oceans. / Whatever is cooked in the house, whether to be chewed or eaten,

sanskrit_iast:
anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ tasminnayatane sadā /
kramaśaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi balipātrāṇyataḥ param //
meaning:
अनिवेद्य न भोक्तव्यं तस्मिन्नयतने सदा /
क्रमशः कीर्तयिष्यामि बलिपात्राण्यतः परम् //
text_mt: is never to be eaten without having offered it first in that abode. / Beyond this, I shall describe in order the vessels for bali offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu yacca phalaṃ proktaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śruṇu /
palāśe brahmavarcastvamaśvatthe vasubhāvanā //
meaning:
येषु यच्च फलं प्रोक्तं तन्मे निगदतः श्रुणु /
पलाशे ब्रह्मवर्चस्त्वमश्वत्थे वसुभावना //
text_mt: Listen as I tell what fruit is declared in which [vessel]: / the splendor of sacred knowledge [is obtained] in a palāśa vessel; the contemplation of wealth in an aśvattha vessel;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtādhipatyaṃ ca plakṣe nityabhudātdṛtam /
puṣṭiḥ prajāśca nyagrodhe buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभूताधिपत्यं च प्लक्षे नित्यभुदात्दृतम् /
पुष्टिः प्रजाश्च न्यग्रोधे बुद्धिः प्रज्ञा धृतिः स्मृतिः //
text_mt: sovereignty over all beings is always declared in a plakṣa vessel; / nourishment and offspring in a nyagrodha vessel, [as well as] intellect, wisdom, resolve, and memory.

sanskrit_iast:
raśodhnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kāśmarīpātramucyate /
saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke mādhūke samudātdṛtam //
meaning:
रशोध्नं च यशस्यं च काश्मरीपात्रमुच्यते /
सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लोके माधूके समुदात्दृतम् //
text_mt: A vessel of kāśmarī is said to destroy demons and bring renown; / supreme good fortune in the world is declared in a vessel of madhūka.

sanskrit_iast:
phalagupātreṣu kurvāṇaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt /
parāṃ dyutimathārketu prākāśyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
फलगुपात्रेषु कुर्वाणः सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् /
परां द्युतिमथार्केतु प्राकाश्यं च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Making [the offering] in vessels of phalgu, one would attain all desires; / supreme brilliance and especially renown [is gained] in an arka vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
bailve lakṣmīntathā medhāṃ nityamāyustathaiva ca /
kṣetrārāmataḍāgeṣu sarvasasyeṣu caiva ha //
meaning:
बैल्वे लक्ष्मीन्तथा मेधां नित्यमायुस्तथैव च /
क्षेत्रारामतडागेषु सर्वसस्येषु चैव ह //
text_mt: In a bilva vessel, [one gains] fortune, wisdom, and everlasting life; / and upon the fields, gardens, ponds, and all crops,

sanskrit_iast:
varṣatya jasraṃ parjanyo veṇupātreṣu kurvataḥ /
eteṣveva supātreṣu bhojanāgramaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
वर्षत्य जस्रं पर्जन्यो वेणुपात्रेषु कुर्वतः /
एतेष्वेव सुपात्रेषु भोजनाग्रमशेषतः //
text_mt: Parjanya rains incessantly for one who makes [offerings] in bamboo vessels. / In these very worthy vessels, one should always offer

sanskrit_iast:
sadā dadyātsa yajñānāṃ sarveṣāṃ phalamāpnuyāt /
pitṛbhyaḥ puṣpamālyāni sugandhāni ca tatparaḥ //
meaning:
सदा दद्यात्स यज्ञानां सर्वेषां फलमाप्नुयात् /
पितृभ्यः पुष्पमाल्यानि सुगन्धानि च तत्परः //
text_mt: the first portion of food completely; he attains the fruit of all sacrifices. / Devoted to the Pitṛs, [offering] flowers, garlands, and fragrant perfumes to them,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā dadyātkriyāyuktaḥ śa vibhāti divākaraḥ /
guggulādīṃstathā dhūpānpitṛbhyo yaḥ prayacchati //
meaning:
सदा दद्यात्क्रियायुक्तः श विभाति दिवाकरः /
गुग्गुलादींस्तथा धूपान्पितृभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: he who always gives, engaged in the rite, shines like the sun. / He who presents incense such as guggulu to the Pitṛs,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyuktānmadhusarpirbhyaṃ so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet /
dhūpaṃ gandhaguṇopetaṃ kṛtvā pitṛparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
संयुक्तान्मधुसर्पिर्भ्यं सो ऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् /
धूपं गन्धगुणोपेतं कृत्वा पितृपरायणः //
text_mt: mixed with honey and clarified butter, obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / Having offered incense endowed with good fragrance, devoted to the Pitṛs,

sanskrit_iast:
labhate ca suśarmāṇi iha cāmutra cobhayoḥ /
dadyādevaṃ pitṛbhyāstu nityameva hyatandritaḥ //
meaning:
लभते च सुशर्माणि इह चामुत्र चोभयोः /
दद्यादेवं पितृभ्यास्तु नित्यमेव ह्यतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: he attains great comfort in both worlds, here and hereafter. / Thus one should give to the Pitṛs continually and unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prayataḥ sadā yastu prayacchati /
gatiṃ cāpratimaṃ cakṣustasmātsalabhate śubham //
meaning:
दीपं पितृभ्यः प्रयतः सदा यस्तु प्रयच्छति /
गतिं चाप्रतिमं चक्षुस्तस्मात्सलभते शुभम् //
text_mt: He who, restrained, always presents a lamp to the Pitṛs, / attains from that a high destination and peerless, auspicious sight.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā yaśasā caiva kāntyā cāpi balena ca /
bhuvi prakāśo bhavati brājate ca triviṣṭape //
meaning:
तेजसा यशसा चैव कान्त्या चापि बलेन च /
भुवि प्रकाशो भवति ब्राजते च त्रिविष्टपे //
text_mt: Through splendor, fame, beauty, and strength, / he becomes radiant on earth and shines in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
apsarobhiḥ parivṛto vimānāgre ca modate /
gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśva japāhutibhireva ca //
meaning:
अप्सरोभिः परिवृतो विमानाग्रे च मोदते /
गन्धपुष्पैश्च धूपैश्व जपाहुतिभिरेव च //
text_mt: Surrounded by Apsarases, he rejoices at the forefront of a heavenly chariot. / With perfumes, flowers, incenses, prayers, and oblations,

sanskrit_iast:
phalamūlanamaskāraiḥ pitṝṇāṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ /
pūjāṃ kṛtvā dvijānpaścātpūjayedannasaṃpadā //
meaning:
फलमूलनमस्कारैः पितॄणां प्रयतः शुचिः /
पूजां कृत्वा द्विजान्पश्चात्पूजयेदन्नसंपदा //
text_mt: with fruits, roots, and obeisances, self-restrained and pure, / having offered worship to the ancestors, he should afterwards honor the twice-born with an abundance of food.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakāleṣu niyataṃ vāyubhūtāḥ pitāmahāḥ /
āviśanti dvijāñchreṣṭhāṃstasmādetadbravīmi te //
meaning:
श्राद्धकालेषु नियतं वायुभूताः पितामहाः /
आविशन्ति द्विजाञ्छ्रेष्ठांस्तस्मादेतद्ब्रवीमि ते //
text_mt: At the times of a śrāddha, having assumed the form of wind, the ancestors / regularly enter the best among the twice-born; therefore I declare this to you.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrai ratnapradānaiśca bhakṣyaiḥ peyaistathaiva ca /
gobhiraśvaistathā grāmaiḥ pūjayeddvijasattamān //
meaning:
वस्त्रै रत्नप्रदानैश्च भक्ष्यैः पेयैस्तथैव च /
गोभिरश्वैस्तथा ग्रामैः पूजयेद्द्विजसत्तमान् //
text_mt: With garments, gifts of jewels, edible foods, and drinks likewise, / with cattle, horses, and villages, one should honor the best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti pitaraḥ prītāḥ pūjiteṣu dvijātiṣu /
tasmādyatnena vidhivatpūjayeta dvijānsadā //
meaning:
भवन्ति पितरः प्रीताः पूजितेषु द्विजातिषु /
तस्माद्यत्नेन विधिवत्पूजयेत द्विजान्सदा //
text_mt: The ancestors become pleased when the twice-born are honored; / therefore, one should always honor the twice-born according to the rules with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kuryādullekhanaṃ dvijāḥ /
prokṣaṇaṃ ca tataḥ kuryācchrāddhakarmaṇyatandritaḥ //
meaning:
सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां कुर्यादुल्लेखनं द्विजाः /
प्रोक्षणं च ततः कुर्याच्छ्राद्धकर्मण्यतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: With both hands, the left placed above, the twice-born should make the furrow; / then, unwearied, he should perform the sprinkling in the rite of the śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
darbhānpiṇḍāṃstathā bhakṣyānpuṣpāṇi vividhāni ca /
gandhadānamalaṅkāramekaikaṃ nirvaped budhaḥ //
meaning:
दर्भान्पिण्डांस्तथा भक्ष्यान्पुष्पाणि विविधानि च /
गन्धदानमलङ्कारमेकैकं निर्वपेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Darbha grass, balls of rice, edible foods, and various flowers, / the gift of perfume, and decoration—the wise man should offer each one separately.

sanskrit_iast:
peṣayitvāñjanaṃ samyagviśveṣāmuttarottaram /
abhyaṅgaṃ darbhaviñjūlaistribhiḥ kuryādyathāvidhi //
meaning:
पेषयित्वाञ्जनं सम्यग्विश्वेषामुत्तरोत्तरम् /
अभ्यङ्गं दर्भविञ्जूलैस्त्रिभिः कुर्याद्यथाविधि //
text_mt: Having thoroughly ground collyrium, [offering it] one by one to all, / he should duly perform the anointing with three bundles of darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast:
apasavyaṃ vitṛbhayaśca dadyādañjanamuttamam /
nipātya jānu sarveṣāṃ vastrārthaṃ sūtrameva vā //
meaning:
अपसव्यं वितृभयश्च दद्यादञ्जनमुत्तमम् /
निपात्य जानु सर्वेषां वस्त्रार्थं सूत्रमेव वा //
text_mt: With the sacred thread over the right shoulder, he should offer excellent collyrium to the ancestors, / having bent his knee, or thread for the sake of clothing to all of them.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva tathaivollekhanaṃ dvijaḥ /
sakṛddevapitṝṇāṃ syātpitṝṇāṃ tribhirucyate //
meaning:
खण्डनं प्रोक्षणं चैव तथैवोल्लेखनं द्विजः /
सकृद्देवपितॄणां स्यात्पितॄणां त्रिभिरुच्यते //
text_mt: The scattering, the sprinkling, and likewise the furrowing, O twice-born, / should be done once for the gods and ancestors, but three times for the ancestors, it is said.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ pavitraṃ hastena pitṝnasarvānsakṛtsakṛt /
cailamantreṇa piṇḍebhyo dattvādarśāñjine hi tam //
meaning:
एकं पवित्रं हस्तेन पितॄनसर्वान्सकृत्सकृत् /
चैलमन्त्रेण पिण्डेभ्यो दत्त्वादर्शाञ्जिने हि तम् //
text_mt: Holding one purifier with the hand, [offering] once to each of all the ancestors, / having given it to the rice-balls with the garment-mantra, [he offers] collyrium on mirror-like surfaces.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sarpistilairyuktāṃstrīnpiṇḍānnirvapedbhuvi /
jānu kṛtvā tathā savyaṃ bhūmau pitṛparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
सदा सर्पिस्तिलैर्युक्तांस्त्रीन्पिण्डान्निर्वपेद्भुवि /
जानु कृत्वा तथा सव्यं भूमौ पितृपरायणः //
text_mt: He should always deposit three rice-balls mixed with ghee and sesame seeds on the ground, / having likewise placed his left knee on the ground, devoted to the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnpitāmahāṃścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān /
āhūya ca pitṝnprāñcaḥ pitṛtīrthena yatnataḥ //
meaning:
पितॄन्पितामहांश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहान् /
आहूय च पितॄन्प्राञ्चः पितृतीर्थेन यत्नतः //
text_mt: Having invoked the fathers, the grandfathers, and likewise the great-grandfathers, / facing eastward, with effort through the tīrtha of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍānparikṣipetsamyagapasavyamatandritaḥ /
annādyaireva mukhyaiścabhakṣyaiścaiva pṛthagvidhaiḥ //
meaning:
पिण्डान्परिक्षिपेत्सम्यगपसव्यमतन्द्रितः /
अन्नाद्यैरेव मुख्यैश्चभक्ष्यैश्चैव पृथग्विधैः //
text_mt: with sacred thread over the right shoulder and unwearied, he should properly scatter the rice-balls, / along with the foremost food and various kinds of edibles.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthaṅmātāmahānāṃ tu kecidicchanti mānavāḥ /
trīnpiṇḍānānupūrvyeṇa sāṃguṣṭhānpuṣṭivarddhanān //
meaning:
पृथङ्मातामहानां तु केचिदिच्छन्ति मानवाः /
त्रीन्पिण्डानानुपूर्व्येण सांगुष्ठान्पुष्टिवर्द्धनान् //
text_mt: Some men, however, desire separately for the maternal grandfathers / three rice-balls in order, measuring the size of a thumb, that increase prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
jānvantarābhyāṃ yatnena piṇḍāndadyādyathākramam /
savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ dhārārthaṃ mantramuccaran //
meaning:
जान्वन्तराभ्यां यत्नेन पिण्डान्दद्याद्यथाक्रमम् /
सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां धारार्थं मन्त्रमुच्चरन् //
text_mt: With effort he should offer the rice-balls in order between his knees, / with both hands, the left placed above, reciting the mantra for the pouring of water.

sanskrit_iast:
namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śoṣāyeti sarvamatandritaḥ /
dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pāṇibhyāṃ prathamaṃ piṇḍamutsṛjet //
meaning:
नमो वः पितरः शोषायेति सर्वमतन्द्रितः /
दक्षिणस्यां तु पाणिभ्यां प्रथमं पिण्डमुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt: Reciting entirely without fatigue: 'Homage to you, O ancestors, for vigor,' / he should offer the first rice-ball with his right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
namo vaḥ pitaraḥ saumyaḥ paṭhannevamatandritaḥ /
savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ dharmer'dhaṃ samatandritaḥ //
meaning:
नमो वः पितरः सौम्यः पठन्नेवमतन्द्रितः /
सव्योत्तराभ्यां पाणिभ्यां धर्मेर्ऽधं समतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: Reciting without fatigue: 'Homage to you, O ancestors, who are Soma-drinking,' / with both hands, the left placed above, completely unwearied according to duty,

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkhalasya lekhāyāmudapātrāvasecanam /
kṣaumaṃ sūtraṃ navaṃ dadyācchāṇaṃ kārpāsakaṃ tathā //
meaning:
उलूखलस्य लेखायामुदपात्रावसेचनम् /
क्षौमं सूत्रं नवं दद्याच्छाणं कार्पासकं तथा //
text_mt: he should pour out the water-vessel in the line of the mortar. / He should offer new linen thread, or hempen, or cotton.

sanskrit_iast:
patrorṇaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ parivarjayet /
varjayedyakṣaṇaṃ yajñe yadyapyahatavastrajām //
meaning:
पत्रोर्णं पट्टसूत्रं च कौशेयं परिवर्जयेत् /
वर्जयेद्यक्षणं यज्ञे यद्यप्यहतवस्त्रजाम् //
text_mt: He should avoid bleached silk, woven silk, and silk fabric; / he should avoid what is injured in the rite, even if produced from unwashed cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
na prīṇanti tathaitāni dātu ścāpyahitaṃ bhavet /
śreṣṭhamāhustrikakudamañjanaṃ nityameva ca //
meaning:
न प्रीणन्ति तथैतानि दातु श्चाप्यहितं भवेत् /
श्रेष्ठमाहुस्त्रिककुदमञ्जनं नित्यमेव च //
text_mt: These do not please [them], and it would bring misfortune to the giver. / They declare that collyrium from Mount Trikakud is always the best,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇebhyaśca telaistailaṃ yatnātsuparirakṣitam /
candanāguruṇī cobhe tamālośīrapadmakam //
meaning:
कृष्णेभ्यश्च तेलैस्तैलं यत्नात्सुपरिरक्षितम् /
चन्दनागुरुणी चोभे तमालोशीरपद्मकम् //
text_mt: and oil diligently preserved from black sesame seeds; / both sandalwood and aloe-wood, tamāla, uśīra, and padmaka;

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaśca guggalaḥ śreṣṭasturuṣkaḥ śveta eva ca /
śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāstathā padmotpalāni ca //
meaning:
धूपश्च गुग्गलः श्रेष्टस्तुरुष्कः श्वेत एव च /
शुक्लाः सुमनसः श्रेष्ठास्तथा पद्मोत्पलानि च //
text_mt: and as incense, bdellium is best, as well as white turuṣka; / white flowers are best, and likewise blue and pink lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharūpopapannāni cāraṇyāni ca kṛtsnaśaḥ /
tathā hi sumanā nāḍīrūpikāsmakuraṇḍikā //
meaning:
गन्धरूपोपपन्नानि चारण्यानि च कृत्स्नशः /
तथा हि सुमना नाडीरूपिकास्मकुरण्डिका //
text_mt: and all wild flowers endowed with fragrance and beauty. / However, the jasmine, the nāḍīrūpikā, the asmakuraṇḍikā—

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇi varjanīyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ /
yathā gandhādapetāni cogragandhāni yāni ca //
meaning:
पुष्पाणि वर्जनीयानि श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः /
यथा गन्धादपेतानि चोग्रगन्धानि यानि च //
text_mt: these flowers are always to be avoided in the śrāddha rite; / likewise those devoid of fragrance and those that have a pungent odor.

sanskrit_iast:
varjanīyāni puṣpāṇi puṣṭimanviccatā sadā /
dvijātayo yathoddiṣṭā niyatāḥ syurudaṅmukhāḥ //
meaning:
वर्जनीयानि पुष्पाणि पुष्टिमन्विच्चता सदा /
द्विजातयो यथोद्दिष्टा नियताः स्युरुदङ्मुखाः //
text_mt: Flowers are always to be avoided by one who desires prosperity. / As prescribed, the twice-born should be restrained and face north.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedyajamānastu vidhivadyakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
teṣāmabhimukho dadyāddarbhatpiṇḍāṃśca yatnataḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेद्यजमानस्तु विधिवद्यक्षिणामुखः /
तेषामभिमुखो दद्याद्दर्भत्पिण्डांश्च यत्नतः //
text_mt: The patron of the sacrifice, facing south, should worship according to rule. / Facing them, he should diligently offer the darbha grass and the rice-balls.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā sākṣādarcitāḥ syuḥ pitāmahāḥ /
haritā vai sa piñjālāḥ puṣṭāḥ snigdhāḥ samāhitāḥ //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना साक्षादर्चिताः स्युः पितामहाः /
हरिता वै स पिञ्जालाः पुष्टाः स्निग्धाः समाहिताः //
text_mt: By this rule, the grandfathers are directly honored. / Green, yellowish, sturdy, smooth, and well-gathered,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnimātrāḥ pramāṇena vitṛtīrthena saṃsmṛtāḥ /
upamūle tathā nīlā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśottamāḥ //
meaning:
रत्निमात्राः प्रमाणेन वितृतीर्थेन संस्मृताः /
उपमूले तथा नीला विष्टरार्थं कुशोत्तमाः //
text_mt: measured to the length of a ratni, held by the tīrtha of the ancestors, / and dark near the root, are the excellent kuśa blades for the seat.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śyāmākanīvārā dūrvā ca samudāhṛtā /
pūrvaṃ kīrttimatāṃ śreṣṭho babhūvāśvaḥ prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
तथा श्यामाकनीवारा दूर्वा च समुदाहृता /
पूर्वं कीर्त्तिमतां श्रेष्ठो बभूवाश्वः प्रजापतिः //
text_mt: Likewise, wild millets, wild rice, and dūrvā grass are recommended. / Formerly, the best of the renowned, the horse, was Prajāpati;

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bālā nipatitā bhūmau kāśatvāmāgatāḥ /
tasmāddeyāḥ sadā kāśāḥ śrāddhakarmasu pūjitāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य बाला निपतिता भूमौ काशत्वामागताः /
तस्माद्देयाः सदा काशाः श्राद्धकर्मसु पूजिताः //
text_mt: his hairs fell upon the ground and became kāśa grass. / Therefore, kāśa grasses are always to be offered and honored in śrāddha rites.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ teṣu karttavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā /
prajāḥ puṣṭidyutiprajñākīrttikāntisamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
पिण्डनिर्वपणं तेषु कर्त्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता /
प्रजाः पुष्टिद्युतिप्रज्ञाकीर्त्तिकान्तिसमन्विताः //
text_mt: The offering of rice-balls should be made upon them by one desiring prosperity. / Offspring endowed with strength, splendor, wisdom, fame, and beauty,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti rucirā nityaṃ vipāpmāno 'ghavarjitāḥ /
sakṛdevāstaredyarbhānpiṇḍārthe dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ //
meaning:
भवन्ति रुचिरा नित्यं विपाप्मानो ऽघवर्जिताः /
सकृदेवास्तरेद्यर्भान्पिण्डार्थे दक्षिणामुखः //
text_mt: ever charming, free from evil, and devoid of sin, come to be. / Facing south, he should spread darbha grass only once for the rice-balls,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgdakṣiṇāgrānniyato vidhi cāpyatra vakṣyati /
na dīno nāpi vā kruddho na caivānyamanā naraḥ /
ekatra cādhāya manaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
प्राग्दक्षिणाग्रान्नियतो विधि चाप्यत्र वक्ष्यति /
न दीनो नापि वा क्रुद्धो न चैवान्यमना नरः /
एकत्र चाधाय मनः श्राद्धं कुर्यात्समाहितः //
text_mt: with tips directed to the south-east, restrained; and here the rule will declare: / A man, not depressed, nor angry, nor absent-minded, / concentrating his mind on one point, should perform the śrāddha with composed attention.

sanskrit_iast:
nihanmi sarvaṃ yadamedhyavadbhaveddhataśca sarve suradānavā mayā /
rakṣāṃsi yakṣāḥ sapiśācasaṃghā hatā mayā yātudhānāśca sarve //
meaning:
निहन्मि सर्वं यदमेध्यवद्भवेद्धतश्च सर्वे सुरदानवा मया /
रक्षांसि यक्षाः सपिशाचसंघा हता मया यातुधानाश्च सर्वे //
text_mt: "I destroy whatever is impure; all the gods and Dānavas have been struck down by me; / the Rakṣases, Yakṣas, along with the hosts of Piśācas, have been slain by me, and all the Yātudhānas."

sanskrit_iast:
etena mantreṇa tu saṃyatātmā tāṃ vai vediṃ sakṛdullikhya dhīraḥ /
śivāṃ hi buddhiṃ dhruvamicchamānaḥ kṣipeddvicātirdiśamuttarāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
एतेन मन्त्रेण तु संयतात्मा तां वै वेदिं सकृदुल्लिख्य धीरः /
शिवां हि बुद्धिं ध्रुवमिच्छमानः क्षिपेद्द्विचातिर्दिशमुत्तरां गतः //
text_mt: With this mantra, self-restrained, the steadfast man, having inscribed that altar once, / desiring auspicious and enduring wisdom, turning to the north, should toss [the implement].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pitryaṃ dṛṣṭamantraṃ hi yasyatasyāsurā varjayantīha sarve /
yasmindeśe paṭhyate mantra eṣa taṃ vai deśaṃ rākṣasā varjayanti //
meaning:
एवं पित्र्यं दृष्टमन्त्रं हि यस्यतस्यासुरा वर्जयन्तीह सर्वे /
यस्मिन्देशे पठ्यते मन्त्र एष तं वै देशं राक्षसा वर्जयन्ति //
text_mt: Indeed, all the Asuras avoid the rite of him whose ancestral mantra is thus seen; / the Rākṣasas shun that region in which this mantra is recited.

sanskrit_iast:
annaprakārānaśucīnasādhūnsaṃvīkṣate no spṛśaṃśvāpi dadyāt /
pavitrapāṇiśca bhavenna vā hi yaḥ pumānna kāryasya phalaṃ samaśnute //
meaning:
अन्नप्रकारानशुचीनसाधून्संवीक्षते नो स्पृशंश्वापि दद्यात् /
पवित्रपाणिश्च भवेन्न वा हि यः पुमान्न कार्यस्य फलं समश्नुते //
text_mt: If a man looks upon impure, improper varieties of food, or touches them while giving, / or if he does not hold a purifier in his hand, he does not obtain the fruit of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā nityaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāddhi yaḥ sadā /
manasā kāṅkṣate yadyattattadyadyuḥ pitamahāḥ //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना नित्यं श्राद्धं कुर्याद्धि यः सदा /
मनसा काङ्क्षते यद्यत्तत्तद्यद्युः पितमहाः //
text_mt: Whoever constantly performs the śrāddha always according to this procedure, / whatever he desires in his mind, that the grandfathers bestow.

sanskrit_iast:
pitaro hṛṣṭamanaso rakṣāṃsi vimanāṃsi ca /
bhavantyevaṃ kṛte śrāddhe nityameva prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
पितरो हृष्टमनसो रक्षांसि विमनांसि च /
भवन्त्येवं कृते श्राद्धे नित्यमेव प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: The ancestors become delighted in mind and the Rakṣases dispirited / when the śrāddha is performed in this manner always with diligence.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāḥ śrāddheṣvavikṣīraṃ balvajā upalāstathā /
viraṇāścotuvālāśca laḍvā varjyāśca nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
शूद्राः श्राद्धेष्वविक्षीरं बल्वजा उपलास्तथा /
विरणाश्चोतुवालाश्च लड्वा वर्ज्याश्च नित्यशः //
text_mt: Śūdras at śrāddhas, sheep's milk, balvaja grass, stones, / viraṇa grass, utuvāla grass, and laḍva grass are always to be avoided.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīnyayajñāni tṛṇāni parivarjayet /
añjanābhyajanaṃ gandhānsūtrapraṇayanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
एवमादीन्ययज्ञानि तृणानि परिवर्जयेत् /
अञ्जनाभ्यजनं गन्धान्सूत्रप्रणयनं तथा //
text_mt: One should avoid grasses unfit for sacrifice such as these. / Collyrium, ointments, perfumes, and the presenting of the thread,

sanskrit_iast:
kāśeḥ punarbhavaiḥ kāryamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet /
kāśāḥ punarbhavā ye ca barhiṇo hyupabarhiṇaḥ //
meaning:
काशेः पुनर्भवैः कार्यमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् /
काशाः पुनर्भवा ये च बर्हिणो ह्युपबर्हिणः //
text_mt: should be performed with fresh shoots of kāśa grass; he obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice. / The fresh kāśa shoots are the barhis and the upabarhis.

sanskrit_iast:
ityete pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ /
puṣpagandhavibhūṣāṇāmeṣa mantra udāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येते पितरो देवा देवाश्च पितरः पुनः /
पुष्पगन्धविभूषाणामेष मन्त्र उदाहृतः //
text_mt: Thus these ancestors are gods, and the gods again are ancestors. / This mantra is declared for flowers, perfumes, and adornments.

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtya dakṣiṇāgniṃ tu homārthaṃ vai prayatnataḥ /
anyārthe laukikaṃ vāpi juhuyātkarmasiddhaye //
meaning:
आहृत्य दक्षिणाग्निं तु होमार्थं वै प्रयत्नतः /
अन्यार्थे लौकिकं वापि जुहुयात्कर्मसिद्धये //
text_mt: Having brought the dakṣiṇāgni fire with effort for the sake of the oblation, / or a secular fire for another purpose, he should offer oblations for the success of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
antarvidhāya samidhastato dīpto vidhīyate /
samāhitena manasā praṇīyāgniṃ samantataḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्विधाय समिधस्ततो दीप्तो विधीयते /
समाहितेन मनसा प्रणीयाग्निं समन्ततः //
text_mt: Having placed fuel sticks within, the flame is then kindled, / having led the fire in every direction with a collected mind.

sanskrit_iast:
agnaye kavyavāhāya svadhā aṅgirase namaḥ /
somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā aṅgirase punaḥ //
meaning:
अग्नये कव्यवाहाय स्वधा अङ्गिरसे नमः /
सोमाय वै पितृमते स्वधा अङ्गिरसे पुनः //
text_mt: “To Agni, bearer of ancestral offerings, svadhā; to Aṅgiras, obeisance. / To Soma, accompanied by the ancestors, svadhā; to Aṅgiras again.

sanskrit_iast:
yamāya vaivasvataye svadhānama iti dhruvam /
ityete homamantrāstu trayāṇāmanupūrvaśaḥ //
meaning:
यमाय वैवस्वतये स्वधानम इति ध्रुवम् /
इत्येते होममन्त्रास्तु त्रयाणामनुपूर्वशः //
text_mt: To Yama Vaivasvata, svadhā, obeisance,” thus surely [it is spoken]. / These indeed are the oblational formulas for the three, in successive order.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇenāgnaye nityaṃ somāyottaratastathā /
etayorantare nityaṃ juhuyādvai vivasvate //
meaning:
दक्षिणेनाग्नये नित्यं सोमायोत्तरतस्तथा /
एतयोरन्तरे नित्यं जुहुयाद्वै विवस्वते //
text_mt: Always to Agni on the south, and likewise to Soma on the north; / between these two he should always offer indeed unto Vivasvat.

sanskrit_iast:
upahāraḥ svadhākārastathaivollekhanaṃ ca yat /
homajapye namaskāraḥ prokṣaṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
उपहारः स्वधाकारस्तथैवोल्लेखनं च यत् /
होमजप्ये नमस्कारः प्रोक्षणं च विशेषतः //
text_mt: The presentation of offerings, the utterance of “svadhā”, and likewise the furrowing [of the ground], / the obeisance in oblations and muttered prayers, and especially the sprinkling [of water],

sanskrit_iast:
bahuhavyendhane cāgnau susamiddhe tathaiva ca /
añjanābyañjanaṃ caiva piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
बहुहव्येन्धने चाग्नौ सुसमिद्धे तथैव च /
अञ्जनाब्यञ्जनं चैव पिण्डनिर्वपणं तथा //
text_mt: and when the fire has abundant fuel for offerings and is well kindled, / the anointing and smearing, as well as the offering of piṇḍas—

sanskrit_iast:
aśvamedhaphalaṃ caitatsamiddhe yatkṛtaṃ dvijaiḥ /
kriyā sarvā yathoddiṣṭāḥ prayatnena samācaret //
meaning:
अश्वमेधफलं चैतत्समिद्धे यत्कृतं द्विजैः /
क्रिया सर्वा यथोद्दिष्टाः प्रयत्नेन समाचरेत् //
text_mt: this [brings] the fruit of a horse sacrifice when performed by twice-born men in a well-kindled [fire]. / One should perform with effort all the rites as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
bahuhavyendhane cāgnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ /
vidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye //
meaning:
बहुहव्येन्धने चाग्नौ सुसमिद्धे विशेषतः /
विधूमे लेलिहाने च होतव्यं कर्मसिद्धये //
text_mt: In a fire with abundant fuel for offerings, and especially well kindled, / free of smoke and licking up [the fuel], one must offer for the success of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
aprabuddhe samiddhe vā juhuyādyo hutāśane /
yajamāno bhave dandhaḥ so 'mutreti hi naḥ śrutam //
meaning:
अप्रबुद्धे समिद्धे वा जुहुयाद्यो हुताशने /
यजमानो भवे दन्धः सो ऽमुत्रेति हि नः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: If someone should offer in a fire that is unignited or [improperly] kindled, / that sacrificer becomes blind in the next world; so indeed it has been heard by us.

sanskrit_iast:
alpendhano vā rūkṣo 'gnirvasphuliṅgaśca sarvaśaḥ /
jvālādhūmāpasavyaśca sa tu vahnirasiddhaye //
meaning:
अल्पेन्धनो वा रूक्षो ऽग्निर्वस्फुलिङ्गश्च सर्वशः /
ज्वालाधूमापसव्यश्च स तु वह्निरसिद्धये //
text_mt: A fire with little fuel, or rough, emitting sparks on all sides, / whose flames and smoke turn counter-clockwise, leads to failure of the rite.

sanskrit_iast:
durgandhaścaiva nīlaśca kṛṣṇaścaiva viśeṣataḥ /
bhūmiṃ vagāhate yatra tatra vidyātparābhavat //
meaning:
दुर्गन्धश्चैव नीलश्च कृष्णश्चैव विशेषतः /
भूमिं वगाहते यत्र तत्र विद्यात्पराभवत् //
text_mt: That which is foul-smelling, and especially blue or black, / wherever it enters the ground, one should know that defeat [will follow].

sanskrit_iast:
arciṣmān piṇḍitaśikhaḥ sarppikāñjanasannibhaḥ /
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva vahniḥ syātkāryasiddhaye //
meaning:
अर्चिष्मान् पिण्डितशिखः सर्प्पिकाञ्जनसन्निभः /
स्निग्धः प्रदक्षिणश्चैव वह्निः स्यात्कार्यसिद्धये //
text_mt: Radiant, with bunched flames, resembling ghee or collyrium, / smooth and turning clockwise, such a fire brings success in one’s undertaking.

sanskrit_iast:
naranārīgaṇebhyaśca pūjāṃ prāpnoti śāśvatīm /
akṣayaṃ pūjitāstena bhavanti pitaro 'gnayaḥ //
meaning:
नरनारीगणेभ्यश्च पूजां प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् /
अक्षयं पूजितास्तेन भवन्ति पितरो ऽग्नयः //
text_mt: And he attains everlasting worship from groups of men and women; / through him the ancestors and the fires become imperishably worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
bilvoduṃbarapatrāṇi phalāni samidhastathā /
śrāddhe mahāpavitrāṇi medhyāni ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
बिल्वोदुंबरपत्राणि फलानि समिधस्तथा /
श्राद्धे महापवित्राणि मेध्यानि च विशेषतः //
text_mt: Leaves of the bilva and uḍumbara, fruits, and likewise fuel sticks / are supremely purifying in a śrāddha, and especially pure for sacrificial rites.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitraṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śuddhaye janmakarmaṇām /
pātreṣu phalamuddiṣṭaṃ yanmayā śrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
पवित्रं च द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शुद्धये जन्मकर्मणाम् /
पात्रेषु फलमुद्दिष्टं यन्मया श्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: A strainer, O best of the twice-born, [is used] for the purification of rites from birth; / whatever fruit was described by me with regard to the vessels in the śrāddha rite,

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva kṛtsnaṃ vijñeyaṃ samitsu ca yathākramam /
kṛtvā samāhitaṃ cittamāgneyaṃ vai karomyaham //
meaning:
तदेव कृत्स्नं विज्ञेयं समित्सु च यथाक्रमम् /
कृत्वा समाहितं चित्तमाग्नेयं वै करोम्यहम् //
text_mt: all that should be understood to apply to the fuel sticks as well in due order. / Having composed his mind, [he says,] “I shall indeed perform the rite to Agni.”

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tathaiva dvijasattamaiḥ /
ghṛtamādāya pātre ca juhuyāddhavyavāhane //
meaning:
अनुज्ञातः कुरुष्वेति तथैव द्विजसत्तमैः /
घृतमादाय पात्रे च जुहुयाद्धव्यवाहने //
text_mt: Permitted with “Perform [it]” in the same way by the best of the twice-born, / taking ghee in the vessel, he should offer into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
palāśaplakṣanyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṅkatāḥ /
uduṃbarastathābilvaścandano yajñiyāśca ye //
meaning:
पलाशप्लक्षन्यग्रोधप्लक्षाश्वत्थविकङ्कताः /
उदुंबरस्तथाबिल्वश्चन्दनो यज्ञियाश्च ये //
text_mt: Palāśa, plakṣa, nyagrodha, aśvattha, vikaṅkata, / uḍumbara, and likewise bilva, sandalwood, and whichever trees are fit for sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
saralo devadāruśca śālaśca kadirastathā /
samidarthe praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सरलो देवदारुश्च शालश्च कदिरस्तथा /
समिदर्थे प्रशस्ताः स्युरेते वृक्षा विशेषतः //
text_mt: sarala, devadāru, śāla, and likewise khadira— / these trees are especially praiseworthy for the purpose of fuel sticks.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmyāḥ kaṇṭakinaścaiva yājñiyā ye ca kecana /
pūjitāḥ samidarthaṃ te pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ yathā //
meaning:
ग्राम्याः कण्टकिनश्चैव याज्ञिया ये च केचन /
पूजिताः समिदर्थं ते पितॄणां वचनं यथा //
text_mt: Those that grow in villages, those with thorns, and whichever are fit for sacrifice, / they are praised for the purpose of fuel sticks according to the word of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
samidbhiḥ ṣaṭphaleyābhirjuhuyādyo hutāśanam /
phalaṃ yatkarmaṇastasya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
समिद्भिः षट्फलेयाभिर्जुहुयाद्यो हुताशनम् /
फलं यत्कर्मणस्तस्य तन्मे निगदतः शृणु //
text_mt: He who offers into the fire with fuel sticks yielding the six kinds of fruit— / hear from me as I declare the fruit of his action.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayaṃ sarvakāmīyamaśvamedhaphalaṃ hi tat /
śleṣmāntako naktamālaḥ kapitthaḥ śālmalistathā //
meaning:
अक्षयं सर्वकामीयमश्वमेधफलं हि तत् /
श्लेष्मान्तको नक्तमालः कपित्थः शाल्मलिस्तथा //
text_mt: It is imperishable, granting all desires, indeed the fruit of a horse sacrifice. / Śleṣmātaka, naktamāla, kapittha, and likewise śālmali,

sanskrit_iast:
nīpo vibhītakaścaiva śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ /
cirabilvastathā kolastidukaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
नीपो विभीतकश्चैव श्राद्धकर्मणि गर्हिताः /
चिरबिल्वस्तथा कोलस्तिदुकः श्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: nīpa and vibhītaka are condemned in the śrāddha rite; / cirabilva, likewise kola, and tinduka in the śrāddha rite,

sanskrit_iast:
balvajaḥ kovidāraśca varjanīyāḥ samantataḥ /
śakunānāṃ nivāsāṃśca varjayeta mahīruhān //
meaning:
बल्वजः कोविदारश्च वर्जनीयाः समन्ततः /
शकुनानां निवासांश्च वर्जयेत महीरुहान् //
text_mt: balvaja and kovidāra are to be avoided entirely; / and one should avoid trees that are dwellings of birds,

sanskrit_iast:
anyāṃścaivaṃvidhānsarvānnayajñīyāṃśca varjayet /
svadheti caiva mantrāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vacanaṃ yathā /
svāheti caiva devānāṃ yajñakarmaṇyudāhṛtam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye
upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe samidvarṇana nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 11//
meaning:
अन्यांश्चैवंविधान्सर्वान्नयज्ञीयांश्च वर्जयेत् /
स्वधेति चैव मन्त्राणां पितॄणां वचनं यथा /
स्वाहेति चैव देवानां यज्ञकर्मण्युदाहृतम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये
उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे समिद्वर्णन नामैकादशो ऽध्यायः // 11//
text_mt:
and all other such [trees] that are unfit for sacrifice should be avoided. / “Svadhā” is prescribed for the mantras of the ancestors, / while “svāhā” is uttered for the gods in the sacrificial rite.

Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled “Description of Fuel Sticks,” in the Rite of Ancestral Offerings in the Upoddhātapāda, the third middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
devāścapitaraścaiva anyonyaṃ niyatāḥ smṛtāḥ /
ātharvaṇastveṣa vidhirityuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
देवाश्चपितरश्चैव अन्योन्यं नियताः स्मृताः /
आथर्वणस्त्वेष विधिरित्युवाच बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: The bard said: / The gods and the ancestors are traditionally remembered as interdependent. / This is indeed the rule of the Atharvans; so spoke Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayeta pitṝnpūrvaṃ devāṃśca tadanantaram /
devā api pitṝnpūrvamarccayanti hi yatnataḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेत पितॄन्पूर्वं देवांश्च तदनन्तरम् /
देवा अपि पितॄन्पूर्वमर्च्चयन्ति हि यत्नतः //
text_mt: One should worship the ancestors first, and the gods immediately thereafter. / Even the gods diligently worship the ancestors first.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣasya duhitā nāmnā viśvā nāmeti viśrutā /
viśvākhyāstu sutāstasyāṃ dharmato jajñire daśa //
meaning:
दक्षस्य दुहिता नाम्ना विश्वा नामेति विश्रुता /
विश्वाख्यास्तु सुतास्तस्यां धर्मतो जज्ञिरे दश //
text_mt: There was a daughter of Dakṣa, renowned by the name Viśvā; / through Dharma, ten sons known as the Viśvas were born from her.

sanskrit_iast:
prakhyātā striṣu lokeṣu sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ /
samastāste mahātmānaścerurugraṃ mahattapaḥ //
meaning:
प्रख्याता स्त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः /
समस्तास्ते महात्मानश्चेरुरुग्रं महत्तपः //
text_mt: Famed in the three worlds, bowed to by all the worlds, / all those great-souled ones performed fierce, severe austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
himavacchikhare ramye devarṣigaṇasevite /
śuddhena mansā prītā ūcustānpitarastadā //
meaning:
हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये देवर्षिगणसेविते /
शुद्धेन मन्सा प्रीता ऊचुस्तान्पितरस्तदा //
text_mt: On a delightful peak of the Himālaya, frequented by hosts of divine seers, / the ancestors, pleased with pure minds, then spoke to them:

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ prītāḥ sma kaṃ kāmaṃ kakhāmahe /
evamukte tu pitṛbhistadā trailokyabhāvanaḥ //
meaning:
वरं वृणीध्वं प्रीताः स्म कं कामं कखामहे /
एवमुक्ते तु पितृभिस्तदा त्रैलोक्यभावनः //
text_mt: “Choose a boon! We are pleased; what desire shall we fulfill?” / When spoken to thus by the ancestors, then the creator of the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca mahātejāstapasā taistu toṣitaḥ /
prīto 'smi tapasānena kaṃ kāmaṃ karavāṇi vaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच महातेजास्तपसा तैस्तु तोषितः /
प्रीतो ऽस्मि तपसानेन कं कामं करवाणि वः //
text_mt: Brahmā of great splendor, delighted by their austerities, spoke: / “I am pleased with this austerity; what desire shall I fulfill for you?”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktāstadā viśve brahmaṇā viśvakarmaṇā /
ūcuste sahitāḥ sarve brahmāṇāṃ lokabhāvanam //
meaning:
