vṛthā jaṭī vṛthā muṇḍī vṛthā nagnaśca yo dvijaḥ //
meaning:
ये धर्मं नानुवर्त्तन्ते ते वै नग्नादयो जनाः /
वृथा जटी वृथा मुण्डी वृथा नग्नश्च यो द्विजः //
text_mt: Those who do not follow dharma are indeed the 'naked' and the rest. / The twice-born who uselessly has matted hair, is uselessly shaved, or is uselessly naked,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā vratī vṛthā jāpī te vai nagnādayo janāḥ /
kuladharmātigāḥ śaśvadvṛthā vṛttikalatrakāḥ //
meaning:
वृथा व्रती वृथा जापी ते वै नग्नादयो जनाः /
कुलधर्मातिगाः शश्वद्वृथा वृत्तिकलत्रकाः //
text_mt: uselessly observes vows, or uselessly recites prayers—they are indeed the 'naked' and the rest, / transgressing family dharma, with useless livelihood and wives.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakarmadiśastvete kupathāḥ parikīrttitāḥ /
etairhi dattaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vai śrāddhaṃ gacchati dānavān //
meaning:
कृतकर्मदिशस्त्वेते कुपथाः परिकीर्त्तिताः /
एतैर्हि दत्तं दृष्टं वै श्राद्धं गच्छति दानवान् //
text_mt: These, having taken up false paths of action, are called followers of the wrong way. / Indeed, what is given or seen by them at a śrāddha goes to the dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca nāstiko gurutalpagaḥ /
dasyuścaiva nṛśaṃsaśca darṇane tānvisarjayet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च कृतघ्नश्च नास्तिको गुरुतल्पगः /
दस्युश्चैव नृशंसश्च दर्णने तान्विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: A slayer of a brāhmaṇa, an ungrateful person, an atheist, a defiler of a guru's bed, / a robber, and a cruel man—one should dismiss them from view.

sanskrit_iast:
patitāḥ krūrakarmāṇaḥ sarvāṃstānparivarjayet /
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca vivāde pravadanti ye //
meaning:
पतिताः क्रूरकर्माणः सर्वांस्तान्परिवर्जयेत् /
देवतानामृषीणां च विवादे प्रवदन्ति ये //
text_mt: The fallen and the cruel in action—all these one should avoid; / and those who dispute in debates concerning the gods and the sages,

sanskrit_iast:
devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścaiva āmnāyaṃ yastu nindati /
asurānyātudhānāṃśca dṛṣṭamebhirvrajatyuta //
meaning:
देवांश्च ब्राह्मणांश्चैव आम्नायं यस्तु निन्दति /
असुरान्यातुधानांश्च दृष्टमेभिर्व्रजत्युत //
text_mt: and whoever reviles the gods, the brāhmaṇas, and the sacred tradition— / when seen by these, [the offering] goes to the asuras and yātudhānas.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatrriyaṃ yugam /
vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मं कृतयुगं प्रोक्तं त्रेता तु क्षत्र्रियं युगम् /
वैश्यं द्वापरमित्याहुः शूद्रं कलियुगं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The Kṛta age is declared to belong to brāhmaṇas, the Tretā age to kṣatriyas, / the Dvāpara age they call that of vaiśyas, and the Kali age is known as that of śūdras.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte 'pūjyanta pitarastretāyāṃ tu surāstathā /
yuddhāni dvāpare nityaṃ pākhaṇḍāśca kalau yuge //
meaning:
कृते ऽपूज्यन्त पितरस्त्रेतायां तु सुरास्तथा /
युद्धानि द्वापरे नित्यं पाखण्डाश्च कलौ युगे //
text_mt: In the Kṛta age the ancestors were worshiped; in the Tretā, likewise the gods; / in the Dvāpara there was constant war, and in the Kali age, heretics.

sanskrit_iast:
apamānāpaviddhaśca kukkuṭo grāmasūkaraḥ /
śvā caiva hanti śrāddhāni darśanādeva sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
अपमानापविद्धश्च कुक्कुटो ग्रामसूकरः /
श्वा चैव हन्ति श्राद्धानि दर्शनादेव सर्वशः //
text_mt: A cock, a village pig, and a dog, / neglected through contempt, ruin śrāddhas merely by seeing them in every way.

sanskrit_iast:
śvasūkaropa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dīrgharogibhireva ca /
patitairmalinaiścaiva na draṣṭavyaṃ kathañcana //
meaning:
श्वसूकरोप संसृष्टं दीर्घरोगिभिरेव च /
पतितैर्मलिनैश्चैव न द्रष्टव्यं कथञ्चन //
text_mt: What is contaminated by a dog or a pig, by those chronically ill, / by the fallen, or by the unwashed must never be seen [by them].

sanskrit_iast:
annaṃ paśyeyurete yattannārhaṃ havyakavyayoḥ /
utsraṣṭavyāḥ pradhā nārthaiḥ saṃskārastvāpado bhavet //
meaning:
अन्नं पश्येयुरेते यत्तन्नार्हं हव्यकव्ययोः /
उत्स्रष्टव्याः प्रधा नार्थैः संस्कारस्त्वापदो भवेत् //
text_mt: The food they look upon is not fit for oblations to the gods or ancestors. / Principal items should be discarded, but in times of distress purification is permitted.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣāṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca pūrvameva vivarjayet /
sṛṣṭaṃ yuktābhiradbhiśca prokṣaṇaṃ ca vidhīyate //
meaning:
हविषां संहतानां च पूर्वमेव विवर्जयेत् /
सृष्टं युक्ताभिरद्भिश्च प्रोक्षणं च विधीयते //
text_mt: One should first discard what has touched contaminated sacrificial food; / sprinkling with appropriate water is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaṃ vāpyapavāraṇam /
gurusūryāgnivāsrāṇāṃ darśanaṃ vāpi yatnataḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धार्थकैः कृष्णतिलैः कार्यं वाप्यपवारणम् /
गुरुसूर्याग्निवास्राणां दर्शनं वापि यत्नतः //
text_mt: Warding off [impurity] should be done with white mustard seeds and black sesame, / or by carefully showing it to the guru, the sun, or fire.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanārūḍhamannādyaṃ pādopahatameva ca /
amedhyairjaṅgamairdṛṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat //
meaning:
आसनारूढमन्नाद्यं पादोपहतमेव च /
अमेध्यैर्जङ्गमैर्दृष्टं शुष्कं पर्युषितं च यत् //
text_mt: Food that has been set on a seat, touched by feet, / seen by impure animals, dried out, or kept overnight,

sanskrit_iast:
asvinnaṃ paridagdhaṃ ca tathaivāgnāvalehitam /
śarkarākīṭapāṣāṇaiḥ keśairyaccāpyu pāhṛtam //
meaning:
अस्विन्नं परिदग्धं च तथैवाग्नावलेहितम् /
शर्कराकीटपाषाणैः केशैर्यच्चाप्यु पाहृतम् //
text_mt: undercooked, burnt, or licked by fire, / or contaminated with gravel, insects, stones, and hair,

sanskrit_iast:
piṇyākaṃ mathitaṃ caiva tathā tilayavādiṣu /
siddhīkṛtāśca ye bhakṣyāḥ pratyakṣalavaṇīkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
पिण्याकं मथितं चैव तथा तिलयवादिषु /
सिद्धीकृताश्च ये भक्ष्याः प्रत्यक्षलवणीकृताः //
text_mt: oil-cake, buttermilk, and eatables prepared with sesame, barley, and the like / that have been salted after cooking,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā caiva tathā doṣopāttaśvopahataṃ tathā /
vāsasā cāvadhūtāni varjyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा चैव तथा दोषोपात्तश्वोपहतं तथा /
वाससा चावधूतानि वर्ज्यानि श्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: and likewise what has been seen with faults, touched by dogs, / or shaken by a cloth—these must be avoided in the śrāddha rite.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃti vedavirodhena kecidvijñābhimāninaḥ /
ayajñaya tayo nāma te dhvaṃsaṃti yathā rajaḥ //
meaning:
संति वेदविरोधेन केचिद्विज्ञाभिमानिनः /
अयज्ञय तयो नाम ते ध्वंसंति यथा रजः //
text_mt: There are some who, opposing the Veda, pride themselves on knowledge; / those sacrifices of theirs perish like dust.

sanskrit_iast:
dadhiśākaṃ tathā bhakṣyaṃ tathā cauṣadhivarjitam /
vārttākaṃ varjayecchrāddhe sarvānabhiṣavānapi /
saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva tathā mānasasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
दधिशाकं तथा भक्ष्यं तथा चौषधिवर्जितम् /
वार्त्ताकं वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे सर्वानभिषवानपि /
सैन्धवं लवणं चैव तथा मानससंभवम् //
text_mt: Curds, herbs, and food lacking [proper] medicinal plants, / eggplant must be avoided in the śrāddha, as well as all fermented drinks, / rock salt, and salt from the Mānasa lake.

sanskrit_iast:
pavitre parame hyete pratyakṣamapi vartite /
agnau prakṣipya gṛṅṇīyāddhastau prakṣipya yatnataḥ //
meaning:
पवित्रे परमे ह्येते प्रत्यक्षमपि वर्तिते /
अग्नौ प्रक्षिप्य गृङ्णीयाद्धस्तौ प्रक्षिप्य यत्नतः //
text_mt: These two [salts] are supremely pure, even when visibly existing; / throwing them into the fire, one should take them, having washed one's hands carefully.

sanskrit_iast:
gamayenmastakaṃ caiva brahmatīrthaṃ hi tatsmṛtam /
dravyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tathaivāvapanaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
गमयेन्मस्तकं चैव ब्रह्मतीर्थं हि तत्स्मृतम् /
द्रव्याणां प्रोक्षणं कार्यं तथैवावपनं पुनः //
text_mt: He should pass it to the head, for that is known as the Brahmā tīrtha; / sprinkling of the substances is to be done, as well as strewing.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya cādbhiḥ siṃcetta ttathā cāsu niveśanam /
aśmamūlaphalekṣūṇāṃ rajjūnāṃ carmaṇāmapi //
meaning:
निधाय चाद्भिः सिंचेत्त त्तथा चासु निवेशनम् /
अश्ममूलफलेक्षूणां रज्जूनां चर्मणामपि //
text_mt: Having placed it, one should sprinkle it with water and set it down. / For stones, roots, fruits, sugarcane, ropes, and hides,

sanskrit_iast:
vaidalānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pūrvavacchaucamiṣyate /
tathā dantāsthi dāruṇāṃ śṛṅgāṇāṃ cāvalekhanam //
meaning:
वैदलानां च सर्वेषां पूर्ववच्छौचमिष्यते /
तथा दन्तास्थि दारुणां शृङ्गाणां चावलेखनम् //
text_mt: and for all split-reed items, purification is desired as before; / likewise the scraping of ivory, bone, wood, and horns.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ mṛnmayānāṃ ca punardāho vidhīyate /
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ jalajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां मृन्मयानां च पुनर्दाहो विधीयते /
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां जलजानां च सर्वशः //
text_mt: For all earthen items, re-burning is prescribed. / For gems, pearls, corals, and all things born in water,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthakānāṃ kalkena tilakalkena vā punaḥ /
syācchaucaṃ sarvabālānāmāvikānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धार्थकानां कल्केन तिलकल्केन वा पुनः /
स्याच्छौचं सर्वबालानामाविकानां च सर्वशः //
text_mt: purification should be with the paste of white mustard or the paste of sesame, / and likewise for all hair garments and woollen items.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipadāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ mṛdbhiradbhirvidhīyate /
ādyantayostu śaucānāmadbhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ vidhiḥ //
meaning:
द्विपदां चैव सर्वेषां मृद्भिरद्भिर्विधीयते /
आद्यन्तयोस्तु शौचानामद्भिः प्रक्षालनं विधिः //
text_mt: And for all two-footed beings, purification is prescribed with earth and water; / but the rule is washing with water at the beginning and the end of purifications.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kārpāsikānāṃ ca bhasmanā samudāhṛtam /
phalapuṣpapalāśānāṃ plāvanaṃ cādbhiriṣyate //
meaning:
तथा कार्पासिकानां च भस्मना समुदाहृतम् /
फलपुष्पपलाशानां प्लावनं चाद्भिरिष्यते //
text_mt: Likewise, for cotton items, [cleansing] with ash is declared; / and immersion in water is prescribed for fruits, flowers, and leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇaṃ hyupalepaśca bhūmeścaivāvalekhanam /
niṣeko gokramo dāhaḥ khananaṃ śuddhiriṣyate //
meaning:
प्रोक्षणं ह्युपलेपश्च भूमेश्चैवावलेखनम् /
निषेको गोक्रमो दाहः खननं शुद्धिरिष्यते //
text_mt: Sprinkling, plastering [with cow dung], scraping of the ground, / drenching, the trampling of cows, burning, and digging are prescribed as purification.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkramo 'dhvagato grāmādvāyupūtā vasuṃdharā /
puṃsāṃ catuṣpadāṃ cava mṛdbhiḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
निष्क्रमो ऽध्वगतो ग्रामाद्वायुपूता वसुंधरा /
पुंसां चतुष्पदां चव मृद्भिः शौचं विधीयते //
text_mt: Stepping out from a village as a traveler, the earth is purified by the wind; / purification with earth is prescribed for men and four-footed beasts.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva samuddiṣṭaḥ śaucānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ /
anirdiṣṭamato yadyattanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
एवमेव समुद्दिष्टः शौचानां विधिरुत्तमः /
अनिर्दिष्टमतो यद्यत्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु //
text_mt: Just so has the supreme rule of purifications been set forth; / whatever is not yet stated, hear that as I declare it.

sanskrit_iast:
prātargṛhāddakṣiṇapaścimena gatvā ceṣukṣepamātraṃ padaṃ vai /
kuryātpurīṣaṃ hi śiro 'vaguṇṭhya na vai spṛśejjātu śiraḥ kareṇa //
meaning:
प्रातर्गृहाद्दक्षिणपश्चिमेन गत्वा चेषुक्षेपमात्रं पदं वै /
कुर्यात्पुरीषं हि शिरो ऽवगुण्ठ्य न वै स्पृशेज्जातु शिरः करेण //
text_mt: Having gone in the morning to the south-west of the house, a distance of merely an arrow's flight, / one should defecate, having veiled one's head; one must never touch one's head with the hand.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaistṛṇairvā kārṣṭhairvā parṇairveṇudalaina ca /
susaṃvṛtte pradeśe ca ṇantardhāya vasuṃdharām //
meaning:
शुक्लैस्तृणैर्वा कार्ष्ठैर्वा पर्णैर्वेणुदलैन च /
सुसंवृत्ते प्रदेशे च णन्तर्धाय वसुंधराम् //
text_mt: With white grass or sticks, leaves, or split bamboo, / in a well-concealed place, having covered the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
uddhṛtyodakamādāya mṛttikāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ /
divā udaṅmukhaḥ kuryādrātrau vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ //
meaning:
उद्धृत्योदकमादाय मृत्तिकां चैव वाग्यतः /
दिवा उदङ्मुखः कुर्याद्रात्रौ वै दक्षिणामुखः //
text_mt: having fetched and taken water and earth, remaining silent, / one should do so facing north by day, and facing south by night.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇena tu hastena gṛhītvātha kamaṇḍalum /
śaucaṃ vāmena hastena gude tisrastu mṛttikāḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन गृहीत्वाथ कमण्डलुम् /
शौचं वामेन हस्तेन गुदे तिस्रस्तु मृत्तिकाः //
text_mt: Having taken the water pot with the right hand, / [performing] purification with the left hand, three applications of earth to the anus,

sanskrit_iast:
daśa cāpi śanairdadyādvāmahaste krameṇa tu /
ubhābhyāṃ vā punardadyāddvābhyāṃ sapta tu mṛttikāḥ //
meaning:
दश चापि शनैर्दद्याद्वामहस्ते क्रमेण तु /
उभाभ्यां वा पुनर्दद्याद्द्वाभ्यां सप्त तु मृत्तिकाः //
text_mt: and ten slowly and successively to the left hand; / or again with both, seven applications of earth with both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdā prakṣālya pādau tu ācamya ca yathāvidhi /
āpastvādyāstrayaścaiva suryāgnyaniladevatāḥ //
meaning:
मृदा प्रक्षाल्य पादौ तु आचम्य च यथाविधि /
आपस्त्वाद्यास्त्रयश्चैव सुर्याग्न्यनिलदेवताः //
text_mt: Having washed the two feet with earth and sipped water according to rule; / for the waters are the first three deities—the Sun, Fire, and Wind.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātsaṃnihito nityamacchidre dve kamaṇḍalū /
ḥṃsavāryavanaireva yathāvatpādadhāvanam //
meaning:
कुर्यात्संनिहितो नित्यमच्छिद्रे द्वे कमण्डलू /
ःंसवार्यवनैरेव यथावत्पादधावनम् //
text_mt: One should keep near at all times two flawless water pots; / [and perform] proper washing of the feet with swan-pure water alone.

sanskrit_iast:
ācamanaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca devakārye tato 'param /
upavāsastrirātraṃ tu duṣṭamukte hyudātdṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आचमनं द्वितीयं च देवकार्ये ततो ऽपरम् /
उपवासस्त्रिरात्रं तु दुष्टमुक्ते ह्युदात्दृतः //
text_mt: Then another, a second water-sipping for a rite to the gods; / a three-night fast is declared if one has been released from defilement.

sanskrit_iast:
viprakṛṣṭeṣu kṛcchraṃ ca prāya ścittamudāhṛtam /
spṛṣṭvā śvānaṃ śvapākaṃ ca taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret //
meaning:
विप्रकृष्टेषु कृच्छ्रं च प्राय श्चित्तमुदाहृतम् /
स्पृष्ट्वा श्वानं श्वपाकं च तप्तकृच्छ्रं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: In severe matters, a kṛcchra penance is declared as expiation; / having touched a dog or an outcaste, one should perform a taptakṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣāsthīni saṃspṛśya upoṣyaṃ śucikāraṇāt /
trirātramuktaṃ sasnehānyekarātramato 'nyathā //
meaning:
मानुषास्थीनि संस्पृश्य उपोष्यं शुचिकारणात् /
त्रिरात्रमुक्तं सस्नेहान्येकरात्रमतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: Having touched human bones, fasting is prescribed for purification: / a three-night fast is stated if they are moist [with fat]; otherwise, a single night.

sanskrit_iast:
kāraskarāḥ kaliṅgāśca tathāndhraśabarādayaḥ /
pītvā cāpobhūtilapā gatvā cāpi yugaṃ dharam //
meaning:
कारस्कराः कलिङ्गाश्च तथान्ध्रशबरादयः /
पीत्वा चापोभूतिलपा गत्वा चापि युगं धरम् //
text_mt: To the Kāraskaras, Kaliṅgas, Andhras, Śabaras, and others, / drinking water there, or going to the Yugaṃdhara,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdhoruttaraparyantaṃ tathodīcyantaraṃ naraḥ /
pāpadeśāśca ye kecitpāpairadhyuṣitā janaiḥ //
meaning:
सिंधोरुत्तरपर्यन्तं तथोदीच्यन्तरं नरः /
पापदेशाश्च ये केचित्पापैरध्युषिता जनैः //
text_mt: up to the northern border of the Indus, and into the northern interior, / or whatever sinful lands are inhabited by wicked people,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣṭaistu varjitā ye vai brāhmaṇailvedapāragaiḥ /
gacchatāṃ rāgasaṃmohātteṣāṃ pāpaṃ na gacchati //
meaning:
शिष्टैस्तु वर्जिता ये वै ब्राह्मणैल्वेदपारगैः /
गच्छतां रागसंमोहात्तेषां पापं न गच्छति //
text_mt: which are shunned by the cultivated and by Brahmins versed in the Vedas— / for those who go [there] out of attachment and delusion, sin does not leave them.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā deśānapuṇyāṃstu kṛtsnaṃ pāpaṃ samaśnute /
āruhya bhṛgutuṅgaṃ tu gatvā puṇyāṃ sarasvatīm //
meaning:
गत्वा देशानपुण्यांस्तु कृत्स्नं पापं समश्नुते /
आरुह्य भृगुतुङ्गं तु गत्वा पुण्यां सरस्वतीम् //
text_mt: Having gone to unholy regions, one incurs total sin; / but ascending the peak of Bhṛgutuṅga, or going to the holy Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
āpagāṃ ca nadīṃ ramyāṃ gaṅgāṃ devīṃ mahānadīm /
himavatprabhavā nadyo yāścānyā ṛṣipūcitāḥ //
meaning:
आपगां च नदीं रम्यां गङ्गां देवीं महानदीम् /
हिमवत्प्रभवा नद्यो याश्चान्या ऋषिपूचिताः //
text_mt: and the delightful stream Āpagā, the divine Gaṅgā, the great river, / and other rivers originating from the Himavat that are revered by ṛṣis,

sanskrit_iast:
sarastīrthāni sarvāṇi nadīḥ prasravaṇāni ca /
gatvaitānmucyate pāpaiḥ svarge cātyantamaśnute //
meaning:
सरस्तीर्थानि सर्वाणि नदीः प्रस्रवणानि च /
गत्वैतान्मुच्यते पापैः स्वर्गे चात्यन्तमश्नुते //
text_mt: to all the sacred lakes, sacred fords, rivers, and springs— / having gone to these, one is freed from sins and attains heaven forever.

sanskrit_iast:
daśarātramaśaucaṃ tu proktaṃ mṛtakamūtake /
brahmaṇasya dvādaśāhaṃ kṣatriyasya vidhīyate //
meaning:
दशरात्रमशौचं तु प्रोक्तं मृतकमूतके /
ब्रह्मणस्य द्वादशाहं क्षत्रियस्य विधीयते //
text_mt: Impurity of ten nights is declared at a death and at a birth / for a Brahmin; twelve days is prescribed for a kṣatriya;

sanskrit_iast:
arddhamāsaṃ tu vaiśyasya māsaṃ śūdrasya caiva ha /
udakyā sarvavarṇānāṃ catūrātreṇa śudhyati //
meaning:
अर्द्धमासं तु वैश्यस्य मासं शूद्रस्य चैव ह /
उदक्या सर्ववर्णानां चतूरात्रेण शुध्यति //
text_mt: half a month for a vaiśya, and a month for a śūdra; / a menstruating woman of all classes is purified after four nights.

sanskrit_iast:
udakyāṃ sūtikāṃ caiva śvānamantāvasāyinam /
nagnādīnmṛtahārāṃśca spṛṣṭvā śaucaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
उदक्यां सूतिकां चैव श्वानमन्तावसायिनम् /
नग्नादीन्मृतहारांश्च स्पृष्ट्वा शौचं विधीयते //
text_mt: Having touched a menstruating woman, a woman in childbed, a dog, an outcaste, / naked ascetics, and corpse-bearers, purification is prescribed:

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā sacailo mṛdbhistu śuddho dvādaśabhirdvijaḥ /
etadeva bhavecchaucaṃ maithune vamane tathā //
meaning:
स्नात्वा सचैलो मृद्भिस्तु शुद्धो द्वादशभिर्द्विजः /
एतदेव भवेच्छौचं मैथुने वमने तथा //
text_mt: Having bathed with one's clothes on, a twice-born is purified with twelve applications of earth; / this same purification applies after sexual intercourse and after vomiting.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdā prakṣālyahastau tu kuryācchaucaṃ ca mānavaḥ /
prakṣālya cādbhiḥ snātvā tu hastau caiva punarmṛdā //
meaning:
मृदा प्रक्षाल्यहस्तौ तु कुर्याच्छौचं च मानवः /
प्रक्षाल्य चाद्भिः स्नात्वा तु हस्तौ चैव पुनर्मृदा //
text_mt: Having washed both hands with earth, a man should perform purification; / and having rinsed with water and bathed, then again [cleanse] both hands with earth,

sanskrit_iast:
triḥ kṛtvā dvādaśāntāni yathā lepastathā bhavet /
evaṃ śaucavidhirdṛṣṭaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu nityadā //
meaning:
त्रिः कृत्वा द्वादशान्तानि यथा लेपस्तथा भवेत् /
एवं शौचविधिर्दृष्टः सर्वकृत्येषु नित्यदा //
text_mt: doing it thrice up to twelve times, according to the extent of defilement; / thus is the rule of purification seen constantly in all duties.

sanskrit_iast:
paridadyānmṛdastisrastisraḥ pādāvasecane /
araṇye śaucametattu grāmyaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param //
meaning:
परिदद्यान्मृदस्तिस्रस्तिस्रः पादावसेचने /
अरण्ये शौचमेतत्तु ग्राम्यं वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् //
text_mt: One should apply three earths, and three in washing the feet; / this is the purification in the wilderness, but next I will speak of that in a village.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdaḥ pañcadaśāmedhyā hastādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
atiriktamṛdaṃ dadyānmṛdante tvadbhireva ca //
meaning:
मृदः पञ्चदशामेध्या हस्तादीनां विशेषतः /
अतिरिक्तमृदं दद्यान्मृदन्ते त्वद्भिरेव च //
text_mt: Fifteen earths for defilement, especially of the hands and the like; / one should apply an extra earth, and at the end of the earths, with water alone.

sanskrit_iast:
adbhiravyaktake śaucametaccaiteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ /
kaṇṭhaṃ śiro vā āvṛtya rathyāpaṇagato 'pi vā //
meaning:
अद्भिरव्यक्तके शौचमेतच्चैतेषु कृत्स्नशः /
कण्ठं शिरो वा आवृत्य रथ्यापणगतो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Purification with water is for the invisible [particles], and this entirely applies to these [cases]; / covering one's neck or head, or having gone onto a street or marketplace,

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā pādayoḥ śaucamācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet /
pakṣālya pātraṃ nikṣipya ācamyābhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचमाचान्तो ऽप्यशुचिर्भवेत् /
पक्षाल्य पात्रं निक्षिप्य आचम्याभ्युक्षणं ततः //
text_mt: without having washed one's feet, even if one has sipped water, one remains impure; / having washed the vessel, set it down, and sipped water, then sprinkling [should be done].

sanskrit_iast:
dravyasyānyasya tu tathā kuryādabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ /
puṣpādīnāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca prokṣaṇaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā //
meaning:
द्रव्यस्यान्यस्य तु तथा कुर्यादभ्युक्षणं ततः /
पुष्पादीनां तृणानां च प्रोक्षणं हविषां तथा //
text_mt: Then likewise, one should sprinkle any other article; / flowers and the like, and grasses, as well as sacrificial offerings, [require] sprinkling;

sanskrit_iast:
parātdṛtānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ nidhāyābhyukṣaṇaṃ tathā /
nāprokṣitaṃ spṛśetkiñcicchraddhe daive 'tha vā punaḥ //
meaning:
परात्दृतानां द्रव्याणां निधायाभ्युक्षणं तथा /
नाप्रोक्षितं स्पृशेत्किञ्चिच्छ्रद्धे दैवे ऽथ वा पुनः //
text_mt: and after placing down articles brought by others, sprinkling [is prescribed]; / one should touch nothing unsprinkled in an ancestral or a divine rite.

sanskrit_iast:
uttaroṇāhareddravyaṃ dakṣiṇena visarjayet /
saṃvṛte yajamānastu sarvaśrāddhe samāharet //
meaning:
उत्तरोणाहरेद्द्रव्यं दक्षिणेन विसर्जयेत् /
संवृते यजमानस्तु सर्वश्राद्धे समाहरेत् //
text_mt: One should bring an article with the left hand and offer it with the right; / the sacrificer should gather it in a concealed place in every ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭe syādviparyāsodaive pitryetathaiva ca /
dakṣiṇena tu hastena dakṣiṇāṃ vedimālabhet //
meaning:
उच्छिष्टे स्याद्विपर्यासोदैवे पित्र्येतथैव च /
दक्षिणेन तु हस्तेन दक्षिणां वेदिमालभेत् //
text_mt: For leftover food, the reverse applies in divine and ancestral rites; / with the right hand, one should touch the southern altar.

sanskrit_iast:
karābhyāmeva devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vikaraṃ tathā /
kṣaraṇaṃ svapnayoścaiva tathā mūtrapurīṣayo //
meaning:
कराभ्यामेव देवानां पितॄणां विकरं तथा /
क्षरणं स्वप्नयोश्चैव तथा मूत्रपुरीषयो //
text_mt: With both hands, [the offering is made] to the gods, and scattered food to the ancestors; / [after] emission and during dreams, and likewise after urine and feces,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣṭhīvite tathābhyaṅge bhutkvā viparidhāya ca /
ucchiṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsparśe tathā pādāvasecane //
meaning:
निष्ठीविते तथाभ्यङ्गे भुत्क्वा विपरिधाय च /
उच्छिष्टानां च संस्पर्शे तथा पादावसेचने //
text_mt: after spitting, oil massage, eating, and changing clothes, / upon touching impure things, and in washing the feet,

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭasya ca saṃbhāṣādaśitvā prayatasya vā /
saṃdeheṣu ca sarveṣu śikhāṃ muktvā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
उच्छिष्टस्य च संभाषादशित्वा प्रयतस्य वा /
संदेहेषु च सर्वेषु शिखां मुक्त्वा तथैव च //
text_mt: after conversing with an impure person, or having eaten when pure, / and in all doubts, and having untied one's topknot,

sanskrit_iast:
vinā yajñopavītena moghaṃ tatsamupaspṛśet /
uṣṭrasyāveśca saṃsparśe darśane 'vācyavācinām //
meaning:
विना यज्ञोपवीतेन मोघं तत्समुपस्पृशेत् /
उष्ट्रस्यावेश्च संस्पर्शे दर्शने ऽवाच्यवाचिनाम् //
text_mt: without a sacred thread, touching [water] is in vain; / upon touching a camel or a sheep, or seeing those who speak unspeakable things,

sanskrit_iast:
jihvayā caiva saṃsvṛśya detāsaktaṃ tathaiva ca /
saśabdamegulībhirvā patitaṃ vā vilokayan //
meaning:
जिह्वया चैव संस्वृश्य देतासक्तं तथैव च /
सशब्दमेगुलीभिर्वा पतितं वा विलोकयन् //
text_mt: having touched with the tongue, or when something is stuck between the teeth, / or hearing a sound with fingers, or looking upon a fallen person,

sanskrit_iast:
sthito yaścācamenmohadācānto 'pyaśucirbhavet /
upaviśya śucau deśe prayataḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
स्थितो यश्चाचमेन्मोहदाचान्तो ऽप्यशुचिर्भवेत् /
उपविश्य शुचौ देशे प्रयतः प्रागुदङ्मुखः //
text_mt: one who sips water while standing out of delusion remains impure even though he has sipped water; / having sat down in a clean place, pure, facing east or north,

sanskrit_iast:
pādau prakṣālya hastau ca antarjānu tvapaḥ spṛśet /
prasannastriḥ pibedvāri prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ //
meaning:
पादौ प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ च अन्तर्जानु त्वपः स्पृशेत् /
प्रसन्नस्त्रिः पिबेद्वारि प्रयतः सुसमाहितः //
text_mt: having washed both feet and both hands, one should touch water between the knees; / pure and well-composed, one should serenely drink water three times.

sanskrit_iast:
dvireva mārjanaṃ kuryātsakṛdabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥ /
khāni mūrddhānamātmānaṃ hastau pādau tathaiva ca //
meaning:
द्विरेव मार्जनं कुर्यात्सकृदभ्युक्षणं ततः /
खानि मूर्द्धानमात्मानं हस्तौ पादौ तथैव च //
text_mt: One should wipe [the mouth] twice, and then sprinkle once; / the bodily orifices, the head, one's self, the hands, and likewise the feet—

sanskrit_iast:
abhyukṣayettatastasya yadyanmīmāṃsita bhavet /
evamācamatastasya vedā yajñāstapāṃsi ca //
meaning:
अभ्युक्षयेत्ततस्तस्य यद्यन्मीमांसित भवेत् /
एवमाचमतस्तस्य वेदा यज्ञास्तपांसि च //
text_mt: one should sprinkle then whatever may be considered doubtful; / for one who sips water in this manner, the Vedas, sacrifices, and austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni vratacaryāśca bhavanti saphalāni vai /
kriyāṃ yaḥ kurute mohādanāsamyeha nāstikaḥ //
meaning:
दानानि व्रतचर्याश्च भवन्ति सफलानि वै /
क्रियां यः कुरुते मोहादनासम्येह नास्तिकः //
text_mt: gifts, and the observance of vows become fruitful indeed; / but an unbeliever who performs a rite here out of delusion without sipping water,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanti hi vṛthā tasya kriyā hyetā na saṃśayaḥ /
vākkāyabuddhipūtāni aspṛṣṭaṃ vāpyaninditam //
meaning:
भवन्ति हि वृथा तस्य क्रिया ह्येता न संशयः /
वाक्कायबुद्धिपूतानि अस्पृष्टं वाप्यनिन्दितम् //
text_mt: his rites indeed become fruitless, without doubt; / things purified by speech, body, and intellect, or untouched and unblamed,

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyānyetāni medhyāni duṣṭamedhyo viparyaye /
manovākkāyamagniśca kālaścaivopalekhanam //
meaning:
ज्ञेयान्येतानि मेध्यानि दुष्टमेध्यो विपर्यये /
मनोवाक्कायमग्निश्च कालश्चैवोपलेखनम् //
text_mt: these are to be known as pure, and impure in the reverse case; / the mind, speech, body, fire, time, and smearing [with cow dung]—

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyāpanaṃ ca śaucānāṃ nityamajñānameva vā /
ato 'nyathā tu yaḥ kuryānmohācchaucasya saṃkaram //
piśācānyātudhānāṃśca phalaṃ gacchatyasaṃśayam /
śauce cāśraddadhāno hi mlecchajātiṣu jāyate 14.113//
meaning:
विख्यापनं च शौचानां नित्यमज्ञानमेव वा /
अतो ऽन्यथा तु यः कुर्यान्मोहाच्छौचस्य संकरम् //
पिशाचान्यातुधानांश्च फलं गच्छत्यसंशयम् /
शौचे चाश्रद्दधानो हि म्लेच्छजातिषु जायते 14.113//
text_mt:
and the proclamation of purifications, or constant ignorance [of impurity]. / But whoever acts otherwise than this, causing confusion of purity out of delusion,

The fruit [of that act] undoubtedly goes to the piśācas and yātudhānas; / and indeed, one lacking faith in purity is born among mleccha peoples.

sanskrit_iast:
ayajvā caiva pāpaśca tiryagyonigato 'pi ca /
śaucena mokṣaṃ kurvāṇaḥ svargavāsī bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
अयज्वा चैव पापश्च तिर्यग्योनिगतो ऽपि च /
शौचेन मोक्षं कुर्वाणः स्वर्गवासी भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: Even a non-sacrificer, a sinner, or one who has entered an animal womb, / attaining liberation through purity, becomes a dweller of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
śucikāmā hi devā vai devaiścaitadudāhṛtam /
bībhatsānaśucīṃścaiva varjayanti surāḥ sadā //
meaning:
शुचिकामा हि देवा वै देवैश्चैतदुदाहृतम् /
बीभत्सानशुचींश्चैव वर्जयन्ति सुराः सदा //
text_mt: For the gods desire purity; this has been proclaimed by the gods themselves. / The deities always avoid those who are repulsive and impure.

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi śaucāni kurvanti nyāyataḥ śubhakarmiṇaḥ /
brahmaṇyāyāti theyāya śaucayuktāya dhīmate //
meaning:
त्रीणि शौचानि कुर्वन्ति न्यायतः शुभकर्मिणः /
ब्रह्मण्यायाति थेयाय शौचयुक्ताय धीमते //
text_mt: Those who perform good deeds observe the three purities in accordance with rule. / For one devoted to Brahman, hospitable, endowed with purity, and wise,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhaktāya dāntāya sānukrośāya ca dvijāḥ /
tasmai devāḥ prayacchanti pitaraḥ śrīvivarddhanāḥ /
manasākāṅkṣitānkāmāṃstrailokyapravarānapi //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe 'śaucavidhirnāma caturdaśo 'dhyoyaḥ // 14//
meaning:
पितृभक्ताय दान्ताय सानुक्रोशाय च द्विजाः /
तस्मै देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति पितरः श्रीविवर्द्धनाः /
मनसाकाङ्क्षितान्कामांस्त्रैलोक्यप्रवरानपि //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे ऽशौचविधिर्नाम चतुर्दशो ऽध्योयः // 14//
text_mt:
devoted to ancestors, self-controlled, and compassionate, O twice-born ones— / to him the gods and the ancestors, increasers of prosperity, grant / desires longed for in the mind, even the best across the three worlds.

Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named “The Rules of Impurity,” in the Ritual of Ancestral Offerings, in the third [book], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part proclaimed by Vāyu in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
aho dhanyastvayā sūta śrāddhakalpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
śrutā naḥ śrāddhakalpāstu ṛṣibhirye prakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
अहो धन्यस्त्वया सूत श्राद्धकल्पः प्रकीर्तितः /
श्रुता नः श्राद्धकल्पास्तु ऋषिभिर्ये प्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: The sages said: / Ah, blessed is the ritual of ancestral offerings proclaimed by you, O bard! / Indeed, the rituals of ancestral offerings that have been proclaimed by the sages have been heard by us.

sanskrit_iast:
atīva vistaro hyasya viśeṣeṇa tu kīrttitaḥ /
devāśeṣaṃ mahāprājña ṛṣestasya mataṃ yathā //
meaning:
अतीव विस्तरो ह्यस्य विशेषेण तु कीर्त्तितः /
देवाशेषं महाप्राज्ञ ऋषेस्तस्य मतं यथा //
text_mt: This has indeed been proclaimed with great elaboration in particular detail, / [including] what remained for the gods, O very wise one, according to the opinion of that sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kīrttayiṣyāmi vo viprā ṛṣestasya mataṃ tu yat /
śrāddhaṃ prati mahābhāgastanme śruṇuta vistarāt //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
कीर्त्तयिष्यामि वो विप्रा ऋषेस्तस्य मतं तु यत् /
श्राद्धं प्रति महाभागस्तन्मे श्रुणुत विस्तरात् //
text_mt: The bard said: / I shall declare to you, O brahmins, what the opinion of that sage is / concerning the ancestral offering, O fortunate ones; listen to that in detail from me.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrāddhaṃmayā pūrvaṃ vidhiśca śrāddhakarmaṇi /
pariśiṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇānāṃ parikṣaṇam //
meaning:
उक्तं श्राद्धंमया पूर्वं विधिश्च श्राद्धकर्मणि /
परिशिष्टं प्रवक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणानां परिक्षणम् //
text_mt: The ancestral offering has previously been spoken of by me, as well as the rule in the rite of ancestral offerings; / I shall declare the remainder: the examination of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
na mīmāṃsyāḥ sadā viprāḥ pavitraṃhyetaduttamam /
daive pitrye ca niyataṃ śrūyate vai parīkṣaṇam //
meaning:
न मीमांस्याः सदा विप्राः पवित्रंह्येतदुत्तमम् /
दैवे पित्र्ये च नियतं श्रूयते वै परीक्षणम् //
text_mt: Brahmins are never to be investigated, for this is the supreme purifier; / but in what pertains to the gods and to the ancestors, examination is indeed regularly heard of.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmindoṣāḥ pradṛśyeramsa hi kāryeṣu varjitaḥ /
jānīyādvāpi saṃvāsādvarjayettaṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
यस्मिन्दोषाः प्रदृश्येरम्स हि कार्येषु वर्जितः /
जानीयाद्वापि संवासाद्वर्जयेत्तं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: He in whom faults are visible is excluded from these rites; / or if one should know [them] through living together, one should avoid him with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
avijñātaṃ dvijaṃ śrāddhe na parīkṣeta paṇḍitaḥ /
siddhā hi viprarūpeṇa caranti pṛthivīmimām //
meaning:
अविज्ञातं द्विजं श्राद्धे न परीक्षेत पण्डितः /
सिद्धा हि विप्ररूपेण चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम् //
text_mt: A wise man should not examine an unknown twice-born person at an ancestral offering; / for perfected beings wander this earth in the form of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādatithimāyāntamabhigacchetkṛtāñjaliḥ /
pūjayeccārghyapādyābhyāṃ tathābhyañjanabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादतिथिमायान्तमभिगच्छेत्कृताञ्जलिः /
पूजयेच्चार्घ्यपाद्याभ्यां तथाभ्यञ्जनभोजनैः //
text_mt: Therefore, one should approach an arriving guest with folded hands / and honour him with water for respectful reception and washing the feet, as well as anointings and food.

sanskrit_iast:
urvī sāgaraparyantāṃ devā yogeśvaraḥ sadā /
nānārūpaiścarantyete prajā dharmeṇa yojayan //
meaning:
उर्वी सागरपर्यन्तां देवा योगेश्वरः सदा /
नानारूपैश्चरन्त्येते प्रजा धर्मेण योजयन् //
text_mt: Across the earth bounded by the ocean, the gods and the masters of yoga always / wander in various forms, directing creatures toward righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddadyātsadā dāntaḥ samabhyārcyātithiṃ naraḥ /
vyañjanāni tu vakṣyāmi phalaṃ teṣāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
तस्माद्दद्यात्सदा दान्तः समभ्यार्च्यातिथिं नरः /
व्यञ्जनानि तु वक्ष्यामि फलं तेषां तथैव च //
text_mt: Therefore, a self-controlled man should always give, having thoroughly worshipped the guest. / Now I will declare the dishes, and likewise their fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomaṃ payasā prāpnuyādvai phalaṃ tathokthasya ca pāyasena /
saṣoḍaśī satraphalaṃ ghṛtena madhvātirātrasya phalaṃ tathaiva //
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमं पयसा प्राप्नुयाद्वै फलं तथोक्थस्य च पायसेन /
सषोडशी सत्रफलं घृतेन मध्वातिरात्रस्य फलं तथैव //
text_mt: He would obtain the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma with milk, and that of an Ukthya with rice boiled in milk; / with clarified butter, that of a Ṣoḍaśin and a Sattra; likewise with honey, the fruit of an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpnuyācchraddadhā no naro vai sarvaiḥ kāmairbhojayedyastu viprān /
sarvārthadaṃ sarvaviprātitheyaṃ phalaṃ ca bhuṅkte sarvamedhasya nityam //
meaning:
तथाप्नुयाच्छ्रद्दधा नो नरो वै सर्वैः कामैर्भोजयेद्यस्तु विप्रान् /
सर्वार्थदं सर्वविप्रातिथेयं फलं च भुङ्क्ते सर्वमेधस्य नित्यम् //
text_mt: Likewise, a faithful man who feeds brahmins with all desired items / obtains all-bestowing hospitality to all brahmins, and constantly enjoys the fruit of a Sarvamedha.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu śrāddhe 'tithiṃ prāptaṃ daive cāpyavamanyate /
taṃ vai devā nirasyanti hato yadvatparāvasuḥ //
meaning:
यस्तु श्राद्धे ऽतिथिं प्राप्तं दैवे चाप्यवमन्यते /
तं वै देवा निरस्यन्ति हतो यद्वत्परावसुः //
text_mt: He who disrespects a guest arrived at an ancestral offering or a rite to the gods— / the gods indeed cast him out, just as Parāvasu was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
devāśca pitaraścaiva temevāntarhitā dvijam /
āviśya vipraṃ mokṣyanti lokānugrahakāraṇāt //
meaning:
देवाश्च पितरश्चैव तेमेवान्तर्हिता द्विजम् /
आविश्य विप्रं मोक्ष्यन्ति लोकानुग्रहकारणात् //
text_mt: The gods and the ancestors themselves, remaining concealed, / will enter that very twice-born brahmin and eat, for the sake of showing grace to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
apūjito dahatyeṣa diśetkāmāṃśca pūjitaḥ /
sarvasvenāpi tasmāddhi pūjayedatithiṃ sadā //
meaning:
अपूजितो दहत्येष दिशेत्कामांश्च पूजितः /
सर्वस्वेनापि तस्माद्धि पूजयेदतिथिं सदा //
text_mt: Unworshipped, this [guest] burns; worshipped, he bestows desires. / Therefore, indeed, one should always worship a guest even with one's whole possession.

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprastho gṛhasthaśca satāmabhyāgato yathā /
vālakhilyo yatiścaiva vijñeyo hyatithiḥ sadā //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थो गृहस्थश्च सतामभ्यागतो यथा /
वालखिल्यो यतिश्चैव विज्ञेयो ह्यतिथिः सदा //
text_mt: A forest hermit, a householder arriving as an unexpected visitor of the virtuous, / a Vālakhilya, and an ascetic: these are always to be known as guests.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyāgataḥ pākacāradatithiḥ syādapāvakaḥ /
atitheratithiḥ proktaḥ so 'tithiryoga ucyate //
meaning:
अभ्यागतः पाकचारदतिथिः स्यादपावकः /
अतिथेरतिथिः प्रोक्तः सो ऽतिथिर्योग उच्यते //
text_mt: An unexpected visitor arriving at the time of cooking is a guest without fire; / a guest of a guest is spoken of, [and] that guest is called union.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvratī na ca saṃkīrṇo nāvidyo nāviśeṣavit /
na ca saṃtānasaṃbaddho na devī nāgase 'tithiḥ //
meaning:
नाव्रती न च संकीर्णो नाविद्यो नाविशेषवित् /
न च संतानसंबद्धो न देवी नागसे ऽतिथिः //
text_mt: Not one without vows, nor one of mixed caste, nor an ignorant one, nor one without discrimination, / nor one attached to offspring, nor a gambler, nor one bent on sin is a guest.

sanskrit_iast:
pipāsitāya śrāntāya bhrāntāyātibubhukṣate /
tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ yajñamya phalamicchatā //
meaning:
पिपासिताय श्रान्ताय भ्रान्तायातिबुभुक्षते /
तस्मै सत्कृत्य दातव्यं यज्ञम्य फलमिच्छता //
text_mt: To one thirsty, weary, wandering, or extremely hungry, / to him food should be given with honor by one desiring the fruit of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
na vaktavyaṃ sadā vipra kṣudhite nāsti kiñcana /
tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ sadāpacitireva saḥ //
meaning:
न वक्तव्यं सदा विप्र क्षुधिते नास्ति किञ्चन /
तस्मै सत्कृत्य दातव्यं सदापचितिरेव सः //
text_mt: It should never be said to a hungry person, “O brahmin, there is nothing.” / Having honoured him, [food] should be given to him; he is always an object of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
akliṣṭa mavraṇaṃ yuktaṃ kṛśavṛttimayācakam /
ekāntaśīlaṃ dhīmantaṃ sadā śrāddheṣu bhojayet //
meaning:
अक्लिष्ट मव्रणं युक्तं कृशवृत्तिमयाचकम् /
एकान्तशीलं धीमन्तं सदा श्राद्धेषु भोजयेत् //
text_mt: One who is unblemished, free from wounds, disciplined, of meager livelihood, non-begging, / fond of solitude, and wise, should always be fed at ancestral offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
no dadāmi tamityevaṃ brūyādyo vai durātmavān /
api jātiśataṃ gatvā na sa mucyeta kilbiṣāt //
meaning:
नो ददामि तमित्येवं ब्रूयाद्यो वै दुरात्मवान् /
अपि जातिशतं गत्वा न स मुच्येत किल्बिषात् //
text_mt: He of wicked soul who says, “I will not give to him”— / even having passed through a hundred births, he would not be freed from sin.

sanskrit_iast:
samodaṃ bhojayedviprānekapaṅktyāṃ tu yo naraḥ /
niyukto hyani yukto vā paṅktyā harati kilbiṣam //
meaning:
समोदं भोजयेद्विप्रानेकपङ्क्त्यां तु यो नरः /
नियुक्तो ह्यनि युक्तो वा पङ्क्त्या हरति किल्बिषम् //
text_mt: The man who feeds brahmins with delight in a single row, / whether appointed or unappointed, takes away the sin of the row.

sanskrit_iast:
pāpmānaṃ gṛhyate kṣipramiṣṭāpūrttaṃ ca naśyati /
yatistu sarvaviprāṇāṃ sarveṣāmagrato bhavet //
meaning:
पाप्मानं गृह्यते क्षिप्रमिष्टापूर्त्तं च नश्यति /
यतिस्तु सर्वविप्राणां सर्वेषामग्रतो भवेत् //
text_mt: Sin is seized quickly, and sacrificial and charitable deeds are destroyed [if broken]; / but an ascetic should be placed at the head of all the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca vedānsetihāsānyaḥ paṭheddvijasattamaḥ /
yogādanantaraṃ so 'tha niyoktavyo vijānatā //
meaning:
पञ्च वेदान्सेतिहासान्यः पठेद्द्विजसत्तमः /
योगादनन्तरं सो ऽथ नियोक्तव्यो विजानता //
text_mt: That best of twice-borns who recites the five Vedas along with the epics / should then be appointed next to the practitioner of yoga by a discerning person.

sanskrit_iast:
trivedo 'nantaraṃ tasya dvivedastadanantaram /
ekavedastataḥ paścādupādhyāyastataḥ param //
meaning:
त्रिवेदो ऽनन्तरं तस्य द्विवेदस्तदनन्तरम् /
एकवेदस्ततः पश्चादुपाध्यायस्ततः परम् //
text_mt: After him, one versed in three Vedas; after that, one versed in two Vedas; / next after that, one versed in one Veda; [and] subsequent to that, a preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvanā ye 'tra saṃkhyātāstānpravakṣye nibodhata /
ya ete pūrvanirddiṣṭāḥ sarve te hyanupūrvaśaḥ //
meaning:
पावना ये ऽत्र संख्यातास्तान्प्रवक्ष्ये निबोधत /
य एते पूर्वनिर्द्दिष्टाः सर्वे ते ह्यनुपूर्वशः //
text_mt: Those who are counted here as purifiers—I shall declare them; understand: / all those who were previously indicated in sequential order,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgaviddhyānayogau sarvatatrastathaiva ca /
yāyāvaraśca pañcaite vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ //
meaning:
षडङ्गविद्ध्यानयोगौ सर्वतत्रस्तथैव च /
यायावरश्च पञ्चैते विज्ञेयाः पङ्क्तिपावनाः //
text_mt: one who knows the six auxiliary sciences, the practitioner of meditation and yoga, one versed in all doctrines, / and a wandering mendicant—these five are to be known as row-purifiers.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhakalpe bhavedyastu sannipatya tu pāvanaḥ /
caturdaśānāṃ vidyānāmekasyāmapi pāragāḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धकल्पे भवेद्यस्तु सन्निपत्य तु पावनः /
चतुर्दशानां विद्यानामेकस्यामपि पारगाः //
text_mt: And he who, having assembled, would be a purifier in the ritual of ancestral offerings / includes those who have mastered even a single one of the fourteen sciences,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāvadvarttamānāśca sarve te paṅktipāvanāḥ /
asaṃdehastu sauparṇāḥ pañcāgneyāśca sāmagāḥ //
meaning:
यथावद्वर्त्तमानाश्च सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिपावनाः /
असंदेहस्तु सौपर्णाः पञ्चाग्नेयाश्च सामगाः //
text_mt: and all those who conduct themselves properly are row-purifiers. / Without doubt, the knowers of the Sauparṇa hymn, keepers of the five fires, and singers of the Sāmaveda;

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaredvidhivadvipra samā dvādaśa saṃtataḥ /
trināciketastrai vidyo yaśca dharmāndvijaḥ paṭhet //
meaning:
यश्चरेद्विधिवद्विप्र समा द्वादश संततः /
त्रिनाचिकेतस्त्रै विद्यो यश्च धर्मान्द्विजः पठेत् //
text_mt: and the brahmin who would observe [vows] according to rule continuously for twelve years, / one who knows the Trināciketa fire, one versed in the three Vedas, and a twice-born who studies the laws;

sanskrit_iast:
bārhaspatye mahāśāstre yaśca pāraṅgato dvijaḥ /
sarve te pāvanā viprāḥ paṅktīnāṃ samudātdṛtāḥ //
meaning:
बार्हस्पत्ये महाशास्त्रे यश्च पारङ्गतो द्विजः /
सर्वे ते पावना विप्राः पङ्क्तीनां समुदात्दृताः //
text_mt: and the twice-born who has mastered the great treatise of Bṛhaspati— / all those brahmins are celebrated as purifiers of rows.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe yoṣitaṃ sevate dvijaḥ /
pitarastasya tanmāsaṃ tasminritasi śerate //
meaning:
आमन्त्रितस्तु यः श्राद्धे योषितं सेवते द्विजः /
पितरस्तस्य तन्मासं तस्मिन्रितसि शेरते //
text_mt: The twice-born who, being invited to an ancestral offering, associates with a woman— / his ancestors lie in that semen for that month.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānaniṣṭhāya dātavyaṃ sānukrośāya dhīmate /
yatiṃ vā vālakhilyaṃ vā bhojayecchrāddakarmaṇi //
meaning:
ध्याननिष्ठाय दातव्यं सानुक्रोशाय धीमते /
यतिं वा वालखिल्यं वा भोजयेच्छ्राद्दकर्मणि //
text_mt: One should give to one devoted to meditation, compassionate, and wise; / or one should feed an ascetic or a Vālakhilya in the ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprasthāya kurvāṇaḥ pūjāmātreṇa tuṣyate /
gṛhasthaṃ bhojayedyastu viśvedevāstu pūjitāḥ //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थाय कुर्वाणः पूजामात्रेण तुष्यते /
गृहस्थं भोजयेद्यस्तु विश्वेदेवास्तु पूजिताः //
text_mt: Performing [it] for a forest hermit, he is pleased by mere worship; / and he who feeds a householder—the Viśvedevas are worshipped [by him].

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprasthena ṛṣayo vālakhilyaiḥ purandaraḥ /
yatīnāṃ tu kṛtā pūjā sākṣādbrahmā tuṃ pūjitaḥ //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थेन ऋषयो वालखिल्यैः पुरन्दरः /
यतीनां तु कृता पूजा साक्षाद्ब्रह्मा तुं पूजितः //
text_mt: Through a forest hermit the sages [are worshipped]; through Vālakhilyas, Purandara; / and the worship rendered to ascetics is Brahmā himself directly worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramo 'pāvano yastu pañcamassaṃkarātmakaḥ /
catvārastvāśramāḥ pūcyāḥ śrāddhe deve tathaiva ca //
meaning:
आश्रमो ऽपावनो यस्तु पञ्चमस्संकरात्मकः /
चत्वारस्त्वाश्रमाः पूच्याः श्राद्धे देवे तथैव च //
text_mt: The fifth stage of life, which is mixed in nature, is impure; / but the four stages of life are to be honored at ancestral offerings and rites to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
caturāśramabāhyebhya stebhyaḥ śrāddhe na dāpayet /
yastiṣṭhedvāyubhakṣaśca cāturāśramabāhyataḥ //
meaning:
चतुराश्रमबाह्येभ्य स्तेभ्यः श्राद्धे न दापयेत् /
यस्तिष्ठेद्वायुभक्षश्च चातुराश्रमबाह्यतः //
text_mt: One should not cause [food] to be given at an ancestral offering to those outside the four stages of life, / even to one who subsists on air outside the four stages of life.

sanskrit_iast:
anāśramītapastepe na taṃ tatra nimantrayet /
ayatirmokṣavādī ca śrutau tau paṅktidūṣakau //
meaning:
अनाश्रमीतपस्तेपे न तं तत्र निमन्त्रयेत् /
अयतिर्मोक्षवादी च श्रुतौ तौ पङ्क्तिदूषकौ //
text_mt: Even if one outside the stages of life has practiced asceticism, one should not invite him there; / a non-ascetic and a mere disputant of liberation are in the Vedic tradition defilers of the row.

sanskrit_iast:
ugreṇa tapasā yuktā bahujñāścitravādinaḥ /
nindanti ca dvijātibhyaḥ sarve te paṅktidūṣakāḥ //
meaning:
उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता बहुज्ञाश्चित्रवादिनः /
निन्दन्ति च द्विजातिभ्यः सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिदूषकाः //
text_mt: Those possessed of severe asceticism, possessing vast knowledge, and skilled in varied disputation, / who revile the twice-born—all of them defile the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
aupavastāstathā sāṃkhyā nāstikā vedanindakāḥ /
dhyānaṃ nindanti ye kecitsarve te paṅktidūṣakāḥ //
meaning:
औपवस्तास्तथा सांख्या नास्तिका वेदनिन्दकाः /
ध्यानं निन्दन्ति ये केचित्सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिदूषकाः //
text_mt: Those who fast hypocritically, followers of Sāṅkhya, materialists, abusers of the Vedas, / and whoever revile meditation—all of them defile the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛthā muṇḍāśca jaṭilāḥ sarve kārpaṭikāstathā /
nirghṛṇānbhinnavṛttāṃśca sarvabhakṣāṃśca varjayet //
meaning:
वृथा मुण्डाश्च जटिलाः सर्वे कार्पटिकास्तथा /
निर्घृणान्भिन्नवृत्तांश्च सर्वभक्षांश्च वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Those shaved needlessly, those with matted hair, all wandering mendicants, / the merciless, the corrupt in conduct, and the omnivorous should be shunned.

sanskrit_iast:
kārukādīnanācārāṃllokavedabahiṣkṛtān /
gāya nānvedavṛttāṃśca havyakavye na bhojayet //
meaning:
कारुकादीननाचारांल्लोकवेदबहिष्कृतान् /
गाय नान्वेदवृत्तांश्च हव्यकव्ये न भोजयेत् //
text_mt: Artisans and the like who are ill-behaved, cast out from society and the Veda, / and those singers not living by the Veda—one should not feed them at offerings to gods or ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
etaistu varttayedyastu kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ sa gacchati /
yo 'śnāti saha śūdreṇā sarve te paṅktidūṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
एतैस्तु वर्त्तयेद्यस्तु कृष्णवर्णं स गच्छति /
यो ऽश्नाति सह शूद्रेणा सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिदूषणाः //
text_mt: He who lives by these falls into dark obscurity; / whoever eats with a Śūdra—all these defile the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
vyākarṣaṇaṃ sattvanibarhaṇaṃ ca kṛṣirvaṇijyā paśupālanaṃ ca /
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ cāpyagurorarervāpyakāryametaddhi sadā dvijānām //
meaning:
व्याकर्षणं सत्त्वनिबर्हणं च कृषिर्वणिज्या पशुपालनं च /
शुश्रूषणं चाप्यगुरोररेर्वाप्यकार्यमेतद्धि सदा द्विजानाम् //
text_mt: Ploughing, destroying living creatures, agriculture, trade, cattle-rearing, / and serving one who is not a teacher or an enemy—this is ever improper work for the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyāsaṃkalpinaḥ sarvānudvṛttāṃśca vivarjayet /
mithyāpravādī nindākṛttathā sūcakadāṃbhikau //
meaning:
मिथ्यासंकल्पिनः सर्वानुद्वृत्तांश्च विवर्जयेत् /
मिथ्याप्रवादी निन्दाकृत्तथा सूचकदांभिकौ //
text_mt: One should avoid all of deceitful resolve and the arrogant, / the false speaker, the defamer, as well as the informer and the hypocrite.

sanskrit_iast:
upapātakasaṃyuktāḥ pātakaiśca viśeṣataḥ /
vede niyogadātāro lobhamohaphalarthinaḥ //
meaning:
उपपातकसंयुक्ताः पातकैश्च विशेषतः /
वेदे नियोगदातारो लोभमोहफलर्थिनः //
text_mt: Those tainted with minor sins, and especially with major sins, / who command [rites] in the Veda seeking the fruits of greed and delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavikrayiṇastānvai śrāddhakarmaṇi varjayet /
na viyogāstu vedānāṃ yo niyuṅkte sa pāpakṛt //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविक्रयिणस्तान्वै श्राद्धकर्मणि वर्जयेत् /
न वियोगास्तु वेदानां यो नियुङ्क्ते स पापकृत् //
text_mt: those sellers of sacred learning—one should indeed avoid them in the ancestral rite. / There are no dispensations regarding the Vedas; he who enjoins [them for hire] is a sinner.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktā vedaphalādbhraśyeddātā dānaphalāttathā /
bhṛtako 'dhyāpayedyastu bhṛtakādhyāpitastu yaḥ //
meaning:
वक्ता वेदफलाद्भ्रश्येद्दाता दानफलात्तथा /
भृतको ऽध्यापयेद्यस्तु भृतकाध्यापितस्तु यः //
text_mt: The speaker falls from the fruit of the Veda, and the giver likewise from the fruit of the gift. / He who teaches for hire, and he who is taught by a hired teacher—

sanskrit_iast:
nārhatastāvapi śrāddhe brahmāṇaḥ krayavikrayī /
krayaśca vikrayaścaivājīvitārthe vigarhitau //
meaning:
नार्हतस्तावपि श्राद्धे ब्रह्माणः क्रयविक्रयी /
क्रयश्च विक्रयश्चैवाजीवितार्थे विगर्हितौ //
text_mt: neither of those two is worthy at an ancestral rite, nor a buyer or seller of the Veda; / buying and selling [sacred lore] for a livelihood are condemned.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttireṣā tu vaiśyasya brāhmaṇasya tu pātakam /
āharedbhṛtito vedān vedebhyaścopajīvati //
meaning:
वृत्तिरेषा तु वैश्यस्य ब्राह्मणस्य तु पातकम् /
आहरेद्भृतितो वेदान् वेदेभ्यश्चोपजीवति //
text_mt: This is the livelihood of a Vaiśya, but a sin for a Brāhmaṇa. / He who learns the Vedas for wages, and he who lives off the Vedas—

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau tau nārhataḥ śrāddhaṃ putrikāpatireva ca /
vṛthā dārāṃśca yo gacchedyo yajeta vṛthādhvaraiḥ //
meaning:
उभौ तौ नार्हतः श्राद्धं पुत्रिकापतिरेव च /
वृथा दारांश्च यो गच्छेद्यो यजेत वृथाध्वरैः //
text_mt: neither of those two is worthy of an ancestral rite, nor is the husband of an appointed daughter, / nor one who approaches his wife in vain, nor one who sacrifices with vain sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
nārhatastāvapi śrāddhaṃ dvijo yaścaiva vārdhuṣī /
striyo raktāntarā yeṣāṃ paradāraparāśca ye //
meaning:
नार्हतस्तावपि श्राद्धं द्विजो यश्चैव वार्धुषी /
स्त्रियो रक्तान्तरा येषां परदारपराश्च ये //
text_mt: Neither of those two is worthy of an ancestral rite, nor the twice-born who is a usurer, / nor those whose women are attached to other men, nor those devoted to others' wives,

sanskrit_iast:
arthakāmaratāścaiva na tāñchrāddheṣu bhojayet /
varṇāśramāṇāṃ dharmeṣu viruddhāḥsarvakarmaṇi //
meaning:
अर्थकामरताश्चैव न ताञ्छ्राद्धेषु भोजयेत् /
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्मेषु विरुद्धाःसर्वकर्मणि //
text_mt: nor those devoted [only] to wealth and sensual desire—one must not feed them at ancestral rites. / Those opposed to the duties of classes and life stages in every action,

sanskrit_iast:
stenaśca sarvayājī ca sarve te paṅktidūṣakāḥ /
yaśca sūkaravadbhuṅkte yaśca pāṇitale dvijaḥ //
meaning:
स्तेनश्च सर्वयाजी च सर्वे ते पङ्क्तिदूषकाः /
यश्च सूकरवद्भुङ्क्ते यश्च पाणितले द्विजः //
text_mt: the thief, and he who sacrifices for anyone—all these defile the assembly; / and whatever twice-born eats like a pig, or eats directly from his palm,

sanskrit_iast:
na tadaśnanti pitaro yaśca vācyaṃ samaśnute /
strīśūdrāyānnametadvai śrāddhocchiṣṭaṃ na dāpayet //
meaning:
न तदश्नन्ति पितरो यश्च वाच्यं समश्नुते /
स्त्रीशूद्रायान्नमेतद्वै श्राद्धोच्छिष्टं न दापयेत् //
text_mt: the ancestors do not eat [what is offered] by him, nor by one who eats blameworthy [food]. / One must not give this food left over from the ancestral rite to a woman or a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadyāccānusaṃmohānna tadgacchati vai pitṝn /
tasmānna deyamannādyamucchiṣṭaṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
यो दद्याच्चानुसंमोहान्न तद्गच्छति वै पितॄन् /
तस्मान्न देयमन्नाद्यमुच्छिष्टं श्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: Whoever gives it out of delusion, it does not reach the ancestors; / therefore, food left over in an ancestral rite must not be given [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca dadhisarpirbhyāṃ śiṣṭaṃ putrāya nānyathā /
avaśeṣaṃ tu dātavyamannādyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अन्यच्च दधिसर्पिर्भ्यां शिष्टं पुत्राय नान्यथा /
अवशेषं तु दातव्यमन्नाद्यं तु विशेषतः //
text_mt: Anything remaining, other than curd and clarified butter, [may be given] to a son, not otherwise; / but the remainder, especially food, should be given [properly].

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpamūlaphalairvāpi tuṣṭā gaccheyurantataḥ /
yāvanna śrapitaṃ cānnaṃ yāvatauṣṇyaṃ na muñcati //
meaning:
पुष्पमूलफलैर्वापि तुष्टा गच्छेयुरन्ततः /
यावन्न श्रपितं चान्नं यावतौष्ण्यं न मुञ्चति //
text_mt: They may depart content even with flowers, roots, and fruits at the end. / As long as the food is not cold, as long as it does not lose its heat,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadaśnanti pitaro yāvadaśnanti vāgyatāḥ /
dattaṃ pratigraho homo bhojanaṃ balireva ca //
meaning:
तावदश्नन्ति पितरो यावदश्नन्ति वाग्यताः /
दत्तं प्रतिग्रहो होमो भोजनं बलिरेव च //
text_mt: so long the ancestors eat, as long as [the guests] eat silently. / A gift, acceptance, an oblation, eating, and the food-offering,

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃguṣṭhena tathā pādyaṃ nāsurebhyo yathā bhavet /
etānyeva ca sarvāṇi dānāni ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
सांगुष्ठेन तथा पाद्यं नासुरेभ्यो यथा भवेत् /
एतान्येव च सर्वाणि दानानि च विशेषतः //
text_mt: and the water for washing feet with the thumb—so that it does not go to the Asuras— / all these and gifts especially,

sanskrit_iast:
antarjānūpaviṣṭena tadvadācamanaṃ bhavet /
muṇḍāñjaṭilakāṣāyāñśrāddhakarmaṇi varjayet //
meaning:
अन्तर्जानूपविष्टेन तद्वदाचमनं भवेत् /
मुण्डाञ्जटिलकाषायाञ्श्राद्धकर्मणि वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: and the sipping of water, should be performed seated with one's hands between the knees. / One should avoid shaven-headed men, those with matted hair, and red-robed ascetics in an ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu vṛtte sthitā nityaṃ jñānino dhyāninastathā /
devabhaktā mahātmānaḥ punīyurdarśanādapi //
meaning:
ये तु वृत्ते स्थिता नित्यं ज्ञानिनो ध्यानिनस्तथा /
देवभक्ता महात्मानः पुनीयुर्दर्शनादपि //
text_mt: Those who ever abide in good conduct, the wise, and the meditators, / the devotees of the gods, the great-souled ones—they purify even by being seen.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhibhyo dhāturaktebhyastridaṇḍebhyaḥ pradāpayet /
sarvaṃ yogeśvarairvyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ hi nirantaram //
meaning:
शिखिभ्यो धातुरक्तेभ्यस्त्रिदण्डेभ्यः प्रदापयेत् /
सर्वं योगेश्वरैर्व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं हि निरन्तरम् //
text_mt: One should give to those wearing topknots, clad in ochre robes, and carrying triple staves. / All the three worlds are pervaded constantly by the lords of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpaśyanti te sarvaṃ yatkiñcijjagatīgatam /
vyaktāvyaktaṃ vaśe kṛtvā sarvasyāpi ca yatparam //
meaning:
तस्मात्पश्यन्ति ते सर्वं यत्किञ्चिज्जगतीगतम् /
व्यक्ताव्यक्तं वशे कृत्वा सर्वस्यापि च यत्परम् //
text_mt: Therefore they perceive everything whatever that exists in the world, / having brought under control the manifest and unmanifest, and what is beyond all.

sanskrit_iast:
satyāsatyaṃ ca yaddṛṣṭaṃ sada sacca mahātmabhiḥ /
sarvajñānāni sṛṣṭāni mokṣādīnimahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
सत्यासत्यं च यद्दृष्टं सद सच्च महात्मभिः /
सर्वज्ञानानि सृष्टानि मोक्षादीनिमहात्मभिः //
text_mt: Truth and untruth, whatever was seen as being and non-being by the great-souled ones, / all sciences, liberation, and the rest were brought forth by the great-souled ones.

sanskrit_iast: tasmātteṣāṃ sadā bhaktaḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti vottamam //
meaning: तस्मात्तेषां सदा भक्तः फलं प्राप्नोति वोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Therefore, one who is ever devoted to them obtains the highest fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛcaśca yo veda sa veda vedānyajūṃṣi yo veda yajñam /
sāmāni yo veda sa veda brahma yo mānasaṃ veda sa veda sarvam //
iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde śrāddhakalpe brāhmaṇaparīkṣā nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 15//
meaning:
ऋचश्च यो वेद स वेद वेदान्यजूंषि यो वेद यज्ञम् /
सामानि यो वेद स वेद ब्रह्म यो मानसं वेद स वेद सर्वम् //
इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे श्राद्धकल्पे ब्राह्मणपरीक्षा नाम पञ्चदशो ऽध्यायः // 15//
text_mt:
He who knows the Ṛg verses knows the Vedas; he who knows the Yajus verses knows the sacrifice; / he who knows the Sāman melodies knows Brahman; he who knows the spiritual Veda knows all.

Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named 'Examination of the Brāhmaṇas' in the rite of ancestral offerings, in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dānāni ca phalāni ca /
tāraṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ svargamārgasukhāvaham //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि दानानि च फलानि च /
तारणं सर्वभूतानां स्वर्गमार्गसुखावहम् //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Hereafter I shall explain the gifts and their fruits, / which deliver all beings and bring the happiness of the celestial path.

sanskrit_iast:
loke śreṣṭhatam sarvamātmanaścaiva yatpriyam /
sarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dātavyaṃ teṣāmevājñayārthinā //
meaning:
लोके श्रेष्ठतम् सर्वमात्मनश्चैव यत्प्रियम् /
सर्वं पितॄणां दातव्यं तेषामेवाज्ञयार्थिना //
text_mt: Whatever in the world is most excellent, and whatever is dear to oneself, / should all be given to the ancestors by one seeking to fulfill their command.

sanskrit_iast:
jāṃbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ sūryasannibham /
divyāpsarobhiḥ saṃpūrṇamannado labhate 'kṣayam //
meaning:
जांबूनदमयं दिव्यं विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम् /
दिव्याप्सरोभिः संपूर्णमन्नदो लभते ऽक्षयम् //
text_mt: A giver of food attains an imperishable, celestial aerial chariot / made of gold, resembling the sun, filled with divine Apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
savyañjanaṃ tu yo dadyādahataṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi /
āyuḥ prākāśyamaiśvaryaṃ rūpaṃ ca labhate śubham //
meaning:
सव्यञ्जनं तु यो दद्यादहतं श्राद्धकर्मणि /
आयुः प्राकाश्यमैश्वर्यं रूपं च लभते शुभम् //
text_mt: He who gives [garments] unworn along with side dishes in an ancestral rite / obtains longevity, splendor, sovereignty, and auspicious beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñopavītaṃ yo dadyācchrāddhakāle tu yajñavit /
pāvanaṃ sarva viprāṇāṃ brahmadānasya tatphalam //
meaning:
यज्ञोपवीतं यो दद्याच्छ्राद्धकाले तु यज्ञवित् /
पावनं सर्व विप्राणां ब्रह्मदानस्य तत्फलम् //
text_mt: He who knows the sacrifice, who gives a sacrificial thread at the time of an ancestral rite, / which purifies all Brāhmaṇas, gains the fruit of the gift of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
plutaṃ vipreṣu yo dadyācchrāddhakāle kamaḍalum /
madhukṣīrājyadadhibhirdātāramupatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
प्लुतं विप्रेषु यो दद्याच्छ्राद्धकाले कमडलुम् /
मधुक्षीराज्यदधिभिर्दातारमुपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: He who gives a flowing water-pot to the Brāhmaṇas at the time of an ancestral rite / is served with honey, milk, clarified butter, and curds.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrāviddhaṃ ca yo dadyācchrāddhakāle kamaṇḍalum /
dhenuṃ salabhate divyāṃ payodāṃ sukhado hinīm //
meaning:
चक्राविद्धं च यो दद्याच्छ्राद्धकाले कमण्डलुम् /
धेनुं सलभते दिव्यां पयोदां सुखदो हिनीम् //
text_mt: He who gives a potter's-wheel-turned water-pot at the time of an ancestral rite / obtains a celestial cow, giving milk and easily milked, which bestows happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
tūlapūrṇe ca yo dadyātpāduke śrāddhakarmaṇi /
śobhanaṃ labhate yānaṃ pādayoḥ sukhamedhate //
meaning:
तूलपूर्णे च यो दद्यात्पादुके श्राद्धकर्मणि /
शोभनं लभते यानं पादयोः सुखमेधते //
text_mt: He who gives sandals filled with cotton in an ancestral rite / obtains a splendid vehicle, and comfort for his feet increases.

sanskrit_iast:
vyacanaṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca dattvā viprāya satkṛtam /
prāpnuyātsarvapuṣpāṇi sugandhīni mṛdūni ca //
meaning:
व्यचनं तालवृन्तं च दत्त्वा विप्राय सत्कृतम् /
प्राप्नुयात्सर्वपुष्पाणि सुगन्धीनि मृदूनि च //
text_mt: Having given an honored fan and a palm leaf to a Brāhmaṇa, / he obtains all manner of fragrant, soft flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe hyupānahau dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadā budhaḥ /
divyaṃ sa labhate yānaṃ vājiyuktaṃ navaṃ tathā //
meaning:
श्राद्धे ह्युपानहौ दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सदा बुधः /
दिव्यं स लभते यानं वाजियुक्तं नवं तथा //
text_mt: The wise man who ever gives shoes to Brāhmaṇas in an ancestral rite / obtains a celestial, new carriage yoked with horses.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe chatraṃ tu yo dadyātpuṣpamālānvitaṃ tathā /
prāsādo hyuttamo bhūtvā gacchantamanugacchati //
meaning:
श्राद्धे छत्रं तु यो दद्यात्पुष्पमालान्वितं तथा /
प्रासादो ह्युत्तमो भूत्वा गच्छन्तमनुगच्छति //
text_mt: He who gives an umbrella adorned with garlands of flowers in an ancestral rite— / it becomes an excellent palace that follows him as he travels.

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇaṃ saśayyābhojanaṃ budhaḥ /
śrāddhe dattvā yatibhyastu nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate //
meaning:
शरणं रत्नसंपूर्णं सशय्याभोजनं बुधः /
श्राद्धे दत्त्वा यतिभ्यस्तु नाकपृष्ठे महीयते //
text_mt: A wise man who gives a shelter filled with jewels, with a bed and food, / to ascetics in an ancestral rite is glorified on the back of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
suktāvaidūryavāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhāni ca /
vāhanāni ca divyāni prayutānyarbudāni ca //
meaning:
सुक्तावैदूर्यवासांसि रत्नानि विविधानि च /
वाहनानि च दिव्यानि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च //
text_mt: Pearls, cat's-eye gems, garments, various jewels, / celestial vehicles by the millions and hundreds of millions,

sanskrit_iast:
sumahadvyomagaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam /
candrasūryanibhaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ labhate 'kṣayam //
meaning:
सुमहद्व्योमगं पुण्यं सर्वकामसमन्वितम् /
चन्द्रसूर्यनिभं दिव्यं विमानं लभते ऽक्षयम् //
text_mt: and an imperishable, celestial aerial chariot, immense, moving through the sky, holy, / endowed with every desire, resembling the sun and moon, he obtains.

sanskrit_iast:
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtaṃ kāmagaṃ sumanojavam /
vasetsa tu vimānāgre stūyamānaḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
अप्सरोभिः परिवृतं कामगं सुमनोजवम् /
वसेत्स तु विमानाग्रे स्तूयमानः समन्ततः //
text_mt: Surrounded by Apsarases, moving at will, swift as thought, / he dwells at the head of that aerial chariot, praised on all sides.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaiḥpuṣpaiścitaścāhurdānānāṃ paramaṃ budhāḥ /
suślakṣmāni suvarṇāni śrāddhe pātrāṇi dāpayet //
meaning:
दिव्यैःपुष्पैश्चितश्चाहुर्दानानां परमं बुधाः /
सुश्लक्ष्मानि सुवर्णानि श्राद्धे पात्राणि दापयेत् //
text_mt: Filled with divine flowers—the wise declare this the supreme among gifts. / One should provide very smooth golden vessels in an ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
rasāstamupatiṣṭhanti bhakṣyaṃ saubhāgyameva ca /
tilānikṣūṃstathā śrāddhe dvijebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati //
meaning:
रसास्तमुपतिष्ठन्ति भक्ष्यं सौभाग्यमेव च /
तिलानिक्षूंस्तथा श्राद्धे द्विजेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Flavours attend upon him, as do food and good fortune, / who gives sesame seeds and sugarcanes to the twice-born in a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
mitrāṇi labhate loke strīṣu saubhāgyameva ca /
yaḥ pātraṃ taijasaṃ dadyānmanojña śrāddhabhojanaiḥ //
meaning:
मित्राणि लभते लोके स्त्रीषु सौभाग्यमेव च /
यः पात्रं तैजसं दद्यान्मनोज्ञ श्राद्धभोजनैः //
text_mt: He obtains friends in the world and good fortune among women, / who gives a metal vessel with pleasing śrāddha meals.

sanskrit_iast:
pātraṃ bhavati kāmānā rūpasya ca dhanasya ca /
rājataṃ kāñcanaṃ vāpi yo dadyācchrāddhakarmaṇi //
meaning:
पात्रं भवति कामाना रूपस्य च धनस्य च /
राजतं काञ्चनं वापि यो दद्याच्छ्राद्धकर्मणि //
text_mt: He becomes a vessel of desires, of beauty, and of wealth, / whoever gives silver or gold in the rite of śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
dānāttu labhate kāmānprākāśyaṃ dhanameva ca /
dhenuṃ śrāddhe tu yo dadyādgṛṣṭiṃ kumbhāpadohanīm //
meaning:
दानात्तु लभते कामान्प्राकाश्यं धनमेव च /
धेनुं श्राद्धे तु यो दद्याद्गृष्टिं कुम्भापदोहनीम् //
text_mt: From the gift he obtains desires, fame, and wealth, / who gives in a śrāddha a milch cow, a heifer that yields a pot of milk.

sanskrit_iast:
gāvastamupatiṣṭhanti naraṃ puṣṭistathaiva ca /
dadyādyaḥ śiśire cāgniṃ bahukāṣṭhaṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
गावस्तमुपतिष्ठन्ति नरं पुष्टिस्तथैव च /
दद्याद्यः शिशिरे चाग्निं बहुकाष्ठं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: Cattle attend upon that man, as does nourishment, / who zealously gives fire with abundant firewood in the cold season.

sanskrit_iast:
kāyāgnidīptiṃ prākāśyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ tabhate naraḥ /
indhanāni tu yo dadyā ddvijebhyaḥ śiśirāgame //
meaning:
कायाग्निदीप्तिं प्राकाश्यं सौभाग्यं तभते नरः /
इन्धनानि तु यो दद्या द्द्विजेभ्यः शिशिरागमे //
text_mt: A man obtains brightness of bodily fire, brilliance, and good fortune, / who gives fuels to the twice-born at the onset of the cold season.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ jayati saṃgrāme śriyā juṣṭastu jāyate /
surabhīṇi ca mālyāni gandhavanti tathaiva ca //
meaning:
नित्यं जयति संग्रामे श्रिया जुष्टस्तु जायते /
सुरभीणि च माल्यानि गन्धवन्ति तथैव च //
text_mt: He is always victorious in battle and is born attended by splendour; / and having worshipped, he should hospitably bestow / fragrant garlands and scents upon worthy recipients in a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā tu pātrebhyaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet /
gandhamālyaṃ mahātmānaṃ sukhāni vividhāni ca //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा तु पात्रेभ्यः श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य दापयेत् /
गन्धमाल्यं महात्मानं सुखानि विविधानि च //
text_mt: Scents, garlands, noble mind, and manifold pleasures, / as well as devoted young wives, attend upon the giver.

sanskrit_iast:
dātāramupatiṣṭhanti yuvatyaśca pativratāḥ /
śayanāsanayānāni bhūmayo vāhanāni ca //
meaning:
दातारमुपतिष्ठन्ति युवत्यश्च पतिव्रताः /
शयनासनयानानि भूमयो वाहनानि च //
text_mt: Beds, seats, carriages, lands, and mounts—

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddheṣvetāni yo dadyādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet /
śrāddhakāle guṇavati vipre vai samupasthite //
meaning:
श्राद्धेष्वेतानि यो दद्यादश्वमेधफलं लभेत् /
श्राद्धकाले गुणवति विप्रे वै समुपस्थिते //
text_mt: whoever gives these in śrāddhas obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice. / When a virtuous Brahmin has arrived at the time of a śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭadravyaṃ ca yo dadyātsmṛtiṃ medhāṃ ca vindati /
sarpiḥpūrṇāni pātrāṇi śrāddhe satkṛtya dāpayet //
meaning:
इष्टद्रव्यं च यो दद्यात्स्मृतिं मेधां च विन्दति /
सर्पिःपूर्णानि पात्राणि श्राद्धे सत्कृत्य दापयेत् //
text_mt: he who gives the desired article obtains memory and intellect. / One should hospitably give vessels filled with clarified butter in a śrāddha;

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhopadohagṛṣṭīnāṃ bahvīnāṃ phalamaśnute /
śrāddhe yathepsitaṃ dattvā puṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
कुम्भोपदोहगृष्टीनां बह्वीनां फलमश्नुते /
श्राद्धे यथेप्सितं दत्त्वा पुण्डरीकफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: he enjoys the fruit of many heifers that yield a pot of milk. / Giving what is desired in a śrāddha, he obtains the fruit of a Puṇḍarīka sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
vanaṃ puṣpaphalopetaṃ dattvā gosavamaśnute /
kūpārāmataḍāgāni kṣetragoṣṭhagṛhāṇi ca //
meaning:
वनं पुष्पफलोपेतं दत्त्वा गोसवमश्नुते /
कूपारामतडागानि क्षेत्रगोष्ठगृहाणि च //
text_mt: Giving a garden endowed with flowers and fruits, he enjoys [the fruit of] a Gosava. / Wells, groves, ponds, fields, cowpens, and houses—

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā modanti te svarge nityamācandratārakam /
svāstīrṇaṃ śayanaṃ dattvā śrāddheratnavibhūṣitam //
meaning:
दत्त्वा मोदन्ति ते स्वर्गे नित्यमाचन्द्रतारकम् /
स्वास्तीर्णं शयनं दत्त्वा श्राद्धेरत्नविभूषितम् //
text_mt: having given these, they rejoice in heaven constantly as long as the moon and stars endure. / Having given a well-spread couch adorned with gems in a śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast:
pitarastasya tuṣyanti svargalokaṃ samaśanute /
asmiṃlloke ca saṃpannaṃ syandanaṃ ca suvāhanaiḥ //
meaning:
पितरस्तस्य तुष्यन्ति स्वर्गलोकं समशनुते /
अस्मिंल्लोके च संपन्नं स्यन्दनं च सुवाहनैः //
text_mt: his ancestors are pleased and he attains the heavenly world. / And in this world, [he is honoured] with an opulent chariot with fine mounts,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭābhiḥ pūjyate cātra dhanadhānyaiśca varddhate /
parṇakauśeyapaṭṭorṇe tathā prāvārakaṃbalau //
meaning:
अष्टाभिः पूज्यते चात्र धनधान्यैश्च वर्द्धते /
पर्णकौशेयपट्टोर्णे तथा प्रावारकंबलौ //
text_mt: and is honoured here by eight [persons?], and prospers with wealth and grain. / Silk made of bark, Chinese silk, woven silk, wool, and also mantle-wraps and blankets,

sanskrit_iast:
ajinaṃ kāñcanaṃ paṭṭaṃ praveṇīṃ mṛgalomakam /
dadyādetāni viprāṇāṃ bhojayitvā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
अजिनं काञ्चनं पट्टं प्रवेणीं मृगलोमकम् /
दद्यादेतानि विप्राणां भोजयित्वा यथाविधि //
text_mt: deer-skin, gold, silk cloth, a braided cloth, and cloth of deer-hair— / having fed the Brahmins according to the rule, he should give these.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpnoti śraddhadhānastu vājapeyaphalaṃ naraḥ /
bahubhāryāḥ surūpāśca putrā bhṛtyāśca kiṅkarāḥ //
meaning:
प्राप्नोति श्रद्धधानस्तु वाजपेयफलं नरः /
बहुभार्याः सुरूपाश्च पुत्रा भृत्याश्च किङ्कराः //
text_mt: The faithful man obtains the fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice. / Many beautiful wives, sons, servants, and attendants,

sanskrit_iast:
vaśe tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni loke cāsminnirāmayam /
kauśeyaṃ kṣaumakārpāsaṃ dukūlaṃ gahanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वशे तिष्ठन्ति भूतानि लोके चास्मिन्निरामयम् /
कौशेयं क्षौमकार्पासं दुकूलं गहनं तथा //
text_mt: creatures remain under his control, and he is free from disease in this world. / Chinese silk, linen, cotton, fine silk, and also woven garments—

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhe caitāni yo dadyātkāmānāpnotyanuttamān /
alakṣmīṃ nāśayantyete tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā //
meaning:
श्राद्धे चैतानि यो दद्यात्कामानाप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् /
अलक्ष्मीं नाशयन्त्येते तमः सूर्योदयो यथा //
text_mt: he who gives these in a śrāddha obtains unsurpassed desires. / These destroy misfortune just as sunrise destroys darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrājate ya vimānāgre nakṣatreṣviva candramāḥ /
vāso hi sarvadaivatye sarvadevairabhiṣṭutam //
meaning:
भ्राजते य विमानाग्रे नक्षत्रेष्विव चन्द्रमाः /
वासो हि सर्वदैवत्ये सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुतम् //
text_mt: He shines at the forefront of a celestial aerial chariot like the moon among the constellations. / For clothing belongs to all deities and is praised by all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrābhāve kriyā nāsti ya5dānatapāṃsi ca /
tasmādvastrāṇi deyāni śrāddhakāle tu nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
वस्त्राभावे क्रिया नास्ति य5दानतपांसि च /
तस्माद्वस्त्राणि देयानि श्राद्धकाले तु नित्यशः //
text_mt: In the absence of clothing, there is no ritual, [no] gift, and [no] austerities; / therefore, garments should constantly be given at the time of a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni sarvāṇyavāpnoti śrāddhe dattvā tu mānavaḥ /
nityaśrāddhe tu yo dadyātprayatastatparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तानि सर्वाण्यवाप्नोति श्राद्धे दत्त्वा तु मानवः /
नित्यश्राद्धे तु यो दद्यात्प्रयतस्तत्परायणः //
text_mt: A person obtains all of them having given them in a śrāddha. / He who, restrained and wholly dedicated, gives in the daily śrāddha,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmānavāpnoti rājyaṃ svage tathava ca /
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute //
meaning:
सर्वकामानवाप्नोति राज्यं स्वगे तथव च /
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते //
text_mt: obtains all desires and sovereignty in heaven likewise; / he enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice complete with all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyajātaṃ tu sukṛtaṃ svastikādyaṃ saśarkaram /
kṛsara madhusarpiśca payaḥ pāyasameva ca //
meaning:
भक्ष्यजातं तु सुकृतं स्वस्तिकाद्यं सशर्करम् /
कृसर मधुसर्पिश्च पयः पायसमेव च //
text_mt: Well-prepared pastries, svastika cakes and the like, with sugar, / kṛsara, honey, clarified butter, milk, and milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhaprāyāśca yo dadyādagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet /
dadhigavyamasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ bhakṣyānnānāvidhāṃstathā //
meaning:
स्निग्धप्रायाश्च यो दद्यादग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् /
दधिगव्यमसंसृष्टं भक्ष्यान्नानाविधांस्तथा //
text_mt: and he who gives mostly rich, unctuous foods obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma. / Pure cow's curd, and likewise various kinds of edible foods—

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā na śocate śrāddhe varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca /
ghṛtena bhojayedviprānghṛtaṃ bhūmau samutsṛjot //
meaning:
दत्त्वा न शोचते श्राद्धे वर्षासु च मघासु च /
घृतेन भोजयेद्विप्रान्घृतं भूमौ समुत्सृजोत् //
text_mt: having given these in a śrāddha in the rainy season and during the Maghās, he does not grieve. / He should feed the Brahmins with clarified butter, and cast clarified butter upon the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
chāyāyāṃ hastinaścaiva dattvā śrāddhena śocate /
odanaṃ pāyasaṃ sarpirmadhumūlaphalāni ca //
meaning:
छायायां हस्तिनश्चैव दत्त्वा श्राद्धेन शोचते /
ओदनं पायसं सर्पिर्मधुमूलफलानि च //
text_mt: And having given [food] in the shadow of an elephant in a śrāddha, he does not grieve. / Boiled rice, milk-rice, clarified butter, honey, roots, and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyāṃśca vividhāndattvā paratreha ca modate /
śarkarākṣīrasaṃyuktāḥ pṛthukā nityamakṣayāḥ //
meaning:
भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान्दत्त्वा परत्रेह च मोदते /
शर्कराक्षीरसंयुक्ताः पृथुका नित्यमक्षयाः //
text_mt: and having given various pastries, he rejoices here and in the hereafter. / Parched flattened rice mixed with sugar and milk [brings] eternal and inexhaustible [merit].

sanskrit_iast:
syāttu saṃvatsaraṃ prītiḥ śākairmāṃsarasena ca /
saktulājāstathāpūpāḥ kulmāṣā vyañjanaiḥ saha //
meaning:
स्यात्तु संवत्सरं प्रीतिः शाकैर्मांसरसेन च /
सक्तुलाजास्तथापूपाः कुल्माषा व्यञ्जनैः सह //
text_mt: There would be satisfaction for a year with vegetables and meat broth. / Barley-meal, parched grain, cakes, half-cooked pulse-gruel along with side dishes,

sanskrit_iast:
sarpiḥsnigdhāni sarvāṇi dadhnā saṃskṛtya bhojayet /
śrāddheṣvetāni yo dadyātpadmaṃ sa labhate nidhim //
meaning:
सर्पिःस्निग्धानि सर्वाणि दध्ना संस्कृत्य भोजयेत् /
श्राद्धेष्वेतानि यो दद्यात्पद्मं स लभते निधिम् //
text_mt: all rich with clarified butter, prepared with curds, he should offer to feed them. / He who gives these in śrāddhas obtains the Padma treasure.

sanskrit_iast:
navasasyāniyo dadyācchrāddhe satkṛtya yatnataḥ /
sarvabhogānavāpnoti pūjyate ca divaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
नवसस्यानियो दद्याच्छ्राद्धे सत्कृत्य यत्नतः /
सर्वभोगानवाप्नोति पूज्यते च दिवं गतः //
text_mt: He who diligently gives new grains with hospitality in a śrāddha / obtains all pleasures and, gone to heaven, is honoured.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni coṣyaleṅyavarāṇi ca /
bhojanāgrāsanaṃ dattvā atithibhyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोज्यानि पेयानि चोष्यलेङ्यवराणि च /
भोजनाग्रासनं दत्त्वा अतिथिभ्यः कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: Foods to chew, to eat, to drink, to suck, and excellent things to lick— / having given the foremost seat for dining to guests with palms folded in reverence,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayajñakratūnāṃ hi phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam /
kṣipramatyuṣṇamakliṣṭaṃ dadyādannaṃ bubhukṣate //
meaning:
सर्वयज्ञक्रतूनां हि फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् /
क्षिप्रमत्युष्णमक्लिष्टं दद्यादन्नं बुभुक्षते //
text_mt: he obtains the unsurpassed fruit of all sacrifices and rites. / One should quickly and attentively give hot, unblemished food to one who is hungry,

sanskrit_iast:
savyañjanaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ bhaktyā satkṛtya yatnataḥ /
taruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ haṃsavāhanam //
meaning:
सव्यञ्जनं तथा स्निग्धं भक्त्या सत्कृत्य यत्नतः /
तरुणादित्यसंकाशं विमानं हंसवाहनम् //
text_mt: along with side dishes and rich, with devotion and zeal. / [He obtains] an aerial chariot resembling the morning sun, drawn by swans;

sanskrit_iast:
annado labhate nityaṃ kanyākoṭīstathaiva ca /
annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ nānyatkiñcittu vidyate //
meaning:
अन्नदो लभते नित्यं कन्याकोटीस्तथैव च /
अन्नदानात्परं दानं नान्यत्किञ्चित्तु विद्यते //
text_mt: the giver of food constantly obtains crores of maiden-attendants. / There is no other gift greater than the gift of food.

sanskrit_iast:
annādbhūtāni jāyante jīvanti prabhavanti ca /
jīvadānātparaṃ dānaṃ nānyatkiñcana vidyate //
meaning:
अन्नाद्भूतानि जायन्ते जीवन्ति प्रभवन्ति च /
जीवदानात्परं दानं नान्यत्किञ्चन विद्यते //
text_mt: From food beings are born, live, and thrive. / There is no other gift greater than the gift of life.

sanskrit_iast:
annāllokāḥ pratiṣṭhanti lokadānasya tatphalam /
annaṃ prajāpatiḥ sākṣātte na sarvamidaṃ tatam //
meaning:
अन्नाल्लोकाः प्रतिष्ठन्ति लोकदानस्य तत्फलम् /
अन्नं प्रजापतिः साक्षात्ते न सर्वमिदं ततम् //
text_mt: From food the worlds endure; that is the fruit of giving a world. / Food is Prajāpati directly; by him all this is pervaded.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādannasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati /
yāni ratnāni medinyāṃ vāhanāni striyastathā //
meaning:
तस्मादन्नसमं दानं न भूतं न भविष्यति /
यानि रत्नानि मेदिन्यां वाहनानि स्त्रियस्तथा //
text_mt: Therefore, equal to the gift of food there has never been nor will there ever be. / Whatever gems there are on earth, vehicles, and women—

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipraṃ prāpnoti tatsarvaṃ pitṛbhaktastu yo naraḥ /
pratiśrayaṃ ca yo dadyādatithibyaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
क्षिप्रं प्राप्नोति तत्सर्वं पितृभक्तस्तु यो नरः /
प्रतिश्रयं च यो दद्यादतिथिब्यः कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: the man devoted to the ancestors quickly obtains all of that. / And he who gives shelter to guests with folded hands,

sanskrit_iast:
devāstaṃ saṃpratīcchanti divyātithyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ /
sarvāṇyetāni yo dadyātpṛthivyāmekarāḍbhavet //
meaning:
देवास्तं संप्रतीच्छन्ति दिव्यातिथ्यैः सहस्रशः /
सर्वाण्येतानि यो दद्यात्पृथिव्यामेकराड्भवेत् //
text_mt: the gods welcome him with thousands of divine hospitalities. / He who gives all of these becomes the sole sovereign of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhirdvābhyāmathaikena dānena tu sukhī bhadet /
dānāni paramo dharmaḥ sadbhiḥ satkṛtya pūjitaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिभिर्द्वाभ्यामथैकेन दानेन तु सुखी भदेत् /
दानानि परमो धर्मः सद्भिः सत्कृत्य पूजितः //
text_mt: By three, by two, or even by a single gift he becomes happy. / Gifts are the supreme dharma, honoured and venerated by the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasyā dhipatyaṃ hi dānenaiva dhruvaṃ sthitam /
arājā labhate rājyamadhanaścottamaṃ dhanam /
kṣīṇāyurlabhate cāyuḥ pitṛbhaktaḥ sadā naraḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
śrāddhakalpe dānapraśaṃsā nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 16//
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यस्या धिपत्यं हि दानेनैव ध्रुवं स्थितम् /
अराजा लभते राज्यमधनश्चोत्तमं धनम् /
क्षीणायुर्लभते चायुः पितृभक्तः सदा नरः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
श्राद्धकल्पे दानप्रशंसा नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः // 16//
text_mt:
For sovereignty over the three worlds is firmly established through gift alone. / A non-king obtains a kingdom, a poor man obtains excellent wealth, / and a man whose life is diminished obtains long life, when always devoted to the ancestors.

Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, entitled 'Praise of Gifts in the Ritual of Śrāddha', in the third part, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle division of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitam /
kāmyaṃ naimittikājasraṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्राद्धकर्मणि पूजितम् /
काम्यं नैमित्तिकाजस्रं श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Hereafter I shall declare what is honoured in the rite of śrāddha: / the optional, the occasional, and the constant in the regular rite of śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
putradāranimittāḥ syuraṣṭakāstisna eva tu /
kṛṣṇapakṣe variṣṭhā hi pūrvākhaṇḍaladevatā //
meaning:
पुत्रदारनिमित्ताः स्युरष्टकास्तिस्न एव तु /
कृष्णपक्षे वरिष्ठा हि पूर्वाखण्डलदेवता //
text_mt: There are three Aṣṭakās having sons and wives as their occasion; / in the dark fortnight, they are indeed the best, having deities in the earlier half.

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyā dvitīyā syāttṛtīyā vaiśvadevikā /
ādyāpūpaiḥ sadākāryā māṃsairanyā sadā bhavet //
meaning:
प्राजापत्या द्वितीया स्यात्तृतीया वैश्वदेविका /
आद्यापूपैः सदाकार्या मांसैरन्या सदा भवेत् //
text_mt: The second [aṣṭakā] belongs to Prajāpati; the third belongs to the Viśvedevas. / The first must always be performed with cakes; the other should always be with meats;

sanskrit_iast:
śākaiḥ kāryā tṛtīyā syādevaṃ dravyagato vidhiḥ /
atrāpīṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vai nityameva vidhīyate //
meaning:
शाकैः कार्या तृतीया स्यादेवं द्रव्यगतो विधिः /
अत्रापीष्टं पितॄणां वै नित्यमेव विधीयते //
text_mt: the third should be performed with vegetables: such is the rule regarding the materials. / In this too, what is desired by the ancestors is prescribed continuously.

sanskrit_iast:
yā cāpyanyā caturthī syāttāṃ ca kuryādviśeṣataḥ /
āsu śrāddhaṃ budhaḥ kurvansarvasvenāpi nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
या चाप्यन्या चतुर्थी स्यात्तां च कुर्याद्विशेषतः /
आसु श्राद्धं बुधः कुर्वन्सर्वस्वेनापि नित्यशः //
text_mt: And whatever fourth [aṣṭakā] there may be, one should perform that especially. / A wise man performing the śrāddha on these, constantly, even with all his wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipramāpnoti hi śreyaḥ paratreha ca modate /
pitaraḥ parvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ //
meaning:
क्षिप्रमाप्नोति हि श्रेयः परत्रेह च मोदते /
पितरः पर्वकालेषु तिथिकालेषु देवताः //
text_mt: swiftly attains the highest good and rejoices here and in the hereafter. / The ancestors [arrive] at the parvan times, the deities at the tithi times;

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣu puruṣā yānti nipātamiva dhenavaḥ /
māsāṃte pratigaccheyuraṣṭakāsu hyapūjitāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषु पुरुषा यान्ति निपातमिव धेनवः /
मासांते प्रतिगच्छेयुरष्टकासु ह्यपूजिताः //
text_mt: men go to all of them, as cows to a watering place. / If unhonored on the aṣṭakās, they return at the end of the month;

sanskrit_iast:
moghāstasya bhavantyāśāḥ paratreha ca sarvaśaḥ /
pūjakānāṃ samutkarṣo nāstikānāmadhogatiḥ //
meaning:
मोघास्तस्य भवन्त्याशाः परत्रेह च सर्वशः /
पूजकानां समुत्कर्षो नास्तिकानामधोगतिः //
text_mt: his hopes become futile in every respect, both here and in the hereafter. / The worshippers attain preeminence; the unbelievers sink to a low state.

sanskrit_iast:
devāstu dāyino yānti tiryaggacchantyadāyinaḥ /
puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ putrānaiśvaryameva ca //
meaning:
देवास्तु दायिनो यान्ति तिर्यग्गच्छन्त्यदायिनः /
पुष्टिं प्रजां स्मृतिं मेधां पुत्रानैश्वर्यमेव च //
