text_mt: The givers go to the gods; the non-givers go to the beasts. / Nourishment, offspring, memory, intellect, sons, and sovereign power—

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāṇaḥ pūjanaṃ cāsu sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ samaśnute /
pratipaddhanalābhāya labdhaṃ cāsya na naśyati //
meaning:
कुर्वाणः पूजनं चासु सर्वं पूर्णं समश्नुते /
प्रतिपद्धनलाभाय लब्धं चास्य न नश्यति //
text_mt: performing worship on these, one attains all of them in full. / [A śrāddha on] the first day leads to the acquisition of wealth, and what is acquired is not lost.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ tu yaḥ kuryāddvipadādhiṃpatir bhavet /
varārthināṃ tṛtīyā tu śatrughnī pāpanāśinī //
meaning:
द्वितीयायां तु यः कुर्याद्द्विपदाधिंपतिर् भवेत् /
वरार्थिनां तृतीया तु शत्रुघ्नी पापनाशिनी //
text_mt: He who performs it on the second day becomes the lord of men. / But the third day, for those desiring boons, destroys enemies and ruins sin.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāṃ tu prakurvāṇaḥ śatrucchidrāṇi paśyati /
pañcamyāṃ cāpikurvāṇaḥ prāpnoti mahatīṃ śriyam //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यां तु प्रकुर्वाणः शत्रुच्छिद्राणि पश्यति /
पञ्चम्यां चापिकुर्वाणः प्राप्नोति महतीं श्रियम् //
text_mt: Performing it on the fourth day, he perceives the weaknesses of his enemies. / And performing it on the fifth, he attains great fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhāni kurvāṇaḥ saṃpūjyaḥ syātprayatnataḥ /
kurute yastu saptamyāṃ śrāddhāni satataṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठ्यां श्राद्धानि कुर्वाणः संपूज्यः स्यात्प्रयत्नतः /
कुरुते यस्तु सप्तम्यां श्राद्धानि सततं नरः //
text_mt: Performing śrāddhas on the sixth day, he becomes worthy of worship with effort. / But the man who always performs śrāddhas on the seventh day

sanskrit_iast:
mahīśatvamavāpnoti gaṇānāṃ cādhipo bhavet /
saṃpūrṇāmṛddhimāpnoti yo 'ṣṭamyāṃ kurute naraḥ //
meaning:
महीशत्वमवाप्नोति गणानां चाधिपो भवेत् /
संपूर्णामृद्धिमाप्नोति यो ऽष्टम्यां कुरुते नरः //
text_mt: attains kingship over the earth and becomes a ruler of hosts. / The man who performs it on the eighth day attains complete prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ navamyāṃ karttavyamaiśvaryaṃ strīśca kāṅkṣatā /
kurvandaśamyāṃ tu naro brāhmīṃ śriyamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
श्राद्धं नवम्यां कर्त्तव्यमैश्वर्यं स्त्रीश्च काङ्क्षता /
कुर्वन्दशम्यां तु नरो ब्राह्मीं श्रियमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: A śrāddha should be performed on the ninth day by one desiring sovereignty and women. / But performing it on the tenth, a man attains the fortune of Brahman;

sanskrit_iast:
vedāṃścaivāpnuyātsarvānviprāṇāṃ samatāṃ vrajet /
ekādaśyāṃ paraṃ dānamaiśvarya satataṃ tathā //
meaning:
वेदांश्चैवाप्नुयात्सर्वान्विप्राणां समतां व्रजेत् /
एकादश्यां परं दानमैश्वर्य सततं तथा //
text_mt: he obtains all the Vedas and achieves equality with the brahmins. / On the eleventh day [it yields] supreme generosity and constant sovereignty;

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ jayalābhaṃ ca rājyamāyurvasūni ca /
prajāvṛddhiṃ paśūnmedhāṃ svātantryaṃ puṣṭimuttamām //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां जयलाभं च राज्यमायुर्वसूनि च /
प्रजावृद्धिं पशून्मेधां स्वातन्त्र्यं पुष्टिमुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: on the twelfth day, obtaining victory, kingship, longevity, and wealth, / increase of offspring, cattle, intellect, independence, and excellent nourishment.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghamāyurathaiśvaryaṃ kurvāṇastu trayodaśīm /
yuvānaśca gṛhe yasya mṛtāstebhyaḥ pradāpayet //
meaning:
दीर्घमायुरथैश्वर्यं कुर्वाणस्तु त्रयोदशीम् /
युवानश्च गृहे यस्य मृतास्तेभ्यः प्रदापयेत् //
text_mt: He who performs it on the thirteenth day [gains] long life and sovereignty. / And those who have died young in one's house, to them he should offer [on that day].

sanskrit_iast:
śastreṇa vā hatā ye ca teṣāṃ dadyāccaturdaśīm /
amāvāsyāṃ prayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryātsadā śuciḥ //
meaning:
शस्त्रेण वा हता ये च तेषां दद्याच्चतुर्दशीम् /
अमावास्यां प्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं कुर्यात्सदा शुचिः //
text_mt: Or to those who have been killed by a weapon, he should make an offering on the fourteenth day. / On the new-moon day, being always purified, he should carefully perform the śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmānavāpnoti svargaṃ cānantamaśnute /
tathāviṣamajātānāṃ yamalānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वकामानवाप्नोति स्वर्गं चानन्तमश्नुते /
तथाविषमजातानां यमलानां च सर्वशः //
text_mt: He attains all desires and enjoys endless heaven. / Likewise, for those born unevenly and twins, in every manner,

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ dadyādamāvāsyāṃ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt /
maghāsu kurvañchrāddhāni sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
श्राद्धं दद्यादमावास्यां सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् /
मघासु कुर्वञ्छ्राद्धानि सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: one should offer śrāddha on the new-moon day: he attains all desires. / Performing śrāddhas under [the asterism] Maghā, he attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣamarcitāstena bhavanti pitarastadā /
pitṛdavā maghā yasmāttasmāttāsvakṣayaṃ smṛtam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
śrāddhakalpe tithiśrāddhavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 17//
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षमर्चितास्तेन भवन्ति पितरस्तदा /
पितृदवा मघा यस्मात्तस्मात्तास्वक्षयं स्मृतम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
श्राद्धकल्पे तिथिश्राद्धवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः // 17//
text_mt:
The ancestors are then visibly honored by him. / Because Maghā belongs to the ancestors, what is [offered] under it is known to be inexhaustible.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Tithi Śrāddhas', in the ritual of śrāddha, in the third section, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
yamastu yāni śrāddhāni provāca śaśabindave /
tāni me śṛṇu kāryāṇi nakṣatreṣu pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
यमस्तु यानि श्राद्धानि प्रोवाच शशबिन्दवे /
तानि मे शृणु कार्याणि नक्षत्रेषु पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / The śrāddhas which Yama declared to Śaśabindu, / hear from me those rites to be performed individually under the lunar mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kṛttikāyogaṃ kurute satataṃ naraḥ /
agnīnādhāya sa svarge rājate sudṛḍhavrataḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धं यः कृत्तिकायोगं कुरुते सततं नरः /
अग्नीनाधाय स स्वर्गे राजते सुदृढव्रतः //
text_mt: The man who continually performs a śrāddha in conjunction with Kṛttikā, / having established the fires, shines in heaven, steadfast in his vows.

sanskrit_iast:
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye tejasvinā bhavet /
prāyaśaḥ krūrakarmāṇi ārdrāyāṃ śrāddhamācaran //
meaning:
अपत्यकामो रोहिण्यां सौम्ये तेजस्विना भवेत् /
प्रायशः क्रूरकर्माणि आर्द्रायां श्राद्धमाचरन् //
text_mt: Desiring offspring, [he should perform it] under Rohiṇī; under Saumya (Mṛgaśīrṣa), he becomes full of brilliance; / usually [performing] cruel acts, performing a śrāddha under Ārdrā;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrabhāgī bhavetputrī śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā punarvasau /
puṣṭikāmaḥ punastiṣye śrāddhaṃ kurvīta mānavaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रभागी भवेत्पुत्री श्राद्धं कृत्वा पुनर्वसौ /
पुष्टिकामः पुनस्तिष्ये श्राद्धं कुर्वीत मानवः //
text_mt: having performed a śrāddha under Punarvasu, he becomes an owner of land and possesses sons; / desiring nourishment, a man should again perform a śrāddha under Tiṣya (Puṣya).

sanskrit_iast:
āśleṣāsu pitṝnarcanvīrānputrānavāpnuyāt /
jātīnāṃ bhavati śreṣṭho maghāsu śrāddhamācaran //
meaning:
आश्लेषासु पितॄनर्चन्वीरान्पुत्रानवाप्नुयात् /
जातीनां भवति श्रेष्ठो मघासु श्राद्धमाचरन् //
text_mt: Worshipping the ancestors under the Āśleṣās, he attains heroic sons; / performing a śrāddha under Maghā, he becomes the best among his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunīṣu pitṝnarcansaubhāgyaṃ labhate naraḥ /
pradānaśīlaḥ sāpatya uttarāsu karoti yaḥ //
meaning:
फाल्गुनीषु पितॄनर्चन्सौभाग्यं लभते नरः /
प्रदानशीलः सापत्य उत्तरासु करोति यः //
text_mt: Worshipping the ancestors under the Phālgunīs, a man obtains good fortune; / he who performs it under Uttarā (Phālgunī) becomes generous and possesses offspring.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsatsu mukhyo bhavati haste 'bhyarcya pitṝnapi /
citrāyāṃ caiva yaḥ kuryātpaśyedrūpavataḥ sutān //
meaning:
संसत्सु मुख्यो भवति हस्ते ऽभ्यर्च्य पितॄनपि /
चित्रायां चैव यः कुर्यात्पश्येद्रूपवतः सुतान् //
text_mt: Worshipping the ancestors under Hasta, he becomes foremost in assemblies; / and he who performs it under Citrā sees handsome sons.

sanskrit_iast:
svātinā caiva yaḥ kuryādvāṇijye lābhamāpnuyāt /
putrārthī tu viśākhāsu śrāddhamīheta mālavaḥ //
meaning:
स्वातिना चैव यः कुर्याद्वाणिज्ये लाभमाप्नुयात् /
पुत्रार्थी तु विशाखासु श्राद्धमीहेत मालवः //
text_mt: And he who performs it under Svāti obtains profit in trade; / desiring sons, a man should strive for a śrāddha under the Viśākhās.

sanskrit_iast:
anurādhāsu kurvāṇo naraścakraṃ pravarttayet /
ādhipatyaṃ bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāṃ satataṃ tu yaḥ //
meaning:
अनुराधासु कुर्वाणो नरश्चक्रं प्रवर्त्तयेत् /
आधिपत्यं भवेच्छ्रेष्ठं ज्येष्ठायां सततं तु यः //
text_mt: A man performing it under Anurādhā sets his wheel [of sovereignty] in motion; / he who [performs it] constantly under Jyeṣṭhā attains excellent dominion.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlenārogyamicchanti hyāṣāḍhāsu mahadyaśaḥ /
uttarāsu tu kurvāṇo vītaśoko bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
मूलेनारोग्यमिच्छन्ति ह्याषाढासु महद्यशः /
उत्तरासु तु कुर्वाणो वीतशोको भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: They desire freedom from disease through Mūla, and great fame under the Āṣāḍhās; / performing it under Uttarā (Āṣāḍhā), a man becomes free from sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
śravaṇena tu lokeṣu prāpnuyātparamāṃ gatim /
rājyabhāgī dhaniṣṭhāsu prāpnuyā dvipulaṃ dhanam //
meaning:
श्रवणेन तु लोकेषु प्राप्नुयात्परमां गतिम् /
राज्यभागी धनिष्ठासु प्राप्नुया द्विपुलं धनम् //
text_mt: Under Śravaṇa he attains the supreme state among the worlds; / under Dhaniṣṭhā he shares in kingship and obtains abundant wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhanirjitalokaśca vedān sāṃgānavāpnuyāt /
nakṣatrairvāruṇaiḥ kurvanbhiṣaksiddhimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
श्राद्धनिर्जितलोकश्च वेदान् सांगानवाप्नुयात् /
नक्षत्रैर्वारुणैः कुर्वन्भिषक्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Having conquered the worlds through śrāddha, he obtains the Vedas with their auxiliary limbs; / performing it under the asterism belonging to Varuṇa (Śatabhiṣaj), a physician attains perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaprauṣṭha pade kurvanvindetājīvikānbahūn /
uttarāsvanatikramya vindedgā vai sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वप्रौष्ठ पदे कुर्वन्विन्देताजीविकान्बहून् /
उत्तरास्वनतिक्रम्य विन्देद्गा वै सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Performing it under Pūrvaprauṣṭhapadā, he finds many sources of livelihood; / not passing over the Uttarās (Uttaraproṣṭhapadā), he finds cows by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
bahukupyakṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vindetkurvansurevatīm /
aśvānaśvayujā bhakto bharaṇyāṃ sādhusattamaḥ //
meaning:
बहुकुप्यकृतं द्रव्यं विन्देत्कुर्वन्सुरेवतीम् /
अश्वानश्वयुजा भक्तो भरण्यां साधुसत्तमः //
text_mt: Performing it under Revatī, he finds wealth consisting of abundant base metals; / devoted under Aśvayuj (Aśvinī), he attains horses; under Bharaṇī, he becomes the best of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ kurvañchaśabindurmahīmimām /
kṛtsnāṃ balena so 'kliṣṭho labhdhvā ca praśaśāsa ha //
iti śrī brahāmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
śrāddhakalpe nakṣatraśrāddhaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 18//
meaning:
इमं श्राद्धविधिं कुर्वञ्छशबिन्दुर्महीमिमाम् /
कृत्स्नां बलेन सो ऽक्लिष्ठो लभ्ध्वा च प्रशशास ह //
इति श्री ब्रहामाण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
श्राद्धकल्पे नक्षत्रश्राद्धं नाम अष्टादशो ऽध्यायः // 18//
text_mt:
Performing this rule of śrāddha, Śaśabindu, without difficulty, / having obtained this entire earth by his might, ruled it.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named 'Nakṣatra Śrāddha', in the ritual of śrāddha, in the third section, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃyuruvāca
kiṃ sviddattaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu tṛptidaṃ vadatāṃ vara /
kiṃsvitsyāccirarātrāya kiṃ vānantyāya kalpate //
meaning:
शंयुरुवाच
किं स्विद्दत्तं पितॄणां तु तृप्तिदं वदतां वर /
किंस्वित्स्याच्चिररात्राय किं वानन्त्याय कल्पते //
text_mt: Śaṃyu said: / What offered to the ancestors gives satisfaction, O best of speakers? / What would last for a long night, or what leads to infinity?

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
havīṣi śrāddhakalpe tu yāni śrāddhavido viduḥ /
tāni me śṛṇu sarvāṇi phalaṃ caiṣāṃ yathātatham //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
हवीषि श्राद्धकल्पे तु यानि श्राद्धविदो विदुः /
तानि मे शृणु सर्वाणि फलं चैषां यथातथम् //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Hear from me all those oblations in the śrāddha ritual that the knowers of śrāddha know, / and their fruit as it truly is.

sanskrit_iast:
tilairvrīhiyavaimāṣairadbhirmūlaphalaistathā /
dattena māsaṃ prīyante śrāddhena hi pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
तिलैर्व्रीहियवैमाषैरद्भिर्मूलफलैस्तथा /
दत्तेन मासं प्रीयन्ते श्राद्धेन हि पितामहाः //
text_mt: By sesame seeds, rice, barley, beans, water, and roots and fruits / offered in a śrāddha, the grandfathers are pleased for a month.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyaiḥ prīṇanti dvau māsau trīnmāsānhāriṇena tu /
śāśena caturo māsānpañca prīṇāti śākunaiḥ //
meaning:
मत्स्यैः प्रीणन्ति द्वौ मासौ त्रीन्मासान्हारिणेन तु /
शाशेन चतुरो मासान्पञ्च प्रीणाति शाकुनैः //
text_mt: With fish they are pleased for two months; for three months with venison; / with hare for four months; with birds he pleases them for five.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāheṇa tu ṣaṇmāsāñchāgalaṃ saptamāsikam /
aṣṭamāsikamityuktaṃ yacca pārvatakaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
वाराहेण तु षण्मासाञ्छागलं सप्तमासिकम् /
अष्टमासिकमित्युक्तं यच्च पार्वतकं भवेत् //
text_mt: With wild boar for six months; that of goat lasts seven months; / that which comes from mountain [game] is said to last eight months.

sanskrit_iast:
rauraveṇa tu prīyante nava māsānpitāmahāḥ /
gavayasya tu māṃsena tṛptiḥ syāddaśamāsikī //
meaning:
रौरवेण तु प्रीयन्ते नव मासान्पितामहाः /
गवयस्य तु मांसेन तृप्तिः स्याद्दशमासिकी //
text_mt: With the meat of the ruru deer the grandfathers are pleased for nine months; / with the meat of the gayal (gavaya) the satisfaction lasts ten months;

sanskrit_iast:
aurabhreṇa ca māṃsena māsānekādaśaiva tu /
śrāddhe ca tṛptidaṃ gavyaṃ payaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
औरभ्रेण च मांसेन मासानेकादशैव तु /
श्राद्धे च तृप्तिदं गव्यं पयः संवत्सरं द्विजाः //
text_mt: and with mutton for eleven months; / and in a śrāddha, cows' milk gives satisfaction for a year, O twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
ānantyāya bhavettadvatkhaḍgamāṃsaṃ pitṛkṣaye /
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ chāyāyāṃ kuñjarasya ca //
meaning:
आनन्त्याय भवेत्तद्वत्खड्गमांसं पितृक्षये /
पायसं मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां छायायां कुञ्जरस्य च //
text_mt: Likewise, rhinoceros meat leads to infinity on the anniversary of the father's death, / and rice cooked in milk with honey and clarified butter, in the shadow of an elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇacchāgasya māsena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī /
atra gāthāḥ pitṛgītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णच्छागस्य मासेन तृप्तिर्भवति शाश्वती /
अत्र गाथाः पितृगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः //
text_mt:
With the meat of a black goat, there is eternal satisfaction.
On this subject, those learned in the past recite verses sung by the ancestors:

sanskrit_iast:
tāste 'haṃ kīrttayiṣyāmi yathāvatsannibodha me /
api naḥ sa kule yāyādyo no dadyāt trayodaśīm //
meaning:
तास्ते ऽहं कीर्त्तयिष्यामि यथावत्सन्निबोध मे /
अपि नः स कुले यायाद्यो नो दद्यात् त्रयोदशीम् //
text_mt:
‘I shall recite them to you as they truly are; understand [them] from me:
May that man be born into our lineage who would offer to us on the thirteenth [tithi]

sanskrit_iast:
ājena sarvalohena varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca /
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko 'pi gayāṃ vrajet /
gaurīṃ vāpyudvahedbhāryāṃ nālaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet //
meaning:
आजेन सर्वलोहेन वर्षासु च मघासु च /
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येको ऽपि गयां व्रजेत् /
गौरीं वाप्युद्वहेद्भार्यां नालं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत् //
text_mt:
‘With goat[-meat] that is completely red, during the rainy season and under the Maghās.
Many sons should be desired, [in hope] that even one might go to Gayā,
or marry a young maiden as wife, or release a blue bull.’

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃyuruvāca
gayādīnāṃ phalaṃ tāta brūhi me paripṛcchataḥ /
dātṝṇāṃ caiva yatpuṇyaṃ nikhilena pravīhi me //
meaning:
शंयुरुवाच
गयादीनां फलं तात ब्रूहि मे परिपृच्छतः /
दातॄणां चैव यत्पुण्यं निखिलेन प्रवीहि मे //

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
gayāyāmakṣayaṃ śrāddhañjapahomatapāṃsi ca /
pitṛkṣaye hi tatputra tasmāttatrākṣayaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
गयायामक्षयं श्राद्धञ्जपहोमतपांसि च /
पितृक्षये हि तत्पुत्र तस्मात्तत्राक्षयं स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
‘At Gayā, śrāddha, silent recitation, oblations, and austerities are inexhaustible.
For that is the destruction of the ancestors' [distress], my son; therefore it is taught to be inexhaustible there.’

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāyāmekaviṃśaṃ tu gauryāmutpāditaḥ sutaḥ /
mahāmahāṃśca juhuyāditi tasya phalaṃ smṛtam /
phalaṃ vṛṣasya vakṣyāmi gadato me nibodhata //
meaning:
पूर्णायामेकविंशं तु गौर्यामुत्पादितः सुतः /
महामहांश्च जुहुयादिति तस्य फलं स्मृतम् /
फलं वृषस्य वक्ष्यामि गदतो मे निबोधत //
text_mt:
‘A son begotten on a virgin wife [sanctifies] the twenty-first [generation],
and he should offer the great sacrifices—such is the fruit taught for that.
I shall describe the fruit of the bull; listen as I speak:

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣotsraṣṭā punātyeva daśātītāndaśāvarān //
meaning: वृषोत्स्रष्टा पुनात्येव दशातीतान्दशावरान् //
text_mt: The releaser of a bull indeed purifies ten past and ten future [generations].

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiñcitspṛśate toyamavatīrṇo nadījale /
vṛṣotsarggatpitṝṇāṃ tu hyakṣayaṃ samudāhṛtam //
meaning:
यत्किञ्चित्स्पृशते तोयमवतीर्णो नदीजले /
वृषोत्सर्ग्गत्पितॄणां तु ह्यक्षयं समुदाहृतम् //
text_mt:
Whatever water [the bull] touches, having entered river water,
by the release of the bull, is declared to be inexhaustible for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
yenayena spṛśettoyaṃ lāṅgūlādibhiraṅgaśaḥ /
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
येनयेन स्पृशेत्तोयं लाङ्गूलादिभिरङ्गशः /
सर्वं तदक्षयं तस्य पितॄणां नात्र संशयः //
text_mt:
With whatever limb, beginning with its tail, it touches the water,
all that becomes inexhaustible for his ancestors; there is no doubt of this.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgaiḥ khurairvā bhūmiṃ yāmullikhatyaniśaṃ vṛṣaḥ /
madhukulyāḥ pitṝṃstasya hyakṣayāśca bhavanti vai //
meaning:
शृङ्गैः खुरैर्वा भूमिं यामुल्लिखत्यनिशं वृषः /
मधुकुल्याः पितॄंस्तस्य ह्यक्षयाश्च भवन्ति वै //
text_mt:
Whatever ground the bull constantly scratches with its horns or hooves,
verily becomes rivers of honey, inexhaustible for his ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasranalvamātreṇa taḍāgena yathāsrutiḥ /
tṛptistu yā pitṝṇāṃ vai sā vṛṣeṇeha kalpate //
meaning:
सहस्रनल्वमात्रेण तडागेन यथास्रुतिः /
तृप्तिस्तु या पितॄणां वै सा वृषेणेह कल्पते //
text_mt:
Just as from a reservoir measuring a thousand nalvas, by the flowing [water],
that satisfaction which belongs to the ancestors is brought about here by the bull.

sanskrit_iast:
yo dadāti guḍonmiśratilāni śrāddhakarmaṇi /
madhu vāmadhumiśraṃ vā sarvamevākṣayaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
यो ददाति गुडोन्मिश्रतिलानि श्राद्धकर्मणि /
मधु वामधुमिश्रं वा सर्वमेवाक्षयं भवेत् //
text_mt:
He who gives sesame seeds mixed with jaggery in the śrāddha rite,
or honey, or [something] mixed with honey, all becomes truly inexhaustible.

sanskrit_iast:
na brāhmaṇaṃ parikṣeta sadā deyaṃ hi mānavaiḥ /
daivekarmaṇi pitrye ca śrūyate vai parīkṣaṇam //
meaning:
न ब्राह्मणं परिक्षेत सदा देयं हि मानवैः /
दैवेकर्मणि पित्र्ये च श्रूयते वै परीक्षणम् //
text_mt:
A brāhmaṇa should not be examined [casually]; gifts should always be given by men.
Indeed, examination is prescribed only in rites for the gods and rites for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedavratasnātāḥ paṅktīnāṃ pāvanā dvijāḥ /
ye ca bhāṣāvidaḥ kecidye ca vyākaraṇe ratāḥ //
meaning:
सर्ववेदव्रतस्नाताः पङ्क्तीनां पावना द्विजाः /
ये च भाषाविदः केचिद्ये च व्याकरणे रताः //
text_mt:
Twice-born men who have bathed at the completion of vows for all the Vedas, who purify rows [of diners],
and those who know languages, and those devoted to grammar;

sanskrit_iast:
adhīyate purāṇaṃ vai dharmaśāstramathāpi ca /
triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgniḥ sa sauparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit //
meaning:
अधीयते पुराणं वै धर्मशास्त्रमथापि च /
त्रिणाचिकेतः पञ्चाग्निः स सौपर्णः षडङ्गवित् //
text_mt:
those who study the Purāṇa and the legal treatises;
one who knows the Triṇāciketa fire, one who maintains the five fires, one who knows the Sauparṇa hymn, one who knows the six Vedāṅgas;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadevasutaścaiva cchandogo jyeṣṭhasāmagaḥ /
puṇyeṣu yaśca tīrtheṣu kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtavrataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मदेवसुतश्चैव च्छन्दोगो ज्येष्ठसामगः /
पुण्येषु यश्च तीर्थेषु कृतस्नानः कृतव्रतः //
text_mt:
the son of a Brahma-marriage, a chanter of the Chandoga, one who sings the Jyeṣṭhasāman,
and one who has bathed at holy pilgrimage-places and kept vows;

sanskrit_iast:
makheṣu ye ca sarveṣu bhavantyavabhṛthāplutāḥ /
ye ca satyavratā nityaṃ svadharmaniratāśca ye //
meaning:
मखेषु ये च सर्वेषु भवन्त्यवभृथाप्लुताः /
ये च सत्यव्रता नित्यं स्वधर्मनिरताश्च ये //
text_mt:
and those who have bathed in final ablutions in all sacrifices,
and those who are ever devoted to the vow of truth and intent upon their own duty;

sanskrit_iast:
akrodhanā lobhaparāstāñchrāddheṣu nimantrayet /
etebhyo dattamakṣayyamete vai paṅktipāvanāḥ //
meaning:
अक्रोधना लोभपरास्ताञ्छ्राद्धेषु निमन्त्रयेत् /
एतेभ्यो दत्तमक्षय्यमेते वै पङ्क्तिपावनाः //
text_mt:
those free from anger and intent on generous giving—these he should invite to śrāddhas.
What is given to them is inexhaustible; they indeed purify the row [of diners].

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhīyā brahmaṇā ye tu yogavratasuniṣṭhitāḥ /
trayo 'pi pūjitāstena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ //
meaning:
श्राद्धीया ब्रह्मणा ये तु योगव्रतसुनिष्ठिताः /
त्रयो ऽपि पूजितास्तेन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः //
text_mt:
Those eligible for śrāddha who are steadfast in the vow of yoga by means of the Veda,
by him the three are worshipped: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhiḥ saha lokāśca yo hyetānpūjayennaraḥ /
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam //
meaning:
पितृभिः सह लोकाश्च यो ह्येतान्पूजयेन्नरः /
पवित्राणां पवित्रं च मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् //
text_mt:
And the worlds together with the ancestors [are worshipped] by whatever man honours them;
[this is] the purifier of purifiers and the auspiciousness of auspicious things.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ yogadharmo nigadyate /
apāṅkteyānpravakṣyami gadato me nibodhata //
meaning:
प्रथमः सर्वधर्माणां योगधर्मो निगद्यते /
अपाङ्क्तेयान्प्रवक्ष्यमि गदतो मे निबोधत //
text_mt:
The duty of yoga is declared to be foremost among all duties.
I shall declare those unfit to sit in the row; listen to me as I speak:

sanskrit_iast:
kitavo madyapo yaśca paśupālo nirākṛtaḥ /
grāmapreṣyo vārdhuṣiko hyāpaṇo vaṇijastathā //
meaning:
कितवो मद्यपो यश्च पशुपालो निराकृतः /
ग्रामप्रेष्यो वार्धुषिको ह्यापणो वणिजस्तथा //
text_mt:
A gambler, a drinker of liquor, a herdsman, an outcast,
a village servant, a usurer, a shopkeeper, and likewise merchants;

sanskrit_iast:
agāra dāhī garado vṛṣalo grāmayājakaḥ /
kāṇḍapṛṣṭho 'tha kuṇḍāśī madhupaḥ somavikrayī //
meaning:
अगार दाही गरदो वृषलो ग्रामयाजकः /
काण्डपृष्ठो ऽथ कुण्डाशी मधुपः सोमविक्रयी //
text_mt:
an arsonist, a poisoner, an outcaste, a village priest,
a mercenary who fights for pay, one who eats the food of an adulteress's son, a drunkard, a seller of soma;

sanskrit_iast:
samudrāntarito bhṛtyaḥ piśunaḥ kūṭasākṣikaḥ /
pitrā vivadamānaśca yasya copapatirgṛhe //
meaning:
समुद्रान्तरितो भृत्यः पिशुनः कूटसाक्षिकः /
पित्रा विवदमानश्च यस्य चोपपतिर्गृहे //
text_mt:
one separated by the sea, a hired servant, an informer, a false witness,
one who disputes with his father, and one in whose house a paramour dwells;

sanskrit_iast:
abhiśastastathā stenaḥ śilpaṃ yaścopajīvati /
stavakaḥ sūpakāraśca yaśca mitrāṇi nindati //
meaning:
अभिशस्तस्तथा स्तेनः शिल्पं यश्चोपजीवति /
स्तवकः सूपकारश्च यश्च मित्राणि निन्दति //
text_mt:
an accused person, a thief, and one who lives by a craft,
a flatterer, a cook, and one who reviles friends;

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇaśca khañjakaścaiva nāstiko vedavarjitaḥ /
unmatto 'pyatha ṣaṇḍhaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ //
meaning:
काणश्च खञ्जकश्चैव नास्तिको वेदवर्जितः /
उन्मत्तो ऽप्यथ षण्ढश्च भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः //
text_mt:
one-eyed, lame, an atheist, one destitute of the Veda,
a madman, an eunuch, an aborticide, one who violates the teacher’s bed;

sanskrit_iast:
bhiṣagjīvī prāśanikaḥ parastrīṃ yaśca sevate /
vikrīṇāti ca yo brahmavratāni niyamāṃstathā //
meaning:
भिषग्जीवी प्राशनिकः परस्त्रीं यश्च सेवते /
विक्रीणाति च यो ब्रह्मव्रतानि नियमांस्तथा //
text_mt:
one who makes a living as a physician, a professional eater, one who attends on another’s wife,
and one who sells the sacred knowledge, vows, and observances;

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭaṃ syānnāstike dattaṃ vrataghne cāpavarjitam /
yaccavāṇijake dattaṃ neha nāmutra saṃbhavet //
meaning:
नष्टं स्यान्नास्तिके दत्तं व्रतघ्ने चापवर्जितम् /
यच्चवाणिजके दत्तं नेह नामुत्र संभवेत् //
text_mt:
What is given to an atheist is ruined, and [what is given] to a vow-breaker is discarded;
and that which is given to a trader does not bear fruit here or in the world beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣepahārake caiva kṛtaghne vidavarjite /
tathā pāṇavike vai ca kāruke dharmavarjite //
meaning:
निक्षेपहारके चैव कृतघ्ने विदवर्जिते /
तथा पाणविके वै च कारुके धर्मवर्जिते //
text_mt:
Likewise regarding a stealer of deposits, an ungrateful person, one destitute of Vedic knowledge,
and a drummer, an artisan destitute of righteousness;

sanskrit_iast:
krīṇāti yo hyapaṇyāni vikrīṇāti praśaṃsati /
anyatrāsya samādhānaṃ na vaṇikūchrāddhamarhati //
meaning:
क्रीणाति यो ह्यपण्यानि विक्रीणाति प्रशंसति /
अन्यत्रास्य समाधानं न वणिकूछ्राद्धमर्हति //
text_mt:
one who buys prohibited goods, sells them, or praises them—
his composure lies elsewhere; a trader does not deserve a śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ dattaṃ paunarbhave dvijaḥ /
ṣaṣṭiṃ kāṇaḥ śataṃ ṣaṇḍhaḥ śvitrī pañcaśatānyapi //
meaning:
भस्मनीव हुतं हव्यं दत्तं पौनर्भवे द्विजः /
षष्टिं काणः शतं षण्ढः श्वित्री पञ्चशतान्यपि //
text_mt:
The oblation given to a twice-born son of a remarried woman is like an offering in ashes:
a one-eyed man [destroys the fruit of] sixty [guests], an eunuch a hundred, and a leper five hundred;

sanskrit_iast:
pāparogī sahasraṃ vai dāturnāśayate phalam /
bhraśyeddhi sa phalāttasmātpradātā yastu bāliśaḥ //
meaning:
पापरोगी सहस्रं वै दातुर्नाशयते फलम् /
भ्रश्येद्धि स फलात्तस्मात्प्रदाता यस्तु बालिशः //
text_mt:
a person afflicted with a vile disease destroys the fruit of a thousand for the giver.
Verily, from that fruit falls the donor who is foolish.

sanskrit_iast:
yadviṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yadbhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
sopānatkaśca yadbhuṅkte yacca dattamasatkṛtam //
meaning:
यद्विष्टितशिरा भुङ्क्ते यद्भुङ्क्ते दक्षिणामुखः /
सोपानत्कश्च यद्भुङ्क्ते यच्च दत्तमसत्कृतम् //
text_mt:
What one eats with head wrapped, what one eats facing the south,
what one eats wearing shoes, and that which is given disrespectfully—

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ tadasuredrāya brahmā bhāgamakalpayat /
śvā caiva brahmahā caiva nāvekṣeta kathañcana //
meaning:
सर्वं तदसुरेद्राय ब्रह्मा भागमकल्पयत् /
श्वा चैव ब्रह्महा चैव नावेक्षेत कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
Brahmā assigned all that as the share for the king of Asuras.
A dog and a killer of a brāhmaṇa should by no means look on.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātparivṛtairdadyāttilaiścānnaṃ vikīrya ca /
rākṣasānāṃ tilāḥ proktāḥ śunāṃ parivṛtāstathā //
meaning:
तस्मात्परिवृतैर्दद्यात्तिलैश्चान्नं विकीर्य च /
राक्षसानां तिलाः प्रोक्ताः शुनां परिवृतास्तथा //
text_mt:
Therefore one should give in enclosed [places], having scattered food with sesame seeds;
sesame seeds are proclaimed [protective] against Rākṣasas, and enclosed spaces against dogs.

sanskrit_iast:
darśanātsūkaro hanti pakṣavātena kukkuṭaḥ /
rajasvalāyāḥ sparśena kruddhoyaśca prayacchati //
meaning:
दर्शनात्सूकरो हन्ति पक्षवातेन कुक्कुटः /
रजस्वलायाः स्पर्शेन क्रुद्धोयश्च प्रयच्छति //
text_mt:
A pig spoils [the rite] by sight, a cock by the wind of its wings,
[a woman] in her menses by touch, and [one who is] angry when he gives.

sanskrit_iast:
nadītīreṣu ramyeṣu saritsu ca sarassu ca /
vivikteṣu ca prīyante datteneha pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
नदीतीरेषु रम्येषु सरित्सु च सरस्सु च /
विविक्तेषु च प्रीयन्ते दत्तेनेह पितामहाः //
text_mt:
On pleasant riverbanks, near streams and lakes,
and in solitary places, the ancestors are pleased with what is given here.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsavyaṃpātayejjānu na yukto vācamīrayet /
tasmātparivṛteneha vidhivaddarbhapāṇinā //
meaning:
नासव्यंपातयेज्जानु न युक्तो वाचमीरयेत् /
तस्मात्परिवृतेनेह विधिवद्दर्भपाणिना //
text_mt:
One must not let down the left knee, nor utter a word when engaged [in the rite].
Therefore, here, by one who is screened, holding darbha-grass in hand according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pitrorārādhanaṃ kāryamevaṃ prīṇayate pitṝn /
anumānya dvijānpūrvamargauṃ kuryādyathāvidhi //
meaning:
पित्रोराराधनं कार्यमेवं प्रीणयते पितॄन् /
अनुमान्य द्विजान्पूर्वमर्गौं कुर्याद्यथाविधि //
text_mt:
the propitiation of the parents is to be performed; in this way one pleases the ancestors.
Having first obtained the assent of the twice-born, one should offer the respectful water according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ nirvapedbhūmau sūrye vā darbhasaṃstare /
śuklapakṣe ca pūrvāṅṇe śrāddhaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi //
meaning:
पितॄणां निर्वपेद्भूमौ सूर्ये वा दर्भसंस्तरे /
शुक्लपक्षे च पूर्वाङ्णे श्राद्धं कुर्याद्यथाविधि //
text_mt:
One should offer to the ancestors on the ground, or before the sun, on a strewing of darbha-grass;
in the bright fortnight, one should perform the śrāddha in the morning according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe 'paraṅṇe tu rauhiṇaṃ vai na laṅghayet /
evamete mahātmāno mahāyogā mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे ऽपरङ्णे तु रौहिणं वै न लङ्घयेत् /
एवमेते महात्मानो महायोगा महौजसः //
text_mt:
In the dark fortnight, however, [one should perform it] in the afternoon; one must not transgress the Rauhiṇa [muhūrta].
Thus these great-souled ones possess great yoga and great splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā vai pitaraḥ pūjyāḥ saṃ prāptau deśakālayoḥ /
pitṛbhaktyaiva tu naro yogaṃ prāpnoti durllabham //
meaning:
सदा वै पितरः पूज्याः सं प्राप्तौ देशकालयोः /
पितृभक्त्यैव तु नरो योगं प्राप्नोति दुर्ल्लभम् //
text_mt:
The ancestors are ever to be worshipped when the place and time have arrived;
verily, by devotion to the ancestors a man attains the yoga that is difficult to obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānena mokṣaṃ gaccheddhi hitvā karma śubhāśubham /
yajñahetostaduddhṛtya mohayitvā jagattathā //
meaning:
ध्यानेन मोक्षं गच्छेद्धि हित्वा कर्म शुभाशुभम् /
यज्ञहेतोस्तदुद्धृत्य मोहयित्वा जगत्तथा //
text_mt:
By meditation he would attain liberation, abandoning auspicious and inauspicious karma.
Having extracted that for the sake of sacrifice, and having deluded the world,

sanskrit_iast:
guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma kaśyapena mahātmanā /
amṛtaṃ guhyamuddhṛtya yoge yogavidāṃ varāḥ //
meaning:
गुहायां निहितं ब्रह्म कश्यपेन महात्मना /
अमृतं गुह्यमुद्धृत्य योगे योगविदां वराः //
text_mt:
the sacred knowledge was placed in a secret cave by the great-souled Kaśyapa.
Having extracted the secret nectar in yoga, O best among those who know yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
proktaḥ sanatkumāreṇa mahāto brahmaṇaḥ padam /
devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyamṛṣīṇāṃ ca parāyaṇam //
meaning:
प्रोक्तः सनत्कुमारेण महातो ब्रह्मणः पदम् /
देवानां परमं गुह्यमृषीणां च परायणम् //
text_mt:
the abode of the supreme Brahman was proclaimed by Sanatkumāra,
the ultimate secret of the gods and the supreme refuge of the sages.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhaktyā prayatnena prāpya te tanmanīṣibhiḥ /
pitṛbhaktaḥ samāsena pitṛpūrvaparaśca yaḥ //
meaning:
पितृभक्त्या प्रयत्नेन प्राप्य ते तन्मनीषिभिः /
पितृभक्तः समासेन पितृपूर्वपरश्च यः //
text_mt:
Attaining that with effort through devotion to the ancestors, by those wise men—
he who is devoted to the ancestors, in brief, and intent upon his ancestors before all else,

sanskrit_iast: ayatnātprāpnuyādeva sarvametanna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning: अयत्नात्प्राप्नुयादेव सर्वमेतन्न संशयः //
text_mt: verily attains all this without effort; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
yasmaiśrāddhāni deyāni yacca dattaṃ mahatphalam /
yeṣu cāpyakṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ tīrtheṣu ca guhāsu ca //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
यस्मैश्राद्धानि देयानि यच्च दत्तं महत्फलम् /
येषु चाप्यक्षयं श्राद्धं तीर्थेषु च गुहासु च //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
To whom funeral offerings should be given, and what given yields great fruit, / and at which sacred water bodies and caves a funeral offering becomes inexhaustible,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu svargamavāpnoti tatte proktaṃ sasaṃgraham /
śrutvemaṃ śrāddhakalpaṃ ca na kuryādyastu mānavaḥ //
meaning:
येषु स्वर्गमवाप्नोति तत्ते प्रोक्तं ससंग्रहम् /
श्रुत्वेमं श्राद्धकल्पं च न कुर्याद्यस्तु मानवः //
text_mt: and at which one attains heaven—that has been declared to you in summary. / But the mortal who, having heard this rite of funeral offerings, does not perform it,

sanskrit_iast:
sa majjennarake ghore nāstikastamasāvṛte /
parivādo na karttavyo yogināṃ tu viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
स मज्जेन्नरके घोरे नास्तिकस्तमसावृते /
परिवादो न कर्त्तव्यो योगिनां तु विशेषतः //
text_mt: that nihilist would sink into a terrible hell enveloped in darkness. / Moreover, censure must not be made, especially of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
parivādātkrimirbhūtvā tatraiva parivarttate /
yogānparivadedyastu dhyānino mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
परिवादात्क्रिमिर्भूत्वा तत्रैव परिवर्त्तते /
योगान्परिवदेद्यस्तु ध्यानिनो मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt: From censure, having become a worm, one revolves in that very place. / The one who reviles the yogas, the meditators desirous of liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchennarakaṃ ghoraṃ śrotāpyasya na saṃśayaḥ /
āvṛtaṃ tamasaḥ sarvaṃ narakaṃ ghoradarśanam /
yogīśvaraparīvādānna svargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
स गच्छेन्नरकं घोरं श्रोताप्यस्य न संशयः /
आवृतं तमसः सर्वं नरकं घोरदर्शनम् /
योगीश्वरपरीवादान्न स्वर्गं याति मानवः //
text_mt: he would go to a terrible hell, and the hearer of it as well, no doubt. / All hell, terrible in appearance, is enveloped in darkness; / from censuring a lord of yogins, a mortal does not go to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
yogeśvarāṇāmā krośaṃ śṛṇuyādyo yatātmanām /
sahi kālaṃ ciraṃ majjennarake nātra saṃśayaḥ /
kuṃbhīpākeṣu pacyante jihvācchede punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
योगेश्वराणामा क्रोशं शृणुयाद्यो यतात्मनाम् /
सहि कालं चिरं मज्जेन्नरके नात्र संशयः /
कुंभीपाकेषु पच्यन्ते जिह्वाच्छेदे पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: He who listens to abuse of the lords of yoga, of self-controlled souls, / will certainly sink into hell for a long time, there is no doubt here; / in the Kumbhīpāka hells they are cooked, their tongues being severed again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
samudre ca yathā loṣaṭastadbatsīdanti te narāḥ /
manasā karmaṇā vācā dveṣaṃ yogeṣu varjayet /
protyānantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkta iha vāpi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
समुद्रे च यथा लोषटस्तद्बत्सीदन्ति ते नराः /
मनसा कर्मणा वाचा द्वेषं योगेषु वर्जयेत् /
प्रोत्यानन्तं फलं भुङ्क्त इह वापि न संशयः //
text_mt: And just like a clod of earth [dissolves] in the ocean, so those men sink. / One should avoid hatred toward yogas in mind, action, and speech; / having departed, he enjoys infinite fruit, or even here, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na pārago vindati paramātmanastrilokamadhye carati svakarmamiḥ /
ṛco yajuḥ sāma tadaṅgapārage 'vikārametaṃ hyanavāpya sīdati //
meaning:
न पारगो विन्दति परमात्मनस्त्रिलोकमध्ये चरति स्वकर्ममिः /
ऋचो यजुः साम तदङ्गपारगे ऽविकारमेतं ह्यनवाप्य सीदति //
text_mt: The one who has not crossed over does not find the Supreme Self, but roams within the three worlds through his own acts; / having crossed to the further shore of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas and their auxiliary branches, not having attained this changeless [Self], he sinks.

sanskrit_iast:
vikārapāraṃ prakṛteśca pāragastrayīguṇānā triguṇasya pāragaḥ /
yaḥ syāccaturviśatitattvapāragaḥ sa pārago nādhyayanasya pāragaḥ //
meaning:
विकारपारं प्रकृतेश्च पारगस्त्रयीगुणाना त्रिगुणस्य पारगः /
यः स्याच्चतुर्विशतितत्त्वपारगः स पारगो नाध्ययनस्य पारगः //
text_mt: He who has reached the end of modification and crossed beyond nature, crossed beyond the three qualities of the three Vedas— / he who has crossed beyond the twenty-four principles is the true master, not one who has merely mastered recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtsnaṃ yathāvatsamupaiti tatparastathaiva bhūyaḥ pralayatvamātmanaḥ /
pratyāharedyogapathaṃ na yo dvijo na sarvapāra kramapāragocaraḥ //
meaning:
कृत्स्नं यथावत्समुपैति तत्परस्तथैव भूयः प्रलयत्वमात्मनः /
प्रत्याहरेद्योगपथं न यो द्विजो न सर्वपार क्रमपारगोचरः //
text_mt: The highest one attains all properly, and likewise the self's dissolution again. / The twice-born who does not withdraw onto the path of yoga is not a master of everything, nor within the range of mastery over the stages.

sanskrit_iast:
vedasya veditavyaṃ ca vedyaṃ vindati yogavit /
taṃ vai vedavidaḥ prāhustamāhurvedapāragam //
meaning:
वेदस्य वेदितव्यं च वेद्यं विन्दति योगवित् /
तं वै वेदविदः प्राहुस्तमाहुर्वेदपारगम् //
text_mt: The knower of yoga finds the Veda, what is to be known, and the knowable; / him indeed the knowers of the Veda call, him they proclaim a master of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaṃ ca veditavyaṃ ca viditvā vai yathāsthitaḥ /
evaṃ vedavidaḥ prāhuranyaṃ vai vedapāragam //
meaning:
वेदं च वेदितव्यं च विदित्वा वै यथास्थितः /
एवं वेदविदः प्राहुरन्यं वै वेदपारगम् //
text_mt: Having known the Veda and what is to be known, abiding truly as it is— / thus the knowers of the Veda proclaim another to be a master of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñānvedāṃstathā kāmāṃstapāṃsi vividhāni ca /
prāpnotyāyuḥ prajāścaiva pitṛbhakto na saśayaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञान्वेदांस्तथा कामांस्तपांसि विविधानि च /
प्राप्नोत्यायुः प्रजाश्चैव पितृभक्तो न सशयः //
text_mt: Sacrifices, Vedas, desires, and various austerities, / life and offspring indeed—the one devoted to the ancestors attains, no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śraddhayā śrāddhakalpaṃ tu yastvimaṃ niyataḥ paṭhet /
sarvāṇyetāni vāpnoti tīrthadānaphalāni ca //
meaning:
श्रद्धया श्राद्धकल्पं तु यस्त्विमं नियतः पठेत् /
सर्वाण्येतानि वाप्नोति तीर्थदानफलानि च //
text_mt: Whoever, restrained, recites this rite of funeral offerings with faith / attains all these fruits and those of gifts at sacred water bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
sa paṅktipāvanaścaiva dvijānāmagrabhugbhavet /
āśrāvya ca dvijānso 'tha sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
स पङ्क्तिपावनश्चैव द्विजानामग्रभुग्भवेत् /
आश्राव्य च द्विजान्सो ऽथ सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: He purifies the row [of diners] and becomes the foremost eater among twice-borns; / and having recited it to the twice-born, he would then attain all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityama nyāṃśca śrāvayeddvijaḥ /
anasūyurjitakrodho lobhamohavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यम न्यांश्च श्रावयेद्द्विजः /
अनसूयुर्जितक्रोधो लोभमोहविवर्जितः //
text_mt: And the twice-born who listens to this daily, and recites it to others, / ungrudging, having conquered anger, freed from greed and delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthādīnāṃ phalaṃ prāpya dānādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ /
mokṣopāyaṃ labhecchreṣṭhaṃ svargopāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
iha cāpi parā puṣṭhistasmātkurvīta nityaśaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थादीनां फलं प्राप्य दानादीनां च सर्वशः /
मोक्षोपायं लभेच्छ्रेष्ठं स्वर्गोपायं न संशयः /
इह चापि परा पुष्ठिस्तस्मात्कुर्वीत नित्यशः //
text_mt: having attained the fruit of sacred water bodies and the like, and of gifts and the like completely, / would obtain the best means to liberation and the means to heaven, no doubt; / and supreme nourishment is here as well; therefore one should do it daily.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ vidhiṃ yo hi paṭhedatandritaḥ samāhitaḥ saṃsadi parvasaṃdhiṣu /
apatyabhāgī ca pareṇa tejasā divaukasāṃ sa vrajate salokatām //
meaning:
इमं विधिं यो हि पठेदतन्द्रितः समाहितः संसदि पर्वसंधिषु /
अपत्यभागी च परेण तेजसा दिवौकसां स व्रजते सलोकताम् //
text_mt: Whoever, unwearied, collected in mind, recites this rule in an assembly on the conjunctions of festival days, / becomes a possessor of offspring and, through supreme splendor, goes to the same world as the heaven-dwellers.

sanskrit_iast:
yena proktastvayaṃ kalpo namastasmai svayaṃbhuve /
mahāyogeśvarebhyaśca sadā ca praṇato 'smyaham //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
śrāddhakalpe brahmaṇaparīkṣā nāma ekonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ // 19//
meaning:
येन प्रोक्तस्त्वयं कल्पो नमस्तस्मै स्वयंभुवे /
महायोगेश्वरेभ्यश्च सदा च प्रणतो ऽस्म्यहम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
श्राद्धकल्पे ब्रह्मणपरीक्षा नाम एकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः // 19//
text_mt:
Homage to that Svayambhū by whom this rite was declared, / and I am always bowed to the great lords of yoga.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, named 'Examination of Brahmins', in the rite of funeral offerings, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ityete pitaro devā devānāmapi devatāḥ /
saptasvete sthitā nityaṃ sthāneṣu pitaro 'vyayāḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
इत्येते पितरो देवा देवानामपि देवताः /
सप्तस्वेते स्थिता नित्यं स्थानेषु पितरो ऽव्ययाः //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
Thus these ancestors are gods, deities even of the gods; / established in these seven stations, the imperishable ancestors are eternal.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatisutā hyete sarveṣāṃ tu mahātmanām /
ādyo gaṇastu yogānāmanuyogavivarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रजापतिसुता ह्येते सर्वेषां तु महात्मनाम् /
आद्यो गणस्तु योगानामनुयोगविवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: They are sons of Prajāpati, of all the great-souled beings. / The first group belongs to yogas, promoting subsequent yoga;

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyo devatānāṃ tu tṛtīyo dānavādinām /
śeṣāstu varṇiṃnāṃ jñeyā iti sarve prakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयो देवतानां तु तृतीयो दानवादिनाम् /
शेषास्तु वर्णिंनां ज्ञेया इति सर्वे प्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: the second belongs to deities; the third to Dānavas and others; / and the rest are to be known as belonging to the social classes: thus all have been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
devāschaitānyajante vai sarvajñāneṣvavasthitān /
āśramaśca yajantyenāṃścatvārastu yathākramam //
meaning:
देवास्छैतान्यजन्ते वै सर्वज्ञानेष्ववस्थितान् /
आश्रमश्च यजन्त्येनांश्चत्वारस्तु यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: The gods sacrifice to these who are established in all knowledge; / and the four stages of life sacrifice to them in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve varṇā yajantyenāṃścatvārastu yathāgamam /
tathā saṃkarajātyaśca mlecchāścāpi yajanti vai //
meaning:
सर्वे वर्णा यजन्त्येनांश्चत्वारस्तु यथागमम् /
तथा संकरजात्यश्च म्लेच्छाश्चापि यजन्ति वै //
text_mt: All four social classes sacrifice to them in accordance with scripture; / likewise, mixed castes and even foreigners sacrifice [to them].

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛṃstu yo yajedbhaktyā pitaraḥ prīṇayanti te /
pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya prajākāmasya vā punaḥ //
meaning:
पितृंस्तु यो यजेद्भक्त्या पितरः प्रीणयन्ति ते /
पितरः पुष्टिकामस्य प्रजाकामस्य वा पुनः //
text_mt: The ancestors whom one sacrifices to with devotion, they gratify [him]; / the ancestors, for one desiring nourishment or one desiring offspring,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ tu svargaṃ ca prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ /
devakāryādapi tathā pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate //
meaning:
पुष्टिं प्रजां तु स्वर्गं च प्रयच्छन्ति पितामहाः /
देवकार्यादपि तथा पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते //
text_mt: the grandfathers grant nourishment, offspring, and heaven. / Likewise, the duty to ancestors is superior even to the duty to gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāṃ hi pitaraḥ pūrvamāpyāyanaṃ smṛtāḥ /
na hi yogagatiḥ sūkṣmā pitṝṇāṃ jñāyate naraiḥ //
meaning:
देवतानां हि पितरः पूर्वमाप्यायनं स्मृताः /
न हि योगगतिः सूक्ष्मा पितॄणां ज्ञायते नरैः //
text_mt: For the ancestors are traditionally remembered as the prior nourishment of deities. / Indeed, the subtle course of yoga of the ancestors is not known by men,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā hi prasiddhena kiṃ punarmāṃsacakṣuṣā /
sarveṣāṃ rājataṃ pātramatha vā rajatānvitam //
meaning:
तपसा हि प्रसिद्धेन किं पुनर्मांसचक्षुषा /
सर्वेषां राजतं पात्रमथ वा रजतान्वितम् //
text_mt: even by renowned austerity, much less by the eye of flesh. / For all, a silver vessel, or one provided with silver,

sanskrit_iast:
pāvanaṃ hyuttamaṃ proktaṃ devānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha /
yeṣāṃ dāsyanti piṇḍāṃstrīnbāndhavā nāmagotrataḥ //
meaning:
पावनं ह्युत्तमं प्रोक्तं देवानां पितृभिः सह /
येषां दास्यन्ति पिण्डांस्त्रीन्बान्धवा नामगोत्रतः //
text_mt: is declared to be the highest purifier for gods together with ancestors. / To those for whom relatives offer three rice balls by name and lineage,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau kuśottarāyāṃ ca apasavyavidhānataḥ /
sarvatra varttamānāste piṇḍāḥ prīṇanti vai pitṝn //
meaning:
भूमौ कुशोत्तरायां च अपसव्यविधानतः /
सर्वत्र वर्त्तमानास्ते पिण्डाः प्रीणन्ति वै पितॄन् //
text_mt: on the ground strewn with kuśa grass, according to the counter-clockwise ritual procedure, / those rice balls, existing everywhere, truly gratify the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
yadāhāro bhavejjanturāhāraḥ so 'sya jāyate /
yathā goṣṭhe pranaṣṭāṃ vai vatso vindati mātaram //
meaning:
यदाहारो भवेज्जन्तुराहारः सो ऽस्य जायते /
यथा गोष्ठे प्रनष्टां वै वत्सो विन्दति मातरम् //
text_mt: Whatever food a creature eats, that becomes his food [there]. / Just as a calf finds its lost mother in a cattle pen,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā taṃ nayate mantro janturyatrāvatiṣṭhati /
nāmagotraṃ ca mantraṃ ca dattamannaṃ nayanti tam //
meaning:
तथा तं नयते मन्त्रो जन्तुर्यत्रावतिष्ठति /
नामगोत्रं च मन्त्रं च दत्तमन्नं नयन्ति तम् //
text_mt: so the mantra leads it to where the creature stays; / name, lineage, and mantra convey that given food to him.

sanskrit_iast:
api yoniśataṃ prāptāṃstṛptistānanugacchati /
evameṣā sthitā sattā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
अपि योनिशतं प्राप्तांस्तृप्तिस्ताननुगच्छति /
एवमेषा स्थिता सत्ता ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Even if they have attained a hundred wombs, satisfaction follows them. / Thus this nature was established by Brahmā Parameṣṭhin

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇamādisargetu lokānāmakṣayārthinām /
ityete pitaraścaiva lokā duhitarastathā //
meaning:
पितॄणमादिसर्गेतु लोकानामक्षयार्थिनाम् /
इत्येते पितरश्चैव लोका दुहितरस्तथा //
text_mt: at the primary creation of the ancestors, for the sake of worlds desiring imperishability. / Thus these ancestors, the worlds, and the daughters,

sanskrit_iast:
dauhitrā yajamānaśca proktāścaiva mayānagha /
kīrttitāḥ pitaraste vai tava putra yathākramam //
meaning:
दौहित्रा यजमानश्च प्रोक्ताश्चैव मयानघ /
कीर्त्तिताः पितरस्ते वै तव पुत्र यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: the daughters' sons, and the sacrificer have been declared by me, O sinless one; / your ancestors have been proclaimed to you, O son, in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃyuruvāca
aho divyastvayā tāta pitṛsargastu kīrtitaḥ /
lokā duhitaraścaiva dohitrāśca śrutāstathā //
meaning:
शंयुरुवाच
अहो दिव्यस्त्वया तात पितृसर्गस्तु कीर्तितः /
लोका दुहितरश्चैव दोहित्राश्च श्रुतास्तथा //
text_mt:
Śaṃyu said:
Oh, the divine creation of ancestors has been proclaimed by you, dear father; / the worlds, daughters, and daughters' sons have likewise been heard,

sanskrit_iast:
dānāni saha śaucena kīrttitāni phalāni ca /
akṣayyatvaṃ dvijāṃścaiva sarvametadudāhṛtam /
adyaprabhṛti karttāsmi sarvametadyathātatham //
meaning:
दानानि सह शौचेन कीर्त्तितानि फलानि च /
अक्षय्यत्वं द्विजांश्चैव सर्वमेतदुदाहृतम् /
अद्यप्रभृति कर्त्तास्मि सर्वमेतद्यथातथम् //
text_mt: and gifts along with purity have been proclaimed, and fruits, / imperishability, and twice-borns—all this has been set forth. / From this day forward, I will perform all this just as it is.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ityetadaṅgirāḥ pūrvamṛṣīṇāmuktavānprabhuḥ /
pṛṣṭaśca saṃśayānsarvānṛṣīnāha nṛsaṃsadi //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
इत्येतदङ्गिराः पूर्वमृषीणामुक्तवान्प्रभुः /
पृष्टश्च संशयान्सर्वानृषीनाह नृसंसदि //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
Thus Angiras, the lord, previously spoke this to the sages; / and questioned, he stated all doubts to the sages in an assembly of men,

sanskrit_iast:
satre tu vitate pūrvaṃ tathā varṣasahasrake /
yasminsadaspatisnāto brahmā sīddevatāprabhuḥ //
meaning:
सत्रे तु वितते पूर्वं तथा वर्षसहस्रके /
यस्मिन्सदस्पतिस्नातो ब्रह्मा सीद्देवताप्रभुः //
text_mt: at the sacrificial session formerly extended for a thousand years, / in which Brahmā, the lord of deities, was the bathed president of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
gatāni tatra varṣāṇāṃ pañcāśacca śatāni vai /
ślokāścātra purā gītā ṛṣibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
गतानि तत्र वर्षाणां पञ्चाशच्च शतानि वै /
श्लोकाश्चात्र पुरा गीता ऋषिभिर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः //
text_mt: Fifty hundred years had passed there; / and verses were sung on this in ancient times by the sages who expounded Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitasya purā satre brahmamaḥ paramātmanaḥ /
tatraiva dattamannāgraṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayarthinām /
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā //
meaning:
दीक्षितस्य पुरा सत्रे ब्रह्ममः परमात्मनः /
तत्रैव दत्तमन्नाग्रं पितॄणामक्षयर्थिनाम् /
लोकानां च हितार्थाय ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना //
text_mt: formerly at the sacrificial session of Brahmā, the Supreme Self, who had received consecration; / in that very place, the foremost portion of food was given by Brahmā Parameṣṭhin for the ancestors who desire imperishability, / and for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
evaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ pūrvaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ putreṇa dhīmatā /
provāca pitṛsargaṃ tu yaścaiva samudāhṛta //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
śrāddhakalpo nāma viṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 20//
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एवं बृहस्पतिः पूर्वं पृष्टः पुत्रेण धीमता /
प्रोवाच पितृसर्गं तु यश्चैव समुदाहृत //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
श्राद्धकल्पो नाम विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 20//
text_mt:
The bard said: / Thus Bṛhaspati, previously questioned by his wise son, / declared the creation of the ancestors, just as has been related.

Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "The Procedure for Śrāddha," in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle portion of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
samāptaścāyaṃ śrāddhakalpaḥ /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
itthaṃ pravarttamānasya jamadagnermahātmanaḥ /
varṣāṇi katicidrājanvyatīyuramitaujasaḥ //
meaning:
समाप्तश्चायं श्राद्धकल्पः /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्थं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य जमदग्नेर्महात्मनः /
वर्षाणि कतिचिद्राजन्व्यतीयुरमितौजसः //
text_mt: And this procedure for śrāddha is concluded. / Vasiṣṭha said: / As the great-souled Jamadagni of boundless splendour was living thus, / a few years passed by, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi nṛpaśārdūla sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ /
vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि नृपशार्दूल सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः /
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः //
text_mt: Rāma also, O tiger among kings, foremost of all maintainers of dharma, / knew the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and was proficient in all treatises.

sanskrit_iast:
pitroścakāra śuśrūṣāṃ vinītātmā mahāmatiḥ /
prītiṃ ca nijaceṣṭābhiranvahaṃ paryavarttayat //
meaning:
पित्रोश्चकार शुश्रूषां विनीतात्मा महामतिः /
प्रीतिं च निजचेष्टाभिरन्वहं पर्यवर्त्तयत् //
text_mt: Humble in nature and highly intelligent, he attended upon his parents, / and daily increased their affection by his actions.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pravarttamānasya varṣāṇi katicinnṛpa /
pitroḥ śuśrūṣayānaiṣīdrāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य वर्षाणि कतिचिन्नृप /
पित्रोः शुश्रूषयानैषीद्रामो मतिमतां वरः //
text_mt: As he lived in this manner, O king, Rāma, foremost of the wise, / spent some years serving his parents.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmahātejāḥ pitāmaha guhaṃ prati /
gantuṃ vyavasito rājandaivena ca niyojitaḥ //
meaning:
स कदाचिन्महातेजाः पितामह गुहं प्रति /
गन्तुं व्यवसितो राजन्दैवेन च नियोजितः //
text_mt: Once, that one of great fiery energy resolved to go to his grandfather's house, / impelled, O king, by destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
nipīḍya śirasā pitroścaraṇau bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ /
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtavā sapraśrayamidaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
निपीड्य शिरसा पित्रोश्चरणौ भृगुपुङ्गवः /
उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूतवा सप्रश्रयमिदं वचः //
text_mt: Touching his parents' feet with his head, that eminent Bhṛgu, / with folded hands, addressed these respectful words [to them]:

sanskrit_iast:
kañcidarthamahaṃ tāta mātaraṃ tvāṃ ca sāmpratam /
vijñāpayitumicchāmi mama tacchrotumarhathaḥ //
meaning:
कञ्चिदर्थमहं तात मातरं त्वां च साम्प्रतम् /
विज्ञापयितुमिच्छामि मम तच्छ्रोतुमर्हथः //
text_mt: "Father, I wish now to make a certain request / to mother and to you; you ought to hear it from me.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahamahaṃ draṣṭumutkaṇṭhitamanāściram /
tasmāttatpārśvamadhunā gamiṣye vāmanujñayā //
meaning:
पितामहमहं द्रष्टुमुत्कण्ठितमनाश्चिरम् /
तस्मात्तत्पार्श्वमधुना गमिष्ये वामनुज्ञया //
text_mt: My mind has long been longing to see my grandfather; / therefore, with your permission, I shall now go to his presence.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūtaścāsakṛttāta sotkaṇṭhaṃ prīyamāṇayā /
pitāmahyā bahumukhairicchantyā mama darśanam //
meaning:
आहूतश्चासकृत्तात सोत्कण्ठं प्रीयमाणया /
पितामह्या बहुमुखैरिच्छन्त्या मम दर्शनम् //
text_mt: And I have been summoned repeatedly, father, through many messengers / by my grandmother, who loves me with longing and wishes to see me.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝnpitāmahasyāpi priyameva pradarśanam /
sadīyaṃ tena tatpārśvaṃ gantuṃ māmanujānata //
meaning:
पितॄन्पितामहस्यापि प्रियमेव प्रदर्शनम् /
सदीयं तेन तत्पार्श्वं गन्तुं मामनुजानत //
text_mt: The sight of one's own descendants is truly pleasing even to ancestors and grandfathers; / therefore, grant me leave to go to his presence."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā saṃbhrāntaṃ samudīritam /
harṣeṇa mahatā yuktau sāśrunetrau babhūvatuḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा संभ्रान्तं समुदीरितम् /
हर्षेण महता युक्तौ साश्रुनेत्रौ बभूवतुः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing this eagerly uttered speech of his, / they were filled with great joy, and their eyes filled with tears.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāliṅgya mahābhāgaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya sādaram /
abhinandyāśiṣā tāta hyubhau tāvidamāhatuḥ //
meaning:
तमालिङ्ग्य महाभागं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय सादरम् /
अभिनन्द्याशिषा तात ह्युभौ ताविदमाहतुः //
text_mt: Embracing that fortunate one and smelling his head with affection, / blessing him with a benediction, father, the two spoke thus to him:

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahagṛhaṃ tāta prayāhi tvaṃ yathāsukham /
pitāmahapitāmahyoḥ prītaye darśanāya ca //
meaning:
पितामहगृहं तात प्रयाहि त्वं यथासुखम् /
पितामहपितामह्योः प्रीतये दर्शनाय च //
text_mt: "Go at your pleasure, child, to your grandfather's house, / for the delight and the sight of your grandfather and grandmother.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā yathānyāyaṃ taṃ śuśrūṣā parāyaṇaḥ /
kañcitkālaṃ tayorvatsa prītaye vasa tadgṛhe //
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा यथान्यायं तं शुश्रूषा परायणः /
कञ्चित्कालं तयोर्वत्स प्रीतये वस तद्गृहे //
text_mt: Having gone there, devoted to serving him properly, / dwell in their house for a short time, child, for their joy.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā nāticiraṃ kālaṃ tayorbhūyo 'pyanuśaya /
atrāgaccha mahābhāga kṣemeṇāsmaddidṛkṣayā //
meaning:
स्थित्वा नातिचिरं कालं तयोर्भूयो ऽप्यनुशय /
अत्रागच्छ महाभाग क्षेमेणास्मद्दिदृक्षया //
text_mt: Having stayed for not too long a time, taking leave of them once more, / return here in safety, O fortunate one, out of a desire to see us.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇārddhamapi śaktāḥ stho na vinā putradarśanam /
tasmātpitāmaha gṛhe na cirātsthātumarhasi //
meaning:
क्षणार्द्धमपि शक्ताः स्थो न विना पुत्रदर्शनम् /
तस्मात्पितामह गृहे न चिरात्स्थातुमर्हसि //
text_mt: We are not able to endure even half a moment without the sight of our son; / therefore, you should not remain in your grandfather's house for long.

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayātha vā putra prapitāmahasannidhim /
gato 'pi śīghramāgaccha krameṇa tadanujñayā //
meaning:
तदाज्ञयाथ वा पुत्र प्रपितामहसन्निधिम् /
गतो ऽपि शीघ्रमागच्छ क्रमेण तदनुज्ञया //
text_mt: Or, if by his command you go, O son, to the presence of your great-grandfather, / return quickly in due course with his permission."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktastau parikramya praṇamya ca mahāmatiḥ /
pitarāvapyanujñāpya pitāmahagṛhaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तस्तौ परिक्रम्य प्रणम्य च महामतिः /
पितरावप्यनुज्ञाप्य पितामहगृहं ततः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed, circumambulating and bowing to the two of them, / that highly intelligent one took leave of his parents and then set out for his grandfather's house.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā bhṛguvaryasya ṛcīkasya mahātmanaḥ /
praviveśāśramaṃ rāmo muniśiṣyopaśobhitam //
meaning:
स गत्वा भृगुवर्यस्य ऋचीकस्य महात्मनः /
प्रविवेशाश्रमं रामो मुनिशिष्योपशोभितम् //
text_mt: Going forth, Rāma entered the hermitage of the great-souled Ṛcīka, best of the Bhṛgus, / adorned with the sage's disciples,

sanskrit_iast:
svādhyāyaghoṣairvipulaiḥ sarvataḥ pratināditam /
praśāntavaira sattvāḍhyaṃ sarvasattvamanoharam //
meaning:
स्वाध्यायघोषैर्विपुलैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादितम् /
प्रशान्तवैर सत्त्वाढ्यं सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरम् //
text_mt: resounding on all sides with the loud chanting of Vedic recitation, / filled with creatures whose enmity was pacified, charming to all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
sa praviśyaśramaṃ ramyamṛcīkaṃ sthitamāsane /
dadarśa rāmo rājendra sa pitāmahamagrataḥ //
meaning:
स प्रविश्यश्रमं रम्यमृचीकं स्थितमासने /
ददर्श रामो राजेन्द्र स पितामहमग्रतः //
text_mt: Entering that delightful hermitage, Rāma, O best of kings, / saw his grandfather Ṛcīka seated on a seat before him,

sanskrit_iast:
jājvalyamānaṃ tapasā dhiṣṇyasthamiva pāvakam /
upāsitaṃ satyavatyā yathā dakṣiṇāya'dhvaram //
meaning:
जाज्वल्यमानं तपसा धिष्ण्यस्थमिव पावकम् /
उपासितं सत्यवत्या यथा दक्षिणायऽध्वरम् //
text_mt: blazing with ascetic heat like fire upon its hearth, / attended by Satyavatī like a sacrifice accompanied by sacrificial fees.

sanskrit_iast:
svasamīpamupāyāntaṃ rāmamālokya tau nṛpa /
suciraṃ taṃ vimarśetāṃ samājñāpūrvadarśanau //
meaning:
स्वसमीपमुपायान्तं राममालोक्य तौ नृप /
सुचिरं तं विमर्शेतां समाज्ञापूर्वदर्शनौ //
text_mt: Beholding Rāma approaching their presence, O king, / the two, who had never seen him before, gazed at him thoughtfully for a long time:

sanskrit_iast:
ko 'yameṣa taporāśiḥ sarvalatraṇapūjitaḥ /
bālo 'yaṃ balavānbhātigāṃbhīryātpraśrayeṇa ca //
meaning:
को ऽयमेष तपोराशिः सर्वलत्रणपूजितः /
बालो ऽयं बलवान्भातिगांभीर्यात्प्रश्रयेण च //
text_mt: "Who is this mass of ascetic power, graced with all auspicious marks? / This boy appears powerful because of his gravity and modesty."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tayościntayatoḥ saharṣaṃ hṛdi kautukāt /
āsasāda śanai rāmaḥ samīpe vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं तयोश्चिन्तयतोः सहर्षं हृदि कौतुकात् /
आससाद शनै रामः समीपे विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: As the two were thus pondering in their hearts with joy and curiosity, / Rāma, filled with humility, slowly approached their presence.

sanskrit_iast:
svanāmagotre matimānuktvā pitrormudānvitaḥ /
saṃspṛśaṃścaraṇau mūrdhnā hastābhyāṃ cābhyavādayat //
meaning:
स्वनामगोत्रे मतिमानुक्त्वा पित्रोर्मुदान्वितः /
संस्पृशंश्चरणौ मूर्ध्ना हस्ताभ्यां चाभ्यवादयत् //
text_mt: Joyfully declaring his name and the lineage of his parents, the wise youth, / touching their feet with his head and his hands, paid homage to them.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastau prītamanasau samuthāpya ca sattamam /
āśīrbhirabhinandetāṃ pṛthak pṛthagubhāvapi //
meaning:
ततस्तौ प्रीतमनसौ समुथाप्य च सत्तमम् /
आशीर्भिरभिनन्देतां पृथक् पृथगुभावपि //
text_mt: Then, raising up the excellent youth with delighted minds, / both of them welcomed him, each with blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāśliṣyāṅkamāropya harṇāśruplutalocanau /
vīkṣantau tanmukhāṃbhojaṃ paraṃ harṣamavāpatuḥ //
meaning:
तमाश्लिष्याङ्कमारोप्य हर्णाश्रुप्लुतलोचनौ /
वीक्षन्तौ तन्मुखांभोजं परं हर्षमवापतुः //
text_mt: Embracing him and taking him upon their laps, their eyes flooded with tears of joy, / they experienced supreme delight gazing upon his lotus face.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sukhopaviṣṭaṃ tamātmavaṃśasamudvaham /
anāmayamapṛcchetāṃ tāvubhau daṃpatī tadā //
meaning:
ततः सुखोपविष्टं तमात्मवंशसमुद्वहम् /
अनामयमपृच्छेतां तावुभौ दंपती तदा //
text_mt: Then, as that perpetuator of their lineage was comfortably seated, / the couple asked him about his welfare:

sanskrit_iast:
pitarau te kuśalino vatsa kiṃbhrātarastathā /
anāyāsena te vṛttirvartate cātha karhicit //
meaning:
पितरौ ते कुशलिनो वत्स किंभ्रातरस्तथा /
अनायासेन ते वृत्तिर्वर्तते चाथ कर्हिचित् //
text_mt: "Child, are your parents well, and likewise your brothers? / And does your livelihood proceed without hardship at all times?"

sanskrit_iast:
samastābhyāṃ tato rājannācacakṣe yathoditaḥ /
tathā svānugataṃ pitrorbhrātṝṇāṃ caiva ceṣṭitam //
meaning:
समस्ताभ्यां ततो राजन्नाचचक्षे यथोदितः /
तथा स्वानुगतं पित्रोर्भ्रातॄणां चैव चेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Then, O king, as he was questioned, he reported fully to both of them / all the activities of his parents and brothers, and how he obeyed them.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tayormahārāja satprītijanitaiguṇaiḥ /
prīyamāṇo 'vasadrāmaḥ pituḥ pitrornniveśane //
meaning:
एवं तयोर्महाराज सत्प्रीतिजनितैगुणैः /
प्रीयमाणो ऽवसद्रामः पितुः पित्रोर्न्निवेशने //
text_mt: Thus, O great king, cherished by them with qualities born of true affection, / Rāma dwelt in the abode of his father's parents.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasminsarvabhūtānāṃ manonayananandanaḥ /
uvāsa katicinmāsāṃstacchuśrūṣāparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
स तस्मिन्सर्वभूतानां मनोनयननन्दनः /
उवास कतिचिन्मासांस्तच्छुश्रूषापरायणः //
text_mt: Gladdening the minds and eyes of all living beings, / he lived there for a few months, devoted to serving them.

sanskrit_iast:
athānujñāpya tau rājanbhṛguvaryo mahāmanāḥ /
pitāmahagurorgantumiyeṣāśrayamāśramam //
meaning:
अथानुज्ञाप्य तौ राजन्भृगुवर्यो महामनाः /
पितामहगुरोर्गन्तुमियेषाश्रयमाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, having taken leave of the two, O king, that noble-minded best of the Bhṛgus / desired to go to the shelter, the hermitage of his grandfather's elder.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tābhyāṃ prītiyuktābhyāmāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ /
yathā cābhyāṃ pradiṣṭena yayā vaurvāśramaṃ prati //
meaning:
स ताभ्यां प्रीतियुक्ताभ्यामाशीर्भिरभिनन्दितः /
यथा चाभ्यां प्रदिष्टेन यया वौर्वाश्रमं प्रति //
text_mt: Congratulated with blessings by the two who were filled with love, / he set out toward the hermitage of Ūrva along the path indicated by them.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ namaskṛtya vidhivaccyavanaṃ ca mahātapāḥ /
sapraharṣaṃ tadājñātaḥ prayayāvāśramaṃ bhṛgoḥ //
meaning:
तं नमस्कृत्य विधिवच्च्यवनं च महातपाः /
सप्रहर्षं तदाज्ञातः प्रययावाश्रमं भृगोः //
text_mt: Having duly paid homage to him and to Cyavana of great austerities, / permitted by them, he joyfully went forth to the hermitage of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvāmunimukhyasya bhṛgorāśramamaṇḍalam /
dadarśa śāntacetobhirmunibhiḥ sarvato vṛtam //
meaning:
स गत्वामुनिमुख्यस्य भृगोराश्रममण्डलम् /
ददर्श शान्तचेतोभिर्मुनिभिः सर्वतो वृतम् //
text_mt: Arriving at the precinct of the hermitage of Bhṛgu, foremost among sages, / he saw it surrounded on all sides by sages of tranquil mind,

sanskrit_iast:
susnigdhaśītalacchāyaiḥ sarvartukaguṇānvitaiḥ /
tarubhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ prītaḥ phalapuṣpottarānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
सुस्निग्धशीतलच्छायैः सर्वर्तुकगुणान्वितैः /
तरुभिः संवृतं प्रीतः फलपुष्पोत्तरान्वितैः //
text_mt: surrounded by trees with very glossy, cool shade, endowed with the virtues of all seasons, / bearing an abundance of fruit and flowers, delighting [the visitor],

sanskrit_iast:
nānākhagakulārāvairmanaḥśrotrasukhāvahaiḥ /
brahmaghoṣaiśca vividhaiḥ sarvataḥ pratināditam //
meaning:
नानाखगकुलारावैर्मनःश्रोत्रसुखावहैः /
ब्रह्मघोषैश्च विविधैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादितम् //
text_mt: resounding on all sides with the cries of various flocks of birds bringing joy to mind and ear, / and with manifold recitations of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
samantrāhutihomotthadhūmagandhena sarvataḥ /
nirastanikhilāghaughaṃ vanāntaravisarpiṇā //
meaning:
समन्त्राहुतिहोमोत्थधूमगन्धेन सर्वतः /
निरस्तनिखिलाघौघं वनान्तरविसर्पिणा //
text_mt: having the entire multitude of sins dispelled on every side / by the scent of smoke rising from the offering of oblations with mantras, wafting through the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
samitkuśāharairdaṇḍamekhalājinamaṇḍitaiḥ /
abhitaḥ śobhitaṃ rājanramyairmunikumārakaiḥ //
meaning:
समित्कुशाहरैर्दण्डमेखलाजिनमण्डितैः /
अभितः शोभितं राजन्रम्यैर्मुनिकुमारकैः //
text_mt: adorned round about, O king, by charming young ascetic boys / carrying firewood and kuśa grass, adorned with staffs, girdles, and antelope skins,

sanskrit_iast:
prasūnajalasaṃpūrmapātrahastābhirantarā /
śobhitaṃ munikalyābhiścarantībhiritastataḥ //
meaning:
प्रसूनजलसंपूर्मपात्रहस्ताभिरन्तरा /
शोभितं मुनिकल्याभिश्चरन्तीभिरितस्ततः //
text_mt: beautified by the daughters of sages walking here and there, / with vessels filled with flowers and water in their hands,

sanskrit_iast:
sapotahariṇīyūthairvisraṃbhādaviśaṅkibhiḥ /
uṭajāṅgaṇaparyantatarucchāyāsvadhiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
सपोतहरिणीयूथैर्विस्रंभादविशङ्किभिः /
उटजाङ्गणपर्यन्ततरुच्छायास्वधिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: occupied in the shade of trees bordering the cottage courtyards / by herds of does with their fawns, fearless out of trust,

sanskrit_iast:
romanthataḥ parāmṛṣṭiyūtha sākṣikamutpradaiḥ /
prārabdhatāṇḍavaṃ kekīmayūrairmadhurasvaraiḥ //
meaning:
रोमन्थतः परामृष्टियूथ साक्षिकमुत्प्रदैः /
प्रारब्धताण्डवं केकीमयूरैर्मधुरस्वरैः //
text_mt: where dance was begun with sweet cries by peacocks, / observed by herds of beasts peacefully chewing the cud and giving joy,

sanskrit_iast:
pravikīrṇakaṇoddeśaṃ mṛgaśabdaiḥ samīpagaiḥ /
anālīḍhātapacchāyāśuṣyannīvārarāśibhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रविकीर्णकणोद्देशं मृगशब्दैः समीपगैः /
अनालीढातपच्छायाशुष्यन्नीवारराशिभिः //
text_mt: with areas where grains were scattered, nearby sounds of deer, / and heaps of wild nīvāra rice drying in the shaded heat untouched [by pests],

sanskrit_iast:
hūyamānānalaṃ kāle pūjyamānātithivrajam /
abhyasyamānacchandaughaṃ cintyamānagamoditam //
meaning:
हूयमानानलं काले पूज्यमानातिथिव्रजम् /
अभ्यस्यमानच्छन्दौघं चिन्त्यमानगमोदितम् //
text_mt: where fires were fed with oblations at the proper time, crowds of guests were honoured, / the multitude of Vedic metres was recited, and the teachings of the sacred scriptures were contemplated.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhyamānākhilasmārttaṃ śrautārthapravicāraṇam /
prārabdhapitṛdevejyaṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam //
meaning:
पठ्यमानाखिलस्मार्त्तं श्रौतार्थप्रविचारणम् /
प्रारब्धपितृदेवेज्यं सर्वभूतमनोहरम् //
text_mt: where all the Smṛti texts were being recited, and the meaning of the Śruti was investigated, / where offerings to the ancestors and gods had commenced, captivating every creature,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvijanabhūyiṣṭhamākāpuruṣasevitam /
tapovṛddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasattvasukhāspadam //
meaning:
तपस्विजनभूयिष्ठमाकापुरुषसेवितम् /
तपोवृद्धिकरं पुण्यं सर्वसत्त्वसुखास्पदम् //
text_mt: abounding in ascetics, frequented by foremost men, / fostering austerities, holy, the abode of happiness for all living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
tapodhanānandakaraṃ brahmalokamivāparam /
prasūnasaurabhabhrāmyanmadhupārāvanāditam //
meaning:
तपोधनानन्दकरं ब्रह्मलोकमिवापरम् /
प्रसूनसौरभभ्राम्यन्मधुपारावनादितम् //
text_mt: giving joy to those whose wealth is penance, like a second world of Brahmā, / made resonant with the humming of bees hovering around the fragrance of flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato vījyamānena vividhena nabhasvatā /
evaṃvidhaguṇopetaṃ paśyannāśramamuttamam //
meaning:
सर्वतो वीज्यमानेन विविधेन नभस्वता /
एवंविधगुणोपेतं पश्यन्नाश्रममुत्तमम् //
text_mt: fanned on all sides by varied breezes. / Beholding that excellent hermitage endowed with such virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
praviveśa vinītātmā sukṛtīvāmarālayam /
saṃpraviśyaśramopāntaṃ rāmaḥ svaprapitāmaham //
meaning:
प्रविवेश विनीतात्मा सुकृतीवामरालयम् /
संप्रविश्यश्रमोपान्तं रामः स्वप्रपितामहम् //
text_mt: he entered with a humble mind, like a meritorious man entering the abode of the gods. / Having entered the precincts of the hermitage, Rāma [beheld] his great-grandfather;

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa parito rājanmuniśiṣyaśatāvṛtam /
vyākhyānavedikāmadhye niviṣṭaṃ kuśaviṣṭare /
sitaśmaśrujaṭākūrcabrahmasūtropaśobhitam //
meaning:
ददर्श परितो राजन्मुनिशिष्यशतावृतम् /
व्याख्यानवेदिकामध्ये निविष्टं कुशविष्टरे /
सितश्मश्रुजटाकूर्चब्रह्मसूत्रोपशोभितम् //
text_mt: he saw him surrounded on all sides by hundreds of ascetic disciples, O king, / seated in the middle of a discourse platform upon a mat of kuśa grass, / adorned with a white beard, matted hair, a whisk, and the sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast: vāmetarorumadhyāsta vāmajaṅghena jānunā //
meaning: वामेतरोरुमध्यास्त वामजङ्घेन जानुना //
text_mt: with his left knee and shank resting upon the middle of his right thigh,

sanskrit_iast:
yogapaṭṭena saṃvītasvadehamṛṣipuṅgavam /
vyākhyānamudrāvilasatsavyapāṇitalāṃbujam //
meaning:
योगपट्टेन संवीतस्वदेहमृषिपुङ्गवम् /
व्याख्यानमुद्राविलसत्सव्यपाणितलांबुजम् //
text_mt: that bull among sages, his body bound by a meditation band, / the lotus of his right palm radiant in the posture of exposition,

sanskrit_iast:
yogapaṭṭoparinyastavibhrājadvāmapāṇikam /
samyagāraṇyavākyānāṃ sūkṣmatattvārthasaṃhatim //
meaning:
योगपट्टोपरिन्यस्तविभ्राजद्वामपाणिकम् /
सम्यगारण्यवाक्यानां सूक्ष्मतत्त्वार्थसंहतिम् //
text_mt: his left hand resting shining upon the meditation band, / who, fully explaining the aggregate of subtle and true meanings of the forest texts,

sanskrit_iast:
vivṛtya munimukhyebhyaḥ śrāvayantaṃ taponidhim /
pituḥ pitāmahaṃ ddaṣṭvā rāmastasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
विवृत्य मुनिमुख्येभ्यः श्रावयन्तं तपोनिधिम् /
पितुः पितामहं द्दष्ट्वा रामस्तस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: was expounding them to the foremost sages, that treasury of penance. / Seeing the grandfather of his father, that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
śanairivamahārāja samīpaṃ samupāgamat /
tamāgatamupālakṣya tatprabhāvapradharṣitāḥ //
meaning:
शनैरिवमहाराज समीपं समुपागमत् /
तमागतमुपालक्ष्य तत्प्रभावप्रधर्षिताः //
text_mt: Rāma slowly approached near, O great king. / Perceiving him arrived, overwhelmed by his splendour,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkāmavāpurmunayo dūrādevākhilā nṛpa /
tāvadūbhṛgurameyātmā tadāgamanatoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्कामवापुर्मुनयो दूरादेवाखिला नृप /
तावदूभृगुरमेयात्मा तदागमनतोषितः //
text_mt: all the sages felt apprehension from afar, O king. / Meanwhile, the immeasurable Bhṛgu, pleased with his arrival,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttānyakathālāpastaṃ paśyannāsa pārthiva /
rāmo 'pi tamupāgamya vinayāvanatānanaḥ //
meaning:
निवृत्तान्यकथालापस्तं पश्यन्नास पार्थिव /
रामो ऽपि तमुपागम्य विनयावनताननः //
text_mt: ceased all other conversation and sat looking at him, O protector of the earth. / Rāma also approached him, his face bowed in humility,

sanskrit_iast:
avandata yathānyayamupendra iva vedhasam /
abhivādya yathānyāyaṃ khyātiṃ ca vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अवन्दत यथान्ययमुपेन्द्र इव वेधसम् /
अभिवाद्य यथान्यायं ख्यातिं च विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: and bowed down according to custom, like Upendra before the Creator. / Having properly saluted him and Khyāti with humility,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃśca saṃbhāvayāmāsa munīnrāmoyathāvayaḥ /
taiśca sarvairmudopetairāśīrbhirabhivarddhitaḥ //
meaning:
तांश्च संभावयामास मुनीन्रामोयथावयः /
तैश्च सर्वैर्मुदोपेतैराशीर्भिरभिवर्द्धितः //
text_mt: Rāma honoured those sages according to their age. / Augmented with blessings by all of them, who were filled with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
upāviveśa medhāvī bhūmau teṣāmanujñayā /
upaviṣṭaṃ tato rāmamāśīrbhirabhinanditam //
meaning:
उपाविवेश मेधावी भूमौ तेषामनुज्ञया /
उपविष्टं ततो राममाशीर्भिरभिनन्दितम् //
text_mt: the wise one sat down on the ground with their permission. / Seeing Rāma thus seated and greeted with blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
papracchakuśalapraśnaṃ tamālokya bhṛgustadā /
kuśalaṃ khalu te vatsa pitrośca kimanāmayam //
meaning:
पप्रच्छकुशलप्रश्नं तमालोक्य भृगुस्तदा /
कुशलं खलु ते वत्स पित्रोश्च किमनामयम् //
text_mt: Bhṛgu then asked him concerning his welfare: / “Is it well with you, dear child, and is there health for your parents,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva bhavataḥpituḥ pitrostathaiva ca /
kimarthamāgato 'tra tvamadhunāmama sannidhim //
meaning:
भ्रातॄणां चैव भवतःपितुः पित्रोस्तथैव च /
किमर्थमागतो ऽत्र त्वमधुनामम सन्निधिम् //
text_mt: and for your brothers, as well as for your father's parents? / For what purpose have you now come here to my presence?

sanskrit_iast:
kenāpi vā tvamādiṣṭaḥ svayamevāthavāgataḥ /
tatorāmo yathānyāyaṃ tasmai sarvamaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
केनापि वा त्वमादिष्टः स्वयमेवाथवागतः /
ततोरामो यथान्यायं तस्मै सर्वमशेषतः //
text_mt: Were you sent by someone, or have you come of your own accord?” / Then Rāma properly and completely recounted to him

sanskrit_iast:
kathayāmāsa yatpṛṣṭaṃ tadā tena mahātmanā /
piturmātuśca vṛttānta bhrātṝṇāṃ ca mahātmanām //
meaning:
कथयामास यत्पृष्टं तदा तेन महात्मना /
पितुर्मातुश्च वृत्तान्त भ्रातॄणां च महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: all that was asked then by that great soul: / the condition of his father, his mother, and his great-souled brothers,

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ pritroścakauśalya darśanaṃ ca tayornṛpa /
etadanyacca sakalaṃ bhṛgoḥ sapraśrayaṃ mudā //
meaning:
पितुः प्रित्रोश्चकौशल्य दर्शनं च तयोर्नृप /
एतदन्यच्च सकलं भृगोः सप्रश्रयं मुदा //
text_mt: the welfare of his father’s parents, and their seeing him, O king. / All this and everything else he humbly and joyfully reported to Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
nyavedayadyathānyāyamātmanaśca samīhitam /
śrutvaitadakhilaṃ rājanrāmeṇa samudīritam //
meaning:
न्यवेदयद्यथान्यायमात्मनश्च समीहितम् /
श्रुत्वैतदखिलं राजन्रामेण समुदीरितम् //
text_mt: duly making known his own desire. / Having heard all this spoken by Rāma, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā viśeṣeṇa bhṛguḥ prīto 'bhyanandata /
evaṃ tasya priyaṃ kurvannutkṛṣṭairātmakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
तं च दृष्ट्वा विशेषेण भृगुः प्रीतो ऽभ्यनन्दत /
एवं तस्य प्रियं कुर्वन्नुत्कृष्टैरात्मकर्मभिः //
text_mt: and seeing him especially, Bhṛgu was delighted and welcomed him. / Thus pleasing him through his own excellent deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāśrame 'vasadrāmo dināni katicinnṛpa /
tataḥ kadācidekānte rāmaṃ munivarottamaḥ //
meaning:
तत्राश्रमे ऽवसद्रामो दिनानि कतिचिन्नृप /
ततः कदाचिदेकान्ते रामं मुनिवरोत्तमः //
text_mt: Rāma dwelt in that hermitage for some days, O king. / Then once, in a secluded spot, that best of eminent sages

sanskrit_iast:
vatsāgaccheti taṃ rājannupāhvayadupahvare /
so 'bhigamya tamāsīnamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
वत्सागच्छेति तं राजन्नुपाह्वयदुपह्वरे /
सो ऽभिगम्य तमासीनमभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: called him aside, saying: “Come, dear child!” / Approaching him as he sat, Rāma bowed with folded hands

sanskrit_iast:
tasthau tatpurato rāmaḥ suprītenāntarātmanā /
āśīrbhirabhinandyātha bhṛgustaṃ prīta mānasaḥ //
meaning:
तस्थौ तत्पुरतो रामः सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना /
आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्याथ भृगुस्तं प्रीत मानसः //
text_mt: and stood before him with a joyful inner self. / Having greeted him with blessings, Bhṛgu, with a delighted mind,

sanskrit_iast:
prāha nādhigatāśaṅkaṃ rāmamālokya sādaram /
śruṇu vatsa vaco mahya yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam //
meaning:
प्राह नाधिगताशङ्कं राममालोक्य सादरम् /
श्रुणु वत्स वचो मह्य यत्त्वां वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: spoke respectfully to Rāma, whose doubts were removed: / “Listen, dear child, to my word which I shall speak to you now,

sanskrit_iast:
hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tava cāsmākameva ca /
gaccha putra mamādeśāddhimavantaṃ mahāgirim //
meaning:
हितार्थं सर्वलोकानां तव चास्माकमेव च /
गच्छ पुत्र ममादेशाद्धिमवन्तं महागिरिम् //
text_mt: for the benefit of all the worlds, of yourself, and of ourselves. / Go, son, by my command to the great mountain Himavat,

sanskrit_iast:
adhunaivāśramādasmāttapase dhṛtamānasaḥ /
tatragatvā mahābhāga kṛtvāśramāpadaṃ śubham //
meaning:
अधुनैवाश्रमादस्मात्तपसे धृतमानसः /
तत्रगत्वा महाभाग कृत्वाश्रमापदं शुभम् //
text_mt: this very moment from this hermitage, with your mind resolved upon austerity. / Having gone there, O fortunate one, and made an auspicious hermitage,

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhaya mahādevaṃ tapasā niyamena ca /
prītimutpādya tasya tvaṃ bhaktyānanyagayā cirāt //
meaning:
आराधय महादेवं तपसा नियमेन च /
प्रीतिमुत्पाद्य तस्य त्वं भक्त्यानन्यगया चिरात् //
text_mt: worship Mahādeva with austerity and self-restraint. / Producing his pleasure after a long time through undivided devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
śreyo mahadavāpnoṣi nātra kāryā vijāraṇā /
tarasā tava bhaktyā ca prīto bhavati śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
श्रेयो महदवाप्नोषि नात्र कार्या विजारणा /
तरसा तव भक्त्या च प्रीतो भवति शङ्करः //
text_mt: you will attain great welfare; no doubt should be entertained in this matter. / Śaṅkara is swiftly pleased by your power and devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
kariṣyati ca te sarvaṃ manasā yadyadicchasi /
tuṣṭe tasmiñjagannāthe śaṅkare bhaktavatsale //
meaning:
करिष्यति च ते सर्वं मनसा यद्यदिच्छसि /
तुष्टे तस्मिञ्जगन्नाथे शङ्करे भक्तवत्सले //
text_mt: and he will grant you everything, whatever you wish in your mind. / When that lord of the universe, Śaṅkara, affectionate to devotees, is satisfied,

sanskrit_iast:
astragrāmamaśeṣaṃ tvaṃ vaṇu putra yathepsitam /
tvayā hitārthaṃ devānāṃ karaṇīyaṃ suduṣkaram //
meaning:
अस्त्रग्राममशेषं त्वं वणु पुत्र यथेप्सितम् /
त्वया हितार्थं देवानां करणीयं सुदुष्करम् //
text_mt: choose, my son, the entire host of divine weapons as you desire. / For the welfare of the gods, a most difficult task must be performed by you;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyate 'bhyadhikaṃ karma śastrasādhyamanekaśaḥ /
tasmāttvaṃ devadeveśaṃ samārādhaya śaṅkaram //
meaning:
विद्यते ऽभ्यधिकं कर्म शस्त्रसाध्यमनेकशः /
तस्मात्त्वं देवदेवेशं समाराधय शङ्करम् //
text_mt: there is abundant work to be accomplished many times by weapons. / Therefore, propitiate Śaṅkara, the lord of the god of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā paramayā yuktastato 'bhīṣṭamavāpsyasi //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde ekaviṃśati tamaudhyāyaḥ // 21//
meaning:
भक्त्या परमया युक्तस्ततो ऽभीष्टमवाप्स्यसि //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे एकविंशति तमौध्यायः // 21//
text_mt:
endowed with supreme devotion; from that you will obtain what you desire.”

Thus ends the twenty-first chapter in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityevamukto bhṛguṇā tathetyuktvā praṇamya ca /
rāmastenābhyanujñātaścakāra gamane manaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्येवमुक्तो भृगुणा तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रणम्य च /
रामस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातश्चकार गमने मनः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed by Bhṛgu, saying “So be it” and bowing down, / Rāma, permitted by him, set his mind on departure.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguṃ khyātiṃ ca vidhivatparikramya praṇamyaca /
pariṣvaktastathā tābhyāmāśīrbhirābhinanditaḥ //
meaning:
भृगुं ख्यातिं च विधिवत्परिक्रम्य प्रणम्यच /
परिष्वक्तस्तथा ताभ्यामाशीर्भिराभिनन्दितः //
text_mt: Having duly circumambulated and bowed down to Bhṛgu and Khyāti, / embraced by the two and greeted with blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
munīṃśca tānnamaskṛtya taiḥ sarvairanumoditaḥ /
niścakramāśramāttasmāttapase kṛtaniścayaḥ //
meaning:
मुनींश्च तान्नमस्कृत्य तैः सर्वैरनुमोदितः /
निश्चक्रमाश्रमात्तस्मात्तपसे कृतनिश्चयः //
text_mt: and having bowed to those sages and received the approval of them all, / he departed from that hermitage, resolved upon austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
tato guruniyogena taduktenaiva vartmanā /
himavantaṃ girivaraṃ yayau rāmo mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
ततो गुरुनियोगेन तदुक्तेनैव वर्त्मना /
हिमवन्तं गिरिवरं ययौ रामो महामनाः //
text_mt: Then, by the master’s direction, along the very path indicated by him, / the high-minded Rāma went to Himavat, the foremost of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'tītya vividhāndeśānparvatānsaritastathā /
vanāni munimukhyānāmāvāsāṃścātyagācchanaiḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽतीत्य विविधान्देशान्पर्वतान्सरितस्तथा /
वनानि मुनिमुख्यानामावासांश्चात्यगाच्छनैः //
text_mt: Passing through various lands, mountains, and rivers, / forests, and the dwellings of foremost sages, he proceeded slowly.

sanskrit_iast:
tatratatra nivāseṣu munīnāṃ nivasanpathi /
tīrtheṣu kṣetramukhyeṣu nivasanvā yayau śanaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्रतत्र निवासेषु मुनीनां निवसन्पथि /
तीर्थेषु क्षेत्रमुख्येषु निवसन्वा ययौ शनैः //
text_mt: Dwelling here and there along the way in the residences of the sages, / and staying at holy bathing places and prominent sacred fields, he went slowly.

sanskrit_iast:
atītya subahūndeśānpaśyannapi manoramān /
āsasādaca laśreṣṭhaṃ himavantamanuttamam //
meaning:
अतीत्य सुबहून्देशान्पश्यन्नपि मनोरमान् /
आससादच लश्रेष्ठं हिमवन्तमनुत्तमम् //
