text_mt: Traversing very many lands and beholding delightful places, / he reached Himavat, the supreme, the foremost of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā parvatavaraṃ nānādrumalatāsthitam /
dadarśa vipulaiḥ śṛṅgairullikhantamivāṃbaram //
meaning:
स गत्वा पर्वतवरं नानाद्रुमलतास्थितम् /
ददर्श विपुलैः शृङ्गैरुल्लिखन्तमिवांबरम् //
text_mt: Having reached that best of mountains, covered with various trees and creepers, / he saw it as if scratching the sky with its vast peaks,

sanskrit_iast:
nānādhātuvicitraiśca pradeśairupaśobhitam /
ratnauṣadhībhirabhitaḥ sphuradbhirabhiśobhitam //
meaning:
नानाधातुविचित्रैश्च प्रदेशैरुपशोभितम् /
रत्नौषधीभिरभितः स्फुरद्भिरभिशोभितम् //
text_mt: adorned with regions variegated by diverse minerals, / beautified all around by radiant gems and medicinal plants,

sanskrit_iast:
marutsaṃghaṭṭanāghṛṣṭanīrasāṃghripajanmanā /
sānilenānalenocchairdahyamānaṃ navaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
मरुत्संघट्टनाघृष्टनीरसांघ्रिपजन्मना /
सानिलेनानलेनोच्छैर्दह्यमानं नवं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places burning anew with high wind-swept fire / born from dry trees rubbed together by the impact of the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidravikarāmarśajvaladarkepalāgnibhiḥ /
dravaddhimāśilājātujalaśāntadavānalam //
meaning:
क्वचिद्रविकरामर्शज्वलदर्केपलाग्निभिः /
द्रवद्धिमाशिलाजातुजलशान्तदवानलम् //
text_mt: in some places with forest fires extinguished by water produced from melting snow-rocks / due to fires of sun-stones blazing when touched by the sun's rays,

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikāñjanadurvarṇasvarṇarāśiprabhākaraiḥ /
sphuratparasparacchāyāśarairddīptavanaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
स्फटिकाञ्जनदुर्वर्णस्वर्णराशिप्रभाकरैः /
स्फुरत्परस्परच्छायाशरैर्द्दीप्तवनं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places its forest lit up with rays of radiance from masses of crystal, antimony, silver, and gold / casting flashing reflections upon one another,

sanskrit_iast:
upatyakaśilāpṛṣṭhavālātapaniṣevibhiḥ /
tuṣāraklinnasiddhaughaurudbhāsitavanaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
उपत्यकशिलापृष्ठवालातपनिषेविभिः /
तुषारक्लिन्नसिद्धौघौरुद्भासितवनं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places its forest illuminated by hosts of Siddhas wet with snow / who resorted to the morning sun on the rock-surfaces of the foothills,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacidarkāśusaṃbhinnaścāmīkaraśilāśritaiḥ /
yakṣaughairbhāsitopāntaṃ viśadbhirivapāvakam //
meaning:
क्वचिदर्काशुसंभिन्नश्चामीकरशिलाश्रितैः /
यक्षौघैर्भासितोपान्तं विशद्भिरिवपावकम् //
text_mt: in some places its borders illuminated by hosts of Yakṣas / resting on gold rocks intersected by sunbeams, appearing as if entering fire.

sanskrit_iast:
darīmukhaviniṣkrāntatarakṣūtpatanākulaiḥ /
mṛgayūthārttasannādairāpūritaguhaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
दरीमुखविनिष्क्रान्ततरक्षूत्पतनाकुलैः /
मृगयूथार्त्तसन्नादैरापूरितगुहं क्वचित् //
text_mt: In some places the caves were filled with the anguished cries of herds of deer, / agitated by the leaping out of hyenas emerging from cavern mouths;

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhyadvarāhaśārdūlayūthapairita steram /
prasabhonmṛṣṭakāntoruśilātarutaṭaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
युद्ध्यद्वराहशार्दूलयूथपैरित स्तेरम् /
प्रसभोन्मृष्टकान्तोरुशिलातरुतटं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the slopes of trees and beautiful large rocks were violently struck / by the troop-leaders of boars and tigers fighting here and there;

sanskrit_iast:
kalabhonmeṣaṇākṛṣṭakariṇībhiranudrutaiḥ /
gavayaiḥ khurasaṃkṣuṇṇaśilāprasthataṭaṅkvacit //
meaning:
कलभोन्मेषणाकृष्टकरिणीभिरनुद्रुतैः /
गवयैः खुरसंक्षुण्णशिलाप्रस्थतटङ्क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the slopes of the rocky plateaus were trampled by the hooves of wild oxen, / pursued by female elephants alarmed at the sight of their calves;

sanskrit_iast:
vāsitarthe 'bhisaṃvṛddhamadonmattamataṅgajaiḥ /
yuddhyadbhiścūrṇitānekagaṇḍaśailavanaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
वासितर्थे ऽभिसंवृद्धमदोन्मत्तमतङ्गजैः /
युद्ध्यद्भिश्चूर्णितानेकगण्डशैलवनं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the groves of large boulders were crushed by fighting bull-elephants / maddened by surging rut for the sake of females;

sanskrit_iast:
bṛṃhitaśravaṇāmarṣānmātaṃ gānabhidhāvatām /
siṃhānāṃ caraṇakṣuṇṇanakhabhinnoparaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
बृंहितश्रवणामर्षान्मातं गानभिधावताम् /
सिंहानां चरणक्षुण्णनखभिन्नोपरं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the rocks were shattered by the claws and trampled by the paws of lions / charging at elephants in fury upon hearing their trumpeting;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasā nipatatsiṃhanakhanirbhinnamastakaiḥ /
gajairākrandanādena pūryamāmaṃ vanaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
सहसा निपतत्सिंहनखनिर्भिन्नमस्तकैः /
गजैराक्रन्दनादेन पूर्यमामं वनं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the forest was filled with the wailing roars / of elephants whose heads were torn open by the claws of suddenly pouncing lions;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭapādabalākṛṣṭakesarā dāruṇākhaiḥ /
bhedyamānākhilaśilāgaṃbhīrakuharaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
अष्टपादबलाकृष्टकेसरा दारुणाखैः /
भेद्यमानाखिलशिलागंभीरकुहरं क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the deep recesses of all the rocks were split open by the fierce claws / of the eight-legged śarabhas forcefully tearing at lions;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrabdhā nekaśabaraprasaktairṛyūthapaiḥ /
itaretarasaṃmardaṃ viprabhagnadṛṣatkvacit //
meaning:
संरब्धा नेकशबरप्रसक्तैरृयूथपैः /
इतरेतरसंमर्दं विप्रभग्नदृषत्क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places the stones were smashed in the mutual clash / of troop-leaders of bears confronted by numerous enraged hunters;

sanskrit_iast:
girikuñjeṣu saṃkrīḍatkariṇīmadvipaṃ kvacit /
kareṇumādravanmattagajākalitakānanam //
meaning:
गिरिकुञ्जेषु संक्रीडत्करिणीमद्विपं क्वचित् /
करेणुमाद्रवन्मत्तगजाकलितकाननम् //
text_mt: in some places the forest was occupied by bull-elephants sporting with cow-elephants in mountain bowers, / and by rutting elephants charging after female elephants;

sanskrit_iast:
svapatsiṃhamukhaśvāsamarutpurmadarīśatam /
gahaneṣu gurutrāsasāśaṅkaviharanmṛgam //
meaning:
स्वपत्सिंहमुखश्वासमरुत्पुर्मदरीशतम् /
गहनेषु गुरुत्राससाशङ्कविहरन्मृगम् //
text_mt: hundreds of its caves were filled with the breath-winds of sleeping lions' mouths, / and deer roamed anxiously in the thickets out of great dread;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭākaśliṣṭalāṅgūlalomatruṭanakātaraiḥ /
krīḍitaṃ camarīyūthairmandamandavicāribhiḥ //
meaning:
कण्टाकश्लिष्टलाङ्गूललोमत्रुटनकातरैः /
क्रीडितं चमरीयूथैर्मन्दमन्दविचारिभिः //
text_mt: it was frequented by herds of yaks wandering very slowly, / fearful of their tail-hairs breaking when entangled in thorns;

sanskrit_iast:
girikandarasaṃsaktakinnarīsamudīritaiḥ /
satālanādairudinairbhṛtāśeṣadiśāmukham //
meaning:
गिरिकन्दरसंसक्तकिन्नरीसमुदीरितैः /
सतालनादैरुदिनैर्भृताशेषदिशामुखम् //
text_mt: the quarters of the sky were completely filled with soaring, rhythmic melodies / uttered by Kinnara women dwelling in the mountain caves;

sanskrit_iast:
araṇyadevatānāṃ ca caretīnāmitastataḥ /
alaktakarasaklinnacaraṇāṅkitabhūtalam //
meaning:
अरण्यदेवतानां च चरेतीनामितस्ततः /
अलक्तकरसक्लिन्नचरणाङ्कितभूतलम् //
text_mt: the ground was imprinted with the feet wet with red lac-juice / of forest deities wandering here and there;

sanskrit_iast:
mayūrakekirīvṛndaiḥ saṃgīta madhurasvaraiḥ /
pravṛttanṛttaṃ parito vitatodagrabarhibhiḥ //
meaning:
मयूरकेकिरीवृन्दैः संगीत मधुरस्वरैः /
प्रवृत्तनृत्तं परितो विततोदग्रबर्हिभिः //
text_mt: dances were begun all around by flocks of peacocks with outstretched upright tails, / accompanied by the sweet-voiced singing of peacocks;

sanskrit_iast:
jalasthalaruhānekakusumotkaravarṣibhiḥ /
gātrāhlādakarairmandaṃ vījyamānaṃ vanānilaiḥ //
meaning:
जलस्थलरुहानेककुसुमोत्करवर्षिभिः /
गात्राह्लादकरैर्मन्दं वीज्यमानं वनानिलैः //
text_mt: it was gently fanned by forest breezes that brought delight to the body, / showering cascades of numerous water-grown and land-grown flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtārttavarasāsvādamādyatpuṃskokilāravaiḥ /
ākulīkṛtaparyantasahakāravanāntaram //
meaning:
भूतार्त्तवरसास्वादमाद्यत्पुंस्कोकिलारवैः /
आकुलीकृतपर्यन्तसहकारवनान्तरम् //
text_mt: the margins of the mango groves were thrown into excitement / by the calls of male cuckoos intoxicated by tasting the sweet juice of the spring season;

sanskrit_iast:
nānāpuṣpāsavonmādyadbhṛṅgasaṃgītanāditam /
anekavihagārāvabadhirīkṛtakānanam //
meaning:
नानापुष्पासवोन्माद्यद्भृङ्गसंगीतनादितम् /
अनेकविहगारावबधिरीकृतकाननम् //
text_mt: it was made to resound with the singing of bees intoxicated by the nectar of various flowers, / and the forest was deafened by the calls of countless birds;

sanskrit_iast:
madhudravārdrāviralapratyagrakusumotkaraiḥ /
vanāntamārutākīrṇairalaṅkṛtamahītalam //
meaning:
मधुद्रवार्द्राविरलप्रत्यग्रकुसुमोत्करैः /
वनान्तमारुताकीर्णैरलङ्कृतमहीतलम् //
text_mt: the surface of the earth was adorned with continuous fresh showers of flowers / moist with streams of honey and scattered by the forest winds;

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭānnipatatāṃ viṣamopalasaṃkaṭe /
nirjharāṇāṃ mahārāvaiḥ samantādbadhirīkṛtam //
meaning:
उपरिष्टान्निपततां विषमोपलसंकटे /
निर्झराणां महारावैः समन्ताद्बधिरीकृतम् //

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:
वशी चकार चाक्षाणि प्रत्याहारपरायणः /
धारणाभिः स्थिरीचक्रे मनश्चञ्चलमात्मवान् //
text_mt: subdued the senses, intent upon withdrawal; / with concentrations the self-possessed ascetic steadied the flickering mind.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānena devadeveśaṃ dadarśa parameśvaram /
svasthāntaḥ karaṇo maitraḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यानेन देवदेवेशं ददर्श परमेश्वरम् /
स्वस्थान्तः करणो मैत्रः सर्वबाधाविवर्जितः //
text_mt: Through meditation he beheld the supreme Lord, the god of gods, / his inner organ tranquil, benevolent, free from all impediments.

sanskrit_iast:
cintayāmāsa deveśaṃ dhyāne dṛṣṭvā jagadgurum /
dhyeyāvasthi tacittātmā niścaledriyadehavān //
meaning:
चिन्तयामास देवेशं ध्याने दृष्ट्वा जगद्गुरुम् /
ध्येयावस्थि तचित्तात्मा निश्चलेद्रियदेहवान् //
text_mt: Having seen the teacher of the world in meditation, he contemplated the lord of the gods, / his mind and self fixed upon the object of meditation, with motionless senses and body.

sanskrit_iast:
ākālāvadhi so 'tiṣṭhannivātasthapradīpavat /
japaṃśca devadeveśaṃ dhyāyaṃśca svamanīṣayā //
meaning:
आकालावधि सो ऽतिष्ठन्निवातस्थप्रदीपवत् /
जपंश्च देवदेवेशं ध्यायंश्च स्वमनीषया //
text_mt: Until the appointed time he stood like a lamp in a windless place, / chanting the name of the god of gods and meditating through his own intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhayadameyātmā sarvabhāvasthamīśvaram /
tataḥ sa niṣphalaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ yannirañjanam //
meaning:
आराधयदमेयात्मा सर्वभावस्थमीश्वरम् /
ततः स निष्फलं रूपमैश्वरं यन्निरञ्जनम् //
text_mt: The immeasurable-souled one propitiated the Lord dwelling in all states of being. / Then, upon that partless divine form which is immaculate,

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ jyotiracintyaṃ yadyogidhyeyamanutta mam /
nityaṃ śuddhaṃ sadā śāntamatīndriyamanaupamam /
ānandamātramacalaṃ vyāptāśeṣacarācaram //
meaning:
परं ज्योतिरचिन्त्यं यद्योगिध्येयमनुत्त मम् /
नित्यं शुद्धं सदा शान्तमतीन्द्रियमनौपमम् /
आनन्दमात्रमचलं व्याप्ताशेषचराचरम् //
text_mt: the supreme, unthinkable light, unexcelled, to be meditated on by yogins, / eternal, pure, ever tranquil, beyond the senses, peerless, / consisting solely of bliss, immovable, pervading all that moves and is still—

sanskrit_iast:
cintayāmāsa tadrūpaṃ devadevasya bhārgavaḥ /
nityaṃ śuddhaṃ sadā śāntamatīndriyamanaupamam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde vasiṣṭhasagarasaṃvāde arcunopākhyāne jāmadagnyatapaścaraṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 22//
meaning:
चिन्तयामास तद्रूपं देवदेवस्य भार्गवः /
नित्यं शुद्धं सदा शान्तमतीन्द्रियमनौपमम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे वसिष्ठसगरसंवादे अर्चुनोपाख्याने जामदग्न्यतपश्चरणं नाम द्वाविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 22//
text_mt:
the Bhārgava contemplated that form of the god of gods: / eternal, pure, ever tranquil, beyond the senses, peerless.

Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled "The Performance of Austerity by the Son of Jamadagni," in the story of Arjuna, in the dialogue between Vasiṣṭha and Sagara, in the Upoddhātapāda, the third, middle section in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Vāyu. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tapasvinaṃ tadā rāmamekāgramanasaṃ bhave /
rahasyekāntanirataṃ niyataṃ śaṃsitavratam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तपस्विनं तदा राममेकाग्रमनसं भवे /
रहस्येकान्तनिरतं नियतं शंसितव्रतम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing then that the ascetic Rāma was single-minded toward Bhava, / intent on secret solitude, self-restrained, his vows commended,

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tamṛṣayaḥ sarve taponirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ /
jñānakarmavayovṛddhā mahāntaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तमृषयः सर्वे तपोनिर्धूतकल्मषाः /
ज्ञानकर्मवयोवृद्धा महान्तः शंसितव्रताः //
text_mt: all the ṛṣis, whose impurities had been shaken off through austerity, / mature in knowledge, action, and age, great men of commended vows,

sanskrit_iast:
didṛkṣavaḥ samājagmuḥ kutūhalasamanvitāḥ /
khyāpayantastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tasya rājanmahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
दिदृक्षवः समाजग्मुः कुतूहलसमन्विताः /
ख्यापयन्तस्तपः श्रेष्ठं तस्य राजन्महात्मनः //
text_mt: came together desirous of seeing him, filled with curiosity, / proclaiming the excellent austerity of that great-souled one, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvatrikratujābālivāmadevamṛkaṇḍavaḥ /
saṃbhāvayantaste rāmaṃ munayo vṛddhasaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
भृग्वत्रिक्रतुजाबालिवामदेवमृकण्डवः /
संभावयन्तस्ते रामं मुनयो वृद्धसंमताः //
text_mt: Bhṛgu, Atri, Kratu, Jābāli, Vāmadeva, and Mṛkaṇḍu, / sages esteemed by the elders, honoring Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
ājagmurāśramaṃ tasya rāmasya tapasastapaḥ /
dūrādeva mahāntaste puṇyakṣetranivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
आजग्मुराश्रमं तस्य रामस्य तपसस्तपः /
दूरादेव महान्तस्ते पुण्यक्षेत्रनिवासिनः //
text_mt: came from afar to the hermitage of that Rāma, whose asceticism was penance itself, / those great men residing in holy sites.

sanskrit_iast:
garīyaḥ sarvalokeṣu tapo 'gryaṃ jñānameva ca /
praśasya tasya te sarveprayayuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam //
meaning:
गरीयः सर्वलोकेषु तपो ऽग्र्यं ज्ञानमेव च /
प्रशस्य तस्य ते सर्वेप्रययुः स्वं स्वमाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Having praised his austerity, the weightiest in all the worlds, foremost, and his knowledge, / they all departed each to his own hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravarttatastasya rāmasya bhagavāñchivaḥ /
prasannacetā nitarāṃ babhūva nṛpasattama //
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्त्ततस्तस्य रामस्य भगवाञ्छिवः /
प्रसन्नचेता नितरां बभूव नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: As that Rāma was proceeding thus, the blessed Śiva / became exceedingly pleased in mind, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
jijñāsustasya bhagavān bhaktimātmani śaṅkaraḥ /
mṛgavyādhavapurbhūtvā yayau rājaṃstadantikam //
meaning:
जिज्ञासुस्तस्य भगवान् भक्तिमात्मनि शङ्करः /
मृगव्याधवपुर्भूत्वा ययौ राजंस्तदन्तिकम् //
text_mt: Wishing to test his devotion to himself, the blessed Śaṅkara, / having assumed the form of a deer-hunter, went to his presence, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnāñjanacayaprakhyo raktāntāyatalocanaḥ /
śaracāpadharaḥ prāṃśurvajrasaṃhanano yuvā //
meaning:
भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रख्यो रक्तान्तायतलोचनः /
शरचापधरः प्रांशुर्वज्रसंहननो युवा //
text_mt: Resembling a heap of crushed collyrium, with long eyes reddish at the corners, / bearing bow and arrows, tall, a youth with limbs firm as a thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
uttuṅgahanubāhvaṃsaḥ piṅgalaśmaśrumūrddhajaḥ /
māṃsavisravasāgandhī sarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तुङ्गहनुबाह्वंसः पिङ्गलश्मश्रुमूर्द्धजः /
मांसविस्रवसागन्धी सर्वप्राणिविहिंसकः //
text_mt: with prominent jaw, arms, and shoulders, with tawny beard and hair, / smelling of raw meat, blood, and fat, a slayer of all living beings,

sanskrit_iast:
sakaṇṭakulatāsparśakṣatārūṣitavigrahaḥ /
sāmaṭaksaṃcarvamāṇaśca māṃsakhaṇḍamanekaśaḥ //
meaning:
सकण्टकुलतास्पर्शक्षतारूषितविग्रहः /
सामटक्संचर्वमाणश्च मांसखण्डमनेकशः //
text_mt: his body covered with scratches from contact with thorny creepers, / chewing on raw and dry pieces of flesh again and again,

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsabhāradvayālaṃbividhānānatakandharaḥ /
ārujaṃstarasā vṛkṣānūruvegena saṃghaśaḥ //
meaning:
मांसभारद्वयालंबिविधानानतकन्धरः /
आरुजंस्तरसा वृक्षानूरुवेगेन संघशः //
text_mt: his neck bent under the arrangement of carrying two loads of meat suspended [from a pole], / breaking down trees violently in masses with the force of his thighs,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyavarttata taṃ deśaṃ pādacārīva parvataḥ /
āsādya sarasastasya tīraṃ kusumitadrumam //
meaning:
अभ्यवर्त्तत तं देशं पादचारीव पर्वतः /
आसाद्य सरसस्तस्य तीरं कुसुमितद्रुमम् //
text_mt: he strode toward that region like a walking mountain. / Having reached the bank of that lake, filled with flowering trees,

sanskrit_iast:
nyadadhānmāsabhāraṃ ca sa mūle kasyacittaroḥ /
niṣasāda kṣaṇantatra tarucchāyāmupāśritaḥ //
meaning:
न्यदधान्मासभारं च स मूले कस्यचित्तरोः /
निषसाद क्षणन्तत्र तरुच्छायामुपाश्रितः //
text_mt: he placed the burden of meat down at the foot of a certain tree, / and sat down there for a moment, taking shelter in the shade of the tree.

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhantaṃ sarasastīre so 'paśyadbhṛgunandanam /
tataḥ sa śīghramutthāya samīpamupasṛtya ca //
meaning:
तिष्ठन्तं सरसस्तीरे सो ऽपश्यद्भृगुनन्दनम् /
ततः स शीघ्रमुत्थाय समीपमुपसृत्य च //
text_mt: He saw the descendant of Bhṛgu standing on the bank of the lake. / Then, rising quickly and approaching near,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāya seṣucāpābhyāṃ karābhyāṃ vidadheṃ'jalim /
sajalāṃbhodasannādagaṃbhīreṇa svareṇa ca //
meaning:
रामाय सेषुचापाभ्यां कराभ्यां विदधेंऽजलिम् /
सजलांभोदसन्नादगंभीरेण स्वरेण च //
text_mt: he made an añjali to Rāma with his hands holding bow and arrows; / and with a voice deep as the rumble of a rain-filled cloud,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāda bhṛguśārdūlaṃ guhāntaravisarpiṇā /
toṣapravarṣavyādho 'haṃ vasāmyasminmahāvane //
meaning:
जगाद भृगुशार्दूलं गुहान्तरविसर्पिणा /
तोषप्रवर्षव्याधो ऽहं वसाम्यस्मिन्महावने //
text_mt: spreading like sound within a cave, he spoke to the tiger of the Bhṛgus: / "I am the hunter Toṣapravarṣa, dwelling in this great forest.

sanskrit_iast:
īśo 'hamasya deśasya saprāṇitaruvīrudhaḥ /
carāmi samacittātmā nānāsattvā miṣāśanaḥ //
meaning:
ईशो ऽहमस्य देशस्य सप्राणितरुवीरुधः /
चरामि समचित्तात्मा नानासत्त्वा मिषाशनः //
text_mt: I am the lord of this land, along with its creatures, trees, and shrubs; / I wander with an equanimous mind, eating the flesh of various beings.

sanskrit_iast:
samaśca sarvabhūteṣu na ca pitrādayo 'pi me /
abhakṣyāgamyapeyādicchandavastuṣu kutracit //
meaning:
समश्च सर्वभूतेषु न च पित्रादयो ऽपि मे /
अभक्ष्यागम्यपेयादिच्छन्दवस्तुषु कुत्रचित् //
text_mt: I am impartial toward all beings, nor do I have parents or others. / In whatever desired things—inedible, inaccessible, undrinkable, and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtyākṛtyavidhaucaiva na viśeṣitadhīraham /
prapanno nābhigamanaṃ nivāsamapi kasyacit //
meaning:
कृत्याकृत्यविधौचैव न विशेषितधीरहम् /
प्रपन्नो नाभिगमनं निवासमपि कस्यचित् //
text_mt: and in rules of what should and should not be done, I have no discriminating mind. / I do not permit anyone's approach or residence,

sanskrit_iast:
śakrasyāpi balenāhamanumanye na saṃśayaḥ /
jānate tadhyathā sarve deśo 'yaṃ madupāśrayaḥ //
meaning:
शक्रस्यापि बलेनाहमनुमन्ये न संशयः /
जानते तध्यथा सर्वे देशो ऽयं मदुपाश्रयः //
text_mt: not even of Śakra by force, of this there is no doubt. / For all know that this region is my resort.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna kaścidāyāti mamātrānumatiṃ vinā /
ityeṣa mama vṛttāntaḥ kārtsnyena kathitastava //
meaning:
तस्मान्न कश्चिदायाति ममात्रानुमतिं विना /
इत्येष मम वृत्तान्तः कार्त्स्न्येन कथितस्तव //
text_mt: Therefore no one comes here without my permission. / Thus has my account been told to you in full.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ ca me brūhi tattvena nijavṛttamaśeṣataḥ /
kastvaṃ kasmādihāyātaḥ kimarthamiha dhiṣṭhitaḥ /
udyato 'nyatra vā gantuṃ kiṃ vā tava cikīrṣitam //
meaning:
त्वं च मे ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन निजवृत्तमशेषतः /
कस्त्वं कस्मादिहायातः किमर्थमिह धिष्ठितः /
उद्यतो ऽन्यत्र वा गन्तुं किं वा तव चिकीर्षितम् //
text_mt: Tell me truly your own story completely: / Who are you? Whence have you come here? For what purpose are you stationed here? / Or are you preparing to go elsewhere, or what is it that you wish to do?"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityevamuktaḥ prahasaṃstena rāmo mahādyutiḥ /
tūṣṇīṃ kṣaṇamiva sthitvā dadhyau kiñcidavāṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्येवमुक्तः प्रहसंस्तेन रामो महाद्युतिः /
तूष्णीं क्षणमिव स्थित्वा दध्यौ किञ्चिदवाङ्मुखः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed by him, smiling, Rāma of great splendor / stood as if silent for a moment, and contemplated with his face turned slightly downward:

sanskrit_iast:
ko 'yameva durādharṣaḥ sajalāṃbhodanisvanaḥ /
bravīti ca giro 'tyarthaṃ vispaṣṭārthapadākṣarāḥ //
meaning:
को ऽयमेव दुराधर्षः सजलांभोदनिस्वनः /
ब्रवीति च गिरो ऽत्यर्थं विस्पष्टार्थपदाक्षराः //
text_mt: "Who is this unconquerable one, with the voice of a water-laden cloud, / who speaks words with such exceedingly clear meaning, terms, and syllables?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu me mahatīṃ śaṅkāṃ tanurasya tanoti vai /
vijātisaṃśrayatvena ramaṇīyā tathā śarāḥ //
meaning:
किं तु मे महतीं शङ्कां तनुरस्य तनोति वै /
विजातिसंश्रयत्वेन रमणीया तथा शराः //
text_mt: Yet his form raises great suspicion in me: / though belonging to a low caste, it is handsome, and so are his arrows."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ cintayatastasya nimittāni śubhāni vai /
babhūvurbhuvi dehe ca svābhipretārthadānyalam //
meaning:
एवं चिन्तयतस्तस्य निमित्तानि शुभानि वै /
बभूवुर्भुवि देहे च स्वाभिप्रेतार्थदान्यलम् //
text_mt: As he was thinking thus, auspicious omens / occurred on the earth and on his body, fully granting the desired object.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vimṛśya bahuśo manasābhṛgupuṅgavaḥ /
uvāca śanakairvyādhaṃ vacanaṃ sūnṛtākṣaram //
meaning:
ततो विमृश्य बहुशो मनसाभृगुपुङ्गवः /
उवाच शनकैर्व्याधं वचनं सूनृताक्षरम् //
text_mt: Then, having reflected much in his mind, the bull of the Bhṛgus / spoke slowly to the hunter words of pleasing and true syllables:

sanskrit_iast:
jāmadagnyo 'smi bhadraṃ te rāmo nāmnā tu bhārgavaḥ /
tapaścartumihāyātaḥ sāṃprataṃ guruśāsanāt //
meaning:
जामदग्न्यो ऽस्मि भद्रं ते रामो नाम्ना तु भार्गवः /
तपश्चर्तुमिहायातः सांप्रतं गुरुशासनात् //
text_mt: "I am the son of Jamadagni, hail to you, Rāma by name, a Bhārgava; / I have come here now to perform austerity by command of my guru.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā sarvalokeśaṃ bhaktyā ca niyamena ca /
ārādhayitumasmiṃstu cirāyāhaṃ samudyataḥ //
meaning:
तपसा सर्वलोकेशं भक्त्या च नियमेन च /
आराधयितुमस्मिंस्तु चिरायाहं समुद्यतः //
text_mt: Through austerity, devotion, and restraint, to propitiate / the lord of all worlds, I have undertaken [penance] here for a long time."

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātmarveśvaraṃ sarvaśaraṇyamabhayapradam /
trinetraṃ pāpadamanaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam //
meaning:
तस्मात्मर्वेश्वरं सर्वशरण्यमभयप्रदम् /
त्रिनेत्रं पापदमनं शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् //
text_mt: Therefore, the Lord of all, refuge of all, bestower of fearlessness, / the three-eyed Śaṅkara, who suppresses sin and is affectionate to his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā toṣayiṣyāmi sarvajñaṃ tripurāntakam /
āśrame 'sminasarastīre niyamaṃ samupāśritaḥ //
meaning:
तपसा तोषयिष्यामि सर्वज्ञं त्रिपुरान्तकम् /
आश्रमे ऽस्मिनसरस्तीरे नियमं समुपाश्रितः //
text_mt: I shall satisfy by austerity, the omniscient destroyer of Tripura, / abiding by restraint in this hermitage on the shore of the lake.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavānyāvatpratyakṣatāṃ haraḥ /
upaiti tāvadatraiva sthāsyāmīti matirmama //
meaning:
भक्तानुकंपी भगवान्यावत्प्रत्यक्षतां हरः /
उपैति तावदत्रैव स्थास्यामीति मतिर्मम //
text_mt: Until the blessed Hara, compassionate to devotees, / becomes visible, so long shall I remain right here: this is my resolve.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāditastvayādyaiva gantumanyatra yujyate /
na cedbhavati me hāniḥ svakṛterniyamasya ca //
meaning:
तस्मादितस्त्वयाद्यैव गन्तुमन्यत्र युज्यते /
न चेद्भवति मे हानिः स्वकृतेर्नियमस्य च //
text_mt: Therefore, it is proper for you to depart elsewhere from here this very day; / if not, harm will come to my own vow and duty.

sanskrit_iast:
mānanīyo 'tha vāhaṃ te bhaktyā deśāntarātithiḥ /
svanivāsamupāyātastapasvī ca tathā muniḥ //
meaning:
माननीयो ऽथ वाहं ते भक्त्या देशान्तरातिथिः /
स्वनिवासमुपायातस्तपस्वी च तथा मुनिः //
text_mt: Or rather, I should be honoured by you with devotion as a guest from another land, / an ascetic and an ascetic sage who has arrived at his own dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatasaṃnidhau nivāso me bhavetpāpāya kevalam /
tava cāpyasukhodarkaṃ matsamīpaniṣevaṇam //
meaning:
त्वतसंनिधौ निवासो मे भवेत्पापाय केवलम् /
तव चाप्यसुखोदर्कं मत्समीपनिषेवणम् //
text_mt: Living in your presence would lead solely to sin for me, / and resorting near me will result in misfortune for you as well.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃmadāśramopānte paricaṅkramaṇādikam /
parityajya sukhībhūyā lokayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
स त्वंमदाश्रमोपान्ते परिचङ्क्रमणादिकम् /
परित्यज्य सुखीभूया लोकयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt: So you, having abandoned wandering about and the like near my hermitage, / become happy in both worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhūyo bhṛgupuṅgavam /
uvāca roṣatāmrākṣastāmrākṣamidamuttaram //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स भूयो भृगुपुङ्गवम् /
उवाच रोषताम्राक्षस्ताम्राक्षमिदमुत्तरम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard his words, he whose eyes were copper-red with anger / spoke this reply once more to that bull of the Bhṛgus whose eyes were red:

sanskrit_iast:
brahman kimidamatyarthaṃ samīpe vasatiṃ mama /
parigarhayase yena kṛtaghnasyeva kāṃpratam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मन् किमिदमत्यर्थं समीपे वसतिं मम /
परिगर्हयसे येन कृतघ्नस्येव कांप्रतम् //
text_mt: "O brāhmaṇa, why do you so excessively censure my living nearby, / as if it were [the act] of an ungrateful person now?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ mayāpakṛtaṃ loke bhavato 'nyasya vā kvacit /
anāgaskāriṇaṃ dāntaṃ ko 'vamanyeta nāmataḥ //
meaning:
किं मयापकृतं लोके भवतो ऽन्यस्य वा क्वचित् /
अनागस्कारिणं दान्तं को ऽवमन्येत नामतः //
text_mt: What harm have I done in the world to you or to anyone else anywhere? / Who, pray, would despise a self-controlled person who commits no offense?

sanskrit_iast:
sannidhiḥ pariharttavyo yadi me viprapuṅgava /
darśanaṃ saha saṃvāsaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇamathāpi ca //
meaning:
सन्निधिः परिहर्त्तव्यो यदि मे विप्रपुङ्गव /
दर्शनं सह संवासः संभाषणमथापि च //
text_mt: If my presence is to be avoided, O best of brāhmaṇas, / along with seeing [me], living together, and speaking [with me],

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣmatādhunaivāsmādapasarttavyamāśramāt /
svasaṃśrayaṃ parityajya kvāhaṃ yāsye bubhukṣitaḥ //
meaning:
आयुष्मताधुनैवास्मादपसर्त्तव्यमाश्रमात् /
स्वसंश्रयं परित्यज्य क्वाहं यास्ये बुभुक्षितः //
text_mt: then you, long-lived one, should withdraw from this hermitage right now! / Having abandoned my own shelter, where shall I go, hungry [as I am]?

sanskrit_iast:
svādhivāsaṃ parityajya bhavatā yoditaḥ katham /
ito 'nyasmin gāmiṣyāmi dūre nāhaṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
स्वाधिवासं परित्यज्य भवता योदितः कथम् /
इतो ऽन्यस्मिन् गामिष्यामि दूरे नाहं विशेषतः //
text_mt: How can I, having abandoned my own dwelling because of what you have said, / go elsewhere from here far away, especially not I?

sanskrit_iast:
gamyatāṃ bhavatānyatra sthīyatāmatra vecchayā /
nāhaṃ cālayituṃ śakyaḥ sthānādasmātkathañcana //
meaning:
गम्यतां भवतान्यत्र स्थीयतामत्र वेच्छया /
नाहं चालयितुं शक्यः स्थानादस्मात्कथञ्चन //
text_mt: Let your honour go elsewhere, or remain here as you please; / I cannot be moved from this place by any means!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kiñcitkopasamanvitaḥ /
tamuvāca punarvākyamidaṃ rājanbhṛgūdvahaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य किञ्चित्कोपसमन्वितः /
तमुवाच पुनर्वाक्यमिदं राजन्भृगूद्वहः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard that statement of his, filled with a little anger, / that bearer of the Bhṛgu lineage spoke this word again to him, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
vyādhajātiriyaṃ krūrā sarvasattvabhayāvahā /
khalakarmaratā nityaṃ dhikkṛtā sarvajantubhiḥ //
meaning:
व्याधजातिरियं क्रूरा सर्वसत्त्वभयावहा /
खलकर्मरता नित्यं धिक्कृता सर्वजन्तुभिः //
text_mt: "This hunter caste is cruel, bringing fear to all living beings, / constantly delighting in wicked deeds, reviled by all creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ jāto 'si pāpīyānsarvaprāṇivihiṃsakaḥ /
sa kathaṃ na parityājyaḥ sujanaiḥ syāttu durmate //
meaning:
तस्यां जातो ऽसि पापीयान्सर्वप्राणिविहिंसकः /
स कथं न परित्याज्यः सुजनैः स्यात्तु दुर्मते //
text_mt: You were born into it, very sinful, a slaughterer of all living beings; / how then should you not be avoided by good people, O evil-minded one?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvihīnajātīyaṃ viditvātmānamabyatha /
śīghramasmādvrajānyatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
तस्माद्विहीनजातीयं विदित्वात्मानमब्यथ /
शीघ्रमस्माद्व्रजान्यत्र नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Therefore, knowing yourself to be of a base caste, without distress / go elsewhere from here quickly; no hesitation should be made here!

sanskrit_iast:
śarīratrāṇakāruṇyātsamīpaṃ nopasarpasi /
yathā tvaṃ kaṇṭakādīnāmasahiṣṇutayā vyathām //
meaning:
शरीरत्राणकारुण्यात्समीपं नोपसर्पसि /
यथा त्वं कण्टकादीनामसहिष्णुतया व्यथाम् //
text_mt: Out of pity for the protection of [their] body, you do not come near [the truth]: / just as you feel pain out of intolerance of thorns and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvehi samastānāṃ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ śarīriṇām /
vyathā cābhihatānāṃ tu vidyate bhavato 'nyathā //
meaning:
तथावेहि समस्तानां प्रियाः प्राणाः शरीरिणाम् /
व्यथा चाभिहतानां तु विद्यते भवतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: so know that life is dear to all embodied beings; / and pain exists for those who are struck down, not otherwise than for you.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāmiti dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ /
etadviruddhācaraṇānnityaṃ sadbhirvigarhitaḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सर्वभूतानामिति धर्मः सनातनः /
एतद्विरुद्धाचरणान्नित्यं सद्भिर्विगर्हितः //
text_mt: Non-violence toward all beings—this is the eternal dharma; / through conduct opposed to this, one is constantly censured by the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaprāṇābhirakṣārthaṃ tvamaśeṣaśarīriṇaḥ /
haniṣyasi kathaṃ satsunāpnoṣi vacanīyatām //
meaning:
आत्मप्राणाभिरक्षार्थं त्वमशेषशरीरिणः /
हनिष्यसि कथं सत्सुनाप्नोषि वचनीयताम् //
text_mt: For the sake of preserving your own life, you / will kill all embodied beings; how will you not incur reproach among the virtuous?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācchīghraṃ tu bhogaccha tvameva puruṣādhama /
tvayā me kṛtyadoṣasya hāniśca na bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तस्माच्छीघ्रं तु भोगच्छ त्वमेव पुरुषाधम /
त्वया मे कृत्यदोषस्य हानिश्च न भविष्यति //
text_mt: Therefore, go away quickly yourself, O vilest of men, / and on your account there will be no loss of my prescribed duty.

sanskrit_iast:
na catsvayamito gaccheśtatastava balādapi /
apasarpaṇatābuddhimahamutpādaye sphuṭam //
meaning:
न चत्स्वयमितो गच्छेश्ततस्तव बलादपि /
अपसर्पणताबुद्धिमहमुत्पादये स्फुटम् //
text_mt: If you do not go from here of your own accord, then by force / I shall clearly produce in you the thought of retreating.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇārddhamapi te pāpa śreyasī neha saṃsthitiḥ /
viruddhācaraṇo nityaṃ dharmadriṣ ko labhecca śām //
meaning:
क्षणार्द्धमपि ते पाप श्रेयसी नेह संस्थितिः /
विरुद्धाचरणो नित्यं धर्मद्रिष् को लभेच्च शाम् //
text_mt: Even for half a moment, O sinner, your staying here is not auspicious; / how can an enemy of dharma, always behaving contrarily, obtain peace?"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prīto 'pi tamidaṃ vacaḥ /
uvāca saṃkruddha iva vyādharūpī pinākadhṛk //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रीतो ऽपि तमिदं वचः /
उवाच संक्रुद्ध इव व्याधरूपी पिनाकधृक् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard Rāma's words, though pleased, the wielder of the Pināka / in the form of a hunter spoke this word to him as if enraged:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvametadahaṃ manyaṃ vyarthaṃ vyavasitaṃ tava /
kutastvaṃ prathamo jñānī kutaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kutastapaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वमेतदहं मन्यं व्यर्थं व्यवसितं तव /
कुतस्त्वं प्रथमो ज्ञानी कुतः शंभुः कुतस्तपः //
text_mt: "I consider all this resolve of yours to be in vain: / where is your foremost knowledge, where is Śambhu, and where is austerity?

sanskrit_iast:
kutastvaṃ kliśyase mūḍha tapasā tena te 'dhunā /
ghruvaṃ mithyāpravṛttasya na hi tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
कुतस्त्वं क्लिश्यसे मूढ तपसा तेन ते ऽधुना /
घ्रुवं मिथ्याप्रवृत्तस्य न हि तुष्यति शङ्करः //
text_mt: Why do you torment yourself with that austerity now, O fool? / Surely Śaṅkara is never pleased with one who has undertaken [it] falsely!

sanskrit_iast:
viruddhalokācaraṇaḥ śaṃbhustasya vituṣṭaye /
pratapatyabudho marttyastvāṃ vinā kaḥ mudurmate //
meaning:
विरुद्धलोकाचरणः शंभुस्तस्य वितुष्टये /
प्रतपत्यबुधो मर्त्त्यस्त्वां विना कः मुदुर्मते //
text_mt: Śambhu's conduct is contrary to the world; for his gratification / what foolish mortal performs austerities except you, O very evil-minded one?

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā ca gataṃ me 'dya yuktametadasaṃśayam /
saṃpūjya pūjakaviddhau śaṃbhostava ca saṃgamaḥ //
meaning:
अथ वा च गतं मे ऽद्य युक्तमेतदसंशयम् /
संपूज्य पूजकविद्धौ शंभोस्तव च संगमः //
text_mt: Or rather, it has occurred to me today: this is undoubtedly fitting— / the meeting between you and Śambhu in the manner of worshipper and worshipped!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā pūjayituṃ yuktaḥ sa eva bhuvane rataḥ /
saṃpūjako 'pi tasya tvaṃ yogyo nātra vicāraṇā //
meaning:
त्वया पूजयितुं युक्तः स एव भुवने रतः /
संपूजको ऽपि तस्य त्वं योग्यो नात्र विचारणा //
text_mt: He alone is fit to be worshipped by you, who delights in the [burning] ground; / and you are worthy to be his worshipper, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahasya lokānāṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ /
śiraśchittvā punaḥ śaṃbhurbrahmahatyāmavāptavān //
meaning:
पितामहस्य लोकानां ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः /
शिरश्छित्त्वा पुनः शंभुर्ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Having cut off the head of Brahmā the grandfather of the worlds, the supreme lord, / Śambhu in turn incurred the sin of slaying a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyābhibhūtena prāyastvaṃ śaṃbhunā dvija /
upadiṣṭo 'si tatkartuṃ nocedevaṃ kathaṃ kṛthāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्याभिभूतेन प्रायस्त्वं शंभुना द्विज /
उपदिष्टो ऽसि तत्कर्तुं नोचेदेवं कथं कृथाः //
text_mt: Most likely you have been instructed by Śambhu, who was overcome by the slaying of a brāhmaṇa, / to do that, O twice-born! If not, how would you have done so?

sanskrit_iast:
tādātmyaguṇasaṃyogānmanyaṃ rudrasya te 'dhunā /
tapaḥ siddhiranuprāptā kolenālpīyasā mune //
meaning:
तादात्म्यगुणसंयोगान्मन्यं रुद्रस्य ते ऽधुना /
तपः सिद्धिरनुप्राप्ता कोलेनाल्पीयसा मुने //
text_mt: Due to the conjunction of essential qualities with Rudra, I think / the perfection of your austerity has now been attained in very little time, O sage!

sanskrit_iast:
prāyo 'dya mātaraṃ hatvā sarvailoṅkairnirākṛtaḥ /
tapovyājena gahane nirjane saṃpravarttase //
meaning:
प्रायो ऽद्य मातरं हत्वा सर्वैलोङ्कैर्निराकृतः /
तपोव्याजेन गहने निर्जने संप्रवर्त्तसे //
text_mt: Most likely having killed your mother today, rejected by all the worlds, / under the guise of austerity you are wandering in an impassable, lonely forest.

sanskrit_iast:
gurustrībrahmahatyotthapātakakṣapaṇāya ca /
tapaścarasi nānena tapasā tatpraṇaśyati //
meaning:
गुरुस्त्रीब्रह्महत्योत्थपातकक्षपणाय च /
तपश्चरसि नानेन तपसा तत्प्रणश्यति //
text_mt: And for the destruction of the sin arising from the slaying of a teacher's wife and a brāhmaṇa / you perform austerity; yet through this austerity that does not perish!

sanskrit_iast:
pātakānāṃ kilānyeṣāṃ prāyaścittāni saṃtyapi /
mātṛdruhāmavehi tvaṃ na kvacitkila niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
पातकानां किलान्येषां प्रायश्चित्तानि संत्यपि /
मातृद्रुहामवेहि त्वं न क्वचित्किल निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: For there are indeed expiations for other sins; / but know that there is no atonement anywhere for those who harm their mother!

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsālakṣaṇo dharmo lokeṣu yadi te mataḥ /
svahastena kathaṃ rāma mātaraṃ kṛttavānasi //
meaning:
अहिंसालक्षणो धर्मो लोकेषु यदि ते मतः /
स्वहस्तेन कथं राम मातरं कृत्तवानसि //
text_mt: If the dharma whose characteristic is non-violence is approved by you in the worlds, / why, O Rāma, did you cut down your mother with your own hand?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā mātṛvadhaṃ ghoraṃ sarvalokavigarhitam /
tvaṃ punardhārmiko bhūtvā kāmato 'nyānvinindasi //
meaning:
कृत्वा मातृवधं घोरं सर्वलोकविगर्हितम् /
त्वं पुनर्धार्मिको भूत्वा कामतो ऽन्यान्विनिन्दसि //
text_mt: Having committed the terrible slaughter of your mother, reviled by all the worlds, / having become 'righteous' again, do you willfully blame others?

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatā hasatāmoghaṃ ātmadoṣamajānatā /
aparyāptamahaṃ nanyaṃ paraṃ doṣavimarśanām //
meaning:
पश्यता हसतामोघं आत्मदोषमजानता /
अपर्याप्तमहं नन्यं परं दोषविमर्शनाम् //
text_mt: Seeing and laughing in vain, not knowing one's own fault, / I consider examining another's fault to be insufficient.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmaṃ yadyahaṃ tyaktvā vartteyamakulobhayam /
tarhi garhaya māṃ kāmaṃ nirupya manasā svayam //
meaning:
स्वधर्मं यद्यहं त्यक्त्वा वर्त्तेयमकुलोभयम् /
तर्हि गर्हय मां कामं निरुप्य मनसा स्वयम् //
text_mt: If, having abandoned my own duty, I were to live causing fear to families, / then censure me at will, having determined [it] yourself in your mind.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāpitṛsutādīnāṃ bharaṇāyaiva kevalam /
kriyate prāṇihananaṃ nijadharmatayā mayā //
meaning:
मातापितृसुतादीनां भरणायैव केवलम् /
क्रियते प्राणिहननं निजधर्मतया मया //
text_mt: Solely for the maintenance of mother, father, sons, and others / the killing of living beings is done by me as my own inherent duty.

sanskrit_iast:
svadharmādāmiṣeṇāhaṃ sakuṭumbo dinedine /
varttāmi sāpi me vṛttirvidhātrā vihitā purā //
meaning:
स्वधर्मादामिषेणाहं सकुटुम्बो दिनेदिने /
वर्त्तामि सापि मे वृत्तिर्विधात्रा विहिता पुरा //
text_mt: By meat from my own duty I subsist day by day with my family; / that livelihood of mine was also ordained by the Creator long ago.

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsena yāvatā me syānnityaṃ pitrādi poṣaṇam /
haniṣye cettadadhikaṃ tarhi yujyeyamenasā //
meaning:
मांसेन यावता मे स्यान्नित्यं पित्रादि पोषणम् /
हनिष्ये चेत्तदधिकं तर्हि युज्येयमेनसा //
text_mt: With as much meat as would constantly suffice for the nourishment of my father and others, / if I were to kill more than that, then I would incur sin.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatpoṣaṇaghātena na vayaṃ syāma ninditāḥ /
tadetatsaṃpradhārya tvaṃ nindavā māṃ praśaṃsa vā //
meaning:
यावत्पोषणघातेन न वयं स्याम निन्दिताः /
तदेतत्संप्रधार्य त्वं निन्दवा मां प्रशंस वा //
text_mt: By killing only as much as is needed for nourishment, we are not blameworthy; / having reflected upon this, either blame me or praise me!

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu vāsādhu vā karma yasya yadvihitaṃ purā /
tadeva tena karttavyamāpadyapi kathañcana //
meaning:
साधु वासाधु वा कर्म यस्य यद्विहितं पुरा /
तदेव तेन कर्त्तव्यमापद्यपि कथञ्चन //
text_mt: Good or bad, whatever deed was ordained for someone long ago, / that very deed should be performed by him even in adversity, by any means.

sanskrit_iast:
nirūpaya svabhuddhyā tvamātmano mama cāntaram /
ahaṃ tu sarvabhāvena mitrādibharaṇe rataḥ //
meaning:
निरूपय स्वभुद्ध्या त्वमात्मनो मम चान्तरम् /
अहं तु सर्वभावेन मित्रादिभरणे रतः //
text_mt: Discern with your own intellect the difference between yourself and me: / I, indeed, am devoted with all my heart to maintaining friends and kin,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtyajya pitaraṃ vṛddhaṃ vinihatya ca mātaram /
bhūtvā tu dhārmikastvaṃ tu tapaścartumihāgataḥ //
meaning:
संत्यज्य पितरं वृद्धं विनिहत्य च मातरम् /
भूत्वा तु धार्मिकस्त्वं तु तपश्चर्तुमिहागतः //
text_mt: while you, having abandoned your aged father and having struck down your mother, / having become 'righteous', have come here to practice austerity!"

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu mūlavidasteṣāṃ vispaṣṭaṃ yatra darśanam /
yathājihvaṃ bhavennātra vacasāpi samīhitum //
meaning:
ये तु मूलविदस्तेषां विस्पष्टं यत्र दर्शनम् /
यथाजिह्वं भवेन्नात्र वचसापि समीहितुम् //
text_mt: For those who know the root [facts], whose vision is clear, / it is not possible here even to wish [to speak] crookedly with words.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu samyagjānāmi tava vṛttamaśeṣataḥ /
tasmādalaṃ te tapasā niṣphalena bhṛgūdvaha //
meaning:
अहं तु सम्यग्जानामि तव वृत्तमशेषतः /
तस्मादलं ते तपसा निष्फलेन भृगूद्वह //
text_mt: I, however, know your conduct fully in its entirety; / therefore, have done with your fruitless austerities, O scion of Bhṛgu!

sanskrit_iast:
sukhamicchasi cettyaktvā kāyakleśakaraṃ tapaḥ /
yāhi rāma tvamanyatra yatra vā na vidurjanāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde trayoviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सुखमिच्छसि चेत्त्यक्त्वा कायक्लेशकरं तपः /
याहि राम त्वमन्यत्र यत्र वा न विदुर्जनाः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे त्रयोविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
If you desire happiness, abandon austerities that cause bodily affliction, / and go elsewhere, O Rāma, where people do not know [you].

Thus ends the twenty-third chapter in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktastena bhūpāla rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ /
nirūpya manasā bhūyastamuvācābhivismitam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तस्तेन भूपाल रामो मतिमतां वरः /
निरूप्य मनसा भूयस्तमुवाचाभिविस्मितम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Addressed thus by him, O king, Rāma, the best of the intelligent, / reflected in his mind and spoke back to him, filled with wonder:

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
kastvaṃ brūhi mahābhāga na vai prākṛtapūruṣaḥ /
indrasyevānubhāvena vapurālakṣyate tava //
meaning:
राम उवाच
कस्त्वं ब्रूहि महाभाग न वै प्राकृतपूरुषः /
इन्द्रस्येवानुभावेन वपुरालक्ष्यते तव //
text_mt: Rāma said: / Tell me, who are you, O noble one? You are certainly no ordinary man. / Your body appears endowed with the majesty of Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrārthapadaudāryaguṇagāṃbhīryajātibhiḥ /
sarvajñasyaiva te vāṇī śrūyate 'timanoharā //
meaning:
विचित्रार्थपदौदार्यगुणगांभीर्यजातिभिः /
सर्वज्ञस्यैव ते वाणी श्रूयते ऽतिमनोहरा //
text_mt: With its wonderful meanings, nobility of words, quality, depth, and refinement, / your voice is heard as if belonging to an all-knowing one, exceedingly captivating.

sanskrit_iast:
indro vahniryamo dhātā varuṇo vā dhanādhipaḥ /
īśānastapano brahmā vāyuḥ somo gururguhaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रो वह्निर्यमो धाता वरुणो वा धनाधिपः /
ईशानस्तपनो ब्रह्मा वायुः सोमो गुरुर्गुहः //
text_mt: Indra, Agni, Yama, Dhātṛ, Varuṇa, or Kubera; / Īśāna, Sūrya, Brahmā, Vāyu, Soma, Bṛhaspati, or Guha—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmanyatamaḥ prāyo bhavānbhavitumarhati /
anubhāvena jātiste hṛdiśaṅkāṃ tanoti me //
meaning:
एषामन्यतमः प्रायो भवान्भवितुमर्हति /
अनुभावेन जातिस्ते हृदिशङ्कां तनोति मे //
text_mt: you must probably be one among these. / Your noble nature spreads doubt in my heart.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāvī bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śrūyate puruṣottamaḥ /
ko vā tvaṃ vapuṣānena brūhi māṃ samupāgataḥ //
meaning:
मायावी भगवान्विष्णुः श्रूयते पुरुषोत्तमः /
को वा त्वं वपुषानेन ब्रूहि मां समुपागतः //
text_mt: The lord Viṣṇu, Puruṣottama, is known as a master of illusion; / or who are you who have approached me with this body? Speak!

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā jagatāṃ nāthaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ /
paramātmātmasaṃbhūtirātmārāmaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
अथ वा जगतां नाथः सर्वज्ञः परमेश्वरः /
परमात्मात्मसंभूतिरात्मारामः सनातनः //
text_mt: Or else, the Lord of the worlds, the omniscient Supreme Lord, / the Supreme Self, self-born, delighting in the Self, eternal,

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandacārī bhagavāñchivaḥ sarvajaganmayaḥ /
vapuṣānena saṃyukte bhavānbhavitumarhati //
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दचारी भगवाञ्छिवः सर्वजगन्मयः /
वपुषानेन संयुक्ते भवान्भवितुमर्हति //
text_mt: acting according to his own free will, the lord Śiva, consisting of the whole universe— / endowed with this body, you must be him.

sanskrit_iast:
nānyasyedṛgbhavelloke prabhāvānugataṃ vapuḥ /
jātyarthasauṣṭhavopetā vāṇī caudāryaśālinī //
meaning:
नान्यस्येदृग्भवेल्लोके प्रभावानुगतं वपुः /
जात्यर्थसौष्ठवोपेता वाणी चौदार्यशालिनी //
text_mt: No one else in the world could have such a body attendant upon majesty, / and speech endowed with refinement of words and sense, abounding in grandeur.

sanskrit_iast:
manye 'haṃ bhaktavātsalyādvānena vapuṣāharaḥ /
pratyakṣatāmupagato saṃdeho 'smatparīkṣayā //
meaning:
मन्ये ऽहं भक्तवात्सल्याद्वानेन वपुषाहरः /
प्रत्यक्षतामुपगतो संदेहो ऽस्मत्परीक्षया //
text_mt: I think that out of affection for your devotees, Hara, / you have become visible in this body to test me; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na kevalaṃ bhavān vyādhasteṣāṃ nedṛgvidhākṛtiḥ /
tasmāttubhyaṃ namastasmai surupaṃ saṃpradarśaya //
meaning:
न केवलं भवान् व्याधस्तेषां नेदृग्विधाकृतिः /
तस्मात्तुभ्यं नमस्तस्मै सुरुपं संप्रदर्शय //
text_mt: You are not merely a hunter; their appearance is not like this. / Therefore, obeisance to you, to him! Reveal your beautiful form.

sanskrit_iast:
āviṣkurvanprasīdātmamahimānuguṇaṃ vapuḥ /
mamānekavidhā śaṅkāmucyeta yena mānasī //
meaning:
आविष्कुर्वन्प्रसीदात्ममहिमानुगुणं वपुः /
ममानेकविधा शङ्कामुच्येत येन मानसी //
text_mt: Be gracious, manifesting a body suited to your own greatness, / whereby my manifold mental doubt may be dispelled.

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda sarvabhāvena buddhimohau mamādhunā /
praṇāśaya svarūpasya grahaṇādeva kevalam //
meaning:
प्रसीद सर्वभावेन बुद्धिमोहौ ममाधुना /
प्रणाशय स्वरूपस्य ग्रहणादेव केवलम् //
text_mt: Be gracious in every way! Dispel my confusion of mind right now / merely by perceiving your true nature.

sanskrit_iast:
prārthayetvāṃ mahābhāga praṇamya śirasāsakṛt /
kastvaṃ me darśayātmānaṃ baddho 'yaṃ te mayāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
प्रार्थयेत्वां महाभाग प्रणम्य शिरसासकृत् /
कस्त्वं मे दर्शयात्मानं बद्धो ऽयं ते मयाञ्जलिः //
text_mt: I entreat you, O noble one, bowing repeatedly with my head: / reveal to me who you are; I have joined my palms before you.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā taṃ mahābhāga jñātumicchanbhṛgūdvahaḥ /
upaviśya tato bhūmau dhyānamāste samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तं महाभाग ज्ञातुमिच्छन्भृगूद्वहः /
उपविश्य ततो भूमौ ध्यानमास्ते समाहितः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O noble one, wishing to know him, the scion of Bhṛgu / sat down upon the ground and remained absorbed in meditation, concentrated.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhapadmāsano maunī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ /
niruddhaprāṇasaṃcāro dadhyau ciramudāradhīḥ //
meaning:
बद्धपद्मासनो मौनी यतवाक्कायमानसः /
निरुद्धप्राणसंचारो दध्यौ चिरमुदारधीः //
text_mt: Assuming the lotus posture, maintaining silence, subduing voice, body, and mind, / holding back the movement of his breath, the noble-minded one meditated for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
sanniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ mano hṛdi nirudhya ca /
cintayāmāsa deveśaṃ dhyānadṛṣṭyā jagadgurum //
meaning:
सन्नियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं मनो हृदि निरुध्य च /
चिन्तयामास देवेशं ध्यानदृष्ट्या जगद्गुरुम् //
text_mt: Restraining the host of senses and confining his mind in the heart, / he meditated on the Lord of the gods, the teacher of the universe, with the eye of meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyacca jagannāthamātmasaṃdhānacakṣuṣā /
svabhaktānugrahakaraṃ mṛgavyādhasvarūpiṇam //
meaning:
अपश्यच्च जगन्नाथमात्मसंधानचक्षुषा /
स्वभक्तानुग्रहकरं मृगव्याधस्वरूपिणम् //
text_mt: And he saw the Lord of the universe with the eye of self-concentration, / bestowing grace upon his devotee, bearing the form of a deer-hunter.

sanskrit_iast:
tata unmīlya nayane śīghramutthāya bhārgavaḥ /
dadarśa devaṃ tenaiva vapuṣā purataḥ sthitam //
meaning:
तत उन्मील्य नयने शीघ्रमुत्थाय भार्गवः /
ददर्श देवं तेनैव वपुषा पुरतः स्थितम् //
text_mt: Then, opening his eyes and rising swiftly, the Bhārgava / saw the god standing before him in that very body.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano 'nugrahārthāya śaraṇyaṃ bhaktavatsalam /
āvirbhūtaṃ mahārāja dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ sasaṃbhramam //
meaning:
आत्मनो ऽनुग्रहार्थाय शरण्यं भक्तवत्सलम् /
आविर्भूतं महाराज दृष्ट्वा रामः ससंभ्रमम् //
text_mt: Seeing the refuge [of all], who is affectionate to his devotees, manifested / for the sake of bestowing grace upon him, O great king, Rāma, agitated with awe,

sanskrit_iast:
romāñchodbhinnasarvāṅgo harṣāśruplutalocanaḥ /
papāta pādayorbhūmau bhaktyā tasya mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
रोमाञ्छोद्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो हर्षाश्रुप्लुतलोचनः /
पपात पादयोर्भूमौ भक्त्या तस्य महामतिः //
text_mt: his whole body bristling with horripilation, his eyes flooded with tears of joy, / fell at his feet on the ground with devotion, he of great intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gadgadamuvācainaṃ saṃbhramākulayā girā /
śaraṇaṃ bhava śarveti śaṅkaretyasakṛnnṛpa //
meaning:
स गद्गदमुवाचैनं संभ्रमाकुलया गिरा /
शरणं भव शर्वेति शङ्करेत्यसकृन्नृप //
text_mt: He spoke to him falteringly with words agitated by awe: / “Be my refuge, O Śarva! O Śaṅkara!” repeatedly, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svarupadhṛk śaṃbhustadbhaktiparitoṣitaḥ /
rāmamutthāpayāmāsa praṇā māvanataṃ bhuvi //
meaning:
ततः स्वरुपधृक् शंभुस्तद्भक्तिपरितोषितः /
राममुत्थापयामास प्रणा मावनतं भुवि //
text_mt: Then Śambhu, assuming his own form and pleased with his devotion, / lifted Rāma up as he bowed in salutation to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpito jagaddhātrā svahastābhyāṃ bhṛgūdvahaḥ /
tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ puraḥ sthitvā kṛtājaliḥ //
meaning:
उत्थापितो जगद्धात्रा स्वहस्ताभ्यां भृगूद्वहः /
तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं पुरः स्थित्वा कृताजलिः //
text_mt: Raised up with both hands by the creator of the world, the scion of Bhṛgu / stood before him with joined palms and praised the god of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
namaste devadevāya śaṅkarāyādimūrttaye /
namaḥ śarvāya śāntāya śāśvatāya namonamaḥ //
meaning:
राम उवाच
नमस्ते देवदेवाय शङ्करायादिमूर्त्तये /
नमः शर्वाय शान्ताय शाश्वताय नमोनमः //
text_mt: Rāma said: / Salutations to you, god of gods, Śaṅkara, primordial form! / Obeisance to Śarva, peaceful, eternal; salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste nīlakaṇṭhāya nīlalohitamūrttaye /
namaste bhūtanāthāya bhūtavāsāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
नमस्ते नीलकण्ठाय नीललोहितमूर्त्तये /
नमस्ते भूतनाथाय भूतवासाय ते नमः //
text_mt: Salutations to you, blue-throated one, whose form is dark blue and red! / Salutations to you, lord of beings, abode of creatures, obeisance to you!

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāvyaktasvarūpāya mahādevāya mīḍhuṣe /
śivāya bahurūpāya trinetrāya namonamaḥ //
meaning:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपाय महादेवाय मीढुषे /
शिवाय बहुरूपाय त्रिनेत्राय नमोनमः //
text_mt: To the one whose form is manifest and unmanifest, to the Great God, the bountiful, / to Śiva of manifold forms, the three-eyed one, salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ bhava me śarva tvadbhaktasya jagatpate /
bhūyo 'nanyāśrayāṇāṃ tu tvameva hi parāyaṇam //
meaning:
शरणं भव मे शर्व त्वद्भक्तस्य जगत्पते /
भूयो ऽनन्याश्रयाणां तु त्वमेव हि परायणम् //
text_mt: Be my refuge, O Śarva, to me your devotee, O Lord of the world! / For you alone are the supreme resort of those with no other refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmayāpakṛtaṃ deva duruktaṃ vāpi śaṅkara /
ajānatā tvāṃ bhagavanmama tatkṣantumarhasi //
meaning:
यन्मयापकृतं देव दुरुक्तं वापि शङ्कर /
अजानता त्वां भगवन्मम तत्क्षन्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Whatever wrong I may have committed, O god, or harsh words [spoken], O Śaṅkara, / not knowing you, O Lord, you ought to forgive me for that.

sanskrit_iast:
ananyavedyarupasya sadbhāvamihakaḥ pumān /
tvāmṛte tava sarveśa samyak śakroti veditum //
meaning:
अनन्यवेद्यरुपस्य सद्भावमिहकः पुमान् /
त्वामृते तव सर्वेश सम्यक् शक्रोति वेदितुम् //
text_mt: Who in this world, other than you yourself, O Lord of all, / is able to properly know the true nature of your form, which cannot be known by another?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ sarvabhāvena prasīda mama śaṅkara /
nānyāsti me gatistubhyaṃ namo bhūyo namo namaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं सर्वभावेन प्रसीद मम शङ्कर /
नान्यास्ति मे गतिस्तुभ्यं नमो भूयो नमो नमः //
text_mt: Therefore, be gracious to me with all your heart, O Śaṅkara! / I have no other recourse; obeisance to you, repeatedly salutations, salutations!

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti saṃstūyamānastu kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ puraḥ /
tiṣṭhantamāha bhagavānprasannātmā jaganmayaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति संस्तूयमानस्तु कृताञ्जलिपुटं पुरः /
तिष्ठन्तमाह भगवान्प्रसन्नात्मा जगन्मयः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Being thus praised, the Lord, the soul of serenity, consisting of the universe, / spoke to him who stood before him with hands folded in reverent supplication:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
prīto 'smi bhavate tāta tapasānena sāṃpratam /
bhaktyā caivānapāyinyā hyapi bhārgavasattama //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
प्रीतो ऽस्मि भवते तात तपसानेन सांप्रतम् /
भक्त्या चैवानपायिन्या ह्यपि भार्गवसत्तम //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I am pleased with you now, dear child, on account of this austerity, / and also because of your unfailing devotion, O best of the Bhārgavas!

sanskrit_iast:
dāsye cābhi mataṃ save bhavate 'haṃ tvayā vṛtam /
bhakto hi me tvamatyarthaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
दास्ये चाभि मतं सवे भवते ऽहं त्वया वृतम् /
भक्तो हि मे त्वमत्यर्थं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: And I will grant all that is desired, chosen by you; / for you are exceedingly devoted to me, there is no deliberation to be made in this regard.

sanskrit_iast:
mayaivāvagataṃ sarvaṃ tdṛdi vatte 'dyavarttate /
tasmādbravīmi yattvāhaṃ tatkuruṣvāviśaṅkitam //
meaning:
मयैवावगतं सर्वं त्दृदि वत्ते ऽद्यवर्त्तते /
तस्माद्ब्रवीमि यत्त्वाहं तत्कुरुष्वाविशङ्कितम् //
text_mt: All that is in your heart has been understood by me today; / therefore, do what I tell you without any hesitation.

sanskrit_iast:
nāstrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe vatsa vidyate śaktiradya te /
raudrāṇāṃ tena bhūyo 'pi tapo ghoraṃ samācara //
meaning:
नास्त्राणां धारणे वत्स विद्यते शक्तिरद्य ते /
रौद्राणां तेन भूयो ऽपि तपो घोरं समाचर //
text_mt: You do not yet have the power to bear the dread missiles today, my child; / therefore, perform once again fierce austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
parītya pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu ca kramāt /
srātvā pavitradehasttavaṃ sarvāṇyastrāṇyavāpsyasi //
meaning:
परीत्य पृथिवीं सर्वां सर्वतीर्थेषु च क्रमात् /
स्रात्वा पवित्रदेहस्त्तवं सर्वाण्यस्त्राण्यवाप्स्यसि //
text_mt: Circumambulate the whole earth, and bathing in sequence / at all the sacred bathing places, with your body purified, you will obtain all the missiles.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe devastenaiva vapuṣā vibhuḥ /
rāmasya paśyato rājankṣaṇena bhavabhāgakṛt //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्तेनैव वपुषा विभुः /
रामस्य पश्यतो राजन्क्षणेन भवभागकृत् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the all-pervading god, who grants the rewards of worldly existence, / disappeared in an instant in that very body before Rāma’s eyes, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhite jagannāthe rāmo natvā tu śaṅkaram /
parītyavasudhāṃ sarvāṃ tīrthasnāne 'karonmanaḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्हिते जगन्नाथे रामो नत्वा तु शङ्करम् /
परीत्यवसुधां सर्वां तीर्थस्नाने ऽकरोन्मनः //
text_mt: When the Lord of the world had vanished, Rāma bowed to Śaṅkara / and set his mind on circumambulating the whole earth to bathe at sacred places.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ parikramya yathākramam /
cakāra sarvatīrtheṣu snānaṃ vidhivadātmavān //
meaning:
ततः स पृथिवीं सर्वां परिक्रम्य यथाक्रमम् /
चकार सर्वतीर्थेषु स्नानं विधिवदात्मवान् //
text_mt: Then, having traversed the whole earth in proper sequence, / the self-controlled one performed ritual ablutions at all sacred places according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtheṣu kṣetramukhyeṣu tathā devālayeṣu ca /
pitṝndevāṃśca vidhivadatarpayadatandritaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थेषु क्षेत्रमुख्येषु तथा देवालयेषु च /
पितॄन्देवांश्च विधिवदतर्पयदतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: At sacred bathing places, prominent sacred grounds, and temples of the gods, / unwearied, he duly gratified the ancestors and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsatapohomajapasnānādisukriyāḥ /
tīrtheṣu vidhivatkurvanparicakrāma medinīm //
meaning:
उपवासतपोहोमजपस्नानादिसुक्रियाः /
तीर्थेषु विधिवत्कुर्वन्परिचक्राम मेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Duly performing auspicious rites such as fasts, austerities, oblations, recitations, and ablutions / at sacred bathing places, he traversed the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ krameṇa tīrtheṣu snātvā caiva vasuṃdharām /
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śanaiḥ śuddhadeho 'bhavannṛpa //
meaning:
एवं क्रमेण तीर्थेषु स्नात्वा चैव वसुंधराम् /
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शनैः शुद्धदेहो ऽभवन्नृप //
text_mt: Having thus bathed at the sacred bathing places in succession, / and having slowly circumambulated the earth, he became purified in body, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
parītyaivaṃ vasumatīṃ bhārgavaḥ śaṃbhuśāsanāt /
jagām bhūyastaṃ deśaṃ yatra pūrvamuvāsa saḥ //
meaning:
परीत्यैवं वसुमतीं भार्गवः शंभुशासनात् /
जगाम् भूयस्तं देशं यत्र पूर्वमुवास सः //
text_mt: Having thus traversed the earth by the command of Śambhu, the Bhārgava / went once again to that region where he had previously dwelt.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā rājansatatraiva sthitvā devamumāpatim /
bhaktyā saṃpūjayāmāsa tapobhirnniyamairapi //
meaning:
गत्वा राजन्सतत्रैव स्थित्वा देवमुमापतिम् /
भक्त्या संपूजयामास तपोभिर्न्नियमैरपि //
text_mt: Having gone there, O king, staying right there, he worshipped the god, the lord of Umā, / with devotion, through austerities and observances.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu devānāmasuraiḥ saha /
babhūva suciraṃ rājansaṃgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु देवानामसुरैः सह /
बभूव सुचिरं राजन्संग्रामो रोमहर्षणः //
text_mt: At that very time, O king, there occurred between the gods and the asuras / a very long war that made the hair stand on end.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devānparājitya yuddhe 'tibalino 'surāḥ /
avāpuramaraiśvaryamaśeṣamakutobhayāḥ //
meaning:
ततो देवान्पराजित्य युद्धे ऽतिबलिनो ऽसुराः /
अवापुरमरैश्वर्यमशेषमकुतोभयाः //
text_mt: Then, having defeated the gods in battle, the extremely powerful asuras, / free from all fear, attained the entire sovereignty of the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhe parājitā devāḥ sakalā vāsavādayaḥ /
śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ cagmurhataiśvaryā hyarātibhiḥ //
meaning:
युद्धे पराजिता देवाः सकला वासवादयः /
शङ्करं शरणं चग्मुर्हतैश्वर्या ह्यरातिभिः //
text_mt: Defeated in battle, their sovereignty destroyed by their enemies, / all the gods, headed by Vāsava, went to Śaṅkara for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
toṣayitvā jagannāthaṃ praṇāmajaya saṃstavaiḥ /
prārthayāmāsurasurānhantuṃ devāḥ pinākinam //
meaning:
तोषयित्वा जगन्नाथं प्रणामजय संस्तवैः /
प्रार्थयामासुरसुरान्हन्तुं देवाः पिनाकिनम् //
text_mt: Having pleased the lord of the universe with prostrations and hymns of victory, / the gods implored the wielder of the Pināka bow to slay the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣāṃ pratiśrutya dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ nṛpa /
devānāṃ varadaḥ śaṃbhurmaho daramuvāca ha //
meaning:
ततस्तेषां प्रतिश्रुत्य दानवानां वधं नृप /
देवानां वरदः शंभुर्महो दरमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Then, having promised them the destruction of the Dānavas, O king, / Śambhu, the granter of boons to the gods, spoke to Mahodara:

sanskrit_iast:
himadrerdakṣiṇe bhāge rāmo nāma mahātapāḥ /
muniputro 'titejasvī māmuddiśya tapasyati //
meaning:
हिमद्रेर्दक्षिणे भागे रामो नाम महातपाः /
मुनिपुत्रो ऽतितेजस्वी मामुद्दिश्य तपस्यति //
text_mt: "On the southern part of the Himalaya, a sage's son of great radiance, / named Rāma, of great ascetic fervor, performs austerities directed toward me.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvātvamadyaiva nivedya mama śāsanam /
mahodara tapasyantaṃ tamihānaya māciram //
meaning:
तत्र गत्वात्वमद्यैव निवेद्य मम शासनम् /
महोदर तपस्यन्तं तमिहानय माचिरम् //
text_mt: Going there this very day, Mahodara, having delivered my command, / bring him here without delay while he is performing austerities."

sanskrit_iast:
ityājñaprastathetyuktvā praṇabhyeśaṃ mahodaraḥ /
jagāma vāyuvegena yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्याज्ञप्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा प्रणभ्येशं महोदरः /
जगाम वायुवेगेन यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: Thus commanded, saying 'So be it,' and bowing to the Lord, Mahodara / went with the speed of the wind to where Rāma was abiding.

sanskrit_iast:
samāsādya sa taṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mahāmunim /
tapasyantamidaṃ vākyamuvāca vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
समासाद्य स तं देशं दृष्ट्वा रामं महामुनिम् /
तपस्यन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: Having reached that place and seen Rāma, the great sage, / engaged in austerity, he spoke these words with humility:

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭumicchati śambhustvāṃ bhṛguvaryaṃ tadājñayā /
āgato 'haṃ tadāgaccha tatpādāṃbujasannidhim //
meaning:
द्रष्टुमिच्छति शम्भुस्त्वां भृगुवर्यं तदाज्ञया /
आगतो ऽहं तदागच्छ तत्पादांबुजसन्निधिम् //
text_mt: "Śambhu desires to see you, O best of the Bhṛgus; by his command / I have come. Therefore, come into the presence of his lotus feet."

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya śīghramutthāya bhārgavaḥ /
tadājñāṃ śirasānandya tatheti pratyabhāṣata //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य शीघ्रमुत्थाय भार्गवः /
तदाज्ञां शिरसानन्द्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Hearing his speech, Bhārgava rose up quickly, / respectfully placed his command on his head, and answered, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato rāmaṃ tvaropetaḥ śaṃbhupārśvaṃ mahodaraḥ /
prāpayāmāsa sahasā kailāse nāgasattame //
meaning:
ततो रामं त्वरोपेतः शंभुपार्श्वं महोदरः /
प्रापयामास सहसा कैलासे नागसत्तमे //
text_mt: Then, with haste, Mahodara quickly brought Rāma / to Śambhu's side on Kailāsa, the best of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
sahitaṃ sakalairbhūtairindrādyaiśca sahāmaraiḥ /
dadarśa bhārgavaśreṣṭhaḥ śaṅkaraṃ bhaktavatsalam //
meaning:
सहितं सकलैर्भूतैरिन्द्राद्यैश्च सहामरैः /
ददर्श भार्गवश्रेष्ठः शङ्करं भक्तवत्सलम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by all the beings, and together with the immortals headed by Indra, / the best of the Bhārgavas beheld Śaṅkara, who is affectionate to his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūyamānaṃ munibhirnāradādyaistapodhanaiḥ /
gandharvairupagāyadbhirnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
संस्तूयमानं मुनिभिर्नारदाद्यैस्तपोधनैः /
गन्धर्वैरुपगायद्भिर्नृत्यद्भिश्चाप्सरोगणैः //
text_mt: praised by sages rich in austerity headed by Nārada, / sung to by Gandharvas, and with troops of Apsarases dancing;

sanskrit_iast:
upāsyamānaṃ deveśaṃ gajacarmadhṛtāmbaram /
bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṅgaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam //
meaning:
उपास्यमानं देवेशं गजचर्मधृताम्बरम् /
भस्मोद्धूलितसर्वाङ्गं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम् //
text_mt: attracted upon, the lord of gods, clad in an elephant hide, / with all his limbs smeared with ashes, three-eyed, bearing the crescent moon on his crest;

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtapiṅgajaṭābhāraṃ nāgābharamabhūṣitam /
pralamboṣṭhabhujaṃ saumyaṃ prasannamukhapaṅkajam //
meaning:
धृतपिङ्गजटाभारं नागाभरमभूषितम् /
प्रलम्बोष्ठभुजं सौम्यं प्रसन्नमुखपङ्कजम् //
text_mt: bearing a mass of tawny matted hair, adorned with serpent ornaments, / with long lip and arms, gentle, his lotus face serene;

sanskrit_iast:
āsthitaṃ kāñcane paṭṭe gīrvāṇasamitau nṛpa /
upāsarpattu deveśaṃ bhṛguvaryaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ //
meaning:
आस्थितं काञ्चने पट्टे गीर्वाणसमितौ नृप /
उपासर्पत्तु देवेशं भृगुवर्यः कृताञ्जलिः //
text_mt: seated on a golden seat in the assembly of the gods, O king. / The best of the Bhṛgus approached the lord of gods with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭhadarśanodvattaromāñcāñcitavigrahaḥ /
bāṣpattu siktakāyena sa tu gatvā harāntikam //
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठदर्शनोद्वत्तरोमाञ्चाञ्चितविग्रहः /
बाष्पत्तु सिक्तकायेन स तु गत्वा हरान्तिकम् //
text_mt: His body bristling with horripilation at the sight of Śrīkaṇṭha, / his body bathed in tears, he went near Hara,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā sasaṃbhramaṃ vācā harṣagadgadayāsakṛt /
namaste devadeveti vyālapannākulākṣaram //
meaning:
भक्त्या ससंभ्रमं वाचा हर्षगद्गदयासकृत् /
नमस्ते देवदेवेति व्यालपन्नाकुलाक्षरम् //
text_mt: and, repeatedly murmuring with faltering syllables in devotion and agitation, / with a voice choked with joy, 'Homage to you, O god of gods!',

sanskrit_iast:
papāta saṃspṛśanmūrdhnā caraṇau puravidviṣaḥ /
paśyatāṃ devavṛndānāṃ madhye bhṛgukulodvaham //
meaning:
पपात संस्पृशन्मूर्ध्ना चरणौ पुरविद्विषः /
पश्यतां देववृन्दानां मध्ये भृगुकुलोद्वहम् //
text_mt: the descendant of the Bhṛgu race fell down touching the feet of the foe of Tripura with his head, / in the midst of the hosts of gods who were looking on.

sanskrit_iast:
tamutthāpya śivaḥ prītaḥ prasannamukhapaṅkajam /
rāmaṃ madhurayā vācā prahasannāha sādaram //
meaning:
तमुत्थाप्य शिवः प्रीतः प्रसन्नमुखपङ्कजम् /
रामं मधुरया वाचा प्रहसन्नाह सादरम् //
text_mt: Raising him up, Śiva, pleased, with a serene lotus face, / spoke to Rāma with a sweet voice, smiling respectfully:

sanskrit_iast:
ime daityagaṇaiḥ krāntāḥ svādhiṣṭhānātparicyutāḥ /
aśakruvantastānhantuṃ gīrvāṇā māmupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
इमे दैत्यगणैः क्रान्ताः स्वाधिष्ठानात्परिच्युताः /
अशक्रुवन्तस्तान्हन्तुं गीर्वाणा मामुपागताः //
text_mt: "Overwhelmed by the hosts of Daityas and fallen from their rightful realm, / the gods, unable to slay them, have come to me.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmamājñayā rāma devānāṃ ca priyepsayā /
jahi daityagaṇānsarvānsamarthastvaṃ hi me mataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मान्ममाज्ञया राम देवानां च प्रियेप्सया /
जहि दैत्यगणान्सर्वान्समर्थस्त्वं हि मे मतः //
text_mt: Therefore, by my command, O Rāma, and out of a desire to please the gods, / slay all the hosts of Daityas; for in my view you are capable."

sanskrit_iast:
tato rāmo 'bravīccharvaṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ /
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sapraśrayamidaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
ततो रामो ऽब्रवीच्छर्वं प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः /
शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सप्रश्रयमिदं वचः //
text_mt: Then Rāma, having bowed down with folded hands, / addressed these modest words to Śarva while all the gods listened:

sanskrit_iast:
svāminna viditaṃ kiṃ te sarvajñasyākhilātmanaḥ /
tathāpi vijñāpayato vacanaṃ me 'vadhāraya //
meaning:
स्वामिन्न विदितं किं ते सर्वज्ञस्याखिलात्मनः /
तथापि विज्ञापयतो वचनं मे ऽवधारय //
text_mt: "O Lord, what is not known to you, the omniscient soul of all? / Yet, heed my words as I make my petition.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi śakrādibhirdevairakhilairamarārayaḥ /
na śakyā hantumekasya śakyāḥ syaste kathaṃ mama //
meaning:
यदि शक्रादिभिर्देवैरखिलैरमरारयः /
न शक्या हन्तुमेकस्य शक्याः स्यस्ते कथं मम //
text_mt: If the enemies of the immortals cannot be slain by all the gods headed by Śakra, / how could they possibly be slain by me alone?

sanskrit_iast:
anastrajño 'smi deveśa yuddhānāmapyakovidaḥ /
kathaṃ haniṣye sakalānsuraśatrūnanāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
अनस्त्रज्ञो ऽस्मि देवेश युद्धानामप्यकोविदः /
कथं हनिष्ये सकलान्सुरशत्रूननायुधः //
text_mt: I know no divine weapons, O lord of gods, nor am I skilled in battles. / Weaponless, how will I slay all the foes of the suras?"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastena deveśaḥ sitaṃ kālāgnisaprabham /
śaivamastramayaṃ tejo dadau tasmai mahātmane //
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तेन देवेशः सितं कालाग्निसप्रभम् /
शैवमस्त्रमयं तेजो ददौ तस्मै महात्मने //
text_mt: Thus addressed by him, the lord of gods gave to that great soul / the white, fiery energy of Śiva's weapon, radiant like the fire of universal destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmīyaṃ paraśuṃ datvā sarvaśastrābhibhāvakam /
rāmapāha prasannātmā gīrvāṇānāṃ tu śṛṇvatam //
meaning:
आत्मीयं परशुं दत्वा सर्वशस्त्राभिभावकम् /
रामपाह प्रसन्नात्मा गीर्वाणानां तु शृण्वतम् //
text_mt: Having bestowed his own battle-axe, which overcomes all weapons, / he spoke to Rāma with a gracious heart, as the gods listened:

sanskrit_iast:
matprasādena sakalānsuraśatrūnvinighnataḥ /
śaktirbhavatu te saumya samastāridurāsadā //
meaning:
मत्प्रसादेन सकलान्सुरशत्रून्विनिघ्नतः /
शक्तिर्भवतु ते सौम्य समस्तारिदुरासदा //
text_mt: "By my grace, as you strike down all the foes of the suras, / may you possess power unassailable by any enemy, O gentle one.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaivāyudhena tvaṃ gaccha yudhyasva śatrubhiḥ /
svayameva ca vetsi tvaṃ yathāvadyuddhakauśalam //
meaning:
अनेनैवायुधेन त्वं गच्छ युध्यस्व शत्रुभिः /
स्वयमेव च वेत्सि त्वं यथावद्युद्धकौशलम् //
text_mt: With this very weapon, go and fight with the enemies; / you will know battle skills properly of your own accord."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktastato rāmaḥ śaṃbhunā taṃ praṇamya ca /
jagrāha paraśuṃ śaiva vibudhārivadhodyataḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवमुक्तस्ततो रामः शंभुना तं प्रणम्य च /
जग्राह परशुं शैव विबुधारिवधोद्यतः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed by Śambhu, Rāma bowed to him / and took up the battle-axe of Śiva, eager to slay the enemies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa śuśubhe rāmo viṣṇuterñjo 'śasaṃbhavaḥ /
rudrabhaktyā samāyukto dyutyeva saviturmahaḥ //
meaning:
ततः स शुशुभे रामो विष्णुतेर्ञ्जो ऽशसंभवः /
रुद्रभक्त्या समायुक्तो द्युत्येव सवितुर्महः //
text_mt: Then Rāma, born of a portion of the energy of Viṣṇu, / endowed with devotion to Rudra, shone like the brilliance of the sun with its radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'nujñātastrinetreṇa devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ /
jagāma hantumasurānyuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽनुज्ञातस्त्रिनेत्रेण देवैः सर्वैः समन्वितः /
जगाम हन्तुमसुरान्युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः //
text_mt: Permitted by the three-eyed god, accompanied by all the gods, / he set out, resolved on battle, to slay the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'bhavatpunaryuddhaṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha /
trailokyavijayodyuktai rājannatibhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
ततो ऽभवत्पुनर्युद्धं देवानामसुरैः सह /
त्रैलोक्यविजयोद्युक्तै राजन्नतिभयङ्करम् //
text_mt: Then there took place once again a most terrifying war, O king, / between the gods and the asuras who were striving to conquer the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rāmo mahābāhustasminyuddhe sudāruṇe /
kuddhaḥ paraśunā tena nijaghāna mahāsurān //
meaning:
अथ रामो महाबाहुस्तस्मिन्युद्धे सुदारुणे /
कुद्धः परशुना तेन निजघान महासुरान् //
text_mt: Then the mighty-armed Rāma, enraged in that dreadful battle, / struck down the great asuras with that battle-axe.

sanskrit_iast:
prahārairaśaniprakhyairnighnandaityānsahasraśaḥ /
cacāra samare rāmaḥ kruddhaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
प्रहारैरशनिप्रख्यैर्निघ्नन्दैत्यान्सहस्रशः /
चचार समरे रामः क्रुद्धः काल इवापरः //
text_mt: Striking down the Daityas by the thousands with blows resembling thunderbolts, / Rāma moved across the battlefield, enraged like another Death.

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tu sakalāndaityāndevānsarvānaharṣayat /
kṣaṇena nāśayāmāsa rāmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
हत्वा तु सकलान्दैत्यान्देवान्सर्वानहर्षयत् /
क्षणेन नाशयामास रामः प्रहरतां वरः //
text_mt: Having slain all the Daityas, Rāma, the best of warriors, / gladdened all the gods and destroyed [the enemy] in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa hanyamā nāstu samastā daityadānavāḥ /
dadṛśuḥ sarvato rāmaṃ hataśeṣā bhayānvitāḥ //
meaning:
रामेण हन्यमा नास्तु समस्ता दैत्यदानवाः /
ददृशुः सर्वतो रामं हतशेषा भयान्विताः //
text_mt: Being slaughtered by Rāma, all the Daityas and Dānavas / who survived the slaughter saw Rāma everywhere, filled with terror.

sanskrit_iast:
hateṣvasurasaṃgheṣu vidruteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ /
rāmamāmantrya vibudhāḥ prayayustridivaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
हतेष्वसुरसंघेषु विद्रुतेषु च कृत्स्नशः /
राममामन्त्र्य विबुधाः प्रययुस्त्रिदिवं पुनः //
text_mt: When the hosts of asuras had been slain and completely routed, / the gods took leave of Rāma and returned to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi hatvā ditijānabhyanujñāpya cāmarān /
svamāśramaṃ samāpede tapasyāsaktamānasaḥ //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि हत्वा दितिजानभ्यनुज्ञाप्य चामरान् /
स्वमाश्रमं समापेदे तपस्यासक्तमानसः //
text_mt: Rāma also, having slain the sons of Diti and taken leave of the immortals, / returned to his hermitage, his mind intent on austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgavyādhapratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā śambhormahāmatiḥ /
bhaktyā saṃpūjayāmāsa sa tasminnāśramevaśī //
meaning:
मृगव्याधप्रतिकृतिं कृत्वा शम्भोर्महामतिः /
भक्त्या संपूजयामास स तस्मिन्नाश्रमेवशी //
text_mt: Having made an image of Śambhu in the form of a deer-hunter, / that self-controlled, wise one worshipped him with devotion in that hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā hṛdyairnaivedyairabhivandanaiḥ /
stotraiśca vidhivadbhaktyā parāṃ prītimupānayat //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne caturviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 24//
meaning:
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा हृद्यैर्नैवेद्यैरभिवन्दनैः /
स्तोत्रैश्च विधिवद्भक्त्या परां प्रीतिमुपानयत् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने चतुर्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 24//
text_mt:
With perfumes, flowers, delightful food-offerings, prostrations, / and hymns according to rule, he brought about supreme delight with devotion.

Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter in the Story of Arjuna in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tatasta draktiyogena sa prītātmā jagatpatiḥ /
pratyakṣamagamattasya sarvaiḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
ततस्त द्रक्तियोगेन स प्रीतात्मा जगत्पतिः /
प्रत्यक्षमगमत्तस्य सर्वैः सह मरुद्गणैः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then, through the practice of that devotion, the pleased Lord of the Universe / appeared visible before him together with all the hosts of the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam /
vṛṣendravāhanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhūtakoṭisamanvitam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम् /
वृषेन्द्रवाहनं शंभुं भूतकोटिसमन्वितम् //
text_mt: Beholding the lord of the gods of gods, three-eyed, bearing the crescent moon on his crest, / having the lord of bulls for his mount, Śambhu accompanied by millions of spirits,

sanskrit_iast:
sasaṃbhramaṃ samutthāya harṣeṇākulalocanaḥ /
praṇāmamakarodbhaktyā śarvāya bhuvi bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
ससंभ्रमं समुत्थाय हर्षेणाकुललोचनः /
प्रणाममकरोद्भक्त्या शर्वाय भुवि भार्गवः //
text_mt: Rising up in haste, his eyes overflowing with joy, / the Bhārgava bowed down in devotion to Śarva on the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
utthāyotthāya deveśaṃ praṇamya śirasāsakṛt /
kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmastuṣṭāva ca jagatpatim //
meaning:
उत्थायोत्थाय देवेशं प्रणम्य शिरसासकृत् /
कृताञ्जलिपुटो रामस्तुष्टाव च जगत्पतिम् //
text_mt: Rising again and again and bowing his head repeatedly before the lord of gods, / his hands joined in reverence, Rāma praised the lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
namaste devadeveśa namaste parameśvara /
namaste jagato nātha namaste tripurāntaka //
meaning:
राम उवाच
नमस्ते देवदेवेश नमस्ते परमेश्वर /
नमस्ते जगतो नाथ नमस्ते त्रिपुरान्तक //
text_mt: Rāma said: / "Homage to you, lord of the gods of gods! Homage to you, supreme lord! / Homage to you, lord of the universe! Homage to you, destroyer of Tripura!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sakalādhyakṣa namaste bhaktavatsala /
namaste sarvabhūteśa namaste vṛṣabhadhvaja //
meaning:
नमस्ते सकलाध्यक्ष नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल /
नमस्ते सर्वभूतेश नमस्ते वृषभध्वज //
text_mt: Homage to you, witness of all! Homage to you, compassionate to devotees! / Homage to you, lord of all beings! Homage to you whose banner bears a bull!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste sakalādhīśa namaste karuṇākara /
namaste sakalāvāsa namaste nīlalohita //
meaning:
नमस्ते सकलाधीश नमस्ते करुणाकर /
नमस्ते सकलावास नमस्ते नीललोहित //
text_mt: Homage to you, master of everything! Homage to you, mine of compassion! / Homage to you, abode of all! Homage to you, dark blue and red!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ sakaladevārigaṇanāśāya śūline /
kapāline namastubhyaṃ sarvalokaikapāline //
meaning:
नमः सकलदेवारिगणनाशाय शूलिने /
कपालिने नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वलोकैकपालिने //
text_mt: Homage to the trident-bearer, destroyer of the hosts of all enemies of the gods! / Homage to you who bear a skull, sole protector of all the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ namaḥ kailāsavāsine /
namo 'stu pāśine tubhyaṃ kālakūṭaviṣāśine //
meaning:
श्मशानवासिने नित्यं नमः कैलासवासिने /
नमो ऽस्तु पाशिने तुभ्यं कालकूटविषाशिने //
text_mt: Homage forever to the dweller in cremation grounds, to the dweller on Kailāsa! / Homage be to you who wield the noose, devourer of the kālakūṭa poison!

sanskrit_iast:
vibhave 'maravandyāya prabhave te svayaṃbhuve /
namo 'khilajagatkarmasākṣibhūtāya śaṃbhave //
meaning:
विभवे ऽमरवन्द्याय प्रभवे ते स्वयंभुवे /
नमो ऽखिलजगत्कर्मसाक्षिभूताय शंभवे //
text_mt: To the all-pervading lord worthy of praise by immortals, the source, the self-existent! / Homage to Śambhu, who stands as witness to the deeds of the entire universe!

sanskrit_iast:
namastripatha gāphenabhāsigārddhandumauline /
mahābhogīndrahārāya śivāya paramātmane //
meaning:
नमस्त्रिपथ गाफेनभासिगार्द्धन्दुमौलिने /
महाभोगीन्द्रहाराय शिवाय परमात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to him whose crest bears the half-moon shining with the foam of the three-streamed [Gaṅgā], / who wears the great king of serpents as a necklace, to Śiva, the supreme self!

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmasaṃcchannadehāya namor'kāgnīnducakṣuṣe /
kapardine namastubhyamandhakāsuramarddine //
meaning:
भस्मसंच्छन्नदेहाय नमोर्ऽकाग्नीन्दुचक्षुषे /
कपर्दिने नमस्तुभ्यमन्धकासुरमर्द्दिने //
text_mt: To him whose body is covered in ash, homage to him whose eyes are the sun, fire, and moon! / Homage to you with matted hair, smiter of the demon Andhaka!

sanskrit_iast:
tripuradhvaṃsine dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsine namaḥ /
girijākucakāśmīravirañjitamahorase //
meaning:
त्रिपुरध्वंसिने दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसिने नमः /
गिरिजाकुचकाश्मीरविरञ्जितमहोरसे //
text_mt: Homage to the destroyer of Tripura, the destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / whose broad chest is reddened by the saffron from the breasts of the Mountain's daughter!

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāya maha te namaste kṛttivāsase /
yogidhyeyasvarūpāya śivāyācintyatejase //
meaning:
महादेवाय मह ते नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे /
योगिध्येयस्वरूपाय शिवायाचिन्त्यतेजसे //
text_mt: To Mahādeva, the great one, homage to you clad in an animal skin! / Whose nature is the object of meditation for yogins, to Śiva of inconceivable splendor!

sanskrit_iast:
svabhaktahṛdayāṃbhojakarṇikāmadhyavarttine /
sakalāgamasiddhāntasārarūpāya te namaḥ //
meaning:
स्वभक्तहृदयांभोजकर्णिकामध्यवर्त्तिने /
सकलागमसिद्धान्तसाररूपाय ते नमः //
text_mt: To him who abides within the pericarp of the heart-lotus of his devotees, / to you whose form is the essence of the conclusions of all Āgamas, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
namo nikhilayogendrabodhanāyāmṛtātmane /
śaṅkarāyākhilavyāptamahimne paramātmane //
meaning:
नमो निखिलयोगेन्द्रबोधनायामृतात्मने /
शङ्करायाखिलव्याप्तमहिम्ने परमात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to him who awakens all lords of yoga, whose nature is nectar, / to Śaṅkara, whose greatness pervades all things, the supreme self!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śarvāya śāntāya brahmaṇe viśvarupiṇe /
ādimadhyāntahīnāya nityāyāvyaktamūrttaye //
meaning:
नमः शर्वाय शान्ताय ब्रह्मणे विश्वरुपिणे /
आदिमध्यान्तहीनाय नित्यायाव्यक्तमूर्त्तये //
text_mt: Homage to Śarva, the peaceful, to Brahman who takes the form of the universe, / devoid of beginning, middle, and end, eternal, whose form is unmanifest!

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāvyaktasvarūpāya sthūlasūkṣmātmane namaḥ /
namo vedāntavedyāya viśvavijñānarūpiṇe //
meaning:
व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपाय स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मने नमः /
नमो वेदान्तवेद्याय विश्वविज्ञानरूपिणे //
text_mt: Homage to him whose nature is manifest and unmanifest, whose self is gross and subtle! / Homage to him who is known through the Vedānta, whose form is universal knowledge!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ surāsuraśreṇimaulipuṣpārcitāṅghraye /
śrīkaṇṭhāya jagaddhātre lokakartre namonamaḥ //
meaning:
नमः सुरासुरश्रेणिमौलिपुष्पार्चिताङ्घ्रये /
श्रीकण्ठाय जगद्धात्रे लोककर्त्रे नमोनमः //
text_mt: Homage to him whose feet are worshiped with flowers from the diadems of rows of gods and asuras, / to Śrīkaṇṭha, supporter of the universe, creator of the world, homage, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
rajoguṇātmane tubhyaṃ viśvasṛṣṭividhāyine /
hiraṇyagarbharūpāya harāya jagadādaye //
meaning:
रजोगुणात्मने तुभ्यं विश्वसृष्टिविधायिने /
हिरण्यगर्भरूपाय हराय जगदादये //
text_mt: To you whose nature is the quality of rajas, who bring about the creation of the universe, / whose form is the Golden Germ, to Hara, the origin of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
namo viśvātmane lokasthitivyā pārakāriṇe /
sattvavijñānarupāya parāya pratyagātmane //
meaning:
नमो विश्वात्मने लोकस्थितिव्या पारकारिणे /
सत्त्वविज्ञानरुपाय पराय प्रत्यगात्मने //
text_mt: Homage to the universal self who conducts the operation of sustaining the world, / whose form is knowledge consisting of sattva, the supreme, innermost self!

sanskrit_iast:
tamoguṇavikārāya jagatsaṃhārakāriṇe /
klpānte rudrarūpāya parāpara vide namaḥ //
meaning:
तमोगुणविकाराय जगत्संहारकारिणे /
क्ल्पान्ते रुद्ररूपाय परापर विदे नमः //
text_mt: To him who transforms into the quality of tamas, who causes the destruction of the universe, / whose form is Rudra at the end of an eon, knower of the higher and lower, homage!

sanskrit_iast:
avikārāya nityāya namaḥ sadasadātmane /
buddhibuddhiprabodhāya buddhīndriyavikāriṇe //
meaning:
अविकाराय नित्याय नमः सदसदात्मने /
बुद्धिबुद्धिप्रबोधाय बुद्धीन्द्रियविकारिणे //
