text_mt: Homage to the changeless, the eternal, whose self is both the real and the unreal, / the illuminator of the intellect's understanding, who undergoes transformation as the sense organs of cognition!

sanskrit_iast:
vasvādityamarudbhiśca sādhyarudrāśvibhedataḥ /
yanmāyābhinnamatayo devāstasmai namonamaḥ //
meaning:
वस्वादित्यमरुद्भिश्च साध्यरुद्राश्विभेदतः /
यन्मायाभिन्नमतयो देवास्तस्मै नमोनमः //
text_mt: Homage, homage to him by whose māyā the minds of the gods are differentiated / into the divisions of Vasus, Ādityas, Maruts, Sādhyas, Rudras, and Aśvins!

sanskrit_iast:
avikāramajaṃ nityaṃ sūkṣmarūpamanaupamam /
tava yattanna jānanti yogino 'pi sadāmalāḥ //
meaning:
अविकारमजं नित्यं सूक्ष्मरूपमनौपमम् /
तव यत्तन्न जानन्ति योगिनो ऽपि सदामलाः //
text_mt: That changeless, unborn, eternal, subtle, incomparable form of yours, / even the ever-pure yogins do not comprehend.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmavijñāya durjñeyaṃ samyagbrahmādayo 'pi hi /
saṃsaranti bhave nūnaṃ na tatkarmātmakāściram //
meaning:
त्वामविज्ञाय दुर्ज्ञेयं सम्यग्ब्रह्मादयो ऽपि हि /
संसरन्ति भवे नूनं न तत्कर्मात्मकाश्चिरम् //
text_mt: Not knowing you, who are so hard to know, even Brahmā and the others indeed / wander for long in cyclic existence, consisting of action and not of that [knowledge].

sanskrit_iast:
yāvannopaiti caraṇau tavājñānavighātinaḥ /
tāvadbhramati saṃsāre paṇḍito 'cetano 'pi vā //
meaning:
यावन्नोपैति चरणौ तवाज्ञानविघातिनः /
तावद्भ्रमति संसारे पण्डितो ऽचेतनो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: As long as one does not approach your feet, which destroy ignorance, / so long does one wander in saṃsāra, whether a learned man or an unintelligent one.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva dakṣaḥ sa kṛtī sa muniḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ /
bhavataścaraṇāṃbhoje yena buddhiḥ sthirīkṛtā //
meaning:
स एव दक्षः स कृती स मुनिः स च पण्डितः /
भवतश्चरणांभोजे येन बुद्धिः स्थिरीकृता //
text_mt: He alone is capable, he has achieved his purpose, he is a sage and a scholar, / by whom the intellect has been steadied upon your lotus feet.

sanskrit_iast:
susūkṣmatvena gahanaḥ sadbhāvaste trayīmayaḥ /
viduṣāmapi mūḍhena sa mayā jñāyate katham //
meaning:
सुसूक्ष्मत्वेन गहनः सद्भावस्ते त्रयीमयः /
विदुषामपि मूढेन स मया ज्ञायते कथम् //
text_mt: Deep and difficult to fathom due to its extreme subtlety, your true nature consists of the three Vedas; / how can it be known by me, a fool, when it is so even for the wise?

sanskrit_iast:
aśabdagojaratvena mahimnastava sāṃpratam /
stotumapyanalaṃ samyaktvā mahaṃ jaḍadhīryataḥ //
meaning:
अशब्दगोजरत्वेन महिम्नस्तव सांप्रतम् /
स्तोतुमप्यनलं सम्यक्त्वा महं जडधीर्यतः //
text_mt: Because your greatness is beyond the reach of words, / I, whose intellect is dull, am completely incapable now of even praising you properly.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādajñānato vāpi mayā bhaktyaiva saṃstutaḥ /
prītaśca bhava deveśa nanu tvaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादज्ञानतो वापि मया भक्त्यैव संस्तुतः /
प्रीतश्च भव देवेश ननु त्वं भक्तवत्सलः //
text_mt: Therefore, whether through ignorance or otherwise, you have been praised by me solely with devotion; / be pleased, O lord of gods, for surely you are affectionate to devotees!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti stutastadā tena bhaktyā rāmeṇa śaṅkaraḥ /
meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā tamuvāca hasanniva //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति स्तुतस्तदा तेन भक्त्या रामेण शङ्करः /
मेघगंभीरया वाचा तमुवाच हसन्निव //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus praised at that time by Rāma with devotion, Śaṅkara, / with a voice deep as a thundercloud, spoke to him as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
rāmāhaṃ suprasanno 'smi śorṃyaśālitayā tava /
tapasā mayi bhaktyā ca stotreṇa ca viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
रामाहं सुप्रसन्नो ऽस्मि शोर्ंयशालितया तव /
तपसा मयि भक्त्या च स्तोत्रेण च विशेषतः //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / "O Rāma, I am exceedingly pleased with your courage, / your asceticism, your devotion to me, and especially your hymn of praise.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ yadyadicchasi cetasā /
tubhyaṃ tattadaśeṣeṇa dāsyāmyahamaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं यद्यदिच्छसि चेतसा /
तुभ्यं तत्तदशेषेण दास्याम्यहमशेषतः //
text_mt: Therefore choose a boon, whatever you desire in your heart; / I will grant all of it to you without remainder."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityukto devadevena taṃ praṇamya bhṛgūdvahaḥ /
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rājannidamuvāca ha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन तं प्रणम्य भृगूद्वहः /
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा राजन्निदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed by the god of gods, bowing to him, that descendant of Bhṛgu, / with his hands joined in reverence, said this, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
yadi deva prasannastvaṃ vārarhe 'smi ca yadyaham /
bhavatastadabhīpsāmi hetumastrāṇyaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
यदि देव प्रसन्नस्त्वं वारर्हे ऽस्मि च यद्यहम् /
भवतस्तदभीप्सामि हेतुमस्त्राण्यशेषतः //
text_mt: "If you are pleased, O god, and if I am worthy of a boon, / then from you I desire to obtain all divine weapons without exception.

sanskrit_iast:
astre śastre ca śāstre ca na matto 'bhyadhiko bhavet /
lokeṣu māṃraṇejetā na bhavettvatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्रे शस्त्रे च शास्त्रे च न मत्तो ऽभ्यधिको भवेत् /
लोकेषु मांरणेजेता न भवेत्त्वत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt: In missiles, hand-weapons, and sacred treatises, let no one be superior to me; / in all the worlds, let there be no conqueror of me in battle, through your grace!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tathetyuktvā tataḥ śaṃbhurastraśastrāṇyaśeṣataḥ /
dadau rāmāya suprītaḥ samantrāṇi kramānnṛpa //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तथेत्युक्त्वा ततः शंभुरस्त्रशस्त्राण्यशेषतः /
ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतः समन्त्राणि क्रमान्नृप //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Saying ‘So be it,’ Śambhu, highly pleased, then gave to Rāma / all missiles and hand-weapons along with their mantras in proper order, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
saprayogaṃ sasaṃhāramastragrāmaṃ caturvidham /
prasādābhimukho rāmaṃ grāhayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
सप्रयोगं ससंहारमस्त्रग्रामं चतुर्विधम् /
प्रसादाभिमुखो रामं ग्राहयामास शङ्करः //
text_mt: Inclined toward grace, Śaṅkara made Rāma master / the fourfold collection of divine weapons together with the methods of discharge and withdrawal.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃgavegaṃ śubhrāśvaṃ sudhvajaṃ ca rathottamam /
iṣudhī cākṣayaśarau dadau rāmāya śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
असंगवेगं शुभ्राश्वं सुध्वजं च रथोत्तमम् /
इषुधी चाक्षयशरौ ददौ रामाय शङ्करः //
text_mt: An excellent chariot with unimpeded speed, white horses, and a splendid banner, / and two quivers of inexhaustible arrows, Śaṅkara gave to Rāma;

sanskrit_iast:
abhedyamajaraṃ divyaṃ dṛḍhajyaṃ vijayaṃ dhanuḥ /
sarvaśastrasahaṃ citraṃ kavacaṃ ca mahādhanam //
meaning:
अभेद्यमजरं दिव्यं दृढज्यं विजयं धनुः /
सर्वशस्त्रसहं चित्रं कवचं च महाधनम् //
text_mt: an unpierceable, ageless, divine bow named Vijaya with a sturdy bowstring, / and an extraordinary, priceless armor capable of withstanding all weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
ajeyatvaṃ ca yuddheṣu śauryaṃ cāpratimaṃ bhuvi /
svecchayā dhāraṇe śāktiṃ prāṇānāṃ ca narādhipa //
meaning:
अजेयत्वं च युद्धेषु शौर्यं चाप्रतिमं भुवि /
स्वेच्छया धारणे शाक्तिं प्राणानां च नराधिप //
text_mt: and invincibility in battles, and peerless valour on the earth, / and the power to sustain his vital breaths at his own will, O ruler of men;

sanskrit_iast:
khyātiṃ ca bījametreṇa tannāmnā sarvalaukikīm /
tapaḥ prabhāvaṃ ca mahatpradadau bhārgavāya saḥ //
meaning:
ख्यातिं च बीजमेत्रेण तन्नाम्ना सर्वलौकिकीम् /
तपः प्रभावं च महत्प्रददौ भार्गवाय सः //
text_mt: and universal renown in the worlds merely by the seed syllable of his name, / and great power of asceticism he bestowed upon that Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakti cātmani rāmāya dattvā rājanyathocitām /
sahitaḥ sakalairbhūtaiścāmaraiścandraśekharaḥ //
meaning:
भक्ति चात्मनि रामाय दत्त्वा राजन्यथोचिताम् /
सहितः सकलैर्भूतैश्चामरैश्चन्द्रशेखरः //
text_mt: Having granted Rāma proper devotion to himself, O king, / the moon-crested god, accompanied by all the spirits and the immortals—

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva vapuṣā śaṃbhuḥ kṣipramantaradhāddharaḥ /
kṛtakṛtyastato rāmo labdhvā sarvamabhīpsitam //
meaning:
तेनैव वपुषा शंभुः क्षिप्रमन्तरधाद्धरः /
कृतकृत्यस्ततो रामो लब्ध्वा सर्वमभीप्सितम् //
text_mt: Śambhu, Hara, quickly vanished in that very form. / Then Rāma, having attained all that he desired and accomplished his goal,

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyatāṃ gate śarve mahodaramuvāca ha /
mahodara madarthe tvamidaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अदृश्यतां गते शर्वे महोदरमुवाच ह /
महोदर मदर्थे त्वमिदं सर्वमशेषतः //
text_mt: when Śarva had vanished from sight, spoke to Mahodara: / ‘O Mahodara, for my sake, you must guard all of this—

sanskrit_iast:
rathacāpādikaṃ tāvatparirakṣitumarhasi /
yadā kṛtyaṃ mamaitena tadānīṃ tvaṃ mayā smṛtaḥ /
rathacāpādikaṃ sarvaṃ prahiṇu tvaṃ madantikam //
meaning:
रथचापादिकं तावत्परिरक्षितुमर्हसि /
यदा कृत्यं ममैतेन तदानीं त्वं मया स्मृतः /
रथचापादिकं सर्वं प्रहिणु त्वं मदन्तिकम् //
text_mt: the chariot, the bow, and the rest—without omission for the time being. / When I have need of this, then, remembered by me, / send the chariot, bow, and everything to my presence.’

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tathetyuktvā gate tasminbhṛguvaryo mahodare /
kṛtakṛtyo gurujanaṃ draṣṭuṃ gantumiyeṣa saḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
तथेत्युक्त्वा गते तस्मिन्भृगुवर्यो महोदरे /
कृतकृत्यो गुरुजनं द्रष्टुं गन्तुमियेष सः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / When Mahodara had departed after saying ‘So be it,’ that best of Bhṛgus, / having accomplished his purpose, desired to go and see his elders.

sanskrit_iast:
gacchannatha tadāsau tu himādrivanagahvare /
viveśa kandaraṃ rāmo bhāvikarmapracoditaḥ //
meaning:
गच्छन्नथ तदासौ तु हिमाद्रिवनगह्वरे /
विवेश कन्दरं रामो भाविकर्मप्रचोदितः //
text_mt: Proceeding then into a mountain forest retreat of the Himālaya, / Rāma entered a cave, impelled by his future destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra dadṛśe bālaṃ dhṛtaprāṇamanudrutam /
vyāghreṇa vipratanayaṃ rudantaṃ bhītabhītavat //
meaning:
स तत्र ददृशे बालं धृतप्राणमनुद्रुतम् /
व्याघ्रेण विप्रतनयं रुदन्तं भीतभीतवत् //
text_mt: There he saw a boy, a brāhmaṇa’s son, clinging to life, pursued / by a tiger, crying out in great terror.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvānukaṃpahṛdayastatparitrāṇakātaraḥ /
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti taṃ vyāghraṃ vadannuccairathānvayāt //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वानुकंपहृदयस्तत्परित्राणकातरः /
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति तं व्याघ्रं वदन्नुच्चैरथान्वयात् //
text_mt: Seeing [this], his heart filled with compassion and anxious to rescue him, / he pursued [the beast], shouting loudly at the tiger: 'Stop! Stop!'

sanskrit_iast:
tamanudrutya vegena cirādiva bhṛgūdvahaḥ /
āsasāda vane ghoraṃ śārdūlamatibhīṣaṇam //
meaning:
तमनुद्रुत्य वेगेन चिरादिव भृगूद्वहः /
आससाद वने घोरं शार्दूलमतिभीषणम् //
text_mt: Pursuing it swiftly, as if taking a long time, the upholder of the Bhṛgu race / reached the terrifying, dreadful tiger in the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāghreṇānudrutaḥ so 'pi palāyanvanagahvare /
nipapāta dvijasutastrastaḥ prāṇabhayāturaḥ //
meaning:
व्याघ्रेणानुद्रुतः सो ऽपि पलायन्वनगह्वरे /
निपपात द्विजसुतस्त्रस्तः प्राणभयातुरः //
text_mt: Pursued by the tiger, fleeing in the forest thicket, / the son of the twice-born fell, terrified and overcome with fear for his life.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi krodharaktākṣo vipraputraparīpsayā /
tṛṇamūlaṃ samādāya kuśāstreṇābhyamantrayat //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि क्रोधरक्ताक्षो विप्रपुत्रपरीप्सया /
तृणमूलं समादाय कुशास्त्रेणाभ्यमन्त्रयत् //
text_mt: Rāma too, his eyes red with anger, wishing to rescue the son of the brahmin, / took up the root of a blade of grass and consecrated it with a missile mantra over a kuśa grass.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvattarakṣurbalavānādravatpatitaṃ dvijam /
dṛṣṭvā nanādasubhṛśaṃ rodasī kampayanniva //
meaning:
तावत्तरक्षुर्बलवानाद्रवत्पतितं द्विजम् /
दृष्ट्वा ननादसुभृशं रोदसी कम्पयन्निव //
text_mt: Meanwhile the powerful hyena ran toward the fallen twice-born; / seeing him, it roared intensely, as if shaking heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā tvastrāgninā vyāghraṃ praharantaṃ nakhāṅkuraiḥ /
akṛtavraṇamevāśu mokṣayāmāsa taṃ dvijam //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा त्वस्त्राग्निना व्याघ्रं प्रहरन्तं नखाङ्कुरैः /
अकृतव्रणमेवाशु मोक्षयामास तं द्विजम् //
text_mt: Having burned with the fire of the missile the tiger as it struck with its claw-tips, / he quickly rescued the twice-born without a single wound.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi brahmāgninirdagdhadehaḥ pāpmā nabhastale /
gāndharvaṃ vapurāsthāya rāmamāheti sādaram //
meaning:
सो ऽपि ब्रह्माग्निनिर्दग्धदेहः पाप्मा नभस्तले /
गान्धर्वं वपुरास्थाय राममाहेति सादरम् //
text_mt: With his body consumed by the fire of the missile, that evil [creature] in the sky / assumed a Gandharva form and respectfully said to Rāma:

sanskrit_iast:
vipraśāpena bhopūrvamahaṃ prāptastarakṣutām /
gacchāmi mocitaḥ śāpāttvayāhamadhunā divam //
meaning:
विप्रशापेन भोपूर्वमहं प्राप्तस्तरक्षुताम् /
गच्छामि मोचितः शापात्त्वयाहमधुना दिवम् //
text_mt: 'O hero, formerly through a brahmin's curse I fell into being a hyena; / freed from the curse by you, I now depart for heaven.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tu gate tasminrāmo vegena vismitaḥ /
patitaṃ dvijaputraṃ taṃ kṛpayā vyavapadyata //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तु गते तस्मिन्रामो वेगेन विस्मितः /
पतितं द्विजपुत्रं तं कृपया व्यवपद्यत //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, when he had departed swiftly, Rāma, filled with wonder, / approached the fallen son of the twice-born with pity.

sanskrit_iast:
mābhairevaṃ vadanvāṇīmārādeva dvijātmajam /
paramṛśattadaṅgāni śanairujjīvayannṛpa //
meaning:
माभैरेवं वदन्वाणीमारादेव द्विजात्मजम् /
परमृशत्तदङ्गानि शनैरुज्जीवयन्नृप //
text_mt: Saying 'Do not fear!' with words from close by, O king, / he touched the limbs of the son of the twice-born, slowly reviving him.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇotthāpitaścaivaṃ sa tadonmīlya locane /
vilokayandadarśāgre bhṛguśreṣṭhamavasthitam //
meaning:
रामेणोत्थापितश्चैवं स तदोन्मील्य लोचने /
विलोकयन्ददर्शाग्रे भृगुश्रेष्ठमवस्थितम् //
text_mt: Raised up thus by Rāma, he opened his eyes then; / looking around, he saw the best of the Bhṛgus standing before him.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmīkṛtaṃ ca śārdūlaṃ dṛṣṭavā vismayamāgataḥ /
gatabhīrāha kastvaṃ bhoḥ kathaṃ veha samāgataḥ //
meaning:
भस्मीकृतं च शार्दूलं दृष्टवा विस्मयमागतः /
गतभीराह कस्त्वं भोः कथं वेह समागतः //
text_mt: And seeing the tiger turned to ashes, he was filled with wonder; / his fear dispelled, he said: 'Who are you, sir, and how did you come here?

sanskrit_iast:
kena vāyaṃ nihantuṃ māmudyato bhasmasātkṛtaḥ /
tarakṣurbhīṣaṇākāraḥ sākṣānmṛtyurivāparaḥ //
meaning:
केन वायं निहन्तुं मामुद्यतो भस्मसात्कृतः /
तरक्षुर्भीषणाकारः साक्षान्मृत्युरिवापरः //
text_mt: Or by whom was this [beast], who was intent on killing me, reduced to ashes— / this hyena of dreadful appearance, like Death himself incarnate?

sanskrit_iast:
bhayasaṃmūḍhamanamo mamādyāpi mahāmate /
hate 'pi tasminnakhilā bhānti vai tanmayā diśaḥ //
meaning:
भयसंमूढमनमो ममाद्यापि महामते /
हते ऽपि तस्मिन्नखिला भान्ति वै तन्मया दिशः //
text_mt: Even now my mind is confounded with fear, O great-minded one; / even though it is slain, all directions seem to me full of it.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāmeva manye sakalaṃ pitā mātā sutdṛdgurū /
paramāpadamāpannaṃ tvaṃ māṃ samupajīvayan //
meaning:
त्वामेव मन्ये सकलं पिता माता सुत्दृद्गुरू /
परमापदमापन्नं त्वं मां समुपजीवयन् //
text_mt: I consider you my all—father, mother, friend, and guru— / since you brought me back to life when I had fallen into the greatest calamity.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīnmunivaraḥ kaścicchānto nāma mahātapāḥ /
putrastasyāsmi tīrthārthī śālagrāmamayāsiṣam //
meaning:
आसीन्मुनिवरः कश्चिच्छान्तो नाम महातपाः /
पुत्रस्तस्यास्मि तीर्थार्थी शालग्राममयासिषम् //
text_mt: There was a certain excellent sage named Śānta of great asceticism; / I am his son; seeking holy sites, I traveled to Śālagrāma.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsaṃprasthitaśśailaṃ didṛkṣurgandhamādanam /
nānāmunigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ puṇyaṃ badarikāśramam //
meaning:
तस्मात्संप्रस्थितश्शैलं दिदृक्षुर्गन्धमादनम् /
नानामुनिगणैर्जुष्टं पुण्यं बदरिकाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Having set out from there, desiring to see Mount Gandhamādana / and the sacred hermitage of Badarī, frequented by hosts of various sages,

sanskrit_iast:
gantukāmo 'pahāyāhaṃ panthānaṃ tu himācale /
praviśangahanaṃ ramyaṃ pradeśālokanākulam //
meaning:
गन्तुकामो ऽपहायाहं पन्थानं तु हिमाचले /
प्रविशन्गहनं रम्यं प्रदेशालोकनाकुलम् //
text_mt: wishing to go, I left the path in the Himālayas / and entered a lovely thicket, eager to behold the region.

sanskrit_iast:
diśaṃprācīṃ samuddiśya krośamātramayāsiṣam /
tato diṣṭavaśenāhaṃ prādravaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
दिशंप्राचीं समुद्दिश्य क्रोशमात्रमयासिषम् /
ततो दिष्टवशेनाहं प्राद्रवं भयपीडितः //
text_mt: Directing myself toward the eastern direction, I went just a krośa; / then, by the power of destiny, I ran, afflicted with fear,

sanskrit_iast:
patitaśca tvayā bhūyobhūmerutthāpito 'dhunā /
pitreva nitarāṃ putraḥ premṇātyarthaṃ dayālunā /
ityeṣa mama vṛttāntaḥ sākalyenoditastava //
meaning:
पतितश्च त्वया भूयोभूमेरुत्थापितो ऽधुना /
पित्रेव नितरां पुत्रः प्रेम्णात्यर्थं दयालुना /
इत्येष मम वृत्तान्तः साकल्येनोदितस्तव //
text_mt: and having fallen, I was just now lifted up from the ground by you / like a son by an exceedingly compassionate father out of great affection. / Thus my entire story has been told to you.'

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti pṛṣṭastadā tena svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ /
kathayāmāsa rājendra rāmastasmai yathākramam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति पृष्टस्तदा तेन स्ववृत्तान्तमशेषतः /
कथयामास राजेन्द्र रामस्तस्मै यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Asked thus by him at that time, O best of kings, Rāma / related to him in due order his own entire story.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastau prītisaṃyuktau kathayantau parasparam /
sthitvā nāticiraṃ kālamatha gantumiyeṣa saḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तौ प्रीतिसंयुक्तौ कथयन्तौ परस्परम् /
स्थित्वा नातिचिरं कालमथ गन्तुमियेष सः //
text_mt: Then the two of them, filled with affection, conversing with one another / after remaining for a short time, then he wished to depart.

sanskrit_iast:
anvīyamānastenātha rāmastasmādguhāmukhāt /
niṣkramyāvasathaṃ pitroḥ saṃpratasthe mudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अन्वीयमानस्तेनाथ रामस्तस्माद्गुहामुखात् /
निष्क्रम्यावसथं पित्रोः संप्रतस्थे मुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Followed by him, Rāma then emerged from the mouth of that cave / and set out with joy for the dwelling of his parents.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇa evāsau vyāghreṇa bhuvi pātitaḥ /
rāmeṇa rakṣitaścābhudyasmāddhyāghraṃ vinighnatā //
meaning:
अकृतव्रण एवासौ व्याघ्रेण भुवि पातितः /
रामेण रक्षितश्चाभुद्यस्माद्ध्याघ्रं विनिघ्नता //
text_mt: Because he was cast down on the ground by the tiger entirely without a wound (akṛtavraṇa), / and was protected by Rāma who slew the tiger,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttadeva nāmāsya babhūva prathitaṃ bhuvi /
vipraputrasya rājendra tadetatso 'kṛtavraṇaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्तदेव नामास्य बभूव प्रथितं भुवि /
विप्रपुत्रस्य राजेन्द्र तदेतत्सो ऽकृतव्रणः //
text_mt: therefore that very name became renowned on earth / for that son of the brahmin, O best of kings—namely Akṛtavraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prabhṛti rāmasya cchāyevātapagā bhuvi /
babhūva mitramatyarthaṃ sarvāvasthāsu pārthiva //
meaning:
तदा प्रभृति रामस्य च्छायेवातपगा भुवि /
बभूव मित्रमत्यर्थं सर्वावस्थासु पार्थिव //
text_mt: From that time forward, on earth like a shadow fleeing the heat, / he became his extraordinary friend in all circumstances, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tenānugato rājanbhṛgorāsādya sannidhim /
dṛṣṭvā khyātiṃ ca so 'bhyetya vinayenābhyavādayat //
meaning:
स तेनानुगतो राजन्भृगोरासाद्य सन्निधिम् /
दृष्ट्वा ख्यातिं च सो ऽभ्येत्य विनयेनाभ्यवादयत् //
text_mt: Accompanied by him, O king, having reached the presence of Bhṛgu / and seeing Khyāti, he approached and saluted with humility.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tābhyāṃ priyamāṇābhyāmāśīrbhirabhinanditaḥ /
dināni katicittatra nyavasattatpriyepsayā //
meaning:
स ताभ्यां प्रियमाणाभ्यामाशीर्भिरभिनन्दितः /
दिनानि कतिचित्तत्र न्यवसत्तत्प्रियेप्सया //
text_mt: Welcomed with blessings by the two who loved him, / he dwelt there for some days, seeking their pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastayoranumate cyavanasya mahāmuneḥ /
āśramaṃ praticakrāma śiṣyasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtam //
meaning:
ततस्तयोरनुमते च्यवनस्य महामुनेः /
आश्रमं प्रतिचक्राम शिष्यसंघैः समावृतम् //
text_mt: Then, with the permission of both, he proceeded toward the hermitage / of the great sage Cyavana, surrounded by hosts of disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
niyantritāntaḥ karaṇaṃ taṃ ca saṃśāntamānasam /
sukanyācāpi tadbhāryāmavandata mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
नियन्त्रितान्तः करणं तं च संशान्तमानसम् /
सुकन्याचापि तद्भार्यामवन्दत महामनाः //
text_mt: The high-minded one saluted him whose inner faculty was restrained, whose mind was completely tranquil, / and also his wife, Sukanyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhyāṃ ca prītiyuktābhyāṃ rāmaḥ samabhinanditaḥ /
aurvāśramaṃ samāpede draṣṭukāmastaponidhim //
meaning:
ताभ्यां च प्रीतियुक्ताभ्यां रामः समभिनन्दितः /
और्वाश्रमं समापेदे द्रष्टुकामस्तपोनिधिम् //
text_mt: Greeted with affection by the two of them, Rāma / went to the hermitage of Ūrva, wishing to see the storehouse of ascetic power.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ cābhivādya medhāvī tena ca pratinanditaḥ /
uvāsa tatra tatprītyā dināni katicinnṛpa //
meaning:
तं चाभिवाद्य मेधावी तेन च प्रतिनन्दितः /
उवास तत्र तत्प्रीत्या दिनानि कतिचिन्नृप //
text_mt: Having saluted him and been greeted in return by him, the wise one / dwelt there for some days out of affection for him, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛṣṭastena śanakairṛcīkabhavanaṃ mudā /
pratasthe bhārgavaḥ śrīmānakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
विसृष्टस्तेन शनकैरृचीकभवनं मुदा /
प्रतस्थे भार्गवः श्रीमानकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt: Permitted by him to leave, the glorious Bhārgava, together with Akṛtavraṇa, / set out slowly and gladly for the dwelling of Ṛcīka.

sanskrit_iast:
avandata pituḥ pitrornatvā pādau pṛthak pṛthak /
tau ca taṃ nṛpa saṃharṣāccāśiṣā pratyanandatām //
meaning:
अवन्दत पितुः पित्रोर्नत्वा पादौ पृथक् पृथक् /
तौ च तं नृप संहर्षाच्चाशिषा प्रत्यनन्दताम् //
text_mt: Bowing down, he saluted the feet of his father's parents individually, / and the two of them with great delight greeted him with blessings, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṣṭaśca tābhyāmakhilaṃ nijavṛttamudāradhīḥ /
kathayāmāsa rājendra yathāvṛttamanukramāt //
meaning:
पृष्टश्च ताभ्यामखिलं निजवृत्तमुदारधीः /
कथयामास राजेन्द्र यथावृत्तमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: Asked by the two of them about his entire story, the generous-minded one, / O best of kings, related what had happened in proper sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā dināni katicittatrāpi tadanujñayā /
jagāmāvasathaṃ pitrormudā paramayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
स्थित्वा दिनानि कतिचित्तत्रापि तदनुज्ञया /
जगामावसथं पित्रोर्मुदा परमया युतः //
text_mt: Having stayed there too for a few days, with their permission, / he went to the dwelling of his parents, filled with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyetya pitarau rājannāsī nāvāśramottame /
avandata tayoḥ pādau yathāvadbhṛgunandana //
meaning:
अभ्येत्य पितरौ राजन्नासी नावाश्रमोत्तमे /
अवन्दत तयोः पादौ यथावद्भृगुनन्दन //
text_mt: Approaching his parents, O king, who were seated in the excellent hermitage, / the descendant of Bhṛgu duly saluted their feet.

sanskrit_iast:
pādapraṇāmāvanataṃ samutthāpya ca sādaram /
āśliṣya netrasalilairnandantau paryaṣiñcatām //
meaning:
पादप्रणामावनतं समुत्थाप्य च सादरम् /
आश्लिष्य नेत्रसलिलैर्नन्दन्तौ पर्यषिञ्चताम् //
text_mt: Raising him respectfully as he bowed in salutation at their feet, / embracing him, rejoicing, they sprinkled him with tears from their eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
āśīrbhirabhinandyāṅke samāropya suhurmukham /
vikṣantau tasya cāṅgāni parispṛśyāpaturmudam //
meaning:
आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्याङ्के समारोप्य सुहुर्मुखम् /
विक्षन्तौ तस्य चाङ्गानि परिस्पृश्यापतुर्मुदम् //
text_mt: Welcoming him with blessings, placing him on their laps, gazing again and again at his face, / and touching his limbs, they attained joy.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛcchatāñca tau rāmaṃ kalenaitāvatā tvayā /
kiṃ kṛtaṃ putra ko vāyaṃ kutra vā tvamupasthitaḥ //
meaning:
अपृच्छताञ्च तौ रामं कलेनैतावता त्वया /
किं कृतं पुत्र को वायं कुत्र वा त्वमुपस्थितः //
text_mt: And the two asked Rāma: 'During this long time, / what was done by you, son? Who is this [companion]? Where have you been staying?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ saha sakāśe tvamāsthito vātra vāgataḥ /
tvayetadakhilaṃ vatsa kathyatāṃ tathyamāvayoḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne bhārgavacarite pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 25//
meaning:
कथं सह सकाशे त्वमास्थितो वात्र वागतः /
त्वयेतदखिलं वत्स कथ्यतां तथ्यमावयोः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने भार्गवचरिते पञ्चविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 25//
text_mt:
How is it that you dwelt in company or arrived here? / Let all this be told truly to us by you, dear child.'

Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Deeds of the Bhārgava' in the Story of Arjuna, in the Upoddhātapāda, the third middle section in the great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭha uvāca
iti pṛṣṭastadā tābhyāṃ rāmo rājankṛtāñjaliḥ /
tayorakathayatsarvamātmanā yadanuṣṭhitam //
meaning:
वशिष्ठ उवाच
इति पृष्टस्तदा ताभ्यां रामो राजन्कृताञ्जलिः /
तयोरकथयत्सर्वमात्मना यदनुष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Asked thus by the two of them at that time, O king, Rāma with palms joined in reverence / told them all that he had performed himself:

sanskrit_iast:
nideśādvai kulagurostapaścaraṇamātmanaḥ /
śaṃbhornideśāttīrthānāmaṭanaṃ ca yathākramam //
meaning:
निदेशाद्वै कुलगुरोस्तपश्चरणमात्मनः /
शंभोर्निदेशात्तीर्थानामटनं च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: the practice of his own austerities by the instruction of the family guru, / and the wandering to sacred sites in due order by the instruction of Śambhu,

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñayaiva daityanāṃ vadhaṃ cāmarakāraṇāt /
haraprasādādatrāpi hyakṛtavraṇadarśanam //
meaning:
तदाज्ञयैव दैत्यनां वधं चामरकारणात् /
हरप्रसादादत्रापि ह्यकृतव्रणदर्शनम् //
text_mt: and by his command alone the slaying of the Daityas for the sake of the immortals, / and also by Hara's grace the meeting with Akṛtavraṇa here.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yadanyaccātmanā kṛtam /
kathayāmāsa tadrāmaḥ pitroḥ saṃprīyamāṇayoḥ //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वमशेषेण यदन्यच्चात्मना कृतम् /
कथयामास तद्रामः पित्रोः संप्रीयमाणयोः //
text_mt: All this in its entirety, and whatever else he had done himself, / Rāma narrated to his parents, who were greatly pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
tau ca tenoditaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā tatkarma vistaram /
hṛṣṭau harṣāntaraṃ bhūyo rājannāpnuvatāvubhau //
meaning:
तौ च तेनोदितं सर्वं श्रुत्वा तत्कर्म विस्तरम् /
हृष्टौ हर्षान्तरं भूयो राजन्नाप्नुवतावुभौ //
text_mt: And hearing all that had been related by him, the detail of that deed, / both of them, delighted, attained even further joy, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pitrormahārāja śuśrūṣāṃ bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ /
prakurvaṃstadvidheyātmā bhrātṝṇāṃ cāviśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
एवं पित्रोर्महाराज शुश्रूषां भृगुपुङ्गवः /
प्रकुर्वंस्तद्विधेयात्मा भ्रातॄणां चाविशेषतः //
text_mt: Thus, O great king, the foremost of the Bhṛgus, whose mind was obedient to them, / performed service to his parents and equally to his brothers.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu kadāciddhaihayeśvaraḥ /
ityeṣa mṛgayāṃ gāntuṃ caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कदाचिद्धैहयेश्वरः /
इत्येष मृगयां गान्तुं चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः //
text_mt: At that very time, once, the lord of the Haihayas, / accompanied by his fourfold army, went out to hunt.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrajyamāne gagane bandhūkakusumāruṇaiḥ /
tārājāladyutiharaiḥ samantādaruṇāṃśubhiḥ //
meaning:
संरज्यमाने गगने बन्धूककुसुमारुणैः /
ताराजालद्युतिहरैः समन्तादरुणांशुभिः //
text_mt: As the sky was colored red like bandhūka blossoms / by the crimson rays on all sides that took away the brilliance of the multitude of stars,

sanskrit_iast:
mandaṃ vījati proddhūtaketakīvanarājibhiḥ /
prābhātike gandhavahe kumudākarasaṃspṛśi //
meaning:
मन्दं वीजति प्रोद्धूतकेतकीवनराजिभिः /
प्राभातिके गन्धवहे कुमुदाकरसंस्पृशि //
text_mt: while the morning wind blew gently, shaking rows of ketakī thickets / and touching beds of water lilies,

sanskrit_iast:
vayāṃsi narmadātīratarunīḍāśrayeṣu ca /
vyāharansvākulā vāco manaḥśrotrasukhāvahāḥ //
meaning:
वयांसि नर्मदातीरतरुनीडाश्रयेषु च /
व्याहरन्स्वाकुला वाचो मनःश्रोत्रसुखावहाः //
text_mt: and the birds in the nests resting on the trees of the Narmadā's bank / uttered sweet calls that brought joy to mind and ear,

sanskrit_iast:
narmadātīratīrthaṃ tadavatīryāghahāriṇi /
tattoye munivṛndeṣu gṛṇātsubrahma śāśvatam //
meaning:
नर्मदातीरतीर्थं तदवतीर्याघहारिणि /
तत्तोये मुनिवृन्देषु गृणात्सुब्रह्म शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: the crowds of sages having descended to that sacred ford on the bank of the Narmadā, / in its sin-destroying water, chanted the eternal Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivatkṛtamaitreṣu sannivṛtya sarittaṭāt /
āśamaṃ prati gacchatsu munimukhyeṣu karmiṣu //
meaning:
विधिवत्कृतमैत्रेषु सन्निवृत्य सरित्तटात् /
आशमं प्रति गच्छत्सु मुनिमुख्येषु कर्मिषु //
text_mt: and the foremost sages, dutiful in rites, having duly performed their morning prayers, / returned from the riverbank and were walking toward the hermitage,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ vīrapatnīṣu vyagrāsu gṛhakarmasu /
homārthaṃ munikalpābhirduhyamānāsu dhenuṣu //
meaning:
प्रत्येकं वीरपत्नीषु व्यग्रासु गृहकर्मसु /
होमार्थं मुनिकल्पाभिर्दुह्यमानासु धेनुषु //
text_mt: while the wives of the heroes were individually occupied with domestic chores, / and cows were being milked by those resembling sages for the oblation,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne munikumāreṣu taṃ dohaṃ hi nayatsu ca /
agnihotrākule jāte sarvabhūtasukhāvahe //
meaning:
स्थाने मुनिकुमारेषु तं दोहं हि नयत्सु च /
अग्निहोत्राकुले जाते सर्वभूतसुखावहे //
text_mt: and the young sons of sages carried that milk to the sacred place, / and the agnihotra fires, bringing joy to all beings, became fully active,

sanskrit_iast:
vikasatsu sarojeṣu gāyatsu bhramareṣu ca /
vāśatsu nīḍānniṣpatya patatriṣu samantataḥ //
meaning:
विकसत्सु सरोजेषु गायत्सु भ्रमरेषु च /
वाशत्सु नीडान्निष्पत्य पतत्रिषु समन्ततः //
text_mt: while lotus flowers bloomed and bees hummed, / and birds flew out from their nests on all sides, chirping,

sanskrit_iast:
anati vyagramattebhaturaṅgarathagāminām /
gātrālhādavivarddhanyāṃ velāyāṃ mandavāyunā //
meaning:
अनति व्यग्रमत्तेभतुरङ्गरथगामिनाम् /
गात्राल्हादविवर्द्धन्यां वेलायां मन्दवायुना //
text_mt: at that hour when the gentle breeze increased the bodily vigor / of the riders on not-too-hurried rutting elephants, horses, and chariots,

sanskrit_iast:
gacchatsu cāśramopāntaṃ prasūnajalahāriṣu /
svādhyā yadakṣairbahubhirajināṃbaradhāribhiḥ //
meaning:
गच्छत्सु चाश्रमोपान्तं प्रसूनजलहारिषु /
स्वाध्या यदक्षैर्बहुभिरजिनांबरधारिभिः //
text_mt: and many wearing deer-skin garments and skilled in recitation / were going to the edge of the hermitage carrying flowers and water,

sanskrit_iast:
samyak prayojyamāneṣu mantreṣūccāvaceṣu ca /
praiṣeṣūccāryamāṇeṣu hūyamāneṣu vahniṣu //
meaning:
सम्यक् प्रयोज्यमानेषु मन्त्रेषूच्चावचेषु च /
प्रैषेषूच्चार्यमाणेषु हूयमानेषु वह्निषु //
text_mt: and higher and lower mantras were being properly recited, / liturgical directions were being chanted, and oblations were being cast into fires,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā vanmantratantroktakriyāsu vitatāsu ca /
jvaladagniśikhākāre tamastapanatejasi //
meaning:
यथा वन्मन्त्रतन्त्रोक्तक्रियासु विततासु च /
ज्वलदग्निशिखाकारे तमस्तपनतेजसि //
text_mt: and rites prescribed by mantras and tantras were being performed according to rule; / when the splendour of the sun, having the form of a blazing tongue of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
pratihatya diśaḥ sarvā vivṛṇvāne ca medinīm /
savitaryudayaṃ yāti naiśe tamasi naśyati //
meaning:
प्रतिहत्य दिशः सर्वा विवृण्वाने च मेदिनीम् /
सवितर्युदयं याति नैशे तमसि नश्यति //
text_mt: repelled darkness from all directions and revealed the earth, / and as the sun arose and the darkness of night vanished,

sanskrit_iast:
tārakāsu vilīnāsu kāṣṭhāsu vimalāsu ca /
kṛtamaitrādiko rājā mṛgayāṃ haihayeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तारकासु विलीनासु काष्ठासु विमलासु च /
कृतमैत्रादिको राजा मृगयां हैहयेश्वरः //
text_mt: the stars having faded and the quarters having cleared, / the king, the lord of the Haihayas, having performed his morning prayer and other rites, to hunt

sanskrit_iast:
niryayau nagarāttasmātpurohitasamanvitaḥ /
balaiḥ sarvaiḥ samuditaiḥ savājirathakuñjaraiḥ //
meaning:
निर्ययौ नगरात्तस्मात्पुरोहितसमन्वितः /
बलैः सर्वैः समुदितैः सवाजिरथकुञ्जरैः //
text_mt: went out from that city accompanied by his family priest, / with all his collected forces, accompanied by horses, chariots, and elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
sacivaḥ sahitaḥ śrīmān savayobhiśca rājabhiḥ /
mahatā balabhāreṇa namayanvasudhātalam //
meaning:
सचिवः सहितः श्रीमान् सवयोभिश्च राजभिः /
महता बलभारेण नमयन्वसुधातलम् //
text_mt: the glorious one accompanied by ministers and kings of his own age, / making the surface of the earth bend beneath the great burden of his army,

sanskrit_iast:
nādayanrathaghoṣeṇa kakubhaḥ sarvato nṛpaḥ /
svabalaughapadakṣepaprakṣuṇṇāvanireṇubhiḥ //
meaning:
नादयन्रथघोषेण ककुभः सर्वतो नृपः /
स्वबलौघपदक्षेपप्रक्षुण्णावनिरेणुभिः //
text_mt: making the directions resound on every side with the roar of chariots, the king, / with the dust of the earth crushed under the tread of his host of troops

sanskrit_iast:
yayau saṃcchādayanvyoma vimānaśatasaṃkulam /
saṃpravaśya vanaṃ ghoraṃ vindhyodrerbalasaṃcayaiḥ //
meaning:
ययौ संच्छादयन्व्योम विमानशतसंकुलम् /
संप्रवश्य वनं घोरं विन्ध्योद्रेर्बलसंचयैः //
text_mt: went, covering the sky crowded with hundreds of aerial vehicles; / and entering the dread forest of the Vindhya mountain with his collected forces,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛśaṃ vilolayā māsa samantādrājasattamaḥ /
parivārya vanaṃ tattu sa rājā nijasainikaiḥ //
meaning:
भृशं विलोलया मास समन्ताद्राजसत्तमः /
परिवार्य वनं तत्तु स राजा निजसैनिकैः //
text_mt: the best of kings stirred it up violently on all sides; / having encircled that forest with his own soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgānnānāvidhānhiṃsrānnijaghāna śitaiḥ śaraiḥ /
ākarṇakṛṣṭakodaṇḍayodhamuktaiḥ śiteṣubhiḥ //
meaning:
मृगान्नानाविधान्हिंस्रान्निजघान शितैः शरैः /
आकर्णकृष्टकोदण्डयोधमुक्तैः शितेषुभिः //
text_mt: that king struck down various kinds of fierce wild beasts with sharp arrows. / With sharp arrows released by warriors drawing their bows to the ear,

sanskrit_iast:
nikṛttagātrāḥ śārdūlā nyapatanbhuvi kecana /
udagravegapādātakhaḍgakhaṇḍitavigrahāḥ //
meaning:
निकृत्तगात्राः शार्दूला न्यपतन्भुवि केचन /
उदग्रवेगपादातखड्गखण्डितविग्रहाः //
text_mt: tigers whose limbs were severed fell to the ground; / their bodies cleaved by the swords of swiftly charging foot-soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
varāhayūthapāḥ kecidrudhirārdrā dharāmaguḥ /
pracaṇḍaśāktikonmuktaśaktinirbhinnamastakāḥ //
meaning:
वराहयूथपाः केचिद्रुधिरार्द्रा धरामगुः /
प्रचण्डशाक्तिकोन्मुक्तशक्तिनिर्भिन्नमस्तकाः //
text_mt: some leader boars covered in blood fell to the earth; / their skulls shattered by spears hurled by fierce spearmen,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaughāḥ pratyapadyanta parvatā iva medinīm /
nārācā viddhasarvāṅgāḥ siṃharkṣaśarabhādayaḥ //
meaning:
मृगौघाः प्रत्यपद्यन्त पर्वता इव मेदिनीम् /
नाराचा विद्धसर्वाङ्गाः सिंहर्क्षशरभादयः //
text_mt: herds of beasts collapsed to the ground like mountains; / with all their limbs pierced by iron shafts, lions, bears, śarabhas, and other beasts

sanskrit_iast:
vasudhāmanvakīryanta śoṇitārdrāḥ samantataḥ /
evaṃ savāguraiḥ kaiścitpatadbhiḥ patitairapi //
meaning:
वसुधामन्वकीर्यन्त शोणितार्द्राः समन्ततः /
एवं सवागुरैः कैश्चित्पतद्भिः पतितैरपि //
text_mt: fell scattered upon the earth, drenched in blood on all sides. / Thus, with some caught in nets, some falling, and others already fallen,

sanskrit_iast:
śvabhiścānudrutaiḥ kaiściddhāvamānaistathā mṛgaiḥ /
āttairvikrośamānaiśca bhītaiḥ prāṇabhayāturaiḥ //
meaning:
श्वभिश्चानुद्रुतैः कैश्चिद्धावमानैस्तथा मृगैः /
आत्तैर्विक्रोशमानैश्च भीतैः प्राणभयातुरैः //
text_mt: with some pursued by hounds, and with beasts fleeing in that manner, / seized, screaming, terrified, and tormented by fear for their lives,

sanskrit_iast:
yugāpāye yathātyarthaṃ vanamākulamābabhau /
varāhasiṃhaśārdūlaśvāvicchaśakulāni ca //
meaning:
युगापाये यथात्यर्थं वनमाकुलमाबभौ /
वराहसिंहशार्दूलश्वाविच्छशकुलानि च //
text_mt: the forest appeared exceedingly agitated, as at the end of an age. / And herds of boars, lions, tigers, porcupines, hares,

sanskrit_iast:
camarīrurugomāyugavayarkṣavṛkānbahūn /
kṛṣṇasārāndvīpimṛgānraktakhaḍgamṛgānavi //
meaning:
चमरीरुरुगोमायुगवयर्क्षवृकान्बहून् /
कृष्णसारान्द्वीपिमृगान्रक्तखड्गमृगानवि //
text_mt: camarī cows, ruru deer, jackals, gavayas, bears, many wolves, / blackbucks, leopards, and rhinoceroses,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrāṅgānmṛgānanyānnyaṅkūnapi ca sarvaśaḥ /
bālānstanandhayānyūnaḥ sthavirānmithunāngaṇān //
meaning:
विचित्राङ्गान्मृगानन्यान्न्यङ्कूनपि च सर्वशः /
बालान्स्तनन्धयान्यूनः स्थविरान्मिथुनान्गणान् //
text_mt: spotted deer, other varied animals, and gazelles on every side— / the young, the sucklings, the mature, the aged, and groups of mated pairs—

sanskrit_iast:
nijaghnurniśitaiḥ śastraiḥ śastravadhyānhi sainikāḥ /
evaṃ hatvā mṛgān ghorānhiṃsraprāyānaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
निजघ्नुर्निशितैः शस्त्रैः शस्त्रवध्यान्हि सैनिकाः /
एवं हत्वा मृगान् घोरान्हिंस्रप्रायानशेषतः //
text_mt: the soldiers slaughtered with sharp weapons, for they were fit to be killed by arms. / Having thus slain terrifying and mostly fierce beasts without remainder,

sanskrit_iast:
śrameṇa mahatā yuktā babhūvurnṛpasainikāḥ /
madhye dinakare prāpte sasainyaḥ sa tadā nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
श्रमेण महता युक्ता बभूवुर्नृपसैनिकाः /
मध्ये दिनकरे प्राप्ते ससैन्यः स तदा नृपः //
text_mt: the king’s soldiers were overcome by great exhaustion. / When the sun reached mid-day, that king with his army,

sanskrit_iast:
narmadāṃ dharmasaṃtaptaḥ pipāsuragamacchanaiḥ /
avatīya tatastasyāstoye sabalavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
नर्मदां धर्मसंतप्तः पिपासुरगमच्छनैः /
अवतीय ततस्तस्यास्तोये सबलवाहनः //
text_mt: scorched by heat and thirsty, approached the Narmadā slowly. / Then, descending into her waters along with his forces and mounts,

sanskrit_iast:
vijāgāha śubhe rājā kṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitaḥ /
snātvā pītvā ca salilaṃ sa tasyāḥ sukhaśītalam //
meaning:
विजागाह शुभे राजा क्षुत्तृष्णापरिपीडितः /
स्नात्वा पीत्वा च सलिलं स तस्याः सुखशीतलम् //
text_mt: afflicted by hunger and thirst, the king plunged into the auspicious [river]. / Having bathed and drunk her pleasantly cool water,

sanskrit_iast:
bisāṃkurāṇi śubhrāṇi svādūni prajaghāsa ca /
vikrīḍya toye suciramuttīrya sabalo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
बिसांकुराणि शुभ्राणि स्वादूनि प्रजघास च /
विक्रीड्य तोये सुचिरमुत्तीर्य सबलो नृपः //
text_mt: he ate sweet, white lotus shoots; / having disported for a long time in the water, the king emerged with his army

sanskrit_iast:
viśaśrāma ca tattīre tarukhaṇḍopamaṇḍite /
ālaṃbapāne tigmāṃśau sasainyaḥ sānugo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
विशश्राम च तत्तीरे तरुखण्डोपमण्डिते /
आलंबपाने तिग्मांशौ ससैन्यः सानुगो नृपः //
text_mt: and rested on its bank adorned with groves of trees. / When the hot-rayed sun began to sink, the king, accompanied by his troops and followers,

sanskrit_iast:
niścakrāma puraṃ gantuṃ vindhyādrivanagahvarāt /
sa gacchanneva dadṛśe narmadā tīramāśritam //
meaning:
निश्चक्राम पुरं गन्तुं विन्ध्याद्रिवनगह्वरात् /
स गच्छन्नेव ददृशे नर्मदा तीरमाश्रितम् //
text_mt: set forth to return to his capital from the forest-cavern of the Vindhya mountain. / As he was going, he saw on the bank of the Narmadā

sanskrit_iast:
āśramaṃ puṇyaśīlasya jamadagnermahātmanaḥ /
tato nivṛtya sainyāni dūre 'vasthāpya pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
आश्रमं पुण्यशीलस्य जमदग्नेर्महात्मनः /
ततो निवृत्य सैन्यानि दूरे ऽवस्थाप्य पार्थिवः //
text_mt: the hermitage of the high-souled Jamadagni of virtuous conduct. / Then the king turned back his troops, stationed them far away,

sanskrit_iast:
paricāraiḥ katipathaiḥ sahito 'yāttadāśamam /
gatvā tadāśramaṃ ramyaṃ purohitasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
परिचारैः कतिपथैः सहितो ऽयात्तदाशमम् /
गत्वा तदाश्रमं रम्यं पुरोहितसमन्वितः //
text_mt: and went to that hermitage accompanied by only a few attendants. / Having reached that lovely hermitage accompanied by his family priest,

sanskrit_iast:
upetya muniśārdūlaṃ nanāma śirasā nṛpaḥ /
abhinaṃ dyāśaṣā taṃ vai jamadagnirnṛpottamam //
meaning:
उपेत्य मुनिशार्दूलं ननाम शिरसा नृपः /
अभिनं द्याशषा तं वै जमदग्निर्नृपोत्तमम् //
text_mt: approaching the tiger among sages, the king bowed his head. / Welcoming that best of kings with a blessing, Jamadagni indeed

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayāmāsa vidhivadarghapādyāsanādibhiḥ /
saṃbhāvayitvā tāṃ pūjāṃ vihitāṃ muninā tadā //
meaning:
पूजयामास विधिवदर्घपाद्यासनादिभिः /
संभावयित्वा तां पूजां विहितां मुनिना तदा //
text_mt: honored him according to rule with arghya, water for washing feet, a seat, and other offerings. / Having accepted that worship performed then by the sage,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣasādāsane śubhra purastasya mahāmuneḥ /
tamāsīnaṃ nṛpavaraṃ kuśāsanagato muniḥ //
meaning:
निषसादासने शुभ्र पुरस्तस्य महामुनेः /
तमासीनं नृपवरं कुशासनगतो मुनिः //
text_mt: he sat down on a bright seat before that great sage. / To the excellent king seated there, the sage, seated on a kuśa grass seat,

sanskrit_iast:
papraccha kuśalapraśnaṃ putramitrādibandhuṣu /
saha saṃkathayaṃstena rājñā munivarottamaḥ //
meaning:
पप्रच्छ कुशलप्रश्नं पुत्रमित्रादिबन्धुषु /
सह संकथयंस्तेन राज्ञा मुनिवरोत्तमः //
text_mt: addressed inquiries of welfare concerning his sons, friends, and other kinsmen. / Conversing with that king, the foremost among the best of sages,

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā nāticiraṃ kālamātithyārthaṃ nyamantrayat /
tataḥ sa rājā suprīto jamadagni mabhāṣata //
meaning:
स्थित्वा नातिचिरं कालमातिथ्यार्थं न्यमन्त्रयत् /
ततः स राजा सुप्रीतो जमदग्नि मभाषत //
text_mt: having waited not very long, invited him to receive hospitality. / Thereupon, that delighted king spoke to Jamadagni:

sanskrit_iast:
maharṣe dehi me 'nujñāṃ gamiṣyāmi svakaṃ puram /
samagravāhanabalo hyahaṃ tasmānmahāmune //
meaning:
महर्षे देहि मे ऽनुज्ञां गमिष्यामि स्वकं पुरम् /
समग्रवाहनबलो ह्यहं तस्मान्महामुने //
text_mt: “O great sage, grant me permission; I shall go to my own city. / For I have my complete host of mounts and forces; therefore, O great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
kartu na śakyamā tithyaṃ tvayā vanyāśinā vane /
athavā tvaṃ tapaḥśaktyā kartumātithyamadya me //
meaning:
कर्तु न शक्यमा तिथ्यं त्वया वन्याशिना वने /
अथवा त्वं तपःशक्त्या कर्तुमातिथ्यमद्य मे //
text_mt: hospitality cannot be offered by you who subsist on forest fare in the forest. / Or even if you are able to offer me hospitality today by the power of your austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
śaknoṣyapi purīṃ gantuṃ māmanujñāturhasi /
anyathā cetkhalaiḥ sainyairatyarthaṃ munisattama //
meaning:
शक्नोष्यपि पुरीं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुर्हसि /
अन्यथा चेत्खलैः सैन्यैरत्यर्थं मुनिसत्तम //
text_mt: you ought to grant me leave to go to my city; / for otherwise, O best of sages, through unruly soldiers

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvināṃ bhavetpīḍā niyamakṣayakārikā /

text_mt: there would be harassment to the ascetics, causing the destruction of their religious vows.” / Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus addressed, that sage said to him: “Stay for a moment;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ saṃpādayithye 'hamātithyaṃ sānugasya te /
ityuktvāhūya tāṃ dogdhrīmuvācāyaṃ mamātithiḥ //

सर्वं संपादयिथ्ये ऽहमातिथ्यं सानुगस्य ते /
इत्युक्त्वाहूय तां दोग्ध्रीमुवाचायं ममातिथिः //
text_mt: I shall provide all hospitality for you along with your followers.” / Having said this, he summoned the milch cow and said: “This is my guest.

sanskrit_iast:

ityuktā muninā dogdhrī sātitheyamaśeṣataḥ /
dudoha nṛpaterāśu yadyogyaṃ munigauravāt //
meaning:
उपाग तस्त्वया तस्मात्क्रियतामद्य सत्कृतिः /
इत्युक्ता मुनिना दोग्ध्री सातिथेयमशेषतः /
दुदोह नृपतेराशु यद्योग्यं मुनिगौरवात् //
text_mt:
"He has arrived; therefore, show him hospitality today."
Having been thus addressed by the sage, that milch-cow, out of reverence for the sage, / quickly milked forth everything suitable for hospitality to the king in its entirety.

sanskrit_iast:
athāśramaṃ tatsurarājasadmanikāśamāsīdbhṛgupuṅgavasya /
vibhūtibhedairavicintyarupamananyasādhyaṃ surabhiprabhāvāt //

अथाश्रमं तत्सुरराजसद्मनिकाशमासीद्भृगुपुङ्गवस्य /
विभूतिभेदैरविचिन्त्यरुपमनन्यसाध्यं सुरभिप्रभावात् //
text_mt: Then the hermitage of that foremost of the Bhṛgus became like the dwelling of the king of gods, / having unimaginable forms through diverse splendors, impossible to accomplish by any other means, through the power of Surabhi.

sanskrit_iast:
anekaratnojjvalacitrahemaprakāśamālāparivītamuccaiḥ /
pūrṇenduśubhrābhraviṣaktaśṛṅgaiḥ prāsādasaṃghaiḥ parivītamantaḥ //
meaning:
अनेकरत्नोज्ज्वलचित्रहेमप्रकाशमालापरिवीतमुच्चैः /
पूर्णेन्दुशुभ्राभ्रविषक्तशृङ्गैः प्रासादसंघैः परिवीतमन्तः //
text_mt: It was completely surrounded on high by brilliant garlands of various jewels and bright gold, / and encompassed within by multitudes of mansions whose pinnacles touched clouds as bright as the full moon.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyārakūṭārasatāmrahemadurvarṇasaudho paladārumṛdbhiḥ /
pṛthagvimiśrairbhavanairanekaiḥ sadbhāsitaṃ netramanobhirāmaiḥ //
meaning:
कांस्यारकूटारसताम्रहेमदुर्वर्णसौधो पलदारुमृद्भिः /
पृथग्विमिश्रैर्भवनैरनेकैः सद्भासितं नेत्रमनोभिरामैः //
text_mt: It shone brightly with numerous buildings—delightful to the eyes and mind— / made separately and in combination of bronze, brass, iron, copper, gold, silver, stone, timber, and clay,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārharatnojjvalahemavedikāniṣkūṭasopānakuṭīviṭaṅkakaiḥ /
tulākapāṭargalakuḍyadehalīniśāntaśālājiraśobhitairbhṛśam //
meaning:
महार्हरत्नोज्ज्वलहेमवेदिकानिष्कूटसोपानकुटीविटङ्ककैः /
तुलाकपाटर्गलकुड्यदेहलीनिशान्तशालाजिरशोभितैर्भृशम् //
text_mt: Greatly adorned with alters of gold brilliant with priceless gems, with private pleasure-gardens, stairs, cottages, and eaves, / with beams, doors, bolts, walls, thresholds, inner apartments, halls, and courtyards,

sanskrit_iast:
valabhyalindāṅgapācārutoraṇairadabhraparyantacatuṣkikādibhiḥ /
staṃbheṣu kuḍyeṣu ca divyaratnavicitracitraiḥ pariśobhamānaiḥ //
meaning:
वलभ्यलिन्दाङ्गपाचारुतोरणैरदभ्रपर्यन्तचतुष्किकादिभिः /
स्तंभेषु कुड्येषु च दिव्यरत्नविचित्रचित्रैः परिशोभमानैः //
text_mt: With lovely arched gateways on upper chambers and porticos, with extensive surrounding quadrangles and the like, / and resplendent on its pillars and walls with variegated pictures made of heavenly gems,

sanskrit_iast:

sa bhakṣyabhojyādibhi rannapānairupetabhāṇḍopagataikadeśaiḥ //

उच्चावचै रत्नवरैर्विचित्रसुवर्णसिंहासनपीठिकाद्यैः /
स भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभि रन्नपानैरुपेतभाण्डोपगतैकदेशैः //
text_mt: With high and low golden thrones and pedestals inlaid with excellent, varied gems, / and with portions furnished with vessels supplied with foods to be chewed and eaten and drinks.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhairamartyocitasarvasaṃpatsamanvitairnetramano 'bhirāmaiḥ /
tasyāśramaṃ sannagaropamānaṃ babhau vadhūbhiścamanoharābhiḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 26//

गृहैरमर्त्योचितसर्वसंपत्समन्वितैर्नेत्रमनो ऽभिरामैः /
तस्याश्रमं सन्नगरोपमानं बभौ वधूभिश्चमनोहराभिः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने षड्विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 26//
text_mt:
With dwellings endowed with all splendors fit for immortals and delightful to the eyes and mind, / his hermitage, resembling an excellent city, shone with captivating women.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter in the story of Arjuna in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the holy and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:

वसिष्ठ उवाच
तस्मिन्पुरे सन्तुलितामरेद्रपुरीप्रभावे मुनिवर्यधेनुः /
विनिर्ममे तेषु गृहेषु पश्चात्तद्योग्यनारीनरवृन्दजातम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / In that city equal in power to the city of the king of gods, the sage's excellent cow / then created within those houses a multitude of women and men appropriate for them,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitraveṣābharaṇaprasūnagandhāṃśukālaṅkṛtavigrahābhiḥ /
sahāvabhāvābhirudāraceṣṭāśrīkāntisaundaryaguṇānvitābhiḥ //
meaning:
विचित्रवेषाभरणप्रसूनगन्धांशुकालङ्कृतविग्रहाभिः /
सहावभावाभिरुदारचेष्टाश्रीकान्तिसौन्दर्यगुणान्विताभिः //
text_mt: Whose bodies were adorned with diverse garments, ornaments, flowers, perfumes, and silks, / endowed with seductive gestures and emotions, noble actions, majesty, radiance, beauty, and virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
mandasphuraddantamarīcijāla vidyotitānanasarojajitendubhābhiḥ /
pratyagrayauvanabharāsavalgugīrbhiḥ sa premamantharakaṭākṣanirīkṣaṇābhiḥ //

text_mt: Whose lotus-faces surpassed the luster of the moon, illuminated by the flashes of their faintly gleaming teeth, / whose charming speech was rich with fresh youth, and who cast slow, affectionate side-glances,

sanskrit_iast:
prītiprasannahṛdayābhiratiprabhābhiḥ śṛṅgārakalpatarupuṣpavibhūṣitābhiḥ /
devāṅganātulitasaubhagasaukumāryarūpābhilāṣamadhurākṛtirañjitābhiḥ //

प्रीतिप्रसन्नहृदयाभिरतिप्रभाभिः शृङ्गारकल्पतरुपुष्पविभूषिताभिः /
देवाङ्गनातुलितसौभगसौकुमार्यरूपाभिलाषमधुराकृतिरञ्जिताभिः //
text_mt: Whose hearts were clear with delight, who possessed the splendor of Rati, adorned with the flowers of the wishing tree of love, / and who charmed with lovely forms that inspired desire, possessing loveliness and delicacy comparable to celestial maidens,

sanskrit_iast:
uttaptahemakalaśopamacārupīnavakṣoruhadvayabharānatamadhyamābhiḥ /
śroṇībharākramaṇakhedapariśritāsmṛgāraktapāvakarasāruṇitāṅghribhūbhiḥ //

उत्तप्तहेमकलशोपमचारुपीनवक्षोरुहद्वयभरानतमध्यमाभिः /
श्रोणीभराक्रमणखेदपरिश्रितास्मृगारक्तपावकरसारुणिताङ्घ्रिभूभिः //
text_mt: Whose waists bent under the weight of their pairs of lovely, swelling breasts resembling jars of heated gold, / the surfaces of whose feet were reddened by alaktaka dye and liquid red sap, weary from the burden of their heavy hips,

sanskrit_iast:
keyūrahāramaṇikaṅkaṇahema kaṇṭhasūtrāmalaśravaṇamaṇḍalamaṇḍitābhiḥ /
sragdāmacumbitasakuntalakeśapāśakāñcīkalāpapariśiñjitanūpurābhiḥ //
meaning:
केयूरहारमणिकङ्कणहेम कण्ठसूत्रामलश्रवणमण्डलमण्डिताभिः /
स्रग्दामचुम्बितसकुन्तलकेशपाशकाञ्चीकलापपरिशिञ्जितनूपुराभिः //
text_mt: Adorned with armlets, necklaces, jeweled bracelets, golden neck-chains, and spotless ear-ornaments, / whose braided hair with loose tresses was kissed by flower-garlands, and whose anklets tinkled along with their girdles,

sanskrit_iast:
āmṛṣṭaroṣaparisāṃtvananarmahāsakelīpriyālapanabhartsanaroṣaṇeṣu /
bhāveṣu pārthivanijapriyadhairyabandhasarvāpahāracatureṣu kṛtāntarābhiḥ //
meaning:
आमृष्टरोषपरिसांत्वननर्महासकेलीप्रियालपनभर्त्सनरोषणेषु /
भावेषु पार्थिवनिजप्रियधैर्यबन्धसर्वापहारचतुरेषु कृतान्तराभिः //
text_mt: Skilled in removing anger, comforting, joking, laughter, play, affectionate talk, reproaches, and indignation, / inwardly adept in every way at stealing the steadfastness of the king and their own lovers,

sanskrit_iast:
tantrīsvanopamitamañjulasaumyageyagandharvatāramadhurāravabhāṣiṇībhiḥ /
vīṇāpravīṇatarapāṇitalāṅgulībhirgaṃbhīracakracaṭuvādaratotsukābhiḥ //
meaning:
तन्त्रीस्वनोपमितमञ्जुलसौम्यगेयगन्धर्वतारमधुरारवभाषिणीभिः /
वीणाप्रवीणतरपाणितलाङ्गुलीभिर्गंभीरचक्रचटुवादरतोत्सुकाभिः //
text_mt: Speaking in soft and sweet sounds resembling the pitch of Gandharvas, singing sweetly and charmingly like the sound of lute strings, / their fingers and palms extremely adept at the vīṇā, eager for amorous sport with deep and flattering words,

sanskrit_iast:
strībhirmadālasa tarābhiratipragalbhabhāvābhirākulitakāmukamānasābhiḥ /
kāmaprayoganipuṇābhirahīnasaṃpadaudāryarūpaguṇaśīlasamanvitābhiḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीभिर्मदालस तराभिरतिप्रगल्भभावाभिराकुलितकामुकमानसाभिः /
कामप्रयोगनिपुणाभिरहीनसंपदौदार्यरूपगुणशीलसमन्विताभिः //
text_mt: Women languid with passion, exhibiting very bold amorous moods, agitating the minds of their lovers, / skilled in the arts of love, endowed with inexhaustible wealth, nobility, beauty, virtue, and good character,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyātigābhiraniśaṃ gṛhakṛtyakarmavyagrātmakābhirapi tatparicārikābhiḥ /
puṃbhiśca tadguṇagaṇocitarūpaśobhairudbhāsitairgṛhacaraiḥ paritaḥ parītam //
meaning:
संख्यातिगाभिरनिशं गृहकृत्यकर्मव्यग्रात्मकाभिरपि तत्परिचारिकाभिः /
पुंभिश्च तद्गुणगणोचितरूपशोभैरुद्भासितैर्गृहचरैः परितः परीतम् //
text_mt: Along with countless maidservants who were constantly occupied with household chores, / and surrounded on all sides by male house-servants resplendent with handsome forms suited to their many virtues.

sanskrit_iast:
sarājamārgāpaṇasaudhasadmasopānadevālayacatvareṣu /
paurairaśeṣārthaguṇaiḥ samantādadhyāsyamānaṃ paripūrṇakāmaiḥ //
meaning:
सराजमार्गापणसौधसद्मसोपानदेवालयचत्वरेषु /
पौरैरशेषार्थगुणैः समन्तादध्यास्यमानं परिपूर्णकामैः //
text_mt: Upon its royal highways, marketplaces, palaces, houses, steps, temples, and squares, / it was occupied everywhere by citizens possessing all material goods and virtues, their desires fully fulfilled,

sanskrit_iast:
aneka ratnojjvalitairvicitraiḥ prāsādasaṃghairatulairasaṃkhyaiḥ /
rathāśvamātaṅgakharoṣṭragojāyogyairanekairapi mandiraiśca //

अनेक रत्नोज्ज्वलितैर्विचित्रैः प्रासादसंघैरतुलैरसंख्यैः /
रथाश्वमातङ्गखरोष्ट्रगोजायोग्यैरनेकैरपि मन्दिरैश्च //
text_mt: With countless and matchless mansions bright with diverse jewels, / and with many stables suitable for chariots, horses, elephants, donkeys, camels, cows, and goats,

sanskrit_iast:
naredrasāmantaniṣādisādipadātisenapatināyakānām /
viprādikānāṃ rathisārathīnāṃ gṛhaistathā māgadhabandināṃ ca //
meaning:
नरेद्रसामन्तनिषादिसादिपदातिसेनपतिनायकानाम् /
विप्रादिकानां रथिसारथीनां गृहैस्तथा मागधबन्दिनां च //
text_mt: With the dwellings of the king, feudatories, elephant-riders, horse-soldiers, foot-soldiers, commanders, and leaders, / of Brahmins and others, of charioteers and drivers, as well as of bards and panegyrists,

sanskrit_iast:
viviktarathyāpaṇacitracatvarairanekavastukrayavikrayaiśca /
mahādhanopaskarasādhunirmitairgṛhaiśca śubhrairgaṇikājanānām //

विविक्तरथ्यापणचित्रचत्वरैरनेकवस्तुक्रयविक्रयैश्च /
महाधनोपस्करसाधुनिर्मितैर्गृहैश्च शुभ्रैर्गणिकाजनानाम् //
text_mt: With spacious roads, shops, and variegated courtyards, with the buying and selling of numerous wares, / and with the white houses of courtesans, well constructed and provided with very costly furnishings,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārharatnojjvalatuṅgagopuraiḥ saha śvagṛdhravrajanartanālayaiḥ /
citrairdhvacaiścāpi patākikābhiḥ śubhraiḥ paṭairmaṇḍapikābhirunnataiḥ //

महार्हरत्नोज्ज्वलतुङ्गगोपुरैः सह श्वगृध्रव्रजनर्तनालयैः /
चित्रैर्ध्वचैश्चापि पताकिकाभिः शुभ्रैः पटैर्मण्डपिकाभिरुन्नतैः //
text_mt: With lofty city gates glittering with precious jewels, along with dance halls filled with troops of horses and kites, / with diverse banners, flags, white cloths, and elevated pavilions,

sanskrit_iast:
kahlārakañjakumudotpalareṇuvāsitaiścakāhvahaṃsakurarībakasārasānām /
nānāravāḍhyaramaṇīyataṭākavāpīsarovaraiścāpi jalopapannaiḥ //

कह्लारकञ्जकुमुदोत्पलरेणुवासितैश्चकाह्वहंसकुररीबकसारसानाम् /
नानारवाढ्यरमणीयतटाकवापीसरोवरैश्चापि जलोपपन्नैः //
text_mt: With delightful ponds, stepwells, and lakes supplied with water, fragrant with the pollen of kahlāra, red lotus, white water-lily, and blue lotus, / filled with the diverse calls of cakravākas, geese, kurarīs, cranes, and sārasa birds,

cūtapriyālapanasāmramadhūkajaṃbūplakṣairnavaiśca tarubhiśca kṛtālavālaiḥ /
paryantaropitamanoramanāgaketakīpunnāgacaṃpakavanaiśca patatrijuṣṭaiḥ //

चूतप्रियालपनसाम्रमधूकजंबूप्लक्षैर्नवैश्च तरुभिश्च कृतालवालैः /
पर्यन्तरोपितमनोरमनागकेतकीपुन्नागचंपकवनैश्च पतत्रिजुष्टैः //
text_mt: With mango, priyāla, jackfruit, āmra, madhūka, jambū, and plakṣa trees, and fresh trees provided with irrigation basins, / and surrounded by planted, delightful groves of nāga, ketakī, punnāga, and campaka trees frequented by birds,

sanskrit_iast:
mandārakundakaravīramanojñayūthikājātyādikairvividhapuṣpaphalaiśca vṛkṣaiḥ /
saṃlakṣyamāṇaparitopavanālibhiśca saṃśobhitaṃ jagati vismayanīyarūpaiḥ //
meaning:
मन्दारकुन्दकरवीरमनोज्ञयूथिकाजात्यादिकैर्विविधपुष्पफलैश्च वृक्षैः /
संलक्ष्यमाणपरितोपवनालिभिश्च संशोभितं जगति विस्मयनीयरूपैः //
text_mt: Adorned with mandāra, kunda, karavīra, lovely yūthikā, jātī, and other trees bearing diverse flowers and fruits, / and with rows of surrounding pleasure gardens visible on all sides, possessing forms astonishing in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarttukapravarasaurabhavāyumandamandapracāribhartsitadharmakālam /
ittha surāsuramanoramabhogasaṃpadvispaṣṭamānavibhavaṃ nagaraṃ naredra //

सर्वर्त्तुकप्रवरसौरभवायुमन्दमन्दप्रचारिभर्त्सितधर्मकालम् /

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyabhogamamitaṃ munihomadhenuḥ sadyo vidhāya vinivedayadāśu tasmai /
jñātvā tato munivaro dvijahomadhenvā saṃpāditaṃ narapate rucirātitheyam //
meaning:
सौभाग्यभोगममितं मुनिहोमधेनुः सद्यो विधाय विनिवेदयदाशु तस्मै /
ज्ञात्वा ततो मुनिवरो द्विजहोमधेन्वा संपादितं नरपते रुचिरातिथेयम् //
text_mt: Having instantly created boundless fortune and enjoyment, the sage's sacrificial cow quickly presented it to him. / Thereupon, having realized that agreeable hospitality for the king had been produced by the twice-born's sacrificial cow, the excellent sage

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya kañcana tadantika mātmaśiṣyaṃ prāsthāpayatsaguṇaśālinamāśu rājan /
gatvā viśāmadhipatestarasā samīpaṃ saṃpraśrayaṃ munisutastamidaṃ babhāṣe //
meaning:
आहूय कञ्चन तदन्तिक मात्मशिष्यं प्रास्थापयत्सगुणशालिनमाशु राजन् /
गत्वा विशामधिपतेस्तरसा समीपं संप्रश्रयं मुनिसुतस्तमिदं बभाषे //

आतिथ्यमस्मदुपपादितमाशु राज्ञा संभावनीयमिति नः कुलदेशिकाज्ञा /

प्रसूनलाजाप्रकरैरजस्रमवीपृषन्सौधगताः सुत्दृद्यैः /

text_mt: and ceaselessly showered [him] with heaps of flowers and fried grain, pleasing to the eyes, / with rains of pure fried grain falling from the lotus hands of the city women who were eager to worship the guest who had arrived.

दूरप्रसारितपृथग्जनसंकुलानि सद्माविवेश सचिवादरदत्तहृस्तः /

iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne saptaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 27//
meaning:

इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय

said to one another: "What is to be accomplished by houses, wealth, and the like? Let us all dwell right here!" / The king, too, having performed the evening rites and having reached his bedchamber, / lay down upon an excellent couch, auspicious and exceedingly bright with heaps of jewels, and, satisfied, slept for a long time, O ruler of men.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter in the Story of Arjuna in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
svapantametya rājānaṃ sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ /
pravodhayitumavyagrā jaguruccairniśātyaye //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
स्वपन्तमेत्य राजानं सूतमागधवन्दिनः /
प्रवोधयितुमव्यग्रा जगुरुच्चैर्निशात्यये //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Approaching the sleeping king at the end of the night, bards, panegyrists, and heralds, / unhurried, sang loudly to awaken him,

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāveṇuravonmiśrakalatālatatānugam /
samastaśrutisuśrāvyapraśastamadhurasvaram //
meaning:
वीणावेणुरवोन्मिश्रकलतालततानुगम् /
समस्तश्रुतिसुश्राव्यप्रशस्तमधुरस्वरम् //
text_mt: accompanied by the sweet, rhythmic stretching of sounds mingled with the lute and the flute, / with praiseworthy, sweet notes pleasant to hear through all microtonal intervals,

sanskrit_iast:
snigdhakaṇṭhāḥ suvispaṣṭamūrcchanāgrāmasūcitam /
jagurgeyaṃ manohāri tāramandralayānvitam //
meaning:
स्निग्धकण्ठाः सुविस्पष्टमूर्च्छनाग्रामसूचितम् /
जगुर्गेयं मनोहारि तारमन्द्रलयान्वितम् //
text_mt: with melodious voices, marked by clear modulations and basic scales; / they sang charming music endowed with high and low registers and tempo.

sanskrit_iast:
ūcuśca taṃ mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ sūtamāgadhāḥ /
svapantaṃ vividhā vāco bubodhayiṣavaḥ śaneḥ //
meaning:
ऊचुश्च तं महात्मानं राजानं सूतमागधाः /
स्वपन्तं विविधा वाचो बुबोधयिषवः शनेः //
text_mt: And the bards and panegyrists, wishing to awaken gently that great-souled king / as he was sleeping, spoke various words:

sanskrit_iast:
pasyāyamastamabhyeti rājendrenduḥ parājitaḥ /
vivarddhamānayā nūnaṃ tava vaktrāṃbujaśriyā //
meaning:
पस्यायमस्तमभ्येति राजेन्द्रेन्दुः पराजितः /
विवर्द्धमानया नूनं तव वक्त्रांबुजश्रिया //
text_mt: "Behold, O king of kings! This moon is setting, defeated, / surely, by the expanding beauty of your lotus face!

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭuṃ tvadāna nāṃbhojaṃ samutsuka ivādhunā /
tamāṃsi bhindannādityaḥ saṃprāpto hyudayaṃ vibho //
meaning:
द्रष्टुं त्वदान नांभोजं समुत्सुक इवाधुना /
तमांसि भिन्दन्नादित्यः संप्राप्तो ह्युदयं विभो //
text_mt: As if eager now to see your lotus face, / the sun has indeed reached dawn, dispelling the darkness, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
rājannakhilaśītāṃśuvaṃśamauliśikhāmaṇe /
nidrayā laṃ mahābuddhe prativudhyasva sāṃpratam //
meaning:
राजन्नखिलशीतांशुवंशमौलिशिखामणे /
निद्रया लं महाबुद्धे प्रतिवुध्यस्व सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: O king, crest-jewel on the diadems of the entire lineage of the cool-rayed [moon], / enough of sleep, O one of great intellect! Awaken now!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śṛṇvannabudhyata mahīpatiḥ /
kṣīrābdau śeṣaśayanādyathāpaṅkajalocanaḥ //
meaning:
इति तेषां वचः शृण्वन्नबुध्यत महीपतिः /
क्षीराब्दौ शेषशयनाद्यथापङ्कजलोचनः //
text_mt: Hearing their words, the ruler of the earth awoke, / just as the lotus-eyed [Viṣṇu awakens] from his bed on Śeṣa in the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
vinidrākṣaḥ samutthāya karma naityakamādarāt /
cakārāvahitaḥ samyagjayādikamaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
विनिद्राक्षः समुत्थाय कर्म नैत्यकमादरात् /
चकारावहितः सम्यग्जयादिकमशेषतः //
text_mt: His eyes freed from sleep, he arose and respectfully performed his daily rites, / completely attentive to the entire [ritual] beginning with the jaya rites.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāmabhivandyeṣṭāṃ gāṃ divyasraggandhabhūṣaṇaḥ /
kṛtvā dūrvāñjanādarśamaṅgalyālambanāni ca //
meaning:
देवतामभिवन्द्येष्टां गां दिव्यस्रग्गन्धभूषणः /
कृत्वा दूर्वाञ्जनादर्शमङ्गल्यालम्बनानि च //
text_mt: Having saluted his chosen deity and the cow, adorned with heavenly garlands and fragrances, / and having touched auspicious objects like dūrvā grass, collyrium, and mirrors,

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā dānāni cārthibhyo natvā gobrahmaṇānapi /
niṣkramya ca purāttasmādupatasthe ca bhāskaram //
meaning:
दत्त्वा दानानि चार्थिभ्यो नत्वा गोब्रह्मणानपि /
निष्क्रम्य च पुरात्तस्मादुपतस्थे च भास्करम् //
text_mt: having given gifts to petitioners and bowed to cows and brahmins, / he departed from that city and worshipped the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadabhyāyayuḥ sarvaṃ mantrisāmantanāyakāḥ /
racitāñjalayo rājannemuśca nṛpasattamam //
meaning:
तावदभ्याययुः सर्वं मन्त्रिसामन्तनायकाः /
रचिताञ्जलयो राजन्नेमुश्च नृपसत्तमम् //
text_mt: Meanwhile, all the ministers, feudatories, and commanders came forward / with folded hands, O king, and bowed to the best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ samupetya taponidhim /
nanāma pādayostasya kirīṭenārkavarcasā //
meaning:
ततः स तैः परिवृतः समुपेत्य तपोनिधिम् /
ननाम पादयोस्तस्य किरीटेनार्कवर्चसा //
text_mt: Then, surrounded by them, he approached that storehouse of austerities / and bowed at his feet with his diadem resplendent as the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
āśīrbhirabhinandyātha rājānaṃ munipuṅgavaḥ /
praśrayāvanataṃ sāmnā tamuvācāsyatāmiti //
meaning:
आशीर्भिरभिनन्द्याथ राजानं मुनिपुङ्गवः /
प्रश्रयावनतं साम्ना तमुवाचास्यतामिति //
text_mt: Then, having greeted the king with blessings, that foremost of sages / gently said to him, as he bowed down with modesty: 'Be seated.'

sanskrit_iast:
tamāsīnaṃ narapatiṃ mahārṣiḥ prītamānasaḥ /
uvāca rajanī vyuṣṭā sukhena tava kiṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
तमासीनं नरपतिं महार्षिः प्रीतमानसः /
उवाच रजनी व्युष्टा सुखेन तव किं नृप //
text_mt: To that king who was seated, the great sage, pleased in his mind, / said: 'Did the night pass pleasantly for you, O king?

sanskrit_iast:
asmākameva rājendra vane vanyena jīvatām /
śakyaṃ mṛgasadharmāṇāṃ yena kenāpi varttitum //
meaning:
अस्माकमेव राजेन्द्र वने वन्येन जीवताम् /
शक्यं मृगसधर्माणां येन केनापि वर्त्तितुम् //
text_mt: It is we alone, O best of kings, living in the forest on wild produce, / sharing the nature of deer, who can subsist on anything whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
araṇye nāgarāṇāṃ tu sthitiratyantaduḥsahā /
anabhyastaṃ hi rājendra nanu sarvaṃ hi duṣkaram //
meaning:
अरण्ये नागराणां तु स्थितिरत्यन्तदुःसहा /
अनभ्यस्तं हि राजेन्द्र ननु सर्वं हि दुष्करम् //
text_mt: Staying in the forest, however, is exceedingly unbearable for city dwellers; / for indeed, O best of kings, whatever is unaccustomed is difficult [for all].

sanskrit_iast:
vanavāsaparikleśaṃ bhavānyatsānugo 'sakṛt /
āptastu bhavato nūnaṃ sā gauravasamunnatiḥ //
meaning:
वनवासपरिक्लेशं भवान्यत्सानुगो ऽसकृत् /
आप्तस्तु भवतो नूनं सा गौरवसमुन्नतिः //
text_mt: The hardship of forest life that you, along with your followers, repeatedly / underwent, was indeed an elevation of respect on your part.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastena muninā sa rājā prītipūrvakam /
prahasanniva taṃ bhūyo vacanaṃ pratyabhāṣata //
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तेन मुनिना स राजा प्रीतिपूर्वकम् /
प्रहसन्निव तं भूयो वचनं प्रत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Addressed thus with affection by that sage, the king, / as if smiling gently, spoke words in reply to him once more:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmankimanayā hyuktyā dṛṣṭaste yādṛśo mahān /
asmābhimahimā yena vismitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat //
meaning:
ब्रह्मन्किमनया ह्युक्त्या दृष्टस्ते यादृशो महान् /
अस्माभिमहिमा येन विस्मितं सकलं जगत् //
text_mt: 'O brahmin, what need is there of such words? Such great greatness of yours / has been seen by us, by which the whole world is astonished.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatprabhāvasaṃjātavibhavāhatacetasaḥ /
ito na gantumicchanti sainikā me mahāmune //
meaning:
भवत्प्रभावसंजातविभवाहतचेतसः /
इतो न गन्तुमिच्छन्ति सैनिका मे महामुने //
text_mt: With minds captivated by the opulence produced by your power, / my soldiers do not wish to depart from here, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tvādṛśānāṃ jagantīha prabhāvaistapasāṃ vibho /
dhriyante sarvadā nūnamacintyaṃ brahmavarcasam //
meaning:
त्वादृशानां जगन्तीह प्रभावैस्तपसां विभो /
ध्रियन्ते सर्वदा नूनमचिन्त्यं ब्रह्मवर्चसम् //
text_mt: Indeed, O lord, the worlds here are always upheld by the power of asceticism / of people like you; unthinkable is brahminical splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
naiva citraṃ tava vibho śakroti tapasā bhavān /
dhruvaṃ karttuṃ hi lokānāmavasthātritayaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
नैव चित्रं तव विभो शक्रोति तपसा भवान् /
ध्रुवं कर्त्तुं हि लोकानामवस्थात्रितयं क्रमात् //
text_mt: It is no wonder at all, O lord, that through your asceticism you are able / indeed to bring about in turn the threefold state of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sudṛṣṭā te tapaḥsiddhirmahatī lokapūjitā /
gamiṣyāmi purīṃ brahmannanujānātu māṃ bhavān //
meaning:
सुदृष्टा ते तपःसिद्धिर्महती लोकपूजिता /
गमिष्यामि पुरीं ब्रह्मन्ननुजानातु मां भवान् //
text_mt: Your great perfection in asceticism, worshiped by the worlds, has been clearly witnessed; / I shall depart for my city, O brahmin; may you give me leave.'

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktastenasa muniḥ kārttavīryeṇa sādaram /
saṃbhāvayitvā nitarāṃ tatheti pratyabhāṣata //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तस्तेनस मुनिः कार्त्तवीर्येण सादरम् /
संभावयित्वा नितरां तथेति प्रत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Addressed thus with respect by that Kārttavīrya, the sage, / having honored him greatly, replied: 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
muninā samanujñāto viniṣkramya tadāśramāt /
sainyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ saṃpratasthe purīṃ prati //
meaning:
मुनिना समनुज्ञातो विनिष्क्रम्य तदाश्रमात् /
सैन्यैः परिवृतः सर्वैः संप्रतस्थे पुरीं प्रति //
text_mt: Permitted by the sage, having departed from that hermitage, / surrounded by all his armies, he set out towards his city.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gacchaṃścintayāmāsa manasā pathi pārthivaḥ /
aho 'sya tapasaḥ siddhirloka vismayadāyinī //
meaning:
स गच्छंश्चिन्तयामास मनसा पथि पार्थिवः /
अहो ऽस्य तपसः सिद्धिर्लोक विस्मयदायिनी //
text_mt: As he went along the road, the king reflected in his mind: / 'Ah, the perfection of his asceticism brings astonishment to the world!

sanskrit_iast:
yayā labdhedṛśī dhenuḥ sarvakāmaduhāṃ varā /
kiṃ me sakalarājyena yogarddhyā vāpyanalpayā //
meaning:
यया लब्धेदृशी धेनुः सर्वकामदुहां वरा /
किं मे सकलराज्येन योगर्द्ध्या वाप्यनल्पया //
text_mt: Through which such a cow was obtained, the best of those yielding all desires; / what use to me is an entire kingdom, or even abundant yogic power?

sanskrit_iast:
goratnabhūtā yadiyaṃ dhenurmunivare sthitā /
anayotpāditā nūnaṃ saṃpatsvargasadāmapi //
meaning:
गोरत्नभूता यदियं धेनुर्मुनिवरे स्थिता /
अनयोत्पादिता नूनं संपत्स्वर्गसदामपि //
text_mt: Since this cow, who is a jewel among cattle, stays with the best of sages; / indeed, even the prosperity of the dwellers of heaven was produced by her.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛddhamaindramapi vyaktaṃ padaṃ trailokyapūjitam /
asyā dhenorahaṃ manye kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
ऋद्धमैन्द्रमपि व्यक्तं पदं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् /
अस्या धेनोरहं मन्ये कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् //
text_mt: I think that even the opulent realm of Indra, worshiped by the three worlds, / clearly does not equal a sixteenth part of this cow.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ cintayānaṃ taṃ paścādabhyetya pārthivam /
candragupto 'bravīnmantrī kṛtāñjali puṭastadā //
meaning:
इत्येवं चिन्तयानं तं पश्चादभ्येत्य पार्थिवम् /
चन्द्रगुप्तो ऽब्रवीन्मन्त्री कृताञ्जलि पुटस्तदा //
text_mt: As he was reflecting thus, the minister Candragupta, approaching the king / from behind, then spoke with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ rājaśārdūla purīṃ pratigamiṣyasi /
rakṣitena ca rājyena puryā vā kiṃ phalaṃ tava //
meaning:
किमर्थं राजशार्दूल पुरीं प्रतिगमिष्यसि /
रक्षितेन च राज्येन पुर्या वा किं फलं तव //
text_mt: 'Why, O tiger among kings, will you go towards the city? / What fruit is there for you in a protected kingdom or in a city?

sanskrit_iast:
goratnabhūtā nṛpateryāvardhenurna cālaye /
varttate nārddhamapi te rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ tava prabho //
meaning:
गोरत्नभूता नृपतेर्यावर्धेनुर्न चालये /
वर्त्तते नार्द्धमपि ते राज्यं शून्यं तव प्रभो //
text_mt: As long as the cow, which is a jewel among cattle, is not in the king's abode, / your kingdom is not even half [complete]; it is empty, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
anyacca dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ mayā rājañchṛṇuṣva tat /
bhavanāni manojñāni manojñāśca tathā striyaḥ //
meaning:
अन्यच्च दृष्टमाश्चर्यं मया राजञ्छृणुष्व तत् /
भवनानि मनोज्ञानि मनोज्ञाश्च तथा स्त्रियः //
text_mt: And listen to another wonder that was seen by me, O king: / lovely mansions and likewise lovely women,

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādā vividhākārā dhanaṃ cādṛṣṭasaṃkṣayam /
dheno tasyāṃ kṣaṇenaiva vilīnaṃ paśyato mama //
meaning:
प्रासादा विविधाकारा धनं चादृष्टसंक्षयम् /
धेनो तस्यां क्षणेनैव विलीनं पश्यतो मम //
text_mt: palaces of diverse forms, and wealth with no visible end— / all vanished into that cow in an instant while I was watching!

sanskrit_iast:
tattapovanamevāsīdidānīṃ rājasattama /
evaṃprabhāvā sā yasya tasya kiṃ durlaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
तत्तपोवनमेवासीदिदानीं राजसत्तम /
एवंप्रभावा सा यस्य तस्य किं दुर्लं भवेत् //
text_mt: Now it became just that penance grove once again, O best of kings! / What could be difficult to attain for one who possesses her of such power?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādratnārhasattvena svīkarttavyā hi gaustvayā /
yadi te 'numataṃ kṛtyamākhyeyamanujīvibhiḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्रत्नार्हसत्त्वेन स्वीकर्त्तव्या हि गौस्त्वया /
यदि ते ऽनुमतं कृत्यमाख्येयमनुजीविभिः //
text_mt: Therefore, being one worthy of jewels, that cow must certainly be taken by you, / if this deed to be done meets with your approval, as advised by your dependents.'

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca /
evamevāhamapyenāṃ na jānāmītyasāṃpratam /
brahmasvaṃ nāpahartavyamiti me śaṅkate manaḥ //
meaning:
राजोवाच /
एवमेवाहमप्येनां न जानामीत्यसांप्रतम् /
ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्तव्यमिति मे शङ्कते मनः //
text_mt: The king said: / 'I too think so; it is not that I do not know it to be unsuitable, / but my mind hesitates, thinking: "The property of a brahmin must not be seized."'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bruvantaṃ rājānamidamāha purohitaḥ /
gargo matimatāṃ śreṣṭho garhayanniva bhūpate //
meaning:
एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानमिदमाह पुरोहितः /
गर्गो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठो गर्हयन्निव भूपते //
text_mt: To the king speaking thus, the family priest Garga, / the best among the wise, said this, as if rebuking him, O king:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmasvaṃ nāpaharttavyamāpadyapi kathañcana /
brahmasvasadṛśaṃ loke durjaraṃ neha vidyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्त्तव्यमापद्यपि कथञ्चन /
ब्रह्मस्वसदृशं लोके दुर्जरं नेह विद्यते //
text_mt: 'The property of a brahmin must never be stolen, even in distress; / in this world, there is nothing as indigestible as the property of a brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṃ hantyupayoktāraṃ lakṣyabhūtaṃ tu haihaya /
kulaṃ samūlaṃ dahati brahmasvāraṇipāvakaḥ //
meaning:
विषं हन्त्युपयोक्तारं लक्ष्यभूतं तु हैहय /
कुलं समूलं दहति ब्रह्मस्वारणिपावकः //
text_mt: Poison kills only the consumer, who is its target, O Haihaya; / but the fire from the kindling stick of a brahmin's property burns the whole family down to the root.

sanskrit_iast:
anivāryamidaṃ loke brahmasvandurjaraṃ viṣam /
putrapautrāntaphaladaṃ vipākakaṭu pārthiva //
meaning:
अनिवार्यमिदं लोके ब्रह्मस्वन्दुर्जरं विषम् /
पुत्रपौत्रान्तफलदं विपाककटु पार्थिव //
text_mt: This property of a brahmin is an irresistible, indigestible poison in this world; / it yields fruits extending up to sons and grandsons, and is bitter in its ripening, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
eśvaryamūḍhaṃ hi manaḥ prabhūmamasadātmanām /
kinnāmāsanna kurute netrāsa dvipralobhitam //
meaning:
एश्वर्यमूढं हि मनः प्रभूममसदात्मनाम् /
किन्नामासन्न कुरुते नेत्रास द्विप्रलोभितम् //
text_mt: Indeed, the mind of wicked lords, infatuated by sovereignty— / what evil does it not commit, enticed by deceptive appearances?

sanskrit_iast:
vedānyastvāmṛte ko 'nyo vinā dānānnṛpottama /
ādānaṃ cintayāno hi bāhmaṇeṣvabhivāñchati //
meaning:
वेदान्यस्त्वामृते को ऽन्यो विना दानान्नृपोत्तम /
आदानं चिन्तयानो हि बाह्मणेष्वभिवाञ्छति //
text_mt: Who else besides you, being generous, O best of kings, / contemplates taking rather than giving, and covets [what belongs] to brahmins?

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśastvaṃ mahābāho karma sajjananinditam /
mā kṛthāstaddhi lokeṣu yaśohānikaraṃ tava //
meaning:
ईदृशस्त्वं महाबाहो कर्म सज्जननिन्दितम् /
मा कृथास्तद्धि लोकेषु यशोहानिकरं तव //
text_mt: Being such as you are, O mighty-armed one, do not perform an action condemned by good people; / for it will bring about the loss of your fame in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśe mahati jātastvaṃ vadānyānāṃ prahībhujām /
yaśāṃśi karmaṇānena saṃprataṃ māvyanīvaśaḥ //
meaning:
वंशे महति जातस्त्वं वदान्यानां प्रहीभुजाम् /
यशांशि कर्मणानेन संप्रतं माव्यनीवशः //
text_mt: You are born in a great lineage of generous rulers of the earth; / do not now destroy your renowned deeds by such an act.

sanskrit_iast:
aho 'nujīvinaḥ kiñcidbhartāraṃ vyasanārṇave /
tatprasādasamunnaddhā majjayaṃ tyanayonmukhāḥ //
meaning:
अहो ऽनुजीविनः किञ्चिद्भर्तारं व्यसनार्णवे /
तत्प्रसादसमुन्नद्धा मज्जयं त्यनयोन्मुखाः //
text_mt: Alas, dependents, haughty from their master's favor and inclined to misconduct, / plunge him into an ocean of calamities!

sanskrit_iast:
śriyā vikurvanpuruṣakṛtyacintye vicetanaḥ /
tanmatānupravṛttiśca rājā sadyo viṣīdati //
meaning:
श्रिया विकुर्वन्पुरुषकृत्यचिन्त्ये विचेतनः /
तन्मतानुप्रवृत्तिश्च राजा सद्यो विषीदति //
text_mt: A king who loses his senses through royal fortune, thoughtless in considering what ought to be done, / who follows their counsel, quickly perishes.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātamunayo mantrī rājānamanayāṃbudhau /
ātmanā saha durbuddhirlohanauriva majjayet //
meaning:
अज्ञातमुनयो मन्त्री राजानमनयांबुधौ /
आत्मना सह दुर्बुद्धिर्लोहनौरिव मज्जयेत् //
text_mt: A foolish minister who does not know prudent counsel / would drown the king along with himself in an ocean of ruin, like an iron boat.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ rājaśārdūla mūḍhasya nayavartmani /
matamasya sudurbuddhernānuvarttitumarhasi //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं राजशार्दूल मूढस्य नयवर्त्मनि /
मतमस्य सुदुर्बुद्धेर्नानुवर्त्तितुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Therefore, O tiger among kings, you should not follow / the opinion of this extremely foolish man, who is bewildered on the path of prudent conduct.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ hi vadatastasya svāmiśreyaskaraṃ vacaḥ /
ākṣipya mantrī rājānamidaṃ bhūyo hyabhāṣata //
meaning:
एवं हि वदतस्तस्य स्वामिश्रेयस्करं वचः /
आक्षिप्य मन्त्री राजानमिदं भूयो ह्यभाषत //
text_mt: While he was thus speaking words that were beneficial to his master, / the minister, rejecting [them], spoke this again to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo 'yaṃ svajātīyahitameva samīkṣate /
mahānti rājakāryāṇi dvijairvettuṃ na śakyate //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो ऽयं स्वजातीयहितमेव समीक्षते /
महान्ति राजकार्याणि द्विजैर्वेत्तुं न शक्यते //
text_mt: 'This brahmin looks only to the benefit of his own caste; / the great affairs of kings cannot be understood by twice-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaiva rājakāryāṇi vedyāni svamanīṣayā /
vinā vai bhojanādāne kāryaṃ vipro na vindati //
meaning:
राज्ञैव राजकार्याणि वेद्यानि स्वमनीषया /
विना वै भोजनादाने कार्यं विप्रो न विन्दति //
text_mt: Royal duties must be known by the king alone through his own intellect; / a brahmin understands nothing beyond taking food.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo nāvamantavyo vandanīyaśca nityaśaḥ /
pratisaṃgrāhayaṇīyaśca nādhikaṃ sādhitaṃ kvacit //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणो नावमन्तव्यो वन्दनीयश्च नित्यशः /
प्रतिसंग्राहयणीयश्च नाधिकं साधितं क्वचित् //
text_mt: A brahmin should not be insulted, but should be honored daily / and treated hospitably; nothing more than that is ever accomplished [by them].

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsvīkṛtya tāṃ dhenuṃ prayāhi svapuraṃ nṛpa /
nocedrājyaṃ parityajya gacchasvatapase vanam //
meaning:
तस्मात्स्वीकृत्य तां धेनुं प्रयाहि स्वपुरं नृप /
नोचेद्राज्यं परित्यज्य गच्छस्वतपसे वनम् //
text_mt: Therefore, having taken possession of that cow, proceed to your own city, O king; / if not, having abandoned your kingdom, go to the forest for asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamāvattvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ daṇḍaḥ kṣatrasya pārthiva /
prasahya haraṇe vāpi nādharmaste bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
क्षमावत्त्वं ब्राह्मणानां दण्डः क्षत्रस्य पार्थिव /
प्रसह्य हरणे वापि नाधर्मस्ते भविष्यति //
text_mt: Forgiveness belongs to brahmins, punishment belongs to the kṣatriya, O king; / even in taking it by force, there will be no unrighteousness on your part.

sanskrit_iast:
prasahya haraṇe doṣaṃ yadi saṃpaśyase nṛpa /
dattvā mūlyaṃ gavāśvādyamṛṣerthenuḥ pragṛhyatām //
meaning:
प्रसह्य हरणे दोषं यदि संपश्यसे नृप /
दत्त्वा मूल्यं गवाश्वाद्यमृषेर्थेनुः प्रगृह्यताम् //
text_mt: If you see a fault in taking it by force, O king, / let the sage's cow be taken after giving a price such as cattle, horses, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
svīkartavyā hi sā dhenustvayā tvaṃ ratnabhāgayataḥ /
tapodhanānāṃ hi kuto ratnasaṃgrahaṇādaraḥ //
meaning:
स्वीकर्तव्या हि सा धेनुस्त्वया त्वं रत्नभागयतः /
तपोधनानां हि कुतो रत्नसंग्रहणादरः //
text_mt: That cow should indeed be acquired by you, since you are the enjoyer of jewels; / for whence would those whose wealth is asceticism have regard for collecting jewels?

sanskrit_iast:
tapodhana balaḥ śāntaḥ prītimānsa nṛpa tvayi /
tasmātte sarvathā dhenuṃ yācitaḥ saṃpradāsyati //
meaning:
तपोधन बलः शान्तः प्रीतिमान्स नृप त्वयि /
तस्मात्ते सर्वथा धेनुं याचितः संप्रदास्यति //
text_mt: He whose strength is penance is calm, and he has affection for you, O king; / therefore, when requested, he will give the cow to you by all means.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā gohiraṇyadyaṃ yadanyadabhivāñchitam /
saṃgṛhya vittaṃ vipulaṃ dhenuṃ tāṃ pratidāsyati //
meaning:
अथ वा गोहिरण्यद्यं यदन्यदभिवाञ्छितम् /
संगृह्य वित्तं विपुलं धेनुं तां प्रतिदास्यति //
text_mt: Or else, having accepted cattle, gold, and whatever other vast wealth / is desired, he will give that cow in return.

sanskrit_iast:
anupekṣyaṃ mahadratnaṃ rājñā vai bhūtimicchatā /
iti me varttate buddhiḥ kathaṃ vā manyate bhavān //
meaning:
अनुपेक्ष्यं महद्रत्नं राज्ञा वै भूतिमिच्छता /
इति मे वर्त्तते बुद्धिः कथं वा मन्यते भवान् //
text_mt: A great jewel must not be ignored by a king who desires prosperity; / this is my opinion; or how do you consider it?'

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca /
gatvā tvameva taṃ vipraṃ prasādya ca viśeṣataḥ /
dattvā cābhīpsitaṃ tasmai tāṃ gāmānaya mantrika //
meaning:
राजोवाच /
गत्वा त्वमेव तं विप्रं प्रसाद्य च विशेषतः /
दत्त्वा चाभीप्सितं तस्मै तां गामानय मन्त्रिक //
text_mt:
The king said:
"Go yourself to that brahmin, propitiate him especially,
give him whatever he desires, and bring that cow, O minister."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktastatorājñā sa mantrī vidhicoditaḥ /
