nivṛtya prayayau śīghraṃ jamadagnerathāśramam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवमुक्तस्ततोराज्ञा स मन्त्री विधिचोदितः /
निवृत्य प्रययौ शीघ्रं जमदग्नेरथाश्रमम् //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Thus spoken to by the king, that minister, urged by fate,
turned back and quickly went to Jamadagni's hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
gate tu nṛpatau tasminnakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ /
samidānayanārthāya rāmo 'pi prayayau vanam //
meaning:
गते तु नृपतौ तस्मिन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः /
समिदानयनार्थाय रामो ऽपि प्रययौ वनम् //
text_mt:
When that king had departed, Rāma, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa,
also went to the forest to gather sacrificial fuel.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa mantrī sabalaḥ samāsādya tadāśramam /
praṇamya muniśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
ततः स मन्त्री सबलः समासाद्य तदाश्रमम् /
प्रणम्य मुनिशार्दूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Then that minister, accompanied by his army, reached that hermitage,
bowed to that tiger among sages, and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
candragupta uvāca
brahmannṛpatinājñaptaṃ rājā tu bhuvi ratnabhāk /
ratnabhūtā ca dhenuḥ sā bhuvi dogdhrīṣvanuttamā //
meaning:
चन्द्रगुप्त उवाच
ब्रह्मन्नृपतिनाज्ञप्तं राजा तु भुवि रत्नभाक् /
रत्नभूता च धेनुः सा भुवि दोग्ध्रीष्वनुत्तमा //
text_mt:
Candragupta said:
"O brahmin, the king has commanded [me]. A king is the enjoyer of jewels on earth,
and that cow is a veritable jewel, peerless among milk-giving cows on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādratnaṃsuvarṇaṃ vā mūlyamuktvā yathocitam /
ādāya goratnabhūtāṃ dhenuṃ me dātumarhasi //
meaning:
तस्माद्रत्नंसुवर्णं वा मूल्यमुक्त्वा यथोचितम् /
आदाय गोरत्नभूतां धेनुं मे दातुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Therefore, having stated an appropriate price in jewels or gold,
accept it, and please give me the cow, who is a jewel among cattle."

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
homadhenuriyaṃ mahyaṃ na dātavyā hi kasyacit /
rājā vadānyaḥ sa kathaṃ brahmasvamabhivāñchati //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
होमधेनुरियं मह्यं न दातव्या हि कस्यचित् /
राजा वदान्यः स कथं ब्रह्मस्वमभिवाञ्छति //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
"This cow for oblations is mine; she must not be given to anyone.
How can that king, renowned as generous, covet a brahmin's property?"

sanskrit_iast:
mantryuvāca
ratnabhāktvaṃna nṛpatirddhenuṃ te pratikāṅkṣati /
gavāyutena tasmāttvaṃ tasmai tāṃ dātumarhasi //
meaning:
मन्त्र्युवाच
रत्नभाक्त्वंन नृपतिर्द्धेनुं ते प्रतिकाङ्क्षति /
गवायुतेन तस्मात्त्वं तस्मै तां दातुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
The minister said:
"The king enjoys jewels; he does not merely desire your cow.
Therefore, in exchange for ten thousand cows, you ought to give her to him."

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
krayavikrayayornāhaṃ karttā jātu kathañcana /
havirdhānīṃ ca vai tasmānnotsahe dātumañjasā //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
क्रयविक्रययोर्नाहं कर्त्ता जातु कथञ्चन /
हविर्धानीं च वै तस्मान्नोत्सहे दातुमञ्जसा //

sanskrit_iast:
mantryuvāca
rājyārdhenātha vā brahmansakalenāpi bhūbhṛtaḥ /
dehi dhenumimāmekāṃ tatte śreyo bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
मन्त्र्युवाच
राज्यार्धेनाथ वा ब्रह्मन्सकलेनापि भूभृतः /
देहि धेनुमिमामेकां तत्ते श्रेयो भविष्यति //

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
jīvannāhaṃ tu dāsyāmi vāsavasyāpi durmate /
guruṇā yācitaṃ kiṃ te vacasā nṛpateḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
जीवन्नाहं तु दास्यामि वासवस्यापि दुर्मते /
गुरुणा याचितं किं ते वचसा नृपतेः पुनः //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
"As long as I live, I will not give [her] even to Vāsava, O evil-minded one!
What is requested by an elder [like me]? Why speak again with the word of the king?"

sanskrit_iast:
mantryuvāca
tvameva svecchayā rājñe dehi dhenuṃ suhṛttayā /
yathā balena nītāyāṃ tasyāṃ tvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi //
meaning:
मन्त्र्युवाच
त्वमेव स्वेच्छया राज्ञे देहि धेनुं सुहृत्तया /
यथा बलेन नीतायां तस्यां त्वं किं करिष्यसि //

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
dātā dvijānāṃ nṛpatiḥ sa yadyapyāhariṣyati /
vipro 'haṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmi svecchāvitaraṇaṃ vinā //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
दाता द्विजानां नृपतिः स यद्यप्याहरिष्यति /
विप्रो ऽहं किं करिष्यामि स्वेच्छावितरणं विना //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
"The king is the giver to the twice-born. Even if he carries her off,
what will I, a brahmin, do, without giving her of my own free will?"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityevamuktaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ sa mantrī pāpacetanaḥ /
prasahya netumārebhe munestasya payasvinīm //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe voyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde 'ṣṭāviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 28//
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्येवमुक्तः संक्रुद्धः स मन्त्री पापचेतनः /
प्रसह्य नेतुमारेभे मुनेस्तस्य पयस्विनीम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वोयुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे ऽष्टाविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः // 28//
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Addressed thus, that evil-minded minister was enraged,
and began to lead away the milch cow of that sage by force.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
jamadagnistato bhūyastamuvāca ruṣānvitaḥ /
brahmasvaṃ nāpaharttavyaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
जमदग्निस्ततो भूयस्तमुवाच रुषान्वितः /
ब्रह्मस्वं नापहर्त्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Then Jamadagni, filled with anger, spoke to him again:
"A brahmin's property must not be stolen by a wise man.

sanskrit_iast:
prasahya gāṃ me harato pāpamāpsyasi durmate /
āyurjāne parikṣīṇaṃ na cedetatkariṣyati //
meaning:
प्रसह्य गां मे हरतो पापमाप्स्यसि दुर्मते /
आयुर्जाने परिक्षीणं न चेदेतत्करिष्यति //
text_mt:
Taking my cow by force, you will incur sin, O evil-minded one!
I know that your life-span is exhausted, if he does not [prevent] this.

sanskrit_iast:
balādicchasi yannetuṃ tanna śakyaṃ kathañcana /
svayaṃ vā yadi sāyucyedvinaśiṣyati pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
बलादिच्छसि यन्नेतुं तन्न शक्यं कथञ्चन /
स्वयं वा यदि सायुच्येद्विनशिष्यति पार्थिवः //
text_mt:
What you wish to take by force cannot be done at all.
Or if she should free herself, the king will perish.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ vināpaharaṇaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām /
śatāyuṣor'junādanyaḥ ko nvicchati jijīviṣuḥ //
meaning:
दानं विनापहरणं ब्राह्मणानां तपस्विनाम् /
शतायुषोर्ऽजुनादन्यः को न्विच्छति जिजीविषुः //
text_mt:
Who else wishing to live, other than Arjuna whose life is a hundred years,
wishes to rob ascetic brahmins without [their] gift?"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastena saṃkruddhaḥ sa mantrīkālacoditaḥ /
baddhvā tāṃ gāṃ dṛḍhaiḥ pāśairvicakarṣa balānvitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तेन संक्रुद्धः स मन्त्रीकालचोदितः /
बद्ध्वा तां गां दृढैः पाशैर्विचकर्ष बलान्वितः //
text_mt:
Thus addressed by him, that minister, enraged and driven by fate,
bound that cow with strong ropes and dragged her with force.

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniratha krodhādbhāvikarmapracoditaḥ /
rurodha taṃ yathāśakti vikarṣantaṃ pāyasvinīm //
meaning:
जमदग्निरथ क्रोधाद्भाविकर्मप्रचोदितः /
रुरोध तं यथाशक्ति विकर्षन्तं पायस्विनीम् //
text_mt:
Then Jamadagni, out of anger, impelled by future destiny,
blocked him to the best of his ability as he dragged away the milch cow.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanna pratimokṣyāmi gāmenāmityamarṣitaḥ /
jagrāha sudṛḍhaṃ kaṇṭhe vāhubhyāṃ tāṃ mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
जीवन्न प्रतिमोक्ष्यामि गामेनामित्यमर्षितः /
जग्राह सुदृढं कण्ठे वाहुभ्यां तां महामुनिः //
text_mt:
"As long as I live, I will not release this cow!" Thus indignant,
the great sage seized her firmly around the neck with both arms.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ krodhaparītātmā candragupto 'tinirghṛṇaḥ /
utsārayadhvamityenamādideśa svasainikān //
meaning:
ततः क्रोधपरीतात्मा चन्द्रगुप्तो ऽतिनिर्घृणः /
उत्सारयध्वमित्येनमादिदेश स्वसैनिकान् //
text_mt:
Then Candragupta, his mind overwhelmed with wrath, utterly merciless,
ordered his own soldiers: "Drive him away!"

sanskrit_iast:
apradhṛṣyatamaṃ loke tamṛṣiṃ rājakiṅkarāḥ /
bhartrājñayā prasahyainaṃ parivavruḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
अप्रधृष्यतमं लोके तमृषिं राजकिङ्कराः /
भर्त्राज्ञया प्रसह्यैनं परिवव्रुः समन्ततः //
text_mt:
The king's servants, by the command of their lord,
surrounded by force on all sides that sage, the most unassailable in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍaiḥ kaśābhirlakuḍairvinighnantaśca muṣṭibhiḥ /
te samutsārayan dhenoḥ sudūrataramantikāt //
meaning:
दण्डैः कशाभिर्लकुडैर्विनिघ्नन्तश्च मुष्टिभिः /
ते समुत्सारयन् धेनोः सुदूरतरमन्तिकात् //
text_mt:
Striking him with rods, whips, cudgels, and fists,
they drove him far away from the presence of the cow.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tathā hanyamono 'pi vyathitaḥkṣamayānvitaḥ /
na cukrodhākrodhanatvaṃ sato hi paramaṃ dhanam //
meaning:
स तथा हन्यमोनो ऽपि व्यथितःक्षमयान्वितः /
न चुक्रोधाक्रोधनत्वं सतो हि परमं धनम् //
text_mt:
Though beaten in this way and in pain, endowed with forbearance,
he did not grow angry; for freedom from anger is indeed the highest treasure of the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca śaktaḥ svatapasā saṃharttumapi rakṣitum /
jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ tasya cintayanna pracukrudhe //
meaning:
स च शक्तः स्वतपसा संहर्त्तुमपि रक्षितुम् /
जगत्सर्वं क्षयं तस्य चिन्तयन्न प्रचुक्रुधे //
text_mt:
Though able by his ascetic power to destroy or to protect
the entire world, he did not rage, reflecting upon its destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
sapūrvaṃ krodhano 'tyarthaṃ māturarthe prasāditaḥ /
rāmeṇābhūttato nityaṃ śānta eva mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
सपूर्वं क्रोधनो ऽत्यर्थं मातुरर्थे प्रसादितः /
रामेणाभूत्ततो नित्यं शान्त एव महातपाः //
text_mt:
Formerly very prone to anger, he had been propitiated by Rāma
for his mother's sake; thenceforth the great ascetic was always peaceful.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hanyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ cūrṇitāṅgāsthivandhanaḥ /
nipapāta mahātejā dharaṇyāṃ gatacetanaḥ //
meaning:
स हन्यमानः सुभृशं चूर्णिताङ्गास्थिवन्धनः /
निपपात महातेजा धरण्यां गतचेतनः //
text_mt:
Severely beaten, the joints of his limbs and bones crushed,
that [sage] of great splendour fell unconscious to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminmunau nipatite sa durātmā viśaṅkitaḥ /
kiṅkarānādiśacchīghraṃ dhenorānayane balāt //
meaning:
तस्मिन्मुनौ निपतिते स दुरात्मा विशङ्कितः /
किङ्करानादिशच्छीघ्रं धेनोरानयने बलात् //
text_mt:
When that sage had fallen, that evil-souled one, apprehensive,
quickly commanded his servants to bring the cow by force.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ savatsāṃ tā dhenuṃ baddhvā pāśairdṛḍhairnṛpaḥ /
kaśābhirabhihanyanta cakṛṣuśca ninīṣayā //
meaning:
ततः सवत्सां ता धेनुं बद्ध्वा पाशैर्दृढैर्नृपः /
कशाभिरभिहन्यन्त चकृषुश्च निनीषया //
text_mt:
Then, binding that cow together with her calf with strong ropes,
striking [her] with whips, the king's men dragged her, intending to carry her off.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣyamāṇā bahubhiḥ kaśābhirlaguḍairapi /
hanyamānā bhṛśaṃ taiśca cukrudhe ca payasvinī //
meaning:
आकृष्यमाणा बहुभिः कशाभिर्लगुडैरपि /
हन्यमाना भृशं तैश्च चुक्रुधे च पयस्विनी //
text_mt:
Dragged by many and struck repeatedly by them
with whips and clubs, the milch cow grew furious.

sanskrit_iast:
vyathitātikaśāpātaiḥ krodhena mahātānvitā /
ākṛṣya pāśān sudṛḍhān kṛtvātmānamamocayat //
meaning:
व्यथितातिकशापातैः क्रोधेन महातान्विता /
आकृष्य पाशान् सुदृढान् कृत्वात्मानममोचयत् //
text_mt:
Tormented by the excessive lashes of the whip, seized with great rage,
she pulled against the tight ropes and freed herself.

sanskrit_iast:
vimuktapāśavandhāsā sarvato 'bhivṛtā balaiḥ /
huṃhāravaṃ prakurvāṇā sarvato 'hyapatadruṣā //
meaning:
विमुक्तपाशवन्धासा सर्वतो ऽभिवृता बलैः /
हुंहारवं प्रकुर्वाणा सर्वतो ऽह्यपतद्रुषा //
text_mt:
Free from the bondage of the ropes, surrounded on all sides by the troops,
making a bellowing roar, she charged in all directions with fury.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣāṇakhurapucchāgrairabhihatya samantataḥ /
rājamantribalaṃ sarvaṃ vyadrāvayadamarṣitā //
meaning:
विषाणखुरपुच्छाग्रैरभिहत्य समन्ततः /
राजमन्त्रिबलं सर्वं व्यद्रावयदमर्षिता //
text_mt:
Striking all around with the tips of her horns, hooves, and tail,
infuriated, she routed the entire army of the king's minister.

sanskrit_iast:
vidrāvya kiṅkarānsarvāṃstarasaiva payasvinī /
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ gaganaṃ pratyapadyata //
meaning:
विद्राव्य किङ्करान्सर्वांस्तरसैव पयस्विनी /
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां गगनं प्रत्यपद्यत //
text_mt:
Having swiftly routed all the servants, the milch cow
took to the sky while all creatures watched.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste bhagnasaṃkalpāḥ saṃbhagnakṣatavigrahāḥ /
prasahya baddhvā tadvatsaṃ jagmurevātinirghṛṇāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते भग्नसंकल्पाः संभग्नक्षतविग्रहाः /
प्रसह्य बद्ध्वा तद्वत्सं जग्मुरेवातिनिर्घृणाः //
text_mt:
Then, their purpose foiled, their bodies bruised and wounded,
those utterly pitiless men forcefully bound her calf and departed.

sanskrit_iast:
payasvinīṃ vinā vatsaṃ gṛhītvā kiṅkaraiḥ saha /
sa pāpastarasā rājñaḥ sannidhiṃ samupāgamat //
meaning:
पयस्विनीं विना वत्सं गृहीत्वा किङ्करैः सह /
स पापस्तरसा राज्ञः सन्निधिं समुपागमत् //
text_mt:
Taking the calf without the milch cow, along with his servants,
that wicked man swiftly went into the presence of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā samīpaṃ nṛpateḥ praṇamyāsmai praśaṃsakṛt /
tadvrattāntamaśeṣeṇa vyācacakṣe sasādhvasaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāder'junopākhyāne ekonatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 29//
meaning:
गत्वा समीपं नृपतेः प्रणम्यास्मै प्रशंसकृत् /
तद्व्रत्तान्तमशेषेण व्याचचक्षे ससाध्वसः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादेर्ऽजुनोपाख्याने एकोनत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 29//
text_mt:
Having gone near the king, bowing to him and offering praise,
he recounted the whole event in full, filled with apprehension.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter in the story of Arjuna, in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
vāsiṣṭha uvāca
śrusvaitatsakalaṃ rājā jamadagnivadhādikam /
udvignacetāḥ subhṛśaṃ cintayāmāsa naikadhā //
meaning:
वासिष्ठ उवाच
श्रुस्वैतत्सकलं राजा जमदग्निवधादिकम् /
उद्विग्नचेताः सुभृशं चिन्तयामास नैकधा //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Hearing all this, beginning with the striking down of Jamadagni,
the king, greatly agitated in mind, reflected in many ways:

sanskrit_iast:
aho me sunṛsaṃsasya lokayorubhayorapi /
brahmasvaharaṇe vāñchā taddhatyā cātigarhitā //
meaning:
अहो मे सुनृसंसस्य लोकयोरुभयोरपि /
ब्रह्मस्वहरणे वाञ्छा तद्धत्या चातिगर्हिता //
text_mt:
"Alas! For me, so cruel, in both worlds
the desire to steal a brahmin's property and the assault upon him are utterly condemned!

sanskrit_iast:
aho nāśrauṣamasyāhaṃ brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ /
vacanaṃ tarhi tāṃ jahyāṃ vimūḍhātmā gatatrapaḥ //
meaning:
अहो नाश्रौषमस्याहं ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः /
वचनं तर्हि तां जह्यां विमूढात्मा गतत्रपः //
text_mt:
Alas! I did not listen to the word of that wise brahmin;
then I, deluded in mind and devoid of shame, would have abandoned that [cow]!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃcitayannaṃva hṛdayena vidūyatā /
svapuraṃ praticakrāma sabalaḥ sānugastataḥ //
meaning:
इति संचितयन्नंव हृदयेन विदूयता /
स्वपुरं प्रतिचक्राम सबलः सानुगस्ततः //
text_mt:
Thus reflecting with an aching heart,
he then departed toward his own city with his army and followers.

sanskrit_iast:
purīṃ pratigate rājñi tasminsaparivārake /
āśramātsahasā rājanviniścakrāma reṇukā //
meaning:
पुरीं प्रतिगते राज्ञि तस्मिन्सपरिवारके /
आश्रमात्सहसा राजन्विनिश्चक्राम रेणुका //
text_mt:
When that king had set out toward the city with his retinue,
O king, Reṇukā suddenly came out from the hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sakṣatasarvāṅgaṃ rudhireṇa pariplutam /
niśceṣṭaṃ paritaṃ bhūmau dadarśa patimātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अथ सक्षतसर्वाङ्गं रुधिरेण परिप्लुतम् /
निश्चेष्टं परितं भूमौ ददर्श पतिमात्मनः //
text_mt: Then she saw her husband with all his limbs wounded, bathed in blood, / lying motionless on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā vihataṃ matvā bharttāraṃ gatacetanam /
anvāhatevāśaninā mūrchitānyapatadbhuvi //
meaning:
ततः सा विहतं मत्वा भर्त्तारं गतचेतनम् /
अन्वाहतेवाशनिना मूर्छितान्यपतद्भुवि //
text_mt: Then, seeing her husband struck down and bereft of consciousness, / as if struck down by a thunderbolt, she fainted and fell to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
cirādiva punarbhūmerutthāyātīva duḥkhitā /
patitvotthāya sā bhūyaḥ susvaraṃ praruroda ha //
meaning:
चिरादिव पुनर्भूमेरुत्थायातीव दुःखिता /
पतित्वोत्थाय सा भूयः सुस्वरं प्ररुरोद ह //
text_mt: Rising from the ground as if after a long time, exceedingly grieved, / falling down and rising again, she wept aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
vilalāpa ca sātyarthaṃ dharaṇīdhūlidhūsarā /
aśrupūrmamukhī dīnā patitā śokasāgare //
meaning:
विललाप च सात्यर्थं धरणीधूलिधूसरा /
अश्रुपूर्ममुखी दीना पतिता शोकसागरे //
text_mt: And she lamented bitterly, grey with the dust of the earth, / her face filled with tears, wretched, fallen into an ocean of sorrow:

sanskrit_iast:
hā nātha piya dharmajña dākṣiṇyāmṛtasāgara /
hā dhigatyantaśānta tvaṃ naiva kāṅkṣeta cedṛśam //
meaning:
हा नाथ पिय धर्मज्ञ दाक्षिण्यामृतसागर /
हा धिगत्यन्तशान्त त्वं नैव काङ्क्षेत चेदृशम् //
text_mt: “Ah, lord, beloved, knower of dharma, ocean of the nectar of kindness! / Ah, alas! You who were exceedingly tranquil could never have anticipated such [a fate]!

sanskrit_iast:
āśramādabhiniṣkrāntaḥ sahasā vyasānarṇave /
kṣiptvānāthāmagādhe māṃ kva ca yāto 'si mānada //
meaning:
आश्रमादभिनिष्क्रान्तः सहसा व्यसानर्णवे /
क्षिप्त्वानाथामगाधे मां क्व च यातो ऽसि मानद //
text_mt: Having stepped out of the hermitage, into a fathomless ocean of calamity / having suddenly cast me, helpless—where have you gone, O granter of honour?

sanskrit_iast:
satāṃ sāptapade maitre muṣitāhaṃ tvayā saha /
yāsi yatra tvamekākī tatra māṃ netumarhasi //
meaning:
सतां साप्तपदे मैत्रे मुषिताहं त्वया सह /
यासि यत्र त्वमेकाकी तत्र मां नेतुमर्हसि //
text_mt: In the friendship of the virtuous that spans seven paces, I was united with you; / where you go alone, there you ought to take me.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tvāmīdṛśāvasthamacirāddhṛdayaṃ mama /
na dīryate mahābhāga kaṭhināḥ khalu yoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा त्वामीदृशावस्थमचिराद्धृदयं मम /
न दीर्यते महाभाग कठिनाः खलु योषितः //
text_mt: Having seen you in such a state, why does my heart not instantly / burst asunder, O illustrious one? Hard indeed are women!

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ vilapantī sā rudatī ca muhurmuhuḥ /
cukrośa rāmarāmeti bhṛśaṃ duḥkhapariplutā //
meaning:
इत्येवं विलपन्ती सा रुदती च मुहुर्मुहुः /
चुक्रोश रामरामेति भृशं दुःखपरिप्लुता //
text_mt: Thus lamenting and weeping again and again, / overwhelmed with intense grief, she cried out repeatedly, ‘O Rāma, Rāma!’

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadrāmo 'pi sa vanātsamidbhārasamanvitaḥ /
akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ svāśramāya nyavarttata //
meaning:
तावद्रामो ऽपि स वनात्समिद्भारसमन्वितः /
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः स्वाश्रमाय न्यवर्त्तत //
text_mt: Meanwhile, Rāma also, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa / and bearing a load of firewood from the forest, returned to his hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
apaśyadbhayaśaṃsīni nimittāni bahūni saḥ /
paśyannudvignahṛdayastūrṇaṃ prāpāśramaṃ vibhuḥ //
meaning:
अपश्यद्भयशंसीनि निमित्तानि बहूनि सः /
पश्यन्नुद्विग्नहृदयस्तूर्णं प्रापाश्रमं विभुः //
text_mt: He saw many portents foreboding danger; / seeing them, anxious at heart, the powerful one quickly reached the hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya rudatī sā bhṛśāturā /
navibhūteva śokena prārudadreṇukā punaḥ //
meaning:
तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य रुदती सा भृशातुरा /
नविभूतेव शोकेन प्रारुदद्रेणुका पुनः //
text_mt: Seeing him arriving, weeping and deeply tormented, / as if renewed by grief, Reṇukā wept again.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya purato rājanbhartṛvyasanapīḍitā /
ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāmudaraṃ samatāḍayat //
meaning:
रामस्य पुरतो राजन्भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता /
उभाभ्यामपि हस्ताभ्यामुदरं समताडयत् //
text_mt: In front of Rāma, O king, afflicted by the calamity that had befallen her husband, / she beat her breast with both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
mārge viditavṛttāntaḥ samyagrāmo 'pi mātaram /
kurarīmiva śokārttā dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamupeyivān //
meaning:
मार्गे विदितवृत्तान्तः सम्यग्रामो ऽपि मातरम् /
कुररीमिव शोकार्त्ता दृष्ट्वा दुःखमुपेयिवान् //
text_mt: Rāma too, who had learned the event on the way, / seeing his mother afflicted with grief like an osprey, was overcome with sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
dhairyamāropya medhāvī duḥśaśokapariplutaḥ /
netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ tasthau bhūmāvardhomukhaḥ //
meaning:
धैर्यमारोप्य मेधावी दुःशशोकपरिप्लुतः /
नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां तस्थौ भूमावर्धोमुखः //
text_mt: Summoning fortitude, the wise one, overwhelmed with difficult grief, / stood on the ground with his eyes filled with tears, his face turned down.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tathāgatamālokya rāmaṃ prāhākṛtavraṇaḥ /
kimidaṃ bhṛguśārdūla naitatvayyupapādyate //
meaning:
तं तथागतमालोक्य रामं प्राहाकृतव्रणः /
किमिदं भृगुशार्दूल नैतत्वय्युपपाद्यते //
text_mt: Observing Rāma in that condition, Akṛtavraṇa said: / ‘What is this, O tiger of the Bhṛgus? This does not befit you.

sanskrit_iast:
na tvādṛśā mahābhāga bhṛśaṃ śocanti kutracit /
dhṛtimanto mahāntastu duḥkhaṃ kurvati na vyaye //
meaning:
न त्वादृशा महाभाग भृशं शोचन्ति कुत्रचित् /
धृतिमन्तो महान्तस्तु दुःखं कुर्वति न व्यये //
text_mt: Men like you, O illustrious one, never grieve exceedingly anywhere; / the great who possess steadfastness do not indulge in grief at loss.

sanskrit_iast:
śokaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ hi pariśoṣapradāyakaḥ /
tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho na tatpātraṃ bhavadṛśāḥ //
meaning:
शोकः सर्वेन्द्रियाणां हि परिशोषप्रदायकः /
त्यज शोकं महाबाहो न तत्पात्रं भवदृशाः //
text_mt: For grief causes the drying up of all the senses; / abandon grief, O mighty-armed one! Those like you are not a vessel for it.

sanskrit_iast:
ehikāmuṣmikārthānāṃ nūnamekāntarodhakaḥ /
śokastasyāvakāśaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ tdṛdi niyacchasi //
meaning:
एहिकामुष्मिकार्थानां नूनमेकान्तरोधकः /
शोकस्तस्यावकाशं त्वं कथं त्दृदि नियच्छसि //
text_mt: Grief is surely the absolute obstructor of worldly and otherworldly goals; / why do you grant room to it in your heart?

sanskrit_iast:
tattvaṃ dhairyadhano bhūtvā parisāṃtvaya mātaram /
rudatīṃ bata vaidhavyaśaṃ kāpahatacetanām //
meaning:
तत्त्वं धैर्यधनो भूत्वा परिसांत्वय मातरम् /
रुदतीं बत वैधव्यशं कापहतचेतनाम् //
text_mt: Therefore, making fortitude your wealth, console your mother / who weeps, alas, her mind struck down by the apprehension of widowhood.

sanskrit_iast:
naivāgamanamastīha vyatikrāntasya vastunaḥ /
tasmādatītamakhilaṃ tyaktvā kṛtyaṃ vicintaya //
meaning:
नैवागमनमस्तीह व्यतिक्रान्तस्य वस्तुनः /
तस्मादतीतमखिलं त्यक्त्वा कृत्यं विचिन्तय //
text_mt: For in this world there is no return of a thing that has passed away; / therefore, leaving behind all that is past, consider what must be done.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ sāṃtvamānaśca tena duḥśasamanvitaḥ /
rāmaḥ saṃstaṃbhayāmāsa śanairātmānamātmanā //
meaning:
इत्येवं सांत्वमानश्च तेन दुःशसमन्वितः /
रामः संस्तंभयामास शनैरात्मानमात्मना //
text_mt: Thus consoled by him, Rāma, though filled with painful grief, / slowly restrained himself by himself.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhaśokaparītā hi reṇukā tvarudanmuhaḥ /
triḥsaptakṛtvo hastābhyāmudaraṃ samatāḍayat //
meaning:
दुःखशोकपरीता हि रेणुका त्वरुदन्मुहः /
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो हस्ताभ्यामुदरं समताडयत् //
text_mt: Overwhelmed with sorrow and grief, weeping repeatedly, / Reṇukā struck her breast with her hands thrice seven times.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvattadantikaṃ rāmaḥ samabhyetyāśrulocanaḥ /
rudatīmalamaṃbeti sāṃtvayāmāsa mātaram //
meaning:
तावत्तदन्तिकं रामः समभ्येत्याश्रुलोचनः /
रुदतीमलमंबेति सांत्वयामास मातरम् //
text_mt: Then Rāma, approaching near her with tearful eyes, / consoled his weeping mother, saying, ‘Enough, mother!’

sanskrit_iast:
uvācāpanayanduḥkhādbhartṛśokaparāyaṇām /
triḥsaptakṛtvo yadidaṃ tvayā vakṣaḥ samāhatam //
meaning:
उवाचापनयन्दुःखाद्भर्तृशोकपरायणाम् /
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो यदिदं त्वया वक्षः समाहतम् //
text_mt: Dispelling her from grief, devoted as she was to sorrow for her husband, he said: / ‘Since you have struck your breast thrice seven times,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatasaṃkhyamahaṃ tasmātkṣattrajāramaśeṣataḥ /
haniṣye bhuvi sarvatra satyametadbravimi te //
meaning:
तावतसंख्यमहं तस्मात्क्षत्त्रजारमशेषतः /
हनिष्ये भुवि सर्वत्र सत्यमेतद्ब्रविमि ते //
text_mt: therefore, that many times, I will completely slay the kṣatriya / stock everywhere on earth—this truth I speak to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ śokamutsṛjya dhairyamātiṣṭa sāṃpratam /
nāstyeva nūnamāyātamatikrāntasya vastunaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं शोकमुत्सृज्य धैर्यमातिष्ट सांप्रतम् /
नास्त्येव नूनमायातमतिक्रान्तस्य वस्तुनः //
text_mt: Therefore, cast off grief and resort to fortitude now; / surely there is no return for a thing that has passed away.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā reṇukā tena bhṛśaṃ duḥkhānvitāpi sā /
kṛcchrāddhairyaṃ samālaṃbya tatheti pratyabhāṣata //
meaning:
इत्युक्ता रेणुका तेन भृशं दुःखान्वितापि सा /
कृच्छ्राद्धैर्यं समालंब्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Thus addressed by him, Reṇukā, though filled with intense grief, / took hold of fortitude with difficulty and replied, ‘So be it.’

sanskrit_iast:
tato rāmo mahābāhuḥ pituḥ saha sahodaraiḥ /
agnau satkarttumārebhe dehaṃ rājanyathavidhi //
meaning:
ततो रामो महाबाहुः पितुः सह सहोदरैः /
अग्नौ सत्कर्त्तुमारेभे देहं राजन्यथविधि //
text_mt: Then the mighty-armed Rāma, together with his brothers, / began to consecrate his father's body in fire according to rule, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartṛśokaparitāṅgī reṇukāpi dṛḍhavratā /
putrānsarvānsamāhūya tvidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
भर्तृशोकपरिताङ्गी रेणुकापि दृढव्रता /
पुत्रान्सर्वान्समाहूय त्विदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Reṇukā too, her limbs enveloped in grief for her husband, firm in her resolve, / summoned all her sons and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
reṇukovāca /
ahaṃ va-pitaraṃ putrāḥ svargataṃ puṇyaśīlinam /
anugantumihecchāmi tanme 'nujñātumarhatha //
meaning:
रेणुकोवाच /
अहं व-पितरं पुत्राः स्वर्गतं पुण्यशीलिनम् /
अनुगन्तुमिहेच्छामि तन्मे ऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ //
text_mt: Reṇukā said: / ‘O sons, I wish to follow your father here, / who was of virtuous conduct and has gone to heaven; therefore, you ought to grant me permission.

sanskrit_iast:
asahyaduḥśaṃ vaidhavyaṃ sahamānā kathaṃ punaḥ /
bhartrā virahitā tena pravarttiṣye vininditā //
meaning:
असह्यदुःशं वैधव्यं सहमाना कथं पुनः /
भर्त्रा विरहिता तेन प्रवर्त्तिष्ये विनिन्दिता //
text_mt: Enduring widowhood, an unbearable sorrow, how again / could I live on, separated from that husband, reproached by all?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādanugamiṣyāmi bharttāraṃ dayitaṃ mama /
yathā tena pravarttiṣye paratrāpi sahāniśam //
meaning:
तस्मादनुगमिष्यामि भर्त्तारं दयितं मम /
यथा तेन प्रवर्त्तिष्ये परत्रापि सहानिशम् //
text_mt: Therefore, I will follow my beloved husband, / so that I may dwell together with him constantly in the other world as well.

sanskrit_iast:
jvalantamimamevāgniṃ saṃpraviśya cirādiva /
bharturmama bhaviṣyāmi pitṛlokapriyātithiḥ //
meaning:
ज्वलन्तमिममेवाग्निं संप्रविश्य चिरादिव /
भर्तुर्मम भविष्यामि पितृलोकप्रियातिथिः //
text_mt: Entering this very blazing fire, after a long time / I will become the beloved guest of my husband in the world of the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
anuvādamṛte putrā bhavadbhistatra karmaṇi /
pratibhūya na vaktavyaṃ yadi matpriyamicchatha //
meaning:
अनुवादमृते पुत्रा भवद्भिस्तत्र कर्मणि /
प्रतिभूय न वक्तव्यं यदि मत्प्रियमिच्छथ //
text_mt: Except for words of assent, O sons, concerning that act, / you must speak no word in opposition, if you wish to please me.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ reṇukā dṛḍhaniścayā /
agniṃ praviśya bharttāramanugantuṃ manodadhe //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं रेणुका दृढनिश्चया /
अग्निं प्रविश्य भर्त्तारमनुगन्तुं मनोदधे //
text_mt: Having spoken these words, Reṇukā, firm in her resolve, / set her mind on entering the fire to follow her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu reṇukāṃ tanayaiḥ saha /
samābhāṣyātigaṃbhīrā vāguvācāśarīrīṇī //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रेणुकां तनयैः सह /
समाभाष्यातिगंभीरा वागुवाचाशरीरीणी //
text_mt: At that very moment, however, addressing Reṇukā / along with her sons, a bodiless voice spoke, exceedingly deep:

sanskrit_iast:
he reṇuke svatanayairgiraṃ me 'vahitā śṛṇu /
mā kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ bhadre pravakṣyāmi priyaṃ tava //
meaning:
हे रेणुके स्वतनयैर्गिरं मे ऽवहिता शृणु /
मा कार्षीः साहसं भद्रे प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रियं तव //
text_mt: ‘O Reṇukā, listen attentively along with your sons to my words! / Do not act rashly, blessed lady! I shall speak what is beneficial to you.

sanskrit_iast:
sāhaso naiva karttavyaḥ kenāpyātmahitaiṣiṇā /
na marttavyantvayā sarvo jīvanbhadrāṇi paśyati //
meaning:
साहसो नैव कर्त्तव्यः केनाप्यात्महितैषिणा /
न मर्त्तव्यन्त्वया सर्वो जीवन्भद्राणि पश्यति //
text_mt: Rashness should never be committed by anyone desiring their own welfare; / you must not die. Living, anyone sees auspicious things.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddhairyadhanā bhūtvā bhava tvaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇī /
nimittamantarīkṛtya kiñcideva śucismite //
meaning:
तस्माद्धैर्यधना भूत्वा भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी /
निमित्तमन्तरीकृत्य किञ्चिदेव शुचिस्मिते //
text_mt: Therefore, making fortitude your wealth, await the appointed time, / finding some pretext, O lady of pure smiles!

sanskrit_iast:
acireṇaiva bharttā te bhaviṣyati sacetanaḥ /
utpannajīvitena tvaṃ kāmaṃ prāpsyasi śobhane /
bhavitrī cirarātrāya bahukalyāṇa bhājanam //
meaning:
अचिरेणैव भर्त्ता ते भविष्यति सचेतनः /
उत्पन्नजीवितेन त्वं कामं प्राप्स्यसि शोभने /
भवित्री चिररात्राय बहुकल्याण भाजनम् //
text_mt: Before long your husband will become conscious; / with his life restored, you will attain your desire, O fair one, / and will be the recipient of much auspiciousness for many nights to come.’

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhṛtimālaṃbya reṇukā /
tadvākyagauravāddharṣamavāpustanayāśca te //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा धृतिमालंब्य रेणुका /
तद्वाक्यगौरवाद्धर्षमवापुस्तनयाश्च ते //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing those words, Reṇukā took courage; / and out of respect for those words, those sons experienced joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tatonītvā piturdehamāśramābhyantaraṃ muneḥ /
śāyayitvā nivāte tu paritaḥ samupāviśan //
meaning:
ततोनीत्वा पितुर्देहमाश्रमाभ्यन्तरं मुनेः /
शाययित्वा निवाते तु परितः समुपाविशन् //
text_mt: Then, having carried the body of the sage, their father, into the hermitage / and laid it in a place sheltered from the wind, they sat down around it.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tatropaviṣṭānāmaprahṛṣṭātmacetasām /
nimattāni śubhānyāsannanekāni mahānti ca //
meaning:
तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानामप्रहृष्टात्मचेतसाम् /
निमत्तानि शुभान्यासन्ननेकानि महान्ति च //
text_mt: For them seated there, their hearts dejected, / there occurred many great and auspicious omens.

sanskrit_iast:
tena te kiñcidāśvastacetaso munipuṅgavāḥ /
niṣeduḥ sahitā mātrā kāṅkṣanto jīvitaṃ pituḥ //
meaning:
तेन ते किञ्चिदाश्वस्तचेतसो मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
निषेदुः सहिता मात्रा काङ्क्षन्तो जीवितं पितुः //
text_mt: Thereby somewhat comforted at heart, those eminent sages / sat along with their mother, longing for their father's life.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rājanbhṛguvaṃśadharo muniḥ /
vidherbalena matimāṃstatrāgacchadyadṛcchayā //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन्भृगुवंशधरो मुनिः /
विधेर्बलेन मतिमांस्तत्रागच्छद्यदृच्छया //
text_mt: In the meantime, O king, an intelligent sage, the upholder of the lineage of Bhṛgu, / came there by chance through the power of destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
atharvaṇāṃ vidhiḥ sā kṣādvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ /
sarvaśāstrārthavitprājñaḥ sakalāsuravanditaḥ //
meaning:
अथर्वणां विधिः सा क्षाद्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः /
सर्वशास्त्रार्थवित्प्राज्ञः सकलासुरवन्दितः //
text_mt: He was the Atharvan ritual incarnate, master of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences, / wise, knower of the meaning of all treatises, praised by all the asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtasaṃjīvinīṃ vidyāṃ yo veda munidurlabhām /
yathāhatānmṛtāndevairutthāpayati dānavān //
meaning:
मृतसंजीविनीं विद्यां यो वेद मुनिदुर्लभाम् /
यथाहतान्मृतान्देवैरुत्थापयति दानवान् //
text_mt: who knew the lore that revives the dead, rare even for sages, / by which he would raise the dānavas slain and killed by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstramośanasaṃ yena rājñāṃ rājyaphalapradam /
praṇītamanujīvanti sarve 'dyāpīha pārthivāḥ //
meaning:
शास्त्रमोशनसं येन राज्ञां राज्यफलप्रदम् /
प्रणीतमनुजीवन्ति सर्वे ऽद्यापीह पार्थिवाः //
text_mt: By whom the treatise of Uśanas, bestowing the fruit of kingship upon kings, / was composed, by which all rulers on earth live even today.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadāśramamāsādya praviṣṭo 'ntarmahāmuniḥ /
dadarśa tadavasthāṃstānsarvānduḥkhapariplutān //
meaning:
स तदाश्रममासाद्य प्रविष्टो ऽन्तर्महामुनिः /
ददर्श तदवस्थांस्तान्सर्वान्दुःखपरिप्लुतान् //
text_mt: Having reached that hermitage, the great sage entered inside / and saw them in that condition, all overwhelmed by grief.

sanskrit_iast:
atha te tu bhṛguṃ dṛṣṭvā vaṃśamya pitaraṃ mudā /
utthāyāsmai daduścāpi satkṛtya paramāsanam //
meaning:
अथ ते तु भृगुं दृष्ट्वा वंशम्य पितरं मुदा /
उत्थायास्मै ददुश्चापि सत्कृत्य परमासनम् //
text_mt: Then, seeing Bhṛgu, the father of their lineage, with joy, / they stood up and, having honored him, offered him an excellent seat.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāśīrbhistu tānsarvānabhinandya mahāmuniḥ /
papraccha kimidaṃ vṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ te nyavedayan //
meaning:
स चाशीर्भिस्तु तान्सर्वानभिनन्द्य महामुनिः /
पप्रच्छ किमिदं वृत्तं तत्सर्वं ते न्यवेदयन् //
text_mt: And greeting them all with blessings, the great sage / asked, “What is this that has happened?” and they reported everything to him.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā sa bhṛguḥ śīghraṃ jalamādāya mantravit /
saṃjīvinyā vinayā taṃ siṣeca proccarannidam //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स भृगुः शीघ्रं जलमादाय मन्त्रवित् /
संजीविन्या विनया तं सिषेच प्रोच्चरन्निदम् //
text_mt: Hearing that, Bhṛgu, knowing the mantras, quickly took water, / and with the saṃjīvinī [spell] modestly sprinkled him, uttering this:

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasya tapaso vīya mamāpi śubhamasti cet /
tenāsau jīvatācchīghraṃ prasupta ivacotthitaḥ //
meaning:
यज्ञस्य तपसो वीय ममापि शुभमस्ति चेत् /
तेनासौ जीवताच्छीघ्रं प्रसुप्त इवचोत्थितः //
text_mt: “If there is any auspicious power in my sacrifice and asceticism, / by that let him quickly revive, like one awakened from sleep!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte śubhe vākye bhṛguṇā sādhukāriṇā /
samuttasthāvathārcīkaḥ sākṣādgrarurivāparaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते शुभे वाक्ये भृगुणा साधुकारिणा /
समुत्तस्थावथार्चीकः साक्षाद्ग्ररुरिवापरः //
text_mt: When this auspicious speech had been spoken by the virtuous Bhṛgu, / then [the son of] Ṛcīka stood up, like another Guru incarnate.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tatra sthitaṃ vandyaṃ bhṛguṃ svasya pitāmaham /
nanāma bhaktyā nṛpate kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र स्थितं वन्द्यं भृगुं स्वस्य पितामहम् /
ननाम भक्त्या नृपते कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह //
text_mt: Seeing the venerable Bhṛgu, his grandfather, standing there, / he bowed in devotion, O king, and with folded hands spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
dhanyo 'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo 'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ ca me //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
धन्यो ऽहं कृतकृत्यो ऽहं सफलं जीवितं च मे //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
“Blessed am I, fulfilled am I, and my life is fruitful,

sanskrit_iast:
yatpaśye caraṇau te 'dya surāsuranamaskṛtau /
bhagavankiṃ karomyadya śuśrūṣāṃ tava mānada //
meaning:
यत्पश्ये चरणौ ते ऽद्य सुरासुरनमस्कृतौ /
भगवन्किं करोम्यद्य शुश्रूषां तव मानद //
text_mt: since today I behold your two feet, revered by gods and asuras! / O Lord, what service shall I render to you today, O honor-giver?

sanskrit_iast:
punīhyātmakulaṃ svasya caraṇāṃbukaṇairvibho /
ityuktvā sahasā'nītaṃ rāmeṇārdhyaṃ mudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
पुनीह्यात्मकुलं स्वस्य चरणांबुकणैर्विभो /
इत्युक्त्वा सहसाऽनीतं रामेणार्ध्यं मुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Purify your own family with drops of water from your feet, O lord!” / Having spoken thus, filled with joy, [taking] the guest-offering brought quickly by Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
pradadau pādayostasya bhaktyāna mitakandharaḥ /
tajjalaṃ śirasādhatta sakuṭuṃbo mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
प्रददौ पादयोस्तस्य भक्त्यान मितकन्धरः /
तज्जलं शिरसाधत्त सकुटुंबो महामनाः //
text_mt: the high-minded one, bowing his head in devotion, poured it at his feet, / and together with his family placed that water on his head.

sanskrit_iast:
atha satkṛtya sa bhṛguṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ /
bhagavan kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena rājñā duṣṭena pātakam //
meaning:
अथ सत्कृत्य स भृगुं पप्रच्छ विनयान्वितः /
भगवन् किं कृतं तेन राज्ञा दुष्टेन पातकम् //
text_mt:
Then, having honored Bhṛgu, he inquired with humility:
“O venerable one, what sin was committed by that wicked king,

sanskrit_iast:
yasyātithyaṃ hi kṛtavānahaṃ samyagvidhānataḥ /
sādhubuddhyāsa duṣṭātmā kiṃ cakāra mahāmate //
meaning:
यस्यातिथ्यं हि कृतवानहं सम्यग्विधानतः /
साधुबुद्ध्यास दुष्टात्मा किं चकार महामते //
text_mt: to whom I offered hospitality duly according to rule / with pious intent? What did that wicked soul do, O high-minded one?”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ sa pṛṣṭo matimānbhṛguḥ sarvavidīśvaraḥ /
ciraṃ dhyātvā samālocya kāraṇaṃ prāha bhūpate //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं स पृष्टो मतिमान्भृगुः सर्वविदीश्वरः /
चिरं ध्यात्वा समालोच्य कारणं प्राह भूपते //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Thus questioned, the wise Bhṛgu, the all-knowing lord, / having meditated long and reflected upon the cause, spoke, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛguruvāca
śṛṇu tāta mahābhāga bījamasya hi karmaṇaḥ /
yaśca vai kṛtavānpāpaṃ sarvajñasya tavānagha //
meaning:
भृगुरुवाच
शृणु तात महाभाग बीजमस्य हि कर्मणः /
यश्च वै कृतवान्पापं सर्वज्ञस्य तवानघ //
text_mt:
Bhṛgu said:
“Listen, my dear fortunate one, to the seed of this deed / and of the sin which he committed against you who are all-knowing and sinless.

sanskrit_iast:
śaptaḥ purā vasiṣṭhena nāśārthaṃ sa mahīpatiḥ /
dvijāparādhato mūḍha vīryaṃ te vinaśiṣyate //
meaning:
शप्तः पुरा वसिष्ठेन नाशार्थं स महीपतिः /
द्विजापराधतो मूढ वीर्यं ते विनशिष्यते //
text_mt:
Formerly that lord of the earth was cursed by Vasiṣṭha for his destruction:
‘Because of an offense against a twice-born, O fool, your valor shall perish!’

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathaṃ vacanaṃ tasya bhaviṣyatyanyathā muneḥ /
ayaṃ rāmo mahāvīryaṃ prasahyanṛpapuṅgavam //
meaning:
तत्कथं वचनं तस्य भविष्यत्यन्यथा मुनेः /
अयं रामो महावीर्यं प्रसह्यनृपपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt: How then will that word of the sage turn out otherwise? / This Rāma, overpowering the bull of kings possessed of great valor,

sanskrit_iast:
haniṣyati mahābāho pratijñāṃ kṛtavānpurā /
yasmāduraḥ pratihataṃ tvayā mātarmamāgrataḥ //
meaning:
हनिष्यति महाबाहो प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान्पुरा /
यस्मादुरः प्रतिहतं त्वया मातर्ममाग्रतः //
text_mt:
shall slay him, O mighty-armed one! Formerly he made a vow:
‘Because, O mother, your breast was struck before me

sanskrit_iast:
ekaviṃśativāraṃ hi bhṛśaṃ duḥkhaparītayā /
triḥ saptakṛtvo niḥkṣatrāṃ kariṣye pṛthivīmimām //
meaning:
एकविंशतिवारं हि भृशं दुःखपरीतया /
त्रिः सप्तकृत्वो निःक्षत्रां करिष्ये पृथिवीमिमाम् //
text_mt: twenty-one times by you who were overwhelmed with intense grief, / thrice seven times I will make this earth bereft of kṣatriyas!’

sanskrit_iast:
ato 'yaṃ vāryamāṇo 'pi tvāyā pitrā nirantaram /
bhāvinor'thasya ca balātkariṣyatyeva mānada //
meaning:
अतो ऽयं वार्यमाणो ऽपि त्वाया पित्रा निरन्तरम् /
भाविनोर्ऽथस्य च बलात्करिष्यत्येव मानद //
text_mt: Therefore, even though continuously restrained by you, his father, / he will indeed carry it out by the force of what is destined to be, O honor-giver.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu rājā mahābhāgo vṛddhānāṃ paryupāsitā /
dattātreyāddhareraṃśāllabdhabodho mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
स तु राजा महाभागो वृद्धानां पर्युपासिता /
दत्तात्रेयाद्धरेरंशाल्लब्धबोधो महामतिः //
text_mt: Yet that king is highly fortunate, an attendant of the elders, / highly intelligent, having attained knowledge from Dattātreya, a portion of Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣādbhakto mahātmā ca tadvadhe pātakaṃ bhavet /
evamuktvā mahārāja sa bhṛgurbrahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ /
yathāgataṃ yayau vidvānbhaviṣyatkālaparyayāt //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyābhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite triṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 30//
meaning:
साक्षाद्भक्तो महात्मा च तद्वधे पातकं भवेत् /
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज स भृगुर्ब्रह्मणः सुतः /
यथागतं ययौ विद्वान्भविष्यत्कालपर्ययात् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्याभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 30//
text_mt:
a direct devotee and a great soul; there will be sin in slaying him.” / Having spoken thus, O great king, Bhṛgu, the son of Brahmā, / being wise, departed just as he had come, in accordance with the course of future time.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter in the Bhārgavacarita, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
brahmaputra mahābhāga vada bhārgavaceṣṭitam /
yaccakāra mahāvīryyo rājñaḥ kruddho hi karmaṇā //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
ब्रह्मपुत्र महाभाग वद भार्गवचेष्टितम् /
यच्चकार महावीर्य्यो राज्ञः क्रुद्धो हि कर्मणा //
text_mt:
Sagara said:
“O fortunate son of Brahmā, describe the deeds of the Bhārgava, / which the one of great valor performed, enraged indeed by the king's action.”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
gate tasminmahābhāge bhṛgo pitṛparāyaṇaḥ /
rāmaḥ provāca saṃkruddho muñcañchvāsānmuharmuhuḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
गते तस्मिन्महाभागे भृगो पितृपरायणः /
रामः प्रोवाच संक्रुद्धो मुञ्चञ्छ्वासान्मुहर्मुहुः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
When that fortunate Bhṛgu had gone, Rāma, devoted to his father, / spoke, enraged, sighing heavily again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
paraśurāma uvāca
aho paśyata mūḍhatvaṃrājño hyutpathagāminaḥ /
kārttavīryasya yo vidvāṃścakre brahmavadhodyamam //
meaning:
परशुराम उवाच
अहो पश्यत मूढत्वंराज्ञो ह्युत्पथगामिनः /
कार्त्तवीर्यस्य यो विद्वांश्चक्रे ब्रह्मवधोद्यमम् //
text_mt:
Paraśurāma said:
“Ah, behold the foolishness of the king who strays from the proper path, / of Kārttavīrya who, though learned, undertook to kill a brāhmaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
daivaṃ hi balavanmanye yatprabhāvāccharīriṇaḥ /
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ sarve prakurvanti vimohitāḥ //
meaning:
दैवं हि बलवन्मन्ये यत्प्रभावाच्छरीरिणः /
शुभं वाप्यशुभं सर्वे प्रकुर्वन्ति विमोहिताः //
text_mt: Indeed I deem fate to be powerful, through whose influence embodied beings, / all deluded, perform what is auspicious or inauspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇavantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve pratijñā kriyate mayā /
kārttavīryaṃ nihatyājau piturvairaṃ prasādhaye //
meaning:
शृणवन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे प्रतिज्ञा क्रियते मया /
कार्त्तवीर्यं निहत्याजौ पितुर्वैरं प्रसाधये //
text_mt: Let all the ṛṣis hear the vow made by me: / Having slain Kārttavīrya in battle, I will avenge my father.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi rājā suraiḥ sarvairindrāddairdānavaistathā /
rakṣiṣyate tathāpyenaṃ saṃhariṣyāmi nānyathā //
meaning:
यदि राजा सुरैः सर्वैरिन्द्राद्दैर्दानवैस्तथा /
रक्षिष्यते तथाप्येनं संहरिष्यामि नान्यथा //
text_mt: Even if the king is protected by all the gods headed by Indra and by the dānavas, / nevertheless I will destroy him, not otherwise!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktaṃ samākarṇya rāmeṇa samuhātmanā /
jamadagniruvācedaṃ putraṃ sāhasabhāṣiṇam //
meaning:
एवमुक्तं समाकर्ण्य रामेण समुहात्मना /
जमदग्निरुवाचेदं पुत्रं साहसभाषिणम् //
text_mt: Hearing this spoken by the high-souled Rāma, / Jamadagni said this to his son who spoke with audacity:

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
śruṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi satāṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam /
yacchrutvā mānavāḥ sarve jāyante dharmakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
श्रुणु राम प्रवक्ष्यामि सतां धर्मं सनातनम् /
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवाः सर्वे जायन्ते धर्मकारिणः //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
“Listen, Rāma, I will tell the eternal dharma of the virtuous, / hearing which all mortals become performers of righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhavo ye mahābhāgāḥ saṃsārānmokṣakāṅkṣiṇāḥ /
na kasmaicitprakupyanti ninditāstāḍitā api //
meaning:
साधवो ये महाभागाः संसारान्मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणाः /
न कस्मैचित्प्रकुप्यन्ति निन्दितास्ताडिता अपि //
text_mt: Those virtuous, highly fortunate ones who desire liberation from the cycle of existence / do not become angry at anyone, even when insulted or beaten.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamādhanā mahābhāgā ye ca dāntāstapasvinaḥ /
teṣāṃ caivākṣayā lokāḥ satataṃ sādhukāriṇām //
meaning:
क्षमाधना महाभागा ये च दान्तास्तपस्विनः /
तेषां चैवाक्षया लोकाः सततं साधुकारिणाम् //
text_mt: Those whose wealth is patience, the highly fortunate, self-controlled ascetics— / imperishable worlds belong to those who ever do what is good.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu duṣṭaistu daṇḍādyairvacasāpi ca tāḍitaḥ /
na ca kṣobhamavāpnoti sa sādhuḥ parikīrtthate //
meaning:
यस्तु दुष्टैस्तु दण्डाद्यैर्वचसापि च ताडितः /
न च क्षोभमवाप्नोति स साधुः परिकीर्त्थते //
text_mt: He who, though struck by the wicked with sticks and the like, or even with words, / does not become agitated, is proclaimed to be virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayettāḍayantaṃ yo na ca sādhuḥ sa pāpabhāk /
kṣamayār'haṇatāṃ prāptāḥ sādhavo brāhmaṇā vayam //
meaning:
ताडयेत्ताडयन्तं यो न च साधुः स पापभाक् /
क्षमयार्ऽहणतां प्राप्ताः साधवो ब्राह्मणा वयम् //
text_mt: He who strikes back at one who strikes is not virtuous; he incurs sin. / Through forgiveness we virtuous brāhmaṇas have attained worshipfulness.

sanskrit_iast:
naranāthavadhe tāta pātakaṃ sumahadbhavet /
tasmānnivāraye tvādya kṣamāṃ kuru tapaścara //
meaning:
नरनाथवधे तात पातकं सुमहद्भवेत् /
तस्मान्निवारये त्वाद्य क्षमां कुरु तपश्चर //
text_mt: In the slaying of a ruler of men, my son, there would be a very great sin. / Therefore I restrain you today: practice patience and perform asceticism!”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ pitrā samādiṣṭaṃ vijñāya nṛpanandana /
rāmaḥ provāca pitaraṃ kṣamāśīlamarindamam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं पित्रा समादिष्टं विज्ञाय नृपनन्दन /
रामः प्रोवाच पितरं क्षमाशीलमरिन्दमम् //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Understanding what was thus instructed by his father, O prince, / Rāma spoke to his father, the subduer of foes whose nature was forgiveness:

sanskrit_iast:
paraśurāma uvāca
śṛṇu tāta mahāprājña vi5ptiṃ mama sāṃpratam /
bhavatā śama uddiṣṭaḥ sādhūnāṃ sumahātmanām //
meaning:
परशुराम उवाच
शृणु तात महाप्राज्ञ वि5प्तिं मम सांप्रतम् /
भवता शम उद्दिष्टः साधूनां सुमहात्मनाम् //
text_mt:
Paraśurāma said:
“Listen, my dear father of great wisdom, to my petition now. / Peace has been taught by you for virtuous, high-souled men.

sanskrit_iast:
ma śamaḥ sādhudīneṣu guruṣvīśvarabhāvanaiḥ /
karttavyo duṣṭaceṣṭeṣu na śamaḥ sukhado bhavet //
meaning:
म शमः साधुदीनेषु गुरुष्वीश्वरभावनैः /
कर्त्तव्यो दुष्टचेष्टेषु न शमः सुखदो भवेत् //
text_mt: Peace should be observed toward the good, the poor, and teachers, with the feeling of the Lord; / toward those of wicked deeds, peace would not bring happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādasya vadhaḥ kāryaḥ kārttavīryasya vai mayā /
dehyājñāṃ mānanīyādya sādhaye vairamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादस्य वधः कार्यः कार्त्तवीर्यस्य वै मया /
देह्याज्ञां माननीयाद्य साधये वैरमात्मनः //
text_mt: Therefore, the slaying of this Kārttavīrya must indeed be done by me. / Give your permission today, O venerable one; let me avenge myself!”

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga vaco mama samāhitaḥ /
kariṣyasi yathā bhāvi tathā naivānyathā bhavet //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
शृणु राम महाभाग वचो मम समाहितः /
करिष्यसि यथा भावि तथा नैवान्यथा भवेत् //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
“Listen with attention, O fortunate Rāma, to my words: / You will do what is destined to be, so it cannot happen otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
ito vrajatvaṃ brahmāṇāṃ bṛccha tāta hitāhitam /
sa yadvadiṣyati vibhustatkarttā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
इतो व्रजत्वं ब्रह्माणां बृच्छ तात हिताहितम् /
स यद्वदिष्यति विभुस्तत्कर्त्ता नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Go from here to Brahmā and ask him, my son, what is beneficial and what is harmful. / Whatever that sovereign lord says, that you will do, no doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktaḥ sa pitaraṃ namaskṛtya mahāmatiḥ /
jagāma brahmaṇo lokamagamyaṃ prākṛtairjanaiḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवमुक्तः स पितरं नमस्कृत्य महामतिः /
जगाम ब्रह्मणो लोकमगम्यं प्राकृतैर्जनैः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Thus spoken to, the wise one, having bowed to his father, / went to the world of Brahmā, inaccessible to ordinary men.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa brahmaṇo lokaṃ śātakaiṃbhavinirmitam /
svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ maṇistaṃbhairvimūṣitam //
meaning:
ददर्श ब्रह्मणो लोकं शातकैंभविनिर्मितम् /
स्वर्णप्राकारसंयुक्तं मणिस्तंभैर्विमूषितम् //
text_mt: He saw the world of Brahmā made of gold, / endowed with golden ramparts and adorned with jeweled pillars.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyatsamāsīnaṃ brahmāṇamamitaujasam /
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यत्समासीनं ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् /
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये रत्नभूषणभूषितम् //
text_mt: There he saw Brahmā seated, possessed of immeasurable splendor, / on a delightful jeweled throne, adorned with gem-encrusted ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhendraiśca munīndraiśca veṣṭitaṃ dhyānatatparaiḥ /
vidyādharīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā //
meaning:
सिद्धेन्द्रैश्च मुनीन्द्रैश्च वेष्टितं ध्यानतत्परैः /
विद्याधरीणां नृत्यं च पश्यन्तं सस्मितं मुदा //
text_mt: surrounded by lords of siddhas and lords of sages intent on meditation, / smiling with joy as he watched the dance of the vidyādharġs,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā phaladātāraṃ karttāraṃ jagatāṃ vibhum /
paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma dhyāyataṃ yatamānasam //
meaning:
तपसा फलदातारं कर्त्तारं जगतां विभुम् /
परिपूर्णतमं ब्रह्म ध्यायतं यतमानसम् //
text_mt: the giver of the fruits of asceticism, the maker and all-pervading lord of the worlds, / his mind restrained as he contemplated the most absolute Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
guhyayogaṃ pravocantaṃ bhaktavṛndeṣu saṃtatam /
dṛṣṭvā tamavyayaṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma bhṛgūdvahaḥ //
meaning:
गुह्ययोगं प्रवोचन्तं भक्तवृन्देषु संततम् /
दृष्ट्वा तमव्ययं भक्त्या प्रणनाम भृगूद्वहः //
text_mt: constantly expounding secret yoga among the hosts of devotees. / Having seen that imperishable one, the scion of Bhṛgu bowed down with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā vinataṃ rāmamāśīrbhirabhinandya ca /
papraccha kuśalaṃ vatsa kathamāgamanaṃ kṛthāḥ //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा विनतं राममाशीर्भिरभिनन्द्य च /
पप्रच्छ कुशलं वत्स कथमागमनं कृथाः //
text_mt: Having seen Rāma bowed down and greeting him with blessings, / he asked after his welfare: “Child, why have you come?”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpṛṣṭo vidhinā rāmaḥ provācākhilamāditaḥ /
vṛttāntaṃ kārttavīryasya pituḥ svasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
संपृष्टो विधिना रामः प्रोवाचाखिलमादितः /
वृत्तान्तं कार्त्तवीर्यस्य पितुः स्वस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: Questioned by the Creator, Rāma related everything from the beginning: / the story of Kārttavġryārjuna and of his own noble father.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā sakalaṃ brahmā vijñātārtho 'pi mānada /
uvāca rāmaṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सकलं ब्रह्मा विज्ञातार्थो ऽपि मानद /
उवाच रामं धर्मिष्ठं परिणामसुखावहम् //
text_mt: Hearing all that, O giver of honor, Brahmā, though he already knew the matter, / spoke to the most righteous Rāma words bringing ultimate happiness:

sanskrit_iast:
pratijñā durlabhā vatsa yāṃ bhavankṛtavānruṣā /
sṛṣṭi reṣā bhagavataḥ saṃbhavetkṛpayā baṭo //
meaning:
प्रतिज्ञा दुर्लभा वत्स यां भवन्कृतवान्रुषा /
सृष्टि रेषा भगवतः संभवेत्कृपया बटो //
text_mt: “Difficult is the vow, my child, which you have made in anger; / this creation of the Lord came to be through compassion, O boy.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsṛṣṭaṃ mayā tāta saṃkleśena tadājñayā /
tannāśakāriṇī caiva pratijñā bhavatā kṛtā //
meaning:
जगत्सृष्टं मया तात संक्लेशेन तदाज्ञया /
तन्नाशकारिणी चैव प्रतिज्ञा भवता कृता //
text_mt: The world was created by me, dear child, with great effort at his command; / yet a vow has been taken by you to destroy it.

sanskrit_iast:
triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kartumicchasi medinīm /
ekasya rājño doṣeṇa pituḥ paribhavena ca //
meaning:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां कर्तुमिच्छसि मेदिनीम् /
एकस्य राज्ञो दोषेण पितुः परिभवेन च //
text_mt: Three times seven times you wish to rid the earth of kings / on account of the fault of a single king and the humiliation of your father.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatrriyaviṭśūdraiḥ sṛṣṭireṣā sanātanī /
āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā harereva punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्र्रियविट्शूद्रैः सृष्टिरेषा सनातनी /
आविर्भूता तिरोभूता हरेरेव पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: This eternal creation consisting of brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśhyas, and śūdras / is manifested and dissolved again and again by Hari alone.

sanskrit_iast:
avyarthā tvatpratijñā tu bhavitrī prāktanena ca /
yadvāyāsena te kāryasiddhirbhavitumarhati //
meaning:
अव्यर्था त्वत्प्रतिज्ञा तु भवित्री प्राक्तनेन च /
यद्वायासेन ते कार्यसिद्धिर्भवितुमर्हति //
text_mt: Yet your vow will not be in vain, due to past karma, / or rather, through effort, your undertaking may achieve success.

sanskrit_iast:
śivalokaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ śivasyājñāmavāpnuhi /
pṛthivyāṃ bahavo bhūpāḥ saṃti śaṅkarakiṅkarāḥ //
meaning:
शिवलोकं प्रयाहि त्वं शिवस्याज्ञामवाप्नुहि /
पृथिव्यां बहवो भूपाः संति शङ्करकिङ्कराः //
text_mt: Go to the realm of Śiva and obtain the command of Śiva; / on earth there are many kings who are servants of Śankara.

sanskrit_iast:
vinaivājñāṃ maheśasya ko vā tānhantumīśvaraḥ /
bibhrataḥ kavacānyaṅge śaktīścāpi durāsadāḥ //
meaning:
विनैवाज्ञां महेशस्य को वा तान्हन्तुमीश्वरः /
बिभ्रतः कवचान्यङ्गे शक्तीश्चापि दुरासदाः //
text_mt: Without the very command of the great lord, who indeed is capable of slaying them, / clad as they are in armors and bearing powers hard to overcome?

sanskrit_iast:
upāyaṃ kuru yatnena jayabījaṃ śubhāvaham /
upāye tu samārabdhe sarve sidhyantyupakramāḥ //
meaning:
उपायं कुरु यत्नेन जयबीजं शुभावहम् /
उपाये तु समारब्धे सर्वे सिध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः //
text_mt: Diligently adopt an expedient, the auspicious seed of victory; / for when an expedient is undertaken, all endeavors succeed.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ kavacaṃ gṛhṇa vatsa gurorharāt /
durllaṅghyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ śivaśaktirvijeṣyati //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णमन्त्रं कवचं गृह्ण वत्स गुरोर्हरात् /
दुर्ल्लङ्घ्यं वैष्णवं तेजः शिवशक्तिर्विजेष्यति //
text_mt: Receive, my child, from your guru Hara the mantra of Śrikṛṣṇa and the armor; / the impassable Vaiṣṇava energy, combined with Śiva’s power, will conquer.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam /
yathākathaṃ ca vijñāpya śaṅkaraṃ labhadurlabham //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं परमाद्भुतम् /
यथाकथं च विज्ञाप्य शङ्करं लभदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: It is the most wondrous armor named Trailokyavijaya; / by any means petitioning Śankara, obtain that which is difficult to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaḥ sa guṇaistubhyaṃ kṛpālurdīnavatsalaḥ /
divyapāśupataṃ cāpi dāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 31//
meaning:
प्रसन्नः स गुणैस्तुभ्यं कृपालुर्दीनवत्सलः /
दिव्यपाशुपतं चापि दास्यत्येव न संशयः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 31//
text_mt:
Pleased with your virtues, compassionate, and fond of the wretched, / he will surely grant you the divine Pāśupata weapon as well, no doubt.”

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter in the story of the scion of Bhṛgu in the Upoddhātapāda, the third part of the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā sa praṇamya jagadgurum /
prasannacetāḥ subhṛśaṃ śivalokaṃ jagāma ha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
ब्रह्मणो वचनं श्रुत्वा स प्रणम्य जगद्गुरुम् /
प्रसन्नचेताः सुभृशं शिवलोकं जगाम ह //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing the word of Brahmā and having bowed to the teacher of the world, / with a greatly delighted mind he went indeed to the realm of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣayojanamūrddhvaṃ ca brahmalokā dvilakṣaṇam /
athanirvacanīyaṃ ca yogigamyaṃ parātparam //
meaning:
लक्षयोजनमूर्द्ध्वं च ब्रह्मलोका द्विलक्षणम् /
अथनिर्वचनीयं च योगिगम्यं परात्परम् //
text_mt: a hundred thousand yojanas above Brahmā’s realm and distinct [from it], / inexpressible, accessible to yogins, higher than the highest,

sanskrit_iast:
vaikuṇṭho dakṣiṇe yasmādgaurīlokaśca vāmataḥ /
yadadho dhruvalokaśca sarvalokaparastu saḥ //
meaning:
वैकुण्ठो दक्षिणे यस्माद्गौरीलोकश्च वामतः /
यदधो ध्रुवलोकश्च सर्वलोकपरस्तु सः //
text_mt: to the right of which is Vaikuṇṭha and to the left the realm of Gaurī, / below which is the realm of Dhruva, and which is superior to all realms.

sanskrit_iast:
tapovīryagatī rāmaḥ śivalokaṃ dadarśa ca /
upamānena rahitaṃ nānākautukasaṃyutam //
meaning:
तपोवीर्यगती रामः शिवलोकं ददर्श च /
उपमानेन रहितं नानाकौतुकसंयुतम् //
text_mt: Reaching it by the power of his asceticism, Rāma beheld the realm of Śiva, / devoid of comparison and filled with various wonders,

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃti yatra yogīndrāḥ siddhāḥ pāśupatāḥ śubhāḥ /
koṭikalpatapaḥ puṇyāḥ śāntā nirmatsarā janāḥ //
meaning:
वसंति यत्र योगीन्द्राः सिद्धाः पाशुपताः शुभाः /
कोटिकल्पतपः पुण्याः शान्ता निर्मत्सरा जनाः //
text_mt: where dwell lords of yogins, siddhas, auspicious Pāśupatas, / peaceful, un-envious people whose merit is the asceticism of a crore of kalpas;

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātamukhairvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ /
yogena yoginā sṛṣṭaṃ svecchayā śaṅkareṇa hi //
meaning:
पारिजातमुखैर्वृक्षैः शोभितं कामधेनुभिः /
योगेन योगिना सृष्टं स्वेच्छया शङ्करेण हि //
text_mt: adorned with trees led by pārijātas and with wishes-granting cows; / created through yoga by the yogin Śankara by his own will,

sanskrit_iast:
śilpināṃ guruṇā svapne na dṛṣṭaṃ niśvakarmaṇā /
sarovaraśatairdivyaiḥ padmarāgavirājitaiḥ //
meaning:
शिल्पिनां गुरुणा स्वप्ने न दृष्टं निश्वकर्मणा /
सरोवरशतैर्दिव्यैः पद्मरागविराजितैः //
text_mt: not seen even in dream by Viśvakarman, the teacher of artisans; / with hundreds of divine lakes shining with rubies,

sanskrit_iast:
śobhitaṃ cātiramyaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ /
suvarṇaratnaracitaprākāreṇa samāvṛtam //
meaning:
शोभितं चातिरम्यं च संयुक्तं मणिवेदिभिः /
सुवर्णरत्नरचितप्राकारेण समावृतम् //
text_mt: adorned and exceedingly delightful, provided with gem-set platforms, / surrounded by an enclosure wall made of gold and jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
atyūrddhvamaṃbarasparśi svacchaṃ kṣīranibhaṃparam /
caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ //
meaning:
अत्यूर्द्ध्वमंबरस्पर्शि स्वच्छं क्षीरनिभंपरम् /
चतुर्द्वारसमायुक्तं शोभितं मणिवेदिभिः //
text_mt: exceedingly high, touching the sky, clear, resembling milk, supreme, / furnished with four gates and adorned with gem-set platforms,

sanskrit_iast:
raktasopānayuktaiśca ratnastaṃbhakapāṭakaiḥ /
nānācitravicitraiśca śobhitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ //
meaning:
रक्तसोपानयुक्तैश्च रत्नस्तंभकपाटकैः /
नानाचित्रविचित्रैश्च शोभितैः सुमनोहरैः //
text_mt: with red staircases, and jewel-pillared doorways / adorned with various colorful and very charming [decorations].

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhaye bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhadvāropaśobhitam /
dadarśarāmo dharmātmā vicitramiva saṃgataḥ //
meaning:
तन्मधये भवनं रम्यं सिंहद्वारोपशोभितम् /
ददर्शरामो धर्मात्मा विचित्रमिव संगतः //
text_mt: In the midst of it, the righteous Rāma saw a delightful mansion / adorned with a lion-gate, resembling a wondrous assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitau dvāra pālau dadarśātibhayaṅkarau /
mahākarāladantāsyau vikṛtāraktalocanau //
meaning:
तत्र स्थितौ द्वार पालौ ददर्शातिभयङ्करौ /
महाकरालदन्तास्यौ विकृतारक्तलोचनौ //
text_mt: There he beheld two gatekeepers standing, exceedingly terrifying, / their faces having huge, dreadful teeth, with deformed, reddish eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhaśailapratīkāśau mahābalaparākramau /
vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgau ca vyāghracarmāṃbarau ca tau //
meaning:
दग्धशैलप्रतीकाशौ महाबलपराक्रमौ /
विभूतिभूषिताङ्गौ च व्याघ्रचर्मांबरौ च तौ //
text_mt: resembling burnt mountains, of mighty strength and valor, / their limbs smeared with sacred ash, and clad in garments of tiger-skin,

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharau jvalantau brahmatejasā /
tau dṛṣṭvā manasā bhītaḥ kiñcidāha vinītavat //
meaning:
त्रिशूलपट्टिशधरौ ज्वलन्तौ ब्रह्मतेजसा /
तौ दृष्ट्वा मनसा भीतः किञ्चिदाह विनीतवत् //
text_mt: bearing tridents and sharp spears, blazing with brāhmaṇical radiance. / Seeing the two, frightened in mind, he spoke somewhat humbly:

sanskrit_iast:
namaskaromi vāmīśau śaṅkaraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ /
īśvarājñāṃ samādāya māmathājñaptumarhatha //
meaning:
नमस्करोमि वामीशौ शङ्करं द्रष्टुमागतः /
ईश्वराज्ञां समादाय मामथाज्ञप्तुमर्हथ //
text_mt: “My obeisance to both of you, O masters; I have come to behold Śankara. / Taking the Lord’s command, you ought now to direct me.”

sanskrit_iast:
tautu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gṛhītvājñāṃ śivasya ca /
praveṣṭumājñāṃ dadaturīśvarānucarau ca tau //
meaning:
तौतु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गृहीत्वाज्ञां शिवस्य च /
प्रवेष्टुमाज्ञां ददतुरीश्वरानुचरौ च तौ //
text_mt: Hearing his words, those two attendants of the Lord, / having obtained Śiva’s permission, granted him permission to enter.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tadājñāmanuprāpya viveśāntaḥ puraṃ mudā /
tatrātiramyāṃ siddhaughaiḥ samākīrṇāṃ sabhāṃ dvijaḥ //
meaning:
स तदाज्ञामनुप्राप्य विवेशान्तः पुरं मुदा /
तत्रातिरम्यां सिद्धौघैः समाकीर्णां सभां द्विजः //
text_mt: Having obtained their permission, he joyfully entered the inner quarters; / there the twice-born saw the Lord’s exceedingly delightful assembly,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vismayamāpede sugandhabahulāṃ vibhoḥ /
tatrāpaśyacchivaṃ śāntaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमापेदे सुगन्धबहुलां विभोः /
तत्रापश्यच्छिवं शान्तं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रशेखरम् //
text_mt: filled with hosts of siddhas, rich with fragrance, and was filled with wonder. / There he beheld the peaceful Śiva, three-eyed, crescent-crested,

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlaśobhitakaraṃ vyāghracarmavarāṃbaram /
vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgaṃ ca nāgayajñopavītinam //
meaning:
त्रिशूलशोभितकरं व्याघ्रचर्मवरांबरम् /
विभूतिभूषिताङ्गं च नागयज्ञोपवीतिनम् //
text_mt: his hand adorned with a trident, clad in an excellent tiger-skin garment, / his limbs smeared with sacred ash, having a serpent as his sacred thread,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham /
pañcānanaṃ daśabhujaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham //
meaning:
आत्मारामं पूर्णकामं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् /
पञ्चाननं दशभुजं भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहम् //
text_mt: delighting in the Self, whose desires are fulfilled, with the luster of a crore of suns, / five-faced, ten-armed, the embodiment of grace toward his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
yogajñāne prabruvantaṃ siddhebhyastarkamudrayā /
stūyamānaṃ ca yokīndraiḥ pramathaprakarairmudā //
meaning:
योगज्ञाने प्रब्रुवन्तं सिद्धेभ्यस्तर्कमुद्रया /
स्तूयमानं च योकीन्द्रैः प्रमथप्रकरैर्मुदा //
text_mt: expounding knowledge of yoga to the siddhas with the gesture of disputation, / being praised with joy by lords of yogins and multitudes of Pramathas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavairyoginībhiśca vṛtaṃ rudragaṇaistathā /
mūrdhnā namāma taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ paramayā mudā //
meaning:
भैरवैर्योगिनीभिश्च वृतं रुद्रगणैस्तथा /
मूर्ध्ना नमाम तं दृष्ट्वा रामः परमया मुदा //
text_mt: surrounded by Bhairavas, yoginġs, and hosts of Rudras. / Seeing him, Rāma bowed down with his head in supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmabhāge kārttikeyaṃ dakṣiṇe ca gaṇeśvaram /
nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca tatpuraḥ //
meaning:
वामभागे कार्त्तिकेयं दक्षिणे च गणेश्वरम् /
नन्दीश्वरं महाकालं वीरभद्रं च तत्पुरः //
text_mt: On his left side [he saw] Kārttikeya, and on his right Gaṇeśvara; / Nandīśvara, Mahākāla, and Vġrabhadra in front of him;

sanskrit_iast:
kroḍe durgāṃ śatabhujāṃ dṛṣṭvā natvātha tāmapi /
stotuṃ pracakrame vidvāngirā gadgadayā vibhum //
meaning:
क्रोडे दुर्गां शतभुजां दृष्ट्वा नत्वाथ तामपि /
स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमे विद्वान्गिरा गद्गदया विभुम् //
text_mt: having seen also Durgā of a hundred arms upon his lap and bowed to her, / the learned one proceeded to praise the all-pervading Lord with a faltering voice:

sanskrit_iast:
namasye śivamīśānaṃ vibhuṃ vyāpakamavyayam /
bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ cograṃ nṛkapālasragujjvalam //
meaning:
नमस्ये शिवमीशानं विभुं व्यापकमव्ययम् /
भुजङ्गभूषणं चोग्रं नृकपालस्रगुज्ज्वलम् //
text_mt: “ I bow to Śiva, the sovereign lord, the all-pervading, omnipresent, imperishable one, / adorned with serpents, fierce, resplendent with a garland of human skulls,

sanskrit_iast:
yo vibhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ sṛṣṭisthitivināśakṛt /
brahmādirūpadhṛgjyeṣṭhastaṃ tvāṃ veda kṛpārṇavam //
meaning:
यो विभुः सर्वलोकानां सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशकृत् /
ब्रह्मादिरूपधृग्ज्येष्ठस्तं त्वां वेद कृपार्णवम् //
text_mt: who is the lord of all worlds, the maker of creation, preservation, and destruction, / assuming forms such as Brahmā, the eldest; I know you to be an ocean of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotu mavāṅmanasagocaram /
jñānabuddhyorasādhyaṃ ca nirākāraṃ namāmyaham //
meaning:
वेदा न शक्ता यं स्तोतु मवाङ्मनसगोचरम् /
ज्ञानबुद्ध्योरसाध्यं च निराकारं नमाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Whom the Vedas are not able to praise, who is beyond the range of speech and mind, / unattainable by intellectual knowledge, and formless—to him I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrādayaḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayo manavo 'surāḥ /
na yaṃ viduryathātattvaṃ taṃ namāmi parātparam //
meaning:
शक्रादयः सुरगणा ऋषयो मनवो ऽसुराः /
न यं विदुर्यथातत्त्वं तं नमामि परात्परम् //
text_mt: Whom the host of gods led by Śakra, the ṛṣis, the Manus, and the asuras / do not know in his true reality—to that one, higher than the highest, I bow.”

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃśāṃśena sṛjayante lokāḥ sarve carācarāḥ /
līyante ca punaryasmiṃstaṃ namāmi jaganmayam //
meaning:
यस्यांशांशेन सृजयन्ते लोकाः सर्वे चराचराः /
लीयन्ते च पुनर्यस्मिंस्तं नमामि जगन्मयम् //
text_mt: By a fraction of whose fraction all worlds, moving and unmoving, are created, / and into whom they dissolve again—to that one, who is the universe itself, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyeṣatkopasaṃbhūto hutāśo dahate 'khilam /
sorddhvalokaṃ sapātālaṃ taṃ namāmi haraṃ param //
meaning:
यस्येषत्कोपसंभूतो हुताशो दहते ऽखिलम् /
सोर्द्ध्वलोकं सपातालं तं नमामि हरं परम् //
text_mt: From a slight [flicker] of whose wrath fire arises and consumes everything, / both the upper world and the nether regions—to that supreme Hara I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthvīpavana vahnyabhabhonabhoyajvendubhāskarāḥ /
mūrttayo 'ṣṭau jagatpūjyāstaṃ yajñaṃ praṇamāmyaham //
meaning:
पृथ्वीपवन वह्न्यभभोनभोयज्वेन्दुभास्कराः /
मूर्त्तयो ऽष्टौ जगत्पूज्यास्तं यज्ञं प्रणमाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Earth, wind, fire, water, sky, sacrificer, moon, and sun— / these eight forms are adored by the world; to that sacrifice I bow down.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kālarūpo jagadādikarttā pātā pṛthagrūpadharo jaganmayaḥ /
rarttā punā rudravapustathānte taṃ kālarūpaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye //
meaning:
यः कालरूपो जगदादिकर्त्ता पाता पृथग्रूपधरो जगन्मयः /
रर्त्ता पुना रुद्रवपुस्तथान्ते तं कालरूपं शरणं प्रपद्ये //
text_mt: Who in the form of Time is the first creator of the universe, who in separate forms preserves it and embodies the universe, / and who at the end destroys it in the form of Rudra—to that one whose form is Time I fly for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā sa tu bhārgavo mudā paṣāta tasyāṅghri samīpa āturaḥ /
utthāpya taṃ vāmakareṇa līlayā dadhre tadā mūrdhni karaṃ kṛpārṇavaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स तु भार्गवो मुदा पषात तस्याङ्घ्रि समीप आतुरः /
उत्थाप्य तं वामकरेण लीलया दध्रे तदा मूर्ध्नि करं कृपार्णवः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Bhārgava, distressed, fell with joy near his feet; / lifting him up playfully with his left hand, the ocean of compassion then placed his hand upon his head.

sanskrit_iast:
āśīrbhirenaṃ hyabhinandya sādaraṃ niveśayāmāsa gaṇeśapūrvataḥ /
uvāca vāmāmabhivīkṣya cāpyumāṃ kṛpārdradṛṣṭyākhilakāmapūrakaḥ //
meaning:
आशीर्भिरेनं ह्यभिनन्द्य सादरं निवेशयामास गणेशपूर्वतः /
उवाच वामामभिवीक्ष्य चाप्युमां कृपार्द्रदृष्ट्याखिलकामपूरकः //
text_mt: Congratulating him respectfully with blessings, he seated him in front of Gaṇeśa; / and looking upon Umā, seated at his left, with a gaze moist with compassion, he who fulfills all desires spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
kastvaṃ vaṭo kasyakule prasūtaḥ kiṃ kāryamuddiśya bhavānihāgataḥ /
vinirddiśāhaṃ tava bhaktibhāvataḥ prītaḥ pradadyāṃ bhavato manogatam //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
कस्त्वं वटो कस्यकुले प्रसूतः किं कार्यमुद्दिश्य भवानिहागतः /
विनिर्द्दिशाहं तव भक्तिभावतः प्रीतः प्रदद्यां भवतो मनोगतम् //
text_mt: Śiva said: / Who are you, young man? In whose family were you born? For what purpose have you come here? / Explain; pleased with your devotion, I shall grant what is in your heart.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktaḥ sa bhṛgurmahātmanā hareṇa viśvārttihareṇa sādaram /
punaśca natvā vibudhāṃ pati guruṃ kṛpāsamudraṃ samuvāca satvaram //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्तः स भृगुर्महात्मना हरेण विश्वार्त्तिहरेण सादरम् /
पुनश्च नत्वा विबुधां पति गुरुं कृपासमुद्रं समुवाच सत्वरम् //
text_mt: Addressed in this manner with respect by the great-souled Hara, who removes the distress of the universe, / having bowed again to the lord of the gods, the guru, the ocean of compassion, Bhṛgu's descendant promptly said:

sanskrit_iast:
paraśurāma uvāca
bhṛgoścāhaṃ kule jāto jamadagnisutau vibho /
rāmo nāma jagadvandyaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
परशुराम उवाच
भृगोश्चाहं कुले जातो जमदग्निसुतौ विभो /
रामो नाम जगद्वन्द्यं त्वामहं शरणं गतः //
text_mt: Paraśurāma said: / I was born in the lineage of Bhṛgu, O lord, as a son of Jamadagni; / named Rāma, I have come for refuge to you who are praised by the whole world.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkāryārthamahaṃ nātha tava sāṃnidhyamāgataḥ /
taṃ prasādhaya viśveśa vāñchitaṃ kāmameva me //
meaning:
यत्कार्यार्थमहं नाथ तव सांनिध्यमागतः /
तं प्रसाधय विश्वेश वाञ्छितं काममेव मे //
text_mt: O lord, the purpose for which I have come into your presence— / accomplish that very desired wish of mine, O ruler of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgayāmāgatasyāpi kārttavīryasya bhūpateḥ /
ātithyaṃ kṛtavān deva jamadagniḥ pitā mama //
meaning:
मृगयामागतस्यापि कार्त्तवीर्यस्य भूपतेः /
आतिथ्यं कृतवान् देव जमदग्निः पिता मम //
text_mt: When King Kārttavīrya came on a hunt, / my father Jamadagni offered him hospitality, O god.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā taṃ sa balāllobhātpātayāmāsa mandadhīḥ /
sā dhenustaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā gavāṃ lokaṃ jagāma ha //
meaning:
राजा तं स बलाल्लोभात्पातयामास मन्दधीः /
सा धेनुस्तं मृतं दृष्ट्वा गवां लोकं जगाम ह //
text_mt: Through greed and by force, that dull-witted king struck him down; / seeing him dead, that cow went away to the world of cows.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā na śocanmaraṇaṃ piturmama nirāgasaḥ /
jagāma svapuraṃ paścānmātā me prārudadbhṛśam //
meaning:
राजा न शोचन्मरणं पितुर्मम निरागसः /
जगाम स्वपुरं पश्चान्माता मे प्रारुदद्भृशम् //
text_mt: The king, not grieving the death of my guiltless father, / departed to his own city; afterwards, my mother wept bitterly.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjñātvā lokavṛttajño bhṛgurnaḥ prapitāmahaḥ /
ājagāma mahādeva hyahamapyāgato vanāt //
meaning:
तज्ज्ञात्वा लोकवृत्तज्ञो भृगुर्नः प्रपितामहः /
आजगाम महादेव ह्यहमप्यागतो वनात् //
text_mt: Knowing that, Bhṛgu, our great-grandfather who knows worldly affairs, / came, O Mahādeva, and I too returned from the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā maha suduḥkhārttānbhrātṝnmātrāsahaiva me /
sāṃtvayitvā sa mantrajño 'jīvayatpitaraṃ mama //
meaning:
मया मह सुदुःखार्त्तान्भ्रातॄन्मात्रासहैव मे /
सांत्वयित्वा स मन्त्रज्ञो ऽजीवयत्पितरं मम //
text_mt: Consoling along with me my brothers and my mother, all stricken with deep sorrow, / he, knowing the mantras, brought my father back to life.

sanskrit_iast:
ānāgate bhṛgau māturduḥkhenāhaṃ prakopitaḥ /
pratijñāṃ kṛtavāndeva sātvayanmātaraṃsvakām //
meaning:
आनागते भृगौ मातुर्दुःखेनाहं प्रकोपितः /
प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान्देव सात्वयन्मातरंस्वकाम् //
text_mt: Before Bhṛgu arrived, enraged by my mother's sorrow, / I made a vow, O god, consoling my mother:

sanskrit_iast:
triḥsaptakṛtvo yadurastāḍitaṃ māturātmanaḥ /
tāvatsaṃkhyamahaṃ pṛthvīṃ kariṣye kṣatravarjitām //
meaning:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो यदुरस्ताडितं मातुरात्मनः /
तावत्संख्यमहं पृथ्वीं करिष्ये क्षत्रवर्जिताम् //
text_mt: ‘As many as twenty-one times as my mother’s breast was beaten, / that many times I shall rid the earth of kṣatriyas.’

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ paripūrṇā me karttā devo jagatpatiḥ /
mahādevo hyato nātha tvatsakāṇamihāgataḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवं परिपूर्णा मे कर्त्ता देवो जगत्पतिः /
महादेवो ह्यतो नाथ त्वत्सकाणमिहागतः //
text_mt: God, the lord of the universe, Mahādeva, will fulfill this [vow] for me; / therefore, O lord, I have come here to your presence.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā durgāmukhaṃ haraḥ /
babhūvānamravadanaschintayānaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tadā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्येवं तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा दुर्गामुखं हरः /
बभूवानम्रवदनस्छिन्तयानः क्षणं तदा //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard those words and looked upon Durgā’s face, / Hara bent his face downward and thought for a moment then.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare durgā vismitā prāhasadbhṛśam /
uvāca ca mahārāja bhārgavaṃ vairasādhakam //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दुर्गा विस्मिता प्राहसद्भृशम् /
उवाच च महाराज भार्गवं वैरसाधकम् //
text_mt: Meanwhile Durgā, filled with wonder, laughed aloud, / and said, O great king, to the Bhārgava who sought his revenge:

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvindvijaputra kṣmāṃ nirbhūpāṃ karttumicchasi /
triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ kopena sāhasaste mahānbaṭo //
meaning:
तपस्विन्द्विजपुत्र क्ष्मां निर्भूपां कर्त्तुमिच्छसि /
त्रिः सप्तकृत्वः कोपेन साहसस्ते महान्बटो //
text_mt: ‘O ascetic, son of a twice-born, you wish to make the earth kingless / twenty-one times in your anger! Great is your daring, O lad!

sanskrit_iast:
hantumicchasi niḥśastraḥ sahasrārjunamīśvaram /
bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā yena rāvaṇo 'pi nirākṛtaḥ //
meaning:
हन्तुमिच्छसि निःशस्त्रः सहस्रार्जुनमीश्वरम् /
भ्रूभङ्गलीलया येन रावणो ऽपि निराकृतः //
text_mt: Weaponless, you wish to slay the lord Sahasrārjuna, / by whom even Rāvaṇa was defeated with a mere playful knit of his brow!

sanskrit_iast:
tasmai pradattaṃ dattena śrīhareḥ kavacaṃ purā /
śaktiratyarthavīryā ca taṃ kathaṃ hantumicchasi //
meaning:
तस्मै प्रदत्तं दत्तेन श्रीहरेः कवचं पुरा /
शक्तिरत्यर्थवीर्या च तं कथं हन्तुमिच्छसि //
text_mt: Formerly, the armor of Śrī Hari was given to him by Datta, / and a spear of immense power; how do you wish to slay him?

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkaraḥ karuṇāsiddhaḥ karttuṃ cāpyanyathā vibhuḥ /
na cānyaḥ śaṅkarātputra satkāryaṃ karttumīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
शङ्करः करुणासिद्धः कर्त्तुं चाप्यन्यथा विभुः /
न चान्यः शङ्करात्पुत्र सत्कार्यं कर्त्तुमीश्वरः //
text_mt: Śaṅkara is perfected through compassion and is competent to alter this; / and none other than Śaṅkara, my son, has the power to achieve this good deed.’

sanskrit_iast:
atha devyā anumatiṃ prāpya śaṃbhurddayārṇavaḥ /
abhyadhādbhadrayā vāyā jamadagnisutaṃ vibhuḥ //
meaning:
अथ देव्या अनुमतिं प्राप्य शंभुर्द्दयार्णवः /
अभ्यधाद्भद्रया वाया जमदग्निसुतं विभुः //
text_mt: Then, having obtained the assent of the Goddess, Śambhu, the ocean of mercy, the lord, / addressed the son of Jamadagni in auspicious speech:

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
adyaprabhṛti vipra tvaṃ mama skandasamo bhava /
dāsyāmi mantraṃ divyaṃ te kavacaṃ ca mahāmate //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
अद्यप्रभृति विप्र त्वं मम स्कन्दसमो भव /
दास्यामि मन्त्रं दिव्यं ते कवचं च महामते //
text_mt: Śiva said: / From this day forward, O brāhmaṇa, be equal to my Skanda; / I shall give you a divine mantra and armor, O noble-minded one,

sanskrit_iast:
līlayā yatprasādena kārttavīryaṃ haniṣyasi /
triḥ saptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ mahīṃ cāpi kariṣyasi //
meaning:
लीलया यत्प्रसादेन कार्त्तवीर्यं हनिष्यसि /
त्रिः सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां महीं चापि करिष्यसि //
text_mt: By the grace of which you will easily slay Kārttavīrya, / and make the earth kingless twenty-one times.

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai dadau mantraṃ sudurlabham /
trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शङ्करस्तस्मै ददौ मन्त्रं सुदुर्लभम् /
त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं परमाद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Śaṅkara gave him a mantra very difficult to obtain, / and the wondrous armor named Trailokyavijaya [‘Victory over the Three Worlds’];

sanskrit_iast:
nāgapāśaṃ pāśupataṃ brahmāstraṃ ca sudurllabham /
nārāyaṇāstramāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
नागपाशं पाशुपतं ब्रह्मास्त्रं च सुदुर्ल्लभम् /
नारायणास्त्रमाग्नेयं वायव्यं वारुणं तथा //
text_mt: The serpent-noose, the pāśupata, and the brahmāstra very difficult to obtain, / the nārāyaṇāstra, the fiery weapon, the wind weapon, and likewise the water weapon,

sanskrit_iast:
ghāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ caiva jṛṃbhaṇāstraṃ mahādbhutam /
gadāṃ śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ śūlaṃ daṇḍamanuttamam //
meaning:
घान्धर्वं गारुडं चैव जृंभणास्त्रं महाद्भुतम् /
गदां शक्तिं च परशुं शूलं दण्डमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: The gandharva weapon, the eagle weapon, and the wondrous weapon of stupor; / the mace, the spear, the battle-axe, the trident, and the peerless staff.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāstragrāmamakhilaṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ saṃbabhūva ha /
namaskṛtya śivaṃ śāntaṃ durgāṃ skandaṃ gaṇeśvaram //
meaning:
शस्त्रास्त्रग्राममखिलं प्रहृष्टः संबभूव ह /
नमस्कृत्य शिवं शान्तं दुर्गां स्कन्दं गणेश्वरम् //
text_mt: [Receiving] that entire array of weapons and missiles, he was filled with joy; / bowing to gentle Śiva, Durgā, Skanda, and the lord of the gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
parikramya yayau rāmaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam /
siddhaṃ kṛtvā śivoktaṃ tu mantraṃ kavacamuttamam //
meaning:
परिक्रम्य ययौ रामः पुष्करं तीर्थमुत्तमम् /
सिद्धं कृत्वा शिवोक्तं तु मन्त्रं कवचमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: And circumambulating them, Rāma went to the excellent sacred place Puṣkara; / and having mastered the excellent mantra and armor spoken by Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhayāmāsa nikhilaṃ svakāryaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ /
nihatya kārttavīryaṃ taṃ sasainyaṃ sakulaṃ mudā /
vinivṛtto gṛhaṃ prāgātpituḥ svasya bhṛgūdvahaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite dvātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 32//
meaning:
साधयामास निखिलं स्वकार्यं भृगुनन्दनः /
निहत्य कार्त्तवीर्यं तं ससैन्यं सकुलं मुदा /
विनिवृत्तो गृहं प्रागात्पितुः स्वस्य भृगूद्वहः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते द्वात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 32//
text_mt:
The descendant of Bhṛgu accomplished his entire mission; / having joyfully slain Kārttavīrya along with his army and his clan, / the upholder of the Bhṛgu lineage returned and went to his father’s house.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, entitled ‘The Account of Bhārgava’, in the third Upoddhātapāda in the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
śrutaṃ sarvaṃ muniśreṣṭha kīrtyamānaṃ tvayā vibho /
kavacaṃ vada sarvatra trailokyavijayapradam //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
श्रुतं सर्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ कीर्त्यमानं त्वया विभो /
कवचं वद सर्वत्र त्रैलोक्यविजयप्रदम् //
text_mt: Sagara said: / Everything related by you, O best of sages, has been heard, O mighty one; / declare the armor that everywhere bestows victory over the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ paramādbhutam /
mantra ca siddhida śaśvatsādhakānāṃ sukhāvaham //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि कवचं परमाद्भुतम् /
मन्त्र च सिद्धिद शश्वत्साधकानां सुखावहम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Listen, child, I shall declare the wondrous armor / and the mantra that constantly grants success and brings happiness to practitioners.

sanskrit_iast:
gopījanapadasyāta vallabhāya samuccaret /
svāhānto 'yaṃ mahāmantro daśārṇo bhuktimuktidaḥ //
meaning:
गोपीजनपदस्यात वल्लभाय समुच्चरेत् /
स्वाहान्तो ऽयं महामन्त्रो दशार्णो भुक्तिमुक्तिदः //
text_mt: One should utter the word ‘gopījana’ and then ‘vallabhāya’; / ending in ‘svāhā’, this great ten-syllable mantra gives worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivastvasya ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam /
devatā kṛṣṇa udito viniyogo 'khilāptaye //
meaning:
सदाशिवस्त्वस्य ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतम् /
देवता कृष्ण उदितो विनियोगो ऽखिलाप्तये //
text_mt: Its sage is Sadāśiva, the meter is declared to be paṅkti, / the deity is proclaimed as Kṛṣṇa, and the ritual application is for the attainment of all ends.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyavijayasyātha kavacasya prajāpatiḥ /
ṛṣiśchandaśca jagatī devo rājeśvaraḥ svayam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यविजयस्याथ कवचस्य प्रजापतिः /
ऋषिश्छन्दश्च जगती देवो राजेश्वरः स्वयम् //
text_mt: Now of the Trailokyavijaya armor, Prajāpati is / the sage, the meter is jagatī, and the deity is Rājeśvara himself.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyavijayaprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ /
praṇavo meśiraḥ pātu śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यविजयप्राप्तौ विनियोगः प्रकीर्त्तितः /
प्रणवो मेशिरः पातु श्रीकृष्णाय नमः सदा //
text_mt: Its ritual application is declared to be for attaining victory over the three worlds: / May the Praṇava protect my head; always: ‘Homage to Śrī Kṛṣṇa!’

sanskrit_iast:
pāyātkapālaṃ kṛṣṇāya svāheti satataṃ mama /
kṛṣṇeti pātu netre me kṛṣṇasvāheti tārakām //
meaning:
पायात्कपालं कृष्णाय स्वाहेति सततं मम /
कृष्णेति पातु नेत्रे मे कृष्णस्वाहेति तारकाम् //
text_mt: May ‘To Kṛṣṇa, svāhā!’ constantly protect my forehead; / may ‘Kṛṣṇa’ protect my two eyes; may ‘Kṛṣṇa, svāhā’ [protect] my pupil.

sanskrit_iast:
haraye nama ityeṣa bhrūlatāṃ pātu me sadā /
oṃ govindāya svāheti nāsikāṃ pātu saṃtatam //
meaning:
हरये नम इत्येष भ्रूलतां पातु मे सदा /
ओं गोविन्दाय स्वाहेति नासिकां पातु संततम् //
