text_mt: May ‘Homage to Hari!’ constantly protect my eyebrow; / may ‘Oṃ, to Govinda, svāhā!’ continuously protect my nose.

sanskrit_iast:
gopālāya namo gaṇḍaṃ pātu me satataṃ manuḥ /
klīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ karṇauṃ pātu kalpatarurmama //
meaning:
गोपालाय नमो गण्डं पातु मे सततं मनुः /
क्लीं कृष्णाय नमः कर्णौं पातु कल्पतरुर्मम //
text_mt: May the mantra ‘Homage to Gopāla!’ constantly protect my cheek; / may ‘Klīṃ, homage to Kṛṣṇa!’, the wish-granting tree, protect my ears.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ pātu nityaṃ me 'dharayugmakam /
oṃ gopīśāya svāheti dantapaṅktiṃ mamāvatu //
meaning:
श्रीं कृष्णाय नमः पातु नित्यं मे ऽधरयुग्मकम् /
ओं गोपीशाय स्वाहेति दन्तपङ्क्तिं ममावतु //
text_mt: May 'śrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ' protect my two lips forever; / may 'oṃ gopīśāya svāhā' guard my row of teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣṇeti radacchidraṃ pātume tryakṣaro manuḥ /
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti jihvikāṃ pātu me sadā //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्णेति रदच्छिद्रं पातुमे त्र्यक्षरो मनुः /
ओं श्रीकृष्णाय स्वाहेति जिह्विकां पातु मे सदा //
text_mt: May the three-syllable mantra 'śrīkṛṣṇa' protect my mouth; / may 'oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāhā' always protect my tongue.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeśvarāya svāheti tālukaṃ pātu me sadā /
rādhikeśāya svāheti kaṇṭhaṃ me pātu sarvadā //
meaning:
रामेश्वराय स्वाहेति तालुकं पातु मे सदा /
राधिकेशाय स्वाहेति कण्ठं मे पातु सर्वदा //
text_mt: May 'rāmeśvarāya svāhā' always protect my palate; / may 'rādhikeśāya svāhā' always protect my throat.

sanskrit_iast:
namo gopīgaṇeśāya grīvāṃ me pātu sarvadā /
oṃ gopeśāya svāheti skandhau pātu sadā mama //
meaning:
नमो गोपीगणेशाय ग्रीवां मे पातु सर्वदा /
ओं गोपेशाय स्वाहेति स्कन्धौ पातु सदा मम //
text_mt: May 'namo gopīgaṇeśāya' always protect my neck; / may 'oṃ gopeśāya svāhā' always protect my shoulders.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kiśoraveṣāya svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ mamāvatu /
udaraṃ pātu me nityaṃ mukundāya namo manuḥ //
meaning:
नमः किशोरवेषाय स्वाहा पृष्ठं ममावतु /
उदरं पातु मे नित्यं मुकुन्दाय नमो मनुः //
text_mt: May 'namaḥ kiśoraveṣāya svāhā' guard my back; / may the mantra 'mukundāya namaḥ' constantly protect my belly.

sanskrit_iast:
hnīṃ śrīṅklīṅkṛṣṇāya svāhā karau pātu sadā mama /
oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ svāhā bāhuyugmaṃ mamāvatu //
meaning:
ह्नीं श्रीङ्क्लीङ्कृष्णाय स्वाहा करौ पातु सदा मम /
ओं विष्णवे नमः स्वाहा बाहुयुग्मं ममावतु //
text_mt: May 'hnīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya svāhā' always protect my hands; / may 'oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ svāhā' guard my pair of arms.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃbhagavate svāhā nakhapaṅktiṃ mamāvatu /
namo nārāyaṇāyeti nakharandhraṃ mamāvatu //
meaning:
ओं ह्रींभगवते स्वाहा नखपङ्क्तिं ममावतु /
नमो नारायणायेति नखरन्ध्रं ममावतु //
text_mt: May 'oṃ hrīṃ bhagavate svāhā' guard my rows of nails; / may 'namo nārāyaṇāya' guard the hollows beneath my nails.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃpadmanābhāya nābhiṃ pātu sadā mama /
oṃ sarveśāya svāheti keśānmama sadāvatu //
meaning:
ओं ह्रींश्रींपद्मनाभाय नाभिं पातु सदा मम /
ओं सर्वेशाय स्वाहेति केशान्मम सदावतु //
text_mt: May 'oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ padmanābhāya' always protect my navel; / may 'oṃ sarveśāya svāhā' always guard my hair.

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya svāheti brahmarandhraṃ sadāvatu /
oṃ mādhavāya svāheti bhālaṃ me sarvadāvatu //
meaning:
नमः कृष्णाय स्वाहेति ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं सदावतु /
ओं माधवाय स्वाहेति भालं मे सर्वदावतु //
text_mt: May 'namaḥ kṛṣṇāya svāhā' always guard my brahmarandhra; / may 'oṃ mādhavāya svāhā' always guard my forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hrīṃśrīṃrasikeśāya kaṭiṃ mama sadāvatu /
namo gopījaneśāya ūrū pātu sadā mama //
meaning:
ओं ह्रींश्रींरसिकेशाय कटिं मम सदावतु /
नमो गोपीजनेशाय ऊरू पातु सदा मम //
text_mt: May 'oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rasikeśāya' always guard my waist; / may 'namo gopījaneśāya' always protect my thighs.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo daityanāśāya svāhetyavatu jānunī /
yaśodānandanāyeti namoto jaṅghake 'vatu //
meaning:
ओं नमो दैत्यनाशाय स्वाहेत्यवतु जानुनी /
यशोदानन्दनायेति नमोतो जङ्घके ऽवतु //
text_mt: May 'oṃ namo daityanāśāya svāhā' guard my knees; / ending with 'namas', may 'yaśodānandanāya' guard my shanks.

sanskrit_iast:
rāsāraṃbhapriyāyeti svāhānto hīṃ mamāvatu /
vṛndāpriyāya svāheti sakalāṅgāni me 'vatu //
meaning:
रासारंभप्रियायेति स्वाहान्तो हीं ममावतु /
वृन्दाप्रियाय स्वाहेति सकलाङ्गानि मे ऽवतु //
text_mt: May 'rāsāraṃbhapriyāya' ending in 'svāhā', [preceded by] 'hrīṃ', guard me; / may 'vṛndāpriyāya svāhā' guard all my limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
pariburṇamanāḥ kṛṣmaḥ prācyāṃ māṃ sarvadāvatu /
svayaṃ golokanātho māmāgneyyāṃ diśi rakṣatu //
meaning:
परिबुर्णमनाः कृष्मः प्राच्यां मां सर्वदावतु /
स्वयं गोलोकनाथो मामाग्नेय्यां दिशि रक्षतु //
text_mt: May Kṛṣṇa, whose mind is fulfilled, always protect me in the east; / may the Lord of Goloka himself protect me in the southeast.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇabrahmasvarūpaśca dakṣiṇe māṃ sadāvatu /
nairṛtyāṃ pātu māṃ kṛṣṇāḥ paścime pātu māṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
पूर्णब्रह्मस्वरूपश्च दक्षिणे मां सदावतु /
नैरृत्यां पातु मां कृष्णाः पश्चिमे पातु मां हरिः //
text_mt: May he whose nature is the full Brahman always protect me in the south; / may Kṛṣṇa protect me in the southwest; may Hari protect me in the west.

sanskrit_iast:
govindaḥ pātu vāyavyāmuttare rasikeśvaraḥ /
aiśānyāṃ me sadā pātu vṛndāvanavihāra kṛt //
meaning:
गोविन्दः पातु वायव्यामुत्तरे रसिकेश्वरः /
ऐशान्यां मे सदा पातु वृन्दावनविहार कृत् //
text_mt: May Govinda protect me in the northwest, and in the north the Lord of the impassioned; / may the one who disports in Vṛndāvana always protect me in the northeast.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndāprāṇeśvaraḥ śaśvatpātu māmūrddhvadeśataḥ /
sadaiva māmadhaḥ pātu balidhvaṃsī mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
वृन्दाप्राणेश्वरः शश्वत्पातु मामूर्द्ध्वदेशतः /
सदैव मामधः पातु बलिध्वंसी महाबलः //
text_mt: May the lord of Vṛndā's life continually protect me from above; / may the mighty crusher of Bali always protect me from below.

sanskrit_iast:
jale sthale cāntarikṣe nṛsiṃhaḥ pātu māṃ sadā /
svapne jāgaraṇe caiva pātu māṃ mādhavaḥ svayam //
meaning:
जले स्थले चान्तरिक्षे नृसिंहः पातु मां सदा /
स्वप्ने जागरणे चैव पातु मां माधवः स्वयम् //
text_mt: In water, on land, and in the sky, may Nṛsiṃha always protect me; / in dreaming and in waking, may Mādhava himself protect me.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāntarātmā nirliptaḥ pātu māṃ sarvato vibhuḥ /
iti te kathitaṃ bhūpa sarvāghaughavināśanam //
meaning:
सर्वान्तरात्मा निर्लिप्तः पातु मां सर्वतो विभुः /
इति ते कथितं भूप सर्वाघौघविनाशनम् //
text_mt: May the all-pervading Inner Self of all, free from attachment, protect me on every side. / Thus has been told to you, O king, that which destroys the multitude of all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ parameśituḥ /
mayā śrutaṃ śivamukhātpravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं परमेशितुः /
मया श्रुतं शिवमुखात्प्रवक्तव्यं न कस्यचित् //
text_mt: the armour of the Supreme Lord named Trailokyavijaya ('Conquest of the Three Worlds'). / It was heard by me from the mouth of Śiva, and must not be spoken to anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ /
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so 'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
गुरुमभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्कवचं धारयेत्तु यः /
कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे बाहौ सो ऽपि विष्णुर्न संशयः //
text_mt: Whoever, having properly worshipped his guru, wears this armour / around his neck or on his right arm, he too is Viṣṇu, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sa sādhako 'vasadyatra tatra vāṇīrame sthite /
yadi syātsiddhakavaco jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
स साधको ऽवसद्यत्र तत्र वाणीरमे स्थिते /
यदि स्यात्सिद्धकवचो जीवन्मुक्तो न संशयः //
text_mt: Wherever that practitioner dwells, Sarasvatī and Lakṣmī abide there. / If he has mastered the armour, he is liberated while living, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
niścitaṃ koṭivarṣāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyāt /
rājasūryasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca //
meaning:
निश्चितं कोटिवर्षाणां पूजायाः फलमाप्नुयात् /
राजसूर्यसहस्राणि वाजपेयशतानि च //
text_mt: He surely attains the fruit of ten million years of worship; / thousands of royal consecrations (rājasūya) and hundreds of vājapeya sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
mahādānāni yānyeva bhuvaścāpi pradakṣiṇā /
trailokyavijayasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm //
meaning:
महादानानि यान्येव भुवश्चापि प्रदक्षिणा /
त्रैलोक्यविजयस्यास्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् //
text_mt: whatever great gifts there be, and circumambulating the earth— / they are not worth a sixteenth part of this Trailokyavijaya [armour].

sanskrit_iast:
vratopavāsaniyamāḥ svādhyāyādhyayane tathā /
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu nāsyārhanti kalāmapi //
meaning:
व्रतोपवासनियमाः स्वाध्यायाध्ययने तथा /
स्नानं च सर्वतीर्थेषु नास्यार्हन्ति कलामपि //
text_mt: Vows, fasts, observances, recitation and study of the Veda, / and bathing at all sacred places are not worth even a fraction of this.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhatvamamaratvaṃ ca dāsatvaṃ śrīharerapi /
yadi syātsiddhakavacaḥ sarvaṃ prāpnoti niścitam //
meaning:
सिद्धत्वममरत्वं च दासत्वं श्रीहरेरपि /
यदि स्यात्सिद्धकवचः सर्वं प्राप्नोति निश्चितम् //
text_mt: Attainment of perfections, immortality, and servitude to glorious Hari— / if one has mastered the armour, one surely obtains all this.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhavetsiddhakavaco daśalakṣaṃ japettu yaḥ /
yo bhavetsiddhakavaco vijayī sa bhaved dhruvam //
meaning:
स भवेत्सिद्धकवचो दशलक्षं जपेत्तु यः /
यो भवेत्सिद्धकवचो विजयी स भवेद् ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: He who recites [it] a million times becomes one who has mastered the armour; / whoever becomes one who has mastered the armour is certainly victorious.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ prāṇā deyāśca bhūpate /
etattu kavacaṃ vatsa na deyaṃ saṃkaṭe 'pi ca //
meaning:
राज्यं देयं शिरो देयं प्राणा देयाश्च भूपते /
एतत्तु कवचं वत्स न देयं संकटे ऽपि च //
text_mt: A kingdom may be given away, one's head may be given away, and one's life may be given away, O king; / but this armour, dear child, must not be given away, even in extremity.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā prakāśitaṃ yatte caiteṣāṃ trāṇakāraṇāt /
mamājñākaraṇāccaiva tadviddhi kulabhāskara /
idaṃ dhṛtvā tu kavacaṃ cakravarttī bhavānbhava //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite trayastriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
मया प्रकाशितं यत्ते चैतेषां त्राणकारणात् /
ममाज्ञाकरणाच्चैव तद्विद्धि कुलभास्कर /
इदं धृत्वा तु कवचं चक्रवर्त्ती भवान्भव //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Know, O sun of your lineage, that it has been revealed to you by me for the sake of protecting these people / and because you obey my command; / having put on this armour, become a universal monarch!

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter in the deeds of Bhārgava, in the third Upoddhātapāda in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
brahmaputra mahābhāga mahānme 'nugrahaḥ kṛtaḥ /
yadidaṃ kavacaṃ mahyaṃ prakāśitamanāmayam //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
ब्रह्मपुत्र महाभाग महान्मे ऽनुग्रहः कृतः /
यदिदं कवचं मह्यं प्रकाशितमनामयम् //
text_mt: Sagara said: / O fortunate son of Brahmā, a great favor has been done to me, / in that this auspicious armour has been revealed to me.

sanskrit_iast:
aurveṇānugṛhīto 'haṃ kṛtāstro yadanugrahāt /
bhavatastu kṛpāpātraṃ jāto 'hamadhunā vibho //
meaning:
और्वेणानुगृहीतो ऽहं कृतास्त्रो यदनुग्रहात् /
भवतस्तु कृपापात्रं जातो ऽहमधुना विभो //
text_mt: I was favoured by Aurva, by whose grace I mastered weapons; / and now, O lord, I have become the recipient of your grace.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa bhārgavendreṇa kārttavīryo nṛpo guro /
yathā samāpito vīrastanme vistarato vada //
meaning:
रामेण भार्गवेन्द्रेण कार्त्तवीर्यो नृपो गुरो /
यथा समापितो वीरस्तन्मे विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt: How King Kārttavīrya, that hero, was slain by Rāma, / the foremost of the Bhārgavas, O guru—tell me that in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpāpātraṃ sa dattasya rājā rāmaḥ śivasya ca /
ubhau tau samare vīrau jaghaṭāte kathaṃ guro //
meaning:
कृपापात्रं स दत्तस्य राजा रामः शिवस्य च /
उभौ तौ समरे वीरौ जघटाते कथं गुरो //
text_mt: That king was the object of Datta's grace, and Rāma of Śiva's; / how did those two heroes clash in battle, O guru?

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi caritaṃ pāpanāśanam /
kārttavīryasya bhūpasya rāmasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि चरितं पापनाशनम् /
कार्त्तवीर्यस्य भूपस्य रामस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Listen, O king, and I shall tell the sin-destroying story / of King Kārttavīrya and of the great-souled Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rāmaḥ kavacaṃ labdhvā mantraṃ caiva gurormukhāt /
cakāra mādhanaṃ tasya bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
स रामः कवचं लब्ध्वा मन्त्रं चैव गुरोर्मुखात् /
चकार माधनं तस्य भक्त्या परमया युतः //
text_mt: Having obtained the armour and the mantra from the mouth of his guru, / that Rāma practiced its propitiation, endowed with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiśāgī triṣavaṇa snānasadhyāparāyaṇaḥ /
uvāsapuṣkare rāma śatavarṣamatandritaḥ //
meaning:
भूमिशागी त्रिषवण स्नानसध्यापरायणः /
उवासपुष्करे राम शतवर्षमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground, devoted to the three daily ablutions and twilight prayers, / Rāma lived at Puṣkara for a hundred years, unwearied.

sanskrit_iast:
samitpuṣpakuśādīni dravyāṇyaharaharbhṛgoḥ /
ānīya kānanādbhūpa prāyacchadakṛtavraṇaḥ //
meaning:
समित्पुष्पकुशादीनि द्रव्याण्यहरहर्भृगोः /
आनीय काननाद्भूप प्रायच्छदकृतव्रणः //
text_mt: Fetching items such as firewood, flowers, and kuśa grass from the forest day after day, / Akṛtavraṇa gave them to the descendant of Bhṛgu, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ dhyānasaṃyukto rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ /
ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam //
meaning:
सततं ध्यानसंयुक्तो रामो मतिमतां वरः /
आराधयामास विभुं कृष्णं कल्मषनाशनम् //
text_mt: Always engaged in meditation, Rāma, best among the wise, / worshipped the all-pervading Kṛṣṇa, the destroyer of blemishes.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaivaṃ yajamānasya rāmasya jagatīpate /
gataṃ varṣaśataṃ tatra dhyānayuktasya nityadā //
meaning:
तस्यैवं यजमानस्य रामस्य जगतीपते /
गतं वर्षशतं तत्र ध्यानयुक्तस्य नित्यदा //
text_mt: As Rāma was worshipping thus, O lord of the earth, / a hundred years passed there while he was constantly engaged in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadā tu mahārāja rāmaḥ snātuṃ gato mahān /
madhyamaṃ puṣkaraṃ tatra dadarśāśvaryamuttamam //
meaning:
एकदा तु महाराज रामः स्नातुं गतो महान् /
मध्यमं पुष्करं तत्र ददर्शाश्वर्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Once, O great king, when the great Rāma went to bathe / at middle Puṣkara, he saw a supreme wonder there.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛga ekaḥ samāyāto mṛgya yuktaḥ palāyitaḥ /
vyādhasya mṛgayāṃ prāpto dharmatapto 'tipīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
मृग एकः समायातो मृग्य युक्तः पलायितः /
व्याधस्य मृगयां प्राप्तो धर्मतप्तो ऽतिपीडितः //
text_mt: A stag arrived, fleeing along with a hind, / having been caught in a hunter's hunt, scorched by the heat, deeply distressed,

sanskrit_iast:
pipāsito mahābhāga jalapānasamutsukaḥ /
rāmasya paśyatastatra sarasastaṭamāgataḥ //
meaning:
पिपासितो महाभाग जलपानसमुत्सुकः /
रामस्य पश्यतस्तत्र सरसस्तटमागतः //
text_mt: thirsty, O fortunate one, and eager to drink water. / As Rāma watched, he came to the bank of the lake there.

sanskrit_iast:
paścānmṛgī samāyātā bhītā sā cakitekṣaṇā /
ubho tau pibatastatra jalaṃ śaṅkitamānasau //
meaning:
पश्चान्मृगी समायाता भीता सा चकितेक्षणा /
उभो तौ पिबतस्तत्र जलं शङ्कितमानसौ //
text_mt: Behind him came the hind, frightened, her eyes startled; / both drank water there, their minds apprehensive.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatsamāgato vyādho bāṇapāṇirdhanurddharaḥ /
sa dṛṣṭvā tatra saṃviṣṭaṃ rāmaṃ bhārgavanandanam //
meaning:
तावत्समागतो व्याधो बाणपाणिर्धनुर्द्धरः /
स दृष्ट्वा तत्र संविष्टं रामं भार्गवनन्दनम् //
text_mt: Just then the hunter arrived, arrow in hand, holding a bow; / seeing Rāma, the delight of the Bhārgavas, seated there,

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaṃ tasthau dūrakṛtekṣaṇaḥ /
sa cintayāmāsa tadā śaṅkito bhṛgunandanāt //
meaning:
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तं तस्थौ दूरकृतेक्षणः /
स चिन्तयामास तदा शङ्कितो भृगुनन्दनात् //
text_mt: accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, he halted, casting his gaze from afar; / he then reflected, apprehensive of the descendant of Bhṛgu:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ rāmo mahāvīro duṣṭānāmantakārakaḥ /
kathametasya hanmyetau paśyato mṛgayāmṛgau //
meaning:
अयं रामो महावीरो दुष्टानामन्तकारकः /
कथमेतस्य हन्म्येतौ पश्यतो मृगयामृगौ //
text_mt: 'This Rāma is a great hero, the destroyer of the wicked; / how can I kill these two hunted deer while he is watching?'

sanskrit_iast:
iti cintā samāviṣṭo vyādho rājanyasattama /
tasthau tatraiva rāmasya bhayātsaṃtrastamānasaḥ //
meaning:
इति चिन्ता समाविष्टो व्याधो राजन्यसत्तम /
तस्थौ तत्रैव रामस्य भयात्संत्रस्तमानसः //
text_mt: Absorbed in such anxiety, O best of kings, / the hunter stayed right there, his mind terrified out of fear of Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmastu tau mṛgoṃ dṛṣṭvā pibantau sabhyaṃ jalam /
tarkayāmāsa medhāvī kimatra bhayakāraṇam //
meaning:
रामस्तु तौ मृगों दृष्ट्वा पिबन्तौ सभ्यं जलम् /
तर्कयामास मेधावी किमत्र भयकारणम् //
text_mt: Rāma, seeing those two deer drinking water fearlessly, / and being wise, reflected: 'What is the cause of fear here?'

sanskrit_iast:
naivātra vyāghrasenādo na ca vyādho hi dṛśyate /
kenaitau kāraṇenāho śaṅkitau cakitekṣaṇau //
meaning:
नैवात्र व्याघ्रसेनादो न च व्याधो हि दृश्यते /
केनैतौ कारणेनाहो शङ्कितौ चकितेक्षणौ //
text_mt: "Indeed, neither the sound of a tiger nor a hunter is seen here; / for what reason, then, are these two suspicious, with startled eyes?

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā mṛgajātirhi nisargāccakitekṣaṇā /
cenaitau jalapāne 'pi paśyataścakitekṣaṇau //
meaning:
अथ वा मृगजातिर्हि निसर्गाच्चकितेक्षणा /
चेनैतौ जलपाने ऽपि पश्यतश्चकितेक्षणौ //
text_mt: Or is the species of deer by nature possessed of startled eyes, / since, even while drinking water, they look about with frightened gaze?

sanskrit_iast:
naitāvatkāraṇaṃ cātra kintu khedabhayāturau /
lakṣayete khinnasarvāṅgau kampayuktau yatastvimau //
meaning:
नैतावत्कारणं चात्र किन्तु खेदभयातुरौ /
लक्षयेते खिन्नसर्वाङ्गौ कम्पयुक्तौ यतस्त्विमौ //
text_mt: Yet this is not the only reason here; rather, they are afflicted by exhaustion and fear, / since they appear with their whole bodies weary and trembling."

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃcintya matimānsa tasthau madhyapuṣkare /
śiṣyeṇa saṃyuto rāmo yāvattau cāpi saṃsthitau //
meaning:
एवं संचिन्त्य मतिमान्स तस्थौ मध्यपुष्करे /
शिष्येण संयुतो रामो यावत्तौ चापि संस्थितौ //
text_mt: Having reflected thus, the wise Rāma remained in the middle lake / together with his disciple, as long as those two remained.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā jalaṃ tatastau tu vṛkṣacchāyāsamāśritau /
rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kathāṃ tau cakraturmudā //
meaning:
पीत्वा जलं ततस्तौ तु वृक्षच्छायासमाश्रितौ /
रामं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कथां तौ चक्रतुर्मुदा //
text_mt: Having drunk the water, the two took shelter in the shade of a tree; / seeing the great-souled Rāma, they gladly conversed.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgyuvāca
kānta cātraiva tiṣṭhāvo yāvadrāmo 'trasaṃsthitaḥ /
asya vīrasya sāṃnidhye bhayaṃ naivāvayorbhavet //
meaning:
मृग्युवाच
कान्त चात्रैव तिष्ठावो यावद्रामो ऽत्रसंस्थितः /
अस्य वीरस्य सांनिध्ये भयं नैवावयोर्भवेत् //
text_mt:
The doe said:
"Beloved, let us stay right here as long as Rāma remains here; / in the presence of this hero, no fear can come to the two of us.

sanskrit_iast:
atrāpyāgatya caivdyādhau hyāvayoḥ prahariṣyati /
dṛṣṭamātro hi muninā bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
अत्राप्यागत्य चैव्द्याधौ ह्यावयोः प्रहरिष्यति /
दृष्टमात्रो हि मुनिना भस्मीभूतो भविष्यति //
text_mt: Even if the hunter comes here and strikes at the two of us, / as soon as he is seen by the sage, he will be reduced to ashes."

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte vacane mṛgyā rāmar śanatuṣṭayā /
mṛgaścovāca harṣeṇa samāviṣṭaḥ priyāṃ svakām //
meaning:
इत्युक्ते वचने मृग्या रामर् शनतुष्टया /
मृगश्चोवाच हर्षेण समाविष्टः प्रियां स्वकाम् //
text_mt: When this statement was made by the doe, pleased at the sight of Rāma, / the buck, filled with joy, spoke to his beloved:

sanskrit_iast:
evameva mahābhāge yadvai vadasi bhāmini /
jāne 'hamapi rāmasya prabhāvaṃ sumahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
एवमेव महाभागे यद्वै वदसि भामिनि /
जाने ऽहमपि रामस्य प्रभावं सुमहात्मनः //
text_mt: "Just so, illustrious lady, what you say is true, beautiful one; / I too know the power of this very great-souled Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'yaṃ saṃdṛśyate cāsya pārśvaṃ śiṣyo 'kṛtavraṇaḥ /
sacāne na mahābhāgastrāto vyāghrabhayāturaḥ //
meaning:
यो ऽयं संदृश्यते चास्य पार्श्वं शिष्यो ऽकृतव्रणः /
सचाने न महाभागस्त्रातो व्याघ्रभयातुरः //
text_mt: This disciple of his, Akṛtavraṇa, who is seen at his side, / this illustrious one was rescued by him when afflicted by fear of a tiger.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ rāmo mahābhāge jamadagnisuto 'nujaḥ /
pitaraṃ kārttavīryeṇa dṛṣṭvā caiva tiraskṛtam //
meaning:
अयं रामो महाभागे जमदग्निसुतो ऽनुजः /
पितरं कार्त्तवीर्येण दृष्ट्वा चैव तिरस्कृतम् //
text_mt: This Rāma, O fortunate one, is the younger son of Jamadagni; / seeing his father insulted by Kārttavīrya,

sanskrit_iast:
cakārātitarāṃ kruddhaḥ pratijñāṃ nṛpaghātinīm /
tatpūrtikāmo hyagamadbrahmalokaṃ purā hyayam //
meaning:
चकारातितरां क्रुद्धः प्रतिज्ञां नृपघातिनीम् /
तत्पूर्तिकामो ह्यगमद्ब्रह्मलोकं पुरा ह्ययम् //
text_mt: he, exceedingly enraged, made a vow to slay the kings; / wishing to fulfill that, he formerly went to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sa brahmā diṣṭavāṃścainaṃ śivalokaṃ vrajeti ha /
tasya tvājñāṃ samādāya gato 'sau śivasannidhim //
meaning:
स ब्रह्मा दिष्टवांश्चैनं शिवलोकं व्रजेति ह /
तस्य त्वाज्ञां समादाय गतो ऽसौ शिवसन्निधिम् //
text_mt: That Brahmā instructed him: 'Go to the world of Śiva.' / Receiving his command, he went into the presence of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
provācākhilavṛttānta rājñaścapyātmanaḥ pituḥ /
sa kṛpālurmahādevaḥ sabhājya bhṛgunandanam //
meaning:
प्रोवाचाखिलवृत्तान्त राज्ञश्चप्यात्मनः पितुः /
स कृपालुर्महादेवः सभाज्य भृगुनन्दनम् //
text_mt: He told the entire story of the king and of his own father; / compassionate Mahādeva, honoring the descendant of Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau kṛṣṇasya sanmantramabhedyaṃ kavacaṃ tathā /
svīyaṃ pāśupataṃ cāstramanyāstragrāmameva ca //
meaning:
ददौ कृष्णस्य सन्मन्त्रमभेद्यं कवचं तथा /
स्वीयं पाशुपतं चास्त्रमन्यास्त्रग्राममेव च //
text_mt: gave him the excellent mantra of Kṛṣṇa and an impenetrable armor, / as well as his own Pāśupata missile and an entire host of other missiles.

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayāmāsa mudā dattvā śastrāṇi cādarāt /
so 'yamatrāgato bhadre metrasādhanatatparaḥ //
meaning:
विसर्जयामास मुदा दत्त्वा शस्त्राणि चादरात् /
सो ऽयमत्रागतो भद्रे मेत्रसाधनतत्परः //
text_mt: Having respectfully given him the weapons, he dismissed him with joy; / this very one has come here, gentle lady, intent upon accomplishing the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ japati dharmātmā kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ sudhīḥ /
śatavarṣāṇi cāpyasya gatāni sumahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
नित्यं जपति धर्मात्मा कृष्णस्य कवचं सुधीः /
शतवर्षाणि चाप्यस्य गतानि सुमहात्मनः //
text_mt: The righteous, wise one constantly repeats the armor of Kṛṣṇa; / a hundred years have passed for this very great-souled one

sanskrit_iast:
mantra sādhayato bhadre na ca tatsiddhireti hi /
ātrāsti kāraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ sāva vai trividhā matā //
meaning:
मन्त्र साधयतो भद्रे न च तत्सिद्धिरेति हि /
आत्रास्ति कारणं भक्तिः साव वै त्रिविधा मता //
text_mt: as he accomplishes the mantra, gentle lady, yet success does not come to it; / here devotion is the cause, and that [devotion] is considered to be threefold,

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā madhyamā caiva kaniṣṭhā taralekṣaṇe /
śivasya nāradasyāpi śukasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तमा मध्यमा चैव कनिष्ठा तरलेक्षणे /
शिवस्य नारदस्यापि शुकस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt: highest, intermediate, and lowest, O restless-eyed lady! / Śiva, Nārada, and the great-souled Śuka,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbarīṣsya rājarṣe rantidevasya māruteḥ /
balervibhīṣaṇasyāpi prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अंबरीष्स्य राजर्षे रन्तिदेवस्य मारुतेः /
बलेर्विभीषणस्यापि प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: the royal sage Ambarīṣa, Rantideva, the son of the Wind, / Bali, Vibhīṣaṇa, and the great-souled Prahlāda,

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā bhaktirevāsti gopīnāmuddhavasya ca /
vasiṣṭhādimunīśānāṃ manvādīnāṃ śubhekṣaṇe //
meaning:
उत्तमा भक्तिरेवास्ति गोपीनामुद्धवस्य च /
वसिष्ठादिमुनीशानां मन्वादीनां शुभेक्षणे //
text_mt: the gopīs, and Uddhava possess highest devotion; / of the lords of sages beginning with Vasiṣṭha, and Manu and others, O fair-eyed one,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyā ca bhaktirevāsti prākṛtānyajaneṣu sā /
madhyabhaktirayaṃ rāmo nityaṃ yamaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
मध्या च भक्तिरेवास्ति प्राकृतान्यजनेषु सा /
मध्यभक्तिरयं रामो नित्यं यमपरायणः //
text_mt: there is intermediate devotion; and that [lowest devotion] is found among ordinary people; / having intermediate devotion, this Rāma, ever devoted to self-restraint,

sanskrit_iast:
sevate gopikādhīśaṃ tena siddhiṃ na cāgataḥ /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktā tvaritaṃ kāntaṃ sā mṛgī hṛṣṭamānasā //
meaning:
सेवते गोपिकाधीशं तेन सिद्धिं न चागतः /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्ता त्वरितं कान्तं सा मृगी हृष्टमानसा //
text_mt:
serves the Lord of the cowherdesses, and therefore he has not attained accomplishment."
Vasiṣṭha said:
Thus spoken to, that doe, delighted in mind, swiftly

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ papraccha bhaktestu lakṣaṇaṃ premadāyakam /
mṛgyuvāca
sādhukānta mahābhāga vacaste 'laukikaṃ priya /
rhadṛg jñānaṃ tava kathaṃ saṃjātaṃ tadvadādhunā //
meaning:
पुनः पप्रच्छ भक्तेस्तु लक्षणं प्रेमदायकम् /
मृग्युवाच
साधुकान्त महाभाग वचस्ते ऽलौकिकं प्रिय /
र्हदृग् ज्ञानं तव कथं संजातं तद्वदाधुना //
text_mt:
asked her beloved again about the characteristics of devotion that bestows love.
The doe said:
"Well said, my beloved, illustrious one, your word is extraordinary, dear one! / How has such knowledge arisen in you? Tell that now."

sanskrit_iast:
mṛga uvāca
śṛṇu priye mahābhāge jñānaṃ puṇyena jāyate //
meaning:
मृग उवाच
शृणु प्रिये महाभागे ज्ञानं पुण्येन जायते //
text_mt:
The buck said:
"Listen, my beloved, illustrious lady: knowledge arises through merit.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpuṇyamadya saṃjātaṃ bhārgavasyāsya darśanāt /
puṇyātmā bhārgavaścāyaṃ kṛṣṇābhakto jitendriyaḥ //
meaning:
तत्पुण्यमद्य संजातं भार्गवस्यास्य दर्शनात् /
पुण्यात्मा भार्गवश्चायं कृष्णाभक्तो जितेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: That merit has arisen today from the sight of this Bhārgava; / this Bhārgava is a virtuous soul, devoted to Kṛṣṇa, with senses conquered,

sanskrit_iast:
guruśuśrūṣako nityaṃ nityanaimittikādaraḥ /
ato 'sya darśanājjātaṃ jñānaṃ me/dyaiva bhāmini //
meaning:
गुरुशुश्रूषको नित्यं नित्यनैमित्तिकादरः /
अतो ऽस्य दर्शनाज्जातं ज्ञानं मे/द्यैव भामिनि //
text_mt: ever serving his guru, attentive to obligatory and occasional rites; / therefore, from the sight of him, knowledge has arisen in me this very day, beautiful lady,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasthitasattvānāṃ śubhāśubhanidarśakam /
adyaiva viditaṃ me 'bhūdrāsasyāsya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यस्थितसत्त्वानां शुभाशुभनिदर्शकम् /
अद्यैव विदितं मे ऽभूद्रासस्यास्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: which shows the good and evil of living beings in the three worlds; / this very day the deed of this great-souled Rāma has become known to me,

sanskrit_iast:
caritaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva pāpaghnaṃ śṛṇvatāmidam /
yadyatkariṣyate caiva tadapi jñānagocaram //
meaning:
चरितं पुण्यदं चैव पापघ्नं शृण्वतामिदम् /
यद्यत्करिष्यते चैव तदपि ज्ञानगोचरम् //
text_mt: which bestows merit and destroys sin for those who hear it; / and whatever he will do is also within the range of my knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
yottamā bhaktirākhyātā tāṃ vinā naiva siddhyati /
kavacaṃ mantrasahitaṃ hyapi varṣāyutāyutaiḥ //
meaning:
योत्तमा भक्तिराख्याता तां विना नैव सिद्ध्यति /
कवचं मन्त्रसहितं ह्यपि वर्षायुतायुतैः //
text_mt: Without that which is called highest devotion, / the armor together with the mantra is not accomplished even in myriads upon myriads of years.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyayaṃ bhārgavo bhadre hyagastyānugrahaṃ labhet /
kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ nāma stotramuttamabhaktidam //
meaning:
यद्ययं भार्गवो भद्रे ह्यगस्त्यानुग्रहं लभेत् /
कृष्णप्रेमामृतं नाम स्तोत्रमुत्तमभक्तिदम् //
text_mt: If this Bhārgava, gentle lady, obtains the grace of Agastya, / and understands the hymn named Kṛṣṇapremāmṛta which bestows highest devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā ca lapsyate siddhiṃ mantrasya kavacasya ca /
sa munirjñātatattvārthaḥ sānukaṃpo 'bhayapradaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा च लप्स्यते सिद्धिं मन्त्रस्य कवचस्य च /
स मुनिर्ज्ञाततत्त्वार्थः सानुकंपो ऽभयप्रदः //
text_mt: he will attain accomplishment of the mantra and the armor; / that sage, knowing the truth of reality, compassionate, bestowing fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
upadekṣyati caivainaṃ tattvajñānaṃ mudāvaham /
śrīkṛṣṇacāritaṃ sarvaṃ nāmabhirgrathitaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
उपदेक्ष्यति चैवैनं तत्त्वज्ञानं मुदावहम् /
श्रीकृष्णचारितं सर्वं नामभिर्ग्रथितं यतः //
text_mt: will teach him the knowledge of reality that brings joy; / since the whole story of Śrī Kṛṣṇa is woven together with names

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapremāmṛtastotrājjñāsyate 'sya mahāmatiḥ /
tataḥ saṃsiddha kavacau rājanaṃ haihayādhipam //
meaning:
कृष्णप्रेमामृतस्तोत्राज्ज्ञास्यते ऽस्य महामतिः /
ततः संसिद्ध कवचौ राजनं हैहयाधिपम् //
text_mt: in the Kṛṣṇapremāmṛtastotra, this wise one will come to know it; / then, having perfected the armor, having slain the king, the ruler of the Haihayas,

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā saputrāmātyaṃ ca sasuhṛdbalavāhanam /
triḥ saptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyatyavanīṃ priya //
meaning:
हत्वा सपुत्रामात्यं च ससुहृद्बलवाहनम् /
त्रिः सप्तकृत्वो निर्भूपां करिष्यत्यवनीं प्रिय //
text_mt: along with his sons, ministers, friends, army, and mounts, / he will rid the earth of kings thrice seven times, my dear!"

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktvā mṛgo rājanvirarāma mṛgīṃ tataḥ /
ātmano mṛgabhāvasya kāraṇaṃ jñātavāṃśca ha //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite catustriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 34//
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवमुक्त्वा मृगो राजन्विरराम मृगीं ततः /
आत्मनो मृगभावस्य कारणं ज्ञातवांश्च ह //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 34//
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Having spoken thus to the doe, O king, the buck then became silent; / and he also knew the cause of his own state as a deer.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter on the deeds of Bhārgava, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
mune paramatattvajñadhyānajñānārthakovida /
bhagavadbhaktisaṃlīnamānasānugrahaḥ kutaḥ //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
मुने परमतत्त्वज्ञध्यानज्ञानार्थकोविद /
भगवद्भक्तिसंलीनमानसानुग्रहः कुतः //
text_mt:
Sagara said:
"O sage, knower of the supreme reality, skilled in the meaning of meditation and knowledge, / whence comes the grace upon those whose minds are absorbed in devotion to the Lord?

sanskrit_iast:
tvayāpi hi mahābhāga yataḥ śaṃsasi satkathāḥ /
śrutvā mṛgamukhātsarvaṃ bhārgavasya viceṣṭitam //
meaning:
त्वयापि हि महाभाग यतः शंससि सत्कथाः /
श्रुत्वा मृगमुखात्सर्वं भार्गवस्य विचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Indeed, by you too, illustrious one, since you relate good tales; / having heard from the mouth of the deer all the deeds of Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyaṃ ca nārāyaṇakathānvitam /
punaḥ prapaccha kiṃ nātha tanme vada savistaram //
meaning:
भूतं भवद्भविष्यं च नारायणकथान्वितम् /
पुनः प्रपच्छ किं नाथ तन्मे वद सविस्तरम् //
text_mt: past, present, and future, accompanied by tales of Nārāyaṇa, / what did she ask again, O master? Tell me that in detail."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi mṛgasya caritaṃ mahat /
yathā pṛṣṭaṃ tayā so 'syai varṇayāmāsa tattvavit //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
शृणु राजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि मृगस्य चरितं महत् /
यथा पृष्टं तया सो ऽस्यै वर्णयामास तत्त्ववित् //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
"Listen, O king, I will tell the great story of the deer, / just as it was asked by her, and as he, the knower of truth, described it to her.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tu caritaṃ tasya bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ /
bhūyaḥ prapaccha taṃ kāntaṃ jñānatattvārthamādarāt //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तु चरितं तस्य भार्गवस्य महात्मनः /
भूयः प्रपच्छ तं कान्तं ज्ञानतत्त्वार्थमादरात् //
text_mt: Having heard the story of that great-souled Bhārgava, / she again questioned her beloved with respect concerning the meaning of the truth of knowledge."

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgyuvāca
sādhusādhu mahābhāga kṛtārthastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
yadasya darśanātte 'dya jātaṃ jñānamatīdriyam //
meaning:
मृग्युवाच
साधुसाधु महाभाग कृतार्थस्त्वं न संशयः /
यदस्य दर्शनात्ते ऽद्य जातं ज्ञानमतीद्रियम् //
text_mt:
The doe said:
"Well done, well done, illustrious one! You have accomplished your goal, there is no doubt, / since from the sight of him this super-sensory knowledge has arisen in you today.

sanskrit_iast:
athātaścātmanaḥ sarvaṃ mamāpi vada kāraṇam /
karmaṇā yena saṃprāptāvāvāṃ tiryagjaniṃ prabho //
meaning:
अथातश्चात्मनः सर्वं ममापि वद कारणम् /
कर्मणा येन संप्राप्तावावां तिर्यग्जनिं प्रभो //
text_mt: Therefore, tell me also the entire reason concerning yourself and me, / through what action we two have obtained birth as animals, O lord."

sanskrit_iast:
iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya priyāyāḥ sa mṛgaḥ svayam /
varṇayāmāsa caritaṃ mṛgyaścaivātmanastadā //
meaning:
इति वाक्यं समाकर्ण्य प्रियायाः स मृगः स्वयम् /
वर्णयामास चरितं मृग्यश्चैवात्मनस्तदा //
text_mt: Having heard this speech of his beloved, that buck himself / then described to the doe her deeds and his own.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛga uvāca
śṛṇu priye mahābhāge yathā'vāṃ mṛgatāṃ gatau /
saṃsāre 'sminnamahābhāge bhāvo 'sya bhavakāraṇam //
meaning:
मृग उवाच
शृणु प्रिये महाभागे यथाऽवां मृगतां गतौ /
संसारे ऽस्मिन्नमहाभागे भावो ऽस्य भवकारणम् //
text_mt:
The buck said:
"Listen, my beloved, illustrious lady, how the two of us attained the state of deer; / in this worldly existence, O fortunate one, one's disposition is the cause of rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvasya sadasabhdyāṃ hi karmabhyāmāgataḥ smṛtim /
purā draviḍadeśe tu nānāṛddhisamākule //
meaning:
जीवस्य सदसभ्द्यां हि कर्मभ्यामागतः स्मृतिम् /
पुरा द्रविडदेशे तु नानाऋद्धिसमाकुले //
text_mt: It has come to my memory through the good and bad deeds of an embodied soul. / Formerly, in the Draviḍa country, crowded with various prosperities,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānāṃ kule vāhaṃ jātaḥ kauśikagotriṇām /
pitā me śivadatto 'bhūnnāmnā śāstraviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणानां कुले वाहं जातः कौशिकगोत्रिणाम् /
पिता मे शिवदत्तो ऽभून्नाम्ना शास्त्रविशारदः //
text_mt: I was born in a family of brāhmaṇas belonging to the Kauśika gotra. / My father was named Śivadatta, a scholar of the śāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putrā vayaṃ jātāścatvāro dvijasattamāḥ /
jyeṣṭho rāmo 'nujastasya dhamastasyānu jaḥ pṛthuḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रा वयं जाताश्चत्वारो द्विजसत्तमाः /
ज्येष्ठो रामो ऽनुजस्तस्य धमस्तस्यानु जः पृथुः //
text_mt: We were born as his four sons, best of dvijas: / the eldest was Rāma, his younger brother was Dhāma, his younger brother was Pṛthu,

sanskrit_iast:
caturtho 'haṃ priye jāto sūrirityabhiviśrutaḥ /
upanīya kramātsarvāñchivadatto mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थो ऽहं प्रिये जातो सूरिरित्यभिविश्रुतः /
उपनीय क्रमात्सर्वाञ्छिवदत्तो महायशाः //
text_mt: and I was born the fourth, O beloved, renowned as Sūri. / Having initiated all of them in due order, the highly renowned Śivadatta

sanskrit_iast:
vedānadhyāpayāmāsa sāṃgāṃśca sarahasyakān /
catvāro 'pi vayaṃ tatra vedādhyayanatatparāḥ //
meaning:
वेदानध्यापयामास सांगांश्च सरहस्यकान् /
चत्वारो ऽपि वयं तत्र वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः //
text_mt: taught them the Vedas along with their auxiliary branches and their secret teachings. / All four of us were intent upon Vedic study there,

sanskrit_iast:
guruśuśrūṣaṇe yuktā jātā jñānaparāyaṇāḥ /
gatvāraṇyaṃ phalānyaṃbusamitkuśamṛdo 'nvaham //
meaning:
गुरुशुश्रूषणे युक्ता जाता ज्ञानपरायणाः /
गत्वारण्यं फलान्यंबुसमित्कुशमृदो ऽन्वहम् //
text_mt: devoted to the service of our guru, and absorbed in knowledge. / Having gone to the forest every day for fruits, water, sacrificial fuel, kuśa grass, and clay,

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya pitre dattvātha kurmo 'dhyayanameva hi /
ekadā tu vayaṃ sarve saṃprāptā parvate vane //
meaning:
आनीय पित्रे दत्त्वाथ कुर्मो ऽध्ययनमेव हि /
एकदा तु वयं सर्वे संप्राप्ता पर्वते वने //
text_mt: and having brought them and given them to our father, we would then engage only in study. / Once, however, we all arrived at a forested mountain,

sanskrit_iast:
audbhidaṃ nāma lolakṣi kṛtamālātaṭe sthitam /
sarve snātvā mahānadyāmuṣasi prītamānasāḥ //
meaning:
औद्भिदं नाम लोलक्षि कृतमालातटे स्थितम् /
सर्वे स्नात्वा महानद्यामुषसि प्रीतमानसाः //
text_mt: named Audbhida, O unsteady-eyed one, situated on the bank of the Kṛtamālā. / Having all bathed at dawn in the great river, with delighted minds,

sanskrit_iast:
dattārghāḥ kṛtajapyāśca samārūḍhā nāgottamam /
śālastamālaiḥ priyakaiḥ panasaiḥ kovidārakaiḥ //
meaning:
दत्तार्घाः कृतजप्याश्च समारूढा नागोत्तमम् /
शालस्तमालैः प्रियकैः पनसैः कोविदारकैः //
text_mt: having offered the water libation and performed our recitations, we ascended that best of mountains. / With śāla, tamāla, priyaka, jackfruit, and kovidāra trees,

sanskrit_iast:
saralārjunapūgaiśca kharjūrairnārikelakaiḥ /
jaṃbūbhiḥ sahakāraiśca kaṭphalairbṛhatīdrumaiḥ //
meaning:
सरलार्जुनपूगैश्च खर्जूरैर्नारिकेलकैः /
जंबूभिः सहकारैश्च कट्फलैर्बृहतीद्रुमैः //
text_mt: and with sarala, arjuna, and areca nut palms, dates, coconuts, / rose-apples, mangoes, kaṭphala trees, and bṛhatī plants,

sanskrit_iast:
anyairnānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ parārthapratipādakaiḥ /
snigdhacchāyaiḥ samāhṛṣṭanānāpakṣinināditaiḥ //
meaning:
अन्यैर्नानाविधैर्वृक्षैः परार्थप्रतिपादकैः /
स्निग्धच्छायैः समाहृष्टनानापक्षिनिनादितैः //
text_mt: with other trees of various kinds that grant benefits to others, / with soothing shade, resounding with various delighted birds,

sanskrit_iast:
śārdūla haribhirbhallairgaṇḍakairmṛganābhibhiḥ /
gacaindraiḥ śārabhādyaiśca sevitaṃ kandarāgataiḥ //
meaning:
शार्दूल हरिभिर्भल्लैर्गण्डकैर्मृगनाभिभिः /
गचैन्द्रैः शारभाद्यैश्च सेवितं कन्दरागतैः //
text_mt: frequented by tigers, lions, bears, rhinoceroses, and musk-deer, / by lordly elephants and śarabhas and other beasts dwelling in caves,

sanskrit_iast:
mallikāpāṭalākundakarṇikārakadaṃbakaiḥ /
sugandhibhirvṛtaṃ cānyairvātoddhūtaparagibhiḥ //
meaning:
मल्लिकापाटलाकुन्दकर्णिकारकदंबकैः /
सुगन्धिभिर्वृतं चान्यैर्वातोद्धूतपरगिभिः //
text_mt: surrounded by fragrant mallikā, pāṭalā, kunda, karṇikāra, and kadamba flowers, / and others whose pollen was tossed up by the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇairnīlapītasitāruṇaiḥ /
śṛṅgaiḥ samullikhantaṃ ca vyoma kautukasaṃ yutam //
meaning:
नानामणिगणाकीर्णैर्नीलपीतसितारुणैः /
शृङ्गैः समुल्लिखन्तं च व्योम कौतुकसं युतम् //
text_mt: and with its peaks, strewn with various gems, blue, yellow, white, and red, / scraping the sky, full of wonders,

sanskrit_iast:
atyuccapātadhvanibhirnirjharaiḥ kandarodgataiḥ /
garjjatamiva saṃsaktaṃ vyālādyairmṛgapakṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
अत्युच्चपातध्वनिभिर्निर्झरैः कन्दरोद्गतैः /
गर्ज्जतमिव संसक्तं व्यालाद्यैर्मृगपक्षिभिः //
text_mt: seeming to roar with its waterfalls issuing from caves with very loud crashing sounds, / teeming with predatory beasts, deer, and birds—

sanskrit_iast:
tatrātikautukāhṛṣṭadṛṣṭayobhrātaro vayam /
nāsmārṣma cātmanātmānaṃ viyuktāśca parasparam //
meaning:
तत्रातिकौतुकाहृष्टदृष्टयोभ्रातरो वयम् /
नास्मार्ष्म चात्मनात्मानं वियुक्ताश्च परस्परम् //
text_mt: there, we brothers, our sight captivated by intense wonder, / did not remember ourselves and became separated from one another.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare caikā mṛgī hyagātpipāsitā /
nirjharāpāta śirasi pātukāmā jalaṃ priye //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैका मृगी ह्यगात्पिपासिता /
निर्झरापात शिरसि पातुकामा जलं प्रिये //
text_mt: In the meantime, a thirsty doe came along, / wishing to drink water, O beloved, at the crest of the waterfall.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ pibantyāstu jalaṃ śārdūlo 'tibhayaṅkaraḥ /
tatra prāpto yadṛcchāto jagṛhe tāṃ bhayarditām //
meaning:
तस्याः पिबन्त्यास्तु जलं शार्दूलो ऽतिभयङ्करः /
तत्र प्राप्तो यदृच्छातो जगृहे तां भयर्दिताम् //
text_mt: As she was drinking water, a terrifying tiger / arrived there by chance and seized her, afflicted with terror.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tadgrahaṇaṃ paśyanbhayena prapalāyitaḥ /
atyuccavattvātpatito mṛtaścaiṇīmanusmaran //
meaning:
अहं तद्ग्रहणं पश्यन्भयेन प्रपलायितः /
अत्युच्चवत्त्वात्पतितो मृतश्चैणीमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Seeing that seizure, I fled in fear. / Because of the extreme height, I fell and died, remembering the doe.

sanskrit_iast:
sā mṛtā tvaṃ mṛgī jātā mṛga stvāhamanusmaran /
jāto bhadre na jāne vai kva gātā bhrātaro 'grajāḥ //
meaning:
सा मृता त्वं मृगी जाता मृग स्त्वाहमनुस्मरन् /
जातो भद्रे न जाने वै क्व गाता भ्रातरो ऽग्रजाः //
text_mt: Having died, she became you, a doe; and I, remembering you, / was born a deer, O auspicious one! I do not know where my elder brothers have gone.

sanskrit_iast:
etanme smṛtimāpannaṃ caritaṃ tava cātmataḥ /
bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tathā śṛṇu bhadre vadāmyaham //
meaning:
एतन्मे स्मृतिमापन्नं चरितं तव चात्मतः /
भूतं भविष्यं च तथा शृणु भद्रे वदाम्यहम् //
text_mt: This past of yours and of mine has come to my memory. / The past and the future likewise—listen, O auspicious one, as I tell it.

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'yaṃ vā vṛṣṭhasaṃlagno vyādho dūrasthito 'bhavat /
rāmasyāsya bhayātso 'pi bhakṣito hariṇā dhunā //
meaning:
यो ऽयं वा वृष्ठसंलग्नो व्याधो दूरस्थितो ऽभवत् /
रामस्यास्य भयात्सो ऽपि भक्षितो हरिणा धुना //
text_mt: The hunter who was pursuing us from behind and stood at a distance / has also now been devoured by a lion out of fear of this Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāṃstyaktvā vidhānena svargalokaṃ gamiṣyati /
avābhyāṃ tu jalaṃ pītaṃ madhyame puṣkare tviha //
meaning:
प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा विधानेन स्वर्गलोकं गमिष्यति /
अवाभ्यां तु जलं पीतं मध्यमे पुष्करे त्विह //
text_mt: Having given up his life in accordance with destiny, he will go to the heavenly world. / But we two have drunk water here in the middle Puṣkara,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdṛṣṭo bhārgavaścāyaṃ sākṣādviṣṇusvarūpadhṛk /
tenānekabhavotpannaṃ pātakaṃ nāśamāgatam //
meaning:
संदृष्टो भार्गवश्चायं साक्षाद्विष्णुस्वरूपधृक् /
तेनानेकभवोत्पन्नं पातकं नाशमागतम् //
text_mt: and this Bhārgava, who bears the direct form of Viṣṇu, has been beheld by us. / By that, the evil accumulated over many births has met its destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyadarśanaṃ labdhvā śrutvā stotraṃ gatipradam /
gamiṣyāvaḥ śubhāṃllokānyeṣu gatvā na śocati //
meaning:
अगस्त्यदर्शनं लब्ध्वा श्रुत्वा स्तोत्रं गतिप्रदम् /
गमिष्यावः शुभांल्लोकान्येषु गत्वा न शोचति //
text_mt: Having obtained the sight of Agastya and heard the hymn that grants liberation, / we shall go to the auspicious worlds, reaching which one does not grieve.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā sa mṛgaḥ priyāyai priyadarśanaḥ /
virarāma prasannātmā paśyanrāmamanā turaḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स मृगः प्रियायै प्रियदर्शनः /
विरराम प्रसन्नात्मा पश्यन्राममना तुरः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to his beloved, that handsome deer / ceased, serene in mind, fearless, looking at Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhargavaḥ śrutavāṃścaiva mṛgoktaṃ śiṣyasaṃyutaḥ /
vismito 'bhūcca rājendra gantuṃ kṛtamatistathā //
meaning:
भर्गवः श्रुतवांश्चैव मृगोक्तं शिष्यसंयुतः /
विस्मितो ऽभूच्च राजेन्द्र गन्तुं कृतमतिस्तथा //
text_mt: And the Bhārgava, having heard what was spoken by the deer, together with his disciple, / was astonished, O king of kings, and resolved to go [forward].

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavramasaṃyukto hyagastyasyāśramaṃ prati /
snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā pratasthe harṣito bhṛśam //
meaning:
अकृतव्रमसंयुक्तो ह्यगस्त्यस्याश्रमं प्रति /
स्नात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा प्रतस्थे हर्षितो भृशम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, toward the hermitage of Agastya, / having bathed and performed the daily rites, he set out, greatly delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa gacchatā mārge dṛṣṭo vyādho mṛtastadā /
siṃhasya saṃprahārema vismitena mahātmanā //
meaning:
रामेण गच्छता मार्गे दृष्टो व्याधो मृतस्तदा /
सिंहस्य संप्रहारेम विस्मितेन महात्मना //
text_mt: As he went on the road, the hunter was seen by Rāma, dead then / by the blow of a lion, and the great-souled one was filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyarddhayojanaṃ gatvā kaniṣṭhaṃ puṣkaraṃ prati /
snātvā mādhyāhnikīṃ sandhyāṃ cakā rātimudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अध्यर्द्धयोजनं गत्वा कनिष्ठं पुष्करं प्रति /
स्नात्वा माध्याह्निकीं सन्ध्यां चका रातिमुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Having gone a yojana and a half toward the lower Puṣkara, / he bathed and performed the midday twilight devotion, filled with great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
hitaṃ tadātmanaḥ proktaṃ mṛgeṇa sa vicārayan /
tāvattatpṛṣṭhasaṃlagnaṃ mṛgayugmamupāgatam //
meaning:
हितं तदात्मनः प्रोक्तं मृगेण स विचारयन् /
तावत्तत्पृष्ठसंलग्नं मृगयुग्ममुपागतम् //
text_mt: Reflecting on that beneficial counsel spoken by the deer to himself, / just then the pair of deer, clinging close behind him, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkare tu jalaṃ pītvābhiṣicyātmatanuṃ jalaiḥ /
paśyato bhārgavasyāgādagastyāśramasaṃmukham //
meaning:
पुष्करे तु जलं पीत्वाभिषिच्यात्मतनुं जलैः /
पश्यतो भार्गवस्यागादगस्त्याश्रमसंमुखम् //
text_mt: Having drunk water in the Puṣkara and sprinkled their bodies with the water, / while the Bhārgava was watching, [the pair] went toward Agastya's hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi sandhyāṃ nirvarttya kuṃbhajasyāśramaṃ yayau /
vipadgataṃ puṣkaraṃ tu paśyamāno mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि सन्ध्यां निर्वर्त्त्य कुंभजस्याश्रमं ययौ /
विपद्गतं पुष्करं तु पश्यमानो महामनाः //
text_mt: Rāma also, having completed his twilight devotion, went to the hermitage of the jar-born [Agastya], / while the great-minded one beheld the Puṣkara where danger had passed,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoḥ padāni nāgānāṃ kuṇḍaṃ saptarṣisaṃsthitam /
gatvopaspṛśya śucyaṃbho jagāmāgastyasaṃśrayam //
meaning:
विष्णोः पदानि नागानां कुण्डं सप्तर्षिसंस्थितम् /
गत्वोपस्पृश्य शुच्यंभो जगामागस्त्यसंश्रयम् //
text_mt: the footprints of Viṣṇu, and the pool of the serpents established by the seven sages. / Having gone and touched the pure water, he proceeded to the sanctuary of Agastya,

sanskrit_iast:
yacca brahmasutā rājansamāyātā sarasvatī /
trīnsaṃpūrayituṃ kuṇḍānagnihotrasya vai vidheḥ //
meaning:
यच्च ब्रह्मसुता राजन्समायाता सरस्वती /
त्रीन्संपूरयितुं कुण्डानग्निहोत्रस्य वै विधेः //
text_mt: and where, O king, Sarasvatī, the daughter of Brahmā, arrived / to fill the three pits for the rite of the agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tīre śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ nānāmuniniṣevitam /
dadarśa mahadāścaryaṃ bhārgavaḥ kuṃbhajāśramam //
meaning:
तत्र तीरे शुभं पुण्यं नानामुनिनिषेवितम् /
ददर्श महदाश्चर्यं भार्गवः कुंभजाश्रमम् //
text_mt: There on the bank, auspicious, holy, and frequented by various sages, / the Bhārgava beheld the wonderful hermitage of the jar-born [Agastya],

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaiḥ siṃhaiḥ sahagataiḥ sevitaṃ śāntamānasaiḥ /
kuṭarairarjunairniṃbaiḥ pāribhadradhavegudaiḥ //
meaning:
मृगैः सिंहैः सहगतैः सेवितं शान्तमानसैः /
कुटरैरर्जुनैर्निंबैः पारिभद्रधवेगुदैः //
text_mt: attended by deer and lions dwelling together with tranquil minds, / dense with kuṭara, arjuna, neem, pāribhadra, dhava, and inguda trees,

sanskrit_iast:
khadirāsanakharjūraiḥ saṃkulaṃ badarīdrumaiḥ /
tatra praviśya vai rāmo hyakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
खदिरासनखर्जूरैः संकुलं बदरीद्रुमैः /
तत्र प्रविश्य वै रामो ह्यकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt: and with khadira, asana, date, and badarī trees. / Entering there with Akṛtavraṇa, Rāma

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa munimāsīnaṃ kumbhajaṃ śāntamānasam /
stimitodasaraḥ prakhyaṃ dhyāyantaṃ brahma śāśvatam //
meaning:
ददर्श मुनिमासीनं कुम्भजं शान्तमानसम् /
स्तिमितोदसरः प्रख्यं ध्यायन्तं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: beheld the sage, the jar-born one, seated with a tranquil mind, / resembling a lake of motionless water, meditating on the eternal Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
kauśyāṃ vṛṣyāṃ mārgakṛttiṃ vasānaṃ pallavoṭaje /
nanāma ca mahārāja svābhidhānaṃ samuccaran //
meaning:
कौश्यां वृष्यां मार्गकृत्तिं वसानं पल्लवोटजे /
ननाम च महाराज स्वाभिधानं समुच्चरन् //
text_mt: seated on a grass mat, wearing a deer skin in a leafy hut. / And he bowed down, O great king, pronouncing his own name:

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'smi jāmadagnyo 'haṃ bhavantaṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ /
tādviddhi praṇipātena namaste lokabhāvana //
meaning:
रामो ऽस्मि जामदग्न्यो ऽहं भवन्तं द्रष्टुमागतः /
ताद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन नमस्ते लोकभावन //
text_mt: "I am Rāma, the son of Jamadagni, come to see you. / Know that through my prostration; homage to you, creator of the world!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavantaṃ rāmaṃ tu unmīlya nayane śanaiḥ /
dṛṣṭvā svāgatamuccārya tasmāyāsanamādiśat //
meaning:
इत्युक्तवन्तं रामं तु उन्मील्य नयने शनैः /
दृष्ट्वा स्वागतमुच्चार्य तस्मायासनमादिशत् //
text_mt: When Rāma had spoken thus, [Agastya] opened his eyes slowly, / saw him, uttered a welcome, and offered him a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
madhuparkaṃ samānīya śiṣyeṇa munipuṅgavaḥ /
dadau papraccha kuśalaṃ tapasaśca kulasya ca //
meaning:
मधुपर्कं समानीय शिष्येण मुनिपुङ्गवः /
ददौ पप्रच्छ कुशलं तपसश्च कुलस्य च //
text_mt: Having the madhuparka brought by his disciple, the eminent sage / presented it and inquired after his welfare, his asceticism, and his family.

sanskrit_iast:
sa pṛṣṭastena vai rāmo ghaṭodbhavamuvāca ha /
bhavatsaṃdarśanādīśa kuśalaṃ mama sarvataḥ //
meaning:
स पृष्टस्तेन वै रामो घटोद्भवमुवाच ह /
भवत्संदर्शनादीश कुशलं मम सर्वतः //
text_mt: Questioned by him, Rāma spoke to the jar-born one: / "By the sight of you, O lord, I have welfare in all respects.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvaṅkaṃ saṃśayaṃ jātaṃ chindhi svavacanāmṛtaiḥ /
mṛgaścaiko mayā dṛṣṭo madhyame puṣkare vibho //
meaning:
किं त्वङ्कं संशयं जातं छिन्धि स्ववचनामृतैः /
मृगश्चैको मया दृष्टो मध्यमे पुष्करे विभो //
text_mt: Yet one doubt has arisen; cut it away with the nectar of your words! / A deer was seen by me at the middle Puṣkara, O lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tenoktamakhilaṃ vṛttaṃ mama bhūtamanāgatam /
tacchūtvā vismayāviṣṭo bhavaccharaṇamāgataḥ //
meaning:
तेनोक्तमखिलं वृत्तं मम भूतमनागतम् /
तच्छूत्वा विस्मयाविष्टो भवच्छरणमागतः //
text_mt: By him, my entire story, past and future, was told. / Hearing that, I was seized with wonder and came to your shelter.

sanskrit_iast:
pāhi māṃ kṛpayā nātha sādhayanta mahāmanum /
śivena dattaṃ kavaca mama sādhayato guro //
meaning:
पाहि मां कृपया नाथ साधयन्त महामनुम् /
शिवेन दत्तं कवच मम साधयतो गुरो //
text_mt: Protect me with compassion, O lord, as I master the great mantra / and the armour given by Śiva, while I practice it, O guru!"

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣmasya samatīta tu sādhikaṃ hi śaracchatam /
na ca siddhimavāpto 'haṃ tanme tvaṃ kṛpayā vada //
meaning:
कृष्मस्य समतीत तु साधिकं हि शरच्छतम् /
न च सिद्धिमवाप्तो ऽहं तन्मे त्वं कृपया वद //
text_mt: More than a hundred autumns have passed for me practicing [this], / yet I have not attained accomplishment; therefore, in your compassion, tell me [the reason].

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ praśnaṃ samākarṇya rāmasya sumahātmanaḥ /
kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā mahārāja mṛgoktaṃ jñātavān hṛdā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं प्रश्नं समाकर्ण्य रामस्य सुमहात्मनः /
क्षणं ध्यात्वा महाराज मृगोक्तं ज्ञातवान् हृदा //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard this inquiry of the great-souled Rāma, / he meditated for a moment, O great king, and understood in his heart what the deer had said,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaṃ cāpi samāyātaṃ mṛgyā saha nijāśrame /
śrotuṃ kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvaṃ tatkāraṇa muniḥ /
vicāryāśvāsayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ svavacomṛtaiḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavaca rite pañcatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 35//
meaning:
मृगं चापि समायातं मृग्या सह निजाश्रमे /
श्रोतुं कृष्णामृतं स्तोत्रं सर्वं तत्कारण मुनिः /
विचार्याश्वासयामास भार्गवः स्ववचोमृतैः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवच रिते पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 35//
text_mt:
and also [understood] that the deer had come with the doe to his own hermitage / to hear the hymn Kṛṣṇāmṛta. Having considered that whole cause, / the sage consoled Bhārgava with the nectar of his words.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter in the section on Bhārgava’s deeds, in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part] of the middle section in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. 35.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
avagatya sa vai sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ prītamānasaḥ /
uvāca bhārgavaṃ rāmamagastyaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
अवगत्य स वै सर्वं कारणं प्रीतमानसः /
उवाच भार्गवं राममगस्त्यः कुंभसंभवः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having understood the whole cause, delighted in mind, / Agastya, who was born from a jar, spoke to Rāma Bhārgava:

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga kathayāmi hitaṃ tava /
mantrasya siddhiṃ yena tvaṃ śīghrameva samāpnuyāḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
शृणु राम महाभाग कथयामि हितं तव /
मन्त्रस्य सिद्धिं येन त्वं शीघ्रमेव समाप्नुयाः //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Listen, O fortunate Rāma, I shall tell you what is beneficial to you, / by which you may swiftly attain accomplishment of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktestu lakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā trividhāyā mahāmate /
yo yateta narastasya siddhirbhavati satvaram //
meaning:
भक्तेस्तु लक्षणं ज्ञात्वा त्रिविधाया महामते /
यो यतेत नरस्तस्य सिद्धिर्भवति सत्वरम् //
text_mt: Having understood the characteristics of devotion, which is threefold, O intelligent one, / the man who makes effort quickly attains accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadāhamanuprāpto 'nantadarśanakāṅkṣayā /
pātālaṃ nāgarācaindraiḥ śobhitaṃ parayā mudā //
meaning:
एकदाहमनुप्राप्तो ऽनन्तदर्शनकाङ्क्षया /
पातालं नागराचैन्द्रैः शोभितं परया मुदा //
text_mt: Once, desiring the vision of Ananta, I reached / Pātāla, adorned with lordly serpent kings, with supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dṛṣṭā mahābhāga mayā siddhāḥ samantataḥ /
sanakādyā nāradaśca gautamo jājaliḥkratuḥ //
meaning:
तत्र दृष्टा महाभाग मया सिद्धाः समन्ततः /
सनकाद्या नारदश्च गौतमो जाजलिःक्रतुः //
text_mt: There, O fortunate one, I beheld perfected sages on all sides: / Sanaka and the others, Nārada, Gautama, Jājali, Kratu,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛbhurhaṃso 'ruṇiścaiva vālmīkiḥ śaktirāsuriḥ /
ete 'nye ca mahāsiddhā vātsyāyanamukhā dvija //
meaning:
ऋभुर्हंसो ऽरुणिश्चैव वाल्मीकिः शक्तिरासुरिः /
एते ऽन्ये च महासिद्धा वात्स्यायनमुखा द्विज //
text_mt: Ṛbhu, Haṃsa, Āruṇi, Vālmīki, Śakti, Āsuri, / these and other great perfected sages, led by Vātsyāyana, O twice-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
upāsata hyupā sīnā jñānārthaṃ phaṇināyakam /
taṃ namaskṛtya nāgaindraiḥ saha siddhairmahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
उपासत ह्युपा सीना ज्ञानार्थं फणिनायकम् /
तं नमस्कृत्य नागैन्द्रैः सह सिद्धैर्महात्मभिः //
text_mt: seated in attendance, worshipping the lord of serpents for knowledge. / Having bowed to him along with the lordly serpents and the great-souled perfected sages,

sanskrit_iast:
upaviṣṭaḥ kathāttatra śṛṇvāno vaiṣṇavīrmudā /
yeyaṃ bhūmirmahābhāga bhūtadhātrī svarūpiṇī //
meaning:
उपविष्टः कथात्तत्र शृण्वानो वैष्णवीर्मुदा /
येयं भूमिर्महाभाग भूतधात्री स्वरूपिणी //
text_mt: I sat there, joyfully hearing tales of Viṣṇu. / This earth, O fortunate one, the bearer of beings personified,

sanskrit_iast:
niviṣṭā puratastasya śṛṇvantī tāḥ kathāḥ sadā /
yadyatpṛcchati sā bhūmiḥ śeṣaṃ sākṣānmahīdharam //
meaning:
निविष्टा पुरतस्तस्य शृण्वन्ती ताः कथाः सदा /
यद्यत्पृच्छति सा भूमिः शेषं साक्षान्महीधरम् //
text_mt: was seated before him, ever listening to those tales. / Whatever that earth asked Śeṣa, the direct supporter of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇvanti ṛṣayaḥ sarve tatrasthā tadanugrahāt /
mayā tatra śrutaṃ vatsa kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ śubham //
meaning:
शृण्वन्ति ऋषयः सर्वे तत्रस्था तदनुग्रहात् /
मया तत्र श्रुतं वत्स कृष्णप्रेमामृतं शुभम् //
text_mt: all the ṛṣis present there heard by his grace. / There, dear child, I heard the auspicious Kṛṣṇapremāmṛta;

sanskrit_iast:
stotraṃ tatte pravakṣyāmi yasyārthaṃ tvamihāgataḥ /
vārāhādyavatārāṇāṃ caritaṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
स्तोत्रं तत्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यस्यार्थं त्वमिहागतः /
वाराहाद्यवताराणां चरितं पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: I shall proclaim to you that hymn for whose sake you have come here. / Having heard the deeds of the incarnations beginning with the Boar, which destroy sin,

sanskrit_iast:
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva jñānavijñāna kāraṇam /
śrutvā sarvaṃ dharā vatsa pratdṛṣṭā taṃ dharādharam //
meaning:
सुखदं मोक्षदं चैव ज्ञानविज्ञान कारणम् /
श्रुत्वा सर्वं धरा वत्स प्रत्दृष्टा तं धराधरम् //
text_mt: which bestow happiness and liberation, and cause spiritual and worldly knowledge, / the earth, dear child, delighted, looking upon that supporter of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca praṇatā bhūyo jñātuṃ kṛṣṇaviceṣṭitam /
dharaṇyuvāca
alaṅkṛtaṃ janma puṃsāmapi nandavrajaukasām //
meaning:
उवाच प्रणता भूयो ज्ञातुं कृष्णविचेष्टितम् /
धरण्युवाच
अलङ्कृतं जन्म पुंसामपि नन्दव्रजौकसाम् //
text_mt: bowed and spoke again in order to know the deeds of Kṛṣṇa. / The Earth said: / The birth of mortal beings, and even of the residents of Nanda's cowherd settlement, is adorned [by him].

sanskrit_iast:
tasya devasya kṛṣṇasya līlāvigrahadhāriṇaḥ /
jayopādhiniyuktāni saṃti nāmānyanekaśaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य देवस्य कृष्णस्य लीलाविग्रहधारिणः /
जयोपाधिनियुक्तानि संति नामान्यनेकशः //
text_mt: Of that god Kṛṣṇa, who assumes a body for his pastimes, / there are many names endowed with victorious attributes.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu nāmāni mukhyāni śrotukāmā cirādaham /
tattāni brūhi nāmāni vāsudevasya vāsuke //
meaning:
तेषु नामानि मुख्यानि श्रोतुकामा चिरादहम् /
तत्तानि ब्रूहि नामानि वासुदेवस्य वासुके //
text_mt: Among them, I have long desired to hear the principal names. / Therefore speak those names of Vāsudeva, O Vāsuki!

sanskrit_iast:
nātaḥ parataraṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate /
śeṣa uvāca
vasuṃdhare varārohe janānāmasti muktidam //
meaning:
नातः परतरं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते /
शेष उवाच
वसुंधरे वरारोहे जनानामस्ति मुक्तिदम् //
text_mt: There is no higher merit than this in the three worlds. / Śeṣa said: / O Vasundharā, O woman of beautiful hips, it bestows liberation upon people;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamaṅgalamūrddhanyamaṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidam /
mahāpātakakoṭighna sarvatīrthaphalapradam //
meaning:
सर्वमङ्गलमूर्द्धन्यमणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धिदम् /
महापातककोटिघ्न सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदम् //
text_mt: it is the crest-jewel of all auspicious things, bestowing the eight accomplishments beginning with animan; / it destroys crores of great sins and grants the fruit of all sacred fords;

sanskrit_iast:
samastajapayajñānāṃ phaladaṃ pāpanāśanam /
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi nāmnāmaṣṭotaraṃ śatam //
meaning:
समस्तजपयज्ञानां फलदं पापनाशनम् /
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि नाम्नामष्टोतरं शतम् //
text_mt: it grants the fruit of all recitation and sacrifices and destroys sins. / Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the one hundred and eight names.

sanskrit_iast:
mahasranāmnāṃ puṇyānāṃ trirāvṛttyā tu yatphalam /
ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya nāmaikaṃ tatprayacchati //
meaning:
महस्रनाम्नां पुण्यानां त्रिरावृत्त्या तु यत्फलम् /
एकावृत्त्या तु कृष्णस्य नामैकं तत्प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: The fruit obtained by reciting the thousand sacred names three times / is granted by a single name of Kṛṣṇa uttered once.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpuṇyataraṃ caitatstotraṃ pātakanāśanam /
nāmnāmaṣṭottaraśatasyāhameva ṛṣiḥ priye //
meaning:
तस्मात्पुण्यतरं चैतत्स्तोत्रं पातकनाशनम् /
नाम्नामष्टोत्तरशतस्याहमेव ऋषिः प्रिये //
text_mt: Therefore, this hymn that destroys sin is more sacred [than all else]. / I myself am the ṛṣi of the one hundred and eight names, my dear;

sanskrit_iast:
chando 'nuṣṭubdevatā tu yogaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāvahaḥ /
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kamalānātho vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
छन्दो ऽनुष्टुब्देवता तु योगः कृष्णप्रियावहः /
श्रीकृष्णः कमलानाथो वासुदेवः सनातनः //
text_mt: the meter is anuṣṭubh, the deity is Yoga bringing love to Kṛṣṇa: / Glorious Kṛṣṇa, Lord of Kamalā, Vāsudeva, Eternal One,

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevātmajaḥ puṇyo līlāmānuṣavigrahaḥ /
śrīvatsakaustabhadharo yaśodāvatsalo hariḥ //
meaning:
वसुदेवात्मजः पुण्यो लीलामानुषविग्रहः /
श्रीवत्सकौस्तभधरो यशोदावत्सलो हरिः //
text_mt: Son of Vasudeva, Sacred One, One who takes a human body for pastimes, / Bearer of the Śrīvatsa and Kaustubha, Fond of Yaśodā, Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujāttacakrāsigadāśaṅkhādyudāyudhaḥ /
devakīnandanaḥ śrīśo nandagopapriyātmajaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजात्तचक्रासिगदाशङ्खाद्युदायुधः /
देवकीनन्दनः श्रीशो नन्दगोपप्रियात्मजः //
text_mt: Four-armed One bearing weapons such as discus, sword, mace, and conch, / Joy of Devakī, Lord of Śrī, Beloved Son of the cowherd Nanda,

sanskrit_iast:
yamunāvegasaṃhārī balabhadrapriyānujaḥ /
pūtanājīvitaharaḥ śakaṭāsurabhañjanaḥ //
meaning:
यमुनावेगसंहारी बलभद्रप्रियानुजः /
पूतनाजीवितहरः शकटासुरभञ्जनः //
text_mt: Subduer of the current of Yamunā, Beloved Younger Brother of Balabhadra, / Slayer of Pūtanā, Destroyer of Śakaṭāsura,

sanskrit_iast:
nandaprajajanānandī saccidānandavigrahaḥ /
navanītaviliptāṅgo navanītanaṭo 'naghaḥ //
meaning:
नन्दप्रजजनानन्दी सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः /
नवनीतविलिप्ताङ्गो नवनीतनटो ऽनघः //
text_mt: Delighter of Nanda's people, Embodiment of being-consciousness-bliss, / Body smeared with fresh butter, Dancer with fresh butter, Sinless One,

sanskrit_iast:
navanītalavāhārī mucukundaprasādakṛt /
ṣoḍaśastrīsahasreśastribhaṅgī madhurākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
नवनीतलवाहारी मुचुकुन्दप्रसादकृत् /
षोडशस्त्रीसहस्रेशस्त्रिभङ्गी मधुराकृतिः //
text_mt: Eater of morsels of fresh butter, Bestower of grace upon Mucukunda, / Lord of sixteen thousand women, Bent in three places, Beautiful in form,

sanskrit_iast:
śukavāgamṛtābdhīndurgovindo govidāṃpatiḥ /
vatsapālanasaṃcārī dhenukāsuramarddanaḥ //
meaning:
शुकवागमृताब्धीन्दुर्गोविन्दो गोविदांपतिः /
वत्सपालनसंचारी धेनुकासुरमर्द्दनः //
text_mt: Moon to the nectar ocean of Śuka's speech, Govinda, Lord of the knowers of the cows, / Wanderer tending calves, Crusher of the demon Dhenuka,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇīkṛtatṛṇāvartto yamalārjunabhañjanaḥ /
uttālatālabhettā ca tamālaśyāmalā kṛtiḥ //
meaning:
तृणीकृततृणावर्त्तो यमलार्जुनभञ्जनः /
उत्तालतालभेत्ता च तमालश्यामला कृतिः //
text_mt: One who made light of Tṛṇāvarta, Splitter of the twin Arjuna trees, / Cleaver of the lofty palm trees, Dark-complexioned like a tamāla tree,

sanskrit_iast:
gopagopīśvaro yogī sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ /
ilāpatiḥ parañjyotiryādavendro yadūdvahaḥ //
meaning:
गोपगोपीश्वरो योगी सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः /
इलापतिः परञ्ज्योतिर्यादवेन्द्रो यदूद्वहः //
text_mt: Lord of cowherds and cowherd women, Yogin, Resplendent as ten million suns, / Lord of the earth, Supreme Light, Chief of the Yādavas, Upholder of the Yadus,

sanskrit_iast:
vanamālī pītavāsāḥ pārijātāpaharakaḥ /
govarddhanācaloddharttā gopālaḥ sarvapālakaḥ //
meaning:
वनमाली पीतवासाः पारिजातापहरकः /
गोवर्द्धनाचलोद्धर्त्ता गोपालः सर्वपालकः //
text_mt: Garlanded with forest flowers, Yellow-robed, Stealer of the pārijāta tree, / Lifter of Mount Govardhana, Gopāla, Protector of all,

sanskrit_iast:
ajo nirañjanaḥ kāmajanakaḥ kañjalocanaḥ /
madhuhā mathurānātho dvārakānāthako balī //
meaning:
अजो निरञ्जनः कामजनकः कञ्जलोचनः /
मधुहा मथुरानाथो द्वारकानाथको बली //
text_mt: Unborn, Spotless, Father of Kāma, Lotus-eyed, / Slayer of Madhu, Lord of Mathurā, Lord of Dvārakā, Powerful One,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛndāvanāntasaṃcārī tulasīdāmabhūṣaṇaḥ /
syamantakamaṇerharttā naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ //
meaning:
वृन्दावनान्तसंचारी तुलसीदामभूषणः /
स्यमन्तकमणेर्हर्त्ता नरनारायणात्मकः //
text_mt: Wanderer in the depths of Vṛndāvana, Adorned with a tulasī garland, / Recoverer of the Syamantaka jewel, Embodiment of Nara and Nārāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
kubjākṛṣṭāṃbaradharo māyī paramapūruṣaḥ /
muṣṭikāsuracāṇūramallayuddhaviśāradaḥ //
meaning:
कुब्जाकृष्टांबरधरो मायी परमपूरुषः /
मुष्टिकासुरचाणूरमल्लयुद्धविशारदः //
text_mt: Wearer of garments made by Kubjā, Master of illusion, Supreme Person, / Skilled in wrestling with the demons Muṣṭika and Cāṇūra,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāravairī kaṃsārirmurārirnarakāntakaḥ /
anādi brahmacārī ca kṛṣṇāvyasanakarṣakaḥ //
meaning:
संसारवैरी कंसारिर्मुरारिर्नरकान्तकः /
अनादि ब्रह्मचारी च कृष्णाव्यसनकर्षकः //
text_mt: Enemy of worldly transmigration, Foe of Kaṃsa, Foe of Mura, Destroyer of Naraka, / Beginningless, Celibate student, Dispeller of Kṛṣṇā’s distress,

sanskrit_iast:
śiśupālaśiraschettā duryodhanakulāntakṛta /
vidurākrūravarado viśvarūpapradarśakaḥ //
meaning:
शिशुपालशिरस्छेत्ता दुर्योधनकुलान्तकृत /
विदुराक्रूरवरदो विश्वरूपप्रदर्शकः //
text_mt: Severer of the head of Śiśupāla, Bringer of end to Duryodhana's family, / Bestower of boons on Vidura and Akrūra, Revealer of the universal form,

sanskrit_iast:
satyavāksatyasaṃkalpaḥ satyabhāmārato jayī /
subhadrāpūrvajo viṣṇurbhīṣmamuktipradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
सत्यवाक्सत्यसंकल्पः सत्यभामारतो जयी /
सुभद्रापूर्वजो विष्णुर्भीष्ममुक्तिप्रदायकः //
text_mt: True of speech, Of true resolve, Delighting in Satyabhāmā, Victorious, / Elder Brother of Subhadrā, Viṣṇu, Giver of liberation to Bhīṣma,

sanskrit_iast:
jagadgururjagannātho veṇuvādya viśāradaḥ /
vṛṣabhāsuravidhvaṃsī bakārirbāṇabāhukṛt //
meaning:
जगद्गुरुर्जगन्नाथो वेणुवाद्य विशारदः /
वृषभासुरविध्वंसी बकारिर्बाणबाहुकृत् //
text_mt: Teacher of the universe, Lord of the world, Skilled in playing the flute, / Destroyer of the bull-demon, Foe of Baka, Severer of Bāṇa’s arms,

sanskrit_iast:
yudhiṣṭirapratiṣṭhātā barhibarhāvataṃsakaḥ /
pārthasārathiravyakto gītāmṛtamahodadhiḥ //
meaning:
युधिष्टिरप्रतिष्ठाता बर्हिबर्हावतंसकः /
पार्थसारथिरव्यक्तो गीतामृतमहोदधिः //
text_mt: Establisher of Yudhiṣṭhira, Adorned with peacock feathers, / Charioteer of Pārtha, Unmanifest One, Vast ocean of the nectar of the Gītā,

sanskrit_iast:
kālīyaphaṇimāṇikyarañjitaḥ śrīpadāṃbujaḥ /
dāmodaro yajñabhoktā dānavaidravināśanaḥ //
meaning:
कालीयफणिमाणिक्यरञ्जितः श्रीपदांबुजः /
दामोदरो यज्ञभोक्ता दानवैद्रविनाशनः //
text_mt: Whose glorious lotus feet are tinted by the gems on Kālīya’s hoods, / Dāmodara, Enjoyer of sacrifices, Destroyer of the lords of Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma pannagāśanavāhanaḥ /
jalakrīḍāsamāsaktagopīvastrāpahārakaḥ //
meaning:
नारायणः परं ब्रह्म पन्नगाशनवाहनः /
जलक्रीडासमासक्तगोपीवस्त्रापहारकः //
text_mt: Nārāyaṇa, Supreme Brahman, Whose mount is the serpent-eater, / Stealer of the clothes of the cowherd women engrossed in water sports,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyaślokastīrthapādo vedavedyo dayānidhiḥ /
sarvatīrthānmakaḥ sarvagraharūpī parātparaḥ //
meaning:
पुण्यश्लोकस्तीर्थपादो वेदवेद्यो दयानिधिः /
सर्वतीर्थान्मकः सर्वग्रहरूपी परात्परः //
text_mt: Celebrated in sacred verse, Whose feet are holy fords, Known through the Vedas, Ocean of compassion, / Imbued with all holy places, Embodiment of all celestial bodies, Higher than the highest.

sanskrit_iast:
ityevaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
kṛṣṇona kṛṣṇabhaktena śrutvā gītāmṛtaṃ purā //
meaning:
इत्येवं कृष्णदेवस्य नाम्नामष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
कृष्णोन कृष्णभक्तेन श्रुत्वा गीतामृतं पुरा //
text_mt: Thus the one hundred and eight names of Lord Kṛṣṇa [are proclaimed]. / Formerly, having heard this nectar of song from Kṛṣṇa, a devotee of Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
stotraṃ kṛṣṇapriyakaraṃ kṛtaṃ tasmānmayā śrutam /
kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ nāma paramānandadāyakam //
meaning:
स्तोत्रं कृष्णप्रियकरं कृतं तस्मान्मया श्रुतम् /
कृष्णप्रेमामृतं नाम परमानन्ददायकम् //
text_mt: this hymn pleasing to Kṛṣṇa was composed, and was heard by me from him; / named Kṛṣṇapremāmṛta, it grants supreme bliss;

sanskrit_iast:
atyupadravaduḥ khaghnaṃ paramāyuṣya varddhanam /
dānaṃ vrataṃ tapastīrthaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tviha janmani //
meaning:
अत्युपद्रवदुः खघ्नं परमायुष्य वर्द्धनम् /
दानं व्रतं तपस्तीर्थं यत्कृतं त्विह जन्मनि //
text_mt: it destroys distress from extreme calamities and greatly increases longevity. / Whatever gift, vow, austerity, and pilgrimage to sacred places has been performed in this birth,

sanskrit_iast:
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet /
putrapradamaputrāṇāmagatī nāṃ gatipradam //
meaning:
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव कोटिकोटिगुणं भवेत् /
पुत्रप्रदमपुत्राणामगती नां गतिप्रदम् //
text_mt:
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet
putrapradamaputrāṇāmagatī nāṃ gatipradam

sanskrit_iast:
dhanavāhaṃ daridrāṇāṃ jayecchūnāṃ jayāvaham /
śiśūnāṃ gokulānāṃ ca puṣṭidaṃ puṇyavarddhanam //
meaning:
धनवाहं दरिद्राणां जयेच्छूनां जयावहम् /
शिशूनां गोकुलानां च पुष्टिदं पुण्यवर्द्धनम् //
text_mt:
dhanavāhaṃ daridrāṇāṃ jayecchūnāṃ jayāvaham
śiśūnāṃ gokulānāṃ ca puṣṭidaṃ puṇyavarddhanam

sanskrit_iast:
bālarogagrahādīnāṃ śamanaṃ śāntikārakam /
ante kṛṣṇasmaraṇadaṃ bhavatāpatrayāpaham //
meaning:
बालरोगग्रहादीनां शमनं शान्तिकारकम् /
अन्ते कृष्णस्मरणदं भवतापत्रयापहम् //
text_mt:
bālarogagrahādīnāṃ śamanaṃ śāntikārakam
ante kṛṣṇasmaraṇadaṃ bhavatāpatrayāpaham

sanskrit_iast:
asiddhasādhakaṃ bhadre japādikaramātmanām /
kṛṣṇāya yādavendrāya jñānamudrāya yogine //
meaning:
असिद्धसाधकं भद्रे जपादिकरमात्मनाम् /
कृष्णाय यादवेन्द्राय ज्ञानमुद्राय योगिने //
text_mt:
asiddhasādhakaṃ bhadre japādikaramātmanām
kṛṣṇāya yādavendrāya jñānamudrāya yogine

sanskrit_iast:
nāthāya rukmiṇīśāya namo vedāntavedine /
imaṃ mantraṃ mahādevi japanneva divā niśam //
meaning:
नाथाय रुक्मिणीशाय नमो वेदान्तवेदिने /
इमं मन्त्रं महादेवि जपन्नेव दिवा निशम् //
text_mt:
nāthāya rukmiṇīśāya namo vedāntavedine
imaṃ mantraṃ mahādevi japanneva divā niśam

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagrahānugrahabhāksarvapriyatamo bhavet /
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvasiddhisamṛddhimān //
meaning:
सर्वग्रहानुग्रहभाक्सर्वप्रियतमो भवेत् /
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृतः सर्वसिद्धिसमृद्धिमान् //
text_mt:
sarvagrahānugrahabhāksarvapriyatamo bhavet
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvasiddhisamṛddhimān

sanskrit_iast:
niṣevya bhogānante 'pikṛṣṇāsāyujyamāpnuyāt /
agastya uvāca
etāvadukto bhāgavānananto mūrttistu saṃkarṣaṇasaṃjñitā vibho //
meaning:
निषेव्य भोगानन्ते ऽपिकृष्णासायुज्यमाप्नुयात् /
अगस्त्य उवाच
एतावदुक्तो भागवाननन्तो मूर्त्तिस्तु संकर्षणसंज्ञिता विभो //
text_mt:
niṣevya bhogānante 'pikṛṣṇāsāyujyamāpnuyāt
agastya uvāca
etāvadukto bhāgavānananto mūrttistu saṃkarṣaṇasaṃjñitā vibho

sanskrit_iast:
dharādharo 'laṃ jagatāṃ dharāyai nirdiśya bhūyo virarāma mānadaḥ /
tatastu sarve sanakādayo ye samāsthitāstatparitaḥ kathādṛtāḥ /
ānanda pūrṇṇaṃbunidhau nimagnāḥ sabhājayāmāsurahīśvaraṃ tam //
meaning:
धराधरो ऽलं जगतां धरायै निर्दिश्य भूयो विरराम मानदः /
ततस्तु सर्वे सनकादयो ये समास्थितास्तत्परितः कथादृताः /
आनन्द पूर्ण्णंबुनिधौ निमग्नाः सभाजयामासुरहीश्वरं तम् //
text_mt:
dharādharo 'laṃ jagatāṃ dharāyai nirdiśya bhūyo virarāma mānadaḥ
tatastu sarve sanakādayo ye samāsthitāstatparitaḥ kathādṛtāḥ
ānanda pūrṇṇaṃbunidhau nimagnāḥ sabhājayāmāsurahīśvaraṃ tam

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
namo namaste 'khilaviśvābhāvana prapannabhaktārttiharāvyayātman /
dharādharāyāpi kṛpārṇavāya śeṣāya viśvaprabhave namaste //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
नमो नमस्ते ऽखिलविश्वाभावन प्रपन्नभक्तार्त्तिहराव्ययात्मन् /
धराधरायापि कृपार्णवाय शेषाय विश्वप्रभवे नमस्ते //
text_mt:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
namo namaste 'khilaviśvābhāvana prapannabhaktārttiharāvyayātman
dharādharāyāpi kṛpārṇavāya śeṣāya viśvaprabhave namaste

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ naḥ paripāyitaṃ vibho vidhūtapāpā bhavatā kṛtā vayam /
bhavādṛśā dīnadayālavo vibho samuddharantyeva nijānhi saṃnatān //
meaning:
कृष्णामृतं नः परिपायितं विभो विधूतपापा भवता कृता वयम् /
भवादृशा दीनदयालवो विभो समुद्धरन्त्येव निजान्हि संनतान् //
text_mt:
kṛṣṇāmṛtaṃ naḥ paripāyitaṃ vibho vidhūtapāpā bhavatā kṛtā vayam
bhavādṛśā dīnadayālavo vibho samuddharantyeva nijānhi saṃnatān

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ namaskṛtya phaṇīśa pādayormano vidhāyākhilakāmapūrayoḥ /
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dharādharādharaṃ sarve vayaṃ svāvasathānupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
एवं नमस्कृत्य फणीश पादयोर्मनो विधायाखिलकामपूरयोः /
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य धराधराधरं सर्वे वयं स्वावसथानुपागताः //
text_mt:
evaṃ namaskṛtya phaṇīśa pādayormano vidhāyākhilakāmapūrayoḥ
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dharādharādharaṃ sarve vayaṃ svāvasathānupāgatāḥ

sanskrit_iast:
iti te 'bhihitaṃ rāma stotraṃ premāmṛtābhidham /
kṛṣṇasya rādhākāntasya siddhidam //
meaning:
इति ते ऽभिहितं राम स्तोत्रं प्रेमामृताभिधम् /
कृष्णस्य राधाकान्तस्य सिद्धिदम् //
text_mt:
iti te 'bhihitaṃ rāma stotraṃ premāmṛtābhidham
kṛṣṇasya rādhākāntasya siddhidam

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ rāma mahābhāga stotraṃ paramadurlabham /
śrutaṃ sākṣādbhagavataḥ śeṣātkathayataḥ kathāḥ //
meaning:
इदं राम महाभाग स्तोत्रं परमदुर्लभम् /
श्रुतं साक्षाद्भगवतः शेषात्कथयतः कथाः //
text_mt:
idaṃ rāma mahābhāga stotraṃ paramadurlabham
śrutaṃ sākṣādbhagavataḥ śeṣātkathayataḥ kathāḥ

sanskrit_iast: yāvanti mantrajālāni stotrāṇi kavacāni ca //
meaning: यावन्ति मन्त्रजालानि स्तोत्राणि कवचानि च //
text_mt: yāvanti mantrajālāni stotrāṇi kavacāni ca

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye tāni sarvāṇi siddhyantyevāsya śīlanāt /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktvā mahārāja kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ stavam /
yāvadvyarasīṃtsa munistāvatsvaryānamāgatam //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये तानि सर्वाणि सिद्ध्यन्त्येवास्य शीलनात् /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज कृष्णप्रेमामृतं स्तवम् /
यावद्व्यरसींत्स मुनिस्तावत्स्वर्यानमागतम् //
text_mt:
trailokye tāni sarvāṇi siddhyantyevāsya śīlanāt
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evamuktvā mahārāja kṛṣṇapremāmṛtaṃ stavam
yāvadvyarasīṃtsa munistāvatsvaryānamāgatam

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiradbhutaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmarūpairmanojavaiḥ /
anuyātamathotplutya strīpuṃsau hariṇau tadā /
agastyacaraṇau natvā samāruruhaturmudā //
meaning:
चतुर्भिरद्भुतैः सिद्धैः कामरूपैर्मनोजवैः /
अनुयातमथोत्प्लुत्य स्त्रीपुंसौ हरिणौ तदा /
अगस्त्यचरणौ नत्वा समारुरुहतुर्मुदा //
text_mt:
caturbhiradbhutaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmarūpairmanojavaiḥ
anuyātamathotplutya strīpuṃsau hariṇau tadā
agastyacaraṇau natvā samāruruhaturmudā

sanskrit_iast:
divyadehadharau bhūtvā saṃkhacakrādicihnitau /
gatau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarva devana maskṛtam /
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhārgavāgastyayostathā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ṣaṭtriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 36//
meaning:
दिव्यदेहधरौ भूत्वा संखचक्रादिचिह्नितौ /
गतौ च वैष्णवं लोकं सर्व देवन मस्कृतम् /
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां भार्गवागस्त्ययोस्तथा //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते षट्त्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 36//
text_mt:
divyadehadharau bhūtvā saṃkhacakrādicihnitau
gatau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarva devana maskṛtam
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhārgavāgastyayostathā

text_mt:

śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga kāryākārviśārada /

शृणु राम महाभाग कार्याकार्विशारद /

text_mt:
agastya uvāca
śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga kāryākārviśārada

ito vidūre sumahatsthānaṃ viṣṇoḥ sudurlabham /
padāni yatra dṛśyante nyastāni sumāhātmanā //
meaning:
इतो विदूरे सुमहत्स्थानं विष्णोः सुदुर्लभम् /

text_mt:

text_mt:

meaning:
यस्त्वेक ईशो निजवाञ्च्छितप्रदो धत्ते तनूर्लोकविहार रक्षणे /

स्वयं समक्षंव्यभिचारदुष्टचित्तास्वपि प्रेमनिबद्धमानसम् //
text_mt:

गताः स्वरूपं निखलं विहाय ते देहस्त्र्यपत्यार्थममत्वमीश्वर //
text_mt:
yaṃ vai prasannā asurāḥ surā narāḥ sakinnarāstiryakeyonayo 'pi hi
gatāḥ svarūpaṃ nikhalaṃ vihāya te dehastryapatyārthamamatvamīśvara

meaning:
तं देवदेवं भजतामभीप्सितप्रदं निरीहं गुणवर्जितं च /
अचिन्त्यमव्यक्तमघौघनाशनं प्राप्तो ऽरणं प्रेमनिधानमादरात् //
text_mt:

acintyamavyaktamaghaughanāśanaṃ prāpto 'raṇaṃ premanidhānamādarāt

sanskrit_iast:
tapanti tāpairvividhaiḥ svadehamanye tu yajñairvividhairyajanti /
svapne 'pi te rūpamalaukikaṃvibho paśyanti naivārthanibaddhavāsanāḥ //
meaning:
तपन्ति तापैर्विविधैः स्वदेहमन्ये तु यज्ञैर्विविधैर्यजन्ति /
स्वप्ने ऽपि ते रूपमलौकिकंविभो पश्यन्ति नैवार्थनिबद्धवासनाः //
text_mt:
tapanti tāpairvividhaiḥ svadehamanye tu yajñairvividhairyajanti
svapne 'pi te rūpamalaukikaṃvibho paśyanti naivārthanibaddhavāsanāḥ

namanti bhaktyātha samarcayanti vai parasparaṃ saṃsadi varṇayanti //
meaning:
ये वै त्वदीयं चरणं भवश्रमान्निर्विण्मचित्ता विधिवत्स्मरन्ति /
नमन्ति भक्त्याथ समर्चयन्ति वै परस्परं संसदि वर्णयन्ति //
text_mt:
ye vai tvadīyaṃ caraṇaṃ bhavaśramānnirviṇmacittā vidhivatsmaranti
namanti bhaktyātha samarcayanti vai parasparaṃ saṃsadi varṇayanti

sanskrit_iast:
tenaikajanmodbhavapaṅkabhedanaprasaktacittā bhavatoṃ'ghripadme /
taranti cānyānapi tārayanti hi bhavauṣadhaṃ nāma sudhā taveśa //
meaning:
तेनैकजन्मोद्भवपङ्कभेदनप्रसक्तचित्ता भवतोंऽघ्रिपद्मे /
तरन्ति चान्यानपि तारयन्ति हि भवौषधं नाम सुधा तवेश //
text_mt:
With minds attached to breaking through the mire born of a single birth at your lotus feet,
they cross over and indeed carry others across; O Lord, your name is the nectar that cures worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ prabho kāmanibaddhacitto bhavantamāryaṃ vividhaprayatnaiḥ /
ārādhayaṃ nātha bhavānabhijñaḥ kiṃ te ha vijñāpyamihāsti loke //
meaning:
अहं प्रभो कामनिबद्धचित्तो भवन्तमार्यं विविधप्रयत्नैः /
आराधयं नाथ भवानभिज्ञः किं ते ह विज्ञाप्यमिहास्ति लोके //
text_mt:
O Lord, with my mind bound by desire, I have worshipped you, the noble one, with various efforts;
O Master, you know everything—what is there in this world for me to report to you?

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityevaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ tu stuvantaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ /
uvācāgādhayā vācā mohayanniva māyayā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्येवं जामदग्न्यं तु स्तुवन्तं प्रणतं पुरः /
उवाचागाधया वाचा मोहयन्निव मायया //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
To Jāmadagnya, who was thus praising and bowing before him,
he spoke in a profound voice, as if confounding him with his illusion:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇa uvāca
hanta rāma mahābhāga siddhaṃ te kāryamuttamam /
kavacasya stavasyāpi prabhāvādavadhāraya //
meaning:
कृष्ण उवाच
हन्त राम महाभाग सिद्धं ते कार्यमुत्तमम् /
कवचस्य स्तवस्यापि प्रभावादवधारय //

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā taṃ kārttavīryaṃ hi rājānaṃ dṛptamānasam /
sādhayitvā piturvairaṃ kuru niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm //
meaning:
हत्वा तं कार्त्तवीर्यं हि राजानं दृप्तमानसम् /
साधयित्वा पितुर्वैरं कुरु निःक्षत्रियां महीम् //
text_mt:
Having slain that King Kārttavīrya of arrogant mind,
and having fulfilled your father's vengeance, rid the earth of kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
mama cakrāvatāro hi kārttavīryo dharātale /
kṛtakāryo dvijaśreṣṭa taṃ samāpaya mānada //
meaning:
मम चक्रावतारो हि कार्त्तवीर्यो धरातले /
कृतकार्यो द्विजश्रेष्ट तं समापय मानद //
text_mt:
For Kārttavīrya is the incarnation of my discus on the surface of the earth;
his purpose accomplished, O best of the twice-born, put an end to him, O honor-giver.

sanskrit_iast:
adya prabhṛti loke 'sminnaṃśāveśena me bhavān /
cariṣyati yathā kālaṃ karttā harttā svayaṃ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
अद्य प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन्नंशावेशेन मे भवान् /
चरिष्यति यथा कालं कर्त्ता हर्त्ता स्वयं प्रभुः //
text_mt:
From this day forward in this world, entered by a portion of me,
you shall wander according to the time, as the creator, destroyer, and lord yourself.

sanskrit_iast:
caturviśe yuge vatsa tretāyāṃ raghuvaṃśajaḥ /
rāmo nāma bhaviṣyāmi caturvyūhaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विशे युगे वत्स त्रेतायां रघुवंशजः /
रामो नाम भविष्यामि चतुर्व्यूहः सनातनः //
text_mt:
In the twenty-fourth yuga, dear boy, during the Tretā, born in the lineage of Raghu,
I shall become Rāma by name, the eternal one of fourfold manifestation,

sanskrit_iast:
kausalyānandajanako rājño daśarathādaham /
tadā kauśikayajñaṃ tu sādhayitvā salakṣmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
कौसल्यानन्दजनको राज्ञो दशरथादहम् /
तदा कौशिकयज्ञं तु साधयित्वा सलक्ष्मणः //
text_mt:
causing joy to Kausalyā, [born] of King Daśaratha;
then, having protected the sacrifice of Kauśika along with Lakṣmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
gamiṣyāmi mahābhāga janakasya pura mahat /
tatreśacāpaṃ nirbhajya pariṇīya videhajām //
meaning:
गमिष्यामि महाभाग जनकस्य पुर महत् /
तत्रेशचापं निर्भज्य परिणीय विदेहजाम् //
text_mt:
I shall go, O fortunate one, to the great city of Janaka;
there, having broken the bow of the Lord and married the daughter of Videha,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā yāsyannayodhyāṃ te hariṣye teja unmadam /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
kṛṣṇa evaṃ samadiśya jāmadagnyaṃ taponidhim /
paśyatoṃ'tardadhe tatra rāmasya mumahātmanaḥ //
iti śrībrahāmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhargavacarite saptatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 37//
meaning:
तदा यास्यन्नयोध्यां ते हरिष्ये तेज उन्मदम् /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
कृष्ण एवं समदिश्य जामदग्न्यं तपोनिधिम् /
पश्यतोंऽतर्दधे तत्र रामस्य मुमहात्मनः //
इति श्रीब्रहामाण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भर्गवचरिते सप्तत्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 37//
text_mt:
as I am going to Ayodhyā, I shall take away your frenzied splendor.”
Vasiṣṭha said:
Having thus instructed Jāmadagnya, the storehouse of austerities,
Kṛṣṇa vanished right there while the great-souled Rāma was watching.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter in the account of Bhārgava in the Upoddhātapāda, the third part in the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
antarddhānaṃ gate kṛṣṇe rāmastu sumahāyaśāḥ /
samudriktamathātmānaṃ mene kṛṣṇānubhāvataḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
अन्तर्द्धानं गते कृष्णे रामस्तु सुमहायशाः /
समुद्रिक्तमथात्मानं मेने कृष्णानुभावतः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
When Kṛṣṇa had disappeared, Rāma of great renown
felt himself exalted through the majesty of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ pradīptāgniriva jvalan /
samāyāto bhārgavo 'sīpurīṃ mahiṣmatīṃ prati //
meaning:
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः प्रदीप्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् /
