समायातो भार्गवो ऽसीपुरीं महिष्मतीं प्रति //
text_mt:
Accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, blazing like a kindled fire,
that Bhārgava arrived towards the sword-like city of Māhiṣmatī,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra pāpaharā puṇyā narmadā saritāṃ varā /
punāti darśanādeva prāṇinaḥ pāpino hyapi //
meaning:
यत्र पापहरा पुण्या नर्मदा सरितां वरा /
पुनाति दर्शनादेव प्राणिनः पापिनो ह्यपि //
text_mt:
where flows the holy Narmadā, the best of rivers, which removes sins,
and purifies even sinful creatures merely upon sight.

sanskrit_iast:
purā traya hareṇāpi niviṣṭena mahātmanā /
tripurasya vināśāya kṛto yatno mahīpate //
meaning:
पुरा त्रय हरेणापि निविष्टेन महात्मना /
त्रिपुरस्य विनाशाय कृतो यत्नो महीपते //
text_mt:
Formerly, O king, even Hara, that great soul, while dwelling there,
made the effort for the destruction of Tripura.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kiṃ varṇyate puṇyaṃ nṛṇāṃ devasvarūpiṇām /
sadṛṣṭvā narmadāṃ bhūpa bhargavaḥ kulanandanaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र किं वर्ण्यते पुण्यं नृणां देवस्वरूपिणाम् /
सदृष्ट्वा नर्मदां भूप भर्गवः कुलनन्दनः //
text_mt:
What merit of men who have the form of gods could be described there?
Beholding the Narmadā, O king, Bhārgava, the joy of his clan,

sanskrit_iast:
namaścakāra suprītaḥ śatrusādhanatatparaḥ /
namo 'stu narmade tubhyaṃ haradehasamudbhave //
meaning:
नमश्चकार सुप्रीतः शत्रुसाधनतत्परः /
नमो ऽस्तु नर्मदे तुभ्यं हरदेहसमुद्भवे //
text_mt:
bowed down, highly pleased, intent on overpowering the enemy:
“Obeisance to you, O Narmadā, born from the body of Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipraṃ nāśaya śatrūnme varadā bhava śobhane /
ityevaṃ sa namaskṛtya narmadāṃ pāpanāśinīm //
meaning:
क्षिप्रं नाशय शत्रून्मे वरदा भव शोभने /
इत्येवं स नमस्कृत्य नर्मदां पापनाशिनीम् //
text_mt:
Quickly destroy my enemies and be a giver of boons, O auspicious one.”
Having thus bowed down to the sin-destroying Narmadā,

sanskrit_iast:
dūtaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kārttavīryārjunaṃ prati /
dūta rājātvayā vācyo yadahaṃ vacmi te 'nagha //
meaning:
दूतं प्रस्थापयामास कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनं प्रति /
दूत राजात्वया वाच्यो यदहं वच्मि ते ऽनघ //
text_mt:
he sent a messenger to Kārttavīryārjuna:
“Messenger, you must say to the king what I tell you, O sinless one:

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃdehastvayā kāryo dūtaḥ kvāpi na badhyate /
yadbalaṃ tu samāśritya jamadagnimuniṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
न संदेहस्त्वया कार्यो दूतः क्वापि न बध्यते /
यद्बलं तु समाश्रित्य जमदग्निमुनिं नृपः //
text_mt:
‘You should have no doubt; an envoy is never to be killed anywhere.
Relying upon whatever power the king humiliated

sanskrit_iast:
tirastvaṃ kṛtavānmūḍha tatputro yoddhumāgataḥ /
śīghraṃ nirgaccha mandātmanyuddhaṃ rāmāya dehi tat //
meaning:
तिरस्त्वं कृतवान्मूढ तत्पुत्रो योद्धुमागतः /
शीघ्रं निर्गच्छ मन्दात्मन्युद्धं रामाय देहि तत् //
text_mt:
the sage Jamadagni, O fool, his son has come to fight!
Come out quickly, dull-witted one, and give that battle to Rāma!

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavaṃ tvaṃ samāsādya gaccha lokāntaraṃ tvarā /
ityevamuktvā rājānaṃ śrutvā tasya vacastathā //
meaning:
भार्गवं त्वं समासाद्य गच्छ लोकान्तरं त्वरा /
इत्येवमुक्त्वा राजानं श्रुत्वा तस्य वचस्तथा //
text_mt:
Having encountered Bhārgava, go quickly to the other world!’
Having spoken thus to the king and having heard his words as well,

sanskrit_iast:
śīghramāgaccha bhadraṃ te vilaṃbo neha śasyate /
tenaivamukto dūtastu gato haihayabhūpatim //
meaning:
शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते विलंबो नेह शस्यते /
तेनैवमुक्तो दूतस्तु गतो हैहयभूपतिम् //
text_mt:
come back quickly; may good fortune be yours; delay is not commended here.”
Addressed in this manner by him, the envoy went to the Haihaya king,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmoditaṃ tatsakalaṃ śrāvayāmāsa saṃsadi /
sa rājātreyabhaktastu mahābalaparākramaḥ //
meaning:
रामोदितं तत्सकलं श्रावयामास संसदि /
स राजात्रेयभक्तस्तु महाबलपराक्रमः //
text_mt:
and recited all that had been uttered by Rāma in the royal assembly.
That king, a devotee of the son of Atri, endowed with great strength and prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
cukrodha śrutvā vācyaṃ taddūtamuttaramāvahat /
kārttavīrya uvāca
mayā bhujabalenaiva dattadattena medinī //
meaning:
चुक्रोध श्रुत्वा वाच्यं तद्दूतमुत्तरमावहत् /
कार्त्तवीर्य उवाच
मया भुजबलेनैव दत्तदत्तेन मेदिनी //
text_mt:
became enraged upon hearing that message, and gave an answer to the envoy.
Kārttavīrya said:
“By the strength of my arms alone, granted by Datta, the earth

sanskrit_iast:
jitā prasahya bhūpālānbaddhvānīya nijaṃ puram /
tadbalaṃ mayi vartteta yuddhaṃ dāsye tavādhunā //
meaning:
जिता प्रसह्य भूपालान्बद्ध्वानीय निजं पुरम् /
तद्बलं मयि वर्त्तेत युद्धं दास्ये तवाधुना //
text_mt:
was conquered by force, and the kings were brought bound to my city;
that same strength resides in me, and I shall give you battle now!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityutkvā visasarjjāśu dūtaṃ haihayabhūpatiḥ /
senādhyakṣaṃ samāhūya provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युत्क्वा विससर्ज्जाशु दूतं हैहयभूपतिः /
सेनाध्यक्षं समाहूय प्रोवाच वदतां वरः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Haihaya king quickly dismissed the messenger.
Summoning the commander-in-chief, the best of speakers said:

sanskrit_iast:
sajjaṃ kuru mahābhāga sainyaṃ me vīrasaṃmataḥ /
yotsye rāmeṇa bhṛguṇā vilaṃbo mā bhavatviti //
meaning:
सज्जं कुरु महाभाग सैन्यं मे वीरसंमतः /
योत्स्ये रामेण भृगुणा विलंबो मा भवत्विति //
text_mt:
“Equip my army, O noble one, as approved by heroes;
I shall fight with Rāma, the Bhṛgu; let there be no delay.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto mahāvīraḥ senādhyakṣaḥ pratāpanaḥ /
sainyaṃ sajjaṃ vidhāyāśu caturaṅga nyavedayat //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो महावीरः सेनाध्यक्षः प्रतापनः /
सैन्यं सज्जं विधायाशु चतुरङ्ग न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt:
Thus addressed, the commander-in-chief, the great hero Pratāpana,
promptly equipped the fourfold army and reported it.

sanskrit_iast:
sainyaṃ sajjaṃ samākarṇya kārttavīryo nṛpo mudā /
sūtopanītaṃ svarathamāruroha viśāṃpate //
meaning:
सैन्यं सज्जं समाकर्ण्य कार्त्तवीर्यो नृपो मुदा /
सूतोपनीतं स्वरथमारुरोह विशांपते //
text_mt:
Hearing that the army was equipped, King Kārttavīrya, in joy,
mounted his chariot brought by the charioteer, O ruler of the people.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya rājñaḥ samantāttu sāmantā maṇḍaleśvarāḥ /
anekākṣauhiṇīyuktāḥ parivāryopatasthire //
meaning:
तस्य राज्ञः समन्तात्तु सामन्ता मण्डलेश्वराः /
अनेकाक्षौहिणीयुक्ताः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे //
text_mt:
All around that king, feudatories and regional rulers,
accompanied by many akṣauhiṇīs, stood surrounding him.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgāstu koṭiśastatra hayasyandanapattayaḥ /
asaṃkhyātā mahārāja sainye sāgarasannibhe //
meaning:
नागास्तु कोटिशस्तत्र हयस्यन्दनपत्तयः /
असंख्याता महाराज सैन्ये सागरसन्निभे //
text_mt:
There were crores of elephants, and horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers
were beyond counting, O great king, in that army resembling an ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyante tatra bhūpālā nānāvaṃśasamudbhavāḥ /
mahāvīrā mahākāyā nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ //
meaning:
दृश्यन्ते तत्र भूपाला नानावंशसमुद्भवाः /
महावीरा महाकाया नानायुद्धविशारदाः //
text_mt:
There kings born of various lineages were seen,
great heroes of massive bodies, skilled in various combats,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāśastrāstrakuśalā nānāvāhagatā nṛpāḥ /
nānālaṅkārasaṃyuktā mattā dānavibhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
नानाशस्त्रास्त्रकुशला नानावाहगता नृपाः /
नानालङ्कारसंयुक्ता मत्ता दानविभूषिताः //
text_mt:
expert with various weapons and missiles, mounted on various vehicles;
adorned with various ornaments, intoxicated [with rut] and decorated with ichor,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmātrakṛteddeśā bhānti nāgā hyanekaśaḥ /
nānājñātisamutpannā hayāḥ pavanaraṃhasaḥ //
meaning:
महामात्रकृतेद्देशा भान्ति नागा ह्यनेकशः /
नानाज्ञातिसमुत्पन्ना हयाः पवनरंहसः //
text_mt:
numerous elephants shone forth, guided by their mahouts;
and horses born of various breeds, swift as the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
plavanto bhānti bhūpāla sādibhiḥ kṛtaśikṣaṇāḥ /
syandanāni sudīrghāṇi javanāśvayutāni ca //
meaning:
प्लवन्तो भान्ति भूपाल सादिभिः कृतशिक्षणाः /
स्यन्दनानि सुदीर्घाणि जवनाश्वयुतानि च //
text_mt:
leaping about, shone, O king, trained well by their riders;
and very long chariots, yoked with swift horses,

sanskrit_iast:
cakranirghoṣayuktāni prāvṛṇmeghopamāni ca /
padātayastu rājante khaḍgacarmadharā nṛpa //
meaning:
चक्रनिर्घोषयुक्तानि प्रावृण्मेघोपमानि च /
पदातयस्तु राजन्ते खड्गचर्मधरा नृप //
text_mt:
filled with the rumbling of wheels, resembled the clouds of the rainy season;
and the foot-soldiers shone bearing swords and shields, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃpūrvamahaṃpūrvamityahaṃpūrvakānvitāḥ /
yadā pracalitaṃ sainyaṃ kārttavīryārjunasya vai //
meaning:
अहंपूर्वमहंपूर्वमित्यहंपूर्वकान्विताः /
यदा प्रचलितं सैन्यं कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनस्य वै //
text_mt:
possessed by the urge of vying with one another, crying, ‘Me first! Me first!’
When the army of Kārttavīryārjuna marched forth,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā prācchāditaṃ vyoma rajasā ca diśo daśa /
nānāvāditranirghoṣairhayānāṃ hreṣitaistathā //
meaning:
तदा प्राच्छादितं व्योम रजसा च दिशो दश /
नानावादित्रनिर्घोषैर्हयानां ह्रेषितैस्तथा //
text_mt:
the sky and the ten directions were covered with dust;
and with the clamor of various musical instruments and the neighing of horses,

sanskrit_iast:
gajānāṃ bṛṃhitai rājanvyāptaṃ gaganamaṇḍalam /
mārge dadarśa rājendro viparītāni bhūpate //
meaning:
गजानां बृंहितै राजन्व्याप्तं गगनमण्डलम् /
मार्गे ददर्श राजेन्द्रो विपरीतानि भूपते //
text_mt:
as well as the trumpeting of elephants, O king, the orb of the sky was filled.
On the path, the lord of kings saw contrary omens, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
śakunāni raṇe tasya mṛtyudautyakarāṇi ca /
muktakeśāṃ chinnanāsāṃ rudatīṃ ca digaṃbarām //
meaning:
शकुनानि रणे तस्य मृत्युदौत्यकराणि च /
मुक्तकेशां छिन्ननासां रुदतीं च दिगंबराम् //
text_mt:
omens of ill in battle, acting as messengers of his death:
with disheveled hair, severed nose, weeping, and naked,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānāṃ vanitāṃ sa dadarśa ha /
kucailaṃ patitaṃ bhagnaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsasam //
meaning:
कृष्णवस्त्रपरीधानां वनितां स ददर्श ह /
कुचैलं पतितं भग्नं नग्नं काषायवाससम् //
text_mt:
wearing black garments—such a woman he beheld;
and a man in rags, fallen, crippled, naked, wearing ochre robes,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgahīnaṃ dadarśāsau naraṃ duḥśitamānasam /
godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ śalyaṃ riktakumbhaṃ sarīmṛpam //
meaning:
अङ्गहीनं ददर्शासौ नरं दुःशितमानसम् /
गोधां च शशकं शल्यं रिक्तकुम्भं सरीमृपम् //
text_mt:
lacking limbs, of distressed mind, he beheld;
as well as an iguana, a hare, a porcupine, an empty pot, a crawling snake,

sanskrit_iast:
kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇaṃ cāsthikhaṇḍakam /
svadakṣiṇe śṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairvaṃ ravam //
meaning:
कार्पासं कच्छपं तैलं लवणं चास्थिखण्डकम् /
स्वदक्षिणे शृगालं च कुर्वन्तं भैर्वं रवम् //
text_mt:
cotton, a tortoise, oil, salt, and a fragment of bone;
and on his right, a jackal making a terrifying howl,

sanskrit_iast:
rogiṇaṃ puṃlkasaṃ caiva vṛṣaṃ ca śyenabhallukau /
dṛṣṭvāpi prayayau yoddhuṃ kālapāśāvṛto hajhāt //
meaning:
रोगिणं पुंल्कसं चैव वृषं च श्येनभल्लुकौ /
दृष्ट्वापि प्रययौ योद्धुं कालपाशावृतो हझात् //
text_mt:
a sick man, an outcaste, a bull, a hawk, and a bear.
Though seeing them, enveloped by the noose of Time, he marched forth impetuously to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
narmadottaratīrastho hyakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ /
vaṭacchāyāsamāsīno rāmo 'paśyadupāgatam //
meaning:
नर्मदोत्तरतीरस्थो ह्यकृतव्रणसंयुतः /
वटच्छायासमासीनो रामो ऽपश्यदुपागतम् //
text_mt: Standing on the northern bank of the Narmadā, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, / seated in the shade of a banyan tree, Rāma saw approaching

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryaṃ nṛpavaraṃ śatakoṭinṛpānvitam /
sahasrākṣauhiṇīyuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūva ha //
meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्यं नृपवरं शतकोटिनृपान्वितम् /
सहस्राक्षौहिणीयुक्तं दृष्ट्वा बभूव ह //
text_mt: Kārttavīrya, the foremost of kings, joined by hundreds of crores of kings / and endowed with a thousand akṣauhiṇīs; having seen him, he became [glad]:

sanskrit_iast:
adya me siddhimāyātaṃ kāryaṃ cirasamīhitam /
yaddṛṣṭigocaro jātaḥ kārtavīryo nṛpādhamaḥ //
meaning:
अद्य मे सिद्धिमायातं कार्यं चिरसमीहितम् /
यद्दृष्टिगोचरो जातः कार्तवीर्यो नृपाधमः //
text_mt: “Today the deed I have long desired has reached fulfillment, / since Kārttavīrya, the basest of kings, has come within the range of my sight.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamuktvā cotthāya dhṛtvā paraśumāyudham /
vyañjṛbhatārināśāyasiṃhaḥ kruddho yathā tathā //
meaning:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा चोत्थाय धृत्वा परशुमायुधम् /
व्यञ्जृभतारिनाशायसिंहः क्रुद्धो यथा तथा //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, he arose, seized his battle-axe weapon, / and yawned for the destruction of the enemy, just like an enraged lion.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā samudyataṃ rāmaṃ sainikānāṃ vadhāya ca /
cakaṃpire bhṛśaṃ sarve mṛtyoriva śarīriṇaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा समुद्यतं रामं सैनिकानां वधाय च /
चकंपिरे भृशं सर्वे मृत्योरिव शरीरिणः //
text_mt: Seeing Rāma fully prepared for the slaughter of the soldiers, / they all trembled violently, like embodied beings facing Death.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yatra yatrānilaraṃhasaṃ bhṛguścikṣepa roṣeṇa yutaḥ paraśvadham /
tatastataśchinnabhujorukaṅgharā nāgā hayāḥ śūranarā nipetuḥ //
meaning:
स यत्र यत्रानिलरंहसं भृगुश्चिक्षेप रोषेण युतः परश्वधम् /
ततस्ततश्छिन्नभुजोरुकङ्घरा नागा हयाः शूरनरा निपेतुः //
text_mt: Wherever that Bhṛgu, filled with wrath, hurled his axe swift as the wind, / from there, arms, thighs, and necks severed, elephants, horses, and heroic men fell.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā gajendro madayuksamantato nālaṃ vanaṃ bharddayati pradhāvan /
tathaiva rāmo 'pi manonilaujā vimarddayāmāsa nṛpasya senām //
meaning:
यथा गजेन्द्रो मदयुक्समन्ततो नालं वनं भर्द्दयति प्रधावन् /
तथैव रामो ऽपि मनोनिलौजा विमर्द्दयामास नृपस्य सेनाम् //
text_mt: Just as a lordly elephant in rut runs forward and crushes a reed-forest all around, / even so Rāma, with the speed of mind and wind, crushed the king’s army.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā tamitthaṃ praharantamojasā rāmaṃ raṇe śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham /
udyamya cāpaṃ mahadāsthito rathaṃ sṛjyaṃ ca kṛtvā kilamansyarājaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तमित्थं प्रहरन्तमोजसा रामं रणे शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठम् /
उद्यम्य चापं महदास्थितो रथं सृज्यं च कृत्वा किलमन्स्यराजः //
text_mt: Seeing Rāma, the best of weapon-bearers, striking thus with might in battle, / raising his great bow, mounting his chariot, and readying his bowstring, the king of the Matsyas,

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣya vāṇānanalogratejasaḥ samākiranbhārgavamāsasāda /
dṛṣṭvā tamāyāntamatho mahātmā rāmo gṛhītvā dhanuṣaṃ mahogram //
meaning:
आकृष्य वाणाननलोग्रतेजसः समाकिरन्भार्गवमाससाद /
दृष्ट्वा तमायान्तमथो महात्मा रामो गृहीत्वा धनुषं महोग्रम् //
text_mt: drawing arrows that burned with fierce fiery splendour and scattering them, approached the Bhārgava; / then seeing him coming, the great-souled Rāma seized his exceedingly fierce bow.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyavyamastraṃ vidadhe ruṣāpluto nivārayanmaṅgalabāṇavarṣam /
sa cāpi rājātibalo manasvī sasarja rāmāya tu parvatāstram //
meaning:
वायव्यमस्त्रं विदधे रुषाप्लुतो निवारयन्मङ्गलबाणवर्षम् /
स चापि राजातिबलो मनस्वी ससर्ज रामाय तु पर्वतास्त्रम् //
text_mt: Filled with rage, he discharged the wind-weapon, warding off Maṅgala's shower of arrows; / and that king too, exceedingly strong and resolute, released the mountain-weapon against Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
tastaṃbha tenātibalaṃ tadastraṃ vāyavyamiṣvastravidhānadakṣaḥ /
rāmo 'pi tatrātibalaṃ viditvā taṃ matsyarājaṃ vividhāstrapūgaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्तंभ तेनातिबलं तदस्त्रं वायव्यमिष्वस्त्रविधानदक्षः /
रामो ऽपि तत्रातिबलं विदित्वा तं मत्स्यराजं विविधास्त्रपूगैः //
text_mt: Skilled in the rules of arrows and missiles, he blocked that exceedingly powerful wind-weapon with it; / Rāma too, knowing that king of the Matsyas there to be exceedingly mighty

sanskrit_iast:
kirantamājau prasabhaṃ sumoca nārāyaṇāstraṃ vidhimantrayuktam /
nārāyaṇāstre bhṛguṇā prayukte rāmeṇa rājannṛpatervadhāya //
meaning:
किरन्तमाजौ प्रसभं सुमोच नारायणास्त्रं विधिमन्त्रयुक्तम् /
नारायणास्त्रे भृगुणा प्रयुक्ते रामेण राजन्नृपतेर्वधाय //
text_mt: as he scattered numerous arrays of missiles forcefully in battle, unleashed the Nārāyaṇa-missile endowed with rites and mantras; / when the Nārāyaṇa-missile was employed by Rāma the Bhṛgu to kill the king, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
diśastu sarvāḥ subhṛśaṃ hi tejasā prajajvalurmatsyapatiścakaṃpe /
rāmastu tasyātha vilakṣya kampaṃ bāṇaiścaturbhirnijaghāna vāhān //
meaning:
दिशस्तु सर्वाः सुभृशं हि तेजसा प्रजज्वलुर्मत्स्यपतिश्चकंपे /
रामस्तु तस्याथ विलक्ष्य कम्पं बाणैश्चतुर्भिर्निजघान वाहान् //
text_mt: all the quarters blazed intensely with splendour, and the lord of the Matsyas trembled; / then, seeing his trembling, Rāma struck down his draught-animals with four arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
śareṇa caikena dhvajaṃ mahātmā ciccheda cāpaṃ ca śaradvayena /
bāṇena caikena prasahya sārathiṃ nipātya bhūmau rathamārddayattribhiḥ //
meaning:
शरेण चैकेन ध्वजं महात्मा चिच्छेद चापं च शरद्वयेन /
बाणेन चैकेन प्रसह्य सारथिं निपात्य भूमौ रथमार्द्दयत्त्रिभिः //
text_mt: With one arrow the great-souled one severed the banner, and with two arrows the bow; / having forcefully felled the charioteer to the ground with one arrow, he battered the chariot with three.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā rathaṃ bhūmigataṃ ca maṅgalaṃ paraśvadhenāśu jaghāna mūrddhani /
sa bhinnaśīrṣo rudhiraṃ vamanmuhurmarcchāmavāpyātha mamāra ca kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा रथं भूमिगतं च मङ्गलं परश्वधेनाशु जघान मूर्द्धनि /
स भिन्नशीर्षो रुधिरं वमन्मुहुर्मर्च्छामवाप्याथ ममार च क्षणात् //
text_mt: Abandoning the chariot, Maṅgala went to the ground, and [Rāma] struck him swiftly on the head with his axe; / his skull shattered, vomiting blood repeatedly, he swooned and then died in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsainyamastreṇa ca saṃpradagdhaṃ vināśamāyādatha bhasmasātkṣaṇāt /
tasminnipatite rājñi candravaṃśasamudbhave //
meaning:
तत्सैन्यमस्त्रेण च संप्रदग्धं विनाशमायादथ भस्मसात्क्षणात् /
तस्मिन्निपतिते राज्ञि चन्द्रवंशसमुद्भवे //
text_mt: His army, utterly scorched by the missile, went to destruction in that moment, turned to ashes; / when that king born of the Lunar lineage had fallen,

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgale nṛpatiśreṣṭhe rāmo harṣamupāgataḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyama bhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite aṣṭātriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 38//
meaning:
मङ्गले नृपतिश्रेष्ठे रामो हर्षमुपागतः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यम भागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते अष्टात्रिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 38//
text_mt:
Maṅgala, the foremost of kings, Rāma attained great joy.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, in the Bhārgavacarita, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part, in the great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
matsyarāje nipatite rājā yuddhaviśāradaḥ /
rājendrānprerayāmāsa kārttavīryo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
मत्स्यराजे निपतिते राजा युद्धविशारदः /
राजेन्द्रान्प्रेरयामास कार्त्तवीर्यो महाबलः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / When the king of the Matsyas had fallen, King Kārttavīrya, skilled in battle / and of great strength, urged forward the sovereign lords:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhadbalaḥ somadatto vidarbho mithileśvaraḥ /
niṣadhādhipatiścaiva magadhādhipatistathā //
meaning:
बृहद्बलः सोमदत्तो विदर्भो मिथिलेश्वरः /
निषधाधिपतिश्चैव मगधाधिपतिस्तथा //
text_mt: Bṛhadbala, Somadatta, the king of Vidarbha, the lord of Mithilā, / the lord of Niṣadha, and also the lord of Magadha

sanskrit_iast:
āyayuḥ samare yoddhaṃ bhārgavedreṇa bhūpate /
varṣantaḥ śarajālāni nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ //
meaning:
आययुः समरे योद्धं भार्गवेद्रेण भूपते /
वर्षन्तः शरजालानि नानायुद्धविशारदाः //
text_mt: came into battle to fight the foremost of Bhārgavas, O king, / raining down showers of arrows, skilled in various modes of warfare,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrābhimāninaḥ sarve haihayasyājñayā tadā /
pinākahastaḥ sa bhṛgurjvaladagniśikhopamaḥ //
meaning:
वीराभिमानिनः सर्वे हैहयस्याज्ञया तदा /
पिनाकहस्तः स भृगुर्ज्वलदग्निशिखोपमः //
text_mt: all proud of their heroism, by the order of the Haihaya then; / holding a bow in hand, that Bhṛgu, resembling a blazing tongue of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa nāgapāśaṃ ca ābhimantrya śarottamam /
tadastraṃ bhārgave dreṇa kṣiptaṃ saṃgrāmamūrddhani //
meaning:
चिक्षेप नागपाशं च आभिमन्त्र्य शरोत्तमम् /
तदस्त्रं भार्गवे द्रेण क्षिप्तं संग्राममूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: consecrated an excellent arrow and discharged the serpent-noose; / that missile discharged on the forefront of battle by the foremost of Bhārgavas

sanskrit_iast:
cakartta gāruḍāstreṇa somadatto mahābalaḥ /
tataḥ kruddho mahābhāgo rāmaḥ śatruvidāraṇaḥ //
meaning:
चकर्त्त गारुडास्त्रेण सोमदत्तो महाबलः /
ततः क्रुद्धो महाभागो रामः शत्रुविदारणः //
text_mt: the mighty Somadatta cut to pieces with the Garuḍa-missile; / then, enraged, the illustrious Rāma, tearer of enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
rudradattena śūlena somadattaṃ jaghāna ha /
bṛhadbalaṃ ca gadayā vidarbhaṃ muṣṭinā tathā //
meaning:
रुद्रदत्तेन शूलेन सोमदत्तं जघान ह /
बृहद्बलं च गदया विदर्भं मुष्टिना तथा //
text_mt: slew Somadatta with the trident given by Rudra, / and Bṛhadbala with a mace, and the king of Vidarbha with a fist;

sanskrit_iast:
maithilaṃ mudgareṇaiva śaktyā ca niṣadhādhipam /
māgadhañcaraṇāghātairastrajālena sainikān //
meaning:
मैथिलं मुद्गरेणैव शक्त्या च निषधाधिपम् /
मागधञ्चरणाघातैरस्त्रजालेन सैनिकान् //
text_mt: the lord of Mithilā with a mallet, and the lord of Niṣadha with a spear, / the lord of Magadha with kicks, and the soldiers with a swarm of missiles.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatya nikhilāṃ senāṃ saṃhārāgnisamīraṇe /
dudrāva kārttavīryaṃ ca jāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
निहत्य निखिलां सेनां संहाराग्निसमीरणे /
दुद्राव कार्त्तवीर्यं च जामदग्न्यो महाबलः //
text_mt: Having destroyed the entire army like the wind [driving] the fire of universal destruction, / the mighty son of Jamadagni rushed toward Kārttavīrya.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ yoddhumāyāntaṃ rājāno 'nye mahārathāḥ /
kāryyākāryavidhānajñāḥ pṛṣṭe kṛtvā ca haihayam //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं योद्धुमायान्तं राजानो ऽन्ये महारथाः /
कार्य्याकार्यविधानज्ञाः पृष्टे कृत्वा च हैहयम् //
text_mt: Seeing him coming to fight, other kings, great chariot-warriors / knowing the distinction between what is to be done and not done, placed the Haihaya at their back,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa yuyudhuścaiva darśayantaśca sauhṛdam /
kānyakubjāśca śataśaḥ saurāṣṭrāvantayastathā //
meaning:
रामेण युयुधुश्चैव दर्शयन्तश्च सौहृदम् /
कान्यकुब्जाश्च शतशः सौराष्ट्रावन्तयस्तथा //
text_mt: fought with Rāma, showing their allegiance; / and hundreds of Kānyakubjas, Saurāṣṭras, and Avantis

sanskrit_iast:
cakruśca śarajālāni rāmasya ca samantataḥ /
śarajālāvṛtasteṣāṃ rāmaḥ saṃgrāmamūrddhani //
meaning:
चक्रुश्च शरजालानि रामस्य च समन्ततः /
शरजालावृतस्तेषां रामः संग्राममूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: created showers of arrows all around Rāma; / covered by their swarm of arrows at the head of the battle,

sanskrit_iast:
na cādṛśyata rājendra tadā sa tvakṛtavraṇaḥ /
sasmāra rāmacaritaṃ yaduktaṃ hariṇena vai //
meaning:
न चादृश्यत राजेन्द्र तदा स त्वकृतव्रणः /
सस्मार रामचरितं यदुक्तं हरिणेन वै //
text_mt: Rāma could not be seen, O best of kings; then Akṛtavraṇa / remembered the deeds of Rāma that had indeed been spoken by the deer,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśalaṃ bhārgavendrasya yācamāno hariṃ muniḥ /
etasminneva kāle tu rāmaḥ śastrāstrakovidaḥ //
meaning:
कुशलं भार्गवेन्द्रस्य याचमानो हरिं मुनिः /
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रामः शस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः //
text_mt: and the sage prayed to Hari for the welfare of the foremost of Bhārgavas; / at that very moment, Rāma, skilled in arms and missiles,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhūya śarajālāni vāyavyāstreṇa mantravit /
udatiṣṭhadraṇākāṅkṣī nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
विधूय शरजालानि वायव्यास्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् /
उदतिष्ठद्रणाकाङ्क्षी नीहारादिव भास्करः //
text_mt: knowing the mantras, dispersed the swarms of arrows with the wind-weapon / and arose, eager for battle, like the sun emerging from fog.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ samare rāmastaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuyudhe balī /
dvādaśākṣauhiṇīstatra ciccheda laghuvikramaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं समरे रामस्तैः सार्द्धं युयुधे बली /
द्वादशाक्षौहिणीस्तत्र चिच्छेद लघुविक्रमः //
text_mt: For three nights the powerful Rāma fought with them in battle; / swift in valor, he cut down twelve akṣauhiṇīs there,

sanskrit_iast:
rambhāstambhavanaṃ yadvat paraśvadhavarāyudhaḥ /
sarvāṃstānbhūpavargāṃśca tadīyaśca mahācamūḥ //
meaning:
रम्भास्तम्भवनं यद्वत् परश्वधवरायुधः /
सर्वांस्तान्भूपवर्गांश्च तदीयश्च महाचमूः //
text_mt: like a grove of plantain trees, with his excellent weapon, the axe; / all those groups of kings and their great armies,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vinihatāṃ tena rāmeṇa sumahātmanā /
ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ sucandraḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा विनिहतां तेन रामेण सुमहात्मना /
आजगाम महावीर्यः सुचन्द्रः सूर्यवंशजः //
text_mt: seeing them slain by that very great-souled Rāma, / the mighty Sucandra, born of the Solar lineage, arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣarājanyasaṃyuktaḥ saptākṣauhiṇisaṃyutaḥ /
tatrānekamahāvīrā garjantastoyadā iva //
meaning:
लक्षराजन्यसंयुक्तः सप्ताक्षौहिणिसंयुतः /
तत्रानेकमहावीरा गर्जन्तस्तोयदा इव //
text_mt: accompanied by a hundred thousand royal warriors and endowed with seven akṣauhiṇīs; / there many great heroes, roaring like rain-clouds,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃpayanto bhuvaṃ rājan yuyudhurbhārgaveṇa ca /
teḥ prayuktāni śastrāṇi mahāstrāṇi ca bhūpate //
meaning:
कंपयन्तो भुवं राजन् युयुधुर्भार्गवेण च /
तेः प्रयुक्तानि शस्त्राणि महास्त्राणि च भूपते //
text_mt: shaking the earth, O king, fought with the Bhārgava; / the arms and great missiles discharged by them, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇena nāśayāmāsa bhārgavendraḥ pratāpavān /
gṛhītvā paraśuṃ divyaṃ kālātakayamopamam //
meaning:
क्षणेन नाशयामास भार्गवेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् /
गृहीत्वा परशुं दिव्यं कालातकयमोपमम् //
text_mt: the radiant, foremost of Bhārgavas destroyed in an instant; / seizing his divine battle-axe resembling the death-god at the end of time,

sanskrit_iast:
kālayansakalā senāṃ ciccheda bhugunandanaḥ /
karṣakastu yathā kṣetre pakvaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā tṛṇam //
meaning:
कालयन्सकला सेनां चिच्छेद भुगुनन्दनः /
कर्षकस्तु यथा क्षेत्रे पक्वं धान्यं तथा तृणम् //
text_mt: driving off the entire army, the descendant of Bhṛgu cut it down, / just as a farmer clears a field of ripe grain and grass completely

sanskrit_iast:
niśeṣayati dātreṇa tathā rāmeṇa tatkṛtam /
lakṣarājanyasainyaṃ tadadṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa dāritam //
meaning:
निशेषयति दात्रेण तथा रामेण तत्कृतम् /
लक्षराजन्यसैन्यं तददृष्ट्वा रामेण दारितम् //
text_mt: with a sickle; so it was done by Rāma; / seeing that army of a hundred thousand royal warriors torn apart by Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
sucandraḥ pṛthivīpālo yuyudhe saṃgare nṛpa /
tāvubhau tatra saṃkṣubdhau nānāśastrāstrakovidau //
meaning:
सुचन्द्रः पृथिवीपालो युयुधे संगरे नृप /
तावुभौ तत्र संक्षुब्धौ नानाशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदौ //
text_mt: Sucandra, the protector of the earth, fought in battle, O king; / both of them agitated there, skilled in various arms and missiles,

sanskrit_iast:
yuyudhāte mahāvīrau munīśanṛpatīśvarau /
rāmo 'smai yāni śastrāṇi cikṣepāstrāṇi cāpi hi //
meaning:
युयुधाते महावीरौ मुनीशनृपतीश्वरौ /
रामो ऽस्मै यानि शस्त्राणि चिक्षेपास्त्राणि चापि हि //
text_mt: the two great heroes, the lord of sages and the sovereign of kings, fought; / whatever weapons and missiles Rāma hurled at him,

sanskrit_iast:
tāni sarvāṇi ciccheda sucandro yuddha paṇḍitaḥ /
tataḥ kruddho raṇe rāmaḥ sucandraṃ pṛthivīśvaram //
meaning:
तानि सर्वाणि चिच्छेद सुचन्द्रो युद्ध पण्डितः /
ततः क्रुद्धो रणे रामः सुचन्द्रं पृथिवीश्वरम् //
text_mt: all of them Sucandra, learned in warfare, cut to pieces; / then Rāma, enraged in battle against Sucandra, lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapratikṛtābhijñaṃ jñātvopaspṛśya vāryatha /
nārāyaṇāstraṃ viśikhe saṃdadhe cānivāritam //
meaning:
कृतप्रतिकृताभिज्ञं ज्ञात्वोपस्पृश्य वार्यथ /
नारायणास्त्रं विशिखे संदधे चानिवारितम् //
text_mt: Knowing that [Sucandra] was skilled in retaliatory strikes, he then sipped water / and fitted the irresistible Nārāyaṇa missile to an arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
tadastraṃ śatasūryābhaṃ kṣiptaṃ rāmeṇa dhīmatā /
hṛṣṭottīrya rathātsadyaḥ sucandraḥ praṇanāma ha //
meaning:
तदस्त्रं शतसूर्याभं क्षिप्तं रामेण धीमता /
हृष्टोत्तीर्य रथात्सद्यः सुचन्द्रः प्रणनाम ह //
text_mt: When that missile, shining like a hundred suns, was loosed by wise Rāma, / Sucandra, delighted, immediately stepped down from his chariot and bowed low.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāstrapūjyaṃ taccāpi nārāyaṇavinirmitam /
tamevaṃ praṇataṃ tyaktvā yathau nārāyamantikam //
meaning:
सर्वास्त्रपूज्यं तच्चापि नारायणविनिर्मितम् /
तमेवं प्रणतं त्यक्त्वा यथौ नारायमन्तिकम् //
text_mt: And that weapon, worshipped by all missiles and fashioned by Nārāyaṇa, / spared him who had thus bowed down, and went near to Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vismito 'bhūttadā rāmaḥ samare śatrasūdanaḥ /
dṛṣṭvā vyarthaṃ mahāstraṃ tadbhūpaṃ svasthaṃ vilokya ca //
meaning:
विस्मितो ऽभूत्तदा रामः समरे शत्रसूदनः /
दृष्ट्वा व्यर्थं महास्त्रं तद्भूपं स्वस्थं विलोक्य च //
text_mt: Then Rāma, the slayer of foes, was astonished in battle, / seeing that great missile rendered futile and beholding the king unharmed.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaḥ śaktiṃ ca musalaṃ tomaraṃ paṭṭiśaṃ tathā /
gadāṃ ca paraśuṃ kopācchikṣepa nṛpamūrddhani //
meaning:
रामः शक्तिं च मुसलं तोमरं पट्टिशं तथा /
गदां च परशुं कोपाच्छिक्षेप नृपमूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: Rāma in his fury hurled a spear, a club, a javelin, a paṭṭiśa, / a mace, and a battle-axe at the king's head.

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha tāni sarvāṇi sucandro līlayaiva hi /
cikṣepa śivaśūlaṃ ca rāmo nṛpataye yadā //
meaning:
जग्राह तानि सर्वाणि सुचन्द्रो लीलयैव हि /
चिक्षेप शिवशूलं च रामो नृपतये यदा //
text_mt: Sucandra caught all of them with ease; / and when Rāma hurled Śiva's trident at the king,

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva puṣpamālāṃ ca tacchūlaṃ nṛpatergale /
dadarśa ca purastasya bhadrakālīṃ jagatprasūm //
meaning:
बभूव पुष्पमालां च तच्छूलं नृपतेर्गले /
ददर्श च पुरस्तस्य भद्रकालीं जगत्प्रसूम् //
text_mt: that trident became a garland of flowers upon the king's neck. / And [Rāma] saw Bhadrakālī, the mother of the universe, standing before him,

sanskrit_iast:
vahantīṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca vikaṭāsyāṃ bhayaṅkarīm /
siṃhasthāṃ ca trinetrāṃ ca triśūlavaradhāriṇīm //
meaning:
वहन्तीं मुण्डमालां च विकटास्यां भयङ्करीम् /
सिंहस्थां च त्रिनेत्रां च त्रिशूलवरधारिणीम् //
text_mt: wearing a garland of severed heads, terrifying with a gaping mouth, / seated upon a lion, three-eyed, and bearing an excellent trident.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vihāya śastrāstraṃ namaskṛtya samaiḍata /
rāma uvāca
namostu te śaṅkaravallabhāyai jagatsavitryai samalaṅkṛtāyai //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा विहाय शस्त्रास्त्रं नमस्कृत्य समैडत /
राम उवाच
नमोस्तु ते शङ्करवल्लभायै जगत्सवित्र्यै समलङ्कृतायै //
text_mt: Seeing her, he dropped his weapons and missiles, bowed, and praised her. / Rāma said: / 'Obeisance to you, the beloved of Śaṅkara, mother of the universe, adorned

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvibhūṣābhiribhārigāyai prapannarakṣāvihitodyamāyai /
dakṣaprasūtyai himavadbhavāyai maheśvarārddhaṅgasamāsthitāyai //
meaning:
नानाविभूषाभिरिभारिगायै प्रपन्नरक्षाविहितोद्यमायै /
दक्षप्रसूत्यै हिमवद्भवायै महेश्वरार्द्धङ्गसमास्थितायै //
text_mt: with various ornaments, riding a lion, striving to protect the surrendered, / born as Dakṣa's daughter, born of the Himavat, seated upon half the body of Maheśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
kālyai kalānāthakalādharāyai bhaktapriyāyai bhuvanādhipāyai /
tārābhidhāyai śivatatparāyai gaṇeśvarārādhitapādukāyai //
meaning:
काल्यै कलानाथकलाधरायै भक्तप्रियायै भुवनाधिपायै /
ताराभिधायै शिवतत्परायै गणेश्वराराधितपादुकायै //
text_mt: to Kālī, bearer of the crescent moon, lover of devotees, sovereign of the world, / named Tārā, devoted to Śiva, whose sandals are worshipped by the lord of Gaṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
parātparāyai parameṣṭhidāyai tāpatrayonmūlanacintanāyai /
jagaddhitāyāstapuratrayāyai bālādikāyai tripurābhidhāyai //
meaning:
परात्परायै परमेष्ठिदायै तापत्रयोन्मूलनचिन्तनायै /
जगद्धितायास्तपुरत्रयायै बालादिकायै त्रिपुराभिधायै //
text_mt: higher than the highest, giver of the highest state, contemplation for uprooting the threefold misery, / benefactor of the world, destroyer of the three cities, beginning with Bālā, named Tripurā;

sanskrit_iast:
samastavidyāsuvilāsadāyai jagajjananyai nihitāhitāyai /
bakānanāyai bahusākhyadāyai vidhvastanānāsuradānvāyai //
meaning:
समस्तविद्यासुविलासदायै जगज्जनन्यै निहिताहितायै /
बकाननायै बहुसाख्यदायै विध्वस्तनानासुरदान्वायै //
text_mt: giver of the playful grace of all lores, mother of the universe, slayer of foes, / crane-faced, giver of great happiness, destroyer of various asuras and dānavas;

sanskrit_iast:
varābhayālaṅkṛtadorlatāyai samastagīrvāṇanamaskṛtāyai /
pītāṃbarāyai pavanāśugāyai śubhapradāyai śivasaṃstutāyai //
meaning:
वराभयालङ्कृतदोर्लतायै समस्तगीर्वाणनमस्कृतायै /
पीतांबरायै पवनाशुगायै शुभप्रदायै शिवसंस्तुतायै //
text_mt: whose creeper-like arms are adorned with the gestures of boon and fearlessness, bowed to by all the gods, / dressed in yellow silk, swift as the wind, bestower of auspiciousness, praised by Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
nāgārigāyai navakhaṇḍapāyai nīlācalābhāṃ galasatprabhāyai /
laghukramāyai lalitābhidhāyai lekhādhipāyai lavaṇākarāyai //
meaning:
नागारिगायै नवखण्डपायै नीलाचलाभां गलसत्प्रभायै /
लघुक्रमायै ललिताभिधायै लेखाधिपायै लवणाकरायै //
text_mt: riding the enemy of serpents, protector of the nine realms, whose lovely glow resembles the blue mountain, / of swift gait, named Lalitā, ruler of the gods, mine of salt;

sanskrit_iast:
lolekṣaṇāyai layavarjitāyai lākṣārasālaṅkṛtapaṅkajāyai /
ramābhidhāyai ratisupriyāyai rogāpahāyai racitākhilāyai //
meaning:
लोलेक्षणायै लयवर्जितायै लाक्षारसालङ्कृतपङ्कजायै /
रमाभिधायै रतिसुप्रियायै रोगापहायै रचिताखिलायै //
text_mt: restless-eyed, devoid of dissolution, whose lotus-feet are adorned with red lacquer, / named Ramā, delightful to Rati, dispeller of illness, maker of all things;

sanskrit_iast:
rājyapradāyai ramaṇotsukāyai ratnaprabhāyai rucirāṃbarāyai /
namo namaste parataḥ purastāt pārśvādharordhvaṃ ca namo namaste //
meaning:
राज्यप्रदायै रमणोत्सुकायै रत्नप्रभायै रुचिरांबरायै /
नमो नमस्ते परतः पुरस्तात् पार्श्वाधरोर्ध्वं च नमो नमस्ते //
text_mt: giver of kingdoms, eager for dalliance, glowing with gems, dressed in exquisite garments! / Bows, bows to you from behind, from the front, from both sides, from below, and from above; bows, bows to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sadā ca sarvatra namo namaste namo namaste 'khilavigrahāyai /
prasīda deveśi mama pratijñāṃ purā kṛtāṃ pālaya bhadrakāli //
meaning:
सदा च सर्वत्र नमो नमस्ते नमो नमस्ते ऽखिलविग्रहायै /
प्रसीद देवेशि मम प्रतिज्ञां पुरा कृतां पालय भद्रकालि //
text_mt: Bows, bows to you always and everywhere; bows, bows to you, whose form is the universe! / Be pleased, O queen of gods, and protect my vow made of old, O Bhadrakālī!

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva jagattrayasyāpi namo namaste /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ stutā tadā devī bhadrakālī tarasvinī //
meaning:
त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव जगत्त्रयस्यापि नमो नमस्ते /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं स्तुता तदा देवी भद्रकाली तरस्विनी //
text_mt: You alone are mother, and you alone are father to the three worlds; bows, bows to you!' / Vasiṣṭha said: / Thus praised, the swift goddess Bhadrakālī then

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca bhārgavaṃ prītā varadānakṛtotsavā /
bhadrakālyuvāca
vatsa rāma mahābhāga prītāsmi tava sāṃpratam //
meaning:
उवाच भार्गवं प्रीता वरदानकृतोत्सवा /
भद्रकाल्युवाच
वत्स राम महाभाग प्रीतास्मि तव सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: rejoiced and, eager to grant a boon, spoke to Bhārgava. / Bhadrakālī said: / 'Dear child, illustrious Rāma, I am pleased with you now.

sanskrit_iast:
varaṃ varaya matto yastvayā cābhyarthitā hṛdi /
rāma uvāca
mātaryadi varo deyastvayā me bhaktava tsale //
meaning:
वरं वरय मत्तो यस्त्वया चाभ्यर्थिता हृदि /
राम उवाच
मातर्यदि वरो देयस्त्वया मे भक्तव त्सले //
text_mt: Choose a boon from me, that which has been desired in your heart.' / Rāma said: / 'O mother, lover of devotees, if a boon is to be given to me by you,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsucandraṃ jaye yuddhe tavānugrahabhājanam /
iti me 'bhihitaṃ devi kuru prītena cetasā //
meaning:
तत्सुचन्द्रं जये युद्धे तवानुग्रहभाजनम् /
इति मे ऽभिहितं देवि कुरु प्रीतेन चेतसा //
text_mt: then let me conquer in battle Sucandra, who is the vessel of your grace; / grant this which I have spoken, O goddess, with a pleased mind,

sanskrit_iast:
yena kenāpyupāyena jaganmātarnamo 'stu te /
bhadrakālyuvāca
āgneyāstreṇa rājendraṃ sucandraṃ naya madgṛham //
meaning:
येन केनाप्युपायेन जगन्मातर्नमो ऽस्तु ते /
भद्रकाल्युवाच
आग्नेयास्त्रेण राजेन्द्रं सुचन्द्रं नय मद्गृहम् //
text_mt: by any means whatsoever, O mother of the universe; obeisance to you!' / Bhadrakālī said: / 'With the missile of Agni dispatch the king of kings, Sucandra, to my abode.

sanskrit_iast:
mamātipriyamadyaiva pārṣado me bhavatvayam /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktamākarṇya sa bhārgavendro devyāḥ priyaṃ kartumathodyato 'bhūt //
meaning:
ममातिप्रियमद्यैव पार्षदो मे भवत्वयम् /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तमाकर्ण्य स भार्गवेन्द्रो देव्याः प्रियं कर्तुमथोद्यतो ऽभूत् //
text_mt: He is very dear to me; this very day let him become my attendant.' / Vasiṣṭha said: / Hearing what was spoken, the foremost Bhārgava became eager to do what pleased the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānniyamyācamanaṃ ca kṛtvā sucandramuddiśya ca tatsamādadhe /
astraṃ prayuktaṃ nṛpatervadhāya rāmeṇa rājan prasabhaṃ tadā tat //
meaning:
प्राणान्नियम्याचमनं च कृत्वा सुचन्द्रमुद्दिश्य च तत्समादधे /
अस्त्रं प्रयुक्तं नृपतेर्वधाय रामेण राजन् प्रसभं तदा तत् //
text_mt: Restraining his breaths and sipping water, he aimed that [weapon] against Sucandra; / and then, O king, Rāma forcibly discharged that missile for the slaying of the king.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā vapurbhūtamayaṃ tadīyaṃ nināya lokaṃ paradevatāyāḥ /
tatastu rāmeṇa kṛtapraṇāmā sā bhadrakālo jagadādikartrī //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा वपुर्भूतमयं तदीयं निनाय लोकं परदेवतायाः /
ततस्तु रामेण कृतप्रणामा सा भद्रकालो जगदादिकर्त्री //
text_mt: Having burned his elemental body, it conducted him to the realm of the supreme deity. / Thereupon, having received Rāma's bow, Bhadrakālī, the primeval creator of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
antarhitābhūdatha jāmadagnyastasthau raṇebhūpavadhābhikāṅkṣī //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekonacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 39//
meaning:
अन्तर्हिताभूदथ जामदग्न्यस्तस्थौ रणेभूपवधाभिकाङ्क्षी //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकोनचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 39//
text_mt:
vanished; and Jāmadagnya stood upon the battlefield, desiring to slay the kings.

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter in the story of Bhārgava, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
sucandre patite rājan rājendrāṇāṃ śiromaṇau /
tatputraḥ puṣkarākṣastu rāmaṃ yoddhumathāgataḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
सुचन्द्रे पतिते राजन् राजेन्द्राणां शिरोमणौ /
तत्पुत्रः पुष्कराक्षस्तु रामं योद्धुमथागतः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / When Sucandra, the crest-jewel of the foremost of kings, had fallen, O king, / his son Puṣkarākṣa came forward to fight Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rathastho mahāvīryaḥ sarvaśastrāstrakovidaḥ /
abhivīkṣya raṇetyugraṃ rāmaṃ kālātakopamam //
meaning:
स रथस्थो महावीर्यः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः /
अभिवीक्ष्य रणेत्युग्रं रामं कालातकोपमम् //
text_mt: Mounted on his chariot, endowed with great valour and skilled in all weapons and missiles, / beholding Rāma terribly fierce in battle like the god of Death,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāra śarajālaṃ ca bhārgavendrasya sarvataḥ /
muhūrttaṃ jāmadagnyo 'pi bāṇaiḥ saṃjhadito 'bhavat //
meaning:
चकार शरजालं च भार्गवेन्द्रस्य सर्वतः /
मुहूर्त्तं जामदग्न्यो ऽपि बाणैः संझदितो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: he created a web of arrows around the foremost Bhārgava on all sides. / For a moment Jāmadagnya was covered with arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niṣkamya sahasā bhārgavendro mahābalaḥ /
śarabandhānmahārāja samudaikṣata sarvataḥ //
meaning:
ततो निष्कम्य सहसा भार्गवेन्द्रो महाबलः /
शरबन्धान्महाराज समुदैक्षत सर्वतः //
text_mt: Then, having broken out quickly from the cage of arrows, O great king, / the mighty Bhārgava looked in every direction.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ puṣkārākṣaṃ tu sucandratanayaṃ tadā /
krodhamāhārayāmāsa didhakṣanniva pāvakaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तं पुष्काराक्षं तु सुचन्द्रतनयं तदा /
क्रोधमाहारयामास दिधक्षन्निव पावकः //
text_mt: Seeing Puṣkarākṣa, the son of Sucandra, / he gave way to anger like a fire eager to burn.

sanskrit_iast:
sa krodhena samāviṣṭo vāruṇaṃ samavāsṛjat /
tato meghāḥ samutpannā garjanto bhairavānnavān //
meaning:
स क्रोधेन समाविष्टो वारुणं समवासृजत् /
ततो मेघाः समुत्पन्ना गर्जन्तो भैरवान्नवान् //
text_mt: Filled with anger, he loosed the missile of Varuṇa; / then clouds arose, roaring with fearful sounds.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛṣurjaladhārābhiḥ plāvayanto dharāṃ nṛpa /
puṣkarākṣo mahāvīryo vāyavyāstrumavāsṛjat //
meaning:
ववृषुर्जलधाराभिः प्लावयन्तो धरां नृप /
पुष्कराक्षो महावीर्यो वायव्यास्त्रुमवासृजत् //
text_mt: They rained down torrents of water, inundating the earth, O king. / The mighty Puṣkarākṣa then loosed the missile of Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
tena te 'darśanaṃ nītāḥ sadya eva balāhakāḥ /
atha rāmo bhṛśaṃ kruddho brāhmaṃ tatrābhisaṃdadhe //
meaning:
तेन ते ऽदर्शनं नीताः सद्य एव बलाहकाः /
अथ रामो भृशं क्रुद्धो ब्राह्मं तत्राभिसंदधे //
text_mt: By that, those clouds were instantly made to disappear. / Then Rāma, fiercely enraged, fitted the missile of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkarākṣo 'pi tenaiva vicakarṣa mahābalaḥ /
brāhma so 'pyāhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍāhata ivāragaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कराक्षो ऽपि तेनैव विचकर्ष महाबलः /
ब्राह्म सो ऽप्याहितं दृष्ट्वा दण्डाहत इवारगः //
text_mt: The mighty Puṣkarākṣa also drew [his bow] with that same [missile]. / Seeing that Brahmā's missile had been warded off, [Rāma,] like a serpent struck with a stick,

sanskrit_iast:
ghoraṃ paraśumādāya niḥśvasaṃstamadhāvata /
rāmasyādhāvatastatra puṣkarākṣo dhanurdharaḥ //
meaning:
घोरं परशुमादाय निःश्वसंस्तमधावत /
रामस्याधावतस्तत्र पुष्कराक्षो धनुर्धरः //
text_mt: took up his terrible battle-axe and rushed at him, hissing with fury. / As Rāma rushed forward, the archer Puṣkarākṣa

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdadhe pañcaviśikhāndīptāsyānuragāniva /
ekaikena ca bāṇena hṛdi śīrṣe bhujadvaye //
meaning:
संदधे पञ्चविशिखान्दीप्तास्यानुरगानिव /
एकैकेन च बाणेन हृदि शीर्षे भुजद्वये //
text_mt: fitted five sharp arrows like fiery-mouthed serpents; / and piercing him successively with one arrow each in the chest, the head, both arms,

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyāṃ ca kramādbhittvā tastaṃbha bhṛśa māturam /
sa caivaṃ pīḍīto rāmaḥ puṣkarākṣeṇa saṃyuge //
meaning:
शिखायां च क्रमाद्भित्त्वा तस्तंभ भृश मातुरम् /
स चैवं पीडीतो रामः पुष्कराक्षेण संयुगे //
text_mt: and the crest, he stopped [Rāma], who was sorely distressed. / And thus tormented in battle by Puṣkarākṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhṛśaṃ dhāvanparaśuṃ mūrdhnyapatayāt /
śikhāmārabhya pādāntaṃ puthkarākṣaṃ dvidhākarot //
meaning:
क्षणं स्थित्वा भृशं धावन्परशुं मूर्ध्न्यपतयात् /
शिखामारभ्य पादान्तं पुथ्कराक्षं द्विधाकरोत् //
text_mt: Rāma paused for a moment, then ran forward with fury and brought down his battle-axe upon [Puṣkarākṣa's] head, / splitting Puṣkarākṣa into two, from his crest down to his feet.

sanskrit_iast:
patite śakale bhūmau tatkālaṃ paśyatā nṛṇām /
āścaryaṃ sumāhajjātaṃ divi caiva divau kasām //
meaning:
पतिते शकले भूमौ तत्कालं पश्यता नृणाम् /
आश्चर्यं सुमाहज्जातं दिवि चैव दिवौ कसाम् //
text_mt: When the two halves fell to the ground, as men looked on at that moment, / a very great wonder arose [among them], and among the sky-dwellers in heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vidārya rāmastaṃ krodhātpuṣkarākṣa mahābalam /
tatsainyamadahatkruddhaḥ pāvako vipinaṃ yathā //
meaning:
विदार्य रामस्तं क्रोधात्पुष्कराक्ष महाबलम् /
तत्सैन्यमदहत्क्रुद्धः पावको विपिनं यथा //
text_mt: Having cleaven mighty Puṣkarākṣa in anger, / Rāma, enraged, burned his army as a fire burns a forest.

sanskrit_iast:
yato yato dhāvati bhārgavendro mano 'nilaujāḥ praharanparaśvadham /
tatastato vājirathebhamānavā nikṛttagātrāḥ śataśo nipetuḥ //
meaning:
यतो यतो धावति भार्गवेन्द्रो मनो ऽनिलौजाः प्रहरन्परश्वधम् /
ततस्ततो वाजिरथेभमानवा निकृत्तगात्राः शतशो निपेतुः //
text_mt:
Wherever the best of the Bhārgavas rushed, possessing the swiftness of mind and wind, striking with his battle-axe,
there horses, chariots, elephants, and men fell by the hundreds, their limbs severed.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmeṇa tatrā tibalena saṃgare nihanyamānāstu paraśvadhena /
hā tāta mātastviti jalpamāṃnā bhasmībabhūvuḥ suvicūrṇitāstadā //
meaning:
रामेण तत्रा तिबलेन संगरे निहन्यमानास्तु परश्वधेन /
हा तात मातस्त्विति जल्पमांना भस्मीबभूवुः सुविचूर्णितास्तदा //
text_mt: Slain there in battle with the battle-axe by Rāma of exceedingly great strength, / crying out, "Alas, father! Mother!", they were then thoroughly crushed into ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrttamātreṇa ca bhārgaveṇa tatpuṣkarākṣasya balaṃ samagram /
anekarājanyakulaṃ hateśvaraṃ itaṃ navākṣauhiṇikaṃ bhṛśāturam //
meaning:
मुहूर्त्तमात्रेण च भार्गवेण तत्पुष्कराक्षस्य बलं समग्रम् /
अनेकराजन्यकुलं हतेश्वरं इतं नवाक्षौहिणिकं भृशातुरम् //
text_mt: And in merely an instant, the entire army of Puṣkarākṣa, / consisting of nine akṣauhiṇīs, its kings slain, its lords killed, was brought by the Bhārgava to deep distress.

sanskrit_iast:
patite puṣkarākṣe tu kārttavīryārjunaḥ svayam /
ājagāma mahāvīryaḥ suvarṇarathamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
पतिते पुष्कराक्षे तु कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनः स्वयम् /
आजगाम महावीर्यः सुवर्णरथमास्थितः //
text_mt: When Puṣkarākṣa had fallen, Kārttavīryārjuna himself, / endowed with great valor, arrived mounted upon a golden chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāśastrasamākīrṇaṃ nānāratnaparicchadam /
daśanalvapramāṇaṃ ca śatavājiyutaṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
नानाशस्त्रसमाकीर्णं नानारत्नपरिच्छदम् /
दशनल्वप्रमाणं च शतवाजियुतं नृपः //
text_mt: strewn with various weapons, furnished with various jewels, / measuring ten nalvas, and yoked with a hundred horses, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
yute bāhusahasreṇa nānāyudhadhareṇa ca /
babhau svarlokamārokṣyandehati sukṛtī yathā //
meaning:
युते बाहुसहस्रेण नानायुधधरेण च /
बभौ स्वर्लोकमारोक्ष्यन्देहति सुकृती यथा //
text_mt: Endowed with a thousand arms bearing various weapons, / he shone like a meritorious soul ascending to heaven having abandoned his body.

sanskrit_iast:
putrāstasya mahāvīryāḥ śataṃ yuddhaviśāradāḥ /
senāḥ saṃvyūhya saṃtasthuḥ saṃgrāme piturājñayā //
meaning:
पुत्रास्तस्य महावीर्याः शतं युद्धविशारदाः /
सेनाः संव्यूह्य संतस्थुः संग्रामे पितुराज्ञया //
text_mt: His one hundred sons, of great valor and skilled in battle, / drew up the forces in array and stood in the battle at their father's command.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryastu balavānrāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇājire /
kālāntakayamaprakhyaṃ yoddhuṃ samupacakrame //
meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्यस्तु बलवान्रामं दृष्ट्वा रणाजिरे /
कालान्तकयमप्रख्यं योद्धुं समुपचक्रमे //
text_mt: The mighty Kārttavīrya, having seen Rāma on the battlefield, / resembling Yama the ender of Time, advanced to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣe pañcaśataṃ bāṇānvāme pañcaśataṃ dhanuḥ /
jagrā ha bhārgavendrasya samare jetumudyataḥ //
meaning:
दक्षे पञ्चशतं बाणान्वामे पञ्चशतं धनुः /
जग्रा ह भार्गवेन्द्रस्य समरे जेतुमुद्यतः //
text_mt: Taking five hundred arrows in his right [hands] and five hundred bows in his left, / he undertook to conquer the chief of the Bhārgavas in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇavarṣaṃ cakārātha rāmasyopari bhūpate /
yathā balāhako vīra parvatopari varṣati //
meaning:
बाणवर्षं चकाराथ रामस्योपरि भूपते /
यथा बलाहको वीर पर्वतोपरि वर्षति //
text_mt: Then, O king, he poured a shower of arrows upon Rāma, / just as a cloud, O hero, rains upon a mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇavarṣeṇa nenājau satkṛto bhṛgunandanaḥ /
jagrāha svaghanurdivyaṃ bāṇavarṣaṃ tathākarot //
meaning:
बाणवर्षेण नेनाजौ सत्कृतो भृगुनन्दनः /
जग्राह स्वघनुर्दिव्यं बाणवर्षं तथाकरोत् //
text_mt: Welcomed in battle with that shower of arrows, the delight of Bhṛgu / grasped his own divine bow and similarly poured a shower of arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvubhauraṇasaṃdṛptau tadā bhārgavahaihayau /
cakraturyaddhamatulaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam //
meaning:
तावुभौरणसंदृप्तौ तदा भार्गवहैहयौ /
चक्रतुर्यद्धमतुलं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् //
text_mt: Then both the Bhārgava and the Haihaya, proud in battle, / fought an incomparable and tumultuous battle that made the hair stand on end.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāstraṃ ca sabhūpālaḥ saṃdadhe raṇamūrddhani /
vadhāya bhārgavendrasya sarvaśastrāstradhṛgabalī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मास्त्रं च सभूपालः संदधे रणमूर्द्धनि /
वधाय भार्गवेन्द्रस्य सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रधृगबली //
text_mt: The mighty king, who wielded all weapons and missiles, / fixed the brahmāstra at the head of the battle for the slaughter of the chief of the Bhārgavas.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi vāryupaspṛśya brahmaṃ brāhmaya saṃdadhe /
tato vyomni sadā sakte dve cāpya stre narādhipa //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि वार्युपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मं ब्राह्मय संदधे /
ततो व्योम्नि सदा सक्ते द्वे चाप्य स्त्रे नराधिप //
text_mt: Rāma also, having touched water, fixed the brahmāstra against the brahmāstra. / Then, O lord of men, both missiles remained locked in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhāte jagatprānte tejasā jvalanārkavat /
trayo lokāḥ sapātālā dṛṣṭvā tanmahadadbhutam //
meaning:
ववृधाते जगत्प्रान्ते तेजसा ज्वलनार्कवत् /
त्रयो लोकाः सपाताला दृष्ट्वा तन्महदद्भुतम् //
text_mt: and swelled at the ends of the universe with brilliance like blazing suns. / Seeing that great marvel, the three worlds together with the netherworld,

sanskrit_iast:
jvaladastrayugaṃ taptā menire 'syopasaṃyamam /
rāmastadā vīkṣya jagatpraṇāśaṃ jagannivāsoktamathāsmarattadā //
meaning:
ज्वलदस्त्रयुगं तप्ता मेनिरे ऽस्योपसंयमम् /
रामस्तदा वीक्ष्य जगत्प्रणाशं जगन्निवासोक्तमथास्मरत्तदा //
text_mt: scorched by the pair of blazing missiles, considered it their dissolution. / Seeing then the destruction of the world, Rāma remembered what had been spoken by the Abode of the Universe:

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣā vidheyādya mayāsya saṃyamo nivāraṇīyaḥ paramāṃśadhāriṇā /
iti vyavasya prabhurugratejā netradvayenātha tadastrayugamam //
meaning:
रक्षा विधेयाद्य मयास्य संयमो निवारणीयः परमांशधारिणा /
इति व्यवस्य प्रभुरुग्रतेजा नेत्रद्वयेनाथ तदस्त्रयुगमम् //
text_mt: "Protection must be offered by me today; its destruction must be averted by [me] bearing the supreme portion." / Deciding thus, the lord of terrible majesty then, with his pair of eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvātirāmaṃ jagadākalayya tasthau kṣaṇaṃ dhyānagato mahātmā /
dhyānaprabhāveṇa tatastu tasya brahmāstrayugmaṃ vigataprabhāvam //
meaning:
पीत्वातिरामं जगदाकलय्य तस्थौ क्षणं ध्यानगतो महात्मा /
ध्यानप्रभावेण ततस्तु तस्य ब्रह्मास्त्रयुग्मं विगतप्रभावम् //
text_mt: drank in that pair of missiles, and, embracing the universe, the great-souled one stood for a moment absorbed in meditation. / Then, by the power of his meditation, the pair of brahmāstras lost their splendor

sanskrit_iast:
papāta bhūmau sahasātha tatkṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsvāsthyamupājagāma /
sa jāmadagnyo mahātāṃ mahīyānsraṣṭuṃ tathā pālayituṃ nihantum //
meaning:
पपात भूमौ सहसाथ तत्क्षणं सर्वं जगत्स्वास्थ्यमुपाजगाम /
स जामदग्न्यो महातां महीयान्स्रष्टुं तथा पालयितुं निहन्तुम् //
text_mt: and suddenly fell to the earth that instant, and the entire world attained peace. / That Jāmadagnya, greater than the great, is competent to create, to preserve, and to destroy;

sanskrit_iast:
vibhustathāpīha nijaṃprabhāvaṃ gopāyituṃ lokavidhiṃ cakāra /
dhanurddharaḥ śūratamo mahasvānsadagraṇīḥ saṃsadi tathyavaktā //
meaning:
विभुस्तथापीह निजंप्रभावं गोपायितुं लोकविधिं चकार /
धनुर्द्धरः शूरतमो महस्वान्सदग्रणीः संसदि तथ्यवक्ता //
text_mt: all-pervading though he is, in order to conceal his own power he observed worldly conduct here. / An archer, the bravest of heroes, glorious, foremost of the virtuous, a speaker of truth in the assembly,

sanskrit_iast:
kalākalāpeṣu kṛtaprayatno vidyāsu śāstreṣu budho vidhijñaḥ /
evaṃ nṛloke prathayansvabhāvaṃ sarvāṇi kalyāni karoti nityam //
meaning:
कलाकलापेषु कृतप्रयत्नो विद्यासु शास्त्रेषु बुधो विधिज्ञः /
एवं नृलोके प्रथयन्स्वभावं सर्वाणि कल्यानि करोति नित्यम् //
text_mt: proficient in the whole range of arts, wise in the branches of knowledge and scriptures, knower of rules— / manifesting such a nature in the world of men, he always accomplishes all auspicious deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tu lokā vijitāstu tena rāmeṇa rājanyaniṣūdanena /
evaṃ sa rāmaḥ prathitaprabhāvaḥ praśāmayitvā tu tadastrayugmam //
meaning:
सर्वे तु लोका विजितास्तु तेन रामेण राजन्यनिषूदनेन /
एवं स रामः प्रथितप्रभावः प्रशामयित्वा तु तदस्त्रयुग्मम् //
text_mt: Indeed, all the worlds were conquered by that Rāma, the destroyer of kṣatriyas. / Thus that Rāma of renowned power, having appeased that pair of missiles,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ pravṛtto nidhanaṃ prakartuṃ raṇāgaṇe haihayavaṃśaketoḥ /
tuṇīrataḥ patriyugaṃ gṛhītvā puṅkhe nidhāyātha dhanurjyakāyām //
meaning:
पुनः प्रवृत्तो निधनं प्रकर्तुं रणागणे हैहयवंशकेतोः /
तुणीरतः पत्रियुगं गृहीत्वा पुङ्खे निधायाथ धनुर्ज्यकायाम् //
text_mt: proceeded once again to bring about the death of the banner of the Haihaya race on the battleground. / Taking a pair of feathered arrows from his quiver and placing them at the notch on his bowstring,

sanskrit_iast:
ālakṣya lakṣyaṃ nṛpakarṇayugmaṃ cakartta cūḍāmaṇihartukāmaḥ /
sa kṛttakarṇo nṛpatirmahātmā vinirjitāśeṣajagatpravīraḥ //
meaning:
आलक्ष्य लक्ष्यं नृपकर्णयुग्मं चकर्त्त चूडामणिहर्तुकामः /
स कृत्तकर्णो नृपतिर्महात्मा विनिर्जिताशेषजगत्प्रवीरः //
text_mt: aiming at the target, the king's pair of ears, he sliced them off, desiring to seize his crest-jewel. / That great-souled monarch, who had conquered all the heroes of the universe, with his ears severed,

sanskrit_iast:
mene nijaṃ vīryamiha praṇaṣṭaṃ rāmeṇa bhūmīśatiraskṛtātmā /
kṣaṇaṃ dharādhīśatanurvivarṇā gatānubhāvā nṛpaterbabhūva //
meaning:
मेने निजं वीर्यमिह प्रणष्टं रामेण भूमीशतिरस्कृतात्मा /
क्षणं धराधीशतनुर्विवर्णा गतानुभावा नृपतेर्बभूव //
text_mt: felt that his own valor was lost here, his soul humiliated by the king of the earth [Rāma]. / For a moment, the body of the ruler of the earth became pale, the king stripped of his majesty,

sanskrit_iast:
lekhyeva saccitrakaraprayuktā sudīnacittasya vilakṣyate 'ga /
tataḥ sa rājā nijavīryavaibhavaṃ samastalokādhikatāṃ prayātam //
meaning:
लेख्येव सच्चित्रकरप्रयुक्ता सुदीनचित्तस्य विलक्ष्यते ऽग /
ततः स राजा निजवीर्यवैभवं समस्तलोकाधिकतां प्रयातम् //
text_mt: appearing like a figure painted by a skilled artist, O mountain, with an exceedingly despondent mind. / Then that king, reflecting upon the majesty of his own valor which surpassed all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
vicintya paulastyajayādilabdhaṃ śocannivāsītsa jayābhikāṅkṣīṃ /
dadhyau punarmīlitalocano nṛpau dattaṃ tamātreyakulapradīpam //
meaning:
विचिन्त्य पौलस्त्यजयादिलब्धं शोचन्निवासीत्स जयाभिकाङ्क्षीं /
दध्यौ पुनर्मीलितलोचनो नृपौ दत्तं तमात्रेयकुलप्रदीपम् //
text_mt: obtained by his victory over the son of Pulastya and others, longing for victory, was as if in mourning. / With closed eyes, the king meditated again upon Datta, the illuminator of the race of Atri,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya prabhāvānugṛhīta ojasā tiraścakārā khilalokapālakān /
yadāsya hṛdyeṣa mahānubhāvo dattaḥ prayāto na hi darśanaṃ tadā //
meaning:
यस्य प्रभावानुगृहीत ओजसा तिरश्चकारा खिललोकपालकान् /
यदास्य हृद्येष महानुभावो दत्तः प्रयातो न हि दर्शनं तदा //
text_mt: favored by whose power he had formerly eclipsed all the guardians of the world with his vigor. / When this high-minded Datta did not appear in his heart,

sanskrit_iast:
khinno 'timātraṃ dharaṇīpatistadā punaḥ punardhyānapathaṃ jagāma /
sa dhyāyamāno 'pi na cājagāma datto manogocaramasya rājan //
meaning:
खिन्नो ऽतिमात्रं धरणीपतिस्तदा पुनः पुनर्ध्यानपथं जगाम /
स ध्यायमानो ऽपि न चाजगाम दत्तो मनोगोचरमस्य राजन् //
text_mt: the ruler of the earth, exceedingly afflicted, entered the path of meditation again and again. / Yet even though meditated upon, Datta did not come into the range of his mind, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasvino dāntatamasya sādhoranāgaso duṣkṛtikāriṇo vibhuḥ /
evaṃ yadātrestanayo mahātmā dṛṣṭo na ca dhyānapathe nṛpeṇa //
meaning:
तपस्विनो दान्ततमस्य साधोरनागसो दुष्कृतिकारिणो विभुः /
एवं यदात्रेस्तनयो महात्मा दृष्टो न च ध्यानपथे नृपेण //
text_mt: For an ascetic, most restrained, virtuous, and blameless [he was], whereas the lord [Kārttavīrya] was a perpetrator of evil deeds. / When the great-souled son of Atri was thus not seen by the king in the path of meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
tadātiduḥ khena vidūyamānaḥ śokena mohena yuto babhūva /
taṃ śokamagnaṃ nṛpatiṃ mahātmā rāmo jagādākhilacittadarśī //
meaning:
तदातिदुः खेन विदूयमानः शोकेन मोहेन युतो बभूव /
तं शोकमग्नं नृपतिं महात्मा रामो जगादाखिलचित्तदर्शी //
text_mt: he was then tormented by immense pain and overcome with grief and delusion. / To that king plunged in grief, the great-souled Rāma, who perceives the minds of all, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
mā śokabhāvaṃ nṛpate prayāhi naivānuśocanti mahānubhāvāḥ /
yaste varāyābhavamādisarge sa eva cāhaṃ taṃva sādanāya //
meaning:
मा शोकभावं नृपते प्रयाहि नैवानुशोचन्ति महानुभावाः /
यस्ते वरायाभवमादिसर्गे स एव चाहं तंव सादनाय //
text_mt: "Do not enter into a state of grief, O king; the magnanimous do not lament. / I who appeared in the primary creation to grant you a boon am that very one come for your destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
samāgatastvaṃ bhavadhīracittaḥ saṃgrāmakāle na viṣādacarcā /
sarvo hi lokaḥ svakṛtaṃ bhunakti śubhāśubhaṃ daivakṛtaṃ vipāke //
meaning:
समागतस्त्वं भवधीरचित्तः संग्रामकाले न विषादचर्चा /
सर्वो हि लोकः स्वकृतं भुनक्ति शुभाशुभं दैवकृतं विपाके //
text_mt: You have arrived here; be firm in mind. At the time of battle, there should be no discussion of dejection. / For all creatures enjoy the fruits of their own actions, good and bad, brought about by destiny in their fruition.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonako 'pyasya śubhāśubhasya viparyayaṃ kartumalaṃ nareśa /
yatte supuṇyaṃ bahujanmasaṃcitaṃ teneha dattasya varārhapātram //
meaning:
अन्योनको ऽप्यस्य शुभाशुभस्य विपर्ययं कर्तुमलं नरेश /
यत्ते सुपुण्यं बहुजन्मसंचितं तेनेह दत्तस्य वरार्हपात्रम् //
text_mt: No one else is capable of reversing this good and bad, O lord of men. / Because of the great merit accumulated by you over many births, you became here a worthy recipient of Datta's boon;

sanskrit_iast:
jāto bhavānadya tu duṣkṛtasya phalaṃ prabhuṅkṣva tvamihārjitasya /
gururvimatyāpakṛtastvayā me yatastataḥ karṇanikṛntanaṃ te //
meaning:
जातो भवानद्य तु दुष्कृतस्य फलं प्रभुङ्क्ष्व त्वमिहार्जितस्य /
गुरुर्विमत्यापकृतस्त्वया मे यतस्ततः कर्णनिकृन्तनं ते //
text_mt: today, however, enjoy the fruit of the evil deed accrued by you here. / Because my preceptor was harmed by you through foolishness, your ears were sliced off

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaṃ mayā paśya harantamojasā cūḍāmaṇiṃ māmapatdṛtya te yaśaḥ /
ityevamuktvā sa bhṛgurmahātmā niyojya bāṇaṃ ca vikṛṣya cāpam //
meaning:
कृतं मया पश्य हरन्तमोजसा चूडामणिं मामपत्दृत्य ते यशः /
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स भृगुर्महात्मा नियोज्य बाणं च विकृष्य चापम् //
text_mt: by me. Behold me stripping away your fame by taking your crest-jewel with my might!" / Having spoken thus, that great-souled Bhṛgu, fixing an arrow and drawing his bow,

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa rājñaḥ sa tu lāghavena cchittvā maṇiṃ rāmamamupājagāma /
tadvīkṣya karmāsya muneḥ sutasya sa cārjuno haihayavaṃśadharttā //
meaning:
चिक्षेप राज्ञः स तु लाघवेन च्छित्त्वा मणिं रामममुपाजगाम /
तद्वीक्ष्य कर्मास्य मुनेः सुतस्य स चार्जुनो हैहयवंशधर्त्ता //
text_mt: shot it with dexterity; and having cut off the jewel of the king, it returned to Rāma. / Beholding that deed of the sage's son, Arjuna, the supporter of the Haihaya race,

sanskrit_iast:
samudyato 'bhūtpunarapyudāyudhastaṃ hantumājau dvijamātmaśatrum /
śūlaśaktigadācakrakhaḍhgapaṭṭiśatomaraiḥ //
meaning:
समुद्यतो ऽभूत्पुनरप्युदायुधस्तं हन्तुमाजौ द्विजमात्मशत्रुम् /
शूलशक्तिगदाचक्रखढ्गपट्टिशतोमरैः //
text_mt: stood ready once again with weapons raised to kill that twice-born enemy in battle, / with tridents, spears, maces, discs, swords, paṭṭiśas, and javelins,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāpraharaṇaiścānyairājaghāna dvijātmajam /
sa rāmo lāghavenaiva saṃprakṣiptānyanena ca //
meaning:
नानाप्रहरणैश्चान्यैराजघान द्विजात्मजम् /
स रामो लाघवेनैव संप्रक्षिप्तान्यनेन च //
text_mt: and struck the son of the twice-born with various other weapons. / But Rāma, with great agility, cut down in mid-air with his swift arrows

sanskrit_iast:
śūlādīni cakarttāśu madhya eva nijāśugaiḥ /
sa rājā vāryupaspṛśya sasarjāgneyamuttamam //
meaning:
शूलादीनि चकर्त्ताशु मध्य एव निजाशुगैः /
स राजा वार्युपस्पृश्य ससर्जाग्नेयमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: the tridents and other weapons hurled by him. / The king, having touched water, discharged the supreme fiery missile.

sanskrit_iast:
astraṃ rāmo vāruṇena śamayāmāsa satvaram /
gāndharvaṃ vidadhe rājā vāyavyenāhanadvibhum //
meaning:
अस्त्रं रामो वारुणेन शमयामास सत्वरम् /
गान्धर्वं विदधे राजा वायव्येनाहनद्विभुम् //
text_mt: Rāma quickly pacified that missile with a water missile. / The king discharged the gāndharva weapon, and struck the lord with the vāyavya weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgāstraṃ gāruḍenāpi rāmaściccheda bhūpate /
dattena dattaṃ yacchūlamavyarthaṃ mantrapūrvakam //
meaning:
नागास्त्रं गारुडेनापि रामश्चिच्छेद भूपते /
दत्तेन दत्तं यच्छूलमव्यर्थं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: Rāma also cut down the serpentine missile with the Gāruḍa missile, O king. / Then the trident, given by Datta with mantras, which was infallible,

sanskrit_iast:
jagrāha samare rājā bhārgavasya vadhāya ca /
tacchūlaṃ śatasūryābhamanivāryaṃ surāsuraiḥ //
meaning:
जग्राह समरे राजा भार्गवस्य वधाय च /
तच्छूलं शतसूर्याभमनिवार्यं सुरासुरैः //
text_mt: The king seized in battle for the slaying of the Bhārgava. / That trident, radiant as a hundred suns and irresistible even to gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣepa rāmamuddiśya samagreṇa balena saḥ /
mūrdhni tadbhārgavasyātha nipapāta mahīpate //
meaning:
चिक्षेप राममुद्दिश्य समग्रेण बलेन सः /
मूर्ध्नि तद्भार्गवस्याथ निपपात महीपते //
text_mt: He hurled aiming at Rāma with all his might. / Then it fell, O king, upon the head of that Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
tena śūlaprahāreṇa vyathito bhārgavastadā /
mūrcchāmavāpa rājendra papāta ca hariṃ smaran //
meaning:
तेन शूलप्रहारेण व्यथितो भार्गवस्तदा /
मूर्च्छामवाप राजेन्द्र पपात च हरिं स्मरन् //
text_mt: Agonized then by that blow of the trident, the Bhārgava / fell into a faint, O king of kings, and dropped down remembering Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
patite bhārgave tatra sarve devā bhayākulāḥ /
samājagmuḥ puraskṛtya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān //
meaning:
पतिते भार्गवे तत्र सर्वे देवा भयाकुलाः /
समाजग्मुः पुरस्कृत्य ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान् //
text_mt: When the Bhārgava had fallen there, all the gods, overcome with fear, / assembled, placing Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara at their head.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkarastu mahājñānī sākṣānmṛtyuñjayaḥ prabhuḥ /
bhārgavaṃ jīvayāmāsa saṃjīvanyā sa vidyayā //
meaning:
शङ्करस्तु महाज्ञानी साक्षान्मृत्युञ्जयः प्रभुः /
भार्गवं जीवयामास संजीवन्या स विद्यया //
text_mt: Then Śaṅkara, the lord possessing great knowledge and the visible conqueror of death, / revived the Bhārgava with the saṃjīvanī lore.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmastu cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśa purataḥ surān /
praṇanāma ca rājendra bhaktyā brahmādikāṃstu tān //
meaning:
रामस्तु चेतनां प्राप्य ददर्श पुरतः सुरान् /
प्रणनाम च राजेन्द्र भक्त्या ब्रह्मादिकांस्तु तान् //
text_mt: Having regained consciousness, Rāma beheld the gods before him, / and he bowed down in devotion, O best of kings, to those [gods] beginning with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
te stutā bhārgavendreṇa sadyo 'darśanamāgatāḥ /
sa rāmo vāryuspṛśya jajāpa kavacaṃ tu tat //
meaning:
ते स्तुता भार्गवेन्द्रेण सद्यो ऽदर्शनमागताः /
स रामो वार्युस्पृश्य जजाप कवचं तु तत् //
text_mt: Praised by the chief of Bhārgavas, they instantly vanished from sight. / Touching water, that Rāma then chanted that armor [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
utthitaśca susaṃrabdho nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā /
smṛtvā pāśupataṃ cāstraṃ śivadattaṃ sa bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
उत्थितश्च सुसंरब्धो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा /
स्मृत्वा पाशुपतं चास्त्रं शिवदत्तं स भार्गवः //
text_mt: He stood up highly enraged, burning as it were with his eyes; / remembering the Pāśupata missile given by Śiva, that Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
sadyaḥ saṃhṛtavāṃstattu kārttavīryaṃ mahābalam /
sa rājā dattabhaktastu viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam /
praviṣṭo bhasmasājjātaṃ śarīraṃ bāhunandana //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite kārttavīryavadho nāma catvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 40//
meaning:
सद्यः संहृतवांस्तत्तु कार्त्तवीर्यं महाबलम् /
स राजा दत्तभक्तस्तु विष्णोश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् /
प्रविष्टो भस्मसाज्जातं शरीरं बाहुनन्दन //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते कार्त्तवीर्यवधो नाम चत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 40//
text_mt:
Instantly destroyed that mighty Kārttavīrya with it. / That king, devoted to Datta, entered the Sudarśana cakra of Viṣṇu, / [and his] body was turned to ashes, O son of Bāhu.

Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'The Slaying of Kārttavīrya', in the account of the Bhārgava, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle section proclaimed by Vāyu, in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
dṛṣṭvā piturvadhaṃ ghoraṃ tatputrāste śataṃ tvarā /
vārayāmāsuratyugraṃ bhārgavaṃ svabaleḥ pṛthak //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
दृष्ट्वा पितुर्वधं घोरं तत्पुत्रास्ते शतं त्वरा /
वारयामासुरत्युग्रं भार्गवं स्वबलेः पृथक् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Seeing the terrible slaying of their father, his hundred sons in haste / individually checked the extremely fierce Bhārgava with their own forces.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikākṣaihiṇīyuktāḥ sarve te yuddhadurmadāḥ /
saṃgrāmaṃ tumulaṃ cakruḥ saṃrabdhāstu piturvadhāt //
meaning:
एकैकाक्षैहिणीयुक्ताः सर्वे ते युद्धदुर्मदाः /
संग्रामं तुमुलं चक्रुः संरब्धास्तु पितुर्वधात् //
text_mt: Accompanied each by an akṣauhiṇī, all of them maddened with war, / infuriated by the death of their father, waged a tumultuous battle.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmastu dṛṣṭvā tatputrāñchūrānraṇaviśāradān /
paraśvadhaṃ samādāya yuyudhe taiśca saṃgare //
meaning:
रामस्तु दृष्ट्वा तत्पुत्राञ्छूरान्रणविशारदान् /
परश्वधं समादाय युयुधे तैश्च संगरे //
text_mt: Beholding his sons, valiant and skilled in battle, / Rāma took up his battle-axe and fought with them in combat.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ senāṃ bhagavānrāmaḥ śatākṣauhiṇisaṃmitām /
nijaghāna tvarāyukto muhurttadvayamātrataḥ //
meaning:
तां सेनां भगवान्रामः शताक्षौहिणिसंमिताम् /
निजघान त्वरायुक्तो मुहुर्त्तद्वयमात्रतः //
text_mt: The blessed Rāma swiftly struck down that army, / measured at a hundred akṣauhiṇīs, in merely two muhūrtas.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśeṣitaṃ svasainyaṃ tu kuṭhāreṇaiva līlayā /
dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa tesarve yuyudhurvīryasaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
निःशेषितं स्वसैन्यं तु कुठारेणैव लीलया /
दृष्ट्वा रामेण तेसर्वे युयुधुर्वीर्यसंमताः //
text_mt: Seeing their own army completely annihilated / with his battle-axe as if in sport by Rāma, all of them fought, proud of their prowess.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhāni divyāni praharanto mahojasaḥ /
parito maṇḍalaṃ cakrurbhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि प्रहरन्तो महोजसः /
परितो मण्डलं चक्रुर्भार्गवस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: Striking with various divine weapons, those of great splendor / formed a circle around the great-souled Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rāmo 'pi balavāṃsteṣāṃ maṇḍalamadhyagaḥ /
vireje bhagavānsākṣādyathā nābhistu cakragā //
meaning:
अथ रामो ऽपि बलवांस्तेषां मण्डलमध्यगः /
विरेजे भगवान्साक्षाद्यथा नाभिस्तु चक्रगा //
text_mt: Then the powerful Rāma too, standing in the middle of their circle, / shone like the lord himself, like the hub of a wheel.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyannivācau virarāja rāmaḥ śataṃ punaste parito bhramantaḥ /
rejuśca gopī gaṇamadhyasaṃsthaḥ kṛṣṇo yathā tāḥ parito bhramantyaḥ //
meaning:
नृत्यन्निवाचौ विरराज रामः शतं पुनस्ते परितो भ्रमन्तः /
रेजुश्च गोपी गणमध्यसंस्थः कृष्णो यथा ताः परितो भ्रमन्त्यः //
text_mt: Rāma shone in battle as if dancing; moreover, those hundred, revolving around him, / shone as the cowherd women revolving around Kṛṣṇa when he stood in their midst.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tu sarve druhiṇapradhānāḥ samāgatāḥ svasvavimānasaṃsthāḥ /
samākirannandanamālyavarṣaiḥ samantato rāmamahīnavīryam //
meaning:
तदा तु सर्वे द्रुहिणप्रधानाः समागताः स्वस्वविमानसंस्थाः /
समाकिरन्नन्दनमाल्यवर्षैः समन्ततो राममहीनवीर्यम् //
text_mt: Then indeed all [the gods] headed by Druhiṇa, mounted upon their respective aerial chariots, / showered from all sides rains of garlands from the Nandana [grove] upon Rāma of unflagging valor.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ śastrapādādudatiṣṭhata dhvanir huṃkāragarbho divamaspṛśansa vai /
tauryatrikasyeva śarakṣatāni bhāntīva yadvannakhadantapātāḥ //
meaning:
यः शस्त्रपादादुदतिष्ठत ध्वनिर् हुंकारगर्भो दिवमस्पृशन्स वै /
तौर्यत्रिकस्येव शरक्षतानि भान्तीव यद्वन्नखदन्तपाताः //
text_mt: The sound that arose from the fall of weapons, filled with roarings, touched heaven; / the wounds from arrows shone like marks of nails and teeth, as if in a dramatic performance of music, song, and dance.

sanskrit_iast:
krandanti śastraiḥ kṣatavikṣatāṅgā gāyanti yadvatkila gītavijñāḥ /
evaṃ pravṛttaṃ nṛpayuddhamaṇḍalaṃ paśyanti devā bhṛśavismitākṣaḥ //
meaning:
क्रन्दन्ति शस्त्रैः क्षतविक्षताङ्गा गायन्ति यद्वत्किल गीतविज्ञाः /
एवं प्रवृत्तं नृपयुद्धमण्डलं पश्यन्ति देवा भृशविस्मिताक्षः //
text_mt: Those whose limbs were wounded and torn by weapons cried out, truly like experts in music singing; / the gods, with eyes full of astonishment, watched the battle circle of the kings thus underway.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu rāmo 'vanipālaputrāñjighāṃsurājau vividhāstrapūgaiḥ /
pṛthakcakārātiba lāṃstu maṇḍaladvicchidya paṅktiṃ prabhurāttacāpaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु रामो ऽवनिपालपुत्राञ्जिघांसुराजौ विविधास्त्रपूगैः /
पृथक्चकारातिब लांस्तु मण्डलद्विच्छिद्य पङ्क्तिं प्रभुरात्तचापः //
text_mt: Then Rāma, desirous of slaying the sons of the king in battle with masses of diverse weapons, / the lord having taken up his bow, broke their line and separated the exceedingly powerful ones from the circle.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaśastānnijaghāna vīrāñchataṃ tadā pañca tataḥ palāyitāḥ /
śūro vṛṣāsyo vṛṣaśūrasenau jayadhvajaścāpi vibhinnadhairyāḥ //
meaning:
एकैकशस्तान्निजघान वीराञ्छतं तदा पञ्च ततः पलायिताः /
शूरो वृषास्यो वृषशूरसेनौ जयध्वजश्चापि विभिन्नधैर्याः //
text_mt: One by one he struck down those valiant hundred; then five fled: / Śūra, Vṛṣāsya, Vṛṣa, Śūrasena, / and Jayadhvaja, their courage shattered.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhayenātha parītacitā himādripādāntarakānanaṃ ca /
pṛthaggatāste suparīpsavo nṛpā na ko 'pi kāṃsviddadṛśe bhṛśārttaḥ //
meaning:
महाभयेनाथ परीतचिता हिमाद्रिपादान्तरकाननं च /
पृथग्गतास्ते सुपरीप्सवो नृपा न को ऽपि कांस्विद्ददृशे भृशार्त्तः //
text_mt: Their minds seized with great fear, into the interior forests at the foot of the Himālaya / those kings went separately, longing to save their lives; sorely afflicted, none of them saw anyone else.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi hatvā nṛpacakramājau rājñaḥ sahāyarthamupāgataṃ ca /
samanvito 'sāvakṛtavraṇena sasnau mudāgatya ca narmadāyām //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि हत्वा नृपचक्रमाजौ राज्ञः सहायर्थमुपागतं च /
समन्वितो ऽसावकृतव्रणेन सस्नौ मुदागत्य च नर्मदायाम् //
text_mt: Rāma too, having slain in battle the circle of kings who had arrived to aid the king, / accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, went in joy and bathed in the Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
srātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam /
pratasthe draṣṭumurvīśa śivaṃ kailāsavāsinam //
meaning:
स्रात्वा नित्यक्रियां कृत्वा संपूज्य वृषभध्वजम् /
प्रतस्थे द्रष्टुमुर्वीश शिवं कैलासवासिनम् //
text_mt: Having bathed, performed his daily rites, and worshipped the bull-bannered [god], / he set out, O lord of the earth, to see Śiva, who dwells on Kailāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
gurupatnīmumāṃ cāpi sutau skandavināyakau /
manoyāyī mahātmāsāvakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
गुरुपत्नीमुमां चापि सुतौ स्कन्दविनायकौ /
मनोयायी महात्मासावकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt: And the guru's wife, Umā, and their two sons, Skanda and Vināyaka. / That great-souled one, traveling with the speed of thought together with Akṛtavraṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakāryo mudā yuktaḥ kailāsaṃ prāpya tatkṣaṇam /
dadarśa tatra nagarīṃ mahatīmalakābhidham //
meaning:
कृतकार्यो मुदा युक्तः कैलासं प्राप्य तत्क्षणम् /
ददर्श तत्र नगरीं महतीमलकाभिधम् //
text_mt: Having accomplished his task and filled with joy, reached Kailāsa that very moment, / and there beheld the great city named Alakā,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇabhavanairupaśobhitām /
nānārupadharairyakṣaiḥ śobhitāṃ citrabhūṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
नानामणिगणाकीर्णभवनैरुपशोभिताम् /
नानारुपधरैर्यक्षैः शोभितां चित्रभूषणैः //
text_mt: Adorned with mansions crowded with various collections of gems, / beautified by Yakṣas bearing diverse forms and wearing variegated ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvṛkṣasamākīṇairvanaiścopavanairyutām /
dīrghikābhiḥ sudīrghābhistaḍāgaiścopaśobhitām //
meaning:
नानावृक्षसमाकीणैर्वनैश्चोपवनैर्युताम् /
दीर्घिकाभिः सुदीर्घाभिस्तडागैश्चोपशोभिताम् //
text_mt: Provided with groves and gardens filled with diverse trees, / and adorned with very long oblong lakes and ponds,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato 'pyāvṛtāṃ bāhye sītayālakanandayā /
tatra devāṅganāsnānamuktakuṅkumapiñjaram //
meaning:
सर्वतो ऽप्यावृतां बाह्ये सीतयालकनन्दया /
तत्र देवाङ्गनास्नानमुक्तकुङ्कुमपिञ्जरम् //
text_mt: Surrounded on the outside on all sides by the cool Alakanandā, / which was yellow with saffron left from the bathing of celestial women there,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣāvira hitāścāṃbhaḥ pibanti kariṇo mudā /
yatra saṃgītasaṃnādā śrūyante tatratatra ha //
meaning:
तृषाविर हिताश्चांभः पिबन्ति करिणो मुदा /
यत्र संगीतसंनादा श्रूयन्ते तत्रतत्र ह //
text_mt: And where elephants, freed from thirst, drank water joyfully, / where the resonances of music were heard here and there,

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvairapsarobhiśca satataṃ sahakāribhiḥ /
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārgavo rājanmudā paramayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सततं सहकारिभिः /
तां दृष्ट्वा भार्गवो राजन्मुदा परमया युतः //
text_mt: Accompanied constantly by Gandharvas and Apsarases. / Beholding it, the Bhārgava, O king, filled with supreme joy,

sanskrit_iast:
yayau tadūrdhvaṃ śikharaṃ yatra śevaparaṃ gṛham /
tato dadarśa rājendra snigdhacchāyaṃ mahāvaṭam //
meaning:
ययौ तदूर्ध्वं शिखरं यत्र शेवपरं गृहम् /
ततो ददर्श राजेन्द्र स्निग्धच्छायं महावटम् //
text_mt: Ascended to the peak above it, where the supreme abode of Śiva was. / Then he beheld, O king of kings, a great banyan tree of pleasant shade;

sanskrit_iast:
tasyādhastādvarāvāsaṃ susevyaṃ siddhasaṃyutam /
dadarṃśa tatra prākāraṃ śatayojanamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
तस्याधस्ताद्वरावासं सुसेव्यं सिद्धसंयुतम् /
ददर्ंश तत्र प्राकारं शतयोजनमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Beneath it was an excellent dwelling, easy to resort to, accompanied by Siddhas. / He beheld there an enclosure a hundred yojanas in circumference,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnācitaṃ ramyaṃ caturdvāraṃ gaṇāvṛtam /
nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ raktākṣaṃ vikaṭodaram //
meaning:
नानारत्नाचितं रम्यं चतुर्द्वारं गणावृतम् /
नन्दीश्वरं महाकालं रक्ताक्षं विकटोदरम् //
text_mt: Charming, studded with various gems, having four gates, and surrounded by the gaṇas: / Nandīśvara, Mahākāla, Raktākṣa, Vikaṭodara,

sanskrit_iast:
piṅgalākṣaṃ viśālākṣaṃ virūpākṣaṃ ghaṭodaram /
mandāraṃ bhairavaṃ bāṇaṃ ruruṃ bhairavameva ca //
meaning:
पिङ्गलाक्षं विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षं घटोदरम् /
मन्दारं भैरवं बाणं रुरुं भैरवमेव च //
text_mt: Piṅgalākṣa, Viśālākṣa, Virūpākṣa, Ghaṭodara, / Mandāra, Bhairava, Bāṇa, Ruru, and Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrakaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca caṇḍaṃ bhṛṅgiṃ riṭiṃ mukham /
siddhendranātharudrāṃśca vidyādharamahoragān //
meaning:
वीरकं वीरभद्रं च चण्डं भृङ्गिं रिटिं मुखम् /
सिद्धेन्द्रनाथरुद्रांश्च विद्याधरमहोरगान् //
text_mt: Vīraka, Vīrabhadra, Caṇḍa, Bhṛṅgin, and Riṭi at the head, / chiefs of Siddhas, Nāthas, and Rudras, Vidyādharas and great serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān /
vetālāndānavendrāṃśca yogīndrāṃśca jaṭādharān //
meaning:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचांश्च कूष्माण्डान्ब्रह्मराक्षसान् /
वेतालान्दानवेन्द्रांश्च योगीन्द्रांश्च जटाधरान् //
text_mt: Bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, kūṣmāṇḍas, brahmarākṣasas, / vetālas, chiefs of Dānavas, and foremost yogins with matted locks,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣakiṃpuruṣāṃścaiva ḍākinīyo ginīstathā /
dṛṣṭvā nandyā5yā tatra praviṣṭo 'ntarmudānvitaḥ //
meaning:
यक्षकिंपुरुषांश्चैव डाकिनीयो गिनीस्तथा /
दृष्ट्वा नन्द्या5या तत्र प्रविष्टो ऽन्तर्मुदान्वितः //
text_mt: Yakṣas, Kiṃpuruṣas, and likewise ḍākinīs and yoginīs. / Having seen [them], with the permission of Nandin he entered inside with joy;

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa tatra bhuvanairāvṛtaṃ śivamandiram /
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ tatra prāgdvārasaṃsthitau //
meaning:
ददर्श तत्र भुवनैरावृतं शिवमन्दिरम् /
चतुर्योजनविस्तीर्णं तत्र प्राग्द्वारसंस्थितौ //
text_mt: He beheld there Śiva's temple surrounded by worlds, / four yojanas in extent; there at the eastern gate stood

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā vāme kārttikeya dakṣa caiva vināyakam /
nanāma bhārgavastau dvau śivatulyaparākramau //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा वामे कार्त्तिकेय दक्ष चैव विनायकम् /
ननाम भार्गवस्तौ द्वौ शिवतुल्यपराक्रमौ //
text_mt: Seeing Kārttikeya on the left and Vināyaka on the right, / the Bhārgava bowed to those two whose prowess equaled Śiva's.

sanskrit_iast:
pārṣadapravarāstatra kṣetrapālāśca saṃsthitāḥ /
ratnasiṃhāsanasthāśca ratnabhūṣamabhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
पार्षदप्रवरास्तत्र क्षेत्रपालाश्च संस्थिताः /
रत्नसिंहासनस्थाश्च रत्नभूषमभूषिताः //
text_mt: The foremost attendants and Kṣetrapālas stood there, / seated upon jewel-studded thrones and adorned with jewel ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgavaṃ praviśantaṃ tu hyapṛcchañśivamandiram /
vināyako mahārāja kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhetyuvāca ha //
meaning:
भार्गवं प्रविशन्तं तु ह्यपृच्छञ्शिवमन्दिरम् /
विनायको महाराज क्षणं तिष्ठेत्युवाच ह //
text_mt: As the Bhārgava was entering Śiva's abode, they asked him, / and Vināyaka said, 'O great king, wait a moment!

sanskrit_iast:
nidrito hyumayā yukto mahādevo 'dhuneti ca /
īśvarājñāṃ gṛhītvāhamatrāgatyakṣaṇāntare //
meaning:
निद्रितो ह्युमया युक्तो महादेवो ऽधुनेति च /
ईश्वराज्ञां गृहीत्वाहमत्रागत्यक्षणान्तरे //
text_mt: Mahādeva is now asleep, accompanied by Umā. / Having received the Lord's command, I will return here in a moment,

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā sārddhaṃ pravekṣyāmi bhrātastiṣṭhātra sāṃpratam /
vināyakacaścaivaṃ śrutvā bhārgavanandanaḥ //
meaning:
त्वया सार्द्धं प्रवेक्ष्यामि भ्रातस्तिष्ठात्र सांप्रतम् /
विनायकचश्चैवं श्रुत्वा भार्गवनन्दनः //
text_mt: and then I will enter together with you. Brother, stay here for now.' / Hearing Vināyaka speak thus, the son of the Bhṛgus,

sanskrit_iast:
pravaktumupacakrāma gaṇeśaṃ tvarayānvitaḥ /
rāma uvāca
gatvā hyantaḥpuraṃ bhrātaḥ praṇamya jagadīśvarau //
meaning:
प्रवक्तुमुपचक्राम गणेशं त्वरयान्वितः /
राम उवाच
गत्वा ह्यन्तःपुरं भ्रातः प्रणम्य जगदीश्वरौ //
text_mt: hastening, began to address Gaṇeśa. / Rāma said: / 'Brother, having gone to the inner apartments and bowed to the two sovereigns of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatīśaṅkarau sadyo yāsyāmi nijamandiram /
kārttavīryaḥ sucandraśca saputrabalabāndhavaḥ //
meaning:
पार्वतीशङ्करौ सद्यो यास्यामि निजमन्दिरम् /
कार्त्तवीर्यः सुचन्द्रश्च सपुत्रबलबान्धवः //
text_mt: to Pārvatī and Śaṅkara, I will immediately go to my own abode. / Kārttavīrya and Sucandra, together with their sons, armies, and kinsmen,

sanskrit_iast:
anye sahasraśo bhūpāḥ kāṃbojāḥ paṅlavāḥ śākāḥ /
kānyakubjāḥ kośaleśā māyāvanto mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
अन्ये सहस्रशो भूपाः कांबोजाः पङ्लवाः शाकाः /
कान्यकुब्जाः कोशलेशा मायावन्तो महाबलाः //
text_mt: and thousands of other kings—Kāmbojas, Pahlavas, Śakas, / Kānyakubjas, and rulers of Kośala, full of deceit and possessed of great might—

sanskrit_iast:
nihatāḥ samare sarve mayā śaṃbhuprasādataḥ /
tamimaṃ praṇipatyaiva yāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati //
meaning:
निहताः समरे सर्वे मया शंभुप्रसादतः /
तमिमं प्रणिपत्यैव यास्यामि स्वगृहं प्रति //
text_mt: have all been slain in battle by me through the grace of Śambhu. / Having bowed down to him, I shall depart for my own home.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhārgavastatra tasthau gaṇapateḥ puraḥ /
provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhārgave sa gaṇādhipaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवस्तत्र तस्थौ गणपतेः पुरः /
प्रोवाच मधुरं वाक्यं भार्गवे स गणाधिपः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the Bhārgava stood there before the lord of the gaṇas. / That leader of the gaṇas spoke sweet words to the Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
vināyaka uvāca
jñaṇaṃ tiṣṭa mahābhāga darśanaṃ te bhaviṣyati /
adya viśveśvaro bhrātarbhavānyā saha varttate //
meaning:
विनायक उवाच
ज्ञणं तिष्ट महाभाग दर्शनं ते भविष्यति /
अद्य विश्वेश्वरो भ्रातर्भवान्या सह वर्त्तते //
