text_mt: Vināyaka said: / 'Wait a moment, O fortunate one, and you will have your audience. / Today the Lord of the Universe, O brother, is with Bhavānī.

sanskrit_iast:
strīpuṃsoryukta yostāta sahaikāsanasaṃsthayoḥ /
karoti sukhabhaṅgaṃ yo narakaṃ sa vrajeddhruvam //
meaning:
स्त्रीपुंसोर्युक्त योस्तात सहैकासनसंस्थयोः /
करोति सुखभङ्गं यो नरकं स व्रजेद्ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: A man who disrupts the pleasure of a man and a woman united together, / seated on the same couch, surely goes to hell.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatastu pitaraṃ guruṃ vā bhūpatiṃ dvijaḥ /
ra7syaṃ samupāsinaṃ na paśyediti niścayaḥ //
meaning:
विशेषतस्तु पितरं गुरुं वा भूपतिं द्विजः /
र7स्यं समुपासिनं न पश्येदिति निश्चयः //
text_mt: Especially a twice-born should never look upon his father, his teacher, or a king / sitting in secret; such is the settled rule.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmato 'kāmato vāpi paśyedyaḥ suratonmukham /
strīvicchedo bhavettasya dhruvaṃ saprasu janmasu //
meaning:
कामतो ऽकामतो वापि पश्येद्यः सुरतोन्मुखम् /
स्त्रीविच्छेदो भवेत्तस्य ध्रुवं सप्रसु जन्मसु //
text_mt: Whoever, intentionally or unintentionally, looks upon [them] intent upon sexual union, / will certainly suffer separation from his wife for seven births.

sanskrit_iast:
śroṇiṃ vakṣaḥ sthalaṃ vaktraṃ yaḥ paśyati parastriyaḥ /
māturvāpi bhaginyā vā duhituḥ sa narādhamaḥ //
meaning:
श्रोणिं वक्षः स्थलं वक्त्रं यः पश्यति परस्त्रियः /
मातुर्वापि भगिन्या वा दुहितुः स नराधमः //
text_mt: He who looks upon the hips, breasts, or face of another man's woman, / or of his mother, his sister, or his daughter, is the lowest of men.'

sanskrit_iast:
bhārgava uvāca
aho śrutamapūrvaṃ kiṃ vacanaṃ tava vaktrataḥ /
brāntyā vinirgataṃ vāpi hāsyārthamathavoditam //
meaning:
भार्गव उवाच
अहो श्रुतमपूर्वं किं वचनं तव वक्त्रतः /
ब्रान्त्या विनिर्गतं वापि हास्यार्थमथवोदितम् //
text_mt: The Bhārgava said: / 'Ah, what unprecedented words have been heard from your mouth! / Did they come forth through delusion, or were they spoken in jest?

sanskrit_iast:
kāmināṃ savikārāṇāmetacchāstranidarśanam /
nirvikārāsya ca śiśorna doṣaḥ kaścideva hi //
meaning:
कामिनां सविकाराणामेतच्छास्त्रनिदर्शनम् /
निर्विकारास्य च शिशोर्न दोषः कश्चिदेव हि //
text_mt: This teaching of the scriptures is for passionate men subject to change; / but for a child who is free from passion, there is no fault whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyāmyantaḥ puraṃ bhrātastava kiṃ tiṣṭha bālaka /
yathādṛṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmi tatra yatsamayocitam //
meaning:
यास्याम्यन्तः पुरं भ्रातस्तव किं तिष्ठ बालक /
यथादृष्टं करिष्यामि तत्र यत्समयोचितम् //
text_mt: I will enter the inner apartments, brother; what is that to you? Stay [here], boy! / Whatever is appropriate to the occasion there, that I will do as I see fit.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva mātā tātaśca tvayā nāma nirūpitau /
jagatāṃ pitarau tau ca pārvatīparameśvarau //
meaning:
तत्रैव माता तातश्च त्वया नाम निरूपितौ /
जगतां पितरौ तौ च पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ //
text_mt: Indeed, it was you who designated them mother and father; / and those two, Pārvatī and the Supreme Lord, are the parents of all the worlds.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhārgavo rājannantargantuṃ samudyataḥ /
vināyakastadotthāya vārayāmāsa satvaram //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भार्गवो राजन्नन्तर्गन्तुं समुद्यतः /
विनायकस्तदोत्थाय वारयामास सत्वरम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, O King, the Bhārgava prepared to enter within. / Then Vināyaka rose and swiftly barred his way.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgyuddhaṃ ca tayorāsīnmitho hastavikarṣaṇam /
dṛṣṭvā sakandastu saṃbhrānto bodhayāmāsa tau tadā //
meaning:
वाग्युद्धं च तयोरासीन्मिथो हस्तविकर्षणम् /
दृष्ट्वा सकन्दस्तु संभ्रान्तो बोधयामास तौ तदा //
text_mt: A war of words ensued between the two, and they dragged each other by the hand. / Seeing this, Skanda became agitated and then tried to dissuade them.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhubhyāṃ dvau samudgṛhya pṛthagutsāritau tathā /
atha kruddho gaṇeśāya bhārgavaḥ paravīrahā /
paraśvadhaṃ samādāya saprakṣeptuṃ samudyataḥ //
meaning:
बाहुभ्यां द्वौ समुद्गृह्य पृथगुत्सारितौ तथा /
अथ क्रुद्धो गणेशाय भार्गवः परवीरहा /
परश्वधं समादाय सप्रक्षेप्तुं समुद्यतः //
text_mt: Seizing both with his two arms, he pushed them apart. / Then the Bhārgava, slayer of enemy heroes, grew enraged at Gaṇeśa, / and taking up his battle-axe, he prepared to hurl it.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gajānano bhṛguvaraṃ krodhātkṣipantaṃ tvarā svātmārthaṃ paraśuṃ tadā nijakareṇoddhṛtya vegena tu /
bhūrlokaṃ bhuvaḥ svarapi tasyordhvaṃ maharvaijanaṃ lokaṃ cāpi tapo 'tha satyamaparaṃ vaikuṇṭhamapyānayat //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा गजाननो भृगुवरं क्रोधात्क्षिपन्तं त्वरा स्वात्मार्थं परशुं तदा निजकरेणोद्धृत्य वेगेन तु /
भूर्लोकं भुवः स्वरपि तस्योर्ध्वं महर्वैजनं लोकं चापि तपो ऽथ सत्यमपरं वैकुण्ठमप्यानयत् //
text_mt: Seeing the best of the Bhṛgus about to hurl the battle-axe in fury, the Elephant-Faced One swiftly lifted him with his own trunk for his own protection, and with great speed / brought him to the world of the earth, the midspace, heaven, and above that to Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and then to Satyaloka, and even to Vaikuṇṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyordhvaṃ ca vidarśayanbhṛguvaraṃ golokamīśātmajo niṣpātyādharalokasaptaka mapītthaṃ darśayāmāsa ca /
uddhṛtyātha tato hi garbhasalile prakṣaptamātraṃ tvarā bhītaṃ prāṇaparipsumānayadatho tatraiva yatrāsthitaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ekacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 41//
meaning:
तस्योर्ध्वं च विदर्शयन्भृगुवरं गोलोकमीशात्मजो निष्पात्याधरलोकसप्तक मपीत्थं दर्शयामास च /
उद्धृत्याथ ततो हि गर्भसलिले प्रक्षप्तमात्रं त्वरा भीतं प्राणपरिप्सुमानयदथो तत्रैव यत्रास्थितः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते एकचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 41//
text_mt:
And showing the best of the Bhṛgus the Goloka above that, the Lord's son hurled him down and likewise showed him the seven lower worlds; / and then, having lifted him up, as soon as he plunged him into the waters of the Cosmic Womb, he swiftly brought back the terrified man, who was longing to preserve his life, to the very place where he had stood.

Thus ends the forty-first chapter in the story of the Bhārgava in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ saṃbhrāmito rāmo gaṇādhīśena bhūpate /
harṣaśokasamāviṣṭo vicintyātmaparābhavam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं संभ्रामितो रामो गणाधीशेन भूपते /
हर्षशोकसमाविष्टो विचिन्त्यात्मपराभवम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having been thus spun around by the lord of the gaṇas, O king, / Rāma was filled with joy and sorrow, reflecting upon his own humiliation.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ cābhito vīkṣya nirvikāramavasthitam /
krodhāviṣṭo bhṛśaṃ bhūtvā prākṣipatsvaparaśvadham //
meaning:
गणेशं चाभितो वीक्ष्य निर्विकारमवस्थितम् /
क्रोधाविष्टो भृशं भूत्वा प्राक्षिपत्स्वपरश्वधम् //
text_mt: Seeing Gaṇeśa standing nearby, unaffected, / he was seized with violent rage and hurled his battle-axe.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśastvabhivīkṣyātha pitrā dattaṃ paraśvadham /
amoghaṃ karttukāmastu vāme taṃ daśane 'grahīt //
meaning:
गणेशस्त्वभिवीक्ष्याथ पित्रा दत्तं परश्वधम् /
अमोघं कर्त्तुकामस्तु वामे तं दशने ऽग्रहीत् //
text_mt: Gaṇeśa, seeing the battle-axe given by his father, / and wishing to make it not in vain, caught it with his left tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu dantaḥ kuṭhāreṇa vicchinno bhūtale 'patat /
bhuvi śoṇitasaṃdigdho vajrāhata ivācalaḥ //
meaning:
स तु दन्तः कुठारेण विच्छिन्नो भूतले ऽपतत् /
भुवि शोणितसंदिग्धो वज्राहत इवाचलः //
text_mt: That tusk, severed by the axe, fell upon the surface of the earth, / smeared with blood upon the ground, like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
dantapātena vidvastā sābdhidvīpadharā dharā /
cakaṃpe pṛthivīpāla lokāstrāsamupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
दन्तपातेन विद्वस्ता साब्धिद्वीपधरा धरा /
चकंपे पृथिवीपाल लोकास्त्रासमुपागताः //
text_mt: Shattered by the fall of the tusk, the earth with its oceans and continents / trembled, O protector of the earth, and the worlds fell into terror.

sanskrit_iast:
hāhākāro mahānāsī ddevānāṃ divi paśyatām /
kārttikeyādayastatra cukruśurbhṛśamāturāḥ //
meaning:
हाहाकारो महानासी द्देवानां दिवि पश्यताम् /
कार्त्तिकेयादयस्तत्र चुक्रुशुर्भृशमातुराः //
text_mt: A great cry of grief arose among the gods who were watching in heaven; / Kārttikeya and the others who were there cried out in deep distress.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kolāhalaṃ śrutvā dantapātadhvaniṃ tathā /
pārvatīśaṅkarau tatra samājagmaturīśvarau //
meaning:
अथ कोलाहलं श्रुत्वा दन्तपातध्वनिं तथा /
पार्वतीशङ्करौ तत्र समाजग्मतुरीश्वरौ //
text_mt: Then, hearing the commotion and the sound of the falling tusk, / the two sovereigns, Pārvatī and Śaṅkara, arrived there.

sanskrit_iast:
herambaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā vakratuṇḍaikadantinam /
papraccha skandaṃ pārvatī kimetaditi kāraṇam //
meaning:
हेरम्बं पुरतो दृष्ट्वा वक्रतुण्डैकदन्तिनम् /
पप्रच्छ स्कन्दं पार्वती किमेतदिति कारणम् //
text_mt: Seeing Heramba before her with his curved trunk and single tusk, / Pārvatī asked Skanda, 'What is the cause of this?'

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu pṛṣṭastadā mātrā senānīḥ sarvamāditaḥ /
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa mātre rāmasya śṛṇvataḥ //
meaning:
स तु पृष्टस्तदा मात्रा सेनानीः सर्वमादितः /
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास मात्रे रामस्य शृण्वतः //
text_mt: Questioned then by his mother, the commander of the army related the whole / affair from the beginning to his mother, while Rāma was listening.

sanskrit_iast:
sā śrutvodantamakhilaṃ jagatāṃ jananī nṛpa /
uvāca śaṅkaraṃ ruṣṭā pārvatī prāṇanāyakam //
meaning:
सा श्रुत्वोदन्तमखिलं जगतां जननी नृप /
उवाच शङ्करं रुष्टा पार्वती प्राणनायकम् //
text_mt: Having heard the whole account, O king, Pārvatī, the mother of the worlds, / was enraged and spoke to Śaṅkara, the lord of her life.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca
ayaṃ te bhārgavaḥ śaṃbho śiṣyaḥ putraḥ samo 'bhavat /
tvattolabdhvā paraṃ tejo varma trailokyajidvibho //
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच
अयं ते भार्गवः शंभो शिष्यः पुत्रः समो ऽभवत् /
त्वत्तोलब्ध्वा परं तेजो वर्म त्रैलोक्यजिद्विभो //
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / 'This Bhārgava, O Śambhu, was your disciple, equal to a son. / Having received from you supreme splendor and armor that conquers the three worlds, O omnipresent one,

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryārjunaṃ saṃkhye jitavānūrjitaṃ nṛpam /
svakāryaṃ sādhayitvā tu prādāttubhyaṃ ca dakṣiṇām //
meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्यार्जुनं संख्ये जितवानूर्जितं नृपम् /
स्वकार्यं साधयित्वा तु प्रादात्तुभ्यं च दक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: he defeated the mighty king Kārttavīryārjuna in battle. / Having accomplished his own purpose, he has offered you his fee of honor,

sanskrit_iast:
yatte sutasya daśana kuṭhāreṇa nyapātayat /
anenaiva kṛtārthastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यत्ते सुतस्य दशन कुठारेण न्यपातयत् /
अनेनैव कृतार्थस्त्वं भविष्यसि न संशयः //
text_mt: in that he struck down your son's tusk with an axe! / By this alone you will have attained your goal, there is no doubt!

sanskrit_iast:
tvamimaṃ bhārgavaṃ śambho rakṣāntevāsisattamam /
tava kāryāṇi sarvāṇi sādhayiṣyati sadguroḥ //
meaning:
त्वमिमं भार्गवं शम्भो रक्षान्तेवासिसत्तमम् /
तव कार्याणि सर्वाणि साधयिष्यति सद्गुरोः //
text_mt: Protect this Bhārgava, O Śambhu, this best of your disciples! / He will accomplish all the deeds of you, his true teacher!

sanskrit_iast:
aha naivātra tiṣṭhāmi yattvayā vimatā vibho /
putrābhyāṃ sahitā yāsye pituḥ svasya niketanam //
meaning:
अह नैवात्र तिष्ठामि यत्त्वया विमता विभो /
पुत्राभ्यां सहिता यास्ये पितुः स्वस्य निकेतनम् //
text_mt: I shall not stay here at all, since I have been disrespected by you, O Lord! / Accompanied by my two sons, I will go to my father's house.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃto bhujiṣyātanayaṃ satkurvantyātmaputravat /
bhavatā tu kṛtonaiva satkāro vacasāpi hi //
meaning:
संतो भुजिष्यातनयं सत्कुर्वन्त्यात्मपुत्रवत् /
भवता तु कृतोनैव सत्कारो वचसापि हि //
text_mt: Virtuous men honor even the son of a maidservant as their own son; / but by you, no honor was shown even with words

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanastanayasyāsya tato yāsyāmi duḥkhitā /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ pārvatyā bhagavānbhavaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मनस्तनयस्यास्य ततो यास्यामि दुःखिता /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं पार्वत्या भगवान्भवः //
text_mt: to your own son; therefore, aggrieved, I shall depart.' / Vasiṣṭha said: / Having heard these words of Pārvatī, the blessed Bhava

sanskrit_iast:
novāca kiñcidvacanaṃ sādhu vāsādhu bhūpate /
sasmāra manasā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇatakleśanāśanam //
meaning:
नोवाच किञ्चिद्वचनं साधु वासाधु भूपते /
सस्मार मनसा कृष्णं प्रणतक्लेशनाशनम् //
text_mt: did not say anything, whether good or bad, O king; / he remembered in his mind Kṛṣṇa, who destroys the affliction of those who bow before him.

sanskrit_iast:
golokanāthaṃ gopīśaṃ nānānunayakovidam /
smṛtamātro 'tha bhagavān keśavaḥ praṇatārttihā /
ājagāma dayāsiṃdhurbhaktavaśyo 'khileśvaraḥ //
meaning:
गोलोकनाथं गोपीशं नानानुनयकोविदम् /
स्मृतमात्रो ऽथ भगवान् केशवः प्रणतार्त्तिहा /
आजगाम दयासिंधुर्भक्तवश्यो ऽखिलेश्वरः //
text_mt: The lord of Goloka, the master of the cowherd maidens, skilled in various conciliations. / As soon as he was remembered, the blessed Keśava, who removes the distress of the surrendered, / an ocean of compassion, obedient to his devotees, the lord of all, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
meghaśyāmo viśadavadano ratnakeyūrahāro vidyudvāsā makarasadṛśe kuṇḍale saṃdadhānaḥ /
barhāpīḍaṃ maṇigaṇayutaṃ bibhradīṣatsmitāsyo gopīnātho gaditasuyaśāḥ kaustubhodbhāsivakṣāḥ //
meaning:
मेघश्यामो विशदवदनो रत्नकेयूरहारो विद्युद्वासा मकरसदृशे कुण्डले संदधानः /
बर्हापीडं मणिगणयुतं बिभ्रदीषत्स्मितास्यो गोपीनाथो गदितसुयशाः कौस्तुभोद्भासिवक्षाः //
text_mt:
Dark as a rain-cloud, with a bright countenance, wearing armlets of jewels and necklaces, clad in garments like lightning, bearing earrings shaped like makaras,
adorned with a crest of peacock feathers set with clusters of gems, his face slightly smiling, the lord of the cowherdesses whose fair fame is widely sung, his chest resplendent with the Kaustubha gem,

sanskrit_iast: rādhayā sahitaḥ śrīmān śrīdāmnā cāparājitaḥ //
meaning: राधया सहितः श्रीमान् श्रीदाम्ना चापराजितः //
text_mt: accompanied by Rādhā, glorious, along with Śrīdāman, invincible,

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṇaṃstejāṃsi sarveṣāṃ svarucā jñānavāridhiḥ /
athainamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā śivaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
मुष्णंस्तेजांसि सर्वेषां स्वरुचा ज्ञानवारिधिः /
अथैनमागतं दृष्ट्वा शिवः संहृष्टमानसः //
text_mt:
stealing away the splendor of all by his own luster, an ocean of wisdom.
Then, seeing that he had arrived, Śiva was rejoiced in his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇipatya yathānyāyaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāgatam /
praveśyābhyantare veśmarādhayā sahitaṃ vibhum //
meaning:
प्रणिपत्य यथान्यायं पूजयामास चागतम् /
प्रवेश्याभ्यन्तरे वेश्मराधया सहितं विभुम् //
text_mt:
Having bowed down in the proper manner, he paid honor to the arrived [one];
having led the lord into the interior of his dwelling along with Rādhā,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnasiṃhāsane namye sadāraṃ sa nyaveśayat /
tha tatra gatā devī pārvatī tanayānvitā //
meaning:
रत्नसिंहासने नम्ये सदारं स न्यवेशयत् /
थ तत्र गता देवी पार्वती तनयान्विता //
text_mt:
he seated him, along with his consort, upon an exquisite throne of gems.
Then the goddess Pārvatī went there, accompanied by her two sons.

sanskrit_iast:
nanāma caraṇānprabhvoḥ putrābhyāṃ sahitā mudā /
tha rāmo 'pi tatraiva gatvā namitakandharaḥ //
meaning:
ननाम चरणान्प्रभ्वोः पुत्राभ्यां सहिता मुदा /
थ रामो ऽपि तत्रैव गत्वा नमितकन्धरः //
text_mt:
She joyfully bowed to the feet of the two lords together with her sons.
Then Rāma too, having gone to that very place with lowered head,

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyāścaraṇopānte papātākulamānasaḥ /
sā yadā nābhyanandattaṃ bhārgavaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ //
meaning:
पार्वत्याश्चरणोपान्ते पपाताकुलमानसः /
सा यदा नाभ्यनन्दत्तं भार्गवं प्रणतं पुरः //
text_mt:
fell down near Pārvatī's feet with a distressed mind.
When she did not welcome that Bhārgava bowed before her,

sanskrit_iast: tadovāca jagannāthaḥ pārvatīṃ prīṇayangirā //
meaning: तदोवाच जगन्नाथः पार्वतीं प्रीणयन्गिरा //
text_mt: the Lord of the Universe spoke, pleasing Pārvatī with his words:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkṛṣma uvāca
ayi naganaṃ dini ninditacandramukhi tvamimaṃ jamadagnisutam /
naya nijahastasarojasamarpitamstakamaṅkamanantaguṇe //
meaning:
श्रीकृष्म उवाच
अयि नगनं दिनि निन्दितचन्द्रमुखि त्वमिमं जमदग्निसुतम् /
नय निजहस्तसरोजसमर्पितम्स्तकमङ्कमनन्तगुणे //
text_mt:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
O daughter of the mountain, whose face outshines the moon, take this son of Jamadagni
into your lap, his head offered by your own lotus hands, O goddess of endless virtues!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavabhayahāriṇi śaṃbhuvihāriṇi kalmaṣanāśini kuṃbhigate /
tava caraṇe patitaṃ satataṃ kṛtakilbiṣamapyava dehi varam //
meaning:
भवभयहारिणि शंभुविहारिणि कल्मषनाशिनि कुंभिगते /
तव चरणे पतितं सततं कृतकिल्बिषमप्यव देहि वरम् //
text_mt:
O remover of worldly fear, delighting with Śambhu, destroyer of impurities, having breasts like water jars!
Protect him who has fallen perpetually at your feet, even if he has committed an offense; grant him a boon!

sanskrit_iast:
śruṇu devi mahābhāge vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ mama /
yacchrutvā harṣitā nūnaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ /
vināyakaste tanayo mahātmā mahatāṃ mahān //
meaning:
श्रुणु देवि महाभागे वेदोक्तं वचनं मम /
यच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षिता नूनं भविष्यसि न संशयः /
विनायकस्ते तनयो महात्मा महतां महान् //
text_mt:
Hear, O noble goddess, my words declared in the Vedas,
hearing which you will surely be delighted, without doubt.
Vināyaka is your son, high-souled, greatest among the great,

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ kāmaḥ krodha udvego bhayaṃ nāviśate kadā /
vedasmṛtipurāṇeṣu saṃhitāsu ca bhāmini //
meaning:
यं कामः क्रोध उद्वेगो भयं नाविशते कदा /
वेदस्मृतिपुराणेषु संहितासु च भामिनि //
text_mt:
whom desire, wrath, anxiety, and fear never penetrate.
In the Vedas, the Smṛtis, the Purāṇas, and the Saṃhitās, O passionate lady,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmānyasyopadiṣṭāni supuṇyāni mahātmabhiḥ /
yāni tāni pravakṣyāmi nikhilāghaharāṇi ca //
meaning:
नामान्यस्योपदिष्टानि सुपुण्यानि महात्मभिः /
यानि तानि प्रवक्ष्यामि निखिलाघहराणि च //
text_mt:
his names are taught by the great-souled, very sacred,
which destroy all sins, and these I shall declare to you.

sanskrit_iast:
pramathānāṃ gaṇā ye ca nānārūpā mahābalāḥ /
teṣāmīśastvayaṃ yasmādgaṇeśastena kīrttitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रमथानां गणा ये च नानारूपा महाबलाः /
तेषामीशस्त्वयं यस्माद्गणेशस्तेन कीर्त्तितः //
text_mt:
Because he is the lord of the Pramatha hosts, diverse in form and immensely strong,
he is therefore celebrated as Gaṇeśa.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāni ca bhaviṣyāṇi varttamānāni yāni ca /
brahmāṇḍānyakhilānyeva yasmiṃllaṃbodaraḥ sa tu //
meaning:
भूतानि च भविष्याणि वर्त्तमानानि यानि च /
ब्रह्माण्डान्यखिलान्येव यस्मिंल्लंबोदरः स तु //
text_mt:
Since all the cosmic eggs—past, present,
and future—reside in him, he is Lambodara ('Big-bellied').

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sthiro devayogena cchinnaṃ saṃyojitaṃ punaḥ /
gajasya śirasā devitena prokto gajānanaḥ //
meaning:
यः स्थिरो देवयोगेन च्छिन्नं संयोजितं पुनः /
गजस्य शिरसा देवितेन प्रोक्तो गजाननः //
text_mt:
Because his severed [head] was made firm and joined once more
with the head of an elephant by divine power, O goddess, he is called Gajānana ('Elephant-faced').

sanskrit_iast:
caturthyāmuditaścandro darbhiṇā śapta āturaḥ /
anena vidhṛto bhāle bhālacandrastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थ्यामुदितश्चन्द्रो दर्भिणा शप्त आतुरः /
अनेन विधृतो भाले भालचन्द्रस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
The moon, risen on the fourth day, cursed by Darbhin, fell into distress;
placed upon his forehead by him, he is therefore remembered as Bhālacandra ('Moon-crested').

sanskrit_iast:
śaptaḥ purā saptabhistu munibhiḥ saṃkṣayaṃ gataḥ /
jātavedā dīpito 'bhūdyenāsauśūrpakarmakaḥ //
meaning:
शप्तः पुरा सप्तभिस्तु मुनिभिः संक्षयं गतः /
जातवेदा दीपितो ऽभूद्येनासौशूर्पकर्मकः //
text_mt:
Formerly cursed by the seven sages, Agni had met with destruction;
he was rekindled by him, wherefore he is Śūrpakarṇa ('Winnowing-fan-eared').

sanskrit_iast:
purā devāsure yuddhe pūjito diviṣadgaṇaiḥ /
vighnaṃ nivārayāmāsa vighnanāśastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे पूजितो दिविषद्गणैः /
विघ्नं निवारयामास विघ्ननाशस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Formerly, in the war between gods and Asuras, worshiped by the hosts of celestials,
he warded off obstacles; therefore he is remembered as Vighnanāśa ('Destroyer of Obstacles').

sanskrit_iast:
adyāyaṃ devi rāmeṇa kuṭhāreṇa nipātya ca /
daśanaṃ daivato bhadre hyekadantaḥ kṛto 'munā //
meaning:
अद्यायं देवि रामेण कुठारेण निपात्य च /
दशनं दैवतो भद्रे ह्येकदन्तः कृतो ऽमुना //
text_mt:
Today, O goddess, a tusk was felled by Rāma with his axe,
and by fate, O auspicious one, he was made Ekadanta ('Single-tusked') by him.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyatyatha paryāye brahmaṇo haravallabhe /
vakrībhaviṣyattuṇḍatvādvakratuṇḍaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यत्यथ पर्याये ब्रह्मणो हरवल्लभे /
वक्रीभविष्यत्तुण्डत्वाद्वक्रतुण्डः स्मृतो बुधैः //
text_mt:
Then in the future epoch of Brahmā, O beloved of Hara,
because his trunk will become curved, he is remembered by the wise as Vakratuṇḍa ('Curved-trunked').

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tavāsya putrasya saṃti nāmāni pārvati /
smaraṇātpāpahārīṇi trikālānugatānyapi //
meaning:
एवं तवास्य पुत्रस्य संति नामानि पार्वति /
स्मरणात्पापहारीणि त्रिकालानुगतान्यपि //
text_mt:
Thus are the names of this son of yours, O Pārvatī,
which remove sin merely by recollection and pertain to the three times.

sanskrit_iast:
asmāttrayodaśīkalpātpūrvasmindaśamībhave /
mayāsmai tu varo dattaḥ sargadevāgrapūjane //
meaning:
अस्मात्त्रयोदशीकल्पात्पूर्वस्मिन्दशमीभवे /
मयास्मै तु वरो दत्तः सर्गदेवाग्रपूजने //
text_mt:
In the tenth birth prior to this thirteenth kalpa,
a boon was granted by me to him for his worship before the gods at the beginning of creation:

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādisaṃskāre garbhādhānādike 'pi ca /
yātrāyāṃ ca vaṇijyādau yuddhe devārcane śubhe //
meaning:
जातकर्मादिसंस्कारे गर्भाधानादिके ऽपि च /
यात्रायां च वणिज्यादौ युद्धे देवार्चने शुभे //
text_mt:
In rites such as birth ceremonies, conception and the rest,
in journey, trade, and such, in war, in auspicious worship of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkaṣṭe kāmyasiddhyarthaṃ pūjayedyo gajānanam /
tasya sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
संकष्टे काम्यसिद्ध्यर्थं पूजयेद्यो गजाननम् /
तस्य सर्वाणि कार्याणि सिद्ध्यन्त्येव न संशयः //
text_mt:
and in times of distress, whoever worships Gajānana for the attainment of his desires,
all his undertakings surely succeed; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktaṃ tu samākarṇya kṛṣṇena sumahātmanā /
pārvatī jagatāṃ nāthā vismitāsīcchubhānanā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तं तु समाकर्ण्य कृष्णेन सुमहात्मना /
पार्वती जगतां नाथा विस्मितासीच्छुभानना //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Having heard this spoken by the great-souled Kṛṣṇa,
Pārvatī, the mistress of the worlds, of auspicious face, was amazed.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā naivottaraṃ prādātpārvatī śivasannidhau /
tadā rādhābravīddevīṃ śivarūpā sanātanī //
meaning:
यदा नैवोत्तरं प्रादात्पार्वती शिवसन्निधौ /
तदा राधाब्रवीद्देवीं शिवरूपा सनातनी //
text_mt:
When Pārvatī gave no reply at all in the presence of Śiva,
then the eternal Rādhā, whose nature is identical with Śiva, spoke to the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrādhovāca /
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścobhāvanyonyāśrayavigrahau /
dvidhā bhinnau prakāśete prapañce 'smin yathā tathā //
meaning:
श्रीराधोवाच /
प्रकृतिः पुरुषश्चोभावन्योन्याश्रयविग्रहौ /
द्विधा भिन्नौ प्रकाशेते प्रपञ्चे ऽस्मिन् यथा तथा //

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ cāhamāvayordevi bhedo naivāsti kaścana /
viṣṇustvamahamevāsmi śivo dviguṇatāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
त्वं चाहमावयोर्देवि भेदो नैवास्ति कश्चन /
विष्णुस्त्वमहमेवास्मि शिवो द्विगुणतां गतः //
text_mt:
You and I, O goddess—there is no difference between us at all;
you are Viṣṇu, I am indeed Śiva doubled in nature.

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya hṛdaye viṣṇurbhavatyā rūpamāsthitaḥ /
mama rūpaṃ samāsthāya viṣṇośca hṛdaye śivaḥ //
meaning:
शिवस्य हृदये विष्णुर्भवत्या रूपमास्थितः /
मम रूपं समास्थाय विष्णोश्च हृदये शिवः //
text_mt:
In the heart of Śiva is Viṣṇu, having assumed your form;
and in the heart of Viṣṇu is Śiva, having assumed my form.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa rāmo mahābhāge vaiṣṇavaḥ śaivatāṃ gataḥ /
gaṇeśo 'yaṃ śivaḥ sākṣādvaiṣṇavatvaṃ samāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
एष रामो महाभागे वैष्णवः शैवतां गतः /
गणेशो ऽयं शिवः साक्षाद्वैष्णवत्वं समास्थितः //
text_mt:
This Rāma, O noble lady, is a Vaiṣṇava who has become a Śaiva;
this Gaṇeśa is Śiva directly, who has assumed the state of a Vaiṣṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
etayorovayoḥ prabhavoścāpi bhedo na dṛśyate /
evāmuktvā tu sā rādhā kroḍe kṛtvā gajānanam //
meaning:
एतयोरोवयोः प्रभवोश्चापि भेदो न दृश्यते /
एवामुक्त्वा तु सा राधा क्रोडे कृत्वा गजाननम् //
text_mt:
No difference is seen between these two, nor between the two of us, nor between the two lords.
Having spoken thus, Rādhā took Gajānana onto her lap,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhnyupāghrāya pasparśa svahastena kapolake /
spṛṣṭamātre kapole tu kṣataṃ pūrttimudāgatam //
meaning:
मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय पस्पर्श स्वहस्तेन कपोलके /
स्पृष्टमात्रे कपोले तु क्षतं पूर्त्तिमुदागतम् //
text_mt:
smelled him on the head, and touched his cheek with her own hand.
As soon as the cheek was touched, the wound attained healing.

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatī muprasannābhūdanunītātha rādhayā /
pādayoḥ patitaṃ rāmamutthāpya nijapāṇinā //
meaning:
पार्वती मुप्रसन्नाभूदनुनीताथ राधया /
पादयोः पतितं राममुत्थाप्य निजपाणिना //
text_mt:
Pārvatī became exceedingly well pleased, being persuaded by Rādhā;
lifting up with her own hand Rāma who was fallen at her feet,

sanskrit_iast:
kroḍīcakāra suprītā mūrdhnyu pāghrāya pārvatī /
evaṃ tayostu satkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmagaṇeśayoḥ //
meaning:
क्रोडीचकार सुप्रीता मूर्ध्न्यु पाघ्राय पार्वती /
एवं तयोस्तु सत्कारं दृष्ट्वा रामगणेशयोः //
text_mt:
Pārvatī joyfully embraced him on her lap and smelled his head.
Seeing such hospitable treatment given to Rāma and Gaṇeśa,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇaḥ skandamupākṛṣya svāṅke premṇā nyaveśayat /
atha śaṃbhurapi prītaḥ śrīdāmānam pasthitam //
meaning:
कृष्णः स्कन्दमुपाकृष्य स्वाङ्के प्रेम्णा न्यवेशयत् /
अथ शंभुरपि प्रीतः श्रीदामानम् पस्थितम् //
text_mt:
Kṛṣṇa pulled Skanda close and lovingly placed him on his lap.
Then Śambhu too, well-pleased, took Śrīdāman who was standing near,

sanskrit_iast:
svotsaṃge sthāpayāmāsa premṇā matkṛtya mānadaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyabhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite dvicatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 42//
meaning:
स्वोत्संगे स्थापयामास प्रेम्णा मत्कृत्य मानदः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते द्विचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 42//
text_mt:
and placed him on his lap with affection, honoring him respectfully.

Thus ends the forty-second chapter in the account of Bhārgava, in the third section, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
evaṃ susnigdhacitteṣu teṣu tiṣṭhatsu bhūpate /
bhavānyutsaṃgato rāmaḥ samutthāya kṛtājaliḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
एवं सुस्निग्धचित्तेषु तेषु तिष्ठत्सु भूपते /
भवान्युत्संगतो रामः समुत्थाय कृताजलिः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
While they remained with very tender minds in this way, O king,
Rāma, having arisen from the lap of Bhavānī with folded palms,

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā nirviśeṣa viśeṣavat /
advayaṃ dvaitamāpannaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇātmakam //
meaning:
तुष्टाव प्रयतो भूत्वा निर्विशेष विशेषवत् /
अद्वयं द्वैतमापन्नं निर्गुणं सगुणात्मकम् //
text_mt:
composed in mind, praised her who is without distinction yet possesses distinction,
non-dual yet entered into duality, devoid of qualities yet consisting of qualities:

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
prakṛtivikṛtijātaṃ viśvametadvidhātuṃ mama kiyadanubhātaṃ vaibhavaṃ tatpramātum /
aviditatanunāmābhīṣṭavastvekadhāmābhavadatha bhava bhāmā pātu māṃ pūrṇakāmā //
meaning:
राम उवाच
प्रकृतिविकृतिजातं विश्वमेतद्विधातुं मम कियदनुभातं वैभवं तत्प्रमातुम् /
अविदिततनुनामाभीष्टवस्त्वेकधामाभवदथ भव भामा पातु मां पूर्णकामा //
text_mt:
Rāma said:
To ordain this universe born of Prakṛti and its transformations, how much of my insight has shone to measure that majesty?
May the consort of Bhava, the single abode of desired reality whose form and names are unknown, whose desires are fulfilled, protect me!

sanskrit_iast:
prakaṭitaguṇābhānaṃ kālasaṃkhyāvidhānaṃ sakalabhavanidānaṃ kīrtyate yatpradhānam /
tadiha nikhilatātaḥ saṃbabhūvokṣapātaḥ kṛtakṛtakanipātaḥ pātu māmadya mātaḥ //
meaning:
प्रकटितगुणाभानं कालसंख्याविधानं सकलभवनिदानं कीर्त्यते यत्प्रधानम् /
तदिह निखिलतातः संबभूवोक्षपातः कृतकृतकनिपातः पातु मामद्य मातः //
text_mt:
That which is praised as Pradhāna, the cause of all existence, displaying the manifestation of the guṇas, ordaining the count of time—
from which the father of all became the showerer [of seed], throwing down the created and uncreated: may that Mother protect me today!

sanskrit_iast:
danujakulavināśīlekhapātāvināśī prathamakulavikāśī sarvavidyāprakāśī /
prasabharacitakāśī bhaktadattākhilāśīravatu vijitapāśī māṃsadā ṣaṇmukhāśī //
meaning:
दनुजकुलविनाशीलेखपाताविनाशी प्रथमकुलविकाशी सर्वविद्याप्रकाशी /
प्रसभरचितकाशी भक्तदत्ताखिलाशीरवतु विजितपाशी मांसदा षण्मुखाशी //
text_mt:
Destroyer of the demon race, imperishable protectress of the gods, displayer of the primary race, illuminator of all wisdom,
forcefully creating luster, bestowing all blessings upon her devotees, conqueror of the fettered: may the mother of the six-faced one protect me always!

sanskrit_iast:
haranikaṭa nivāsī kṛṣṇasevāvilāsī praṇatajanavibhāsī gopakanyāprahāsī /
harakṛtabahumāno gopikeśaikatāno viditabahuvidhāno jāyatāṃ kīrtihā nau //
meaning:
हरनिकट निवासी कृष्णसेवाविलासी प्रणतजनविभासी गोपकन्याप्रहासी /
हरकृतबहुमानो गोपिकेशैकतानो विदितबहुविधानो जायतां कीर्तिहा नौ //
text_mt:
Abiding near Hara, taking pleasure in the service of Kṛṣṇa, illuminating those who bow to her, smiling upon the cowherd maidens,
highly honored by Hara, single-minded toward the lord of the cowherdesses, knowing manifold rites: may she be the destroyer of ill fame for us two!

sanskrit_iast:
prabhuniyatamānā yo nunnabhaktāntarāyo tdṛtaduritanikāyo jñānadātāparāyoḥ /
sakalaguṇagariṣṭho rādhikāṅkeniviṣṭo mama kṛtamaparādhaṃ kṣantumarhatvagādham //
meaning:
प्रभुनियतमाना यो नुन्नभक्तान्तरायो त्दृतदुरितनिकायो ज्ञानदातापरायोः /
सकलगुणगरिष्ठो राधिकाङ्केनिविष्टो मम कृतमपराधं क्षन्तुमर्हत्वगाधम् //
text_mt: He who possesses measured and constant majesty, who removes the obstacles of his devotees, who bears away heaps of sins, who bestows knowledge, who is beyond comprehension, / who is highest in all virtues, seated on the lap of Rādhikā—may he deign to forgive my deep offense.

sanskrit_iast:
yā rādhā jagadudbhavasthitilayeṣvārādhyate vā janaiḥ śabdaṃ bodhayatīśavaktraṃvigalatpremāmṛtāsvādanam /
rāseśī rasikeśvarī ramaṇatdṛnniṣṭhānijānandinī netrī sā paripātu māmavanataṃ rādheti ya kīrtyate //
meaning:
या राधा जगदुद्भवस्थितिलयेष्वाराध्यते वा जनैः शब्दं बोधयतीशवक्त्रंविगलत्प्रेमामृतास्वादनम् /
रासेशी रसिकेश्वरी रमणत्दृन्निष्ठानिजानन्दिनी नेत्री सा परिपातु मामवनतं राधेति य कीर्त्यते //
text_mt: She, Rādhā, who is worshipped by people during the creation, maintenance, and dissolution of the universe, who makes understood the word, the tasting of the nectar of love flowing from the Lord’s mouth, / queen of the rāsa, sovereign of the lovers, devoted to gazing at her beloved, rejoicing in her own self, the leader—may that one celebrated as ‘Rādhā’ protect me who am bowed down.

sanskrit_iast: yasyā garbhasamudbhavo hyativirāḍyasyāṃśabhūto virāṭ yannābhyaṃburuhodbhavena vidhinaikāntopadiṣṭena vai sṛṣṭaṃ sarvamidaṃ carācaramayaṃ viśvaṃ ca yadromasu brahmāṇḍāni vibhānti tasya jananī śaśvatprasannāstu sā //
meaning: यस्या गर्भसमुद्भवो ह्यतिविराड्यस्यांशभूतो विराट् यन्नाभ्यंबुरुहोद्भवेन विधिनैकान्तोपदिष्टेन वै सृष्टं सर्वमिदं चराचरमयं विश्वं च यद्रोमसु ब्रह्माण्डानि विभान्ति तस्य जननी शश्वत्प्रसन्नास्तु सा //
text_mt: From whose womb the supreme Virāṭ indeed arose, of whom the Virāṭ is a portion; and by Brahmā, who sprang from his navel-lotus and was instructed in solitude, / this entire universe composed of moving and unmoving beings was created; and on whose bodily hairs cosmic eggs shine forth—may his mother always be pleased!

sanskrit_iast:
pāyādyaḥ sa carācarasya jagato vyāpī vibhuḥ saccidānandābdhiḥ prakaṭasthito vilasati premāndhayā rādhayā /
kṛṣṇaḥ pūrṇatamo mamopari dayāklinnāntaraḥ stātsadā yenāhaṃ sukṛtī bhavāmi ca bhavāmyānandalīnāntaraḥ //
meaning:
पायाद्यः स चराचरस्य जगतो व्यापी विभुः सच्चिदानन्दाब्धिः प्रकटस्थितो विलसति प्रेमान्धया राधया /
कृष्णः पूर्णतमो ममोपरि दयाक्लिन्नान्तरः स्तात्सदा येनाहं सुकृती भवामि च भवाम्यानन्दलीनान्तरः //
text_mt: May he who is the all-pervading, almighty ocean of existence, consciousness, and bliss, who manifestly abides and sports with Rādhā blinded by love, protect [me]! / May Kṛṣṇa, the most complete, his heart ever moistened with compassion toward me, [be pleased], so that I become virtuous and my heart becomes merged in bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
stutvaivaṃ jāmadagnyastu virarāma ha tatparam /
vijñātākhilatattvārtho hṛṣṭaromā kṛtārthavat //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
स्तुत्वैवं जामदग्न्यस्तु विरराम ह तत्परम् /
विज्ञाताखिलतत्त्वार्थो हृष्टरोमा कृतार्थवत् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having thus praised [them], the son of Jamadagni then fell silent, / having understood the reality of all truths, his hair standing on end, feeling fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca prasannātmā kṛṣṇaḥ kamalalocanaḥ /
bhārgavaṃ praṇataṃ bhaktyā kṛpāpātraṃ purasthitam //
meaning:
अथोवाच प्रसन्नात्मा कृष्णः कमललोचनः /
भार्गवं प्रणतं भक्त्या कृपापात्रं पुरस्थितम् //
text_mt: Then lotus-eyed Kṛṣṇa, his heart pleased, / spoke to the Bhārgava, who stood before him, bowed down in devotion and worthy of grace.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣma uvāca
siddho 'si bhārgavendra tvaṃ prasādānmama saṃpratam /
adya prabhṛti vatsāsmiṃlloke śreṣṭhatamo bhava //
meaning:
कृष्म उवाच
सिद्धो ऽसि भार्गवेन्द्र त्वं प्रसादान्मम संप्रतम् /
अद्य प्रभृति वत्सास्मिंल्लोके श्रेष्ठतमो भव //
text_mt: Kṛṣṇa said: / O best of Bhārgavas, you have attained perfection now by my grace. / From this day forward, my child, become the greatest in this world.

sanskrit_iast:
tubhyaṃ varo mayā dattaḥ purā viṣṇupadāśrame /
tatsarvaṃ kramato bhāvyaṃ samā bahvīstvayā vibho //
meaning:
तुभ्यं वरो मया दत्तः पुरा विष्णुपदाश्रमे /
तत्सर्वं क्रमतो भाव्यं समा बह्वीस्त्वया विभो //
text_mt: A boon was given to you by me previously in the hermitage of Viṣṇupada; / all of that must come to pass in due order for many years through you, O mighty one.

sanskrit_iast:
dayā vidheyā dīneṣu śreya uttamamicchatā /
yogaśca sādanīyo vai śatrūṇāṃ nigrahastathā //
meaning:
दया विधेया दीनेषु श्रेय उत्तममिच्छता /
योगश्च सादनीयो वै शत्रूणां निग्रहस्तथा //
text_mt: Compassion should be shown to the wretched by one desiring the highest good; / yoga should indeed be practiced, and likewise the restraint of enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
tvatsamo nāsti loke 'smiṃstejasā ca balena ca /
jñānena yaśasā vāpi sarvaśreṣṭhatamo bhavān //
meaning:
त्वत्समो नास्ति लोके ऽस्मिंस्तेजसा च बलेन च /
ज्ञानेन यशसा वापि सर्वश्रेष्ठतमो भवान् //
text_mt: There is no one equal to you in this world in splendor or strength; / in knowledge or fame, you shall be the foremost of all.

sanskrit_iast:
atha svagṛhamāsādya pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kuru /
tapaścara yathākālaṃ tena siddhiḥ karasthitā //
meaning:
अथ स्वगृहमासाद्य पित्रोः शुश्रूषणं कुरु /
तपश्चर यथाकालं तेन सिद्धिः करस्थिता //
text_mt: Now, having reached your home, serve your parents; / practice asceticism at the proper time; through that, perfection will rest in your hand.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhotsaṃgātsamutthāpya gaṇeśaṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ /
āliṅgya gāḍhaṃ rāseṇa maitrīṃ tasya cakāra ha //
meaning:
राधोत्संगात्समुत्थाप्य गणेशं राधिकेश्वरः /
आलिङ्ग्य गाढं रासेण मैत्रीं तस्य चकार ह //
text_mt: Raising Gaṇeśa from the lap of Rādhā, the Lord of Rādhikā / embraced him closely and, with delight, established friendship between him [and Rāma].

sanskrit_iast:
athobhāvapi saṃprītau tadā rāmagaṇeśvarau /
kṛṣṇājñayā mahābhāgau babhūvaturarindama //
meaning:
अथोभावपि संप्रीतौ तदा रामगणेश्वरौ /
कृष्णाज्ञया महाभागौ बभूवतुररिन्दम //
text_mt: Then both of them, Rāma and the lord of the gaṇas, were well pleased, / and by Kṛṣṇa's command, O tamer of foes, those highly fortunate ones became [friends].

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devī rādhā kṛṣṇapriyā satī /
ubhābhyāṃ ca varaṃ prādātprasannāsyā mudānvitā //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवी राधा कृष्णप्रिया सती /
उभाभ्यां च वरं प्रादात्प्रसन्नास्या मुदान्विता //
text_mt: In the meantime, the virtuous goddess Rādhā, beloved of Kṛṣṇa, / her face cheerful and filled with joy, granted a boon to both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhovāca /
sarvasya jagato vandyau durādharṣauṃ priyāvahau /
madbhaktau ca viśeṣeṇa bhavantau bhavatāṃ sutau //
meaning:
राधोवाच /
सर्वस्य जगतो वन्द्यौ दुराधर्षौं प्रियावहौ /
मद्भक्तौ च विशेषेण भवन्तौ भवतां सुतौ //
text_mt: Rādhā said: / May both of you, my sons, be worthy of worship by the whole world, invincible, bringers of joy, / and especially devoted to me.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatornāma cauccārya yatkāryaṃ yaḥ samārabhet /
siddhiṃ prayātu tatasarvaṃ matprasādāddhi tasya tu //
meaning:
भवतोर्नाम चौच्चार्य यत्कार्यं यः समारभेत् /
सिद्धिं प्रयातु ततसर्वं मत्प्रसादाद्धि तस्य तु //
text_mt: And whatever undertaking anyone begins having uttered your two names, / may all of that attain success indeed by my grace!

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca jaganmātā bhavānī bhavavallabhā /
vatsa rāma prasannāhaṃ tubhyaṃ kaṃ pradade varam /
taṃ prabrūhi mahābhāga bhayaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ /
rāma uvāca
janmānta rasahasreṣu yeṣuyeṣu vrajāmyaham //
meaning:
अथोवाच जगन्माता भवानी भववल्लभा /
वत्स राम प्रसन्नाहं तुभ्यं कं प्रददे वरम् /
तं प्रब्रूहि महाभाग भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः /
राम उवाच
जन्मान्त रसहस्रेषु येषुयेषु व्रजाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Then Bhavānī, mother of the universe and beloved of Bhava, said: / “Child Rāma, I am pleased; what boon shall I grant you? / State it, O highly fortunate one, casting fear far away.” / Rāma said: / “In whichever thousands of other births I may wander,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇayorbhavayorbhakto bhaviṣyāmīti dehi me /
abhedena ca paśyāmi kṛṣṇau cāpi bhavau tathā //
meaning:
कृष्णयोर्भवयोर्भक्तो भविष्यामीति देहि मे /
अभेदेन च पश्यामि कृष्णौ चापि भवौ तथा //
text_mt: grant me this: that I shall be a devotee of Kṛṣṇa and Bhava, / and that I may see Kṛṣṇa and Bhava without distinction!”

sanskrit_iast:
pārvatyuvāca
evamastu mahābhāga bhakto 'si bhavakṛṣṇayoḥ /
cirañjīvī bhavāśu tvaṃ prasādānmama suvrata //
meaning:
पार्वत्युवाच
एवमस्तु महाभाग भक्तो ऽसि भवकृष्णयोः /
चिरञ्जीवी भवाशु त्वं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रत //
text_mt: Pārvatī said: / So be it, O highly fortunate one! You are a devotee of Bhava and Kṛṣṇa. / May you soon become long-lived by my grace, O you of good vows!

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca dharādhīśaḥ prasannastamumāpatiḥ /
praṇataṃ bhārgavendraṃ tu varārhaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अथोवाच धराधीशः प्रसन्नस्तमुमापतिः /
प्रणतं भार्गवेन्द्रं तु वरार्हं जगदीश्वरः //
text_mt: Then the lord of the earth, the husband of Umā, Lord of the Universe, pleased, / spoke to that foremost Bhārgava, bowed down and worthy of boons.

sanskrit_iast:
śiva uvāca
rāmabhakto 'si me vatsa yaste datto varo mayā /
sa bhaviṣyati kārtsyena satyamuktaṃ na cānyathā //
meaning:
शिव उवाच
रामभक्तो ऽसि मे वत्स यस्ते दत्तो वरो मया /
स भविष्यति कार्त्स्येन सत्यमुक्तं न चान्यथा //
text_mt: Śiva said: / O child, you are devoted to Rāma; the boon that was granted to you by me / will be completely fulfilled; it is spoken truthfully, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti loke 'smin bhavato balavattaraḥ /
na ko 'pi bhavatādvatsa tejasvī ca bhavatparaḥ //
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन् भवतो बलवत्तरः /
न को ऽपि भवताद्वत्स तेजस्वी च भवत्परः //
text_mt: From this day forward in this world, let there be no one / stronger than you, O child, and no one more splendid than you.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
atha kṛṣṇo 'pyanujñāpya śivaṃ ca naganandinīm /
golokaṃ prayayau yuktaḥ śrīdāmnā cāpi rādhayā //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
अथ कृष्णो ऽप्यनुज्ञाप्य शिवं च नगनन्दिनीम् /
गोलोकं प्रययौ युक्तः श्रीदाम्ना चापि राधया //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then Kṛṣṇa also, taking leave of Śiva and the daughter of the mountain, / departed for Goloka accompanied by Śrīdāman and Rādhā.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rāmo 'pi dharmātmā bhavānīṃ ca bhavaṃ tathā /
saṃpūjya cābhivādyātha pradakṣiṇamupā kramīt //
meaning:
अथ रामो ऽपि धर्मात्मा भवानीं च भवं तथा /
संपूज्य चाभिवाद्याथ प्रदक्षिणमुपा क्रमीत् //
text_mt: Then the righteous Rāma, having worshipped / Bhavānī and Bhava and bowed to them, performed circumambulation.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇeśaṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca natvāpṛcchya ca bhūpate /
akṛtavraṇasaṃyukto niścakrāma gṛhāntarāt //
meaning:
गणेशं कार्त्तिकेयं च नत्वापृच्छ्य च भूपते /
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तो निश्चक्राम गृहान्तरात् //
text_mt: Having bowed to and taken leave of Gaṇeśa and Kārttikeya, O king, / accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, he went out from the interior of the house.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkramyamāṇo rāmastu nandīśvaramukhairgaṇaiḥ /
namaskṛto yayau rājansvagṛhaṃ parayā mudā //
iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya
upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite tricatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 43//
meaning:
निष्क्रम्यमाणो रामस्तु नन्दीश्वरमुखैर्गणैः /
नमस्कृतो ययौ राजन्स्वगृहं परया मुदा //
इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय
उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते त्रिचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 43//
text_mt:
Departing, Rāma was saluted by the gaṇas / led by Nandīśvara, O king, and went to his own home with supreme joy.

Thus ends the forty-third chapter, on the deeds of the Bhārgava, in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
rājannevaṃ bhṛgurvidvānpaśyañjanapadānbahūn /
samājagāma dharmātmākṛtavraṇasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
राजन्नेवं भृगुर्विद्वान्पश्यञ्जनपदान्बहून् /
समाजगाम धर्मात्माकृतव्रणसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / O king, thus the wise Bhṛgu, viewing many regions, / the righteous one, arrived accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nililyuḥ kṣattriyāḥ sarve yatra tatra nirīkṣya tam /
vrajantaṃ bhārgavaṃ mārge prāṇarakṣaṇatatparāḥ //
meaning:
निलिल्युः क्षत्त्रियाः सर्वे यत्र तत्र निरीक्ष्य तम् /
व्रजन्तं भार्गवं मार्गे प्राणरक्षणतत्पराः //
text_mt: All the kṣatriyas hid here and there upon seeing him, / the Bhārgava walking on the road, intent upon saving their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsasāda rājendra rāmaḥ svapiturāśramam /
śāntasattvasamākīrṇaṃ vedadhtraninināditam //
meaning:
अथाससाद राजेन्द्र रामः स्वपितुराश्रमम् /
शान्तसत्त्वसमाकीर्णं वेदध्त्रनिनिनादितम् //
text_mt: Then, O king of kings, Rāma reached his father’s hermitage, / crowded with peaceful living beings, resounding with the deep chanting of the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra siṃhā mṛgā gāvo nāgamārjjāramūṣakāḥ /
samaṃ ca ranti saṃhṛṣṭā bhayaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ //
meaning:
यत्र सिंहा मृगा गावो नागमार्ज्जारमूषकाः /
समं च रन्ति संहृष्टा भयं त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः //
text_mt: where lions, deer, cows, elephants, cats, and mice / roam together delighted, having cast fear far away,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra dhūmaṃ samīkṣyaiva hyagnihotrasamudbhavam /
unnadanti mayūrāśca nṛtyanti ca mahīpane //
meaning:
यत्र धूमं समीक्ष्यैव ह्यग्निहोत्रसमुद्भवम् /
उन्नदन्ति मयूराश्च नृत्यन्ति च महीपने //
text_mt: where, seeing the smoke rising from the agnihotra fire, / peacocks call out and dance, O ruler of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sāyantane kāle sūryasyābhimukhaṃ dvijaiḥ /
jalāñjalīnprakṣipadbhiḥ kriyate bhūrcalāvilā //
meaning:
यत्र सायन्तने काले सूर्यस्याभिमुखं द्विजैः /
जलाञ्जलीन्प्रक्षिपद्भिः क्रियते भूर्चलाविला //
text_mt: where at evening time, as the twice-born cast cupfuls of water with folded hands / toward the sun, the ground is made moist and muddy,

sanskrit_iast:
yatrāntevāsibhirnityaṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi saṃhitāḥ /
abhyasyante mudā yuktairbrahmacaryavrate sthitaiḥ //
meaning:
यत्रान्तेवासिभिर्नित्यं वेदाः शास्त्राणि संहिताः /
अभ्यस्यन्ते मुदा युक्तैर्ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितैः //
text_mt: where the Vedas, śāstras, and saṃhitās are constantly / practiced by disciples filled with joy, established in the vow of brahmacarya.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rāmaḥ prasannātmā paśyannāśramasaṃpadam /
praviveśa śanai rājannakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
अथ रामः प्रसन्नात्मा पश्यन्नाश्रमसंपदम् /
प्रविवेश शनै राजन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt: Then Rāma, pleased in mind, beholding the splendor of the hermitage, / entered slowly, O king, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ proccaradbhirdvijātmajaiḥ /
dvijaiśca satkṛto rāmaḥ paraṃ harṣamupāgataḥ //
meaning:
जयशब्दं नमःशब्दं प्रोच्चरद्भिर्द्विजात्मजैः /
द्विजैश्च सत्कृतो रामः परं हर्षमुपागतः //
text_mt: Honored with shouts of “Victory!” and “Salutations!” / uttered by the sons of twice-born and the twice-born themselves, Rāma experienced supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramābhyantare tatra saṃpraviśya nijaṃ gṛham /
dadarśa pitaraṃ rāmo jamadagniṃ taponidhim //
meaning:
आश्रमाभ्यन्तरे तत्र संप्रविश्य निजं गृहम् /
ददर्श पितरं रामो जमदग्निं तपोनिधिम् //
text_mt: Entering there into the interior of the hermitage, into his own home, / Rāma saw his father, Jamadagni, a treasury of asceticism,

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣādbhṛgumivāsīnaṃ nigrahānugrahakṣamam /
papāta caraṇopānte hyaṣṭāṅgāliṅgitāvaniḥ //
meaning:
साक्षाद्भृगुमिवासीनं निग्रहानुग्रहक्षमम् /
पपात चरणोपान्ते ह्यष्टाङ्गालिङ्गितावनिः //
text_mt: seated like Bhṛgu in person, capable of punishing and showing grace; / he fell at the proximity of his feet, touching the ground with the eight limbs [of his body].

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'haṃ tavā dāso 'smi proccaranniti bhūpate /
jagrāha caraṇau cāpi vidhivatsajjanāgraṇīḥ //
meaning:
रामो ऽहं तवा दासो ऽस्मि प्रोच्चरन्निति भूपते /
जग्राह चरणौ चापि विधिवत्सज्जनाग्रणीः //
text_mt: Saying aloud, “I am Rāma, your servant,” O king, / the foremost of virtuous men clasped his feet in accordance with rule.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mātuśca caraṇavabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ /
uvāca praṇato vākyaṃ tayoḥ saṃharṣakāraṇam //
meaning:
अथ मातुश्च चरणवभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः /
उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यं तयोः संहर्षकारणम् //
text_mt: Then, having greeted his mother’s feet with joined palms, / he, bowed down, spoke words that were a cause of joy for both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
pitastava prabhāveṇa tapaso 'tidurāsadaḥ /
kārttavīryo hato yuddhe samutrabalavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
राम उवाच
पितस्तव प्रभावेण तपसो ऽतिदुरासदः /
कार्त्तवीर्यो हतो युद्धे समुत्रबलवाहनः //
text_mt:
Rāma said:
"Father, by the power of your asceticism, Kārttavīryārjuna,
who was exceedingly unassailable, was slain in battle along with his army and mounts.

sanskrit_iast:
yaste 'parādhaṃ kṛtavānduṣṭamantripracoditaḥ /
tasya daṇḍo mayā dattaḥ prasahya munipuṅgava //
meaning:
यस्ते ऽपराधं कृतवान्दुष्टमन्त्रिप्रचोदितः /
तस्य दण्डो मया दत्तः प्रसह्य मुनिपुङ्गव //
text_mt:
The punishment for the wrong he committed against you, instigated by his evil ministers,
has been forcefully inflicted by me, O best of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantaṃ tu namaskṛtya gato 'haṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam /
taṃ namaskṛtya vidhivatsvakāryaṃ pratyavedayam //
meaning:
भवन्तं तु नमस्कृत्य गतो ऽहं ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकम् /
तं नमस्कृत्य विधिवत्स्वकार्यं प्रत्यवेदयम् //
text_mt:
Having bowed to you, I went into the presence of Brahmā.
Having bowed to him according to rule, I reported my purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
samāmuvāca bhagavāñchrutvā vṛttāntamāditaḥ /
vraja svakāryasiddhyarthaṃ śivalokaṃ sanātanam //
meaning:
समामुवाच भगवाञ्छ्रुत्वा वृत्तान्तमादितः /
व्रज स्वकार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं शिवलोकं सनातनम् //
text_mt:
Having heard the entire account from the beginning, the Blessed One said to me:
'Go to the eternal world of Śiva for the accomplishment of your purpose.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvāhaṃ tadvayastāta namaskṛtya pitā maham /
gatavāñchivalokaṃ vai haradarśanakāṅkṣayā //
meaning:
श्रुत्वाहं तद्वयस्तात नमस्कृत्य पिता महम् /
गतवाञ्छिवलोकं वै हरदर्शनकाङ्क्षया //
text_mt:
Having heard his word, O father, and having bowed to the Grandfather,
I went to the world of Śiva, desiring a vision of Hara.

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya tatra bhagavannumayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ /
namaskṛto mayā devo vāñchitārtha pradāyakaḥ //
meaning:
प्रविश्य तत्र भगवन्नुमया सहितः शिवः /
नमस्कृतो मया देवो वाञ्छितार्थ प्रदायकः //
text_mt:
Having entered there, O blessed one, Śiva, who is accompanied by Umā
and who bestows desired boons, was saluted by me.

sanskrit_iast:
tadagre nikhilaḥ svīyo vṛttānto viniveditaḥ /
mayā samāhitadhiyā sa sarvaṃ śrutavānapi //
meaning:
तदग्रे निखिलः स्वीयो वृत्तान्तो विनिवेदितः /
मया समाहितधिया स सर्वं श्रुतवानपि //
text_mt:
Before him, my whole account was related
by me with an attentive mind, and he heard it all.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā vicārya ta tsarvaṃ dadau mahyaṃ kṛpānvitaḥ /
trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ sarvasiddhidam //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा विचार्य त त्सर्वं ददौ मह्यं कृपान्वितः /
त्रैलोक्यविजयं नाम कवचं सर्वसिद्धिदम् //
text_mt:
Having heard and considered all that, full of compassion he gave to me
the armour named Trailokyavijaya, which grants all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
tallabdhvā taṃ namaskṛtya puṣkaraṃ samupāgataḥ /
tatrāhaṃ sādhayitvā tu kavacaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ //
meaning:
तल्लब्ध्वा तं नमस्कृत्य पुष्करं समुपागतः /
तत्राहं साधयित्वा तु कवचं हृष्टमानसः //
text_mt:
Having obtained that and bowed to him, I went to Puṣkara.
There, having perfected the armour, with a joyful mind,

sanskrit_iast:
kārttavīryaṃ nihatyājau śivalokaṃ punargataḥ /
tatra tau tu mayā dṛṣṭau dvāre skandavināyakau //
meaning:
कार्त्तवीर्यं निहत्याजौ शिवलोकं पुनर्गतः /
तत्र तौ तु मया दृष्टौ द्वारे स्कन्दविनायकौ //
text_mt:
having slain Kārttavīryārjuna in battle, I went once more to the world of Śiva.
There, Skanda and Vināyaka were seen by me at the gate.

sanskrit_iast:
taunamaskṛtya dharmajña praveṣṭuṃ codyato 'bhavam /
sa māmavekṣya gāmapo viśantaṃ tvarayānvitam //
meaning:
तौनमस्कृत्य धर्मज्ञ प्रवेष्टुं चोद्यतो ऽभवम् /
स मामवेक्ष्य गामपो विशन्तं त्वरयान्वितम् //
text_mt:
Having bowed to them, O knower of dharma, I prepared to enter.
Seeing me entering with haste, the protector of the followers

sanskrit_iast:
vārayāmāsa sahasā nādyāvasara ityatha /
mama tena pitastatra vāgyuddhaṃ hastakarṣaṇam //
meaning:
वारयामास सहसा नाद्यावसर इत्यथ /
मम तेन पितस्तत्र वाग्युद्धं हस्तकर्षणम् //
text_mt:
stopped me abruptly, saying, 'Now is not the time.'
Then, O father, there arose between me and him a battle of words and seizing of hands.

sanskrit_iast:
sañjātaparaśukṣemamato 'bhūdbhṛgunandana /
sa tajjñātvā samudgṛhya māmadhaścorddhvameva ca //
meaning:
सञ्जातपरशुक्षेममतो ऽभूद्भृगुनन्दन /
स तज्ज्ञात्वा समुद्गृह्य मामधश्चोर्द्ध्वमेव च //
text_mt:
From that, O descendant of Bhṛgu, an exchange of axe-blows arose.
Realising that, he grasped me, and upwards and downwards

sanskrit_iast:
kareṇa bhrāmayāmāsa punaścānītavāṃstataḥ /
taṃ dṛṣṭvātikrudhā kṣiptaḥ kuṭhāro hi mayā tataḥ //
meaning:
करेण भ्रामयामास पुनश्चानीतवांस्ततः /
तं दृष्ट्वातिक्रुधा क्षिप्तः कुठारो हि मया ततः //
text_mt:
swung me around with his trunk, and then brought me back again.
Seeing him, in intense anger the axe was hurled by me.

sanskrit_iast:
danto nipati,stasya tato deva upāgataḥ /
pārvatī tatra ruṣṭābhūttadā kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ //
meaning:
दन्तो निपति,स्तस्य ततो देव उपागतः /
पार्वती तत्र रुष्टाभूत्तदा कृष्णः समागतः //
text_mt:
His tusk fell off, and then the god arrived.
Pārvatī became angry there; at that time Kṛṣṇa arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
rādhayā sahitastena sānunītā varaṃ dadau /
mahyaṃ kṛṣmo jagāmātha tena maitrīṃ vidhāya ca //
meaning:
राधया सहितस्तेन सानुनीता वरं ददौ /
मह्यं कृष्मो जगामाथ तेन मैत्रीं विधाय च //
text_mt:
Together with Rādhā, by him she was conciliated, and she granted a boon
to me. Then Kṛṣṇa, having forged friendship with him, departed.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamya deveśau pārvatīparameśvarau /
āgatastava sānnidhyamakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्य देवेशौ पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ /
आगतस्तव सान्निध्यमकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt:
Then, having bowed to the two supreme rulers of the gods, Pārvatī and Parameśvara,
I have come into your presence, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityaktvā bhārgavo rāmo virarāma ca bhūpate /
jamadagniruvācedaṃ rāmaṃ śatrunibarhaṇam //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्यक्त्वा भार्गवो रामो विरराम च भूपते /
जमदग्निरुवाचेदं रामं शत्रुनिबर्हणम् //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Having spoken thus, Rāma the Bhārgava fell silent, O king.
Jamadagni said this to Rāma, the destroyer of foes:

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
kṣatrahatyābhibhūtastvaṃ tāvaddoṣopaśāntaye /
prayaścittaṃ tatastāvadyathāvatkartumarhasi //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
क्षत्रहत्याभिभूतस्त्वं तावद्दोषोपशान्तये /
प्रयश्चित्तं ततस्तावद्यथावत्कर्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
"You are overcome by the sin of slaying kṣatriyas; therefore, for the pacification of that fault,
you ought to perform penance properly at once."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ prāha pitaraṃ rāmo matimatāṃ varaḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ tu tadyogyaṃ tvaṃ me nirdeṣṭumarhasi //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः प्राह पितरं रामो मतिमतां वरः /
प्रायश्चित्तं तु तद्योग्यं त्वं मे निर्देष्टुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Being addressed thus, Rāma, best among the wise, said to his father:
"You ought to instruct me in the penance that is fitting for it."

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagniruvāca
vrataiśca niyamaiścaiva karṣayandehamātmanaḥ /
śākamūlaphalāhāro dvādaśābdaṃ tapaścara //
meaning:
जमदग्निरुवाच
व्रतैश्च नियमैश्चैव कर्षयन्देहमात्मनः /
शाकमूलफलाहारो द्वादशाब्दं तपश्चर //
text_mt:
Jamadagni said:
"Mortifying your own body with vows and observances,
subsisting on vegetables, roots, and fruits, practice asceticism for twelve years."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ mātaraṃ ca bhṛgūdvahaḥ /
prayayau tapase rājannakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं मातरं च भृगूद्वहः /
प्रययौ तपसे राजन्नकृतव्रणसंयुतः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Being addressed thus, that descendant of Bhṛgu bowed to him and to his mother,
and set out for asceticism, O king, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
sa gatvā parvata varaṃ mahendramarikarṣaṇaḥ /
kṛtvā'śramapadaṃ tasmiṃstapastepe suduścaram //
meaning:
स गत्वा पर्वत वरं महेन्द्रमरिकर्षणः /
कृत्वाऽश्रमपदं तस्मिंस्तपस्तेपे सुदुश्चरम् //
text_mt:
Having gone to Mahendra, the excellent mountain, the crusher of enemies
established a hermitage upon it and performed severe asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
vrataistapobhirniyamairdevatārādhanairapi /
ninye varṣāṇi kati cidrāmastasminmahāmanāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde
sagaropākhyāne bhārgavacarite catuścatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 44//
meaning:
व्रतैस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्देवताराधनैरपि /
निन्ये वर्षाणि कति चिद्रामस्तस्मिन्महामनाः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे
सगरोपाख्याने भार्गवचरिते चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 44//
text_mt:
Through vows, austerities, observances, and worship of deities,
the noble-minded Rāma spent several years there.

Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter in the Bhārgavacarita of the Sagaropākhyāna, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tataḥ kadācidvipine caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ /
mṛgayāmagamacchūraḥ śūrasenādibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
ततः कदाचिद्विपिने चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः /
मृगयामगमच्छूरः शूरसेनादिभिः सह //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Then once in the forest, accompanied by a fourfold army,
the heroic [king] went hunting along with Śūrasena and others.

sanskrit_iast:
te praviśya mahāraṇyaṃ hatvā bahuvidhānmṛgān /
jagmustṛṣārttā madhyāhne saritaṃ narmadāmanu //
meaning:
ते प्रविश्य महारण्यं हत्वा बहुविधान्मृगान् /
जग्मुस्तृषार्त्ता मध्याह्ने सरितं नर्मदामनु //
text_mt:
Having entered the great wilderness and slain many kinds of deer,
they went, afflicted with thirst at midday, along the river Narmadā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca vāri nadyā gataśramāḥ /
gacchanto dadṛśurmārgo jamadagnerathāśramam //
meaning:
तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च वारि नद्या गतश्रमाः /
गच्छन्तो ददृशुर्मार्गो जमदग्नेरथाश्रमम् //
text_mt:
Having bathed there and drunk the water of the river, their weariness gone,
as they were proceeding on their path, they saw the hermitage of Jamadagni.

sanskrit_iast:
ddaṣṭvāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ munīnāgacchataḥ pathi /
kasyedamiti papracchurbhāvikarmapracoditāḥ //
meaning:
द्दष्ट्वाश्रमपदं रम्यं मुनीनागच्छतः पथि /
कस्येदमिति पप्रच्छुर्भाविकर्मप्रचोदिताः //
text_mt:
Seeing that lovely hermitage and sages walking on the path,
impelled by their future destiny, they asked, 'Whose is this?'

sanskrit_iast:
te procuratiśāntātmā jamadagnermahātapāḥ /
vasatyasminsuto yasya rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
ते प्रोचुरतिशान्तात्मा जमदग्नेर्महातपाः /
वसत्यस्मिन्सुतो यस्य रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः //
text_mt:
They replied, 'In this resides Jamadagni, of exceedingly peaceful mind and great austerity,
whose son is Rāma, best of weapon-bearers.'

sanskrit_iast:
tachrutvā bhīrabhūtteṣāṃ rāmanāmānukīrttanāt /
krodhaṃ prasaṅyānṛśaṃsyaṃ pūrvavairamanusmaran //
meaning:
तछ्रुत्वा भीरभूत्तेषां रामनामानुकीर्त्तनात् /
क्रोधं प्रसङ्यानृशंस्यं पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt:
Hearing that, fear arose in them from the utterance of Rāma's name;
[yet] giving way to anger and cruelty, remembering their former enmity,

sanskrit_iast:
atha te procuranyonyaṃ pitṛhanturvadhātpituḥ /
vaira niryātanaṃ kiṃ tu kariṣyāmo diśādhunā //
meaning:
अथ ते प्रोचुरन्योन्यं पितृहन्तुर्वधात्पितुः /
वैर निर्यातनं किं तु करिष्यामो दिशाधुना //
text_mt:
they said to one another: 'By slaying the slayer of our father,
shall we not avenge our father's enmity now in this region?'

sanskrit_iast:
ityaktvā khaḍgahastāste saṃpraviśya tadāśramam /
prajāghnire prayāteṣu munivīreṣu sarvataḥ //
meaning:
इत्यक्त्वा खड्गहस्तास्ते संप्रविश्य तदाश्रमम् /
प्रजाघ्निरे प्रयातेषु मुनिवीरेषु सर्वतः //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, holding swords in their hands, they entered that hermitage
and struck him down when the heroic sages had dispersed everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ hatvāsya śiro hṛtvā niṣādā iva nirdayāḥ /
prayayuste durātmānaḥ sabalāḥ svapurīṃ prati //
meaning:
तं हत्वास्य शिरो हृत्वा निषादा इव निर्दयाः /
प्रययुस्ते दुरात्मानः सबलाः स्वपुरीं प्रति //
text_mt:
Having slain him and severed his head like pitiless Niṣādas,
those evil-minded ones, accompanied by their forces, set out toward their own city.

sanskrit_iast:
putrāstasya mahātmānau dṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ hatam /
parivārya mahārāja ruruduḥ śokakarśitāḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रास्तस्य महात्मानौ दृष्ट्वा स्वपितरं हतम् /
परिवार्य महाराज रुरुदुः शोककर्शिताः //
text_mt:
Seeing their father slain, his noble sons
surrounded him, O great king, and wept, emaciated with sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
bharttāraṃ nihataṃ bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya reṇukā /
papāta mūrcchitā sadyo latevāśanitāḍitā //
meaning:
भर्त्तारं निहतं भूमौ पतितं वीक्ष्य रेणुका /
पपात मूर्च्छिता सद्यो लतेवाशनिताडिता //
text_mt:
Seeing her husband slain, fallen on the ground, Reṇukā
fell unconscious at once, like a creeper struck by lightning.

sanskrit_iast:
sā svacetasi saṃmūcchya śokapāvakadīpitāḥ /
dūrapranaṣṭasaṃjñeva sadyaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata //
meaning:
सा स्वचेतसि संमूच्छ्य शोकपावकदीपिताः /
दूरप्रनष्टसंज्ञेव सद्यः प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत //
text_mt:
Fainting in her mind, blazing with the fire of sorrow,
her consciousness entirely lost as it were, she was immediately separated from her life-breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
anālapantyāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃjñāṃ yātā hi te punaḥ /
nyapatanmūrcchitā bhūmau nimagnāḥ śokasāgare //
meaning:
अनालपन्त्यां तस्यां तु संज्ञां याता हि ते पुनः /
न्यपतन्मूर्च्छिता भूमौ निमग्नाः शोकसागरे //
text_mt:
When she did not speak, [the sons,] having regained consciousness,
fell unconscious to the ground once more, plunged in an ocean of grief.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastapodhanā ye 'nye tatta povanavāsinaḥ /
sametyāśvāsayāmāsustulyaduḥkhāḥ sutānmune //
meaning:
ततस्तपोधना ये ऽन्ये तत्त पोवनवासिनः /
समेत्याश्वासयामासुस्तुल्यदुःखाः सुतान्मुने //
text_mt:
Then the other ascetics residing in that penance grove,
coming together, consoled the sons of the sage, sharing their grief.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃtvyamānā munigaṇairjāmadagnyā yathāvidhi /
ādhakṣurvacasā teṣāmagnau pitroḥ kalevare //
meaning:
सांत्व्यमाना मुनिगणैर्जामदग्न्या यथाविधि /
आधक्षुर्वचसा तेषामग्नौ पित्रोः कलेवरे //
text_mt:
Being consoled by the hosts of sages according to rule, the sons of Jamadagni,
at their word, burned the bodies of their two parents in fire.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrureva tadūrddhvaṃ vai yatkarttavyamanantaram /
pitrormaraṇaduḥkhena pīḍyamānā divāniśam //
meaning:
चक्रुरेव तदूर्द्ध्वं वै यत्कर्त्तव्यमनन्तरम् /
पित्रोर्मरणदुःखेन पीड्यमाना दिवानिशम् //
text_mt:
Thereafter, they indeed performed whatever rites had to be done next,
tormented day and night by the grief of their parents' death.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāle gate rāmaḥ samānāṃ dvādaśāvadhau /
nivṛttastapasaḥ sakhyā sahāgādāśramaṃ pituḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge sagaropākhyāne
bhārgavacarite pañcacatvāriṃśattamodhyāyaḥ // 45//
meaning:
ततः काले गते रामः समानां द्वादशावधौ /
निवृत्तस्तपसः सख्या सहागादाश्रमं पितुः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे सगरोपाख्याने
भार्गवचरिते पञ्चचत्वारिंशत्तमोध्यायः // 45//
text_mt:
Then, when the time had passed to the limit of twelve years,
Rāma, returned from his asceticism, came with his friend to his father's hermitage.

Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter in the Bhārgavacarita of the Sagaropākhyāna, in the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
sagacchanpathi śuśrāva munibhyasta ttvamāditaḥ /
rājaputravyavasitaṃ pitrauḥ svargatimeva ca //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
सगच्छन्पथि शुश्राव मुनिभ्यस्त त्त्वमादितः /
राजपुत्रव्यवसितं पित्रौः स्वर्गतिमेव च //

sanskrit_iast:
pitustu jīvaharaṇaṃ śiroharaṇameva ca /
tanmṛtereva maraṇaṃ śrutvā mātuśca kevalam //
meaning:
पितुस्तु जीवहरणं शिरोहरणमेव च /
तन्मृतेरेव मरणं श्रुत्वा मातुश्च केवलम् //
text_mt:
the taking of his father's life and the cutting off of his head,
and hearing of the death of his mother solely from his death,

sanskrit_iast:
vilalāpa mahābāhurduḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ /
tamathāśvāsayāmāsa tulyaduḥkho 'kṛtavraṇaḥ //
meaning:
विललाप महाबाहुर्दुःखशोकसमन्वितः /
तमथाश्वासयामास तुल्यदुःखो ऽकृतव्रणः //
text_mt:
the mighty-armed one lamented, overcome with pain and sorrow.
Then Akṛtavraṇa, sharing his grief, consoled him.

sanskrit_iast:
hetubhiḥ śāstranirdiṣṭair vīryasāmarthyasūcakaiḥ /
yuktilaukikadṛṣṭāntaistacchokaṃ saṃvyaśāmayat //
meaning:
हेतुभिः शास्त्रनिर्दिष्टैर् वीर्यसामर्थ्यसूचकैः /
युक्तिलौकिकदृष्टान्तैस्तच्छोकं संव्यशामयत् //
text_mt: With reasons taught in the scriptures indicative of strength and valour, / with logical arguments and worldly examples, he completely appeased that grief.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃtvitastena maidhāvī dhṛtimālaṃbya bhārgavaḥ /
prayayau sahitaḥ sakhyā bhrātṝṇāṃ tu didṛkṣayā //
meaning:
सांत्वितस्तेन मैधावी धृतिमालंब्य भार्गवः /
प्रययौ सहितः सख्या भ्रातॄणां तु दिदृक्षया //
text_mt: Consoled by him, the wise Bhārgava, taking hold of his resolve, / departed along with his friend, wishing to see his brothers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāndṛṣṭvābhivādyaitānduḥkhitānduḥkhakarśitaḥ /
śokāmaṣayutastaiśca saha tsthau dinatrayam //
meaning:
स तान्दृष्ट्वाभिवाद्यैतान्दुःखितान्दुःखकर्शितः /
शोकामषयुतस्तैश्च सह त्स्थौ दिनत्रयम् //
text_mt: Having seen them, emaciated with grief, he saluted those sorrowful ones; / filled with grief and wrath, he stayed with them for three days.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'sya sumāhānkrodhaḥ smarato nidhanaṃ pituḥ /
babhūva sahasā sarvalokasaṃharaṇakṣamaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽस्य सुमाहान्क्रोधः स्मरतो निधनं पितुः /
बभूव सहसा सर्वलोकसंहरणक्षमः //
text_mt: Then, as he remembered his father's death, an immense wrath arose / suddenly in him, capable of destroying all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
māturarthe kṛtāṃ pūrvaṃ pratijñāṃ satyasaṃgaraḥ /
dṛḍhīcakāra hṛdaye sarvakṣatravadhodyataḥ //
meaning:
मातुरर्थे कृतां पूर्वं प्रतिज्ञां सत्यसंगरः /
दृढीचकार हृदये सर्वक्षत्रवधोद्यतः //
text_mt: True to his promise, he made firm in his heart / the vow previously made for his mother's sake, intent on slaying all kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatravaṃśyānaśeṣeṇa hatvā taddehalohitaiḥ /
kariṣye tarpaṇaṃ pitroriti niścitya bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्रवंश्यानशेषेण हत्वा तद्देहलोहितैः /
करिष्ये तर्पणं पित्रोरिति निश्चित्य भार्गवः //
text_mt: "Having completely slain the descendants of the kṣatriya lineage, / I shall make libations to my parents with the blood of their bodies"—having thus resolved, the Bhārgava,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāmākhyāyātmasamīhitam /
prayayau tadanujñātaḥ kṛtvā saṃsthāṃpituḥ kriyām //
meaning:
भ्रातॄणां चैव सर्वेषामाख्यायात्मसमीहितम् /
प्रययौ तदनुज्ञातः कृत्वा संस्थांपितुः क्रियाम् //
text_mt: disclosed his intention to all his brothers; / having performed the funeral rites for his father and permitted by them, he set forth.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ prāpya māhiṣmatīṃ tataḥ /
tadbāhyopavane sthitvā sasmāra sa mahodaram //
meaning:
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः प्राप्य माहिष्मतीं ततः /
तद्बाह्योपवने स्थित्वा सस्मार स महोदरम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, he then reached Māhiṣmatī; / staying in its outer park, he remembered Mahodara.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasmai rathacāpādyaṃ sahasāśvasamanvitam /
preṣayāmāsa rāmāya sarvasaṃhananāni ca //
meaning:
स तस्मै रथचापाद्यं सहसाश्वसमन्वितम् /
प्रेषयामास रामाय सर्वसंहननानि च //
text_mt: He quickly sent to that Rāma a chariot, bows, and other weapons, / along with horses, and all forms of body armour.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'pi rathamāruhya sannaddhaḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ /
gṛhītvāpūrayacchaṅkhaṃ rudradattamamitrajit //
meaning:
रामो ऽपि रथमारुह्य सन्नद्धः सशरं धनुः /
गृहीत्वापूरयच्छङ्खं रुद्रदत्तममित्रजित् //
text_mt: Mounting the chariot and clad in armour, Rāma, conqueror of enemies, / took his bow along with arrows and blew the conch given by Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
jyāghoṣaṃ ca cakāroccai rodasī kaṃpayanniva /
sahasāhotha sārathyaṃ cakre sārathināṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
ज्याघोषं च चकारोच्चै रोदसी कंपयन्निव /
सहसाहोथ सारथ्यं चक्रे सारथिनां वरः //
text_mt: And he made a twang of the bowstring loudly, as if shaking heaven and earth; / then Sahasāha, the best of charioteers, took charge of the driving.

sanskrit_iast:
rathajyāśaṅkhanādaistu vadhātpitroramarṣiṇaḥ /
tasyābhūnnagarī sarvā saṃkṣubdhāśca naradvipāḥ //
meaning:
रथज्याशङ्खनादैस्तु वधात्पित्रोरमर्षिणः /
तस्याभून्नगरी सर्वा संक्षुब्धाश्च नरद्विपाः //
text_mt: By the sounds of the chariot, the bowstring, and the conch of him who was enraged by the murder of his parents, / that entire city was agitated, and its men and elephants were shaken.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ tvāgatamājñāya sarvakṣatrakulāntakam /
saṃkṣubdhāścakrurudyogaṃ saṃgrāmāya nṛpātmajāḥ //
meaning:
रामं त्वागतमाज्ञाय सर्वक्षत्रकुलान्तकम् /
संक्षुब्धाश्चक्रुरुद्योगं संग्रामाय नृपात्मजाः //
text_mt: Having learnt that Rāma had arrived, the exterminator of the entire kṣatriya race, / the agitated sons of the king made preparation for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
atha pañcarathāḥ śurāḥ śūrasenādayo nṛpa /
rāmeṇa yoddhuṃ sahitā rājabhiśca krurudyamam //
meaning:
अथ पञ्चरथाः शुराः शूरसेनादयो नृप /
रामेण योद्धुं सहिता राजभिश्च क्रुरुद्यमम् //
text_mt: Then the five charioteers, heroic Śūrasena and the others, O king, / joined with kings and made an effort to fight against Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgavalopetāstataste kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ /
rāmamāsādayāmāsuḥ pataṅgā iva pāvakam //
meaning:
चतुरङ्गवलोपेतास्ततस्ते क्षत्रियर्षभाः /
राममासादयामासुः पतङ्गा इव पावकम् //
text_mt: Endowed with fourfold armies, those bulls among kṣatriyas / then rushed at Rāma like moths into a fire.

sanskrit_iast:
nivārya tānāpatato rathenaikena bhārgavaḥ /
yuyudhe pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ samare 'mitavikramaḥ //
meaning:
निवार्य तानापततो रथेनैकेन भार्गवः /
युयुधे पार्थिवैः सर्वैः समरे ऽमितविक्रमः //
text_mt: Warding them off as they rushed on, the Bhārgava of immeasurable prowess / fought with all the kings in battle with a single chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ punarabhūdyuddhaṃ rāmasya saha rājabhiḥ /
jaghāna yatra saṃkruddho rājñāṃ śatamudāradhīḥ //
meaning:
ततः पुनरभूद्युद्धं रामस्य सह राजभिः /
जघान यत्र संक्रुद्धो राज्ञां शतमुदारधीः //
text_mt: Then once again a battle took place between Rāma and the kings, / wherein the high-minded one, intensely enraged, slew a hundred kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa śūrasenādīnhatvā sabalavāhanān /
traṇena pātayāmāsa kṣitau kṣatriyamaṇḍalam //
meaning:
ततः स शूरसेनादीन्हत्वा सबलवाहनान् /
त्रणेन पातयामास क्षितौ क्षत्रियमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Then, having slain Śūrasena and the others along with their armies and mounts, / he felled the host of kṣatriyas to the earth in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste bhagnasaṃkalpā hatasvabalavāhanāḥ /
hataśiṣṭā nṛpatayo dudruvuḥ sarvatodiśam //
meaning:
ततस्ते भग्नसंकल्पा हतस्वबलवाहनाः /
हतशिष्टा नृपतयो दुद्रुवुः सर्वतोदिशम् //
text_mt: Then, their resolves broken, their armies and mounts destroyed, / the kings who survived the slaughter fled in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vidrāvya sainyāni hatvā jitvātha saṃyuge /
jaghāna śataśo rājñaḥ śūrāñcharavarāgninā //
meaning:
एवं विद्राव्य सैन्यानि हत्वा जित्वाथ संयुगे /
जघान शतशो राज्ञः शूराञ्छरवराग्निना //
text_mt: Having thus routed the armies, having slain and conquered in battle, / he killed hundreds of kings and heroes with the fire of his excellent arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ krodhaparītātmā dagdhukāmo 'khilāṃ purīm /
udairayadbhārgavo 'straṃ kālāgnisadṛśaprabham //
meaning:
ततः क्रोधपरीतात्मा दग्धुकामो ऽखिलां पुरीम् /
उदैरयद्भार्गवो ऽस्त्रं कालाग्निसदृशप्रभम् //
text_mt: Then, his mind consumed with anger, wishing to burn down the entire city, / the Bhārgava unleashed a divine weapon possessing splendour like the fire of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
jvālākavalitāśeṣapuraprākāramālinīm /
purīṃ sahastyaśvanarāṃ sa dadāhāstrapāvakaḥ //
meaning:
ज्वालाकवलिताशेषपुरप्राकारमालिनीम् /
पुरीं सहस्त्यश्वनरां स ददाहास्त्रपावकः //
text_mt: Swallowing all the lines of city ramparts in flames, / that weapon-fire burned down the city together with its elephants, horses, and men.

sanskrit_iast:
dahyamānāṃ purīṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ /
jīvanāya jagāmāśu vītihotro bhayāturaḥ //
meaning:
दह्यमानां पुरीं दृष्ट्वा प्राणत्राणपरायणः /
जीवनाय जगामाशु वीतिहोत्रो भयातुरः //
text_mt: Seeing the city being burnt down, intent on saving his life, / Vītihotra quickly fled to survive, stricken with fear.

sanskrit_iast:
astrāgninā purīṃ sarvāṃ dagdhvā hatvā ca śātravān /
prāśayāno 'khilān lokān sākṣātkāla ivāntakaḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्राग्निना पुरीं सर्वां दग्ध्वा हत्वा च शात्रवान् /
प्राशयानो ऽखिलान् लोकान् साक्षात्काल इवान्तकः //
text_mt: Having burnt the whole city with the weapon-fire and slain his foes, / he seemed to swallow all the worlds like Kāla, the Ender himself.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sahasāhena cānvitaḥ /
jagāmarathaghoṣeṇa kaṃpayanniva medinīm //
meaning:
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तः सहसाहेन चान्वितः /
जगामरथघोषेण कंपयन्निव मेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa and joined by Sahasāha, / he went, as if shaking the earth with the roar of his chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
vinighnan kṣatriyānsarvān saṃśāmya pṛthivītale /
mahendrādriṃ yayau rāmastapase dhatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
विनिघ्नन् क्षत्रियान्सर्वान् संशाम्य पृथिवीतले /
महेन्द्राद्रिं ययौ रामस्तपसे धतमानसः //
text_mt: Striking down all the kṣatriyas, bringing peace to the earth's surface, / Rāma, his mind fixed on austerity, went to Mount Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnaṣṭacatuṣkaṃ ca yāvatkṣatrasamudgamam /
pratyetya bhūyastaddhatyai baddhadīkṣo dhṛtavrataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्नष्टचतुष्कं च यावत्क्षत्रसमुद्गमम् /
प्रत्येत्य भूयस्तद्धत्यै बद्धदीक्षो धृतव्रतः //
text_mt: Having bound himself by consecration and observed vows, he returned / for their slaughter after thirty-two [years], when the kṣatriyas rose again.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatrakṣetreṣu bhūyaśca kṣatramutpāditaṃ dvijaiḥ /
nijaghāna punarbhūmau rājña śatasahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्रक्षेत्रेषु भूयश्च क्षत्रमुत्पादितं द्विजैः /
निजघान पुनर्भूमौ राज्ञ शतसहस्रशः //
text_mt: And in the kṣatriya wives, kṣatriyas were begotten anew by Brahmins; / he struck down kings on the earth again by the hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣadvayena bhūyo 'pi kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm /
ṣaṭcatuṣṭayavarṣāntaṃ tapastepe punaśca saḥ //
meaning:
वर्षद्वयेन भूयो ऽपि कृत्वा निःक्षत्रियां महीम् /
षट्चतुष्टयवर्षान्तं तपस्तेपे पुनश्च सः //
text_mt: Having made the earth devoid of kṣatriyas once more within two years, / he again performed austerity for twenty-four years.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo 'pi rājan saṃbuddhaṃ kṣatramutpāditaṃ dvijaiḥ /
jaghāna bhūmau niḥśeṣaṃ sākṣātkāla ivāntakaḥ //
meaning:
भूयो ऽपि राजन् संबुद्धं क्षत्रमुत्पादितं द्विजैः /
जघान भूमौ निःशेषं साक्षात्काल इवान्तकः //
text_mt: Again, O king, he slew without remainder on the earth the kṣatriyas / who had grown up, begotten by Brahmins, like Kāla, the Ender himself.

sanskrit_iast:
kālena tāvatā bhūyaḥ samutpannaṃ nṛpāttvayam /
nighnaṃścacāra pṛthivīṃ varṣadvayamanāratam //
meaning:
कालेन तावता भूयः समुत्पन्नं नृपात्त्वयम् /
निघ्नंश्चचार पृथिवीं वर्षद्वयमनारतम् //
text_mt: Within that much time, kṣatriyas were born again; / slaying them, he traversed the earth continuously for two years.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ rāmeṇa rājendra smaratā nidhanaṃ pituḥ /
triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā //
meaning:
अलं रामेण राजेन्द्र स्मरता निधनं पितुः /
त्रिः सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी तेन निःक्षत्रिया कृता //
text_mt: Enough! By Rāma, O king of kings, remembering his father's death, / the earth was made devoid of kṣatriyas thrice seven times.

sanskrit_iast:
triḥsaptakṛtvastanmātā yaduraḥ svamatāḍayat /
tāvadrāmeṇa tasmāttu kṣatramutsāditaṃ bhuvi //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite ṣaṭcatvāriṃśatta mo 'dhyāyaḥ // 46//
meaning:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वस्तन्माता यदुरः स्वमताडयत् /
तावद्रामेण तस्मात्तु क्षत्रमुत्सादितं भुवि //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते षट्चत्वारिंशत्त मो ऽध्यायः // 46//
text_mt:
Because his mother struck her own chest thrice seven times, / for that reason Rāma exterminated the kṣatriyas on earth that many times.

Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, in the story of the Bhārgava, in the third section, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part proclaimed by Vāyu, in the glorious Mahāpurāṇa of Brahmāṇḍa. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
tato mūrddhābhiṣiktānāṃ rājñāmamitatejasām /
ṣaṭsahasradvayaṃ rāmo jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītavān //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
ततो मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तानां राज्ञाममिततेजसाम् /
षट्सहस्रद्वयं रामो जीवग्राहं गृहीतवान् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Then Rāma captured alive twelve thousand / consecrated kings of boundless splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rājasahasrāṇi gṛhītvā munibhiḥ saha /
sa jagāma mahātejāḥ kurukṣetraṃ tapomayam //
meaning:
ततो राजसहस्राणि गृहीत्वा मुनिभिः सह /
स जगाम महातेजाः कुरुक्षेत्रं तपोमयम् //
text_mt: Then, taking thousands of kings along with the sages, / that one of great splendour went to Kurukṣetra, which consists of austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sarasāṃ pañcakaṃ tatra khānayitvā bhṛgudvahaḥ /
sukhāvagāhatīrthāni tāni cakre samantataḥ //
meaning:
सरसां पञ्चकं तत्र खानयित्वा भृगुद्वहः /
सुखावगाहतीर्थानि तानि चक्रे समन्ततः //
text_mt: Having had five lakes dug there, the best of the Bhṛgus / made them into sacred bathing sites of easy descent on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna tatra vai rājñaḥ śarīraprabhavāmṛjā /
sarāṃsi tāni vai pañca pūrayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
जघान तत्र वै राज्ञः शरीरप्रभवामृजा /
सरांसि तानि वै पञ्च पूरयामास भार्गवः //
text_mt: There he slew the kings; with the liquid produced from their bodies / the Bhārgava filled those five lakes.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā teṣu yathānyāyaṃ jāmadagnayaḥ pratāpavān /
pitṝnsaṃtarpayāmāsa yathāśāstramatandritaḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा तेषु यथान्यायं जामदग्नयः प्रतापवान् /
पितॄन्संतर्पयामास यथाशास्त्रमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: Having bathed in them in the proper manner, the glorious son of Jamadagni, / unflagging, satisfied his ancestors in accordance with the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ pretasya rājendra śrāddhādikamaśeṣataḥ /
brāhmaṇaiḥ saha mātuśca tatra cakre yathoditam //
meaning:
पितुः प्रेतस्य राजेन्द्र श्राद्धादिकमशेषतः /
ब्राह्मणैः सह मातुश्च तत्र चक्रे यथोदितम् //
text_mt: O best of kings, along with Brahmins he performed there entirely / the ancestral rites and other ceremonies as prescribed for his deceased father and mother.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tīrṇapratīkaḥ sa kurukṣetre tapomaye /
uvāsātandritaḥ samyak pitṛpūjāparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
एवं तीर्णप्रतीकः स कुरुक्षेत्रे तपोमये /
उवासातन्द्रितः सम्यक् पितृपूजापरायणः //
text_mt: Having thus fulfilled his pledge, in Kurukṣetra, which consists of austerity, / he dwelt, untiring and completely devoted to the worship of his ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛtyabhūdrājaṃstīrthānāmuttamottamam /
vihitaṃ jāmadagnyena kurukṣetre tapovane //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृत्यभूद्राजंस्तीर्थानामुत्तमोत्तमम् /
विहितं जामदग्न्येन कुरुक्षेत्रे तपोवने //
text_mt: From that time forth, O king, there came to be the highest of all sacred places, / established by the son of Jamadagni in the penance grove of Kurukṣetra,

sanskrit_iast:
sasyamaṃ tapañcakamiti sthānaṃ trailokyaviśrutam /
yatra yakre bhṛguśreṣṭhaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimakṣayām //
meaning:
सस्यमं तपञ्चकमिति स्थानं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् /
यत्र यक्रे भृगुश्रेष्ठः पितॄणां तृप्तिमक्षयाम् //
text_mt: the place known across the three worlds as Samantapañcaka, / where the best of the Bhṛgus brought imperishable satisfaction to his ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
snānadānatapohomadvijabhojanatarpaṇaiḥ /
bhṛśamāpyāyitāstena yatra te pitaro 'khilāḥ //
meaning:
स्नानदानतपोहोमद्विजभोजनतर्पणैः /
भृशमाप्यायितास्तेन यत्र ते पितरो ऽखिलाः //
text_mt: Where all those ancestors were abundantly gratified by him / through ablutions, gifts, austerities, fire offerings, feeding Brahmins, and libations,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpurakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṛlokaṃ ca śāśvatam /
samantapañcakaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ loke pariśrutam //
meaning:
अवापुरक्षयां तृप्तिं पितृलोकं च शाश्वतम् /
समन्तपञ्चकं नाम तीर्थं लोके परिश्रुतम् //
text_mt: they attained imperishable satisfaction and the eternal realm of ancestors; / the sacred site celebrated in the world by the name Samantapañcaka

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ mahāpuṇyopabṛṃhitam /
martyānāṃ yatra yātānāmenāṃsi nikhilāni tu //
meaning:
सर्वपापक्षयकरं महापुण्योपबृंहितम् /
मर्त्यानां यत्र यातानामेनांसि निखिलानि तु //
text_mt: destroys all sins and is magnified by great merit; / when mortals go there, all their sins

sanskrit_iast:
dūrādevāpayāsyanti pravāte śuṣkaparṇavat /
tatkṣetracaryāgamanaṃ martyānāmasatāmiha //
meaning:
दूरादेवापयास्यन्ति प्रवाते शुष्कपर्णवत् /
तत्क्षेत्रचर्यागमनं मर्त्यानामसतामिह //
text_mt: will flee far away, like dry leaves in a gust of wind. / For wicked mortals in this world, reaching and walking in that sacred precinct

sanskrit_iast:
na labhyate mahārāja jātu janmaśatairapi /
samantapañcakaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetre 'tipāvanam //
meaning:
न लभ्यते महाराज जातु जन्मशतैरपि /
समन्तपञ्चकं तीर्थं कुरुक्षेत्रे ऽतिपावनम् //
text_mt: cannot be obtained, O great king, even in hundreds of births— / the sacred site Samantapañcaka, supremely purifying in Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra snātaḥ sarvatīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ /
kṛtakṛtyastato rāmaḥ samyak pūrṇamanorathaḥ //
meaning:
यत्र स्नातः सर्वतीर्थैः स्नातो भवति मानवः /
कृतकृत्यस्ततो रामः सम्यक् पूर्णमनोरथः //
text_mt: bathing in which a person is bathed in all sacred waters. / Thereupon, having accomplished his task and fully fulfilled his desires, Rāma,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāsa tatra niyataḥ kañcitkālaṃ mahāmatiḥ /
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vaśī //
meaning:
उवास तत्र नियतः कञ्चित्कालं महामतिः /
ततः संवत्सरस्यान्ते ब्राह्मणैः सहितो वशी //
text_mt: being self-controlled and highly wise, dwelt there restrained for some time. / Then, at the end of a year, accompanied by Brāhmaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛpiṇḍapradānāya jāmadagnyo 'gamadgayām /
tato gatvā tataḥ śrāddhe yathāśāstramarindamaḥ //
meaning:
पितृपिण्डप्रदानाय जामदग्न्यो ऽगमद्गयाम् /
ततो गत्वा ततः श्राद्धे यथाशास्त्रमरिन्दमः //
text_mt: Jāmadagnya, subduer of enemies, went to Gayā to offer rice balls to the ancestors. / Arriving there, at the ancestor-rite in accordance with the scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāṃstarpayāmāsa pitṝnuddiśya satkṛtān /
śaivaṃ tatra paraṃ sthānaṃ candrapādamiti smṛtam //
meaning:
