ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयामास पितॄनुद्दिश्य सत्कृतान् /
शैवं तत्र परं स्थानं चन्द्रपादमिति स्मृतम् //
text_mt: he gratified the honored Brāhmaṇas on behalf of the ancestors. / There is the supreme Śaiva site known as Candrapāda;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛtṛptikaraṃ kṣetraṃ tādṛgloke na vidyate /
yatrārcitāḥ svakulajairyathāśakti manāgapi //
meaning:
पितृतृप्तिकरं क्षेत्रं तादृग्लोके न विद्यते /
यत्रार्चिताः स्वकुलजैर्यथाशक्ति मनागपि //
text_mt: no sacred ground in the world is known like it for satisfying the ancestors, / where, if honored even a little according to ability by members of their family,

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraḥ piṇḍadānādyaiḥ prāpsyanti gatimakṣayām /
pitṝnuddiśya tatrāsau tarppiteṣu dvijātiṣu //
meaning:
पितरः पिण्डदानाद्यैः प्राप्स्यन्ति गतिमक्षयाम् /
पितॄनुद्दिश्य तत्रासौ तर्प्पितेषु द्विजातिषु //
text_mt: the ancestors will attain an imperishable state through offerings of rice balls and the like. / When the twice-born were gratified there on behalf of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau ca vidhivatpiṇḍaṃ pitṛbhaktisamanvitaḥ /
tatastatpitaraḥ sarve pitṛlokādupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ददौ च विधिवत्पिण्डं पितृभक्तिसमन्वितः /
ततस्तत्पितरः सर्वे पितृलोकादुपागताः //
text_mt: he offered the rice ball according to the prescribed rite, filled with devotion to the ancestors. / Then all his ancestors arrived from the realm of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
jagṛhustatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ jamadagnipurogamāḥ /
atha saṃprītamanasaḥ sametya bhṛgunandanam //
meaning:
जगृहुस्तत्कृतां पूजां जमदग्निपुरोगमाः /
अथ संप्रीतमनसः समेत्य भृगुनन्दनम् //
text_mt: headed by Jamadagni, and accepted the worship performed by him. / Then, their minds well pleased, approaching the descendant of Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
ūcustatpitaraḥ sarve 'dṛśyā bhūtvāntarikṣagāḥ /
pitara ūcuḥ
mahatkarma kṛtaṃ vīra bhavatānyaiḥ suduṣkaram //
meaning:
ऊचुस्तत्पितरः सर्वे ऽदृश्या भूत्वान्तरिक्षगाः /
पितर ऊचुः
महत्कर्म कृतं वीर भवतान्यैः सुदुष्करम् //
text_mt: all his ancestors, remaining in the intermediate space invisible, spoke. / The ancestors said: / 'A great deed, very difficult for others to do, has been performed by you, hero!

sanskrit_iast:
asmānapi yathānyāyaṃ samyak tarpitavānasi /
asmākamakṣayāṃ prītiṃ tathāpi tvaṃ na yacchasi //
meaning:
अस्मानपि यथान्यायं सम्यक् तर्पितवानसि /
अस्माकमक्षयां प्रीतिं तथापि त्वं न यच्छसि //
text_mt: You have also properly gratified us according to the rules; / nevertheless, you do not grant us imperishable satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatrahatyāṃ hi kṛtvā tu kṛtakarmābhavadyataḥ /
kṣetrasyāsya prabhāveṇa bhaktyā ca tava darśanam //
meaning:
क्षत्रहत्यां हि कृत्वा तु कृतकर्माभवद्यतः /
क्षेत्रस्यास्य प्रभावेण भक्त्या च तव दर्शनम् //
text_mt: For because you performed the slaughter of the Kṣatriyas, your actions have brought consequence; / but through the power of this sacred place and through your devotion, we have obtained

sanskrit_iast:
prāptāḥsma pūjitāḥ kiṃ tu nākṣayyaphalabhāginaḥ /
tsamāttvaṃ vīrahatyādipāpapraśamanāya hi //
meaning:
प्राप्ताःस्म पूजिताः किं तु नाक्षय्यफलभागिनः /
त्समात्त्वं वीरहत्यादिपापप्रशमनाय हि //
text_mt: sight [of you], and have been honored; yet we are not recipients of the imperishable fruit. / Therefore, for the pacification of the sin of slaying heroes and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kuru dharmaṃ ca śāśvatam /
vadhācca vinivartasva kṣatriyāṇāmataḥ param //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं यथान्यायं कुरु धर्मं च शाश्वतम् /
वधाच्च विनिवर्तस्व क्षत्रियाणामतः परम् //
text_mt: perform expiation according to the rules, and practice eternal dharma; / and desist from the slaughter of Kṣatriyas henceforth!

sanskrit_iast:
piturnna te 'parādhyante na svatantraṃ yato jagat /
tannimittaṃ tu maraṇaṃ pituste vihitaṃ purā //
meaning:
पितुर्न्न ते ऽपराध्यन्ते न स्वतन्त्रं यतो जगत् /
तन्निमित्तं तु मरणं पितुस्ते विहितं पुरा //
text_mt: They did not commit an offense against your father, for the world is not independent; / the death of your father was already ordained formerly with them as the instrument.

sanskrit_iast:
hantuṃ kaṃ kaḥ samarthaḥ syālloke rakṣitumeva vā /
nimittamātrameveha sarvaḥ sarvasya caitayoḥ //
meaning:
हन्तुं कं कः समर्थः स्याल्लोके रक्षितुमेव वा /
निमित्तमात्रमेवेह सर्वः सर्वस्य चैतयोः //
text_mt: Who in this world is able to slay whom, or indeed to protect anyone? / In these two matters, everyone is merely an instrument for everyone else.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ karmānurūpaṃ te ceṣṭante sarva eva hi /
kālānuvṛttaṃ balavānnṛloko nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ध्रुवं कर्मानुरूपं ते चेष्टन्ते सर्व एव हि /
कालानुवृत्तं बलवान्नृलोको नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Truly, all beings act strictly in accordance with their karma; / the world of mortals is powerfully driven by time; there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit_iast:
bādhituṃ bhuvi bhūtāni bhūtānāṃ na vidhiṃ vinā /
śakyate vatsa sarvo 'pi yataḥ śaktyā svakarmakṛt //
meaning:
बाधितुं भुवि भूतानि भूतानां न विधिं विना /
शक्यते वत्स सर्वो ऽपि यतः शक्त्या स्वकर्मकृत् //
text_mt: Beings cannot harm beings on earth without divine ordinance, / dear child, since each one acts according to their karma through their power.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatraṃ prati tato roṣaṃ vimucyāsmatpriyepsayā /
śamamā pnuhi bhadraṃ te sa hyasmākaṃ paraṃ balam //
meaning:
क्षत्रं प्रति ततो रोषं विमुच्यास्मत्प्रियेप्सया /
शममा प्नुहि भद्रं ते स ह्यस्माकं परं बलम् //
text_mt: Therefore, abandoning your anger toward the Kṣatriyas out of a desire for our welfare, / attain tranquility! May you have good fortune! That indeed is our highest strength.'

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
ityuktvāntardadhuḥ sarve pitaro bhṛgunandanam /
sa cāpi tadvacaḥ sarvaṃ pratijagrāha sādaram //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधुः सर्वे पितरो भृगुनन्दनम् /
स चापि तद्वचः सर्वं प्रतिजग्राह सादरम् //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / Having spoken thus, all the ancestors vanished from the descendant of Bhṛgu; / and he too respectfully accepted all their words.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtavraṇasaṃyukto mudā paramayā yutaḥ /
prayayau ca tadā rāmastasmātsiddhavanāśramam //
meaning:
अकृतव्रणसंयुक्तो मुदा परमया युतः /
प्रययौ च तदा रामस्तस्मात्सिद्धवनाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Joined by Akṛtavraṇa, filled with supreme joy, / Rāma then set out from there to the hermitage in the Siddha Forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsthitvā bhṛguśreṣṭho brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito nṛpa /
tapase dhṛtasaṃkalpo babhūva sa mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्स्थित्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठो ब्राह्मणैः सहितो नृप /
तपसे धृतसंकल्पो बभूव स महामनाः //
text_mt: Staying there, O king, that noble-minded best of the Bhṛgus / resolved upon ascetic penance, accompanied by Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarathaṃ sahasāhaṃ ca dhanuḥsaṃhananāni ca /
punarāgamasaṃketaṃ kṛtvā prāsthāpayattadā //
meaning:
सरथं सहसाहं च धनुःसंहननानि च /
पुनरागमसंकेतं कृत्वा प्रास्थापयत्तदा //
text_mt: He sent away his chariot, together with his arms and his implements for stringing bows, / making an appointment for their return at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa sarvatīrtheṣu cakre snānamatandritaḥ /
parītyapṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ pitṛdevādibūjakaḥ //
meaning:
ततः स सर्वतीर्थेषु चक्रे स्नानमतन्द्रितः /
परीत्यपृथिवीं सर्वां पितृदेवादिबूजकः //
text_mt: Then, unwearied, he bathed in all the sacred waters, / roaming the entire earth, worshipping ancestors, deities, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ krameṇa pṛthivīṃ trivāraṃ bhugunandanaḥ /
paricakrāma rājendra lokavṛttamanuvrataḥ //
meaning:
एवं क्रमेण पृथिवीं त्रिवारं भुगुनन्दनः /
परिचक्राम राजेन्द्र लोकवृत्तमनुव्रतः //
text_mt: In this manner, following the conduct of the world, the descendant of Bhṛgu / traversed the earth three times, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa parvataśreṣṭhaṃ mahendraṃ punarapyatha /
jagāma tapase rājanbāhmaṇairabhisaṃvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ततः स पर्वतश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रं पुनरप्यथ /
जगाम तपसे राजन्बाह्मणैरभिसंवृतः //
text_mt: Then, O king, surrounded by Brāhmaṇas, he went again / to Mahendra, the best of mountains, for the sake of ascetic penance.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasmiṃścirarātrāya muni siddhaniṣevite /
nivāsamātmano rājankalpayāmāsa dharmavit //
meaning:
स तस्मिंश्चिररात्राय मुनि सिद्धनिषेविते /
निवासमात्मनो राजन्कल्पयामास धर्मवित् //
text_mt: On that mountain resorted to by Siddhas, O king, that knower of dharma, / the sage, prepared his abode for a long period.

sanskrit_iast:
munayastaṃ tapasyantaṃ sarvakṣetranivāsinaḥ /
draṣṭukāmāḥ samājagmurniyatā brahmavādinaḥ //
meaning:
मुनयस्तं तपस्यन्तं सर्वक्षेत्रनिवासिनः /
द्रष्टुकामाः समाजग्मुर्नियता ब्रह्मवादिनः //
text_mt: Desiring to see him engaged in asceticism, the self-controlled sages, / expositors of the Veda dwelling in all sacred places, gathered together.

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśuste munigaṇāstapasyāsaktamānasam /
kṣātraṃ kakṣamaśeṣeṇa dagdhvā śāntamivānalam //
meaning:
ददृशुस्ते मुनिगणास्तपस्यासक्तमानसम् /
क्षात्रं कक्षमशेषेण दग्ध्वा शान्तमिवानलम् //
text_mt: Those hosts of sages saw him whose mind was intent on asceticism, / like a fire that has quieted down after burning all the fuel of the Kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tānāgatāndṛṣṭvā munīndivyāṃstapomayān /
arghyādisamudācāraiḥ pūjayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
अथ तानागतान्दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्दिव्यांस्तपोमयान् /
अर्घ्यादिसमुदाचारैः पूजयामास भार्गवः //
text_mt: Then, seeing those divine sages embodied in ascetic power who had arrived, / the Bhārgava honored them with water offerings and traditional courtesies.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtakauśalasaṃpraśnapūrvakāḥ sumahodayāḥ /
teṣāṃ tasya ca saṃvṛttāḥ kathāḥ puṇyā manoharāḥ //
meaning:
कृतकौशलसंप्रश्नपूर्वकाः सुमहोदयाः /
तेषां तस्य च संवृत्ताः कथाः पुण्या मनोहराः //
text_mt: Beginning with inquiries of well-being, most auspicious, / sacred, and charming conversations took place between them and him.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣāmanumate munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām /
hayamedhaṃ mahāyajñamāhartumupacakrame //
meaning:
ततस्तेषामनुमते मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् /
हयमेधं महायज्ञमाहर्तुमुपचक्रमे //
text_mt: Then, with the assent of those sages of purified self, / he undertook to perform the great sacrifice, the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhṛtya sarvasaṃbhārānaurvādyaiḥ sahito nṛpa /
viśvāmitrabharadvājamārkaṇḍeyādibhistathā //
meaning:
संभृत्य सर्वसंभारानौर्वाद्यैः सहितो नृप /
विश्वामित्रभरद्वाजमार्कण्डेयादिभिस्तथा //
text_mt: Gathering all the sacrificial materials, accompanied by the descendants of Ūrva and others, O king, / as well as Viśvāmitra, Bharadvāja, Mārkaṇḍeya, and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣā manumate kṛtvā kāśyapaṃ gurumātmanaḥ /
vājimedhaṃ tato rājannājahāra mahākratum //
meaning:
तेषा मनुमते कृत्वा काश्यपं गुरुमात्मनः /
वाजिमेधं ततो राजन्नाजहार महाक्रतुम् //
text_mt: and making Kāśyapa his officiating priest with their approval, / he then performed the great horse sacrifice, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhūtkāśyapo 'dhvaryurudgātā gautamo muniḥ /
viśvāmitro 'bhavaddhotā rāmasya viditātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याभूत्काश्यपो ऽध्वर्युरुद्गाता गौतमो मुनिः /
विश्वामित्रो ऽभवद्धोता रामस्य विदितात्मनः //
text_mt: Kāśyapa became his adhvaryu, the sage Gautama the udgātā, / and Viśvāmitra was the hotā for Rāma of known self.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmatvamakarottasya mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ /
bharadvājāgniveśyādyā veda vedāṅgapāragāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मत्वमकरोत्तस्य मार्कण्डेयो महामुनिः /
भरद्वाजाग्निवेश्याद्या वेद वेदाङ्गपारगाः //
text_mt: The great sage Mārkaṇḍeya assumed the office of brahman priest; / Bharadvāja, Āgniveśya, and others, who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

sanskrit_iast:
munayaścakruranyāni karmāṇyanye yathākramam /
puttraiḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiśca sahito bhagavānbhṛguḥ //
meaning:
मुनयश्चक्रुरन्यानि कर्माण्यन्ये यथाक्रमम् /
पुत्त्रैः शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैश्च सहितो भगवान्भृगुः //
text_mt: and other sages performed the other rites in due order; / and the venerable Bhṛgu, along with his sons, disciples, and grand-disciples,

sanskrit_iast:
sādasyamakarodrājannanyaiśca munibhiḥ saha /
sa taiḥ sahākhilaṃ karma samāpya bhṛgupuṅgavaḥ //
meaning:
सादस्यमकरोद्राजन्नन्यैश्च मुनिभिः सह /
स तैः सहाखिलं कर्म समाप्य भृगुपुङ्गवः //
text_mt: together with other sages, served as the assembly members, O king. / Having completed the entire rite with them, the eminent Bhṛgu

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ pūjayāmāsa yathāvadguruṇā saha /
alaṅkṛtya yathānyāya kanyāṃ rūpavatīṃ mahīm //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं पूजयामास यथावद्गुरुणा सह /
अलङ्कृत्य यथान्याय कन्यां रूपवतीं महीम् //
text_mt: duly honored the brahman priest along with the preceptor. / Adorning the beautiful earth according to proper custom, like a maiden,

sanskrit_iast:
puragrāmaśatopetāṃ samudrāṃbaramālinīm /
āhūya bhṛguśārdūlaḥ saśailavanakānanām //
meaning:
पुरग्रामशतोपेतां समुद्रांबरमालिनीम् /
आहूय भृगुशार्दूलः सशैलवनकाननाम् //
text_mt: endowed with hundreds of cities and villages, garlanded with the ocean for its garment, / containing mountains, forests, and woods, the tiger among Bhṛgus summoned [Kāśyapa]

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyapāya dadau sarvāmṛte taṃ śailamuttamam /
ātmanaḥ sannivāsārthaṃ taṃ rāmaḥ paryakalpayat //
meaning:
काश्यपाय ददौ सर्वामृते तं शैलमुत्तमम् /
आत्मनः सन्निवासार्थं तं रामः पर्यकल्पयत् //
text_mt: and gave it all to Kāśyapa, except for that excellent mountain; / that one Rāma reserved for his own habitation.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabhṛtirājendra pūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ /
hiraṇyaratnavastraśvagogajānnādibhistathā //
meaning:
ततः प्रभृतिराजेन्द्र पूजयामास शास्त्रतः /
हिरण्यरत्नवस्त्रश्वगोगजान्नादिभिस्तथा //
text_mt: From then on, O best of kings, he honored [them] according to the scriptures / with gold, jewels, garments, horses, cows, elephants, food, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
purā samāpya yajñānte tathā cāvabhṛthāplutaḥ /
cakre dravyaparityāgaṃ teṣāmanumate tadā //
meaning:
पुरा समाप्य यज्ञान्ते तथा चावभृथाप्लुतः /
चक्रे द्रव्यपरित्यागं तेषामनुमते तदा //
text_mt: Having concluded the sacrifice at the end and bathed in the final ablution, / he then distributed his wealth with their permission.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā ca sarvabhūtānāmabhayaṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ /
tatrāpi parvatavare tapaścartuṃ samārabhat //
meaning:
दत्त्वा च सर्वभूतानामभयं भृगुनन्दनः /
तत्रापि पर्वतवरे तपश्चर्तुं समारभत् //
text_mt: And granting freedom from fear to all beings, the descendant of Bhṛgu / began to practice ascetic penance there on that excellent mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastaṃ samanujñāya sadasyā ṛtvijastathā /
yayuryathāgataṃ sarve munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तं समनुज्ञाय सदस्या ऋत्विजस्तथा /
ययुर्यथागतं सर्वे मुनयः शंसितव्रताः //
text_mt: Then, taking leave of him, the assembly members, the officiating priests, / and all the sages of praised vows departed just as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣu teṣu bhagavānakṛtavraṇasaṃyutaḥ /
tapo mahatsamāsthāya tatraiva nyavasatsukhī //
meaning:
गतेषु तेषु भगवानकृतव्रणसंयुतः /
तपो महत्समास्थाय तत्रैव न्यवसत्सुखी //
text_mt: When they had departed, the venerable one, accompanied by Akṛtavraṇa, / undertook great asceticism and dwelt right there happily.

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyapī tu tato bhūmirjananāthā hyanekaśaḥ /
sarvaduḥkhapraśāntyarthaṃ mārīcānumatena tu //
meaning:
काश्यपी तु ततो भूमिर्जननाथा ह्यनेकशः /
सर्वदुःखप्रशान्त्यर्थं मारीचानुमतेन तु //
text_mt: Then the earth, belonging to Kāśyapa, had many rulers; / and for the pacification of all sorrows, with the assent of [Kāśyapa] son of Marīci,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra dīpapratiṣṭhākhyavrataṃ viṣṇumukhoditam /
cacāra dharaṇī samyak dukhairḥmuktābhavacca sā //
meaning:
तत्र दीपप्रतिष्ठाख्यव्रतं विष्णुमुखोदितम् /
चचार धरणी सम्यक् दुखैर्ःमुक्ताभवच्च सा //
text_mt: the earth properly performed the vow called the dedication of lamps, spoken from the mouth of Viṣṇu, / and she was liberated from sorrows.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa jāmadagnyasya prādurbhāva udāhṛtaḥ /
yasmiñśrute naraḥ sarvapātakairvipramucyate //
meaning:
इत्येष जामदग्न्यस्य प्रादुर्भाव उदाहृतः /
यस्मिञ्श्रुते नरः सर्वपातकैर्विप्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Thus this manifestation of Jāmadagnya has been recounted, / upon hearing which a person is completely freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāvaḥ kārttavīryasya loke prathitatejasaḥ /
prasaṃgātkathitaḥ samyaṅnātisaṃkṣepavistaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रभावः कार्त्तवीर्यस्य लोके प्रथिततेजसः /
प्रसंगात्कथितः सम्यङ्नातिसंक्षेपविस्तरः //
text_mt: The majesty of Kārttavīrya, whose splendor was famed throughout the world, / has been fully recounted in this context, neither too concise nor too detailed.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa nṛpaḥ kārttavīryo 'bhavadbhuvi /
na tādṛśaḥ pumātkaścidbhāvī bhūtāthavā śrutaḥ //
meaning:
एवंप्रभावः स नृपः कार्त्तवीर्यो ऽभवद्भुवि /
न तादृशः पुमात्कश्चिद्भावी भूताथवा श्रुतः //
text_mt: Such was the majesty of King Kārttavīrya on earth; / no such man will ever be, has ever been, or was ever heard of.

sanskrit_iast:
dattātreyādvaraṃ vavre mṛtimuttamapūruṣāt /
yatpurā so 'gamanmuktiṃ raṇe rāmeṇa ghātitaḥ //
meaning:
दत्तात्रेयाद्वरं वव्रे मृतिमुत्तमपूरुषात् /
यत्पुरा सो ऽगमन्मुक्तिं रणे रामेण घातितः //
text_mt: From Dattātreya he chose the boon of death at the hands of the foremost person, / through which he formerly attained liberation when slain in battle by Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāsītpañcamaḥ putraḥ pakhyāto yo jayadhvajaḥ /
putrastasya mahābāhustālajaṅgho 'bhavannṛpa //
meaning:
तस्यासीत्पञ्चमः पुत्रः पख्यातो यो जयध्वजः /
पुत्रस्तस्य महाबाहुस्तालजङ्घो ऽभवन्नृप //
text_mt: He had a fifth son, celebrated as Jayadhvaja; / his son was the mighty-armed Tālajaṅgha, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
abhūttasyāpi putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām /
tālajaṅghābhidhā yeṣāṃ vītihotro 'grajo 'bhavat //
meaning:
अभूत्तस्यापि पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् /
तालजङ्घाभिधा येषां वीतिहोत्रो ऽग्रजो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: He too had a hundred sons, excellent archers, / called the Tālajaṅghas, of whom Vītihotra was the eldest.

sanskrit_iast:
putraiḥ savītihotrādyairhaihayādyaiśca rājabhiḥ /
kālaṃ mahāntamavasaddhimādrivānagahvare //
meaning:
पुत्रैः सवीतिहोत्राद्यैर्हैहयाद्यैश्च राजभिः /
कालं महान्तमवसद्धिमाद्रिवानगह्वरे //
text_mt: With his sons, headed by Vītihotra, and the Haihaya kings, / he lived for a long time in a cave in the forest of the Himavat mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ pūrvaṃ rāma bāṇena dravanpṛṣṭhe 'bhitāḍitaḥ /
tālajaṅgho 'patadbhūmau mūrchito gāḍhavedanaḥ //
meaning:
यः पूर्वं राम बाणेन द्रवन्पृष्ठे ऽभिताडितः /
तालजङ्घो ऽपतद्भूमौ मूर्छितो गाढवेदनः //
text_mt: Formerly struck in the back by Rāma's arrow as he fled, / Tālajaṅgha fell to the earth unconscious, in severe agony.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa vītihotrastaṃ dravandaivavaśādiva /
rathamāropya vegena palāyanaparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
ददर्श वीतिहोत्रस्तं द्रवन्दैववशादिव /
रथमारोप्य वेगेन पलायनपरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Vītihotra, as if driven by fate, saw him as he fled; / placing him on his chariot, he quickly set about fleeing.

sanskrit_iast:
te tatra nyavasansarve himādrau bhayapīḍitāḥ /
kṛcchraṃ mahāntamāsādya śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ //
meaning:
ते तत्र न्यवसन्सर्वे हिमाद्रौ भयपीडिताः /
कृच्छ्रं महान्तमासाद्य शाकमूलफलाशनः //
text_mt: Stricken with fear, they all dwelt there on the Himavat, / having met with great hardship, subsisting on herbs, roots, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śāntiṃ gate rāme tapasyāsaktamānase /
jālajaṅghaḥ svakaṃ rājyaṃ saputraḥ pratyapadyata //
meaning:
ततः शान्तिं गते रामे तपस्यासक्तमानसे /
जालजङ्घः स्वकं राज्यं सपुत्रः प्रत्यपद्यत //
text_mt: Then, when Rāma had found peace and his mind was fixed on ascetic practice, / Tālajaṅgha, together with his sons, regained his own kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
sanniveśya purīṃ bhūyaḥ pūrvavannṛpasattamaḥ /
vasaṃstadā nijaṃ rājyamāpālayadarindamaḥ //
meaning:
सन्निवेश्य पुरीं भूयः पूर्ववन्नृपसत्तमः /
वसंस्तदा निजं राज्यमापालयदरिन्दमः //
text_mt: Having re-established the city as before, that best of kings, / living there, that subduer of enemies governed his realm.

sanskrit_iast:
suputraḥ sānugabalaḥ pūrvavairamanusmaran /
abhyāyayau mahārāja tālajaṅghaḥ puraṃ tava //
meaning:
सुपुत्रः सानुगबलः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् /
अभ्याययौ महाराज तालजङ्घः पुरं तव //
text_mt: Accompanied by his worthy sons and an army of followers, remembering the ancient enmity, / Tālajaṅgha marched against your city, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgabalopetaḥ kaṃpayanniva medinīm /
rurodābhyetya nagarīmayodhyāṃ sa mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
चतुरङ्गबलोपेतः कंपयन्निव मेदिनीम् /
रुरोदाभ्येत्य नगरीमयोध्यां स महीपतिः //
text_mt: Endowed with a fourfold army, as though making the earth tremble, / that ruler of the earth approached and besieged the city of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niṣkramya nagarātphalagutantro 'pi te pitā /
yuyudhe tairnṛpaiḥ sarvairvṛddho 'pi taruṇo yathā //
meaning:
ततो निष्क्रम्य नगरात्फलगुतन्त्रो ऽपि ते पिता /
युयुधे तैर्नृपैः सर्वैर्वृद्धो ऽपि तरुणो यथा //
text_mt: Then your father, going forth from the city though with feeble forces, / fought with all those kings, though old, as if he were a youth.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatānekamātagaturaṅgarathasainikaḥ /
śatrubhirnirjito vṛddhaḥ palāyanaparo ' bhavat //
meaning:
निहतानेकमातगतुरङ्गरथसैनिकः /
शत्रुभिर्निर्जितो वृद्धः पलायनपरो ' भवत् //
text_mt: Having slain many of their elephant-, horse-, and chariot-soldiers, / the old man, defeated by the enemies, took to flight.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā sa nagaraṃ rājyaṃ sakośabalavāhanam /
antarvatnyā ca te mātrā sahito vanamāviśat //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा स नगरं राज्यं सकोशबलवाहनम् /
अन्तर्वत्न्या च ते मात्रा सहितो वनमाविशत् //
text_mt: Abandoning city and kingdom, along with his treasury, army, and mounts, / he entered the forest together with your pregnant mother.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra caurvāśramopānte nivasannacirādiva /
śokāmarṣasamāviṣṭo vṛddhabhāvena ca svayam //
meaning:
तत्र चौर्वाश्रमोपान्ते निवसन्नचिरादिव /
शोकामर्षसमाविष्टो वृद्धभावेन च स्वयम् //
text_mt: Dwelling there near Aurva's hermitage, not long after, / overcome with grief and anger, and also by his advanced age,

sanskrit_iast:
vilokyamāno mātrā te bāṣpagadgadakaṇṭhayā /
anātha iva rājendra svargalokamito gataḥ //
meaning:
विलोक्यमानो मात्रा ते बाष्पगद्गदकण्ठया /
अनाथ इव राजेन्द्र स्वर्गलोकमितो गतः //
text_mt: as your mother watched with a throat choked with tears, / he departed from this world for heaven like a helpless man, O foremost of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste jananī rājanduḥkhaśokasamanvitā /
citāmāropayadbhartū rudatī sā kalevaram //
meaning:
ततस्ते जननी राजन्दुःखशोकसमन्विता /
चितामारोपयद्भर्तू रुदती सा कलेवरम् //
text_mt: Then your mother, O king, filled with misery and grief, / weeping, placed her husband's body upon the pyre.

sanskrit_iast:
anaśanādiduḥkhena bhartturvyasanakarśitā /
cakārāgnipraveśāya sudṛḍhāṃ matimātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अनशनादिदुःखेन भर्त्तुर्व्यसनकर्शिता /
चकाराग्निप्रवेशाय सुदृढां मतिमात्मनः //
text_mt: Wasted by the torment of her husband's plight and the suffering of fasting and the like, / she made a firm resolution to enter the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
aurvastadakhilaṃ śrutvā svayameva mahāmuniḥ /
nirgatya cāśramāttāṃ ca vārayannidamabravīt //
meaning:
और्वस्तदखिलं श्रुत्वा स्वयमेव महामुनिः /
निर्गत्य चाश्रमात्तां च वारयन्निदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing all that, the great sage Aurva himself / came out of the hermitage and, preventing her, said this:

sanskrit_iast:
na marttavyaṃ tvayā rājñi sāṃprataṃ jaṭhare tava /
putrastiṣṭhati sarveṣāṃ pravaraścavarttinām //
meaning:
न मर्त्तव्यं त्वया राज्ञि सांप्रतं जठरे तव /
पुत्रस्तिष्ठति सर्वेषां प्रवरश्चवर्त्तिनाम् //
text_mt: "You must not die, O queen! At present in your womb / dwells a son who will be the foremost of all universal emperors."

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mātā tava manasvinī /
virarāma mṛtestāṃ tu muniḥ svāśramamānayat /
tataḥ sā sarvaduḥkhāni niyamya tvanmukhāṃbujam //
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा माता तव मनस्विनी /
विरराम मृतेस्तां तु मुनिः स्वाश्रममानयत् /
ततः सा सर्वदुःखानि नियम्य त्वन्मुखांबुजम् //
text_mt: Hearing his words, your high-minded mother / desisted from dying, and the sage led her to his hermitage. / Then she, checking all her sorrows, eager to behold your lotus face,

sanskrit_iast:
didṛkṣurāśramopānte tasyaiva nyavasatsukham /
suṣāva ca tataḥ kāle sā tvāmaurvāśrame tadā //
meaning:
दिदृक्षुराश्रमोपान्ते तस्यैव न्यवसत्सुखम् /
सुषाव च ततः काले सा त्वामौर्वाश्रमे तदा //
text_mt: dwelt happily near his hermitage. / Then, in due course, she gave birth to you there in Aurva's hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavataḥ so 'karonmuniḥ /
aurvāśrame vivṛddhaśca bhavāṃstenānukaṃpitaḥ //
meaning:
जातकर्मादिकं सर्वं भवतः सो ऽकरोन्मुनिः /
और्वाश्रमे विवृद्धश्च भवांस्तेनानुकंपितः //
text_mt: The sage performed all your rites, beginning with the birth ceremonies; / and you, favored by him, grew up in Aurva's hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayaiva viditaṃ sarvamataḥ paramarindama /
evaṃ prabhāvo nṛpatiḥ kārttavīryo 'bhavadbhuvi //
meaning:
त्वयैव विदितं सर्वमतः परमरिन्दम /
एवं प्रभावो नृपतिः कार्त्तवीर्यो ऽभवद्भुवि //
text_mt: All beyond this is known to you yourself, O subduer of enemies. / Such was the majesty of King Kārttavīrya on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ /
yadvaṃśajairjito yuddhe pitā te vanamādiśat //
meaning:
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेण सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः /
यद्वंशजैर्जितो युद्धे पिता ते वनमादिशत् //
text_mt: renowned throughout all the worlds through the power of this observance, / whose descendants conquered your father in battle and drove him to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvṛttāntamaśeṣeṇa mayā te samudīritam /
etacca sarvamākhyātaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ tava //
meaning:
तद्वृत्तान्तमशेषेण मया ते समुदीरितम् /
एतच्च सर्वमाख्यातं व्रतानामुत्तमं तव //
text_mt: I have told you that story in its entirety; / and this best of observances has all been related to you,

sanskrit_iast:
samantratantraṃ lokeṣu sarvalokaphalapradam /
na hyasya kartturnṛpateḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye //
meaning:
समन्त्रतन्त्रं लोकेषु सर्वलोकफलप्रदम् /
न ह्यस्य कर्त्तुर्नृपतेः पुरुषार्थचतुष्टये //
text_mt: with its mantras and rites, known in the worlds, yielding fruit to all people. / Indeed, for the king who performs it, among the four goals of human life,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatyabhīpsitaṃ kiñciddarllabhaṃ bhuvanatraye /
saṃkṣepeṇa mayākhyātaṃ vrataṃ haihayabhūbhujaḥ /
jāmadagnyasya ca mune kimanyatkathayāmi te //
meaning:
भवत्यभीप्सितं किञ्चिद्दर्ल्लभं भुवनत्रये /
संक्षेपेण मयाख्यातं व्रतं हैहयभूभुजः /
जामदग्न्यस्य च मुने किमन्यत्कथयामि ते //
text_mt: no desired thing is difficult to attain in the three worlds. / I have told in brief the observance of the Haihaya king / and of the sage Jāmadagnya. What else shall I relate to you?

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
tataḥ sa sagaro rājā kṛtāñjalipuṭo munim //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततः स सगरो राजा कृताञ्जलिपुटो मुनिम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Then that king Sagara, with hands joined in reverence, to the sage

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca bhagavannetatkartumicchāmyahaṃ vratam /
samyaktamupadeśena tatrānujñāṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
उवाच भगवन्नेतत्कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं व्रतम् /
सम्यक्तमुपदेशेन तत्रानुज्ञां प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: said: "O venerable one, I wish to perform this observance / properly according to instruction; give me permission for that.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇānena viprarṣe kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ /
ityuktastena rājñātu tathetyuktvā mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणानेन विप्रर्षे कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः /
इत्युक्तस्तेन राज्ञातु तथेत्युक्त्वा महामुनिः //
text_mt: By this action, O brāhmaṇa sage, I shall have achieved my goal, without a doubt." / Thus addressed by that king, the great sage said, "So be it,"

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣayāmāsa rājānaṃ śastroktenaiva vartmanā /
sa dīkṣito vasiṣṭhena sagaro rājasattamaḥ //
meaning:
दीक्षयामास राजानं शस्त्रोक्तेनैव वर्त्मना /
स दीक्षितो वसिष्ठेन सगरो राजसत्तमः //
text_mt: and initiated the king according to the method prescribed in the scriptures. / Initiated by Vasiṣṭha, Sagara, the best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
dravyāṇyānīya vidhivatpracacāra śubhavratam /
pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ vidhinā tena pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
द्रव्याण्यानीय विधिवत्प्रचचार शुभव्रतम् /
पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथं विधिना तेन पार्थिवः //
text_mt: having brought the materials in accordance with the rules, undertook the auspicious observance. / Having worshipped the Lord of the Universe with that rite, the monarch,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya ca yathāyogyamanujñāya guruṃ tataḥ /
pratijñāmakarodrājā vratametadanuttamam //
meaning:
समाप्य च यथायोग्यमनुज्ञाय गुरुं ततः /
प्रतिज्ञामकरोद्राजा व्रतमेतदनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: having concluded it appropriately and obtained leave from his guru, / the king took a vow regarding this incomparable observance:

sanskrit_iast:
ājīvāntaṃ dhariṣyāmi yatneneti mahāmatiḥ /
athānujñāpya rājānaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ //
meaning:
आजीवान्तं धरिष्यामि यत्नेनेति महामतिः /
अथानुज्ञाप्य राजानं वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः //
text_mt: "I shall maintain it diligently until the end of my life," resolved the noble-minded one. / Then, having granted leave to the king, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
sannivartyānugacchantaṃ prajagāma nijāśramam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaropākhyāne vasiṣṭhagamanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सन्निवर्त्यानुगच्छन्तं प्रजगाम निजाश्रमम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरोपाख्याने वसिष्ठगमनं नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
turning back [the king] who followed after him, departed for his own hermitage.

Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter, called 'The Departure of Vasiṣṭha', in the Story of Sagara in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part proclaimed by Vāyu in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
gate tasminmunivare sagaro rājasattamaḥ /
ayodhyāyāmadhivasnpālayāmāsa medinīm //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
गते तस्मिन्मुनिवरे सगरो राजसत्तमः /
अयोध्यायामधिवस्न्पालयामास मेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / When that foremost of sages had departed, Sagara, the best of kings, / residing in Ayodhyā, protected the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃpadgaṇopetaḥ sarvadharmārthatattvavit /
vayasaiva sa bālo 'bhūtkarmaṇā vṛddhasaṃmataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वसंपद्गणोपेतः सर्वधर्मार्थतत्त्ववित् /
वयसैव स बालो ऽभूत्कर्मणा वृद्धसंमतः //
text_mt: Endowed with a multitude of all fortunes, knowing the truth of all dharma and statecraft, / in age alone he was a youth, but in deed regarded as mature.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi na divā bhukteṃ śete vā niśi saṃsmaran /
sudīrghaṃ niḥśvasityuṣṇamudvignahṛdayo 'niśam //
meaning:
तथापि न दिवा भुक्तें शेते वा निशि संस्मरन् /
सुदीर्घं निःश्वसित्युष्णमुद्विग्नहृदयो ऽनिशम् //
text_mt: Even so, remembering, he did not eat by day nor sleep at night; / he sighed deeply and hotly, his heart constantly distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā rājā svarājyaṃ nijagurumavajityāribhiḥ saṃgṛhītaṃ mātrā sārddhaṃ prayāntaṃ vanamatigahanaṃsvargataṃ taṃ ca tasmin /
śokāviṣṭaḥ saroṣaṃ sakalaripukulocchittaye satpratijñaścake sadyaḥ pratijñāṃ paribhavamanalaṃ soḍhumikṣvākuvaṃśyaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा राजा स्वराज्यं निजगुरुमवजित्यारिभिः संगृहीतं मात्रा सार्द्धं प्रयान्तं वनमतिगहनंस्वर्गतं तं च तस्मिन् /
शोकाविष्टः सरोषं सकलरिपुकुलोच्छित्तये सत्प्रतिज्ञश्चके सद्यः प्रतिज्ञां परिभवमनलं सोढुमिक्ष्वाकुवंश्यः //
text_mt: Having heard that his own kingdom had been seized by enemies who had defeated his father, that [his father] had gone to the dense forest with his mother and died there, / the descendant of Ikṣvāku, overwhelmed with grief, full of anger, resolute in his good vow, unable to bear the humiliation, made a vow at once for the destruction of the entire host of his enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācinmahīpālaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ /
ripuṃ jetuṃ manaścakre diśaśca sakalāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
स कदाचिन्महीपालः कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः /
रिपुं जेतुं मनश्चक्रे दिशश्च सकलाः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Once, having performed auspicious and festive rites, that protector of the earth / resolved to conquer the enemy and all the quarters in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
anekarathasāhasrairgajāśvarathasainikaiḥ /
sarvataḥ saṃvṛto rājā niścakrāma purottamāt //
meaning:
अनेकरथसाहस्रैर्गजाश्वरथसैनिकैः /
सर्वतः संवृतो राजा निश्चक्राम पुरोत्तमात् //
text_mt: Surrounded on all sides by thousands of chariots and by troops of elephants, horses, and chariots, / the king marched forth from the foremost of cities.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrūnhantuṃ pratasthe nijabalanivahenotpatadbhisturaṅgairnāsattvormijālākulajalanidhinibhenātha ṣāḍaṅgikena /
mattairmātaṅgayūthaiḥ sakulagirikulenaiva bhūmaṇḍalena śvetacchatradhvajaughairapi śaśisukarābhātakhenaiva sārddham //
meaning:
शत्रून्हन्तुं प्रतस्थे निजबलनिवहेनोत्पतद्भिस्तुरङ्गैर्नासत्त्वोर्मिजालाकुलजलनिधिनिभेनाथ षाडङ्गिकेन /
मत्तैर्मातङ्गयूथैः सकुलगिरिकुलेनैव भूमण्डलेन श्वेतच्छत्रध्वजौघैरपि शशिसुकराभातखेनैव सार्द्धम् //
text_mt: He set out to slay his enemies with his own host of troops—with leaping horses, with his sixfold army resembling the ocean agitated by waves of myriad sea-monsters, / with herds of rutting elephants resembling the earth accompanied by mountain ranges, and with hosts of white parasols and banners resembling the sky illuminated by the lovely rays of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāgresarasainyayūthacaraṇaprakṣuṇṇaśailoccayakṣodāpūritanimnabhāgamavanīpālasya saṃyāsyataḥ /
pratyekaṃ caturaṅgasainyanikaraprakṣodasaṃbhūtabhūreṇuprāvṛtirutsthalī samabhavadbhūmistu tatrāniśam //
meaning:
तस्याग्रेसरसैन्ययूथचरणप्रक्षुण्णशैलोच्चयक्षोदापूरितनिम्नभागमवनीपालस्य संयास्यतः /
प्रत्येकं चतुरङ्गसैन्यनिकरप्रक्षोदसंभूतभूरेणुप्रावृतिरुत्स्थली समभवद्भूमिस्तु तत्रानिशम् //
text_mt: As that ruler of the earth marched along, the depressions in the terrain were filled with the crushed debris of mountain heaps trampled by the feet of his vanguard divisions, / and, veiled by the earth's dust produced from the pulverizing [tread] of each of the four arms of his army, the earth there became an uneven ground continuously.

sanskrit_iast:
nighnandṛptānanekāndvipaturagarathavyūhasaṃbhinnavīrānsadyaḥ śobhāṃ dadhāno 'suranikaracamūrnighnataścandramauliḥ /
dūrādevābhiśaṃsannarinagaranirodheṣu karmābhiṣaṅge teṣāṃ śīghrāpayānakṣaṇamabhidiśati prāṇidhairyaṃ vidhatte //
meaning:
निघ्नन्दृप्ताननेकान्द्विपतुरगरथव्यूहसंभिन्नवीरान्सद्यः शोभां दधानो ऽसुरनिकरचमूर्निघ्नतश्चन्द्रमौलिः /
दूरादेवाभिशंसन्नरिनगरनिरोधेषु कर्माभिषङ्गे तेषां शीघ्रापयानक्षणमभिदिशति प्राणिधैर्यं विधत्ते //
text_mt: Slaying many haughty warriors scattered among the arrays of elephants, horses, and chariots, instantly bearing the splendour of the moon-crested god [Śiva] as he slays the armies of the Asura hosts, / proclaiming it even from afar, in the press of actions while laying siege to enemy cities, he granted courage to living beings, determining the moment for their swift retreat.

sanskrit_iast: vijigīṣurdiśo rājā rājño yasyābhiyāsyati //
meaning: विजिगीषुर्दिशो राजा राज्ञो यस्याभियास्यति //
text_mt: The king, desiring to conquer the quarters, marched against whichever king’s

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayaṃ sa nṛpastasya sadyaḥ praṇatimeṣyati /
vijitya nṛpatīnsarvānkṛtvā ca svapadānugān //
meaning:
विषयं स नृपस्तस्य सद्यः प्रणतिमेष्यति /
विजित्य नृपतीन्सर्वान्कृत्वा च स्वपदानुगान् //
text_mt: realm—that king would immediately bow in submission. / Having conquered all kings and made them his followers,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketa gāminaḥ kāṃścitkṛtvā rājye nyavarttata /
evaṃ sa visarandikṣu dakṣiṇābhimukho nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
संकेत गामिनः कांश्चित्कृत्वा राज्ये न्यवर्त्तत /
एवं स विसरन्दिक्षु दक्षिणाभिमुखो नृपः //
text_mt: and having made some bound by oath, he returned to his kingdom. / Thus advancing through the quarters, the king, turning toward the south,

sanskrit_iast:
smaranpūrvakṛtaṃ vairaṃ haihayānabhyavarttata /
tatastasya nṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ samagrarathakuñjaraiḥ //
meaning:
स्मरन्पूर्वकृतं वैरं हैहयानभ्यवर्त्तत /
ततस्तस्य नृपैः सार्द्धं समग्ररथकुञ्जरैः //
text_mt: remembered the feud of old and marched against the Haihayas. / Then between him and the kings with all their chariots and elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva haihayairvīraiḥ saṃgrāmo romaharṣaṇaḥ /
rājñāṃ yatra sahasrāṇi sa balāni mahāhave //
meaning:
बभूव हैहयैर्वीरैः संग्रामो रोमहर्षणः /
राज्ञां यत्र सहस्राणि स बलानि महाहवे //
text_mt: a hair-raising battle took place with the heroic Haihayas, / in which the mighty-armed lord of Kosala, enraged,

sanskrit_iast:
nijaghāna mahābāhuḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kosaleśvaraḥ /
jitvā haihayabhūpālānbhaṅktvā dagdhvā ca tatpurīm //
meaning:
निजघान महाबाहुः संक्रुद्धः कोसलेश्वरः /
जित्वा हैहयभूपालान्भङ्क्त्वा दग्ध्वा च तत्पुरीम् //
text_mt: slew thousands of kings and their forces in the great fight. / Having conquered the Haihaya kings, and having broken and burnt their city,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśeṣaśūnyā makarodvairāntakaraṇo nṛpaḥ /
samagrabalasaṃmarddapramṛṣṭāśeṣabhūtalaḥ //
meaning:
निःशेषशून्या मकरोद्वैरान्तकरणो नृपः /
समग्रबलसंमर्द्दप्रमृष्टाशेषभूतलः //
text_mt: the king, putting an end to the feud, made it completely desolate. / Having swept away the entire surface of the earth by crushing their whole army,

sanskrit_iast:
haihayānāmaśeṣaṃ tu cakre rājyaṃ rajaḥsamam /
rājyaṃ purīṃ cāpahāya bhraṣṭaiśvaryā hatatviṣaḥ //
meaning:
हैहयानामशेषं तु चक्रे राज्यं रजःसमम् /
राज्यं पुरीं चापहाय भ्रष्टैश्वर्या हतत्विषः //
text_mt: he reduced the entire realm of the Haihayas to dust. / Abandoning their kingdom and capital, their sovereignty ruined, their splendour destroyed,

sanskrit_iast:
rājāno hatabhūyiṣṭhā vyadravanta samantataḥ /
abhidrutya nṛpāṃstāṃstu dravamāṇānmahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
राजानो हतभूयिष्ठा व्यद्रवन्त समन्ततः /
अभिद्रुत्य नृपांस्तांस्तु द्रवमाणान्महीपतिः //
text_mt: the kings, most of whom were killed, fled in all directions. / But chasing down those fleeing kings, the lord of the earth

sanskrit_iast:
jaghāna sānugānmattaḥ prajāḥ kruddha ivāntakaḥ /
tatastānprati sakrodhaḥ sagaraḥ samare 'rihā //
meaning:
जघान सानुगान्मत्तः प्रजाः क्रुद्ध इवान्तकः /
ततस्तान्प्रति सक्रोधः सगरः समरे ऽरिहा //
text_mt: in a fury slew them along with their followers, as the enraged god of death [slays] living beings. / Then, enraged toward them in battle, Sagara, the slayer of foes,

sanskrit_iast:
mumocāstraṃ mahāraudraṃ bhārgavaṃ rīpubhīṣaṇam /
tenotsṛṣṭātiraudratribhuvanabhayadaprasphuradbhārgavāstrajvālādandahyamānāvaśatanutatayaste nṛpāḥ sādya eva /
vāyvastrāvṛttadhūmodgamapaṭalatamomuṣṭadṛṣṭiprasārā bhremurbhūpṛṣṭaloṭhadbahulatamarajogūḍhamātrā muhūrttam //
meaning:
मुमोचास्त्रं महारौद्रं भार्गवं रीपुभीषणम् /
तेनोत्सृष्टातिरौद्रत्रिभुवनभयदप्रस्फुरद्भार्गवास्त्रज्वालादन्दह्यमानावशतनुततयस्ते नृपाः साद्य एव /
वाय्वस्त्रावृत्तधूमोद्गमपटलतमोमुष्टदृष्टिप्रसारा भ्रेमुर्भूपृष्टलोठद्बहुलतमरजोगूढमात्रा मुहूर्त्तम् //
text_mt: discharged the Bhārgava weapon, exceedingly terrible and terrifying to enemies. / Scorched by the blazing flames of that exceedingly terrible Bhārgava weapon discharged by him, which terrified the three worlds, those kings instantly lost control of their bodies, / and with their range of sight snatched away by the darkness of the rising masses of smoke rolled back by the wind weapon, they wandered for a moment, simply concealed by the thick dust rolling upon the earth's surface.

sanskrit_iast:
āganeyāstrapratāpapratihatagatayo 'dṛṣṭamārgāḥ samantā dbhūpālā naṣṭasaṃghāḥ paravaśatanavo vyākulībhūtacittāḥ /
bhītāḥ saṃtyuktavastrāyudhakavacavibhūṣādikā muktakeśā vispaṣṭonmattabhāvānbhṛśa taramanukurvantyagrataḥ śātravāṇām //
meaning:
आगनेयास्त्रप्रतापप्रतिहतगतयो ऽदृष्टमार्गाः समन्ता द्भूपाला नष्टसंघाः परवशतनवो व्याकुलीभूतचित्ताः /
भीताः संत्युक्तवस्त्रायुधकवचविभूषादिका मुक्तकेशा विस्पष्टोन्मत्तभावान्भृश तरमनुकुर्वन्त्यग्रतः शात्रवाणाम् //
text_mt: Their passage checked by the fierce heat of the fiery weapon, seeing no path on all sides, the kings, their ranks shattered, their bodies helpless, their minds thrown into confusion, / terrified, casting aside clothes, weapons, armour, and ornaments, with dishevelled hair, clearly imitated the behaviour of madmen before their enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
vijitya haihayānsarvānsamare sagaro balī /
saṃkṣubdhasāgarākāraḥ kāṃbojānabhyavarttata //
meaning:
विजित्य हैहयान्सर्वान्समरे सगरो बली /
संक्षुब्धसागराकारः कांबोजानभ्यवर्त्तत //
text_mt: Having conquered all the Haihayas in battle, the mighty Sagara, / resembling an agitated ocean, marched against the Kāmbojas.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvāditraghoṣāhatapaṭaharavākarṇanadhvastadhairyāḥ sadyaḥ saṃtyaktarājyasvabalapurapurandhrīsamūhā vimūḍhāḥ /
kāṃbojāstālajaṅghāḥ śakayavanakirātādayaḥ sākamete bhremurbhūryastrabhītyā diśi diśi ripavo yasya pūrvāparādhāḥ //
meaning:
नानावादित्रघोषाहतपटहरवाकर्णनध्वस्तधैर्याः सद्यः संत्यक्तराज्यस्वबलपुरपुरन्ध्रीसमूहा विमूढाः /
कांबोजास्तालजङ्घाः शकयवनकिरातादयः साकमेते भ्रेमुर्भूर्यस्त्रभीत्या दिशि दिशि रिपवो यस्य पूर्वापराधाः //
text_mt: Their courage shattered by hearing the roar of drums struck by sounds of various musical instruments, instantly abandoning their kingdoms, their own armies, and the women of their cities, bewildered, / these Kāmbojas, Tālajaṅghas, Śakas, Yavanas, Kirātas, and others together, his enemies who had committed former offenses, wandered in every direction out of fear of his manifold weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
bhītāstasya nareśvarasya ripavaḥ kecitpratā pānalajvālāmuṣṭadṛśo visṛjya vasatiṃ rājyaṃ ca putrādibhiḥ /
dviṭsainyaiḥ samabhidrutā vanabhuvaṃ saṃprāpya tatrāpi te 'staimityaṃ samupāgatā giriguhāsuptotthitena dviṣaḥ //
meaning:
भीतास्तस्य नरेश्वरस्य रिपवः केचित्प्रता पानलज्वालामुष्टदृशो विसृज्य वसतिं राज्यं च पुत्रादिभिः /
द्विट्सैन्यैः समभिद्रुता वनभुवं संप्राप्य तत्रापि ते ऽस्तैमित्यं समुपागता गिरिगुहासुप्तोत्थितेन द्विषः //
text_mt: Terrified of that lord of men, some enemies, their eyes blinded by the blazing flames of his fiery splendour, abandoned their dwelling and their kingdom along with their sons and others; / pursued by the enemy forces, they reached the forest regions, and even there those foes were rendered motionless by [the sound] of his roar, like that of [a lion] rising from sleep in a mountain cave.

sanskrit_iast:
tālajaṅghānnihatyājau rājā sa balavāhanān /
krameṇa nāśayāmāsa tadrājyamarikarṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तालजङ्घान्निहत्याजौ राजा स बलवाहनान् /
क्रमेण नाशयामास तद्राज्यमरिकर्षणः //
text_mt: Having slain the Tālajaṅghas in battle along with their armies and mounts, / that king, the tormentor of foes, gradually destroyed their realm.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yavanakāṃbojakirātādīnanekaśaḥ /
nijaghāna ruṣāviṣṭaḥ palhavānpāradānapi //
meaning:
ततो यवनकांबोजकिरातादीननेकशः /
निजघान रुषाविष्टः पल्हवान्पारदानपि //
text_mt: Then, overcome with fury, he slew Yavanas, Kāmbojas, Kirātas, and many others, / as well as Palhavas and Pāradas.

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamānāstu te sarve rājānastena saṃyuge /
dudruvuḥ saṃghaśo bhītā hataśiṣṭāḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
हन्यमानास्तु ते सर्वे राजानस्तेन संयुगे /
दुद्रुवुः संघशो भीता हतशिष्टाः समन्ततः //
text_mt: While being slaughtered by him in battle, all those kings, / the survivors of the slaughter, fled in crowds on all sides in terror.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmābhiryasya rājyaṃ bahubhirapatdṛtaṃ tasya putro 'dhunāhaṃ hantuṃ vaḥ sapratijñaṃ prasabhamupagato vairaniryātanaiṣī /
ityuccaiḥ śrāvayāṇo yudhi nijacaritaṃ vairibhirnāgavīryaḥ kṣatrairvidhvaṃsitejāḥ sagaranarapatiḥ smārayāmāsa bhūpaḥ //
meaning:
युष्माभिर्यस्य राज्यं बहुभिरपत्दृतं तस्य पुत्रो ऽधुनाहं हन्तुं वः सप्रतिज्ञं प्रसभमुपगतो वैरनिर्यातनैषी /
इत्युच्चैः श्रावयाणो युधि निजचरितं वैरिभिर्नागवीर्यः क्षत्रैर्विध्वंसितेजाः सगरनरपतिः स्मारयामास भूपः //
text_mt: “I am the son of him whose kingdom was seized by many of you, and I have now come by force under vow to slay you, seeking vengeance for the feud!” / Proclaiming aloud in battle his own conduct thus, the king, lord Sagara, possessing the strength of an elephant, made the kṣatriya enemies whose splendour was ruined remember [their deed].

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā rājavaryaṃ sakalaripukulaprakṣayopāttadīkṣaṃ bhītāḥ strībālapūrvaṃ śaraṇamabhiyayuḥ svāsusarakṣaṇāya /
ikṣvākūṇāṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ kulagurumabhitaḥ sapta rājñāṃ kaleṣu prakhyātāḥ saṃprasūtā nṛpavararipavaḥ pāradāḥ palhavādyāḥ //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा राजवर्यं सकलरिपुकुलप्रक्षयोपात्तदीक्षं भीताः स्त्रीबालपूर्वं शरणमभिययुः स्वासुसरक्षणाय /
इक्ष्वाकूणां वसिष्ठं कुलगुरुमभितः सप्त राज्ञां कलेषु प्रख्याताः संप्रसूता नृपवररिपवः पारदाः पल्हवाद्याः //
text_mt: Seeing that best of kings dedicated to the complete extermination of the whole race of enemies, terrified, they went together with their women and children for refuge to save their lives / to Vasiṣṭha, the family guru of the Ikṣvākus; the enemies of that best of kings, born in the lineages of seven kings, famous—the Pāradas, Palhavas, and others—surrounded him.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhamāśramopānte vasaṃtamṛṣibhirvṛtam /
upagamyābruvansarve kṛtāñjalipuṭā nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठमाश्रमोपान्ते वसंतमृषिभिर्वृतम् /
उपगम्याब्रुवन्सर्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटा नृपाः //
text_mt: Approaching Vasiṣṭha who was dwelling near his hermitage surrounded by sages, / all those kings with folded hands said:

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ bhaṃva no brahmannārttānāmabhayaiṣiṇām /
sagarāstrāgninirdagdhaśarīrāṇāṃ mumūrṣatām //
meaning:
शरणं भंव नो ब्रह्मन्नार्त्तानामभयैषिणाम् /
सगरास्त्राग्निनिर्दग्धशरीराणां मुमूर्षताम् //
text_mt: “Be our refuge, O holy man, for us who are afflicted and seek freedom from fear, / whose bodies are burned by the fire of Sagara's weapons and who are on the verge of death!

sanskrit_iast:
sa hantyasamānaśeṣeṇa vairāntakaraṇonmukhaḥ /
tasmādbhayāddhi niṣkrāntā vayaṃ jīvitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
स हन्त्यसमानशेषेण वैरान्तकरणोन्मुखः /
तस्माद्भयाद्धि निष्क्रान्ता वयं जीवितकाङ्क्षिणः //
text_mt: Intent on putting an end to the feud, he is slaying us without remnant; / out of fear of him we have fled, desiring our lives.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhinnarājyabhogarddhisvadārāpatyabāndhavāḥ /
kevalaṃ prāṇarakṣārthaṃ tvāṃ tvayaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
विभिन्नराज्यभोगर्द्धिस्वदारापत्यबान्धवाः /
केवलं प्राणरक्षार्थं त्वां त्वयं शरणं गतः //
text_mt: Deprived of the prosperity and enjoyments of our kingdoms, of our own wives, children, and kinsmen, / solely to save our lives have we come to you for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
na hyanyo 'sti pumāṃlloke sauhṛdena balena vā /
yastaṃ nivarttayitvāsmānpālayenmahato bhayāt //
meaning:
न ह्यन्यो ऽस्ति पुमांल्लोके सौहृदेन बलेन वा /
यस्तं निवर्त्तयित्वास्मान्पालयेन्महतो भयात् //
text_mt: Indeed, there is no other person in the world, whether through friendship or power, / who could turn him back and protect us from this great danger.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kilārkānvayabhuvāṃ rājñāṃ kulagurur vṛtaḥ /
tadvaṃśapūrvajairbhūpaistvataprabhāvaśca tādṛśaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं किलार्कान्वयभुवां राज्ञां कुलगुरुर् वृतः /
तद्वंशपूर्वजैर्भूपैस्त्वतप्रभावश्च तादृशः //
text_mt: For you were chosen as the family guru of the kings born in the solar lineage / by the royal ancestors of that dynasty, and such is your spiritual power.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāyaṃ sagaro 'pyadya gurugauravayantritaḥ /
bhavannideśaṃ nātyeti velāmiva mahodadhiḥ //
meaning:
तेनायं सगरो ऽप्यद्य गुरुगौरवयन्त्रितः /
भवन्निदेशं नात्येति वेलामिव महोदधिः //
text_mt: Therefore even Sagara today, restrained by reverence for his guru, / will not transgress your command, just as the great ocean does not transgress its shore.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ naḥ suhṛtpitā mātā lokānāṃ ca gururvibho /
tasmādasmānmahābhāga paritrātuṃ tvamarhasi //
meaning:
त्वं नः सुहृत्पिता माता लोकानां च गुरुर्विभो /
तस्मादस्मान्महाभाग परित्रातुं त्वमर्हसि //
text_mt: You are our friend, father, mother, and the guru of the worlds, O almighty lord; / therefore, O highly fortunate one, you ought to protect us.”

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ /
śanairvilokayāmāsa śaraṇaṃ samupāgatān //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः /
शनैर्विलोकयामास शरणं समुपागतान् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Hearing their words, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha / slowly looked upon those who had come for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhastrībālabhūyiṣṭhānhataśeṣānnṛpānvayān /
dṛṣṭvā tvatapyadbhagavānsarvabhūtānukaṃpakaḥ //
meaning:
वृद्धस्त्रीबालभूयिष्ठान्हतशेषान्नृपान्वयान् /
दृष्ट्वा त्वतप्यद्भगवान्सर्वभूतानुकंपकः //
text_mt: Seeing the survivors of the royal lineages, consisting mostly of old people, women, and children, / the venerable one, who is compassionate to all beings, felt pity.

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ nirūpya manasā tānvilokya ca sādaram /
ujjīvayañchanairvācā mā bhaiṣṭeti mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
चिरं निरूप्य मनसा तान्विलोक्य च सादरम् /
उज्जीवयञ्छनैर्वाचा मा भैष्टेति महामतिः //
text_mt: Reflecting in his mind for a long time and looking at them with kindness, / the highly intelligent one, reviving them slowly with his speech, saying, “Do not fear!”

sanskrit_iast:
athāvocanmahābhāgaḥ kṛpayā parayānvitaḥ /
samaye sthāpayāmāsa rājñastāñjīvitārthinaḥ //
meaning:
अथावोचन्महाभागः कृपया परयान्वितः /
समये स्थापयामास राज्ञस्ताञ्जीवितार्थिनः //
text_mt: then spoke, full of supreme compassion; / the highly fortunate one bound those kings who sought their lives by an agreement.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpavyā kopadagdhaṃ nṛpakulavihitāśeṣadharmādapetaṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ samayamavanipālapratijñānivṛttyai /
gatvā taṃ rājavaryaṃ svayamatha śanakaiḥ sāṃtvayitvā yathāvatsaprāṇānāmarīṇāmapagamanavidhāvabhyanujñāṃ yayāce //
meaning:
भूपव्या कोपदग्धं नृपकुलविहिताशेषधर्मादपेतं कृत्वा तेषां वसिष्ठः समयमवनिपालप्रतिज्ञानिवृत्त्यै /
गत्वा तं राजवर्यं स्वयमथ शनकैः सांत्वयित्वा यथावत्सप्राणानामरीणामपगमनविधावभ्यनुज्ञां ययाचे //
text_mt: After making an agreement with them to ward off the king's vow, since they were burnt by the king's anger and deprived of all the duties prescribed for a royal line, Vasiṣṭha went in person to that best of kings, consoled him gently as was fitting, and asked permission for his enemies to depart with their lives.

sanskrit_iast:
sakrodho 'pi mahīpatirguruvacaḥ saṃbhāvayaṃstānarīndharmasya svakulocitasya ca tathā veṣasya saṃtyāgataḥ /
śrautasmārttavibhinnakarmaniratānvipraiśca dūroñjhitānsāsūnkevalamatyajanmṛtasamānekaikaśaḥ pārthivān //
meaning:
सक्रोधो ऽपि महीपतिर्गुरुवचः संभावयंस्तानरीन्धर्मस्य स्वकुलोचितस्य च तथा वेषस्य संत्यागतः /
श्रौतस्मार्त्तविभिन्नकर्मनिरतान्विप्रैश्च दूरोञ्झितान्सासून्केवलमत्यजन्मृतसमानेकैकशः पार्थिवान् //
text_mt: Though enraged, the king respected his guru's word, and one by one spared those rulers alive, yet as good as dead, having caused them to abandon the dharma and dress suited to their own families, setting them to engage in acts at variance with Śruti and Smṛti, and having them cast far off by the brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
arddhamuṇḍāñchakāṃścakre palhavān śmaśrudhāriṇaḥ /
yavanānvigataśmaśrūnkāṃbojāṃścabukānvitān //
meaning:
अर्द्धमुण्डाञ्छकांश्चक्रे पल्हवान् श्मश्रुधारिणः /
यवनान्विगतश्मश्रून्कांबोजांश्चबुकान्वितान् //
text_mt: He made the Śakas half-shaven; the Pahlavas he made wear beards; / the Yavanas shaven-bearded; and the Kāmbojas keep beards on their chins.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ virūpānanyāṃśca sa cakāra nṛpānvayān /
vedoktakarmanirmuktānvipraiśca parivarjitān //
meaning:
एवं विरूपानन्यांश्च स चकार नृपान्वयान् /
वेदोक्तकर्मनिर्मुक्तान्विप्रैश्च परिवर्जितान् //
text_mt: In this way, he disfigured other royal lineages as well, / freeing them from the rites prescribed in the Veda and cast out by brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā saṃsthāpya samaye jīvatastānvya sarjayat /
tataste ripavastasya tyaktasvācāralakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वा संस्थाप्य समये जीवतस्तान्व्य सर्जयत् /
ततस्ते रिपवस्तस्य त्यक्तस्वाचारलक्षणाः //
text_mt: Having done so and binding them to the agreement, he released them alive. / Thereupon, those enemies of his, abandoning the marks of their proper conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
vrātyatāṃ samanuprāptāḥ sarvavarṇavinintitāḥ /
dhikkṛtā satataṃ sarvenṛśaṃsā nirapatrapāḥ //
meaning:
व्रात्यतां समनुप्राप्ताः सर्ववर्णविनिन्तिताः /
धिक्कृता सततं सर्वेनृशंसा निरपत्रपाः //
text_mt: became outcasts, reviled by all varnas, / constantly censured by all, cruel and shameless.

sanskrit_iast: krūrāśca saṃghaśo loke babhūvurmlechajātayaḥ //
meaning: क्रूराश्च संघशो लोके बभूवुर्म्लेछजातयः //
text_mt: Fierce, they became hosts of Mleccha castes in the world.

sanskrit_iast:
muktāstenātha rājñā śakayavanakirātādayaḥ sadya eva tyaktasvācāraveṣā girigahanaguhādyāśayāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ /
etā adyāpi sadbhiḥ satatamavamatā jātayo 'satpravṛttyā varttante duṣṭaceṣṭā jagati narapateḥ pālayantaḥ pratijñām //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaropākhyāne sagarapratijñāpālanaṃ nāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 48//
meaning:
मुक्तास्तेनाथ राज्ञा शकयवनकिरातादयः सद्य एव त्यक्तस्वाचारवेषा गिरिगहनगुहाद्याशयाः संबभूवुः /
एता अद्यापि सद्भिः सततमवमता जातयो ऽसत्प्रवृत्त्या वर्त्तन्ते दुष्टचेष्टा जगति नरपतेः पालयन्तः प्रतिज्ञाम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरोपाख्याने सगरप्रतिज्ञापालनं नामाष्टाचत्वारिंशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 48//
text_mt:
Released by that king, the Śakas, Yavanas, Kirātas, and others instantly abandoned their proper conduct and dress, making their dwellings in mountains, thickets, caves, and the like. / Even today these castes, constantly despised by the virtuous because of their unrighteous ways, live in the world acting wickedly, keeping the king's vow.

Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, named 'Fulfillment of Sagara's Vow' in the Sagara episode, in the third section, the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Vāyu. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
athānujñāya sagaro vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam /
balena mahatā yukto vidarbhānabhyavarttata //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
अथानुज्ञाय सगरो वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम् /
बलेन महता युक्तो विदर्भानभ्यवर्त्तत //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Then, having taken leave of Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages, / Sagara, accompanied by a great army, set out toward Vidarbha.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vidarbharāṭ tasmai svasutāṃ prītipūrvakam /
keśinyākhyāmanupamāmanurūpāṃ nyavedayat //
meaning:
ततो विदर्भराट् तस्मै स्वसुतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् /
केशिन्याख्यामनुपमामनुरूपां न्यवेदयत् //
text_mt: Then the king of Vidarbha affectionately offered him / his own daughter named Keśinī, matchless and suitable for him.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyā rājaśārdūlo vidhivadvahnisākṣikam /
śubhe muhūrte keśinyāḥ pārṇiṃ jagrāha bhūmipaḥ //
meaning:
स तस्या राजशार्दूलो विधिवद्वह्निसाक्षिकम् /
शुभे मुहूर्ते केशिन्याः पार्णिं जग्राह भूमिपः //
text_mt: That tiger among kings, the ruler of the earth, / took Keśinī's hand according to rule before the witness of fire, at an auspicious moment.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā dināni katicidgṛhe tasyātisatkṛtaḥ /
vidarbharājñā saṃmantrya tato gantuṃ prajakrame //
meaning:
स्थित्वा दिनानि कतिचिद्गृहे तस्यातिसत्कृतः /
विदर्भराज्ञा संमन्त्र्य ततो गन्तुं प्रजक्रमे //
text_mt: Having stayed a few days in his house, highly honored, / he consulted with the king of Vidarbha and then prepared to depart.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātastatastena pāribarhaiśca satkṛtaḥ /
niṣkramya tatpurādrājā śūrasenānupeyivān //
meaning:
अनुज्ञातस्ततस्तेन पारिबर्हैश्च सत्कृतः /
निष्क्रम्य तत्पुराद्राजा शूरसेनानुपेयिवान् //
text_mt: Permitted by him and honored with wedding gifts, / the king departed from that city and went to the Śūrasenas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhāvitastataścaiva yādavairmātṛsodaraiḥ /
dhanaughaistarpitastaiśca madhurāyā viniryayau //
meaning:
संभावितस्ततश्चैव यादवैर्मातृसोदरैः /
धनौघैस्तर्पितस्तैश्च मधुराया विनिर्ययौ //
text_mt: Then, respected by the Yādavas, the brothers of his mother, / and gratified by them with streams of wealth, he set out from Mathurā.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa sagaro rājā vijitya vasudhāmimām /
karaiśca sa nṛpānsarvāṃścakre saṃketagānapi //
meaning:
एवं स सगरो राजा विजित्य वसुधामिमाम् /
करैश्च स नृपान्सर्वांश्चक्रे संकेतगानपि //
text_mt: Having thus conquered this earth, King Sagara / made all kings pay tribute and bound them to agreements.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'numānya nṛpatīnnijarājyāya sānugān /
anujajñe narapatiḥ samastānanuyāyinaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽनुमान्य नृपतीन्निजराज्याय सानुगान् /
अनुजज्ञे नरपतिः समस्ताननुयायिनः //
text_mt: Then, having granted permission to the kings and their followers to return to their own kingdoms, / the ruler of men gave leave to all his followers.

sanskrit_iast:
tato balena mahātā skandhāvārasamanvitaḥ /
śanairapīḍayandeśānsvarājyamupajagmivān //
meaning:
ततो बलेन महाता स्कन्धावारसमन्वितः /
शनैरपीडयन्देशान्स्वराज्यमुपजग्मिवान् //
text_mt: Then, accompanied by his army camp and with a great force, / he went gently without oppressing the lands, returning to his own kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhāvyamānaśca muhurupadābhiranekaśaḥ /
nānājanapadaistūrmamayodhyāṃ samupāgamat //
meaning:
संभाव्यमानश्च मुहुरुपदाभिरनेकशः /
नानाजनपदैस्तूर्ममयोध्यां समुपागमत् //
text_mt: Being honored continually with gifts of varied kinds / by diverse provinces, he swiftly arrived at Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tadāgamanamājñāya nāgaraḥ sakalo janaḥ /
nagarīṃ tāmalañcakre mahotsavasamutsukaḥ //
meaning:
तदागमनमाज्ञाय नागरः सकलो जनः /
नगरीं तामलञ्चक्रे महोत्सवसमुत्सुकः //
text_mt: Learning of his arrival, all the city folk, / eager for a great festival, decorated that city.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā nagarī sarvā kṛtakautukamaṅgalā /
siktasaṃmṛṣṭabhūbhāgā pūrṇakumbhaśatāvṛtā //
meaning:
ततः सा नगरी सर्वा कृतकौतुकमङ्गला /
सिक्तसंमृष्टभूभागा पूर्णकुम्भशतावृता //
text_mt: Then that entire city had auspicious rituals performed, / its ground sprinkled and swept, filled with hundreds of full jars,

sanskrit_iast:
samucchritadhvajaśatā patākābhiraṃlakṛtā /
sarvatrāgarudhūpāñaḍhyā vicitrakusumojjvalā //
meaning:
समुच्छ्रितध्वजशता पताकाभिरंलकृता /
सर्वत्रागरुधूपाञढ्या विचित्रकुसुमोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: with hundreds of raised standards, adorned with banners, / rich everywhere with the incense of agallochum, bright with colorful flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
sadratnatoraṇottuṅgagopurāṭṭalabhūṣitā /
prasūnalājavarṣaiśca svalaṅkṛtamahāpathā //
meaning:
सद्रत्नतोरणोत्तुङ्गगोपुराट्टलभूषिता /
प्रसूनलाजवर्षैश्च स्वलङ्कृतमहापथा //
text_mt: adorned with archways of fine gems, lofty gateway towers, and battlements, / its broad highways well adorned with showers of flowers and parched grain.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavasamāyuktā pratigehamabhūtpurī /
saṃbūjitāśeṣavāstudevatāgṛhamālinī //
meaning:
महोत्सवसमायुक्ता प्रतिगेहमभूत्पुरी /
संबूजिताशेषवास्तुदेवतागृहमालिनी //
text_mt: At every house the city was filled with great festivities, / hung with garlands for all the house-deities who had been worshipped;

sanskrit_iast:
dikcakrajayino rājñaḥ saṃdarśanamudānvitaiḥ /
paurajānapadairtdṛṣṭaiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṅkṛtā //
meaning:
दिक्चक्रजयिनो राज्ञः संदर्शनमुदान्वितैः /
पौरजानपदैर्त्दृष्टैः सर्वतः समलङ्कृता //
text_mt: it was adorned on all sides by joyful citizens and country folk / who were filled with joy at the sight of the king, the conqueror of all the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarve tathāntaḥ puravāsinaḥ /
vārakātākadabaiśca nagarībhiśca savṛtāḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वे तथान्तः पुरवासिनः /
वारकाताकदबैश्च नगरीभिश्च सवृताः //
text_mt: Then all the subjects and the dwellers of the inner apartments, / surrounded by hosts of courtesans and city women,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyāyayustataḥ sarve samatya puravāsinaḥ /
sa taiḥ sametya nṛpatirlabdhāśīrvāda saktkriyaḥ //
meaning:
अभ्याययुस्ततः सर्वे समत्य पुरवासिनः /
स तैः समेत्य नृपतिर्लब्धाशीर्वाद सक्त्क्रियः //
text_mt: and all the city dwellers came together and approached. / The king, having met with them and received blessings and honors,

sanskrit_iast:
badhirīkṛtadikcakro jayaśabdena bhūriṇā /
nānāvāditrasaṃghoṣamiśreṇa madhureṇa ca //
meaning:
बधिरीकृतदिक्चक्रो जयशब्देन भूरिणा /
नानावादित्रसंघोषमिश्रेण मधुरेण च //
text_mt: deafening the compass of the directions with a great sound of victory / mingled with the sweet noise of various musical instruments,

sanskrit_iast:
satkṛtya tānyathā yogaṃ sahitastairmudānvitaiḥ /
ānandayanprajāḥ sarvāḥ praviveśa purottamam //
meaning:
सत्कृत्य तान्यथा योगं सहितस्तैर्मुदान्वितैः /
आनन्दयन्प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम् //
text_mt: honoring them as was fitting, accompanied by those delighted people / and gladdening all his subjects, entered the supreme city.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaghoṣaiḥ sumadhurairbrāhmaṇairabhinanditaḥ /
saṃstūyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ //
meaning:
वेदघोषैः सुमधुरैर्ब्राह्मणैरभिनन्दितः /
संस्तूयमानः सुभृशं सूतमागधवन्दिभिः //
text_mt: Welcomed with the sweetest Vedic recitations by brahmins, / praised exceedingly by bards, panegyrists, and minstrels,

sanskrit_iast:
jayaśabdaiśca parito nānājanapaderitaiḥ /
kalatālaravonmiśravīṇāveṇutalasvanaiḥ //
meaning:
जयशब्दैश्च परितो नानाजनपदेरितैः /
कलतालरवोन्मिश्रवीणावेणुतलस्वनैः //
text_mt: with shouts of victory sounded on all sides by diverse peoples, / with sounds of lutes, flutes, and cymbals mingled with soft rhythmic beats,

sanskrit_iast:
gāyadbhirgāyakajanairnṛtyadbhirgaṇikājanaiḥ /
anvīyamāno vilasacchvetacchatravirājitaḥ //
meaning:
गायद्भिर्गायकजनैर्नृत्यद्भिर्गणिकाजनैः /
अन्वीयमानो विलसच्छ्वेतच्छत्रविराजितः //
text_mt: surrounded by singing singers and dancing courtesans, / shining with a radiant white parasol,

sanskrit_iast:
vikīryamāṇaḥ paritaḥ sallājakusumotkaraiḥ /
purīmayodhyāmaviśatsvapurīmiva vāsavaḥ //
meaning:
विकीर्यमाणः परितः सल्लाजकुसुमोत्करैः /
पुरीमयोध्यामविशत्स्वपुरीमिव वासवः //
text_mt: scattered all around with showers of fine parched grain and flowers, / he entered the city of Ayodhyā as Indra enters his own city.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭipūtena gandhena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vartmanā /
jagāma madhyenagaraṃ gṛhaṃ śrīmadalaṅkṛtam //
meaning:
दृष्टिपूतेन गन्धेन ब्राह्मणानां च वर्त्मना /
जगाम मध्येनगरं गृहं श्रीमदलङ्कृतम् //
text_mt: Along the pathway purified by the sight and sweet scent of the brahmins, / he went through the midst of the city to his glorious and adorned palace.

sanskrit_iast:
avaruhya tato yānādbhāryābhyāṃ sahito mudā /
praviveśa gṛhaṃ māturhṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāyutam //
meaning:
अवरुह्य ततो यानाद्भार्याभ्यां सहितो मुदा /
प्रविवेश गृहं मातुर्हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम् //
text_mt: Then, joyfully stepping down from the chariot together with his two wives, / he entered his mother's house, which was filled with delighted and prosperous people.

sanskrit_iast:
paryaṅkasthāmupāgamya mātaraṃ vinayānvitaḥ /
tatpādau saṃspṛśanmūrdhnā praṇāmamakarottadā //
meaning:
पर्यङ्कस्थामुपागम्य मातरं विनयान्वितः /
तत्पादौ संस्पृशन्मूर्ध्ना प्रणाममकरोत्तदा //
text_mt: Approaching his mother, who sat upon a couch, full of modesty, / he touched her feet with his head and made his prostration.

sanskrit_iast:
sābhinandya tamāśīrbhirharṣagadgadayā girā /
sasaṃbhramaṃ samutthāya paryaṣvajata cātmajam //
meaning:
साभिनन्द्य तमाशीर्भिर्हर्षगद्गदया गिरा /
ससंभ्रमं समुत्थाय पर्यष्वजत चात्मजम् //
text_mt: Greeting him with blessings in a voice stammering with joy, / she rose in excitement and embraced her son.

sanskrit_iast:
saharṣaṃ bahudhāśīrbhirabhyanandadubhe snuṣe /
sa tāṃ saṃbhāvya kathayā tatra sthitvā cirādiva //
meaning:
सहर्षं बहुधाशीर्भिरभ्यनन्ददुभे स्नुषे /
स तां संभाव्य कथया तत्र स्थित्वा चिरादिव //
text_mt: With joy she repeatedly blessed both her daughters-in-law; / and having honored her with conversation and stayed there for a while,

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātastayā rājā niścakrāma tadālayāt /
tataḥ sānucaro rājā śvetavyajanavījitaḥ //
meaning:
अनुज्ञातस्तया राजा निश्चक्राम तदालयात् /
ततः सानुचरो राजा श्वेतव्यजनवीजितः //
text_mt: the king, taking leave of her, departed from her abode. / Then the king, accompanied by his attendants and fanned with white fly-whisks,

sanskrit_iast:
surarāja iva śrīmānsabhāṃ samagamacchanaiḥ /
saṃpraviśya sabhāṃ divyāmanekanṛpasevitām //
meaning:
सुरराज इव श्रीमान्सभां समगमच्छनैः /
संप्रविश्य सभां दिव्यामनेकनृपसेविताम् //
text_mt: like the glorious king of the gods, went slowly to the assembly hall. / Having entered the divine assembly hall attended by many kings,

sanskrit_iast:
natvā gurujanaṃ sarvamāśīrbhiścābhinanditaḥ /
siṃhāsane śubhe divye niṣasāda nareśvaraḥ //
meaning:
नत्वा गुरुजनं सर्वमाशीर्भिश्चाभिनन्दितः /
सिंहासने शुभे दिव्ये निषसाद नरेश्वरः //
text_mt: bowing down to all the elders and greeted with blessings, / the lord of men sat down upon an auspicious, divine throne.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsevyamānaśca nṛpairnānājanapadeśvaraiḥ /
nānāvidhāḥ kathāḥ kurvansa tatra nṛpasattamaḥ //
meaning:
संसेव्यमानश्च नृपैर्नानाजनपदेश्वरैः /
नानाविधाः कथाः कुर्वन्स तत्र नृपसत्तमः //
text_mt: Attended by kings, the lords of various lands, / and conversing on various subjects, that best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprīyamāmaḥ sutarāmuvāsa saha bandhubhiḥ /
pratijñāṃ pālayitvaivaṃ jitadiṅmaṇḍalo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
संप्रीयमामः सुतरामुवास सह बन्धुभिः /
प्रतिज्ञां पालयित्वैवं जितदिङ्मण्डलो नृपः //
text_mt: exceedingly delighted, dwelt together with his kinsmen. / Having thus fulfilled his vow, the king, the conqueror of the circle of the quarters,

sanskrit_iast:
anvatiṣṭhadyanthānyāya marthatrayamudāradhīḥ /
svaprabhāvajitāśeṣavairirdiṅmaṇḍalādhipaḥ //
meaning:
अन्वतिष्ठद्यन्थान्याय मर्थत्रयमुदारधीः /
स्वप्रभावजिताशेषवैरिर्दिङ्मण्डलाधिपः //
text_mt: noble in mind, pursued the three aims [of life] in accordance with propriety. / Having conquered all enemies by his own splendor, the lord of the circle of the quarters

sanskrit_iast:
ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīmanvaśāsadvṛṣo yathā /
svaryātasya pituḥ pūrvaṃ paribhāvamamarṣitaḥ //
meaning:
एकातपत्रां पृथिवीमन्वशासद्वृषो यथा /
स्वर्यातस्य पितुः पूर्वं परिभावममर्षितः //
text_mt: ruled over the earth under a single royal parasol like a bull, / having earlier resented the humiliation of his father who had gone to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yāṃ pratijñāmārūḍhastāṃ samyakparipūrya ca /
saptadvīpābdhinagaragrāmāyatanamālinīm //
meaning:
स यां प्रतिज्ञामारूढस्तां सम्यक्परिपूर्य च /
सप्तद्वीपाब्धिनगरग्रामायतनमालिनीम् //
text_mt: Having fully carried out the vow he had undertaken, / [he protected the earth] garlanded with its seven continents, oceans, cities, villages, and hermitages.

sanskrit_iast:
jitvā śatrūnaśeṣeṇa pālayāmāsa medinīma /
evaṃ gacchati kāle ca vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ //
meaning:
जित्वा शत्रूनशेषेण पालयामास मेदिनीम /
एवं गच्छति काले च वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः //
text_mt: Having conquered his enemies entirely, he protected the earth. / And as time passed in this way, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyajagāma taṃ bhūyo draṣṭukāmo jareśvaram /
tamāyāntamatiprekṣya munivaryaṃ sasaṃbhramaḥ //
meaning:
अभ्यजगाम तं भूयो द्रष्टुकामो जरेश्वरम् /
तमायान्तमतिप्रेक्ष्य मुनिवर्यं ससंभ्रमः //
text_mt: wishing to see the lord of men again, came there. / Seeing that foremost of sages arriving, in haste,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyujjagāmārghahastaḥ sahitastairnapairnṛpaḥ /
ardhyapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayitvā mahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्युज्जगामार्घहस्तः सहितस्तैर्नपैर्नृपः /
अर्ध्यपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा महामतिः //
text_mt: the king, together with those kings, went out to meet him with respectful offering in hand. / Having duly honoured him with respectful offering, water for the feet, and other rites, the wise one

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmamakarottasmai gurubhaktisamanvitaḥ /
āśīrbhirvarddhayitvā taṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ sagaraṃ tadā //
meaning:
प्रणाममकरोत्तस्मै गुरुभक्तिसमन्वितः /
आशीर्भिर्वर्द्धयित्वा तं वसिष्ठः सगरं तदा //
text_mt: bowed down to him, filled with devotion to the guru. / Then Vasiṣṭha, having congratulated Sagara with blessings,

sanskrit_iast:
āsyatāmiti hovāca saha sarvairnareśvaraiḥ /
upāviśattato rājā kāñcane paramāsane //
meaning:
आस्यतामिति होवाच सह सर्वैर्नरेश्वरैः /
उपाविशत्ततो राजा काञ्चने परमासने //
text_mt: said to him: “Be seated, along with all the rulers of men.” / Thereupon the king sat down upon an excellent golden seat,

sanskrit_iast:
muninā samanujñātaḥ sabhāryaḥ saha rājabhiḥ /
āpavastunṛpaśreṣṭhamupāsīnamupahvare //
meaning:
मुनिना समनुज्ञातः सभार्यः सह राजभिः /
आपवस्तुनृपश्रेष्ठमुपासीनमुपह्वरे //
text_mt: permitted by the sage, accompanied by his wife and the kings. / Then Āpava [Vasiṣṭha] addressed the foremost of kings, who was seated close by,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca śṛṇvatāṃ rājñāṃ śanairmṛdvakṣaraṃ vacaḥ /
vasiṣṭha uvāca
kuśalaṃ nanu te rājanvāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca //
meaning:
उवाच शृण्वतां राज्ञां शनैर्मृद्वक्षरं वचः /
वसिष्ठ उवाच
कुशलं ननु ते राजन्वाह्येष्वाभ्यन्तरेषु च //
text_mt: speaking softly and gently so that the kings could hear: / Vasiṣṭha said: / “Is all well with you, O king, among external and internal affairs,

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṣvamātyavargeṣu rājye vā sakale 'dhunā /
diṣṭyā ca vijitāḥ sarve samagrabalavāhanāḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रिष्वमात्यवर्गेषु राज्ये वा सकले ऽधुना /
दिष्ट्या च विजिताः सर्वे समग्रबलवाहनाः //
text_mt: among your counsellors, assemblies of ministers, and in your entire kingdom now? / By good fortune all your enemies, with all their forces and conveyances,

sanskrit_iast:
ayatnenaiva yuddheṣu bhavatā ripavo hi yat /
diṣṭyārūḍhapratijñena mama mānayatā vacaḥ //
meaning:
अयत्नेनैव युद्धेषु भवता रिपवो हि यत् /
दिष्ट्यारूढप्रतिज्ञेन मम मानयता वचः //
text_mt: have indeed been conquered by you in battle without effort! / By good fortune you, holding firm to your vow and honouring my word,

sanskrit_iast:
arayastyaktadharmāṇastvayā jīvavisarjitāḥ /
tānvijityetarāñjetuṃ punardigvijayecchayā //
meaning:
अरयस्त्यक्तधर्माणस्त्वया जीवविसर्जिताः /
तान्विजित्येतराञ्जेतुं पुनर्दिग्विजयेच्छया //
text_mt: have spared the lives of those enemies who abandoned dharma. / Having conquered them, wishing to conquer others in a campaign of universal conquest,

sanskrit_iast:
gatassavāhanabalastvamityaśṛṇavaṃ vacaḥ /
jitadiṅmaṇḍalaṃ bhūyaḥ śrutvā tvāṃ nagarasthitam //
meaning:
गतस्सवाहनबलस्त्वमित्यशृणवं वचः /
जितदिङ्मण्डलं भूयः श्रुत्वा त्वां नगरस्थितम् //
text_mt: you set out with conveyances and armies—so I heard word. / Having heard that you, having conquered the circle of the quarters, are once more settled in your city,

sanskrit_iast:
prītyāhamāgato draṣṭumidānīṃ rājasattama /
jaiminiruvāca
vasiṣṭhenaivamuktastu sagarastālajaṅghajit //
meaning:
प्रीत्याहमागतो द्रष्टुमिदानीं राजसत्तम /
जैमिनिरुवाच
वसिष्ठेनैवमुक्तस्तु सगरस्तालजङ्घजित् //
text_mt: I have come now out of affection to see you, O best of kings.” / Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by Vasiṣṭha, Sagara, conqueror of the Tālajaṅghas,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā pratyuvāca mahāmunim /
sagara uvāca
kuśalaṃ nanu sarvatra maharṣe nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच महामुनिम् /
सगर उवाच
कुशलं ननु सर्वत्र महर्षे नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: folded his hands in reverence and replied to the great sage: / Sagara said: / “All is indeed well in every way, O great sage; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kalyāṇābhimukhāḥ sarve devatāśca mune 'niśam /
bhavāndhyāyati kalyāṇaṃ manasā yasya saṃtatam //
meaning:
कल्याणाभिमुखाः सर्वे देवताश्च मुने ऽनिशम् /
भवान्ध्यायति कल्याणं मनसा यस्य संततम् //
text_mt: All deities are constantly inclined toward welfare, O sage, / for him whose welfare you continually contemplate in your mind.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya me copasargāśca saṃbhavanti kathaṃ mune /
bhavatānugṛhīto 'smi kṛtārthaścādhunā kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य मे चोपसर्गाश्च संभवन्ति कथं मुने /
भवतानुगृहीतो ऽस्मि कृतार्थश्चाधुना कृतः //
text_mt: How could afflictions befall me, O sage? / I have been favoured by you, and now made accomplished in my purpose,

sanskrit_iast:
yanmāṃ draṣṭumihāyātaḥ svayameva bhavānguro /
yanmahyamāha bhagavānvipakṣavijayādikam //
meaning:
यन्मां द्रष्टुमिहायातः स्वयमेव भवान्गुरो /
यन्मह्यमाह भगवान्विपक्षविजयादिकम् //
text_mt: in that you, O guru, have yourself come here to see me. / As for what your reverence spoke of concerning the conquest of adversaries and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tattathānuṣṭhitaṃ kiṃ tu sarvaṃ bhavadanugrahāt /
bhavatprasādataḥ sarvaṃ manye prāptaṃ mahīkṣitām //
meaning:
तत्तथानुष्ठितं किं तु सर्वं भवदनुग्रहात् /
भवत्प्रसादतः सर्वं मन्ये प्राप्तं महीक्षिताम् //
text_mt: all that was accomplished in that way solely through your grace. / Through your favour, I deem, everything is obtained by rulers of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā mama kā śaktiḥ śatrūnhantuṃ tathāvidhān /
analpī kurute phalyaṃ yanme vyavasitaṃ bhavān //
meaning:
अन्यथा मम का शक्तिः शत्रून्हन्तुं तथाविधान् /
अनल्पी कुरुते फल्यं यन्मे व्यवसितं भवान् //
text_mt: Otherwise, what power would I have had to slay such enemies? / That you magnify my undertaking as fruitful—

sanskrit_iast:
phalamalpamapi prītyai syādagasyādhiropituḥ /
jaiminiruvāca
evaṃ saṃbhāvitaḥ samyaksageraṇa mahāmuniḥ //
meaning:
फलमल्पमपि प्रीत्यै स्यादगस्याधिरोपितुः /
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवं संभावितः सम्यक्सगेरण महामुनिः //
text_mt: even a small fruit would bring joy to one who planted the tree.” / Jaimini said: / Having been thus duly honoured by Sagara, the great sage,

sanskrit_iast:
abhyanujñāya taṃ bhūyaḥ prajāgāma nijāśramam /
vasiṣṭe tu gate rājā sagaraḥprītamānasaḥ //
meaning:
अभ्यनुज्ञाय तं भूयः प्रजागाम निजाश्रमम् /
वसिष्टे तु गते राजा सगरःप्रीतमानसः //
text_mt: after bidding him farewell, departed once again to his own hermitage. / When Vasiṣṭha had departed, King Sagara, glad at heart,

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyāyāmabhivasanpraśaśāsākhilāṃ bhuvam /
bhāryābhyāṃ samupetābhyāṃ rūpaśīlaguṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
अयोध्यायामभिवसन्प्रशशासाखिलां भुवम् /
भार्याभ्यां समुपेताभ्यां रूपशीलगुणादिभिः //
text_mt: dwelling in Ayodhyā, ruled the whole earth. / Accompanied by his two wives endowed with beauty, good character, and virtues,

sanskrit_iast:
bubhuje viṣayānramyānyathākāmaṃ yathāsukham /
sumatiḥ keśinī cobhe vikasadvadanāṃbuje //
meaning:
बुभुजे विषयान्रम्यान्यथाकामं यथासुखम् /
सुमतिः केशिनी चोभे विकसद्वदनांबुजे //
text_mt: he enjoyed delightful objects of sense at will and at pleasure. / Both Sumati and Keśinī, whose lotus-faces were blooming,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaudāryaguṇopete pīnavṛttapayodhare /
nīlakuñcitakeśāḍhye sarvābharaṇabhūṣite //
meaning:
रूपौदार्यगुणोपेते पीनवृत्तपयोधरे /
नीलकुञ्चितकेशाढ्ये सर्वाभरणभूषिते //
text_mt: endowed with beauty and nobility of virtues, with plump, rounded breasts, / graced with dark, curly hair, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanne navayauvanagocare /
priye sannihite tasya nityaṃ priyahite rate //
meaning:
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ने नवयौवनगोचरे /
प्रिये सन्निहिते तस्य नित्यं प्रियहिते रते //
text_mt: endowed with every auspicious mark, in the bloom of fresh youth, / beloved and close to him, were ever devoted to his pleasure and welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
svācārabhāvaceṣṭābhirjahratustanmano 'niśam /
sa cāpi bharaṇotkarṣapratītātmā mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
स्वाचारभावचेष्टाभिर्जह्रतुस्तन्मनो ऽनिशम् /
स चापि भरणोत्कर्षप्रतीतात्मा महीपतिः //
text_mt: Through their good conduct, affection, and graceful gestures, they continually captivated his heart; / and that lord of the earth, his soul renowned for excellence in providing for others,

sanskrit_iast:
ramamāṇo yathākāmaṃ saha tābhyāṃ pure 'vasat /
anyeṣāṃ bhuvi rājñāṃ tu rājaśabdo na cāpyabhūt //
meaning:
रममाणो यथाकामं सह ताभ्यां पुरे ऽवसत् /
अन्येषां भुवि राज्ञां तु राजशब्दो न चाप्यभूत् //
text_mt: dwelt in the city sporting at will with both of them. / Indeed, the title of ‘king’ was not held by other kings on earth

sanskrit_iast:
guṇena cābhavattasya sagarasya mahātmanaḥ /
alpo 'pi dharmaḥ satataṃ yathā bhavati mānase //
meaning:
गुणेन चाभवत्तस्य सगरस्य महात्मनः /
अल्पो ऽपि धर्मः सततं यथा भवति मानसे //
text_mt: by virtue of merit as it was by that high-souled Sagara. / In order that even a small dharma might constantly remain in his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
rā5stasyārthakāmau tu na tathā vipulāvapi /
alubdhamānasor'thaṃ ca bheje dharmamapīḍayan //
meaning:
रा5स्तस्यार्थकामौ तु न तथा विपुलावपि /
अलुब्धमानसोर्ऽथं च भेजे धर्ममपीडयन् //
text_mt: [he did not let] wealth and desire, even though extensive, [harm it]. / With a mind free of greed, he pursued wealth without injuring dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
tadarthameva rājendra kāmaṃ cāpīḍayaṃstayoḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaradigvijayo nāmaikonapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 49//
meaning:
तदर्थमेव राजेन्द्र कामं चापीडयंस्तयोः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरदिग्विजयो नामैकोनपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 49//
text_mt:
and for that very purpose, O king of kings, he enjoyed pleasure without harming either of them.

Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, named ‘The Universal Conquest of Sagara,’ in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part proclaimed by Vāyu in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
evaṃ sa rājā vidhivatpālayāmāsa medinīm /
saptadvīpavatīṃ samyaksākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवं स राजा विधिवत्पालयामास मेदिनीम् /
सप्तद्वीपवतीं सम्यक्साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Thus that king duly protected the earth / possessing the seven continents, like another Dharma incarnate.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādīṃstathā varṇānsvesve dharme pṛthakpṛthak /
sthāpayitvā yathānyāyaṃ rarakṣāvyāhatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणादींस्तथा वर्णान्स्वेस्वे धर्मे पृथक्पृथक् /
स्थापयित्वा यथान्यायं ररक्षाव्याहतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: Having established the varṇas, beginning with the brāhmaṇas, each in their respective dharma according to rule, / he protected them with unsubdued senses.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāśca sarvavarṇeṣu yathāśreṣṭhānuvarttinaḥ /
varṇāścaivānulomyena tadvadartheṣu ca kramāt //
meaning:
प्रजाश्च सर्ववर्णेषु यथाश्रेष्ठानुवर्त्तिनः /
वर्णाश्चैवानुलोम्येन तद्वदर्थेषु च क्रमात् //
text_mt: The subjects across all varṇas followed the most distinguished among them, / and the varṇas followed in natural order and likewise in their pursuits successively.

sanskrit_iast:
na sati sthavire bālaṃ mṛtyurabhayupagacchati /
sarvavarṇeṣu bhūpāle mahīṃ tasminpraśāsati //
meaning:
न सति स्थविरे बालं मृत्युरभयुपगच्छति /
सर्ववर्णेषु भूपाले महीं तस्मिन्प्रशासति //
text_mt: Death did not overtake a child while an elder was alive, / across all the varṇas, while that protector of the earth was ruling the world.

sanskrit_iast:
sphītānyapetabādhāni tadā rāṣṭrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ /
teṣvasaṃkhyā janapadāścāturvarṇyajanāvṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्फीतान्यपेतबाधानि तदा राष्ट्राणि कृत्स्नशः /
तेष्वसंख्या जनपदाश्चातुर्वर्ण्यजनावृताः //
text_mt: The realms then were prosperous in their entirety, free from afflictions; / in them were countless provinces inhabited by people of the four varṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
te cāsaṃkhyāgṛhagrāmaśatopetā vibhāgaśaḥ /
deśāścāvāsabhuyiṣṭā nṛpe tasminpraśāsati //
meaning:
ते चासंख्यागृहग्रामशतोपेता विभागशः /
देशाश्चावासभुयिष्टा नृपे तस्मिन्प्रशासति //
text_mt: and these were divided into countless hundreds of homes and villages, / with territories thickly populated, while that king ruled.

sanskrit_iast:
anāśramī dvijaḥ kaścinna babhūva tadābhuvi /
prajānāṃ sarvavarṇeṣu prāraṃbhāḥ phaladāyinaḥ //
meaning:
अनाश्रमी द्विजः कश्चिन्न बभूव तदाभुवि /
प्रजानां सर्ववर्णेषु प्रारंभाः फलदायिनः //
text_mt: No twice-born on earth at that time was without an āśrama; / the undertakings of the subjects across all varṇas bore fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
svocitānyeva karmāṇi prārabhante ca mānavāḥ /
puruṣārthopapannāni karmāṇi ca tadā nṛṇām //
meaning:
स्वोचितान्येव कर्माणि प्रारभन्ते च मानवाः /
पुरुषार्थोपपन्नानि कर्माणि च तदा नृणाम् //
text_mt: Human beings undertook only the actions proper to themselves, / and the deeds of men at that time were endowed with the ends of human life.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotsavasamudyuktāḥ puragrāmavrajākarāḥ /
anyonyapriyakāmāśca rājabhaktisamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
महोत्सवसमुद्युक्ताः पुरग्रामव्रजाकराः /
अन्योन्यप्रियकामाश्च राजभक्तिसमन्विताः //
text_mt: Cities, villages, cattle pens, and mines were ever eager for great festivities; / people were mutually affectionate and filled with devotion to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
nanindito 'bhiśasto vā daridro vyādhito 'pi vā /
prajāsu kaścillubdho vā kṛpaṇo vāpi nābhavat //
meaning:
ननिन्दितो ऽभिशस्तो वा दरिद्रो व्याधितो ऽपि वा /
प्रजासु कश्चिल्लुब्धो वा कृपणो वापि नाभवत् //
text_mt: None among the subjects was blameworthy, cursed, poor, or diseased, / nor was anyone greedy or miserable.

sanskrit_iast:
janāḥ paraguṇaprītāḥ svasaṃparkābhikāṅkṣiṇāḥ /
guruṣu praṇatā nityaṃ sadvidyāvyasanādṛtāḥ //
meaning:
जनाः परगुणप्रीताः स्वसंपर्काभिकाङ्क्षिणाः /
गुरुषु प्रणता नित्यं सद्विद्याव्यसनादृताः //
text_mt: People were delighted by the virtues of others, desirous of association with good people, / ever bowed before gurus, and devoted to attachment to true learning.

sanskrit_iast:
parāpavādabhītāśca svadāraratayo 'niśam /
nisargātkhalasaṃsargaviratā dharmatatparāḥ //
meaning:
परापवादभीताश्च स्वदाररतयो ऽनिशम् /
निसर्गात्खलसंसर्गविरता धर्मतत्पराः //
text_mt: Fearful of slandering others, ever delighting in their own wives, / by nature turning away from the company of wicked people, intent upon dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
