āstikāḥ sarvaśo 'bhūvan prajāstasminpraśāsati /
evaṃ subāhutanye svapratāpārjitāṃ mahīm //
meaning:
आस्तिकाः सर्वशो ऽभूवन् प्रजास्तस्मिन्प्रशासति /
एवं सुबाहुतन्ये स्वप्रतापार्जितां महीम् //
text_mt: the subjects were everywhere orthodox believers while he ruled. / Thus, the son of Subāhu [ruled] the earth acquired by his own valour.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtavaśca mahābhāga yathākālānuvartinaḥ /
śālibhūyiṣṭhasasyāḍhyā sadaiva sakalā mahī //
meaning:
ऋतवश्च महाभाग यथाकालानुवर्तिनः /
शालिभूयिष्ठसस्याढ्या सदैव सकला मही //
text_mt: The seasons, O fortunate one, followed their proper times; / the entire earth was always rich in crops, predominantly rice,

sanskrit_iast: babhūva nṛpaśārdūle tasmin rājyāni śāsati //
meaning: बभूव नृपशार्दूले तस्मिन् राज्यानि शासति //
text_mt: while that tiger among kings was ruling the realms.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṣṭādaśamaṇḍalādhipatibhiḥ sevārthamabhyāgataiḥ prakhyātoruparākramairnṛpaśatairmūrddhābhiṣiktaiḥ pṛthak /
saṃviṣṭairmaṇiviṣṭareṣu nitarāmadhyāsyamānāmaraiḥ śakrasyeva virājate divi sabhā ratnaprabhodbhāsitā //
meaning:
यस्याष्टादशमण्डलाधिपतिभिः सेवार्थमभ्यागतैः प्रख्यातोरुपराक्रमैर्नृपशतैर्मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तैः पृथक् /
संविष्टैर्मणिविष्टरेषु नितरामध्यास्यमानामरैः शक्रस्येव विराजते दिवि सभा रत्नप्रभोद्भासिता //
text_mt: His assembly hall—attended on every side by the lords of the eighteen realms who had arrived to pay homage, by hundreds of consecrated kings renowned for their vast valour, seated on jewelled seats—shone illumined with the radiance of gems, like the celestial hall of Śakra in heaven occupied by the immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketāviṣayāntarābhyupagamāḥ sarve 'pi sopāyanāḥ kṛtvā sainyaniveśanāni paritaḥ puryāḥ pṛthak pārthivāḥ /
draṣṭuṃ kāṅkṣitarājakāḥ satanayāvijñāpayanto muhurdvāsthaireva nareśvarāya suciraṃ vatsyantamantaḥpure //
meaning:
संकेताविषयान्तराभ्युपगमाः सर्वे ऽपि सोपायनाः कृत्वा सैन्यनिवेशनानि परितः पुर्याः पृथक् पार्थिवाः /
द्रष्टुं काङ्क्षितराजकाः सतनयाविज्ञापयन्तो मुहुर्द्वास्थैरेव नरेश्वराय सुचिरं वत्स्यन्तमन्तःपुरे //
text_mt: Having agreed to treaties and other conditions, all kings, bearing tribute, / pitched their camps all around the city separately. / Desiring to see [him], the gathered kings together with their sons repeatedly announced themselves through the door-keepers / to the king who was to dwell for a long time within his inner chambers.

sanskrit_iast:
namannaredramukuṭaśreṇīnāmatigharṣaṇāt /
kiṇīkṛtau virājete caraṇau tasya bhūbhujaḥ //
meaning:
नमन्नरेद्रमुकुटश्रेणीनामतिघर्षणात् /
किणीकृतौ विराजेते चरणौ तस्य भूभुजः //
text_mt: From the excessive friction against the rows of crowns of bowing kings, / the two feet of that ruler of the earth, calloused, shone brightly.

sanskrit_iast:
sevāgatanaredraughavinikīrṇaiḥ samantataḥ /
ratnairbhāti sabhā tasya guhā some ravī yathā //
meaning:
सेवागतनरेद्रौघविनिकीर्णैः समन्ततः /
रत्नैर्भाति सभा तस्य गुहा सोमे रवी यथा //
text_mt: With the jewels scattered all around by the throngs of kings who came to serve him, / his assembly hall shone like a cave [brightened] by the moon and the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa rājā dharmeṇa bhānuvaṃśaśikhāmaṇiḥ /
ananyaśāsanāmurvīmanvaśāsadarindamaḥ //
meaning:
एवं स राजा धर्मेण भानुवंशशिखामणिः /
अनन्यशासनामुर्वीमन्वशासदरिन्दमः //
text_mt: Thus that king, the crest-jewel of the solar dynasty, / the subduer of enemies, ruled the earth with righteousness, his command brookable by none.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pālayataḥ pṛthvīṃ sagarasya mahīpateḥ /
na cāpapāta mut putramukhālokanajṛṃbhitā //
meaning:
इत्थं पालयतः पृथ्वीं सगरस्य महीपतेः /
न चापपात मुत् पुत्रमुखालोकनजृंभिता //
text_mt: As King Sagara was protecting the earth in this way, / no joy arose [in him] that is born from gazing upon the face of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
vinā tāṃ duḥkhito 'tyarthaṃ citayāmāsa naikadhā /
aho kaṣṭamaputro 'hamasminvaṃśe dhruvaṃ tu yat //
meaning:
विना तां दुःखितो ऽत्यर्थं चितयामास नैकधा /
अहो कष्टमपुत्रो ऽहमस्मिन्वंशे ध्रुवं तु यत् //
text_mt: Being extremely sorrowful without that, he reflected in many ways: / “Alas, what misery! I am childless in this lineage, where surely

sanskrit_iast:
prayānti nūnamasmākaṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍaviplavam /
nirayādapi satputre saṃjāte pitaraḥ kila //
meaning:
प्रयान्ति नूनमस्माकं पितरः पिण्डविप्लवम् /
निरयादपि सत्पुत्रे संजाते पितरः किल //
text_mt: our ancestors are heading toward the loss of funeral rice-balls! / Even from hell, indeed, when a virtuous son is born, the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
prītyā prayānti tadgehaṃ jātakarmakriyotsukāḥ /
mahatā sukṛtenāpi saṃprāptasya divaṃ kila //
meaning:
प्रीत्या प्रयान्ति तद्गेहं जातकर्मक्रियोत्सुकाः /
महता सुकृतेनापि संप्राप्तस्य दिवं किल //
text_mt: eager for the performance of the birth-rites, go with joy to his house. / Even for one who has reached heaven by great merit,

sanskrit_iast:
aputrasyāmarāḥ svarge dvāraṃ noddhāṭayanti hi /
pitā tu lokamubhayoḥ svarlokaṃ tatpitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
अपुत्रस्यामराः स्वर्गे द्वारं नोद्धाटयन्ति हि /
पिता तु लोकमुभयोः स्वर्लोकं तत्पितामहाः //
text_mt: the gods do not open the gate of heaven if he is sonless. / The father indeed [wins] the world of both, while his grandfathers will conquer heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
jeṣyanti kila satputre jāte vaṃśadvaye 'pi ca /
anapatyatayāhaṃ tu putriṇāṃ yā bhavedgatiḥ //
meaning:
जेष्यन्ति किल सत्पुत्रे जाते वंशद्वये ऽपि च /
अनपत्यतयाहं तु पुत्रिणां या भवेद्गतिः //
text_mt: when a virtuous son is born in both lines. / But because of childlessness, the state which belongs to those who have sons

sanskrit_iast:
na tāṃ prāpkyāmi vai nūnaṃ sudurlabhatarā hi sā /
padādaindrātkilābhinnamṛddhaṃ rājyamakhaṇḍitam //
meaning:
न तां प्राप्क्यामि वै नूनं सुदुर्लभतरा हि सा /
पदादैन्द्रात्किलाभिन्नमृद्धं राज्यमखण्डितम् //
text_mt: I shall surely not attain, for that is exceedingly difficult to reach. / This flourishing, undivided kingdom, surely not different from the station of Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
mama yattadapuṇyasya yāti niṣphalatāmiha /
idaṃ matpūrvajaireva siṃhāsanamadhiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
मम यत्तदपुण्यस्य याति निष्फलतामिह /
इदं मत्पूर्वजैरेव सिंहासनमधिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: which belongs to me, an unmeritorious one, goes to fruitlessness here! / This throne, occupied by my own ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
aputratvena rājyaṃ ca parādhīnatvameṣyati /
tasmādaurvāśramamahaṃ gatvā taṃ munipuṅgavam //
meaning:
अपुत्रत्वेन राज्यं च पराधीनत्वमेष्यति /
तस्मादौर्वाश्रममहं गत्वा तं मुनिपुङ्गवम् //
text_mt: and the kingdom will fall under the control of others due to sonlessness. / Therefore, having gone to the hermitage of Aurva, to that bull among sages,

sanskrit_iast:
prasādayiṣye putrārthaṃ bhāryābhyāṃ sahito 'dhunā /
gatvā tasmai tvaputratvaṃ vinivedya mahātmane //
meaning:
प्रसादयिष्ये पुत्रार्थं भार्याभ्यां सहितो ऽधुना /
गत्वा तस्मै त्वपुत्रत्वं विनिवेद्य महात्मने //
text_mt: I shall now propitiate him for the sake of a son, together with my two wives. / Having gone and made known my sonlessness to that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
sa yadvakṣyati tatsarvaṃ kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ /
iti sañcintya manasā sagarorājasattamaḥ //
meaning:
स यद्वक्ष्यति तत्सर्वं करिष्ये नात्र संशयः /
इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा सगरोराजसत्तमः //
text_mt: I will do everything that he speaks; there is no doubt about this.” / Reflecting thus in his mind, Sagara, the best of kings,

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa kṛtyavidrājangantumaurvāśramaṃ prati /
sa mantripravare rājyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tato vanam //
meaning:
इत्येष कृत्यविद्राजन्गन्तुमौर्वाश्रमं प्रति /
स मन्त्रिप्रवरे राज्यं प्रतिष्ठाप्य ततो वनम् //
text_mt: this knower of duties, O king, [set out] to go toward the hermitage of Aurva. / Having established the kingdom in the care of his foremost minister, he then [went] to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
prayayau rathamāruhya bhāryābhyāṃ sahito mudā /
jagāma rathaghoṣeṇa meghanādātiśaṅkibhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रययौ रथमारुह्य भार्याभ्यां सहितो मुदा /
जगाम रथघोषेण मेघनादातिशङ्किभिः //
text_mt: Mounting his chariot together with his two wives, he set forth joyfully. / He proceeded with the rumble of the chariot, while peacocks, suspecting it to be the rumble of clouds,

sanskrit_iast:
stabdhekṣaṇairlakṣyamāṇo mārgopānte śikhaṇḍibhiḥ /
priyābhyāṃ darśayanrājansāraṅgāṃstimitekṣaṇān //
meaning:
स्तब्धेक्षणैर्लक्ष्यमाणो मार्गोपान्ते शिखण्डिभिः /
प्रियाभ्यां दर्शयन्राजन्सारङ्गांस्तिमितेक्षणान् //
text_mt: watched him with motionless eyes by the edge of the road, O king; / showing to his two beloveds the deer with steady eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamamūrdhvamukhānsadyaḥ palāyanaparānpunaḥ /
vṛkṣānpuṣpaphalopetānvilokya mudito 'bhavat //
meaning:
क्षममूर्ध्वमुखान्सद्यः पलायनपरान्पुनः /
वृक्षान्पुष्पफलोपेतान्विलोक्य मुदितो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: their faces upturned for a moment, and then intent on flight, / and seeing trees laden with flowers and fruits, he became delighted:

sanskrit_iast:
amlānakusumaiḥ svāduphalaiḥ śādvalabhūmikaiḥ /
susnigdhapallavacchāyairabhitaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ nagaiḥ //
meaning:
अम्लानकुसुमैः स्वादुफलैः शाद्वलभूमिकैः /
सुस्निग्धपल्लवच्छायैरभितः संभृतं नगैः //
text_mt: [the forest] filled on all sides with trees bearing unfading flowers and sweet fruits, / with grassy grounds and having the shade of glossy tender leaves;

sanskrit_iast:
cūtāgrapallavāsvādasnigdhakaṇṭhapikāravaiḥ /
śrotrābhirāmajanakaissaṃghuṣṭaṃ sarvatodiśam //
meaning:
चूताग्रपल्लवास्वादस्निग्धकण्ठपिकारवैः /
श्रोत्राभिरामजनकैस्संघुष्टं सर्वतोदिशम् //
text_mt: resounding in every quarter with the sweet-voiced calls of the cuckoos / whose throats were smoothed by tasting the tips of mango shoots, delighting the ears;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvartukusumopetaṃ bhramadbhramaramaṇḍitam /
prasūnastabakānamraballarīvellitadrumam //
meaning:
सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेतं भ्रमद्भ्रमरमण्डितम् /
प्रसूनस्तबकानम्रबल्लरीवेल्लितद्रुमम् //
text_mt: endowed with flowers of all seasons, adorned with hovering bees, / its trees entwined with creeping vines bent low with clusters of blossoms;

sanskrit_iast:
kapiyūthasamākrāntava naspatiśatāvṛtam /
unmattaśikhisāraṅgakūjatpakṣigaṇānvitam //
meaning:
कपियूथसमाक्रान्तव नस्पतिशतावृतम् /
उन्मत्तशिखिसारङ्गकूजत्पक्षिगणान्वितम् //
text_mt: filled with hundreds of great trees climbed over by troops of monkeys, / accompanied by flocks of birds singing along with frenzied peacocks and deer;

sanskrit_iast:
gāyadvidyādharavadhūgītikāsumanoharam /
saṃcaratkinnarīdvandvavirājadvanagahvaram //
meaning:
गायद्विद्याधरवधूगीतिकासुमनोहरम् /
संचरत्किन्नरीद्वन्द्वविराजद्वनगह्वरम् //
text_mt: exceedingly charming with the songs of singing Vidyādhara maidens, / its forest caves splendid with moving Kinnara couples;

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsasārasacakrāhvakāraṇḍavaśukādibhiḥ /
susvarairāvṛtopāntaiḥ sarobhiḥ parivāritam //
meaning:
हंससारसचक्राह्वकारण्डवशुकादिभिः /
सुस्वरैरावृतोपान्तैः सरोभिः परिवारितम् //
text_mt: surrounded by lakes whose borders were crowded with sweet-voiced / swans, cranes, cakravākas, kāraṇḍavas, parrots, and others;

sanskrit_iast:
saraḥ svaṃbuja kahlārakumudotpalarāśiṣu /
śanaiḥ parivahanmandamārutāpūrṇadiṅmukham //
meaning:
सरः स्वंबुज कह्लारकुमुदोत्पलराशिषु /
शनैः परिवहन्मन्दमारुतापूर्णदिङ्मुखम् //
text_mt: with the gentle breeze slowly blowing over the masses of lotuses, kahlāras, white lilies, and blue lotuses in the lakes, / filling the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaguṇopetamadhigāhya tapovanam /
gacchanrathenātha nṛpaḥ praharṣaṃ paramaṃ yayau //
meaning:
एवंविधगुणोपेतमधिगाह्य तपोवनम् /
गच्छन्रथेनाथ नृपः प्रहर्षं परमं ययौ //
text_mt: Having entered the penance grove endowed with such qualities, / the king, proceeding by chariot, attained the highest delight.

sanskrit_iast:
upaśāntāśayaḥ so 'tha saṃprāpyāśramamaṇḍalam /
bhāryābhyāṃ sahitaḥ śrīmānvāhādavaruroha vai //
meaning:
उपशान्ताशयः सो ऽथ संप्राप्याश्रममण्डलम् /
भार्याभ्यां सहितः श्रीमान्वाहादवरुरोह वै //
text_mt: Then, his mind calmed, having reached the circle of the hermitage, / the glorious one descended from the chariot along with his two wives.

sanskrit_iast:
dhuryānviśrāmayetyuktvā yantāramavanīpatiḥ /
āsasādāśramopāntaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ //
meaning:
धुर्यान्विश्रामयेत्युक्त्वा यन्तारमवनीपतिः /
आससादाश्रमोपान्तं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः //
text_mt: Having said to the charioteer, “Rest the draft-animals,” / the lord of the earth approached the vicinity of the hermitage of the purified great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śrutvā muniśiṣyebhyaḥ kṛtanityakriyādaram /
muniṃ draṣṭuṃ vinītātmā praviveśāśramaṃ tadā //
meaning:
स श्रुत्वा मुनिशिष्येभ्यः कृतनित्यक्रियादरम् /
मुनिं द्रष्टुं विनीतात्मा प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा //
text_mt: Hearing from the sage’s disciples that he had completed his daily rites with reverence, / [the king], modest in demeanor, then entered the hermitage to see the sage.

sanskrit_iast:
munimadhye samāsīnamṛṣivṛndaiḥ samanvitam /
nanāma śirasā rājā bhāryābhyāṃ sahito mudā //
meaning:
मुनिमध्ये समासीनमृषिवृन्दैः समन्वितम् /
ननाम शिरसा राजा भार्याभ्यां सहितो मुदा //
text_mt: The king, along with his two wives, bowed down with his head in joy / to the sage seated in the midst, surrounded by groups of ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapraṇāmaṃ nṛpatimṛṣiraurvaḥ pratāpavān /
upaviśeti premṇā vai saha tābhyāṃ samādiśat //
meaning:
कृतप्रणामं नृपतिमृषिरौर्वः प्रतापवान् /
उपविशेति प्रेम्णा वै सह ताभ्यां समादिशत् //
text_mt: To the king who had offered obeisance, the glorious sage Aurva / affectionately commanded, “Be seated,” together with the two of them.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayitvā mahāmuniḥ /
ātithyena ca vanyena sabhāryaṃ tamatoṣayat //
meaning:
अर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयित्वा महामुनिः /
आतिथ्येन च वन्येन सभार्यं तमतोषयत् //
text_mt: Having honored him properly with guest-water, foot-water, and other offerings, / the great sage gratified him and his wives with forest-born hospitality.

sanskrit_iast:
athātithyopaviśrāntaṃ praṇamyā sīnamagrataḥ /
rājānamabravīdaurvaḥ śanairmṛdvakṣaraṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
अथातिथ्योपविश्रान्तं प्रणम्या सीनमग्रतः /
राजानमब्रवीदौर्वः शनैर्मृद्वक्षरं वचः //
text_mt: Then, to the king who had rested from the hospitality and sat before him having bowed, / Aurva spoke slowly in gentle words:

sanskrit_iast:
kuśalaṃ nanu te rājye bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca /
apidharmeṇa sakalāḥ prajāstvaṃ parirakṣasi //
meaning:
कुशलं ननु ते राज्ये बाह्येष्वाभ्यन्तरेषु च /
अपिधर्मेण सकलाः प्रजास्त्वं परिरक्षसि //
text_mt: “Is all well with your kingdom, in external and internal matters? / Do you protect all your subjects in accordance with dharma?

sanskrit_iast:
api jetuṃ trivargaṃ tvamupāyaiḥ samyagīhase /
phalanti hi guṇāstubhyaṃ tvayā samyakpracoditāḥ //
meaning:
अपि जेतुं त्रिवर्गं त्वमुपायैः सम्यगीहसे /
फलन्ति हि गुणास्तुभ्यं त्वया सम्यक्प्रचोदिताः //
text_mt: Do you endeavor to master the threefold path of life properly through expedient means? / For virtues properly prompted by you bear fruit for you.

sanskrit_iast:
diṣṭyātvayā jitāḥ sarve ripavo nṛpasattama /
diṣṭyā ca sakalaṃ rājyaṃ tvayā dharmeṇa rakṣyate //
meaning:
दिष्ट्यात्वया जिताः सर्वे रिपवो नृपसत्तम /
दिष्ट्या च सकलं राज्यं त्वया धर्मेण रक्ष्यते //
text_mt: By good fortune all enemies have been conquered by you, O best of kings! / By good fortune the entire kingdom is protected by you with dharma!

sanskrit_iast:
dharma eva sthitiryeṣāṃ teṣāṃ nāstyatraviplavaḥ /
na taṃ rakṣati kiṃ dharmaḥ svayaṃ yenābhirakṣitaḥ //
meaning:
धर्म एव स्थितिर्येषां तेषां नास्त्यत्रविप्लवः /
न तं रक्षति किं धर्मः स्वयं येनाभिरक्षितः //
text_mt: Those whose foundation is dharma suffer no ruin here. / Does not dharma protect him by whom it has itself been preserved?

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamevāhamaśrauṣaṃ vijitya sakalāṃ mahīm /
sabalonagarīṃ prāptaḥ kṛtadāro bhavāniti //
meaning:
पूर्वमेवाहमश्रौषं विजित्य सकलां महीम् /
सबलोनगरीं प्राप्तः कृतदारो भवानिति //
text_mt: Earlier indeed I heard that, having conquered the entire earth, / you arrived at the city with your army and took wives.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñāṃ tu pravaro dharmo yatprajāparipālanam /
bhavanti sukhino nūnaṃ tenaiveha paratra ca //
meaning:
राज्ञां तु प्रवरो धर्मो यत्प्रजापरिपालनम् /
भवन्ति सुखिनो नूनं तेनैवेह परत्र च //
text_mt: The foremost duty of kings is the protection of subjects; / surely by that alone they become happy in this world and the next.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bhavānrājya bharaṇaṃ parityajya madantikam /
bhāryābhyāṃ sahito rājansamāyāto 'si me vada //
meaning:
स भवान्राज्य भरणं परित्यज्य मदन्तिकम् /
भार्याभ्यां सहितो राजन्समायातो ऽसि मे वद //
text_mt: Relinquishing the governance of the kingdom, you / have come to my presence with your two wives, O king; tell me [the reason].”

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
evamuktastu muninā sagaro rājasattamaḥ /
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prāha taṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagarasyaurvāśramagamanaṃ nāma pañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 50//
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना सगरो राजसत्तमः /
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्राह तं मधुरं वचः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरस्यौर्वाश्रमगमनं नाम पञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 50//
text_mt:
Jaimini said: / Being spoken to thus by the sage, Sagara, the best of kings, / made an añjali fold with his hands and spoke these sweet words to him.

Thus ends the fiftieth chapter, named ‘The Going of Sagara to the Hermitage of Aurva’, in the third Upoddhātapāda in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa, proclaimed by Vāyu. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
sagara uvāca
kuśalaṃ mama sarvatra maharṣe nātra saṃśayaḥ /
yasya me tvamanudhyātā śamaṃ bhārgavasattamaḥ //
meaning:
सगर उवाच
कुशलं मम सर्वत्र महर्षे नात्र संशयः /
यस्य मे त्वमनुध्याता शमं भार्गवसत्तमः //
text_mt: Sagara said: / “All is well with me everywhere, O great sage; there is no doubt of this, / since you, the best of the Bhārgavas, wish for my peace.

sanskrit_iast:
yastathā śikṣitaḥ pūrvamastre śastre ca sāṃpratam /
so 'haṃ kathamaśaktaḥ syāṃ sakalārivinigrahe //
meaning:
यस्तथा शिक्षितः पूर्वमस्त्रे शस्त्रे च सांप्रतम् /
सो ऽहं कथमशक्तः स्यां सकलारिविनिग्रहे //
text_mt: Having been instructed in that manner formerly in missiles and now in weapons, / how could I be powerless in suppressing all enemies?

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ me guruḥ suhṛddaivaṃ bandhurmitraṃ ca kevalam /
na hyanyamabhijānāmi tvāmṛte pitaraṃ ca me //
meaning:
त्वं मे गुरुः सुहृद्दैवं बन्धुर्मित्रं च केवलम् /
न ह्यन्यमभिजानामि त्वामृते पितरं च मे //
text_mt: You alone are my guru, well-wisher, deity, kinsman, and friend; / indeed, I know of no other father than you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayopadiṣṭenāstreṇa sakalā bhūbhṛto mayā /
vijitā yadanusmṛtyā śaktiḥ sā tapasastava //
meaning:
त्वयोपदिष्टेनास्त्रेण सकला भूभृतो मया /
विजिता यदनुस्मृत्या शक्तिः सा तपसस्तव //
text_mt: With the missile taught by you, all kings were conquered by me; / remembering it, that [victory] is the power of your ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tvaṃ jagatsarvaṃ punāsi paripāsi ca /
sraṣṭuṃ saṃharttumapi ca śaknoṣyeva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
तपसा त्वं जगत्सर्वं पुनासि परिपासि च /
स्रष्टुं संहर्त्तुमपि च शक्नोष्येव न संशयः //
text_mt: Through ascetic heat you purify and protect the entire world; / you are even able to create and destroy it—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānananyasāmānyaprabhāvastapasaśca te /
iha tasyaikadeśo 'pi dṛśyate vismayapradaḥ //
meaning:
महाननन्यसामान्यप्रभावस्तपसश्च ते /
इह तस्यैकदेशो ऽपि दृश्यते विस्मयप्रदः //
text_mt: Great and unequalled is the power of your ascetic heat; / even a single part of it seen here evokes wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyasiṃhāsane bālyādupetya mṛgapotakaḥ /
pibatyaṃbhaḥ śanairbrahmanniḥśaṅkaṃ te tapovane //
meaning:
पश्यसिंहासने बाल्यादुपेत्य मृगपोतकः /
पिबत्यंभः शनैर्ब्रह्मन्निःशङ्कं ते तपोवने //
text_mt: Look: in childish innocence a fawn approaches the lion's seat / and slowly drinks water, O Brahmin, without fear in your hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
dhayatyatrātivisraṃbhāt kṛśāpi hariṇī stanam /
karoti mṛgaśṛṅgāgre gaṇḍakaṇḍūyanaṃ ruruḥ //
meaning:
धयत्यत्रातिविस्रंभात् कृशापि हरिणी स्तनम् /
करोति मृगशृङ्गाग्रे गण्डकण्डूयनं रुरुः //
text_mt: Here, out of utter trust, even an emaciated doe suckles at the breast [of another]; / a stag scratches its cheek against the tip of a deer's horn.

sanskrit_iast:
navaprasūtāṃ hariṇīṃ hatvā vṛttyai vanāntare /
vyāghrī tvattapasāvāse saiva puṣṇāti tacchiśūn //
meaning:
नवप्रसूतां हरिणीं हत्वा वृत्त्यै वनान्तरे /
व्याघ्री त्वत्तपसावासे सैव पुष्णाति तच्छिशून् //
text_mt: A tigress that killed a newly-calved doe for food in another forest / nourishes the very same fawns in the dwelling of your ascetic heat.

sanskrit_iast:
gajaṃ drutamanudrutya siṃho yasmādidaṃ vanam /
praviṣṭo 'nusarantau tvadbhayādekatra tiṣṭhataḥ //
meaning:
गजं द्रुतमनुद्रुत्य सिंहो यस्मादिदं वनम् /
प्रविष्टो ऽनुसरन्तौ त्वद्भयादेकत्र तिष्ठतः //
text_mt: Because a lion entered this forest chasing swiftly after an elephant, / the two of them, though pursuing, stay together in one place out of fear of you.

sanskrit_iast:
nakulastvāśumārjāramayūraśaśapannagāḥ /
vṛkasūkaraśārdūlaśarabharkṣaplavaṅgamāḥ //
meaning:
नकुलस्त्वाशुमार्जारमयूरशशपन्नगाः /
वृकसूकरशार्दूलशरभर्क्षप्लवङ्गमाः //
text_mt: Mongoose, swift cat, peacock, hare, and serpent; / wolf, boar, tiger, śarabha, bear, and monkey;

sanskrit_iast:
sṛgālā gavayāgāvo hariṇā mahiṣāstathā /
vane 'tra sahajaṃ vairaṃ hitvā maitrīmupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
सृगाला गवयागावो हरिणा महिषास्तथा /
वने ऽत्र सहजं वैरं हित्वा मैत्रीमुपागताः //
text_mt: Jackals, gayals, cows, deer, and likewise buffaloes— / abandoning their natural enmity in this forest, have attained friendship.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhā tapaḥśaktirlokavismayadāyinī /
na kvāpi dṛśyate brahmaṃstvāmṛte bhuvi durlabhā //
meaning:
एवंविधा तपःशक्तिर्लोकविस्मयदायिनी /
न क्वापि दृश्यते ब्रह्मंस्त्वामृते भुवि दुर्लभा //
text_mt: Such power of ascetic heat, bestowing wonder upon the world / and rare on earth, is seen nowhere, O Brahmin, except in you.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ tu tvatprasādena vijitya vasudhāmi mām /
ripubhiḥ saha viprarṣe svarājyaṃ samupāgataḥ //
meaning:
अहं तु त्वत्प्रसादेन विजित्य वसुधामि माम् /
रिपुभिः सह विप्रर्षे स्वराज्यं समुपागतः //
text_mt: Having conquered this earth together with its enemies by your grace, / O Brahmin sage, I have returned to my own kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśyāmātyastrivarge 'pi yathāyogyakṛtādaraḥ /
tvayopadiṣṭamārgeṇa samyagrājyamapālayam //
meaning:
वश्यामात्यस्त्रिवर्गे ऽपि यथायोग्यकृतादरः /
त्वयोपदिष्टमार्गेण सम्यग्राज्यमपालयम् //
text_mt: With ministers obedient and due regard paid appropriately to the three aims of life, / I properly protected the realm in the manner instructed by you.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravarttamānasya mama rājye 'vatiṣṭhataḥ /
bhavaddidṛkṣā saṃjātā sāpekṣā bhṛgupuṅgava //
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्त्तमानस्य मम राज्ये ऽवतिष्ठतः /
भवद्दिदृक्षा संजाता सापेक्षा भृगुपुङ्गव //
text_mt: As I remained thus acting within the kingdom, / a desire arose, full of longing, to see you, O best of the Bhṛgus.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvadya mayi paryāptamanapatyatayaiva me /
pitṛpiṇḍapradānena saha saṃrakṣaṇaṃ bhuvaḥ //
meaning:
किं त्वद्य मयि पर्याप्तमनपत्यतयैव मे /
पितृपिण्डप्रदानेन सह संरक्षणं भुवः //
text_mt: Yet today, on account of my childlessness alone, / the protection of the earth together with the offering of balls of rice to the ancestors seems insufficient to me.

sanskrit_iast:
tadidaṃ duḥśamatyarthamanivāryaṃ manogatam /
nānayo 'paharttāṃ lokaṃ'smin mameti tvāmupāgataḥ //
meaning:
तदिदं दुःशमत्यर्थमनिवार्यं मनोगतम् /
नानयो ऽपहर्त्तां लोकंऽस्मिन् ममेति त्वामुपागतः //
text_mt: This deep, irresistible sorrow in my heart is hard to calm; / 'There is no remover of it in this world for me'—thinking thus, I have come to you."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktaḥ sagareṇātha sthitvā so 'tarmanāḥ kṣaṇam /
uvāca bhagavānaurvaḥ sanideśamidaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तः सगरेणाथ स्थित्वा सो ऽतर्मनाः क्षणम् /
उवाच भगवानौर्वः सनिदेशमिदं वचः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by Sagara, the venerable Aurva paused a moment, reflective in mind, / and then spoke these words containing an instruction:

sanskrit_iast:
niyamya saha bhāryābhyāṃ kiñcitkālamihāvasa /
avāpsyati tato 'bhīṣṭaṃ bhavānnātra vicāramā //
meaning:
नियम्य सह भार्याभ्यां किञ्चित्कालमिहावस /
अवाप्स्यति ततो ऽभीष्टं भवान्नात्र विचारमा //
text_mt: "Practising self-restraint together with your two wives, dwell here for some time; / then you will obtain your desire—let there be no doubt about this."

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca tatrāvasatprītastacchuśrūṣāparāyamaḥ /
patnībhyāṃ saha dharmātmā bhaktiyuktaściraṃ tadā //
meaning:
स च तत्रावसत्प्रीतस्तच्छुश्रूषापरायमः /
पत्नीभ्यां सह धर्मात्मा भक्तियुक्तश्चिरं तदा //
text_mt: And he dwelled there joyfully, devoted to his service, / together with his two wives, righteous and full of devotion for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
rājapatnyau ca te tasya sarvakālamatandrite /
muneratanutāṃ prītiṃ vinayācārabhaktibhiḥ //
meaning:
राजपत्न्यौ च ते तस्य सर्वकालमतन्द्रिते /
मुनेरतनुतां प्रीतिं विनयाचारभक्तिभिः //
text_mt: The two royal wives, ever unwearied, / extended delight to the sage through modesty, good conduct, and devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā śuśrūṣayā caiva tayostuṣṭo mahāmuniḥ /
rājapatnyau samāhūya idaṃ vacanama bravīt //
meaning:
भक्त्या शुश्रूषया चैव तयोस्तुष्टो महामुनिः /
राजपत्न्यौ समाहूय इदं वचनम ब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Pleased by their devotion and service, the great sage / summoned the two royal wives and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavatyau varamasmatto vriyatāṃ kāmamīpsitam /
dāsyāmi taṃ na saṃdeho yadyapi syātsudurllabham //
meaning:
भवत्यौ वरमस्मत्तो व्रियतां काममीप्सितम् /
दास्यामि तं न संदेहो यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् //
text_mt: "May you two choose a desired boon from me at your wish; / I will grant it, there is no doubt, even if it should be very difficult to obtain."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇamyaśirasā te 'pyubhe taṃ mahāmunim /
ūcaturbhagavānputrānkāmayāveti sādaram //
meaning:
ततः प्रणम्यशिरसा ते ऽप्युभे तं महामुनिम् /
ऊचतुर्भगवान्पुत्रान्कामयावेति सादरम् //
text_mt: Then, bowing with their heads to that great sage, / both respectfully said: "Lord, we desire sons."

sanskrit_iast:
tataste bhagavānāha bhavatībhyāṃ mayā punaḥ /
rājñaścapriyakāmena varo datto 'yamīpsitaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्ते भगवानाह भवतीभ्यां मया पुनः /
राज्ञश्चप्रियकामेन वरो दत्तो ऽयमीप्सितः //
text_mt: Then the venerable one said to them: "By me, desiring what is pleasing to you / and to the king, this sought-after boon is granted.

sanskrit_iast:
putravatyau mahābhāge bhavatyau matprasādataḥ /
bhavetāṃ dhruvamanyacca śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama //
meaning:
पुत्रवत्यौ महाभागे भवत्यौ मत्प्रसादतः /
भवेतां ध्रुवमन्यच्च श्रूयतां वचनं मम //
text_mt: O fortunate women, by my grace you two shall surely have sons; / and hear another word of mine:

sanskrit_iast:
putro bhaviṣyatyekasyāmekaḥ so 'natidhārmikaḥ /
tathāpi tasya kalpāntaṃ saṃbhūtiśca bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
पुत्रो भविष्यत्येकस्यामेकः सो ऽनतिधार्मिकः /
तथापि तस्य कल्पान्तं संभूतिश्च भविष्यति //
text_mt: To one there will be a single son, not exceedingly righteous, / yet his lineage will continue until the end of the kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭiḥ putrasahasrāṇāmaparasyāṃ ca jāyate /
akṛtārthāśca te sarve vinaṅkṣyantyacirādiva //
meaning:
षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणामपरस्यां च जायते /
अकृतार्थाश्च ते सर्वे विनङ्क्ष्यन्त्यचिरादिव //
text_mt: And sixty thousand sons shall be born to the other; / they will all perish before long, without fulfilling their aims.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃvidhaguṇepeto varau dattau mayā yuvām /
abhīpsitaṃ tu yadyasyāḥ svecchayā tatprakīrtyatām //
meaning:
एवंविधगुणेपेतो वरौ दत्तौ मया युवाम् /
अभीप्सितं तु यद्यस्याः स्वेच्छया तत्प्रकीर्त्यताम् //
text_mt: Endowed with such qualities, two boons have been granted by me to you two; / whatever is desired by either, let that be declared according to your own wish."

sanskrit_iast:
evamukte tu muninā vaidarbhyānvayavarddhanam /
varayāmāsa tanayaṃ putrānanyāstathā parā //
meaning:
एवमुक्ते तु मुनिना वैदर्भ्यान्वयवर्द्धनम् /
वरयामास तनयं पुत्रानन्यास्तथा परा //
text_mt: When this was spoken by the sage, the Vidarbha princess chose the single son / who would continue the lineage, and the other chose the [many] sons.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dattvā varaṃ rājñe sagarāya mahāmuniḥ /
sabhāryāmanumānyainaṃ visasarja purīṃ prati //
meaning:
इति दत्त्वा वरं राज्ञे सगराय महामुनिः /
सभार्यामनुमान्यैनं विससर्ज पुरीं प्रति //
text_mt: Having thus granted the boon to King Sagara, the great sage / gave him and his wives permission and sent them back to the city.

sanskrit_iast:
muninā samanujñātaḥ kṛta kṛtyo mahīpatiḥ /
rathamāruhya vegena sapriyaḥ prayayau purīm //
meaning:
मुनिना समनुज्ञातः कृत कृत्यो महीपतिः /
रथमारुह्य वेगेन सप्रियः प्रययौ पुरीम् //
text_mt: Permitted by the sage, having achieved his purpose, the lord of the earth / mounted his chariot and swiftly returned to the city with his beloved wives.

sanskrit_iast:
sa praviśya purīṃ ramyāṃ tdṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtām /
ānanditaḥ paurajanai reme paramayā mudā //
meaning:
स प्रविश्य पुरीं रम्यां त्दृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् /
आनन्दितः पौरजनै रेमे परमया मुदा //
text_mt: Entering the lovely city filled with prosperous and well-fed people, / he, welcomed joyfully by the citizens, delighted with supreme happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu rājapatnyāvubhe nṛpa /
rājñe prāvocatāṃ garbhaṃ mudā paramayā yute //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजपत्न्यावुभे नृप /
राज्ञे प्रावोचतां गर्भं मुदा परमया युते //
text_mt: At that very time, O king, both royal wives, / filled with supreme joy, reported pregnancy to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
vavṛdhe ca tayorgarbhaḥ śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ /
saha saṃtoṣasaṃpattyā pitroḥ paurajanasya ca //
meaning:
ववृधे च तयोर्गर्भः शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् /
सह संतोषसंपत्त्या पित्रोः पौरजनस्य च //
text_mt: And the embryo in the two grew like the moon in the bright fortnight, / along with the abundance of delight of both parents and of the citizens.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇe tu tataḥ kāle muhūrte keśinīśubhe /
asūyatāgnigarbhābhaṃ kumāramamitadyutim //
meaning:
संपूर्णे तु ततः काले मुहूर्ते केशिनीशुभे /
असूयताग्निगर्भाभं कुमारममितद्युतिम् //
text_mt: Then, when the time was complete, at an auspicious moment Keśinī / gave birth to an immensely radiant prince, resembling the womb of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmādikaṃ tasya kṛtvā caiva yathāvidhi /
asamañcasa ityeva nāma tasyā karonnṛpaḥ //
meaning:
जातकर्मादिकं तस्य कृत्वा चैव यथाविधि /
असमञ्चस इत्येव नाम तस्या करोन्नृपः //
text_mt: Having duly performed the birth rites and other ceremonies for him, / the king gave him the name Asamañjasa.

sanskrit_iast:
sumatiścāpi tatkāle garbhālābamasūyata /
saṃprasūtaṃ tu taṃ tyaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājākaronmanaḥ //
meaning:
सुमतिश्चापि तत्काले गर्भालाबमसूयत /
संप्रसूतं तु तं त्यक्तं दृष्ट्वा राजाकरोन्मनः //
text_mt: Sumati also, at that time, gave birth to a womb-gourd; / seeing what was born, the king made up his mind to discard it.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjñātvā bhagavānaurvastatrāgacchadyadṛcchayā /
samyak saṃbhāvito rājñā tamuvāca tvarānvitaḥ //
meaning:
तज्ज्ञात्वा भगवानौर्वस्तत्रागच्छद्यदृच्छया /
सम्यक् संभावितो राज्ञा तमुवाच त्वरान्वितः //
text_mt: Knowing that, the venerable Aurva arrived there as if by chance; / duly honoured by the king, he said to him in haste:

sanskrit_iast:
garbhālāburayaṃ rājanna tyaktuṃ bhavatārhati /
putrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrabījabhūto yatastava //
meaning:
गर्भालाबुरयं राजन्न त्यक्तुं भवतार्हति /
पुत्राणां षष्टिसाहस्रबीजभूतो यतस्तव //
text_mt: "O king, you ought not to abandon this womb-gourd, / because it is the seed of your sixty thousand sons.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttatsakalīkṛtya ghṛtakuṃbheṣu yatnataḥ /
niḥkṣipya sapidhāneṣu rakṣaṇīyaṃ pṛthakpṛthak //
meaning:
तस्मात्तत्सकलीकृत्य घृतकुंभेषु यत्नतः /
निःक्षिप्य सपिधानेषु रक्षणीयं पृथक्पृथक् //
text_mt: Therefore, having divided it into parts, placing them carefully / into jars of clarified butter with lids, each should be preserved separately.

sanskrit_iast:
samyagevaṃ kṛte rājanbhavato matprasādataḥ /
yathoktasaṃkhyā patrāṇāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
सम्यगेवं कृते राजन्भवतो मत्प्रसादतः /
यथोक्तसंख्या पत्राणां भविष्यति न संशयः //
text_mt: When this is done properly, O king, by my grace / the stated number of sons will come to be—there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kāle pūrṇe tataḥ kumbhānbhittvā niryānti te pṛthak /
evaṃ te ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ putrāṇāṃ jāyate nṛpa //
meaning:
काले पूर्णे ततः कुम्भान्भित्त्वा निर्यान्ति ते पृथक् /
एवं ते षष्टिसाहस्रं पुत्राणां जायते नृप //
text_mt: Then, when the time is complete, having broken the jars they will emerge separately; / thus, O king, sixty thousand sons will be born to you."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhagavānaurvastatraivāntaradhādvibhuḥ /
rājā ca tattathā cakre yathaurveṇa samīritam //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवानौर्वस्तत्रैवान्तरधाद्विभुः /
राजा च तत्तथा चक्रे यथौर्वेण समीरितम् //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, the venerable lord Aurva vanished right there; / and the king did precisely as had been stated by Aurva.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe ghṛtakuṃbhātkrameṇa te /
bhittvābhittvā punarjajñuḥ sahasaivānuvāsaram //
meaning:
ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे घृतकुंभात्क्रमेण ते /
भित्त्वाभित्त्वा पुनर्जज्ञुः सहसैवानुवासरम् //
text_mt: Then, when a full year had passed, from the jars of clarified butter, in due course, / having burst them, they were born day after day in rapid succession.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ krameṇa saṃjātāstanayāste mahīpate /
vavṛdhuḥ saṃghaśo rājanṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃkhyāyā //
meaning:
एवं क्रमेण संजातास्तनयास्ते महीपते /
ववृधुः संघशो राजन्षष्टिसाहस्रसंख्याया //
text_mt: Thus, in due course, those sons of the earth's lord were born; / they grew up in crowds, O king, to the number of sixty thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
apṛthagdharmacaraṇā mahābalaparākramāḥ /
babhūvuste durādharṣāḥ krūrātmāno viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अपृथग्धर्मचरणा महाबलपराक्रमाः /
बभूवुस्ते दुराधर्षाः क्रूरात्मानो विशेषतः //
text_mt: Not practicing separate duties, possessing great strength and prowess, / they became unassailable and particularly cruel by nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sa nātiprītimāṃsteṣu rājā matimatāṃ varaḥ /
keśinītanayaṃ tvekaṃ bahumāna sutaṃ priyam //
meaning:
स नातिप्रीतिमांस्तेषु राजा मतिमतां वरः /
केशिनीतनयं त्वेकं बहुमान सुतं प्रियम् //
text_mt: The king, the best among the wise, had no great fondness for them; / but he held in high esteem the one beloved son, the child of Keśinī.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhaṃ vidhivattasmai kārayāmāsa pārthivaḥ /
sacāpyānandayāmāsa svaguṇaiḥ suhṛdo 'khilān //
meaning:
विवाहं विधिवत्तस्मै कारयामास पार्थिवः /
सचाप्यानन्दयामास स्वगुणैः सुहृदो ऽखिलान् //
text_mt: The king had a marriage duly performed for him; / and he too delighted all his friends with his good qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravarta mānasya keśinītanayasya tu /
ajāyata sutaḥ śrīmānaṃśumāniti viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्त मानस्य केशिनीतनयस्य तु /
अजायत सुतः श्रीमानंशुमानिति विश्रुतः //
text_mt: To that son of Keśinī, who conducted himself thus, / was born a glorious son renowned as Aṃśumat.

sanskrit_iast:
sa bālya eva matimānudāraiḥ svaguṇairbhṛśam /
prīṇayāmāsa sutdṛdaḥ svapitāmahameva ca //
meaning:
स बाल्य एव मतिमानुदारैः स्वगुणैर्भृशम् /
प्रीणयामास सुत्दृदः स्वपितामहमेव च //
text_mt: Even in childhood, that wise boy greatly delighted his friends / and his own grandfather with his noble qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare rājñastasya putro 'samañjasaḥ /
āviṣṭo naṣṭaceṣṭo 'bhūtsa piśācena kena cit //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राज्ञस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽसमञ्जसः /
आविष्टो नष्टचेष्टो ऽभूत्स पिशाचेन केन चित् //
text_mt: In the meantime, that king's son, Asamañjasa, / became possessed by a certain piśāca and lost his self-control.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu kaścidabhūdvaiśyaḥ pūrvajanmani dharmavit /
kasyācidviṣaye rājñaḥ prabhūtadhanadhānyavān //
meaning:
स तु कश्चिदभूद्वैश्यः पूर्वजन्मनि धर्मवित् /
कस्याचिद्विषये राज्ञः प्रभूतधनधान्यवान् //
text_mt: In a previous birth, he had been a certain vaiśya who knew righteousness, / possessed of abundant wealth and grain, living in the territory of some king.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kadācidaraṇyeṣu vicarannidhimuttamam /
dṛṣṭvā grahītumārebhe vaṇiglobhavariplutaḥ //
meaning:
स कदाचिदरण्येषु विचरन्निधिमुत्तमम् /
दृष्ट्वा ग्रहीतुमारेभे वणिग्लोभवरिप्लुतः //
text_mt: Once, wandering in the forests, he saw an excellent treasure / and, overcome with greed, that merchant began to take it.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastadrakṣako 'bhyetya piśācaḥ prāha taṃ tadā /
kṣudhito 'haṃ cirādasminnivasannidhipālakaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तद्रक्षको ऽभ्येत्य पिशाचः प्राह तं तदा /
क्षुधितो ऽहं चिरादस्मिन्निवसन्निधिपालकः //
text_mt: Then its guardian, a piśāca, approached and said to him at that time: / 'I am hungry, dwelling here as the guardian of this treasure for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttatparihārāya mama dattvā gavāmiṣam /
kāmataḥ pratigṛhṇīṣva nidhimenaṃ mamājñayā //
meaning:
तस्मात्तत्परिहाराय मम दत्त्वा गवामिषम् /
कामतः प्रतिगृह्णीष्व निधिमेनं ममाज्ञया //
text_mt: Therefore, to dispel that [hunger], give me beef, / and freely take this treasure by my command.'

sanskrit_iast:
satasmai tatpariśrutya dāsyāmīti gavāmiṣam /
ādatta ca nidhiṃ taṃ tu piśācenānumoditaḥ //
meaning:
सतस्मै तत्परिश्रुत्य दास्यामीति गवामिषम् /
आदत्त च निधिं तं तु पिशाचेनानुमोदितः //
text_mt: Having promised him, 'I will give beef,' / he took that treasure, permitted by the piśāca.

sanskrit_iast:
na prādācca tato mauḍhyāttasmai yattatpratiśrutam /
pratiśrutāpradānottharoṣaṃ na śraddadhe nṛpa //
meaning:
न प्रादाच्च ततो मौढ्यात्तस्मै यत्तत्प्रतिश्रुतम् /
प्रतिश्रुताप्रदानोत्थरोषं न श्रद्दधे नृप //
text_mt: Then, out of foolishness, he did not give him what he had promised; / he did not heed the wrath that arose from not giving what was promised, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tamevaṃ suciraṃ kālaṃ pratīkṣyāśanakāṅkṣayā /
apanītadhanaḥ so 'pi mamāra vyathitaḥ kṣudhā //
meaning:
तमेवं सुचिरं कालं प्रतीक्ष्याशनकाङ्क्षया /
अपनीतधनः सो ऽपि ममार व्यथितः क्षुधा //
text_mt: Having waited for him thus for a very long time in desire for food, / deprived of his treasure, [the piśāca] too died, tormented by hunger.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyo 'pi bālo maraṇaṃ saṃprāpya sagarasya tu /
babhūva kāle keśinyāṃ tanayo 'nvayavarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
वैश्यो ऽपि बालो मरणं संप्राप्य सगरस्य तु /
बभूव काले केशिन्यां तनयो ऽन्वयवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: The vaiśya boy also died, / and in time became the son of Sagara by Keśinī, increaser of the lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
aśarīraḥ piśāce 'pi pūrvavairamanusmaran /
vāyubhūto 'viśaddehaṃ rājaputrasya bhūpate //
meaning:
अशरीरः पिशाचे ऽपि पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् /
वायुभूतो ऽविशद्देहं राजपुत्रस्य भूपते //
text_mt: Even though bodiless, the piśāca, remembering the ancient enmity, / entered the body of the prince as wind, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāviṣṭastataḥ so 'pi krūracitto 'bhavattadā /
mativibhraṃśamāsādya muhustena balātkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
तेनाविष्टस्ततः सो ऽपि क्रूरचित्तो ऽभवत्तदा /
मतिविभ्रंशमासाद्य मुहुस्तेन बलात्कृतः //
text_mt: Possessed by him, he then became cruel-minded; / falling into delusion of mind, he was constantly overpowered by him.

sanskrit_iast:
asamañjasatvaṃ nagare cakre so 'pi nṛśaṃsavat /
bālāṃśca yūnaḥ sthavirānyoṣitaśca sadā khalaḥ //
meaning:
असमञ्जसत्वं नगरे चक्रे सो ऽपि नृशंसवत् /
बालांश्च यूनः स्थविरान्योषितश्च सदा खलः //
text_mt: He caused impropriety in the city like a villain; / the wicked one constantly [seized] boys, young men, old men, and women,

sanskrit_iast:
hatvāhatvā pracikṣepa sarayvāmatinirdayaḥ /
tataḥ paurajanāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tasya kadaryatām //
meaning:
हत्वाहत्वा प्रचिक्षेप सरय्वामतिनिर्दयः /
ततः पौरजनाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तस्य कदर्यताम् //
text_mt: and repeatedly striking them, he ruthlessly hurled them into the Sarayū. / Then all the citizens, having seen his vile conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
bahuśo nikṛtāstena gatvā rājñe vyajijñāpan /
rājā ca tadupaśrutya tamāhūya prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
बहुशो निकृतास्तेन गत्वा राज्ञे व्यजिज्ञापन् /
राजा च तदुपश्रुत्य तमाहूय प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: and having been mistreated by him many times, went and reported [it] to the king. / And the king, having heard of that, summoned him with diligence

sanskrit_iast:
vārayāmāsa bahudhā duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ /
bahuśaḥ pratiṣiddho 'pi pitrā tena mahātmanā //
meaning:
वारयामास बहुधा दुःखेन महतान्वितः /
बहुशः प्रतिषिद्धो ऽपि पित्रा तेन महात्मना //
text_mt: and restrained him in many ways, overcome with great sorrow. / Although repeatedly forbidden by that high-souled father,

sanskrit_iast:
jale tapte ca saṃtaptāḥ saṃbabhūvuryathā yavāḥ /
nāśakattaṃ yadā pāpādvinivarttayituṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
जले तप्ते च संतप्ताः संबभूवुर्यथा यवाः /
नाशकत्तं यदा पापाद्विनिवर्त्तयितुं नृपः //
text_mt: just as barley grains roasted in hot water become [parched], / when the king was unable to turn him back from evil,

sanskrit_iast:
lokāpavādabhīrutvādviṣayānatyajattadā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaracarite 'samañjasatyāgo nāmaikapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 51//
meaning:
लोकापवादभीरुत्वाद्विषयानत्यजत्तदा //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरचरिते ऽसमञ्जसत्यागो नामैकपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 51//
text_mt:
he then banished him from his territories out of fear of public reproach.

Thus ends the fifty-first chapter, named 'The Banishing of Asamañjasa,' in the story of Sagara, in the third [part], the Upoddhātapāda, in the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa, spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
tyaktvā putraṃ sa dharmātmā sagaraḥ prema tadgatam /
dharmaśīle tadā vāle cakārāṃśumati prabhuḥ //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
त्यक्त्वा पुत्रं स धर्मात्मा सगरः प्रेम तद्गतम् /
धर्मशीले तदा वाले चकारांशुमति प्रभुः //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Having cast out his son, the righteous lord Sagara / directed that love toward the boy Aṃśumān, who was devoted to righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu sumatyāstanayā nṛpa /
vavṛdhuḥ saghaśaḥ sarve parasparamanuvratāḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सुमत्यास्तनया नृप /
ववृधुः सघशः सर्वे परस्परमनुव्रताः //
text_mt: At that very time, O king, the sons of Sumatī / all grew up in crowds, devoted to one another.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrasaṃhananāḥ krūrā nirdayā nirapatrapāḥ /
adharmaśīlā nitarāmekagharmāṇa eva ca //
meaning:
वज्रसंहननाः क्रूरा निर्दया निरपत्रपाः /
अधर्मशीला नितरामेकघर्माण एव च //
text_mt: They had bodies like adamantine bolts; they were cruel, ruthless, shameless, / exceedingly unrighteous, and of a single disposition.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakāryābhiniratāḥ krodhanā mūḍhacetasaḥ /
adhṛṣyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ janopadravakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
एककार्याभिनिरताः क्रोधना मूढचेतसः /
अधृष्याः सर्वभूतानां जनोपद्रवकारिणः //
text_mt: United in a single purpose, wrathful, dull-witted, / invincible to all beings, they caused distress to the people.

sanskrit_iast:
vinayācā rasanmārganirapekṣāḥ samantataḥ /
babādhire jagatsarvamasurā iva kāmataḥ //
meaning:
विनयाचा रसन्मार्गनिरपेक्षाः समन्ततः /
बबाधिरे जगत्सर्वमसुरा इव कामतः //
text_mt: Disregarding discipline, proper conduct, and the good path on every side, / they harassed the entire world at their will, like asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhvastayajñasanmārgaṃ bhuvanaṃ tairupadrutam /
niḥsvādhyāya vaṣaṭkāraṃ babhūvārtaṃ viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
विध्वस्तयज्ञसन्मार्गं भुवनं तैरुपद्रुतम् /
निःस्वाध्याय वषट्कारं बभूवार्तं विशेषतः //
text_mt: The world was afflicted by them, its sacrifices and good paths destroyed; / lacking private Vedic recitation and the vaṣaṭ-call, it was especially distressed.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhvasyamāne subhṛśaṃ sāgarairvaradarpitaiḥ /
prakṣobhaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāsuramahoragāḥ //
meaning:
विध्वस्यमाने सुभृशं सागरैर्वरदर्पितैः /
प्रक्षोभं परमं जग्मुर्देवासुरमहोरगाः //
text_mt: As it was being violently devastated by the sons of Sagara haughty with boons, / the gods, asuras, and great serpents fell into the greatest agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
dharāsā sāgarākrāntā na calāpi tadā calā /
tapaḥ samādhibhaṅgaśca prababhūva tapasvinām //
meaning:
धरासा सागराक्रान्ता न चलापि तदा चला /
तपः समाधिभङ्गश्च प्रबभूव तपस्विनाम् //
text_mt: The earth, overwhelmed by the sons of Sagara, became shaken though previously immovable; / and the break of ascetic practice and contemplation occurred for the ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
havyakavyaparibhraṣṭāstridaśāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha /
duḥśena mahātāviṣṭā viriñjabhavanaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
हव्यकव्यपरिभ्रष्टास्त्रिदशाः पितृभिः सह /
दुःशेन महाताविष्टा विरिञ्जभवनं ययुः //
text_mt: Deprived of offerings to the gods and ancestors, the thirty [gods], along with the ancestors, / overcome with great sorrow, went to the abode of Viriñci.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā yathānyāyaṃ devāḥ śarvapurogamāḥ /
śaśaṃsuḥ sakalaṃ tasmai sāgarāṇāṃ viceṣṭitam //
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा यथान्यायं देवाः शर्वपुरोगमाः /
शशंसुः सकलं तस्मै सागराणां विचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Having gone there according to custom, the gods, with Śarva at their head, / related all the conduct of the sons of Sagara to him.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchratvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
kṣaṇamantarmanā bhūtvā jagāda surasattamaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रत्वा वचनं तेषां ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
क्षणमन्तर्मना भूत्वा जगाद सुरसत्तमः //
text_mt: Having heard their words, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / became introspective for a moment and said to the best of the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
devāḥśṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo vāṇīmavahitā mama /
vinaṅkṣyantyaciremaiva sāgarā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
देवाःशृणुत भद्रं वो वाणीमवहिता मम /
विनङ्क्ष्यन्त्यचिरेमैव सागरा नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: 'Hear, O gods, may you have good fortune, my words attentively! / In no long time the sons of Sagara will perish; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tena sarvaṃ niyamyate /
nimittamātramanyattu sa eva sakaleśitā //
meaning:
कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं तेन सर्वं नियम्यते /
निमित्तमात्रमन्यत्तु स एव सकलेशिता //
text_mt: Wait for a certain time; everything is restrained by Time. / Everything else is merely an instrumental cause; he alone is the master of all.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyuṣmaddhitārthāya yadvakṣyāmi surottamāḥ /
sarvairbhavadbhiradhunā tatkarttavyamataṃ dritaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्युष्मद्धितार्थाय यद्वक्ष्यामि सुरोत्तमाः /
सर्वैर्भवद्भिरधुना तत्कर्त्तव्यमतं द्रितैः //
text_mt: Therefore, for your welfare, what I shall tell you, O best of gods, / that must now be done by all of you without delay.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoraṃśena bhagavānkapilo jayatāṃ varaḥ /
jāto jagaddhitārthāya yogīndrapravaro bhuvi //
meaning:
विष्णोरंशेन भगवान्कपिलो जयतां वरः /
जातो जगद्धितार्थाय योगीन्द्रप्रवरो भुवि //
text_mt: Through a portion of Viṣṇu, the blessed Kapila, best of the victorious, / foremost among lords of yogins, has been born on earth for the welfare of the world.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyapītasalile divyavarṣaśatāvadhi /
dhyāyannāste 'dhunāṃ'bhodhāvekānte tatra kutra cit //
meaning:
अगस्त्यपीतसलिले दिव्यवर्षशतावधि /
ध्यायन्नास्ते ऽधुनांऽभोधावेकान्ते तत्र कुत्र चित् //
text_mt: In the ocean whose waters were drunk by Agastya, for the duration of a hundred divine years, / he now sits meditating in solitude somewhere therein.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā yūyaṃ mamādeśātkapilaṃ munipuṅgavam /
dhyānāva sānamicchantastiṣṭhadhvaṃ tadupahvare //
meaning:
गत्वा यूयं ममादेशात्कपिलं मुनिपुङ्गवम् /
ध्यानाव सानमिच्छन्तस्तिष्ठध्वं तदुपह्वरे //
text_mt: Having gone by my command, wait near that bull among sages, / Kapila, awaiting the end of his meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
samādhiviratau tasya svābhiprāyamaśeṣataḥ /
natvā tasmai vadiṣyadhvaṃ sa vaḥ śreyo vidhāsyati //
meaning:
समाधिविरतौ तस्य स्वाभिप्रायमशेषतः /
नत्वा तस्मै वदिष्यध्वं स वः श्रेयो विधास्यति //
text_mt: Upon the cessation of his absorption, having bowed to him, / you shall tell him your intention in full; he will bring about your welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
samādhibhaṅgaśca muneryathā syātsāgaraiḥ kṛtaḥ /
kurudhvaṃ ca tathā yūyaṃ pravṛttiṃ vibudhottamāḥ //
meaning:
समाधिभङ्गश्च मुनेर्यथा स्यात्सागरैः कृतः /
कुरुध्वं च तथा यूयं प्रवृत्तिं विबुधोत्तमाः //
text_mt: And make such an effort, O best of gods, / that the sage's contemplation is disrupted by the sons of Sagara.'

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
ityuktāstena vibudhāstaṃ praṇamya vitāmaham /
gatvā taṃ vibudhaśreṣṭaṃ te kṛtāñjalayo 'bruvan //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
इत्युक्तास्तेन विबुधास्तं प्रणम्य वितामहम् /
गत्वा तं विबुधश्रेष्टं ते कृताञ्जलयो ऽब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by him, the gods bowed to that grandfather, / went to that foremost of sages, and with joined palms said:

sanskrit_iast:
devā ūcuḥ
prasīda no muniśreṣṭha vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ /
upadrutaṃ jagatsarvaṃsāgaraiḥ saṃpraṇaśyati //
meaning:
देवा ऊचुः
प्रसीद नो मुनिश्रेष्ठ वयं त्वां शरणं गताः /
उपद्रुतं जगत्सर्वंसागरैः संप्रणश्यति //
text_mt: The gods said: / 'Be pleased with us, O best of sages! We have taken refuge in you. / The entire world, harassed by the sons of Sagara, is perishing.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ kilākhilalokānāṃ sthitisahārakāraṇaḥ /
viṣṇoraṃśena yogīndrasvarūpī bhuvi saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
त्वं किलाखिललोकानां स्थितिसहारकारणः /
विष्णोरंशेन योगीन्द्रस्वरूपी भुवि संस्थितः //
text_mt: You indeed are the cause of preservation and destruction of all the worlds; / you abide on earth as a portion of Viṣṇu in the form of a lord of yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsāṃ tāpatrayārttānāmārtināśāya kevalam /
svecchayā te dhṛto deho na tu tvaṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
पुंसां तापत्रयार्त्तानामार्तिनाशाय केवलम् /
स्वेच्छया ते धृतो देहो न तु त्वं तपतां वरः //
text_mt: A body was assumed by you of your own will solely to destroy the distress / of men afflicted by the threefold suffering; you are indeed the foremost of ascetics.

sanskrit_iast:
manasaiva jagatsarvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumeva ca /
vidhātuṃ svecchayā brahmanbhavāñchakrotyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
मनसैव जगत्सर्वं स्रष्टुं संहर्तुमेव च /
विधातुं स्वेच्छया ब्रह्मन्भवाञ्छक्रोत्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: With your mind alone, O Brahman, you are without doubt able / to create, destroy, and arrange the entire world according to your will.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṃ no dhātā vidhātā ca tvaṃ gurustvaṃ parāyaṇam /
paritrātā tvamasmākaṃ vinivarttaya cāpadam //
meaning:
त्वं नो धाता विधाता च त्वं गुरुस्त्वं परायणम् /
परित्राता त्वमस्माकं विनिवर्त्तय चापदम् //
text_mt: You are our creator and ordainer; you are our teacher; you are our supreme refuge; / you are our protector; please avert this misfortune.

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇaṃ bhava viprendra vipredrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
sāgarairdahyamānānāṃ lokatrayanivāsinām //
meaning:
शरणं भव विप्रेन्द्र विप्रेद्राणां विशेषतः /
सागरैर्दह्यमानानां लोकत्रयनिवासिनाम् //
text_mt: Be a refuge, O best of brāhmaṇas, especially for the foremost brāhmaṇas / and the inhabitants of the three worlds who are scorched by the sons of Sagara.

sanskrit_iast:
nanu vai sāttvikī ceṣṭā bhavatīha bhavādṛśām /
trātumarhasi tasmāttvaṃ lokānasmāṃśca suvrata //
meaning:
ननु वै सात्त्विकी चेष्टा भवतीह भवादृशाम् /
त्रातुमर्हसि तस्मात्त्वं लोकानस्मांश्च सुव्रत //
text_mt: Indeed, for beings like you, conduct here is consisting of sattva. / Therefore, O you of noble vows, you ought to protect the worlds and us.

sanskrit_iast:
na cedakāle bhagavanvinaṅkṣyatyakhilaṃ jagat /
jaiminiruvāca
ityuktaḥ sakalairdevairunmīlya nayane śanaiḥ //
meaning:
न चेदकाले भगवन्विनङ्क्ष्यत्यखिलं जगत् /
जैमिनिरुवाच
इत्युक्तः सकलैर्देवैरुन्मील्य नयने शनैः //
text_mt: If not, the entire world will perish before its time, O blessed one!' / Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by all the gods, slowly opening his eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya tānuvācedaṃ kapilaḥ sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ /
svakarmaṇaiva nirdagdhāḥ pravinaṅkṣyanti sāgarāḥ //
meaning:
विलोक्य तानुवाचेदं कपिलः सूनृतं वचः /
स्वकर्मणैव निर्दग्धाः प्रविनङ्क्ष्यन्ति सागराः //
text_mt: Kapila looked at them and spoke this true and pleasant word: / 'Scorched by their own actions, the sons of Sagara will surely perish.'

sanskrit_iast:
kāle prāpte tu yuṣmābhiḥ satāvatparipālyatām /
ahaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ vināśāya durātmanām //
meaning:
काले प्राप्ते तु युष्माभिः सतावत्परिपाल्यताम् /
अहं तु कारणं तेषां विनाशाय दुरात्मनाम् //
text_mt: “When the right time arrives, you should just wait patiently. / I myself will be the cause for the destruction of those wicked ones.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyāmi suraśreṣṭhā bhavatāmarthasiddhaye /
mama krodhāgni vipluṣṭāḥ sāgarāḥ pāpacetasaḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यामि सुरश्रेष्ठा भवतामर्थसिद्धये /
मम क्रोधाग्नि विप्लुष्टाः सागराः पापचेतसः //
text_mt: O best of gods, I shall bring about the accomplishment of your aim. / Scorched by the fire of my anger, the sons of Sagara of evil intent,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyantu cireṇaiva kālopahatabuddhayaḥ /
tasmādgatajvarā devā lokāścaivākutobhayāḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यन्तु चिरेणैव कालोपहतबुद्धयः /
तस्माद्गतज्वरा देवा लोकाश्चैवाकुतोभयाः //
text_mt: their minds ruined by Time, will before long meet their end. / Therefore let the gods be freed from anxiety, and let the worlds be free from danger on every side!

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantu te durācārāḥ kṣipraṃ yāsyanti saṃkṣayam /
tadyūyaṃ nirbhayā bhūtvā vrajadhvaṃ svāṃ purīṃ prati //
meaning:
भवन्तु ते दुराचाराः क्षिप्रं यास्यन्ति संक्षयम् /
तद्यूयं निर्भया भूत्वा व्रजध्वं स्वां पुरीं प्रति //
text_mt: Let those of evil conduct quickly perish! / Therefore, becoming fearless, depart to your own city.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaṃ kañcitpratīkṣadhvaṃ tato 'bhīṣṭamavāpsyatha /
kapilenaivamuktāste devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ //
meaning:
कालं कञ्चित्प्रतीक्षध्वं ततो ऽभीष्टमवाप्स्यथ /
कपिलेनैवमुक्तास्ते देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः //
text_mt: Wait for a short time; then you will obtain what you desire.” / Addressed thus by Kapila, all those gods, together with Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ praṇamya tato jagmuḥ pratītāgnidivaṃ prati /
etasminnantare rājā sagaraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ //
meaning:
तं प्रणम्य ततो जग्मुः प्रतीताग्निदिवं प्रति /
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा सगरः पृथिवीपतिः //
text_mt: bowed down to him and then departed satisfied toward heaven. / In the meantime, King Sagara, the lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
vājimedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kartuṃ cakre manoratham /
āhṛtya sarvasaṃbhārānvasiṣṭhānumate tadā //
meaning:
वाजिमेधं महायज्ञं कर्तुं चक्रे मनोरथम् /
आहृत्य सर्वसंभारान्वसिष्ठानुमते तदा //
text_mt: formed the desire to perform the great sacrifice, the horse sacrifice. / Having gathered all the sacrificial materials with Vasiṣṭha’s approval,

sanskrit_iast:
aurvādyaiḥ sahito viprairyathāvaddīkṣito 'bhavat /
dīkṣāṃ praviṣṭo nṛpatirhayasaṃcāraṇāya vai //
meaning:
और्वाद्यैः सहितो विप्रैर्यथावद्दीक्षितो ऽभवत् /
दीक्षां प्रविष्टो नृपतिर्हयसंचारणाय वै //
text_mt: he was duly consecrated together with Aurva and the other Brahmins. / Having entered upon the consecration, the king, for the wandering of the horse,

sanskrit_iast:
putrānsarvānsamāhūya saṃdideśa mahayaśāḥ /
saṃcārayitvā turagaṃ parītya pṛthivītale //
meaning:
पुत्रान्सर्वान्समाहूय संदिदेश महयशाः /
संचारयित्वा तुरगं परीत्य पृथिवीतले //
text_mt: summoned all his sons and instructed them, he of great renown: / “Having let the horse roam about, going around the surface of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipraṃ mamāntikaṃ putrāḥ punarāhartumarhatha /
jaiminiruvāca
tataste piturādeśāttamādāya turaṅgamam //
meaning:
क्षिप्रं ममान्तिकं पुत्राः पुनराहर्तुमर्हथ /
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततस्ते पितुरादेशात्तमादाय तुरङ्गमम् //
text_mt: O sons, you must bring it back quickly to my presence.” / Jaimini said: / Then, by their father’s command, taking that horse,

sanskrit_iast:
paricaṅkramayāmāsuḥ sakale kṣitimaṇḍale /
vidhicodanayaivāśvaḥ sa bhūmau parivartitataḥ //
meaning:
परिचङ्क्रमयामासुः सकले क्षितिमण्डले /
विधिचोदनयैवाश्वः स भूमौ परिवर्तिततः //
text_mt: they led it roaming over the entire circle of the earth. / The horse was made to wander over the earth solely by injunction of ritual ordinance,

sanskrit_iast:
na tu digvijayārthāya karādānārthameva ca /
pṛthivībhūbhujā tena pūrvameva vinirjitā //
meaning:
न तु दिग्विजयार्थाय करादानार्थमेव च /
पृथिवीभूभुजा तेन पूर्वमेव विनिर्जिता //
text_mt: not for the purpose of conquering the quarters or exacting tribute; / for the earth had already been conquered beforehand by that monarch,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpāścodāravīryeṇa karadāḥ samare kṛtāḥ /
tataste rājatanayā nistoye lavaṇāṃbudhau //
meaning:
नृपाश्चोदारवीर्येण करदाः समरे कृताः /
ततस्ते राजतनया निस्तोये लवणांबुधौ //
text_mt: and kings had been made tribute-payers in battle through his noble valor. / Then those princes, at the salt ocean deprived of its water,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtale viviśurhṛṣṭāḥ parivārya turaṅgamam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya uvoddhātapāde sagaravarite 'śvamocanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 52//
meaning:
भूतले विविशुर्हृष्टाः परिवार्य तुरङ्गमम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उवोद्धातपादे सगरवरिते ऽश्वमोचनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 52//
text_mt:
entered the ground, delighted, surrounding the horse.

Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, entitled “The Release of the Horse” in the story of Sagara, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle part, in the great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
teṣu tatra niviṣṭeṣu vāsavena pracoditaḥ /
jahāraṃ turagaṃ vāyustatkṣaṇena rasātalam //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
तेषु तत्र निविष्टेषु वासवेन प्रचोदितः /
जहारं तुरगं वायुस्तत्क्षणेन रसातलम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / When they had entered there, the wind, impelled by Indra, / seized the horse in an instant and carried it down to the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭamaśvaṃ taiḥ sarvairapahṛtya sadāgatiḥ /
anayattatpathā rājankapilasyāntikaṃ muneḥ //
meaning:
अदृष्टमश्वं तैः सर्वैरपहृत्य सदागतिः /
अनयत्तत्पथा राजन्कपिलस्यान्तिकं मुनेः //
text_mt: Stealing the horse unseen by all of them, the wind / led it along that path, O king, to the vicinity of the sage Kapila.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samākulāḥ sarve vinaṣṭe 'śve nṛpātmajāḥ /
parītya vasudhāṃ sarvāṃ pramārgantasturagamam //
meaning:
ततः समाकुलाः सर्वे विनष्टे ऽश्वे नृपात्मजाः /
परीत्य वसुधां सर्वां प्रमार्गन्तस्तुरगमम् //
text_mt: Then, thrown into confusion when the horse was lost, all the sons of the king / wandered around the whole earth, searching for the horse.

sanskrit_iast:
vicitya pṛthivīṃ te tu sa purācalakānanām /
apaśyanto yajñapaśuṃ duḥkhaṃ mahadavāpnuvan //
meaning:
विचित्य पृथिवीं ते तु स पुराचलकाननाम् /
अपश्यन्तो यज्ञपशुं दुःखं महदवाप्नुवन् //
text_mt: Searching the earth with its cities, mountains, and forests, / not seeing the sacrificial animal, they suffered great distress.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'yodhyāṃ samāsādya ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritām /
dṛṣṭvā praṇamya pitaraṃ tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayan //
meaning:
ततो ऽयोध्यां समासाद्य ऋषिभिः परिवारिताम् /
दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य पितरं तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् //
text_mt: Then, arriving at Ayodhyā, surrounded by sages, / having seen and bowed down to their father, they reported everything to him:

sanskrit_iast:
parītya pṛthvīmasmābhirniviṣṭe varuṇālaye /
rakṣyamāṇo 'pi paśyadbhiḥ kenāpi turago hṛtaḥ //
meaning:
परीत्य पृथ्वीमस्माभिर्निविष्टे वरुणालये /
रक्ष्यमाणो ऽपि पश्यद्भिः केनापि तुरगो हृतः //
text_mt: “Having traversed the earth, when we entered the abode of Varuṇa, / even though guarded by us while watching, the horse was stolen by someone.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktastai ruṣāviṣṭastānuvāca nṛpottamaḥ /
prayāsyadhvamadharmiṣṭhāḥ sarve 'nāvṛttaye punaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तस्तै रुषाविष्टस्तानुवाच नृपोत्तमः /
प्रयास्यध्वमधर्मिष्ठाः सर्वे ऽनावृत्तये पुनः //
text_mt: Addressed thus by them, the best of kings, overcome with fury, said to them: / “Go forth, you unrighteous ones, all of you, never to return again!

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ bhavadbhirjīvadbhirvinaṣṭo vai darātmabhiḥ /
turageṇa vinā satyaṃ nehāga manamasti vaḥ //
meaning:
कथं भवद्भिर्जीवद्भिर्विनष्टो वै दरात्मभिः /
तुरगेण विना सत्यं नेहाग मनमस्ति वः //
text_mt: How was it lost while you, evil-minded ones, were alive? / Truly, without the horse there is no coming back here for you!”

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sametya tasmātte saprayātāḥ parasparam /
ūcurna dṛśyate 'dyāpi turagaḥ kiṃ prakumaha //
meaning:
ततः समेत्य तस्मात्ते सप्रयाताः परस्परम् /
ऊचुर्न दृश्यते ऽद्यापि तुरगः किं प्रकुमह //
text_mt: Then assembling together, having set out from there, they said to one another: / “The horse is still not seen; what shall we do?

sanskrit_iast:
vasudhā vicitāsmābhiḥ saśailavanakānanā /
na cāpi dṛśyate vājī tadvārttāpi na kutracit //
meaning:
वसुधा विचितास्माभिः सशैलवनकानना /
न चापि दृश्यते वाजी तद्वार्त्तापि न कुत्रचित् //
text_mt: The earth has been searched by us, with its mountains, woods, and forests, / and the horse is not seen, nor is there any news of it anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādabdheḥ samārabhya pātālāvadhi medinīm /
vibhajya ravātvā pātālaṃ viviśāma turaṅgamam //
meaning:
तस्मादब्धेः समारभ्य पातालावधि मेदिनीम् /
विभज्य रवात्वा पातालं विविशाम तुरङ्गमम् //
text_mt: Therefore, starting from the ocean down to the netherworld, dividing the earth / and digging down to the netherworld, let us enter after the horse.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti kṛtvā matiṃ sarve sāgarāḥ krūraniścayāḥ /
nicakhnurbhūmimaṃbodhestaṭā dārabhya sarvataḥ //
meaning:
इति कृत्वा मतिं सर्वे सागराः क्रूरनिश्चयाः /
निचख्नुर्भूमिमंबोधेस्तटा दारभ्य सर्वतः //
text_mt: Having made this resolve, all the sons of Sagara, cruel in their determination, / dug the earth on all sides, beginning from the shore of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
taiḥ khanyamānā vasudhā rarāsa bhṛśavihvalā /
cukruśuścāpi bhūtāni dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ viceṣṭitam //
meaning:
तैः खन्यमाना वसुधा ररास भृशविह्वला /
चुक्रुशुश्चापि भूतानि दृष्ट्वा तेषां विचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Dug up by them, the earth cried out in severe distress, / and living beings also shrieked upon seeing their actions.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste bhārataṃ khaṇḍaṃ khātvā saṃkṣibya bhūtale /
bhūmeryojanasāhasraṃ yojayāmāsuraṃbudhau //
meaning:
ततस्ते भारतं खण्डं खात्वा संक्षिब्य भूतले /
भूमेर्योजनसाहस्रं योजयामासुरंबुधौ //
text_mt: Then, having dug through the realm of Bhārata and casting [the earth] down, / they added a thousand yojanas of earth into the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
āpātālatalaṃ te tu khananto medinītalam /
carantamaśvaṃ pātāle dadṛśurnṛpanandanāḥ //
meaning:
आपातालतलं ते तु खनन्तो मेदिनीतलम् /
चरन्तमश्वं पाताले ददृशुर्नृपनन्दनाः //
text_mt: Digging the surface of the earth down to the floor of the netherworld, / the king's sons saw the horse wandering in the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprahṛṣṭāstataḥ sarve sametya ca samantataḥ /
saṃtoṣājjahasuḥ kecinnanṛtuśca mudānvitāḥ //
meaning:
संप्रहृष्टास्ततः सर्वे समेत्य च समन्ततः /
संतोषाज्जहसुः केचिन्ननृतुश्च मुदान्विताः //
text_mt: Overjoyed then, all gathering together from all sides, / some laughed with satisfaction, and others danced filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśuśca mahātmānaṃ kapilaṃ dīptatejasam /
vṛddhaṃ padmāsanāsīnaṃ nāsāgranyastalocanam //
meaning:
ददृशुश्च महात्मानं कपिलं दीप्ततेजसम् /
वृद्धं पद्मासनासीनं नासाग्रन्यस्तलोचनम् //
text_mt: And they saw the great-souled Kapila of blazing brilliance, / aged, seated in the lotus posture, his gaze fixed on the tip of his nose,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛjvāyataśirogrīvaṃ puroviṣṭabdhavakṣasam /
svatejasābhisaratā paribūrṇena sarvataḥ //
meaning:
ऋज्वायतशिरोग्रीवं पुरोविष्टब्धवक्षसम् /
स्वतेजसाभिसरता परिबूर्णेन सर्वतः //
text_mt: his head and neck straight and upright, his chest projected forward, / surrounded on all sides by his own overflowing radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśyamānaṃ parito nivātasthapradīpavat /
svāntaprakāśitāśeṣavijñānamayavigraham //
meaning:
प्रकाश्यमानं परितो निवातस्थप्रदीपवत् /
स्वान्तप्रकाशिताशेषविज्ञानमयविग्रहम् //
text_mt: illuminating all around like a lamp standing in a windless place, / his form consisting entirely of consciousness made manifest within himself,

sanskrit_iast:
samādhigatacittantu nibhṛtāṃbhodhisannibham /
ārūḍhayogaṃ vidhivaddhyeyasaṃlīnamānasam //
meaning:
समाधिगतचित्तन्तु निभृतांभोधिसन्निभम् /
आरूढयोगं विधिवद्ध्येयसंलीनमानसम् //
text_mt: his mind absorbed in meditative trance, resembling a tranquil ocean, / having ascended to yoga according to rule, his mind dissolved in the object of meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
cdṛdadyatdadvaḍḍha dyadṛ ḍaddhaṭhṭhaṇthrṭhṭhadaḍḍaṭhṭha-thrṭhṭhaḍḍaṇnrṭhṭhaḍaṇṭhṭhagṭhṭha
yogīndrapravaraṃ śāntaṃ jvālāmāla mivānalam /
vilokya tatra tiṣṭhantaṃ vimṛśantaḥ parasparam //
meaning:
च्दृदद्यत्दद्वड्ढ द्यदृ डद्धठ्ठण्थ्र्ठ्ठदड्डठ्ठ-थ्र्ठ्ठड्डण्न्र्ठ्ठडण्ठ्ठग्ठ्ठ
योगीन्द्रप्रवरं शान्तं ज्वालामाल मिवानलम् /
विलोक्य तत्र तिष्ठन्तं विमृशन्तः परस्परम् //
text_mt: […] / the foremost of the lords of yogins, tranquil, like a fire with a wreath of flames; / seeing him standing there, deliberating with one another,

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrttamiva te rājansādhvasaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ /
tato 'yamaśvahartteti sāgarā kālacoditāḥ //
meaning:
मुहूर्त्तमिव ते राजन्साध्वसं परमं गताः /
ततो ऽयमश्वहर्त्तेति सागरा कालचोदिताः //
text_mt: for a moment, O king, they were overcome with great fear. / Then, impelled by Time, the sons of Sagara, thinking, “This is the thief of the horse,”

sanskrit_iast:
parivavrurdurātmānaḥ kapilaṃ munisattamam /
tatastaṃ parivāryocuśvoro 'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
परिवव्रुर्दुरात्मानः कपिलं मुनिसत्तमम् /
ततस्तं परिवार्योचुश्वोरो ऽयं नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: those wicked-minded ones surrounded Kapila, the best of sages. / Then, surrounding him, they said: “This is the thief, there is no doubt about it!

sanskrit_iast:
aśvaharttā tato 'hyeṣa vadhyo 'smābhirdurāśayaḥ /
taṃ prākṛtavadāsīnaṃ te sarve hatavuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
अश्वहर्त्ता ततो ऽह्येष वध्यो ऽस्माभिर्दुराशयः /
तं प्राकृतवदासीनं ते सर्वे हतवुद्धयः //
text_mt: Therefore this horse-thief of evil intention is to be killed by us!” / To him seated like an ordinary man, all those of ruined intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
āsannamaraṇāścakrurdharṣitaṃ munimañjasā /
jaiminiruvāca
tato muniradīnātmā dhyānabhaṅgapradharṣitaḥ //
meaning:
आसन्नमरणाश्चक्रुर्धर्षितं मुनिमञ्जसा /
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततो मुनिरदीनात्मा ध्यानभङ्गप्रधर्षितः //
text_mt: with death approaching them, immediately offered violence to the sage. / Jaimini said: / Then the sage of unvanquished spirit, assaulted by the interruption of his meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhena mahatā'viṣṭaścukṣubhe kapilastadā /
pracacāla durādharṣo dharṣitastair durātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
क्रोधेन महताऽविष्टश्चुक्षुभे कपिलस्तदा /
प्रचचाल दुराधर्षो धर्षितस्तैर् दुरात्मभिः //
text_mt: overcome with great anger, Kapila was then stirred up; / difficult to assail, he was roused upon being assaulted by those wicked ones,

sanskrit_iast:
vyajṛṃbhata ca kalpānte marudbhiriva cānalaḥ /
tasya cārṇavagaṃbhīrādvapuṣaḥ kopapāvakaḥ //
meaning:
व्यजृंभत च कल्पान्ते मरुद्भिरिव चानलः /
तस्य चार्णवगंभीराद्वपुषः कोपपावकः //
text_mt: and flamed up like fire with the winds at the end of an eon. / And from his body, deep as the ocean, the fire of wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
didhakṣuriva pātālāṃllokānsāṃkarṣaṇo 'nalaḥ /
śuśubhe dharṣaṇakrodhaparāmarśavidīpitaḥ //
meaning:
दिधक्षुरिव पातालांल्लोकान्सांकर्षणो ऽनलः /
शुशुभे धर्षणक्रोधपरामर्शविदीपितः //
text_mt: blazed forth, kindled by the touch of anger at the assault, / as if the fire of Saṃkarṣaṇa wishing to consume the worlds and the netherworlds.

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlayattadā netre vahnicakrasamadyutiḥ /
tadākṣiṇī kṣaṇaṃ rājanrājetāṃ subhṛśāruṇe //
meaning:
उन्मीलयत्तदा नेत्रे वह्निचक्रसमद्युतिः /
तदाक्षिणी क्षणं राजन्राजेतां सुभृशारुणे //
text_mt: He opened his two eyes, having the radiance of a wheel of fire; / then his eyes shone exceedingly red for a moment, O king,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasaṃvyāsamuditau puṣpavantāvivāṃbare /
tato 'pyudvarttamānābhyāṃ netrābhyāṃ nṛpanandanān //
meaning:
पूर्वसंव्यासमुदितौ पुष्पवन्ताविवांबरे /
ततो ऽप्युद्वर्त्तमानाभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां नृपनन्दनान् //
text_mt: like the sun and the moon risen in the sky at the dawn of day. / Then with his rolling eyes, deep [with wrath], he looked upon the princes

sanskrit_iast:
avaikṣata ca gaṃbhīraḥ kṛtāntaḥ kālaparyaye /
kruddhasya tasyanetrābhyāṃ sahasā pāvakārciṣaḥ //
meaning:
अवैक्षत च गंभीरः कृतान्तः कालपर्यये /
क्रुद्धस्य तस्यनेत्राभ्यां सहसा पावकार्चिषः //
text_mt: like Death at the end of Time. / From the eyes of the enraged one, flames of fire suddenly

sanskrit_iast:
niścerurabhilodikṣu kālāgneriva saṃtatāḥ /
sadhūmakavalodagrāḥ sphuliṅgaughamuco muhuḥ //
meaning:
निश्चेरुरभिलोदिक्षु कालाग्नेरिव संतताः /
सधूमकवलोदग्राः स्फुलिङ्गौघमुचो मुहुः //
text_mt: issued forth in all directions, continuous like the fire of cosmic dissolution, / towering with mouthfuls of smoke, incessantly emitting showers of sparks.

sanskrit_iast:
munikrodhānalajvālāḥ samantāvdyānaśurdiśaḥ /
vyālodaraugrakuharā jvālā stannetranirgatāḥ //
meaning:
मुनिक्रोधानलज्वालाः समन्ताव्द्यानशुर्दिशः /
व्यालोदरौग्रकुहरा ज्वाला स्तन्नेत्रनिर्गताः //
text_mt: The flames of fire from the sage's anger spread through all the directions. / The flames issuing from his eyes were terrifying like the belly of a serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
virejurnibhṛtāṃbhodhervaḍavāgnerivārciṣaḥ /
krodhāgniḥ sumahārāja jvālāvavyāptadigantaraḥ //
meaning:
विरेजुर्निभृतांभोधेर्वडवाग्नेरिवार्चिषः /
क्रोधाग्निः सुमहाराज ज्वालावव्याप्तदिगन्तरः //
text_mt: They blazed like the flames of the submarine fire in the quiet ocean. / That fire of wrath, O great king, enveloped the quarters with its flames;

sanskrit_iast: dagdhāṃścakāra tānsarvānāvṛṇvāno nabhastalam //
meaning: दग्धांश्चकार तान्सर्वानावृण्वानो नभस्तलम् //
text_mt: Encompassing the vault of heaven, it reduced them all to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
saśabdamudbhrāntamarutprakopavivarttamānānaladhūmajālaiḥ /
mahīrajobhiśca nitāntamuddhataiḥ samāvṛtaṃ loka mabhūdbhṛśāturam //
meaning:
सशब्दमुद्भ्रान्तमरुत्प्रकोपविवर्त्तमानानलधूमजालैः /
महीरजोभिश्च नितान्तमुद्धतैः समावृतं लोक मभूद्भृशातुरम् //
text_mt: The world became exceedingly distressed, completely covered / with masses of smoke from the swirling fire provoked by the roaring and agitated winds, and by the clouds of dust violently raised from the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa vahnirvilikhannivābhitaḥ samīravegābhihatābhiraṃbaram /
śikhābhirurvīśasutānaśeṣato dadāha sadyaḥ sura vidviṣastān //
meaning:
ततः स वह्निर्विलिखन्निवाभितः समीरवेगाभिहताभिरंबरम् /
शिखाभिरुर्वीशसुतानशेषतो ददाह सद्यः सुर विद्विषस्तान् //
text_mt: Then that fire, as if scraping the sky all around with its flames driven by the force of the wind, / instantly burned completely those sons of the earth's lord, enemies of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
miṣataḥ sarvalokasya ktodhāgnistamṛte hayam /
sāgarāṃstānaśeṣeṇa bhasmasādakarotsa tān //
meaning:
मिषतः सर्वलोकस्य क्तोधाग्निस्तमृते हयम् /
सागरांस्तानशेषेण भस्मसादकरोत्स तान् //
text_mt: Before the eyes of the whole world, the fire of wrath, leaving aside that horse, / reduced all those sons of Sagara entirely to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ krodhāgninā tena sāgarāḥ pāpacetasaḥ /
jajvaluḥ sahasā dāve taravo nīrasā iva //
meaning:
एवं क्रोधाग्निना तेन सागराः पापचेतसः /
जज्वलुः सहसा दावे तरवो नीरसा इव //
text_mt: Thus, by that fire of wrath, the evil-minded sons of Sagara / blazed up suddenly like sapless trees in a forest fire.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ tu nidhanaṃ sāgarāṇāndurātmanām /
anyonyamabuvandevā vismitā ṛṣibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा तेषां तु निधनं सागराणान्दुरात्मनाम् /
अन्योन्यमबुवन्देवा विस्मिता ऋषिभिः सह //
text_mt: Seeing the death of those wicked sons of Sagara, / the gods, along with the sages, said to one another in astonishment:

sanskrit_iast:
ahodāruṇapāpānāṃ vipāko na cirāyitaḥ /
durantaḥ khalu loke 'sminnarāṇāmasadātmanām //
meaning:
अहोदारुणपापानां विपाको न चिरायितः /
दुरन्तः खलु लोके ऽस्मिन्नराणामसदात्मनाम् //
text_mt: "Ah! The ripening of terrible sins has not been long delayed; / dreadful indeed in this world is the end of wicked men.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi me parvatākārā nṛśaṃsāḥ krūravuddhayaḥ /
yugapadvilayaṃ prāptāḥ sahasaiva tṛṇāgnivat //
meaning:
यदि मे पर्वताकारा नृशंसाः क्रूरवुद्धयः /
युगपद्विलयं प्राप्ताः सहसैव तृणाग्निवत् //
text_mt: Since these mountain-like, cruel, and mercilessly disposed men / have met destruction simultaneously, all at once like grass in a fire!

sanskrit_iast:
udvejanīyā bhūtānāṃ sadbhiratyantagarhitāḥ /
ājīvāntamime hartu diṣṭyā saṃkṣayamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
उद्वेजनीया भूतानां सद्भिरत्यन्तगर्हिताः /
आजीवान्तमिमे हर्तु दिष्ट्या संक्षयमागताः //
text_mt: They caused anxiety to living beings and were thoroughly despised by the virtuous; / fortunately, these who took away the means of subsistence have met their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
paropatāpi nitarāṃ sarvalokajugupsitam /
iha kṛtvāśubhaṃ karma kaḥpumānvindate sukham //
meaning:
परोपतापि नितरां सर्वलोकजुगुप्सितम् /
इह कृत्वाशुभं कर्म कःपुमान्विन्दते सुखम् //
text_mt: After committing an evil deed here that intensely afflicts others / and is abhorred by all the world, what man finds happiness?

sanskrit_iast:
vikrośya sarvabhūtāni saṃprayātāḥ svakarmabhiḥ /
brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ pāpā nirayaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
विक्रोश्य सर्वभूतानि संप्रयाताः स्वकर्मभिः /
ब्रह्मदण्डहताः पापा निरयं शाश्वतीः समाः //
text_mt: Making all creatures cry out, struck down by the staff of Brahman through their own deeds, / the sinners have gone to hell for eternal years.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsadaiva karttavyaṃ karma puṃsāṃ manīpiṇām /
durataśca parityājyamitarallokaninditam //
meaning:
तस्मात्सदैव कर्त्तव्यं कर्म पुंसां मनीपिणाम् /
दुरतश्च परित्याज्यमितरल्लोकनिन्दितम् //
text_mt: Therefore, wise men should always perform virtuous deeds, / and keep far away from other deeds that are condemned by the world.

sanskrit_iast:
karttavyaḥ śreyase yatno yāvajjīvaṃ vijānatā /
nācaretkasyaciddrohamanityaṃ jīvanaṃ yataḥ //
meaning:
कर्त्तव्यः श्रेयसे यत्नो यावज्जीवं विजानता /
नाचरेत्कस्यचिद्द्रोहमनित्यं जीवनं यतः //
text_mt: A wise man should strive for the highest good as long as he lives; / he should not commit hostility against anyone, for life is transient.

sanskrit_iast:
anityo 'yaṃ sadā dehaḥsapadaścāticañcalāḥ /
saṃsāraścātinissārastatkathaṃ viśvasedbudhaḥ //
meaning:
अनित्यो ऽयं सदा देहःसपदश्चातिचञ्चलाः /
संसारश्चातिनिस्सारस्तत्कथं विश्वसेद्बुधः //
text_mt: This body is ever transient, fortunes are extremely fickle, / and the cycle of existence is utterly devoid of substance; how then can a wise man put his trust in it?"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ suramunīndreṣu kathayatsu parasparam /
munikrodhendhanībhūtā vineśuḥ sagarātmajāḥ //
meaning:
एवं सुरमुनीन्द्रेषु कथयत्सु परस्परम् /
मुनिक्रोधेन्धनीभूता विनेशुः सगरात्मजाः //
text_mt: While the foremost gods and sages were thus speaking among themselves, / the sons of Sagara perished, having become the fuel for the sage's wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagadhadehāḥ sahasā bhuvaṃ viṣṭabhya bhasmanā /
avāpurnirayaṃ sadyaḥ sāgarāste svakamabhiḥ //
meaning:
निर्दगधदेहाः सहसा भुवं विष्टभ्य भस्मना /
अवापुर्निरयं सद्यः सागरास्ते स्वकमभिः //
text_mt: Their bodies instantly incinerated, covering the earth with ash, / those sons of Sagara immediately reached hell by their own actions.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāṃstānaśeṣeṇa dagdhavātatkrodhajo 'nalaḥ /
kṣaṇena lokānakhilānudyato dagdhumañjasā //
meaning:
सागरांस्तानशेषेण दग्धवातत्क्रोधजो ऽनलः /
क्षणेन लोकानखिलानुद्यतो दग्धुमञ्जसा //
text_mt: Having burned all those sons of Sagara, the fire born of that anger / prepared at once to burn up all the worlds in a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayabhītāstato devāḥ sametya divi saṃsthitāḥ /
tuṣṭuvuste mahātmānaṃ krodhāgniśamanārthinaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sagaracaritesāgarāvināśo nāma tripañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 53//
meaning:
भयभीतास्ततो देवाः समेत्य दिवि संस्थिताः /
तुष्टुवुस्ते महात्मानं क्रोधाग्निशमनार्थिनः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सगरचरितेसागराविनाशो नाम त्रिपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 53//
text_mt:
Then the gods, standing in heaven, terrified with fear, / assembled and praised that great-souled one, seeking to pacify the fire of his wrath.

Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, named 'The Destruction of the Sons of Sagara' in the account of Sagara, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section spoken by Vāyu, in the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
krodhāgnimenaṃ viprendra sadyaḥ saṃharttumarhasi /
no cedakāle loko 'yaṃ sakalastena dahyate //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
क्रोधाग्निमेनं विप्रेन्द्र सद्यः संहर्त्तुमर्हसि /
नो चेदकाले लोको ऽयं सकलस्तेन दह्यते //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / "O best of brāhmaṇas, you ought to withdraw this fire of wrath at once; / otherwise, this entire world will be burned by it prematurely.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭaste mahimānena vyāptamāsīccarācaram /
kṣamasva saṃhara krodhaṃ namaste viprapuṅgava //
meaning:
दृष्टस्ते महिमानेन व्याप्तमासीच्चराचरम् /
क्षमस्व संहर क्रोधं नमस्ते विप्रपुङ्गव //
text_mt: Your greatness has been witnessed; by this [fire] the moving and unmoving world has been pervaded. / Forgive, withdraw your anger, salutations to you, O eminent brāhmaṇa!"

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu bhagavānkapilo muniḥ /
tūrṇameva kṣayaṃ ninye krodhāgnimatibhairavam //
meaning:
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु भगवान्कपिलो मुनिः /
तूर्णमेव क्षयं निन्ये क्रोधाग्निमतिभैरवम् //
text_mt: Being thus praised, the venerable sage Kapila / quickly brought that exceedingly terrifying fire of wrath to cessation.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praśāntamabhavajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram /
devāstapasvinaścaiva babhūvurvigatajvarāḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रशान्तमभवज्जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् /
देवास्तपस्विनश्चैव बभूवुर्विगतज्वराः //
text_mt: Then the entire world, moving and unmoving, became peaceful, / and the gods and ascetics were relieved of their fever of distress.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānnārado muniḥ /
ayodhyā magamadrājandevalokādyadṛcchayā //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवान्नारदो मुनिः /
अयोध्या मगमद्राजन्देवलोकाद्यदृच्छया //
text_mt: At that very time, the venerable sage Nārada, / wandering at will from the heavenly world, came to Ayodhyā, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāgatamabhiprekṣya nāradaṃ sagarastadā /
arghyapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayāmāsa śāstrataḥ //
meaning:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नारदं सगरस्तदा /
अर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयामास शास्त्रतः //
text_mt: Seeing that Nārada had arrived, Sagara then / duly honoured him according to the scriptures with water for respectful reception, water for the feet, and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
parigṛhya ca tatpūjāmāsīnaḥ paramāsane /
nārado rājaśārdūlamidaṃ vacanamabravīt //
meaning:
परिगृह्य च तत्पूजामासीनः परमासने /
नारदो राजशार्दूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having accepted his worship and seated on an excellent throne, / Nārada spoke these words to that tiger among kings:

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
hayasaṃcāraṇārthāya saṃprayātāstavātmajāḥ /
brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ sarve vinaṣṭā nṛpasattama //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
हयसंचारणार्थाय संप्रयातास्तवात्मजाः /
ब्रह्मदण्डहताः सर्वे विनष्टा नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: Nārada said: / "Your sons, who went forth to follow the horse, / have all perished, struck down by the staff of Brahman, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃrakṣyamāṇastaiḥ sarvairhayaste yajñiyo nṛpa /
kenāpya lakṣitaḥ kvāpi nīto vidhivaśāddivi //
meaning:
संरक्ष्यमाणस्तैः सर्वैर्हयस्ते यज्ञियो नृप /
केनाप्य लक्षितः क्वापि नीतो विधिवशाद्दिवि //
text_mt: While being guarded by all of them, O king, your sacrificial horse, / unnoticed by anyone, was taken to heaven by the power of destiny.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vinaṣṭaṃ turagaṃ vicinvanto mahītale /
prālabhanta na te kvāpi tatpravṛttiṃ cirānnṛpa //
meaning:
ततो विनष्टं तुरगं विचिन्वन्तो महीतले /
प्रालभन्त न ते क्वापि तत्प्रवृत्तिं चिरान्नृप //
text_mt: Then, searching the surface of the earth for the lost horse, / they did not find any news of it anywhere for a long time, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'vaneradhaste 'śvaṃ vicetuṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ /
sāgarāste samārabhya pracakhnurvasudhātalam //
meaning:
ततो ऽवनेरधस्ते ऽश्वं विचेतुं कृतनिश्चयाः /
सागरास्ते समारभ्य प्रचख्नुर्वसुधातलम् //
text_mt: Then, resolved to search for the horse beneath the earth, / those sons of Sagara began digging up the surface of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
khananto vasudhā maśvaṃ pātāle dadṛśurnṛpa /
samīpe tasya yogīndraṃ kapilaṃ camahāmunim //
meaning:
खनन्तो वसुधा मश्वं पाताले ददृशुर्नृप /
समीपे तस्य योगीन्द्रं कपिलं चमहामुनिम् //
text_mt: Digging the earth, they saw the horse in Pātāla, O king, / and near it, Kapila, the lord of yogins and great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpakarmāṇaste sarve kālacoditāḥ /
kapilaṃ kopayāmāsuraśvaharttāyamityalam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा पापकर्माणस्ते सर्वे कालचोदिताः /
कपिलं कोपयामासुरश्वहर्त्तायमित्यलम् //
text_mt: Seeing him, all those evil-doers, impelled by time, / provoked Kapila's wrath, crying, 'This is the stealer of the horse!'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatkrodhasaṃbhūtanetrāgnerdahato diśaḥ /
indhanībhūtadehāste putrāḥ saṃkṣayamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तत्क्रोधसंभूतनेत्राग्नेर्दहतो दिशः /
