इन्धनीभूतदेहास्ते पुत्राः संक्षयमागताः //
text_mt: Then, as the fire from his eyes, born of that wrath, burned the directions, / your sons, their bodies turned to fuel, met their destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
krūrāḥ pāpasamācārāḥ sarvalokoparodhakāḥ /
yataste tena rājendra na śokaṃ kartumarhasi //
meaning:
क्रूराः पापसमाचाराः सर्वलोकोपरोधकाः /
यतस्ते तेन राजेन्द्र न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Since they were cruel, of wicked conduct, and harassers of all the world, / you should not grieve, O lord of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ dhairyadhano bhūtvā bhavita vyatayātmanaḥ /
naṣṭaṃ mṛtamatītaṃ ca nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ //
meaning:
स त्वं धैर्यधनो भूत्वा भवित व्यतयात्मनः /
नष्टं मृतमतीतं च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः //
text_mt: Becoming one whose wealth is fortitude, submit to what must inevitably be; / the wise do not grieve for what is lost, dead, or past.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpautramimaṃ bālamaṃśumantaṃ mahāmatim /
turagānayanārthāya niyuṅkṣva nṛpasattama //
meaning:
तस्मात्पौत्रमिमं बालमंशुमन्तं महामतिम् /
तुरगानयनार्थाय नियुङ्क्ष्व नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: Therefore, appoint this young grandson, the highly intelligent Aṃśumat, / to bring back the horse, O best of kings."

sanskrit_iast:
ityaktvā rājaśārdūlaṃ sadasyartviksamanvitam /
kṣaṇena paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ nārado 'ntardadhe muniḥ //
meaning:
इत्यक्त्वा राजशार्दूलं सदस्यर्त्विक्समन्वितम् /
क्षणेन पश्यतां तेषां नारदो ऽन्तर्दधे मुनिः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to that tiger among kings in the presence of the assembly and sacrificial priests, / the sage Nārada vanished in an instant before their eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchratvā vacana tasya nāradasya nṛpottamaḥ /
duḥkhaśokaparātātmā dadhyau ciramudāradhīḥ //
meaning:
तच्छ्रत्वा वचन तस्य नारदस्य नृपोत्तमः /
दुःखशोकपरातात्मा दध्यौ चिरमुदारधीः //
text_mt: Hearing those words of Nārada, the noble-minded best of kings, / his heart overcome with grief and sorrow, fell into deep contemplation for a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dhyānayuktaṃ sadasi samāsīnamavāṅmukham /
vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha rājānaṃ sāṃtvayandeśakālavit //
meaning:
तं ध्यानयुक्तं सदसि समासीनमवाङ्मुखम् /
वसिष्ठः प्राह राजानं सांत्वयन्देशकालवित् //
text_mt: Seeing him seated in the assembly with his face cast down in meditation, / Vasiṣṭha, who knew the right place and time, spoke consolingly to the king:

sanskrit_iast:
kimidaṃ dhairyasārāṇāmavakāśaṃ bhavadṛśām /
labhate hṛdi cecchokaḥ prāptaṃ dhīra tayā phalam //
meaning:
किमिदं धैर्यसाराणामवकाशं भवदृशाम् /
लभते हृदि चेच्छोकः प्राप्तं धीर तया फलम् //
text_mt: "Why does such grief find room in the heart of people like you, / whose essence is fortitude? The fruit of firmness has already been attained.

sanskrit_iast:
daurmanasyaṃ śithilayansarvaṃ diṣṭavaśānugam /
manvāno 'nantaraṃ kṛtyaṃ kartumarhasyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
दौर्मनस्यं शिथिलयन्सर्वं दिष्टवशानुगम् /
मन्वानो ऽनन्तरं कृत्यं कर्तुमर्हस्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: Dispelling this dejection, considering that everything follows the sway of destiny, / you must certainly do the duty that lies immediately before you."

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭhenaivamuktastu rājā kāryārthatattvavit /
dhṛtiṃ sattvaṃ samālaṃbya tatheti pratyabhāṣata //
meaning:
वसिष्ठेनैवमुक्तस्तु राजा कार्यार्थतत्त्ववित् /
धृतिं सत्त्वं समालंब्य तथेति प्रत्यभाषत //
text_mt: Addressed in this manner by Vasiṣṭha, the king, knowing the truth of proper action, / resorted to patience and fortitude, and replied, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumantaṃ samāhūya pautraṃ vinayaśālinam /
brahmakṣattrasabhāmadhye śanairidamabhāṣata //
meaning:
अंशुमन्तं समाहूय पौत्रं विनयशालिनम् /
ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रसभामध्ये शनैरिदमभाषत //
text_mt: Summoning his well-behaved grandson Aṃśumat / into the midst of the assembly of brāhmaṇas and kṣatriyas, he spoke slowly as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmadaṇḍahatāḥ sarve pitarastava putraka /
patitāḥ pāpakarmāṇo niraye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मदण्डहताः सर्वे पितरस्तव पुत्रक /
पतिताः पापकर्माणो निरये शाश्वतीः समाः //
text_mt: "All your fathers, my dear boy, struck down by the staff of Brahman, / sinners that they were, have fallen into hell for eternal years.

sanskrit_iast:
tvameva saṃtatirmahyaṃ rājyasyāsya ca rakṣitā /
tvadāyattamaśeṣaṃ me śreyo 'mutra paratra ca //
meaning:
त्वमेव संततिर्मह्यं राज्यस्यास्य च रक्षिता /
त्वदायत्तमशेषं मे श्रेयो ऽमुत्र परत्र च //
text_mt: You alone are my continuation and the protector of this kingdom; / all my welfare, both here and in the world beyond, depends upon you.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvaṃ gaccha mamādeśātpātāle kapilāntikam /
turagānayanārthāya yatnena mahātānvitaḥ //
meaning:
स त्वं गच्छ ममादेशात्पाताले कपिलान्तिकम् /
तुरगानयनार्थाय यत्नेन महातान्वितः //
text_mt: Go, therefore, by my command to Pātāla, to the presence of Kapila, / endowed with great effort in order to bring back the horse."

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prārthayitvā vidhivatprasādya ca viśeṣataḥ /
ādāya turagaṃ vatsa śīghramāgantumarhasi //
meaning:
तं प्रार्थयित्वा विधिवत्प्रसाद्य च विशेषतः /
आदाय तुरगं वत्स शीघ्रमागन्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Entreating him properly and particularly propitiating him, / having taken the horse, my child, you should return quickly."

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
evamuktoṃ'śumāṃstena praṇamya pitaraṃ pituḥ /
tathetyuktvā mahābuddhiḥ prayayau kapilāntikam //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवमुक्तोंऽशुमांस्तेन प्रणम्य पितरं पितुः /
तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबुद्धिः प्रययौ कपिलान्तिकम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Thus addressed by him, Aṃśumat bowed to the father of his father, / said, "So be it," and the highly intelligent one set out to the presence of Kapila.

sanskrit_iast:
tamupāgamya vidhivannamaskṛtya yathāmati /
praśrayāvanato bhūtvā śanairidamuvāca ha //
meaning:
तमुपागम्य विधिवन्नमस्कृत्य यथामति /
प्रश्रयावनतो भूत्वा शनैरिदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Having approached him, bowed down properly according to his understanding, / and bent low in humble respect, he slowly said this:

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda vipraśārdūla tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ /
kopaṃ ca saṃhara kṣipraṃ lokaprakṣayakārakam //
meaning:
प्रसीद विप्रशार्दूल त्वामहं शरणं गतः /
कोपं च संहर क्षिप्रं लोकप्रक्षयकारकम् //
text_mt: "Be pleased, O tiger among Brahmins! I have taken refuge in you. / Subdue quickly your anger that brings about the destruction of worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayi kruddhe jagatsarvaṃ praṇāśamupayāsyati /
praśāntimupayāhyāśulokāḥ saṃtu gatavyathāḥ //
meaning:
त्वयि क्रुद्धे जगत्सर्वं प्रणाशमुपयास्यति /
प्रशान्तिमुपयाह्याशुलोकाः संतु गतव्यथाः //
text_mt: When you are enraged, the whole universe will go to ruin. / Attain peace swiftly; let the worlds be freed from torment!

sanskrit_iast:
prasanno 'smānmahābhāga paśya saumyena cakṣuṣā /
ye tvatkrodhāgninirdagdhāstatsaṃtatimavehi mām //
meaning:
प्रसन्नो ऽस्मान्महाभाग पश्य सौम्येन चक्षुषा /
ये त्वत्क्रोधाग्निनिर्दग्धास्तत्संततिमवेहि माम् //
text_mt: Being pleased, look upon us, O fortunate one, with a gentle eye. / Know me to be the descendant of those who were burned up by the fire of your wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnāṃśumantaṃ naptāraṃ sagarasya mahīpateḥ /
so 'haṃ tasya niyogena tvatprasādābhikāṅkṣayā //
meaning:
नाम्नांशुमन्तं नप्तारं सगरस्य महीपतेः /
सो ऽहं तस्य नियोगेन त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षया //
text_mt: named Aṃśumat, the grandson of King Sagara. / As such, I, by his command and desiring your grace,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpto dāsyasi cedbrahmaṃsturagānayanāya ca /
jaiminiruvāca
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yogīndrapravaro muniḥ //
meaning:
प्राप्तो दास्यसि चेद्ब्रह्मंस्तुरगानयनाय च /
जैमिनिरुवाच
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा योगीन्द्रप्रवरो मुनिः //
text_mt: have arrived to take back the horse, if you grant it, O holy one!" / Jaimini said: / Hearing that speech of his, the sage, foremost among great yogins,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumantaṃ samālokya prasanna idamabravīt /
svāgataṃ bhavato vatsa diṣṭyā ca tvamihāgataḥ //
meaning:
अंशुमन्तं समालोक्य प्रसन्न इदमब्रवीत् /
स्वागतं भवतो वत्स दिष्ट्या च त्वमिहागतः //
text_mt: looked upon Aṃśumat and, pleased, said this: / "Welcome to you, my child, and by good fortune you have come here.

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha śīghraṃ hayaścāyaṃ nīyatāṃ sagarāntikam /
adhikṣipto 'sya yajño 'pi prāgataḥ saṃpravarttatām //
meaning:
गच्छ शीघ्रं हयश्चायं नीयतां सगरान्तिकम् /
अधिक्षिप्तो ऽस्य यज्ञो ऽपि प्रागतः संप्रवर्त्तताम् //
text_mt: Go quickly, and let this horse be led to the presence of Sagara. / Let his interrupted sacrifice also proceed as before.

sanskrit_iast:
vriyatāṃ ca varo mattastvayā yaste manogataḥ /
dāsye sudurlabhamapi tvadbhaktiparitoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
व्रियतां च वरो मत्तस्त्वया यस्ते मनोगतः /
दास्ये सुदुर्लभमपि त्वद्भक्तिपरितोषितः //
text_mt: And choose a boon from me, whatever is in your heart; / gratified by your devotion, I shall grant even what is very hard to obtain.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ tu saṃpramāśaṃ hi gatvā vada pitāmaham /
pāpānāṃ maraṇaṃ tveṣāṃ na ca śocitumarhasi //
meaning:
एषां तु संप्रमाशं हि गत्वा वद पितामहम् /
पापानां मरणं त्वेषां न च शोचितुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Having gone, tell your grandfather of the destruction of these [uncles]; / but you should not grieve for the death of these wicked ones."

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ praṇāmya cogīndramaṃśumānidamabravīt /
varaṃ dadāsi cenmahyaṃ varaye tvāṃ mahāmune //
meaning:
ततः प्रणाम्य चोगीन्द्रमंशुमानिदमब्रवीत् /
वरं ददासि चेन्मह्यं वरये त्वां महामुने //
text_mt: Then, having bowed to the lord of yogins, Aṃśumat said this: / "If you grant me a boon, I choose [this from] you, O great sage:

sanskrit_iast:
varamarhāmi cettvattaḥ prasanno dātumarhasi /
tvadroṣapāvakapluṣṭāḥ pitaro ye mamākhilāḥ //
meaning:
वरमर्हामि चेत्त्वत्तः प्रसन्नो दातुमर्हसि /
त्वद्रोषपावकप्लुष्टाः पितरो ये ममाखिलाः //
text_mt: If I am worthy of a boon from you, be pleased to grant it: / All those forefathers of mine who were scorched by the fire of your wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprayāsyanti te brahmannirayaṃ śāsvatīḥ samāḥ /
brahmadaṇḍahatānāṃ tu na hi piṇḍodakakriyāḥ //
meaning:
संप्रयास्यन्ति ते ब्रह्मन्निरयं शास्वतीः समाः /
ब्रह्मदण्डहतानां तु न हि पिण्डोदकक्रियाः //
text_mt: they will go to hell, O holy one, for eternal years; / for there are no rites of rice-balls and water for those slain by a Brahmin's rod [of punishment].

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍodakavihīnānāmiha loke mahāmune /
vidyate pitṛsālokyaṃ na khalu śruticoditam //
meaning:
पिण्डोदकविहीनानामिह लोके महामुने /
विद्यते पितृसालोक्यं न खलु श्रुतिचोदितम् //
text_mt: For those devoid of rice-balls and water in this world, O great sage, / the realm of the ancestors is not found to be prescribed in scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayaḥ svargavāso 'stu teṣāṃ tu tvatprasādataḥ /
vareṇānena bhagavankṛtakṛtyo bhāvāmyaham //
meaning:
अक्षयः स्वर्गवासो ऽस्तु तेषां तु त्वत्प्रसादतः /
वरेणानेन भगवन्कृतकृत्यो भावाम्यहम् //
text_mt: Let there be imperishable residence in heaven for them, by your grace! / By this boon, O blessed lord, my purpose will be fulfilled.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprasīda tvamevaiṣāṃ svargatervada kāraṇam /
yenoddhāraṇameteṣāṃ vahneḥ kopasya vai bhavet //
meaning:
तत्प्रसीद त्वमेवैषां स्वर्गतेर्वद कारणम् /
येनोद्धारणमेतेषां वह्नेः कोपस्य वै भवेत् //
text_mt: Therefore be pleased and tell the means for their attainment of heaven, / by which there may be deliverance of these [ancestors] from the fire of anger."

sanskrit_iast:
tatastamāha yogīndraḥsuprasannena cetasā /
nirayoddhāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ tvayā vatsa na śakyate //
meaning:
ततस्तमाह योगीन्द्रःसुप्रसन्नेन चेतसा /
निरयोद्धारणं तेषां त्वया वत्स न शक्यते //
text_mt: Then the lord of yogins said to him with an entirely pleased mind: / "Their deliverance from hell cannot be achieved by you, my child.

sanskrit_iast:
taiścāpi narake tāvadvastavyaṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ /
kālaḥ pratīkṣyatāṃ tāvadyāvattvatpautrasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
तैश्चापि नरके तावद्वस्तव्यं पापकर्मभिः /
कालः प्रतीक्ष्यतां तावद्यावत्त्वत्पौत्रसंभवः //
text_mt: And those evil-doers must dwell in hell for that long. / Let the time be awaited until the birth of your grandson.

sanskrit_iast:
kālānte bhavitā vatsa pautrastava mahāmatiḥ /
rājā bhagīratho nāma sarvadharmārthatattvavit //
meaning:
कालान्ते भविता वत्स पौत्रस्तव महामतिः /
राजा भगीरथो नाम सर्वधर्मार्थतत्त्ववित् //
text_mt: At the end of that time, my child, there will be your grandson, high-minded, / a king named Bhagīratha, knowing the truth of all dharma and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu yatnena mahatā pitṛgauravayantritaḥ /
āneṣyati divo gaṅgāṃ tapastaptvā mahāddhruvam //
meaning:
स तु यत्नेन महता पितृगौरवयन्त्रितः /
आनेष्यति दिवो गङ्गां तपस्तप्त्वा महाद्ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: Controlled by respect for his ancestors, with great effort / he will surely bring the Gaṅgā from heaven after performing great austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaṃbhasā pāviteṣu teṣāṃ gātrāsthibhasmasu /
prāpnuvanti gatiṃ svarge bhavataḥ pitaro 'khilāḥ //
meaning:
तदंभसा पावितेषु तेषां गात्रास्थिभस्मसु /
प्राप्नुवन्ति गतिं स्वर्गे भवतः पितरो ऽखिलाः //
text_mt: When the ashes of their limbs and bones are purified by its water, / all your forefathers will attain the realm of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti tasyā māhātmyaṃ gaṅgāyā nṛpanandana /
bhāgīrathīti loke 'sminsā vikhyātimupaiṣyati //
meaning:
तथेति तस्या माहात्म्यं गङ्गाया नृपनन्दन /
भागीरथीति लोके ऽस्मिन्सा विख्यातिमुपैष्यति //
text_mt: Such indeed is the greatness of that Gaṅgā, O prince; / she will achieve fame in this world as 'Bhāgīrathī.'

sanskrit_iast:
yattoyaplāviteṣvasthibhasmalomanakheṣvapi /
nirayādapi saṃyāti dehī svarlokamakṣayam //
meaning:
यत्तोयप्लावितेष्वस्थिभस्मलोमनखेष्वपि /
निरयादपि संयाति देही स्वर्लोकमक्षयम् //
text_mt: When even the ashes of the bones, hair, and nails are flooded with her water, / the embodied soul departs even from hell to the imperishable heavenly world.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te naśokaṃ karttumarhasi /
pitāmahāya caivainamaśvaṃ saṃpratipādaya //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ भद्रं ते नशोकं कर्त्तुमर्हसि /
पितामहाय चैवैनमश्वं संप्रतिपादय //
text_mt: Therefore go, may good fortune be yours! You should not grieve. / And deliver this horse to your grandfather."

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā tathetyuktvā mahāmatiḥ /
yayau tenābhyanujñātaḥ sāketanagaraṃ prati //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततः प्रणम्य तं भक्त्या तथेत्युक्त्वा महामतिः /
ययौ तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातः साकेतनगरं प्रति //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Then, having bowed to him with devotion, and having said, "So be it," the highly intelligent one, / permitted by him, set out toward the city of Sāketa.

sanskrit_iast:
sagaraṃ sa samāsādya taṃ praṇamya yathākramam /
nyavedayacca vṛttāntaṃ munesteṣāṃ tathānmanaḥ //
meaning:
सगरं स समासाद्य तं प्रणम्य यथाक्रमम् /
न्यवेदयच्च वृत्तान्तं मुनेस्तेषां तथान्मनः //
text_mt: Having reached Sagara and bowed to him in proper order, / he reported the news of the sage, and also of those [uncles] and of himself.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadauturagaṃ cāpi samānītaṃ prayatnataḥ /
ataḥ paramanuṣṭheyamabravītkiṃ mayeti ca //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde kapilāśramasthāśvānayanaṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 54//
meaning:
प्रददौतुरगं चापि समानीतं प्रयत्नतः /
अतः परमनुष्ठेयमब्रवीत्किं मयेति च //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे कपिलाश्रमस्थाश्वानयनं नाम चतुष्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 54//
text_mt:
He also gave over the horse that had been brought with great effort, / and said: "What is to be performed by me beyond this?"

Thus in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa, spoken by Vāyu, in the middle part, in the third Upoddhātapāda, the fifty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Bringing of the Horse Stationed at Kapila's Hermitage."

sanskrit_iast:
Äḥ
abhinandyāśiṣātyarthaṃ lālayanpraśaśaṃsa ha //
meaning:
Äः
अभिनन्द्याशिषात्यर्थं लालयन्प्रशशंस ह //
text_mt: [Sagara], having greeted [him] exceedingly with blessings, cherishing [him], praised [him].

sanskrit_iast:
atha ṛtviksadasyaiśca sahito rājasattamaḥ /
upākramata taṃ yajñe vidhivadvedapāragaiḥ //
meaning:
अथ ऋत्विक्सदस्यैश्च सहितो राजसत्तमः /
उपाक्रमत तं यज्ञे विधिवद्वेदपारगैः //
text_mt: Then, together with the officiating priests and assembly members who were masters of the Vedas, that best of kings / commenced that sacrifice according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravavṛte yajñaḥ sarvasaṃpadguṇānvitaḥ /
samyagaurvavasiṣṭhādyairmunibhiḥ saṃpravarttitaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रववृते यज्ञः सर्वसंपद्गुणान्वितः /
सम्यगौर्ववसिष्ठाद्यैर्मुनिभिः संप्रवर्त्तितः //
text_mt: Then the sacrifice proceeded, endowed with all abundance and excellence, / duly conducted by Aurva, Vasiṣṭha, and other sages.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇmayamayī vediḥ pātrāṇyuccāvacāni ca /
susamṛddhaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yajñe sarvaṃ babhūva ha //
meaning:
हिरण्मयमयी वेदिः पात्राण्युच्चावचानि च /
सुसमृद्धं यथाशास्त्रं यज्ञे सर्वं बभूव ह //
text_mt: The altar was made of gold, and there were various vessels of higher and lower kinds; / everything at the sacrifice was very opulent in accordance with the scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravarttitaṃ yajñamṛtvijaḥ sarva eva te /
kramātsamāpayāmāsuryajamānapurassarāḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्त्तितं यज्ञमृत्विजः सर्व एव ते /
क्रमात्समापयामासुर्यजमानपुरस्सराः //
text_mt: All those officiating priests, led by the sacrificer, / completed in proper order the sacrifice that had been thus conducted.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpayitvā taṃ yajñaṃ rājā vidhividāṃ varaḥ /
yathāvaddakṣiṇāṃ caiva ṛtvijāṃ pradadau tadā //
meaning:
समापयित्वा तं यज्ञं राजा विधिविदां वरः /
यथावद्दक्षिणां चैव ऋत्विजां प्रददौ तदा //
text_mt: Having completed that sacrifice, the king, foremost among those who know the ritual, / then duly gave sacrificial fees to the officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast:
atha ṛtviksadasyānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tathārthinām /
tatkāṅkṣitādabhyadhikaṃ pradadau vasu sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
अथ ऋत्विक्सदस्यानां ब्राह्मणानां तथार्थिनाम् /
तत्काङ्क्षितादभ्यधिकं प्रददौ वसु सर्वशः //
text_mt: Then he gave wealth on all sides, exceeding what was desired by them, / to the officiating priests, members of the assembly, Brahmins, and suppliants.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃtarpya viprādīndakṣiṇābhiryathākramam /
kṣamāpayāmāsa gurūnsadasyānpraṇipatya ca //
meaning:
एवं संतर्प्य विप्रादीन्दक्षिणाभिर्यथाक्रमम् /
क्षमापयामास गुरून्सदस्यान्प्रणिपत्य च //
text_mt: Having thus gratified the Brahmins and others with fees in due order, / he prostrated himself and asked forgiveness of the elders and assembly members.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādyaistato varṇairṛtvigbhiśca samanvitaḥ /
vārakīyākadaṃbaiśca sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाद्यैस्ततो वर्णैरृत्विग्भिश्च समन्वितः /
वारकीयाकदंबैश्च सूतमागधवन्दिभिः //
text_mt: Accompanied then by the varṇas beginning with the Brahmins, and by the officiating priests, / and by hosts of courtesans, bards, chroniclers, and panegyrists,

sanskrit_iast:
anvīyamānaḥ sastrīkaḥ śvetacchatravirājitaḥ /
dodhūyamānacamaro vālavyajanarājitaḥ //
meaning:
अन्वीयमानः सस्त्रीकः श्वेतच्छत्रविराजितः /
दोधूयमानचमरो वालव्यजनराजितः //
text_mt: followed [by them], accompanied by his wife, shining with a white umbrella, / with yak-tail chowries waved about him, adorned with hair-fans,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvāditranirghoṣairbadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ /
sa gatvā sarayūtīraṃ yathāśāśtraṃ yathāvidhi //
meaning:
नानावादित्रनिर्घोषैर्बधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः /
स गत्वा सरयूतीरं यथाशाश्त्रं यथाविधि //
text_mt: deafening the quarters with the sounds of various musical instruments, / having gone to the bank of the Sarayū according to the scriptures and according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
cakārāvabhṛthasnānaṃ muditaḥ sahabandhubhiḥ /
evaṃ snātvā sapatnīkaḥ suhṛdbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
चकारावभृथस्नानं मुदितः सहबन्धुभिः /
एवं स्नात्वा सपत्नीकः सुहृद्भिर्ब्राह्मणैः सह //
text_mt: he performed the final ablution bath, rejoiced together with his kinsmen. / Having thus bathed, accompanied by his wife, along with friends and Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādinānāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ /
maṅgalyairvedaghoṣaiśca saha viprajaneritaiḥ //
meaning:
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गादिनानावादित्रनिःस्वनैः /
मङ्गल्यैर्वेदघोषैश्च सह विप्रजनेरितैः //
text_mt: amidst the sounds of various musical instruments such as vīṇās, flutes, and mṛdaṅgas, / and auspicious Vedic chants uttered by the Brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstūyamānaḥ paritaḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ /
praviveśa purīṃ ramyāṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāyutam //
meaning:
संस्तूयमानः परितः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः /
प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम् //
text_mt: being praised all around by bards, chroniclers, and panegyrists, / he entered the lovely city filled with delighted and prosperous people,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetavyajana sacchatrapatākādhvajamālinīm /
siktasaṃmṛṣṭabhūbhāgāpaṇaśobhāsamanvitām //
meaning:
श्वेतव्यजन सच्छत्रपताकाध्वजमालिनीम् /
सिक्तसंमृष्टभूभागापणशोभासमन्विताम् //
text_mt: garlanded with white fans, umbrellas, pennants, and flags, / endowed with the beauty of marketplaces whose grounds were sprinkled and swept,

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsādriprakāśābhirujjvalāṃ saudhapaṅktibhiḥ /
sa tatrāgarudhūpotthagandhāmoditadiṅmukham //
meaning:
कैलासाद्रिप्रकाशाभिरुज्ज्वलां सौधपङ्क्तिभिः /
स तत्रागरुधूपोत्थगन्धामोदितदिङ्मुखम् //
text_mt: blazing with rows of mansions radiant like Mount Kailāsa, / where the directions were scented with the fragrance arising from the incense of agallochum;

sanskrit_iast:
vikīryamāṇaḥ paritaḥ pauranārījanairmuhuḥ /
lājavarṣeṇa sānandaṃ vīkṣamāṇaśca nāgaraiḥ //
meaning:
विकीर्यमाणः परितः पौरनारीजनैर्मुहुः /
लाजवर्षेण सानन्दं वीक्षमाणश्च नागरैः //
text_mt: being continually showered all around with a rain of parched grain by the townswomen, / and being watched with joy by the citizens,

sanskrit_iast:
upadābhiranekābhistatratatra vaṇigjanaiḥ /
saṃbhāvyamānaḥ śanakairjagama svapuraṃ prati //
meaning:
उपदाभिरनेकाभिस्तत्रतत्र वणिग्जनैः /
संभाव्यमानः शनकैर्जगम स्वपुरं प्रति //
text_mt: being honored with numerous gifts here and there by merchants, / he slowly proceeded toward his own palace.

sanskrit_iast:
sa praviśya gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ sarvamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam /
samyaksaṃbhāvayāmāsa suhṛdo brāhmaṇānapi //
meaning:
स प्रविश्य गृहं रम्यं सर्वमण्डलमण्डितम् /
सम्यक्संभावयामास सुहृदो ब्राह्मणानपि //
text_mt: Having entered his delightful palace adorned with every circle [of beauty], / he duly honoured his friends and also the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsevyamānaśca tadā nānādeśeśvarairnṛpaiḥ /
sabhāyāṃ rājaśārdūlo reme śakra ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
संसेव्यमानश्च तदा नानादेशेश्वरैर्नृपैः /
सभायां राजशार्दूलो रेमे शक्र इवापरः //
text_mt: Attended upon at that time by kings ruling diverse lands, / that tiger among kings rejoiced in the assembly hall like a second Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ suhṛdbhiḥ sahitaḥ pūrayitvā manoratham /
sagaraḥ saha bhāryābhyāṃ reme nṛpavarottamaḥ //
meaning:
एवं सुहृद्भिः सहितः पूरयित्वा मनोरथम् /
सगरः सह भार्याभ्यां रेमे नृपवरोत्तमः //
text_mt: Having thus fulfilled his desire together with his friends, / Sagara, the best of noble kings, made merry with his two wives.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumantaṃ tataḥ pautraṃ mudā vinayaśālinam /
vasiṣṭhānumate rājā yauvarājye 'bhyaṣecayat //
meaning:
अंशुमन्तं ततः पौत्रं मुदा विनयशालिनम् /
वसिष्ठानुमते राजा यौवराज्ये ऽभ्यषेचयत् //
text_mt: Then, with the approval of Vasiṣṭha, the king joyfully consecrated / his grandson Aṃśumat, who was adorned with modesty, to the office of crown prince.

sanskrit_iast:
paurajānapadānāṃ tu bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāmapi /
sa priyo 'bhavadatyarthamudāraiśca guṇairnṛpaḥ //
meaning:
पौरजानपदानां तु बन्धूनां सुहृदामपि /
स प्रियो ऽभवदत्यर्थमुदारैश्च गुणैर्नृपः //
text_mt: And to the citizens, country folk, kinsmen, and friends, / the king became exceedingly dear by virtue of his noble qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
prajāstamanvarajyanta bālamapyamitaujasam /
navaṃ ca śuklapakṣādauśītāṃśumaciroditam //
meaning:
प्रजास्तमन्वरज्यन्त बालमप्यमितौजसम् /
नवं च शुक्लपक्षादौशीतांशुमचिरोदितम् //
text_mt: The subjects were devoted to him, though still a youth, whose splendour was boundless, / like the new moon just risen at the beginning of the bright fortnight.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena sahitaḥ śrīmānsutdṛdbhiśca nṛpottamaḥ /
bhāryābhyāmanurūpābhyāṃ ramamāṇo 'vasacciram //
meaning:
स तेन सहितः श्रीमान्सुत्दृद्भिश्च नृपोत्तमः /
भार्याभ्यामनुरूपाभ्यां रममाणो ऽवसच्चिरम् //
text_mt: Together with him and with his friends, that glorious, best of kings / dwelt for a long time, rejoicing with his two well-matched wives.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvaiva rājaśārdūlaḥ sākṣāddharma ivāparaḥ /
pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ saśailavanakānanām //
meaning:
युवैव राजशार्दूलः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः /
पालयामास वसुधां सशैलवनकाननाम् //
text_mt: While still a youth, that tiger among kings, like Dharma incarnate, / protected the earth with its mountains, forests, and groves.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mahānahimadīdhitivaṃśamauliratnāya yamānavapuruttarakosaleśaḥ /
pūrṇenduvatsakalalokamano 'bhirāmaḥ sārddha prajābhirakhilābhiralaṃ jaharṣa //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde sāgaropākhyāneśumato rājyaprāptirnāma pañcapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 55//
meaning:
एवं महानहिमदीधितिवंशमौलिरत्नाय यमानवपुरुत्तरकोसलेशः /
पूर्णेन्दुवत्सकललोकमनो ऽभिरामः सार्द्ध प्रजाभिरखिलाभिरलं जहर्ष //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सागरोपाख्यानेशुमतो राज्यप्राप्तिर्नाम पञ्चपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 55//
text_mt:
Thus the lord of Northern Kosala—a crest-jewel of the solar dynasty, his form charming the minds of all people like the full moon—rejoiced exceedingly together with all his subjects.

Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, named 'The Attainment of the Kingdom by Aṃśumat' in the story of Sagara, in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmāṇḍa, proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
etatte caritaṃ sarvaṃ sagarasya mahātmanaḥ /
saṃkṣepavistarābhyāṃ tu kathitaṃ pāpanāśanam //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एतत्ते चरितं सर्वं सगरस्य महात्मनः /
संक्षेपविस्तराभ्यां तु कथितं पापनाशनम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / All this story of the great-souled Sagara, which destroys sins, / has been told to you in brief and in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṇḍoṃ 'yaṃ bhārato nāma dakṣiṇottaramāyataḥ /
navayojanasāhasraṃ vistāraparimaṇḍalam //
meaning:
खण्डों ऽयं भारतो नाम दक्षिणोत्तरमायतः /
नवयोजनसाहस्रं विस्तारपरिमण्डलम् //
text_mt: This realm named Bhārata extends from south to north; / its circular extent is nine thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
putraistasya naredrasya mṛgayadbhisturaṅgamam /
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu khātvāṣṭau vinipātitāḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रैस्तस्य नरेद्रस्य मृगयद्भिस्तुरङ्गमम् /
योजनानां सहस्रं तु खात्वाष्टौ विनिपातिताः //
text_mt: By the sons of that king searching for the horse, / having dug eight thousand yojanas, [the land] was made to cave in.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarasya sutairyasmādvarddhito makarālayaḥ /
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu sāgarākhyāmavāptavān //
meaning:
सागरस्य सुतैर्यस्माद्वर्द्धितो मकरालयः /
ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु सागराख्यामवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Because the ocean, the abode of sea-monsters, was enlarged by the sons of Sagara, / from that time forward it acquired the name Sāgara in the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmapādāvadhi mahīṃ satīrthakṣetrakānanām /
abdhiḥ saṃkramayāmāsa parikṣipya nijāṃbhasā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मपादावधि महीं सतीर्थक्षेत्रकाननाम् /
अब्धिः संक्रमयामास परिक्षिप्य निजांभसा //
text_mt: As far as Brahmapāda, the ocean flooded the earth, / covering it with its own waters along with holy fords, sacred precincts, and forests.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastannilayāḥ sarve sadevāsuramānavāḥ /
itastataśca saṃjātā duḥkhena mahatānvitāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तन्निलयाः सर्वे सदेवासुरमानवाः /
इतस्ततश्च संजाता दुःखेन महतान्विताः //
text_mt: Then all those dwelling there, along with gods, asuras, and humans, / were scattered hither and thither, afflicted with great distress.

sanskrit_iast:
gokarṇaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvasurārcitam /
sārddhayojanavistāraṃ tīre paścima vāridheḥ //
meaning:
गोकर्णं नाम विख्यातं क्षेत्रं सर्वसुरार्चितम् /
सार्द्धयोजनविस्तारं तीरे पश्चिम वारिधेः //
text_mt: There is a renowned sacred precinct named Gokarṇa, worshipped by all gods, / a yojana and a half in width, on the shore of the western ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsaṃkhyāni tīrthāni munidevālayāśca vai /
vasaṃti siddhasaṃghāśca kṣetre tasminpurā nṛpa //
meaning:
तत्रासंख्यानि तीर्थानि मुनिदेवालयाश्च वै /
वसंति सिद्धसंघाश्च क्षेत्रे तस्मिन्पुरा नृप //
text_mt: Countless holy fords and abodes of sages and gods were there; / and hosts of Siddhas once resided in that sacred precinct, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraṃ tallokavikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham /
tattīrthamabdherapatadbhāge dakṣiṇapaścime //
meaning:
क्षेत्रं तल्लोकविख्यातं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् /
तत्तीर्थमब्धेरपतद्भागे दक्षिणपश्चिमे //
text_mt: That sacred precinct, world-renowned, auspicious, and dispelling all sins, / that holy ford fell into the south-western region of the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sarve tapastaptvā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ /
nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam //
meaning:
यत्र सर्वे तपस्तप्त्वा मुनयः संशितव्रताः /
निर्वाणं परमं प्राप्ताः पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् //
text_mt: Where, having performed austerities, all the sages of strict vows / attained supreme nirvāṇa, free from rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
tattretrasya prabhāveṇa prītyā bhūtagaṇaiḥ saha /
devyā ca sakalairdevairnityaṃ vasati śaṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
तत्त्रेत्रस्य प्रभावेण प्रीत्या भूतगणैः सह /
देव्या च सकलैर्देवैर्नित्यं वसति शङ्करः //
text_mt: Through the power of that sacred site, Śaṅkara ever dwells there / with delight, together with the hosts of spirits, the Goddess, and all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
enāṃsi yatsamuddiśya tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvatām /
nṛṇāmāśu praṇaśyanti pravāte śuṣkaparṇavat //
meaning:
एनांसि यत्समुद्दिश्य तीर्थयात्रां प्रकुर्वताम् /
नृणामाशु प्रणश्यन्ति प्रवाते शुष्कपर्णवत् //
text_mt: Of men making a pilgrimage to holy places with that [site] as their goal, / sins perish swiftly like dry leaves in a strong wind.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣetrasevanaratir naiva jātvabhijāyate /
samīpe vasamānonāmapi puṃsāṃ durātmanām //
meaning:
तत्क्षेत्रसेवनरतिर् नैव जात्वभिजायते /
समीपे वसमानोनामपि पुंसां दुरात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Devotion to serving that sacred precinct never arises at all / even in evil-minded men who dwell near it.

sanskrit_iast:
mahātā sukṛtenaiva tatkṣetragamane ratiḥ /
nṛṇāṃ saṃjāyate rājannānyathā tu kathañcana //
meaning:
महाता सुकृतेनैव तत्क्षेत्रगमने रतिः /
नृणां संजायते राजन्नान्यथा तु कथञ्चन //
text_mt: Only through great merit does devotion to going to that sacred precinct / arise in men, O king, not otherwise by any means.

sanskrit_iast:
nirbandhena tu ye tasminprāṇinaḥ sthirajaṅgamāḥ /
mriyante nṛpa sadyaste svargaṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam //
meaning:
निर्बन्धेन तु ये तस्मिन्प्राणिनः स्थिरजङ्गमाः /
म्रियन्ते नृप सद्यस्ते स्वर्गं प्राप्स्यन्ति शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: Those living beings, stationary or moving, who perforce / die there, O king, will instantly attain eternal heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyāpi sakalaiḥ pāpairyasya mucyeta mānavaḥ /
kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvatīrthaniketanam //
meaning:
स्मृत्यापि सकलैः पापैर्यस्य मुच्येत मानवः /
क्षेत्राणामुत्तमं क्षेत्रं सर्वतीर्थनिकेतनम् //
text_mt: By the mere remembrance of which a person may be freed from all sins, / [it is] the best of sacred precincts, the abode of all holy fords.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā caiteṣu tīrtheṣu yajantaśca sadāśivam /
siddhikāmā vasaṃti sma munayastatra kecana //
meaning:
स्नात्वा चैतेषु तीर्थेषु यजन्तश्च सदाशिवम् /
सिद्धिकामा वसंति स्म मुनयस्तत्र केचन //
text_mt: Having bathed in these holy fords and worshipping Sadāśiva, / certain sages desirous of spiritual perfection used to dwell there.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhavinirmuktā ye tasminvītamatsarāḥ /
nivasaṃtyacireṇaiva tatsiddhiṃprāpnuvanti hi //
meaning:
कामक्रोधविनिर्मुक्ता ये तस्मिन्वीतमत्सराः /
निवसंत्यचिरेणैव तत्सिद्धिंप्राप्नुवन्ति हि //
text_mt: Those who, freed from desire and anger and devoid of envy, / dwell there, indeed soon attain that perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
japahomaratāḥ śāntā nipatā brahmacāriṇaḥ /
vasaṃti tasminye te hi siddhiṃ prāpsyantyabhīpsitām //
meaning:
जपहोमरताः शान्ता निपता ब्रह्मचारिणः /
वसंति तस्मिन्ये ते हि सिद्धिं प्राप्स्यन्त्यभीप्सिताम् //
text_mt: Those who, devoted to recitation and oblations, peaceful, restrained, and celibate, / dwell there, will indeed attain the desired perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
dānahomajapādyaṃ vai pitṛdevadvijārcanam /
anyasmātkoṭiguṇitaṃ bhavettasminphalaṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
दानहोमजपाद्यं वै पितृदेवद्विजार्चनम् /
अन्यस्मात्कोटिगुणितं भवेत्तस्मिन्फलं नृप //
text_mt: Gifts, oblations, recitation, and the like, and the worship of ancestors, gods, and twice-borns— / the fruit of these there becomes a crore times greater than elsewhere, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃbhodhisalile magna tasmin kṣetre 'tipāvane /
mahatā tapasā yuktā munayastannivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
अंभोधिसलिले मग्न तस्मिन् क्षेत्रे ऽतिपावने /
महता तपसा युक्ता मुनयस्तन्निवासिनः //
text_mt: When that most purifying sacred precinct was submerged in the waters of the ocean, / the sages dwelling there, endowed with great asceticism,

sanskrit_iast:
sahyaṃ śikhariṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nilayārthaṃ samāruhan /
vasaṃtastatra te sarve saṃpradhārya parasparam //
meaning:
सह्यं शिखरिणं श्रेष्ठं निलयार्थं समारुहन् /
वसंतस्तत्र ते सर्वे संप्रधार्य परस्परम् //
text_mt: ascended the Sahya, the excellent mountain, for a dwelling place; / living there, having consulted with one another,

sanskrit_iast:
sahendrādrau tapasyantaṃ rāmaṃ gantuṃ pracakramuḥ /
rājovāca /
agastyapītatoye 'bdhau parito rājanandanaiḥ //
meaning:
सहेन्द्राद्रौ तपस्यन्तं रामं गन्तुं प्रचक्रमुः /
राजोवाच /
अगस्त्यपीततोये ऽब्धौ परितो राजनन्दनैः //
text_mt: they set out to go to Rāma, who was practicing austerities on Mount Mahendra. / The king said: / When the ocean, its water drunk by Agastya, was dug all around by the princes,

sanskrit_iast:
khātvādhaḥ pātite kṣetre satīrthāśramakānane /
bhūbhāgeṣu tathānyeṣu puragramākarādiṣu //
meaning:
खात्वाधः पातिते क्षेत्रे सतीर्थाश्रमकानने /
भूभागेषु तथान्येषु पुरग्रमाकरादिषु //
text_mt: and the sacred precinct with holy fords, hermitages, and forests was cast down, / and likewise other regions of the earth with towns, villages, and mines,

sanskrit_iast:
vināśiteṣu deśeṣu samudropāntavarttiṣu /
kimakārṣurmuniśreṣṭha janāstannilayāstataḥ //
meaning:
विनाशितेषु देशेषु समुद्रोपान्तवर्त्तिषु /
किमकार्षुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ जनास्तन्निलयास्ततः //
text_mt: when the lands bordering the sea were destroyed, / what did the people dwelling there do then, O best of sages?

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva cāvasankṛcchrātprasthitānyatra vā tataḥ /
kiyatā caiva kālena saṃpūrṇo 'bhūdapāṃnidhiḥ /
kena vāpi prakāreṇa brahmannetadvadasva me //
meaning:
तत्रैव चावसन्कृच्छ्रात्प्रस्थितान्यत्र वा ततः /
कियता चैव कालेन संपूर्णो ऽभूदपांनिधिः /
केन वापि प्रकारेण ब्रह्मन्नेतद्वदस्व मे //
text_mt: Did they stay right there with difficulty, or did they depart elsewhere from there? / And in how much time was the ocean filled, / and in what manner, O brāhmaṇa? Tell me this.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
anūpeṣu pradeśeṣu nāśiteṣu durātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
अनूपेषु प्रदेशेषु नाशितेषु दुरात्मभिः //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / When the marshy regions were destroyed by the evil-minded ones,

sanskrit_iast:
janāstannilayāḥ sarve saṃprayātā itastataḥ /
tatraiva cāvasankṛcchrātkecitkṣetranivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
जनास्तन्निलयाः सर्वे संप्रयाता इतस्ततः /
तत्रैव चावसन्कृच्छ्रात्केचित्क्षेत्रनिवासिनः //
text_mt: all the people dwelling there departed hither and thither; / and some inhabitants of the sacred precinct stayed right there with difficulty.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu rājannaṃśumataḥ sutaḥ /
babhūva bhuvidharmātmā dilīpa iti viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजन्नंशुमतः सुतः /
बभूव भुविधर्मात्मा दिलीप इति विश्रुतः //
text_mt: At that very time, O king, a son was born to Aṃśumat, / righteous-souled, renowned on earth as Dilīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
rājye 'bhiṣicya taṃ samyagbhuktabhogoṃ'śumānnṛpaḥ /
vanaṃ jagāma medhāvī tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ //
meaning:
राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य तं सम्यग्भुक्तभोगोंऽशुमान्नृपः /
वनं जगाम मेधावी तपसे धृतमानसः //
text_mt: Having duly consecrated him on the throne, King Aṃśumat, having enjoyed worldly pleasures, / wise and with mind set on austerity, went to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
dilīpastu tataḥśrīmānaśeṣāṃ pṛthivīmimām /
pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa vijitya sakalānarīn //
meaning:
दिलीपस्तु ततःश्रीमानशेषां पृथिवीमिमाम् /
पालयामास धर्मेण विजित्य सकलानरीन् //
text_mt: Then the glorious Dilīpa, having conquered all enemies, / protected this entire earth in accordance with dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagīratho nāma sutastasyāsīllokaviśrutaḥ /
sarvadharmārthakuśalaḥ śrīmānamitavikramaḥ //
meaning:
भगीरथो नाम सुतस्तस्यासील्लोकविश्रुतः /
सर्वधर्मार्थकुशलः श्रीमानमितविक्रमः //
text_mt: He had a son known to the world, named Bhagīratha, / skilled in all matters of righteousness and statecraft, glorious, of boundless valour.

sanskrit_iast:
rājye 'bhiṣicya taṃ rājā dilīpo 'pi vanaṃ yayau /
sa cāpi pālayannurvīṃ samyagvihatakaṇṭakām //
meaning:
राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य तं राजा दिलीपो ऽपि वनं ययौ /
स चापि पालयन्नुर्वीं सम्यग्विहतकण्टकाम् //
text_mt: King Dilīpa also, having consecrated him on the throne, departed to the forest; / and he, too, ruling the earth from which all thorns had been thoroughly removed,

sanskrit_iast:
mumude vividhairbhogairdivi devapatiryathā /
sa śuśrāvātmanaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvajānāṃ mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
मुमुदे विविधैर्भोगैर्दिवि देवपतिर्यथा /
स शुश्रावात्मनः पूर्वं पूर्वजानां महीपतिः //
text_mt: rejoiced with diverse enjoyments, like the lord of the gods in heaven. / That ruler of the earth had heard before concerning his own ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
niraye patanaṃ ghoraṃ viprakopasamudbhavam /
brahmadaṇḍahatānsarvānpitañchrutvātiduḥkhitaḥ //
meaning:
निरये पतनं घोरं विप्रकोपसमुद्भवम् /
ब्रह्मदण्डहतान्सर्वान्पितञ्छ्रुत्वातिदुःखितः //
text_mt: of their terrible fall into hell, born of the wrath of a brāhmaṇa; / hearing that all his forefathers had been struck down by the rod of Brahman, he was deeply sorrowful.

sanskrit_iast:
rājye bandhuṣu bhoge vā nirvedaṃ paramaṃ yayau /
sa mantripravare rājyaṃ vinyasya tapase vanam //
meaning:
राज्ये बन्धुषु भोगे वा निर्वेदं परमं ययौ /
स मन्त्रिप्रवरे राज्यं विन्यस्य तपसे वनम् //
text_mt: He felt utter detachment from his kingdom, his kinsmen, and pleasures; / having entrusted the kingdom to his foremost minister, [he departed] to the forest for austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
prayayau svapitṝnnākaṃ ninīṣurnṛpasattamaḥ /
tapasā mahātā pūrvamāyuṣe kamalodbhavam //
meaning:
प्रययौ स्वपितॄन्नाकं निनीषुर्नृपसत्तमः /
तपसा महाता पूर्वमायुषे कमलोद्भवम् //
text_mt: Wishing to lead his ancestors to heaven, the best of kings set forth / [to propitiate] the lotus-born [Brahmā] first with great austerity for the sake of long life.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya tasmāllebhe ca yāvadāyurnijepsitam /
tato gaṅgāṃ mahārāja samārādhya prasādya ca //
meaning:
आराध्य तस्माल्लेभे च यावदायुर्निजेप्सितम् /
ततो गङ्गां महाराज समाराध्य प्रसाद्य च //
text_mt: Having propitiated him, he obtained from him the lifespan he desired. / Then, O great king, having propitiated and pleased Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
varamāgamanaṃ vavre divastasyā mahīṃprati /
tatastāṃ śirasā dharttu tapasā'rādhayacchivam //
meaning:
वरमागमनं वव्रे दिवस्तस्या महींप्रति /
ततस्तां शिरसा धर्त्तु तपसाऽराधयच्छिवम् //
text_mt: he chose the boon of her descent from heaven to earth. / Then, to bear her on his head, he propitiated Śiva through austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi tadvaraṃ tasmai pradadau bhaktavatsalaḥ /
merormūrdhnastato gaṅgāṃ pataṃ tī śirasātmanaḥ //
meaning:
स चापि तद्वरं तस्मै प्रददौ भक्तवत्सलः /
मेरोर्मूर्ध्नस्ततो गङ्गां पतं ती शिरसात्मनः //
text_mt: And he, who is affectionate to his devotees, granted him that boon. / Then the lord of the worlds caught on his head Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
sagrāhanakramakarāṃ jagrāha jagatāṃ patiḥ /
sā tacchiraḥ samāsādya mahāvegapravāhinī //
meaning:
सग्राहनक्रमकरां जग्राह जगतां पतिः /
सा तच्छिरः समासाद्य महावेगप्रवाहिनी //
text_mt: who was falling from the summit of Mount Meru, accompanied by alligators, crocodiles, and makaras. / Reaching his head, flowing with great speed,

sanskrit_iast:
tajjaṭāmaṇḍale śubhre vililye sātigahvare /
culakodakavacchaṃbhorvilīnāṃ śirasi prabhoḥ //
meaning:
तज्जटामण्डले शुभ्रे विलिल्ये सातिगह्वरे /
चुलकोदकवच्छंभोर्विलीनां शिरसि प्रभोः //
text_mt: she disappeared within the exceedingly deep coil of his bright matted locks. / Seeing that she had vanished upon the head of the lord Śambhu like a handful of water,

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya tatpramokṣāya punarārādhayaddharam /
sa tāṃ śarvaprasādena labdhvā tu bhuvamāgatām //
meaning:
विलोक्य तत्प्रमोक्षाय पुनराराधयद्धरम् /
स तां शर्वप्रसादेन लब्ध्वा तु भुवमागताम् //
text_mt: he propitiated Hara again for her release. / Having obtained her by the grace of Śarva and seeing her arrive on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
āninye sāgarā dagdhā yatra tāṃ vai diśaṃ prati /
sa'nuvrajantī rājānaṃ rājarṣeryajataḥ pathi //
meaning:
आनिन्ये सागरा दग्धा यत्र तां वै दिशं प्रति /
सऽनुव्रजन्ती राजानं राजर्षेर्यजतः पथि //
text_mt: he led her toward that direction where the sons of Sagara had been burnt. / Following the king, she, on her way, [came to the hermitage] of the royal sage who was performing a sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
tadyajñavāṭamakhilaṃ plāvayāmāsa sarvataḥ /
sa tu rājaṛṣiḥ kruddho yajñavāṭe 'khile tayā //
meaning:
तद्यज्ञवाटमखिलं प्लावयामास सर्वतः /
स तु राजऋषिः क्रुद्धो यज्ञवाटे ऽखिले तया //
text_mt: and flooded that entire sacrificial enclosure on all sides. / But that royal sage, angered because his entire sacrificial enclosure

sanskrit_iast:
magne gaṇḍūṣajalavatsa papau tāmaśeṣataḥ /
atandrito varṣaśataṃ śuśrūṣitavā sa taṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
मग्ने गण्डूषजलवत्स पपौ तामशेषतः /
अतन्द्रितो वर्षशतं शुश्रूषितवा स तं पुनः //
text_mt: had been submerged by her, drank her up completely like a sip of water. / [The king] unweariedly served him again for a hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprasannānnṛpatirleme gaṅgāṃ mahātmanaḥ /
uṣitvā suciraṃ tasyanisṛtā jaṭharādyataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रसन्नान्नृपतिर्लेमे गङ्गां महात्मनः /
उषित्वा सुचिरं तस्यनिसृता जठराद्यतः //
text_mt: and from that pleased great-souled [sage], the king obtained Gaṅgā. / Because, having dwelt [there] for a very long time, she emerged from his belly,

sanskrit_iast:
prathitaṃ jāhnavītyasyāstato nāmābhavadbhuvi /
bhagīrathānugā bhūtvā tatpitṝṇāmaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
प्रथितं जाह्नवीत्यस्यास्ततो नामाभवद्भुवि /
भगीरथानुगा भूत्वा तत्पितॄणामशेषतः //
text_mt: her name became renowned on earth from then on as Jāhnavī. / Following Bhagīratha, the celestial river

sanskrit_iast:
nijāṃbhasāsthibhasmāni siṣeca suranimnagā /
tatastadaṃbhasā sikteṣvasthibhasmasu tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
निजांभसास्थिभस्मानि सिषेच सुरनिम्नगा /
ततस्तदंभसा सिक्तेष्वस्थिभस्मसु तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: sprinkled the bones and ashes of all his ancestors with her water. / Then, as soon as their bones and ashes were sprinkled with that water,

sanskrit_iast:
nirayātsāgarāḥ sarve naṣṭapāpā divaṃ yayuḥ /
evaṃ sā sāgarānsarvāndivaṃ nītvā mahāndī //
meaning:
निरयात्सागराः सर्वे नष्टपापा दिवं ययुः /
एवं सा सागरान्सर्वान्दिवं नीत्वा महान्दी //
text_mt: all the sons of Sagara, freed from sin, went from hell to heaven. / Thus, having led all the sons of Sagara to heaven, that great river

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva mārgeṇa javātprayātā pūrvasāgaram /
senormūrdhnaścaturbhedā bhūtvā yātā caturddiśam //
meaning:
तेनैव मार्गेण जवात्प्रयाता पूर्वसागरम् /
सेनोर्मूर्ध्नश्चतुर्भेदा भूत्वा याता चतुर्द्दिशम् //
text_mt: swiftly proceeded by that very path to the eastern ocean. / Becoming fourfold from the summit of Mount Meru, she went in the four directions.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhedatayā cābhūttasyā nāmnāṃ catuṣṭayam /
sītā cālakanandā ca sucakṣurbhadravatyapi //
meaning:
चतुर्भेदतया चाभूत्तस्या नाम्नां चतुष्टयम् /
सीता चालकनन्दा च सुचक्षुर्भद्रवत्यपि //
text_mt: And on account of being divided into four, she had a quartet of names: / Sītā, Alakanandā, Sucakṣu, and Bhadravatī.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyapītasalilācciraṃ śuṣkodakā api /
gaṅgāṃbhasā punaḥ pūrṇāścatvāro 'mbudhayo 'bhavan //
meaning:
अगस्त्यपीतसलिलाच्चिरं शुष्कोदका अपि /
गङ्गांभसा पुनः पूर्णाश्चत्वारो ऽम्बुधयो ऽभवन् //
text_mt: The four oceans, whose water had been drunk by Agastya and had long remained dry, / were filled again with the water of Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvamāṇe samudre tu sāgaraiḥ parivarddhite /
antarhitābhavandeśā bahavastatsamīpagāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वमाणे समुद्रे तु सागरैः परिवर्द्धिते /
अन्तर्हिताभवन्देशा बहवस्तत्समीपगाः //
text_mt: When the ocean was filled and swollen by the sons of Sagara, / many regions adjacent to it were submerged.

sanskrit_iast:
samudropāntavarttīni kṣetrāṇi ca samantataḥ /
itastataḥ prayātāśca janāstannilayā nṛpa //
meaning:
समुद्रोपान्तवर्त्तीनि क्षेत्राणि च समन्ततः /
इतस्ततः प्रयाताश्च जनास्तन्निलया नृप //
text_mt: And the holy places on the margins of the ocean were inundated on all sides; / the people dwelling there departed in all directions, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
gokarṇamiti ca kṣetraṃ pūrvaṃ proktaṃ tu yattava /
armavopāttavarttitvātsamudre 'tarddhimāgamat //
meaning:
गोकर्णमिति च क्षेत्रं पूर्वं प्रोक्तं तु यत्तव /
अर्मवोपात्तवर्त्तित्वात्समुद्रे ऽतर्द्धिमागमत् //
text_mt: And the holy place called Gokarṇa, which was mentioned to you previously, / because of its location near the ocean, disappeared into the sea.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastannilayāḥ sarve taduddhārābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ /
sahyādrerbhṛguśārdūlaṃ draṣṭukāmā yayurnṛpa //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde gaṅgānayanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
ततस्तन्निलयाः सर्वे तदुद्धाराभिकाङ्क्षिणः /
सह्याद्रेर्भृगुशार्दूलं द्रष्टुकामा ययुर्नृप //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे गङ्गानयनं नाम षट्पञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Then all the inhabitants thereof, desiring its rescue / and wishing to see the tiger of the Bhṛgus on the Sahya mountain, set out, O king.

Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named 'The Bringing Down of the Gaṅgā', in the Upoddhātapāda, the third [part], in the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
tataḥ śuṣkasumitrādyā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ /
yayurdidṛkṣavo rāmaṃ mahendramacalaṃ prati //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
ततः शुष्कसुमित्राद्या मुनयः शंसितव्रताः /
ययुर्दिदृक्षवो रामं महेन्द्रमचलं प्रति //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Then the sages headed by Śuṣka and Sumitra, who had strict vows, / wishing to see Rāma, went toward the Mahendra mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
atītya subahūndeśānvanāni saritastathā /
āseduracalaśreṣṭhaṃ krameṇa munipuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
अतीत्य सुबहून्देशान्वनानि सरितस्तथा /
आसेदुरचलश्रेष्ठं क्रमेण मुनिपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: Passing through very many regions, forests, and rivers, / those foremost sages gradually reached that best of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāruhya śanaistasyakhyātamāśramamaṇḍalam /
praśāntakrūrasattvāḍhyaṃ śubhaṃ madhye tapovanam //
meaning:
तमारुह्य शनैस्तस्यख्यातमाश्रममण्डलम् /
प्रशान्तक्रूरसत्त्वाढ्यं शुभं मध्ये तपोवनम् //
text_mt: Climbing it slowly, they reached the midst of his renowned circle of hermitages, / an auspicious forest of austerities where cruel creatures were tranquil,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarttuphalapuṣpāḍhyatarukhaṇḍamanoharam /
snigdhacchāyamanaupamyaṃ svāmodisukhamārutam //
meaning:
सर्वर्त्तुफलपुष्पाढ्यतरुखण्डमनोहरम् /
स्निग्धच्छायमनौपम्यं स्वामोदिसुखमारुतम् //
text_mt: charming with groves of trees rich in the fruits and flowers of all seasons, / with cooling shade, peerless, and possessing fragrant, pleasant breezes.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tadāśramamāsādya brahmaghoṣeṇa nāditam /
viviśurtdṛṣṭamanaso yathāvṛddhapurassaram //
meaning:
तं तदाश्रममासाद्य ब्रह्मघोषेण नादितम् /
विविशुर्त्दृष्टमनसो यथावृद्धपुरस्सरम् //
text_mt: Having reached that hermitage resounding with the chanting of the Veda, / with delighted minds they entered according to seniority.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāsane sukhāsīnaṃ mṛdukṛṣṇājinottare /
śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ śāntaṃ dadṛśuste tapodhanāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मासने सुखासीनं मृदुकृष्णाजिनोत्तरे /
शिष्यैः परिवृतं शान्तं ददृशुस्ते तपोधनाः //
text_mt: Those whose wealth was austerity saw him seated comfortably on a seat of sacred grass / covered with a soft black buckskin, surrounded by disciples, tranquil,

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnimiva lokāṃstrīndagdhvā pūrvaṃ nijecchayā /
taddoṣaśāntyai tapasi pravṛttamiv dehinam //
meaning:
कालाग्निमिव लोकांस्त्रीन्दग्ध्वा पूर्वं निजेच्छया /
तद्दोषशान्त्यै तपसि प्रवृत्तमिव् देहिनम् //
text_mt: like the fire of cosmic destruction having burnt the three worlds before by his own will, / who had now engaged in austerity as an embodied being to quell that sin.

sanskrit_iast:
te sametya bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ vinayācāraśālinaḥ /
vavandire mahāmaunaṃ bhaktipraṇatakandharāḥ //
meaning:
ते समेत्य भृगुश्रेष्ठं विनयाचारशालिनः /
ववन्दिरे महामौनं भक्तिप्रणतकन्धराः //
text_mt: Approaching the best of the Bhṛgus, those [sages] endowed with modest conduct / bowed their necks in devotion and saluted him who maintained great silence.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastānāgatāndṛṣṭvā munīnbhṛgukulodvahaḥ /
arghapādyādibhiḥ samyakpūjayāmāsa sādaram //
meaning:
ततस्तानागतान्दृष्ट्वा मुनीन्भृगुकुलोद्वहः /
अर्घपाद्यादिभिः सम्यक्पूजयामास सादरम् //
text_mt: Then, seeing the sages who had arrived, the scion of the Bhṛgu race / worshipped them properly and respectfully with water for hospitality, water for the feet, and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
tānāsīnānkṛtātithyānṛṣīndeśāntarāgatān /
uvāca bhṛguśārdūlaḥ smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ //
meaning:
तानासीनान्कृतातिथ्यानृषीन्देशान्तरागतान् /
उवाच भृगुशार्दूलः स्मितपूर्वमिदं वचः //
text_mt: To those seated sages who had received hospitality and had come from another country, / that tiger of the Bhṛgus spoke these words with a smile:

sanskrit_iast:
svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgā yūyaṃ sarve samāgatāḥ /
karaṇīyaṃ kimasmābhirvadadhvamavicāritam //
meaning:
स्वागतं वो महाभागा यूयं सर्वे समागताः /
करणीयं किमस्माभिर्वदध्वमविचारितम् //
text_mt: “Welcome to you, O fortunate ones! All of you have come together. / What should be done by us? Speak without hesitation.”

sanskrit_iast:
tataste munayo rāmaṃ praṇamyedamathābruvan /
avehyasmānmuniśreṣṭha gokarṇanilayānmunīn //
meaning:
ततस्ते मुनयो रामं प्रणम्येदमथाब्रुवन् /
अवेह्यस्मान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ गोकर्णनिलयान्मुनीन् //
text_mt: Then those sages, having bowed to Rāma, spoke thus: / “Know us, O best of sages, as sages residing in Gokarṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
khanadbhiḥ sāgarairbhūmiṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare /
satīrthaṃ tanmahākṣetraṃ patitaṃ sāgarāṃbhasi //
meaning:
खनद्भिः सागरैर्भूमिं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे /
सतीर्थं तन्महाक्षेत्रं पतितं सागरांभसि //
text_mt: While the sons of Sagara were digging the earth for a certain purpose, / that great holy place together with its sacred bathing sites fell into the ocean waters.

sanskrit_iast:
utsāritārmavajalaṃ kṣetraṃ tatsarvapāvanam /
upalabdhumabhīpsāmo bhavatastu na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
उत्सारितार्मवजलं क्षेत्रं तत्सर्वपावनम् /
उपलब्धुमभीप्सामो भवतस्तु न संशयः //
text_mt: We desire to recover that holy place, which purifies all, / with the ocean water driven away by you, there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇoraṃśena saṃjāto bhavānbhṛgukule kila /
tasmātkartumaśakyaṃ te trailokye 'pi na kiñcana //
meaning:
विष्णोरंशेन संजातो भवान्भृगुकुले किल /
तस्मात्कर्तुमशक्यं ते त्रैलोक्ये ऽपि न किञ्चन //
text_mt: You were born from a portion of Viṣṇu in the Bhṛgu race. / Therefore, nothing is impossible for you to accomplish even in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vāñchitārthaprado loke tvamevetyanuśuśruma /
vayaṃ tvāmāgatāḥ sarve rāmaitadabhiyācitum //
meaning:
वाञ्छितार्थप्रदो लोके त्वमेवेत्यनुशुश्रुम /
वयं त्वामागताः सर्वे रामैतदभियाचितुम् //
text_mt: We have heard that you alone in the world are the granter of desired objects. / All of us have come to you, O Rāma, to request this.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tvamātmaprabhāveṇa kṣetrapravaramadya tat /
dātumarhasi viprendra samutsāryārmavodakam //
meaning:
स त्वमात्मप्रभावेण क्षेत्रप्रवरमद्य तत् /
दातुमर्हसि विप्रेन्द्र समुत्सार्यार्मवोदकम् //
text_mt: You ought today, O best of brahmins, by your own power / to grant us that foremost holy place, driving back the waters of the ocean.”

sanskrit_iast:
rāma uvāca
etatsarvamaśeṣaṇa viditaṃ me tapodhanāḥ /
karaṇīyaṃ ca vaḥ kṛtyaṃ mayā nātra vicāraṇā //
meaning:
राम उवाच
एतत्सर्वमशेषण विदितं मे तपोधनाः /
करणीयं च वः कृत्यं मया नात्र विचारणा //
text_mt: Rāma said: / “All this is known to me completely, O ascetics, / and your task must be done by me; there is no deliberation about this.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu yuṣmadabhipretaṃ karma loke sudāruṇam /
śastrasaṃgrahaṇācchakyaṃ mayāpi na tadanyathā //
meaning:
किं तु युष्मदभिप्रेतं कर्म लोके सुदारुणम् /
शस्त्रसंग्रहणाच्छक्यं मयापि न तदन्यथा //
text_mt: Yet the deed desired by you is very terrible in this world; / it can be accomplished by me only by taking up a weapon, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
dattasarvābhayo 'haṃ vai nyastaśastraḥ śamānvitaḥ /
tapaḥ samāsthitaścartu prāgeva pitṛ śāsanāt //
meaning:
दत्तसर्वाभयो ऽहं वै न्यस्तशस्त्रः शमान्वितः /
तपः समास्थितश्चर्तु प्रागेव पितृ शासनात् //
text_mt: Having granted freedom from fear to all, having laid down my weapons, endowed with tranquility, / I have undertaken austerity to perform, long ago, by the command of my father.

sanskrit_iast:
na jātu śastragrahaṇaṃ kariṣyāmītyahaṃ purā /
pratiśrutya satāṃ madhye tapaḥ karttumihānaghāḥ //
meaning:
न जातु शस्त्रग्रहणं करिष्यामीत्यहं पुरा /
प्रतिश्रुत्य सतां मध्ये तपः कर्त्तुमिहानघाः //
text_mt: Having promised formerly among good men, ‘I shall never take up a weapon,’ / [I came] here to perform austerity, O sinless ones.

sanskrit_iast:
śastragrahaṇasādhyatvādyuṣmadīpsitavastunaḥ /
kiṅkarttavyaṃ mayātreti mama ḍolāyate manaḥ //
meaning:
शस्त्रग्रहणसाध्यत्वाद्युष्मदीप्सितवस्तुनः /
किङ्कर्त्तव्यं मयात्रेति मम डोलायते मनः //
text_mt: Since the object you desire can only be achieved by taking up a weapon, / my mind wavers as to what should be done by me in this matter.”

sanskrit_iast:
śuṣka upāca /
satāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya śastrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ tu yat /
tannacyāvayate satyadyathoktaṃ brahmaṇā purā //
meaning:
शुष्क उपाच /
सतां संरक्षणार्थाय शस्त्रसंग्रहणं तु यत् /
तन्नच्यावयते सत्यद्यथोक्तं ब्रह्मणा पुरा //
text_mt: Śuṣka said: / “Taking up a weapon for the sake of protecting the good / does not cause one to fall from truth, as was declared formerly by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādasmaddhitārthāya bhavatā grāhyamāyudham /
dharma eva mahāṃstena caritaste bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तस्मादस्मद्धितार्थाय भवता ग्राह्यमायुधम् /
धर्म एव महांस्तेन चरितस्ते भविष्यति //
text_mt: Therefore, a weapon must be taken up by you for our welfare; / by that, a great righteousness will indeed be practiced by you.”

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
evaṃ saṃprārthyamānastu munibhirbhṛgupuṅgavaḥ /
tamanudrutya medhāvī dharmamuddiśya kevalam //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवं संप्रार्थ्यमानस्तु मुनिभिर्भृगुपुङ्गवः /
तमनुद्रुत्य मेधावी धर्ममुद्दिश्य केवलम् //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Thus entreatied by the sages, the wise tiger of the Bhṛgus, / assenting to that solely for the sake of righteousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sa taiḥ saha muniśreṣṭho diśaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām /
samuddiśya cacau rājandraṣṭukāmaḥ saritpatim //
meaning:
स तैः सह मुनिश्रेष्ठो दिशं दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् /
समुद्दिश्य चचौ राजन्द्रष्टुकामः सरित्पतिम् //
text_mt: that best of sages set out with them, O king, facing toward the southwest direction, / desiring to see the lord of rivers [the ocean].

sanskrit_iast:
sa sahyamacalaśreṣṭhamavatīrya bhṛgūdvahaḥ /
tatparaṃ saritāṃ patyustīraṃ prāpa mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
स सह्यमचलश्रेष्ठमवतीर्य भृगूद्वहः /
तत्परं सरितां पत्युस्तीरं प्राप महामनाः //
text_mt: Descending from Mount Sahya, the best of mountains, that scion of Bhṛgu, / great-minded, reached the further shore of the lord of rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dadarśa mahābhāgaḥ parito mārutākulam /
ākaraṃ sarvaratnānāṃ pūryamāṇamanāratam //
meaning:
स ददर्श महाभागः परितो मारुताकुलम् /
आकरं सर्वरत्नानां पूर्यमाणमनारतम् //
text_mt: The illustrious one saw [the ocean] troubled on all sides by the wind, / a mine of all jewels, being constantly filled,

sanskrit_iast:
aparijñeyagāṃbhīryaṃ mahātāmiva mānasam /
duṣpārapāraṃ sarvasya vividhagrahasaṃhatim //
meaning:
अपरिज्ञेयगांभीर्यं महातामिव मानसम् /
दुष्पारपारं सर्वस्य विविधग्रहसंहतिम् //
text_mt: its depth unfathomable like the mind of great beings, / its shore hard for anyone to reach, having a multitude of diverse sea-monsters,

sanskrit_iast:
apradhṛṣya tamaṃ loke dhātāramiva kevalam /
ātmānamiva cātmatve nyakkṛtākhilamuddhatam //
meaning:
अप्रधृष्य तमं लोके धातारमिव केवलम् /
आत्मानमिव चात्मत्वे न्यक्कृताखिलमुद्धतम् //
text_mt: most unassailable in the world, like the sole Creator, / humbling everything haughty, like the Self in its true nature,

sanskrit_iast:
āśrayaṃ sarvasattvānāmāpagānāṃ ca pārthivaḥ /
atyarthacapalottugataraṅgaśatamālinam //
meaning:
आश्रयं सर्वसत्त्वानामापगानां च पार्थिवः /
अत्यर्थचपलोत्तुगतरङ्गशतमालिनम् //
text_mt: the refuge of all creatures and rivers, O king, / garlanded with hundreds of exceedingly restless, towering waves,

sanskrit_iast:
upāntopalasaṃghātakuharāntarasaṃśrayāt /
viśīryamāṇalaharīśataphenaughasobhitam //
meaning:
उपान्तोपलसंघातकुहरान्तरसंश्रयात् /
विशीर्यमाणलहरीशतफेनौघसोभितम् //
text_mt: adorned with a flood of foam from hundreds of breaking billows / clinging within the hollows of rocks on the shore.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṃbhīraghoṣaṃ jaladhiṃ paśyanmunigaṇaiḥ saha /
saṃsevyamānastaralairlaharīkaṇaśītalaiḥ //
meaning:
गंभीरघोषं जलधिं पश्यन्मुनिगणैः सह /
संसेव्यमानस्तरलैर्लहरीकणशीतलैः //
text_mt: Gazing with the company of sages upon the roaring ocean, / refreshed by the cool spray of surging waves,

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrttamiva rājendra tīrenadanadīpateḥ /
viśaśrame mahābāhurdraṣṭukāmaḥ pracetasam //
meaning:
मुहूर्त्तमिव राजेन्द्र तीरेनदनदीपतेः /
विशश्रमे महाबाहुर्द्रष्टुकामः प्रचेतसम् //
text_mt: the mighty-armed one rested for a moment, O best of kings, / upon the shore of the lord of rivers, desiring to see Pracetas.

sanskrit_iast:
tato rāmaḥ samutthāya dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ /
meghagaṃbhirayā vācā varuṇaṃ vākyamabravīt //
meaning:
ततो रामः समुत्थाय दक्षिणाभिमुखः स्थितः /
मेघगंभिरया वाचा वरुणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then Rāma arose, stood facing south, / and spoke to Varuṇa in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ munigaṇaiḥ sārddhamāgatastvaddidṛkṣayā /
tasmātsvarūpadhṛṅmahyaṃ praceto dehi darśanam //
meaning:
अहं मुनिगणैः सार्द्धमागतस्त्वद्दिदृक्षया /
तस्मात्स्वरूपधृङ्मह्यं प्रचेतो देहि दर्शनम् //
text_mt: "I have come along with this host of sages desiring to see you; / therefore, assuming your own form, O Pracetas, grant me a sight of yourself."

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrutvāpi tadvākyaṃ varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ /
na cacāla nijasthānānnṛpa dhīratarastvayam //
meaning:
इति श्रुत्वापि तद्वाक्यं वरुणो यादसां पतिः /
न चचाल निजस्थानान्नृप धीरतरस्त्वयम् //
text_mt: Even upon hearing those words, Varuṇa, the lord of aquatic creatures, / did not stir from his place, O king, being exceedingly steadfast.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punaśca rāmeṇa samāhūto 'pi toyarāṭ /
na dadau darśanaṃ tasmai prativācyaṃ ca nābhyadhāt //
meaning:
पुनः पुनश्च रामेण समाहूतो ऽपि तोयराट् /
न ददौ दर्शनं तस्मै प्रतिवाच्यं च नाभ्यधात् //
text_mt: Though summoned again and again by Rāma, the king of waters / did not appear before him, nor did he offer an answer.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅghanīyaṃ tadvākyaṃ varuṇenāvadhīritam /
atyantamiti kāryārthī viduṣā samupekṣitam //
meaning:
अलङ्घनीयं तद्वाक्यं वरुणेनावधीरितम् /
अत्यन्तमिति कार्यार्थी विदुषा समुपेक्षितम् //
text_mt: Finding his incontrovertible command disregarded by Varuṇa / and utterly neglected by the wise one, the seeker of his purpose [grew furious].

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pracetasā vākyaṃ manyamāno 'vadhīritam /
cukopa tamabhiprekṣya rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रचेतसा वाक्यं मन्यमानो ऽवधीरितम् /
चुकोप तमभिप्रेक्ष्य रामः शस्त्रभृतां वरः //
text_mt: Then, considering his speech slighted by Pracetas, / Rāma, the best of weapon-bearers, looked toward him and grew enraged.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣubdhasāgarākāraḥ sa tadā svabalāśrayāt /
nistoyamarṇavaṃ kartumiyeṣa ruṣito bhṛśam //
meaning:
संक्षुब्धसागराकारः स तदा स्वबलाश्रयात् /
निस्तोयमर्णवं कर्तुमियेष रुषितो भृशम् //
text_mt: Assuming the likeness of an agitated ocean, / relying then upon his own might, he was greatly angered and resolved to make the ocean waterless.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jalamupaspṛśya samīpe vijayaṃ dhanuḥ /
tataḥ praṇamya manasā śarvaṃ rāmo mahāddhanuḥ //
meaning:
ततो जलमुपस्पृश्य समीपे विजयं धनुः /
ततः प्रणम्य मनसा शर्वं रामो महाद्धनुः //
text_mt: Then, having sipped water, Rāma took up near him / his great bow Vijaya, and having bowed in mind to Śarva,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvāropayāmāsa krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ /
abhimṛśya dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ saguṇaṃ bhṛgusattamaḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वारोपयामास क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः /
अभिमृश्य धनुःश्रेष्ठं सगुणं भृगुसत्तमः //
text_mt: his eyes reddened with rage, he strung it; / having touched that excellent strung bow, the best of the Bhṛgus

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jyāghoṣamakarottadā /
jyāghoṣaḥ śuśruve tasya divispṛgatiniṣṭhuraḥ //
meaning:
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां ज्याघोषमकरोत्तदा /
ज्याघोषः शुश्रुवे तस्य दिविस्पृगतिनिष्ठुरः //
text_mt: twanged the bowstring as all beings looked on; / the twang of his bowstring was heard, touching the sky, exceedingly harsh,

sanskrit_iast:
cacāla nikhilāyena saptadvīpārmavā mahī /
tataḥ sarabhasaṃ rāmaścāpe kālānalopamam //
meaning:
चचाल निखिलायेन सप्तद्वीपार्मवा मही /
ततः सरभसं रामश्चापे कालानलोपमम् //
text_mt: by which the entire earth with its seven continents and oceans trembled. / Then swiftly upon the bow Rāma fitted an excellent arrow,

sanskrit_iast:
suvarmapuṅkhaṃ viśikhaṃ saṃdadhe śarasattamam /
tasminnastraṃ mahāghoraṃ bhārgavaṃ vahnidaivatam //
meaning:
सुवर्मपुङ्खं विशिखं संदधे शरसत्तमम् /
तस्मिन्नस्त्रं महाघोरं भार्गवं वह्निदैवतम् //
text_mt: resembling the fire of destruction, having golden feathers; / upon it the tiger among the Bhṛgus joined the most dreadful

sanskrit_iast:
yuyoja bhṛguśārdūlaḥ samantrābhyāsamokṣaṇam /
tataścacāla vasudhā saśailavanakānanā //
meaning:
युयोज भृगुशार्दूलः समन्त्राभ्यासमोक्षणम् /
ततश्चचाल वसुधा सशैलवनकानना //
text_mt: Bhārgava missile, whose presiding deity is fire, / with the recitation of mantras for its discharge; then the earth trembled with its mountains, forests, and groves.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣobhaṃ paramaṃ jagmurdevāsuramahoragāḥ /
saṃdhitāstraṃ bhṛguśreṣṭhaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanam //
meaning:
प्रक्षोभं परमं जग्मुर्देवासुरमहोरगाः /
संधितास्त्रं भृगुश्रेष्ठं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनम् //
text_mt: The gods, asuras, and great serpents fell into supreme agitation. / Seeing the best of the Bhṛgus with the missile aimed and his eyes reddened with wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saṃbhrāntamanaso babhūvuḥ sacarācarāḥ /
sadigdāhabhrapaṭalairabhavansaṃvṛtā diśaḥ //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा संभ्रान्तमनसो बभूवुः सचराचराः /
सदिग्दाहभ्रपटलैरभवन्संवृता दिशः //
text_mt: [all beings] with the moving and unmoving were bewildered in mind; / the quarters were covered with masses of clouds like burning horizons.

sanskrit_iast:
vavuśca paruṣā vātā rajovyāptā mahāravāḥ /
mandaraśmiraśītāṃśurabhūtasaṃraktamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
ववुश्च परुषा वाता रजोव्याप्ता महारवाः /
मन्दरश्मिरशीतांशुरभूतसंरक्तमण्डलः //
text_mt: Harsh winds blew, filled with dust, roaring loudly; / the sun became dim of rays, with its disc turned blood-red.

sanskrit_iast:
solkāpātāśanirvṛṣṭirbabhūva rudhirodakā /
kimetaditi saṃbhrāntā dhūmodgārātibhīṣaṇam //
meaning:
सोल्कापाताशनिर्वृष्टिर्बभूव रुधिरोदका /
किमेतदिति संभ्रान्ता धूमोद्गारातिभीषणम् //
text_mt: There fell showers of meteors and thunderbolts, with water of blood. / Bewildered, [all creatures wondered], "What is this?" as he drew the great arrow,

sanskrit_iast:
adhiropitadivyāstraṃ pracakarṣa mahāśaram /
dhanurvikarṣamāṇaṃ taṃ sphurajjvālāgrasāyakam //
meaning:
अधिरोपितदिव्यास्त्रं प्रचकर्ष महाशरम् /
धनुर्विकर्षमाणं तं स्फुरज्ज्वालाग्रसायकम् //
text_mt: most terrifying with emissions of smoke, upon which the divine missile was charged; / as he drew the bow, with the glittering flame at the tip of his arrow,

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśurmunayo rāmaṃ kalpāntānalasannibham /
ākarṇākṛṣṭakodaṇḍamaṇḍalābhyaṃ tarasthitam //
meaning:
ददृशुर्मुनयो रामं कल्पान्तानलसन्निभम् /
आकर्णाकृष्टकोदण्डमण्डलाभ्यं तरस्थितम् //
text_mt: the sages beheld Rāma resembling the fire at the end of an eon, / standing within the circle of the bow drawn up to his ear.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pratibhayākāraṃ duṣprāpamabhavadvapuḥ /
vikṛṣṭadhanuṣastasya rūpamugraṃ raveriva //
meaning:
तस्य प्रतिभयाकारं दुष्प्रापमभवद्वपुः /
विकृष्टधनुषस्तस्य रूपमुग्रं रवेरिव //
text_mt: His form became terrible to behold and difficult to approach; / the form of him with his bow drawn back was fierce like the sun

sanskrit_iast:
kalpānte 'bhyuditasyeva maṇḍalaṃ pariveṣitam /
kalpāntāgnasamajvālābhīṣaṇaṃ sphurato vapuḥ //
meaning:
कल्पान्ते ऽभ्युदितस्येव मण्डलं परिवेषितम् /
कल्पान्ताग्नसमज्वालाभीषणं स्फुरतो वपुः //
text_mt: risen at the end of an eon with an encircling halo; / his blazing form, terrifying with flames equal to the fire at the end of an eon,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyālakṣyata cakramya hareriva ca maṇḍalam /
sphuratkrodhānalajvālāparītasyātiraudratām //
meaning:
तस्यालक्ष्यत चक्रम्य हरेरिव च मण्डलम् /
स्फुरत्क्रोधानलज्वालापरीतस्यातिरौद्रताम् //
text_mt: appeared like the disc of Hari's cakra; / surrounded by flaring flames of anger-fire, it assumed an exceedingly fierce aspect,

sanskrit_iast:
avāpa viṣṇoḥ sa tadā narasiṃhākṛteriva /
vapurvikṛṣṭacāpasya bhṛkuṭīkuṭilānanam //
meaning:
अवाप विष्णोः स तदा नरसिंहाकृतेरिव /
वपुर्विकृष्टचापस्य भृकुटीकुटिलाननम् //
text_mt: like the form of Viṣṇu in the shape of Narasiṃha; / with his bow drawn back and his face frowning with arched brows,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasyābhūdbhavasyeva didhakṣostripuraṃ purā /
jājvalyamānavapuṣaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā bhayāt //
meaning:
रामस्याभूद्भवस्येव दिधक्षोस्त्रिपुरं पुरा /
जाज्वल्यमानवपुषं तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा भयात् //
text_mt: Rāma became like Bhava of old, desiring to burn Tripura. / Seeing him of intensely blazing body, out of sudden fear,

sanskrit_iast:
prasīda jaya rāmeti tuṣṭuvurmunayo 'khilāḥ /
tato 'strāgnisphuraddhūmapaṭalaiḥ śakalīkṛtam //
meaning:
प्रसीद जय रामेति तुष्टुवुर्मुनयो ऽखिलाः /
ततो ऽस्त्राग्निस्फुरद्धूमपटलैः शकलीकृतम् //
text_mt: all the sages praised him: "Be gracious! Be victorious, O Rāma!" / Then, torn by masses of smoke glowing with the missile's fire,

sanskrit_iast:
babhūva cchannamaṃbhodherantaḥ puramaśaiṣataḥ /
jvaladastrānalajvālāpa ritāpaparāhataḥ //
meaning:
बभूव च्छन्नमंभोधेरन्तः पुरमशैषतः /
ज्वलदस्त्रानलज्वालाप रितापपराहतः //
text_mt: the entire inner realm of the ocean was completely obscured; / struck by the intense torment of the blazing fire of the missile,

sanskrit_iast:
atyaricyata saṃbhrāntasalilaugha udanvataḥ /
timiṅgilatimigrāhanakramatsyāhikacchapāḥ //
meaning:
अत्यरिच्यत संभ्रान्तसलिलौघ उदन्वतः /
तिमिङ्गिलतिमिग्राहनक्रमत्स्याहिकच्छपाः //
text_mt: the ocean's bewildered mass of water surged beyond measure; / the timiṅgilas, timis, alligators, crocodiles, fish, serpents, and turtles—

sanskrit_iast:
prajagmuḥ paramāmārttiṃ prāṇinaḥ salileśayāḥ /
utpatannipatattāmyannānāsattvoddhatormibhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रजग्मुः परमामार्त्तिं प्राणिनः सलिलेशयाः /
उत्पतन्निपतत्ताम्यन्नानासत्त्वोद्धतोर्मिभिः //
text_mt: the creatures living in the water fell into supreme agony; / leaping up, plunging down, and fainting, with waves tossed high by various creatures,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣobhaṃ bhṛśamaṃbhodhiḥ sahasā samupāgamat /
trāsarāsaṃ ca vipulamaṃbhasā plavatā saha //
meaning:
प्रक्षोभं भृशमंभोधिः सहसा समुपागमत् /
त्रासरासं च विपुलमंभसा प्लवता सह //
text_mt: the ocean suddenly reached an extreme agitation; / with its floating waters accompanied by immense terror and confusion,

sanskrit_iast:
udvelatāmitastaptāḥ salilāntaracāriṇaḥ /
tatastasmāccharājjvālāḥ phūtkṛtāśeṣa bhīṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
उद्वेलतामितस्तप्ताः सलिलान्तरचारिणः /
ततस्तस्माच्छराज्ज्वालाः फूत्कृताशेष भीषणाः //
text_mt: the dwellers of the deep waters were scorched and overflowed on all sides. / Then from that arrow, flames terrifying with complete hissing,

sanskrit_iast:
nirūpitamiva vyaktaṃ niśceruḥ sarvato diśam /
tataḥ pracaṇḍapavanaiḥ sarvataḥ parivarttitam //
meaning:
निरूपितमिव व्यक्तं निश्चेरुः सर्वतो दिशम् /
ततः प्रचण्डपवनैः सर्वतः परिवर्त्तितम् //
text_mt: as if clearly ordained, burst forth in every direction; / then, whirled on all sides by violent gales,

sanskrit_iast:
agnijvālāmayaṃ raktavitānābhamalakṣyata /
pralayābdherivātyarthamastrāgnivyākulāṃbhasaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निज्वालामयं रक्तवितानाभमलक्ष्यत /
प्रलयाब्धेरिवात्यर्थमस्त्राग्निव्याकुलांभसः //
text_mt: it appeared like a red canopy composed of flames of fire; / its waters greatly churned by the fire of the missile as if of the ocean of dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
samudriktatayā tasya taraṅgāstīramabhyayuḥ /
astrāgnividdhākulitajalaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā //
meaning:
समुद्रिक्ततया तस्य तरङ्गास्तीरमभ्ययुः /
अस्त्राग्निविद्धाकुलितजलघोषेण भूयसा //
text_mt: its surging waves rushed toward the shore; / with the tremendous roar of its waters agitated and struck by the fire of the missile,

sanskrit_iast:
kakubho badhirīkuvannalakṣyata payonidhiḥ /
parito 'strānalajvālāparivītajalāvilaḥ //
meaning:
ककुभो बधिरीकुवन्नलक्ष्यत पयोनिधिः /
परितो ऽस्त्रानलज्वालापरिवीतजलाविलः //
text_mt: the ocean appeared to deafen the directions; / with its turbid waters encircled on all sides by flames of the missile's fire,

sanskrit_iast:
jagāma paramāmārttiṃ sahyaḥ sadyastadāśrayaḥ /
ākarṇākṛṣṭakodaṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ payonidhiḥ //
meaning:
जगाम परमामार्त्तिं सह्यः सद्यस्तदाश्रयः /
आकर्णाकृष्टकोदण्डं दृष्ट्वा रामं पयोनिधिः //
text_mt: the Sahya mountain, being its refuge, immediately fell into supreme distress. / Seeing Rāma with his bow drawn back to his ear, the ocean

sanskrit_iast:
viṣādamagamattīvraṃ yamaṃ dṛṣṭveva pātakī /
bhayakaṃpitasarvāṅgastato nadanadīpatiḥ //
meaning:
विषादमगमत्तीव्रं यमं दृष्ट्वेव पातकी /
भयकंपितसर्वाङ्गस्ततो नदनदीपतिः //
text_mt: fell into intense despair, as a sinner seeing Yama; / with all his limbs trembling from fear, the lord of rivers then,

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya sahajaṃ dhairyaṃ bhīrutvaṃ samupāgamat /
tataḥ svarūpamāsthāya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
विहाय सहजं धैर्यं भीरुत्वं समुपागमत् /
ततः स्वरूपमास्थाय सर्वाभरणभूषितः //
text_mt: abandoning his natural steadfastness, succumbed to fear. / Then, assuming his true form, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
uttīryamāṇaḥ svajalaṃ varuṇaḥ pratyadṛśyata /
kṛtāñjaliḥ sārvahastaḥ pracetā bhārgavāntikam //
meaning:
उत्तीर्यमाणः स्वजलं वरुणः प्रत्यदृश्यत /
कृताञ्जलिः सार्वहस्तः प्रचेता भार्गवान्तिकम् //
text_mt: Varuṇa was seen emerging from his waters; / with joined palms, both hands folded, Pracetas approached the Bhārgava

sanskrit_iast:
tvarayābhyāyāyau śīghrasāyakādbhītabhītavat /
abhyetyākṛṣṭadhanuṣaḥ sa tasya caraṇābjayoḥ //
meaning:
त्वरयाभ्यायायौ शीघ्रसायकाद्भीतभीतवत् /
अभ्येत्याकृष्टधनुषः स तस्य चरणाब्जयोः //
text_mt: in haste, coming quickly as one terrified of the arrow; / coming before him, whose bow was drawn, [he fell] at his lotus feet,

sanskrit_iast:
abravīcca bhṛśaṃ bhītaḥ saṃbhramākulitākṣaram /
rakṣa māṃ bhṛguśārdūla kṛpayā śaraṇāgatam //
meaning:
अब्रवीच्च भृशं भीतः संभ्रमाकुलिताक्षरम् /
रक्ष मां भृगुशार्दूल कृपया शरणागतम् //
text_mt: and, exceedingly afraid, spoke in words confused with agitation: / "Protect me, O tiger of the Bhṛgus! Have mercy on me who have sought your refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
aparādhamimaṃ rāma mayā kṛtamajānatā /
sthito 'smi tava nirdeśeśādhi kiṃ karavāṇi vai //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe madhyamabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde bhārgavaṃ prati varuṇāgamanaṃ nāma saptapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 57//
meaning:
अपराधमिमं राम मया कृतमजानता /
स्थितो ऽस्मि तव निर्देशेशाधि किं करवाणि वै //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे मध्यमभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवं प्रति वरुणागमनं नाम सप्तपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 57//
text_mt:
This offense was committed by me out of ignorance, O Rāma. / I stand at your command; instruct me, what indeed shall I do?"

Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, named "The Coming of Varuṇa to the Bhārgava", in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ varuṇaṃ vilokya patitaṃ bhuvi /
saṃjahāra punardhīmānastraṃ mṛgukulodvahaḥ //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
एवं ब्रुवाणं वरुणं विलोक्य पतितं भुवि /
संजहार पुनर्धीमानस्त्रं मृगुकुलोद्वहः //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Seeing Varuṇa speaking thus and fallen on the ground, / the wise scion of Bhṛgu's lineage withdrew his weapon once again.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtdṛtāstrastato rāmo varuṇaṃ purataḥ sthiram /
vilokya bigatakrodhastamuvāca hasanniva //
meaning:
संत्दृतास्त्रस्ततो रामो वरुणं पुरतः स्थिरम् /
विलोक्य बिगतक्रोधस्तमुवाच हसन्निव //
text_mt: His weapon withdrawn, Rāma then beheld Varuṇa standing firm before him; / his anger departed, he spoke to him as if smiling:

sanskrit_iast:
gokarṇanilayāḥ pūrvamimemāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ /
samāyātā mahendrādrau nivasaṃtaṃ saritpate //
meaning:
गोकर्णनिलयाः पूर्वमिमेमां मुनिपुङ्गवाः /
समायाता महेन्द्राद्रौ निवसंतं सरित्पते //
text_mt: “O lord of rivers, these foremost sages, dwellers of Gokarṇa, / previously came to me while I was residing on Mount Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast:
tvattoye medinīṃ pūrvaṃ khanadbhiḥ sagarātmajaiḥ /
adho nipātitaṃ kṣetraṃ gokarṇamṛṣisevitam //
meaning:
त्वत्तोये मेदिनीं पूर्वं खनद्भिः सगरात्मजैः /
अधो निपातितं क्षेत्रं गोकर्णमृषिसेवितम् //
text_mt: Formerly, by the sons of Sagara digging the earth into your waters, / the sacred field of Gokarṇa, frequented by sages, was cast down.

sanskrit_iast:
upalabdhumime bhūyaḥ kṣetraṃ tadbhavavallabham /
adhāvanmāmupāgamya munayastīrthavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
उपलब्धुमिमे भूयः क्षेत्रं तद्भववल्लभम् /
अधावन्मामुपागम्य मुनयस्तीर्थवासिनः //
text_mt: In order to recover once again that sacred field dear to Bhava, / these sages, dwellers of the holy place, ran and approached me.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmarthe tataḥ so 'haṃ mahendrādacalottamāt /
bhavantamāgato draṣṭuṃ sahaibhirmunipuṅgavaiḥ //
meaning:
एषामर्थे ततः सो ऽहं महेन्द्रादचलोत्तमात् /
भवन्तमागतो द्रष्टुं सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः //
text_mt: For their sake, therefore, I have come from Mount Mahendra, the best of mountains, / together with these foremost sages, to see you.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmadarthe salilaṃ samutsāryātmano bhavān /
dātumarhati tatkṣetrameṣāṃ toye ca pūrvavat //
meaning:
तस्मान्मदर्थे सलिलं समुत्सार्यात्मनो भवान् /
दातुमर्हति तत्क्षेत्रमेषां तोये च पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: Therefore, for my sake, pushing back your waters, / you ought to grant them that sacred field in the waters as before.”

sanskrit_iast:
jaiminiruvāca
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ /
nirūpya manasā rāmamida bhūyo 'bravīdvacaḥ //
meaning:
जैमिनिरुवाच
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वरुणो यादसां पतिः /
निरूप्य मनसा राममिद भूयो ऽब्रवीद्वचः //
text_mt: Jaimini said: / Having heard his speech, Varuṇa, the lord of aquatic creatures, / reflecting upon Rāma in his mind, spoke these words in reply:

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇa uvāca
na śakyamutsārayituṃ madaṃbhaḥ kenacidbhavet /
tathā hi me varo dattaḥ purānena viriñcinā //
meaning:
वरुण उवाच
न शक्यमुत्सारयितुं मदंभः केनचिद्भवेत् /
तथा हि मे वरो दत्तः पुरानेन विरिञ्चिना //
text_mt: Varuṇa said: / “It would not be possible for anyone to drive back my waters; / for indeed a boon was granted to me in ancient times by Viriñci.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'haṃ tvattejasedārīṃ vihāya sahajāṃ dhṛtim /
kātaraṃ samupāyāto vaśatāṃ tava bhārgava //
meaning:
सो ऽहं त्वत्तेजसेदारीं विहाय सहजां धृतिम् /
कातरं समुपायातो वशतां तव भार्गव //
text_mt: Yet, by your fiery energy, abandoning my innate resolve now, / I have fallen into panic and come under your sway, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmarthe viśeṣaṇa bhavatā paricoditaḥ /
kathaṃ na kuryāṃ karmedamahaṃ kṣattrakulāntaka //
meaning:
एषामर्थे विशेषण भवता परिचोदितः /
कथं न कुर्यां कर्मेदमहं क्षत्त्रकुलान्तक //
text_mt: Urged especially by you for their sake, / how could I not perform this deed, O terminator of the Kṣatriya race?

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyāvatpramāṇaṃ me bhavānsaṃkalpayiṣyati /
tāvatsaṃghārayiṣyāmi bhūmau salilamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्माद्यावत्प्रमाणं मे भवान्संकल्पयिष्यति /
तावत्संघारयिष्यामि भूमौ सलिलमात्मनः //
text_mt: Therefore, however far a measure you shall determine for me, / to that extent I will gather back my water upon the earth.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā sa sāyakam /
yathāgataṃ pracikṣepa dhanurnirbhidya bhārgavaḥ //
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तथेत्युक्त्वा स सायकम् /
यथागतं प्रचिक्षेप धनुर्निर्भिद्य भार्गवः //
text_mt: Hearing his speech and saying “So be it,” that Bhārgava, / having bent his bow, shot the arrow in the direction from which it had come.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nirūpya sīmānaṃ darśayāno mahīpate /
sruvaṃ jagrāha matimānkṣaptukāmo jalāśaye //
meaning:
ततो निरूप्य सीमानं दर्शयानो महीपते /
स्रुवं जग्राह मतिमान्क्षप्तुकामो जलाशये //
text_mt: Then, having determined the boundary, demonstrating it, O king, / the wise one took up a sacrificial ladle, intending to cast it into the reservoir of water.

sanskrit_iast:
prasannacetasaṃ rāmaṃ gataroṣamathātmani /
antarhite sarinnāthe rāmaḥ suvamudaṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसन्नचेतसं रामं गतरोषमथात्मनि /
अन्तर्हिते सरिन्नाथे रामः सुवमुदङ्मुखः //
text_mt: When the lord of rivers had vanished, seeing that Rāma's mind was pleased / and his anger toward him had subsided, Rāma, facing north,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayitvātivegena cikṣepa lavaṇārṇave /
kṣiptatvena samudre tu diśamuttarapaścimām //
meaning:
भ्रामयित्वातिवेगेन चिक्षेप लवणार्णवे /
क्षिप्तत्वेन समुद्रे तु दिशमुत्तरपश्चिमाम् //
text_mt: swung the ladle with great speed and cast it into the salt sea; / by being cast into the ocean toward the north-west direction,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā sruvopatadrājanyojanānāṃ śatadvayam /
tīrthaṃ śurpārakaṃ nāma sarvapāpavimocanam //
meaning:
गत्वा स्रुवोपतद्राजन्योजनानां शतद्वयम् /
तीर्थं शुर्पारकं नाम सर्वपापविमोचनम् //
text_mt: the ladle flew, O king, and fell two hundred yojanas away, / at the sacred place named Śūrpāraka, which frees from all sins,

sanskrit_iast:
viśrutaṃ yattrilokeṣu tīre nadanadīpateḥ /
tīrthaṃ tadantarīkṛtya sruvo rāmakarāccyutaḥ //
meaning:
विश्रुतं यत्त्रिलोकेषु तीरे नदनदीपतेः /
तीर्थं तदन्तरीकृत्य स्रुवो रामकराच्च्युतः //
text_mt: renowned throughout the three worlds on the shore of the lord of rivers and streams. / Having embraced that holy place, the ladle fallen from Rāma’s hand

sanskrit_iast:
nipapāta mahārāja sūcayanrāmavikramam /
yatrābhūdrāmasṛṣṭāyā bhuvo niṣṭhātha pārthiva //
meaning:
निपपात महाराज सूचयन्रामविक्रमम् /
यत्राभूद्रामसृष्टाया भुवो निष्ठाथ पार्थिव //
text_mt: fell down, O great king, indicating Rāma's valor, / where the boundary of the land created by Rāma was established, O ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaṃ śūrpārakaṃ tattu śrīmallokapariśrutam /
utsārayitvā salilaṃ samudrastāvadātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थं शूर्पारकं तत्तु श्रीमल्लोकपरिश्रुतम् /
उत्सारयित्वा सलिलं समुद्रस्तावदात्मनः //
text_mt: That is the splendid sacred place Śūrpāraka, celebrated throughout the worlds. / Having driven back its own waters to that extent,

sanskrit_iast:
atiṣṭhadapasṛtyorvīṃ dattvā rāmāya pārthiva /
anatikrāntamaryādo yathākālaṃ bhṛgūdvahaḥ //
meaning:
अतिष्ठदपसृत्योर्वीं दत्त्वा रामाय पार्थिव /
अनतिक्रान्तमर्यादो यथाकालं भृगूद्वहः //
text_mt: the ocean retreated and stood still, having yielded the earth to Rāma, O ruler of the earth; / and the scion of Bhṛgu, never transgressing the proper bounds, in due course

sanskrit_iast:
samayaṃ svāpayāmāsa tasyaivānumate bhuvi /
vijñāya pūrvasīmāntāṃ bhuvamabhyutsasarja ha //
meaning:
समयं स्वापयामास तस्यैवानुमते भुवि /
विज्ञाय पूर्वसीमान्तां भुवमभ्युत्ससर्ज ह //
text_mt: established the covenant on earth with his consent alone, / and, recognizing the former boundaries, released the land.

sanskrit_iast:
vyasmayanta surāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam /
nagaragramasīmānaḥ kiñcitkiñcitkvacitkvacit //
meaning:
व्यस्मयन्त सुराः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम् /
नगरग्रमसीमानः किञ्चित्किञ्चित्क्वचित्क्वचित् //
text_mt: All the gods were amazed, seeing the valor of Rāma; / the boundaries of towns and villages [appeared] little by little, here and there.

sanskrit_iast:
sahye tu pūrvavattasminnabdherapasṛteṃ'bhasi /
tatra daivāttathā sthānānnimnatvātsa pralakṣya tu //
meaning:
सह्ये तु पूर्ववत्तस्मिन्नब्धेरपसृतेंऽभसि /
तत्र दैवात्तथा स्थानान्निम्नत्वात्स प्रलक्ष्य तु //
