text_mt: When the water of the ocean had retreated on the Sahya mountain as before, / observing the low-lying parts due to destiny and location,

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣāṃ bhṛguśreṣṭho munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām /
yathābhilaṣitaṃ sthānaṃ pradadau prītipūrvakam //
meaning:
ततस्तेषां भृगुश्रेष्ठो मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् /
यथाभिलषितं स्थानं प्रददौ प्रीतिपूर्वकम् //
text_mt: the best of the Bhṛgus then gave to those sages of cultivated minds / the place as desired, out of affection.

sanskrit_iast:
tataste munayaḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahātānvitāḥ /
kṛtakṛtyā bhṛśaṃ rāmamāśiṣā samapūjayan //
meaning:
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे हर्षेण महातान्विताः /
कृतकृत्या भृशं राममाशिषा समपूजयन् //
text_mt: Then all those sages, filled with great joy, / having accomplished their purpose, abundantly honored Rāma with blessings.

sanskrit_iast:
athaitairabhyanujñāto yayau prāptamanorathaḥ /
gate munivare rāme deśāttasmānnijāśramam //
meaning:
अथैतैरभ्यनुज्ञातो ययौ प्राप्तमनोरथः /
गते मुनिवरे रामे देशात्तस्मान्निजाश्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, permitted by them, having attained his desire, he departed. / When Rāma, the best of sages, had gone from that place to his own hermitage,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhūya munayaḥ sarve prajagmustīramaṃbudheḥ /
paricaṅkramya tāṃ bhūmiṃ yatnena mahātānvitāḥ //
meaning:
संभूय मुनयः सर्वे प्रजग्मुस्तीरमंबुधेः /
परिचङ्क्रम्य तां भूमिं यत्नेन महातान्विताः //
text_mt: all the sages assembled and went to the shore of the ocean; / wandering all around that land with great effort,

sanskrit_iast:
dadṛśuḥ sarvato rājanhyarmavāntaḥ sthitāṃ mahīm /
nityatvā tsarvadevānāmadhiṣṭhānatayā tathā //
meaning:
ददृशुः सर्वतो राजन्ह्यर्मवान्तः स्थितां महीम् /
नित्यत्वा त्सर्वदेवानामधिष्ठानतया तथा //
text_mt: they saw the earth situated everywhere within the waters, O king. / Because of its permanence and being the abode of all gods,

sanskrit_iast:
kātamabdhau nipatitaṃ naṣṭatoyaṃ ciroṣitam /
api rudraprabhāvema prāyānnātyantaviplavam //
meaning:
कातमब्धौ निपतितं नष्टतोयं चिरोषितम् /
अपि रुद्रप्रभावेम प्रायान्नात्यन्तविप्लवम् //
text_mt: although fallen into the ocean, deprived of water, and having dwelt there long, / by the power of Rudra it did not undergo total destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tatteyaniḥsṛtaṃ kṣetramabhūtpūrvavadeva hi /
etaddhi devasāmarthyamacintyaṃ nṛpasattama //
meaning:
तत्तेयनिःसृतं क्षेत्रमभूत्पूर्ववदेव हि /
एतद्धि देवसामर्थ्यमचिन्त्यं नृपसत्तम //
text_mt: That sacred field emerged from the water and became just as it was before; / for this power of the gods is inconceivable, O best of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rāmeṇa jaladheḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭā vasuṃdharā /
dakṣiṇottarato rājanayojanānāṃ catuḥśatam //
meaning:
एवं रामेण जलधेः पुनः सृष्टा वसुंधरा /
दक्षिणोत्तरतो राजनयोजनानां चतुःशतम् //
text_mt: Thus the earth was recreated from the ocean by Rāma / four hundred yojanas from south to north, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
nātikrāmati so 'dyāpi sīmānaṃ payasāṃ nidhiḥ /
kṛtaṃ rāmeṇa mahatā na tu sajjaṃ mahaddhanuḥ //
meaning:
नातिक्रामति सो ऽद्यापि सीमानं पयसां निधिः /
कृतं रामेण महता न तु सज्जं महद्धनुः //
text_mt: Even today, that receptacle of waters does not overstep the boundary / made by the great Rāma, without even stringing his great bow.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhāvo rāmo 'sau sagaraśca mahīpatiḥ /
yasya putrairayaṃ khaṇḍo bhārato 'bdhau nipatitaḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रभावो रामो ऽसौ सगरश्च महीपतिः /
यस्य पुत्रैरयं खण्डो भारतो ऽब्धौ निपतितः //
text_mt: Such was the power of this Rāma and of King Sagara, / by whose sons this tract of Bhārata was cast into the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ sahasrantu varddhitaśca mahodadhiḥ /
rāmeṇābhūtpunaḥ sṛṣṭaṃ yojanānāṃ tu ṣaṭśatam //
meaning:
योजनानां सहस्रन्तु वर्द्धितश्च महोदधिः /
रामेणाभूत्पुनः सृष्टं योजनानां तु षट्शतम् //
text_mt: The great ocean was enlarged by a thousand yojanas; / but six hundred yojanas were recreated by Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
sagarasya sutairyasmādvarddhito makarālayaḥ /
tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu sāgarākhyāmavāptavān //
meaning:
सगरस्य सुतैर्यस्माद्वर्द्धितो मकरालयः /
ततः प्रभृति लोकेषु सागराख्यामवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Because the abode of sea monsters was expanded by the sons of Sagara, / from that time onward in the worlds it obtained the name Sāgara.

sanskrit_iast:
etatte 'bhihitaṃ samyaṅmahataścaritaṃ mayā /
rāmasya kārttavīryasya sagarasya mahīpateḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokta madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upāddhātapāde 'ṣṭapañcaśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 58//
meaning:
एतत्ते ऽभिहितं सम्यङ्महतश्चरितं मया /
रामस्य कार्त्तवीर्यस्य सगरस्य महीपतेः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्त मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपाद्धातपादे ऽष्टपञ्चशत्तमो ऽध्यायः // 58//
text_mt:
Thus the deeds of the great Rāma, of Kārttavīrya, / and of King Sagara have been related to you properly by me.

Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter in the Upoddhātapāda, the third part of the middle section, spoken by Vāyu, in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
ṛṣayastveva muktāstu paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ /
paraṃ śuśrūṣayā bhūyaḥ papracchustadanantaram //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
ऋषयस्त्वेव मुक्तास्तु परं हर्षमुपागताः /
परं शुश्रूषया भूयः पप्रच्छुस्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Having been spoken to thus, the sages attained supreme joy, / and immediately thereafter, out of great desire to hear, asked again:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vaṃśānāmānupūrvyeṇa rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām /
sthitiṃ caiṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ ca brūhi naḥ paripṛcchatām //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
वंशानामानुपूर्व्येण राज्ञां चामिततेजसाम् /
स्थितिं चैषां प्रभावं च ब्रूहि नः परिपृच्छताम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / “Tell us, who are inquiring, the orderly succession of dynasties / of kings of boundless splendor, and their stability and power.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktastatastaistu tadāsau lomaharṣaṇaḥ /
śṛṇvatāmuttarākhyāne ṛṣīṇāṃ vākya kovidaḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तैस्तु तदासौ लोमहर्षणः /
शृण्वतामुत्तराख्याने ऋषीणां वाक्य कोविदः //
text_mt: Addressed thus by them, that Lomaharṣaṇa, / skilled in speech, to the sages listening to the subsequent narrative,

sanskrit_iast:
akhyānakuśalo bhūyaḥ paraṃ vākyamuvāca ha /
bruvato me nibodhaṃśca ṛṣirāha yathā mama //
meaning:
अख्यानकुशलो भूयः परं वाक्यमुवाच ह /
ब्रुवतो मे निबोधंश्च ऋषिराह यथा मम //
text_mt: well-versed in ancient narratives, spoke this further speech: / “Listen to me as I speak, as the sage recounted to me.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśānāmānupūrvyeṇa rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām /
sthitiṃ caiṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ ca kramato me nibodhata //
meaning:
वंशानामानुपूर्व्येण राज्ञां चामिततेजसाम् /
स्थितिं चैषां प्रभावं च क्रमतो मे निबोधत //
text_mt: Understand from me in sequence the orderly succession of dynasties / of kings of boundless splendor, their duration, and their power.”

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇasya sapatnīkān stutā devī udāhṛtā /
tasyāḥ putrau kalirvaidyaḥ stutā ca surasuṃdarī //
meaning:
वरुणस्य सपत्नीकान् स्तुता देवी उदाहृता /
तस्याः पुत्रौ कलिर्वैद्यः स्तुता च सुरसुंदरी //
text_mt: Varuṇa's wife is praised as the goddess Stutā. / Her sons were Kali and Vaidya, and their praised [daughter] was Surasundarī.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliputrau mahāvīryauṃ jayaśca vijayaśca ha /
vaidyaputrau ghṛṇiścaiva muniścaiva mahābalau //
meaning:
कलिपुत्रौ महावीर्यौं जयश्च विजयश्च ह /
वैद्यपुत्रौ घृणिश्चैव मुनिश्चैव महाबलौ //
text_mt: The two sons of Kali were the heroic Jaya and Vijaya. / The two sons of Vaidya were Ghṛṇi and Muni, endowed with great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
prattānāmanu kāmānāmanyonyasya prabhakṣiṇau /
bhakṣyitvā tāvanyonyaṃ vināśaṃ samavāpnutaḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्तानामनु कामानामन्योन्यस्य प्रभक्षिणौ /
भक्ष्यित्वा तावन्योन्यं विनाशं समवाप्नुतः //
text_mt: Devouring each other in accordance with their natural desires, / having eaten one another, the two met with destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliḥ surāyāḥ saṃjñeyastasya putro madaḥ smṛtaḥ /
smṛtā hiṃsā kalerbhāryā śreṣṭhā yā nikṛtasmṛtiḥ //
meaning:
कलिः सुरायाः संज्ञेयस्तस्य पुत्रो मदः स्मृतः /
स्मृता हिंसा कलेर्भार्या श्रेष्ठा या निकृतस्मृतिः //
text_mt: Kali is known as [the son] of Surā, and his son is remembered as Mada. / Hiṃsā is remembered as the wife of Kali, the foremost of which is Nikṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
prasūtānye kaleḥ putrāścatvāraḥ puruṣādakāḥ /
nāke vighnaśca vikhyāto bhadramovidhamastathā //
meaning:
प्रसूतान्ये कलेः पुत्राश्चत्वारः पुरुषादकाः /
नाके विघ्नश्च विख्यातो भद्रमोविधमस्तथा //
text_mt: Other sons were born to Kali, four man-eaters: / Nāka, known as Vighna, and likewise Bhadrama and Vidhama.

sanskrit_iast:
aśiraskatayā vighno nākaścaivāśarīravān /
bhadramaścaikahasto 'bhūdvidhamaścaikapātsmṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अशिरस्कतया विघ्नो नाकश्चैवाशरीरवान् /
भद्रमश्चैकहस्तो ऽभूद्विधमश्चैकपात्स्मृतः //
text_mt: Vighna was headless, and Nāka was bodiless; / Bhadrama had one hand, and Vidhama is recorded as having one foot.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadramasya tathāpatnī tāmasī pūtanā tathā /
revatī vidhamasyāpi tayoḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
भद्रमस्य तथापत्नी तामसी पूतना तथा /
रेवती विधमस्यापि तयोः पुत्राः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Likewise the wife of Bhadrama was the dark Pūtanā, / and Revatī was [the wife] of Vidhama; their sons were in the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
nākasya śakuniḥ patnī vighnasya ca ayo mukhī /
rākṣasāstu mahāvīryāḥ saṃdhyādvayavicārimaḥ //
meaning:
नाकस्य शकुनिः पत्नी विघ्नस्य च अयो मुखी /
राक्षसास्तु महावीर्याः संध्याद्वयविचारिमः //
text_mt: Śakuni was the wife of Nāka, and Ayomukhī of Vighna; / they were indeed rākṣasas of great valor who roam at the two twilights.

sanskrit_iast:
revatīpūtanāputrā naiṛtā nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ /
grahaste rākṣasāḥ sarve bālānāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
रेवतीपूतनापुत्रा नैऋता नामतः स्मृताः /
ग्रहस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे बालानां तु विशेषतः //
text_mt: The sons of Revatī and Pūtanā are recorded by name as the Nairṛtas; / all those rākṣasas are seizing spirits, especially of children.

sanskrit_iast:
skandasteṣāmadhipatirbrahmaṇo 'numataḥ prabhuḥ /
bṛhaspateryā bhaginī varastrī brahmacāriṇī //
meaning:
स्कन्दस्तेषामधिपतिर्ब्रह्मणो ऽनुमतः प्रभुः /
बृहस्पतेर्या भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी //
text_mt: Skanda is their master, the lord authorized by Brahmā. / The sister of Bṛhaspati, an excellent woman practicing celibacy,

sanskrit_iast:
yogasiddhā jagatkṛtsnamasaktā carate sadā /
prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca //
meaning:
योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नमसक्ता चरते सदा /
प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य च //
text_mt: accomplished in yoga, roams the entire universe forever unattached; / she was the wife of Prabhāsa, the eighth of the Vasus.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmā surastasyā jātaḥ śilpiprajāpatiḥ /
tvaṣṭā virājo rūpāṇi dharmapautra udāradhīḥ //
meaning:
विश्वकर्मा सुरस्तस्या जातः शिल्पिप्रजापतिः /
त्वष्टा विराजो रूपाणि धर्मपौत्र उदारधीः //
text_mt: From her was born the divine Viśvakarman, the creator-craftsman, / Tvaṣṭṛ, the forms of Virāj, grandson of Dharma, noble-minded,

sanskrit_iast:
karttā śilpisahasrāṇāṃ tridaśānāṃ tu yogataḥ /
yaḥsarveṣāṃ vimānāni devatānāṃ cakāra ha //
meaning:
कर्त्ता शिल्पिसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां तु योगतः /
यःसर्वेषां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह //
text_mt: maker of thousands of crafts for the thirty gods through yoga, / who indeed fashioned the aerial chariots of all the deities,

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣāścopajīvanti yasya śilpaṃ mahātmanaḥ /
prahrādī viśrutā tasya patnī tvaṣṭurvirocanā //
meaning:
मानुषाश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः /
प्रह्रादी विश्रुता तस्य पत्नी त्वष्टुर्विरोचना //
text_mt: and by whose craft human beings live—of that great soul, / the renowned wife was Virocanā, daughter of Prahrāda, belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
virocanasya bhaginī mātā triśirasastathā /
devācāryasya mahato viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ //
meaning:
विरोचनस्य भगिनी माता त्रिशिरसस्तथा /
देवाचार्यस्य महतो विश्वरूपस्य धीमतः //
text_mt: She was the sister of Virocana and the mother of Triśiras, / the great teacher of the gods, the wise Viśvarūpa.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvakarmātmajaśvaiva viśvakarmā mayaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sureṇuriti vikhyātā svasā tasya yavīyasī //
meaning:
विश्वकर्मात्मजश्वैव विश्वकर्मा मयः स्मृतः /
सुरेणुरिति विख्याता स्वसा तस्य यवीयसी //
text_mt: And the son of Viśvakarman is known as Viśvakarman Maya; / his younger sister was renowned as Sureṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṣṭrī yā saviturbhāryā punaḥ saṃjñeti viśrutā /
prāsūta sā mahābhāgaṃ manuṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
त्वाष्ट्री या सवितुर्भार्या पुनः संज्ञेति विश्रुता /
प्रासूत सा महाभागं मनुं ज्येष्ठं विवस्वतः //
text_mt: The daughter of Tvaṣṭṛ, who was the wife of Savitṛ, is further famed as Saṃjñā; / she gave birth to the highly fortunate Manu, the eldest [son] of Vivasvat.

sanskrit_iast:
yamau prāsūta ca punaryamaṃ ca yamunāṃ ca ha /
sā tu gatvā kurūndevī vaḍavā rūpadhāriṇī //
meaning:
यमौ प्रासूत च पुनर्यमं च यमुनां च ह /
सा तु गत्वा कुरून्देवी वडवा रूपधारिणी //
text_mt: And then she gave birth to twins, Yama and Yamunā. / Having gone to the Kurus, that goddess assumed the form of a mare.

sanskrit_iast:
savituścāsya rūpasya nāsikābhyāṃ tu tau smṛtau /
prāsūta sā mahābhāga tvantarikṣe 'śvinau kila //
meaning:
सवितुश्चास्य रूपस्य नासिकाभ्यां तु तौ स्मृतौ /
प्रासूत सा महाभाग त्वन्तरिक्षे ऽश्विनौ किल //
text_mt: From the two nostrils of Savitṛ of that [equine] form, those two were born; / she gave birth, O fortunate one, indeed to the two Aśvins in the atmosphere,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsatyaṃ caiva dasraṃ ca mārttaṇḍasyātmajāvubhau /
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kasmānmārttaṇḍa ityeṣa vivasvānudito budhaiḥ //
meaning:
नासत्यं चैव दस्रं च मार्त्तण्डस्यात्मजावुभौ /
ऋषय ऊचुः
कस्मान्मार्त्तण्ड इत्येष विवस्वानुदितो बुधैः //
text_mt: both Nāsatya and Dasra, the two sons of Mārttaṇḍa. / The sages said: / Why has this Vivasvat been called Mārttaṇḍa by the wise?

sanskrit_iast:
kimarthaṃ sāsurūpā vai nāsikābhyāmasūyata /
etadveditumicchāmo sarvaṃ no brūhi pṛcchatām //
meaning:
किमर्थं सासुरूपा वै नासिकाभ्यामसूयत /
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामो सर्वं नो ब्रूहि पृच्छताम् //
text_mt: For what reason did she, having the form of a mare, give birth through the two nostrils? / We desire to know this; tell all to us who are asking.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
cirotpannamatirbhinnamaṇḍaṃ tvaṣṭrā vidāritam /
garbhavadhaṃ bhrāntaḥ kaśyapo vidruto bhavet //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
चिरोत्पन्नमतिर्भिन्नमण्डं त्वष्ट्रा विदारितम् /
गर्भवधं भ्रान्तः कश्यपो विद्रुतो भवेत् //
text_mt: The bard said: / The egg, which had been produced long ago, was cracked and split open by Tvaṣṭṛ; / bewildered, fearing the destruction of the fetus, Kaśyapa ran up.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍe dvidhākṛte tvaṇḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṣṭedamabravīt /
naitannyūnaṃ bhavādaṇḍaṃ mārttaṇḍastvaṃ bhavānagha //
meaning:
अण्डे द्विधाकृते त्वण्डं दृष्ट्वा त्वष्टेदमब्रवीत् /
नैतन्न्यूनं भवादण्डं मार्त्तण्डस्त्वं भवानघ //
text_mt: When the egg was made into two parts, seeing the egg, Tvaṣṭṛ said this: / 'This egg shall not be deficient; you, sinless one, are Mārttaṇḍa!'

sanskrit_iast:
na khalvayaṃ mṛtoṃ'ḍastha iti snehātpitābravīt /
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāmānvarthamudāharan //
meaning:
न खल्वयं मृतोंऽडस्थ इति स्नेहात्पिताब्रवीत् /
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा नामान्वर्थमुदाहरन् //
text_mt: 'Surely he has not died within the egg,' the father said out of affection. / Hearing that word of his, they declared an etymologically meaningful name.

sanskrit_iast:
yanmārttaṇḍo bhavetyuktastvaṇḍātsoṃḍe dvidhākṛte /
tasmādvivasvānmārttaṇḍaḥ purāṇajñairvibhāvyate //
meaning:
यन्मार्त्तण्डो भवेत्युक्तस्त्वण्डात्सोंडे द्विधाकृते /
तस्माद्विवस्वान्मार्त्तण्डः पुराणज्ञैर्विभाव्यते //
text_mt: Because he was addressed, 'Be Mārttaṇḍa,' from the egg when the egg was divided in two, / therefore Vivasvat is recognized as Mārttaṇḍa by knowers of the Purāṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prajāḥ pravakṣyāmi mārttaṇḍasya vivasvataḥ /
vijajñe saviturbhāryā saṃjñā putrāṃstu trīnpunaḥ //
meaning:
ततः प्रजाः प्रवक्ष्यामि मार्त्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः /
विजज्ञे सवितुर्भार्या संज्ञा पुत्रांस्तु त्रीन्पुनः //
text_mt: Next I will declare the offspring of Mārttaṇḍa Vivasvat: / Saṃjñā, the wife of Savitṛ, bore three more children:

sanskrit_iast:
manuṃ yamīṃ yamaṃ caiva chāyā sā tapatī tathā /
śanaiścaraṃ tathaivaite mārttaṇḍasyātmajāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
मनुं यमीं यमं चैव छाया सा तपती तथा /
शनैश्चरं तथैवैते मार्त्तण्डस्यात्मजाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Manu, Yamī, and Yama; likewise Chāyā bore Tapatī / and Śanaiścara—these are recorded as the offspring of Mārttaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvānkaśyapājjajñe dākṣāyiṇyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ /
tasya saṃjñābhavadbhāryā tvāṣṭrī devī vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वान्कश्यपाज्जज्ञे दाक्षायिण्यां महायशाः /
तस्य संज्ञाभवद्भार्या त्वाष्ट्री देवी विवस्वतः //
text_mt: The renowned Vivasvat was born from Kaśyapa through the daughter of Dakṣa; / the goddess born of Tvaṣṭṛ, Saṃjñā, became the wife of Vivasvat.

sanskrit_iast:
sureṇuriti vikhyātā punaḥ saṃjñeti viśrutā /
sā tu bhāryā bhagavato mārttaṇḍasyātitejasaḥ //
meaning:
सुरेणुरिति विख्याता पुनः संज्ञेति विश्रुता /
सा तु भार्या भगवतो मार्त्तण्डस्यातितेजसः //
text_mt: She was celebrated as Sureṇu and further known as Saṃjñā; / she was indeed the wife of the blessed Mārttaṇḍa of extraordinary splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
na khalvaye mṛto hyaṇḍe iti snehāttamabravīt /
ajānankaśyapaḥ snehāt mārttaṇḍa iti cocyate //
meaning:
न खल्वये मृतो ह्यण्डे इति स्नेहात्तमब्रवीत् /
अजानन्कश्यपः स्नेहात् मार्त्तण्ड इति चोच्यते //
text_mt: 'Surely he has not died in the egg,' he said to him out of affection; / out of affection, not knowing, Kaśyapa said: 'And he is called Mārttaṇḍa.'

sanskrit_iast:
tejastvabhyadhikaṃ tasya nityameva vivasvataḥ /
yenāpi tāpayāmāsa trīlloṅkānkaśyapātmajaḥ //
meaning:
तेजस्त्वभ्यधिकं तस्य नित्यमेव विवस्वतः /
येनापि तापयामास त्रील्लोङ्कान्कश्यपात्मजः //
text_mt: Great indeed was the constant fiery energy of Vivasvat, / by which that son of Kaśyapa scorched the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇyapatyāni saṃjñāyāṃ janayāmāsa vai raviḥ /
dvau sutau tu mahāvīryauṃ kanyaikā viditaiva ca //
meaning:
त्रीण्यपत्यानि संज्ञायां जनयामास वै रविः /
द्वौ सुतौ तु महावीर्यौं कन्यैका विदितैव च //
text_mt: Ravi fathered three offspring upon Saṃjñā: / two sons of great valor, and one daughter who is well known.

sanskrit_iast:
manurvaivasvato jyeṣṭhaḥ śrāddhadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ /
tato yamo yamī caiva yamajau saṃbabhūvatuḥ //
meaning:
मनुर्वैवस्वतो ज्येष्ठः श्राद्धदेवः प्रजापतिः /
ततो यमो यमी चैव यमजौ संबभूवतुः //
text_mt: The eldest was Manu Vaivasvata, the Prajāpati Śrāddhadeva; / then Yama and Yamī were born as twins.

sanskrit_iast:
asahyatejastadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjñā vivasvataḥ /
asahantī svakāṃ chāyāṃ savarṇāṃ nirmame punaḥ //
meaning:
असह्यतेजस्तद्रूपं दृष्ट्वा संज्ञा विवस्वतः /
असहन्ती स्वकां छायां सवर्णां निर्ममे पुनः //
text_mt: Seeing that form of Vivasvat possessing unbearable fiery brilliance, / unable to endure it, Saṃjñā created her own shadow-double of identical color.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhāgā tu sā nārī tasyāśchāyāsamudgatā /
prāñjaliḥ prayatā bhūtvā punaḥ saṃjñāmabhāṣata //
meaning:
महाभागा तु सा नारी तस्याश्छायासमुद्गता /
प्राञ्जलिः प्रयता भूत्वा पुनः संज्ञामभाषत //
text_mt: That fortunate woman arisen from her shadow, / having folded her hands in reverence and restrained herself, addressed Saṃjñā:

sanskrit_iast:
vadasva kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ sā saṃjñā tāmathābravīt /
ahaṃ yāsyāpi bhadraṃ te svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ //
meaning:
वदस्व किं मया कार्यं सा संज्ञा तामथाब्रवीत् /
अहं यास्यापि भद्रं ते स्वमेव भवनं पितुः //
text_mt: 'Tell me, what is to be done by me?' Then Saṃjñā said to her: / 'May good betide you; I am going to the house of my own father.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayeha bhavane mahyaṃ vastavyaṃ nirviśaṅkayā /
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ca varavarṇinī //
meaning:
त्वयेह भवने मह्यं वस्तव्यं निर्विशङ्कया /
इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं कन्या च वरवर्णिनी //
text_mt: You must dwell here in my abode without hesitation, / and these two boys of mine, as well as the fair-complexioned daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
bharttavyā naivamākhyeyamidaṃ bhagavate tvayā /
imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ tathetyuktā tathā ca sā //
meaning:
भर्त्तव्या नैवमाख्येयमिदं भगवते त्वया /
इमौ च बालकौ मह्यं तथेत्युक्ता तथा च सा //
text_mt: are to be maintained. This must not be told by you to the lord; / and these two boys are mine.' Addressed with 'So be it,' she acted accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
tvaṣṭuḥ samīpamagamadvrīḍiteva tapasvinī /
pitā tāmāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā kruddhaḥ saṃjñāmathābravīt //
meaning:
त्वष्टुः समीपमगमद्व्रीडितेव तपस्विनी /
पिता तामागतां दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धः संज्ञामथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: As if ashamed, the ascetic woman went to the presence of Tvaṣṭṛ. / Seeing her arrive, the father became angry and then said to Saṃjñā:

sanskrit_iast:
bharttuḥ samīpaṃ gaccheti niyuktā ca punaḥ punaḥ /
agamadvaḍavā bhūtvācchādya rūpamaninditā //
meaning:
भर्त्तुः समीपं गच्छेति नियुक्ता च पुनः पुनः /
अगमद्वडवा भूत्वाच्छाद्य रूपमनिन्दिता //
text_mt: 'Go to the presence of your husband!' And urged again and again, / the blameless woman concealed her form and, becoming a mare, went away.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarānsā kurūngatvā tṛṇānyatha cacāra sā /
dvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃjñāyāṃ saṃjñeyamiti cintya tām //
meaning:
उत्तरान्सा कुरून्गत्वा तृणान्यथ चचार सा /
द्वितीयायां तु संज्ञायां संज्ञेयमिति चिन्त्य ताम् //
text_mt: Having gone to the northern Kurus, she grazed on grasses. / But upon the second Saṃjñā, thinking, 'This is Saṃjñā,'

sanskrit_iast:
ādityo janayāmāsa putrāvādityavarcasau /
pūrvajasya manostulyau sādṛśyena tu tau prabhū //
meaning:
आदित्यो जनयामास पुत्रावादित्यवर्चसौ /
पूर्वजस्य मनोस्तुल्यौ सादृश्येन तु तौ प्रभू //
text_mt: the Āditya fathered two sons possessing the radiance of an Āditya, / both masters equal to their elder brother Manu by resemblance.

sanskrit_iast: śrutaśravā manustābhyāṃ sāvarṇirvai bhaviṣyati //
meaning: श्रुतश्रवा मनुस्ताभ्यां सावर्णिर्वै भविष्यति //
text_mt: Of the two, the one who is Śrutaśravas will become Manu Sāvarṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutakarmā tu vijñeyo graho vai yaḥ śanaiścaraḥ /
manurevābhavatso 'pi sāvarṇiriti cocyate //
meaning:
श्रुतकर्मा तु विज्ञेयो ग्रहो वै यः शनैश्चरः /
मनुरेवाभवत्सो ऽपि सावर्णिरिति चोच्यते //
text_mt: Śrutakarman is to be known as the planet Śanaiścara; / he too became a Manu and is called Sāvarṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjñā tu pārthivī sā vai svasya putrasya vai tadā /
cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ ta tathā pūrvajeṣu vai //
meaning:
संज्ञा तु पार्थिवी सा वै स्वस्य पुत्रस्य वै तदा /
चकाराभ्यधिकं स्नेहं त तथा पूर्वजेषु वै //
text_mt: Then that earthly Saṃjñā showed greater affection / for her own son than she did toward the earlier-born ones.

sanskrit_iast:
manustacchākṣamatsarvaṃ yamastadvai na cākṣamat /
bahuśo jalpamānastu sāpatnyādatiduḥkhitaḥ //
meaning:
मनुस्तच्छाक्षमत्सर्वं यमस्तद्वै न चाक्षमत् /
बहुशो जल्पमानस्तु सापत्न्यादतिदुःखितः //
text_mt: Manu tolerated all that, but Yama did not tolerate it; / weeping and speaking repeatedly, he was extremely pained because of step-motherly treatment.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ vai roṣācca bālācca bhāvinor'thasya vai balāt /
yadā saṃtarjayāmāsa cchāyāṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ //
meaning:
तां वै रोषाच्च बालाच्च भाविनोर्ऽथस्य वै बलात् /
यदा संतर्जयामास च्छायां वैवस्वतो यमः //
text_mt: When, out of anger, childishness, and the force of what was destined to happen, / Yama Vaivasvata threatened Chāyā,

sanskrit_iast:
sā śaśāpa tataḥ krodhātsārṇijananī yamam /
yadā tarjayase 'kasmātpitṛbhāryāṃ yaśasvinīm //
meaning:
सा शशाप ततः क्रोधात्सार्णिजननी यमम् /
यदा तर्जयसे ऽकस्मात्पितृभार्यां यशस्विनीम् //
text_mt: then the mother of Sāvarṇi cursed Yama out of anger: / 'Since you suddenly threaten your father's illustrious wife,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttavaiṣa caramaḥ patiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ /
yamastu tena śāpena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्तवैष चरमः पतिष्यति न संशयः /
यमस्तु तेन शापेन भृशं पीडितमानसः //
text_mt: therefore this foot of yours will fall off; there is no doubt!' / But Yama, his mind severely tormented by that curse,

sanskrit_iast:
manunā saha dharmātmā pituḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat /
bhṛśaṃ śāpabhayodvignaḥ saṃjñāvākyairvinirjitaḥ //
meaning:
मनुना सह धर्मात्मा पितुः सर्वं न्यवेदयत् /
भृशं शापभयोद्विग्नः संज्ञावाक्यैर्विनिर्जितः //
text_mt: being righteous, reported everything to his father along with Manu, / deeply agitated by the fear of the curse, overcome by the words of Saṃjñā:

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ /
bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣantumarhati //
meaning:
तस्यां मयोद्यतः पादो न तु देहे निपातितः /
बाल्याद्वा यदि वा मोहात्तद्भवान्क्षन्तुमर्हति //
text_mt: 'My foot was raised toward her, but not dropped upon her body; / whether out of childishness or confusion, you ought to forgive that!'

sanskrit_iast:
śapto 'hamasmi lokeśa jananyā tapatāṃ vara /
tava prasādo nastrātumetasmānmahato bhayāt //
meaning:
शप्तो ऽहमस्मि लोकेश जनन्या तपतां वर /
तव प्रसादो नस्त्रातुमेतस्मान्महतो भयात् //
text_mt: I have been cursed by my mother, O lord of the worlds, best of those who radiate heat! / May your grace protect us from this great terror.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvānevamuktastu yamaṃ provāca vai prabhuḥ /
asaṃśayaṃ putra mahadbhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam //
meaning:
विवस्वानेवमुक्तस्तु यमं प्रोवाच वै प्रभुः /
असंशयं पुत्र महद्भविष्यत्यत्र कारणम् //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the lord Vivasvat said to Yama: / “Undoubtedly, my son, there must be a great cause for this,

sanskrit_iast:
yena tvāmāviśatkrodho dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam /
na śakyametanmithya tu karttuṃ māturvacastava //
meaning:
येन त्वामाविशत्क्रोधो धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम् /
न शक्यमेतन्मिथ्य तु कर्त्तुं मातुर्वचस्तव //
text_mt: whereby anger took hold of you, a knower of dharma and a speaker of truth. / Yet it is impossible to make this word of your mother false.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyanti ca mahīṃ tava /
tataḥ pādaṃ mahāprājña punaḥ sāṃprāpsyase sukham //
meaning:
कृमयो मांसमादाय यास्यन्ति च महीं तव /
ततः पादं महाप्राज्ञ पुनः सांप्राप्स्यसे सुखम् //
text_mt: Worms will take flesh [from it] and fall to the earth, / and then, O greatly wise one, you shall regain the well-being of your foot.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtamevaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ mātustava bhaviṣyati /
śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
कृतमेवं वचः सत्यं मातुस्तव भविष्यति /
शापस्य परिहारेण त्वं च त्रातो भविष्यसि //
text_mt: In this way the word of your mother will be made true, / and by mitigating the curse, you will also be saved.”

sanskrit_iast:
ādityastvabravītsaṃjñāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu tu /
tulyeṣvabhyadhikasneha ekasminkriyate tvayā //
meaning:
आदित्यस्त्वब्रवीत्संज्ञां किमर्थं तनयेषु तु /
तुल्येष्वभ्यधिकस्नेह एकस्मिन्क्रियते त्वया //
text_mt: Then Āditya said to Saṃjñā: “For what reason / is greater affection shown by you to one among sons who are equal?”

sanskrit_iast:
sā tatpariharantī vai nācacakṣe vivasvataḥ /
ātmanā sa samādhāya yogāttattvamapaśyata //
meaning:
सा तत्परिहरन्ती वै नाचचक्षे विवस्वतः /
आत्मना स समाधाय योगात्तत्त्वमपश्यत //
text_mt: Evading [the question], she did not tell Vivasvat. / Concentrating himself through yoga, he perceived the truth.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ śaptukāmo bhagavānnāśāya kupitaḥ prabhuḥ /
sā tatsarvaṃ yathā tattvamācacakṣe vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
तां शप्तुकामो भगवान्नाशाय कुपितः प्रभुः /
सा तत्सर्वं यथा तत्त्वमाचचक्षे विवस्वतः //
text_mt: The lord, wrathful, wished to curse her for her destruction; / [then] she told Vivasvat everything as it truly was.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvāṃstu yathā śrutvā kruddhastvaṣṭāramabhyayāt /
tvaṣṭā tu taṃ yathānyāyamarcayitvā vibhāvasum //
meaning:
विवस्वांस्तु यथा श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस्त्वष्टारमभ्ययात् /
त्वष्टा तु तं यथान्यायमर्चयित्वा विभावसुम् //
text_mt: Having heard this, Vivasvat went in anger to Tvaṣṭṛ. / But Tvaṣṭṛ, having duly honored Vibhāvasu,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāṃtvayāmāsa vai śanaiḥ /
tavātitejasā yuktamidaṃ rūpaṃ na śobhate //
meaning:
निर्दग्धुकामं रोषेण सांत्वयामास वै शनैः /
तवातितेजसा युक्तमिदं रूपं न शोभते //
text_mt: slowly pacified him as he wished to consume [everything] in his rage: / “Endowed with excessive brilliance, this form of yours is not pleasing.

sanskrit_iast:
asahantī tu tatsaṃjñā vane carati śādvale /
drakṣyate tāṃ bhavanadya svāṃ bhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm //
meaning:
असहन्ती तु तत्संज्ञा वने चरति शाद्वले /
द्रक्ष्यते तां भवनद्य स्वां भार्यां शुभचारिणीम् //
text_mt: Unable to bear it, Saṃjñā roams in a grassy forest. / You will see her today, your virtuous wife.

sanskrit_iast:
ślāghyayauvanasaṃpannāṃ yogamāsthāya gopate /
anukūlaṃ bhavedevaṃ yadi syātsamayo mataḥ //
meaning:
श्लाघ्ययौवनसंपन्नां योगमास्थाय गोपते /
अनुकूलं भवेदेवं यदि स्यात्समयो मतः //
text_mt: Endowed with praiseworthy youth, resorting to yoga, O lord of light, / it would be suitable in this way if an agreement is approved [by you].

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ nivarttayeyaṃ te hyādyaṃ śreṣṭhamarindama /
rūpaṃ vivasvatastvāsīttiryagūrddhvamadhastathā //
meaning:
रूपं निवर्त्तयेयं ते ह्याद्यं श्रेष्ठमरिन्दम /
रूपं विवस्वतस्त्वासीत्तिर्यगूर्द्ध्वमधस्तथा //
text_mt: Indeed, I would pare down your form, which is foremost and primal, O subduer of foes!” / For Vivasvat’s form had extended horizontally, upward, and downward;

sanskrit_iast:
tenāsau pīḍitā devī rūpeṇa tu divaspateḥ /
tasmātte samacakraṃ tu vartate rūpamadbhutam //
meaning:
तेनासौ पीडिता देवी रूपेण तु दिवस्पतेः /
तस्मात्ते समचक्रं तु वर्तते रूपमद्भुतम् //
text_mt: by that form of the lord of heaven, the goddess had been tormented. / Therefore, an evenly balanced, wondrous form was produced for you.

sanskrit_iast:
anujñātastatastvaṣṭrā rūpanirvarttanāya vai /
tato 'bhyupāgamattvaṣṭā mārttaṇḍasya vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
अनुज्ञातस्ततस्त्वष्ट्रा रूपनिर्वर्त्तनाय वै /
ततो ऽभ्युपागमत्त्वष्टा मार्त्तण्डस्य विवस्वतः //
text_mt: Permitted then by Tvaṣṭṛ to alter his form, / Tvaṣṭṛ thereupon approached Mārtaṇḍa Vivasvat.

sanskrit_iast:
bhramimāropya tattejaḥ śātayāmāsa tasya vai /
taṃ nirmūlita tejaskaṃ tejasāpahṛtena tu //
meaning:
भ्रमिमारोप्य तत्तेजः शातयामास तस्य वै /
तं निर्मूलित तेजस्कं तेजसापहृतेन तु //
text_mt: Mounting him on a lathe, he pared down his brilliance. / When his radiance was pared down, with his excess splendor removed,

sanskrit_iast:
kāntāṃ prabhākaro draṣṭumiyeṣa śubhadarśanaḥ /
dadarśa yogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ tathā //
meaning:
कान्तां प्रभाकरो द्रष्टुमियेष शुभदर्शनः /
ददर्श योगमास्थाय स्वां भार्यां वडवां तथा //
text_mt: the light-maker of handsome appearance desired to see his beloved. / Resorting to yoga, he saw his wife as a mare.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejasā niyamena ca /
aśvarūpeṇa mārttaṇḍastāṃ mukhe samabhāvayat //
meaning:
अदृश्यां सर्वभूतानां तेजसा नियमेन च /
अश्वरूपेण मार्त्तण्डस्तां मुखे समभावयत् //
text_mt: Invisible to all beings by her splendor and restraint, / Mārtaṇḍa, taking the form of a horse, impregnated her in the mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
maithunāntaniviṣṭā ca parapuṃso 'bhiśaṅkayā /
sā taṃ niḥsārayāmāsa nobhyāṃ śukraṃ vivasvataḥ //
meaning:
मैथुनान्तनिविष्टा च परपुंसो ऽभिशङ्कया /
सा तं निःसारयामास नोभ्यां शुक्रं विवस्वतः //
text_mt: As intercourse was completed, fearing another male, / she discharged Vivasvat's semen through her nostrils.

sanskrit_iast:
devau tasmādajāyetāmaśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau /
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvādaśamūrtitaḥ //
meaning:
देवौ तस्मादजायेतामश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ /
नासत्यश्चैव दस्रश्च स्मृतौ द्वादशमूर्तितः //
text_mt: From that the two gods, the Aśvins, were born, the best of physicians; / they are remembered as Nāsatya and Dasra from his twelve-fold form.

sanskrit_iast:
mārttaṇḍasya sutāvetāvaṣṭamasya prajāpateḥ /
tāṃ tu rūpeṇa kāntena darśayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
मार्त्तण्डस्य सुतावेतावष्टमस्य प्रजापतेः /
तां तु रूपेण कान्तेन दर्शयामास भास्करः //
text_mt: These two are the sons of Mārtaṇḍa, the eighth Prajāpati. / Then the sun showed himself to her in a lovely form.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā bhāryāṃ tuto ṣaitāmuvāca ha /
yamastu tena śāpena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ //
meaning:
स तां दृष्ट्वा तदा भार्यां तुतो षैतामुवाच ह /
यमस्तु तेन शापेन भृशं पीडितमानसः //
text_mt: Seeing his wife then, he was delighted and spoke to her. / But Yama, his mind severely afflicted by that curse,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmeṇa rañjayāmāsa dharmarājastatastu saḥ /
so 'labhatkarmaṇāṃ tena śubhena paramāṃ dyutim //
meaning:
धर्मेण रञ्जयामास धर्मराजस्ततस्तु सः /
सो ऽलभत्कर्मणां तेन शुभेन परमां द्युतिम् //
text_mt: gratified [the world] through righteousness; thence he became the King of Dharma. / Through that auspicious conduct he obtained supreme splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāmādhipatyaṃ ca lokapālatvameva ca /
manuḥ prajāpatistveṣa sāvarṇiḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
पितॄणामाधिपत्यं च लोकपालत्वमेव च /
मनुः प्रजापतिस्त्वेष सावर्णिः स महायशाः //
text_mt: sovereignty over the ancestors, and guardianship of the world. / As for Manu Sāvarṇi, he is a Prajāpati of great renown;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyaḥ so 'nāgate tasminmanuḥ sāvarṇikentare /
merupṛṣṭhe tapo ghoramadyāpi carate prabhuḥ //
meaning:
भाव्यः सो ऽनागते तस्मिन्मनुः सावर्णिकेन्तरे /
मेरुपृष्ठे तपो घोरमद्यापि चरते प्रभुः //
text_mt: he is to become the Manu in the future Sāvarṇika manvantara. / That lord performs severe tapas on the ridge of Mount Meru even today.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātā śanaiścarastatragrahatvaṃ sa tu labdhavān /
tvaṣṭā tu tena rūpeṇa viṣṇoścakramakalpayat //
meaning:
भ्राता शनैश्चरस्तत्रग्रहत्वं स तु लब्धवान् /
त्वष्टा तु तेन रूपेण विष्णोश्चक्रमकल्पयत् //
text_mt: His brother Śanaiścara attained the status of a planet. / And Tvaṣṭṛ fashioned the discus of Viṣṇu out of that shaved-off radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāmaho 'pratihataṃ dānavānprativāraṇam /
yavīyasī tayoryā tu yamunāca yaśasvinī //
meaning:
महामहो ऽप्रतिहतं दानवान्प्रतिवारणम् /
यवीयसी तयोर्या तु यमुनाच यशस्विनी //
text_mt: an irresistible, immense light warding off the Dānavas. / As for the younger sister of the two, the renowned Yamunā,

sanskrit_iast:
abhavatsā saricchreṣṭhā yamunā lokapāvanī /
yastu jyeṣṭho mahātejāḥ sargo yasyeti sāṃpratam //
meaning:
अभवत्सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यमुना लोकपावनी /
यस्तु ज्येष्ठो महातेजाः सर्गो यस्येति सांप्रतम् //
text_mt: she became that foremost of rivers, Yamunā, purifying the world. / But he who was the eldest, of great splendor, whose creation is now current—

sanskrit_iast:
vistaraṃ tasya vakṣyāmi manorvaivasvatasya ha /
idaṃ tu janma devānāṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā //
meaning:
विस्तरं तस्य वक्ष्यामि मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह /
इदं तु जन्म देवानां शृणुयाद्वा पठेच्च वा //
text_mt: I shall describe in detail him, Manu Vaivasvata. / Whoever hears or recites this birth of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
vaivasvatasya putrāṇāṃ saptānāṃ tu mahaujasām /
āpadaṃ prāpya mucyeta prāpnuyācca mahadyaśaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte tṛtīya upoddhātapāde vaivasvatotpattirnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ // 59//
meaning:
वैवस्वतस्य पुत्राणां सप्तानां तु महौजसाम् /
आपदं प्राप्य मुच्येत प्राप्नुयाच्च महद्यशः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे वैवस्वतोत्पत्तिर्नामैकोनषष्टितमोध्यायः // 59//
text_mt:
and of the seven exceedingly mighty sons of Vaivasvata, / will be freed when encountering misfortune and will obtain great fame.

Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Origin of Vaivasvata," in the third [section], the Upoddhātapāda, of the great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa spoken by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tato manvantare 'tīte cākṣuṣe daivataiḥ saha /
vaivasvatāya mahate pṛthivīrājyamādiśat //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततो मन्वन्तरे ऽतीते चाक्षुषे दैवतैः सह /
वैवस्वताय महते पृथिवीराज्यमादिशत् //
text_mt: The sūta said: / Then, when the Cākṣuṣa manvantara had passed, along with the gods / he assigned the kingship of the earth to the great Vaivasvata.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvaivasvatātputrā jajñire daśa tatsamāḥ /
ikṣvākuśca nṛgaścaiva dhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātirevaca //
meaning:
तस्माद्वैवस्वतात्पुत्रा जज्ञिरे दश तत्समाः /
इक्ष्वाकुश्च नृगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेवच //
text_mt: From that Vaivasvata were born ten sons equal to him: / Ikṣvāku, Nṛga, Dhṛṣṭa, and Śaryāti,

sanskrit_iast:
nariṣyantastathā prāṃśurnābhāgo diṣṭa eva ca /
karūṣaśca pṛṣadhraśca navaite mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
नरिष्यन्तस्तथा प्रांशुर्नाभागो दिष्ट एव च /
करूषश्च पृषध्रश्च नवैते मानवाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Nariṣyanta, Prāṃśu, Nābhāga, and Diṣṭa, / and Karūṣa and Pṛṣadhra; these nine are remembered as the Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā tu manuḥ pūrvaṃ coditastu prabodhitam /
yaṣṭuṃ prajakrame kāmaṃ hayamedhena bhūpatiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा तु मनुः पूर्वं चोदितस्तु प्रबोधितम् /
यष्टुं प्रजक्रमे कामं हयमेधेन भूपतिः //
text_mt: Instructed and enlightened earlier by Brahmā, / the king desired and undertook to sacrifice with a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
athākarotputrakāmaḥ parāmiṣṭiṃ prajāpatiḥ /
mitrāvaruṇayoraṃśe analāhutimeva yat //
meaning:
अथाकरोत्पुत्रकामः परामिष्टिं प्रजापतिः /
मित्रावरुणयोरंशे अनलाहुतिमेव यत् //
text_mt: Then, desiring a son, the Prajāpati performed a supreme sacrifice, / offering an oblation into the fire for the share of Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra divyāṃbaradharā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā /
divyāsaṃhananā caiva ilā jajña iti śrutam //
meaning:
तत्र दिव्यांबरधरा दिव्याभरणभूषिता /
दिव्यासंहनना चैव इला जज्ञ इति श्रुतम् //
text_mt: There, wearing celestial garments, adorned with celestial ornaments, / and of divine physique, Ilā was born, as is heard.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmiletyatha hovāca manurdaṇḍadharastataḥ /
anugacchasva bhadraṃ te tamilā pratyuvāca ha //
meaning:
तामिलेत्यथ होवाच मनुर्दण्डधरस्ततः /
अनुगच्छस्व भद्रं ते तमिला प्रत्युवाच ह //
text_mt: Then Manu, bearer of the royal rod, said to her, to Ilā: / “Follow me; fortune be yours!” Ilā replied to him,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmayuktamidaṃ vākyaṃ putrakāmaṃ prajāpatim /
mitrāvaruṇayoraṃśe jātāsmi vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
धर्मयुक्तमिदं वाक्यं पुत्रकामं प्रजापतिम् /
मित्रावरुणयोरंशे जातास्मि वदतां वर //
text_mt: this righteous speech to the Prajāpati who desired a son: / “I was born as a portion belonging to Mitra and Varuṇa, O best of speakers.

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ sakāśaṃ yāsyāmi māto dharmo hato vadhīt /
evamuktvā punardevī tayorantikamāgamat //
meaning:
तयोः सकाशं यास्यामि मातो धर्मो हतो वधीत् /
एवमुक्त्वा पुनर्देवी तयोरन्तिकमागमत् //
text_mt: I will go into their presence; let not dharma, violated, strike me down.” / Having spoken thus, the goddess came again into their presence.

sanskrit_iast:
gatvāntikaṃ varārohā prāñjalirvākyamabravīt /
aṃśe 'sminyuvayorjātā devau kiṃ karavāṇi vām //
meaning:
गत्वान्तिकं वरारोहा प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
अंशे ऽस्मिन्युवयोर्जाता देवौ किं करवाणि वाम् //
text_mt: Approaching them, the woman of fair hips folded her hands and said: / “I am born as a portion of you two, O gods; what shall I do for you both?

sanskrit_iast:
manunaivāhamuktāsmi anugacchasva māmiti /
tathā tu bruvatīṃ sādhvīmiḍāmāśritya tāvubhau //
meaning:
मनुनैवाहमुक्तास्मि अनुगच्छस्व मामिति /
तथा तु ब्रुवतीं साध्वीमिडामाश्रित्य तावुभौ //
text_mt: Manu has told me: 'Follow me.'” / To the virtuous Idā speaking thus, taking refuge with them, both

sanskrit_iast:
devau ca mitrāvaruṇāvidaṃ vacanamūcatuḥ /
anena tava dharmajñe praśrayoṇa damena ca //
meaning:
देवौ च मित्रावरुणाविदं वचनमूचतुः /
अनेन तव धर्मज्ञे प्रश्रयोण दमेन च //
text_mt: the gods, Mitra and Varuṇa, addressed these words: / “By this humility, self-control, and truthfulness of yours,

sanskrit_iast:
satyena caiva suśroṇi prītau svau varavarṇini /
āvayostvaṃ mahābhāge khyātiṃ kanye prayāsyasi //
meaning:
सत्येन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतौ स्वौ वरवर्णिनि /
आवयोस्त्वं महाभागे ख्यातिं कन्ये प्रयास्यसि //
text_mt: O knower of dharma, O woman of fair hips and fair complexion, we are pleased. / You, O highly fortunate maiden, shall attain fame belonging to us both.

sanskrit_iast:
sudyumna iti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu pūjitaḥ /
jagatpriyo dharmaśīlo manorvaṃśavivarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
सुद्युम्न इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजितः /
जगत्प्रियो धर्मशीलो मनोर्वंशविवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: Celebrated as Sudyumna, honored in the three worlds, / dear to the world, virtuous in character, and an enlarger of Manu’s line.”

sanskrit_iast:
mānavaḥ sa tu sudyumnaḥ strībhāvamagamatprabhuḥ /
sā tu devī varaṃ labdhvā nivṛttā pitaraṃ prati //
meaning:
मानवः स तु सुद्युम्नः स्त्रीभावमगमत्प्रभुः /
सा तु देवी वरं लब्ध्वा निवृत्ता पितरं प्रति //
text_mt: That lord, Sudyumna, the son of Manu, attained womanhood. / Having received the boon, that goddess returned to her father.

sanskrit_iast:
budhenottaramāsādya maithunāyopamantritā /
somaputrādbudhāccāsyāmailo jajñe purūkhāḥ //
meaning:
बुधेनोत्तरमासाद्य मैथुनायोपमन्त्रिता /
सोमपुत्राद्बुधाच्चास्यामैलो जज्ञे पुरूखाः //
text_mt: Approaching the north, she was solicited for intercourse by Budha; / and from Budha, son of Soma, Purūravas Aila was born to her.

sanskrit_iast:
budhātsā janayitvā tu sudyumnatvaṃ punargatāḥ /
sudyumnasya tu dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ //
meaning:
बुधात्सा जनयित्वा तु सुद्युम्नत्वं पुनर्गताः /
सुद्युम्नस्य तु दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः //
text_mt: Having given birth [to a son] by Budha, she attained the state of Sudyumna once again. / And Sudyumna had three most righteous heirs.

sanskrit_iast:
utkalaśca gayaścaiva vinataśca tathaiva ca /
utkalasyotkalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinatasyāpi paścimam //
meaning:
उत्कलश्च गयश्चैव विनतश्च तथैव च /
उत्कलस्योत्कलं राष्ट्रं विनतस्यापि पश्चिमम् //
text_mt: Utkala, Gaya, and likewise Vinata: / Utkala held the kingdom of Utkala, and Vinata [the country of] the west,

sanskrit_iast:
dikpūrvā tasya rājarṣergayasya tu gayā purī /
praviṣṭetu manau tasminprajāḥ sṛṣṭvā divākaram //
meaning:
दिक्पूर्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्गयस्य तु गया पुरी /
प्रविष्टेतु मनौ तस्मिन्प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा दिवाकरम् //
text_mt: while the eastern quarter belonged to that royal sage Gaya, and his city was Gayā. / But when that Manu had entered the sun after creating progeny,

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhā tadadhātkṣattramakarotpṛthivīmimām /
ikṣvākureva dāyādo bhāgaṃ daśamamāptavān //
meaning:
दशधा तदधात्क्षत्त्रमकरोत्पृथिवीमिमाम् /
इक्ष्वाकुरेव दायादो भागं दशममाप्तवान् //
text_mt: he divided the kṣatriya [dominion] tenfold and divided this earth. / Ikṣvāku, being an heir, received a tenth share.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyābhāvattu sudyumno naiva bhāgamavāptavān /
vasiṣṭhavacanāccāsītpratiṣṭhāne mahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
कन्याभावत्तु सुद्युम्नो नैव भागमवाप्तवान् /
वसिष्ठवचनाच्चासीत्प्रतिष्ठाने महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: Because of having been a woman, Sudyumna received no share at all. / Yet by the word of Vasiṣṭha, that exceedingly radiant one was placed at Pratiṣṭhāna.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāṃ dharmarājasya sudyumnasya mahātmanaḥ /
etacchrutvā tu ṛṣayaḥ papracchuḥ sūtajaṃ prati /
mānavaḥ sa tu sudyamnaḥ strībhāvamagamatkatham //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठां धर्मराजस्य सुद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः /
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु ऋषयः पप्रच्छुः सूतजं प्रति /
मानवः स तु सुद्यम्नः स्त्रीभावमगमत्कथम् //
text_mt: Such was the establishment of the righteous king, the great-souled Sudyumna. / Having heard this, the sages questioned the son of the bard: / 'How did Sudyumna, the son of Manu, come to be a woman?'

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
purā maheśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ kumārāssanakādayaḥ /
ilāvṛtaṃ samājagmurdadṛśurvṛṣabhadhvajam //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पुरा महेश्वरं द्रष्टुं कुमारास्सनकादयः /
इलावृतं समाजग्मुर्ददृशुर्वृषभध्वजम् //
text_mt: The bard said: / Formerly, the young sages Sanaka and the others, wishing to see Maheśvara, / came to Ilāvṛta and saw the bull-bannered [god].

sanskrit_iast:
umayā ramamāṇaṃ taṃ vilokya pihitesthale /
pratijagmustataḥ sarve vrīḍitābhūcchivāpyatha //
meaning:
उमया रममाणं तं विलोक्य पिहितेस्थले /
प्रतिजग्मुस्ततः सर्वे व्रीडिताभूच्छिवाप्यथ //
text_mt: Beholding him sporting with Umā in a secluded spot, / they all turned back, and Śivā too became bashful.

sanskrit_iast:
provāca vacanaṃ devī priyahetoḥ priyaṃ priyā /
imaṃ mamāśramaṃ deva yaḥ pumānsaṃ pravekṣyati //
meaning:
प्रोवाच वचनं देवी प्रियहेतोः प्रियं प्रिया /
इमं ममाश्रमं देव यः पुमान्सं प्रवेक्ष्यति //
text_mt: The loving goddess spoke pleasing words to her beloved for his sake: / 'O god, whatever male enters this hermitage of mine,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyati dhruvaṃ nārī sa tulyāpsarasāṃ śubhā /
tatra sarvāṇi bhūtāni piśācāḥ paśavaśca ye //
meaning:
भविष्यति ध्रुवं नारी स तुल्याप्सरसां शुभा /
तत्र सर्वाणि भूतानि पिशाचाः पशवश्च ये //
text_mt: shall surely become an auspicious woman resembling an apsaras.' / There all the spirits, piśācas, and beasts that were there,

sanskrit_iast:
strībhūtāḥ saharudreṇa kroḍantyapsaraso yathā /
umāvanaṃ praviṣṭastu sa rājā mṛgayāṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीभूताः सहरुद्रेण क्रोडन्त्यप्सरसो यथा /
उमावनं प्रविष्टस्तु स राजा मृगयां गतः //
text_mt: having become females, frolic along with Rudra like apsarases. / But that king, having gone hunting, entered Umā's forest;

sanskrit_iast:
piśācaiḥ saha bhūtaistu rudre strībhāvamāsthite /
tasmātsarājā sudyumnaḥ strībhāvaṃ labdhavānpunaḥ /
mahādevaprasādācca mānavatvamavāptavān //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe madhyamabhāge vāyuprokte vaivasvatamanoḥ sṛṣṭirnāma ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 60//
meaning:
पिशाचैः सह भूतैस्तु रुद्रे स्त्रीभावमास्थिते /
तस्मात्सराजा सुद्युम्नः स्त्रीभावं लब्धवान्पुनः /
महादेवप्रसादाच्च मानवत्वमवाप्तवान् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे मध्यमभागे वायुप्रोक्ते वैवस्वतमनोः सृष्टिर्नाम षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 60//
text_mt:
and when Rudra, along with piśācas and spirits, had assumed womanhood, / that king Sudyumna likewise obtained womanhood once again, / and by the grace of Mahādeva he regained manhood.

Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, called 'The Creation of Vaivasvata Manu', in the middle part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa, proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
visargaṃ manuputrāṇāṃ vistareṇa nibodhata /
pṛṣadhro hiṃsayitvā tu gurorgāṃ niśi tatkṣaye //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
विसर्गं मनुपुत्राणां विस्तरेण निबोधत /
पृषध्रो हिंसयित्वा तु गुरोर्गां निशि तत्क्षये //
text_mt: The bard said: / Learn in detail of the progeny of the sons of Manu. / For Pṛṣadhra, having killed his guru's cow at night to consume it,

sanskrit_iast:
śāpācchūdratvamāpannaścyavanasya mahātmanaḥ /
karūṣasya tu kārūṣāḥ kṣattriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ //
meaning:
शापाच्छूद्रत्वमापन्नश्च्यवनस्य महात्मनः /
करूषस्य तु कारूषाः क्षत्त्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः //
text_mt: became reduced to the status of a śūdra by the curse of the great-souled Cyavana. / From Karūṣa came the Kārūṣas, kṣatriyas furious in battle;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraṃ kṣattriyagaṇo vikrāntaḥ saṃbabhūva ha /
nābhāgo diṣṭaputrastu vidvānāsīdbhalandanaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रं क्षत्त्रियगणो विक्रान्तः संबभूव ह /
नाभागो दिष्टपुत्रस्तु विद्वानासीद्भलन्दनः //
text_mt: a valiant host of a thousand kṣatriyas was born. / The wise Nābhāga, son of Diṣṭa, had a son, Bhalandana.

sanskrit_iast:
bhalandanasya putro 'bhūtprāṃśurnāma mahābalaḥ /
prāṃśoreko 'bhavatputraḥ prajāpatisamo nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
भलन्दनस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत्प्रांशुर्नाम महाबलः /
प्रांशोरेको ऽभवत्पुत्रः प्रजापतिसमो नृपः //
text_mt: Bhalandana's son was named Prāṃśu, a man of great might. / Prāṃśu had an only son, a king equal to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvartena divaṃ nītaḥ sasuhṛtsahabāndhavaḥ /
vivādo 'tra mahānāsītsaṃvarttasya bṛhaspateḥ //
meaning:
संवर्तेन दिवं नीतः ससुहृत्सहबान्धवः /
विवादो ऽत्र महानासीत्संवर्त्तस्य बृहस्पतेः //
text_mt: He was led to heaven by Saṃvarta along with his friends and kinsmen. / In this matter there arose a great dispute between Saṃvarta and Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā tu yajñasya kruddhastasya bṛhaspatiḥ /
saṃvarttena tate yajñe cukopa sa bhṛśaṃ tadā //
meaning:
ऋद्धिं दृष्ट्वा तु यज्ञस्य क्रुद्धस्तस्य बृहस्पतिः /
संवर्त्तेन तते यज्ञे चुकोप स भृशं तदा //
text_mt: Beholding the splendor of that sacrifice, Bṛhaspati became angry with him; / when the sacrifice was extended by Saṃvarta, he grew exceedingly enraged at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
lokānāṃ sahi nāśāya daivatairhi prasāditaḥ /
maruttaścakravarttī sa nariṣyantamavāsavān //
meaning:
लोकानां सहि नाशाय दैवतैर्हि प्रसादितः /
मरुत्तश्चक्रवर्त्ती स नरिष्यन्तमवासवान् //
text_mt: For he, [bent] upon the destruction of the worlds, was propitiated by the gods. / That emperor was Marutta, who dwelt near Nariṣyanta.

sanskrit_iast:
nariṣyantasya dāyādo rājā daṇḍadharo damaḥ /
tasya putrastu vijñāto rājāsīdrāṣṭravarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
नरिष्यन्तस्य दायादो राजा दण्डधरो दमः /
तस्य पुत्रस्तु विज्ञातो राजासीद्राष्ट्रवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: Nariṣyanta's heir was King Dama, who wielded the rod [of justice]. / His son, known as King Rāṣṭravardhana, [succeeded him].

sanskrit_iast:
sudhṛtistasya putrastu naraḥ sudhṛtitaḥ punaḥ /
kevalasya putrastu bandhumānkevalātmajaḥ //
meaning:
सुधृतिस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु नरः सुधृतितः पुनः /
केवलस्य पुत्रस्तु बन्धुमान्केवलात्मजः //
text_mt: Sudhṛti was his son, and Nara was born from Sudhṛti. / Kevala's son was Bandhumat, born as the offspring of Kevala.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bandhumataḥ putrodharmātmā vegavānnṛpa /
budho vegavataḥ putrastṛṇabindurbudhātmajaḥ //
meaning:
अथ बन्धुमतः पुत्रोधर्मात्मा वेगवान्नृप /
बुधो वेगवतः पुत्रस्तृणबिन्दुर्बुधात्मजः //
text_mt: Then the righteous King Vegavat was the son of Bandhumat; / Budha was the son of Vegavat, and Tṛṇabindu was the son of Budha.

sanskrit_iast:
tretāyugamukhe rājā tṛtīye saṃbabhūva ha /
kanyā tu tasyeḍaviḍāmātā viśravaso hi sā //
meaning:
त्रेतायुगमुखे राजा तृतीये संबभूव ह /
कन्या तु तस्येडविडामाता विश्रवसो हि सा //
text_mt: He was a king at the opening of the third Tretāyuga. / His daughter was Iḍaviḍā, who was the mother of Viśravas.

sanskrit_iast:
putro yo 'sya viśālo 'bhūdrājā paramadhārmikaḥ /
dāśvānprakhyātavīryyaujā viśālā yena nirmitā //
meaning:
पुत्रो यो ऽस्य विशालो ऽभूद्राजा परमधार्मिकः /
दाश्वान्प्रख्यातवीर्य्यौजा विशाला येन निर्मिता //
text_mt: The son who was born to him was Viśāla, a king of supreme righteousness, / generous, celebrated for his strength and vigor, by whom Viśālā was built.

sanskrit_iast:
viśālasya suto rājā hemacandro mahābalaḥ /
sucandra iti vikhyāto hemacandrādanantaraḥ //
meaning:
विशालस्य सुतो राजा हेमचन्द्रो महाबलः /
सुचन्द्र इति विख्यातो हेमचन्द्रादनन्तरः //
text_mt: Viśāla's son was King Hemacandra of great might; / next after Hemacandra was the one known as Sucandra.

sanskrit_iast:
sucandratanayo rājā dhūmrāśva iti viśrutaḥ /
dhūmrāśvatanayo vidvānsṛṃjayaḥ samapadyata //
meaning:
सुचन्द्रतनयो राजा धूम्राश्व इति विश्रुतः /
धूम्राश्वतनयो विद्वान्सृंजयः समपद्यत //
text_mt: Sucandra's son was the celebrated King Dhūmrāśva; / Dhūmrāśva's son was the wise Sṛñjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛñjayasya sutaḥ śrīmānsahadevaḥ pratāpavān /
kṛśāśvaḥ sahadevasya putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
सृञ्जयस्य सुतः श्रीमान्सहदेवः प्रतापवान् /
कृशाश्वः सहदेवस्य पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः //
text_mt: Sṛñjaya's son was the glorious and majestic Sahadeva; / Kṛśāśva was the exceedingly righteous son of Sahadeva.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśāśvasya mahātejā somadattaḥ pratāpavān /
somadattasya rājarṣeḥ suto 'bhūjjanamejayaḥ //
meaning:
कृशाश्वस्य महातेजा सोमदत्तः प्रतापवान् /
सोमदत्तस्य राजर्षेः सुतो ऽभूज्जनमेजयः //
text_mt: Kṛśāśva's son was the majestic Somadatta of great splendor; / the royal sage Somadatta's son was Janamejaya.

sanskrit_iast:
janamejayātmajaścaiva pramatirnāma viśrutaḥ /
tṛṇabinduprabhāveṇa sarve vaiśālakā nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
जनमेजयात्मजश्चैव प्रमतिर्नाम विश्रुतः /
तृणबिन्दुप्रभावेण सर्वे वैशालका नृपाः //
text_mt: The son of Janamejaya was celebrated by the name Pramati. / By the power of Tṛṇabindu, all the kings of the line of Viśāla

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghāyuṣo mahātmāno vīryavantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ /
śaryātermithunaṃ tvāsīdānartto nāma viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
दीर्घायुषो महात्मानो वीर्यवन्तः सुधार्मिकाः /
शर्यातेर्मिथुनं त्वासीदानर्त्तो नाम विश्रुतः //
text_mt: were long-lived, great-souled, valiant, and very righteous. / Śaryāti had twins: the one celebrated as Ānarta,

sanskrit_iast:
putraḥ sukanyā kanyā ca bhāryā yā cyavanasya ca /
ānarttasya tu dāyādo revo nāma suvīryavān //
meaning:
पुत्रः सुकन्या कन्या च भार्या या च्यवनस्य च /
आनर्त्तस्य तु दायादो रेवो नाम सुवीर्यवान् //
text_mt: a son; and a daughter, Sukanyā, who was the wife of Cyavana. / The heir of Ānarta was the very valiant Reva,

sanskrit_iast:
ānarttaviṣayo yasya purī cāpi kuśasthalī /
revasya raivataḥ putraḥ kakudmī nāma dhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
आनर्त्तविषयो यस्य पुरी चापि कुशस्थली /
रेवस्य रैवतः पुत्रः ककुद्मी नाम धार्मिकः //
text_mt: whose country was the region of Ānarta and whose city was Kuśasthalī. / Reva's righteous son was Raivata, named Kakudmin.

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭho bhrātṛśatasyāsīdrājyaṃ prāpya kuśasthalīm /
kanyayā saha śrutvā ca gāndharvaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tike //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठो भ्रातृशतस्यासीद्राज्यं प्राप्य कुशस्थलीम् /
कन्यया सह श्रुत्वा च गान्धर्वं ब्रह्मणोंऽतिके //
text_mt: He was the eldest of a hundred brothers, and having obtained kingship in Kuśasthalī, / he went with his daughter to the presence of Brahmā and listened to music of the Gandharvas.

sanskrit_iast:
muharttaṃ devadevasya mārtyaṃ bahuyugaṃ vibho /
ājagāma yuvā caiva svāṃ purīṃ yādavairvṛtām //
meaning:
मुहर्त्तं देवदेवस्य मार्त्यं बहुयुगं विभो /
आजगाम युवा चैव स्वां पुरीं यादवैर्वृताम् //
text_mt: A moment of the god of gods, O lord, was many mortal yugas; / and returning, still a youth, to his city, [he found] it occupied by the Yādavas,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāṃ dvāravatīṃ nāma bahudvārāṃ manoramām /
bhojavṛṣṇyandhakairguptāṃ vasudevapurogamaiḥ //
meaning:
कृतां द्वारवतीं नाम बहुद्वारां मनोरमाम् /
भोजवृष्ण्यन्धकैर्गुप्तां वसुदेवपुरोगमैः //
text_mt: built into the charming city named Dvāravatī, with many gates, / protected by the Bhojas, Vṛṣṇis, and Andhakas headed by Vasudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ kathāṃ revataḥ śrutvā yathātattvamarindamaḥ /
kanyāṃ tu baladevāya suvratāṃ nāma revatīm /
dattvā jagāma śikharaṃ merostapasi saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
तां कथां रेवतः श्रुत्वा यथातत्त्वमरिन्दमः /
कन्यां तु बलदेवाय सुव्रतां नाम रेवतीम् /
दत्त्वा जगाम शिखरं मेरोस्तपसि संस्थितः //
text_mt: Having heard that account as it truly was, that tamer of foes, Revata, / gave his daughter of good vows, named Revatī, to Baladeva, / and went to the peak of Mount Meru, dedicated to ascetic austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
reme rāmaśca dharmātmā revatyā sahitaḥ kila /
tāṃ kathāmṛṣayaḥ śrutvā papracchuktadanantaram //
meaning:
रेमे रामश्च धर्मात्मा रेवत्या सहितः किल /
तां कथामृषयः श्रुत्वा पप्रच्छुक्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: And the righteous Rāma took delight in company with Revatī. / Having heard that account, the sages questioned him immediately thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ bahuyuge kāle samatīte mahāmate /
na jarā revatīṃ prāptā raivataṃ vā kakudminam /
etacchuśrūṣamāṇānno gāndharvaṃ vada caiva hi //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं बहुयुगे काले समतीते महामते /
न जरा रेवतीं प्राप्ता रैवतं वा ककुद्मिनम् /
एतच्छुश्रूषमाणान्नो गान्धर्वं वद चैव हि //
text_mt: The sages said: / 'How, O noble-minded one, when a time of many yugas had elapsed, / was old age not reached by Revatī or by Raivata Kakudmin? / Tell this to us who wish to hear, and [speak] also of the Gandharva music.'

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
na jarā kṣutpipāse vā na ca mṛtyubhayaṃ tataḥ /
na ca rogaḥ prabhavati brahmalokaṃ gatasya ha //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
न जरा क्षुत्पिपासे वा न च मृत्युभयं ततः /
न च रोगः प्रभवति ब्रह्मलोकं गतस्य ह //
text_mt: The bard said: / 'Neither old age, nor hunger and thirst, nor fear of death, / nor disease holds sway over one who has gone to the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
gāndharvaṃ prati yaccāpi pṛṣṭastu munisattamāḥ /
tato 'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena suvratāḥ //
meaning:
गान्धर्वं प्रति यच्चापि पृष्टस्तु मुनिसत्तमाः /
ततो ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि याथातथ्येन सुव्रताः //
text_mt: And regarding the Gandharva music about which I have been asked, O best of sages, / of that I shall tell according to the truth, O men of good vows.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrchanāstvekaviṃśatiḥ /
tānāścaikonapañcāśadityetsvaramaṇḍalam //
meaning:
सप्त स्वरास्त्रयो ग्रामा मूर्छनास्त्वेकविंशतिः /
तानाश्चैकोनपञ्चाशदित्येत्स्वरमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Seven notes, three parent scales, and twenty-one modal shifts, / and forty-nine melodic patterns—such is this system of musical notes:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍjaṣabhau ca gāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā /
dhaivataścāpi vijñeyastathā cāpi niṣādakaḥ //
meaning:
षड्जषभौ च गान्धारो मध्यमः पञ्चमस्तथा /
धैवतश्चापि विज्ञेयस्तथा चापि निषादकः //
text_mt: ṣaḍja, ṛṣabha, gāndhāra, madhyama, likewise pañcama, / dhaivata is also to be known, and similarly niṣāda.

sanskrit_iast: sauvīrā madhyamā grāmā hariṇāśca tathaiva ca //
meaning: सौवीरा मध्यमा ग्रामा हरिणाश्च तथैव च //
text_mt: Sauvīrā, the Madhyamā scales, and likewise the Hariṇās […]

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ kāloyanopetāścaturthāśuddhamadhyamāḥ /
nagniṃ ca pauṣā vai deva dṛṣṭvā kāñca yathākramaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः कालोयनोपेताश्चतुर्थाशुद्धमध्यमाः /
नग्निं च पौषा वै देव दृष्ट्वा काञ्च यथाक्रमः //
text_mt: accompanied by its kāloyana, the fourths are the pure madhyamas; / […] and having seen [them] in proper sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamagrāmikākhyātā ṣaḍjagrāmā nibodhata /
uttaraṃ mandrā rajanī tathā vāconnarāyatāḥ //
meaning:
मध्यमग्रामिकाख्याता षड्जग्रामा निबोधत /
उत्तरं मन्द्रा रजनी तथा वाचोन्नरायताः //
text_mt: the scales of the madhyamagrāma have been declared. Learn now of the ṣaḍjagrāma: / the Uttaramandrā, Rajanī, and likewise the Vacā, the Uttarāyatā,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaṣaḍjā tathā caiva tathānyā cābhimudgaṇā /
gāndhāragrāmikā śyāmā kīrtimānā nibodhata //
meaning:
मध्यषड्जा तथा चैव तथान्या चाभिमुद्गणा /
गान्धारग्रामिका श्यामा कीर्तिमाना निबोधत //
text_mt: the Madhyaṣaḍjā, and also another, the Abhirudgatā. / Learn of the scales belonging to the gāndhāragrāma: Śyāmā, Kīrtimānā […]'

sanskrit_iast:
agniṣṭomaṃ tu mādyaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vājapeyikam /
yavarātasūyastu ṣaṣṭhavattu suvarmakam //
meaning:
अग्निष्टोमं तु माद्यं तु द्वितीयं वाजपेयिकम् /
यवरातसूयस्तु षष्ठवत्तु सुवर्मकम् //
text_mt: The first is the Agniṣṭoma, the second is the Vājapeyika, / [the third] Rājasūya, [and so forth], while the sixth has Suvarma.

sanskrit_iast:
sapta gausavanā nāma mahāvṛṣṭikatāṣṭamām /
brahmadānaṃ ca navamaṃ prājāpatyamanantaram /
nāgayakṣāśrayaṃ vidvān tadgottaratathaiva ca //
meaning:
सप्त गौसवना नाम महावृष्टिकताष्टमाम् /
ब्रह्मदानं च नवमं प्राजापत्यमनन्तरम् /
नागयक्षाश्रयं विद्वान् तद्गोत्तरतथैव च //
text_mt: The seventh is named Gosavana, and the eighth is the Mahāvṛṣṭika; / the ninth is Brahmadāna, followed immediately by Prājāpatya; / the wise man should likewise know Uttarā and that resting on Nāgas and Yakṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
padakrāntamṛgakrāntaṃ viṣṇukrāntamanoharā /
sūryakāntadhareṇyaiva saṃtakokilaviśrutaḥ //
meaning:
पदक्रान्तमृगक्रान्तं विष्णुक्रान्तमनोहरा /
सूर्यकान्तधरेण्यैव संतकोकिलविश्रुतः //
text_mt: Padakrāntā, Mṛgakrāntā, Viṣṇukrāntā, and Manoharā; / Sūryakāntā, Dhareṇyā, and the renowned Saṃtakokilā;

sanskrit_iast:
tenavānityapavaśapiśācātīvanahyapi /
sāvitramardhasāvitraṃ sarvatobhadrameva ca //
meaning:
तेनवानित्यपवशपिशाचातीवनह्यपि /
सावित्रमर्धसावित्रं सर्वतोभद्रमेव च //
text_mt: and Tenavānityā, Pavā, [the mūrchanā] of Piśācas, and Atīvanahī; / Sāvitrī, Ardhasāvitrī, and Sarvatobhadrā;

sanskrit_iast:
manoharamadhātryaṃ ca gandharvānupataśca yaḥ /
alaṃbuṣeseṣṭamatho viṣṇuvaiṇavarāvubhau //
meaning:
मनोहरमधात्र्यं च गन्धर्वानुपतश्च यः /
अलंबुषेसेष्टमथो विष्णुवैणवरावुभौ //
text_mt: Manoharā, Madhātryā, and that which follows the Gandharvas; / and that dear to Alambuṣā, and both Viṣṇu and Vaiṇava;

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāvijayaṃ caiva sarvabhūtamanoharaḥ /
hatotsṛṣṭo vijānīta skandhaṃ tu priyameva ca //
meaning:
सागराविजयं चैव सर्वभूतमनोहरः /
हतोत्सृष्टो विजानीत स्कन्धं तु प्रियमेव च //
text_mt: Sāgarā, Vijayā, and Sarvabhūtamanoharā; / know Hatotsṛṣṭā, and Skandhapriyā;

sanskrit_iast:
manoharamadhātryaṃ ca gandharvānupataśca yaḥ /
alaṃbuseṣṭasya tathā nāradapriya eva ca //
meaning:
मनोहरमधात्र्यं च गन्धर्वानुपतश्च यः /
अलंबुसेष्टस्य तथा नारदप्रिय एव च //
text_mt: Manoharā, Madhātryā, and that which follows the Gandharvas; / and that dear to Alambuṣā, as well as Nāradapriyā;

sanskrit_iast:
kathito bhīmasenena nagarātānayapriyaḥ /
vikalopanītavinatāśrīrākhyo bhārgavapriyaḥ //
meaning:
कथितो भीमसेनेन नगरातानयप्रियः /
विकलोपनीतविनताश्रीराख्यो भार्गवप्रियः //
text_mt: proclaimed by Bhīmasena, and Nagarātānayapriyā; / [the mūrchanā] called Vikalopanītā, Vinatā, and Śrī, beloved of the Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśa tathā pañcadaśecchantīha nāradaḥ /
sasauvīrāṃ susovīrā brahmaṇo hyapagīyate //
meaning:
चतुर्दश तथा पञ्चदशेच्छन्तीह नारदः /
ससौवीरां सुसोवीरा ब्रह्मणो ह्यपगीयते //
text_mt: Nārada here desires fourteen as well as fifteen; / the Sauvīrā and Susauvīrā are indeed sung for Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarādisvaraścaiva brahmā vai devatāstrayaḥ /
harideśasamutpannā hariṇasyāvyajāyata //
meaning:
उत्तरादिस्वरश्चैव ब्रह्मा वै देवतास्त्रयः /
हरिदेशसमुत्पन्ना हरिणस्याव्यजायत //
text_mt: The note Uttarā and the others have Brahmā and the [other] three deities; / born in the realm of Hari, [the mūrchanā] Hariṇā was produced.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrchanā hariṇā te vai candrasyāsyādhidaivatam /
karopanītā vivṛtāvanudriḥ svaramaṇḍale //
meaning:
मूर्छना हरिणा ते वै चन्द्रस्यास्याधिदैवतम् /
करोपनीता विवृतावनुद्रिः स्वरमण्डले //
text_mt: Hariṇā is their mūrchanā, and the Moon is its presiding deity; / Karopanītā is unfolded in the register of notes […].

sanskrit_iast:
sākalopanatātasmānmanutasyānnadaivataḥ /
manudeśāḥ samutpannā mūrcchanāśuddhamātmanā //
meaning:
साकलोपनतातस्मान्मनुतस्यान्नदैवतः /
मनुदेशाः समुत्पन्ना मूर्च्छनाशुद्धमात्मना //
text_mt: From Sākalopanatā, Manu is its presiding deity; / born in the realm of Manu, the mūrchanā is pure in nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttasmānmṛgāmargīmṛgendrosyādhidaivatā /
sāvaśramasamādyumnā anekāpauruṣānakhān //
meaning:
तस्मात्तस्मान्मृगामर्गीमृगेन्द्रोस्याधिदैवता /
सावश्रमसमाद्युम्ना अनेकापौरुषानखान् //
text_mt: From that is the Mṛgī mūrchanā, whose presiding deity is the lion; / […] many […].

sanskrit_iast:
mūrcchanāyojanāhyeṣāsyādrajasārajanītataḥ /
tāni uttara madrāṃsapadgadaivatakaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
मूर्च्छनायोजनाह्येषास्याद्रजसारजनीततः /
तानि उत्तर मद्रांसपद्गदैवतकं विदुः //
text_mt: This combination of mūrchanās begins with rajas and then Rajanī; / they know those as Uttarā and Mandrā, having Pada as their deity.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduttaratāyāvatprathamaṃ svāyamaṃ viduḥ /
tamoduttaramaidroyadevatāsyādruvena ca //
meaning:
तस्मादुत्तरतायावत्प्रथमं स्वायमं विदुः /
तमोदुत्तरमैद्रोयदेवतास्याद्रुवेन च //
text_mt: Therefore, as far as Uttarāyatā, they know it as the first, Svāyamā; / and Uttaramandrā, whose deity is [Indra] with Dhruva.

sanskrit_iast:
apāmaduttaratvāvadhaivatasyottarāyaṇaḥ /
syādijamūrchanāhyeca pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ //
meaning:
अपामदुत्तरत्वावधैवतस्योत्तरायणः /
स्यादिजमूर्छनाह्येच पितरः श्राद्धदेवताः //
text_mt: Because it is higher than the waters, it belongs to the northern course of Dhaivata; / and the ancestors, deities of the ancestral rites, are the deities of this mūrchanā.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaṣaḍjasvara kṛtvā yasmādagnimaharṣayaḥ /
upaiti tasmānnajānī yācchuddhayacchikarāsabhā //
meaning:
शुद्धषड्जस्वर कृत्वा यस्मादग्निमहर्षयः /
उपैति तस्मान्नजानी याच्छुद्धयच्छिकरासभा //
text_mt: Because the great sages produce the note Śuddhaṣaḍja from fire, / therefore one should know [it] as pure […].

sanskrit_iast:
ityetā mūrchanāḥ kṛtvā yasyāmīdṛśabhāvanaḥ /
pakṣiṇāṃ mūrchanāḥ śrutvā pakṣokā mūrchanāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येता मूर्छनाः कृत्वा यस्यामीदृशभावनः /
पक्षिणां मूर्छनाः श्रुत्वा पक्षोका मूर्छनाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Having thus produced these mūrchanās, in which such bhāvanā exists, / hearing the mūrchanās of birds, they are remembered as the mūrchanās stated by birds.

sanskrit_iast:
nāgādṛṣṭiviṣāgītānopasarpantimūrchanāḥ /
nānāsādhāramaścaivavaḍavātrividastathā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamābhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde gāndharvamūrchanālakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 61//
meaning:
नागादृष्टिविषागीतानोपसर्पन्तिमूर्छनाः /
नानासाधारमश्चैववडवात्रिविदस्तथा //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमाभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे गान्धर्वमूर्छनालक्षणवर्णनं नामैकषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 61//
text_mt:
Serpents whose glance is venomous do not approach songs and mūrchanās; / various intermediate forms and threefold mares […].

Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Characteristics of Musical Modes (mūrchanā) in Gandharva Lore', in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvācāryamataṃ buddhvā pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ /
vikhyātānvai alaṅkārāṃstanme nigadataḥ śruṇu //
meaning:
पूर्वाचार्यमतं बुद्ध्वा प्रवक्ष्याम्यनुपूर्वशः /
विख्यातान्वै अलङ्कारांस्तन्मे निगदतः श्रुणु //
text_mt: Having understood the opinion of the ancient teachers, I shall declare in proper order / the renowned ornaments (alaṅkāra); listen to me as I proclaim them.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkārāstu vaktavyāḥ svaiḥ svairvarṇaiḥ prahetavaḥ /
saṃsthā nayogaiśca tathā sadā nāḍhyādyavekṣayā //
meaning:
अलङ्कारास्तु वक्तव्याः स्वैः स्वैर्वर्णैः प्रहेतवः /
संस्था नयोगैश्च तथा सदा नाढ्याद्यवेक्षया //
text_mt: Ornaments should be stated as causes by means of their own respective melodic lines (varṇa), / and through positions and applications, always with regard to the nāḍīs and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
vākyārthapadayogārthairalaṅkāraiśca pūraṇam /
padāni gītakasyāhuḥ purastātpṛṣṭhato 'tha vā //
meaning:
वाक्यार्थपदयोगार्थैरलङ्कारैश्च पूरणम् /
पदानि गीतकस्याहुः पुरस्तात्पृष्ठतो ऽथ वा //
text_mt: Filling out [the composition] by means of the meaning of sentences, the combination of words, and ornaments, / they declare these words to belong to the song, either before or behind.

sanskrit_iast:
sthātonitrīnaro nīḍḍīmanaḥkaṇṭhaśirasthayā /
eteṣu triṣu sthāneṣu pravṛtto vidhiruttamaḥ //
meaning:
स्थातोनित्रीनरो नीड्डीमनःकण्ठशिरस्थया /
एतेषु त्रिषु स्थानेषु प्रवृत्तो विधिरुत्तमः //
text_mt: [Originating] from the mind, the throat, and the head, / in these three registers the highest procedure operates.

sanskrit_iast:
cattvāraḥ prakṛtau varṇāḥ pravicārasya nurvidhā /
vikalpamaṣṭadhā caiva devāḥ ṣoḍaśadhā viduḥ //
meaning:
चत्त्वारः प्रकृतौ वर्णाः प्रविचारस्य नुर्विधा /
विकल्पमष्टधा चैव देवाः षोडशधा विदुः //
text_mt: There are four primary melodic lines (varṇa), but human examination has many forms; / they know an eightfold distinction, and the gods know sixteen varieties.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭo varmaḥ prasaṃcārī tṛtīyamavarohaṇam /
ārohaṇaṃ caturthaṃ tu varṇaṃ varmavido viduḥ //
meaning:
सृष्टो वर्मः प्रसंचारी तृतीयमवरोहणम् /
आरोहणं चतुर्थं तु वर्णं वर्मविदो विदुः //
text_mt: The emitted line is the transitory (saṃcārin), descending (avarohaṇa) is the third, / and ascending (ārohaṇa) is the fourth; thus know the experts in melodic lines.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraikaḥ saṃcarasthāyī saṃcarastu caro 'bhavat /
avarohaṇavarṇānāmavarohaṃ vinirdiśet //
meaning:
तत्रैकः संचरस्थायी संचरस्तु चरो ऽभवत् /
अवरोहणवर्णानामवरोहं विनिर्दिशेत् //
text_mt: Among them, one is stationary (sthāyin), while the transitory (saṃcārin) is mobile; / one should point out descent for descending melodic lines.

sanskrit_iast:
ārohaṇena vārohānvarṇānvarṇavido viduḥ /
eteṣāmeva varṇānāmalaṅkārannibodhata //
meaning:
आरोहणेन वारोहान्वर्णान्वर्णविदो विदुः /
एतेषामेव वर्णानामलङ्कारन्निबोधत //
text_mt: Experts in melodic lines know the ascending lines by means of ascent; / learn now the ornaments (alaṅkāra) of these very melodic lines.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṅkārāstu catvārasthāpanī kramarejanaḥ /
pramādasyāpramādaśca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
अलङ्कारास्तु चत्वारस्थापनी क्रमरेजनः /
प्रमादस्याप्रमादश्च तेषां वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् //
text_mt: There are four ornaments: Sthāpanī, Krama, Recana, / and Pramāda and Apramāda; I shall declare their characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
visvaro 'ṣṭakalāścaiva sthānaṃ dvyekatarāgataḥ /
āvarttasyākramo tvākṣī vekāryāṃ parimāṇataḥ //
meaning:
विस्वरो ऽष्टकलाश्चैव स्थानं द्व्येकतरागतः /
आवर्त्तस्याक्रमो त्वाक्षी वेकार्यां परिमाणतः //
text_mt: A discord (visvara) and eight kalās, and the register coming from two or one; / the irregularity of recurrence according to measure in Vikāryā […].

sanskrit_iast:
kumāraṃ saṃparaṃ viddhi dvistaraṃ vāmanaṃ gataḥ /
eṣa vai eṣa caivasyakutarekaḥ kulādhikaḥ //
meaning:
कुमारं संपरं विद्धि द्विस्तरं वामनं गतः /
एष वै एष चैवस्यकुतरेकः कुलाधिकः //
text_mt: Know Kumāra as supreme, extending twofold […]; / and this indeed would be […].

sanskrit_iast:
sveta sve kātare jātakalāmagnitaraiṣitaḥ /
tasmiṃścaiva svare vṛddhirniṣṭapte tadvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
स्वेत स्वे कातरे जातकलामग्नितरैषितः /
तस्मिंश्चैव स्वरे वृद्धिर्निष्टप्ते तद्विचक्षणः //
text_mt: […] born in one's own […], / and there is an increase on that note; one who knows this is discerning.

sanskrit_iast:
syenastu aparo hasta uttaraḥ kamalākalaḥ /
pramāṇaghasabindurnā jāyate vidure punaḥ //
meaning:
स्येनस्तु अपरो हस्त उत्तरः कमलाकलः /
प्रमाणघसबिन्दुर्ना जायते विदुरे पुनः //
text_mt: The falcon is the other hand, higher with lotus-like kalās; / a drop of measured eating is not produced again in Vidura.

sanskrit_iast:
kalā kāryā tu varṇānāṃ tadā nuḥ sthāpito bhavet /
viparyayasya ropisyā dyasya prādurghaṭī mama //
meaning:
कला कार्या तु वर्णानां तदा नुः स्थापितो भवेत् /
विपर्ययस्य रोपिस्या द्यस्य प्रादुर्घटी मम //
text_mt: A kalā should be made of the melodic lines, then a man would be established; / of inversion […].

sanskrit_iast:
ekottaraḥ svarastu syātṣaḍjataḥ paramaḥ svaraḥ /
akṣepaskandanākāryaṃ kākasyoyacapuṣkalam //
meaning:
एकोत्तरः स्वरस्तु स्यात्षड्जतः परमः स्वरः /
अक्षेपस्कन्दनाकार्यं काकस्योयचपुष्कलम् //
text_mt: The note would be one step higher, the highest note from ṣaḍja; / casting down and jumping should not be done, which is abundant like a crow […].

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtārau taunusarvāyyau kāryaṃ vā kāraṇaṃ tathā /
ākṣiptamavarohyāsītprokṣamadyastathaiva ca //
meaning:
संतारौ तौनुसर्वाय्यौ कार्यं वा कारणं तथा /
आक्षिप्तमवरोह्यासीत्प्रोक्षमद्यस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Both [notes] are expanding, either the effect or the cause; / it was cast down and descending, and likewise sprinkling today.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśe ca kalāsthānāmekāntaragatas tathā /
preśollikhitamalaṅkāramevasvarasamanvitā //
meaning:
द्वादशे च कलास्थानामेकान्तरगतस् तथा /
प्रेशोल्लिखितमलङ्कारमेवस्वरसमन्विता //
text_mt: At the twelfth position of the kalā, moving at an interval of one, / the ornament marked out [is produced] endowed with musical notes.

sanskrit_iast:
svarasvarabahugrāmakāprayoṣṭanupatkalā /
prakṣiptameva kalayācopādānārayo bhavet //
meaning:
स्वरस्वरबहुग्रामकाप्रयोष्टनुपत्कला /
प्रक्षिप्तमेव कलयाचोपादानारयो भवेत् //
text_mt: In many scales of note after note, a kalā follows […]; / it is inserted by the kalā, and there would be a wheel of appropriation.

sanskrit_iast:
dvikathaṃvāvathābhūtayatrabhāṣitamucyate /
uccarādviśvarārūḍhātathāyāṣṭasvarātathā //
meaning:
द्विकथंवावथाभूतयत्रभाषितमुच्यते /
उच्चराद्विश्वरारूढातथायाष्टस्वरातथा //
text_mt: Whether said twice, where it is spoken; / rising from a discordant note, and likewise with eight notes;

sanskrit_iast:
vāpaḥ syādavaroheṇa nārato bhavati dhruvam /
ekāntaraṃ ca hyetevaitamevasvarasattamaḥ //
meaning:
वापः स्यादवरोहेण नारतो भवति ध्रुवम् /
एकान्तरं च ह्येतेवैतमेवस्वरसत्तमः //
text_mt: there would be omission through descent; it definitely does not cease; / and at intervals of one note indeed, O best of notes.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṣipracchedanāmācacatuṣkalagaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
alaṅkārā bhavantyete triṃśaddevaiḥ prakīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
सक्षिप्रच्छेदनामाचचतुष्कलगणः स्मृतः /
अलङ्कारा भवन्त्येते त्रिंशद्देवैः प्रकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: Named Sakṣipraccheda, it is remembered as having a group of four kalās; / these ornaments, thirty in number, are proclaimed by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāsthānaprayogeṇa kalāmātrāpramāṇataḥ /
saṃsthānaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ ca vikāro lakṣaṇastathā //
meaning:
वर्णास्थानप्रयोगेण कलामात्राप्रमाणतः /
संस्थानं च प्रमाणं च विकारो लक्षणस्तथा //
text_mt: Through the application of melodic lines and registers, according to the measure of kalās and mātrās, / through arrangement, measure, modification, and characteristic,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhamidaṃ jñeya malaṅkāraprayojanam /
yathātmano hyalaṅkāro vipayasto vigarhitaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विधमिदं ज्ञेय मलङ्कारप्रयोजनम् /
यथात्मनो ह्यलङ्कारो विपयस्तो विगर्हितः //
text_mt: this fourfold purpose of ornament is to be known. / Just as an ornament on oneself, when misplaced, is censured,

sanskrit_iast:
varmamevāpyalaṅkarttuṃ viṣamāhyātmasaṃbhavāḥ /
nānābharaṇasaṃyogā yathā nāryā vibhūṣaṇam //
meaning:
वर्ममेवाप्यलङ्कर्त्तुं विषमाह्यात्मसंभवाः /
नानाभरणसंयोगा यथा नार्या विभूषणम् //
text_mt: even to adorn a melodic line, [misplaced ones] arising from oneself are irregular; / just as an assemblage of various ornaments is the adornment of a woman,

sanskrit_iast:
varmasya caivālaṅkāro vibhūṣā hyātmasaṃbhavaḥ /
na pāde kuṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na kaṇṭhe rasanā tathā //
meaning:
वर्मस्य चैवालङ्कारो विभूषा ह्यात्मसंभवः /
न पादे कुण्डलं दृष्टं न कण्ठे रसना तथा //
text_mt: so the ornament of a melodic line is an embellishment born of itself; / an earring is not seen on the foot, nor a girdle on the throat.

sanskrit_iast:
evamevādyalaṅkāre viparyasto vigarhitaḥ /
kriyamāṇo 'pyalaṅkāro nāgaṃ yaścaiva darśayat //
meaning:
एवमेवाद्यलङ्कारे विपर्यस्तो विगर्हितः /
क्रियमाणो ऽप्यलङ्कारो नागं यश्चैव दर्शयत् //
text_mt: Just so, in the first place, an ornament when inverted is censured; / even though an ornament is being made, it does not display the limb.

sanskrit_iast:
yathādṛṣṭasya mārgasyakarttavyasyavidhīyate /
lakṣaṇaṃparyavasyāpivarttikā mapivarttate //
meaning:
यथादृष्टस्य मार्गस्यकर्त्तव्यस्यविधीयते /
लक्षणंपर्यवस्यापिवर्त्तिका मपिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: As is prescribed for the path seen to be done, / the characteristic also terminates, and it proceeds in the commentary.

sanskrit_iast:
yāthātathyena vakṣyāmi māsodbhavamukhodbhava /
trayoviṃśatiśītistu vijñātapavadaivatam //
meaning:
याथातथ्येन वक्ष्यामि मासोद्भवमुखोद्भव /
त्रयोविंशतिशीतिस्तु विज्ञातपवदैवतम् //
text_mt: I shall declare in accordance with truth that which arises from the mouth and arises from the months; / twenty-three and eighty are known to have Dhaivata as the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
nagonātupurastānumadhyamāṃśastu paryayaḥ /
tayorvibhāgo devānāṃ lāvaṇye mārgasaṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
नगोनातुपुरस्तानुमध्यमांशस्तु पर्ययः /
तयोर्विभागो देवानां लावण्ये मार्गसंस्थितः //
text_mt: […] not before, however; the middle part is the inversion; / the division between them is established in the path for the gods’ beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
anuṣaṅgamayo dṛṣṭaṃ svasāraṃ vasvarātara /
viparyayaḥ saṃvartto ca saptasvarapadakramam //
meaning:
अनुषङ्गमयो दृष्टं स्वसारं वस्वरातर /
विपर्ययः संवर्त्तो च सप्तस्वरपदक्रमम् //
text_mt: Consisting of connection, his own essence is seen across notes; / inversion and winding is the sequence of the seven notes and words.

sanskrit_iast:
gāndhārasetugīyante varomadbhagavānica /
pañcamaṃmadhyamañcaivadhaivataṃ tu niṣādataḥ //
meaning:
गान्धारसेतुगीयन्ते वरोमद्भगवानिच /
पञ्चमंमध्यमञ्चैवधैवतं तु निषादतः //
text_mt: In the gāndhāra [mode] they are sung, [as are] the blessed boons; / the fifth and the middle note indeed, and the sixth after the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍjarṣabhaścajānīmomadrakeṣvevanāntare /
dvevdyaparatukiṃvidyāddvayamuṣṇantikasyatu //
meaning:
षड्जर्षभश्चजानीमोमद्रकेष्वेवनान्तरे /
द्वेव्द्यपरतुकिंविद्याद्द्वयमुष्णन्तिकस्यतु //
text_mt: The first and second notes we recognize in the madraka meters without interval; / what else may one know from the two? Whose warmth do the two steal?

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛte vaikṛte caiva gāndhāraḥ sa prayujyate /
padasyātyayarūpantusaptarūpantukauśikīm //
meaning:
प्राकृते वैकृते चैव गान्धारः स प्रयुज्यते /
पदस्यात्ययरूपन्तुसप्तरूपन्तुकौशिकीम् //
text_mt: In both the natural and the modified form, the gāndhāra note is employed; / but the form of passing beyond the word, the sevenfold form, is the kauśikī [style].

sanskrit_iast:
gāndhārasyenakārtsyena cāyaṃ yasyavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
eṣacaivakramoddiṣṭomadhyamāṃśasya madhyamaḥ //
meaning:
गान्धारस्येनकार्त्स्येन चायं यस्यविधिः स्मृतः /
एषचैवक्रमोद्दिष्टोमध्यमांशस्य मध्यमः //
text_mt: For whoever this rule is remembered regarding the gāndhāra in its entirety, / this sequence is designated as the middle of the middle part.

sanskrit_iast:
yāni proktāni gītānivaturūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ /
tataḥ saptasvaraṅkāryaṃsaptarūpañcakauśikī //
meaning:
यानि प्रोक्तानि गीतानिवतुरूपं विशेषतः /
ततः सप्तस्वरङ्कार्यंसप्तरूपञ्चकौशिकी //
text_mt: Whichever songs have been spoken of, especially in fourfold form, / then the work of seven notes is to be done, along with the sevenfold kauśikī.

sanskrit_iast:
agadarśanamityāhurmānudvaimamaketathā /
dvitīyāmāsamātrāṇābhiḥ sarvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
अगदर्शनमित्याहुर्मानुद्वैममकेतथा /
द्वितीयामासमात्राणाभिः सर्वाः प्रतिष्ठिताः //
text_mt: They declare it the vision of wholeness, thus […] / by the measures of the second month, all are established.

sanskrit_iast:
uttarevaprakṛtyevaṃmātābrāhmatalāyata /
tathāhatānopiḍakeyatramāyāṃnivarttate //
meaning:
उत्तरेवप्रकृत्येवंमाताब्राह्मतलायत /
तथाहतानोपिडकेयत्रमायांनिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: In the northern [region], by nature, thus the mother stretched out on Brahmā’s surface; / likewise, even when afflicted, where the illusion turns back in the lump.

sanskrit_iast:
pādenaikenamāyātrā pādonāmativārimaḥ /
saṃkhyāpanopahūtāṃvaitatrapānamiti smṛtam //
meaning:
पादेनैकेनमायात्रा पादोनामतिवारिमः /
संख्यापनोपहूतांवैतत्रपानमिति स्मृतम् //
text_mt: With one quarter is the measure, less by a quarter indeed […]; / called upon by numbering, drinking is remembered there.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyapādabhaṅgañcagrahenāmapratiṣṭhitam /
pūrvamaṣṭhatīṭatī nadvitīyaṃ cāparāntikaiḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयपादभङ्गञ्चग्रहेनामप्रतिष्ठितम् /
पूर्वमष्ठतीटती नद्वितीयं चापरान्तिकैः //
text_mt: And the breaking of the second quarter is established through the take; / the previous one […], and not the second by the westerners.

sanskrit_iast:
pādabhāgasapādaṃ tu prakṛtyamapi saṃsthitam /
caturthamuttaraṃ caivamadravatpāvamadrakau //
meaning:
पादभागसपादं तु प्रकृत्यमपि संस्थितम् /
चतुर्थमुत्तरं चैवमद्रवत्पावमद्रकौ //
text_mt: A quarter-part together with a quarter stands even by nature; / the fourth is northern, and thus possessing the madra meter are the two madrakas.

sanskrit_iast:
madrakodakṣiṇasyāpi yathoktā varttate kalā /
sarvamevānuyogaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ buddhimiṣyate //
meaning:
मद्रकोदक्षिणस्यापि यथोक्ता वर्त्तते कला /
सर्वमेवानुयोगं तु द्वितीयं बुद्धिमिष्यते //
text_mt: And the kalā of the southern madraka proceeds as stated; / every questioning indeed is considered a second intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
pādauvāharaṇaṃ cāsyātpāraṃ nātra vidhīyate /
ekatvaṃ munuyogasya dvayoryadyaddvijottama //
meaning:
पादौवाहरणं चास्यात्पारं नात्र विधीयते /
एकत्वं मुनुयोगस्य द्वयोर्यद्यद्द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: And there should be the extraction of the feet; no further boundary is prescribed here; / regarding the unity of the questioning of the two, whatever [it may be], O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
anekasamavāyastu pātakā hariṇā smṛtāḥ /
tisṛṇāṃ caiva vṛttīnāṃ vṛttau vṛtte ca dakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
अनेकसमवायस्तु पातका हरिणा स्मृताः /
तिसृणां चैव वृत्तीनां वृत्तौ वृत्ते च दक्षिणः //
text_mt: The multitude of combinations are remembered by Hari as causes of downfall; / and among the three styles, in the style and in the meter, the southern [is used].

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau tu samavāyastu vīrā saṃmūrchanā tathā /
kasyanāsutarācaiva svaraśākhā prakīrttitā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde bhārgavacarite gāndharvalakṣaṇaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 62//
meaning:
अष्टौ तु समवायस्तु वीरा संमूर्छना तथा /
कस्यनासुतराचैव स्वरशाखा प्रकीर्त्तिता //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे भार्गवचरिते गान्धर्वलक्षणं नाम द्विषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 62//
text_mt:
Eight are the combinations, heroic is the mūrchanā likewise; / whose melodic branch is declared not to be superior?

Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, named "The Definition of the Art of the Gandharvas," in the story of the Bhārgava, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
kukudminanastu taṃ lokaṃ raivatasya gatasya ha /
tdṛtā puṇyajanaiḥ sarvā rākṣasaiḥ sākuśasthalī //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
कुकुद्मिननस्तु तं लोकं रैवतस्य गतस्य ह /
त्दृता पुण्यजनैः सर्वा राक्षसैः साकुशस्थली //
text_mt:
The bard said:
When that Raivata Kukudmin had departed to that world, / all of that Kuśasthalī was seized by the Puṇyajanas, the rākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvai bhrātṛśataṃ tasya dhārmikasya mahātmanaḥ /
nibadhyamānaṃ nārācairvidiśaḥ prādravadbhayāt //
meaning:
तद्वै भ्रातृशतं तस्य धार्मिकस्य महात्मनः /
निबध्यमानं नाराचैर्विदिशः प्राद्रवद्भयात् //
