text_mt: His son was Muni, and from him Ūrjavaha is remembered; / from Ūrjavaha came Sanadvāja, and Śakuni was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
svāgataḥ śakuneḥ putraḥ suvarcāstatsutaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sutopastasya dāyādaḥ suśrutastasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
स्वागतः शकुनेः पुत्रः सुवर्चास्तत्सुतः स्मृतः /
सुतोपस्तस्य दायादः सुश्रुतस्तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: Svāgata was the son of Śakuni; Suvarcas is remembered as his son; / Sutapas was his heir, and Suśruta was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
suśrutasya jayaḥ putro jayasya vijayaḥ sutaḥ /
vijayasya kratuḥ putra- kratośca sunayaḥ smataḥ //
meaning:
सुश्रुतस्य जयः पुत्रो जयस्य विजयः सुतः /
विजयस्य क्रतुः पुत्र- क्रतोश्च सुनयः स्मतः //
text_mt: The son of Suśruta was Jaya; Vijaya was the son of Jaya; / Vijaya's son was Kratu, and Kratu's [son] is remembered as Sunaya.

sanskrit_iast:
sunayādvītahavyastu vītahavyātmajo dhṛtiḥ /
dhṛtestu bahulāśvo 'bhūdbahulāśvasutaḥ kṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सुनयाद्वीतहव्यस्तु वीतहव्यात्मजो धृतिः /
धृतेस्तु बहुलाश्वो ऽभूद्बहुलाश्वसुतः कृतिः //
text_mt: From Sunaya came Vītahavya, and Vītahavya's son was Dhṛti; / from Dhṛti was Bahulāśva; Bahulāśva's son was Kṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsaṃtiṣṭhate vaṃśo canakānāṃ mahātmanām /
ityete maithilāḥ proktāḥ somasyāpi nibodhata //
eti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīye upoddhātapāde nimivaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 64//
meaning:
तस्मिन्संतिष्ठते वंशो चनकानां महात्मनाम् /
इत्येते मैथिलाः प्रोक्ताः सोमस्यापि निबोधत //
एति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीये उपोद्धातपादे निमिवंशानुकीर्तनं नाम चतुःषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 64//
text_mt:
With him concludes the lineage of the great-souled Janakas. / Thus these Maithilas have been declared; now learn of Soma.

Thus in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu, in the middle part, in the third Upoddhātapāda, ends the sixty-fourth chapter, titled 'Proclamation of the Lineage of Nimi'.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
pitā somasya vai viprā jajñe 'trirbhagavānṛṣiḥ /
tatrātriḥ sarvalokānāṃ tasthau svenaujasā vṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
पिता सोमस्य वै विप्रा जज्ञे ऽत्रिर्भगवानृषिः /
तत्रात्रिः सर्वलोकानां तस्थौ स्वेनौजसा वृतः //
text_mt: The sūta said: / O Brahmins, the venerable sage Atri was born as the father of Soma; / there Atri stood, surrounded by his own splendor, among all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā śubhānyeva samācaran /
kāṣṭhakuḍyaśilābhūta ūrddhvabāhurmahādyutiḥ //
meaning:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा शुभान्येव समाचरन् /
काष्ठकुड्यशिलाभूत ऊर्द्ध्वबाहुर्महाद्युतिः //
text_mt: Practicing only auspicious deeds in action, mind, and speech, / motionless like wood, a wall, or a stone, his arms raised high, endowed with great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
suduścaraṃ nāma tapo yena taptaṃ mahātpurā /
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyānīti hi naḥ śrutam //
meaning:
सुदुश्चरं नाम तपो येन तप्तं महात्पुरा /
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि दिव्यानीति हि नः श्रुतम् //
text_mt: By him great asceticism, very difficult to perform, was formerly practiced; / for three thousand celestial years, so indeed have we heard.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyorddhvaretasastatra sthitasyānimiṣasya ha /
somatvaṃ tanurāpede mahābuddhiḥ sa vai dvijaḥ //
meaning:
तस्योर्द्ध्वरेतसस्तत्र स्थितस्यानिमिषस्य ह /
सोमत्वं तनुरापेदे महाबुद्धिः स वै द्विजः //
text_mt: As he stood there unblinking, having drawn up his semen, / his body attained the nature of Soma; he was indeed a Brahmin of great intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhvamācakrame tasya somatvaṃ bhāvitātmanaḥ /
netrābhyā masravatsomo daśadhā dyotayan diśaḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्द्ध्वमाचक्रमे तस्य सोमत्वं भावितात्मनः /
नेत्राभ्या मस्रवत्सोमो दशधा द्योतयन् दिशः //
text_mt: The nature of Soma mounted upward in him whose self was purified; / from his eyes Soma flowed forth, illuminating the ten directions.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ garbhaṃ vidhinā hṛṣṭā daśa devyo dadhustadā /
sametya dhārayāmāsurna ca tāḥ samaśaknuvan //
meaning:
तं गर्भं विधिना हृष्टा दश देव्यो दधुस्तदा /
समेत्य धारयामासुर्न च ताः समशक्नुवन् //
text_mt: Then, rejoicing, the ten goddess [directions] properly took up that fetus; / coming together, they held it, yet they were not able [to bear it].

sanskrit_iast:
sa tābhyaḥ sahasaivātha digbhyo garbhaḥ prasādhitaḥ /
papāta bhāsayaṃllokāñchītāṃśuḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ //
meaning:
स ताभ्यः सहसैवाथ दिग्भ्यो गर्भः प्रसाधितः /
पपात भासयंल्लोकाञ्छीतांशुः सर्वभावनः //
text_mt: Then all at once that fetus, fully formed, fell from those directions; / the cool-rayed one, the animator of all, fell, illuminating the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na dhāraṇe śaktāstasya garbhasya tāḥ striyaḥ /
tataḥ sahābhiḥ śītāṃśurnipapāta vasuṃdharām //
meaning:
यदा न धारणे शक्तास्तस्य गर्भस्य ताः स्त्रियः /
ततः सहाभिः शीतांशुर्निपपात वसुंधराम् //
text_mt: When those women were unable to bear his fetus, / then the cool-rayed one fell down along with them to the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
patantaṃ somamālokya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ /
rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
पतन्तं सोममालोक्य ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः /
रथमारोपयामास लोकानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Seeing Soma falling, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / mounted him upon a chariot out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sa hi vedamayo viprā dharmātmā satyasaṃgaraḥ /
yukte vājisahasreṇa rathe 'dhyāsteti naḥśrutam //
meaning:
स हि वेदमयो विप्रा धर्मात्मा सत्यसंगरः /
युक्ते वाजिसहस्रेण रथे ऽध्यास्तेति नःश्रुतम् //
text_mt: For he is composed of the Vedas, O Brahmins, righteous and true to his promise; / he mounted the chariot yoked with a thousand steeds, so have we heard.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminnipatite devāḥ putre 'treḥ paramātmanaḥ /
tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sapta viśrutāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्निपतिते देवाः पुत्रे ऽत्रेः परमात्मनः /
तुष्टुवुर्ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा मानसाः सप्त विश्रुताः //
text_mt: When that son of the supreme-souled Atri had fallen down, the gods / and the celebrated seven mind-born sons of Brahmā praised him;

sanskrit_iast:
tatraivāṅgirasāstasya bhṛgoścaivātmajāstathā /
ṛgbhiryajurbhirbahubhiratharvāṅgirasairapi //
meaning:
तत्रैवाङ्गिरसास्तस्य भृगोश्चैवात्मजास्तथा /
ऋग्भिर्यजुर्भिर्बहुभिरथर्वाङ्गिरसैरपि //
text_mt: Right there the sons of Aṅgiras and the sons of Bhṛgu also [praised] him / with many verses from the Ṛgveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvāṅgiras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvataḥ /
āpyāyamānaṃ lokāṃstrīnbhāvayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
ततः संस्तूयमानस्य तेजः सोमस्य भास्वतः /
आप्यायमानं लोकांस्त्रीन्भावयामास सर्वशः //
text_mt: Then, as he was being praised, the radiance of the shining Soma, / swelling forth, nourished the three worlds on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tena rathamukhyena sāgarāntāṃ vasuṃdharām /
triḥsaptakṛtvo 'tiyaśāścakārābhipradakṣiṇam //
meaning:
स तेन रथमुख्येन सागरान्तां वसुंधराम् /
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वो ऽतियशाश्चकाराभिप्रदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: With that foremost chariot, the highly celebrated one / circumambulated the earth bordered by the oceans twenty-one times.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya yadvarddhitaṃ tejaḥ pṛthivīmanvapadyata /
oṣadhyastāḥ samudbhūtāstejasā khaṃ jvalatyuta //
meaning:
तस्य यद्वर्द्धितं तेजः पृथिवीमन्वपद्यत /
ओषध्यस्ताः समुद्भूतास्तेजसा खं ज्वलत्युत //
text_mt: His increased radiance that fell upon the earth / gave rise to those medicinal herbs, and by that radiance the sky blazes.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiḥ puṇyātyayaṃ lokānprajāścāpi caturvidhāḥ /
poṣṭā hi bhagavānsomo jagato hi dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
ताभिः पुण्यात्ययं लोकान्प्रजाश्चापि चतुर्विधाः /
पोष्टा हि भगवान्सोमो जगतो हि द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Through them [he sustains] the worlds until the end of merit, and also the four classes of beings; / for the venerable Soma is indeed the nourisher of the world, O best of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sa labdhatejāstapasā saṃstavaistaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ /
tavastepe mahābhāgaḥ samānāṃ navatīrdaśa //
meaning:
स लब्धतेजास्तपसा संस्तवैस्तैः स्वकर्मभिः /
तवस्तेपे महाभागः समानां नवतीर्दश //
text_mt: Having obtained radiance through asceticism, through those hymns of praise, and through his own deeds, / the fortunate one performed tapas for ten [times] ninety years.

sanskrit_iast:
iraṇyavarṇā yā devyo dhārayantyātmanā jagat /
vibhustāsāṃ mudā somaḥ prakhyātaḥsvena karmaṇā //
meaning:
इरण्यवर्णा या देव्यो धारयन्त्यात्मना जगत् /
विभुस्तासां मुदा सोमः प्रख्यातःस्वेन कर्मणा //
text_mt: The golden-hued goddesses who uphold the world by themselves— / Soma, renowned for his deed, became their all-pervading lord with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ /
bījauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāmapāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तस्मै ददौ राज्यं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः /
बीजौषधीनां विप्राणामपां च द्विजसत्तमाः //
text_mt: Then Brahmā, the foremost of knowers of Brahman, granted him sovereignty / over seeds, medicinal herbs, Brahmins, and the waters, O best of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'bhiṣikto mahātejā mahārājyena rājarāṭ /
lokānvai bhāvayāmāsa tejasvī tapatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
सो ऽभिषिक्तो महातेजा महाराज्येन राजराट् /
लोकान्वै भावयामास तेजस्वी तपतां वरः //
text_mt: Having been consecrated with great sovereignty, the radiant king of kings, / being luminous, animated the worlds, foremost among the splendid.

sanskrit_iast:
saptaviṃśatirindostu dākṣāyaṇyo mahāvratāḥ /
dadau prācetaso dakṣo nakṣatrāṇīti yā viduḥ //
meaning:
सप्तविंशतिरिन्दोस्तु दाक्षायण्यो महाव्रताः /
ददौ प्राचेतसो दक्षो नक्षत्राणीति या विदुः //
text_mt: Dakṣa, son of Pracetas, gave twenty-seven daughters of Dakṣa, / of great vows, to Indu—those which they know as the constellations.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatprāpya mahādrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ prabhuḥ /
samārebhe rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam //
meaning:
स तत्प्राप्य महाद्राज्यं सोमः सोमवतां प्रभुः /
समारेभे राजसूयं सहस्रशतदक्षिणम् //
text_mt: Having attained that great sovereignty, Soma, the lord of those possessing soma, / undertook a rājasūya sacrifice with a hundred thousand sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvamīyivān /
sadasyastatra bhagavānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भश्चोद्गाता ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वमीयिवान् /
सदस्यस्तत्र भगवान्हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः //
text_mt: Hiraṇyagarbha was the udgātṛ chanter, Brahmā undertook the role of the brahmā priest, / and the venerable lord Hari Nārāyaṇa was an attendant member of the assembly there,

sanskrit_iast: sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ //
meaning: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैराद्यैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वृतः //
text_mt: Surrounded by the primordial brahmarṣis headed by Sanatkumāra.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāmadadātsomastrīṃllokāniti naḥ śrutam /
tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca vai dvijāḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणामददात्सोमस्त्रींल्लोकानिति नः श्रुतम् /
तेभ्यो ब्रह्मर्षिमुख्येभ्यः सदस्येभ्यश्च वै द्विजाः //
text_mt: As the sacrificial gift, Soma gave the three worlds, so have we heard, / to those foremost brahmarṣis and to the members of the assembly, O Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva vapuḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ /
kīrttirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire //
meaning:
तं सिनी च कुहूश्चैव वपुः पुष्टिः प्रभा वसुः /
कीर्त्तिर्धृतिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च नव देव्यः सिषेविरे //
text_mt:
Sinī, Kuhū, Vapus, Puṣṭi, Prabhā, Vasu,
Kīrti, Dhṛti, and Lakṣmī—nine goddesses waited upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ /
atireje hi rājendro daśadhā bhāsayandiśaḥ //
meaning:
प्राप्यावभृथमव्यग्रः सर्वदेवर्षिपूजितः /
अतिरेजे हि राजेन्द्रो दशधा भासयन्दिशः //
text_mt:
Having reached the final ablution, undisturbed, praised by all the celestial sages,
the foremost of kings shone exceedingly, illuminating the directions tenfold.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tatprāpya duṣprāpamaiśvaryamṛṣisaṃstutam /
vibabhrāma matirviprā vinayādanayāvṛtā //
meaning:
तस्य तत्प्राप्य दुष्प्रापमैश्वर्यमृषिसंस्तुतम् /
विबभ्राम मतिर्विप्रा विनयादनयावृता //
text_mt:
Having attained that sovereignty hard to obtain, extolled by the sages,
his mind, surrounded by injustice, fell away from modesty, O brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspateḥ savai bhāryāṃ tārāṃ nāma yaśasvinīm /
jahāra sahasā sarvānavamatyāṅgiraḥsutān //
meaning:
बृहस्पतेः सवै भार्यां तारां नाम यशस्विनीम् /
जहार सहसा सर्वानवमत्याङ्गिरःसुतान् //
text_mt:
Indeed, he forcibly abducted the renowned Tārā, the wife of Bṛhaspati,
having completely disregarded all the sons of Aṅgiras.

sanskrit_iast:
sa yācyamāno devaiśca tathā devarṣibhiśca ha /
naiva vyasarjayattārāṃ tasmā aṅgirase tadā //
meaning:
स याच्यमानो देवैश्च तथा देवर्षिभिश्च ह /
नैव व्यसर्जयत्तारां तस्मा अङ्गिरसे तदा //
text_mt:
Though entreated by the gods and likewise by the celestial sages,
he did not at all release Tārā to that descendant of Aṅgiras then.

sanskrit_iast:
uśanāstasya jagrāha pārṣṇimaṅgiraso bhavaḥ /
sa hi śiṣyo mahātejāḥ pituḥ pūrvaṃ bṛhaspateḥ //
meaning:
उशनास्तस्य जग्राह पार्ष्णिमङ्गिरसो भवः /
स हि शिष्यो महातेजाः पितुः पूर्वं बृहस्पतेः //
text_mt:
Uśanas protected his rear from the descendant of Aṅgiras;
for that one of great splendor had previously been the pupil of Bṛhaspati's father.

sanskrit_iast:
tena snehena bhagavānrudrastasya bṛhaspateḥ /
pārṣmigrāho 'bhavaddevaḥ pragṛhyājagavaṃ dhanuḥ //
meaning:
तेन स्नेहेन भगवान्रुद्रस्तस्य बृहस्पतेः /
पार्ष्मिग्राहो ऽभवद्देवः प्रगृह्याजगवं धनुः //
text_mt:
Out of that affection, Lord Rudra became
the protector of Bṛhaspati's rear, seizing the Ājagava bow.

sanskrit_iast:
tena brahmaśiro nāma paramāstraṃ mahātmanā /
uddiśya devānutsṛṣṭaṃ yenaiṣāṃ nāśitaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
तेन ब्रह्मशिरो नाम परमास्त्रं महात्मना /
उद्दिश्य देवानुत्सृष्टं येनैषां नाशितं यशः //
text_mt:
By that great-souled one, the supreme weapon called Brahmaśiras
was discharged aimed at the gods, whereby their fame was destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tadyuddhamabhavatprakhyātaṃ tārakāmayam /
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca lokakṣayakaraṃ mahat //
meaning:
तत्र तद्युद्धमभवत्प्रख्यातं तारकामयम् /
देवानां दानवानां च लोकक्षयकरं महत् //
text_mt:
There that great battle took place, celebrated as the Tārakāmaya [war],
between the gods and the Dānavas, causing destruction to the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śiṣṭāstu ye devāstuṣitāścaiva te smṛtāḥ /
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurādidevaṃ pitāmaham //
meaning:
तत्र शिष्टास्तु ये देवास्तुषिताश्चैव ते स्मृताः /
ब्रह्माणं शरणं जग्मुरादिदेवं पितामहम् //
text_mt:
The gods who remained there, who are remembered as the Tuṣitas,
went for refuge to Brahmā, the primal deity, the Grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
tato nivāryośanasaṃ rudraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca śaṅkaram /
dadāvāṅgirase tārāṃ svayametya pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
ततो निवार्योशनसं रुद्रं ज्येष्ठं च शङ्करम् /
ददावाङ्गिरसे तारां स्वयमेत्य पितामहः //
text_mt:
Then, having restrained Uśanas and Rudra, the eldest Śaṅkara,
the Grandfather came in person and gave Tārā back to the descendant of Aṅgiras.

sanskrit_iast:
antarvatnīṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tārāṃ tārādhipānanām /
garbhamutsṛja sadyastvaṃ vipraḥ prāha bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्वत्नीं च तां दृष्ट्वा तारां ताराधिपाननाम् /
गर्भमुत्सृज सद्यस्त्वं विप्रः प्राह बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt:
And seeing that Tārā, whose face resembled the lord of the stars, was pregnant,
the brahmin Bṛhaspati said: "Discharge the embryo immediately!

sanskrit_iast:
madīyāyāṃ na te yonau garbho dhāryaḥ kathañcana /
atho tārāsṛjadgarbhaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam //
meaning:
मदीयायां न ते योनौ गर्भो धार्यः कथञ्चन /
अथो तारासृजद्गर्भं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् //
text_mt:
The embryo must by no means be retained by you in what belongs to me!"
Then Tārā discharged the embryo, blazing like fire.

sanskrit_iast:
jātamātro 'tha bhagavāndevānāmākṣipadvapuḥ /
tataḥ saṃśayamāpannastārāmakathayansurāḥ //
meaning:
जातमात्रो ऽथ भगवान्देवानामाक्षिपद्वपुः /
ततः संशयमापन्नस्तारामकथयन्सुराः //
text_mt:
As soon as he was born, the lord eclipsed the splendor of the gods.
Then, seized with doubt, the gods said to Tārā:

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ brūhi sutaḥ kasya somasyātha bṛhaspateḥ /
hrīyamāṇā yadā devānnāha sā sādhvasādhu vā //
meaning:
सत्यं ब्रूहि सुतः कस्य सोमस्याथ बृहस्पतेः /
ह्रीयमाणा यदा देवान्नाह सा साध्वसाधु वा //
text_mt:
"Speak the truth: whose son is he? Soma's or Bṛhaspati's?"
When, feeling ashamed before the gods, she said neither good nor bad,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tāṃ śaptumārabdhaḥ kumāro dasyuhantamaḥ /
taṃ nivārya tadābrahmā tārāṃ papraccha saṃśayam //
meaning:
तदा तां शप्तुमारब्धः कुमारो दस्युहन्तमः /
तं निवार्य तदाब्रह्मा तारां पप्रच्छ संशयम् //
text_mt:
then that boy, the foremost slayer of enemies, began to curse her.
Restraining him then, Brahmā questioned Tārā to resolve the doubt:

sanskrit_iast:
yadatra tathyaṃ tadbrūhi tāre kasya sutastvayam /
sā prāñjaliruvācedaṃ brahmāṇaṃ varadaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
यदत्र तथ्यं तद्ब्रूहि तारे कस्य सुतस्त्वयम् /
सा प्राञ्जलिरुवाचेदं ब्रह्माणं वरदं प्रभुम् //
text_mt:
"Speak that which is the truth here, O Tārā! Whose son is this?"
With folded hands she said this to Brahmā, the boon-granting lord:

sanskrit_iast:
somasyati mahātmānaṃ kumāraṃ dasyuhantamam /
tataḥ sutamupāghrāya somo rājā prajāpatiḥ //
meaning:
सोमस्यति महात्मानं कुमारं दस्युहन्तमम् /
ततः सुतमुपाघ्राय सोमो राजा प्रजापतिः //
text_mt:
"[He is] Soma's," of that great-souled boy, the foremost slayer of enemies.
Then King Soma, the Prajāpati, having smelled his son's head,

sanskrit_iast:
budha ityakaronnāma tasya putrasya dhīmataḥ /
pratighasraṃ ca gagane samabhyuttiṣṭhate budhaḥ //
meaning:
बुध इत्यकरोन्नाम तस्य पुत्रस्य धीमतः /
प्रतिघस्रं च गगने समभ्युत्तिष्ठते बुधः //
text_mt:
gave the name 'Budha' to that wise son;
and day after day Budha rises in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
utpādayāmāsa tadā putraṃ ve rājaputrikā /
tasya putro mahātejā babhūvailaḥ purūravāḥ //
meaning:
उत्पादयामास तदा पुत्रं वे राजपुत्रिका /
तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा बभूवैलः पुरूरवाः //
text_mt:
Then that princess indeed brought forth a son;
his son was the greatly radiant Aila Purūravas.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśyāṃ jajñire tasya patrāḥ ṣaṭ sumahaujasaḥ /
prasahya dharṣitastatra vivaśo rājayakṣmaṇā //
meaning:
उर्वश्यां जज्ञिरे तस्य पत्राः षट् सुमहौजसः /
प्रसह्य धर्षितस्तत्र विवशो राजयक्ष्मणा //
text_mt:
Six sons of exceedingly great vigor were born to him by Urvaśī.
Assailed there violently, helpless with consumption,

sanskrit_iast:
tato yakṣmābhibhūtastu somaḥ prakṣiṇamaṇḍalaḥ /
jagāma śaraṇāyātha pitaraṃ so 'trimeva tu //
meaning:
ततो यक्ष्माभिभूतस्तु सोमः प्रक्षिणमण्डलः /
जगाम शरणायाथ पितरं सो ऽत्रिमेव तु //
text_mt:
then Soma, overwhelmed by consumption, his disc waning,
went indeed to his father Atri for refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tatpāpaśamanaṃ cakārātrirmahāyaśāḥ /
sa rājayakṣmaṇā muktaḥ śrīyā jajavāla sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य तत्पापशमनं चकारात्रिर्महायशाः /
स राजयक्ष्मणा मुक्तः श्रीया जजवाल सर्वशः //
text_mt:
Atri of great renown performed the appeasement of that sin for him.
Freed from consumption, he blazed on all sides with splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsomasya vai janma kīrttitaṃ dvijasattamāḥ /
vaṃśaṃ tasya dvijaśreṣṭhā kīrtyamānaṃ nibodhata //
meaning:
एतत्सोमस्य वै जन्म कीर्त्तितं द्विजसत्तमाः /
वंशं तस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठा कीर्त्यमानं निबोधत //
text_mt:
This birth of Soma has been proclaimed, O best of brahmins!
Understand his lineage, O foremost of the twice-born, as it is recounted:

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ kalmaṣaśodhanam /
saumyasya canma śrutvaivaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde somasaumyayorjanmakathanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 65//
meaning:
धन्यमारोग्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं कल्मषशोधनम् /
सौम्यस्य चन्म श्रुत्वैवं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे सोमसौम्ययोर्जन्मकथनं नाम पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 65//
text_mt:
It brings fortune, health, longevity, is meritorious, and removes impurities.
Just by hearing of the birth of the son of Soma, one is freed from all sins.

Thus ends the sixty-fifth chapter, named 'The narration of the birth of Soma and the son of Soma', in the Upoddhātapāda, the third part, in the middle section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa proclaimed by Vāyu. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhasya tu purūravāḥ /
tejasvī dānaśīlaśca yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
सोमस्य तु बुधः पुत्रो बुधस्य तु पुरूरवाः /
तेजस्वी दानशीलश्च यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः //
text_mt:
The bard said:
Soma's son was Budha, and Budha's [son] was Purūravas,
splendid, generous, a sacrificer who gave abundant sacrificial fees,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavādī parākrāntaḥ śatrubhiryudhi durjayaḥ /
āharttā jāgnihotrasya yajñānāṃ ca mahīpatiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मवादी पराक्रान्तः शत्रुभिर्युधि दुर्जयः /
आहर्त्ता जाग्निहोत्रस्य यज्ञानां च महीपतिः //
text_mt:
an expounder of Brahman, valorous, invincible to enemies in battle,
a maintainer of the Agnihotra and of sacrifices, a lord of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
satyavāgdharmabuddhiśca kāntaḥ saṃvṛttamaithunaḥ /
atīva triṣu lokeṣu rūpeṇāpratimo 'bhavat //
meaning:
सत्यवाग्धर्मबुद्धिश्च कान्तः संवृत्तमैथुनः /
अतीव त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणाप्रतिमो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
truthful in speech, of righteous intellect, charming, restrained in lovemaking;
he was exceedingly matchless in beauty in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ brahmavādinaṃ dāntaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyavādinam /
urvaśī varayāmāsa hitvā mānaṃ yaśasvinī //
meaning:
तं ब्रह्मवादिनं दान्तं धर्मज्ञं सत्यवादिनम् /
उर्वशी वरयामास हित्वा मानं यशस्विनी //
text_mt:
Him, the expounder of Brahman, self-restrained, knower of righteousness, speaker of truth,
the renowned Urvaśī chose, casting aside her pride.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā sahāvasadrājā daśa varṣāṇi cāṣṭa ca /
sapta ṣaṭsapta cāṣṭau ca daśa cāṣṭau ca vīryavān //
meaning:
तया सहावसद्राजा दश वर्षाणि चाष्ट च /
सप्त षट्सप्त चाष्टौ च दश चाष्टौ च वीर्यवान् //
text_mt:
The valiant king lived with her for ten years and eight,
seven, six, seven, eight, and ten and eight,

sanskrit_iast:
vane caitrarathe ramye tathā mandākinītaṭe /
alakāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ nandane ca vanottame //
meaning:
वने चैत्ररथे रम्ये तथा मन्दाकिनीतटे /
अलकायां विशालायां नन्दने च वनोत्तमे //
text_mt:
in the delightful Caitraratha forest, and likewise on the bank of the Mandākinī,
in spacious Alakā, and in the excellent Nandana grove,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhamādanapādeṣu meruśṛṅge nagottame /
uttarāṃśca kurūnprāpya kalāpagrāmameva ca //
meaning:
गन्धमादनपादेषु मेरुशृङ्गे नगोत्तमे /
उत्तरांश्च कुरून्प्राप्य कलापग्राममेव च //
text_mt:
at the foothills of Gandhamādana, on the peak of Meru, the best of mountains,
and having reached the Northern Kurus, and the village of Kalāpa.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣu vanamukhyeṣu surairācariteṣu ca /
urvaśyā mahito rājā reme paramayā mudā //
meaning:
एतेषु वनमुख्येषु सुरैराचरितेषु च /
उर्वश्या महितो राजा रेमे परमया मुदा //
text_mt:
In these foremost forests frequented by the gods,
the king, honored by Urvaśī, delighted with the greatest joy.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
gandharvī corvaśī devī rājānaṃ mānuṣaṃ katham /
utsṛjya taṃ ca saṃprāptā tanno brūhi ca duṣkṛtam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
गन्धर्वी चोर्वशी देवी राजानं मानुषं कथम् /
उत्सृज्य तं च संप्राप्ता तन्नो ब्रूहि च दुष्कृतम् //
text_mt:
The sages said:
How did Urvaśī, a gandharvī, a divine lady,
abandon that human king and depart? Tell us of that misdeed.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
brahmaśāpābhibhūtā sā mānuṣaṃ samupasthitā /
ātmanaḥ śāpamokṣārthaṃ niyamaṃ sā cakāra tu //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ब्रह्मशापाभिभूता सा मानुषं समुपस्थिता /
आत्मनः शापमोक्षार्थं नियमं सा चकार तु //
text_mt:
The bard said:
Overcome by a curse of Brahmā, she approached the mortal.
For the sake of release from her curse, however, she made a pact:

sanskrit_iast:
anagnadarśanaṃ caiva akāmātsaha maithunam /
dvau meṣau śayanābhyāśe sā tāvaddhyavatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
अनग्नदर्शनं चैव अकामात्सह मैथुनम् /
द्वौ मेषौ शयनाभ्याशे सा तावद्ध्यवतिष्ठते //
text_mt:
"[There must be] no sight of you naked, and no lovemaking without my consent.
Two rams [must stay] near my bed; so long will she remain.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtamātraṃ tathā'hāraḥ kālamekaṃ tu pārthiva /
yadyeṣa samayo rājanyāvatkālaśca te dṛḍhaḥ //
meaning:
घृतमात्रं तथाऽहारः कालमेकं तु पार्थिव /
यद्येष समयो राजन्यावत्कालश्च ते दृढः //
text_mt:
My food [shall be] ghee alone, once a day, O king.
If this agreement, O king, remains firm for you for whatever time,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatkālaṃ tu vatsyāmi eṣa naḥ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ /
tasyāstaṃ samayaṃ sarvaṃ sa rājā paryapālayat //
meaning:
तावत्कालं तु वत्स्यामि एष नः समयः कृतः /
तस्यास्तं समयं सर्वं स राजा पर्यपालयत् //
text_mt:
for that long will I dwell [with you]; this is the agreement made by us."
The king preserved that entire agreement of hers.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sā cāvasattena sahelenā bhigāminī /
varṣāṇyatha catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tadbhaktyā śāpamohitā //
meaning:
एवं सा चावसत्तेन सहेलेना भिगामिनी /
वर्षाण्यथ चतुःषष्टिं तद्भक्त्या शापमोहिता //
text_mt:
Thus she lived with that son of Ilā, having intercourse [with him],
for sixty-four years, out of devotion to him, bewildered by the curse.

sanskrit_iast:
urvaśī mānuṣaṃ prāptā gandharvāścintayānvitāḥ /
gandharvā ūcuḥ
cintayadhvaṃ mahābhāgā yathā sā tu varāṅganā //
meaning:
उर्वशी मानुषं प्राप्ता गन्धर्वाश्चिन्तयान्विताः /
गन्धर्वा ऊचुः
चिन्तयध्वं महाभागा यथा सा तु वराङ्गना //
text_mt:
When Urvaśī went to the mortal, the gandharvas were filled with anxiety.
The gandharvas said:
"Deliberate, O fortunate ones, so that that excellent woman,

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchettu punardevānurvaśī svargabhūṣaṇam /
tato viśvāpasurnāma gandharvaḥ sumahāmatiḥ //
meaning:
आगच्छेत्तु पुनर्देवानुर्वशी स्वर्गभूषणम् /
ततो विश्वापसुर्नाम गन्धर्वः सुमहामतिः //
text_mt:
Urvaśī, the ornament of heaven, may return to the gods."
Then the gandharva named Viśvāvasu, of very great intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
jahāroraṇakau tasyāstatpaścātsā divaṃ gatā /
tasyāstu viraheṇāsau bhramamāṇastvathorvaśīm //
meaning:
जहारोरणकौ तस्यास्तत्पश्चात्सा दिवं गता /
तस्यास्तु विरहेणासौ भ्रममाणस्त्वथोर्वशीम् //
text_mt:
carried off her two rams; after that she went to heaven.
Wandering about because of separation from her, however, he then

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa ca kurukṣetre tayā saṃbhāṣito 'pyayam /
gandharvānupadhāveti sa taccakre 'tha te daduḥ //
meaning:
ददर्श च कुरुक्षेत्रे तया संभाषितो ऽप्ययम् /
गन्धर्वानुपधावेति स तच्चक्रे ऽथ ते ददुः //
text_mt:
beheld Urvaśī at Kurukṣetra, and was addressed by her:
"Run after the gandharvas!" He did that, and then they gave [him]

sanskrit_iast:
agnisthālīṃ tayā rājā gataḥ svargaṃ mahārathaḥ /
eko 'gniḥ pūrvamāsīdvai ailastaṃ trīnakalpayat //
meaning:
अग्निस्थालीं तया राजा गतः स्वर्गं महारथः /
एको ऽग्निः पूर्वमासीद्वै ऐलस्तं त्रीनकल्पयत् //
text_mt:
the pot of fire, by which that great chariot-warrior king went to heaven.
Previously there was only one fire; that descendant of Ilā made it threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃprabhāvo rājāsīdailastu dvijasattamāḥ /
deśe puṇyatame caiva maharṣibhiralaṅkṛte //
meaning:
एवंप्रभावो राजासीदैलस्तु द्विजसत्तमाः /
देशे पुण्यतमे चैव महर्षिभिरलङ्कृते //
text_mt:
Such was the power of the king, the son of Ilā, O best of brahmins!
In the most sacred region adorned by the great sages,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ sa kārayāmāsa prayāge pṛthivīpatiḥ /
uttare yāmune tīre pratiṣṭhāne mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
राज्यं स कारयामास प्रयागे पृथिवीपतिः /
उत्तरे यामुने तीरे प्रतिष्ठाने महायशाः //
text_mt:
that lord of the earth, of great renown, ruled his kingdom:
at Prayāga, at Pratiṣṭhāna, on the northern bank of the Yamunā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya putrā babhūvurhi ṣaḍindropamatejasaḥ /
gandharvaloke viditā āyurddhīmānamāvasuḥ //
meaning:
तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि षडिन्द्रोपमतेजसः /
गन्धर्वलोके विदिता आयुर्द्धीमानमावसुः //
text_mt: He had six sons equal in splendour to Indra, / renowned in the world of the gandharvas: wise Āyu and Amāvasu,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāvasuḥ śratāyuśca ghṛtāyuścovarśīsutāḥ /
amāva sostu vai jāte bhīmo rājātha viśvacit //
meaning:
विश्वावसुः श्रतायुश्च घृतायुश्चोवर्शीसुताः /
अमाव सोस्तु वै जाते भीमो राजाथ विश्वचित् //
text_mt: Viśvāvasu, Śrutāyu, and Ghṛtāyu—the sons of Urvaśī. / To Amāvasu was born King Bhīma, and then Viśvacit.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmānbhīmasya dāyādo rājāsītkāñcanaprabhaḥ /
vidvāṃstu kāñcanasyāpi suhotro 'bhūnmahābala //
meaning:
श्रीमान्भीमस्य दायादो राजासीत्काञ्चनप्रभः /
विद्वांस्तु काञ्चनस्यापि सुहोत्रो ऽभून्महाबल //
text_mt: Bhīma's heir was the glorious King Kāñcanaprabha; / and Kāñcana's [son] was the learned and very powerful Suhotra.

sanskrit_iast:
suhotrasyābhavajjahnuḥ keśinīgarbhasaṃbhavaḥ /
pratigatya tato gaṅgā vitate ya5karmaṇi //
meaning:
सुहोत्रस्याभवज्जह्नुः केशिनीगर्भसंभवः /
प्रतिगत्य ततो गङ्गा वितते य5कर्मणि //
text_mt: To Suhotra was born Jahnu, sprung from the womb of Keśinī. / Then the Gaṅgā, flowing against him when his sacrifice was underway,

sanskrit_iast:
sādayāmāsa taṃ deśaṃ bhāvinor'thasya darśanāt /
gaṅgayā plāvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭaṃ samantataḥ //
meaning:
सादयामास तं देशं भाविनोर्ऽथस्य दर्शनात् /
गङ्गया प्लावितं दृष्ट्वा यज्ञवाटं समन्ततः //
text_mt: flooded that place, because of seeing what was destined to happen. / Seeing the sacrificial enclosure inundated all around by the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
sauhotrirapi saṃkruddho gaṅgāṃ rājā dvijottamāḥ /
tadārājarṣiṇā pītāṃ gaṅgāṃ dṛṣṭvā surarṣayaḥ //
meaning:
सौहोत्रिरपि संक्रुद्धो गङ्गां राजा द्विजोत्तमाः /
तदाराजर्षिणा पीतां गङ्गां दृष्ट्वा सुरर्षयः //
text_mt: the king, the son of Suhotra, was enraged with the Gaṅgā, O best of the twice-born! / Then, seeing the Gaṅgā drunk up by that royal sage, the divine sages

sanskrit_iast:
upaninyurmahābhāgā duhitṛtvena jāhnavīm /
yauvanāśvasya pautrīṃ tu kāverīṃ jahnurāvahat //
meaning:
उपनिन्युर्महाभागा दुहितृत्वेन जाह्नवीम् /
यौवनाश्वस्य पौत्रीं तु कावेरीं जह्नुरावहत् //
text_mt: of great good fortune brought the daughter of Jahnu (Jāhnavī) to him as his daughter. / And Jahnu married Kāverī, granddaughter of Yuvanāśva.

sanskrit_iast:
yuvanāśvasya śāpena gaṅgārddhena vinirmame /
kāverīṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭha jahnubhāryāmaninditām //
meaning:
युवनाश्वस्य शापेन गङ्गार्द्धेन विनिर्ममे /
कावेरीं सरितां श्रेष्ठ जह्नुभार्यामनिन्दिताम् //
text_mt: By the curse of Yuvanāśva, half of Gaṅgā became / Kāverī, best of rivers, the blameless wife of Jahnu.

sanskrit_iast:
jahnustu dayitaṃ putraṃ sunahaṃ nāma dhārmikam /
kāveryāṃ janayāmāsa ajakastasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
जह्नुस्तु दयितं पुत्रं सुनहं नाम धार्मिकम् /
कावेर्यां जनयामास अजकस्तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: Jahnu begot upon Kāverī a beloved, righteous son / named Sunaha, and Ajaka was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
ajakasya tu dāyādo balākāśvo mahāyaśāḥ /
babhūva mṛga śīlaḥ suśastasyātmajaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अजकस्य तु दायादो बलाकाश्वो महायशाः /
बभूव मृग शीलः सुशस्तस्यात्मजः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Ajaka's heir was the illustrious Balākāśva, / who had the disposition of a deer, and Kuśa is remembered as his son.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśaputrā babhūvuśca catvāro devavarcasaḥ /
kuśāṃbaḥ kuśānābhaśca amūrtarayamo vasuḥ //
meaning:
कुशपुत्रा बभूवुश्च चत्वारो देववर्चसः /
कुशांबः कुशानाभश्च अमूर्तरयमो वसुः //
text_mt: Kuśa had four sons endowed with divine radiance: / Kuśāmba, Kuśanābha, Amūrtarayas, and Vasu.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśikastu tapastepe putrārthī rājasattamaḥ /
pūrṇe varṣasahasre vai śatakraturapaśyata //
meaning:
कुशिकस्तु तपस्तेपे पुत्रार्थी राजसत्तमः /
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे वै शतक्रतुरपश्यत //
text_mt: Kuśika, the best of kings, performed austerities, desiring a son; / when a thousand years were completed, Śatakratu observed him.

sanskrit_iast:
tamugratapasaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ /
samarthaḥ putrajanane svayamevāsya śāśvataḥ //
meaning:
तमुग्रतपसं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षः पुरन्दरः /
समर्थः पुत्रजनने स्वयमेवास्य शाश्वतः //
text_mt: Seeing him engaged in fierce tapas, the thousand-eyed Purandara, / being himself capable of generating a son for him, that eternal one,

sanskrit_iast:
putratvaṃ kalpayāmāsa svayameva purandaraḥ /
gādhirnāmābhavatputraḥ kauśikaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रत्वं कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पुरन्दरः /
गाधिर्नामाभवत्पुत्रः कौशिकः पाकशासनः //
text_mt: Purandara himself resolved to become his son. / He became the son named Gādhi, the Kauśika, [namely] Pākaśāsana.

sanskrit_iast:
paurukutsyabhavadbhāryā gādhestasyāmajāyata /
pūrvaṃ kanyā mahābhāgā nāmnā satyavatī śubhā //
meaning:
पौरुकुत्स्यभवद्भार्या गाधेस्तस्यामजायत /
पूर्वं कन्या महाभागा नाम्ना सत्यवती शुभा //
text_mt: Gādhi had a wife born of the lineage of Purukutsa; from her was born / first a fortunate maiden, the auspicious one named Satyavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ gādhiḥ putrakāmāya ṛcīkāya dadau prabhuḥ /
tasyāḥ prītastu vai bharttā bhārgavo bhṛgunandanaḥ //
meaning:
तां गाधिः पुत्रकामाय ऋचीकाय ददौ प्रभुः /
तस्याः प्रीतस्तु वै भर्त्ता भार्गवो भृगुनन्दनः //
text_mt: The lord Gādhi gave her to Ṛcīka, who desired a son. / Her husband, the Bhārgava, son of Bhṛgu, was pleased with her,

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthe sādhayāmāsa caruṃ gādhestathaiva ca /
athāvocatpriyāṃ tatra ṛcīko bhārgavastadā //
meaning:
पुत्रार्थे साधयामास चरुं गाधेस्तथैव च /
अथावोचत्प्रियां तत्र ऋचीको भार्गवस्तदा //
text_mt: and prepared a sacrificial porridge for the sake of a son, and likewise one for Gādhi. / Then Ṛcīka the Bhārgava spoke there to his beloved wife:

sanskrit_iast:
upabhojyaścarurayaṃ tvayā mātrā ca te śubhā /
tasyā janiṣyate putro dīptimānkṣattriyarṣabhaḥ //
meaning:
उपभोज्यश्चरुरयं त्वया मात्रा च ते शुभा /
तस्या जनिष्यते पुत्रो दीप्तिमान्क्षत्त्रियर्षभः //
text_mt: "This sacrificial porridge is to be eaten by you, and [this one] by your mother, O auspicious lady; / to her will be born a radiant son, an eminent kṣatriya,

sanskrit_iast:
ajeyaḥ kṣattriyairyuddhe kṣatriyarṣabhasūdanaḥ /
tavāpi putraṃ kalyāṇi dhṛtimantaṃ tapodhanam //
meaning:
अजेयः क्षत्त्रियैर्युद्धे क्षत्रियर्षभसूदनः /
तवापि पुत्रं कल्याणि धृतिमन्तं तपोधनम् //
text_mt: unconquerable by kṣatriyas in battle, a slayer of eminent kṣatriyas. / For you too, auspicious woman, steadfast, rich in tapas,

sanskrit_iast:
śamātmakaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ carureṣa vidhāsyati /
evamuktvā tu tāṃ bhāryāmṛcīko bhṛgunandanaḥ //
meaning:
शमात्मकं द्विजश्रेष्ठं चरुरेष विधास्यति /
एवमुक्त्वा तु तां भार्यामृचीको भृगुनन्दनः //
text_mt: devoted to tranquility, an eminent twice-born son will this sacrificial porridge produce." / Having spoken thus to his wife, Ṛcīka, the joy of Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasyabhirato nityamaraṇyaṃ praviśeśa ha /
gādhiḥ sadārastu tadā ṛcīkāśramamabhyagāt //
meaning:
तपस्यभिरतो नित्यमरण्यं प्रविशेश ह /
गाधिः सदारस्तु तदा ऋचीकाश्रममभ्यगात् //
text_mt: ever devoted to tapas, entered the forest. / Then Gādhi together with his wife came to the hermitage of Ṛcīka,

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena sutāṃ draṣṭuṃ nareśvaraḥ /
carudvayaṃ gṛhītvā tu ṛṣeḥ styavatī tadā //
meaning:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन सुतां द्रष्टुं नरेश्वरः /
चरुद्वयं गृहीत्वा तु ऋषेः स्त्यवती तदा //
text_mt: the king having come on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred waters to see his daughter. / Then Satyavatī, taking the two sacrificial porridges of the sage,

sanskrit_iast:
bharturvacanamavyagrā hṛṣṭā mātre nyavedayat /
mātā tu tasyai daivaina duhitre svacaruṃ dadau //
meaning:
भर्तुर्वचनमव्यग्रा हृष्टा मात्रे न्यवेदयत् /
माता तु तस्यै दैवैन दुहित्रे स्वचरुं ददौ //
text_mt: composed and delighted, reported the husband's instruction to her mother. / But the mother, by fate, gave her own sacrificial porridge to her daughter,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāścarumathājñānādātmanaḥ sā cakāra ha /
atha satyavatī garbhaṃ kṣatriyāntakaraṃ śubham //
meaning:
तस्याश्चरुमथाज्ञानादात्मनः सा चकार ह /
अथ सत्यवती गर्भं क्षत्रियान्तकरं शुभम् //
text_mt: and out of ignorance, she took her [daughter's] porridge for herself. / Then Satyavatī [bore] a splendid embryo that would destroy the kṣatriyas;

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayāmāsa dīptena vapuṣā ghoradarśanā /
tāmṛcīkastato dṛṣṭvā yogenāpyavamṛśya ca //
meaning:
धारयामास दीप्तेन वपुषा घोरदर्शना /
तामृचीकस्ततो दृष्ट्वा योगेनाप्यवमृश्य च //
text_mt: she bore it with a blazing body, terrifying in appearance. / Seeing her then, and discerning through yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
tadābravīddvijaśreṣṭhaḥ svāṃ bhāryāṃ varavarṇinīm /
mātrāsi vañcitā bhadre caruvyatyāsahetunā //
meaning:
तदाब्रवीद्द्विजश्रेष्ठः स्वां भार्यां वरवर्णिनीम् /
मात्रासि वञ्चिता भद्रे चरुव्यत्यासहेतुना //
text_mt: the best of the twice-born spoke to his fair-complexioned wife: / "You have been deceived by your mother, auspicious one, because of an exchange of the sacrificial porridge.

sanskrit_iast:
janiṣyati hi putraste krūrakarmātidārumaḥ /
mātā janiṣyate cāpi tathā bhūtaṃ tapodhanam //
meaning:
जनिष्यति हि पुत्रस्ते क्रूरकर्मातिदारुमः /
माता जनिष्यते चापि तथा भूतं तपोधनम् //
text_mt: For your son will be of cruel deeds and extremely dreadful, / while your mother will bear one who will be like [a sage] rich in tapas.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ hi brahmatapasā mayā tatra samarpitam /
evamuktā mahābhāgā bhartrā satyavatī tadā //
meaning:
विश्वं हि ब्रह्मतपसा मया तत्र समर्पितम् /
एवमुक्ता महाभागा भर्त्रा सत्यवती तदा //
text_mt: For all [energy] was placed by me there by means of Brahmanic tapas." / Being spoken to in this way by her husband, the highly fortunate Satyavatī

sanskrit_iast:
prasādayāmāsa patiṃ suto me nedṛśo bhavet /
brāhmaṇāpasadastvatta ityukto munimabravīt //
meaning:
प्रसादयामास पतिं सुतो मे नेदृशो भवेत् /
ब्राह्मणापसदस्त्वत्त इत्युक्तो मुनिमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: propitiated her husband: "May my son not be like that, / an outcast among brāhmaṇas, [born] from you!" Thus addressed, he said to the sage [i.e., she addressed the sage]:

sanskrit_iast:
naiva saṃkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayā /
ugrakarmā bhavetputraḥ piturmātuśca kāraṇāt //
meaning:
नैव संकल्पितः कामो मया भद्रे तथा त्वया /
उग्रकर्मा भवेत्पुत्रः पितुर्मातुश्च कारणात् //
text_mt: "This desire was not conceived by me, fair lady, nor by you; / [yet] the son would become one of fierce deeds on account of his father and mother."

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ satyavatī vākyamevamuktābravīdidam /
icchaṃllokānapi mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punaḥ sutam //
meaning:
पुनः सत्यवती वाक्यमेवमुक्ताब्रवीदिदम् /
इच्छंल्लोकानपि मुने सृजेथाः किं पुनः सुतम् //
text_mt: Being addressed thus, Satyavatī again spoke this word: / "Wishing it, O sage, you could create even worlds, so why not a son?

sanskrit_iast:
śamātmakamṛjuṃ bharttaḥ putraṃ me dātumarhasi /
kāmamevaṃvidhaḥ pautro mama syāttava suvrata //
meaning:
शमात्मकमृजुं भर्त्तः पुत्रं मे दातुमर्हसि /
काममेवंविधः पौत्रो मम स्यात्तव सुव्रत //
text_mt: You ought to grant me, my lord, a son who is peaceful and upright. / By all means, let such a grandson be mine and yours, O you of noble vows,

sanskrit_iast:
yadyanyathā na sakyaṃ vai kartuṃmevaṃ dvijottama /
tataḥ prasādamakarotsa tasyāstapaso balāt //
meaning:
यद्यन्यथा न सक्यं वै कर्तुंमेवं द्विजोत्तम /
ततः प्रसादमकरोत्स तस्यास्तपसो बलात् //
text_mt: if it is not possible to do otherwise, O best of the twice-born!" / Thereupon, by the power of his tapas, he granted grace to her:

sanskrit_iast:
putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre vā varavarṇini /
tvayā yathoktaṃ vacanaṃ tathā bhadrebhaviṣyati //
meaning:
पुत्रे नास्ति विशेषो मे पौत्रे वा वरवर्णिनि /
त्वया यथोक्तं वचनं तथा भद्रेभविष्यति //
text_mt: "There is no difference to me between a son or a grandson, O fair-complexioned woman; / as you have spoken in words, so it will be, auspicious one."

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsatyavatī putraṃ janayāmāsa bhārgavam /
tapasyabhirataṃ dāntaṃ jamadagniṃ śamātmakam //
meaning:
तस्मात्सत्यवती पुत्रं जनयामास भार्गवम् /
तपस्यभिरतं दान्तं जमदग्निं शमात्मकम् //
text_mt: Therefore Satyavatī gave birth to a Bhārgava son, / devoted to tapas, self-controlled, Jamadagni, possessing a peaceful soul.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgoścaruviparyāse raudravaiṣṇavayoḥ purā /
jamanādvaiṣṇavasyāgnerjamadagnirajāyata //
viśvāmitraṃ tu dāyādaṃ gādhiḥ kuśikanandanaḥ /
prāpya brahmarṣisamatāṃ jagāma brahmaṇā vṛtaḥ 66.58//
meaning:
भृगोश्चरुविपर्यासे रौद्रवैष्णवयोः पुरा /
जमनाद्वैष्णवस्याग्नेर्जमदग्निरजायत //
विश्वामित्रं तु दायादं गाधिः कुशिकनन्दनः /
प्राप्य ब्रह्मर्षिसमतां जगाम ब्रह्मणा वृतः 66.58//
text_mt:
In the exchange of Bhṛgu's sacrificial porridge, belonging to Rudra and Viṣṇu formerly, / from the consumption (jamana) of the fire of Viṣṇu, Jamadagni was born.

And Gādhi, the son of Kuśika, having obtained Viśvāmitra as his heir, / attained equality with a brahmarṣi, chosen by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
sā hi satyavatī puṇyā satyavrataparāyaṇā /
kauśikī tu samākhyātā pravṛtteyaṃ mahānadī //
meaning:
सा हि सत्यवती पुण्या सत्यव्रतपरायणा /
कौशिकी तु समाख्याता प्रवृत्तेयं महानदी //
text_mt: That holy Satyavatī, dedicated to true vows, / became known as the Kauśikī, issuing forth as a great river.

sanskrit_iast:
parisrutā mahābhāgā kauśikī saritāṃ varā /
ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavo reṇuko nāma pārthivaḥ //
meaning:
परिस्रुता महाभागा कौशिकी सरितां वरा /
इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो रेणुको नाम पार्थिवः //
text_mt: Flowing forth, the fortunate Kauśikī is the best of rivers. / There was a king named Reṇuka, born of the lineage of Ikṣvāku.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kanyā mahābhāgā kamalī nāma reṇukā /
reṇukāyāṃ kamalyāṃ tu tapodhṛtisamādhinā //
meaning:
तस्य कन्या महाभागा कमली नाम रेणुका /
रेणुकायां कमल्यां तु तपोधृतिसमाधिना //
text_mt: His daughter was the highly fortunate Kamalī named Reṇukā; / and upon Reṇukā Kamalī, by tapas, steadfastness, and absorption (samādhi),

sanskrit_iast:
ārcīko janayāmāma jamadagniḥ sudāruṇam /
sarvavidyāntagaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhanurvedasya pāragam //
meaning:
आर्चीको जनयामाम जमदग्निः सुदारुणम् /
सर्वविद्यान्तगं श्रेष्ठं धनुर्वेदस्य पारगम् //
text_mt: Jamadagni, son of Ṛcīka, begot an exceedingly terrible [son], / who reached the end of all learning, the foremost, who went across to the end of the Dhanurveda,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ kṣattriyahantāraṃ pradīptamiva pāvakam /
aurvasyaivamṛcīkasya satyavatyāṃ mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
रामं क्षत्त्रियहन्तारं प्रदीप्तमिव पावकम् /
और्वस्यैवमृचीकस्य सत्यवत्यां महामनाः //
text_mt: Rāma, slayer of the kṣatriyas, like a blazing fire. / Thus of Aurva Ṛcīka upon Satyavatī, the high-minded

sanskrit_iast:
jamadagnistapovīryājjajñe brahmavidāṃ varaḥ /
madhyamaśca śunaḥśephaḥ śunaḥ pucchaḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ //
meaning:
जमदग्निस्तपोवीर्याज्जज्ञे ब्रह्मविदां वरः /
मध्यमश्च शुनःशेफः शुनः पुच्छः कनिष्ठकः //
text_mt: Jamadagni was born by the power of tapas, best among knowers of Brahman; / and the middle one was Śunaḥśepha, and Śunaḥpuccha the youngest.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrastu dharmātmā nāmnā viśvarathaḥ smṛtaḥ /
jajñe bhṛguprasādena kauśikānvayavarddhanaḥ //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्तु धर्मात्मा नाम्ना विश्वरथः स्मृतः /
जज्ञे भृगुप्रसादेन कौशिकान्वयवर्द्धनः //
text_mt: And the righteous Viśvāmitra, remembered by the name Viśvaratha, / was born by the grace of Bhṛgu, increaser of the Kauśika lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrasya putrastu śunaḥśepho 'bhavanmuniḥ /
hariścandrasya yajñe tu paśutve niyataḥ sa vai //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्रस्तु शुनःशेफो ऽभवन्मुनिः /
हरिश्चन्द्रस्य यज्ञे तु पशुत्वे नियतः स वै //
text_mt: And the sage Śunaḥśepha became a son of Viśvāmitra, / he who had been appointed as the sacrificial beast in Hariścandra's sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
devairdattaḥ śunaḥśepho viśvāmitrāya vai punaḥ /
devairdattaḥ sa vai yasmāddevarātastato 'bhavat //
meaning:
देवैर्दत्तः शुनःशेफो विश्वामित्राय वै पुनः /
देवैर्दत्तः स वै यस्माद्देवरातस्ततो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Śunaḥśepha was given back again by the gods to Viśvāmitra; / because he was given by the gods (devaiḥ dattaḥ), he therefore became Devarāta.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāmitrasya putrāṇāṃ śunaḥśepho 'grajaḥ smṛtaḥ /
madhucchandādayaścaiva kṛtadevau dhruvāṣṭakau //
meaning:
विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्राणां शुनःशेफो ऽग्रजः स्मृतः /
मधुच्छन्दादयश्चैव कृतदेवौ ध्रुवाष्टकौ //
text_mt: Śunaḥśepha is remembered as the eldest among the sons of Viśvāmitra; / then there were Madhucchandas and the others, Kṛtadeva, Dhruvāṣṭaka,

sanskrit_iast:
kacchapaḥ pūraṇaścaiva viśvāmitrasutāstu vai /
teṣāṅgotrāṇi bahudhā kauśikānāṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
कच्छपः पूरणश्चैव विश्वामित्रसुतास्तु वै /
तेषाङ्गोत्राणि बहुधा कौशिकानां महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Kacchapa, and Pūraṇa—these were indeed the sons of Viśvāmitra. / Their clans (gotras) are manifold among those great Kauśikas.

sanskrit_iast:
pārthivā devarātāśca jājñavalkyāḥ samarpaṇāḥ /
uduṃbarāśca vātaḍyāstalakāyanacāndravāḥ //
meaning:
पार्थिवा देवराताश्च जाज्ञवल्क्याः समर्पणाः /
उदुंबराश्च वातड्यास्तलकायनचान्द्रवाः //
text_mt:
The Pārthivas, Devarātas, Yājñavalkyas, Samarpaṇas,
Udumbaras, Vātaḍyas, Tālakāyanas, and Cāndravas;

sanskrit_iast:
lohiṇyo reṇavaschaiva tathā kāriṣavaḥ smṛtāḥ /
babhravaḥ paṇinaschaiva dhyānajapyāstathaiva ca //
meaning:
लोहिण्यो रेणवस्छैव तथा कारिषवः स्मृताः /
बभ्रवः पणिनस्छैव ध्यानजप्यास्तथैव च //
text_mt:
The Rohiṇyas, Raiṇavas, and likewise the Kāriṣis are remembered,
the Babhrus, Pāṇinis, and likewise the Dhyānajapyas;

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmāyanā hiraṇyākṣāḥ sāṃkṛtā gālavāḥ smṛtāḥ /
devalā yāmadūtāśca śālaṅkāyanabāṣkalāḥ //
lālāḍhyā bādarāścānye viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ /
ṛṣyantaravivāhyāste bahabaḥ kauśikāḥ smṛtāḥ // 65.73//
meaning:
श्यामायना हिरण्याक्षाः सांकृता गालवाः स्मृताः /
देवला यामदूताश्च शालङ्कायनबाष्कलाः //
लालाढ्या बादराश्चान्ये विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः /
ऋष्यन्तरविवाह्यास्ते बहबः कौशिकाः स्मृताः // 65.73//

sanskrit_iast:
kauśikāḥ sauśrutāścaiva tathānye saindhavāyanāḥ /
yogeśvarasya puṇyasya bahmarṣeḥ kauśikasya vai /
viśvāmitrasya putrāṇāṃ śunaḥśepho 'grajaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
कौशिकाः सौश्रुताश्चैव तथान्ये सैन्धवायनाः /
योगेश्वरस्य पुण्यस्य बह्मर्षेः कौशिकस्य वै /
विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्राणां शुनःशेफो ऽग्रजः स्मृतः //
text_mt:
The Kauśikas, Sauśrutas, and likewise other Saindhavāyanas.
Of the holy Kauśika, the lord of yoga, the brāhmaṇa sage
Viśvāmitra's sons, Śunaḥśepha is remembered as the eldest.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣadvatī sutaścāpi viśvāmitrāttathāṣṭakaḥ /
aṣṭakasya suto lauhiḥ prokto jahnugaṇo mayā //
meaning:
दृषद्वती सुतश्चापि विश्वामित्रात्तथाष्टकः /
अष्टकस्य सुतो लौहिः प्रोक्तो जह्नुगणो मया //
text_mt:
And Aṣṭaka was born to Viśvāmitra from Dṛṣadvatī.
Aṣṭaka's son was Lauhi; the group of Jahnu has been declared by me.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kiṃlakṣaṇena dharmeṇa tapaseha śrutena vā //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
किंलक्षणेन धर्मेण तपसेह श्रुतेन वा //
text_mt:
The sages said:
By what characteristic virtue, by what asceticism here, or by what sacred learning,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyaṃ samanuprāptaṃ viśvāmitrādibhirnṛpaiḥ /
yenayenābhidhānena brāhmaṇyaṃ kṣatriyā gatāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्यं समनुप्राप्तं विश्वामित्रादिभिर्नृपैः /
येनयेनाभिधानेन ब्राह्मण्यं क्षत्रिया गताः //
text_mt:
was brāhmaṇahood attained by Viśvāmitra and other kings?
By what particular designation did the kṣatriyas attain brāhmaṇahood?

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣaṃ jñātumicchāmi tapaso dānatastathā /
evamuktastato vākyamabravīdidamarthavat //
meaning:
विशेषं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तपसो दानतस्तथा /
एवमुक्तस्ततो वाक्यमब्रवीदिदमर्थवत् //
text_mt:
I wish to know the particular merit of asceticism and of giving."
Being addressed thus, he then spoke these meaningful words:

sanskrit_iast:
anyāyopagatairdravyairāhūya dvijasattamān /
dharmābhikāṅkṣī yajate na dharmaphalamaśnute //
meaning:
अन्यायोपगतैर्द्रव्यैराहूय द्विजसत्तमान् /
धर्माभिकाङ्क्षी यजते न धर्मफलमश्नुते //
text_mt:
"He who, desiring merit, summons the best among the twice-born
and sacrifices with wealth acquired unlawfully does not enjoy the fruit of merit.

sanskrit_iast:
japaṃ kṛtvā tathā tīvraṃ dhanalobhānniraṅkuśaḥ /
rāgamohānvito hyante pāvanārthaṃ dadāti yaḥ //
meaning:
जपं कृत्वा तथा तीव्रं धनलोभान्निरङ्कुशः /
रागमोहान्वितो ह्यन्ते पावनार्थं ददाति यः //
text_mt:
Likewise, he who uncurbed performs severe recitation out of greed for wealth,
and at the end, filled with passion and delusion, gives gifts for the sake of purification,

sanskrit_iast:
tena dattāni dānāni hyaphalāni bhavantyuta /
tasya dharmapravṛttasya hiṃsakasya durātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तेन दत्तानि दानानि ह्यफलानि भवन्त्युत /
तस्य धर्मप्रवृत्तस्य हिंसकस्य दुरात्मनः //
text_mt:
the gifts given by him indeed become fruitless;
even though he engages in religious rites, he remains an injurious, evil-minded man.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ labdhvā dhane mohāddadato yajataśca ha /
saṃkliṣṭaṃ karmaṇā dānaṃ na tiṣṭhati durātmanaḥ //
meaning:
एवं लब्ध्वा धने मोहाद्ददतो यजतश्च ह /
संक्लिष्टं कर्मणा दानं न तिष्ठति दुरात्मनः //
text_mt:
When wealth is thus acquired and he gives and sacrifices out of delusion,
the gift tainted by [unlawful] action does not stand for the evil-minded man.

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyāgatānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ tīrthaṃ saṃpratipādanam /
kāmānanabhi saṃdhāya yajate ca dadāti ca //
meaning:
न्यायागतानां द्रव्याणां तीर्थं संप्रतिपादनम् /
कामाननभि संधाय यजते च ददाति च //
text_mt:
Bestowing wealth acquired lawfully upon a worthy recipient,
he sacrifices and gives without fixing his mind upon desires.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dānaphalamāpnoti tacca dānaṃ sukhodayam /
dānena bhogānāpnoti svargaṃ satyena gacchati //
meaning:
स दानफलमाप्नोति तच्च दानं सुखोदयम् /
दानेन भोगानाप्नोति स्वर्गं सत्येन गच्छति //
text_mt:
He attains the fruit of giving, and that gift brings about happiness.
By giving one attains pleasures; by truth one goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā tu sutaptena lokānviṣṭabhya tiṣṭhati /
satyaṃ tu tapasaḥ śreyastasmājjñānaṃ guru smṛtam //
meaning:
तपसा तु सुतप्तेन लोकान्विष्टभ्य तिष्ठति /
सत्यं तु तपसः श्रेयस्तस्माज्ज्ञानं गुरु स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
By well-practiced asceticism, however, he stands sustaining the worlds.
Truth is better than asceticism; knowledge, therefore, is remembered as weightier.

sanskrit_iast:
śrūyate hi tapassiddhāḥ kṣattropetā dvijātayaḥ /
viśvāmitro narapatirmāndhātā saṃkṛtiḥ kapiḥ //
meaning:
श्रूयते हि तपस्सिद्धाः क्षत्त्रोपेता द्विजातयः /
विश्वामित्रो नरपतिर्मान्धाता संकृतिः कपिः //
text_mt:
For it is heard that twice-born persons endowed with kṣatriya power were perfected through asceticism:
King Viśvāmitra, Māndhātṛ, Saṅkṛti, Kapi,

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyaśca purukutsaśca śalo gṛtsamadaḥ prabhuḥ /
ārṣṭiṣeṇo 'jamīḍhaśca bhārgavyomastathaiva ca //
meaning:
काश्यश्च पुरुकुत्सश्च शलो गृत्समदः प्रभुः /
आर्ष्टिषेणो ऽजमीढश्च भार्गव्योमस्तथैव च //
text_mt:
Kāśya, Purukutsa, Śala, the lord Gṛtsamada,
Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, Ajamīḍha, and likewise Bhārgavyoma,

sanskrit_iast:
kakṣīvāṃścaivauśijaśca nṛpaśca śiśirastathā /
rathāntaraḥ śaunakaśca viṣṇuvṛddhādayo nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
कक्षीवांश्चैवौशिजश्च नृपश्च शिशिरस्तथा /
रथान्तरः शौनकश्च विष्णुवृद्धादयो नृपाः //
text_mt:
Kakṣīvat, Auśija, King Śiśira,
Rathāntara, Śaunaka, and kings beginning with Viṣṇuvṛddha.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatropetāḥ smṛtā hyete tapasā ṛṣitāṃ gatāḥ /
ete rājarṣayaḥ sarve siddhiṃ tu mahatīṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्रोपेताः स्मृता ह्येते तपसा ऋषितां गताः /
एते राजर्षयः सर्वे सिद्धिं तु महतीं गताः //
text_mt:
These indeed, endowed with kṣatriya power, are remembered as having attained the state of ṛṣis through asceticism.
All these royal sages attained supreme perfection.

sanskrit_iast:
ata jñardhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi āyorvaṃśaṃ mahātmanaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya uvoddhāta pāde bhārgavacarite amāvasuvaṃśānukīrttanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 66//
meaning:
अत ज्ञर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि आयोर्वंशं महात्मनः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उवोद्धात पादे भार्गवचरिते अमावसुवंशानुकीर्त्तनं नाम षट्षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः // 66//
text_mt:
Hereafter I shall declare the genealogy of the great-souled Āyu."

Thus ends the sixty-sixth chapter, named 'The Proclamation of the Lineage of Amāvasu' in the deeds of the Bhārgavas, in the third Upoddhātapāda, in the middle part of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa Brahmāṇḍa, proclaimed by Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast:
āyoḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ pañcaivāsanmahābalāḥ /
svarbhānuta nayāyāṃ te prabhāyāṃ jajñire nṛpāḥ //
meaning:
आयोः पुत्रा महात्मानः पञ्चैवासन्महाबलाः /
स्वर्भानुत नयायां ते प्रभायां जज्ञिरे नृपाः //
text_mt:
The sons of the great-souled Āyu were five, endowed with great strength.
Those kings were born to Prabhā, the daughter of Svarbhānu:

sanskrit_iast:
nahuṣaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ kṣatravṛddhastataḥ smṛtaḥ /
raṃbho rajiranenāśca triṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ //
meaning:
नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां क्षत्रवृद्धस्ततः स्मृतः /
रंभो रजिरनेनाश्च त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः //
text_mt:
Nahuṣa was the first of them; after him Kṣatravṛddha is remembered,
Rambha, Raji, and Anenas, renowned across the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatravṛddhātmajaścaiva sunahotro mahāyaśāḥ /
sunahotrasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्रवृद्धात्मजश्चैव सुनहोत्रो महायशाः /
सुनहोत्रस्य दायादास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः //
text_mt:
The son of Kṣatravṛddha was the highly renowned Sunahotra.
Sunahotra had three heirs who were supremely righteous:

sanskrit_iast:
kāśaḥ śalaśca dvāvetau tathā gṛtsamadaḥ prabhuḥ /
putro gṛtsamadasyāpi śunako yasya śaunakaḥ //
meaning:
काशः शलश्च द्वावेतौ तथा गृत्समदः प्रभुः /
पुत्रो गृत्समदस्यापि शुनको यस्य शौनकः //
text_mt:
These two, Kāśa and Śala, and likewise the lord Gṛtsamada.
The son of Gṛtsamada was Śunaka, whose [son was] Śaunaka.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaiva vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathaiva ca /
etasya vaṃśesaṃbhūtā vicitraiḥ karmabhirdvijāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियाश्चैव वैश्याः शूद्रास्तथैव च /
एतस्य वंशेसंभूता विचित्रैः कर्मभिर्द्विजाः //
text_mt:
Brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and likewise śūdras
were born in his lineage, as twice-borns distinguished by diverse actions.

sanskrit_iast:
śalātmajo hyārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ śiśirastasya jātmajaḥ /
śaunakāścārṣṭiṣeṇāśca kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
शलात्मजो ह्यार्ष्टिषेणः शिशिरस्तस्य जात्मजः /
शौनकाश्चार्ष्टिषेणाश्च क्षत्रोपेता द्विजातयः //
text_mt:
The son of Śala was Ārṣṭiṣeṇa, and Śiśira was his son.
The Śaunakas and the Ārṣṭiṣeṇas are twice-born persons endowed with kṣatriya power.

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyasya kāśipo rājā putro dīrghatapāstathā /
dhanvaśca dīrghatapaso vidvāndhanvantarīstataḥ //
meaning:
काश्यस्य काशिपो राजा पुत्रो दीर्घतपास्तथा /
धन्वश्च दीर्घतपसो विद्वान्धन्वन्तरीस्ततः //
text_mt:
The son of Kāśa was King Kāśipa, and his [son was] Dīrghatapas;
Dīrghatapas had Dhanva, and from him [came] the wise Dhanvantari.

sanskrit_iast:
tapasoṃ'te mahātejā jāto vṛddhasya dhīmataḥ /
athainamṛṣayaḥ procuḥ sūtaṃ vākyamida punaḥ //
meaning:
तपसोंऽते महातेजा जातो वृद्धस्य धीमतः /
अथैनमृषयः प्रोचुः सूतं वाक्यमिद पुनः //
text_mt:
At the culmination of asceticism, he of great splendor was born to the wise elder.
Then the sages spoke these words again to the bard:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kaśca dhanvantarirdevo mānuṣeṣviha jajñivān /
etadveditumicchāmastannobrūhi parantapa //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कश्च धन्वन्तरिर्देवो मानुषेष्विह जज्ञिवान् /
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामस्तन्नोब्रूहि परन्तप //
text_mt:
The sages said:
"And who is this god Dhanvantari who was born among mortals here?
We wish to know this; tell that to us, O scorcher of foes!"

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
dhanvantareḥ saṃbhavo 'yaṃ śrūyatāmiha vai dvijāḥ /
sa saṃbhūtaḥ samudrānte mathyamāne 'mṛte purā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
धन्वन्तरेः संभवो ऽयं श्रूयतामिह वै द्विजाः /
स संभूतः समुद्रान्ते मथ्यमाने ऽमृते पुरा //
text_mt:
The bard said:
"Let this origin of Dhanvantari be heard here, O twice-born ones!
He was born anciently at the edge of the ocean as the nectar was being churned.

sanskrit_iast:
utpannaḥ kalaśātpūrvaṃ sarvataśca śriyā vṛtaḥ /
sadyaḥsaṃsiddhakāryaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇukhasthitaḥ //
meaning:
उत्पन्नः कलशात्पूर्वं सर्वतश्च श्रिया वृतः /
सद्यःसंसिद्धकार्यं तं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुखस्थितः //
text_mt:
He arose previously from the jar, surrounded on all sides by fortune.
Seeing him, who accomplished his task instantly, Viṣṇu, who stood in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
abjastvamiti hovāca tasmādabjastu sa smṛtaḥ /
abjaḥ provāca viṣṇuṃ taṃ tanayo 'smi tava prabho //
meaning:
अब्जस्त्वमिति होवाच तस्मादब्जस्तु स स्मृतः /
अब्जः प्रोवाच विष्णुं तं तनयो ऽस्मि तव प्रभो //
text_mt:
said, 'You are Abja (water-born)'; therefore he is remembered as Abja.
Abja spoke to Viṣṇu: 'I am your son, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
vidhatsva bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ ca mama loke surottama /
evamuktaḥ sa dṛṣṭvā tu tathyaṃ provāca sa prabhuḥ //
meaning:
विधत्स्व भागं स्थानं च मम लोके सुरोत्तम /
एवमुक्तः स दृष्ट्वा तु तथ्यं प्रोवाच स प्रभुः //
text_mt:
Assign a share and an abode for me in the world, O best among the gods!'
Being addressed thus, that lord saw the truth and said:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛto yajñavibhāgastu daiteyairhi suraistathā /
vedeṣu vidhiyuktaṃ ca vidhihotraṃ maharṣibhiḥ //
meaning:
कृतो यज्ञविभागस्तु दैतेयैर्हि सुरैस्तथा /
वेदेषु विधियुक्तं च विधिहोत्रं महर्षिभिः //
text_mt:
'The division of sacrificial shares has already been made by the Daiteyas and the gods,
and the ritual oblation has been established in the Vedas by the great sages according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
na sakyamiha homaṃ vai tubhyaṃ kartuṃ kadāyana /
arvāksūto 'si he deva tava mantro na vai prabho //
meaning:
न सक्यमिह होमं वै तुभ्यं कर्तुं कदायन /
अर्वाक्सूतो ऽसि हे देव तव मन्त्रो न वै प्रभो //
text_mt:
It is not possible to make a sacrificial offering for you here at any time.
You were born later, O god; there is indeed no mantra for you, O lord!

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃbhūtyāṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi /
aṇimādiyutāṃ siddhiṃ gatastatra bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
द्वितीयायां तु संभूत्यां लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि /
अणिमादियुतां सिद्धिं गतस्तत्र भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
In your second birth, however, you will attain renown in the world;
having attained the perfection endowed with lightness and other [yogic powers], you will be there.

sanskrit_iast:
etenaiva śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prāpsyasi prabho /
cā (ca) turmantrairghṛtairgavyairyakṣyante tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
एतेनैव शरीरेण देवत्वं प्राप्स्यसि प्रभो /
चा (च) तुर्मन्त्रैर्घृतैर्गव्यैर्यक्ष्यन्ते त्वां द्विजातयः //
text_mt:
With that very body you will attain divinity, O lord!
Twice-born persons will sacrifice to you with four mantras and clarified butter from cows.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā tvaṃ punaścaiva hyāyurvedaṃ vidhāsyasi /
avaśyabhāvīhyartho 'yaṃ prāgdṛṣṭastvabjayoninā //
meaning:
अथ वा त्वं पुनश्चैव ह्यायुर्वेदं विधास्यसि /
अवश्यभावीह्यर्थो ऽयं प्राग्दृष्टस्त्वब्जयोनिना //
text_mt:
And furthermore, you will set in order the Āyurveda.
This inevitable purpose was previously seen by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ dvāpara prāpya bhavitā tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ /
tasmāttasmai varaṃ dattvā viṣṇurantardadhe tataḥ //
meaning:
द्वितीयं द्वापर प्राप्य भविता त्वं न संशयः /
तस्मात्तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा विष्णुरन्तर्दधे ततः //
text_mt:
Having reached the second Dvāpara, you will be [born]; there is no doubt.'
Having given him that boon, Viṣṇu then vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye dvāpare prāpte saunahotraḥ sa kāśirāṭ /
putrakāmastapastepe nṛpo dīrghatapāstathā //
meaning:
द्वितीये द्वापरे प्राप्ते सौनहोत्रः स काशिराट् /
पुत्रकामस्तपस्तेपे नृपो दीर्घतपास्तथा //
text_mt:
When the second Dvāpara arrived, that King of Kāśi, of Sunahotra's lineage,
King Dīrghatapas, desiring a son, performed asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
abjaṃ devaṃ tu putrārthe hyārirādhayiṣurnṛpaḥ /
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa tato dhanvantarirnṛpam //
meaning:
अब्जं देवं तु पुत्रार्थे ह्यारिराधयिषुर्नृपः /
वरेण च्छन्दयामास ततो धन्वन्तरिर्नृपम् //
text_mt:
Desiring to propitiate the god Abja for the sake of a son, the king
[prayed, and] then Dhanvantari invited the king to ask for a boon.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛpa uvāca
bhagavanyadi tuṣṭastvaṃ putro me gatimānbhaveḥ /
tatheti samanujñāya tatraivāntaradhātprabhuḥ //
meaning:
नृप उवाच
भगवन्यदि तुष्टस्त्वं पुत्रो मे गतिमान्भवेः /
तथेति समनुज्ञाय तत्रैवान्तरधात्प्रभुः //
text_mt:
The king said:
'O venerable one, if you are pleased, may you become my illustrious son!'
Saying 'So be it,' the lord consented and vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya gehe samutpanno devo dhanvantaristadā /
kāśirājo mahārājaḥ sarva rogapraṇāśanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य गेहे समुत्पन्नो देवो धन्वन्तरिस्तदा /
काशिराजो महाराजः सर्व रोगप्रणाशनः //
text_mt:
Then the god Dhanvantari was born in his house,
as the great king, the King of Kāśi, who destroyed all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
āyurvedaṃ bharadvājātprāpyeha sabhiṣakkriyam /
tamaṣṭadhā punarvyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat //
meaning:
आयुर्वेदं भरद्वाजात्प्राप्येह सभिषक्क्रियम् /
तमष्टधा पुनर्व्यस्य शिष्येभ्यः प्रत्यपादयत् //
text_mt:
Having obtained Āyurveda here along with the medical practice from Bharadvāja,
he divided it again into eight parts and delivered it to his disciples."

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvantarisutaścāpi ketumāniti viśrutaḥ /
atha ketumataḥ putro jajñe bhīmaratho nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
धन्वन्तरिसुतश्चापि केतुमानिति विश्रुतः /
अथ केतुमतः पुत्रो जज्ञे भीमरथो नृपः //
text_mt: And Dhanvantari's son was renowned as Ketumān. / Then to Ketumān was born the king Bhīmaratha.

sanskrit_iast:
putro bhīmarathasyāpi jāto dhīmānprajeśvaraḥ /
divodāsa iti khyāto vārāṇasyadhipo 'bhavat //
meaning:
पुत्रो भीमरथस्यापि जातो धीमान्प्रजेश्वरः /
दिवोदास इति ख्यातो वाराणस्यधिपो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: And Bhīmaratha had a wise son, a lord of subjects, / renowned as Divodāsa, who became the ruler of Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu purīṃ vārāmasīṃ purā /
śūnyāṃ niveśayāmāsa kṣemako nāma rākṣasaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु पुरीं वारामसीं पुरा /
शून्यां निवेशयामास क्षेमको नाम राक्षसः //
text_mt: At that very time in the past, a rākṣasa named Kṣemaka / settled the deserted city of Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
śaptā hi sā purī pūrvaṃ nikuṃbhena mahātmanā /
śūnyā varṣasahasraṃ vai bhavitrīti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
शप्ता हि सा पुरी पूर्वं निकुंभेन महात्मना /
शून्या वर्षसहस्रं वै भवित्रीति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: For that city had formerly been cursed by the great-souled Nikuṃbha: / 'It shall remain desolate for a thousand years, again and again.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṃ tu śaptamātrāyāṃ divodāsaḥ prajeśvaraḥ /
viṣayānte purīṃ ramyāṃ gomatyāṃ saṃnyaveśayat //
meaning:
तस्यां तु शप्तमात्रायां दिवोदासः प्रजेश्वरः /
विषयान्ते पुरीं रम्यां गोमत्यां संन्यवेशयत् //
text_mt: As soon as it was cursed, Divodāsa, the lord of subjects, / founded a delightful city on the Gomatī, at the border of his realm.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
vārāṇasīṃ kimarthaṃ tāṃ nikuṃbhaḥ śaptavānpurā /
nikuṃbhaścāpi dharmātmā siddhakṣetraṃ śaśāpa yaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
वाराणसीं किमर्थं तां निकुंभः शप्तवान्पुरा /
निकुंभश्चापि धर्मात्मा सिद्धक्षेत्रं शशाप यः //
text_mt: The sages said: / For what reason did Nikuṃbha formerly curse Vārāṇasī? / And why did Nikuṃbha, righteous of soul, curse that realm of perfection?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
divodāsastu rājarṣirnagarīṃ prāpya pārthivaḥ /
vasate sa mahātejāḥ sphītāyāṃ vai narādhipaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
दिवोदासस्तु राजर्षिर्नगरीं प्राप्य पार्थिवः /
वसते स महातेजाः स्फीतायां वै नराधिपः //
text_mt: The bard said: / Having obtained the city, King Divodāsa, the royal sage, / that king of immense splendor, dwelt in that thriving [realm].

sanskrit_iast:
etasminneva kāle tu kṛtadāro maheśvaraḥ /
devyāḥ sa priyakāmastu vasanvai śvaśurāntike //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कृतदारो महेश्वरः /
देव्याः स प्रियकामस्तु वसन्वै श्वशुरान्तिके //
text_mt: At that very time, Maheśvara, having married, / resided near his father-in-law, desiring what was pleasing to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
devājñayā pāriṣadā viśvarupāstapodhanāḥ /
pūrvoktarūpasaṃveṣaistoṣayanti maheśvarīm //
meaning:
देवाज्ञया पारिषदा विश्वरुपास्तपोधनाः /
पूर्वोक्तरूपसंवेषैस्तोषयन्ति महेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: By order of the god, his attendants, of all shapes and rich in austerities, / pleased Maheśvarī with the forms and attire previously described.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣyate tairmahādevo menā naiva tu tuṣyati /
jugupsate sā nityaṃ vai devaṃ devīṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
हृष्यते तैर्महादेवो मेना नैव तु तुष्यति /
जुगुप्सते सा नित्यं वै देवं देवीं तथैव च //
text_mt: Mahādeva rejoiced at them, but Menā was not pleased at all; / indeed, she constantly looked down upon both the god and the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mama pārśve tvanācārastava bharttā maheśvaraḥ /
daridraḥ sarvathaiveha hā kaṣṭaṃ lajjate na vai //
meaning:
मम पार्श्वे त्वनाचारस्तव भर्त्ता महेश्वरः /
दरिद्रः सर्वथैवेह हा कष्टं लज्जते न वै //
text_mt: [She said,] 'Your husband Maheśvara has bad conduct at my side; / he is utterly destitute here—alas, what sorrow!—and feels no shame at all.'

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā tathoktā vacasā strīsvabhāvānna cakṣame /
smitaṃ kṛtvā tu varadā harapārśvamathāgamat //
meaning:
मात्रा तथोक्ता वचसा स्त्रीस्वभावान्न चक्षमे /
स्मितं कृत्वा तु वरदा हरपार्श्वमथागमत् //
text_mt: Thus addressed by her mother, [the goddess] could not endure it due to womanly nature. / Having smiled, the giver of boons then went to Hara's side.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṇṇavadanā devī mahādevamabhāṣata /
neha vatsyāmyahaṃ deva naya māṃ svaṃ niveśanam //
meaning:
विषण्णवदना देवी महादेवमभाषत /
नेह वत्स्याम्यहं देव नय मां स्वं निवेशनम् //
text_mt: With a dejected face, the goddess spoke to Mahādeva: / 'I will not live here, O god; take me to your own dwelling.'

sanskrit_iast:
tathoktastu mahādevaḥ sarvāṃllokānnirīkṣya ha /
vāsārthaṃ rocayāmāsa pṛthivyāṃ tu dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
तथोक्तस्तु महादेवः सर्वांल्लोकान्निरीक्ष्य ह /
वासार्थं रोचयामास पृथिव्यां तु द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Thus addressed, Mahādeva, having surveyed all the worlds, / chose [a place] on earth for their dwelling, O best of the twice-born:

sanskrit_iast:
vārāṇasīṃ mahātejāḥ siddhakṣetraṃ maheśvaraḥ /
divodāsena tāṃ jñātvā niviṣṭāṃ nagarīṃ bhavaḥ //
meaning:
वाराणसीं महातेजाः सिद्धक्षेत्रं महेश्वरः /
दिवोदासेन तां ज्ञात्वा निविष्टां नगरीं भवः //
text_mt: Vārāṇasī, the realm of perfection, O highly lustrous Maheśvara. / Learning that that city was occupied by Divodāsa, Bhava,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvasthaṃ sa samāhūya gaṇeśaṃ kṣemamabravīt /
gaṇeśvara purīṃ gatvā śūnyāṃ vārāṇasīṃ kuru //
meaning:
पार्श्वस्थं स समाहूय गणेशं क्षेममब्रवीत् /
गणेश्वर पुरीं गत्वा शून्यां वाराणसीं कुरु //
text_mt: having summoned the lord of the gaṇas who stood beside him, said calmly: / 'O Gaṇeśvara, go and make the city of Vārāṇasī deserted,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdunā cābhyupāyena ativīryaḥ sa pārthivaḥ /
tato gatvā nikuṃbhastu purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ purā //
meaning:
मृदुना चाभ्युपायेन अतिवीर्यः स पार्थिवः /
ततो गत्वा निकुंभस्तु पुरीं वाराणसीं पुरा //
text_mt: and by gentle means, for that king is of exceedingly great power.' / Then, having gone to the city of Vārāṇasī in the past, Nikuṃbha

sanskrit_iast:
svapne saṃdarśayāmāsa maṅkanaṃ nāmato dvijam /
śreyaste 'haṃ kariṣyāmi sthānaṃ me rocayānagha //
meaning:
स्वप्ने संदर्शयामास मङ्कनं नामतो द्विजम् /
श्रेयस्ते ऽहं करिष्यामि स्थानं मे रोचयानघ //
text_mt: showed himself in a dream to a brāhmaṇa named Maṅkana: / 'I shall bring you welfare; choose a dwelling for me, O sinless one.

sanskrit_iast:
madrūpāṃ pratimāṃ kṛtvā nagaryante niveśaya /
tathā svapne yathā dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kāritavāndvijaḥ //
meaning:
मद्रूपां प्रतिमां कृत्वा नगर्यन्ते निवेशय /
तथा स्वप्ने यथा दृष्टं सर्वं कारितवान्द्विजः //
text_mt: Make an image in my form and install it at the edge of the city.' / The brāhmaṇa had everything done exactly as seen in the dream,

sanskrit_iast:
nagarīdvāryanujñāpya rājānaṃ tu yathāvidhi /
pūjā tumahatī caiva nityameva prayujyate //
meaning:
नगरीद्वार्यनुज्ञाप्य राजानं तु यथाविधि /
पूजा तुमहती चैव नित्यमेव प्रयुज्यते //
text_mt: at the city gate, having obtained permission from the king according to rule. / And a great worship was indeed performed there daily,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhairdhūpaiśca vālyaiśca prekṣaṇīyestathaiva ca /
annapradānayuktaiśca hyatyadbhutamivābhavat //
meaning:
गन्धैर्धूपैश्च वाल्यैश्च प्रेक्षणीयेस्तथैव च /
अन्नप्रदानयुक्तैश्च ह्यत्यद्भुतमिवाभवत् //
text_mt: with perfumes, incense, garlands, spectacles, / and offerings of food; it was truly wonderful.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃpūjyate tatra nityameva gaṇeśvaraḥ /
tato varasahasrāṇi nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati //
meaning:
एवं संपूज्यते तत्र नित्यमेव गणेश्वरः /
ततो वरसहस्राणि नागराणां प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Thus the lord of the gaṇas was daily worshipped there, / and then he bestowed thousands of boons upon the citizens—

sanskrit_iast:
putrānhiraṇyamāyūṃṣi sarvakāmāṃstathaiva ca /
rājñastu mahiṣī śreṣṭā suyaśā nāma viśrutā //
meaning:
पुत्रान्हिरण्यमायूंषि सर्वकामांस्तथैव च /
राज्ञस्तु महिषी श्रेष्टा सुयशा नाम विश्रुता //
text_mt: sons, gold, longevity, and all desired objects. / Now the king's chief queen was renowned by the name of Suyaśā;

sanskrit_iast:
putrārthamāgatā sādhvī rājñā devī pracoditā /
pūjāṃ tu vipulāṃ kṛtvā devī putrānayācata //
meaning:
पुत्रार्थमागता साध्वी राज्ञा देवी प्रचोदिता /
पूजां तु विपुलां कृत्वा देवी पुत्रानयाचत //
text_mt: for the sake of a son, that virtuous queen came, urged by the king. / Having performed an extensive worship, the queen begged for sons.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punarathāgatya bahuśaḥ putrakāraṇāt /
na prayacchati putrāṃstu nikuṃbhaḥ kāraṇena tu //
meaning:
पुनः पुनरथागत्य बहुशः पुत्रकारणात् /
न प्रयच्छति पुत्रांस्तु निकुंभः कारणेन तु //
text_mt: Though she returned again and again, many times, for the sake of a son, / Nikuṃbha did not grant sons, due to a specific purpose:

sanskrit_iast:
krudhyate yadi rājā tu tata kiñcitpravarttate /
atha dīrgheṇa kālena krodho rājānamāviśat //
meaning:
क्रुध्यते यदि राजा तु तत किञ्चित्प्रवर्त्तते /
अथ दीर्घेण कालेन क्रोधो राजानमाविशत् //
text_mt: 'If the king becomes angry, then something will proceed.' / Then, after a long time, anger entered the king:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaṃ tvidaṃ maṃhaddvāri nāgarāṇāṃ prayacchati /
prītyā varāṃśca śataśo na kiñcinnaḥ prayacchati //
meaning:
भूतं त्विदं मंहद्द्वारि नागराणां प्रयच्छति /
प्रीत्या वरांश्च शतशो न किञ्चिन्नः प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: 'This great spirit at the gate bestows with pleasure / hundreds of boons upon the citizens, but grants nothing to us.

sanskrit_iast:
māmakaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ nagaryāṃ mama caiva tu /
sa yācitaśca bahuśo devyā me putrakāraṇāt //
meaning:
मामकैः पूज्यते नित्यं नगर्यां मम चैव तु /
स याचितश्च बहुशो देव्या मे पुत्रकारणात् //
text_mt: He is daily worshipped by my people, and indeed in my city; / and he has been petitioned many times by my queen for the sake of a son.

sanskrit_iast:
na dadāti ca putraṃ me kṛtaghno bahubhojanaḥ /
ato nārhati pūjā tu matsakāśātkathañcana //
meaning:
न ददाति च पुत्रं मे कृतघ्नो बहुभोजनः /
अतो नार्हति पूजा तु मत्सकाशात्कथञ्चन //
text_mt: Yet he does not give me a son, this ungrateful, gluttonous [spirit]! / Therefore he does not deserve worship from me in any way.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttu nāśayiṣyāmitasya sthānaṃ durātmanaḥ /
evaṃ tu sa viniścitya durātmā rājakilbiṣī //
meaning:
तस्मात्तु नाशयिष्यामितस्य स्थानं दुरात्मनः /
एवं तु स विनिश्चित्य दुरात्मा राजकिल्बिषी //
text_mt: Hence I will destroy the shrine of that evil-minded one!' / Having thus resolved, that evil-minded king, committing an offense,

sanskrit_iast:
sthānaṃ gaṇapateśtasya nāśayāmāsa durmatiḥ /
bhagnamāyatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānamaśapatprabhuḥ //
meaning:
स्थानं गणपतेश्तस्य नाशयामास दुर्मतिः /
भग्नमायतनं दृष्ट्वा राजानमशपत्प्रभुः //
text_mt: that foolish man destroyed the shrine of that lord of the gaṇas. / Seeing his temple broken, the powerful lord cursed the king:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādvināparādhaṃ me tvayā sthānaṃ vināśitam /
akasmāttu purī śūnyā bhavitrīte narādhipa //
meaning:
यस्माद्विनापराधं मे त्वया स्थानं विनाशितम् /
अकस्मात्तु पुरी शून्या भवित्रीते नराधिप //
text_mt: 'Since my shrine has been destroyed by you without an offense [on my part], / your city shall unexpectedly become deserted, O ruler of men.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatastena tu śāpena śūnyā vārāṇasī tadā /
śaptvā purīṃ nikuṃbhastu mahādevamathānayat //
meaning:
ततस्तेन तु शापेन शून्या वाराणसी तदा /
शप्त्वा पुरीं निकुंभस्तु महादेवमथानयत् //
text_mt: Then, because of that curse, Vārāṇasī became deserted at that time. / Having cursed the city, Nikuṃbha then brought Mahādeva [there].

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyāṃ purīṃ mahā devo nirmame padamātmanaḥ /
tulyāṃ devavibhūtyā tu devyāścaiva mahāmanāḥ //
meaning:
शून्यां पुरीं महा देवो निर्ममे पदमात्मनः /
तुल्यां देवविभूत्या तु देव्याश्चैव महामनाः //
text_mt: In the deserted city, Mahādeva established his own abode, / equal to the glory of the gods, for himself and the goddess, O magnanimous one.

sanskrit_iast:
ramate tatra vai devī hyaiśvaryātsā tu vismitā /
devyā krīḍārthamīśāno devo vākyamathābravīt //
meaning:
रमते तत्र वै देवी ह्यैश्वर्यात्सा तु विस्मिता /
देव्या क्रीडार्थमीशानो देवो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: The goddess sported there, astonished at its splendor. / For the sake of sporting with the goddess, the divine Īśāna spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaṃ veśma vimokṣyāmi hyavimuktaṃ hi me gṛham /
prahasyaināmathovāca hyavimuktaṃ hi me gṛham /
nāhaṃ devi gamiṣyāmi tvanyatredaṃ vihāya vai //
meaning:
नाहं वेश्म विमोक्ष्यामि ह्यविमुक्तं हि मे गृहम् /
प्रहस्यैनामथोवाच ह्यविमुक्तं हि मे गृहम् /
नाहं देवि गमिष्यामि त्वन्यत्रेदं विहाय वै //
text_mt: 'I will not leave this dwelling, for my home is Avimukta.' / Laughing, he then said to her: 'Indeed, my home is Avimukta; / I shall not go anywhere else, O goddess, abandoning this place.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā saha ramasveha kṣetre bhāminyanuttame /
tasmāttadavimuktaṃ hi proktaṃ devena vai svayam //
meaning:
मया सह रमस्वेह क्षेत्रे भामिन्यनुत्तमे /
तस्मात्तदविमुक्तं हि प्रोक्तं देवेन वै स्वयम् //
text_mt: Sport here with me, O passionate lady, in this peerless field.' / Therefore it was declared as Avimukta ('never forsaken') by the god himself.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ vārāṇasī śaptā hyavimuktaṃ ca kīrttitā /
yasminvasedbhavo devaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एवं वाराणसी शप्ता ह्यविमुक्तं च कीर्त्तिता /
यस्मिन्वसेद्भवो देवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः //
text_mt: Thus Vārāṇasī was cursed, and celebrated as Avimukta, / in which Lord Bhava, worshipped by all gods, would dwell

sanskrit_iast:
yugeṣu triṣu dharmātmā saha devyā maheśvaraḥ /
antarddhānaṃ kalau yāti tatpuraṃ tu mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
युगेषु त्रिषु धर्मात्मा सह देव्या महेश्वरः /
अन्तर्द्धानं कलौ याति तत्पुरं तु महात्मनः //
text_mt: through three yugas, righteous Maheśvara along with the goddess. / But in the Kali [age], that city of the great-souled one vanishes.

sanskrit_iast:
antarhite pure tasminpurī sā vasate punaḥ /
evaṃ vārāṇasī śaptā niveśaṃ punarāgatā //
meaning:
अन्तर्हिते पुरे तस्मिन्पुरी सा वसते पुनः /
एवं वाराणसी शप्ता निवेशं पुनरागता //
text_mt: When that city has vanished, the city is inhabited again. / Thus Vārāṇasī was cursed, and again became inhabited.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrasenasya putrāṇāṃ śatamuttamadhanvinām /
hatvā niveśayāmāsa divodāso narādhipaḥ //
meaning:
भद्रसेनस्य पुत्राणां शतमुत्तमधन्विनाम् /
हत्वा निवेशयामास दिवोदासो नराधिपः //
text_mt: Having slain the hundred sons of Bhadrasena, all excellent archers, / King Divodāsa established his dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrasenasya rājyaṃ tu hataṃ tena balīyasā /
bhadrasenasya putrastu durmado nāma nāmataḥ //
meaning:
भद्रसेनस्य राज्यं तु हतं तेन बलीयसा /
भद्रसेनस्य पुत्रस्तु दुर्मदो नाम नामतः //
text_mt: The kingdom of Bhadrasena was destroyed by that more powerful one. / But Bhadrasena had a son named Durmada;

sanskrit_iast:
divodāsena bāleti ghṛṇayā sa visarjitaḥ /
divodāsāddṛṣadvatyāṃ vīro jajñe pratarddanaḥ //
meaning:
दिवोदासेन बालेति घृणया स विसर्जितः /
दिवोदासाद्दृषद्वत्यां वीरो जज्ञे प्रतर्द्दनः //
text_mt: because he was a child, he was spared out of pity by Divodāsa. / From Divodāsa, through Dṛṣadvatī, was born the hero Pratardana.

sanskrit_iast:
tena putreṇa bālena prahṛtaṃ tasya vai punaḥ /
vairasyānta mahārāja tadā tena vidhitsatā //
meaning:
तेन पुत्रेण बालेन प्रहृतं तस्य वै पुनः /
वैरस्यान्त महाराज तदा तेन विधित्सता //
text_mt: By that son, [though still] a boy, he was indeed struck down again, / as he sought to bring an end to the enmity, O great king.

sanskrit_iast:
pratardanasya putrau dvau vatso gargaśca viśrutau /
vatsaputro hyalarkastu sannatistasya cātmajaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतर्दनस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ वत्सो गर्गश्च विश्रुतौ /
वत्सपुत्रो ह्यलर्कस्तु सन्नतिस्तस्य चात्मजः //
text_mt: Pratardana had two sons, renowned as Vatsa and Garga. / Vatsa's son was Alarka, and Sannati was his son.

sanskrit_iast:
alarkaṃ prati rājarṣiṃ śrokoṃ gītaḥ purātanaiḥ /
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca //
meaning:
अलर्कं प्रति राजर्षिं श्रोकों गीतः पुरातनैः /
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च //
text_mt: Concerning the royal sage Alarka, a verse was sung by the ancients: / 'For sixty thousand years, and six hundred years,

sanskrit_iast:
yuvā rūpeṇa saṃpanno hyalarkaḥ kāśisattamaḥ /
lopāmudrāprasādena paramāyuravāptavān //
meaning:
युवा रूपेण संपन्नो ह्यलर्कः काशिसत्तमः /
लोपामुद्राप्रसादेन परमायुरवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Alarka, best of the Kāśis, remained young and endowed with beauty; / by the grace of Lopāmudrā he obtained supreme longevity.'

sanskrit_iast:
śāpasyānte mahābāhurhatvā kṣemakarākṣasam /
ramyāmāvāsayāmāsa purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
शापस्यान्ते महाबाहुर्हत्वा क्षेमकराक्षसम् /
रम्यामावासयामास पुरीं वाराणसीं नृपः //
text_mt: At the end of the curse, the mighty-armed king, having slain the rākṣasa Kṣemaka, / settled the delightful city of Vārāṇasī.

sanskrit_iast:
sannaterapi dāyādaḥ sunītho nāma dhārmikaḥ /
sunīthasya tu dāyādaḥ kṣaimākhyo nāma dhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
सन्नतेरपि दायादः सुनीथो नाम धार्मिकः /
सुनीथस्य तु दायादः क्षैमाख्यो नाम धार्मिकः //
text_mt: The heir of Sannati was the righteous Sunītha. / The heir of Sunītha was the righteous one named Kṣema.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemasya ketumānputraḥ suketustasya cātmajaḥ /
suketutanayaścāpi dharmaketuriti śrutaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेमस्य केतुमान्पुत्रः सुकेतुस्तस्य चात्मजः /
सुकेतुतनयश्चापि धर्मकेतुरिति श्रुतः //
text_mt: The son of Kṣema was Ketumān, and his son was Suketu. / And the son of Suketu is renowned as Dharmaketu.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaketostu dāyādaḥ satyaketurmahārathaḥ /
satyaketusutaścāpi vibhurnāma prajeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
धर्मकेतोस्तु दायादः सत्यकेतुर्महारथः /
सत्यकेतुसुतश्चापि विभुर्नाम प्रजेश्वरः //
text_mt: The heir of Dharmaketu was the great chariot-warrior Satyaketu. / And the son of Satyaketu was the lord of subjects named Vibhu.

sanskrit_iast:
suvibhustu vibhoḥ putraḥ sukumārastataḥ smṛtaḥ /
sukumārasya putrastu dhṛṣṭaketuḥ sudhārmikaḥ //
meaning:
सुविभुस्तु विभोः पुत्रः सुकुमारस्ततः स्मृतः /
सुकुमारस्य पुत्रस्तु धृष्टकेतुः सुधार्मिकः //
text_mt: Suvibhu was the son of Vibhu; from him is remembered Sukumāra. / And the son of Sukumāra was the very righteous Dhṛṣṭaketu.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛṣṭaketostu dāyādo veṇuhotraḥ prajeśvaraḥ /
veṇuhotrasutaścāpi gārgyo vai nāma viśrutaḥ //
meaning:
धृष्टकेतोस्तु दायादो वेणुहोत्रः प्रजेश्वरः /
वेणुहोत्रसुतश्चापि गार्ग्यो वै नाम विश्रुतः //
text_mt: The heir of Dhṛṣṭaketu was the lord of subjects Veṇuhotra. / And the son of Veṇuhotra was the renowned Gārgya.

sanskrit_iast:
gārgyasya gargabhūmistu vaṃśo vatsasya dhīmataḥ /
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaiva tayoḥ putrāḥ sudhārmikāḥ //
meaning:
गार्ग्यस्य गर्गभूमिस्तु वंशो वत्सस्य धीमतः /
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रियाश्चैव तयोः पुत्राः सुधार्मिकाः //
text_mt: Gargabhūmi was [the son] of Gārgya, and [such was] the lineage of the wise Vatsa. / Their sons were very righteous brāhmaṇas and kṣatriyas,

sanskrit_iast:
vikrāntā balavantaśca sihatulyaparākramāḥ /
ityete kāśyapāḥ proktā rajerapi nibodhata //
meaning:
विक्रान्ता बलवन्तश्च सिहतुल्यपराक्रमाः /
इत्येते काश्यपाः प्रोक्ता रजेरपि निबोधत //
text_mt: valorous, strong, and possessing prowess equal to lions. / Thus these Kāśyapas have been declared. Learn also of Raji.

sanskrit_iast:
rajeḥ putraśatānyāsanpañca vīryavato bhuvi /
rājeyamiti vikhyātaṃ kṣatra siṃdrabhayāvaham //
meaning:
रजेः पुत्रशतान्यासन्पञ्च वीर्यवतो भुवि /
राजेयमिति विख्यातं क्षत्र सिंद्रभयावहम् //
text_mt: Powerful Raji had five hundred sons on earth; / they were renowned as the Rājeyas, a kṣatriya [order] bringing terror to Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devāsure yuddhe samutpanne sudāruṇe /
devāścaivāsurāścaiva pitāmahamathābruvan //
meaning:
तदा देवासुरे युद्धे समुत्पन्ने सुदारुणे /
देवाश्चैवासुराश्चैव पितामहमथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Then, when a very terrible battle between gods and asuras arose, / both the gods and the asuras spoke to the Grandfather:

sanskrit_iast:
āvayorbhagavanyuddhe vijetā ko bhaviṣyati /
brūhi naḥ sarvalokeśa śrotumicchāmahe vayam //
meaning:
आवयोर्भगवन्युद्धे विजेता को भविष्यति /
ब्रूहि नः सर्वलोकेश श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् //
text_mt: “O Lord, which of us two shall be victorious in battle? / Tell us, O Lord of all worlds; we wish to hear.”

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca /
yeṣāmarthāya saṃgrāme rajirāttāyudhaḥ prabhuḥ /
yotsyate te vijaṣyante trīṃllokānnātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच /
येषामर्थाय संग्रामे रजिरात्तायुधः प्रभुः /
योत्स्यते ते विजष्यन्ते त्रींल्लोकान्नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / “Those on whose behalf in battle the powerful Raji fights, having taken up arms, / they shall conquer the three worlds; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rajiryatastato lakṣmīryato lakṣmīstato dhṛtiḥ /
yato dhṛtistato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ //
meaning:
रजिर्यतस्ततो लक्ष्मीर्यतो लक्ष्मीस्ततो धृतिः /
