ददौ जितां वसुमतीं सुराणां सुरसत्तमः //
text_mt: by whom the paths of the world were established, a threefold-stepping form assumed, / and the conquered earth given to the gods, the best of the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
yena saiṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā dvidhākṛtvā ca tatpunaḥ /
pūrvadaityo mahāvīryo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ //
meaning:
येन सैंहं वपुः कृत्वा द्विधाकृत्वा च तत्पुनः /
पूर्वदैत्यो महावीर्यो हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः //
text_mt: by whom, having assumed a lion-like form and divided it again into two, / the primeval Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu of great valor was slain;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ purā hyanalo bhūtvā tvaurvaḥ saṃvarttako vibhuḥ /
pātālasthor'ṇavagataḥ papau toyamayaṃ haviḥ //
meaning:
यः पुरा ह्यनलो भूत्वा त्वौर्वः संवर्त्तको विभुः /
पातालस्थोर्ऽणवगतः पपौ तोयमयं हविः //
text_mt: who formerly, having become the all-pervading fire Aurva that brings destruction, / remaining in Pātāla and entering the ocean, drank the watery oblation;

sanskrit_iast:
sahasracaraṇaṃ devaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasraśaḥ /
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ yamāhurvai yuge yuge //
meaning:
सहस्रचरणं देवं सहस्रांशुं सहस्रशः /
सहस्रशिरसं देवं यमाहुर्वै युगे युगे //
text_mt: whom they proclaim yuga after yuga as the thousand-footed god, / the thousand-rayed in thousands of ways, the thousand-headed god;

sanskrit_iast:
nābhyaraṇyāṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham /
ekārṇavagate loke tatpaṅkajamapaṅkajam //
meaning:
नाभ्यरण्यां समुद्भूतं यस्य पैतामहं गृहम् /
एकार्णवगते लोके तत्पङ्कजमपङ्कजम् //
text_mt: from the forest of whose navel arose the lotus, the dwelling of the Grandfather, / when the world was dissolved into a single ocean, a spotless lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
yena te nihatā daityāḥ saṃgrāme tārakāmaye /
sarvadevamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ //
meaning:
येन ते निहता दैत्याः संग्रामे तारकामये /
सर्वदेवमयं कृत्वा सर्वायुधधरं वपुः //
text_mt: by whom those Daityas were slain in the battle over Tārakā, / having made his body composed of all gods and bearing all weapons;

sanskrit_iast:
mahābalena votsiktaḥ kālanemirnipātitaḥ /
uttarāṃśe samudrasya kṣīrodasyāmṛtodadheḥ /
yaḥ śeteśaśvataṃ yogamācchādya timiraṃ mahat //
meaning:
महाबलेन वोत्सिक्तः कालनेमिर्निपातितः /
उत्तरांशे समुद्रस्य क्षीरोदस्यामृतोदधेः /
यः शेतेशश्वतं योगमाच्छाद्य तिमिरं महत् //
text_mt: by whom Kālanemi, insolent with great strength, was cast down; / who rests in the northern part of the ocean, the Ocean of Milk, the sea of nectar, / covering the great darkness through eternal yoga;

sanskrit_iast:
surāraṇīgarbhamadhatta divyaṃ tapaḥprakarṣādaditiḥ purāyam /
śakraṃ ca yo daityagaṇaṃ ca rūddhaṃ garbhāvamānena bhṛśaṃ cakāra ha //
meaning:
सुरारणीगर्भमधत्त दिव्यं तपःप्रकर्षाददितिः पुरायम् /
शक्रं च यो दैत्यगणं च रूद्धं गर्भावमानेन भृशं चकार ह //
text_mt: formerly Aditi, by the excellence of her asceticism, bore this divine child within her womb, the fire-stick of the gods; / and he greatly humbled Śakra and the host of Daityas who had obstructed him, through the humiliation of entering the womb;

sanskrit_iast:
padāni yo lokapadāni kṛtvā cakāra daityānsalileśayāṃstān /
kṛtvā ca devāṃstridivasya devāṃścakre sureśaṃ puruhūtameva //
meaning:
पदानि यो लोकपदानि कृत्वा चकार दैत्यान्सलिलेशयांस्तान् /
कृत्वा च देवांस्त्रिदिवस्य देवांश्चक्रे सुरेशं पुरुहूतमेव //
text_mt: who, making his steps the realms of the world, made those Daityas dwell in the waters, / and, having made the gods the rulers of heaven, made Puruhūta the lord of the gods;

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyena vidhinā anvāhāryeṇa karmaṇā //
meaning: गार्हपत्येन विधिना अन्वाहार्येण कर्मणा //
text_mt: by the Gārhapatya rite, by the Anvāhārya ritual,

sanskrit_iast:
agnimāhavanīyaṃ ca vedīṃ caiva kuśaṃ sruvam /
prokṣaṇīyaṃ śrutaṃ caiva āvabhṛthyaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अग्निमाहवनीयं च वेदीं चैव कुशं स्रुवम् /
प्रोक्षणीयं श्रुतं चैव आवभृथ्यं तथैव च //
text_mt: and the Āhavanīya fire, the altar, the kuśa grass, the sruva ladle, / the sprinkling water, the sacred scripture, and the ritual ablution;

sanskrit_iast:
atharṣīṃścaiva yaścakre havyabhāgapradānmakhe /
havyādāṃśca surāṃścakre kavyādāṃśca pitṝnapi /
bhogārthaṃ yajñavidhinā yo yajño yajñakarmaṇi //
meaning:
अथर्षींश्चैव यश्चक्रे हव्यभागप्रदान्मखे /
हव्यादांश्च सुरांश्चक्रे कव्यादांश्च पितॄनपि /
भोगार्थं यज्ञविधिना यो यज्ञो यज्ञकर्मणि //
text_mt: and who then appointed the ṛṣis to distribute shares of oblations in sacrifice, / made the gods eat the oblations, and the ancestors eat the funeral offerings, / who is himself the sacrifice in sacrificial action, for the sake of enjoyment through sacrificial ordinance;

sanskrit_iast:
yūpānsamitsruvaṃ somaṃ pavitraṃ paridhīnapi /
yajñiyāni ca dravyāṇi yajñiyāṃśca tathānalān //
meaning:
यूपान्समित्स्रुवं सोमं पवित्रं परिधीनपि /
यज्ञियानि च द्रव्याणि यज्ञियांश्च तथानलान् //
text_mt: who [made] the sacrificial posts, firewood, sruva ladles, soma, purifying strainers, and enclosing sticks, / the sacrificial substances and the sacrificial fires,

sanskrit_iast:
sadasyānyajamānāṃśca hyaśvamedhānkratuttamān /
vicitrānrājasūyadīnpārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā //
meaning:
सदस्यान्यजमानांश्च ह्यश्वमेधान्क्रतुत्तमान् /
विचित्रान्राजसूयदीन्पारमेष्ठ्येन कर्मणा //
text_mt: the assembly members, the patrons of sacrifice, the horse-sacrifices as the highest of rites, / and various sacrifices beginning with the Rājasūya, through his supreme lordship;

sanskrit_iast:
udgātrādīṃśca yaḥ kṛtvā yajñāṃllokānanukramam /
kṣaṇā nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca kalāstraikālyameva ca //
meaning:
उद्गात्रादींश्च यः कृत्वा यज्ञांल्लोकाननुक्रमम् /
क्षणा निमेषाः काष्ठाश्च कलास्त्रैकाल्यमेव च //
text_mt: and who, having created the Udgātṛ and other [priests], the sacrifices, the worlds in due order, / the instants, twinklings of an eye, kāṣṭhās, kalās, and the three divisions of time,

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrttāstithayo māsā dinaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā /
ṛtavaḥ kālayogāśca pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ triṣu //
meaning:
मुहूर्त्तास्तिथयो मासा दिनं संवत्सरं तथा /
ऋतवः कालयोगाश्च प्रमाणं त्रिविधं त्रिषु //
text_mt: the muhūrtas, lunar days, months, days, and years, / the seasons, junctures of time, and the threefold measure in the three [worlds],

sanskrit_iast:
āyuḥ kṣetrāṇyatha balaṃ kṣaṇaṃ yadrūpasauṣṭhavam /
medhāvitvaṃ ca śauryaṃ ca śāstrasyeva ca pāraṇam //
meaning:
आयुः क्षेत्राण्यथ बलं क्षणं यद्रूपसौष्ठवम् /
मेधावित्वं च शौर्यं च शास्त्रस्येव च पारणम् //
text_mt: lifespan, fields, strength, momentary beauty of form, / intellect, courage, and the mastery of the scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
trayo varṇāstrayo lokāstraividyaṃ pāvakāstrayaḥ /
traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi tisro mātrā guṇāstrayaḥ //
meaning:
त्रयो वर्णास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रैविद्यं पावकास्त्रयः /
त्रैकाल्यं त्रीणि कर्माणि तिस्रो मात्रा गुणास्त्रयः //
text_mt: the three varnas, the three worlds, the triple knowledge, the three fires, / the three times, the three actions, the three morae, and the three qualities—

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭā lokeśvarāścaiva yena yena ca karmaṇā /
sarvabhūtagaṇāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ sarvabhūtagaṇātmanā //
meaning:
सृष्टा लोकेश्वराश्चैव येन येन च कर्मणा /
सर्वभूतगणाः सृष्टाः सर्वभूतगणात्मना //
text_mt: and the lords of the worlds were created by whichever action, / and the hosts of all beings were created by him who is the self of all hosts of beings;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇaṃ saṃdhāya pūrveṇa yogena ramate ca yaḥ /
gatāgatānāṃ yo netā sarvatra vividheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
क्षणं संधाय पूर्वेण योगेन रमते च यः /
गतागतानां यो नेता सर्वत्र विविधेश्वरः //
text_mt: who, joining an instant with ancient yoga, takes delight; / who is the guide of the coming and going, the manifold lord everywhere;

sanskrit_iast:
yo gatirddharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmaṇām /
cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā //
meaning:
यो गतिर्द्धर्मयुक्तानामगतिः पापकर्मणाम् /
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य प्रभवश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता //
text_mt: who is the refuge of the righteous, and non-refuge for evildoers; / the source of the four varnas, and the protector of the four varnas;

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśamyasaṃśrayaḥ /
digantaraṃ nabho bhūmirāpo vāyurvibhāvasuḥ //
meaning:
चातुर्विद्यस्य यो वेत्ता चातुराशम्यसंश्रयः /
दिगन्तरं नभो भूमिरापो वायुर्विभावसुः //
text_mt: the knower of the fourfold knowledge, the resort of the four stages of life; / the quarters of space, the sky, the earth, water, wind, and fire;

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryadvayaṃ jyotiryugeśāḥ kṣaṇadācarāḥ /
yaḥ paraṃ śruyate devo yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यद्वयं ज्योतिर्युगेशाः क्षणदाचराः /
यः परं श्रुयते देवो यः परं श्रूयते तपः //
text_mt: the twin lights of moon and sun, the lords of yugas, the prowlers of the night; / who is heard of as the supreme god, who is heard of as supreme austerity;

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paraṃ tamasaḥ prāhuryaḥ paraṃ paramātmavān /
ādityādistu yo devo yaśca daityāntako vibhuḥ //
meaning:
यः परं तमसः प्राहुर्यः परं परमात्मवान् /
आदित्यादिस्तु यो देवो यश्च दैत्यान्तको विभुः //
text_mt: whom they call beyond darkness, who is supremely possessed of the self, / who is the primal deity beginning with Āditya, and the all-pervading destroyer of the Daityas;

sanskrit_iast:
yugānteṣvantako yaśca yaśca lokāntakāntakaḥ /
seturyo lokasetūnāṃ medho yo madhyakarmaṇām //
meaning:
युगान्तेष्वन्तको यश्च यश्च लोकान्तकान्तकः /
सेतुर्यो लोकसेतूनां मेधो यो मध्यकर्मणाम् //
text_mt: who is the end-maker at the ends of yugas, and the destroyer of the destroyer of the worlds; / the bridge among the bridges of the world, the essence of intermediate actions;

sanskrit_iast:
vedyo yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām /
somabhūtastu bhūtānāmagnibhūto 'gnivarcasām //
meaning:
वेद्यो यो वेदविदुषां प्रभुर्यः प्रभवात्मनाम् /
सोमभूतस्तु भूतानामग्निभूतो ऽग्निवर्चसाम् //
text_mt: the one to be known by knowers of the Veda, the sovereign of powerful souls; / who has become Soma among living beings, and Agni among those of fiery splendor;

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ manurbhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām /
vinayo nayatṛptānāṃ tejastejasvināmapi //
meaning:
मनुष्याणां मनुर्भूतस्तपोभूतस्तपस्विनाम् /
विनयो नयतृप्तानां तेजस्तेजस्विनामपि //
text_mt: who has become Manu among humans, and asceticism among ascetics; / discipline among those satisfied with guidance, and majesty among the majestic;

sanskrit_iast:
vigraho vigrahāṇāṃ yo gatirgatimatāmapi /
ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyuprāṇo hutāśanaḥ //
meaning:
विग्रहो विग्रहाणां यो गतिर्गतिमतामपि /
आकाशप्रभवो वायुर्वायुप्राणो हुताशनः //
text_mt: who is the body among embodied forms, and the goal among those that move; / wind is born from space, and fire has wind as its breath;

sanskrit_iast:
devā hutāśanaprāṇāḥ prāṇo 'gnermadhusūdanaḥ /
rasācchoṇitasaṃbhūtiḥ śoṇitānmāsamucyate //
meaning:
देवा हुताशनप्राणाः प्राणो ऽग्नेर्मधुसूदनः /
रसाच्छोणितसंभूतिः शोणितान्मासमुच्यते //
text_mt: the gods have fire as their breath, and Madhusūdana is the breath of fire. / From chyme arises blood, from blood flesh is said to come;

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsātta medaso janma medaso 'sthi nirucyate /
asyno majjā samabhavanmajjātaḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
मांसात्त मेदसो जन्म मेदसो ऽस्थि निरुच्यते /
अस्य्नो मज्जा समभवन्मज्जातः शुक्रसंभवः //
text_mt: from flesh the birth of fat occurs, from fat bone is declared; / from bone marrow came to be, and from marrow arises semen.

sanskrit_iast:
śukrādgarbhaḥ samābhava drasamūlena karmaṇā /
tatrāpāṃ prathamāvāpaḥ sa saumyo rāśirucyate //
meaning:
शुक्राद्गर्भः समाभव द्रसमूलेन कर्मणा /
तत्रापां प्रथमावापः स सौम्यो राशिरुच्यते //
text_mt: From semen the embryo came to be, through action rooted in chyle. / There the first infusion is of water; that is called the lunar aggregate.

sanskrit_iast:
garbho 'śmasaṃbhavo jñeyo dvitīyo rāśirucyate /
śukraṃ somātmakaṃ vidyādārttavaṃ pāvakātmakam //
meaning:
गर्भो ऽश्मसंभवो ज्ञेयो द्वितीयो राशिरुच्यते /
शुक्रं सोमात्मकं विद्यादार्त्तवं पावकात्मकम् //
text_mt: The embryo should be known as born from solid essence; it is called the second aggregate. / One should know that semen has the nature of Soma, and menstrual fluid has the nature of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvau rasānugāvetau vīrye ca śaśipāvakau /
kaphavarge bhavecchukraṃ pittavarge ca śoṇitam //
meaning:
भावौ रसानुगावेतौ वीर्ये च शशिपावकौ /
कफवर्गे भवेच्छुक्रं पित्तवर्गे च शोणितम् //
text_mt: These two conditions follow chyme, and in vigor they are moon and fire; / semen belongs to the phlegm class, and blood to the bile class.

sanskrit_iast:
kaphasya tdṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ nābhyāṃ pittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam /
dehasya madhye tdṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tu manasaḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
कफस्य त्दृदयं स्थानं नाभ्यां पित्तं प्रतिष्ठितम् /
देहस्य मध्ये त्दृदयं स्थानं तु मनसः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The heart is the seat of phlegm; bile is established in the navel. / The heart is in the middle of the body, remembered as the seat of the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
nābhiścodara saṃsthā tu tatra devo hutāśanaḥ /
manaḥ prajāpatirjñeyaḥ kaphaḥ somo vibhāvyate //
meaning:
नाभिश्चोदर संस्था तु तत्र देवो हुताशनः /
मनः प्रजापतिर्ज्ञेयः कफः सोमो विभाव्यते //
text_mt: The navel is located in the abdomen, and there the god Fire resides. / Mind should be known as Prajāpati; phlegm is recognized as Soma.

sanskrit_iast:
pittamagniḥ smṛto hyetadagnīṣomātmakaṃ jagat /
evaṃ pravarttite garbhe vṛtte karkandhusaṃnibhe //
meaning:
पित्तमग्निः स्मृतो ह्येतदग्नीषोमात्मकं जगत् /
एवं प्रवर्त्तिते गर्भे वृत्ते कर्कन्धुसंनिभे //
text_mt: Bile is remembered as fire; thus this world has the nature of Agni and Soma. / When the embryo is thus set in motion, rounded like a jujube fruit,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuḥ praveśanaṃ cakre saṃgataḥ paramātmanā /
sa pañcadhā śarīrastho vidyate varddhayetpunaḥ //
meaning:
वायुः प्रवेशनं चक्रे संगतः परमात्मना /
स पञ्चधा शरीरस्थो विद्यते वर्द्धयेत्पुनः //
text_mt: wind enters [it], united with the supreme self. / It exists fivefold in the body, and causes it to grow again:

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpānau samānaśca hyudāno vyāna eva ca /
prāṇo 'sya paramātmānaṃ varddhayanparivarttate //
meaning:
प्राणापानौ समानश्च ह्युदानो व्यान एव च /
प्राणो ऽस्य परमात्मानं वर्द्धयन्परिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: prāṇa, apāna, samāna, udāna, and vyāna. / His prāṇa circulates, causing the supreme self to grow;

sanskrit_iast:
apānaḥ paścimaṃ kāyamu dāno 'rddhaṃ śarīriṇaḥ /
vyāno vyānīyate yena samānaḥ sarvasaṃdhiṣu //
meaning:
अपानः पश्चिमं कायमु दानो ऽर्द्धं शरीरिणः /
व्यानो व्यानीयते येन समानः सर्वसंधिषु //
text_mt: apāna [pervades] the lower body, udāna the upper half of the embodied being, / vyāna is that by which circulation is effected, and samāna is in all the joints.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtāvāptistatastasya jāyatendriyagocarā /
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam //
meaning:
भूतावाप्तिस्ततस्तस्य जायतेन्द्रियगोचरा /
पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् //
text_mt: Then occurs its attainment of the elements, accessible to the senses: / earth, wind, space, water, and fire as the fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvedriyaniviṣṭāste svasvayogaṃ pracakrire /
pārthivaṃ dehamāhustu prāṇātmānaṃ ca mārutam //
meaning:
सर्वेद्रियनिविष्टास्ते स्वस्वयोगं प्रचक्रिरे /
पार्थिवं देहमाहुस्तु प्राणात्मानं च मारुतम् //
text_mt: Entering into all the senses, they performed their respective functions. / They call the body earthy, and the life-breath wind.

sanskrit_iast:
chidrāṇyākāśayonīni jalātsrāvaḥ pravarttate /
jyotiścakṣuṣi koṣṭho 'smātteṣāṃ yannāmataḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
छिद्राण्याकाशयोनीनि जलात्स्रावः प्रवर्त्तते /
ज्योतिश्चक्षुषि कोष्ठो ऽस्मात्तेषां यन्नामतः स्मृतम् //
text_mt:
The bodily cavities have ether as their source; flow proceeds from water;
light is in the eye, and the internal belly [proceeds] from fire, which is recalled by their name.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāhya viṣayāṃścaiva yasya vīryātpravartitāḥ /
ityetānpuruṣaḥ sarvānsṛjatyekaḥ sanātanaḥ //
meaning:
संग्राह्य विषयांश्चैव यस्य वीर्यात्प्रवर्तिताः /
इत्येतान्पुरुषः सर्वान्सृजत्येकः सनातनः //
text_mt: And grasping the sense-objects through whose vigor they are set in motion— / thus does the eternal, single Puruṣa create all these.

sanskrit_iast:
naidhane 'sminkathaṃ loke naratvaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ /
eṣa naḥ saṃśayo dhīmanneṣa vai vismayo mahān //
meaning:
नैधने ऽस्मिन्कथं लोके नरत्वं विष्णुरागतः /
एष नः संशयो धीमन्नेष वै विस्मयो महान् //
text_mt: How did Viṣṇu enter the human state in this mortal world? / This is our doubt, O wise one, and this indeed is our great wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ gatirgatimatāmāpanno mānuṣīṃ tanum /
śrotumicchāmahe viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi ca yathākramam //
meaning:
कथं गतिर्गतिमतामापन्नो मानुषीं तनुम् /
श्रोतुमिच्छामहे विष्णोः कर्माणि च यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: How did he, the refuge of all beings, assume a human body? / We wish to hear about the deeds of Viṣṇu in proper sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ viṣṇurvedairdevaścai kathyate /
viṣṇorutpattimāścaya kathayasva mahāmate //
meaning:
आश्चर्यं परमं विष्णुर्वेदैर्देवश्चै कथ्यते /
विष्णोरुत्पत्तिमाश्चय कथयस्व महामते //
text_mt: Viṣṇu is proclaimed by the Vedas to be the supreme wonder and god. / Tell of the wondrous birth of Viṣṇu, O highly intelligent one!

sanskrit_iast:
etadāścaryamākhyātaṃ kathyatāṃ vai sukhāvaham /
prakhyātabalavīryasya prādurbhāvanmahātmanaḥ /
karmaṇāścaryabhūtasya viṣṇoḥ sattvamihocyate //
meaning:
एतदाश्चर्यमाख्यातं कथ्यतां वै सुखावहम् /
प्रख्यातबलवीर्यस्य प्रादुर्भावन्महात्मनः /
कर्मणाश्चर्यभूतस्य विष्णोः सत्त्वमिहोच्यते //
text_mt: Let this wondrous, auspicious account be told— / the manifestation of that great-souled one renowned for strength and valor, / whose deeds are marvelous: the nature of Viṣṇu is described here.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrttayiṣyāmi prādurbhāvaṃ mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अहं वः कीर्त्तयिष्यामि प्रादुर्भावं महात्मनः //
text_mt: The bard said: / I will recount to you the manifestation of that great-souled one,

sanskrit_iast:
yathā babhūva bhagavānmānuṣeṣu mahātapāḥ /
bhṛgustrīvadhadoṣeṇa bhṛguśāpena mānuṣe //
meaning:
यथा बभूव भगवान्मानुषेषु महातपाः /
भृगुस्त्रीवधदोषेण भृगुशापेन मानुषे //
text_mt: how the blessed lord of great austerities appeared among mortals, / through the fault of slaying Bhṛgu’s wife, because of Bhṛgu’s curse [to be born] in a mortal [womb].

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate ca yugānteṣu devakāryārthasiddhaye /
tasya divyāṃ tanuṃ viṣṇorgadato me nibodhata //
meaning:
जायते च युगान्तेषु देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये /
तस्य दिव्यां तनुं विष्णोर्गदतो मे निबोधत //
text_mt: He is born at the ends of yugas for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose. / Listen as I describe that divine body of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
yugadharme parāvṛtte kāle ca śithile prabhuḥ /
karttuṃ dharmavyavasthānaṃ jāyate mānuṣeṣviha /
bhṛgoḥ śāpanimittena devāsurakṛtena ca //
meaning:
युगधर्मे परावृत्ते काले च शिथिले प्रभुः /
कर्त्तुं धर्मव्यवस्थानं जायते मानुषेष्विह /
भृगोः शापनिमित्तेन देवासुरकृतेन च //
text_mt: When the duty of the age has turned away and the times have deteriorated, the lord / is born here among mortals in order to establish righteousness, / through the cause of Bhṛgu's curse and because of what happened between the gods and asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kathaṃ devāsurakṛte tadvyāhāramavāptavān /
etadveditumicchāmo vṛttaṃ devāsuraṃ katham //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कथं देवासुरकृते तद्व्याहारमवाप्तवान् /
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामो वृत्तं देवासुरं कथम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / How did he incur that curse because of what occurred between gods and asuras? / We wish to know this: how did the event between the gods and asuras take place?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
devāsuraṃ yathāvṛttaṃ bruvatastannibodhata //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
देवासुरं यथावृत्तं ब्रुवतस्तन्निबोधत //
text_mt: The bard said: / Listen as I recount that conflict between gods and asuras as it occurred.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityastrailokyaṃ prākpraśāsati /
balinādhiṣṭhitaṃ rājyaṃ punarlokatraye kramāt //
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यस्त्रैलोक्यं प्राक्प्रशासति /
बलिनाधिष्ठितं राज्यं पुनर्लोकत्रये क्रमात् //
text_mt: Formerly, the Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu ruled the three worlds; / then, in due course, sovereignty over the three worlds was held by Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
sakhyamāsītparaṃ teṣāṃ devānāmasuraiḥ saha /
yugākhyā daśa saṃpūrṇā hyāsīdavyāhataṃ jagat //
meaning:
सख्यमासीत्परं तेषां देवानामसुरैः सह /
युगाख्या दश संपूर्णा ह्यासीदव्याहतं जगत् //
text_mt: There was supreme friendship between those gods and the asuras; / for ten full yugas the world was unhindered.

sanskrit_iast:
nideśasthāyinaścaiva tayordevāsurābhavan /
baddhe balau vivādo 'tha saṃpravṛttaḥ sudāruṇaḥ //
meaning:
निदेशस्थायिनश्चैव तयोर्देवासुराभवन् /
बद्धे बलौ विवादो ऽथ संप्रवृत्तः सुदारुणः //
text_mt: Both the gods and asuras followed their commands. / But when Bali was bound, an exceedingly terrible dispute broke out.

sanskrit_iast:
devāsurāṇāṃ ca tadā ghoraḥ kṣayakaro mahān /
teṣāṃ dvīpanimittaṃ vai saṃgrāmā bahavo 'bhaven //
meaning:
देवासुराणां च तदा घोरः क्षयकरो महान् /
तेषां द्वीपनिमित्तं वै संग्रामा बहवो ऽभवेन् //
text_mt: Then there was a dreadful, massive destruction of gods and asuras; / for the sake of the continents many battles took place between them.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhe 'smindaśa dvau ca ṣaṇḍāmarkāntagāḥ smṛtāḥ /
nāmatastu samāsena śṛṇudhvaṃ tānvivakṣataḥ //
meaning:
वराहे ऽस्मिन्दश द्वौ च षण्डामर्कान्तगाः स्मृताः /
नामतस्तु समासेन शृणुध्वं तान्विवक्षतः //
text_mt: In this Varāha [kalpa], twelve [battles] ending with the defeat of Ṣaṇḍa and Marka are recorded; / listen to them by name in brief as I state them.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamo nārasiṃhastu dvitīyaścāpi vāmanaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ sa tu vārāhaścaturtho 'mṛtamanthanaḥ //
meaning:
प्रथमो नारसिंहस्तु द्वितीयश्चापि वामनः /
तृतीयः स तु वाराहश्चतुर्थो ऽमृतमन्थनः //
text_mt: The first was the Nārasiṃha battle, the second was the Vāmana, / the third was the Vārāha, and the fourth was the Churning of the Nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgrāmaḥ pañcamaścaiva sughorastārakāmayaḥ /
ṣaṣṭho hyāḍībakasteṣāṃ saptamastraipuraḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
संग्रामः पञ्चमश्चैव सुघोरस्तारकामयः /
षष्ठो ह्याडीबकस्तेषां सप्तमस्त्रैपुरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The fifth battle was the very terrible Tārakāmaya; / the sixth of them is known as Āḍībaka, and the seventh as Traipura.

sanskrit_iast:
andhakāro 'ṣṭamasteṣāṃ dhvajaśca navamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
vārtraśca daśamo ghorastato hālāhalaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अन्धकारो ऽष्टमस्तेषां ध्वजश्च नवमः स्मृतः /
वार्त्रश्च दशमो घोरस्ततो हालाहलः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The eighth of them is remembered as Andhakāra, and the ninth as Dhvaja; / the tenth was the terrible Vārtra, and after that the Hālāhala is recorded.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛto dvādaśakasteṣāṃ ghoraḥ kolāhalo 'paraḥ /
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo narasiṃhena sūditaḥ //
meaning:
स्मृतो द्वादशकस्तेषां घोरः कोलाहलो ऽपरः /
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो नरसिंहेन सूदितः //
text_mt: The twelfth of them is remembered as the terrible, further [battle of] Kolāhala. / The Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain by Narasiṃha;

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanena balirbaddhastrailokyākramaṇe kṛte /
hiraṇyākṣo hato dvandve prativāde ca daivate //
meaning:
वामनेन बलिर्बद्धस्त्रैलोक्याक्रमणे कृते /
हिरण्याक्षो हतो द्वन्द्वे प्रतिवादे च दैवते //
text_mt: Bali was bound by Vāmana when the stride across the three worlds was made; / Hiraṇyākṣa was slain in a duel, in a dispute concerning divinity.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābalo mahāsattvaḥ saṃgrāmeṣvaparājitaḥ /
daṃṣṭrayā tu varāheṇa sa daityastu dvidhākṛtaḥ //
meaning:
महाबलो महासत्त्वः संग्रामेष्वपराजितः /
दंष्ट्रया तु वराहेण स दैत्यस्तु द्विधाकृतः //
text_mt: Great in strength and courage, undefeated in battles, / that Daitya was split in two by the Boar with his tusk.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādo nirjito yuddhe indreṇāmṛtamanthane /
virocanastu prāhlādirnityamindravadhodyataḥ //
meaning:
प्रह्लादो निर्जितो युद्धे इन्द्रेणामृतमन्थने /
विरोचनस्तु प्राह्लादिर्नित्यमिन्द्रवधोद्यतः //
text_mt: Prahlāda was defeated in battle by Indra at the Churning of the Nectar. / Virocana, Prahlāda's son, was ever bent on the slaughter of Indra;

sanskrit_iast:
indreṇaiva sa vikramya nihatastārakāmaye /
bhavādavadhyatāṃ prāpya viśeṣāstrādibhistu yaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रेणैव स विक्रम्य निहतस्तारकामये /
भवादवध्यतां प्राप्य विशेषास्त्रादिभिस्तु यः //
text_mt: he was slain through valor by Indra himself in the Tārakāmaya [battle]. / The one who had obtained invulnerability from Bhava against special weapons and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
sa jaṃbho nihataḥ ṣaṣṭhe śakrāviṣṭena viṣṇunā /
aśaknuvatsu deveṣu paraṃ soḍhumadaivatam //
meaning:
स जंभो निहतः षष्ठे शक्राविष्टेन विष्णुना /
अशक्नुवत्सु देवेषु परं सोढुमदैवतम् //
text_mt: that Jambha was slain in the sixth [battle] by Viṣṇu entering into Śakra, / when the gods were unable to bear the hostile anti-divine power.

sanskrit_iast:
nihatā dānavāḥ sarve tripure tryaṃbakeṇa tu /
atha daityāḥ surāścaiva rākṣasāstvandhakārike //
meaning:
निहता दानवाः सर्वे त्रिपुरे त्र्यंबकेण तु /
अथ दैत्याः सुराश्चैव राक्षसास्त्वन्धकारिके //
text_mt: All the Dānavas were slain at Tripura by Tryambaka; / then the Daityas, asuras, and Rākṣasas in the Andhakāra battle

sanskrit_iast:
jitā devamanuṣyeste pitṛbhiścaiva saṃgatāḥ /
savṛtrāndānavāṃścaiva saṃgatānkṛtsnaśaśca tān //
meaning:
जिता देवमनुष्येस्ते पितृभिश्चैव संगताः /
सवृत्रान्दानवांश्चैव संगतान्कृत्स्नशश्च तान् //
text_mt: were conquered by gods and humans united with the ancestors. / And all those Dānavas gathered together with Vṛtra,

sanskrit_iast:
jaghne viṣṇusahāyena mahendrastena varddhitaḥ /
hato dhvaje mahendreṇa mayāchatraśca yogavit //
meaning:
जघ्ने विष्णुसहायेन महेन्द्रस्तेन वर्द्धितः /
हतो ध्वजे महेन्द्रेण मयाछत्रश्च योगवित् //
text_mt: Mahendra, assisted by Viṣṇu and strengthened by him, destroyed entirely. / In the Dhvaja [battle], Mahendra slew Maya with his umbrella, skilled in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajalakṣaṃ samāviśya vipracittiḥ mahānujaḥ /
daityāṃśca dānavāṃścaiva saṃhatānkṛtsnaśaśca tān //
meaning:
ध्वजलक्षं समाविश्य विप्रचित्तिः महानुजः /
दैत्यांश्च दानवांश्चैव संहतान्कृत्स्नशश्च तान् //
text_mt: Vipracitti, the mighty younger brother, having entered the banner emblem, / and all those Daityas and Dānavas gathered together in full force,

sanskrit_iast:
jayaddhālāhale sarvairdevaiḥ parivṛto vṛṣā /
rajiḥ kolāhale sarvāndaityānparivṛto 'jayat //
meaning:
जयद्धालाहले सर्वैर्देवैः परिवृतो वृषा /
रजिः कोलाहले सर्वान्दैत्यान्परिवृतो ऽजयत् //
text_mt: Indra, surrounded by all the gods, defeated in the Hālāhala [battle]. / Raji, surrounded [by his forces], conquered all the Daityas in the Kolāhala [battle],

sanskrit_iast:
yajñasyāvabhṛthe jitvā ṣaṇḍāmakārai tu daivataiḥ /
ete devāsurā vṛttāḥ saṃgrāmā dvādaśaiva tu //
meaning:
यज्ञस्यावभृथे जित्वा षण्डामकारै तु दैवतैः /
एते देवासुरा वृत्ताः संग्रामा द्वादशैव तु //
text_mt: having defeated Ṣaṇḍa and Marka with the deities at the end of the sacrifice. / These twelve battles indeed took place between the gods and asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
surāsurakṣayakarāḥ prajānā maśivaśca ha /
hiraṇyakaśipū rājā varṣāṇāmarbudaṃ babhau //
meaning:
सुरासुरक्षयकराः प्रजाना मशिवश्च ह /
हिरण्यकशिपू राजा वर्षाणामर्बुदं बभौ //
text_mt: causing the destruction of suras and asuras and inauspiciousness for creatures. / King Hiraṇyakaśipu shone for a hundred million years,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā śatasahasrāṇi hyadhikāni dvisaphatiḥ /
aśītiśca sahasrāṇi trailokyasyeśvaro 'bhavat //
meaning:
तथा शतसहस्राणि ह्यधिकानि द्विसफतिः /
अशीतिश्च सहस्राणि त्रैलोक्यस्येश्वरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: as well as one hundred thousand, seventy-two [thousand], / and eighty thousand [years]; he was the sovereign of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṃparyeṇa rājā tu balirvarṣārbudhaṃ punaḥ /
ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi triṃśacca niyutāni ca //
meaning:
पारंपर्येण राजा तु बलिर्वर्षार्बुधं पुनः /
षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि त्रिंशच्च नियुतानि च //
text_mt: Then, by succession, King Bali ruled for a hundred million years, / and sixty thousand, and thirty hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
bale rājyādhikārastu yāvatkālaṃ babhūva ha /
prahlādo nirjito 'bhūcca tāvatkālaṃ sahāsuraiḥ //
meaning:
बले राज्याधिकारस्तु यावत्कालं बभूव ह /
प्रह्लादो निर्जितो ऽभूच्च तावत्कालं सहासुरैः //
text_mt: As long as Bali held authority over the realm, / for that long Prahlāda remained defeated along with the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāstrayaste vikhyātā hyasurāṇāṃ mahau jasaḥ /
daityasaṃsthamidaṃ sarvamāsīddaśayugaṃ kila //
meaning:
इन्द्रास्त्रयस्ते विख्याता ह्यसुराणां महौ जसः /
दैत्यसंस्थमिदं सर्वमासीद्दशयुगं किल //
text_mt: These three of great vigor are renowned as the Indras of the asuras; / this whole [realm] remained in the power of the Daityas for ten yugas, it is said.

sanskrit_iast:
aśapattu tataḥ śukro rāṣṭraṃ daśayugaṃ punaḥ /
trailokyamidamavyagraṃ mahendro hyabhyayādbaleḥ //
meaning:
अशपत्तु ततः शुक्रो राष्ट्रं दशयुगं पुनः /
त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्यग्रं महेन्द्रो ह्यभ्ययाद्बलेः //
text_mt: Then Śukra cursed the realm for another ten yugas. / Mahendra then attained these three undisturbed worlds from Bali.

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādasya hṛte tasmiṃstrailokye kālaparyayāt /
paryāyeṇaiva saṃprāptaṃ trailokyaṃ pākaśāsanam //
meaning:
प्रह्लादस्य हृते तस्मिंस्त्रैलोक्ये कालपर्ययात् /
पर्यायेणैव संप्राप्तं त्रैलोक्यं पाकशासनम् //
text_mt: When those three worlds were taken away from Prahlāda in the course of time, / the three worlds came in turn to Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'surānparityajya yajño devānupāgamat /
yajñe devānatha gate kāvyaṃ te hyasurāṃ bruvan //
meaning:
ततो ऽसुरान्परित्यज्य यज्ञो देवानुपागमत् /
यज्ञे देवानथ गते काव्यं ते ह्यसुरां ब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Then, having abandoned the asuras, the sacrifice went to the gods. / When the sacrifice had gone to the gods, those asuras spoke to Śukra:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tanno miṣatāṃ rāṣṭraṃ tyaktvā yajñaḥ surāngataḥ /
sthātuṃ na śakrumo hyadya praviśāma rasātalam //
meaning:
किं तन्नो मिषतां राष्ट्रं त्यक्त्वा यज्ञः सुरान्गतः /
स्थातुं न शक्रुमो ह्यद्य प्रविशाम रसातलम् //
text_mt: “How is it that the sacrifice has abandoned our kingdom and gone to the gods before our eyes? / We cannot remain today; let us enter Rasātala!”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto 'bravīdetānviṣaṇṇaḥ sāṃtvayangirā /
mābhaiṣṭa dhārayiṣyāmi tejasā svena vaḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीदेतान्विषण्णः सांत्वयन्गिरा /
माभैष्ट धारयिष्यामि तेजसा स्वेन वः सुराः //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the dejected [sage], consoling them with his words, said: / “Do not fear, O asuras! I will sustain you with my own splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣṭiroṣadhayaścaiva rasā vastu ca yatparam /
kṛtsnāni hyapi tiṣṭhantu pāpasteṣāṃ sureṣu vai //
meaning:
वृष्टिरोषधयश्चैव रसा वस्तु च यत्परम् /
कृत्स्नानि ह्यपि तिष्ठन्तु पापस्तेषां सुरेषु वै //
text_mt: Let rain, herbs, essences, and whatever supreme substance there is / all remain, and let their sin fall upon the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmadarthaṃ pradāsyāmi tatsarva dhāryate mayā /
tato devāsurāndṛṣṭvā dhṛtānkāvyena dhīmatā //
meaning:
युष्मदर्थं प्रदास्यामि तत्सर्व धार्यते मया /
ततो देवासुरान्दृष्ट्वा धृतान्काव्येन धीमता //
text_mt: I will give all that to you; it is all sustained by me.” / Then the gods, seeing the asuras sustained by the wise Śukra,

sanskrit_iast:
amantrayaṃstadā te vai saṃvighnā vijigīṣayā /
eṣa kāvya idaṃ sarvaṃ vyāvarttayati no balāt //
meaning:
अमन्त्रयंस्तदा ते वै संविघ्ना विजिगीषया /
एष काव्य इदं सर्वं व्यावर्त्तयति नो बलात् //
text_mt: conferred then, agitated by the desire to conquer: / “This Śukra is forcibly reversing all this for us.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhu gacchāmahe tūrṇaṃ yāvannāpyāyayettu tān /
prasahya hatvā śiṣṭāṃstu pātālaṃ prāpayāmahe //
meaning:
साधु गच्छामहे तूर्णं यावन्नाप्याययेत्तु तान् /
प्रसह्य हत्वा शिष्टांस्तु पातालं प्रापयामहे //
text_mt: Come, let us go quickly before he revitalizes them! / Overpowering and slaying them, we shall drive the survivors to Pātāla!”

sanskrit_iast:
tato devāstu saṃrabdhā dānavānabhisṛtya vai /
jaghnustairvadhyamānāste kāvyamevābhidudruvuḥ //
meaning:
ततो देवास्तु संरब्धा दानवानभिसृत्य वै /
जघ्नुस्तैर्वध्यमानास्ते काव्यमेवाभिदुद्रुवुः //
text_mt: Then the enraged gods charged the Dānavas / and struck them; being slaughtered by them, they fled straight to Śukra.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāvyastu tāndṛṣṭvā tūrṇaṃ devairabhidrutān /
samārakṣata saṃtrastāndevebhyastānditeḥ sutān //
meaning:
ततः काव्यस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा तूर्णं देवैरभिद्रुतान् /
समारक्षत संत्रस्तान्देवेभ्यस्तान्दितेः सुतान् //
text_mt: Then Śukra, seeing them quickly pursued by the gods, / protected those terrified sons of Diti from the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyo dṛṣṭvā sthitāndevāṃstatra daivamacintayat /
tānuvāca tato dhyātvā pūrvavṛttamanusmaran //
meaning:
काव्यो दृष्ट्वा स्थितान्देवांस्तत्र दैवमचिन्तयत् /
तानुवाच ततो ध्यात्वा पूर्ववृत्तमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Seeing the gods standing firm there, Kāvya reflected on fate; / having meditated, recalling past events, he then said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaṃ vijitaṃ sarvaṃ vāmanena tribhiḥkramaiḥ /
balirbaddho hato jaṃbho nihataśca virocanaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यं विजितं सर्वं वामनेन त्रिभिःक्रमैः /
बलिर्बद्धो हतो जंभो निहतश्च विरोचनः //
text_mt: "The entire three worlds were conquered by Vāmana in three strides; / Bali was bound, Jambha was killed, and Virocana was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsurā dvādaśasu saṃgrāmeṣu surairhatāḥ /
taistairupāyairbhūyiṣṭhā nihatā ye pradhānataḥ //
meaning:
महासुरा द्वादशसु संग्रामेषु सुरैर्हताः /
तैस्तैरुपायैर्भूयिष्ठा निहता ये प्रधानतः //
text_mt: The great asuras were killed by the gods in twelve battles; / by various expedients, most of those who were foremost have been destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
kiñcicchiṣṭāstu vai yūyaṃ yuddhe svalpe tu vai svayam /
nītiṃ vo hi vidhāsyāmi kālaḥ kaścitpratīkṣyatām //
meaning:
किञ्चिच्छिष्टास्तु वै यूयं युद्धे स्वल्पे तु वै स्वयम् /
नीतिं वो हि विधास्यामि कालः कश्चित्प्रतीक्ष्यताम् //
text_mt: Only a few of you remain, [yet you would engage] even in a petty fight on your own; / I shall devise a strategy for you, so let some time be awaited.

sanskrit_iast:
yāsyāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ mantrārthe vijayāya ca /
agnimāpyāyayeddhotā metraireṣa dahiṣyati //
meaning:
यास्याम्यहं महादेवं मन्त्रार्थे विजयाय च /
अग्निमाप्याययेद्धोता मेत्रैरेष दहिष्यति //
text_mt: I shall go to Mahādeva for the sake of mantras and for victory; / just as the hotṛ-priest invigorates the fire, so this [deity] will burn [them] with mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yāsyāmyahaṃ devaṃ mantrārthe nīlalohitam /
yuṣmānanugrahīṣyāmi punaḥ paścādihāgataḥ //
meaning:
ततो यास्याम्यहं देवं मन्त्रार्थे नीललोहितम् /
युष्माननुग्रहीष्यामि पुनः पश्चादिहागतः //
text_mt: Therefore I shall go to god Nīlalohita for the sake of mantras; / having returned here afterwards, I will bestow favor upon you.

sanskrit_iast:
yūyaṃ tapaścaradhvaṃ vai saṃvṛtā valkalairvane /
na vai devā vādhiṣyanti yāvadāgamanaṃ mama //
meaning:
यूयं तपश्चरध्वं वै संवृता वल्कलैर्वने /
न वै देवा वाधिष्यन्ति यावदागमनं मम //
text_mt: Practice austerities in the forest, clothed in bark garments; / the gods will certainly not strike you down until my return.

sanskrit_iast:
apratīpāṃstato mantrāndevātprāpya maheśvarāt /
yotsyāmahe punardevāṃstataḥ prāpsyatha vai jayam //
meaning:
अप्रतीपांस्ततो मन्त्रान्देवात्प्राप्य महेश्वरात् /
योत्स्यामहे पुनर्देवांस्ततः प्राप्स्यथ वै जयम् //
text_mt: Having obtained irresistible mantras from the god Maheśvara, / we shall fight the gods again; then you will indeed obtain victory."

sanskrit_iast:
tataste kṛtasaṃvādā devānūcustato 'surāḥ /
nyastaśastrā vayaṃ sarve lokānyūyaṃ kramantu vai //
meaning:
ततस्ते कृतसंवादा देवानूचुस्ततो ऽसुराः /
न्यस्तशस्त्रा वयं सर्वे लोकान्यूयं क्रमन्तु वै //
text_mt: Then, having held council, those asuras said to the gods: / "We have all laid down our weapons; you may stride over the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vayaṃ tapaścariṣyāmaḥ saṃvṛttā valkalairvane /
prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā satyānuvyātdṛtaṃ tu tat //
meaning:
वयं तपश्चरिष्यामः संवृत्ता वल्कलैर्वने /
प्रह्लादस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सत्यानुव्यात्दृतं तु तत् //
text_mt: We shall practice austerities in the forest, clothed in bark garments." / Having heard the speech of Prahlāda, which was affirmed as true,

sanskrit_iast:
tato devā nyavarttanta vijvarā muditāśca ha /
nyastaśastreṣu daityeṣu svānvai jagmuryathāgatān //
meaning:
ततो देवा न्यवर्त्तन्त विज्वरा मुदिताश्च ह /
न्यस्तशस्त्रेषु दैत्येषु स्वान्वै जग्मुर्यथागतान् //
text_mt: the gods then turned back, freed of distress and delighted; / when the daityas had laid down their weapons, they went to their respective places as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastānabravītkāvyaḥ kañcitkālaṃ pratīkṣyatām /
nirutsukāstapoyuktāḥ kālaḥ kāryārthasādhakaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तानब्रवीत्काव्यः कञ्चित्कालं प्रतीक्ष्यताम् /
निरुत्सुकास्तपोयुक्ताः कालः कार्यार्थसाधकः //
text_mt: Then Kāvya said to them: "Let some time be awaited / without impatience, engaged in austerities; time brings about the fulfillment of undertakings.

sanskrit_iast:
piturmamāśramasthā vai saṃpratīkṣata dānavāḥ /
sa saṃdiśyasurānkāvyo mahodevaṃ prapadya ca //
meaning:
पितुर्ममाश्रमस्था वै संप्रतीक्षत दानवाः /
स संदिश्यसुरान्काव्यो महोदेवं प्रपद्य च //
text_mt: O dānavas, wait patiently, staying in the hermitage of my father." / Having thus instructed the asuras, Kāvya approached Mahādeva,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamyaivamuvācāyaṃ jagatprabhavamīśvaram /
mantrānicchāmi he deva ye na saṃti bṛhaspatau //
meaning:
प्रणम्यैवमुवाचायं जगत्प्रभवमीश्वरम् /
मन्त्रानिच्छामि हे देव ये न संति बृहस्पतौ //
text_mt: and bowing down, he spoke thus to the Lord, the source of the universe: / "O god, I desire mantras that do not exist with Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
parābhavāya devānāmasureṣvabhayāvahān /
evamukto 'bravīddevo mantrānicchasi vai dvija //
meaning:
पराभवाय देवानामसुरेष्वभयावहान् /
एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीद्देवो मन्त्रानिच्छसि वै द्विज //
text_mt: for the defeat of the gods and to bring fearlessness to the asuras." / Being addressed thus, the god said: "You desire mantras, O twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ cara mayoddiṣṭaṃ brahmacārī samāhitaḥ /
pūrmaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai kuṇḍadhūmamavākśirāḥ //
meaning:
व्रतं चर मयोद्दिष्टं ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः /
पूर्मं वर्षसहस्रं वै कुण्डधूममवाक्शिराः //
text_mt: Observe an observance prescribed by me, celibate and concentrated, / for a full thousand years, head downward, [inhaling] smoke from a pit.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi pāsyati bhadraṃ te matto mantramavāpsyasi /
tathokto devadevena sa śukrastu mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
यदि पास्यति भद्रं ते मत्तो मन्त्रमवाप्स्यसि /
तथोक्तो देवदेवेन स शुक्रस्तु महातपाः //
text_mt: If you drink it, may good fortune be yours: you shall obtain the mantra from me." / Being addressed thus by the God of gods, that Śukra of great austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
pādau saṃspṛśya devasya bāḍhamityabhāṣata /
vrataṃ carāmyahaṃ deva yathoddiṣṭo 'smi vaiprabho //
meaning:
पादौ संस्पृश्य देवस्य बाढमित्यभाषत /
व्रतं चराम्यहं देव यथोद्दिष्टो ऽस्मि वैप्रभो //
text_mt: touching the feet of the god, said: "So be it! / I shall observe the vow, O god, as I have been instructed, O Lord!"

sanskrit_iast:
tato niyukto devena kuṇḍadhāro 'sya dhūmakṛt /
asurāṇāṃ hitārthāya tasmiñchukre gate tadā //
meaning:
ततो नियुक्तो देवेन कुण्डधारो ऽस्य धूमकृत् /
असुराणां हितार्थाय तस्मिञ्छुक्रे गते तदा //
text_mt: Then an attendant was appointed by the god as his smoke-maker in the pit. / When Śukra had thus gone for the welfare of the asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārthaṃ tatra vasati brahma caryaṃ maheśvare /
tadbuddhvā nītipūrvaṃ tu rāṣṭraṃ nyastaṃ tadāsuraiḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रार्थं तत्र वसति ब्रह्म चर्यं महेश्वरे /
तद्बुद्ध्वा नीतिपूर्वं तु राष्ट्रं न्यस्तं तदासुरैः //
text_mt: and resided there practicing celibacy near Maheśvara for the sake of mantras, / the gods, realizing that the kingdom had then been laid aside by the asuras out of policy,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmiñchidre tadāmarṣāddevāstānsamabhidravan /
pragṛhītāyudhāḥ sarve bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिञ्छिद्रे तदामर्षाद्देवास्तान्समभिद्रवन् /
प्रगृहीतायुधाः सर्वे बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: rushed against them at that vulnerability out of anger, / all holding up their weapons, led by Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvāsuragaṇā devānpragṛhītāyudhānpunaḥ /
utpetuḥ sahasā sarve saṃtrastāste tato 'bhavan //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वासुरगणा देवान्प्रगृहीतायुधान्पुनः /
उत्पेतुः सहसा सर्वे संत्रस्तास्ते ततो ऽभवन् //
text_mt: Seeing the gods again holding up their weapons, the hosts of asuras / all jumped up suddenly, and they were filled with terror.

sanskrit_iast:
nyaste śastre 'bhaye datte hyācārye vratamāsthite /
saṃtyajya samayaṃ devāste sapatnajighāṃsavaḥ //
meaning:
न्यस्ते शस्त्रे ऽभये दत्ते ह्याचार्ये व्रतमास्थिते /
संत्यज्य समयं देवास्ते सपत्नजिघांसवः //
text_mt: [The asuras said:] "Our weapons having been laid down, fearlessness granted, and the teacher having undertaken an observance, / the gods, breaking their agreement, desire to slay their rivals.

sanskrit_iast:
anācāryāstu bhadraṃ vo viśvastāstapase sthitāḥ /
cīravalkājinadharā niṣkriyā niṣparigrahāḥ //
meaning:
अनाचार्यास्तु भद्रं वो विश्वस्तास्तपसे स्थिताः /
चीरवल्काजिनधरा निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहाः //
text_mt: Bereft of our teacher—good fortune to you!—we are trusting and devoted to austerity, / wearing rags, bark, and skins, inactive and without possessions.

sanskrit_iast:
raṇe vijetuṃ devānvai na śakṣyāmaḥ kathañcana /
ayuddhena prapadyāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ kāvyamātaram //
meaning:
रणे विजेतुं देवान्वै न शक्ष्यामः कथञ्चन /
अयुद्धेन प्रपद्यामः शरणं काव्यमातरम् //
text_mt: We shall by no means be able to conquer the gods in battle; / without fighting, let us take refuge with the mother of Kāvya."

sanskrit_iast:
prāpadyanta tato bhītāstayā caiva tadābhayam /
dattaṃ teṣāṃ tu bhītānāṃ daityānāmabhayārthinām //
meaning:
प्रापद्यन्त ततो भीतास्तया चैव तदाभयम् /
दत्तं तेषां तु भीतानां दैत्यानामभयार्थिनाम् //
text_mt: Terrified, they then took refuge, and fearlessness was indeed granted / by her to those terrified daityas who sought freedom from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā cābhyupapannāṃstāndṛṣṭvā devāstadāsurān /
abhijaghnuḥ prasahyaitānvicārya ca balābalam //
meaning:
तया चाभ्युपपन्नांस्तान्दृष्ट्वा देवास्तदासुरान् /
अभिजघ्नुः प्रसह्यैतान्विचार्य च बलाबलम् //
text_mt: Seeing the asuras protected by her, the gods then / forcibly attacked them, having weighed their relative strength and weakness.

sanskrit_iast:
tata stānvadhyamānāṃstu devairdṛṣṭvāsurāṃstadā /
devī kruddhābravīdenānanindratvaṃ karomyaham //
meaning:
तत स्तान्वध्यमानांस्तु देवैर्दृष्ट्वासुरांस्तदा /
देवी क्रुद्धाब्रवीदेनाननिन्द्रत्वं करोम्यहम् //
text_mt: Then, seeing those asuras being slain by the gods, / the angry goddess said to them: "I shall make [the world] without Indra!"

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstabhya śīghraṃ saṃraṃbhādindraṃ sābhyacarattataḥ /
tataḥ saṃstaṃbhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ devāstu mūḍhavat //
meaning:
संस्तभ्य शीघ्रं संरंभादिन्द्रं साभ्यचरत्ततः /
ततः संस्तंभितं दृष्ट्वा शक्रं देवास्तु मूढवत् //
text_mt: Quickly immobilizing Indra in her fury, she advanced against him; / then, seeing Śakra immobilized, the gods, as if bewildered,

sanskrit_iast:
vyadravanta tato bhītā dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ vaśīkṛtam /
gateṣu surasaṃgheṣu viṣmurindramabhāṣata //
meaning:
व्यद्रवन्त ततो भीता दृष्ट्वा शक्रं वशीकृतम् /
गतेषु सुरसंघेषु विष्मुरिन्द्रमभाषत //
text_mt: fled in terror, seeing Śakra brought under control. / When the hosts of gods had fled, Viṣṇu spoke to Indra:

sanskrit_iast:
māṃ tvaṃ praviśa bhadraṃ te neṣyāmi tvāṃ sureśvara /
evamuktastato viṣṇuḥ praviveśa purandaraḥ //
meaning:
मां त्वं प्रविश भद्रं ते नेष्यामि त्वां सुरेश्वर /
एवमुक्तस्ततो विष्णुः प्रविवेश पुरन्दरः //
text_mt: "Enter into me—good fortune to you! I shall carry you away, O lord of the gods!" / Being spoken to thus, Purandara then entered Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣmunā rakṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī kruddhā vaco 'vadat /
eṣā tvāṃ viṣṇunā sārddha dahāmi maghavanbalāt //
meaning:
विष्मुना रक्षितं दृष्ट्वा देवी क्रुद्धा वचो ऽवदत् /
एषा त्वां विष्णुना सार्द्ध दहामि मघवन्बलात् //
text_mt: Seeing him protected by Viṣṇu, the angry goddess said these words: / "Here I will burn you by force along with Viṣṇu, O Maghavan!

sanskrit_iast:
miṣatā sarvabhūtānāṃ dṛśyatāṃ me tapobalam /
tayābhibhūtau tau devāvindrāviṣṇū jajalpatuḥ //
meaning:
मिषता सर्वभूतानां दृश्यतां मे तपोबलम् /
तयाभिभूतौ तौ देवाविन्द्राविष्णू जजल्पतुः //
text_mt: While all beings watch, let the power of my austerities be seen!" / Overcome by her, the two gods, Indra and Viṣṇu, discussed together;

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ mucyeva sahitau viṣṇurindramabhāṣata /
indro 'bravījjahi hyenāṃ yāvanno na dahe dvibho //
meaning:
कथं मुच्येव सहितौ विष्णुरिन्द्रमभाषत /
इन्द्रो ऽब्रवीज्जहि ह्येनां यावन्नो न दहे द्विभो //
text_mt: "How may the two of us together be freed?" Viṣṇu said to Indra. / Indra said: "Slay her, O Lord, before she burns the two of us!

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣeṇābhibhūto 'hamimāṃ tajjahi māciram /
tataḥ samīkṣya tāṃ viṣṇuḥ strīvadhaṃ karttumāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
विशेषेणाभिभूतो ऽहमिमां तज्जहि माचिरम् /
ततः समीक्ष्य तां विष्णुः स्त्रीवधं कर्त्तुमास्थितः //
text_mt: I am especially overwhelmed; therefore slay her without delay!" / Then, looking upon her, Viṣṇu resolved to commit the slaying of a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
abhidhyāya tataśśakramāpannaṃ satvaraṃ prabhuḥ /
tasyāḥ saṃtvaramāṇāyāḥ śīghraṅkārī murārihā //
meaning:
अभिध्याय ततश्शक्रमापन्नं सत्वरं प्रभुः /
तस्याः संत्वरमाणायाः शीघ्रङ्कारी मुरारिहा //
text_mt: Then, considering Śakra who was in distress, the Lord acted swiftly; / as she was acting in haste, the swift-acting Slayer of Muru,

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā viṣṇustato devaḥ krūraṃ buddhvā cikīrṣitam /
kruddhastadastramāvidhya śiraściccheda mādhavaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिधा विष्णुस्ततो देवः क्रूरं बुद्ध्वा चिकीर्षितम् /
क्रुद्धस्तदस्त्रमाविध्य शिरश्चिच्छेद माधवः //
text_mt: the god Viṣṇu, having realized the cruel deed she wished to do, / became enraged; brandishing that weapon, Mādhava cut off her head.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā strīvadhaṃ ghoraṃ cukopa bhṛgurīśvaraḥ /
tato 'bhiśapto bhṛguṇā viṣṇurbhāryāvadhe tadā //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा स्त्रीवधं घोरं चुकोप भृगुरीश्वरः /
ततो ऽभिशप्तो भृगुणा विष्णुर्भार्यावधे तदा //
text_mt: Seeing that terrible slaying of a woman, the lord Bhṛgu was enraged; / then Viṣṇu was cursed by Bhṛgu at that time for the slaying of his wife:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātte jānatā dharmamavadhyā strī niṣūditā /
tasmāttvaṃ saptakṛtvo vai manuṣyeṣu prapadyase //
meaning:
यस्मात्ते जानता धर्ममवध्या स्त्री निषूदिता /
तस्मात्त्वं सप्तकृत्वो वै मनुष्येषु प्रपद्यसे //
text_mt: "Because you, knowing the dharma, have killed a woman who ought not to be slain, / therefore you shall be born seven times among men!"

sanskrit_iast:
tatastenābhiśāpena naṣṭe dharme punaḥ punaḥ /
sarvaloka hitārthāya jāyate mānuṣeṣviha //
meaning:
ततस्तेनाभिशापेन नष्टे धर्मे पुनः पुनः /
सर्वलोक हितार्थाय जायते मानुषेष्विह //
text_mt: From that curse of his, whenever dharma is lost again and again, / he is born here among men for the welfare of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
anuvyāhṛtya viṣmuṃ sa tadādāya śiraḥ svayam /
samānīya tataḥ kāye samāyojyedamabravīt //
meaning:
अनुव्याहृत्य विष्मुं स तदादाय शिरः स्वयम् /
समानीय ततः काये समायोज्येदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Having cursed Viṣṇu, he then took the head himself, / and bringing it to the body and joining it, he spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃ tvāṃ viṣṇunā satyaṃ hatāṃ saṃjīvayāmyaham /
yadi kṛtsno mayā dharmaścarito jñāyate 'pi vā //
meaning:
एतां त्वां विष्णुना सत्यं हतां संजीवयाम्यहम् /
यदि कृत्स्नो मया धर्मश्चरितो ज्ञायते ऽपि वा //
text_mt: "This you, who were truly slain by Viṣṇu, I shall bring back to life! / If the entire dharma has been practiced or even known by me,

sanskrit_iast:
tena satyena jīvasva yadi satyaṃ bravīmyaham /
satyābhivyahṛtāttasya devī saṃjīvitā tadā //
meaning:
तेन सत्येन जीवस्व यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् /
सत्याभिव्यहृतात्तस्य देवी संजीविता तदा //
text_mt: by that truth, live, if I speak the truth!" / By his utterance of truth, the lady was then brought back to life.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tāṃ prokṣya śītābhiradbhirjīveti so 'bravīt /
tatastāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭvā suptotthitāmiva //
meaning:
तदा तां प्रोक्ष्य शीताभिरद्भिर्जीवेति सो ऽब्रवीत् /
ततस्तां सर्वभूतानां दृष्ट्वा सुप्तोत्थितामिव //
text_mt: Then, sprinkling her with cool water, he said: "Live!" / Then, seeing her as if she had awakened from sleep,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhusādhvityadṛśyānāṃ vācastāḥ sasvanurdiśaḥ /
dṛṣṭvā saṃjīvitāmevaṃ devīṃ tāṃ bhṛguṇā tadā //
meaning:
साधुसाध्वित्यदृश्यानां वाचस्ताः सस्वनुर्दिशः /
दृष्ट्वा संजीवितामेवं देवीं तां भृगुणा तदा //
text_mt: voices of the invisible [beings] resounded in the quarters, saying: "Bravo! Bravo!" / Seeing that lady thus brought back to life by Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
miṣatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat /
asaṃbhrāntena bhṛguṇā patnī saṃjīvitāṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
मिषतां सर्वभूतानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् /
असंभ्रान्तेन भृगुणा पत्नी संजीवितां ततः //
text_mt: it seemed like a marvel to all living beings looking on. / Then, seeing his wife brought back to life by the unflinching Bhṛgu,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā śakro na lebhe 'tha śarma kāvyabhayāttataḥ /
prajāgare tataścendro jayantīmātmanaḥ sutām //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा शक्रो न लेभे ऽथ शर्म काव्यभयात्ततः /
प्रजागरे ततश्चेन्द्रो जयन्तीमात्मनः सुताम् //
text_mt: Śakra found no peace of mind out of fear of Kāvya; / then, in his sleepless vigilance, Indra [called] his daughter Jayantī.

sanskrit_iast:
provāca matimānvākyaṃ svāṃ kanyāṃ pākaśāsanaḥ /
eṣa kāvyo hyanindrāya carate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ //
meaning:
प्रोवाच मतिमान्वाक्यं स्वां कन्यां पाकशासनः /
एष काव्यो ह्यनिन्द्राय चरते दारुणं तपः //
text_mt:
The wise destroyer of Pāka spoke these words to his daughter:
'This Kāvya is practicing harsh austerities to dethrone Indra.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāhaṃ vyākulaḥ putri kṛto dhṛtimanā dṛḍham /
gaccha saṃbhāvayasvainaṃ śramāpanayanaiḥ śubhe //
meaning:
तेनाहं व्याकुलः पुत्रि कृतो धृतिमना दृढम् /
गच्छ संभावयस्वैनं श्रमापनयनैः शुभे //
text_mt:
Because of him, O daughter, I have been made intensely anxious, [even though] resolute of mind.
Go, auspicious one, and attend upon him by relieving his fatigue,

sanskrit_iast:
taistairmano 'nukūlaiśca hyupacārairatadritā /
devī sārīndraduhitā jayantī śubhacāriṇī //
meaning:
तैस्तैर्मनो ऽनुकूलैश्च ह्युपचारैरतद्रिता /
देवी सारीन्द्रदुहिता जयन्ती शुभचारिणी //
text_mt:
and by various pleasing services, unweariedly.'
That goddess, the daughter of Indra, the well-behaved Jayantī,

sanskrit_iast:
susvarūpadharāgāttaṃ durvahaṃ vratamāsthitam /
pitrā yathoktaṃ vākyaṃ sā kāvye kṛtavatī tadā //
meaning:
सुस्वरूपधरागात्तं दुर्वहं व्रतमास्थितम् /
पित्रा यथोक्तं वाक्यं सा काव्ये कृतवती तदा //
text_mt:
bearing a lovely form, went to him as he undertook that unendurable vow.
Then she did toward Kāvya exactly as she had been told by her father,

sanskrit_iast:
gīrbhiścaivānukūlābhiḥ stuvantī valgubhāṣiṇī /
gātrasaṃvāhanaiḥ kāle sevamānā tvacāsukhaiḥ //
meaning:
गीर्भिश्चैवानुकूलाभिः स्तुवन्ती वल्गुभाषिणी /
गात्रसंवाहनैः काले सेवमाना त्वचासुखैः //
text_mt:
praising him with soothing words, sweetly spoken,
serving him in due season with massages of his limbs pleasant to the skin.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣantyanukūlā ca uvāsa bahulāḥ samāḥ /
pūrṇaṃ dhūmavrate cāpi ghore varṣasahasrake //
meaning:
शुश्रूषन्त्यनुकूला च उवास बहुलाः समाः /
पूर्णं धूमव्रते चापि घोरे वर्षसहस्रके //
text_mt:
Attending upon him and acting agreeably, she dwelt [there] for many years.
And when a thousand terrible years of the smoke-vow had been completed,

sanskrit_iast:
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa kāvyaṃ prīto 'bhavastadā /
evaṃ vrataṃ tvayaikena cīrṇaṃ nānyena kena cit //
meaning:
वरेण च्छन्दयामास काव्यं प्रीतो ऽभवस्तदा /
एवं व्रतं त्वयैकेन चीर्णं नान्येन केन चित् //
text_mt:
Bhava, being pleased, offered Kāvya a boon then:
'Such a vow has been performed by you alone, and by no one else.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvaṃ tapasā buddhyā śrutena ca balena ca /
tejasā vāpi vibudhānsarvānabhibhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वं तपसा बुद्ध्या श्रुतेन च बलेन च /
तेजसा वापि विबुधान्सर्वानभिभविष्यसि //
text_mt:
Therefore, by your ascetic heat, wisdom, Vedic learning, strength,
and splendor, you shall overcome all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
yacca kiñcinmamabrahma vidyate bhṛgunandana /
sāṃga ca sarahasyaṃ ca yajñopaniṣadastathā //
meaning:
यच्च किञ्चिन्ममब्रह्म विद्यते भृगुनन्दन /
सांग च सरहस्यं च यज्ञोपनिषदस्तथा //
text_mt:
Whatever sacred lore of mine exists, O son of Bhṛgu,
with its limbs and with its secrets, and likewise the secret teachings of sacrifice—

sanskrit_iast:
pratibhāti te sarvaṃ tadvācyaṃ tu na kasyacit /
sarvābhibhāvī tena tvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭho bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
प्रतिभाति ते सर्वं तद्वाच्यं तु न कस्यचित् /
सर्वाभिभावी तेन त्वं द्विजश्रेष्ठो भविष्यसि //
text_mt:
all of that will be revealed to you; yet it must not be told to anyone.
Thereby you shall become the best of Brahmins, prevailing over all.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ tasyai bhārgavāya bhavaḥ punaḥ /
prajeśatvaṃ dhaneśatvamavadhyatvaṃ ca vai dadau //
meaning:
एवं दत्त्वा वरं तस्यै भार्गवाय भवः पुनः /
प्रजेशत्वं धनेशत्वमवध्यत्वं च वै ददौ //
text_mt:
Having thus granted a boon to that descendant of Bhṛgu, Bhava further
gave him lordship over subjects, lordship over wealth, and invulnerability to being slain.

sanskrit_iast:
etāṃllabdhvā varānkāvyaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ /
harṣātprādurbabhau tasya divyaṃ stotraṃ maheśituḥ //
meaning:
एतांल्लब्ध्वा वरान्काव्यः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः /
हर्षात्प्रादुर्बभौ तस्य दिव्यं स्तोत्रं महेशितुः //
text_mt:
Having obtained these boons, Kāvya, his bodily hair bristling with delight,
in his joy gave utterance to a divine hymn of praise to the Great Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tiryaksthitastvevaṃ tuṣṭuve nīlalohitam /
namo 'stu śitikaṇṭhāya surādyāya suvarcase //
meaning:
तदा तिर्यक्स्थितस्त्वेवं तुष्टुवे नीललोहितम् /
नमो ऽस्तु शितिकण्ठाय सुराद्याय सुवर्चसे //
text_mt:
Then, standing crosswise, he praised Nīlalohita thus:
'Homage be to the blue-throated one, the primeval of the gods, the brilliantly radiant,

sanskrit_iast:
lelihānāya lehyāya vatsarāya jagatpate /
kapardine hyūrddhvaromṇe haryakṣavaradāya ca //
meaning:
लेलिहानाय लेह्याय वत्सराय जगत्पते /
कपर्दिने ह्यूर्द्ध्वरोम्णे हर्यक्षवरदाय च //
text_mt:
to the licking one, to the one to be licked, to the year, O Lord of the world!
To the one with matted hair, to the one with hair standing erect, to the grantor of boons to the lion,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃstutāya sutīrthāya devadevāya raṃhase /
uṣṇīṣiṇe suvaktrāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe //
meaning:
संस्तुताय सुतीर्थाय देवदेवाय रंहसे /
उष्णीषिणे सुवक्त्राय सहस्राक्षाय मीढुषे //
text_mt:
to the celebrated one, to the good sacred ford, to the God of gods, to the swift-moving one,
to the turbaned one, to the fair-faced one, to the thousand-eyed one, to the bountiful,

sanskrit_iast:
vasuretāya rudrāya tapase cīravāsase /
nisvāya muktakeśāya senānye rohitāya ca //
meaning:
वसुरेताय रुद्राय तपसे चीरवाससे /
निस्वाय मुक्तकेशाय सेनान्ये रोहिताय च //
text_mt:
to the one whose seed is wealth, to Rudra, to asceticism, to the rag-clad one,
to the destitute one, to the loose-haired one, to the general, to the red one,

sanskrit_iast:
kavaye rājavṛddhāya takṣakakrīḍanāya ca /
giriśāyārkanetrāya yataye cājyapāya ca //
meaning:
कवये राजवृद्धाय तक्षकक्रीडनाय च /
गिरिशायार्कनेत्राय यतये चाज्यपाय च //
text_mt:
to the poet, to the elder of kings, to the one whose plaything is Takṣaka,
to the mountain-dweller, to the sun-eyed one, to the ascetic, to the drinker of clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
suvṛttāya suhastāya dhanvine bhārgavāya ca /
sahasrabāhave caiva sahasrāmalacakṣuṣe //
meaning:
सुवृत्ताय सुहस्ताय धन्विने भार्गवाय च /
सहस्रबाहवे चैव सहस्रामलचक्षुषे //
text_mt:
to the well-behaved, to the fair-handed, to the archer, to Bhārgava,
to the thousand-armed one, to the one with a thousand pure eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakukṣaye caiva sahasracaraṇāya ca /
sahasraśirase caiva bahurūpāya vedhase //
meaning:
सहस्रकुक्षये चैव सहस्रचरणाय च /
सहस्रशिरसे चैव बहुरूपाय वेधसे //
text_mt:
to the one with a thousand bellies, to the one with a thousand feet,
to the one with a thousand heads, to the multiform creator,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavāya viśvarūpāya śvetāya puruṣāya ca /
niṣaṅgiṇe kavacine sūkṣmāya kṣapaṇāya ca //
meaning:
भवाय विश्वरूपाय श्वेताय पुरुषाय च /
निषङ्गिणे कवचिने सूक्ष्माय क्षपणाय च //
text_mt:
to Bhava, to the omniform one, to the white one, to the Puruṣa,
to the quiver-bearer, to the mail-clad one, to the subtle one, to the destroyer,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrāya caiva bhīmāya ugrāya ca śivāya ca /
mahādevāya sarvāya viśvarūpaśivāya ca //
meaning:
ताम्राय चैव भीमाय उग्राय च शिवाय च /
महादेवाय सर्वाय विश्वरूपशिवाय च //
text_mt:
to the copper-colored one, to the frightful one, to the fierce one, and to Śiva,
to Mahādeva, to Sarva, to Śiva who has all forms,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyāya vasiṣṭhāya varṣāya madhyamāya ca /
dhāmne caiva piśaṅgāya piṅgalāyāruṇāya ca //
meaning:
हिरण्याय वसिष्ठाय वर्षाय मध्यमाय च /
धाम्ने चैव पिशङ्गाय पिङ्गलायारुणाय च //
text_mt:
to the golden one, to the most excellent one, to the year, to the middle one,
to the abode, to the reddish-brown one, to the tawny one, to the reddish-dawn one,

sanskrit_iast:
pinākine ceṣumate citrāya rohitāya ca /
dundubhyāyaikapādāya arhāya buddhaye tathā /
mṛgavyādhāya sarvāya sthāṇave bhīṣaṇāya ca //
meaning:
पिनाकिने चेषुमते चित्राय रोहिताय च /
दुन्दुभ्यायैकपादाय अर्हाय बुद्धये तथा /
मृगव्याधाय सर्वाय स्थाणवे भीषणाय च //
text_mt:
to the one bearing the Pināka, to the arrow-bearing one, to the manifold, to the red one,
to the one belonging to the drum, to the one-footed, to the worthy one, to intellect,
to the hunter of deer, to all, to the motionless pillar, to the terrible one,

sanskrit_iast:
bahurūpāya cogrāya trinetrāyeśvarāya ca /
kapiloyaikavīrāya mṛtyave tryaṃbakāya ca //
meaning:
बहुरूपाय चोग्राय त्रिनेत्रायेश्वराय च /
कपिलोयैकवीराय मृत्यवे त्र्यंबकाय च //
text_mt:
to the multiform one, to the fierce one, to the three-eyed Lord,
to Kapila, to the sole hero, to death, to Tryambaka,

sanskrit_iast:
vāstoṣpate pinākāya śaṅkarāya śivāya ca /
āraṇyāya gṛhasthāya yatine bahmacāriṇe //
meaning:
वास्तोष्पते पिनाकाय शङ्कराय शिवाय च /
आरण्याय गृहस्थाय यतिने बह्मचारिणे //
text_mt:
to the Lord of the dwelling, to the Pināka-bearer, to Śaṅkara, to Śiva,
to the forest-dweller, to the householder, to the ascetic, to the celibate student,

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhyāya caiva yogāya dhyānine dīkṣitāya ca /
antarhitāya sarvāya tapyāya vyāpine tathā //
meaning:
सांख्याय चैव योगाय ध्यानिने दीक्षिताय च /
अन्तर्हिताय सर्वाय तप्याय व्यापिने तथा //
text_mt:
to Sāṃkhya, to Yoga, to the meditator, to the consecrated one,
to the concealed one, to Sarva, to the one to be heated, and to the all-pervading,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhāya caiva śuddhāya muktāya kevalāya ca /
rodhase caikitānāya brahmiṣṭhāya mahārṣaye //
meaning:
बुद्धाय चैव शुद्धाय मुक्ताय केवलाय च /
रोधसे चैकितानाय ब्रह्मिष्ठाय महार्षये //
text_mt:
to the awakened one, to the pure one, to the liberated one, to the isolated one,
to the obstructive one, to the attentive one, to the foremost of knowers of Brahman, to the great ṛṣi,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpādāya medhyāya varmiṇe śīghragāya ca /
śikhaṇḍine kapālāya daṇḍine viśvamedhase //
meaning:
चतुष्पादाय मेध्याय वर्मिणे शीघ्रगाय च /
शिखण्डिने कपालाय दण्डिने विश्वमेधसे //
text_mt:
to the four-footed one, to the pure sacrificial one, to the armored one, to the swift-going one,
to the crested one, to the skull-bearing one, to the staff-bearer, to the all-wise,

sanskrit_iast:
apratītāya dīptāya bhāskarāya sumedhase /
krūrāya vikṛtāyaiva bībhatsāya śivāya ca //
meaning:
अप्रतीताय दीप्ताय भास्कराय सुमेधसे /
क्रूराय विकृतायैव बीभत्साय शिवाय च //
text_mt:
to the unquestioned one, to the blazing one, to the illuminator, to the highly intelligent one,
to the cruel one, to the deformed one, to the loathsome one, to Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śucaye paridhānāya sadyojātāya mṛtyave /
piśitāśāya śarvāya meghāya vaidyutāya ca //
meaning:
शुचये परिधानाय सद्योजाताय मृत्यवे /
पिशिताशाय शर्वाय मेघाय वैद्युताय च //
text_mt:
to the pure one, to the enclosure, to Sadyojāta, to death,
to the eater of raw flesh, to Śarva, to the cloud, to the lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣāya ca jaghanyāya lokānāmīśvarāya ca /
anāmayāya cedhmāya hiraṇyāyaikacakṣuṣe //
meaning:
दक्षाय च जघन्याय लोकानामीश्वराय च /
अनामयाय चेध्माय हिरण्यायैकचक्षुषे //
text_mt:
to the skilled one, to the lowest one, to the Lord of the worlds,
to the healthy one, to the sacrificial firewood, to the golden one, to the one-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
śreṣṭhāya vāmadevāya īśānāya ca dhīmate /
mahākalpāya dīptāya rodanāya hasāya ca //
meaning:
श्रेष्ठाय वामदेवाय ईशानाय च धीमते /
महाकल्पाय दीप्ताय रोदनाय हसाय च //
text_mt:
to the best one, to Vāmadeva, to Īśāna the wise,
to the great cosmic age, to the blazing one, to weeping, and to laughter,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍhadhanvine kavacine rathine ca varūthine /
bhṛgunāthāya śukrāya gahvariṣṭhāya dhīmate //
meaning:
दृढधन्विने कवचिने रथिने च वरूथिने /
भृगुनाथाय शुक्राय गह्वरिष्ठाय धीमते //
text_mt:
to the firm-bowed one, to the mail-clad one, to the charioteer, to the chariot-shielded one,
to the master of the Bhṛgus, to Śukra, to the dweller in the abyss, to the wise,

sanskrit_iast:
amoghāya praśāntāya sadā viprapriyāya ca /
digvāsaḥ kṛttivāsāya bhagaghnāya namo 'stu te //
meaning:
अमोघाय प्रशान्ताय सदा विप्रप्रियाय च /
दिग्वासः कृत्तिवासाय भगघ्नाय नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
to the unfailing one, to the tranquil one, to the one who is always fond of Brahmins,
to the space-clad one, to the hide-clad one, to the slayer of Bhaga—homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
paśūnāṃ pataye caiva bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ /
prabhave ṛgyajuḥsāmne svāhāyai ca sudhāya ca //
meaning:
पशूनां पतये चैव भूतानां पतये नमः /
प्रभवे ऋग्यजुःसाम्ने स्वाहायै च सुधाय च //
text_mt:
Homage to the Lord of beasts, and to the Lord of beings,
to the origin, to the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman, to Svāhā, and to the nectar of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṣaṭkāratamāyaiva tubhyaṃ mantrātmane namaḥ /
sraṣṭre dhātre tathā kartre hartre ca kṣapaṇāya ca //
meaning:
वषट्कारतमायैव तुभ्यं मन्त्रात्मने नमः /
स्रष्ट्रे धात्रे तथा कर्त्रे हर्त्रे च क्षपणाय च //
text_mt:
to the ultimate Vaṣaṭ call; homage to you whose self is mantra,
to the creator, the upholder, and the maker, the destroyer, and the annihilator!

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhaveśāya tubhyaṃ karmātmane namaḥ /
vasave caiva sādhyāya rudrādityāśvināya ca //
meaning:
भूतभव्यभवेशाय तुभ्यं कर्मात्मने नमः /
वसवे चैव साध्याय रुद्रादित्याश्विनाय च //
text_mt:
Homage to you whose self is action, the Lord of past, future, and present,
to the Vasu, to the Sādhya, to the Rudras, Ādityas, and Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāya marute caiva tubhyaṃ devātmane namaḥ /
agnīṣomavidhijñāya paśumantrau ṣadhāya ca //
meaning:
विश्वाय मरुते चैव तुभ्यं देवात्मने नमः /
अग्नीषोमविधिज्ञाय पशुमन्त्रौ षधाय च //
text_mt:
to the Viśvedevas, to the Maruts; homage to you whose self is the gods,
to the knower of the rule of Agni and Soma, to the sacrificial animal, mantra, and herbs!

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇāvabhṛthāyaiva tubhyaṃ yajñātmane namaḥ /
tapase caiva satyāya tyāgāya ca śamāya ca //
meaning:
दक्षिणावभृथायैव तुभ्यं यज्ञात्मने नमः /
तपसे चैव सत्याय त्यागाय च शमाय च //
text_mt:
To the sacrificial fee and the concluding ablution; homage to you whose self is sacrifice,
to ascetic heat, to truth, to renunciation, and to tranquility,

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsāyātha lobhāya suveṣāyāniśāya ca /
sarvabhūtātprabhūtāya tubhyaṃ yogātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसायाथ लोभाय सुवेषायानिशाय च /
सर्वभूतात्प्रभूताय तुभ्यं योगात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
to non-violence, to freedom from greed, to the beautifully attired, to the constant,
to the one born before all beings; homage to you whose self is yoga!

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyai cāntarikṣāya mahāse tridivāya ca /
janastapāya satyāya tubhyaṃ lokātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
पृथिव्यै चान्तरिक्षाय महासे त्रिदिवाय च /
जनस्तपाय सत्याय तुभ्यं लोकात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
To the earth, to the intermediate space, to the Maharloka, to heaven,
to Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka; homage to you whose self is the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktāyātha mahate bhūtāyaivendriyāya ca /
tanmātrāyātha mahate tubhyaṃ tattvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तायाथ महते भूतायैवेन्द्रियाय च /
तन्मात्रायाथ महते तुभ्यं तत्त्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
To the unmanifest, to the cosmic intellect, to the elements, and to the sense-organs,
to the subtle elements, to the great one; homage to you whose self is the principles of reality!

sanskrit_iast:
nityāya cāpyaliṅgāya sūkṣmāya cetarāya ca /
śuddhāya vibhave caiva tubhyaṃ nityātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
नित्याय चाप्यलिङ्गाय सूक्ष्माय चेतराय च /
शुद्धाय विभवे चैव तुभ्यं नित्यात्मने नमः //
text_mt:
To the eternal one, to the uncharacterized one, to the subtle one, and to the other,
to the pure one, to the omnipresent one; homage to you whose self is eternal!

sanskrit_iast:
namaste triṣu lokeṣu svaranteṣu bhuvādiṣu /
satyāntamaharādyeṣu caturṣu ca namo 'stu te //
meaning:
नमस्ते त्रिषु लोकेषु स्वरन्तेषु भुवादिषु /
सत्यान्तमहराद्येषु चतुर्षु च नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
Homage to you in the three worlds, ending in heaven, beginning with Bhūrloka;
and homage be to you in the four [higher worlds], beginning with Mahar and ending with Satya!

sanskrit_iast:
nāmastotre mayā hyasminyadasadvyāhṛtaṃ prabho /
madbhakta itibrahmaṇya sarvaṃ tatkṣantumarhasi //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte madhyamabhāge tṛtīya upoddhātapāde stavasamāptirnāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ // 72//
meaning:
नामस्तोत्रे मया ह्यस्मिन्यदसद्व्याहृतं प्रभो /
मद्भक्त इतिब्रह्मण्य सर्वं तत्क्षन्तुमर्हसि //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते मध्यमभागे तृतीय उपोद्धातपादे स्तवसमाप्तिर्नाम द्विसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः // 72//
text_mt:
Whatever improper thing has been uttered by me in this hymn of names, O Lord,
thinking "he is my devotee", O friend of Brahmins, you ought to forgive it all.'

Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, titled "Conclusion of the Hymn of Praise", in the third Upoddhātapāda of the middle section, in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Vāyu. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
evamārādhya deveśamīśānaṃ nīlalohitam /
prahvo 'tipraṇatastasmai prāñjalirvākyamabravīt //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
एवमाराध्य देवेशमीशानं नीललोहितम् /
प्रह्वो ऽतिप्रणतस्तस्मै प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
The sūta said:
Having thus worshipped the God of gods, Īśāna, Nīlalohita,
bowed low, extremely humble, he addressed him with joined palms.

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyasya gātraṃ saṃspṛśya hastena prītimānbhavaḥ /
nikāmaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhāddharaḥ //
meaning:
काव्यस्य गात्रं संस्पृश्य हस्तेन प्रीतिमान्भवः /
निकामं दर्शनं दत्त्वा तत्रैवान्तरधाद्धरः //
text_mt:
Touching the body of Kāvya with his hand, Bhava, being delighted,
granted him the vision he desired, and Hara vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ so 'tarhite tāsmindeve sānucare tadā /
tiṣṭhantīṃ prājalirbhūtvā jayantīmidamabravīt //
meaning:
ततः सो ऽतर्हिते तास्मिन्देवे सानुचरे तदा /
तिष्ठन्तीं प्राजलिर्भूत्वा जयन्तीमिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then, when that god had disappeared along with his attendants, / he, folding his hands, addressed Jayantī who was standing there:

sanskrit_iast:
kasya tvaṃ subhage kā vā duḥkhite mayi duḥkhitā /
sahatā tapasā yuktaṃ kimarthaṃ māṃ jigīṣsi //
meaning:
कस्य त्वं सुभगे का वा दुःखिते मयि दुःखिता /
सहता तपसा युक्तं किमर्थं मां जिगीष्सि //
text_mt: “Whose daughter are you, fortunate lady, or who are you, grieving when I was in grief? / Enduring [hardships] alongside me engaged in austerity, why do you seek to win me over?

sanskrit_iast:
anayā satataṃ bhaktyā praśrayeṇa damena ca /
snehena caiva suśroṇi prīto 'smi varavarṇini //
meaning:
अनया सततं भक्त्या प्रश्रयेण दमेन च /
स्नेहेन चैव सुश्रोणि प्रीतो ऽस्मि वरवर्णिनि //
text_mt: By this constant devotion, modesty, and self-restraint, / and by your affection, fair-hipped lady of excellent complexion, I am pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
kimicchasi varārohe kaste kāmaḥ samṛddhyatām /
taṃ te saṃpūrayāmyadya yadyapi syātsudurlabhaḥ //
meaning:
किमिच्छसि वरारोहे कस्ते कामः समृद्ध्यताम् /
तं ते संपूरयाम्यद्य यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभः //
text_mt: What do you desire, beautiful lady? What wish of yours may be fulfilled? / I shall grant it to you today, even if it were very hard to obtain.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamuktābravīdenaṃ tapasā jñātumarhasi /
cikīrṣitaṃ me brahmiṣṭha tvaṃ hi vettha yathātatham //
meaning:
एवमुक्ताब्रवीदेनं तपसा ज्ञातुमर्हसि /
चिकीर्षितं मे ब्रह्मिष्ठ त्वं हि वेत्थ यथातथम् //
text_mt: Addressed thus, she said to him: “You should know by your austerity / what I desire to do, O most devoted to Brahman; for you know things as they truly are.”

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto 'bravīdenāṃ dṛṣṭvā divyena cakṣuṣā /
māhendrī tvaṃ varārohe maddhitārthamihāgatā //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो ऽब्रवीदेनां दृष्ट्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा /
माहेन्द्री त्वं वरारोहे मद्धितार्थमिहागता //
text_mt: Addressed thus, he looked with his divine eye and said to her: / “You are the daughter of Indra, beautiful lady, come here for my benefit.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā saha tvaṃ suśroṇi daśavarṣāṇi bhāmini /
adṛśyaṃ sarvabhūtaistu saṃprayogamihecchasi //
meaning:
मया सह त्वं सुश्रोणि दशवर्षाणि भामिनि /
अदृश्यं सर्वभूतैस्तु संप्रयोगमिहेच्छसि //
text_mt: Fair-hipped, passionate woman, you desire union with me here / for ten years, unseen by all living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
devīndranīlavarṇābhevarārohe sulocane /
imaṃ vṛṇīṣva kāmaṃ tvaṃ matto vai valgubhāṣiṇi //
meaning:
देवीन्द्रनीलवर्णाभेवरारोहे सुलोचने /
इमं वृणीष्व कामं त्वं मत्तो वै वल्गुभाषिणि //
text_mt: O lady with the radiance and hue of sapphire, beautiful woman with lovely eyes, / sweet-spoken one, choose this desire from me!”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhavatu gacchāvo gṛhānmattebhagāmini /
tataḥ svagṛhamāgamya jayatyā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
एवं भवतु गच्छावो गृहान्मत्तेभगामिनि /
ततः स्वगृहमागम्य जयत्या सहितः प्रभुः //
text_mt: “So be it; let us go home, O lady who walks like an elephant in rut.” / Then, having arrived at his own house together with Jayantī, the lord—

sanskrit_iast:
sa tayā cāvasaddevyā daśa varṣāṇi bhārgavaḥ /
adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ māyayā saṃvṛtastadā //
meaning:
स तया चावसद्देव्या दश वर्षाणि भार्गवः /
अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानां मायया संवृतस्तदा //
text_mt: that Bhārgava lived with that goddess for ten years, / unseen by all living beings, enveloped then by his illusory power.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtārthamāmataṃ jñātavā kāvyaṃ sarve diteḥ sutāḥ /
abhijagsurgṛhaṃ tasya muditāstaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ //
meaning:
कृतार्थमामतं ज्ञातवा काव्यं सर्वे दितेः सुताः /
अभिजग्सुर्गृहं तस्य मुदितास्तं दिदृक्षवः //
text_mt: Knowing that Kāvya had achieved his aim and was esteemed, all the sons of Diti / went to his house, delighted and wishing to see him.

sanskrit_iast:
gatā yadā na paśyanti jayatyā saṃvṛtaṃ gurum /
lakṣamaṃ tasya tad buddhvā pratijagmuryathāgatam //
meaning:
गता यदा न पश्यन्ति जयत्या संवृतं गुरुम् /
लक्षमं तस्य तद् बुद्ध्वा प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम् //
text_mt: When they arrived and did not see their preceptor covered [from sight] with Jayantī, / they understood that mark of his and returned as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatistu saṃruddhaṃ jñātvā kāvyaṃ vareṇa ha /
prītyarthe daśa varṣāṇi jayantyā hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिस्तु संरुद्धं ज्ञात्वा काव्यं वरेण ह /
प्रीत्यर्थे दश वर्षाणि जयन्त्या हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati, however, knowing that Kāvya was detained through a boon, / desiring to please Jayantī for ten years out of a wish for her welfare,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhvā tadantaraṃ so 'tha devānāṃ mantracoditaḥ /
kāvyasya rūpamāsthāya so 'surānsamabhāṣata //
meaning:
बुद्ध्वा तदन्तरं सो ऽथ देवानां मन्त्रचोदितः /
काव्यस्य रूपमास्थाय सो ऽसुरान्समभाषत //
text_mt: and perceiving that opportunity, impelled by the counsel of the gods, / assumed the form of Kāvya and spoke to the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ so 'bhyāgatāndṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatiruvāca tān /
svāgataṃ mama yājyānāṃ saṃprāpto 'smi hitāya ca //
meaning:
ततः सो ऽभ्यागतान्दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिरुवाच तान् /
स्वागतं मम याज्यानां संप्राप्तो ऽस्मि हिताय च //
text_mt: Then Bṛhaspati, seeing them arrive, said to them: / “Welcome to my patrons in sacrifice; I have arrived for your welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ vo 'dhyāpayiṣyāmi prāptā vidyā mayā hi yāḥ /
tataste hṛṣṭamanaso vidyārthamupapedire //
meaning:
अहं वो ऽध्यापयिष्यामि प्राप्ता विद्या मया हि याः /
ततस्ते हृष्टमनसो विद्यार्थमुपपेदिरे //
text_mt: I shall teach you the sciences that I have obtained.” / Thereupon, with delighted minds, they approached him for the sake of the sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe kāvyastadā tasminsamaye daśavārṣike /
samayānte devayājī sadyo jātamatistadā //
meaning:
पूर्णे काव्यस्तदा तस्मिन्समये दशवार्षिके /
समयान्ते देवयाजी सद्यो जातमतिस्तदा //
text_mt: Then, when that ten-year agreement was completed, / at the end of the term, Kāvya, the sacrificer of the gods, immediately came to his senses.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhiṃ cakre tataścāpi yājyānāṃ pratyavekṣaṇe /
śukra uvāca
devi gacchāmyahaṃ draṣṭuṃ tava yājyāñchucismite //
meaning:
बुद्धिं चक्रे ततश्चापि याज्यानां प्रत्यवेक्षणे /
शुक्र उवाच
देवि गच्छाम्यहं द्रष्टुं तव याज्याञ्छुचिस्मिते //
text_mt: And then he set his mind on inspecting his patrons in sacrifice. / Śukra said: / “Goddess, I am going to see your patrons in sacrifice, O lady of pure smiles,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhrāntaprekṣite sādhvi trivarṇāyatalocane /
evamuktābravīddevī bhaja bhaktāṃ mahāvrata /
eṣa brahmansatāṃ dharmo na dharmaṃ lopayāmi te //
meaning:
विभ्रान्तप्रेक्षिते साध्वि त्रिवर्णायतलोचने /
एवमुक्ताब्रवीद्देवी भज भक्तां महाव्रत /
एष ब्रह्मन्सतां धर्मो न धर्मं लोपयामि ते //
text_mt: with tremulous glances, virtuous lady whose long eyes have three colors.” / Addressed thus, the goddess said: “Serve your devoted patron, O keeper of great vows! / This, O brāhmaṇa, is the duty of the virtuous; I do not violate your duty.”

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
tato gatvā surāndṛṣṭvā devācāryeṇa dhīmatā //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
ततो गत्वा सुरान्दृष्ट्वा देवाचार्येण धीमता //
text_mt: The bard said: / Then, having gone and seen the [Asuras] deceived by the wise teacher of the gods / in the form of Kāvya, he spoke again with words:

sanskrit_iast:
vañcitānkāvyarūpeṇa vacasā punarabravīt /
kāvyaṃ māmanujānīdhvameṣa hyāṅgiraso muniḥ //
meaning:
वञ्चितान्काव्यरूपेण वचसा पुनरब्रवीत् /
काव्यं मामनुजानीध्वमेष ह्याङ्गिरसो मुनिः //
text_mt: “Recognize me as Kāvya; for this is the sage descended from Aṅgiras!

sanskrit_iast:
vañcitā bata yūyaṃ vai mayi sakte tu dānavāḥ /
śrutvā tathā bruvāṇaṃ taṃ saṃbhrāntā ditijāstataḥ //
meaning:
वञ्चिता बत यूयं वै मयि सक्ते तु दानवाः /
श्रुत्वा तथा ब्रुवाणं तं संभ्रान्ता दितिजास्ततः //
text_mt: Alas, O Dānavas, you have indeed been deceived while I was occupied!” / Hearing him speak thus, the sons of Diti were bewildered.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpraikṣantāvubhau tatra sthirāsīnau śucismitau /
saṃpramūḍhāḥ sthitāḥ sarve prāpadyanta na kiñcana //
meaning:
संप्रैक्षन्तावुभौ तत्र स्थिरासीनौ शुचिस्मितौ /
संप्रमूढाः स्थिताः सर्वे प्रापद्यन्त न किञ्चन //
text_mt: They looked at both of them standing there, seated firmly and with pure smiles; / completely confounded, they all stood still and could not understand anything.

sanskrit_iast:
tatasteṣu pramūḍheṣu kāvyastānpunarabravīt /
ācāryo yo hyayaṃ kāvyo devāyāryo 'yamaṅgirāḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तेषु प्रमूढेषु काव्यस्तान्पुनरब्रवीत् /
आचार्यो यो ह्ययं काव्यो देवायार्यो ऽयमङ्गिराः //
text_mt: Then, as they were confounded, Kāvya said to them again: / “This one is indeed the preceptor Kāvya; that one is Aṅgiras, the teacher of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
anugacchata māṃ sarve tyajatainaṃ bṛhaspatim /
evamukte tu te sarve tāvubhau samavekṣya ca //
meaning:
अनुगच्छत मां सर्वे त्यजतैनं बृहस्पतिम् /
एवमुक्ते तु ते सर्वे तावुभौ समवेक्ष्य च //
text_mt: Follow me, all of you, and abandon this Bṛhaspati!” / When this was said, they all looked at both of them,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāsurā viśeṣa tu na vyajānaṃstayordvayoḥ /
bṛhaspatiruvācaināmaṃ bhrāto 'yamaṅgirāḥ //
meaning:
तदासुरा विशेष तु न व्यजानंस्तयोर्द्वयोः /
बृहस्पतिरुवाचैनामं भ्रातो ऽयमङ्गिराः //
text_mt: and the Asuras could not discern any difference between the two. / Bṛhaspati said to them: “This Aṅgiras is confused!

sanskrit_iast:
kāvyo 'haṃ vo gururdaityā madrūpo 'yaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ /
saṃmohayati rūpeṇa māmakenaiṣa vo 'surāḥ //
meaning:
काव्यो ऽहं वो गुरुर्दैत्या मद्रूपो ऽयं बृहस्पतिः /
संमोहयति रूपेण मामकेनैष वो ऽसुराः //
text_mt: I am Kāvya, your preceptor, O Daityas; this Bṛhaspati has taken my form! / He is bewildering you, O Asuras, with this form of mine.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā tasya vacaste vai saṃmantryātha vaco 'bruvan /
ayaṃ no daśavarṣāṇi satataṃ śāsti vai prabhuḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा तस्य वचस्ते वै संमन्त्र्याथ वचो ऽब्रुवन् /
अयं नो दशवर्षाणि सततं शास्ति वै प्रभुः //
text_mt: Hearing his words, they deliberated and then said: / “This lord has continually instructed us for ten years.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vai gururasmākamantarepsurayaṃ dvijāḥ /
tatastedānavāḥ sarve praṇipatyābhivādya ca //
meaning:
एष वै गुरुरस्माकमन्तरेप्सुरयं द्विजाः /
ततस्तेदानवाः सर्वे प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च //
text_mt: He alone is our preceptor; this brāhmaṇa is seeking an advantage.” / Then all those Dānavas, bowing down and greeting him respectfully,

sanskrit_iast:
vacanaṃ jagṛhustasya vidyābhyāsena mohitāḥ /
ūcustamasurāḥ sarve kruddhāḥ saṃraktalocanāḥ //
meaning:
वचनं जगृहुस्तस्य विद्याभ्यासेन मोहिताः /
ऊचुस्तमसुराः सर्वे क्रुद्धाः संरक्तलोचनाः //
text_mt: accepted his words, deluded by the practice of the sciences. / Enraged, with blood-red eyes, all the Asuras said to him:

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ gururhito 'smākaṃ gaccha tvaṃ nāsi no guruḥ /
bhārgavo 'giraso vāyaṃ bhavatveṣaiva no guruḥ //
meaning:
अयं गुरुर्हितो ऽस्माकं गच्छ त्वं नासि नो गुरुः /
भार्गवो ऽगिरसो वायं भवत्वेषैव नो गुरुः //
text_mt: “This one is our preceptor who desires our welfare; go away, you are not our preceptor! / Whether he is Bhārgava or Āṅgirasa, let him alone be our preceptor.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitā vayaṃ nideśe 'sya gaccha tvaṃ sādhu mā ciram /
evamuktvā surāḥ sarve prāpadyanta bṛhaspatim //
meaning:
स्थिता वयं निदेशे ऽस्य गच्छ त्वं साधु मा चिरम् /
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे प्रापद्यन्त बृहस्पतिम् //
text_mt: We abide by his instruction; go away quickly without delay!” / Having spoken thus, all the [Asuras] resorted to Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā na pratipadyante tenoktaṃ tanmahaddhitam /
cukopa bhārgavaste ṣāmavalepena vai tadā //
meaning:
यदा न प्रतिपद्यन्ते तेनोक्तं तन्महद्धितम् /
चुकोप भार्गवस्ते षामवलेपेन वै तदा //
text_mt: When they did not accept that great benefit spoken by him, / Bhārgava became enraged then at their arrogance:

sanskrit_iast:
bodhitāpi mayā yasmānna māṃ bhajata dānavāḥ /
tasmātpraṇaṣṭasaṃjñā vai parābhavamavāpsyatha //
meaning:
बोधितापि मया यस्मान्न मां भजत दानवाः /
तस्मात्प्रणष्टसंज्ञा वै पराभवमवाप्स्यथ //
text_mt: “Because, even though informed by me, you do not honor me, O Dānavas, / therefore, deprived of your senses, you will suffer defeat!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti vyāhṛtya tānkāvyo jagāmātha yathāgatam /
śaptāṃstānasurāñjñātvā kāvyena tu bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
इति व्याहृत्य तान्काव्यो जगामाथ यथागतम् /
शप्तांस्तानसुराञ्ज्ञात्वा काव्येन तु बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: Having spoken thus to them, Kāvya then departed as he had come. / Knowing that those Asuras were cursed by Kāvya, Bṛhaspati,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtārthaḥ sa tadā hṛṣṭaḥ svarūpaṃ pratyapadyata /
buddhvāsurāṃstadā braṣṭānkṛtārthoṃ'tarddhimāgamat //
meaning:
कृतार्थः स तदा हृष्टः स्वरूपं प्रत्यपद्यत /
बुद्ध्वासुरांस्तदा ब्रष्टान्कृतार्थोंऽतर्द्धिमागमत् //
text_mt: having achieved his purpose, delighted, assumed his own form. / Knowing that the Asuras were now ruined, he, his purpose achieved, vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pranaṣṭe tasmiṃste vibhrāntā dānavāstadā /
aho dhigvañcitāḥ snehātparasparamathābruvan //
meaning:
ततः प्रनष्टे तस्मिंस्ते विभ्रान्ता दानवास्तदा /
अहो धिग्वञ्चिताः स्नेहात्परस्परमथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Then, when he had disappeared, those Dānavas were bewildered. / “Alas, fie! We have been deceived out of affection!” they then said to one another.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmato 'vimukhāścaiva kāritā vedhasā vayam /
dagdhāścaivopadhāyogātsvesve kārye tu māyayā //
meaning:
धर्मतो ऽविमुखाश्चैव कारिता वेधसा वयम् /
दग्धाश्चैवोपधायोगात्स्वेस्वे कार्ये तु मायया //
text_mt: “We have been turned away from righteousness by the Creator, / and we have been consumed through deceit by illusion in our own affairs!”

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'surāḥ paritrastā devebhyastvaritā yayuḥ /
prahlādamagrataḥ kṛtvā kāvyasyānugamaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
ततो ऽसुराः परित्रस्ता देवेभ्यस्त्वरिता ययुः /
प्रह्लादमग्रतः कृत्वा काव्यस्यानुगमं पुनः //
text_mt: Then the Asuras, terrified of the gods, went swiftly, / putting Prahlāda in front, in pursuit of Kāvya once again.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāvyaṃ samāsādya hyabhitasthu ravāṅmukhāḥ /
tānāgatānpunardṛṣṭvā kāvyo yājyānuvāca ha //
meaning:
ततः काव्यं समासाद्य ह्यभितस्थु रवाङ्मुखाः /
