text_mt: Except for sovereignty, they are equal to Brahmā, those beings of great splendor, / possessing sight of majesty, victory, lordship, stability, and dispassion.

sanskrit_iast:
te brahmalaukikāḥ sarve gatiṃ prāpyānivarttinīm /
brahmaṇā sahadevaiśca saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare //
meaning:
ते ब्रह्मलौकिकाः सर्वे गतिं प्राप्यानिवर्त्तिनीम् /
ब्रह्मणा सहदेवैश्च संप्राप्ते प्रतिसंचरे //
text_mt: All those dwellers in the realm of Brahmā, having attained the non-returning state, / when the cosmic reabsorption arrives, together with Brahmā and the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasoṃ'te kriyātmāno buddhāvasthā manīṣiṇaḥ /
avyakte saṃpralīyante sarve te kṣaṇadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
तपसोंऽते क्रियात्मानो बुद्धावस्था मनीषिणः /
अव्यक्ते संप्रलीयन्ते सर्वे ते क्षणदर्शिनः //
text_mt: at the end of their austerities, with nature transformed into ritual action, the wise ones who have attained enlightenment, / all those seers of the moment, merge into the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetadamṛtaṃ śukraṃ nityamakṣayavyayam /
devarṣayo brahmasatraṃ sanātanamupāsate //
meaning:
इत्येतदमृतं शुक्रं नित्यमक्षयव्ययम् /
देवर्षयो ब्रह्मसत्रं सनातनमुपासते //
text_mt: This is immortal, radiant, eternal, undecaying, and imperishable. / The divine seers attend upon this eternal sacrifice to Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
apunarmārakādīnāṃ teṣāṃ caivoddhvaretasām /
karmābhyāsakṛtāṃ śraddhāṃ vedānteṣūpalakṣyate //
meaning:
अपुनर्मारकादीनां तेषां चैवोद्ध्वरेतसाम् /
कर्माभ्यासकृतां श्रद्धां वेदान्तेषूपलक्ष्यते //
text_mt: Of those non-recurrent ones and those celibate ascetics, / the faith born from the practice of action is discerned in the Vedāntas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te 'bhyāsino yuktāḥ parāṃ kāṣṭhāmupāsate /
hitvā śarīraṃ pāpmānamamṛtatvāya te gātāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र ते ऽभ्यासिनो युक्ताः परां काष्ठामुपासते /
हित्वा शरीरं पाप्मानममृतत्वाय ते गाताः //
text_mt: There those disciplined practitioners attend upon the supreme goal. / Having cast off the body and evil, they have gone to immortality:

sanskrit_iast:
vītarāgā jitakrodhā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ /
śāntāḥ praṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ //
meaning:
वीतरागा जितक्रोधा निर्मोहाः सत्यवादिनः /
शान्ताः प्रणिहितात्मानो दयावन्तो जितेन्द्रियाः //
text_mt: free from passion, conquerors of anger, free from delusion, speakers of truth, / tranquil, with minds absorbed, compassionate, masters over their senses,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsaṃgāḥ śucayaścaiva brahmasāyujyagāḥ smṛtāḥ /
akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ //
meaning:
निःसंगाः शुचयश्चैव ब्रह्मसायुज्यगाः स्मृताः /
अकामयुक्तैर्ये वीरास्तपोभिर्दग्धकिल्बिषाः //
text_mt: detached and pure, they are remembered as attaining union with Brahman. / Those heroes who, by desireless austerities, have burned away their sins,

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ smṛtāḥ /
etadbrahmapadaṃ divyaṃ parame vyomni bhāsvaram /
yatra gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha //
meaning:
तेषांमभ्रंशिनो लोका अप्रमेयसुखाः स्मृताः /
एतद्ब्रह्मपदं दिव्यं परमे व्योम्नि भास्वरम् /
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति ह्यमरा ब्रह्मणा सह //
text_mt: theirs are the unfailing worlds, remembered as possessing immeasurable bliss. / This is the divine abode of Brahman, luminous in the supreme sky, / going to which the immortals do not grieve, together with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
kasmādeṣu parārddhaṃśca kaścaiva para ucyate /
etadveditumicchāmastanno nigada sattama //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
कस्मादेषु परार्द्धंश्च कश्चैव पर उच्यते /
एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामस्तन्नो निगद सत्तम //
text_mt: The ṛṣis said: / Why is parārdha so called among these, and what is called para? / We wish to know this; tell it to us, O best of the virtuous!

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
śṛṇudhvaṃ me parārddhasya parisaṃkhyāṃ parasyaca //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
शृणुध्वं मे परार्द्धस्य परिसंख्यां परस्यच //
text_mt: The bard said: / Hear from me the calculation of parārdha and of para.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ daśaśataṃ caiva sahasraṃ caiva saṃkhyāyā /
vijñeyamāsahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇi daśāyutam //
meaning:
एकं दशशतं चैव सहस्रं चैव संख्याया /
विज्ञेयमासहस्रं तु सहस्राणि दशायुतम् //
text_mt: One, ten, a hundred, and a thousand in counting / should be understood up to a thousand; ten thousands is an ayuta.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu niyutaṃ procyate budhaiḥ /
tathā śatasahasrāṇāṃ daśaprayutamucyate //
meaning:
एकं शतसहस्रं तु नियुतं प्रोच्यते बुधैः /
तथा शतसहस्राणां दशप्रयुतमुच्यते //
text_mt: One hundred thousand is called niyuta by the wise, / and ten hundred thousands is called prayuta.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā daśasahasrāṇāmayutaṃ koṭirucyate /
arbudaṃ daśakoṭyastu hyabjaṃ koṭiśataṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
तथा दशसहस्राणामयुतं कोटिरुच्यते /
अर्बुदं दशकोट्यस्तु ह्यब्जं कोटिशतं विदुः //
text_mt: So an ayuta of ten thousands is called a koṭi. / Ten koṭis is an arbuda, and they know a hundred koṭis as an abja.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasramāpi koṭīnāṃ kharvamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ /
daśakoṭisahasrāṇi nikharvamiti taṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रमापि कोटीनां खर्वमाहुर्मनीषिणः /
दशकोटिसहस्राणि निखर्वमिति तं विदुः //
text_mt: The wise call a thousand koṭis a kharva. / Ten thousand koṭis they know as nikharva.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ koṭi sahasrāṇāṃ śaṅkurityabhidhīyate /
sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ koṭīnāṃ padmamucyate //
meaning:
शतं कोटि सहस्राणां शङ्कुरित्यभिधीयते /
सहस्रं तु सहस्राणां कोटीनां पद्ममुच्यते //
text_mt: A hundred thousand koṭis is designated a śaṅku. / A thousand thousand koṭis is called a padma.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ koṭīnāṃ daśadhā punaḥ /
guṇitāni samudraṃ vai prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ //
meaning:
सहस्राणि सहस्राणां कोटीनां दशधा पुनः /
गुणितानि समुद्रं वै प्राहुः संख्याविदो जनाः //
text_mt: A thousand thousand koṭis multiplied again tenfold, / those who know numbers call a samudra.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭīsahasraniyutamantyamityabhidhīyate /
koṭīsahasraprayutaṃ madhyamityabhisaṃjñitam //
meaning:
कोटीसहस्रनियुतमन्त्यमित्यभिधीयते /
कोटीसहस्रप्रयुतं मध्यमित्यभिसंज्ञितम् //
text_mt: A niyuta of thousands of koṭis is called an antya. / A prayuta of thousands of koṭis is known as a madhya.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikoṭisahasraṃ tu parārddha iti kīrtyate /
parārddhaṃ dviguṇaṃ cāpi paramāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
कोटिकोटिसहस्रं तु परार्द्ध इति कीर्त्यते /
परार्द्धं द्विगुणं चापि परमाहुर्मनीषिणः //
text_mt: A thousand koṭis of koṭis is proclaimed as parārdha. / And twice a parārdha the wise call a para.

sanskrit_iast:
śatamāhuḥ parivṛḍhaṃ sahasraṃ paripadmakam /
vijñeyamayutaṃ tasmānniyutaṃ prayutaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
शतमाहुः परिवृढं सहस्रं परिपद्मकम् /
विज्ञेयमयुतं तस्मान्नियुतं प्रयुतं ततः //
text_mt: They say a hundred is parivṛḍha; a thousand is paripadma. / Ayuta should be known from that, then niyuta, and prayuta.

sanskrit_iast:
arbudaṃ nyarbudaṃ caiva kharbudaṃ ca tataḥ smṛtam /
kharvaṃ caiva nikharvaṃ ca śaṅkuḥ padmantathaiva ca //
meaning:
अर्बुदं न्यर्बुदं चैव खर्बुदं च ततः स्मृतम् /
खर्वं चैव निखर्वं च शङ्कुः पद्मन्तथैव च //
text_mt: Arbuda, nyarbuda, and then kharbuda is remembered; / and kharva and nikharva, śaṅku and likewise padma,

sanskrit_iast:
samudramantyaṃ madhyaṃ ca parārddhaṃ ca paraṃ tataḥ /
evamaṣṭādaśaitāni sthānāni gaṇanāvidhau //
meaning:
समुद्रमन्त्यं मध्यं च परार्द्धं च परं ततः /
एवमष्टादशैतानि स्थानानि गणनाविधौ //
text_mt: samudra, antya, madhya, parārdha, and then para: / thus there are these eighteen decimal places in the method of enumeration.

sanskrit_iast:
śatādīni vijānīyātsaṃjñitāni maharṣibhiḥ /
kalpasaṃkhyāpravṛttasya parārddho brahmamaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
शतादीनि विजानीयात्संज्ञितानि महर्षिभिः /
कल्पसंख्याप्रवृत्तस्य परार्द्धो ब्रह्ममः स्मृतः //
text_mt: One should know that hundreds and the rest were named by the great sages. / For Brahmā engaged in the reckoning of kalpas, a parārdha is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvaccheṣo 'pi kālo 'sya tasyānte pratitiṣṭhate /
para eva parārddhaśca saṃkhyātaḥ saṃkhyāyā mayā //
meaning:
तावच्छेषो ऽपि कालो ऽस्य तस्यान्ते प्रतितिष्ठते /
पर एव परार्द्धश्च संख्यातः संख्याया मया //
text_mt: His remaining time is just as long, and at its end he stands established. / The highest [measure] is indeed the parārdha, and it has been enumerated by me by way of calculation.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādasya paraṃ viryaṃ paramāyuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ /
parā śaktiḥ paro dharmaḥ parāvidyā parā dhṛtiḥ //
meaning:
यस्मादस्य परं विर्यं परमायुः परं तपः /
परा शक्तिः परो धर्मः पराविद्या परा धृतिः //
text_mt: Because his strength is supreme, his lifespan is supreme, his ascetic power is supreme, / his potency is supreme, his dharma is supreme, his knowledge is supreme, his resolve is supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ brahma paraṃ jñānaṃ paramaiśvaryameva ca /
tasmātparataraṃ bhūtaṃ brahmaṇo yanna vidyate //
meaning:
परं ब्रह्म परं ज्ञानं परमैश्वर्यमेव च /
तस्मात्परतरं भूतं ब्रह्मणो यन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: his Brahman is supreme, his knowledge is supreme, and his sovereignty is supreme, / therefore there is no being higher than Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pare sthito hyeṣa paraḥ sarvārthevu tataḥ param /
saṃkhyātastu paro brahmā tasyārddhasya parārddhatā //
meaning:
परे स्थितो ह्येष परः सर्वार्थेवु ततः परम् /
संख्यातस्तु परो ब्रह्मा तस्यार्द्धस्य परार्द्धता //
text_mt: For established in the supreme, he is superior in all respects to what is beyond. / Brahmā is declared supreme; half of that [span] is the nature of a parārdha.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyeyaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyeyaṃ satataṃ cāpi tāntrikam /
saṃkhyeyaṃ saṃkhyayā dṛṣṭamaparārddhādvibhāṣyate //
meaning:
संख्येयं चाप्यसंख्येयं सततं चापि तान्त्रिकम् /
संख्येयं संख्यया दृष्टमपरार्द्धाद्विभाष्यते //
text_mt: The numerable and the innumerable, both continuous and ritualistic— / the numerable seen by calculation is explained starting from the lower half.

sanskrit_iast:
rāśau dṛṣṭe na saṃkhyāsti tadasaṃkhyāstu lakṣṇam /
ānantyaṃ sikatā dyeṣu hṛṣṭaṃ cānyaṃ tvalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
राशौ दृष्टे न संख्यास्ति तदसंख्यास्तु लक्ष्णम् /
आनन्त्यं सिकता द्येषु हृष्टं चान्यं त्वलक्षणम् //
text_mt: When a heap is seen, there is no [individual] number; that indeed is the mark of the innumerable. / Boundlessness is observed in sand grains and the like, but another [thing] lacks such characteristics.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaraistatprasaṃkhyānaṃ śuddhatvāddivyadṛṣṭibhiḥ /
evaṃ jñānapratiṣṭhatvātsarvaṃ brahmānupaśyati //
meaning:
ईश्वरैस्तत्प्रसंख्यानं शुद्धत्वाद्दिव्यदृष्टिभिः /
एवं ज्ञानप्रतिष्ठत्वात्सर्वं ब्रह्मानुपश्यति //
text_mt: That enumeration [is known] by the lords of divine vision because of their purity. / Thus, through being established in knowledge, Brahmā perceives everything.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā tu te sarve naimiṣeyāstapasvinaḥ /
bāṣpaparyākulākṣāstu praharṣādgadgadasvarāḥ //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः /
बाष्पपर्याकुलाक्षास्तु प्रहर्षाद्गद्गदस्वराः //
text_mt: Hearing this, all those ascetics, the inhabitants of Naimiṣa, / their eyes filled with tears, their voices faltering with great joy,

sanskrit_iast:
papracchurmātāriśvānaṃ sarve te brahmavādinaḥ /
brahmalokastu bhagavanyāvanmātrāntare prabho //
meaning:
पप्रच्छुर्मातारिश्वानं सर्वे ते ब्रह्मवादिनः /
ब्रह्मलोकस्तु भगवन्यावन्मात्रान्तरे प्रभो //
text_mt: all those exponents of the Veda asked Mātariśvan: / "O lord, at what distance is the world of Brahmā situated, O master,

sanskrit_iast:
yojanāgreṇa saṃkhyātaḥ sādhanaṃ yojanasya tu /
krośasya ca parīmāṇaṃ śrotumīcchāma tattvataḥ //
meaning:
योजनाग्रेण संख्यातः साधनं योजनस्य तु /
क्रोशस्य च परीमाणं श्रोतुमीच्छाम तत्त्वतः //
text_mt: measured by the sum of yojanas? We wish to hear truly / the definition of a yojana and the measure of a krośa."

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mātariśvā vinītavat /
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathākramam //
meaning:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मातरिश्वा विनीतवत् /
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं यथादृष्टं यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: Hearing their words, Mātariśvan, like one modest, / spoke sweet words, as seen and in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca
etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi śruṇudhvaṃ me vivakṣitam /
avyaktādvyaktabhāgo vai mahānsthūlo vibhāṣyate //
meaning:
वायुरुवाच
एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रुणुध्वं मे विवक्षितम् /
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तभागो वै महान्स्थूलो विभाष्यते //
text_mt: Vāyu said: / "I shall declare this to you; listen to what I wish to say. / The manifest portion [evolving] from the unmanifest is explained as the gross cosmic intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaiva mahato bhāgā bhūtādiḥ sthūla ucyate /
daśabhāgādhikaṃ cāpi bhūtādiparimāṇakam //
meaning:
दशैव महतो भागा भूतादिः स्थूल उच्यते /
दशभागाधिकं चापि भूतादिपरिमाणकम् //
text_mt: A tenth part of the cosmic intellect is declared to be the gross origin of the elements, / and the measure of the origin of the elements is also ten times greater.

sanskrit_iast:
paramāṇuḥ susūkṣmastu bhāvagrāhyo na cakṣuṣā /
yadabhedyatamaṃ loke vijñeyaṃ paramāṇuvat //
meaning:
परमाणुः सुसूक्ष्मस्तु भावग्राह्यो न चक्षुषा /
यदभेद्यतमं लोके विज्ञेयं परमाणुवत् //
text_mt: An atom (paramāṇu) is extremely subtle, graspable only by the mind and not by the eye; / that which is most indivisible in the world is to be understood like an atom.

sanskrit_iast:
jālāntaragate bhānaiṃ yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ /
prathamaṃ tatpramāṇānāṃ paramāṇuṃ pracakṣate //
meaning:
जालान्तरगते भानैं यत्सूक्ष्मं दृश्यते रजः /
प्रथमं तत्प्रमाणानां परमाणुं प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: The subtle speck of dust that is seen in a beam of sunlight penetrating a lattice / is said to be the first of measures, an atom.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ samāvāyo yadā bhavet /
trasareṇuḥ samākhyātastatpadmaraja ucyate //
meaning:
अष्टानां परमाणूनां समावायो यदा भवेत् /
त्रसरेणुः समाख्यातस्तत्पद्मरज उच्यते //
text_mt: When there is a combination of eight atoms, / it is called a trasareṇu; it is said to be the pollen of a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
trasareṇavo 'tha ye 'pyaṣṭau rathareṇustu sasmṛtaḥ /
te 'pyaṣṭau samavāyasthā bālāgraṃ tatsmṛtaṃ budhaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रसरेणवो ऽथ ये ऽप्यष्टौ रथरेणुस्तु सस्मृतः /
ते ऽप्यष्टौ समवायस्था बालाग्रं तत्स्मृतं बुधैः //
text_mt: Eight trasareṇus are remembered as a chariot-mote (rathareṇu). / Eight of those combined are remembered by the wise as a hair's tip.

sanskrit_iast:
bālāgrāṇyaṣṭalikṣā syādyūkālikṣāṣṭakaṃ bhavet /
yūkāṣṭakaṃ yavaprāhuraṅgulaṃ tu yavāṣṭakam //
meaning:
बालाग्राण्यष्टलिक्षा स्याद्यूकालिक्षाष्टकं भवेत् /
यूकाष्टकं यवप्राहुरङ्गुलं तु यवाष्टकम् //
text_mt: Eight hair-tips make a nit (likṣā); eight nits make a louse (yūkā). / Eight lice are called a barleycorn (yava); eight barleycorns make a finger's breadth (aṅgula).

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāṅgulaparvāṇi vitastisthānamucyate /
ratniścāguliparvāṇi vijñeyo hyekaviṃśatiḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशाङ्गुलपर्वाणि वितस्तिस्थानमुच्यते /
रत्निश्चागुलिपर्वाणि विज्ञेयो ह्येकविंशतिः //
text_mt: Twelve finger-breadths are called the measure of a span (vitasti). / And a cubit (aratni) should be known as twenty-one finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro viṃśatiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṅgulāni tu /
kiṣkurdviratnirvijñeyo dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारो विंशतिश्चैव हस्तः स्यादङ्गुलानि तु /
किष्कुर्द्विरत्निर्विज्ञेयो द्विचत्वारिंशदङ्गुलः //
text_mt: Twenty-four finger-breadths make a forearm (hasta). / A kiṣku should be known as two aratnis, forty-two finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaṃ caiva dhanurāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ /
etadgavyūtisaṃkhyāyāmādānaṃ dhanuṣaḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
षण्णवत्यङ्गुलं चैव धनुराहुर्मनीषिणः /
एतद्गव्यूतिसंख्यायामादानं धनुषः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The wise call ninety-six finger-breadths a bow (dhanus). / This is remembered as the standard bow in the calculation of a gavyūti.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurdaṇḍayugaṃ nālī tulyānyastaistathāṅgulaiḥ /
dhanuṣāṃ triśataṃ nalvamāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ //
meaning:
धनुर्दण्डयुगं नाली तुल्यान्यस्तैस्तथाङ्गुलैः /
धनुषां त्रिशतं नल्वमाहुः संख्याविदो जनाः //
text_mt: A bow is two staff-lengths (daṇḍa); a nālī is equal to those in finger-breadths. / People knowledgeable in numbers say that three hundred bows make a nalva.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuḥ sahasre dve cāpi gavyūtirupadiśyate /
aṣṭau dhanuḥ sahasrāṇi yojanaṃ tu vidhīyate //
meaning:
धनुः सहस्रे द्वे चापि गव्यूतिरुपदिश्यते /
अष्टौ धनुः सहस्राणि योजनं तु विधीयते //
text_mt: Two thousand bows are taught to be a gavyūti. / Eight thousand bows are determined to be a yojana.

sanskrit_iast:
etena dhanuṣā caiva yojanaṃ tu samāpyate /
etatsahasraṃ vijñeyaṃ śakrakośāntaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
एतेन धनुषा चैव योजनं तु समाप्यते /
एतत्सहस्रं विज्ञेयं शक्रकोशान्तरं तथा //
text_mt: A yojana is completed by this bow; / a thousand of these should be known as the distance to Indra's sphere.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanānāṃ ca saṃkhyātaṃ saṃkhyājñānaviśāradaiḥ /
etena yojanāgreṇa śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tare //
meaning:
योजनानां च संख्यातं संख्याज्ञानविशारदैः /
एतेन योजनाग्रेण शृणुध्वं ब्रह्मणोंऽतरे //
text_mt: Thus it has been calculated in yojanas by those skilled in the knowledge of numbers. / By this count of yojanas, hear the distance to [the world of] Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahītalātsahasrāṇāṃ rātādūrdhvaṃ divākaraḥ /
divākarātsahasre tu śate caurddhvaṃ niśākaraḥ //
meaning:
महीतलात्सहस्राणां रातादूर्ध्वं दिवाकरः /
दिवाकरात्सहस्रे तु शते चौर्द्ध्वं निशाकरः //
text_mt: One hundred thousand [yojanas] above the surface of the earth is the sun. / One hundred thousand [yojanas] above the sun is the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yojanānāṃ niśākarāt /
nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamupariṣṭātprakāśata //
meaning:
पूर्णं शतसहस्रं तु योजनानां निशाकरात् /
नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशत //
text_mt: A full one hundred thousand yojanas above the moon, / the entire circle of constellations shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
śataṃ sahasraṃ saṃkhyātametaddviguṇitaṃ punaḥ /
grahāntaramathaikaikamūrddhvaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍarāt //
meaning:
शतं सहस्रं संख्यातमेतद्द्विगुणितं पुनः /
ग्रहान्तरमथैकैकमूर्द्ध्वं नक्षत्रमण्डरात् //
text_mt: One hundred thousand [yojanas] is reckoned, and this doubled again, / is the interval of each planet above the circle of constellations.

sanskrit_iast:
tārāgrahāṇāṃ sarveṣāmadhyastāccarate budhaḥ /
tasyorddhvaṃ carate śukrastasmādūrddhvaṃ ca lohitaḥ //
meaning:
ताराग्रहाणां सर्वेषामध्यस्ताच्चरते बुधः /
तस्योर्द्ध्वं चरते शुक्रस्तस्मादूर्द्ध्वं च लोहितः //
text_mt: Below all the starry planets travels Mercury (Budha). / Above him travels Venus (Śukra), and above him Mars (Lohita).

sanskrit_iast:
tato bṛhaspatiścorddhvaṃ tasmādūrddhvaṃ śanaiścaraḥ /
urddhvaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu yojanānāṃ śanaiścarāt //
meaning:
ततो बृहस्पतिश्चोर्द्ध्वं तस्मादूर्द्ध्वं शनैश्चरः /
उर्द्ध्वं शतसहस्रं तु योजनानां शनैश्चरात् //
text_mt: Above that is Jupiter (Bṛhaspati), and above him Saturn (Śanaiścara). / One hundred thousand yojanas above Saturn,

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣimaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnamupariṣṭātprakāśate /
ṛṣibhyastu sahasrāṇāṃ śatādūrddhvaṃ vibhāṣyate //
meaning:
सप्तर्षिमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशते /
ऋषिभ्यस्तु सहस्राणां शतादूर्द्ध्वं विभाष्यते //
text_mt: the entire circle of the Seven Sages shines above. / One hundred thousand [yojanas] above the sages, it is explained,

sanskrit_iast:
yo 'sau tārāmaye divye vimāne hrasvarūpake /
uttānapādaputro 'sau meḍhībhūto dhruvo divi //
meaning:
यो ऽसौ तारामये दिव्ये विमाने ह्रस्वरूपके /
उत्तानपादपुत्रो ऽसौ मेढीभूतो ध्रुवो दिवि //
text_mt: is he who, in a divine aerial chariot made of stars, small in form, / that son of Uttānapāda, Dhruva, stands as a pivot in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyasyaiṣa utsedho vyākhyāto yojanairmayā /
manvantareṣu devānāmijyā yatraiva laukikī //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यस्यैष उत्सेधो व्याख्यातो योजनैर्मया /
मन्वन्तरेषु देवानामिज्या यत्रैव लौकिकी //
text_mt: This height of the three worlds has been explained by me in yojanas, / where the worldly sacrifice of the gods occurs during the manvantaras.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramebhya iṣṭā tu loke 'sminsaṃpravarttate /
sarvāsāṃ devayonīnāṃ sthitihetuḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमेभ्य इष्टा तु लोके ऽस्मिन्संप्रवर्त्तते /
सर्वासां देवयोनीनां स्थितिहेतुः स वै स्मृतः //
text_mt: Sacrifice by the varnas and āśramas proceeds in this world; / it is remembered as the cause of sustenance for all the classes of divine beings.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyametadvyākhyātamata ūrddhvaṃ nibodhata /
dhruvādūrddhvaṃ maharloko yasmiṃste kalpavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यमेतद्व्याख्यातमत ऊर्द्ध्वं निबोधत /
ध्रुवादूर्द्ध्वं महर्लोको यस्मिंस्ते कल्पवासिनः //
text_mt: The three worlds have been explained; hear what is above this: / above Dhruva is Maharloka, in which dwell those who live for a kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāyojanakoṭīśā ityevaṃ niścayogataḥ /
dvīkoṭyāṃ tu maharlokājjanaloko vyavasthitaḥ //
meaning:
एकायोजनकोटीशा इत्येवं निश्चयोगतः /
द्वीकोट्यां तु महर्लोकाज्जनलोको व्यवस्थितः //
text_mt: Its [distance] is one crore of yojanas; thus is the conclusion reached. / Janaloka is situated two crores [of yojanas] from Maharloka,

sanskrit_iast: yatra te brahmaṇaḥ putrā dakṣādyāḥ sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning: यत्र ते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा दक्षाद्याः साधकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: where the sons of Brahmā, beginning with Dakṣa, remembered as the accomplished ones, [reside].

sanskrit_iast:
vai rājā yatra te devā bhūtadāhavivarjitāḥ /
ṣaḍguṇaṃ tu tapolokātsatyalokāntaraṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
वै राजा यत्र ते देवा भूतदाहविवर्जिताः /
षड्गुणं तु तपोलोकात्सत्यलोकान्तरं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: Where those kings and gods reside, free from the burning of creatures. / The distance of Satyaloka from Tapoloka is remembered as sixfold.

sanskrit_iast:
apunarmārako nāma brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate /
yasminna cyavate bhūyo brahmaṇaṃ ya upāsate //
meaning:
अपुनर्मारको नाम ब्रह्मलोकः स उच्यते /
यस्मिन्न च्यवते भूयो ब्रह्मणं य उपासते //
text_mt: It is called Brahmaloka, which is indeed free from dying again, / from which one who worships Brahmā does not fall again.

sanskrit_iast:
ekakoṭiryojanānāṃ pañcāśanniyutāni tu /
ūrddhvabhāgastatoṃ'ḍasya brahmalokātparaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एककोटिर्योजनानां पञ्चाशन्नियुतानि तु /
ऊर्द्ध्वभागस्ततोंऽडस्य ब्रह्मलोकात्परः स्मृतः //
text_mt: One crore and fifty lakhs of yojanas— / that is remembered as the upper portion of the egg beyond Brahmaloka.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśaiva koṭyastu niyutāni ca pañca ṣaṭ /
sa caurddhva saṃpracāro 'sya gatyantaścaparaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशैव कोट्यस्तु नियुतानि च पञ्च षट् /
स चौर्द्ध्व संप्रचारो ऽस्य गत्यन्तश्चपरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Fourteen crores and fifty-six lakhs [of yojanas]— / that is remembered as its upward extension and the final limit of movement.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvāgrametadvyākhyātaṃ yojanagrādyathāśrutam /
adhogatīnāṃ vakṣyāmi bhūtānāṃ sthānakalpanām //
meaning:
ध्रुवाग्रमेतद्व्याख्यातं योजनग्राद्यथाश्रुतम् /
अधोगतीनां वक्ष्यामि भूतानां स्थानकल्पनाम् //
text_mt: This height up to Dhruva has been explained according to tradition by the measure of yojanas. / I shall explain the arrangement of the places of creatures who have fallen below,

sanskrit_iast:
gacchanti ghorakarmāṇaḥ prāṇino yatra karmabhiḥ /
narako rauravo ghoraḥ śūkarastāla evaṃ ca //
meaning:
गच्छन्ति घोरकर्माणः प्राणिनो यत्र कर्मभिः /
नरको रौरवो घोरः शूकरस्ताल एवं च //
text_mt: where living beings of terrible deeds go according to their actions: / the dreadful hell Raurava, and Śūkara, and Tāla,

sanskrit_iast:
taptakumbho mahājvālaḥ śabalo 'tha vimohanaḥ /
kṛmī ca kṛmibhakṣaśca lālābhakṣo viśaṃsanaḥ //
meaning:
तप्तकुम्भो महाज्वालः शबलो ऽथ विमोहनः /
कृमी च कृमिभक्षश्च लालाभक्षो विशंसनः //
text_mt: Taptakumbha, Mahājvāla, Śabala, and Vimohana, / Kṛmi and Kṛmibhakṣa, Lālābhakṣa, Viśaṃsana,

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśirāḥ pūyavaho rudhirāndhustathaivaca /
viṣṭākīrṇaśca narako mūtrakīrṇa stathaiva ca //
meaning:
अधःशिराः पूयवहो रुधिरान्धुस्तथैवच /
विष्टाकीर्णश्च नरको मूत्रकीर्ण स्तथैव च //
text_mt: Adhaḥśiras, Pūyavaha, and likewise Rudhirāndhu, / and the hell strewn with feces, and likewise strewn with urine,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vaitaraṇī kṛṣṇamasipatravanaṃ tathā /
agnijvālo mahāghoraḥ saṃdaṃśo 'thāśvabhojanaḥ //
meaning:
तथा वैतरणी कृष्णमसिपत्रवनं तथा /
अग्निज्वालो महाघोरः संदंशो ऽथाश्वभोजनः //
text_mt: and the black Vaitaraṇī, and the forest of sword leaves (Asipatravana), / Agnijvāla, the most dreadful Saṃdaṃśa, and Aśvabhojana.

sanskrit_iast:
tamaścakṛṣṇasūtraśca lohaścāpyabhijastathā /
apratiṣṭho 'tha vīciśca narakā hyevamādayaḥ //
meaning:
तमश्चकृष्णसूत्रश्च लोहश्चाप्यभिजस्तथा /
अप्रतिष्ठो ऽथ वीचिश्च नरका ह्येवमादयः //
text_mt: Tamas, Kṛṣṇasūtra, Loha, and also Abhijit, / Apratiṣṭha, and Avīci—such are the hells and others like them.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasā narakāḥ sarve yamasya viṣaye sthitāḥ /
yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ patantīha vṛthakpṛthak //
meaning:
तामसा नरकाः सर्वे यमस्य विषये स्थिताः /
येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पतन्तीह वृथक्पृथक् //
text_mt: All these hells are characterized by tamas, situated in the realm of Yama, / into which evildoers fall here separately according to their deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmeradhastātte sarve rauravādyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ /
raurave kūṭasākṣe tumithyā yaścābhiśasati //
meaning:
भूमेरधस्तात्ते सर्वे रौरवाद्यः प्रकीर्त्तिताः /
रौरवे कूटसाक्षे तुमिथ्या यश्चाभिशसति //
text_mt: All of them, beginning with Raurava, are proclaimed to lie below the earth. / A man who gives false testimony, or who makes false accusations,

sanskrit_iast:
krūragraha pakṣavādī hyasaktaḥ patate naraḥ /
rādho godhro bhrūṇahā ca hyagnidātā purasya ca //
meaning:
क्रूरग्रह पक्षवादी ह्यसक्तः पतते नरः /
राधो गोध्रो भ्रूणहा च ह्यग्निदाता पुरस्य च //
text_mt: or who, holding fierce bias, argues partisanly without detachment, falls into Raurava. / A traitor, a slayer of cows, an abortionist, and one who sets fire to a town,

sanskrit_iast:
śūkare brahmahā majjetsurāpaḥ svarṇataskaraḥ /
tāle patetkṣatriyahā hatvā vaiśyaṃ ca majjati //
meaning:
शूकरे ब्रह्महा मज्जेत्सुरापः स्वर्णतस्करः /
ताले पतेत्क्षत्रियहा हत्वा वैश्यं च मज्जति //
text_mt: a slayer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, and a thief of gold sink into Śūkara. / One who slays a kṣatriya falls into Tāla, and after killing a vaiśya one also sinks [there].

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyā ca yaḥ kuryādyaśca syādgurutalpagaḥ /
saptakumbheṣvasau gāmī tathā rājabhaṭaśca yaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्या च यः कुर्याद्यश्च स्याद्गुरुतल्पगः /
सप्तकुम्भेष्वसौ गामी तथा राजभटश्च यः //
text_mt: He who commits the murder of a brahmin, or who violates the teacher's bed, / and likewise a king's soldier—such a one goes into Saptakumbha.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtāpyate vāśvaṇiktathāca dhanarakṣitā /
sādhvīvikrayakarttā ca yastu bhaktaṃ parityajet //
meaning:
संताप्यते वाश्वणिक्तथाच धनरक्षिता /
साध्वीविक्रयकर्त्ता च यस्तु भक्तं परित्यजेत् //
text_mt: Or the horse-merchant, and likewise the hoarder of wealth, is tormented [there]; / also one who sells a virtuous woman, and whoever abandons a loyal follower.

sanskrit_iast:
mahājvāle duhitaraṃ snuṣāṃ gacchati yastu vai /
vedaṃ vikrīṇateye ca vedaṃ vai dūṣayanti ye //
meaning:
महाज्वाले दुहितरं स्नुषां गच्छति यस्तु वै /
वेदं विक्रीणतेये च वेदं वै दूषयन्ति ये //
text_mt: He who approaches his daughter or daughter-in-law [sexually falls] into Mahājvāla; / likewise those who sell the Veda, and those who corrupt the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃścaivāvamanyante vākśaraistāḍayanti ca /
agamyagāmī ca naro narakaṃ śabalaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
गुरुंश्चैवावमन्यन्ते वाक्शरैस्ताडयन्ति च /
अगम्यगामी च नरो नरकं शबलं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: and who insult elders and strike them with arrow-like words; / and the man who approaches forbidden women goes to the Śabala hell.

sanskrit_iast:
vimohe patate ghore maryādāṃ yobhinatti vai /
duriṣṭaṃ kurute yastu kīḍalohaṃ prapadyate //
meaning:
विमोहे पतते घोरे मर्यादां योभिनत्ति वै /
दुरिष्टं कुरुते यस्तु कीडलोहं प्रपद्यते //
text_mt: He who transgresses righteous conduct falls into terrible Vimoha; / while he who performs flawed sacrifices goes to Kīḍaloha.

sanskrit_iast:
devabrāhmaṇavidveṣṭā gurūṇāṃ vāpyapūjakaḥ /
ratnaṃ dūṣayate yastu kṛmibhakṣe prapadyate //
meaning:
देवब्राह्मणविद्वेष्टा गुरूणां वाप्यपूजकः /
रत्नं दूषयते यस्तु कृमिभक्षे प्रपद्यते //
text_mt: He who hates the gods and brahmins, or does not worship elders, / or defiles gems, goes to Kṛmibhakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
paryaśnāti ya eko 'nnaṃ brāhmaṇānsuhṛdo vinā /
lālābhakṣe sa tiṣṭhettu durgandhe narake gataḥ //
meaning:
पर्यश्नाति य एको ऽन्नं ब्राह्मणान्सुहृदो विना /
लालाभक्षे स तिष्ठेत्तु दुर्गन्धे नरके गतः //
text_mt: He who eats food alone, excluding brahmins and friends, / having gone to the Lālābhakṣa hell, remains in foul odor.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇḍakarttā kulālaśca niṣkahartā cikitsakaḥ /
ārāme 'pyagnidātā yaḥ patate sa viśaṃsani //
meaning:
काण्डकर्त्ता कुलालश्च निष्कहर्ता चिकित्सकः /
आरामे ऽप्यग्निदाता यः पतते स विशंसनि //
text_mt: The maker of arrows, the potter, the thief of gold, the physician, / and he who sets fire to a park falls into Viśaṃsana.

sanskrit_iast:
asatpratigrahī yaśca tathaivāyājyayājakaḥ /
nakṣatrairjīvate yaśca naro gacchatyadhomukham //
meaning:
असत्प्रतिग्रही यश्च तथैवायाज्ययाजकः /
नक्षत्रैर्जीवते यश्च नरो गच्छत्यधोमुखम् //
text_mt: He who accepts improper gifts, and likewise one who sacrifices for those unfit to sacrifice, / and the man who makes a living by astrology goes headlong [downwards].

sanskrit_iast: kṣīraṃ surāṃ ca lavaṇaṃ lākṣāṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ tilān evamādīni vikrīṇanghore pūyavahe patet //
meaning: क्षीरं सुरां च लवणं लाक्षां गन्धं रसं तिलान् एवमादीनि विक्रीणन्घोरे पूयवहे पतेत् //
text_mt: One who sells milk, liquor, salt, lac, perfumes, liquids, sesame seeds, / and such things, falls into the terrible Pūyavaha.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kukkuṭānnibadnāti mārjārānsūkarāṃstathā /
pakṣiṇaśca mṛgāñchāgānso 'pyenaṃ narakaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
यः कुक्कुटान्निबद्नाति मार्जारान्सूकरांस्तथा /
पक्षिणश्च मृगाञ्छागान्सो ऽप्येनं नरकं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: He who binds roosters, cats, pigs, / birds, deer, and goats also goes to this hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ajāviko māhiṣikastathā cakradhvajī ca yaḥ /
raṅgopajīvako vipraḥ śākanirgrāmayājakaḥ //
meaning:
अजाविको माहिषिकस्तथा चक्रध्वजी च यः /
रङ्गोपजीवको विप्रः शाकनिर्ग्रामयाजकः //
text_mt: The rearer of goats and sheep, the rearer of buffaloes, the oil-presser or liquor-seller, / the brahmin who lives by the stage, the priest of outcastes or entire villages,

sanskrit_iast:
agāradāhī garadaḥ kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī /
surāpo māsabhakṣaśca tathā ca paśughātakaḥ //
meaning:
अगारदाही गरदः कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयी /
सुरापो मासभक्षश्च तथा च पशुघातकः //
text_mt: an arsonist, a poisoner, one who eats the food of an adulteress's son, a seller of soma, / a drinker of liquor, a meat-eater, and likewise a slaughterer of animals,

sanskrit_iast:
viśastā mahiṣādīnāṃ mṛgahantā tathaiva ca /
parvakāraśca mūcī ca yaśca syānmitraghātakaḥ //
meaning:
विशस्ता महिषादीनां मृगहन्ता तथैव च /
पर्वकारश्च मूची च यश्च स्यान्मित्रघातकः //
text_mt: the butcher of buffaloes and similar beasts, and likewise the killer of deer, / a manufacturer of weapons, a cobbler, and whoever slays a friend—

sanskrit_iast:
rudhirāndhau patantyete hyevamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ /
upaviṣṭaṃ bhoktumatha paṅktyāṃ vai vañcayanti ye //
meaning:
रुधिरान्धौ पतन्त्येते ह्येवमाहुर्मनीषिणः /
उपविष्टं भोक्तुमथ पङ्क्त्यां वै वञ्चयन्ति ये //
text_mt: these fall into Rudhirāndha: so the wise have said. / Furthermore, those who deceive someone who has sat down to eat in a dining line,

sanskrit_iast:
patanti narake ghore viḍbhuje nātra saṃśayaḥ /
mṛṣāvādī naro yaśca tathā prākrośako 'śubhaḥ //
meaning:
पतन्ति नरके घोरे विड्भुजे नात्र संशयः /
मृषावादी नरो यश्च तथा प्राक्रोशको ऽशुभः //
text_mt: fall into the terrible Viḍbhuja hell; of this there is no doubt. / The man who speaks falsehood, and the ill-omened one who continually scolds,

sanskrit_iast:
patate narake ghore mūtrākīrṇe sa pāpakṛta /
madhugrāhābhihantāro yānti vaitagṇīṃ narāḥ //
meaning:
पतते नरके घोरे मूत्राकीर्णे स पापकृत /
मधुग्राहाभिहन्तारो यान्ति वैतग्णीं नराः //
text_mt: that evildoer falls into the terrible hell filled with urine. / Men who destroy beehives to take honey go to Vaitaraṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
unmattāścittabhagnāścaśaucācāravivarjitāḥ /
krodhanā duḥkhadā ye ca kuhakāḥ kṛṣṇagāminaḥ //
meaning:
उन्मत्ताश्चित्तभग्नाश्चशौचाचारविवर्जिताः /
क्रोधना दुःखदा ये च कुहकाः कृष्णगामिनः //
text_mt: The mad, the broken-minded, those devoid of purity and proper conduct, / the wrathful, those who inflict suffering, deceivers, and practitioners of black magic,

sanskrit_iast:
asipatra vanacchadakṛto hyorabhrikāśca ye /
karttanaṣu vikṛtyanta mṛgavyādhaḥ sudāruṇaiḥ //
meaning:
असिपत्र वनच्छदकृतो ह्योरभ्रिकाश्च ये /
कर्त्तनषु विकृत्यन्त मृगव्याधः सुदारुणैः //
text_mt: those who fell trees in the sword-leaf forest, and breeders of sheep / are hacked to pieces by very terrible hunters of wild game.

sanskrit_iast:
āśrama pratyavasitā hyagnijvāle patanti vai /
bhakṣyante śyāmaśabalairayastuḍaśva vāyasaiḥ //
meaning:
आश्रम प्रत्यवसिता ह्यग्निज्वाले पतन्ति वै /
भक्ष्यन्ते श्यामशबलैरयस्तुडश्व वायसैः //
text_mt: Those who have apostatized from their stage of life fall into Agnijvāla; / they are devoured by dark and spotted crows with beaks of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭāpūrtavratālopātsaṃdaṃśe narake patet /
skandante ye divāsvapne vratino brahmacāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
इष्टापूर्तव्रतालोपात्संदंशे नरके पतेत् /
स्कन्दन्ते ये दिवास्वप्ने व्रतिनो ब्रह्मचारिणः //
text_mt: Because of neglecting sacrificial and charitable acts and religious vows, one falls into the Saṃdaṃśa hell; / also those who have taken vows and students of sacred learning who emit semen during daytime sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
putrairadhyāpitā ye ca putrairākṣāpitāśca ye /
te sarva narakaṃ yānti niyataṃ tu śvabhojanam //
meaning:
पुत्रैरध्यापिता ये च पुत्रैराक्षापिताश्च ये /
ते सर्व नरकं यान्ति नियतं तु श्वभोजनम् //
text_mt: Those who are taught by their sons and those who are insulted by their sons— / they all inevitably go to the Śvabhojana hell.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramaviruddhā ye krodhaharṣasamanvitāḥ /
karmāṇi ye tu kurvanti sarve nirayavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धा ये क्रोधहर्षसमन्विताः /
कर्माणि ये तु कुर्वन्ति सर्वे निरयवासिनः //
text_mt: Those opposed to the classes and stages of life, and who, filled with anger and rash delight, / perform deeds—all of them become dwellers of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
upariṣṭātsthito ghora uṣṇātmā rauravo mahān /
sudāruṇastu śītātmā tasyādhastāttapaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपरिष्टात्स्थितो घोर उष्णात्मा रौरवो महान् /
सुदारुणस्तु शीतात्मा तस्याधस्तात्तपः स्मृतः //
text_mt: At the top is situated the terrible, hot Mahāraurava; / and below it, the exceedingly dreadful, cold hell named Tapas is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
evamādikrameṇaiva varṇyamānānnibodhata /
bhūmeradhastātsaptaiva narakāḥ parikīrttitāḥ //
meaning:
एवमादिक्रमेणैव वर्ण्यमानान्निबोधत /
भूमेरधस्तात्सप्तैव नरकाः परिकीर्त्तिताः //
text_mt: Understand these hells as they are described in order, beginning with these: / precisely seven hells are proclaimed below the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
adharmasūtayaste syurandhatāmisrakādayaḥ /
rauravaḥ prathamasteṣāṃ mahāraurava eva ca //
meaning:
अधर्मसूतयस्ते स्युरन्धतामिस्रकादयः /
रौरवः प्रथमस्तेषां महारौरव एव च //
text_mt: They are the offspring of unrighteousness, beginning with Andhatāmisra. / The first of them is Raurava, and Mahāraurava indeed;

sanskrit_iast:
asyādhaḥ punarapyanyaḥ śītastapa iti smṛtaḥ /
tṛtīyaḥ kālasūtraḥ syānmahāhirvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अस्याधः पुनरप्यन्यः शीतस्तप इति स्मृतः /
तृतीयः कालसूत्रः स्यान्महाहिर्विविधः स्मृतः //
text_mt: below this again is another, cold hell, known as Tapas; / the third is Kālasūtra, known for its various great serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
apratiṣṭhaścaturthaḥ syāda vīciḥ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
lohaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ smṛtasteṣāmavidheyastu saptamaḥ //
meaning:
अप्रतिष्ठश्चतुर्थः स्याद वीचिः पञ्चमः स्मृतः /
लोहः षष्ठः स्मृतस्तेषामविधेयस्तु सप्तमः //
text_mt: Apratiṣṭha is the fourth, and Avīci is recorded as the fifth; / Loha is remembered as the sixth among them, and Avidheya as the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
ghorātvādrauravaḥ proktaḥ soṣṇako dahanaḥ smṛtaḥ /
sudāruṇastu śītātmā tsyādhastāttapo 'dhamaḥ //
meaning:
घोरात्वाद्रौरवः प्रोक्तः सोष्णको दहनः स्मृतः /
सुदारुणस्तु शीतात्मा त्स्याधस्तात्तपो ऽधमः //
text_mt: Because of its terror it is called Raurava, and is remembered as hot and burning; / but exceedingly dreadful, cold, and lowest is Tapas below it.

sanskrit_iast:
savāṃ nikṛntanaḥ prokto kālasūtro 'tidāruṇaḥ /
apratiṣṭhe sthitirnāsti bhramastasminsadā smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सवां निकृन्तनः प्रोक्तो कालसूत्रो ऽतिदारुणः /
अप्रतिष्ठे स्थितिर्नास्ति भ्रमस्तस्मिन्सदा स्मृतः //
text_mt: Kālasūtra is proclaimed to be a cutter of all things, exceedingly frightful; / in Apratiṣṭha there is no standing still: perpetual whirling is remembered there.

sanskrit_iast:
avīcirdāruṇaḥ prokto yantrasaṃpīḍanācca saḥ /
tasmātsudāruṇo lohaḥ karmaṇāṃ śrayaṇācca saḥ //
meaning:
अवीचिर्दारुणः प्रोक्तो यन्त्रसंपीडनाच्च सः /
तस्मात्सुदारुणो लोहः कर्मणां श्रयणाच्च सः //
text_mt: Avīci is declared dreadful because of crushing by mechanical presses; / fiercer than that is Loha, because of the burning of deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhūtaśarītvādavidheyastu sa smṛtaḥ /
pīḍābandhavadhāsaṃgādapratīkāralakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तथाभूतशरीत्वादविधेयस्तु स स्मृतः /
पीडाबन्धवधासंगादप्रतीकारलक्षणः //
text_mt: And Avidheya is remembered as having a body of that nature, / characterized by irretrievability because of the continuity of torment, bondage, and slaughter.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrddhvādhaḥ saṃgatāste tu nirālokāśca te smṛtāḥ /
duḥkhotkarṣastu sarveṣu hyadharmasya nimittataḥ //
ūrddhvalokaiḥ samāvetau nirālokau ca tāvubhau /
kūṭāgārapra māṇaiśca śarīraistatra nārakāḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्द्ध्वाधः संगतास्ते तु निरालोकाश्च ते स्मृताः /
दुःखोत्कर्षस्तु सर्वेषु ह्यधर्मस्य निमित्ततः //
ऊर्द्ध्वलोकैः समावेतौ निरालोकौ च तावुभौ /
कूटागारप्र माणैश्च शरीरैस्तत्र नारकाः //
text_mt: They extend above and below, and are remembered as lightless; / the intensity of sorrow in all of them is due to unrighteousness. / Filled with the upper worlds, yet both lightless, / the inhabitants of hell are there with bodies the size of multi-storied mansions.

sanskrit_iast:
upabhogasamarthaistu sadyo jāyanti karmabhiḥ /
duḥkhaprakarṣaścograstu teṣu sarveṣu vai smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपभोगसमर्थैस्तु सद्यो जायन्ति कर्मभिः /
दुःखप्रकर्षश्चोग्रस्तु तेषु सर्वेषु वै स्मृतः //
text_mt: By their deeds they are immediately born with [bodies] capable of undergoing experience; / and the fierce extremity of pain in all of them is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
upabhogasamarthaistu sadyo jāyanti karmabhiḥ /
duḥkhaprakarṣaścograstu teṣu sarveṣu vai smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपभोगसमर्थैस्तु सद्यो जायन्ति कर्मभिः /
दुःखप्रकर्षश्चोग्रस्तु तेषु सर्वेषु वै स्मृतः //
text_mt: By their deeds they are immediately born with [bodies] capable of undergoing experience; / and the fierce extremity of pain in all of them is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
yātanāścāpyasaṃkhyeyā nārakāṇāṃ tathā smṛtāḥ /
tatrānubhūyate duḥkhaṃ kṣīṇe karmaṇi vai punaḥ //
meaning:
यातनाश्चाप्यसंख्येया नारकाणां तथा स्मृताः /
तत्रानुभूयते दुःखं क्षीणे कर्मणि वै पुनः //
text_mt: The torments of the denizens of hell are likewise remembered as innumerable; / sorrow is experienced there, and then, when the deed is exhausted,

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagyonau prasūyante karmaśeṣeṇa teṃ'tataḥ /
devāṃśca tārakāścaiva hyūrddhvaṃ cādhaśca saṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
तिर्यग्योनौ प्रसूयन्ते कर्मशेषेण तेंऽततः /
देवांश्च तारकाश्चैव ह्यूर्द्ध्वं चाधश्च संस्थिताः //
text_mt: they are born at last in an animal womb through the remainder of karma. / And the gods and stars are situated above and below;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmanimittena sadyo jāyanti mūrttayaḥ /
upabhogārthamutpattiraupapattikakarmataḥ //
meaning:
धर्माधर्मनिमित्तेन सद्यो जायन्ति मूर्त्तयः /
उपभोगार्थमुत्पत्तिरौपपत्तिककर्मतः //
text_mt: by reason of righteousness and unrighteousness bodily forms immediately arise; / the birth is for the sake of experiencing [fruits], from karma that produces immediate results.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyanti nārakāndevā hyadhovaktrā hyaghogatān /
nārakāṃśca tathā devānsarvānpaśyaṃ tyadhemukhān //
meaning:
पश्यन्ति नारकान्देवा ह्यधोवक्त्रा ह्यघोगतान् /
नारकांश्च तथा देवान्सर्वान्पश्यं त्यधेमुखान् //
text_mt: The gods see the denizens of hell who have their faces turned downward and have gone downward; / and the denizens of hell likewise see all the gods with their faces turned downward.

sanskrit_iast:
anayostulyatā yasmāddhāramāśca svabhāvataḥ /
tasmādūrddhvamadhobhāvo lokāloke na vidyate //
meaning:
अनयोस्तुल्यता यस्माद्धारमाश्च स्वभावतः /
तस्मादूर्द्ध्वमधोभावो लोकालोके न विद्यते //
text_mt: Because of the equality between these two and the nature of their support, / therefore between the world and non-world there is no true 'above' or 'below'.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā svābhāvikī saṃjñā lokāloke pravarttate /
athābruvanpunarvāyuṃbrāhmaṇāḥ satriṇastadā //
meaning:
एषा स्वाभाविकी संज्ञा लोकालोके प्रवर्त्तते /
अथाब्रुवन्पुनर्वायुंब्राह्मणाः सत्रिणस्तदा //
text_mt: This natural conception prevails in the world and non-world. / Then the brahmins performing the sacrificial session spoke again to Vāyu:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ lokālokanivāsinām /
saṃsāre saṃsarantīha yāvantaḥ prāṇinaśca te //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां लोकालोकनिवासिनाम् /
संसारे संसरन्तीह यावन्तः प्राणिनश्च ते //
text_mt: The sages said: / "Of all the living beings dwelling in the world and non-world, / as many creatures as wander here in saṃsāra—"

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyāyā parisaṃkhyāya tānnaḥ prabrūhi kṛtsnaśaḥ /
ṛṣīṇāṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā maruto vākyamabravīt //
meaning:
संख्याया परिसंख्याय तान्नः प्रब्रूहि कृत्स्नशः /
ऋषीणां तद्वचः श्रुत्वा मरुतो वाक्यमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: having reckoned them completely by number, tell them to us in full.' / Hearing that speech of the ṛṣis, the Wind-god spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca
na śakyaṃ divyayā dṛṣṭyā jñātuṃ jñānena vā punaḥ /
cakṣuṣā vai prasaṃkhyātumato hyante na ca dvijāḥ //
meaning:
वायुरुवाच
न शक्यं दिव्यया दृष्ट्या ज्ञातुं ज्ञानेन वा पुनः /
चक्षुषा वै प्रसंख्यातुमतो ह्यन्ते न च द्विजाः //
text_mt: Vāyu said: / 'O twice-born ones, it is not possible to know or even to reckon by divine sight, or again by knowledge, or with the eye; therefore, there is no end.

sanskrit_iast:
anādhyānādameyatvānnaiva praśno vidhīyate /
brahmaṇā saṃjñitaṃ yattu saṃkhyayā tannibodhata //
meaning:
अनाध्यानादमेयत्वान्नैव प्रश्नो विधीयते /
ब्रह्मणा संज्ञितं यत्तु संख्यया तन्निबोधत //
text_mt: Because it cannot be meditated upon and cannot be measured, no question [concerning it] is prescribed. / But understand what has been designated by number by Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgaḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ bhavediha /
pārthivāḥ kṛmayastāvatsaṃsekādyeṣu saṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
यः सहस्रतमो भागः स्थावराणां भवेदिह /
पार्थिवाः कृमयस्तावत्संसेकाद्येषु संभवः //
text_mt: The thousandth part of what the immovable beings would be here / are the earthly worms whose origin is from moisture and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsekajānāṃ bhāgena sahasreṇaiva saṃmitāḥ /
audakā jantavaḥ sarve niścayāttannidhāryatām //
meaning:
संसेकजानां भागेन सहस्रेणैव संमिताः /
औदका जन्तवः सर्वे निश्चयात्तन्निधार्यताम् //
text_mt: All aquatic creatures are measured by only a thousandth part / of those born of moisture; let that be understood with certainty.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasreṇaiva bhāgena sattvānāṃ salilaukasām /
vihaṅgamāstu vijñeyā laukikāste ca sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रेणैव भागेन सत्त्वानां सलिलौकसाम् /
विहङ्गमास्तु विज्ञेया लौकिकास्ते च सर्वशः //
text_mt: By only a thousandth part of the water-dwelling creatures / are the earthly birds to be known everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgasteṣāṃ vai pakṣimāṃ bhavet /
paśavastatsamā jñeyā laukikāstu catuṣpadāḥ //
meaning:
यः सहस्रतमो भागस्तेषां वै पक्षिमां भवेत् /
पशवस्तत्समा ज्ञेया लौकिकास्तु चतुष्पदाः //
text_mt: The thousandth part of what those birds would be / are to be known as equal to beasts, the earthly four-footed animals.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sahasreṇaiva saṃmitāḥ /
dvipadāstatsahasreṇa saṃmitā dhārmikāḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
चतुष्पदानां सर्वेषां सहस्रेणैव संमिताः /
द्विपदास्तत्सहस्रेण संमिता धार्मिकाः पुनः //
text_mt: Measured by only a thousandth part of all the four-footed animals / are two-footed beings; measured by a thousandth of them, again, are the righteous.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasreṇaiva bhāgena dhārmikebhyo divaṃ gatāḥ /
yaḥ sahasratamo bhāgo dhārmikāṇāṃ bhaveddivi //
meaning:
सहस्रेणैव भागेन धार्मिकेभ्यो दिवं गताः /
यः सहस्रतमो भागो धार्मिकाणां भवेद्दिवि //
text_mt: By only a thousandth part of the righteous are those who have gone to heaven. / The thousandth part of the righteous who would be in heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃmitāstena bhāgena mokṣiṇastāvadeva hi /
svargopapādakaistulyā yātanāsthānavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
संमितास्तेन भागेन मोक्षिणस्तावदेव हि /
स्वर्गोपपादकैस्तुल्या यातनास्थानवासिनः //
text_mt: by just so much a part are those who attain liberation measured. / Equal to those born in heaven are the dwellers in the abode of torment.

sanskrit_iast:
patitādharmavidveṣāddurātmāno mriyanti ye /
raurave tamasi hyete śītoṣṇaṃ prāpnuvanti te //
meaning:
पतिताधर्मविद्वेषाद्दुरात्मानो म्रियन्ति ये /
रौरवे तमसि ह्येते शीतोष्णं प्राप्नुवन्ति ते //
text_mt: Those fallen wicked souls who die out of hatred of righteousness, / in the Raurava darkness indeed they experience cold and heat,

sanskrit_iast:
vedanāḥ kaṭukāḥ stabdhā yātanāsthānamāgatāḥ /
uṣṇastu rauravo jñeyastejoghorarasātmakaḥ //
meaning:
वेदनाः कटुकाः स्तब्धा यातनास्थानमागताः /
उष्णस्तु रौरवो ज्ञेयस्तेजोघोररसात्मकः //
text_mt: arrived at the place of torment with severe, paralyzing pains. / Raurava is known to be hot, consisting of a fierce and fiery nature;

sanskrit_iast:
tatoṃ'dhanāmakaścāpi śītānmā satataṃ tapaḥ /
evaṃ sudurlabhāḥ saṃtaḥ svarge vā dhārmikā narāḥ //
meaning:
ततोंऽधनामकश्चापि शीतान्मा सततं तपः /
एवं सुदुर्लभाः संतः स्वर्गे वा धार्मिका नराः //
text_mt: and then the one named Andha is cold in nature, a constant affliction. / In this way, virtuous men in heaven or righteous people are exceedingly rare.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā saṃjñīkṛtā saṃkhyā ceśvareṇa svayaṃbhuvā /
gaṇānā dinivṛttaiṣā saṃkhyā brāhmī tvamānuṣī //
meaning:
एषा संज्ञीकृता संख्या चेश्वरेण स्वयंभुवा /
गणाना दिनिवृत्तैषा संख्या ब्राह्मी त्वमानुषी //
text_mt: This number was designated by the lord, the Self-born. / Terminating after a day of the gaṇas, this reckoning is divine, not human.'

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
mahāñjanastapaḥ satyo bhūto bhavyo bhavastathā /
uktā hyete tvayā lākā lākānāmantaraṇa ca //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
महाञ्जनस्तपः सत्यो भूतो भव्यो भवस्तथा /
उक्ता ह्येते त्वया लाका लाकानामन्तरण च //
text_mt: The ṛṣis said: / 'Mahas, Janas, Tapas, Satya, Bhūta, Bhavya, and Bhava— / indeed, these worlds have been declared by you, and the interval between the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
lokāntaraṃ ca yādṛk ca tanno brūhi yathā tathā /
teṣāṃ tadvacana śrutvā ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām /
sa vāyurdṛṣṭatattvārtha idaṃ tattvamuvāca ha //
meaning:
लोकान्तरं च यादृक् च तन्नो ब्रूहि यथा तथा /
तेषां तद्वचन श्रुत्वा ऋषीणामूर्द्ध्वरेतसाम् /
स वायुर्दृष्टतत्त्वार्थ इदं तत्त्वमुवाच ह //
text_mt: and what kind the intermediate world is, tell that to us as it is.' / Hearing that speech of those ṛṣis of upward-drawn semen, / that Vāyu, who had seen the true reality, spoke this truth:

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuruvāca
vyaktaṃ tarkeṇa paśyanti yogātpratyakṣadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
वायुरुवाच
व्यक्तं तर्केण पश्यन्ति योगात्प्रत्यक्षदर्शिनः //
text_mt: Vāyu said: / 'Those who perceive directly see the manifest through reasoning, by means of yoga,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyāhāreṇa dhyānena tapasā kṣayamātmanaḥ /
ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ śuddhabuddhayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्याहारेण ध्यानेन तपसा क्षयमात्मनः /
ऋभुः सनत्कुमाराद्याः संबुद्धाः शुद्धबुद्धयः //
text_mt: through withdrawal, meditation, and asceticism, [and attain] the dissolution of the self. / Ṛbhu, Sanatkumāra, and others, fully awakened and of pure intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
vyapetakośā virajāḥ saṃto brahmaiva sattamāḥ /
akṣayāḥ prītisaṃyuktā brāhme tiṣṭhanti yoginaḥ //
meaning:
व्यपेतकोशा विरजाः संतो ब्रह्मैव सत्तमाः /
अक्षयाः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता ब्राह्मे तिष्ठन्ति योगिनः //
text_mt: freed from sheaths, free of passion, being Brahman itself, the best of beings, / imperishable, endowed with bliss, those yogins dwell in the realm of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ bālaśilyānāṃ tairyathākṛtamīśvaraiḥ /
yathātraiva sayā dṛṣṭaṃ sāṃnidhyaṃ tatra kurvatā //
meaning:
ऋषीणां बालशिल्यानां तैर्यथाकृतमीश्वरैः /
यथात्रैव सया दृष्टं सांनिध्यं तत्र कुर्वता //
text_mt: Just as it was performed by those ṛṣis, the Bālakhilyas, by the masters, / just as presence was seen there by him who was doing it right here,

sanskrit_iast:
agrāhyamakṛtārthānāmālayaṃ ceśvarasya yat /
īśvaraḥ paramāṇutvādbhāvagrāhyo manīṣiṇām //
meaning:
अग्राह्यमकृतार्थानामालयं चेश्वरस्य यत् /
ईश्वरः परमाणुत्वाद्भावग्राह्यो मनीषिणाम् //
text_mt: and the abode of the Lord is ungraspable to those who have not achieved their goal. / Because of his infinitesimal subtlety, the Lord is to be grasped by the contemplation of the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ /
draṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbandhamadhiṣṭātṛtvameva ca //
meaning:
ज्ञानं वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं तपः सत्यं क्षमा धृतिः /
द्रष्टृत्वमात्मसंबन्धमधिष्टातृत्वमेव च //
text_mt: Knowledge, dispassion, sovereignty, asceticism, truth, forgiveness, firmness, / the state of being the seer, connection to the self, and being the presiding ruler—

sanskrit_iast:
avyayāni daśaitāni tasmistiṃṣṭhanti śaṅkare /
vibhutvātkhalu yogāḍhyo brahmaṇo 'nugrahe rataḥ //
meaning:
अव्ययानि दशैतानि तस्मिस्तिंष्ठन्ति शङ्करे /
विभुत्वात्खलु योगाढ्यो ब्रह्मणो ऽनुग्रहे रतः //
text_mt: these ten imperishable qualities abide in that Śaṅkara. / Being all-pervading and rich in yoga, he is devoted to the grace of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
sa lokavigraho bhūtvā sāhāyyamupatiṣṭhate /
akṣaraṃ dhruvamavyagramaṣṭamaṃ tvaupasargikam //
meaning:
स लोकविग्रहो भूत्वा साहाय्यमुपतिष्ठते /
अक्षरं ध्रुवमव्यग्रमष्टमं त्वौपसर्गिकम् //
text_mt: Taking a worldly form, he stands by as an aid. / The imperishable, firm, undisturbed, and the eighth is the secondary creation.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyeśvarasya cinmātraṃ sthānaṃ māyāmayaṃ param /
māyayā kṛtamācaṣṭe māyī devo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तस्येश्वरस्य चिन्मात्रं स्थानं मायामयं परम् /
मायया कृतमाचष्टे मायी देवो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: The supreme abode of that Lord, which is pure consciousness, is composed of māyā. / The illusionist god, the great Lord, declares what is made by māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāmupasaṃhārastatpramāṇaṃ hi kīrtyate /
vistareṇānupūrvyā ca bruvato me nibodhata //
meaning:
देवानामुपसंहारस्तत्प्रमाणं हि कीर्त्यते /
विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्या च ब्रुवतो मे निबोधत //
text_mt: The dissolution of the gods and its measurement are indeed proclaimed; / understand from me as I speak in detail and in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśaiva koṭyastu niyutāni daśeṣavaḥ /
bhūlokādbrahmaloko vai yojanaiḥ saṃprakīrtyate //
meaning:
त्रयोदशैव कोट्यस्तु नियुतानि दशेषवः /
भूलोकाद्ब्रह्मलोको वै योजनैः संप्रकीर्त्यते //
text_mt: Thirteen crores and ten hundred thousands [of yojanas] / from the realm of the earth to the world of Brahmā are proclaimed in yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā yojanakoṭī tu pañcāśanniyutāni ca /
ūrddhva bhāgavato 'ḍaṃ tu brahmalokātparaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
एका योजनकोटी तु पञ्चाशन्नियुतानि च /
ऊर्द्ध्व भागवतो ऽडं तु ब्रह्मलोकात्परं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: One crore of yojanas and fifty hundred thousands [above]— / the egg in the upper part beyond the world of Brahmā is remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣorddhvagaḥ pracārastu gatyantaśca tataḥ smṛtaḥ /
nityā hyaparisaṃkṣātāḥ parasparaguṇāśrayāt //
meaning:
एषोर्द्ध्वगः प्रचारस्तु गत्यन्तश्च ततः स्मृतः /
नित्या ह्यपरिसंक्षाताः परस्परगुणाश्रयात् //
text_mt: This is the upward course, and the end of movement is remembered from there. / Eternal indeed and uncalculated from the mutual resting upon qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmāḥ prasavadharmiṇyastataḥ prakṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
yebhyo 'dhikarttā saṃjajñe kṣetrajño brahmasaṃjñitaḥ //
meaning:
सूक्ष्माः प्रसवधर्मिण्यस्ततः प्रकृतयः स्मृताः /
येभ्यो ऽधिकर्त्ता संजज्ञे क्षेत्रज्ञो ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः //
text_mt: subtle, having the nature of production, the material causes are known from that, / from which the master was born, the knower of the field called Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsu prakṛtimatsūkṣmamadhiṣṭhātṛtvamavyayam /
anutpādyaṃ paraṃ dhāma paramāṇu pareśayam //
meaning:
तासु प्रकृतिमत्सूक्ष्ममधिष्ठातृत्वमव्ययम् /
अनुत्पाद्यं परं धाम परमाणु परेशयम् //
text_mt: In them, the subtle, imperishable presiding rulership belongs to the possessor of prakṛti; / it is unproduced, the supreme abode, infinitesimal, resting in the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayaścāpyanūhyaśca tvamūrttirmūrttimānasau /
prādurbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścaivāpyanugrahaḥ //
meaning:
अक्षयश्चाप्यनूह्यश्च त्वमूर्त्तिर्मूर्त्तिमानसौ /
प्रादुर्भावस्तिरोभावः स्थितिश्चैवाप्यनुग्रहः //
text_mt: He is imperishable, unfathomable, formless, and having form; / manifestation, disappearance, maintenance, and grace,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhiranyairanaupamyaḥ paramāṇumaheśvaraḥ /
satejā eṣa tamaso yaḥ purastātprakāśakaḥ //
meaning:
विधिरन्यैरनौपम्यः परमाणुमहेश्वरः /
सतेजा एष तमसो यः पुरस्तात्प्रकाशकः //
text_mt: the rule incomparable to others—the great Lord is infinitesimal; / endowed with splendor, he is the illuminator who is beyond darkness.

sanskrit_iast:
yadaṇḍamāsītsauvarmaṃ prathamaṃ tvaupasargikam /
bṛhattu sarvato vṛttamīśvarāttadvyajāyate //
meaning:
यदण्डमासीत्सौवर्मं प्रथमं त्वौपसर्गिकम् /
बृहत्तु सर्वतो वृत्तमीश्वरात्तद्व्यजायते //
text_mt: The egg which was golden, the first among secondary creations, / large and round on every side, was born from the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarādbījanirbhedaḥ kṣetrajño bījamiṣyate /
yoniṃ prakṛti mācaṣṭe sā ca nārāyaṇātmikā //
meaning:
ईश्वराद्बीजनिर्भेदः क्षेत्रज्ञो बीजमिष्यते /
योनिं प्रकृति माचष्टे सा च नारायणात्मिका //
text_mt: The sprouting of the seed is from the Lord; the knower of the field is regarded as the seed. / Nature is called the womb, and it has the nature of Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhurlokasya sṛṣṭyarthaṃ lokasaṃsthānameva ca /
sannisargaḥ satattvācca lokadhāturmahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
विभुर्लोकस्य सृष्ट्यर्थं लोकसंस्थानमेव च /
सन्निसर्गः सतत्त्वाच्च लोकधातुर्महात्मनः //
text_mt: For the purpose of creating the universe and establishing the worlds, the all-pervading Lord [acts]; / the creation of the great-souled creator of the world is true to reality.

sanskrit_iast:
purastādbrahmalokasya hyaṇḍādarvāk ca brahmaṇaḥ /
tyormadhye puraṃ divyaṃ mana mayamanāmayam //
meaning:
पुरस्ताद्ब्रह्मलोकस्य ह्यण्डादर्वाक् च ब्रह्मणः /
त्योर्मध्ये पुरं दिव्यं मन मयमनामयम् //
text_mt: In front of the world of Brahmā and this side of the cosmic egg of Brahmā, / between the two is a divine city, composed of mind, free from sickness.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvigrahavataḥ sthānamīśvarasyāmitaujasaḥ /
śivaṃ nāma puraṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ janmabhīruṇām //
meaning:
तद्विग्रहवतः स्थानमीश्वरस्यामितौजसः /
शिवं नाम पुरं तत्र शरणं जन्मभीरुणाम् //
text_mt: That is the abode of the embodied Lord of boundless splendor; / the city named Śiva is there, a refuge for those who fear rebirth.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ /
abhyantaraṃ tu vistīrṇaṃ mahīmaṇḍalasaṃsthitam //
meaning:
सहस्राणां शतं पूर्वं योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः /
अभ्यन्तरं तु विस्तीर्णं महीमण्डलसंस्थितम् //
text_mt: First a hundred thousand yojanas, O best of the twice-born, / its interior is vast, resting upon the circle of the earth,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhnārkaprakāśena paratejo 'bhimardinā /
śāta kaiṃbhena mahatā prākāreṇārkavarcasā //
meaning:
मध्याह्नार्कप्रकाशेन परतेजो ऽभिमर्दिना /
शात कैंभेन महता प्राकारेणार्कवर्चसा //
text_mt: having the radiance of the midday sun, crushing the splendor of others, / with a great rampart made of gold, brilliant as the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraiścaturbhiḥ sauvarṇairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ /
tapanīyanibhaiḥ śubhrairgāḍhaṃ sukṛtaveṣṭanam //
meaning:
द्वारैश्चतुर्भिः सौवर्णैर्मुक्तादामविभूषितैः /
तपनीयनिभैः शुभ्रैर्गाढं सुकृतवेष्टनम् //
text_mt: with four golden gates adorned with strings of pearls, / resembling molten gold, white, firmly and well enclosed.

sanskrit_iast:
taccākāśe puraṃ ramyaṃ divyaṃ ghaṇṭādināditam /
ramye puravaraśreṣṭhe tasminvaihāyabhūmiṣu //
meaning:
तच्चाकाशे पुरं रम्यं दिव्यं घण्टादिनादितम् /
रम्ये पुरवरश्रेष्ठे तस्मिन्वैहायभूमिषु //
text_mt: And that charming, divine city in the sky resounds with bells and the like; / in that charming, foremost of excellent cities, on grounds in the air,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnavicitreṣu patākābahuleṣu ca /
sarvakāmasamṛddheṣu vanopavanaśobhiṣu //
meaning:
नानारत्नविचित्रेषु पताकाबहुलेषु च /
सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु वनोपवनशोभिषु //
text_mt: variegated with various gems, abundant with flags, / prosperous with all desires, adorned with groves and parks,

sanskrit_iast:
rājateṣu gṛhānteṣu śātakaiṃbhamayeṣu ca /
saṃdhyābhrasannikāśeṣu kailāsapratimeṣu ca //
meaning:
राजतेषु गृहान्तेषु शातकैंभमयेषु च /
संध्याभ्रसन्निकाशेषु कैलासप्रतिमेषु च //
text_mt: in silver and golden houses, / resembling evening clouds, like Mount Kailāsa,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛṣṭaiḥ śabdādibhirbhogairye bhaviṣyānusāriṇaḥ /
prāsādavarapṛṣṭheṣu teṣu modanti suvratāḥ //
meaning:
हृष्टैः शब्दादिभिर्भोगैर्ये भविष्यानुसारिणः /
प्रासादवरपृष्ठेषु तेषु मोदन्ति सुव्रताः //
text_mt: men of good vows who pursue the future rejoice on the roofs of those excellent palaces / through delighted pleasures of sound and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaghoṣairaviratāḥ kathāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ /
gītavāditraghoṣāśca saṃsravāśca samantataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मघोषैरविरताः कथाश्च विविधाः शुभाः /
गीतवादित्रघोषाश्च संस्रवाश्च समन्ततः //
text_mt: There are unceasing Vedic chants and various auspicious recitations, / sounds of songs and musical instruments, and recitations on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhatāścaivamatulā janāśrayakṛtastathā /
evamādīni vartante teṣāṃ prāsādamūrddhani //
meaning:
संहताश्चैवमतुला जनाश्रयकृतस्तथा /
एवमादीनि वर्तन्ते तेषां प्रासादमूर्द्धनि //
text_mt: dense and unequaled, made as a refuge for people; / such things and more take place on the tops of their palaces.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrapādaḥ prāsādastapanīyamayaḥ śubhaḥ /
anaupamyairvarai ratnaiḥ sarvataḥ saṃvibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रपादः प्रासादस्तपनीयमयः शुभः /
अनौपम्यैर्वरै रत्नैः सर्वतः संविभूषितः //
text_mt: The auspicious palace has a thousand pillars, made of refined gold, / decorated all around with matchless, supreme jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
sphāṭikaiścandrasaṃkāśairvaiḍūryamaṇisaprabhaiḥ /
bālasuryamayaiścāpi sauvarṇaiścāgnisaprabhaiḥ //
meaning:
स्फाटिकैश्चन्द्रसंकाशैर्वैडूर्यमणिसप्रभैः /
बालसुर्यमयैश्चापि सौवर्णैश्चाग्निसप्रभैः //
text_mt: with crystals resembling the moon, with lapis lazuli gemstones shining brightly, / with others resembling the morning sun, and golden ones gleaming like fire.

sanskrit_iast:
cukruśurmunayaḥ śrutvā naimiṣeyāstapasvinaḥ /
āpannasaṃśayāścemaṃ vākyamūcuḥ samīraṇam //
meaning:
चुक्रुशुर्मुनयः श्रुत्वा नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः /
आपन्नसंशयाश्चेमं वाक्यमूचुः समीरणम् //
text_mt: Hearing this, the ascetic sages, the inhabitants of Naimiṣa, cried out; / beset with doubt, they addressed this speech to the Wind:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ke tu tatra mahātmāno ye bhavasyānusāriṇaḥ /
anugrāhyatamāḥ samyakpramodante purottame //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
के तु तत्र महात्मानो ये भवस्यानुसारिणः /
अनुग्राह्यतमाः सम्यक्प्रमोदन्ते पुरोत्तमे //
text_mt: The sages said: / Who are those great-souled followers of Bhava there / who, most worthy of grace, rejoice fully in that excellent city?

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā vāyurvākyamudairayat /
vāyuruvāca
śrūyatāṃ devadevasya bhaktiryairanukalpitā //
meaning:
ऋषीणां वचनं श्रुत्वा वायुर्वाक्यमुदैरयत् /
वायुरुवाच
श्रूयतां देवदेवस्य भक्तिर्यैरनुकल्पिता //
text_mt: Hearing the words of the sages, Vāyu delivered this speech. / Vāyu said: / Hear about those by whom devotion to the God of gods has been cultivated.

sanskrit_iast:
hrīmantasphūrjitā dāntāḥ śauryayuktā hyalolupāḥ /
karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā //
meaning:
ह्रीमन्तस्फूर्जिता दान्ताः शौर्ययुक्ता ह्यलोलुपाः /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना //
text_mt: Endowed with modesty, radiant, self-restrained, courageous, and free from greed, / with action, thought, and speech, and with a purified inner self,

sanskrit_iast:
ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapannā ye maheśvaram /
tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam //
meaning:
अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा प्रपन्ना ये महेश्वरम् /
तैर्लब्धं रुद्रसालोक्यं शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् //
text_mt: having become single-minded, those who take refuge in Maheśvara / obtain co-residence with Rudra, the eternal, imperishable abode.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavasya rūpasādṛśyaṃ gatāścaiva hyanuttamam /
vaiśvānāramukhāḥ sarve viśvarūpāḥ kapardinaḥ //
meaning:
भवस्य रूपसादृश्यं गताश्चैव ह्यनुत्तमम् /
वैश्वानारमुखाः सर्वे विश्वरूपाः कपर्दिनः //
text_mt: They attain matchless resemblance to the form of Bhava: / all having faces like fire, universal forms, and matted hair;

sanskrit_iast:
nīlakaṇṭhāḥ śitagrīvāstīkṣṇadaṃṣṭāstrilocanāḥ /
arddhacandrakṛtoṣṇīṣā jaṭāmukuṭa dhāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
नीलकण्ठाः शितग्रीवास्तीक्ष्णदंष्टास्त्रिलोचनाः /
अर्द्धचन्द्रकृतोष्णीषा जटामुकुट धारिणः //
text_mt: blue-necked, dark-throated, sharp-toothed, three-eyed, / wearing crests shaped like the crescent moon, and wearing diadems of matted locks;

sanskrit_iast:
sarve daśabhujā vīrāḥ padmāntarasugandhinaḥ /
taruṇādityasaṃkāśāḥ sarve te pītavāsasaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे दशभुजा वीराः पद्मान्तरसुगन्धिनः /
तरुणादित्यसंकाशाः सर्वे ते पीतवाससः //
text_mt: all ten-armed heroes, fragrant like the center of a lotus, / resembling the morning sun, and all wearing yellow garments;

sanskrit_iast:
pinākapāṇayaḥ sarveśveta govṛṣavāhanāḥ /
śriyānvitāḥ kuṇḍalino muktāhāravibhūṣitāḥ //
meaning:
पिनाकपाणयः सर्वेश्वेत गोवृषवाहनाः /
श्रियान्विताः कुण्डलिनो मुक्ताहारविभूषिताः //
text_mt: all holding Pināka bows in hand, mounted on white bullocks, / endowed with splendor, wearing earrings, adorned with pearl necklaces;

sanskrit_iast:
tejasābhyadhikairdahaiḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ /
vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ //
meaning:
तेजसाभ्यधिकैर्दहैः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः /
विभज्य बहुधात्मानं जरामृत्युविवर्जिताः //
text_mt: omniscient, all-seeing, with bodies superior in splendor; / dividing themselves into many, free from old age and death;

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍante vividhairbhāvairbhogānprāpya sudurlabhān /
svacchandagatayaḥ siddhāḥ siddhaiścanyairvibodhitāḥ //
meaning:
क्रीडन्ते विविधैर्भावैर्भोगान्प्राप्य सुदुर्लभान् /
स्वच्छन्दगतयः सिद्धाः सिद्धैश्चन्यैर्विबोधिताः //
text_mt: moving at will, perfected, awakened by other perfected beings, / they sport with various emotions after obtaining pleasures very hard to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ koṭyo naikā mahātmanām /
ebhiḥ saha mahātmā vai devadevo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
एकादशानां रुद्राणां कोट्यो नैका महात्मनाम् /
एभिः सह महात्मा वै देवदेवो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: There are many crores of the eleven great-souled Rudras. / Together with these, the great-souled Maheśvara, the God of gods,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavānmodate pārvatīpriyaḥ /
nāhaṃ teṣāṃ tu rudrāṇāṃ bhavasya ca mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
भक्तानुकंपी भगवान्मोदते पार्वतीप्रियः /
नाहं तेषां तु रुद्राणां भवस्य च महात्मनः //
text_mt: compassionate to his devotees, the beloved of Pārvatī, the Blessed One rejoices. / I do not see any difference between those Rudras

sanskrit_iast:
nānātvamanupaśyāmi satyametadbravīmi vaḥ /
mātāriśvābravītpuṇyamityetāmīśvarācchrutām //
meaning:
नानात्वमनुपश्यामि सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वः /
मातारिश्वाब्रवीत्पुण्यमित्येतामीश्वराच्छ्रुताम् //
text_mt: and the great-souled Bhava; this truth I speak to you. / Mātariśvan spoke this sacred [truth] heard from the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
atha te ṛṣayaḥ sarve divākarasamaprabhāḥ /
śrutvemāṃ paramāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ traiyaṃbakīntataḥ //
meaning:
अथ ते ऋषयः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः /
श्रुत्वेमां परमां पुण्यां कथां त्रैयंबकीन्ततः //
text_mt: Then all those sages, possessing splendor equal to the sun, / having heard this supreme, sacred account concerning Tryambaka,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛśaṃ cānugrahaṃ prāpya harṣaṃ caivāpyanuttamam /
saṃbhājayitvā cāpyenaṃ vāyumūcurmahābalam //
meaning:
भृशं चानुग्रहं प्राप्य हर्षं चैवाप्यनुत्तमम् /
संभाजयित्वा चाप्येनं वायुमूचुर्महाबलम् //
text_mt: attained intense grace and matchless joy; / and having honored the mighty Vāyu, they spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
samīraṇa mahābhāga tvasmākaṃ ca tvayā vibho /
īśvarasyottamaṃ puṇyamaṣṭamaṃ tvaupasārgikam //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
समीरण महाभाग त्वस्माकं च त्वया विभो /
ईश्वरस्योत्तमं पुण्यमष्टमं त्वौपसार्गिकम् //
text_mt: The sages said: / O illustrious Wind, O pervasive one, by you our Lord’s / supreme, sacred eighth superinduced [manifestation]

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca cathāvatparikīrtitam /
yogadharmasamṛddhaṃ vai paramaṃ paramātmanaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य स्थानं प्रमाणं च चथावत्परिकीर्तितम् /
योगधर्मसमृद्धं वै परमं परमात्मनः //
text_mt: and its location and extent have been properly proclaimed— / that supreme [state] of the Supreme Self, abundant in the dharma of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasya māhātmyaṃ durvijñeyaṃ surairapi /
svena māhātmyayogena sahasrasyāmitaujasaḥ //
meaning:
महादेवस्य माहात्म्यं दुर्विज्ञेयं सुरैरपि /
स्वेन माहात्म्ययोगेन सहस्रस्यामितौजसः //
text_mt: The greatness of Mahādeva of boundless splendor is hard to understand even for the gods; / by the yoga of his own majesty, of the thousandfold one,

sanskrit_iast:
yasya bhaktaṃṣu saṃmoho hyanukaṃpārthameva ca /
brāhmī lakṣmyā svayaṃ juṣṭā yā sāpratimaśālinī //
meaning:
यस्य भक्तंषु संमोहो ह्यनुकंपार्थमेव च /
ब्राह्मी लक्ष्म्या स्वयं जुष्टा या साप्रतिमशालिनी //
text_mt: whose infatuation for his devotees is solely for the sake of compassion, / that matchless, splendid [manifestation] which is itself attended by divine Fortune,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpyajyotsneva candrasya vinyastā viśvarūpiṇaḥ /
vibhūtirbhrājate 'tyarthaṃ devadevasya veśmani //
meaning:
व्याप्यज्योत्स्नेव चन्द्रस्य विन्यस्ता विश्वरूपिणः /
विभूतिर्भ्राजते ऽत्यर्थं देवदेवस्य वेश्मनि //
text_mt: pervading like the moonlight of the moon, arranged by the Universal-formed One— / that glory shines exceedingly in the abode of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevasya tulyānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ tu mahātmanām /
tatsarvaṃ nikhilenedaṃ vaktrādamṛtanisravaḥ //
meaning:
महादेवस्य तुल्यानां रुद्राणां तु महात्मनाम् /
तत्सर्वं निखिलेनेदं वक्त्रादमृतनिस्रवः //
text_mt: Of the great-souled Rudras who are equal to Mahādeva, / all this, a stream of nectar from your mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
āpītaṃ khalu śarvasya bhaktyāsmābhistu suvrata /
nāsti kiñcidavijñeya manyaccaivānugāminaḥ /
praśnaṃ devavaraprāṇa yathāvadvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
आपीतं खलु शर्वस्य भक्त्यास्माभिस्तु सुव्रत /
नास्ति किञ्चिदविज्ञेय मन्यच्चैवानुगामिनः /
प्रश्नं देववरप्राण यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: has indeed been drunk through devotion to Śarva by us, O you of noble vows! / There is nothing unknown [to you]; you ought to speak properly, O vital breath of the best of gods, / to this other question of [us,] your followers:

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sa khalūvāca bhagavānkiṃ bhūyo varttayāmyaham /
yanmayā caiva vaktavyaṃ tadvadiṣyāmi suvratāḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
स खलूवाच भगवान्किं भूयो वर्त्तयाम्यहम् /
यन्मया चैव वक्तव्यं तद्वदिष्यामि सुव्रताः //
text_mt: The bard said: / The Blessed One indeed said: “What further should I describe? / Whatever is to be spoken by me, that I shall declare, O you of noble vows!”

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
ādityāḥ paripārśve ye siṃhā vai krodhavikramāḥ /
vaiśvānarā bhūtagaṇa vyāghrāscaivānugāminaḥ //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
आदित्याः परिपार्श्वे ये सिंहा वै क्रोधविक्रमाः /
वैश्वानरा भूतगण व्याघ्रास्चैवानुगामिनः //
text_mt: The sages said: / The Ādityas at his sides, the lions of wrathful valor, / the fires, the hosts of spirits, and the attendant tigers—

sanskrit_iast:
ābhutasaṃplave ghore sarvaprāṇibhṛtāṃ kṣaye /
kimāvasthā bhavantyete tanno brūhi yathārthavat //
meaning:
आभुतसंप्लवे घोरे सर्वप्राणिभृतां क्षये /
किमावस्था भवन्त्येते तन्नो ब्रूहि यथार्थवत् //
text_mt: in the terrible inundation of all beings, at the destruction of all living creatures, / in what condition do they remain? Tell us that according to the truth,

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāyeśvarasadbhāvamavyaktaṃ prabhavaṃ tathā /
vāyuruvāca
yatra pūrvaṃ gatāste tu kumārā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
विज्ञायेश्वरसद्भावमव्यक्तं प्रभवं तथा /
वायुरुवाच
यत्र पूर्वं गतास्ते तु कुमारा ब्रह्मणः सुताः //
text_mt: having understood the true nature of the Lord and the unmanifest source. / Vāyu said: / Where those Kumāras, the sons of Brahmā, previously went—

sanskrit_iast:
sanandanaśca sanakastṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ /
voḍhuśca kapilasteṣāmāsuriśca mahāyaśāḥ //
meaning:
सनन्दनश्च सनकस्तृतीयश्च सनातनः /
वोढुश्च कपिलस्तेषामासुरिश्च महायशाः //
text_mt: Sanandana, Sanaka, and third Sanātana, / and Voḍhu, and Kapila, and the highly renowned Āsuri among them,

sanskrit_iast:
muniḥ pañjaśikhaścaiva ye cānye 'pyevamādayaḥ /
tataḥ kāle vyatikrānte kalpānāṃ paryaye gate //
meaning:
मुनिः पञ्जशिखश्चैव ये चान्ये ऽप्येवमादयः /
ततः काले व्यतिक्रान्ते कल्पानां पर्यये गते //
text_mt: and the sage Pañcaśikha, and whichever others are of this kind— / then, when time has elapsed, when the cycle of kalpas has passed,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūtavināśānte pralaye pratyupasthite /
anekarudrakoṭyastu yā prasannā maheśvarīm //
meaning:
महाभूतविनाशान्ते प्रलये प्रत्युपस्थिते /
अनेकरुद्रकोट्यस्तु या प्रसन्ना महेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: when the dissolution ending in the destruction of the great elements has arrived, / the many crores of Rudras, however, who are devoted to the Great Goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
śabdādīnviṣayānbhogānsaṃtyajyāṣṭavidhāśrayāt /
praviśya sarvabhūtāni jñānayuktena tejasā //
meaning:
शब्दादीन्विषयान्भोगान्संत्यज्याष्टविधाश्रयात् /
प्रविश्य सर्वभूतानि ज्ञानयुक्तेन तेजसा //
text_mt: having abandoned the sensory objects such as sound and pleasures from the eightfold resort, / having entered all beings with splendor endowed with knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
vihāya padamavyagraṃ bhūtānāma nukaṃpayā /
tatra yānti mahātmānaḥ paramāṇuṃ maheśvaram //
meaning:
विहाय पदमव्यग्रं भूतानाम नुकंपया /
तत्र यान्ति महात्मानः परमाणुं महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: having abandoned the unperturbed state out of compassion for living beings, / there those great-souled ones go to the supreme, subtle Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
taranti sumahāvarttāṃ janmamṛtyūdakāṃ nadīm /
tataḥ paśyantyaparvāṇaṃ paraṃ brahmāṇāmeva ca //
meaning:
तरन्ति सुमहावर्त्तां जन्ममृत्यूदकां नदीम् /
ततः पश्यन्त्यपर्वाणं परं ब्रह्माणामेव च //
text_mt: They cross the river whose water is birth and death, full of great whirlpools; / then they behold the whole, supreme Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
devyā vai sahitāḥ sapta yā devyaḥ parikīrttitāḥ /
yattatsahasraṃ siṃhānāmādityānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
देव्या वै सहिताः सप्त या देव्यः परिकीर्त्तिताः /
यत्तत्सहस्रं सिंहानामादित्यानां तथैव च //
text_mt: Together with the Goddess, those seven goddesses who are proclaimed, / and that thousand of lions, and likewise of Ādityas,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānarā bhūtagaṇā vyāghrāścaivānugāminaḥ /
āveśyātmani tānsarvān saṃkhyāyogyabhavāṃstathā //
meaning:
वैश्वानरा भूतगणा व्याघ्राश्चैवानुगामिनः /
आवेश्यात्मनि तान्सर्वान् संख्यायोग्यभवांस्तथा //
text_mt: the fires, the hosts of spirits, and the attendant tigers— / having absorbed all of them into himself, and likewise the beings eligible for enumeration,

sanskrit_iast:
lokānsapta imānbhūyo mahābhūtāni pañca ca /
viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ karoti vikaroti ca //
meaning:
लोकान्सप्त इमान्भूयो महाभूतानि पञ्च च /
विष्णुना सह संयुक्तः करोति विकरोति च //
text_mt: these seven worlds again, and the five great elements, / joined with Viṣṇu, he creates and transforms.

sanskrit_iast:
sa rudro yaḥ sāmamayastathaiva ca yajurmayaḥ /
sa eṣa otaḥ protaśca bahirantaśca niścayāt //
meaning:
स रुद्रो यः साममयस्तथैव च यजुर्मयः /
स एष ओतः प्रोतश्च बहिरन्तश्च निश्चयात् //
text_mt: He is Rudra who consists of the Sāmaveda and likewise consists of the Yajurveda; / he is warp and woof, definitively outside and inside.

sanskrit_iast:
eko hi bhagavānnāthaḥ prabhavaścāntakṛddvijāḥ /
tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve divākarasamaprabhāḥ //
meaning:
एको हि भगवान्नाथः प्रभवश्चान्तकृद्द्विजाः /
ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे दिवाकरसमप्रभाः //
text_mt: For the Blessed One is the one protector, the origin and the bringer of the end, O twice-born ones! / Then all those sages, possessing splendor equal to the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
susatyaṃ śravasaḥ samyagāropyāgniṃ tathātmani /
karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā //
meaning:
सुसत्यं श्रवसः सम्यगारोप्याग्निं तथात्मनि /
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना //
text_mt: truly hearing [this], properly depositing the sacred fire within themselves, / with action, thought, and speech, and with a purified inner self,

sanskrit_iast:
ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapadyante maheśvaram /
vratopavāsaniratāḥ sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ //
meaning:
अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा प्रपद्यन्ते महेश्वरम् /
व्रतोपवासनिरताः सर्वभूतदयापराः //
text_mt: having become single-minded, take refuge in Maheśvara, / intent on vows and fasts, devoted to compassion for all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
yogaṃ tvanuyamaṃ divyaṃ prāptantaiśchinnasaṃśayaiḥ /
prapadya parayā bhaktyājñānayuktena tejasā //
meaning:
योगं त्वनुयमं दिव्यं प्राप्तन्तैश्छिन्नसंशयैः /
प्रपद्य परया भक्त्याज्ञानयुक्तेन तेजसा //
text_mt: Attaining divine yoga and restraint, their doubts dispelled, / having taken refuge with supreme devotion, with splendor endowed with knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam /
yaḥ paṭhettapasā yukto vāyuproktāmimāṃ śrutim //
meaning:
तैर्लब्धं रुद्रसालोक्यं शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् /
यः पठेत्तपसा युक्तो वायुप्रोक्तामिमां श्रुतिम् //
text_mt: they obtain co-residence with Rudra, the eternal, imperishable abode. / Whoever, endowed with asceticism, recites this sacred revelation proclaimed by Vāyu,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpivaiśyo vā svakriyāparaḥ /
labhate rudralokaṃ vai kāraṇaṃ lokakāraṇam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वापिवैश्यो वा स्वक्रियापरः /
लभते रुद्रलोकं वै कारणं लोककारणम् //
text_mt: whether a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya intent on his own duties, / obtains the world of Rudra, the cause, the cause of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
vinivṛtte tadā sarge prakṛtyā vasthitena vai /
tadātyantaparokṣatvādadṛṣṭatvācca kasyacit //
meaning:
विनिवृत्ते तदा सर्गे प्रकृत्या वस्थितेन वै /
तदात्यन्तपरोक्षत्वाददृष्टत्वाच्च कस्यचित् //
text_mt: When the creation has then ceased, remaining in its primordial material cause, / because it is completely beyond perception then, and not seen by anyone,

sanskrit_iast:
anākhyānādabodhyatvādajñānājjñānināmapi /
āgatāgatikatvācca grahaṇaṃ tanna vidyate //
meaning:
अनाख्यानादबोध्यत्वादज्ञानाज्ज्ञानिनामपि /
आगतागतिकत्वाच्च ग्रहणं तन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: because it cannot be expressed, cannot be comprehended, and is unknown even to the wise, / and because of its arriving and departing nature, it cannot be grasped.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvagrāhyānumānācca cintayitvedamucyate /
sthite tu kāraṇe tasminnitye sadasadātmake //
meaning:
भावग्राह्यानुमानाच्च चिन्तयित्वेदमुच्यते /
स्थिते तु कारणे तस्मिन्नित्ये सदसदात्मके //
text_mt: And from inference grasped through existing states, having reflected, this is said: / When that eternal cause, consisting of being and non-being, remains,

sanskrit_iast:
anirdeśye pravṛttirvai svātmikākāraṇena tu /
evaṃ saptadvirabhyastāḥ kramātprakṛtayastu vai //
meaning:
अनिर्देश्ये प्रवृत्तिर्वै स्वात्मिकाकारणेन तु /
एवं सप्तद्विरभ्यस्ताः क्रमात्प्रकृतयस्तु वै //
text_mt: Indefinable, its activity indeed belongs to its own nature through its own cause. / Thus the seven primary elements, taken twofold in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyāhāre tadā sarge praviśanti parasparam /
yenedamāvṛtaṃ sarvamaṇḍamapsu pralīyate //
meaning:
प्रत्याहारे तदा सर्गे प्रविशन्ति परस्परम् /
येनेदमावृतं सर्वमण्डमप्सु प्रलीयते //
text_mt: Enter into one another at the time of withdrawal during creation. / That by which this whole cosmic egg is enveloped dissolves into the waters,

sanskrit_iast:
saptadvīpasamudrāntaṃ saptalokaṃ saparvatam /
udakāvaraṇaṃ yacca jyotiṣyālīyate tu yat //
meaning:
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तं सप्तलोकं सपर्वतम् /
उदकावरणं यच्च ज्योतिष्यालीयते तु यत् //
text_mt: Together with its seven continents, oceans, seven worlds, and mountains. / And that sheath of water dissolves into fire;

sanskrit_iast:
yattejasaṃ cāvaraṇaṃ māruto grasate nu yat /
yadvāyavyaṃ cāvaraṇamākāśagrasate tu tat //
meaning:
यत्तेजसं चावरणं मारुतो ग्रसते नु यत् /
यद्वायव्यं चावरणमाकाशग्रसते तु तत् //
text_mt: And that sheath of fire the wind then swallows; / And that sheath consisting of wind space then swallows;

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśāvaraṇaṃ yacca bhūtādirgrasate tu tat /
bhūtādiṃ grasate cāpi mahānvai buddhilakṣamaḥ //
meaning:
आकाशावरणं यच्च भूतादिर्ग्रसते तु तत् /
भूतादिं ग्रसते चापि महान्वै बुद्धिलक्षमः //
text_mt: And that sheath of space the origin of the elements then swallows; / And the origin of the elements the cosmic intellect, characterized by intelligence, swallows;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāntaṃ grasate 'vyaktaṃ guṇasāmyaṃ tataḥ param /
etau saṃhāravistārau brahmā vyaktau tataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
महान्तं ग्रसते ऽव्यक्तं गुणसाम्यं ततः परम् /
एतौ संहारविस्तारौ ब्रह्मा व्यक्तौ ततः पुनः //
text_mt: The unmanifest swallows the cosmic intellect; beyond that is the equilibrium of the gunas. / These two, dissolution and expansion, Brahmā [produces] again from the manifest;

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjate grasate caiva vikārātsargasaṃyame /
saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇāḥ saṃsiddhā jñāninastu ye //
meaning:
सृजते ग्रसते चैव विकारात्सर्गसंयमे /
संसिद्धकार्यकरणाः संसिद्धा ज्ञानिनस्तु ये //
text_mt: He emits and swallows [them] from modifications during the creation and dissolution. / But those wise ones whose organs and actions are perfected, who have attained perfection,

sanskrit_iast:
gatvā javaṃ javībhāve sthāne sveṣu prasaṃyamāt /
pratyāhāre 'dhiyujyante kṣetrajñāḥ karaṇaiḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
गत्वा जवं जवीभावे स्थाने स्वेषु प्रसंयमात् /
प्रत्याहारे ऽधियुज्यन्ते क्षेत्रज्ञाः करणैः पुनः //
text_mt: Having attained speed in the state of swiftness in their own places due to complete restraint, / In the withdrawal, the field-knowers are again joined with the organs.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ kṣetramityāhurbrahmā kṣetrajña ucyate /
sādharmyavaidharmyakṛtaḥ saṃyogo nādimāstayoḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमित्याहुर्ब्रह्मा क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते /
साधर्म्यवैधर्म्यकृतः संयोगो नादिमास्तयोः //
text_mt: They say the unmanifest is the field; Brahmā is called the field-knower. / Their connection, caused by similarity and dissimilarity, has no beginning.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sargeṣu vijñeyaḥ kṣetrajñeṣviha brāhmaṇāḥ /
brahmaviccaiva vijñeyaḥ kṣetrajñānātpṛthak //
meaning:
एवं सर्गेषु विज्ञेयः क्षेत्रज्ञेष्विह ब्राह्मणाः /
ब्रह्मविच्चैव विज्ञेयः क्षेत्रज्ञानात्पृथक् //
text_mt: Thus it should be understood among creations, O brahmins, with regard to the field-knowers here; / And the knower of Brahman should be known as distinct from the field-knower.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayāviṣayatvaṃ ca kṣetrakṣetrajñayoḥ smṛtam /
brahmā tvaviṣayo jñeyo viṣayaḥ kṣetramucyate //
meaning:
विषयाविषयत्वं च क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोः स्मृतम् /
ब्रह्मा त्वविषयो ज्ञेयो विषयः क्षेत्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: The state of being an object and a non-object is traditionally taught of the field and the field-knower: / Brahmā should be known as the non-object, while the field is called the object.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñārthaṃ pracakṣate /
bahutvācca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīrī bahudhā smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञार्थं प्रचक्षते /
बहुत्वाच्च शरीराणां शरीरी बहुधा स्मृतः //
text_mt: The field, presided over by the field-knower, is said to be for the sake of the field-knower; / And on account of the plurality of bodies, the embodied self is remembered as manifold.

sanskrit_iast:
avyūhāśaṅkarāccaiva jyotiryacca vyavasthitam /
yasmātpratiśarīraṃ hi sukhaduḥkho palabdhitā //
meaning:
अव्यूहाशङ्कराच्चैव ज्योतिर्यच्च व्यवस्थितम् /
यस्मात्प्रतिशरीरं हि सुखदुःखो पलब्धिता //
text_mt: And because there is no aggregate mixture, the light remains [distinct]; / For in every body there is the experience of pleasure and pain.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpuruṣanānātvaṃ vijñeyaṃ tu vijānatā /
yadā pravarttate caiṣāṃ bhedānāṃ caiva saṃyamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्पुरुषनानात्वं विज्ञेयं तु विजानता /
यदा प्रवर्त्तते चैषां भेदानां चैव संयमः //
