text_mt: Therefore the plurality of puruṣas must indeed be understood by one who discerns. / And when the dissolution of these distinctions takes place,

sanskrit_iast:
svabhāvakāritāḥ sarve kālena mahatā tadā /
nivarttante tadā tasminsthitarāgāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
स्वभावकारिताः सर्वे कालेन महता तदा /
निवर्त्तन्ते तदा तस्मिन्स्थितरागाः स्वयंभुवः //
text_mt: All brought about by their own nature over a long time, / Then the Svayambhus whose desires have ceased return into that [cause].

sanskrit_iast:
saha sāyujyakaiḥ sarvairbrahmalokanivāsibhiḥ /
vinivṛttestadā teṣāṃ sthiterātmanivāsinām //
meaning:
सह सायुज्यकैः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिभिः /
विनिवृत्तेस्तदा तेषां स्थितेरात्मनिवासिनाम् //
text_mt: Along with all who have attained communion, dwelling in the world of Brahmā, / At the cessation of their existence, they dwell in the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālavāsināṃ teṣāṃ tatra vai doṣadarśinām /
utpadyate 'tha vairāgyamātmavāda praṇāśanam //
meaning:
तत्कालवासिनां तेषां तत्र वै दोषदर्शिनाम् /
उत्पद्यते ऽथ वैराग्यमात्मवाद प्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: In those who dwell there at that time, seeing faults therein, / There then arises dispassion, which destroys false doctrines of the self.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojyabhoktṛtvanānātvaisteṣāṃ tadbhāvadarśinām /
pṛthagjñānena kṣetrajñāstataste brahmalaukikāḥ //
meaning:
भोज्यभोक्तृत्वनानात्वैस्तेषां तद्भावदर्शिनाम् /
पृथग्ज्ञानेन क्षेत्रज्ञास्ततस्ते ब्रह्मलौकिकाः //
text_mt: Due to the multiplicities of the object of enjoyment and the enjoyer, for those who see that nature, / Through distinct knowledge, those field-knowers belonging to Brahmā's world,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtau kāraṇātītāḥ sarve nānāpradarśinaḥ /
svātmanyevāvatiṣṭhante praśāntādarśanātmakāḥ //
meaning:
प्रकृतौ कारणातीताः सर्वे नानाप्रदर्शिनः /
स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठन्ते प्रशान्तादर्शनात्मकाः //
text_mt: Gone beyond the cause into nature, all perceiving manifoldness, / Rest in their very Self, their nature being peaceful non-perception.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhā nirañjanāḥ sarve cetanācetanāstathā /
tatraiva parinirvāṇāḥ smṛtānāgāminastu te //
meaning:
शुद्धा निरञ्जनाः सर्वे चेतनाचेतनास्तथा /
तत्रैव परिनिर्वाणाः स्मृतानागामिनस्तु ते //
text_mt: Pure, stainless, all conscious and unconscious alike, / Having attained final nirvana right there, they are known as those who do not return.

sanskrit_iast:
nirguṇatvāgnirātmānaḥ prakṛtyante vyatikramāt /
ityevaṃ prākṛtaḥ proktaḥ pratisargaḥ svayaṃbhuvā //
meaning:
निर्गुणत्वाग्निरात्मानः प्रकृत्यन्ते व्यतिक्रमात् /
इत्येवं प्राकृतः प्रोक्तः प्रतिसर्गः स्वयंभुवा //
text_mt: Being devoid of gunas, self-less, through transcending at the end of nature. / Thus has been declared the primary secondary creation by the Self-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramācārayutaḥ pratisargaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ /
sa vrajecchivasālokyaṃ bhaktimānvigatajvaraḥ //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाचारयुतः प्रतिसर्गं शृणोति यः /
स व्रजेच्छिवसालोक्यं भक्तिमान्विगतज्वरः //
text_mt: Endowed with the conduct of his varṇa and āśrama, whoever hears this secondary creation, / He, full of devotion and free from anguish, goes to the realm of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
amadyapaśca ya śūdro bhavabhakto jitedriyaḥ /
ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī apratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अमद्यपश्च य शूद्रो भवभक्तो जितेद्रियः /
आभूतसंप्लवस्थायी अप्रतीघातलक्षणः //
text_mt: And a Śūdra who drinks no liquor, devoted to Bhava, with senses conquered, / Remaining until the dissolution of elements, characterized by non-obstruction,

sanskrit_iast:
gāṇapatyaṃ sa labhate sthānaṃ vā sārvakālikam /
madyapo madyapaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiśca modate //
meaning:
गाणपत्यं स लभते स्थानं वा सार्वकालिकम् /
मद्यपो मद्यपैः सार्द्धं भूतसंघैश्च मोदते //
text_mt: He attains the state of a leader of the Gaṇas, or an eternal abode. / A liquor-drinker rejoices with liquor-drinkers and hosts of spirits.

sanskrit_iast:
sevyamāno mahīpṛṣṭhe martyānāṃ varado bhavaḥ /
iti hovāca bhagavānvāyurvākyamidavaram //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte uttarabhāge caturtha upasaṃhārapāde śivapuravarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सेव्यमानो महीपृष्ठे मर्त्यानां वरदो भवः /
इति होवाच भगवान्वायुर्वाक्यमिदवरम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उत्तरभागे चतुर्थ उपसंहारपादे शिवपुरवर्णनं नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Worshipped on the surface of the earth, Bhava is the giver of boons to mortals. / Thus spoke the blessed Vāyu this excellent speech.

Thus in the holy Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa, proclaimed by Vāyu, in the final part, the fourth Upasaṃhārapāda, the second chapter named 'Description of the City of Śiva'.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
pratyāhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi parasyānte svayaṃbhuvaḥ /
brahmaṇaḥ sthitikāle tu kṣīṇe tasmiṃstadā prabhoḥ //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
प्रत्याहारं प्रवक्ष्यामि परस्यान्ते स्वयंभुवः /
ब्रह्मणः स्थितिकाले तु क्षीणे तस्मिंस्तदा प्रभोः //
text_mt: The bard said: / I shall describe the withdrawal at the end of the supreme Self-born one, / When the period of maintenance of that powerful Lord Brahmā is exhausted.

sanskrit_iast:
yathedaṃ kurute vyaktaṃ susūkṣmaṃ viśvamīśvaraḥ /
avyaktaṃ grasate vyaktaṃ pratyāhāre ca kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
यथेदं कुरुते व्यक्तं सुसूक्ष्मं विश्वमीश्वरः /
अव्यक्तं ग्रसते व्यक्तं प्रत्याहारे च कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: Just as the Lord makes this manifest world very subtle, / So the unmanifest swallows the manifest completely during withdrawal.

sanskrit_iast:
purāntadvyaṇukādyānāṃ saṃpūrṇe kalpasaṃkṣaye /
upasthite mahāghore hyapratyakṣe tu kasyacit //
meaning:
पुरान्तद्व्यणुकाद्यानां संपूर्णे कल्पसंक्षये /
उपस्थिते महाघोरे ह्यप्रत्यक्षे तु कस्यचित् //
text_mt: At the complete end of the kalpa for gross elements, dyads and the like, / When the greatly terrible [dissolution], invisible indeed to anyone, has arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
ante drumasya saṃprāpte paścimāsya manostadā /
ante kaliyuge tasminkṣīṇe saṃhāra ucyate //
meaning:
अन्ते द्रुमस्य संप्राप्ते पश्चिमास्य मनोस्तदा /
अन्ते कलियुगे तस्मिन्क्षीणे संहार उच्यते //
text_mt: When the end of the tree of the last Manu has arrived, / When that Kaliyuga is exhausted at the end, the dissolution is spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃprakṣāle tadā vṛ-tte pratyāhāre hyupasthite /
pratyāhāre tadā tasminbhūtatanmātrasaṃkṣaye //
meaning:
संप्रक्षाले तदा वृ-त्ते प्रत्याहारे ह्युपस्थिते /
प्रत्याहारे तदा तस्मिन्भूततन्मात्रसंक्षये //
text_mt: When the washing away has occurred and withdrawal has arrived, / In that withdrawal, when the subtle elements of the gross elements are destroyed,

sanskrit_iast:
mahadādivikārasya viśeṣāntasya saṃkṣaye /
svabhāvakārite tasminpravṛtte pratisaṃcare //
meaning:
महदादिविकारस्य विशेषान्तस्य संक्षये /
स्वभावकारिते तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते प्रतिसंचरे //
text_mt: At the destruction of the modifications beginning with the cosmic intellect up to the gross specifics, / When that cosmic reabsorption, brought about by nature, has begun,

sanskrit_iast:
āpo grasaṃti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmergandhātmakaṃ gumam /
āttagandhā tato bhūmiḥ pralayatvāya kalpate //
meaning:
आपो ग्रसंति वै पूर्वं भूमेर्गन्धात्मकं गुमम् /
आत्तगन्धा ततो भूमिः प्रलयत्वाय कल्पते //
text_mt: The waters first swallow the quality consisting of smell belonging to earth; / Then the earth, its smell taken away, is ready for dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇaṣṭe gandhatanmātre toyāvasthā dharā bhavet /
āpastadā praviṣṭāstu vegavatyo mahāsvanāḥ //
meaning:
प्रणष्टे गन्धतन्मात्रे तोयावस्था धरा भवेत् /
आपस्तदा प्रविष्टास्तु वेगवत्यो महास्वनाः //
text_mt: When the subtle element of smell is destroyed, the earth assumes the state of water. / The waters, then having entered, swift and of great roar,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāpūrayitvedaṃ tiṣṭhanti vicaranti ca /
apāmapi gaṇo yastu jyotiḥṣvālīyate rasaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वमापूरयित्वेदं तिष्ठन्ति विचरन्ति च /
अपामपि गणो यस्तु ज्योतिःष्वालीयते रसः //
text_mt: Having filled all this, remain and surge about. / But that quality of taste belonging to the waters dissolves into fires;

sanskrit_iast:
naśyantyāpastadā tatra rasatanmātrasaṃkṣayāt /
tīvratejohṛtarasājyotiṣṭvaṃ prāpnuvantyuta //
meaning:
नश्यन्त्यापस्तदा तत्र रसतन्मात्रसंक्षयात् /
तीव्रतेजोहृतरसाज्योतिष्ट्वं प्राप्नुवन्त्युत //
text_mt: The waters then perish there from the destruction of the subtle element of taste; / With their taste taken away by intense fire, they indeed attain the state of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
graste ca salile tejaḥ sarvatomukhamīkṣate /
athāgniḥ sarvato vyāpta ādatte tajjalaṃ tadā //
meaning:
ग्रस्ते च सलिले तेजः सर्वतोमुखमीक्षते /
अथाग्निः सर्वतो व्याप्त आदत्ते तज्जलं तदा //
text_mt: And when the water is swallowed, the fire appears facing in all directions. / Then fire, pervading everywhere, takes in that water.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāpūryate 'rcirbhistadā jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ /
arcirbhiḥ saṃtate tasmiṃstaryagūrdhvamadhastataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वमापूर्यते ऽर्चिर्भिस्तदा जगदिदं शनैः /
अर्चिर्भिः संतते तस्मिंस्तर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्ततः //
text_mt: All this world is then gradually filled with flames. / When it is covered with flames obliquely, above, and below,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣo 'pi guṇaṃ rūpaṃ vāyuratti prakāśakam /
pralīyate tadā tasmindīpārciriva mārute //
meaning:
ज्योतिषो ऽपि गुणं रूपं वायुरत्ति प्रकाशकम् /
प्रलीयते तदा तस्मिन्दीपार्चिरिव मारुते //
text_mt: The wind consumes the illuminating quality, form, of fire as well. / Then it dissolves in it like the flame of a lamp in the wind.

sanskrit_iast:
pranaṣṭe rūpatanmātre hṛtarūpo vibhāvasuḥ /
upaśāmyati tejo hivāyurādhūyate mahān //
meaning:
प्रनष्टे रूपतन्मात्रे हृतरूपो विभावसुः /
उपशाम्यति तेजो हिवायुराधूयते महान् //
text_mt: When the subtle element of form is destroyed, fire, its form taken away, / Subsides indeed, and the great wind blows violently.

sanskrit_iast:
nirāloke tadā loke vāyubhūte ca tejasi /
tatastu mūlamāsādya vāyuḥ saṃbandhamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
निरालोके तदा लोके वायुभूते च तेजसि /
ततस्तु मूलमासाद्य वायुः संबन्धमात्मनः //
text_mt: When the world is then without light and fire has become wind, / Then reaching its root, the wind's own connection,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvañcādhaśca tiryakca dodhavīti diśo daśa /
vāyorapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśaṃ grasate ca tat //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वञ्चाधश्च तिर्यक्च दोधवीति दिशो दश /
वायोरपि गुणं स्पर्शमाकाशं ग्रसते च तत् //
text_mt: Above, below, and obliquely, it shakes the ten directions violently. / Space then swallows the quality of touch belonging to the wind as well.

sanskrit_iast:
praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khantu tiṣṭhatyanāvṛtam /
arūpamarasasparśamagandhaṃ na ca mūrtimat //
meaning:
प्रशाम्यति तदा वायुः खन्तु तिष्ठत्यनावृतम् /
अरूपमरसस्पर्शमगन्धं न च मूर्तिमत् //
text_mt: The wind then subsides, but space remains uncovered, / Formless, tasteless, touchless, odorless, and not having physical form.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāpūrayacchabdaiḥ sumahattatprakāśate /
tasmiṃllīne tadā śiṣṭamākāśaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
सर्वमापूरयच्छब्दैः सुमहत्तत्प्रकाशते /
तस्मिंल्लीने तदा शिष्टमाकाशं शब्दलक्षणम् //
text_mt: Filling everything with sounds, that immense [space] shines forth. / When that has dissolved, the remaining space is characterized by sound.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdamātraṃ tadākāśaṃ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati /
tatra śabdaṃ gumaṃ tasya bhūtadirgrasate punaḥ //
meaning:
शब्दमात्रं तदाकाशं सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति /
तत्र शब्दं गुमं तस्य भूतदिर्ग्रसते पुनः //
text_mt: Space then remains having only sound, pervading everything. / There the origin of the elements in turn swallows its quality of sound.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtendriyeṣu yugapadbhūtādau saṃsthiteṣu vai /
abhimānātmako hyeṣa bhūtādistāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
भूतेन्द्रियेषु युगपद्भूतादौ संस्थितेषु वै /
अभिमानात्मको ह्येष भूतादिस्तामसः स्मृतः //
text_mt: When the elements and sense faculties are simultaneously dissolved into the origin of the elements, / This origin of the elements, consisting of ego, is remembered as tāmasic.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtādirgrasate cāpi mahānvai buddhilakṣaṇaḥ /
mahānātmā tu vijñeyaḥ saṃkalpo vyavasāyakaḥ //
meaning:
भूतादिर्ग्रसते चापि महान्वै बुद्धिलक्षणः /
महानात्मा तु विज्ञेयः संकल्पो व्यवसायकः //
text_mt: And the origin of the elements is swallowed by the cosmic intellect, which is characterised by understanding. / The cosmic intellect is to be known as the self, forming resolves and determinations.

sanskrit_iast:
buddhirmanaśca liṅgaṃ ca mahānakṣara eva ca /
paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdaistamāhustattva cintakāḥ //
meaning:
बुद्धिर्मनश्च लिङ्गं च महानक्षर एव च /
पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैस्तमाहुस्तत्त्व चिन्तकाः //
text_mt: Intellect, mind, subtle body, cosmic intellect, and the imperishable— / thinkers on truth describe it using these synonymous words.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpralīneṣu bhūteṣu guṇasāmye tato mahān /
līyante guṇasāmyaṃ tu svātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
संप्रलीनेषु भूतेषु गुणसाम्ये ततो महान् /
लीयन्ते गुणसाम्यं तु स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते //
text_mt: When the elements are completely dissolved, the cosmic intellect [abides] in the equilibrium of the guṇas; / then they dissolve, but the equilibrium of the guṇas abides in its own self.

sanskrit_iast:
līyante sarvabhūtānāṃ kāraṇāni prasaṃgame /
ityeṣa saṃyamaścaiva tattvānāṃ kāraṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
लीयन्ते सर्वभूतानां कारणानि प्रसंगमे /
इत्येष संयमश्चैव तत्त्वानां कारणैः सह //
text_mt: The causes of all beings dissolve at the time of dissolution. / Such is this withdrawal of the principles along with their causes.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvaprasaṃyamo hyeṣa smṛto hyāvartako dvijāḥ /
dharmādharmauṃ tapo jñānaṃ śubhaṃ satyānṛte tathā //
meaning:
तत्त्वप्रसंयमो ह्येष स्मृतो ह्यावर्तको द्विजाः /
धर्माधर्मौं तपो ज्ञानं शुभं सत्यानृते तथा //
text_mt: This withdrawal of the principles is recalled as bringing about return, O twice-born ones; / [likewise] righteousness and unrighteousness, asceticism, knowledge, the auspicious, and truth and falsehood,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvabhāvo hyadhobhāvaḥ sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye /
sarvametatprapañcasthaṃ guṇamātrātmakaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वभावो ह्यधोभावः सुखदुःखे प्रियाप्रिये /
सर्वमेतत्प्रपञ्चस्थं गुणमात्रात्मकं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: being above and being below, pleasure and pain, the pleasant and the unpleasant— / all this abiding in the manifold universe is recalled as consisting merely of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
nirindriyāṇāṃ ca tadā jñānināṃ yacchubhāśubham /
prakṛtyāṃ caiva tatsarvaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ pratiṣṭhati //
meaning:
निरिन्द्रियाणां च तदा ज्ञानिनां यच्छुभाशुभम् /
प्रकृत्यां चैव तत्सर्वं पुण्यं पापं प्रतिष्ठति //
text_mt: And what is good and bad for the sense-free knowers then, / all that, virtue and sin, abides in nature.

sanskrit_iast:
yātyavasthā tu sācaiva dehināṃ tu nirucyate /
jantūnāṃ pāpapuṇyaṃ tu prakṛtau yatpratiṣṭhitam //
meaning:
यात्यवस्था तु साचैव देहिनां तु निरुच्यते /
जन्तूनां पापपुण्यं तु प्रकृतौ यत्प्रतिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: That state which is attained is described indeed for embodied beings; / and the sin and merit of living creatures rests in nature.

sanskrit_iast:
avasthāsthāni tānyeva puṇyapāpāni jantavaḥ /
yojayante punardehānparatvena tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अवस्थास्थानि तान्येव पुण्यपापानि जन्तवः /
योजयन्ते पुनर्देहान्परत्वेन तथैव च //
text_mt: Existing in those states, creatures join these very merits and sins / to bodies again through their status as other.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmauṃ tu jantūnāṃ guṇamātrātmakāvubhau /
kāraṇaiḥ svaiḥ pracīyete kāyatveneha jantubhiḥ //
meaning:
धर्माधर्मौं तु जन्तूनां गुणमात्रात्मकावुभौ /
कारणैः स्वैः प्रचीयेते कायत्वेनेह जन्तुभिः //
text_mt: The righteousness and unrighteousness of creatures both consist merely of the guṇas; / they are accumulated by creatures here through their own causes as a body.

sanskrit_iast:
sacetanāḥ pralīyante kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitā guṇāḥ /
sarge ca pratisarge ca saṃsāre caiva jantavaḥ //
meaning:
सचेतनाः प्रलीयन्ते क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठिता गुणाः /
सर्गे च प्रतिसर्गे च संसारे चैव जन्तवः //
text_mt: Conscious, the guṇas overseen by the knower of the field dissolve; / and in primary creation, in secondary creation, and in transmigration, living creatures

sanskrit_iast:
saṃyujyante viyujyante kāraṇaiḥ saṃcaranti ca /
rājasī tāmasī caiva sāttvikī caiva vṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
संयुज्यन्ते वियुज्यन्ते कारणैः संचरन्ति च /
राजसी तामसी चैव सात्त्विकी चैव वृत्तयः //
text_mt: are united, separated, and wander through their causes. / The dispositions are of the nature of rajas, tamas, and sattva;

sanskrit_iast:
guṇamātrāḥ pravartante puruṣādhiṣṭhatā stridhā /
urddhvadeśātmakaṃ sattvamadhobhāgātmakaṃ tamaḥ //
meaning:
गुणमात्राः प्रवर्तन्ते पुरुषाधिष्ठता स्त्रिधा /
उर्द्ध्वदेशात्मकं सत्त्वमधोभागात्मकं तमः //
text_mt: consisting merely of the guṇas, they proceed threefold, overseen by the puruṣa. / Sattva is of the nature of the upper realm; tamas is of the nature of the lower region;

sanskrit_iast:
tayoḥ pravarttakaṃ madhye ihaivāvarttakaṃ rajaḥ /
ityevaṃ parivartantetrayaścetoguṇātmakāḥ //
meaning:
तयोः प्रवर्त्तकं मध्ये इहैवावर्त्तकं रजः /
इत्येवं परिवर्तन्तेत्रयश्चेतोगुणात्मकाः //
text_mt: and between the two, rajas is the stimulator that causes return right here. / Thus the three consisting of the mental guṇas revolve.

sanskrit_iast:
lokeṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ tanna kāryaṃ vijānatā /
avidyāpratyayāraṃbhā ārabhyante hi mānavaiḥ //
meaning:
लोकेषु सर्वभूतानां तन्न कार्यं विजानता /
अविद्याप्रत्ययारंभा आरभ्यन्ते हि मानवैः //
text_mt: In the worlds of all beings, that is not to be done by one who knows; / for undertakings caused by ignorance are begun by human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu gatayastisraḥ śubhātpāpātmikāḥ smṛtāḥ /
tamaso 'bhibhavājjanturyāthātathyaṃ na vindati //
meaning:
एतास्तु गतयस्तिस्रः शुभात्पापात्मिकाः स्मृताः /
तमसो ऽभिभवाज्जन्तुर्याथातथ्यं न विन्दति //
text_mt: These three courses are remembered as consisting of good and evil. / From the overpowering by tamas, a creature does not find reality as it is.

sanskrit_iast:
atattvadarśanātso 'tha vividhaṃ vadhyate tataḥ /
prākṛtena ca bandhena tathyāvaikārikeṇa ca //
meaning:
अतत्त्वदर्शनात्सो ऽथ विविधं वध्यते ततः /
प्राकृतेन च बन्धेन तथ्यावैकारिकेण च //
text_mt: Then, from not seeing reality, he is bound in various ways: / by the bond related to nature, and by that related to its modifications;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇābhistatīyena baddho 'tyantaṃ vivarttate /
ityete vai trayaḥ proktā bandhā hyajñānahetukāḥ //
meaning:
दक्षिणाभिस्ततीयेन बद्धो ऽत्यन्तं विवर्त्तते /
इत्येते वै त्रयः प्रोक्ता बन्धा ह्यज्ञानहेतुकाः //
text_mt: and bound by the third, through priestly gifts, he revolves perpetually. / These three bonds are indeed declared to have their cause in ignorance.

sanskrit_iast:
anitye nityasaṃjñā ca duḥkhe ca sukhadarśanam /
asve svamiti ca jñānamaśucau śuciniścayaḥ //
meaning:
अनित्ये नित्यसंज्ञा च दुःखे च सुखदर्शनम् /
अस्वे स्वमिति च ज्ञानमशुचौ शुचिनिश्चयः //
text_mt: The notion of the permanent in the impermanent, seeing pleasure in pain, / the thought of 'mine' in what is not one's own, and the conviction of purity in what is impure—

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāmete manodoṣā jñānadoṣā viparyayāt /
rāgadveṣanivṛttiśca tajjñānaṃ samudāhṛtam //
meaning:
येषामेते मनोदोषा ज्ञानदोषा विपर्ययात् /
रागद्वेषनिवृत्तिश्च तज्ज्ञानं समुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: those in whom these mental defects exist, defects of knowledge from error; / and the cessation of passion and hatred—that is declared to be knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānaṃ tamaso mūraṃ karmadvayaphalaṃ rajaḥ /
karma jastu punardeho mahāduḥkhaṃ pravarttate //
meaning:
अज्ञानं तमसो मूरं कर्मद्वयफलं रजः /
कर्म जस्तु पुनर्देहो महादुःखं प्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Ignorance is the root of tamas; rajas is the fruit of both types of actions; / but the body is born of action, and great pain ensues.

sanskrit_iast:
śrotrajā netrajā caiva tvagjihvāghrāṇajā tathā /
punarbhavakarī duḥkhātkarmaṇā jāyate tṛṣā //
meaning:
श्रोत्रजा नेत्रजा चैव त्वग्जिह्वाघ्राणजा तथा /
पुनर्भवकरी दुःखात्कर्मणा जायते तृषा //
text_mt: Arising from the ear, the eye, the skin, the tongue, and the nose, / thirst, bringing about rebirth from suffering, is born of action.

sanskrit_iast:
satṛṣṇo 'bhihito bālaḥ svakṛtaiḥ karmaṇaḥ phalaiḥ /
tailavīḍakavajjīvastatraiva parivarttate //
meaning:
सतृष्णो ऽभिहितो बालः स्वकृतैः कर्मणः फलैः /
तैलवीडकवज्जीवस्तत्रैव परिवर्त्तते //
text_mt: The fool possessed of thirst is driven by the fruits of his own actions; / like an oil-press insect, the living soul revolves right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmūlamanarthānāmajñāna mupadiśyate /
taṃ śatrumavadhāryaikaṃ jñāne yatnaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
तस्मान्मूलमनर्थानामज्ञान मुपदिश्यते /
तं शत्रुमवधार्यैकं ज्ञाने यत्नं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: Therefore, ignorance is taught as the root of misfortunes. / Ascertaining that as the sole enemy, one should make effort toward knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāddhi tyajate sarvaṃ tyāgādbuddhirvirajyate /
vairāgyācchudhyate cāpi śuddhaḥ sattvena mucyate //
meaning:
ज्ञानाद्धि त्यजते सर्वं त्यागाद्बुद्धिर्विरज्यते /
वैराग्याच्छुध्यते चापि शुद्धः सत्त्वेन मुच्यते //
text_mt: For from knowledge everything is renounced; from renunciation the intellect becomes detached; / and from detachment one is purified; being purified, one is liberated through sattva.

sanskrit_iast:
ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi rāgaṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam /
abhiṣvaṅgāya yogaḥ syādviṣayeṣvavaśātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि रागं भूतापहारिणम् /
अभिष्वङ्गाय योगः स्याद्विषयेष्ववशात्मनः //
text_mt: Henceforth I shall declare passion, which robs beings [of their sense]. / Attachment comes to be for the one who has no control over himself regarding sense-objects.

sanskrit_iast:
aniṣṭamiṣṭamaprītiprītitāpaviṣādanam /
duḥkhalābhe na tāpaśca sukhānusmaraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अनिष्टमिष्टमप्रीतिप्रीतितापविषादनम् /
दुःखलाभे न तापश्च सुखानुस्मरणं तथा //
text_mt: The undesired and the desired, displeasure, pleasure, burning distress, dejection, / burning distress when pain is obtained, and similarly dwelling in thought on pleasure—

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa vaiṣayo rāgaḥ saṃbhūtyāḥ kāraṇaṃ smṛtaḥ /
brahmādau sthāvarānte vai saṃsārehyādibhautike //
meaning:
इत्येष वैषयो रागः संभूत्याः कारणं स्मृतः /
ब्रह्मादौ स्थावरान्ते वै संसारेह्यादिभौतिके //
text_mt: this passion regarding sense-objects is remembered as the cause of rebirth, / in transmigration relating to the elements, beginning with Brahmā and ending with immovable things.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānapūrvakaṃ tasmādajñānaṃ tu vivarjayet /
yasya cārṣe na pramāṇaṃ śiṣṭācāraṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अज्ञानपूर्वकं तस्मादज्ञानं तु विवर्जयेत् /
यस्य चार्षे न प्रमाणं शिष्टाचारं तथैव च //
text_mt: Therefore, preceded by non-ignorance, one should avoid ignorance. / One who has no authority in the Vedic tradition and similarly in the conduct of the virtuous,

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramaviruddho yaḥ śiṣṭaśāstravirodhakaḥ /
eṣa mārgo hi niraye tiryyagyonau ca kāraṇam //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धो यः शिष्टशास्त्रविरोधकः /
एष मार्गो हि निरये तिर्य्यग्योनौ च कारणम् //
text_mt: who opposes the castes and life-stages, who opposes the authoritative treatises— / this path is indeed the cause of hell and of animal birth.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryyagyo nigataṃ caiva kāraṇaṃ tattrarucyate /
trividho yātanāsthāne tiryyagyonau ca ṣaḍvidhe //
meaning:
तिर्य्यग्यो निगतं चैव कारणं तत्त्ररुच्यते /
त्रिविधो यातनास्थाने तिर्य्यग्योनौ च षड्विधे //
text_mt: The cause leading to animal birth is spoken of there: / threefold in the place of torment, and sixfold in animal birth.

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇe viṣaye caiva pratighātastu sarvaśaḥ /
anaiśvaryaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ pratighātātmakaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
कारणे विषये चैव प्रतिघातस्तु सर्वशः /
अनैश्वर्यं तु तत्सर्वं प्रतिघातात्मकं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: In the cause and in the object, there is obstruction everywhere; / all that lack of power is remembered as having obstruction as its nature.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣā tāmasī vṛttirbhūtādīnāṃ caturvidhā /
sattvasthamātrakaṃ cittaṃ yathāsattvaṃ pradarśanāt //
meaning:
इत्येषा तामसी वृत्तिर्भूतादीनां चतुर्विधा /
सत्त्वस्थमात्रकं चित्तं यथासत्त्वं प्रदर्शनात् //
text_mt: Thus this fourfold tāmasika disposition of the origin of the elements [is described]. / The mind abides merely in sattva through perception according with true reality;

sanskrit_iast:
tattvānāṃ ca yathātattvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai tattvadarśanāt /
sattvakṣetrajñanānātvametannānārthadarśanam //
meaning:
तत्त्वानां च यथातत्त्वं दृष्ट्वा वै तत्त्वदर्शनात् /
सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञनानात्वमेतन्नानार्थदर्शनम् //
text_mt: and seeing the principles according to reality through the vision of reality, / this vision of distinct objects is the distinction between sattva and the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
nānātvadarśanaṃ jñānaṃ jñānādvai yoga ucyate /
tena baddhasya vai bandho mokṣo muktasya tena ca //
meaning:
नानात्वदर्शनं ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद्वै योग उच्यते /
तेन बद्धस्य वै बन्धो मोक्षो मुक्तस्य तेन च //
text_mt: The vision of difference is knowledge; from knowledge yoga is spoken of. / By that there is bondage for the bound one, and by that there is liberation for the released.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāre vinivṛtte tu mukto liṅgena mucyate /
niḥsaṃbandho hyacaitanyaḥ svātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
संसारे विनिवृत्ते तु मुक्तो लिङ्गेन मुच्यते /
निःसंबन्धो ह्यचैतन्यः स्वात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते //
text_mt: When transmigration has ceased, the liberated one is freed from the subtle body; / devoid of connection and insentient, he abides in his own self alone.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmanyavasthitaścāpi virūpākhyena likhyate /
ityetallakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ samāsājjñāna mokṣayoḥ //
meaning:
स्वात्मन्यवस्थितश्चापि विरूपाख्येन लिख्यते /
इत्येतल्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं समासाज्ज्ञान मोक्षयोः //
text_mt: Abiding in his own self, he is described by the name 'formless.' / Thus has been stated in brief the characteristic of knowledge and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāpi trividhaḥ prokto mokṣo vai tattvadarśibhiḥ /
pūrvaṃ viyogo jñānena dvitīye rāgasaṃkṣayāt //
meaning:
स चापि त्रिविधः प्रोक्तो मोक्षो वै तत्त्वदर्शिभिः /
पूर्वं वियोगो ज्ञानेन द्वितीये रागसंक्षयात् //
text_mt: And that liberation is declared to be threefold by the seers of reality: / first, separation through knowledge; second, from the destruction of passion;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṣṇākṣa yāttṛtīyastu vyākhyātaṃ mokṣakāraṇam /
liṅgābhāvāttu kaivalyaṃ kaivalyāttu nirañjanam //
meaning:
तृष्णाक्ष यात्तृतीयस्तु व्याख्यातं मोक्षकारणम् /
लिङ्गाभावात्तु कैवल्यं कैवल्यात्तु निरञ्जनम् //
text_mt: and the third cause of liberation is explained as being from the destruction of thirst. / From the absence of the subtle body comes isolation, and from isolation comes the taintless state.

sanskrit_iast:
nirañjanatvācchuddhastu nitānyo naiva vidyate /
ata ūrddhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vairāgyaṃ doṣadarśanāt //
meaning:
निरञ्जनत्वाच्छुद्धस्तु नितान्यो नैव विद्यते /
अत ऊर्द्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि वैराग्यं दोषदर्शनात् //
text_mt: From being taintless, one is pure, and nothing other exists at all. / Henceforth I shall declare dispassion arising from seeing defects.

sanskrit_iast:
divye ca mānuṣe caiva viṣaye pañcalakṣaṇe /
apradveṣo 'nabhiṣvaṅgaḥ karttavyo doṣadarśanāt //
meaning:
दिव्ये च मानुषे चैव विषये पञ्चलक्षणे /
अप्रद्वेषो ऽनभिष्वङ्गः कर्त्तव्यो दोषदर्शनात् //
text_mt: Toward divine and human sense-objects of five characteristics, / absence of aversion and absence of attachment should be cultivated through seeing defects.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaprītiviṣādānāṃ kāryaṃ tu parivarjanam /
evaṃ vairāgyamāsthāya śarīrī nirmamo bhavet //
meaning:
तपप्रीतिविषादानां कार्यं तु परिवर्जनम् /
एवं वैराग्यमास्थाय शरीरी निर्ममो भवेत् //
text_mt: The avoidance of burning distress, joy, and dejection is to be done. / Having resorted to dispassion in this way, the embodied soul should become free from the sense of 'mine.'

sanskrit_iast:
anityamaśivaṃ duḥkhamiti vuddhyānucintya ca /
viśuddhaṃ kāryakaraṇaṃ sattvasyātiniṣaivayā //
meaning:
अनित्यमशिवं दुःखमिति वुद्ध्यानुचिन्त्य च /
विशुद्धं कार्यकरणं सत्त्वस्यातिनिषैवया //
text_mt: Reflecting with the intellect, 'It is impermanent, inauspicious, and painful,' / the body and senses are purified through deep resort to sattva.

sanskrit_iast:
paripakvakaṣāyo hi kṛtsnāndoṣānprapaśyati /
tataḥ prayāṇakāle hi doṣairnaimittikaistathā //
meaning:
परिपक्वकषायो हि कृत्स्नान्दोषान्प्रपश्यति /
ततः प्रयाणकाले हि दोषैर्नैमित्तिकैस्तथा //
text_mt: With impurities fully ripened, he beholds all defects. / Then, at the time of departure, through occasional defects,

sanskrit_iast:
ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ /
sa śarīramupāśritya kṛtsnāndoṣānruṇaddhi vai //
meaning:
ऊष्मा प्रकुपितः काये तीव्रवायुसमीरितः /
स शरीरमुपाश्रित्य कृत्स्नान्दोषान्रुणद्धि वै //
text_mt: the heat in the body is stirred up, impelled by a violent wind; / resorting to the body, it blocks all the defects.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇakthānāni bhindanhi chindanmarmāṇyatītya ca /
śaityātprakupito vāyurūrddhvaṃ tūtkramate tataḥ //
meaning:
प्राणक्थानानि भिन्दन्हि छिन्दन्मर्माण्यतीत्य च /
शैत्यात्प्रकुपितो वायुरूर्द्ध्वं तूत्क्रमते ततः //
text_mt: Rending the vital spots and cutting through the vulnerable parts, / the wind, agitated by cold, then moves upward to depart.

sanskrit_iast:
sa cāyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇasthāneṣvavasthitaḥ /
samāsātsaṃvṛte jñāne saṃcṛtteṣu ca karmasu //
meaning:
स चायं सर्वभूतानां प्राणस्थानेष्ववस्थितः /
समासात्संवृते ज्ञाने संचृत्तेषु च कर्मसु //
text_mt: And this [wind] abides in the vital spots of all beings. / When knowledge is veiled completely and actions have gathered,

sanskrit_iast:
sa jīvo nābhyadhiṣṭhānaḥ karmabhiḥ svaiḥ purākṛtaiḥ /
aṣṭāṅgapraṇavṛttiṃ vai sa vicyāvayate punaḥ //
meaning:
स जीवो नाभ्यधिष्ठानः कर्मभिः स्वैः पुराकृतैः /
अष्टाङ्गप्रणवृत्तिं वै स विच्यावयते पुनः //
text_mt: That individual soul, residing at the navel, through its own actions performed formerly, / dislodges again the eightfold operation of the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīraṃ prajahansoṃ'te nirucchvāsastato bhavet /
evaṃ prāṇaiḥ parityakto mṛta ityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
शरीरं प्रजहन्सोंऽते निरुच्छ्वासस्ततो भवेत् /
एवं प्राणैः परित्यक्तो मृत इत्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: Abandoning the body at the end, it then becomes breathless; / thus abandoned by the vital breaths, it is spoken of as dead.

sanskrit_iast:
yatheha loke svapne taṃ nīyamānamitastataḥ /
rañjanaṃ tadvidheyasya te tānyo na ca vidyate //
meaning:
यथेह लोके स्वप्ने तं नीयमानमितस्ततः /
रञ्जनं तद्विधेयस्य ते तान्यो न च विद्यते //
text_mt: Just as in this world, in a dream, one is led here and there, / [subject to] the colouring of that to which one is subject, and no other exists for them.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛṣṇākṣayastṛtīyastu vyākhyātaṃ mokṣalakṣaṇam /
śabdādye viṣaye doṣadṛṣṭirvai pañcalakṣaṇe //
meaning:
नृष्णाक्षयस्तृतीयस्तु व्याख्यातं मोक्षलक्षणम् /
शब्दाद्ये विषये दोषदृष्टिर्वै पञ्चलक्षणे //
text_mt: The destruction of thirst is declared as the third characteristic of liberation, / [along with] observing the defect in the fivefold objects [of sense], beginning with sound.

sanskrit_iast:
apradveṣo 'nabhiṣvaṅgaḥ prītitāpavivarjanam /
vairāgyakāraṇaṃ hyete prakṛtīnāṃ layasya ca //
meaning:
अप्रद्वेषो ऽनभिष्वङ्गः प्रीतितापविवर्जनम् /
वैराग्यकारणं ह्येते प्रकृतीनां लयस्य च //
text_mt: Absence of hatred, lack of attachment, and abandonment of pleasure and anguish / are indeed the causes of detachment and of the dissolution of the primal causes.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau prakṛtayo jñeyāḥ pūrvoktā vai yathākramam /
avyaktādyāstu vijñeyā bhūtāntāḥ prakṛterbhavāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टौ प्रकृतयो ज्ञेयाः पूर्वोक्ता वै यथाक्रमम् /
अव्यक्ताद्यास्तु विज्ञेया भूतान्ताः प्रकृतेर्भवाः //
text_mt: The eight primal causes are to be known, as stated before in due order; / beginning with the unmanifest and ending with the elements, they are born of prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramācārayuktaḥ śiṣṭaḥ śāstrāvirodhanaḥ /
varṇāśramāṇāṃ dharmo 'yaṃ devasthāneṣu kāraṇam //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाचारयुक्तः शिष्टः शास्त्राविरोधनः /
वर्णाश्रमाणां धर्मो ऽयं देवस्थानेषु कारणम् //
text_mt: Endowed with the conduct of classes and life-stages, disciplined, not contradicting scripture— / this duty of classes and life-stages is the cause of [attaining] the stations of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīni piśācāntānyaṣṭau sthānāni devatā /
aiśvaryamāṇimādyaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ hyaṣṭalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनि पिशाचान्तान्यष्टौ स्थानानि देवता /
ऐश्वर्यमाणिमाद्यं हि कारणं ह्यष्टलक्षणम् //
text_mt: The stations of the deities are eight, beginning with Brahmā and ending with the piśācas; / sovereignty, beginning with atomicity, is indeed the eightfold cause.

sanskrit_iast:
nimittamapratīghāte dṛṣṭe śabdādilakṣaṇe /
aṣṭāvetāni rūpāṇi prākṛtāni yathākramam //
meaning:
निमित्तमप्रतीघाते दृष्टे शब्दादिलक्षणे /
अष्टावेतानि रूपाणि प्राकृतानि यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: It is the cause of unimpeded sight, whose characteristics begin with sound; / these eight forms belong to prakṛti, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñeṣvanusajjante guṇamātratmakāni tu /
prāvṛṭkāle pṛthagmeghaṃ paśyantīva sacakṣuṣaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञेष्वनुसज्जन्ते गुणमात्रत्मकानि तु /
प्रावृट्काले पृथग्मेघं पश्यन्तीव सचक्षुषः //
text_mt: They attach themselves to the knowers of the field, though consisting merely of the guṇas, / just as those with eyes see distinct clouds in the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast:
paśyantyevaṃ vidhāḥ siddhā jīvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā /
khādataścānnapānāni yonīḥ praviśatastathā //
meaning:
पश्यन्त्येवं विधाः सिद्धा जीवं दिव्येन चक्षुषा /
खादतश्चान्नपानानि योनीः प्रविशतस्तथा //
text_mt: Siddhas of such kind see the soul with divine vision / as it eats food and drink, and as it enters wombs,

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagūrdhvamadhastācca dhāvato 'pi yathākramam /
jīvaḥ prāṇastathā liṅgaṃ karaṇaṃ ca catuṣṭayam //
meaning:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्ताच्च धावतो ऽपि यथाक्रमम् /
जीवः प्राणस्तथा लिङ्गं करणं च चतुष्टयम् //
text_mt: and as it runs in due course across, upward, and downward. / Soul, vital breath, subtle body, and sense organ—these are the fourfold [designation].

sanskrit_iast:
paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdairekārthaiḥ so 'bhilaṣyate /
vyaktāvyaktapramāṇo 'yaṃ sa vai bhuṅkte tu kṛtsnaśaḥ //
meaning:
पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैरेकार्थैः सो ऽभिलष्यते /
व्यक्ताव्यक्तप्रमाणो ऽयं स वै भुङ्क्ते तु कृत्स्नशः //
text_mt: It is desired and designated by synonymous words that have one meaning; / having the measure of the manifest and the unmanifest, it indeed experiences completely.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktānugrahāntaṃ ca kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ ca yat /
evaṃ jñātvā śucirbhūtvā jñānādvai vipramucyate //
meaning:
अव्यक्तानुग्रहान्तं च क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं च यत् /
एवं ज्ञात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा ज्ञानाद्वै विप्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Ending with the grace of the unmanifest and presided over by the knower of the field— / having known this and become pure, one is indeed completely liberated through knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭaṃ caiva yathā tattvaṃ tattvānāṃ tattvadarśane /
yatheṣṭaṃ pariniryāti bhinne dehe sunirvṛte //
meaning:
नष्टं चैव यथा तत्त्वं तत्त्वानां तत्त्वदर्शने /
यथेष्टं परिनिर्याति भिन्ने देहे सुनिर्वृते //
text_mt: And just as an entity is dissolved upon the vision of the truth of the entities, / so, when the body is dissolved and completely at peace, it departs as it pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
bhidyate karaṇaṃ cāpi hyavyaktajñāninastataḥ /
mukto guṇaśarīreṇa praṇādyena tu sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
भिद्यते करणं चापि ह्यव्यक्तज्ञानिनस्ततः /
मुक्तो गुणशरीरेण प्रणाद्येन तु सर्वशः //
text_mt: And the internal organ also dissolves for the knower of the unmanifest; / released from the body made of guṇas, beginning with the vital breaths, on all sides,

sanskrit_iast:
nānyaccharīramādatte dagdhe vīje yathāṅkuraḥ /
jñānī ca sarvasaṃsārāvijñaśārīramānasaḥ //
meaning:
नान्यच्छरीरमादत्ते दग्धे वीजे यथाङ्कुरः /
ज्ञानी च सर्वसंसाराविज्ञशारीरमानसः //
text_mt: it does not take on another body, like a sprout when the seed is burnt; / and the possessor of knowledge, having understood the bodily and mental [nature] of all transmigration,

sanskrit_iast:
jñānāccaturddaśābuddhaḥ prakṛtistho nivartate /
prakṛtiṃ satyamityāhurvikāro 'nṛtamucyate //
meaning:
ज्ञानाच्चतुर्द्दशाबुद्धः प्रकृतिस्थो निवर्तते /
प्रकृतिं सत्यमित्याहुर्विकारो ऽनृतमुच्यते //
text_mt: awakened from the fourteenfold [creation] through knowledge, abiding in prakṛti, turns away. / They say that prakṛti is real, while the modification is called unreal.

sanskrit_iast:
asadbhāvo 'nṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ sadbhāvaḥ satya mucyate /
anāmarūpaṃ kṣetrajñanāmarūpaṃ pracakṣate //
meaning:
असद्भावो ऽनृतं ज्ञेयं सद्भावः सत्य मुच्यते /
अनामरूपं क्षेत्रज्ञनामरूपं प्रचक्षते //
text_mt: Non-being is to be known as unreal; being is called real. / They declare that the knower of the field is formless and nameless, [yet] has name and form.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātkṣetraṃ vijānāti tatmātkṣetrajña ucyate /
kṣetraṃ pratyayate yasmātkṣetrajñaḥ śubha ucyate //
meaning:
यस्मात्क्षेत्रं विजानाति तत्मात्क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते /
क्षेत्रं प्रत्ययते यस्मात्क्षेत्रज्ञः शुभ उच्यते //
text_mt: Because it knows the field, it is therefore called the knower of the field; / because it witnesses the field, the knower of the field is called auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñaḥ smaryate tasmātkṣetraṃ tajjñairvibhāṣyate /
kṣetraṃ tvatpratyayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kṣetrajñaḥ pratyayaḥ sadā //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञः स्मर्यते तस्मात्क्षेत्रं तज्ज्ञैर्विभाष्यते /
क्षेत्रं त्वत्प्रत्ययं दृष्टं क्षेत्रज्ञः प्रत्ययः सदा //
text_mt: Therefore it is remembered as the knower of the field, and the field is explained by those who know it; / the field is seen as that which has cognition, while the knower of the field is ever the cognition itself.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣapaṇātkāraṇāccaiva kṣatatrāṇāttathaiva ca /
bhojyatvaviṣayatvācca kṣetraṃ kṣetravido viduḥ //
meaning:
क्षपणात्कारणाच्चैव क्षतत्राणात्तथैव च /
भोज्यत्वविषयत्वाच्च क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रविदो विदुः //
text_mt: Because of perishing, and being a cause, and protecting from injury, / and because of being an object of enjoyment and an object [of experience], the knowers of the field know the field.

sanskrit_iast:
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ sarvairūpyaṃ vilakṣaṇam /
vikāralakṣaṇaṃ tadvai so 'kṣaraḥ kṣarameti ca //
meaning:
महदाद्यं विशेषान्तं सर्वैरूप्यं विलक्षणम् /
विकारलक्षणं तद्वै सो ऽक्षरः क्षरमेति च //
text_mt: Beginning with the cosmic intellect and ending with the specific elements, having all shapes, characterized by distinction, / marked by modification—the imperishable attains that perishable.

sanskrit_iast:
tamevānuvikāraṃ tu yasmādvai kṣarate punaḥ /
tasmācca kāraṇāccaiva jñaramityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
तमेवानुविकारं तु यस्माद्वै क्षरते पुनः /
तस्माच्च कारणाच्चैव ज्ञरमित्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: Because it flows forth again in accordance with that very modification, / for that cause and reason it is called perishable.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāre narakebhyaśca trāyate puruṣaṃ ca yat /
duḥkhatrāṇātpunaścāpi kṣetramityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
संसारे नरकेभ्यश्च त्रायते पुरुषं च यत् /
दुःखत्राणात्पुनश्चापि क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: And because it protects the puruṣa from transmigration and from hells, / and also from protecting against suffering, it is called the field.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhaduḥkhamahaṃbhāvādbhojyamityabhidhīyate /
acetanatvādviṣayastadvidharmā vibhuḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
सुखदुःखमहंभावाद्भोज्यमित्यभिधीयते /
अचेतनत्वाद्विषयस्तद्विधर्मा विभुः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Pleasure and pain, because of the sense of ego, are called the object of enjoyment; / because it is unconscious, it is an object [of experience]; opposite in nature to it is the all-pervading [puruṣa] remembered.

sanskrit_iast:
na kṣīyate na kṣarati vikāraprasṛtaṃ tu tat /
akṣaraṃ tena vāpyuktama kṣīṇatvāttathaiva ca //
meaning:
न क्षीयते न क्षरति विकारप्रसृतं तु तत् /
अक्षरं तेन वाप्युक्तम क्षीणत्वात्तथैव च //
text_mt: It does not diminish, nor does it perish, while that [other] spreads forth as modification; / by that, and likewise because of non-diminution, it is called the imperishable.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmātpūryanuśete ca tasmātpuruṣa ucyate /
purapratyayiko yasmātpuruṣetyabhidhīyate //
meaning:
यस्मात्पूर्यनुशेते च तस्मात्पुरुष उच्यते /
पुरप्रत्ययिको यस्मात्पुरुषेत्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: Because it dwells in the city [of the body], therefore it is called puruṣa; / because it is conscious of the city, it is designated as puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣaṃ kathayasvātha kathito 'jñairvibhāṣyate /
śuddho nirañjanābhāso jñātā jñānavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
पुरुषं कथयस्वाथ कथितो ऽज्ञैर्विभाष्यते /
शुद्धो निरञ्जनाभासो ज्ञाता ज्ञानविवर्जितः //
text_mt: Speak now of the puruṣa, which, though described, is spoken of by the ignorant: / pure, having the appearance of being taintless, the knower devoid of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
astināstīti so 'nyo vā baddho mukto gataḥsthitaḥ /
nairhetukāttvanirdeśyādahastasminna vidyate //
meaning:
अस्तिनास्तीति सो ऽन्यो वा बद्धो मुक्तो गतःस्थितः /
नैर्हेतुकात्त्वनिर्देश्यादहस्तस्मिन्न विद्यते //
text_mt: Whether 'it is' or 'it is not,' or whether it is other, bound or liberated, departed or remaining— / because it is causeless and indefinable, no day exists in it.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhatvānna tu dṛśyo vai draṣṭṛtvātsamadarśanaḥ /
ātmapratyayakāritvādanyūnaṃ vāpyahetukam //
meaning:
शुद्धत्वान्न तु दृश्यो वै द्रष्टृत्वात्समदर्शनः /
आत्मप्रत्ययकारित्वादन्यूनं वाप्यहेतुकम् //
text_mt: Because of its purity it is not visible, [yet] because of being the seer it possesses equal vision; / because it produces its own apprehension, it is without deficiency or without cause.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvagrāhyamanumānāccintayanna pramuhyate /
yadā paśyati jñātāraṃ śāntārthaṃ darśanātmakam //
meaning:
भावग्राह्यमनुमानाच्चिन्तयन्न प्रमुह्यते /
यदा पश्यति ज्ञातारं शान्तार्थं दर्शनात्मकम् //
text_mt: Grasped through existence by inference, contemplating it one is not deluded; / when one sees the knower whose essence is vision, whose purpose is pacified,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśyādṛśyeṣu nirdeśyaṃ tadā taddurddharaṃ varam /
vijñātā na ca dṛśyeta vṛthaktveneha sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
दृश्यादृश्येषु निर्देश्यं तदा तद्दुर्द्धरं वरम् /
विज्ञाता न च दृश्येत वृथक्त्वेनेह सर्वशः //
text_mt: indefinable among things visible and invisible, then it is that hard-to-hold supreme [state]; / and the knower is not seen distinctly here in any way.

sanskrit_iast:
svenātmanā tathātmānaṃ kāraṇātmā niyacchati /
prakṛtau kāraṇe tatra svātmanyevopatiṣṭhati //
meaning:
स्वेनात्मना तथात्मानं कारणात्मा नियच्छति /
प्रकृतौ कारणे तत्र स्वात्मन्येवोपतिष्ठति //
text_mt: By one's own self the causal self restrains the self; / in prakṛti, the cause there, it abides in its own self.

sanskrit_iast:
astināstīti so 'nyo vā ihāmutreti vā punaḥ /
ekatvaṃ vā pṛthakvaṃ vā kṣetrajñaḥ puruṣo 'pi vā //
meaning:
अस्तिनास्तीति सो ऽन्यो वा इहामुत्रेति वा पुनः /
एकत्वं वा पृथक्वं वा क्षेत्रज्ञः पुरुषो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Whether 'it is' or 'it is not,' or whether it is other, or whether 'here' or 'hereafter,' / whether oneness or manifoldness, or whether knower of the field or puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmā vā sa nirātmā vā cetano 'cetano 'pi vā /
karttā vā so 'pyakarttā vā bhoktā vā bhojyameva ca //
meaning:
आत्मा वा स निरात्मा वा चेतनो ऽचेतनो ऽपि वा /
कर्त्ता वा सो ऽप्यकर्त्ता वा भोक्ता वा भोज्यमेव च //
text_mt: whether self or non-self, conscious or unconscious, / whether agent or non-agent, enjoyer or the object of enjoyment—

sanskrit_iast:
yadgatvā na nivarttante kṣetrajñaṃ tu nirañjanam /
avācyaṃ tadanākhyānādagrāhyaṃ vādahetubhiḥ //
meaning:
यद्गत्वा न निवर्त्तन्ते क्षेत्रज्ञं तु निरञ्जनम् /
अवाच्यं तदनाख्यानादग्राह्यं वादहेतुभिः //
text_mt: having reached that taintless knower of the field, they do not return; / it is unutterable because of being indescribable, ungraspable by reasons of debate,

sanskrit_iast:
apratarkyamacintyatvādavā yetvācca sarvaśaḥ /
nālapya vacasā tattvamaprāpya manasā saha //
meaning:
अप्रतर्क्यमचिन्त्यत्वादवा येत्वाच्च सर्वशः /
नालप्य वचसा तत्त्वमप्राप्य मनसा सह //
text_mt: incomprehensible because it cannot be thought, and completely unutterable, / that reality which cannot be spoken by speech nor attained along with the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñe nirguṇe śuddhe śānte kṣīṇe nirañjane /
vyapetasukhaduḥkhe ca niruddhe śāntimāgate //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञे निर्गुणे शुद्धे शान्ते क्षीणे निरञ्जने /
व्यपेतसुखदुःखे च निरुद्धे शान्तिमागते //
text_mt: When the knower of the field, devoid of guṇas, pure, pacified, diminished, and taintless, / free from pleasure and pain, has been restrained and attained peace,

sanskrit_iast:
nirātmake punastasminvācyāvācyaṃ na vidyate /
etau saṃhāravistārau vyaktāvyaktau tataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
निरात्मके पुनस्तस्मिन्वाच्यावाच्यं न विद्यते /
एतौ संहारविस्तारौ व्यक्ताव्यक्तौ ततः पुनः //
text_mt: in that self-less [state] there is neither speakable nor unspeakable. / These two, dissolution and expansion, manifest and unmanifest, then again

sanskrit_iast:
sṛjyate grasate caiva vyaktau paryavatiṣṭhate /
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ punaḥ sarge pravarttate //
meaning:
सृज्यते ग्रसते चैव व्यक्तौ पर्यवतिष्ठते /
क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं सर्वं पुनः सर्गे प्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: are emitted and swallowed up, and abide in the manifest; / presided over by the knower of the field, everything proceeds again into creation.

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhānaṃ prapadyeta tasyānte buddhipūrvakam /
sādharmyavaidharmyakṛtaḥ saṃyogo viditastayoḥ /
anādimāṃśca saṃyogo mahāpuruṣajaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अधिष्ठानं प्रपद्येत तस्यान्ते बुद्धिपूर्वकम् /
साधर्म्यवैधर्म्यकृतः संयोगो विदितस्तयोः /
अनादिमांश्च संयोगो महापुरुषजः स्मृतः //
text_mt: At its end, it would resort to the foundation consciously; / the union of the two, produced by similarity and dissimilarity, is known; / and this beginningless union is remembered as born of the great puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvacca sargaprati sargakālastāvajjagattiṣṭhati saṃnirudhya /
pūrvaṃ hi tasyaiva ca buddhipūrvaṃ pravarttate tatpuruṣārthaṃmeva //
meaning:
यावच्च सर्गप्रति सर्गकालस्तावज्जगत्तिष्ठति संनिरुध्य /
पूर्वं हि तस्यैव च बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्त्तते तत्पुरुषार्थंमेव //
text_mt: And as long as the time of primary and secondary creation lasts, so long the world remains restrained; / for earlier, consciously, it proceeds solely for that purpose of the puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā nisargapratisargapūrvā prādhānikī ceśvarakāritā vā /
anādyanantā hyabhimānapūrvakaṃ vitrāsayantī jagadabhyupaiti //
meaning:
एषा निसर्गप्रतिसर्गपूर्वा प्राधानिकी चेश्वरकारिता वा /
अनाद्यनन्ता ह्यभिमानपूर्वकं वित्रासयन्ती जगदभ्युपैति //
text_mt: This [power], preceded by natural evolution and secondary creation, belonging to the primal matter or impelled by the Lord, / beginningless and endless, terrifying the world, approaches preceded by egotism.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargastṛtīyo hetulakṣaṇaḥ /
ukto hyasmiṃstadātyantaṃ kālaṃ jñātvā pramucyate //
meaning:
इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गस्तृतीयो हेतुलक्षणः /
उक्तो ह्यस्मिंस्तदात्यन्तं कालं ज्ञात्वा प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Thus this elemental creation, the third, characterized by cause, / has been declared; knowing the time in this at that moment, one is utterly liberated.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa pratisargo vastrividaḥ kīrttito mayā /
vistareṇānupūrvyāca bhūyaḥ kiṃ varttayāmyaham //
iti śrī brahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte uttarabhāge caturtha upasaṃhārapāde pratisargo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्येष प्रतिसर्गो वस्त्रिविदः कीर्त्तितो मया /
विस्तरेणानुपूर्व्याच भूयः किं वर्त्तयाम्यहम् //
इति श्री ब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते उत्तरभागे चतुर्थ उपसंहारपादे प्रतिसर्गो नाम तृतीयो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus this threefold secondary creation has been proclaimed to you by me / in detail and in due order. What further shall I relate?

Thus ends the third chapter, named Secondary Creation, in the fourth Upasaṃhārapāda of the Uttarabhāga, spoken by Vāyu, in the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
śrutaṃ sumahadākhyānaṃ bhavatā parikīrttitam /
prajānāṃ manubhiḥ sārddhaṃ devānāmṛṣibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
श्रुतं सुमहदाख्यानं भवता परिकीर्त्तितम् /
प्रजानां मनुभिः सार्द्धं देवानामृषिभिः सह //
text_mt: The sages said: / The very great narrative told by you has been heard, / concerning the subjects together with the Manus, and the gods along with the sages,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛgandharvabhūtānāṃ piśācoragarakṣasām /
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣāṇāmeva pakṣiṇām //
meaning:
पितृगन्धर्वभूतानां पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् /
दैत्यानां दानवानां च यक्षाणामेव पक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: of the ancestors, Gandharvas, spirits, Piśācas, serpents, and Rākṣasas, / of the Daityas, Dānavas, Yakṣas, and birds,

sanskrit_iast:
atyadbhutāni karmāṇi vividhā dharmaniścayāḥ /
vicitrāśca kathāyogā janma cāgryamanuttamam //
meaning:
अत्यद्भुतानि कर्माणि विविधा धर्मनिश्चयाः /
विचित्राश्च कथायोगा जन्म चाग्र्यमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: their exceedingly wondrous deeds, the various determinations of dharma, / their diverse narrative sequences, and their foremost, unsurpassed birth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkathyamānamasmākaṃ bhavatā ślakṣṇayā girā /
manaḥ karṇasukhaṃ saute prīṇātyamṛtasannibham //
meaning:
तत्कथ्यमानमस्माकं भवता श्लक्ष्णया गिरा /
मनः कर्णसुखं सौते प्रीणात्यमृतसन्निभम् //
text_mt: Being recounted to us by you in smooth speech, / pleasing to the mind and ears, O bard, it delights like nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
evamārādhya te sūtaṃ satkṛtya ca maharṣayaḥ /
papracchuḥ sattriṇaḥ sarve punaḥ sargapravarttanam //
meaning:
एवमाराध्य ते सूतं सत्कृत्य च महर्षयः /
पप्रच्छुः सत्त्रिणः सर्वे पुनः सर्गप्रवर्त्तनम् //
text_mt: Having thus honored the bard and paid him respect, / all the sacrificers asked about the setting in motion of creation once again:

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ suta mahāprājña punaḥ sargaḥ prapatsyate /
bandheṣu saṃpralīneṣu guṇasāmye tamomaye //
meaning:
कथं सुत महाप्राज्ञ पुनः सर्गः प्रपत्स्यते /
बन्धेषु संप्रलीनेषु गुणसाम्ये तमोमये //
text_mt: How, O bard of great wisdom, will creation take place again / when the bonds are completely dissolved in the equilibrium of the guṇas consisting of tamas,

sanskrit_iast:
vikāreṣvavisṛṣṭeṣu hyavyakte cātmani sthite /
apravṛtte brahmaṇā tu sahasā yojyagaistadā //
meaning:
विकारेष्वविसृष्टेषु ह्यव्यक्ते चात्मनि स्थिते /
अप्रवृत्ते ब्रह्मणा तु सहसा योज्यगैस्तदा //
text_mt: when the evolutes are not yet emitted, abiding in the unmanifest Self, / and when, without commencement, [all things] are suddenly brought together by Brahman?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ prapatsyate sargastannaḥ prabrūhi pṛcchatām /
evamuktastataḥ sūtastadāsau lomaharṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
कथं प्रपत्स्यते सर्गस्तन्नः प्रब्रूहि पृच्छताम् /
एवमुक्तस्ततः सूतस्तदासौ लोमहर्षणः //
text_mt: How will creation proceed? Tell us that as we ask. / Being addressed thus, then, the bard Lomaharṣaṇa

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyātumupacakrāma punaḥ sargapravarttanam /
atra vo varttayiṣyāmi yathā sargaḥ prapatsyate //
meaning:
व्याख्यातुमुपचक्राम पुनः सर्गप्रवर्त्तनम् /
अत्र वो वर्त्तयिष्यामि यथा सर्गः प्रपत्स्यते //
text_mt: began to explain the setting in motion of creation once again: / Here I shall describe to you how creation proceeds.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavatsa tu vijñeyaḥ samāsāttannibodhata /
dṛṣṭenaivānumeyaṃ ca tarkaṃ vakṣyāmi yuktitaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्ववत्स तु विज्ञेयः समासात्तन्निबोधत /
दृष्टेनैवानुमेयं च तर्कं वक्ष्यामि युक्तितः //
text_mt: It is to be understood as being just as before; comprehend it in brief. / And I shall state by reasoning the inference based strictly on what is observed.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādvāco nivarttante tvaprāpya manasā saha /
avyakta vatparokṣatvādgahanaṃ taddurāsadam //
meaning:
यस्माद्वाचो निवर्त्तन्ते त्वप्राप्य मनसा सह /
अव्यक्त वत्परोक्षत्वाद्गहनं तद्दुरासदम् //
text_mt: Since words turn back together with the mind without reaching it, / it is deep and difficult to approach, because like the unmanifest it is beyond perception.

sanskrit_iast:
vikāraiḥ pratisaṃsṛṣṭo guṇaḥ sāmyena varttate /
pradhānaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca sādharmyeṇaiva tiṣṭhati //
meaning:
विकारैः प्रतिसंसृष्टो गुणः साम्येन वर्त्तते /
प्रधानं पुरुषाणां च साधर्म्येणैव तिष्ठति //
text_mt: When it has dissolved together with the evolutes, the guṇa exists in equilibrium; / and pradhāna remains solely by similarity of nature with the puruṣas.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmauṃ pralīyete hyavyakte prāṇināṃ sadā /
sattvamātrātmako dharmo guṇe sattve pratiṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
धर्माधर्मौं प्रलीयेते ह्यव्यक्ते प्राणिनां सदा /
सत्त्वमात्रात्मको धर्मो गुणे सत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठितः //
text_mt: Dharma and adharma of living beings are always dissolved in the unmanifest; / dharma, consisting solely of sattva, is established in the sattva guṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
tamomātrātmako dharmo guṇe tamasi tiṣṭhati /
avibhāgena tāvetau guṇasāmye sthitāvubhau //
meaning:
तमोमात्रात्मको धर्मो गुणे तमसि तिष्ठति /
अविभागेन तावेतौ गुणसाम्ये स्थितावुभौ //
text_mt: adharma, consisting solely of tamas, rests in the tamas guṇa; / both of them abide undivided in the equilibrium of the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ kāryaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ pradhānasya prapatsyate /
buddhipūrvaṃ kṣetrajña adhiṣṭhāsyati tānguṇān //
meaning:
सर्वं कार्यं बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रधानस्य प्रपत्स्यते /
बुद्धिपूर्वं क्षेत्रज्ञ अधिष्ठास्यति तान्गुणान् //
text_mt: Every effect of pradhāna will proceed preceded by intellect; / preceded by intellect, the knower of the field will preside over those guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tānabhimānena prapatsyati punastadā /
yadā pravarttitavyaṃ tu kṣetrakṣetrajñayor dvayoḥ //
meaning:
एवं तानभिमानेन प्रपत्स्यति पुनस्तदा /
यदा प्रवर्त्तितव्यं तु क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर् द्वयोः //
text_mt: Thus, through self-conceit, it will then grasp them again / when the two, the field and the knower of the field, are to be set in motion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhojyabhoktṛtvasaṃbandhāḥ prapatsyante ca tāvubhau /
tasmādakṣaramavyaktaṃ sāmye sthitvā guṇātmakam //
meaning:
भोज्यभोक्तृत्वसंबन्धाः प्रपत्स्यन्ते च तावुभौ /
तस्मादक्षरमव्यक्तं साम्ये स्थित्वा गुणात्मकम् //
text_mt: And the two will assume the relations of the consumed and the consumer; / therefore, the imperishable unmanifest, consisting of the guṇas, having remained in equilibrium,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ tatra vaipamyaṃ bhajate tu tat /
tataḥ prapatsyate vyaktaṃ kṣetrakṣetrajñayordvayoḥ //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं तत्र वैपम्यं भजते तु तत् /
ततः प्रपत्स्यते व्यक्तं क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्द्वयोः //
text_mt: presided over by the knower of the field, undergoes disequilibrium there. / Then the manifest will proceed from the two, the field and the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ sattvaṃ vikāraṃ janayiṣyati /
mahadādyaṃ viśeṣāntaṃ caturviṃśaguṇātmakam //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं सत्त्वं विकारं जनयिष्यति /
महदाद्यं विशेषान्तं चतुर्विंशगुणात्मकम् //
text_mt: Sattva presided over by the knower of the field will produce the evolute / consisting of the twenty-four qualities, beginning with the cosmic intellect and ending with the specific elements.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrajñasya pradhānasya puruṣasya pravartsyataḥ /
ādidevaḥ pradhānasyānugrahāya prajakṣate //
meaning:
क्षेत्रज्ञस्य प्रधानस्य पुरुषस्य प्रवर्त्स्यतः /
आदिदेवः प्रधानस्यानुग्रहाय प्रजक्षते //
text_mt: Of the knower of the field, of pradhāna, and of the puruṣa about to proceed, / the primordial god is proclaimed for the grace of pradhāna.

sanskrit_iast:
anādyau varamutpādau ubhau sūkṣmau tu tau smṛtau /
anādisaṃyogayutau sarvaṃ kṣetrajñameva ca //
meaning:
अनाद्यौ वरमुत्पादौ उभौ सूक्ष्मौ तु तौ स्मृतौ /
अनादिसंयोगयुतौ सर्वं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च //
text_mt: Both are known to be beginningless, excellent in origin, and subtle, / endowed with a beginningless union, and all is indeed the knower of the field.

sanskrit_iast:
abuddhipūrvakaṃ yuktamāśaktau tu varau tadā /
apratyayamamoghaṃ ca sthitāvudakamatsyavat //
meaning:
अबुद्धिपूर्वकं युक्तमाशक्तौ तु वरौ तदा /
अप्रत्ययममोघं च स्थितावुदकमत्स्यवत् //
text_mt: Unpreceded by intellect, conjoined, but then incapable [of creation alone], both excellent, / devoid of conscious cognition and unfailing, they remain like water and a fish.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttapūrvauṃ tau pūrvaṃ punaḥ sarvaṃ prapatsyate /
ajñā guṇaiḥ pravarttante rajaḥsattvatamo 'bhidhaiḥ //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तपूर्वौं तौ पूर्वं पुनः सर्वं प्रपत्स्यते /
अज्ञा गुणैः प्रवर्त्तन्ते रजःसत्त्वतमो ऽभिधैः //
text_mt: The two having been active before, everything will proceed again as before. / The ignorant proceed by means of the guṇas named rajas, sattva, and tamas.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttikāle rajasābhipanno mahattvabhūtādiviśeṣatāṃ ca /
viśeṣatāṃ cendriyatāṃ ca yāti guṇāvasānauṣadhibhirmanuṣyaḥ //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तिकाले रजसाभिपन्नो महत्त्वभूतादिविशेषतां च /
विशेषतां चेन्द्रियतां च याति गुणावसानौषधिभिर्मनुष्यः //
text_mt: At the time of activity, overcome by rajas, [the self] attains the state of cosmic intellect, the origin of the elements, and the specific elements, / and attains the condition of the specific elements and the sense faculties; at the end of the guṇas, man [arises] through the plants.

sanskrit_iast:
satyābhidhyāyinastasya dhyāyinaḥ sannimittakam /
rajaḥ sattvatamovyaktā vidharmāṇaḥ parasparam //
meaning:
सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तस्य ध्यायिनः सन्निमित्तकम् /
रजः सत्त्वतमोव्यक्ता विधर्माणः परस्परम् //
text_mt: For him who meditates on truth, meditating with good cause, / rajas, sattva, and tamas become manifest, having mutually distinct properties.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyantaṃ vai pravatsyante kṣetramajñāmvu sarvaśaḥ /
saṃsiddhakāryakaraṇā utpadyante 'bhimāninaḥ //
meaning:
आद्यन्तं वै प्रवत्स्यन्ते क्षेत्रमज्ञाम्वु सर्वशः /
संसिद्धकार्यकरणा उत्पद्यन्ते ऽभिमानिनः //
text_mt: They will enter the beginning and the end, the field and the ignorant in every way; / possessing accomplished bodies and organs, endowed with self-conceit, they are born.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve sattvāḥ prapadyante hyavyaktātpūrvameva ca /
prāksṛtau ye tvasuvahāḥ sādhakāścāpyasādhakāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वे सत्त्वाः प्रपद्यन्ते ह्यव्यक्तात्पूर्वमेव च /
प्राक्सृतौ ये त्वसुवहाः साधकाश्चाप्यसाधकाः //
text_mt: Indeed, all beings proceed from the unmanifest just as before; / those who were bearers of life in the previous creation, both successful and unsuccessful,

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃśāntāstu te sarve sthānaprakaraṇaiḥ saha /
kāryāṇi pratipatsyante utpatsyante punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
असंशान्तास्तु ते सर्वे स्थानप्रकरणैः सह /
कार्याणि प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते उत्पत्स्यन्ते पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: all of them, not having been entirely extinguished, along with the topics of their positions, / will undertake their tasks and will be born again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇamātrātmakāveva dharmādharmauṃ parasparam /
ārapsaṃte hi cānyonyaṃ vareṇānugraheṇa vā //
meaning:
गुणमात्रात्मकावेव धर्माधर्मौं परस्परम् /
आरप्संते हि चान्योन्यं वरेणानुग्रहेण वा //
text_mt: Consisting solely of the guṇas, dharma and adharma / will mutually act upon each other, either through excellence or grace.

sanskrit_iast:
śarvastulyaprasṛṣṭyartha sargādau yāti vikriyām /
guṇāstaṃ pratidhīyante tasmāttattasya rocate //
meaning:
शर्वस्तुल्यप्रसृष्ट्यर्थ सर्गादौ याति विक्रियाम् /
गुणास्तं प्रतिधीयन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते //
text_mt: At the beginning of creation, Śarva undergoes transformation for the sake of equal creation; / the guṇas are directed toward him, therefore that is pleasing to him.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇāste yāni karmāṇi prāksṛṣṭyāṃ pratipedire /
tānyeva pratipadyante sṛjyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
गुणास्ते यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्ट्यां प्रतिपेदिरे /
तान्येव प्रतिपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Whatever actions those guṇas undertook in the previous creation, / those very same ones they undertake as they are created again and again:

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukūre dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte /
tadbhāvitāḥ prapadyante tasmāttattasya rocate //
meaning:
हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदुकूरे धर्माधर्मावृतानृते /
तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते //
text_mt: harmful and harmless, gentle and cruel, dharma and adharma, true and false; / conditioned by those, they proceed; therefore that is pleasing to him.

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhūteṣu nānātvamindriyārtheṣu mūrttiṣu /
viprayogaśca bhūtānāṃ guṇebhyaḥ saṃpravarttate //
meaning:
महाभूतेषु नानात्वमिन्द्रियार्थेषु मूर्त्तिषु /
विप्रयोगश्च भूतानां गुणेभ्यः संप्रवर्त्तते //
text_mt: Diversity among the gross elements, sense objects, and bodily forms, / and the separation of beings, proceeds from the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa vo mayā khyātaḥ punaḥ sargaḥ samāsataḥ /
samāsādeva vakṣyāmi brahmaṇo 'tha samudbhavam //
meaning:
इत्येष वो मया ख्यातः पुनः सर्गः समासतः /
समासादेव वक्ष्यामि ब्रह्मणो ऽथ समुद्भवम् //
text_mt: Thus has creation again been related to you by me in brief; / now I shall speak in brief of the birth of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktātkāraṇāttasmānnityātsadasadātmakāt /
pradhānapuruṣābhyāṃ tu jāyate ca maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
अव्यक्तात्कारणात्तस्मान्नित्यात्सदसदात्मकात् /
प्रधानपुरुषाभ्यां तु जायते च महेश्वरः //
text_mt: From that unmanifest cause, eternal, consisting of both existence and non-existence, / and from pradhāna and puruṣa, Maheśvara is born.

sanskrit_iast:
sa punaḥ saṃbhāvayitā jāyate brahmasaṃjñitaḥ /
sṛjate sa punarlokānabhimāna guṇātmakān //
meaning:
स पुनः संभावयिता जायते ब्रह्मसंज्ञितः /
सृजते स पुनर्लोकानभिमान गुणात्मकान् //
text_mt: He, the producer, is born again under the name of Brahmā; / he creates the worlds again, consisting of self-conceit and the guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārastu mahatastasmādbhūtāni cātmanaḥ /
yugapatsaṃpravarttante bhūtānyevendriyāṇi ca //
meaning:
अहङ्कारस्तु महतस्तस्माद्भूतानि चात्मनः /
युगपत्संप्रवर्त्तन्ते भूतान्येवेन्द्रियाणि च //
text_mt: Ego arises from the cosmic intellect, and from that [arise] the elements and the self; / simultaneously the elements and the sense faculties proceed.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhedāśca bhūtebhya iti sargaḥ pravarttate /
vistarāvayavasteṣāṃ yathāprajñaṃ yathāśrutam /
kīrttyato vo yathāpūrvaṃ tathaivāpyupadhāryatām //
meaning:
भूतभेदाश्च भूतेभ्य इति सर्गः प्रवर्त्तते /
विस्तरावयवस्तेषां यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम् /
कीर्त्त्यतो वो यथापूर्वं तथैवाप्युपधार्यताम् //
text_mt: And varieties of beings arise from the elements; thus creation proceeds. / Their detailed arrangement, according to understanding and according to tradition, / has been recited to you just as before; let it be comprehended in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast:
etacchrutvā naimiṣeyā stadānīṃ lokotpattiṃ susthitiṃ cāpyayaṃ ca /
tasminsatre 'vabhṛthaṃ prāpya śuddhāḥ puṇyaṃ lokamṛṣayaḥ prāpnuvanti //
meaning:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा नैमिषेया स्तदानीं लोकोत्पत्तिं सुस्थितिं चाप्ययं च /
तस्मिन्सत्रे ऽवभृथं प्राप्य शुद्धाः पुण्यं लोकमृषयः प्राप्नुवन्ति //
text_mt: Having heard this at that time, concerning the origin of the world, its stable preservation, and its dissolution, / having attained the concluding bath at that sacrifice, purified, the sages, inhabitants of Naimiṣa, attain the holy world.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yūyaṃ vidhinā devātādīniṣṭvā caivāvabhṛthaṃ prāpya śuddhāḥ /
tyaktvā dehānāyuṣoṃ'te kṛtārthāḥ puṇyaṃ lokaṃ prāpya modadhvamevam //
meaning:
यथा यूयं विधिना देवातादीनिष्ट्वा चैवावभृथं प्राप्य शुद्धाः /
त्यक्त्वा देहानायुषोंऽते कृतार्थाः पुण्यं लोकं प्राप्य मोदध्वमेवम् //
text_mt: Just as you, having sacrificed according to rule to the deities and others, and having attained the concluding bath, purified, / having cast off your bodies at the end of life, fulfilled in purpose, rejoice upon reaching the holy world!

sanskrit_iast:
ete te naimiṣeyā vai dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca vai tadā /
jagmuścāvabhṛthasnātāḥ svargaṃ sarve tu satriṇaḥ //
meaning:
एते ते नैमिषेया वै दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च वै तदा /
जग्मुश्चावभृथस्नाताः स्वर्गं सर्वे तु सत्रिणः //
text_mt: Indeed, those inhabitants of Naimiṣa, having seen and touched [all things] then, / and having bathed in the concluding bath, all the sacrificers went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāstathā yūyamapi iṣṭā bahuvidhairmakhaiḥ /
āyuṣoṃ'te tataḥ svargaṃ gantāraḥ stha dvijottamāḥ //
meaning:
विप्रास्तथा यूयमपि इष्टा बहुविधैर्मखैः /
आयुषोंऽते ततः स्वर्गं गन्तारः स्थ द्विजोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Likewise you also, O brāhmaṇas, having sacrificed with manifold sacrifices, / will go to heaven at the end of life, O best of the twice-born!

sanskrit_iast:
prakriyā prathamaḥ pādaḥ kathāyāstu parigrahaḥ /
anuṣaṅga upoddhāta upasaṃhāra eva ca //
meaning:
प्रक्रिया प्रथमः पादः कथायास्तु परिग्रहः /
अनुषङ्ग उपोद्धात उपसंहार एव च //
text_mt: Prakriyā is the first pāda, the introduction to the narrative, / then Anuṣaṅga, Upoddhāta, and Upasaṃhāra.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva catuḥpādaṃ purāṇaṃ lokasammatam /
uvāca bhāgavānsakṣādvāyulokahite rataḥ //
meaning:
एवमेव चतुःपादं पुराणं लोकसम्मतम् /
उवाच भागवान्सक्षाद्वायुलोकहिते रतः //
text_mt: Just thus did the Lord himself, Vāyu, devoted to the welfare of the world, / speak the Purāṇa in four pādas, approved by the world.

sanskrit_iast:
naimiṣe satramā sādya munibhyo munisattama /
tatprasādaṃ ca saṃsiddhaṃ bhūtotpattilayānvitam //
meaning:
नैमिषे सत्रमा साद्य मुनिभ्यो मुनिसत्तम /
तत्प्रसादं च संसिद्धं भूतोत्पत्तिलयान्वितम् //
text_mt: Having arrived at the sacrificial session in Naimiṣa, O best of sages, [he proclaimed] to the sages / this accomplished [work], through his grace, endowed with the origination and dissolution of beings.

sanskrit_iast:
prādhānikīmimāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ tathaiveśvarakāritām /
samyagviditvā medhāvī na mohamadhigacchati //
meaning:
प्राधानिकीमिमां सृष्टिं तथैवेश्वरकारिताम् /
सम्यग्विदित्वा मेधावी न मोहमधिगच्छति //
text_mt: Having correctly understood this creation arising from the primary material cause and likewise brought about by the Lord, / a wise man does not fall into delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ yo brāhmaṇo vidvānitihāsaṃ purātanam /
śṛṇuyācchrāvayedvāpi tathādhyāpayate 'pi ca //
meaning:
इदं यो ब्राह्मणो विद्वानितिहासं पुरातनम् /
शृणुयाच्छ्रावयेद्वापि तथाध्यापयते ऽपि च //
text_mt: Whatever learned brāhmaṇa should hear, recite, / or even teach this ancient history,

sanskrit_iast:
sthāneṣu sa mahendrasya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ /
brahmasāyujyago bhūtvā brahmaṇā saha modate //
meaning:
स्थानेषु स महेन्द्रस्य मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः /
ब्रह्मसायुज्यगो भूत्वा ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते //
text_mt: he rejoices in the abodes of Mahendra for eternal years; / having attained union with Brahman, he rejoices with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ kīrtimatāṃ kīrtiṃ prajeśānāṃ mahātmanām /
prathayanpṛthivīśānāṃ brahmabhūyāya gacchati //
meaning:
तेषां कीर्तिमतां कीर्तिं प्रजेशानां महात्मनाम् /
प्रथयन्पृथिवीशानां ब्रह्मभूयाय गच्छति //
text_mt: Proclaiming the renown of those renowned lords of creatures, the great-souled lords of the earth, / he attains the state of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiśca saṃmitam /
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanenoktaṃ purāṇa brahmavādinā //
meaning:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं वेदैश्च संमितम् /
कृष्णद्वैपायनेनोक्तं पुराण ब्रह्मवादिना //
text_mt: Auspiocious, fame-bestowing, life-giving, meritorious, and equal to the Vedas / is the Purāṇa spoken by Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana, who proclaims Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
manvantareśvarāṇāṃ ca yaḥ kīrtiṃ prathayedimām /
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhūridravimatejasām //
meaning:
मन्वन्तरेश्वराणां च यः कीर्तिं प्रथयेदिमाम् /
देवतानामृषीणां च भूरिद्रविमतेजसाम् //
text_mt: And whoever should proclaim this renown of the rulers of the manvantaras, / and of the gods and sages endowed with immense wealth and splendor,

sanskrit_iast:
sa sarvairmucyate pāpaiḥ puṇyaṃ ca mahadāpnuyāt /
yaścedaṃ śrāvayedvidvānsadā parvaṇi parvaṇi //
meaning:
स सर्वैर्मुच्यते पापैः पुण्यं च महदाप्नुयात् /
यश्चेदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्सदा पर्वणि पर्वणि //
text_mt: he is freed from all sins and shall obtain great merit. / And whatever wise person should always recite this on every junction of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūtapāpmā jitasvargo brahmabhūyāya kalpate /
yaścedaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe brāhmaṇān pādamantataḥ //
meaning:
धूतपाप्मा जितस्वर्गो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते /
यश्चेदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे ब्राह्मणान् पादमन्ततः //
text_mt: his sins shaken off and heaven won, he is fit for the state of Brahman. / And whatever person should recite this to brāhmaṇas during an ancestral rite, even a single quarter-verse,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣeyaṃ sarvakāmīyaṃ pitṝṃstacchopatiṣṭhate /
yasmātpurā hyaṇantīdaṃ purāṇaṃ tena cocyate //
meaning:
अक्षेयं सर्वकामीयं पितॄंस्तच्छोपतिष्ठते /
यस्मात्पुरा ह्यणन्तीदं पुराणं तेन चोच्यते //
text_mt: it serves his ancestors as imperishable and fulfilling all desires. / Because in ancient times they recited this, it is therefore called 'Purāṇa'.

sanskrit_iast:
niruktamasya yo veda sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
tathaiva triṣu varṇeṣu ye manuṣyā adhīyate //
meaning:
निरुक्तमस्य यो वेद सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
तथैव त्रिषु वर्णेषु ये मनुष्या अधीयते //
text_mt: Whoever knows its etymology is liberated from all sins. / Likewise, whatever men among the three castes study it,

sanskrit_iast:
itihāsamimaṃ śrutvā dharmāya vidadhe matim /
yāvantyasya śarīreṣu romakūpāni sarvaśaḥ //
meaning:
इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा धर्माय विदधे मतिम् /
यावन्त्यस्य शरीरेषु रोमकूपानि सर्वशः //
text_mt: having heard this history, direct their minds to righteousness. / As many hair-pores as there are all over his body,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatkoṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi divi modate /
brahmasāyujyago bhūtvā daivataiḥ saha modate //
meaning:
तावत्कोटिसहस्राणि वर्षाणि दिवि मोदते /
ब्रह्मसायुज्यगो भूत्वा दैवतैः सह मोदते //
text_mt: for so many thousands of crores of years he rejoices in heaven; / having attained union with Brahman, he rejoices with the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca yaśasvi ca /
brahmā dadau śāstramidaṃ purāṇaṃ mātariśvane //
meaning:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं पवित्रं च यशस्वि च /
ब्रह्मा ददौ शास्त्रमिदं पुराणं मातरिश्वने //
text_mt: Destructive of all sins, meritorious, purifying, and glorious— / Brahmā gave this teaching, the Purāṇa, to Mātariśvan.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāccośanasā prāptaṃ tasmāccāpi bṛhaspatiḥ /
bṛhaspatistu provāca savitre tadanantaram //
meaning:
तस्माच्चोशनसा प्राप्तं तस्माच्चापि बृहस्पतिः /
बृहस्पतिस्तु प्रोवाच सवित्रे तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: From him it was obtained by Uśanas, and from him Bṛhaspati; / Bṛhaspati, in turn, told it to Savitṛ next.

sanskrit_iast:
savitā mṛtyave prāha mṛtyuścendrāya vai punaḥ /
indraścāpi vasiṣṭhāya so 'pi sārasvatāya ca //
meaning:
सविता मृत्यवे प्राह मृत्युश्चेन्द्राय वै पुनः /
इन्द्रश्चापि वसिष्ठाय सो ऽपि सारस्वताय च //
text_mt: Savitṛ told it to Mṛtyu, and Mṛtyu again to Indra; / and Indra to Vasiṣṭha, and he to Sārasvata.

sanskrit_iast:
sārasvatastridhāmne 'tha tridhāmā ca śaradvate /
śaradvāṃstu triviṣṭāya soṃ'tarikṣāya dattavān //
meaning:
सारस्वतस्त्रिधाम्ने ऽथ त्रिधामा च शरद्वते /
शरद्वांस्तु त्रिविष्टाय सोंऽतरिक्षाय दत्तवान् //
text_mt: Sārasvata then [gave it] to Tridhāman, and Tridhāman to Śaradvant; / Śaradvant gave it to Triviṣṭa, and he to Antarikṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
carṣiṇe cāntarikṣo vai so 'pi trayyāruṇāya ca /
trayyāruṇāddhanañjayaḥ sa vai prādātkṛtañjaye //
meaning:
चर्षिणे चान्तरिक्षो वै सो ऽपि त्रय्यारुणाय च /
त्रय्यारुणाद्धनञ्जयः स वै प्रादात्कृतञ्जये //
text_mt: Antarikṣa gave it to Carṣiṇi, and he to Trayyāruṇa; / from Trayyāruṇa [it went] to Dhanañjaya, and he gave it to Kṛtañjaya.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtañjayāttṛṇañjayo bharadvājāya so 'pyatha /
gautamāya bharadvājaḥ so 'pi niryyantare punaḥ //
meaning:
कृतञ्जयात्तृणञ्जयो भरद्वाजाय सो ऽप्यथ /
गौतमाय भरद्वाजः सो ऽपि निर्य्यन्तरे पुनः //
text_mt: From Kṛtañjaya [it went] to Tṛṇañjaya, and he then to Bharadvāja; / Bharadvāja to Gautama, and he again to Niryantara.

sanskrit_iast:
niryyantarastu provāca tathā vājaśravāya vai /
sa dadau somaśuṣmāya sa cādāttṛṇabindave //
meaning:
निर्य्यन्तरस्तु प्रोवाच तथा वाजश्रवाय वै /
स ददौ सोमशुष्माय स चादात्तृणबिन्दवे //
text_mt: Niryantara told it likewise to Vājaśravas; / he gave it to Somaśuṣma, and he gave it to Tṛṇabindu.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇabindustu dakṣāya dakṣaḥ provāca śaktaye /
śakteḥ parāśaraścāpi garbhasthaḥ śrutavānidam //
meaning:
तृणबिन्दुस्तु दक्षाय दक्षः प्रोवाच शक्तये /
शक्तेः पराशरश्चापि गर्भस्थः श्रुतवानिदम् //
text_mt: Tṛṇabindu [gave it] to Dakṣa, and Dakṣa told it to Śakti; / Parāśara, while still in the womb, heard this from Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
parāśarājjātukarṇyastasmāddvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ /
dvaipāyanā tpunaścāpi mayā prāptaṃ dvijottama //
meaning:
पराशराज्जातुकर्ण्यस्तस्माद्द्वैपायनः प्रभुः /
द्वैपायना त्पुनश्चापि मया प्राप्तं द्विजोत्तम //
text_mt: From Parāśara, Jātūkarṇya [received it], and from him the lord Dvaipāyana; / and from Dvaipāyana, in turn, it was obtained by me, O best of the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā caitatpunaḥ proktaṃ putrāyāmitabuddhaye /
ityeva vākyaṃ brahmādiguruṇāṃ samudātdṛtam //
meaning:
मया चैतत्पुनः प्रोक्तं पुत्रायामितबुद्धये /
इत्येव वाक्यं ब्रह्मादिगुरुणां समुदात्दृतम् //
text_mt: And by me this was spoken again to my son of boundless intellect. / Thus indeed is this teaching held high by the lineage of teachers beginning with Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskāryāśca guravaḥ prayatnena manīṣibhiḥ /
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvārthasādhakam //
meaning:
नमस्कार्याश्च गुरवः प्रयत्नेन मनीषिभिः /
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं पुण्यं सर्वार्थसाधकम् //
text_mt: And the teachers must be saluted with effort by wise men. / Auspicious, fame-bestowing, life-giving, meritorious, achieving all aims,

sanskrit_iast:
pāpaghnaṃ niyamenedaṃ śrotavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sadā /
nāśucau nāpi pāpāya nāpyasaṃvatsaroṣite //
meaning:
पापघ्नं नियमेनेदं श्रोतव्यं ब्राह्मणैः सदा /
नाशुचौ नापि पापाय नाप्यसंवत्सरोषिते //
text_mt: destroying sins, this should always be heard with restraint by brāhmaṇas. / Not to the impure, nor to the sinful, nor to one who has not dwelt [as a student] for a year,

sanskrit_iast:
nāśraddadhāne 'viduṣe nāputrāya kathañcana /
nāhitāya pradātavyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam //
meaning:
नाश्रद्दधाने ऽविदुषे नापुत्राय कथञ्चन /
नाहिताय प्रदातव्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: not to the faithless, to the unlearned, nor ever to one without a son, / nor to one who is ill-disposed should this supreme purifier be given.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ vai yasya yoniṃ vadanti vyaktaṃ dehaṃ kālametaṃ gatiṃ ca /
vahnirvaktraṃ candrasūryauṃ ca netrediśaḥ śrotre ghrāṇamāhuśca vāyum //
meaning:
अव्यक्तं वै यस्य योनिं वदन्ति व्यक्तं देहं कालमेतं गतिं च /
वह्निर्वक्त्रं चन्द्रसूर्यौं च नेत्रेदिशः श्रोत्रे घ्राणमाहुश्च वायुम् //
text_mt: Whose origin they call the unmanifest, whose manifest body is time, and this movement; / fire is his mouth, the moon and the sun are his two eyes, the cardinal directions his ears, and wind, they say, his breath;

sanskrit_iast:
vāco vedā antarikṣaṃ śarīraṃ kṣitiḥ pādāstārakā romakūpāḥ /
sarvāṇi dyaurmastakāni tvatho vai vidyāścaivopaniṣadyasya puccham //
meaning:
वाचो वेदा अन्तरिक्षं शरीरं क्षितिः पादास्तारका रोमकूपाः /
सर्वाणि द्यौर्मस्तकानि त्वथो वै विद्याश्चैवोपनिषद्यस्य पुच्छम् //
text_mt: the Vedas are his words, the intermediate space his body, the earth his feet, the stars his hair-pores; / heaven all of his heads, the sciences and the Upaniṣad his tail;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ devadevaṃ jananaṃ janānāṃ yajñātmakaṃ satyalokapratiṣṭham /
varaṃ varāṇāṃ varadaṃ maheśvaraṃ brahmāṇamādiṃ prayato namasye //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe vāyuprokte dvādaśasāharsyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ uttarabhāge caturthaṃ upasaṃhārapāde brahmāṇḍāvarttaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तं देवदेवं जननं जनानां यज्ञात्मकं सत्यलोकप्रतिष्ठम् /
वरं वराणां वरदं महेश्वरं ब्रह्माणमादिं प्रयतो नमस्ये //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे वायुप्रोक्ते द्वादशसाहर्स्यां संहितायां उत्तरभागे चतुर्थं उपसंहारपादे ब्रह्माण्डावर्त्तं नाम चतुर्थो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
to that God of gods, the progenitor of beings, whose essence is sacrifice, established in Satyaloka, / the best among the best, the giver of boons, the great lord, Brahmā the primeval, I bow with devotion.

Thus ends the fourth chapter, named 'The Evolution of the Cosmic Egg', in the fourth section, the Upasaṃhārapāda, in the latter half of the twelve-thousand-verse Saṃhitā spoken by Vāyu, in the holy Mahāpurāṇa, the Brahmāṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ /
atha śrīlalitopākhyānaṃ prārabhyate /
caturbhuje candrakalāvataṃse kuconnate kuṅkumarāgaśoṇe /
puṇḍrekṣupāśāṅkuśapuṣpabāṇahaste namaste jagadekamātaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीगणेशाय नमः /
अथ श्रीललितोपाख्यानं प्रारभ्यते /
चतुर्भुजे चन्द्रकलावतंसे कुचोन्नते कुङ्कुमरागशोणे /
पुण्ड्रेक्षुपाशाङ्कुशपुष्पबाणहस्ते नमस्ते जगदेकमातः //
text_mt: Homage to holy Gaṇeśa. / Now the holy Lalitopākhyāna is begun. / Four-armed, crested with the crescent moon, with elevated breasts, red as the hue of saffron, / holding the sugarcane bow, noose, goad, and flower arrows in your hands: homage to you, sole Mother of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
astu naḥ śreyase nityaṃ vastu vāmāṅgasundaram /
yatastṛtīyo viduṣāṃ tṛtīyastu paraṃ mahaḥ //
meaning:
अस्तु नः श्रेयसे नित्यं वस्तु वामाङ्गसुन्दरम् /
यतस्तृतीयो विदुषां तृतीयस्तु परं महः //
text_mt: May that entity, beautiful in the left side of its body, eternally lead to our welfare, / from which arises the third [state] of the wise, while the third is the supreme splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
agastyo nāma devarṣirvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ /
sarvasiddhāntasārajño brahmānandarasātmakaḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्यो नाम देवर्षिर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः /
सर्वसिद्धान्तसारज्ञो ब्रह्मानन्दरसात्मकः //
text_mt: A divine sage named Agastya, who had crossed over the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences, / who knew the essence of all established truths, and whose self was the bliss of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
cacārādbhutahetūni tīrthānyāyatanāni ca /
śailāraṇyāpagāmukhyānsarvāñjanapadānapi //
meaning:
चचाराद्भुतहेतूनि तीर्थान्यायतनानि च /
शैलारण्यापगामुख्यान्सर्वाञ्जनपदानपि //
text_mt: wandered to miraculous sacred places and shrines, / and through all realms, headed by mountains, forests, and rivers.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu teṣvakhilāñjantūnajñānatimirāvṛtān /
śiśnodaraparāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa tānprati //
meaning:
तेषु तेष्वखिलाञ्जन्तूनज्ञानतिमिरावृतान् /
शिश्नोदरपरान्दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास तान्प्रति //
text_mt: Seeing all beings in those various places enveloped in the darkness of ignorance / and devoted only to the genitals and belly, he reflected upon them.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cintayamānasya carato vasudhāmimām /
prāptamāsīnmahāpuṇyaṃ kāñcīnagaramuttamam //
meaning:
तस्य चिन्तयमानस्य चरतो वसुधामिमाम् /
प्राप्तमासीन्महापुण्यं काञ्चीनगरमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: As he was wandering over this earth, full of concern, / he reached the most sacred and excellent city of Kāñcī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vāraṇaśailenadramekāmranilayaṃ śivam /
kāmākṣīṃ karidoṣadhnīmapūjayadathātmavān //
meaning:
तत्र वारणशैलेनद्रमेकाम्रनिलयं शिवम् /
कामाक्षीं करिदोषध्नीमपूजयदथात्मवान् //
text_mt: There, the self-controlled sage worshipped Śiva, whose dwelling is the Ekāmra tree, / upon the Vāraṇa mountain, and Kāmākṣī, who destroys sins committed by beings.

sanskrit_iast:
lokahetordayārdrasya dhīmataścintano muhuḥ /
cirakālena tapasā toṣito 'bhūjjanārdanaḥ //
meaning:
लोकहेतोर्दयार्द्रस्य धीमतश्चिन्तनो मुहुः /
चिरकालेन तपसा तोषितो ऽभूज्जनार्दनः //
text_mt: For the sake of the world, Janārdana was gratified by the wise sage, / moist with compassion, who contemplated repeatedly, by means of his long-practiced asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīvāṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā sākṣāccinmātravigrahām /
śaṅkhacakrākṣavalayapustakojjvalabāhukām //
meaning:
हयग्रीवां तनुं कृत्वा साक्षाच्चिन्मात्रविग्रहाम् /
शङ्खचक्राक्षवलयपुस्तकोज्ज्वलबाहुकाम् //
text_mt: Assuming the form of Hayagrīva, which is consciousness alone personified, / with arms resplendent with the conch, discus, rosary, and book,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrayitrīṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ prabhayā dehajātayā /
prādurbabhūva purato muneramitatejasā //
meaning:
पूरयित्रीं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रभया देहजातया /
प्रादुर्बभूव पुरतो मुनेरमिततेजसा //
text_mt: filling the entire universe with the radiance born of his body, / he appeared before the sage with boundless splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvānandabharitaḥ praṇamya ca muhurmuhuḥ /
vinayāvanato bhūtvā santuṣṭāva jagatpatim //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वानन्दभरितः प्रणम्य च मुहुर्मुहुः /
विनयावनतो भूत्वा सन्तुष्टाव जगत्पतिम् //
text_mt: Seeing him, filled with bliss and bowing repeatedly, / bending low in modesty, he praised the Lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
athovāca jagannāthastuṣṭo 'smi tapasā tava /
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te bhavitā bhūsurottamaḥ //
meaning:
अथोवाच जगन्नाथस्तुष्टो ऽस्मि तपसा तव /
वरं वरय भद्रं ते भविता भूसुरोत्तमः //
text_mt: Then the Lord of the universe said: "I am pleased with your asceticism; / choose a boon; welfare shall be unto you, O best of brāhmaṇas!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti pṛṣṭo bhagavatā provāca munisattamaḥ /
yadi tuṣṭo 'si bhagavannime pāmarajantavaḥ //
meaning:
इति पृष्टो भगवता प्रोवाच मुनिसत्तमः /
यदि तुष्टो ऽसि भगवन्निमे पामरजन्तवः //
text_mt: Thus asked by the Blessed Lord, the best of sages said: / "If you are pleased, O Lord, by what means may these wretched beings

sanskrit_iast:
kenopāyena muktāḥ syuretanme vaktumarhasi /
iti pṛṣṭo dvijenātha devadevo janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
केनोपायेन मुक्ताः स्युरेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि /
इति पृष्टो द्विजेनाथ देवदेवो जनार्दनः //
