text_mt: be liberated? You should tell me this." / Thus asked by the twice-born, the God of gods, Janārdana, [replied]:

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ śivena carito mama /
ayameva kṛtaḥ praśno brahmaṇā tu tataḥ param //
meaning:
एष एव पुरा प्रश्नः शिवेन चरितो मम /
अयमेव कृतः प्रश्नो ब्रह्मणा तु ततः परम् //
text_mt: "This very question was addressed to me formerly by Śiva; / this very question was asked after that by Brahmā;

sanskrit_iast: kṛto durvāsasā paścādbhavatā tu tataḥ param //
meaning: कृतो दुर्वाससा पश्चाद्भवता तु ततः परम् //
text_mt: it was asked later by Durvāsas, and after that, by you."

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ gurubhūtairmahātmabhiḥ /
mamopadeśo lokeṣu prathito 'stu varo mama //
meaning:
भवद्भिः सर्वभूतानां गुरुभूतैर्महात्मभिः /
ममोपदेशो लोकेषु प्रथितो ऽस्तु वरो मम //
text_mt:
“Through you, who are great-souled gurus of all beings,
may my instruction become renowned in the worlds; this is my boon.

sanskrit_iast:
ahamādirhi bhūtānāmādikartā svayaṃ prabhuḥ /
sṛṣṭisthitilayānāṃ tu sarveṣāmapi kārakaḥ //
meaning:
अहमादिर्हि भूतानामादिकर्ता स्वयं प्रभुः /
सृष्टिस्थितिलयानां तु सर्वेषामपि कारकः //
text_mt:
For I am the beginning of all beings, the primal creator, the Lord himself,
and indeed the maker of all creation, maintenance, and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast: trimūrtistriguṇātīto guṇahīno guṇāśrayaḥ //
meaning: त्रिमूर्तिस्त्रिगुणातीतो गुणहीनो गुणाश्रयः //
text_mt: Possessing three forms, beyond the three guṇas, devoid of guṇas, the refuge of guṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
icchāvihāro bhūtātmā pradhānapuruṣātmakaḥ /
evaṃ bhūtasya me brahmaṃstrijagadrūpadhāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
इच्छाविहारो भूतात्मा प्रधानपुरुषात्मकः /
एवं भूतस्य मे ब्रह्मंस्त्रिजगद्रूपधारिणः //
text_mt:
sporting at will, the self of all beings, consisting of pradhāna and puruṣa.
Of me, who am thus, O Brahman, bearing the form of the threefold world,

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhākṛtamabhūdrūpaṃ pradhāna puruṣātmakam /
mama pradhānaṃ yadrūpaṃ sarvalokaguṇātmakam //
meaning:
द्विधाकृतमभूद्रूपं प्रधान पुरुषात्मकम् /
मम प्रधानं यद्रूपं सर्वलोकगुणात्मकम् //
text_mt:
the form was divided in two, consisting of pradhāna and puruṣa.
My form that is pradhāna consists of the guṇas of all the worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ yadguṇātītaṃ parātparataraṃ mahat /
evameva tayorjñātvā mucyate te ubhe kimu //
meaning:
अपरं यद्गुणातीतं परात्परतरं महत् /
एवमेव तयोर्ज्ञात्वा मुच्यते ते उभे किमु //
text_mt:
the other, which is beyond the guṇas, is higher than the highest, great.
Having known both of them in this way, is one released?

sanskrit_iast:
tapobhiścirakālotthairyamaiśca niyamairapi /
tyāgairduṣkarmanāśānte muktirāśveva labhyate //
meaning:
तपोभिश्चिरकालोत्थैर्यमैश्च नियमैरपि /
त्यागैर्दुष्कर्मनाशान्ते मुक्तिराश्वेव लभ्यते //
text_mt:
By austerities practiced for a long time, and by yamas and niyamas,
and by renunciations, at the end of the destruction of bad karma, liberation is quickly attained.

sanskrit_iast:
yadrūpaṃ yadguṇayutaṃ tadguṇyaikyena labhyate /
anyatsarvajagadrūpaṃ karmabhogaparākramam //
meaning:
यद्रूपं यद्गुणयुतं तद्गुण्यैक्येन लभ्यते /
अन्यत्सर्वजगद्रूपं कर्मभोगपराक्रमम् //
text_mt:
Whatever form is endowed with whatever guṇa is attained through oneness with that possessor of guṇas;
the other is the form of the entire universe, displaying the valor of karmic experiences.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhirlabhyate tacca tattyāgenāpi labhyate /
dustarastu tayostyāgaḥ sakalairapi tāpasa //
meaning:
कर्मभिर्लभ्यते तच्च तत्त्यागेनापि लभ्यते /
दुस्तरस्तु तयोस्त्यागः सकलैरपि तापस //
text_mt:
And that is attained through works, or it is attained even through the abandonment thereof;
but the abandonment of both is hard to traverse for everyone, O ascetic.

sanskrit_iast: anapāyaṃ ca sugamaṃ sadasatkarmagocaram //
meaning: अनपायं च सुगमं सदसत्कर्मगोचरम् //
text_mt: It is imperishable and easily accessible, the domain of good and bad karma.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmasthena guṇenaiva satā cāpyasatāpivā /
ātmaikyenaiva yajjñānaṃ sarvasiddhigradāyakam //
meaning:
आत्मस्थेन गुणेनैव सता चाप्यसतापिवा /
आत्मैक्येनैव यज्ज्ञानं सर्वसिद्धिग्रदायकम् //
text_mt:
By the quality present within oneself, whether real or unreal,
knowledge solely through oneness with the Self grants all supernatural powers.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇatrayavihīnānāṃ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ nṛṇāmapi /
yadrūpadhyānamātreṇa duṣkṛtaṃ sukṛtāyate //
meaning:
वर्णत्रयविहीनानां पापिष्ठानां नृणामपि /
यद्रूपध्यानमात्रेण दुष्कृतं सुकृतायते //
text_mt:
Even for men who are devoid of the three varṇas and most sinful,
by the mere meditation on her form, bad action turns into good action.

sanskrit_iast:
yer'cayanti parāṃ śaktiṃ vidhināvidhināpi vā /
na te saṃsāriṇo nūnaṃ muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
येर्ऽचयन्ति परां शक्तिं विधिनाविधिनापि वा /
न ते संसारिणो नूनं मुक्ता एव न संशयः //
text_mt:
Those who worship the supreme Śakti, whether according to rule or not according to rule,
are certainly not transmigrating beings; they are truly liberated, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo vā yāṃ samārādhya dhyānayogabalena ca /
īśvaraḥ sarvasiddhānāmarddhanārīśvaro 'bhavat //
meaning:
शिवो वा यां समाराध्य ध्यानयोगबलेन च /
ईश्वरः सर्वसिद्धानामर्द्धनारीश्वरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
Worshiping whom, by the power of meditation and yoga,
Śiva became the Lord of all accomplished ones, the Lord Who is Half Woman.

sanskrit_iast:
anye 'bjapramukhā devāḥ siddhāstaddhyānavaibhavāt /
tasmādaśeṣalokānāṃ tripurārādhanaṃ vinā //
meaning:
अन्ये ऽब्जप्रमुखा देवाः सिद्धास्तद्ध्यानवैभवात् /
तस्मादशेषलोकानां त्रिपुराराधनं विना //
text_mt:
Other gods, beginning with the lotus-born [Brahmā], became accomplished through the majesty of meditation upon her;
therefore, for all worlds, without the worship of Tripurā,

sanskrit_iast:
na sto bhogāpavargauṃ tu yaugapadyena kutracit /
tanmanāstadgataprāṇastadyājī tadgatehakaḥ //
meaning:
न स्तो भोगापवर्गौं तु यौगपद्येन कुत्रचित् /
तन्मनास्तद्गतप्राणस्तद्याजी तद्गतेहकः //
text_mt:
enjoyment and liberation do not exist anywhere simultaneously.
Fixing your mind on her, devoting your life-breath to her, sacrificing to her, directing your efforts to her,

sanskrit_iast:
tādātmyenaiva karmāṇi kurvanmuktimavāpsyasi /
etadrahasyamākhyātaṃ sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
तादात्म्येनैव कर्माणि कुर्वन्मुक्तिमवाप्स्यसि /
एतद्रहस्यमाख्यातं सर्वेषां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt:
performing actions through identity with her alone, you shall attain liberation.
This secret has been declared out of a desire for the welfare of all,

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭenaiva tapasā bhavato munisattama /
devāśca munayaḥ siddhā mānuṣāśca tathāpare /
tvanmukhāṃbhojato 'vāpyasiddhiṃ yāntu parātparām //
meaning:
सन्तुष्टेनैव तपसा भवतो मुनिसत्तम /
देवाश्च मुनयः सिद्धा मानुषाश्च तथापरे /
त्वन्मुखांभोजतो ऽवाप्यसिद्धिं यान्तु परात्पराम् //
text_mt:
being pleased with your austerity, O best of sages.
May the gods, sages, perfected ones, and likewise other human beings,
receiving it from your lotus mouth, attain the highest accomplished state!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā hayagrīvasya śārṅgiṇaḥ /
praṇipatya punarvākyamuvāca madhusūdanam //
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हयग्रीवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः /
प्रणिपत्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt:
Having heard these words of Hayagrīva, the bow-bearing Śārṅgin,
[Agastya] bowed down and again addressed words to Madhusūdana:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavankīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatā yatpuroditam /
kiṃvihāraṃ kiṃprabhāvametanme vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
भगवन्कीदृशं रूपं भवता यत्पुरोदितम् /
किंविहारं किंप्रभावमेतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
“O Lord, what kind of form is that which was described by you earlier?
What is its sport? What is its power? You ought to tell me this.”

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
eṣoṃ'śabhūto devarṣe hayagrīvo mamāparaḥ /
śrotumicchasiyadyattvaṃ tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhati //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
एषोंऽशभूतो देवर्षे हयग्रीवो ममापरः /
श्रोतुमिच्छसियद्यत्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हति //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
“This other Hayagrīva, O divine sage, is a portion of me.
Whatever you wish to hear, he is able to tell it all.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityādiśya jagannātho hayagrīvaṃ tapodhanam /
purataḥ kumbhajātasya munerantaradhāddhariḥ //
meaning:
इत्यादिश्य जगन्नाथो हयग्रीवं तपोधनम् /
पुरतः कुम्भजातस्य मुनेरन्तरधाद्धरिः //
text_mt:
Having thus instructed the ascetic Hayagrīva
in front of the sage born from the pitcher, Hari disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā tapodhanaḥ /
hayagrīveṇa muninā svāśramaṃ pratyapadyata //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne agastyayātrājanārdanāvirbhāvo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
ततस्तु विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा तपोधनः /
हयग्रीवेण मुनिना स्वाश्रमं प्रत्यपद्यत //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने अगस्त्ययात्राजनार्दनाविर्भावो नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Then, filled with wonder, his hair standing on end, that ascetic
went to his hermitage along with the sage Hayagrīva.

Thus in the venerable Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa, in the latter section, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the Lalitopākhyāna, the fifth chapter, named ‘The Journey of Agastya and the Manifestation of Janārdana.’

sanskrit_iast:
athopaveśya caivainamāsane paramādbhute /
hayānanamupāgatyāgastyo vākyaṃ samabravīt //
meaning:
अथोपवेश्य चैवैनमासने परमाद्भुते /
हयाननमुपागत्यागस्त्यो वाक्यं समब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Then, having seated him on a supremely wondrous seat,
approaching the horse-faced one, Agastya spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvasiddhāntavittam /
lokābhyudayaheturhi darśanaṃ hi bhavādṛśām //
meaning:
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वसिद्धान्तवित्तम् /
लोकाभ्युदयहेतुर्हि दर्शनं हि भवादृशाम् //
text_mt:
“O Lord, knower of all dharmas, best among knowers of all doctrines,
the sight of those like you is indeed the cause of the world's elevation.

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbhāvaṃ mahādevyāstasyā rūpāntarāṇi ca /
vihāraścaiva mukhyā ye tānno vistarato vada //
meaning:
आविर्भावं महादेव्यास्तस्या रूपान्तराणि च /
विहारश्चैव मुख्या ये तान्नो विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt:
The manifestation of the Great Goddess, and her other forms,
and those sports that are principal—tell us those in detail.”

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
anādirakhilādhārā sadasatkarmarūpiṇī /
dhyānaikadṛśyā dhyānāṅgī vidyāṅgī hṛdayāspadā //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
अनादिरखिलाधारा सदसत्कर्मरूपिणी /
ध्यानैकदृश्या ध्यानाङ्गी विद्याङ्गी हृदयास्पदा //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
“She is without beginning, the support of all, having the form of good and bad karma,
to be seen through meditation alone, whose limbs are meditation, whose limbs are knowledge, whose abode is the heart.

sanskrit_iast: ātmaikyādvyaktimāyāti cirānuṣṭhānagauravāt //
meaning: आत्मैक्याद्व्यक्तिमायाति चिरानुष्ठानगौरवात् //
text_mt: Through oneness with the Self, she comes to manifestation due to the dignity of long practice.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau prādurabhūcchaktirbrahmaṇo dhyānayogataḥ /
prakṛtirnāma sā khyātā devānāmiṣṭasiddhidā //
meaning:
आदौ प्रादुरभूच्छक्तिर्ब्रह्मणो ध्यानयोगतः /
प्रकृतिर्नाम सा ख्याता देवानामिष्टसिद्धिदा //
text_mt:
In the beginning, Śakti manifested from the meditation and yoga of Brahmā;
she is known by the name Prakṛti, granting the desired accomplishment of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyamudabhūdrūpaṃ pravṛtte 'mṛtamanthane /
śarvasaṃmohajanakamavāṅmanasagojaram //
meaning:
द्वितीयमुदभूद्रूपं प्रवृत्ते ऽमृतमन्थने /
शर्वसंमोहजनकमवाङ्मनसगोजरम् //
text_mt:
Her second form arose when the churning for nectar commenced,
producing delusion in Śarva, beyond the reach of speech and mind.

sanskrit_iast:
yaddarśanādabhūdīśaḥ sarvajño 'pi vimohitaḥ /
visṛjya pārvatīṃ śīghrantayā ruddho 'tanodratam //
meaning:
यद्दर्शनादभूदीशः सर्वज्ञो ऽपि विमोहितः /
विसृज्य पार्वतीं शीघ्रन्तया रुद्धो ऽतनोद्रतम् //
text_mt:
By the sight of which the Lord, though omniscient, was utterly deluded;
abandoning Pārvatī, he quickly pursued her and engaged in union.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ vai janayāmāsa śāstāramasurārdanam //
meaning: तस्यां वै जनयामास शास्तारमसुरार्दनम् //
text_mt: Upon her he indeed fathered Śāstṛ, the destroyer of the asuras.”

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
kathaṃ vai sarvabhūteśo vaśī manmatha śāsanaḥ /
aho vimohito devyā janayāmāsa cātmajam //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
कथं वै सर्वभूतेशो वशी मन्मथ शासनः /
अहो विमोहितो देव्या जनयामास चात्मजम् //
text_mt:
Agastya said:
“How indeed was the Lord of all beings, self-controlled, the punisher of Manmatha,
ah, deluded by the Goddess, and fathered a son?”

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
purāmarapurādhīśo vijayaśrīsamṛddhimān /
trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa sadevāsuramānuṣam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
पुरामरपुराधीशो विजयश्रीसमृद्धिमान् /
त्रैलोक्यं पालयामास सदेवासुरमानुषम् //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
“Formerly, the lord of the city of the immortals, possessed of the prosperity of victory and fortune,
protected the three worlds together with gods, asuras, and humans.

sanskrit_iast:
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ gajendramadhiruhya saḥ /
cacārākhilalokeṣu pūjyamāno 'khilairapi /
taṃ pramattaṃ viditvātha bhavānīpatikhyayaḥ //
meaning:
कैलासशिखराकारं गजेन्द्रमधिरुह्य सः /
चचाराखिललोकेषु पूज्यमानो ऽखिलैरपि /
तं प्रमत्तं विदित्वाथ भवानीपतिख्ययः //
text_mt:
Having mounted the lord of elephants, which resembled the peak of Mount Kailāsa,
he roamed through all the worlds, being worshiped by all.
Knowing him to be intoxicated, the lord of Bhavānī,

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsasamathāhūya prajighāya tadantikam /
khaṇḍājinadharo daṇḍīdhūridhūsaravigrahaḥ /
unmattarūpadhārī ca yayau vidyādharādhvanā //
meaning:
दुर्वाससमथाहूय प्रजिघाय तदन्तिकम् /
खण्डाजिनधरो दण्डीधूरिधूसरविग्रहः /
उन्मत्तरूपधारी च ययौ विद्याधराध्वना //
text_mt:
having summoned Durvāsas, dispatched him to his presence.
Wearing a torn hide, holding a staff, his body grey with dust,
and wearing the appearance of a madman, he went by the path of the Vidyādharas.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare kāle kācidvidyādharāṅganā /
yadṛcchayāgatā tasya puraścārutarākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे काले काचिद्विद्याधराङ्गना /
यदृच्छयागता तस्य पुरश्चारुतराकृतिः //
text_mt:
In the meantime, a certain Vidyādhara woman
of very charming form came before him by chance.

sanskrit_iast:
cirakālena tapasā toṣayitvā parāṃbikām /
tatsamarpitamālyaṃ ca labdhvā saṃtuṣṭamānasā //
meaning:
चिरकालेन तपसा तोषयित्वा परांबिकाम् /
तत्समर्पितमाल्यं च लब्ध्वा संतुष्टमानसा //
text_mt:
Having gratified the Supreme Mother by long-standing austerity,
and having obtained a garland presented by her, her mind was delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛguśāvākṣīmuvāca munipuṅgavaḥ /
kutra vā gamyate bhīru kuto labdhamidaṃ tvayā //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा मृगुशावाक्षीमुवाच मुनिपुङ्गवः /
कुत्र वा गम्यते भीरु कुतो लब्धमिदं त्वया //
text_mt:
Seeing her, whose eyes were like those of a young deer, the eminent sage said:
‘Where are you going, timid one? Whence was this obtained by you?’

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya sā mahātmānamuvāca vinayānvitā /
cireṇa tapasā brahmandevyā dattaṃ prasannayā //
meaning:
प्रणम्य सा महात्मानमुवाच विनयान्विता /
चिरेण तपसा ब्रह्मन्देव्या दत्तं प्रसन्नया //
text_mt:
Bowing to that great-souled one, she said with humility:
‘Through long austerity, O Brahman, it was given by the gracious Goddess.’

sanskrit_iast:
tachrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ so 'pṛcchanmālyamuttamam /
pṛṣṭamātreṇa sā tuṣṭā dadau tasmai mahātmane //
meaning:
तछ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः सो ऽपृच्छन्माल्यमुत्तमम् /
पृष्टमात्रेण सा तुष्टा ददौ तस्मै महात्मने //
text_mt:
Having heard those words of hers, he asked for that excellent garland;
as soon as it was requested, she, being pleased, gave it to that great-souled one.

sanskrit_iast:
karābhyāṃ tatsamādāya kṛtārtho 'smīti satvaram /
dadhau svaśirasā bhaktyā tāmuvācātirṣitaḥ //
meaning:
कराभ्यां तत्समादाय कृतार्थो ऽस्मीति सत्वरम् /
दधौ स्वशिरसा भक्त्या तामुवाचातिर्षितः //
text_mt:
Taking it with both hands, thinking ‘I have achieved my purpose,’
he placed it quickly on his head with devotion and, extremely joyful, said to her:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāmalabhyaṃ yattallabdhaṃ bhāgyato mayā /
bhaktirastu padāṃbhoje devyāstava samujjvalā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनामलभ्यं यत्तल्लब्धं भाग्यतो मया /
भक्तिरस्तु पदांभोजे देव्यास्तव समुज्ज्वला //
text_mt:
‘That which is unattainable even to Brahmā and others has been obtained by me through good fortune;
may your devotion to the lotus feet of the Goddess remain radiant.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyacchobhanākāre gaccha saumye yathāsukham /
sā taṃ praṇamya śirasā yayau tuṣṭā yathāgatam //
meaning:
भविष्यच्छोभनाकारे गच्छ सौम्ये यथासुखम् /
सा तं प्रणम्य शिरसा ययौ तुष्टा यथागतम् //
text_mt:
O gentle one of fair form to come, go as you please.’
Having bowed to him with her head, she went delighted as she had come.

sanskrit_iast:
preṣayitvā sa tāṃ bhūyo yayau vidyādharādhvanā /
vidyādharavadhūhastātpratijagrāha vallakīm //
meaning:
प्रेषयित्वा स तां भूयो ययौ विद्याधराध्वना /
विद्याधरवधूहस्तात्प्रतिजग्राह वल्लकीम् //
text_mt:
Having sent her away, he again went by the path of the Vidyādharas;
from the hand of a Vidyādhara woman he took a lute,

sanskrit_iast:
divyasraganulepāṃśca divyānyābharaṇāni ca /
kvacidgṛhṇankvacidgā yankvaciddhasan //
meaning:
दिव्यस्रगनुलेपांश्च दिव्यान्याभरणानि च /
क्वचिद्गृह्णन्क्वचिद्गा यन्क्वचिद्धसन् //
text_mt:
and divine garlands, ointments, and divine ornaments;
here taking, here singing, and here laughing,

sanskrit_iast:
svecchāvihārī sa muniryayau yatra purandaraḥ /
svakarasthāṃ tato mālāṃ śakrāya pradadau muniḥ //
meaning:
स्वेच्छाविहारी स मुनिर्ययौ यत्र पुरन्दरः /
स्वकरस्थां ततो मालां शक्राय प्रददौ मुनिः //
text_mt:
roaming at his own will, that sage went where Purandara was.
Then the sage gave the garland resting in his hand to Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ gṛhītvā gajaskandhe sthāpayāmāsa devarāṭ /
gajastu tāṃ gṛhītvātha preṣayāmāsa bhūtale //
meaning:
तां गृहीत्वा गजस्कन्धे स्थापयामास देवराट् /
गजस्तु तां गृहीत्वाथ प्रेषयामास भूतले //
text_mt:
Receiving it, the king of the gods placed it on the elephant’s shoulder;
and the elephant, taking it, threw it down onto the surface of the earth.”

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā preṣitāṃ mālāṃ tadā krodhena tāpasaḥ /
uvāca na dhṛtā mālā śirasā tu mayārpitā //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा प्रेषितां मालां तदा क्रोधेन तापसः /
उवाच न धृता माला शिरसा तु मयार्पिता //
text_mt: Seeing that garland cast away, the ascetic then spoke in anger: / "The garland offered by me was not placed upon your head!

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaiśvaryamattena bhavatā hyavamānitā /
mahādevyā dhṛtā yā tu brahmādyaiḥ pūjyatehi sā //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यमत्तेन भवता ह्यवमानिता /
महादेव्या धृता या तु ब्रह्माद्यैः पूज्यतेहि सा //
text_mt: Intoxicated by sovereignty over the three worlds, you have insulted it; / it was worn by the Great Goddess, and is indeed worshipped by Brahmā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā yacchāsito lokaḥ sadevāsuramānuṣaḥ /
aśobhano hyatejasko mama śāpādbhaviṣyati //
meaning:
त्वया यच्छासितो लोकः सदेवासुरमानुषः /
अशोभनो ह्यतेजस्को मम शापाद्भविष्यति //
text_mt: The world together with gods, asuras, and humans, which is ruled by you, / will by my curse become devoid of splendor and vigor!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śaptvā vinītena tena saṃpūjito 'pi saḥ /
tūṣṇīmeva yayau brahmanbhāvikāryamanusmaran //
meaning:
इति शप्त्वा विनीतेन तेन संपूजितो ऽपि सः /
तूष्णीमेव ययौ ब्रह्मन्भाविकार्यमनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Having thus cursed him, though worshipped by him with humility, / he departed in silence, O Brahmin, keeping future events in mind.

sanskrit_iast:
vijayaśrīstatastasya daityaṃ tu balimanvagāt /
nityaśrīrnityapuruṣaṃ vāsudevamathānvagāt //
meaning:
विजयश्रीस्ततस्तस्य दैत्यं तु बलिमन्वगात् /
नित्यश्रीर्नित्यपुरुषं वासुदेवमथान्वगात् //
text_mt: The Fortune of Victory then went from him to the Daitya Bali, / and eternal Fortune went to the eternal Puruṣa, Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
indro 'pi svapuraṃ gatvā sarvadevasamanvitaḥ /
viṣaṇṇacetā niḥśrīkaścintayāmāsa devarāṭ //
meaning:
इन्द्रो ऽपि स्वपुरं गत्वा सर्वदेवसमन्वितः /
विषण्णचेता निःश्रीकश्चिन्तयामास देवराट् //
text_mt: Indra too went to his city accompanied by all the gods; / dejected at heart and stripped of fortune, the king of gods reflected.

sanskrit_iast:
athāmarapure dṛṣṭvā nimittānyaśubhāni ca /
bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya vākyametaduvāca ha //
meaning:
अथामरपुरे दृष्ट्वा निमित्तान्यशुभानि च /
बृहस्पतिं समाहूय वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह //
text_mt: Then, seeing inauspicious omens in the city of the immortals, / he summoned Bṛhaspati and spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavansarvadharmajña trikālajñānakovida /
dṛśyate 'dṛṣṭapūrvāṇi nimittānyaśubhāni ca //
meaning:
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ त्रिकालज्ञानकोविद /
दृश्यते ऽदृष्टपूर्वाणि निमित्तान्यशुभानि च //
text_mt: "O Blessed One, knower of all dharma, skilled in knowledge of the three times, / never-before-seen and inauspicious omens are being seen.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃphalāni ca tāni syurupāyo vātha kīdṛśaḥ /
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devendrasya bṛhaspatiḥ /
pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ śubham //
meaning:
किंफलानि च तानि स्युरुपायो वाथ कीदृशः /
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवेन्द्रस्य बृहस्पतिः /
प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं शुभम् //
text_mt: What might their fruits be, and what is the remedy?" / Having heard those words of the king of gods, Bṛhaspati / then replied with words endowed with dharma and benefit, auspicious:

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasya karmaṇo rājankalpakoṭiśatairapi /
prāyaścittopabhogābhyāṃ vinā nāśo na jāyate //
meaning:
कृतस्य कर्मणो राजन्कल्पकोटिशतैरपि /
प्रायश्चित्तोपभोगाभ्यां विना नाशो न जायते //
text_mt: "Of an action committed, O king, even through hundreds of crores of kalpas, / destruction does not occur without expiation and experience [of its fruit]."

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
karma vā kīdṛśaṃ brahmanprāyaścittaṃ ca kīdṛśam /
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanme vistarato vada //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
कर्म वा कीदृशं ब्रह्मन्प्रायश्चित्तं च कीदृशम् /
तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt: Indra said: / "What kind of action [is it], O Brahmin, and what kind of expiation? / I wish to hear all that; tell me that in detail."

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
hananasteyahiṃsāśca pānamanyāṅganāratiḥ /
karma pañcavidhaṃ prāhurduṣkṛtaṃ dharaṇīpateḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
हननस्तेयहिंसाश्च पानमन्याङ्गनारतिः /
कर्म पञ्चविधं प्राहुर्दुष्कृतं धरणीपतेः //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "Killing, theft, injury, drinking, and sporting with another's woman: / they say the misdeed of a ruler of the earth is of five kinds.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatriyaviṭśūdragoturaṅgakharoṣṭrakāḥ /
catuṣpado 'ṇḍajābjāśca tiryaco 'nasthikāstathā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रियविट्शूद्रगोतुरङ्गखरोष्ट्रकाः /
चतुष्पदो ऽण्डजाब्जाश्च तिर्यचो ऽनस्थिकास्तथा //
text_mt: [Killing] a Brahmin, Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, Śūdra, cow, horse, donkey, camel, / quadrupeds, egg-born, water-born, animals, and bone-less creatures:

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ ca sahasraṃ ca śataṃ daśa tathā daśa /
daśapañcatrirekārdhamānupūrvyādidaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
अयुतं च सहस्रं च शतं दश तथा दश /
दशपञ्चत्रिरेकार्धमानुपूर्व्यादिदं भवेत् //
text_mt: Ten thousand, one thousand, one hundred, ten, and ten; / ten, five, three, one, and a half—this should be in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ strīṇāmuktārthe pāpamādiśet /
pitṛmātṛgurusvāmi putrāṇāṃ caiva niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां स्त्रीणामुक्तार्थे पापमादिशेत् /
पितृमातृगुरुस्वामि पुत्राणां चैव निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: For women of Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas, one should assign the sin in the stated manner; / and expiation is for fathers, mothers, gurus, masters, and sons.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvājñayā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadājñālaṅghaner'thakam /
daśabrāhmaṇabhṛtyarthamekaṃ hanyāddvijaṃ nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
गुर्वाज्ञया कृतं पापं तदाज्ञालङ्घनेर्ऽथकम् /
दशब्राह्मणभृत्यर्थमेकं हन्याद्द्विजं नृपः //
text_mt: Sin committed by a guru's order becomes [meaningless] by transgressing his command. / A king may kill one twice-born for the sake of the maintenance of ten Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
śatabrāhmaṇabhṛtyarthaṃ brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ tu vā /
pañcabrahmavidāmarthe traiśyamekaṃ tu daṇḍayet //
meaning:
शतब्राह्मणभृत्यर्थं ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणं तु वा /
पञ्चब्रह्मविदामर्थे त्रैश्यमेकं तु दण्डयेत् //
text_mt: For the maintenance of a hundred Brahmins, a Brahmin [may kill] a Brahmin; / for the sake of five knowers of Brahman, one should punish a single [king].

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyaṃ daśaviśāmarthe viśāṃ vā daṇḍayettathā /
tathā śataviśāmarthe dvijamekaṃ tu daṇḍayet //
meaning:
वैश्यं दशविशामर्थे विशां वा दण्डयेत्तथा /
तथा शतविशामर्थे द्विजमेकं तु दण्डयेत् //
text_mt: [One should punish] a Vaiśya for the sake of ten Vaiśyas, or punish a Vaiśya likewise; / likewise, for the sake of a hundred Vaiśyas, one should punish a single twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ daṇḍayedbrāhmaṇaṃ tu vā /
tacchatārthaṃ tu vā vaiśyaṃ taddaśārddhaṃ tu śūdrakam //
meaning:
शूद्राणां तु सहस्राणां दण्डयेद्ब्राह्मणं तु वा /
तच्छतार्थं तु वा वैश्यं तद्दशार्द्धं तु शूद्रकम् //
text_mt: For [the sake of] thousands of Śūdras, one should punish a Brahmin; / or for the sake of a hundred of them, a Vaiśya; for half of ten of them, a Śūdra.

sanskrit_iast:
bandhūnāṃ caiva mitrāṇāmiṣṭārthe tu tripādakam /
arthaṃ kalatraputrārthe svātmārthe na tu kiñcana //
meaning:
बन्धूनां चैव मित्राणामिष्टार्थे तु त्रिपादकम् /
अर्थं कलत्रपुत्रार्थे स्वात्मार्थे न तु किञ्चन //
text_mt: For the sake of the desired good of kinsmen and friends, three quarters; / [all] wealth for the sake of wife and son; but nothing for the sake of oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ hantumārabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ viśam /
gāṃ vā turagamanyaṃ vā hatvā doṣairna lipyate //
meaning:
आत्मानं हन्तुमारब्धं ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियं विशम् /
गां वा तुरगमन्यं वा हत्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते //
text_mt: Having slain a Brahmin, a Kṣatriya, a Vaiśya, / a cow, or a horse, or another who has undertaken to kill oneself, one is not stained by sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmadārātmajabhrātṛbandhūnāṃ ca dvijottama /
kramāddaśaguṇo doṣo rakṣaṇe ca tathā phalam //
meaning:
आत्मदारात्मजभ्रातृबन्धूनां च द्विजोत्तम /
क्रमाद्दशगुणो दोषो रक्षणे च तथा फलम् //
text_mt: For oneself, wife, son, brother, and kinsmen, O best of the twice-born, / the sin is ten times greater in order, and likewise the fruit in protecting [them].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūpadvijaśrotriyavedavidvratīvedāntavidvedavidāṃ vināśe /
ekadvipañcāśadathāyutaṃ ca syānniṣkṛtiśceti vadanti saṃtaḥ //
meaning:
भूपद्विजश्रोत्रियवेदविद्व्रतीवेदान्तविद्वेदविदां विनाशे /
एकद्विपञ्चाशदथायुतं च स्यान्निष्कृतिश्चेति वदन्ति संतः //
text_mt: In the destruction of a king, twice-born, Śrotriya, knower of the Veda, vows-keeper, knower of Vedānta, and [great] knowers of the Veda, / the expiation would be one, two, fifty, and ten thousand, so say the virtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ ca rakṣaṇavidhau hi kṛte ca dāne pūrvoditottaraguṇaṃ pravadanti puṇyam /
teṣāṃ ca darśanavidhau namane cakārye śūśrūṣaṇe 'pi caratāṃ sadṛśāṃśca teṣām //
meaning:
तेषां च रक्षणविधौ हि कृते च दाने पूर्वोदितोत्तरगुणं प्रवदन्ति पुण्यम् /
तेषां च दर्शनविधौ नमने चकार्ये शूश्रूषणे ऽपि चरतां सदृशांश्च तेषाम् //
text_mt: And when protection is performed and gift is given to them, they declare merit multiplied beyond what was stated before; / and in seeing them, bowing down, rendering service, and for those behaving similarly to them.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhavyāghramṛgādīni lokahiṃsākarāṇi tu /
nṛpo hanyācca satataṃ devārthe brāhmaṇārthake //
meaning:
सिंहव्याघ्रमृगादीनि लोकहिंसाकराणि तु /
नृपो हन्याच्च सततं देवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थके //
text_mt: Lions, tigers, deer, and others that cause harm to people / a king should constantly kill for the sake of the gods and for the sake of Brahmins.

sanskrit_iast: āpatsvātmārthake cāpi hatvā medhyāni bhakṣayet //
meaning: आपत्स्वात्मार्थके चापि हत्वा मेध्यानि भक्षयेत् //
text_mt: Even in times of distress for his own sake, having killed sacrificial animals, he may eat them.

sanskrit_iast:
nātmārthe pācayedanna nātmārthe pācayetpaśūn /
devārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā pacamāno na lipyate //
meaning:
नात्मार्थे पाचयेदन्न नात्मार्थे पाचयेत्पशून् /
देवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा पचमानो न लिप्यते //
text_mt: He should not cook food for himself, nor cook animals for himself; / cooking for the sake of the gods or for the sake of Brahmins, he is not stained.

sanskrit_iast:
purā bhagavatī māyā jagadujjīvanonmukhī /
sasarja sarvadevāṃśca tathaivāsuramānuṣān //
meaning:
पुरा भगवती माया जगदुज्जीवनोन्मुखी /
ससर्ज सर्वदेवांश्च तथैवासुरमानुषान् //
text_mt: Long ago, the blessed Māyā, eager to sustain the world, / created all the gods, and likewise the asuras and human beings.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya paśūnapi caturdaśa /
yajñāśca tadvidhānāni kṛtvā cainānuvāca ha //
meaning:
तेषां संरक्षणार्थाय पशूनपि चतुर्दश /
यज्ञाश्च तद्विधानानि कृत्वा चैनानुवाच ह //
text_mt: For their preservation, having also made fourteen beasts / and sacrifices and their rites, she said to them:

sanskrit_iast:
yajadhvaṃ paśubhirdevānvidhinānena mānavāḥ /
iṣṭāni ye pradāsyanti puṣṭāste yajñabhāvitāḥ //
meaning:
यजध्वं पशुभिर्देवान्विधिनानेन मानवाः /
इष्टानि ये प्रदास्यन्ति पुष्टास्ते यज्ञभाविताः //
text_mt: "Worship the gods with beasts by this rite, O humans! / Nourished, consecrated by sacrifice, they will bestow desired things.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ /
daridro nārakaścaiva bhavejjanmani janmani //
meaning:
एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः /
दरिद्रो नारकश्चैव भवेज्जन्मनि जन्मनि //
text_mt: Whoever does not follow the wheel thus set in motion here / becomes poor and a hell-dweller birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
devatārthe ca pitrarthe tathaivābhyāgate gurau /
mahadāgamane caiva hanyānmedhyānpaśūndvijaḥ //
meaning:
देवतार्थे च पित्रर्थे तथैवाभ्यागते गुरौ /
महदागमने चैव हन्यान्मेध्यान्पशून्द्विजः //
text_mt: For the sake of the deities, for the sake of ancestors, likewise when a guru has arrived, / and upon the arrival of an eminent person, a twice-born may kill sacrificial beasts.

sanskrit_iast:
āpatsu brāhmaṇo māṃsaṃ medhyamaśnanna doṣabhāk /
vihitāni tu kāryāṇi pratiṣiddhāni varjayet //
meaning:
आपत्सु ब्राह्मणो मांसं मेध्यमश्नन्न दोषभाक् /
विहितानि तु कार्याणि प्रतिषिद्धानि वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: In times of distress, a Brahmin eating sacrificial meat does not partake in sin; / but he should perform prescribed actions and avoid prohibited ones.

sanskrit_iast:
purābhūdyuvanāśvasya devatānāṃ mahākratuḥ /
mamāyamiti devānāṃ kalahaḥ samajāyata //
meaning:
पुराभूद्युवनाश्वस्य देवतानां महाक्रतुः /
ममायमिति देवानां कलहः समजायत //
text_mt: Long ago, there was a great sacrifice of Yuvanāśva for the deities; / a dispute arose among the gods, saying, 'This is mine!'

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vibhajya devānāṃ mānuṣāṃśca paśūnapi /
vibhajyaikaikaśaḥ pradādbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
तदा विभज्य देवानां मानुषांश्च पशूनपि /
विभज्यैकैकशः प्रदाद्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः //
text_mt: Then Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, having apportioned to the gods / humans and beasts as well, gave them one by one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu paramā śaktirbhūtasaṃdhasahāyinī /
kupitābhūttato brahmā tāmuvāca nayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तु परमा शक्तिर्भूतसंधसहायिनी /
कुपिताभूत्ततो ब्रह्मा तामुवाच नयान्वितः //
text_mt: Thereupon the supreme Śakti, accompanied by the host of spirits, / became angry; then Brahmā, endowed with prudence, spoke to her.

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhūtā samudvīkṣya bhūtānandabhayānvitaḥ /
prāñjaliḥ praṇatastutvā prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भूता समुद्वीक्ष्य भूतानन्दभयान्वितः /
प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतस्तुत्वा प्रसीदेति पुनः पुनः //
text_mt: Beholding her manifest, filled with awe and fear before the spirits, / with joined palms, bowing down and praising, he said again and again: 'Be pleased!'

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhūtā yato 'si tvaṃ kṛtartho 'smi puro mama /
tvayaitadakhilaṃ karma nirmitaṃ suśubhāśubham //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भूता यतो ऽसि त्वं कृतर्थो ऽस्मि पुरो मम /
त्वयैतदखिलं कर्म निर्मितं सुशुभाशुभम् //
text_mt: "Since you have become manifest before me, I am fulfilled! / By you all this work, very auspicious and inauspicious, was fashioned.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutayaḥ smṛtayaścaiva tvayaiva pratipāditāḥ /
tvayaiva kalpitā yāgā manmukhāttu mahākratau //
meaning:
श्रुतयः स्मृतयश्चैव त्वयैव प्रतिपादिताः /
त्वयैव कल्पिता यागा मन्मुखात्तु महाक्रतौ //
text_mt: The Vedas and the Smṛtis were indeed set forth by you; / by you indeed sacrifices were arranged through my mouth in the great sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
ye vibhaktāstu paśavo devānāṃ parameśvari /
te sarve tāvakāḥ saṃtubhūtānāmapi tṛptaye //
meaning:
ये विभक्तास्तु पशवो देवानां परमेश्वरि /
ते सर्वे तावकाः संतुभूतानामपि तृप्तये //
text_mt: The beasts that were apportioned for the gods, O Supreme Lady, / let them all be yours, for the satisfaction of the spirits as well!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe teṣāṃ pura eva pitāmahaḥ /
taduktenaiva vidhinā cakāra ca mahākratūn //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे तेषां पुर एव पितामहः /
तदुक्तेनैव विधिना चकार च महाक्रतून् //
text_mt: Having said this, the Grandfather vanished right before them; / and he performed great sacrifices by the very rite spoken by her.

sanskrit_iast:
iyāja ca parāṃ śaktiṃ hatvā medhyānpaśūnapi /
tattadvibhāgo vedeṣu proktatvādiha noditaḥ //
meaning:
इयाज च परां शक्तिं हत्वा मेध्यान्पशूनपि /
तत्तद्विभागो वेदेषु प्रोक्तत्वादिह नोदितः //
text_mt: And he worshipped the supreme Śakti, having also slaughtered sacrificial beasts; / their various divisions are not stated here because they are declared in the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
striyaḥ śudrāstathā māṃsamādadyurbrāhmaṇaṃ vinā /
āpatsu brāhmaṇo vāpi bhakṣayedgurvanujñayā //
meaning:
स्त्रियः शुद्रास्तथा मांसमादद्युर्ब्राह्मणं विना /
आपत्सु ब्राह्मणो वापि भक्षयेद्गुर्वनुज्ञया //
text_mt: Women and Śūdras may take meat without a Brahmin; / in times of distress, even a Brahmin may eat [it] by the permission of a guru.

sanskrit_iast:
śivodbhavamida piṇḍamatyatha śivatāṃ gatam /
udbudhyasva paśo tvaṃ hi nāśivaḥ sañchivo hyasi //
meaning:
शिवोद्भवमिद पिण्डमत्यथ शिवतां गतम् /
उद्बुध्यस्व पशो त्वं हि नाशिवः सञ्छिवो ह्यसि //
text_mt: "This body sprung from Śiva has gone beyond to the state of Śiva; / awaken, O beast! For you are not un-Śiva, you are indeed Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
īśaḥ sarvajagatkartā prabhavaḥ pralayastathā /
yato viśvādhiko rudrastena rudro 'si vai paśo //
meaning:
ईशः सर्वजगत्कर्ता प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा /
यतो विश्वाधिको रुद्रस्तेन रुद्रो ऽसि वै पशो //
text_mt: The Lord is the creator of the entire universe, its origin as well as dissolution; / since Rudra is superior to the universe, therefore you are indeed Rudra, O beast!"

sanskrit_iast:
anena turagaṃ gā vā gajoṣṭramahiṣādikam /
ātmārthaṃ vā parārthaṃ vā hatvā doṣairna lipyate //
meaning:
अनेन तुरगं गा वा गजोष्ट्रमहिषादिकम् /
आत्मार्थं वा परार्थं वा हत्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते //
text_mt: Having killed with this [mantra] a horse, cow, elephant, camel, buffalo, and the like, / for one's own sake or for another's sake, one is not stained by sins.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāniṣṭakarānvāpi nāgākhubalivṛścikān /
etadgṛhāśramasthānāṃ kriyāphalamabhīpsatām /
manaḥsaṃkalpasiddhānāṃ mahatāṃ śivavarcasām //
meaning:
गृहानिष्टकरान्वापि नागाखुबलिवृश्चिकान् /
एतद्गृहाश्रमस्थानां क्रियाफलमभीप्सताम् /
मनःसंकल्पसिद्धानां महतां शिववर्चसाम् //
text_mt: Or even [by killing] snakes, mice, offerings-[stealing pests], and scorpions that bring harm to the house: / this is the fruit of action for those residing in the householder order who desire results, / who have attained their heart's resolves, who are great, and who have the splendor of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
paśuyajñena cānyeṣāmiṣṭā pūrtikaraṃ bhavet /
japahomārcanādyaistu teṣāmiṣṭaṃ ca sidhyati //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne hiṃsādyasvarūpakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
पशुयज्ञेन चान्येषामिष्टा पूर्तिकरं भवेत् /
जपहोमार्चनाद्यैस्तु तेषामिष्टं च सिध्यति //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने हिंसाद्यस्वरूपकथनं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
And for others, the fulfillment of desires comes through animal sacrifice, / but for these [great ones], their desire is accomplished through recitation, oblation, worship, and the like.

Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Nature of Violence and the Like,' in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
bhagavansarvamākhyātaṃ hiṃsādyasya tu lakṣaṇam /
steyasya lakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā tanme vistarato vada //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
भगवन्सर्वमाख्यातं हिंसाद्यस्य तु लक्षणम् /
स्तेयस्य लक्षणं किं वा तन्मे विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt: Indra said: / Blessed Lord, everything concerning the characteristics of violence and the like has been told. / But what are the characteristics of theft? Tell me that in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
pāpānāmadhikaṃ pāpaṃ hananaṃ jīvajātinām /
etasmādadhikaṃ pāpaṃ viśvaste śaraṇaṃ gate //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
पापानामधिकं पापं हननं जीवजातिनाम् /
एतस्मादधिकं पापं विश्वस्ते शरणं गते //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Greater than [other] sins is the sin of killing living creatures; / greater than this is the sin [committed] against one who is trusting and has sought refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvasya hatvā pāpiṣṭhaṃ śūdraṃ vāpyantyajātijam /
brahmahatyādhikaṃ pāpaṃ tasmānnāstyasya niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वस्य हत्वा पापिष्ठं शूद्रं वाप्यन्त्यजातिजम् /
ब्रह्महत्याधिकं पापं तस्मान्नास्त्यस्य निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: If one slays even a very wicked person, a śūdra, or one born of an outcast caste after winning his trust, / the sin is greater than the killing of a brāhmaṇa; therefore, there is no expiation for it.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmajñasya daridrasya kṛcchrārjitadhanasya ca /
bahuputrakalatrasya tena jīvitumicchataḥ /
taddravyasteyadoṣasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मज्ञस्य दरिद्रस्य कृच्छ्रार्जितधनस्य च /
बहुपुत्रकलत्रस्य तेन जीवितुमिच्छतः /
तद्द्रव्यस्तेयदोषस्य प्रायश्चित्तं न विद्यते //
text_mt: For the sin of stealing the wealth of a knower of Brahman who is poor, whose wealth was acquired with hardship, / who has many children and a wife, and who desires to live by means of that [wealth], / there is no expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvastadravyaharaṇaṃ tasyāpyadhikamucyate /
viśvaste vāpyaviśvaste na daridradhanaṃ haret //
meaning:
विश्वस्तद्रव्यहरणं तस्याप्यधिकमुच्यते /
विश्वस्ते वाप्यविश्वस्ते न दरिद्रधनं हरेत् //
text_mt: The taking of the property of a trusting person is said to be greater even than that; / whether one is trusting or not, one must never take the wealth of a poor person.

sanskrit_iast:
tato devadvijātīnāṃ hemaratnāpahārakam /
yo hanyādavicāreṇa so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet //
meaning:
ततो देवद्विजातीनां हेमरत्नापहारकम् /
यो हन्यादविचारेण सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् //
text_mt: Therefore, whoever kills without hesitation a stealer of gold and jewels belonging to the gods and the twice-born / obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
gurudevadvijasuhṛtputrasvātmasukheṣu ca /
steyādadhaḥkrameṇaiva daśottaraguṇaṃ tvagham //
meaning:
गुरुदेवद्विजसुहृत्पुत्रस्वात्मसुखेषु च /
स्तेयादधःक्रमेणैव दशोत्तरगुणं त्वघम् //
text_mt: With respect to the guru, gods, twice-born, friends, sons, and the happiness of one's own self, / the sin [increases] tenfold in successive descending order through theft.

sanskrit_iast:
antyajātpādajādvaiśyātkṣatriyādbrāhmaṇādapi /
daśottaraguṇaiḥ pāpairlipyate dhanahārakaḥ //
meaning:
अन्त्यजात्पादजाद्वैश्यात्क्षत्रियाद्ब्राह्मणादपि /
दशोत्तरगुणैः पापैर्लिप्यते धनहारकः //
text_mt: From an outcast, from a śūdra, from a vaiśya, from a kṣatriya, and from a brāhmaṇa, / the stealer of wealth is tainted by sins multiplied tenfold in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam /
rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam //
meaning:
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् /
रहस्यातिरहस्यं च सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् //
text_mt: In this very connection, they cite this ancient history, / most secret of secrets, which destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
purā kāñcīpure jāto vajrākhyo nāma corakaḥ /
tasminpuravare ramye sarvaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ /
sarve nīrogiṇo dāntāḥ sukhino dayayāñcitāḥ //
meaning:
पुरा काञ्चीपुरे जातो वज्राख्यो नाम चोरकः /
तस्मिन्पुरवरे रम्ये सर्वैश्वर्यसमन्विताः /
सर्वे नीरोगिणो दान्ताः सुखिनो दययाञ्चिताः //
text_mt: Formerly, in the city of Kāñcī, there was born a thief named Vajra. / In that excellent and charming city, [the inhabitants] were endowed with all prosperity; / all were free from disease, self-restrained, happy, and adorned with compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaiśvaryasamṛddhe 'sminnagare sa tu taskaraḥ /
stokāstokakrameṇaiva bahudravyamapāharat //
meaning:
सर्वैश्वर्यसमृद्धे ऽस्मिन्नगरे स तु तस्करः /
स्तोकास्तोकक्रमेणैव बहुद्रव्यमपाहरत् //
text_mt: In this city thriving with every kind of wealth, that thief, / by little and little, stole much property.

sanskrit_iast:
tadaraṇye 'vaṭaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayāmāsa lobhataḥ /
tadgopanaṃ niśārdhāyāṃ tasmindūraṃ gate sati //
meaning:
तदरण्ये ऽवटं कृत्वा स्थापयामास लोभतः /
तद्गोपनं निशार्धायां तस्मिन्दूरं गते सति //
text_mt: Making a pit in that forest, he placed it [there] out of greed. / In concealing it at midnight, when he had gone far off,

sanskrit_iast:
kirātaḥ kaścidāgatya taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu daśāṃśataḥ /
jahārāviditastena kāṣṭhabhāraṃ vahanyayau //
meaning:
किरातः कश्चिदागत्य तं दृष्ट्वा तु दशांशतः /
जहाराविदितस्तेन काष्ठभारं वहन्ययौ //
text_mt: a certain Kirāta came, saw him, and / unbeknownst to him, carried off a tenth part of it and went away bearing a load of wood.

sanskrit_iast:
so 'pi tacchilayācchādya mṛdbhirāpūryayatnataḥ /
punaśca tatpuraṃ prāyādvajro 'pi dhanatṛṣmayā //
meaning:
सो ऽपि तच्छिलयाच्छाद्य मृद्भिरापूर्ययत्नतः /
पुनश्च तत्पुरं प्रायाद्वज्रो ऽपि धनतृष्मया //
text_mt: Vajra too, having covered it with a stone and carefully filled it with earth, / went back to that city out of thirst for wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahudhanaṃ tdṛtvā niścikṣepa mahītale /
kirāto 'pi gṛhaṃ prāpya babhāṣe muditaḥ priyām //
meaning:
एवं बहुधनं त्दृत्वा निश्चिक्षेप महीतले /
किरातो ऽपि गृहं प्राप्य बभाषे मुदितः प्रियाम् //
text_mt: Having thus taken much wealth, he buried it in the earth. / The Kirāta also, having reached home, said joyfully to his beloved:

sanskrit_iast:
mayā kāṣṭhaṃ samāhartuṃ gacchatā pathi nirjane /
labdhaṃ dhanamidaṃ bhīru samādhatsva dhanārthini //
meaning:
मया काष्ठं समाहर्तुं गच्छता पथि निर्जने /
लब्धं धनमिदं भीरु समाधत्स्व धनार्थिनि //
text_mt: “As I was going along a deserted path to gather firewood, / this wealth was found by me, timid woman; receive it, you who desire wealth.”

sanskrit_iast:
tacchrutvā tatsamādāya nidhāyābhyantare tataḥ /
cintayantī tato vākyamidaṃ svapatimabravīt //
meaning:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्समादाय निधायाभ्यन्तरे ततः /
चिन्तयन्ती ततो वाक्यमिदं स्वपतिमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Hearing that, taking it and placing it inside, / she then reflected and spoke these words to her husband:

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ saṃcarate vipro māmakānāṃ gṛheṣu yaḥ /
māṃ vilokyaivamacirādbahubhāgyavatī bhavet //
meaning:
नित्यं संचरते विप्रो मामकानां गृहेषु यः /
मां विलोक्यैवमचिराद्बहुभाग्यवती भवेत् //
text_mt: “The brāhmaṇa who constantly visits the houses of my people, / on seeing me, [said]: ‘Before long she will be very fortunate.

sanskrit_iast:
cāturvarṇyāsu narīṣu stheyaṃ cedrājavallabhā /
kiṃ tu bhille kirāte ca śailūṣe cāntyajātije /
lakṣmīrna tiṣṭhati ciraṃ śāpādvalmīkajanmanaḥ //
meaning:
चातुर्वर्ण्यासु नरीषु स्थेयं चेद्राजवल्लभा /
किं तु भिल्ले किराते च शैलूषे चान्त्यजातिजे /
लक्ष्मीर्न तिष्ठति चिरं शापाद्वल्मीकजन्मनः //
text_mt: If she were among the women of the four castes, she would be beloved of a king. / But among a Bhilla, a Kirāta, an actor, and one born of an outcast caste, / Lakṣmī does not stay long, because of the curse of the one born of an anthill.’

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi bahubhāgyānāṃ puṇyānāmapi pātriṇe /
dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tu tadvākyaṃ na kadācidvṛthā bhavet //
meaning:
तथापि बहुभाग्यानां पुण्यानामपि पात्रिणे /
दृष्टपूर्वं तु तद्वाक्यं न कदाचिद्वृथा भवेत् //
text_mt: Even so, for a recipient of great fortunes and merits, / that statement seen previously can never be in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vātmaprayāsena kṛcchrādyallabhyate dhanam /
tadeva tiṣṭhati cirādanyadgacchati kālataḥ //
meaning:
अथ वात्मप्रयासेन कृच्छ्राद्यल्लभ्यते धनम् /
तदेव तिष्ठति चिरादन्यद्गच्छति कालतः //
text_mt: Or rather, that wealth which is obtained with hardship through one's own labor, / that alone remains for a long time; other [wealth] vanishes in time.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamāgatavittaṃ tu dharmārthairviniyojayet /
kuruṣvaitena tasmāttvaṃ vāpīkūpādikāñchubhān //
meaning:
स्वयमागतवित्तं तु धर्मार्थैर्विनियोजयेत् /
कुरुष्वैतेन तस्मात्त्वं वापीकूपादिकाञ्छुभान् //
text_mt: One should apply wealth that has come of itself to purposes of dharma. / Therefore, construct auspicious stepped ponds, wells, and the like with this.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāvibhāgyaprabodhitam /
bahūdakasamaṃ deśaṃ tatra tatra vyalokayat //
meaning:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भाविभाग्यप्रबोधितम् /
बहूदकसमं देशं तत्र तत्र व्यलोकयत् //
text_mt: Having heard her words, awakened to his future fortune, / he looked here and there for a level area with abundant water.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmame 'tha mahendrasya digbhāge vimalodakam /
subahudravyasaṃ sādhyaṃ taṭākaṃ cākṣayodakam //
meaning:
निर्ममे ऽथ महेन्द्रस्य दिग्भागे विमलोदकम् /
सुबहुद्रव्यसं साध्यं तटाकं चाक्षयोदकम् //
text_mt: Then, in the direction of Mahendra, he constructed a reservoir with clear water, / which required a great deal of wealth to accomplish, and possessed inexhaustible water.

sanskrit_iast:
datteṣu karmakāribhyo nikhileṣu dhaneṣu ca /
asaṃbūrṇaṃ tu tatkarma dṛṣṭvā cintākulo 'bhavat //
meaning:
दत्तेषु कर्मकारिभ्यो निखिलेषु धनेषु च /
असंबूर्णं तु तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा चिन्ताकुलो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: When all the wealth had been given to the laborers, / seeing that work still incomplete, he became distressed with worry:

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ cora vajranāmānamajñāto 'nucarāmyaham /
tenaiva bahudhā kṣiptaṃ dhanaṃ bhūri mahītale //
meaning:
तं चोर वज्रनामानमज्ञातो ऽनुचराम्यहम् /
तेनैव बहुधा क्षिप्तं धनं भूरि महीतले //
text_mt: “I will follow that thief named Vajra without being noticed; / much wealth has been buried in the ground in many places by him alone.

sanskrit_iast:
stokaṃstokaṃ hariṣyāmi tatratatra dhanaṃ bahu /
iti niścitya manasā tenājñātastamanvagāt //
meaning:
स्तोकंस्तोकं हरिष्यामि तत्रतत्र धनं बहु /
इति निश्चित्य मनसा तेनाज्ञातस्तमन्वगात् //
text_mt: Little by little, I shall take much wealth here and there.” / Having thus resolved in his mind, he followed him unnoticed by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivātdṛtya taddravyaṃ tena setumapūrayat /
madhye jalāvṛtastena prāsādaścāpi śārṅgiṇaḥ //
meaning:
तथैवात्दृत्य तद्द्रव्यं तेन सेतुमपूरयत् /
मध्ये जलावृतस्तेन प्रासादश्चापि शार्ङ्गिणः //
text_mt: Taking that wealth in the very same way, he completed the embankment with it. / Surrounded by water in the middle, a palace for the wielder of the Śārṅga bow was also [built] by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tattaṭākamabhūddivyamaśoṣitajalaṃ mahat /
setumadhye cakārāsau śaṅkarāyatanaṃ mahat //
meaning:
तत्तटाकमभूद्दिव्यमशोषितजलं महत् /
सेतुमध्ये चकारासौ शङ्करायतनं महत् //
text_mt: That reservoir became divine, extensive, and with water that never dried up. / In the middle of the embankment, he built a great temple to Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
kānanaṃ ca kṣayaṃ nītaṃ bahusattvasamākulam /
tenāgryāṇi mahārhāṇi kṣetrāṇyapi cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
काननं च क्षयं नीतं बहुसत्त्वसमाकुलम् /
तेनाग्र्याणि महार्हाणि क्षेत्राण्यपि चकार सः //
text_mt: And the forest, teeming with many living creatures, was cleared; / from it he made excellent, highly valuable fields.

sanskrit_iast:
devatābhyo dvijebhyaśca padattāni vibhajya vai /
brāhmaṇāṃśca samāmantrya devavrātamukhānbahūn //
meaning:
देवताभ्यो द्विजेभ्यश्च पदत्तानि विभज्य वै /
ब्राह्मणांश्च समामन्त्र्य देवव्रातमुखान्बहून् //
text_mt: Having divided them, he gave them to deities and the twice-born. / And having invited many brāhmaṇas headed by Devavrāta,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtoṣya hemavastrādyairidaṃ vacanamabravīt /
kva cāhaṃ vīradattākhyaḥ kirātaḥ kāṣṭhavikrayī //
meaning:
संतोष्य हेमवस्त्राद्यैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् /
क्व चाहं वीरदत्ताख्यः किरातः काष्ठविक्रयी //
text_mt: and satisfied them with gold, garments, and the like, he spoke these words: / “Where am I, a Kirāta named Vīradatta, a seller of firewood,

sanskrit_iast:
kva vā mahāsetubandhaḥ kva devālayakalpanā /
kva vā kṣetrāṇi kḷptāni brāhmaṇāyatanāni ca //
meaning:
क्व वा महासेतुबन्धः क्व देवालयकल्पना /
क्व वा क्षेत्राणि कॢप्तानि ब्राह्मणायतनानि च //
text_mt: and where is the construction of a great embankment, where the fashioning of a temple, / and where are fields prepared and dwellings for brāhmaṇas?

sanskrit_iast:
kṛpayaiva kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bhavatāṃ bhūsurottamāḥ /
pratigṛhya tathaivaitaddevavrātamukhā dvijāḥ //
meaning:
कृपयैव कृतं सर्वं भवतां भूसुरोत्तमाः /
प्रतिगृह्य तथैवैतद्देवव्रातमुखा द्विजाः //
text_mt: All has been done through your grace alone, O best of earthly gods!” / Accepting it in that manner, the twice-born headed by Devavrāta,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijavarmeti nāmāsmai tasyai śīlavatīti ca /
cakruḥ saṃtuṣṭamanaso mahātmāno mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
द्विजवर्मेति नामास्मै तस्यै शीलवतीति च /
चक्रुः संतुष्टमनसो महात्मानो महौजसः //
text_mt: those high-souled, very powerful men, with hearts well pleased, / bestowed on him the name Dvijavarmā, and on her the name Śīlavatī.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya bandhumiḥ sahito vaśī /
tatraiva vasatiṃ cakre mudito bhāryayā saha //
meaning:
तेषां संरक्षणार्थाय बन्धुमिः सहितो वशी /
तत्रैव वसतिं चक्रे मुदितो भार्यया सह //
text_mt: For their protection, the self-controlled man, together with his kinsmen, / took up residence in that very place, joyful, with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
purohitābhidhānena devarātapurantviti /
nāma cakre purasyāsya toṣa yannakhilāndvijān //
meaning:
पुरोहिताभिधानेन देवरातपुरन्त्विति /
नाम चक्रे पुरस्यास्य तोष यन्नखिलान्द्विजान् //
text_mt: After the name of his priest, he gave to this town / the name Devarātapura, pleasing all the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kālavaśaṃ prāpto dvijavarmā mṛtastadā /
yamasya brahmaṇo viṣṇordūtā rudrasya cāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ततः कालवशं प्राप्तो द्विजवर्मा मृतस्तदा /
यमस्य ब्रह्मणो विष्णोर्दूता रुद्रस्य चागताः //
text_mt: Then, falling under the power of time, Dvijavarmā died. / The messengers of Yama, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
anyo 'nyamabhavatteṣāṃ yuddhaṃ devāsuropamam /
atrāntare samāgatya nārado munirabravīt //
meaning:
अन्यो ऽन्यमभवत्तेषां युद्धं देवासुरोपमम् /
अत्रान्तरे समागत्य नारदो मुनिरब्रवीत् //
text_mt: There arose among them a battle resembling that between gods and asuras. / In the meantime, the sage Nārada arrived and said:

sanskrit_iast:
mā kurvantu mitho yuddhaṃ śṛṇvantu vacanaṃ mama /
ayaṃ kirātaścairyeṇa setubandhaṃ purākarot //
meaning:
मा कुर्वन्तु मिथो युद्धं शृण्वन्तु वचनं मम /
अयं किरातश्चैर्येण सेतुबन्धं पुराकरोत् //
text_mt: “Do not fight with one another; hear my word! / Formerly, this Kirāta constructed the embankment through theft.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyubhūtascaredeko yāvaddravyavato mṛtiḥ /
sa bahubhyo hareddravyaṃ teṣāṃ yāvattathā mṛtiḥ //
meaning:
वायुभूतस्चरेदेको यावद्द्रव्यवतो मृतिः /
स बहुभ्यो हरेद्द्रव्यं तेषां यावत्तथा मृतिः //
text_mt: He shall wander alone, having become wind, until the death of the owner of the wealth; / that one stole wealth from many, [so he must wander] until their death likewise.”

sanskrit_iast:
gateṣvakhiladūteṣu śrutvā nāradabhāṣitam /
cacāra dvādaśābdaṃ tu vāyubhūtoṃ'tarikṣagaḥ //
meaning:
गतेष्वखिलदूतेषु श्रुत्वा नारदभाषितम् /
चचार द्वादशाब्दं तु वायुभूतोंऽतरिक्षगः //
text_mt: When all the messengers had departed upon hearing the words of Nārada, / he wandered for twelve years as wind, moving in the intermediate space.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāryāṃ tasyāha sa munistava doṣo na kiñcana /
tvayā kṛtena puṇyena brahmalokamito vraja //
meaning:
भार्यां तस्याह स मुनिस्तव दोषो न किञ्चन /
त्वया कृतेन पुण्येन ब्रह्मलोकमितो व्रज //
text_mt: The sage said to his wife: “You have no fault whatsoever. / By the merit acquired by you, go from here to the world of Brahmā.”

sanskrit_iast:
vāyubhūtaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā necchati brahmamandiram /
nirvedaṃ paramāpannā munimevamabhāṣata //
meaning:
वायुभूतं पतिं दृष्ट्वा नेच्छति ब्रह्ममन्दिरम् /
निर्वेदं परमापन्ना मुनिमेवमभाषत //
text_mt: Seeing her husband turned into wind, she did not desire the abode of Brahmā. / Having reached utter dejection, she spoke thus to the sage:

sanskrit_iast:
vinā patimahaṃ tena na gaccheyaṃ pitāmaham /
hahaivāste patiryāvatsvadehaṃ labhate tathā //
meaning:
विना पतिमहं तेन न गच्छेयं पितामहम् /
हहैवास्ते पतिर्यावत्स्वदेहं लभते तथा //
text_mt: "Without my husband, I will not go to the Grandfather. / Let me remain right here, as long as my husband regains his body in that way.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu yā gatistasya tāmevānucarāmyaham /
parihāro 'thavā kiṃ tu mayā kāryastu tena vā //
meaning:
ततस्तु या गतिस्तस्य तामेवानुचराम्यहम् /
परिहारो ऽथवा किं तु मया कार्यस्तु तेन वा //
text_mt: Then, whatever destiny is his, that very one shall I follow. / But what expiation must be performed by me, or by him?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā prītaḥ prāha tapodhanaḥ /
bhogātmakaṃ śarīraṃ tu karma kāryakaraṃ tava //
meaning:
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा प्रीतः प्राह तपोधनः /
भोगात्मकं शरीरं तु कर्म कार्यकरं तव //
text_mt: Hearing her words, the ascetic, pleased, said: / "A body meant for enjoyment will act effectively for you through your deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
mama prabhāvādbhavitā parihāraṃ vadāmi te /
nirāhāro mahātīrthesnātvā nityaṃ hi sāṃbikam //
meaning:
मम प्रभावाद्भविता परिहारं वदामि ते /
निराहारो महातीर्थेस्नात्वा नित्यं हि सांबिकम् //
text_mt: By my power it will come to be; I shall declare the expiation to you. / Fasting, having bathed at a great sacred place, ever [worshipping] Śiva with Ambikā,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
dhyātvā hṛdi maheśānaṃ śatarudramanuṃ japet //
meaning:
पूजयित्वा शिवं भक्त्या कन्दमूलफलाशनः /
ध्यात्वा हृदि महेशानं शतरुद्रमनुं जपेत् //
text_mt: worshipping Śiva with devotion, eating bulbs, roots, and fruits, / meditating in the heart upon the Great Lord, one should mutter the Śatarudra mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahā mucyate pāpairaṣṭottarasahasrataḥ /
pāpairanyaiśca sakalairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्महा मुच्यते पापैरष्टोत्तरसहस्रतः /
पापैरन्यैश्च सकलैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: A slayer of a Brahmin is freed from sins by a thousand and eight [recitations]; / he is freed from all other sins as well; of this there is no doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
ityādiśya dadau tasyai rudrādhyāyaṃ tapodhanaḥ /
anugṛhyeti tāṃ nārīṃ tatraivāntarddhimāgamat //
meaning:
इत्यादिश्य ददौ तस्यै रुद्राध्यायं तपोधनः /
अनुगृह्येति तां नारीं तत्रैवान्तर्द्धिमागमत् //
text_mt: Having instructed thus, the ascetic gave her the Rudrādhyāya. / Having shown favor to that woman, he vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
bhartuḥ priyārthe saṃkalpya jajāpa paramaṃ japam /
vimuktasteyadoṣeṇa svaśarīramavāpa saḥ //
meaning:
भर्तुः प्रियार्थे संकल्प्य जजाप परमं जपम् /
विमुक्तस्तेयदोषेण स्वशरीरमवाप सः //
text_mt: Resolving for the sake of her husband's well-being, she muttered the supreme recitation. / Freed from the fault of theft, he regained his own body.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vajrābhidhaścauraḥ kāladharmamupāgataḥ /
anye taddravyavanto 'pi kāladharmamupāgatāḥ //
meaning:
ततो वज्राभिधश्चौरः कालधर्ममुपागतः /
अन्ये तद्द्रव्यवन्तो ऽपि कालधर्ममुपागताः //
text_mt: Then the thief named Vajra met his death. / The others who possessed that wealth also met their death.

sanskrit_iast: yamastu tānsamāhūya vākyaṃ caitaduvāca ha //
meaning: यमस्तु तान्समाहूय वाक्यं चैतदुवाच ह //
text_mt: Then Yama, having summoned them together, spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadbhistu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ daivātsukṛtamapyuta /
kimicchatha phalaṃ bhoktuṃ duṣkṛtasya śubhasya vā //
meaning:
भवद्भिस्तु कृतं पापं दैवात्सुकृतमप्युत /
किमिच्छथ फलं भोक्तुं दुष्कृतस्य शुभस्य वा //
text_mt: "Sin was committed by you, and by chance good deeds as well. / Which fruit do you desire to enjoy first, that of the evil deed or of the good?"

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā procurvajrādikāstataḥ /
sukṛtasya phalaṃ tvādau paścātpāpasya bhujyate //
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रोचुर्वज्रादिकास्ततः /
सुकृतस्य फलं त्वादौ पश्चात्पापस्य भुज्यते //
text_mt: Hearing his words, Vajra and the others said then: / "First let the fruit of good deeds be enjoyed, and afterward that of sin."

sanskrit_iast:
punarāha yamo yūyaṃ putramitra kalatrakaiḥ /
etasyaiva balātsarve tridivaṃ gacchata drutam //
meaning:
पुनराह यमो यूयं पुत्रमित्र कलत्रकैः /
एतस्यैव बलात्सर्वे त्रिदिवं गच्छत द्रुतम् //
text_mt: Yama spoke again: "Together with your sons, friends, and wives, / through his power alone, go swiftly, all of you, to heaven."

sanskrit_iast:
te 'dhiruhya vimānāgryaṃ dvijavarmāṇamāśritāḥ /
yathocitaphalopetāstridivaṃ jagmurañjasā //
meaning:
ते ऽधिरुह्य विमानाग्र्यं द्विजवर्माणमाश्रिताः /
यथोचितफलोपेतास्त्रिदिवं जग्मुरञ्जसा //
text_mt: Mounting an excellent aerial car, having resorted to Dvijavarma, / endowed with the appropriate fruit, they went straight to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijavarmākhilāṃllokānatītya pramadāsakhaḥ /
gāṇapatyamanuprāpya kailāse 'dyāpi modate //
meaning:
द्विजवर्माखिलांल्लोकानतीत्य प्रमदासखः /
गाणपत्यमनुप्राप्य कैलासे ऽद्यापि मोदते //
text_mt: Dvijavarma, having surpassed all the worlds, accompanied by his wife, / having attained leadership of the Gaṇas, rejoices on Kailāsa even today.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
tāratamyavibhāgaṃ ca kathaya tvaṃ mahāmate /
setubandhādikānāṃ ca puṇyānāṃ puṇyavardhanam //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
तारतम्यविभागं च कथय त्वं महामते /
सेतुबन्धादिकानां च पुण्यानां पुण्यवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Indra said: / "O wise one, explain the distinction of degrees / of meritorious acts, such as the building of the causeway, which increase merit."

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
puṇyasyārddhaphalaṃ prāpya dvijavarmā mahāyaśāḥ /
vajraḥ prāpya tadardhaṃ tu tadardhena yutāḥ pare //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
पुण्यस्यार्द्धफलं प्राप्य द्विजवर्मा महायशाः /
वज्रः प्राप्य तदर्धं तु तदर्धेन युताः परे //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "Having received half the fruit of the merit, Dvijavarma was illustrious; / Vajra received half of that, and the others were endowed with half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
manovākkāyaceṣṭābhiścaturdhākriyate kṛtiḥ /
vinaśyettena tenaiva kṛtaistatparihārakaiḥ //
meaning:
मनोवाक्कायचेष्टाभिश्चतुर्धाक्रियते कृतिः /
विनश्येत्तेन तेनैव कृतैस्तत्परिहारकैः //
text_mt: Action is performed in four ways by the activities of mind, speech, and body; / it is destroyed through those very [expounding acts] performed as their remedies."

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
āsavasya tu kiṃ rūpaṃ ko doṣaḥ kaścavā guṇaḥ /
annaṃ doṣakaraṃ kiṃ tu tanme vistarato vada //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
आसवस्य तु किं रूपं को दोषः कश्चवा गुणः /
अन्नं दोषकरं किं तु तन्मे विस्तरतो वद //
text_mt: Indra said: / "What is the nature of liquor, what is its fault, and what is its virtue? / And what food produces fault? Tell me that in detail."

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
paiṣṭikaṃ tālajaṃ kairaṃ mādhūkaṃ guḍasaṃbhavam /
kramānnyūnataraṃ pāpaṃ tadarddhārddhārddhatastathā //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
पैष्टिकं तालजं कैरं माधूकं गुडसंभवम् /
क्रमान्न्यूनतरं पापं तदर्द्धार्द्धार्द्धतस्तथा //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "[Liquor] made from meal, from palm, from coconut, from madhūka flowers, and that produced from molasses: / the sin is progressively lesser, by half, half, and half again.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyāditrivarṇānāmāsavaṃ peyamucyate /
strīṇāmapi tṛtīyādi peyaṃ syādbrāhmaṇīṃ vinā //
meaning:
क्षत्रियादित्रिवर्णानामासवं पेयमुच्यते /
स्त्रीणामपि तृतीयादि पेयं स्याद्ब्राह्मणीं विना //
text_mt: For the three classes beginning with the Kṣatriya, liquor is said to be drinkable. / For women too, beginning from the third, it may be drinkable, except for a Brahmin woman.

sanskrit_iast:
patihīnā ca kanyā ca tyajedṛtumatī tathā /
abhartṛsannidhau nārī madyaṃ pibati lolupā //
meaning:
पतिहीना च कन्या च त्यजेदृतुमती तथा /
अभर्तृसन्निधौ नारी मद्यं पिबति लोलुपा //
text_mt: A woman without a husband, an unmarried girl, and one in her menses should abandon it. / A greedy woman who drinks liquor in the absence of her husband

sanskrit_iast: unmādinīti sākhyātā tāṃ tyajedantyajāmiva //
meaning: उन्मादिनीति साख्याता तां त्यजेदन्त्यजामिव //
text_mt: is proclaimed 'mad'; one should abandon her like an outcaste.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṣṭaṣaṭcatasrastu dvijātīnāmayaṃ bhavet /
strīṇāṃ madyaṃ tadarddhaṃ syātpādaṃ syādbhartṛsaṅgame //
meaning:
दशाष्टषट्चतस्रस्तु द्विजातीनामयं भवेत् /
स्त्रीणां मद्यं तदर्द्धं स्यात्पादं स्याद्भर्तृसङ्गमे //
text_mt: Ten, eight, six, and four [measures] are for the twice-born; / for women, liquor should be half of that, and a quarter when uniting with the husband.

sanskrit_iast:
madyaṃ pītvā dvijo mohātkṛcchracāndrāyamaṃ caret /
japeccāyutagāyatrīṃ jātavedasameva vā //
meaning:
मद्यं पीत्वा द्विजो मोहात्कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायमं चरेत् /
जपेच्चायुतगायत्रीं जातवेदसमेव वा //
text_mt: A twice-born who drinks liquor through delusion should perform the Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa penances, / and should mutter the Gāyatrī ten thousand times, or the Jātavedas verse.

sanskrit_iast:
ambikā hṛdayaṃ vāpi japecchuddho bhavennaraḥ /
kṣatriyo 'pi trivarṇānāṃ dvijādardhor'dhataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
अम्बिका हृदयं वापि जपेच्छुद्धो भवेन्नरः /
क्षत्रियो ऽपि त्रिवर्णानां द्विजादर्धोर्ऽधतः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Or a man muttering the Ambikāhṛdaya will become purified. / A Kṣatriya also, among the three classes, [requires] half and half progressively from the twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāmardhārdhakḷptiḥ syātkārayedvā dvijairapi /
antarjale sahasraṃ vā japecchuddhimavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
स्त्रीणामर्धार्धकॢप्तिः स्यात्कारयेद्वा द्विजैरपि /
अन्तर्जले सहस्रं वा जपेच्छुद्धिमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: For women, there should be an allotment of half of half, or they should have it performed by twice-born; / or, muttering a thousand times submerged in water, one will attain purity.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaurī caṇḍikā tripurāṃbikā /
bhairavo bhairavī kālī mahāśāstrī ca mātaraḥ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती गौरी चण्डिका त्रिपुरांबिका /
भैरवो भैरवी काली महाशास्त्री च मातरः //
text_mt: Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Gaurī, Caṇḍikā, Tripurāmbikā, / Bhairava, Bhairavī, Kālī, Mahāśāstrī, and the Mothers,

sanskrit_iast:
anyāśca śaktayastāsāṃ pūjane madhu śasyate /
brāhmaṇastu vinā tena yajedvedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
अन्याश्च शक्तयस्तासां पूजने मधु शस्यते /
ब्राह्मणस्तु विना तेन यजेद्वेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt: and other Śaktis: in worshipping them, liquor is praised. / But a Brahmin who has mastered the Vedāṅgas should worship without it.

sanskrit_iast:
tanniveditamaśnantastadananyāstadātmakāḥ /
tāsāṃ pravāhā gacchanti nirlepāste parāṃ gatim //
meaning:
तन्निवेदितमश्नन्तस्तदनन्यास्तदात्मकाः /
तासां प्रवाहा गच्छन्ति निर्लेपास्ते परां गतिम् //
text_mt: Eating what has been offered to them, devoted to no other, identifying with them, / their streams, undefiled, go to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtasyākhilapāpasya jñānato 'jñānato 'pi vā /
prāyaścittamidaṃ proktaṃ parāśakteḥ padasmṛtiḥ //
meaning:
कृतस्याखिलपापस्य ज्ञानतो ऽज्ञानतो ऽपि वा /
प्रायश्चित्तमिदं प्रोक्तं पराशक्तेः पदस्मृतिः //
text_mt: For all sin committed, whether knowingly or unknowingly, / this is declared the expiation: remembrance of the supreme Śakti's feet.

sanskrit_iast:
anabhyarcya parāṃ śaktiṃ pibenmadyaṃ tu yo 'dhamaḥ /
raurave narake 'bdaṃ tu nivasedbrindusaṃkhyayā //
meaning:
अनभ्यर्च्य परां शक्तिं पिबेन्मद्यं तु यो ऽधमः /
रौरवे नरके ऽब्दं तु निवसेद्ब्रिन्दुसंख्यया //
text_mt: The vile person who drinks liquor without worshipping the supreme Śakti / will dwell in the Raurava hell for a year for every drop.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogecchayā tu yo madyaṃ pibetsa mānuṣādhamaḥ /
prāyaścitaṃ na caivāsya śilāgnipatanādṛte //
meaning:
भोगेच्छया तु यो मद्यं पिबेत्स मानुषाधमः /
प्रायश्चितं न चैवास्य शिलाग्निपतनादृते //
text_mt: The vile man who drinks liquor out of a desire for pleasure / has no expiation other than falling into fire upon a rock.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo mohānna tu pibetsnehādvā kāmato 'pi vā /
anugrahācca mahatāmanutāpācca karmaṇaḥ //
meaning:
द्विजो मोहान्न तु पिबेत्स्नेहाद्वा कामतो ऽपि वा /
अनुग्रहाच्च महतामनुतापाच्च कर्मणः //
text_mt: A twice-born must not drink through delusion, affection, or desire. / Through the grace of the great and repentance for the deed,

sanskrit_iast:
arcanācca parāśakteryamaiśca niyamairapi /
cāndrāyaṇena kṛcchreṇa dinasaṃkhyākṛtena ca /
śuddhyecca brāhmaṇo doṣāddviguṇādbuddhipūrvataḥ //
iti brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne steyapānakathanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
अर्चनाच्च पराशक्तेर्यमैश्च नियमैरपि /
चान्द्रायणेन कृच्छ्रेण दिनसंख्याकृतेन च /
शुद्ध्येच्च ब्राह्मणो दोषाद्द्विगुणाद्बुद्धिपूर्वतः //
इति ब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने स्तेयपानकथनं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
and through worshipping the supreme Śakti, through restraints and observances, / through Cāndrāyaṇa, Kṛcchra, and rites measured by number of days, / a Brahmin will be purified from the fault, which is double if done intentionally.

Thus ends the seventh chapter, titled "The Discussion of Theft and Drinking," in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
agamyāgamanaṃ kiṃ vā ko doṣaḥ kā ca niṣkṛtiḥ /
etanme muniśārdūla vistarādvaktumarhasi //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
अगम्यागमनं किं वा को दोषः का च निष्कृतिः /
एतन्मे मुनिशार्दूल विस्तराद्वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt: Indra said: / "What is intercourse with forbidden women, what is the fault, and what is the expiation? / You ought to tell me this at length, O tiger among sages."

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
agamyāgamanaṃ nāma mātṛsvasṛgurustriyaḥ /
mātulasya priyā ceti gatvemā nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
अगम्यागमनं नाम मातृस्वसृगुरुस्त्रियः /
मातुलस्य प्रिया चेति गत्वेमा नास्ति निष्कृतिः //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / "Intercourse with forbidden women means the mother, the sister, the teacher's wife, / and the maternal uncle's beloved; having approached these, there is no expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛsaṅge tu yadaghaṃ tadeva svasṛsaṅgame /
gurustrīsaṃgame tadvadguravo bahavaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
मातृसङ्गे तु यदघं तदेव स्वसृसङ्गमे /
गुरुस्त्रीसंगमे तद्वद्गुरवो बहवः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Whatever sin is in union with the mother, that very same is in union with the sister; / likewise in union with the teacher's wife; many kinds of teachers are recorded.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmopadeśamārabhya yāvadvedāntadarśanam /
ekena vakṣyate yena sa mahāgururucyate //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोपदेशमारभ्य यावद्वेदान्तदर्शनम् /
एकेन वक्ष्यते येन स महागुरुरुच्यते //
text_mt: He by whom instruction in the Brahman is spoken beginning from initiation / up to the realization of the Vedānta, he is called a supreme teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmopadeśamekatra vedaśāstrāṇyathaikataḥ /
ācāryaḥ sa tu vijñeyastadekaikāstu deśikāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोपदेशमेकत्र वेदशास्त्राण्यथैकतः /
आचार्यः स तु विज्ञेयस्तदेकैकास्तु देशिकाः //
text_mt: One who teaches the Brahman in one part, or the Vedas and scriptures in one part, / is to be known as an ācārya; and those teaching each individual subject are instructors.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorātmāntameva syādāyāryasya priyāgame /
dvādaśābdaṃ caretkṛccha3mekaikaṃ tu ṣaḍabdataḥ //
meaning:
गुरोरात्मान्तमेव स्यादायार्यस्य प्रियागमे /
द्वादशाब्दं चरेत्कृच्छ3मेकैकं तु षडब्दतः //
text_mt: For approaching the guru's beloved, it ends only with one's life; for approaching the ācārya's beloved, / one should perform the Kṛcchra penance for twelve years, and for each [instructor's wife] for six years.

sanskrit_iast:
mātulasya priyāṃ gatvā ṣaḍabdaṃ kṛcchramācaret /
brāhmaṇastu sajātīyāṃ pramadāṃ yadi gacchati //
meaning:
मातुलस्य प्रियां गत्वा षडब्दं कृच्छ्रमाचरेत् /
ब्राह्मणस्तु सजातीयां प्रमदां यदि गच्छति //
text_mt: Having approached the maternal uncle's beloved, one should perform the Kṛcchra penance for six years. / If a Brahmin approaches a woman of his own caste,

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitastrirātraṃ tu prāṇāyāmaśataṃ caret /
kulaṭāṃ tu sajātīyāṃ trirātreṇa viśudhyati //
meaning:
उपोषितस्त्रिरात्रं तु प्राणायामशतं चरेत् /
कुलटां तु सजातीयां त्रिरात्रेण विशुध्यति //
text_mt: fasting for three nights, he should perform a hundred breath-controls. / Approaching an unchaste woman of his own caste, he is purified in three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāhātkṣatriyāṅgatvā saptāhā dvaiśyajāmapi /
cakrīkirātakaivartakarmakārādiyoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाहात्क्षत्रियाङ्गत्वा सप्ताहा द्वैश्यजामपि /
चक्रीकिरातकैवर्तकर्मकारादियोषितः //
text_mt: Having approached a Kṣatriya woman, [purification is] in five days; a Vaiśya woman, in seven days; / for the wives of oil-millers, Kirātas, fishermen, and laborers,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhiḥ syāddvādaśāhena dharāśaktyarcanena ca /
anantyajāṃ brāhmaṇo gatvā pramādādabdataḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
शुद्धिः स्याद्द्वादशाहेन धराशक्त्यर्चनेन च /
अनन्त्यजां ब्राह्मणो गत्वा प्रमादादब्दतः शुचिः //
text_mt: purification will be in twelve days, along with the worship of the earth-power. / A Brahmin who has approached an outcaste woman through negligence is purified in a year.

sanskrit_iast:
devadāsī brahmadāsī svatantrāśūdradāsikā /
dāsī caturvidhā proktā dve cādye kṣatriyāsame //
meaning:
देवदासी ब्रह्मदासी स्वतन्त्राशूद्रदासिका /
दासी चतुर्विधा प्रोक्ता द्वे चाद्ये क्षत्रियासमे //
text_mt:
A servant of the gods (devadāsī), a servant of Brahmins (brahmadāsī), an independent woman (svatantrā), and a Śūdra's servant woman:
a servant woman is declared to be of four kinds; the first two are equal to a Kṣatriya woman.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāveśyāṅganātulyā tadanyā hīnajātivat /
ātmadāsīṃ dvijo mohāduktārthe doṣamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
अन्यावेश्याङ्गनातुल्या तदन्या हीनजातिवत् /
आत्मदासीं द्विजो मोहादुक्तार्थे दोषमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
Another is equal to a courtesan, and the other is like a woman of low caste.
If a twice-born man, through delusion, [approaches] his own female servant, he incurs the sin according to what has been stated.

sanskrit_iast:
svastrīmṛtumatīṃ gatvā prājāpatyaṃ caredvratam /
dviguṇena parāṃ nārīṃ caturbhiḥ kṣatriyāṅganām //
meaning:
स्वस्त्रीमृतुमतीं गत्वा प्राजापत्यं चरेद्व्रतम् /
द्विगुणेन परां नारीं चतुर्भिः क्षत्रियाङ्गनाम् //
text_mt:
Having approached one's own wife in her fertile period [unlawfully], one should perform the Prājāpatya penance;
[approaching] another's woman, [a penance] twice as much; a Kṣatriya woman, four times [as much];

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabhirvaiśyanārīṃ ca śūdrāṃ ṣauḍaśabhistathā /
dvātriṃśatā saṃkarajāṃ veśyāṃ śūdrāmivācaret //
meaning:
अष्टभिर्वैश्यनारीं च शूद्रां षौडशभिस्तथा /
द्वात्रिंशता संकरजां वेश्यां शूद्रामिवाचरेत् //
text_mt:
eight times for a Vaiśya woman, and sixteen times for a Śūdra woman;
thirty-two times for a mixed-caste woman; and for a courtesan, one should perform [the penance] as for a Śūdra woman.

sanskrit_iast:
rajasvalāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ mohato gantumicchati /
snātvānyavastrasaṃyuktamuktārthenaiva śudhyati //
meaning:
रजस्वलां तु यो भार्यां मोहतो गन्तुमिच्छति /
स्नात्वान्यवस्त्रसंयुक्तमुक्तार्थेनैव शुध्यति //
text_mt:
He who through delusion wishes to approach his menstruating wife,
becomes purified only by bathing, putting on other clothes, and according to what has been stated.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya taccheṣadinaṃ snātvā karma samācaret /
tathaivānyāṅganāṃ gatvā taduktārthaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
उपोष्य तच्छेषदिनं स्नात्वा कर्म समाचरेत् /
तथैवान्याङ्गनां गत्वा तदुक्तार्थं समाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Fasting for the remainder of that day and having bathed, he should perform ritual action;
likewise, having approached another woman, he should perform what has been prescribed for that.

sanskrit_iast:
pitroranujñayā kanyāṃ yo gacchedvidhinā vinā /
trirātropoṣaṇācchuddhistāmevodvāhayettadā //
meaning:
पित्रोरनुज्ञया कन्यां यो गच्छेद्विधिना विना /
त्रिरात्रोपोषणाच्छुद्धिस्तामेवोद्वाहयेत्तदा //
text_mt:
He who approaches a maiden with the permission of her parents, but without the [proper] rite,
becomes purified by fasting for three nights; then he should marry that very girl.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ dattvā tu yo 'nyasmai dattā yaścānuyacchati /
pitroranujñayā pādadinārdhena viśudhyati //
meaning:
कन्यां दत्त्वा तु यो ऽन्यस्मै दत्ता यश्चानुयच्छति /
पित्रोरनुज्ञया पाददिनार्धेन विशुध्यति //
text_mt:
He who, having given a maiden to one, [gives her] to another, and he who accepts the one who has been given,
becomes purified in half of a quarter-day (three muhūrtas) with the permission of the parents.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ yo māsaṃ kanyābhāve tu gacchati /
vṛṣalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञातः पितृभ्यां यो मासं कन्याभावे तु गच्छति /
वृषलः स तु विज्ञेयः सर्वकर्मबहिष्कृतः //
text_mt:
He who is known by the parents, but who approaches [another woman] for a month in the absence of a maiden,
is to be known as an outcaste (vṛṣala), excluded from all religious rites.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ yo gatvā paroḍhāṃ tadvināśane /
vidhavā jāyate neyaṃ pūrvagantāramāpnuyāt //
meaning:
ज्ञातः पितृभ्यां यो गत्वा परोढां तद्विनाशने /
विधवा जायते नेयं पूर्वगन्तारमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt:
He who approaches another's married wife with the parents' knowledge, upon his destruction
she does not become a widow, [but] should go to the previous approacher.

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahāddvijātīnāmudvāhavidhinā tathā /
tyāgakarmāṇi kurvīta śrautasmārtādikāni ca //
meaning:
अनुग्रहाद्द्विजातीनामुद्वाहविधिना तथा /
त्यागकर्माणि कुर्वीत श्रौतस्मार्तादिकानि च //
text_mt:
By the grace of the twice-born, and according to the rites of marriage,
he should perform the rites of abandonment as well as those ordained by the Śruti and Smṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
ādāvudvāhitā vāpi tadvināśe 'nyadaḥ pitā /
bhogecchoḥ sādhanaṃ sā tu na yegyākhilakarmasu //
meaning:
आदावुद्वाहिता वापि तद्विनाशे ऽन्यदः पिता /
भोगेच्छोः साधनं सा तु न येग्याखिलकर्मसु //
text_mt:
Even if she was married in the beginning, upon his death, her father gives her to another;
she is a means of enjoyment for one desiring pleasure, but she is not fit for all sacred rites.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādipipīlakāntaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam /
pañcabhūtātmakaṃ proktaṃ caturvāsanayānvitam //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिपिपीलकान्तं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् /
पञ्चभूतात्मकं प्रोक्तं चतुर्वासनयान्वितम् //
text_mt:
From Brahmā down to an ant, the world of the immovable and movable
is declared to consist of the five elements and to be accompanied by four innate drives:

sanskrit_iast:
janmādyāhāramathananidrābhītyaśca sarvadā /
āhāreṇa vinā janturnāhāro madanātsmṛtaḥ //
meaning:
जन्माद्याहारमथननिद्राभीत्यश्च सर्वदा /
आहारेण विना जन्तुर्नाहारो मदनात्स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Birth, food, sexual intercourse (churning), sleep, and fear at all times.
Without food a creature cannot exist; [and] food is held to proceed from desire.

sanskrit_iast:
dustaro madanastasmātsarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi /
punnārīrūpavatkṛtvā madananenaiva viśvasṛk //
meaning:
दुस्तरो मदनस्तस्मात्सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि /
पुन्नारीरूपवत्कृत्वा मदननेनैव विश्वसृक् //
text_mt:
Therefore, desire is insurmountable for all living beings as well.
Having made them in the form of male and female, by desire alone the creator of the universe

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttimakarodādau sṛṣṭisthitilayātmikām /
tatpravṛttyā pravartante tannivṛttyākṣayāṃ gatim //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तिमकरोदादौ सृष्टिस्थितिलयात्मिकाम् /
तत्प्रवृत्त्या प्रवर्तन्ते तन्निवृत्त्याक्षयां गतिम् //
text_mt:
performed at the beginning engagement [in action] consisting of creation, preservation, and dissolution;
by that engagement beings engage, [and] by its cessation they attain an imperishable state.

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttyaiva yathā muktiṃ prāpnuyurye na dhīyutāḥ /
tadrahasyaṃ tadopāyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam //
meaning:
प्रवृत्त्यैव यथा मुक्तिं प्राप्नुयुर्ये न धीयुताः /
तद्रहस्यं तदोपायं शृणु वक्ष्यामि सांप्रतम् //
text_mt:
How those who are not endowed with [transcendental] intellect may attain liberation through engagement itself,
listen to that secret and its means; I shall describe it now.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmako vāsudevaḥ puruṣastu purātanaḥ /
iyaṃ hi mūlaprakṛtirlakṣmīḥ sarvajagatprasūḥ //
meaning:
सर्वात्मको वासुदेवः पुरुषस्तु पुरातनः /
इयं हि मूलप्रकृतिर्लक्ष्मीः सर्वजगत्प्रसूः //
text_mt:
Vāsudeva, the ancient Puruṣa, is the soul of all;
this indeed is primordial nature (mūlaprakṛti), Lakṣmī, the mother of the entire universe.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāpañcātmatṛptyarthaṃ mathanaṃ kriyatetarām /
evaṃ mantrānubhāvātsyānmathanaṃ kriyate yadi //
meaning:
पञ्चापञ्चात्मतृप्त्यर्थं मथनं क्रियतेतराम् /
एवं मन्त्रानुभावात्स्यान्मथनं क्रियते यदि //
text_mt:
The churning is performed especially for the satisfaction of the five elements.
If churning is performed thus by the power of the mantra,

sanskrit_iast: tāvubhau mantrakarmāṇau na doṣo vidyate tayoḥ //
meaning: तावुभौ मन्त्रकर्माणौ न दोषो विद्यते तयोः //
text_mt: both of them become performers of mantra action, [and] no fault exists in the two of them.

sanskrit_iast:
tapobalavatāmetatkevalānāmadhogatiḥ /
svastrīviṣaya evedaṃ tayorapi vidherbalāt //
meaning:
तपोबलवतामेतत्केवलानामधोगतिः /
स्वस्त्रीविषय एवेदं तयोरपि विधेर्बलात् //
text_mt:
This belongs to those possessing the power of austerity; for ordinary men there is a downward fall.
This applies only to one's own wife, for both of them, by the power of injunction.

sanskrit_iast:
parasparātmyaikyahṛdordevyā bhaktyārdracetasoḥ /
tayorapi manākcenna niṣiddhadivaseṣvagham //
meaning:
परस्परात्म्यैक्यहृदोर्देव्या भक्त्यार्द्रचेतसोः /
तयोरपि मनाक्चेन्न निषिद्धदिवसेष्वघम् //
text_mt:
For those two whose hearts are united in mutual oneness, whose minds are softened by devotion to the Goddess,
even slightly, if it is not on forbidden days, there is no sin.

sanskrit_iast:
iyamaṃbā jagaddhātrī puruṣo 'yaṃ sadāśivaḥ /
pañcaviṃśatitattvānāṃ prītaye mathyate 'dhunā //
meaning:
इयमंबा जगद्धात्री पुरुषो ऽयं सदाशिवः /
पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानां प्रीतये मथ्यते ऽधुना //
text_mt:
This is the Mother, the supporter of the world; this is Puruṣa, Sadāśiva;
now churning is performed for the gratification of the twenty-five principles.

sanskrit_iast:
etanmantrānubhāvācca mathanaṃ kriyate yadi /
tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau na doṣo vidyate tayoḥ //
meaning:
एतन्मन्त्रानुभावाच्च मथनं क्रियते यदि /
तावुभौ पुण्यकर्माणौ न दोषो विद्यते तयोः //
text_mt:
And if churning is performed through the power of this mantra,
both of them become performers of meritorious action; no fault exists in the two of them.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ ca śṛṇu devendra rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat /
sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ yaugapadyena nāśanam //
meaning:
इदं च शृणु देवेन्द्र रहस्यं परमं महत् /
सर्वेषामेव पापानां यौगपद्येन नाशनम् //
text_mt:
Listen also to this, O lord of gods, the supreme, great secret,
the simultaneous destroyer of all sins whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiśraddhāsamāyuktaḥ snātvāntarjalasaṃsthitaḥ /
aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu japetpañcadaśākṣarīm //
meaning:
भक्तिश्रद्धासमायुक्तः स्नात्वान्तर्जलसंस्थितः /
अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु जपेत्पञ्चदशाक्षरीम् //
text_mt:
Endowed with devotion and faith, having bathed and standing in water,
one should recite the fifteen-syllabled mantra one thousand and eight times.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhya ca parāṃ śaktiṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ /
tena naśyanti pāpāni kalpakoṭikṛtānyapi /
sarvāpadbhyo vimucyeta sarvābhīṣṭaṃ ca vindati //
meaning:
आराध्य च परां शक्तिं मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः /
तेन नश्यन्ति पापानि कल्पकोटिकृतान्यपि /
सर्वापद्भ्यो विमुच्येत सर्वाभीष्टं च विन्दति //

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvabhūtahite rata /
saṃyogajasya pāpasya viśeṣaṃ vaktumarhasi //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
भगवन्सर्वधर्मज्ञ सर्वभूतहिते रत /
संयोगजस्य पापस्य विशेषं वक्तुमर्हसि //
text_mt:
Indra said:
O blessed one, knower of all righteousness, devoted to the welfare of all beings,
you ought to tell the distinction regarding the sin born of contact.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
saṃyogajaṃ tu yatpāpaṃ taccaturdhā nigadyate /
kartā pradhānaḥ sahakṛnnimitto 'numataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
संयोगजं तु यत्पापं तच्चतुर्धा निगद्यते /
कर्ता प्रधानः सहकृन्निमित्तो ऽनुमतः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
Bṛhaspati said:
The sin born of contact is said to be of four kinds:
the direct perpetrator, the instigator, the accomplice, and the approver, in order.

sanskrit_iast: kramāddaśāṃśato 'ghaṃ syācchuddhiḥ pūrvoktamārgataḥ //
