meaning: क्रमाद्दशांशतो ऽघं स्याच्छुद्धिः पूर्वोक्तमार्गतः //
text_mt: The sin is reduced by a tenth part respectively, and purification is by the path stated previously.

sanskrit_iast:
madyaṃ kalañjaṃ niryāsaṃ chatrākaṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā /
laśunaṃ ca kaliṅgaṃ ca mahākośātakīṃ tathā //
meaning:
मद्यं कलञ्जं निर्यासं छत्राकं गृञ्जनं तथा /
लशुनं च कलिङ्गं च महाकोशातकीं तथा //
text_mt:
Liquor, red garlic (kalañja), exudations, mushrooms, carrots,
garlic, kaliṅga, and the large loofah (mahākośātakī),

sanskrit_iast:
biṃbīṃ ca kavakaṃ caiva hastinīṃ śiśulaṃbikām /
auduṃbaraṃ ca vārtākaṃ katakaṃ bilvamallikā //
meaning:
बिंबीं च कवकं चैव हस्तिनीं शिशुलंबिकाम् /
औदुंबरं च वार्ताकं कतकं बिल्वमल्लिका //
text_mt:
biṃbī, fungi, hastinī, hanging gourds,
figs, brinjals, kataka, and bilva-jasmine:

sanskrit_iast:
kramāddaśaguṇaṃ nyūnamaghameṣāṃ vinirdiśet /
puragrāmāṅgavaiśyāṅgaveśyopāyanavikrayī //
meaning:
क्रमाद्दशगुणं न्यूनमघमेषां विनिर्दिशेत् /
पुरग्रामाङ्गवैश्याङ्गवेश्योपायनविक्रयी //
text_mt:
one should indicate the sin of these as being tenfold less in succession.
One who sells women of town, village, or Vaiśya caste, or courtesans as gifts,

sanskrit_iast:
sevakaḥ purasaṃsthaśca kugrāmastho 'bhiśastakaḥ /
vaidyo vaikhānasaḥ śaivo nārījīvo 'nnavikrayī //
meaning:
सेवकः पुरसंस्थश्च कुग्रामस्थो ऽभिशस्तकः /
वैद्यो वैखानसः शैवो नारीजीवो ऽन्नविक्रयी //
text_mt:
a servant, a resident of a town, one residing in a wretched village, an accuser,
a physician, a Vaikhānasa, a Śaiva, one who lives off women, a food seller,

sanskrit_iast:
śastrajīvī parivrāṭ ca vaidikācāranindakaḥ /
kramāddaśaguṇānnyūnameṣāmannādane bhavet //
meaning:
शस्त्रजीवी परिव्राट् च वैदिकाचारनिन्दकः /
क्रमाद्दशगुणान्न्यूनमेषामन्नादने भवेत् //
text_mt:
one living by weapons, a wandering mendicant, and a reviler of Vedic practice:
in eating the food of these, [the sin] decreases tenfold successively.

sanskrit_iast:
svatantraṃ tailakḷptaṃ tu hyuktārthaṃ pāpamādiśet /
taireva dṛṣṭaṃ tadbhuktamuktapāpaṃ vinirdiśet //
meaning:
स्वतन्त्रं तैलकॢप्तं तु ह्युक्तार्थं पापमादिशेत् /
तैरेव दृष्टं तद्भुक्तमुक्तपापं विनिर्दिशेत् //
text_mt:
Food prepared independently with oil carries the sin according to what has been said;
eaten when seen by those very persons, one should specify the stated sin.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva saśūdrāṇāṃ yathaudanam /
tailapakvamadṛṣṭaṃ ca bhuñjanpādamaghaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशां चैव सशूद्राणां यथौदनम् /
तैलपक्वमदृष्टं च भुञ्जन्पादमघं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Eating the rice of Brahmins, Kṣatriyas, and Vaiśyas, along with Śūdras,
cooked in oil and unseen, incurs a quarter of the sin.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijātmadāsīkḷptaṃ ca tayā dṛṣṭe tadardhake /
veśyāyāstu tripādaṃ syāttathā dṛṣṭe tadodane //
meaning:
द्विजात्मदासीकॢप्तं च तया दृष्टे तदर्धके /
वेश्यायास्तु त्रिपादं स्यात्तथा दृष्टे तदोदने //
text_mt:
When prepared by a twice-born's own female servant, if seen by her, it is half of that;
for a courtesan's [food], it is three quarters, when her rice is likewise seen.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrāvatsyāttu gopānnaṃ vinā gavyacatuṣṭayam /
tailājyaguḍasaṃyuktaṃ pakvaṃ vaiśyānna duṣyati //
meaning:
शूद्रावत्स्यात्तु गोपान्नं विना गव्यचतुष्टयम् /
तैलाज्यगुडसंयुक्तं पक्वं वैश्यान्न दुष्यति //
text_mt:
The cowherd's food is like a Śūdra's, except for the four products of the cow;
food mixed with oil, clarified butter, or molasses and cooked is like a Vaiśya's and does not defile.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśyāvadbrāhmaṇī bhraṣṭā tayā dṛṣṭena kiñcana //
meaning: वैश्यावद्ब्राह्मणी भ्रष्टा तया दृष्टेन किञ्चन //
text_mt: A fallen Brahmin woman is like a Vaiśya woman; nothing [is spoiled] by her glance.

sanskrit_iast:
bruvasyānnaṃ dvijo bhuktvā prāṇāyāmaśataṃ caret /
athavāntarjale japtvādrupadāṃ vā trivārakam //
meaning:
ब्रुवस्यान्नं द्विजो भुक्त्वा प्राणायामशतं चरेत् /
अथवान्तर्जले जप्त्वाद्रुपदां वा त्रिवारकम् //
text_mt:
Having eaten the food of a fraudulent man (bruva), a twice-born should perform a hundred breath-controls,
or recite the Drupadā mantra three times while standing in water.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ viṣṇustryaṃbakaṃ vā tthaivāntarjale japet /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ tataḥ pāpādviśudhyati //
meaning:
इदं विष्णुस्त्र्यंबकं वा त्थैवान्तर्जले जपेत् /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां ततः पापाद्विशुध्यति //
text_mt:
Or he should recite the mantra 'idaṃ viṣṇuḥ' or the Tryambaka hymn in the water in the same way;
having fasted for one night, he is thereupon purified from the sin.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā prokṣayedannamabliṅgaiḥ pāvamānikaiḥ /
annasūktaṃ japitvā tu bhṛgurvai vāruṇīti ca //
meaning:
अथवा प्रोक्षयेदन्नमब्लिङ्गैः पावमानिकैः /
अन्नसूक्तं जपित्वा तु भृगुर्वै वारुणीति च //
text_mt:
Or he should sprinkle the food with the water hymns and the purifying verses (pāvamānī),
and having recited the Annasūkta and the hymn 'bhṛgurvai vāruṇiḥ',

sanskrit_iast:
brahmārpaṇamiti ślokaṃ japtvā niyamamāśritaḥ /
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
ब्रह्मार्पणमिति श्लोकं जप्त्वा नियममाश्रितः /
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां ततः शुद्धो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
and reciting the verse 'brahmārpaṇam' while observing self-restraint,
having fasted for one night, he will thereupon become pure.

sanskrit_iast:
strī bhuktvā tu bruvādyannamekādyānbhojaye ddvijān /
āpadi brāhmaṇo hyeṣāmannaṃ bhuktvā na doṣabhāk //
meaning:
स्त्री भुक्त्वा तु ब्रुवाद्यन्नमेकाद्यान्भोजये द्द्विजान् /
आपदि ब्राह्मणो ह्येषामन्नं भुक्त्वा न दोषभाक् //
text_mt:
A woman who eats the food of a fraudulent man should feed one or more twice-born men;
in times of distress, a Brahmin who eats their food incurs no fault.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ viṣṇuriti mantreṇa saptavārābhimantritam /
so 'haṃbhāvena taddhyātvā bhuktvā doṣairna lipyate //
meaning:
इदं विष्णुरिति मन्त्रेण सप्तवाराभिमन्त्रितम् /
सो ऽहंभावेन तद्ध्यात्वा भुक्त्वा दोषैर्न लिप्यते //
text_mt:
Consecrated seven times with the mantra 'idaṃ viṣṇuḥ',
meditating on it with the conviction 'I am He', eating it, he is not tainted by faults.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā śaṅkaraṃ dhyāyañjaptvā traiyyaṃbakaṃ manum /
so 'haṃbhāvena tajjñānānna doṣaiḥ pravilipyate //
meaning:
अथवा शङ्करं ध्यायञ्जप्त्वा त्रैय्यंबकं मनुम् /
सो ऽहंभावेन तज्ज्ञानान्न दोषैः प्रविलिप्यते //
text_mt:
Or meditating upon Śaṅkara and reciting the Tryambaka mantra,
through knowledge of that with the conviction 'I am He', he is not at all tainted by faults.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ rahasyaṃ devendra śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama /
dhyātvā devīṃ parāṃ śaktiṃ japtvā pañcadaśākṣarīm //
meaning:
इदं रहस्यं देवेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम /
ध्यात्वा देवीं परां शक्तिं जप्त्वा पञ्चदशाक्षरीम् //
text_mt:
Listen to this secret, my word, O lord of gods:
having meditated upon the Goddess, the Supreme Śakti, and recited the fifteen-syllabled mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
tanniveditabuddhyādau yo 'śnāti pratyahaṃ dvijaḥ /
nāsyānnadoṣajaṃ kiñcinna dāridrayabhayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
तन्निवेदितबुद्ध्यादौ यो ऽश्नाति प्रत्यहं द्विजः /
नास्यान्नदोषजं किञ्चिन्न दारिद्रयभयं तथा //
text_mt: The twice-born who eats daily, aware that it is first offered to her, / has no [affliction] arising from the fault of food, nor any fear of poverty.

sanskrit_iast:
na vyādhijaṃ bhayaṃ tasya na ca śatrubhayaṃ tathā /
japato muktirevāsya sadā sarvatra maṅgalam //
meaning:
न व्याधिजं भयं तस्य न च शत्रुभयं तथा /
जपतो मुक्तिरेवास्य सदा सर्वत्र मङ्गलम् //
text_mt: He has no fear arising from disease, nor fear of enemies; / for one who recites [it], there is indeed liberation, and always good fortune everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa te kathitaḥ śakra pāpānāmapi vistaraḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ tathā teṣāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne 'ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एष ते कथितः शक्र पापानामपि विस्तरः /
प्रायश्चित्तं तथा तेषां किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ऽष्टमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This detailed account of sins has thus been related to you, Śakra, / as well as their expiation; what else do you wish to hear?

Thus ends the eighth chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
indra uvāca
bhagavansarva dharmajña trikālajñānavittama /
duṣkṛtaṃ tatpratīkāro bhavatā samyagīritaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्र उवाच
भगवन्सर्व धर्मज्ञ त्रिकालज्ञानवित्तम /
दुष्कृतं तत्प्रतीकारो भवता सम्यगीरितः //
text_mt: Indra said: / Blessed lord, knower of all righteousness, best among those possessing knowledge of the three times, / the evil deed and its remedy have been well spoken by you.

sanskrit_iast:
kena karmavipākena mamāpadi yamāgatā /
prāyaścittaṃ ca kiṃ tasya gadasva vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
केन कर्मविपाकेन ममापदि यमागता /
प्रायश्चित्तं च किं तस्य गदस्व वदतां वर //
text_mt: By the fruition of what karma did this misfortune come upon me? / And what is its expiation? Tell [me], O best of speakers!

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatiruvāca
kāśyapasya tato jajñe dityāṃ danuriti smṛtaḥ /
kanyā rūpavatī nāma dhātre tāṃ pradadau pitā //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच
काश्यपस्य ततो जज्ञे दित्यां दनुरिति स्मृतः /
कन्या रूपवती नाम धात्रे तां प्रददौ पिता //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Then to Kaśyapa, by Ditī, was born one known as Danu; / the father gave the daughter named Rūpavatī to Dhātṛ.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ putrastato jāto viśvarūpo mahādyutiḥ /
nārāyaṇaparo nityaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः पुत्रस्ततो जातो विश्वरूपो महाद्युतिः /
नारायणपरो नित्यं वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः //
text_mt: From her was then born a son, Viśvarūpa of great splendor, / ever devoted to Nārāyaṇa, having crossed to the further shore of the Vedas and auxiliary sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
tato daityeśvaro vavre bhṛguputraṃ purohitam /
bhavānadhikṛto rājye devānāmiva vāsavaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दैत्येश्वरो वव्रे भृगुपुत्रं पुरोहितम् /
भवानधिकृतो राज्ये देवानामिव वासवः //
text_mt: Then the lord of Daityas chose the son of Bhṛgu as priest: / 'You are appointed over the kingdom, like Vāsava over the gods.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pūrve ca kāle tu sudharmāyāṃ tvayi sthite /
tvayā kaścitkṛtaḥ praśna ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau tadā //
meaning:
ततः पूर्वे च काले तु सुधर्मायां त्वयि स्थिते /
त्वया कश्चित्कृतः प्रश्न ऋषीणां सन्निधौ तदा //
text_mt: Then at an earlier time, while you were seated in the Sudharmā hall, / a question was posed by you then in the presence of the ṛṣis:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārastīrthayātrā vā ko 'dhiko 'sti tayorgumaḥ /
vadantu tadviniścitya bhavanto madanugrahāt //
meaning:
संसारस्तीर्थयात्रा वा को ऽधिको ऽस्ति तयोर्गुमः /
वदन्तु तद्विनिश्चित्य भवन्तो मदनुग्रहात् //
text_mt: 'Samsara or pilgrimage to sacred places—which virtue of these two is greater? / Having determined that, may you speak out of favor toward me.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatpraśnasyottaraṃ vaktuṃ te sarva upacakrire /
tatpūrvameva kathitaṃ mayā vidhibalena vai //
meaning:
तत्प्रश्नस्योत्तरं वक्तुं ते सर्व उपचक्रिरे /
तत्पूर्वमेव कथितं मया विधिबलेन वै //
text_mt: They all began to speak an answer to that question; / indeed, prior to them it was spoken by me by the force of destiny:

sanskrit_iast:
tīrtha yātrā samadhikā saṃsārāditi ca drutam /
tacchrutvā te prakupitāḥ śepurmāmṛṣayo 'khilāḥ //
meaning:
तीर्थ यात्रा समधिका संसारादिति च द्रुतम् /
तच्छ्रुत्वा ते प्रकुपिताः शेपुर्मामृषयो ऽखिलाः //
text_mt: 'Pilgrimage to sacred places is far superior to samsara!' / Hearing that, all those ṛṣis became enraged and cursed me:

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmiṃ vrajeḥ śīghraṃ dārirdyeṇa mitaiḥ sutaiḥ /
evaṃ prakupitaiḥ śaptaḥ khinnaḥ kāñcīṃ samāviśam //
meaning:
कर्मभूमिं व्रजेः शीघ्रं दारिर्द्येण मितैः सुतैः /
एवं प्रकुपितैः शप्तः खिन्नः काञ्चीं समाविशम् //
text_mt: 'Go quickly to the realm of action with poverty and few sons!' / Thus cursed by the enraged [ṛṣis], sorrowful, I entered Kāñcī.

sanskrit_iast:
purīṃ purodhasā hīnāṃ vīkṣya cintākulātmanā /
bhavatā saha devaistu paurohityārthamādarāt //
meaning:
पुरीं पुरोधसा हीनां वीक्ष्य चिन्ताकुलात्मना /
भवता सह देवैस्तु पौरोहित्यार्थमादरात् //
text_mt: Seeing the city bereft of a family priest, with your mind agitated by worry, / for the sake of the priesthood, with respect, together with the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
prārthito viśvarūpastu babhūva tapatāṃ varaḥ /
svasrīyo dānavānāṃ tu devānāṃ ca purohitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रार्थितो विश्वरूपस्तु बभूव तपतां वरः /
स्वस्रीयो दानवानां तु देवानां च पुरोहितः //
text_mt: you requested Viśvarūpa, the best of ascetics; / and he became the sister's son of the Dānavas and the priest of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
nātyarthama karodvairaṃ daityeṣvapi mahātapāḥ /
babhūvatustulyabalau tadā detyendravāsavau //
meaning:
नात्यर्थम करोद्वैरं दैत्येष्वपि महातपाः /
बभूवतुस्तुल्यबलौ तदा देत्येन्द्रवासवौ //
text_mt: The great ascetic did not harbor excessive hostility even toward the Daityas; / then the lord of Daityas and Vāsava became equal in strength.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastvaṃ kupito rājansvaklīyaṃ dānaveśituḥ /
hantumicchannagāścāśu tapasaḥ sādhanaṃ vanam //
meaning:
ततस्त्वं कुपितो राजन्स्वक्लीयं दानवेशितुः /
हन्तुमिच्छन्नगाश्चाशु तपसः साधनं वनम् //
text_mt: Then you, O king, becoming angry and wishing to slay the sister's son of the Dānava lord, / quickly went to the forest, the place for performing asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
tamāsanasthaṃ munibhistriśṛṅgamiva parvatam /
trayī mukharadigbhāgaṃ brahmānadaikaniṣṭhitam //
meaning:
तमासनस्थं मुनिभिस्त्रिशृङ्गमिव पर्वतम् /
त्रयी मुखरदिग्भागं ब्रह्मानदैकनिष्ठितम् //
text_mt: Him seated on an ascetic's seat like a three-peaked mountain, / his quarters resounding with the three Vedas, firmly fixed on the bliss of Brahman alone,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtahitaṃ taṃ tu matvā ceśānukūlitaḥ /
śirāṃsi yaugapadyena chinnātyāsaṃstvayaiva tu //
meaning:
सर्वभूतहितं तं तु मत्वा चेशानुकूलितः /
शिरांसि यौगपद्येन छिन्नात्यासंस्त्वयैव तु //
text_mt: regarding him as beneficial to all beings, yet favored by the Lord, / his heads were simultaneously severed by you alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tena pāpena saṃyuktaḥ pīḍitaśca muhurmuhuḥ /
tato meruguhāṃ nītvā bahūnabdānhi saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
तेन पापेन संयुक्तः पीडितश्च मुहुर्मुहुः /
ततो मेरुगुहां नीत्वा बहूनब्दान्हि संस्थितः //
text_mt: Afflicted by that sin and tormented again and again, / having then gone to a cave of Meru, [you] stayed there for many years.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā jñātvā tu munivākyataḥ /
putra śokena saṃtaptastvāṃ śaśāpa ruṣānvitaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ज्ञात्वा तु मुनिवाक्यतः /
पुत्र शोकेन संतप्तस्त्वां शशाप रुषान्वितः //
text_mt: Then, hearing his word and learning [of it] from the words of the sages, / [Tvaṣṭṛ], burning with grief for his son, cursed you in anger:

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśrīko bhavatu kṣipraṃ mama śāpena vāsavaḥ /
anāthakāstato devā viṣaṇṇā daityapīḍitāḥ //
meaning:
निःश्रीको भवतु क्षिप्रं मम शापेन वासवः /
अनाथकास्ततो देवा विषण्णा दैत्यपीडिताः //
text_mt: 'Let Vāsava quickly become devoid of fortune through my curse!' / Bereft of a protector, the gods then became despondent, oppressed by the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā mayā ca rahitāḥ sarve devāḥ palāyitāḥ /
gatvā tu brahmasadanaṃ natvā tadvṛttamūcire //
meaning:
त्वया मया च रहिताः सर्वे देवाः पलायिताः /
गत्वा तु ब्रह्मसदनं नत्वा तद्वृत्तमूचिरे //
text_mt: Bereft of you and me, all the gods fled; / having gone to the abode of Brahmā and bowed, they related that event.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu cintayā māsa tadaghasya pratikriyām /
tasya pratikriyāṃ vettuṃ na śaśākātmabhūstadā //
meaning:
ततस्तु चिन्तया मास तदघस्य प्रतिक्रियाम् /
तस्य प्रतिक्रियां वेत्तुं न शशाकात्मभूस्तदा //
text_mt: Then he considered the counteracting of that sin; / the self-born [Brahmā] was unable then to know the remedy for it.

sanskrit_iast: tato devaiḥ parivṛto nārāyaṇamupāgamat //
meaning: ततो देवैः परिवृतो नारायणमुपागमत् //
text_mt: Then, surrounded by the gods, he approached Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā stutvā caturvakrastadvṛttāntaṃ vyajijñapat /
vicintya so 'pi bahudhā kṛpayā lokanāyakaḥ //
meaning:
नत्वा स्तुत्वा चतुर्वक्रस्तद्वृत्तान्तं व्यजिज्ञपत् /
विचिन्त्य सो ऽपि बहुधा कृपया लोकनायकः //
text_mt: Bowing and praising [him], the four-faced [Brahmā] made known the account; / having considered [it] in many ways, that lord of the worlds, out of compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
tadaghaṃ tu tridhā bhittvā triṣu sthāneṣvathārpayat /
strīṣu bhūmyāṃ ca vṛkṣeṣu teṣāmapi varaṃ dadau //
meaning:
तदघं तु त्रिधा भित्त्वा त्रिषु स्थानेष्वथार्पयत् /
स्त्रीषु भूम्यां च वृक्षेषु तेषामपि वरं ददौ //
text_mt: split that sin into three parts and then placed it in three places: / in women, in the earth, and in trees; and he granted them boons as well:

sanskrit_iast:
tadā bharttṛsamāyogaṃ putrāvāptimṛtuṣvapi /
chede punarbhavatvaṃ tu sarveṣāmapi śākhinām //
meaning:
तदा भर्त्तृसमायोगं पुत्रावाप्तिमृतुष्वपि /
छेदे पुनर्भवत्वं तु सर्वेषामपि शाखिनाम् //
text_mt: Union with a husband and obtaining a son even in menstrual periods, / and regrowth for all trees upon being cut;

sanskrit_iast:
khātapūrtiṃ dharaṇyaśca pradadau madhusūdanaḥ /
teṣvaghaṃ prababhūvāśu rajoniryāsamūṣaram //
meaning:
खातपूर्तिं धरण्यश्च प्रददौ मधुसूदनः /
तेष्वघं प्रबभूवाशु रजोनिर्यासमूषरम् //
text_mt: and the slayer of Madhu granted to the earth the filling up of excavations; / among them, the sin quickly manifested as menses, sap, and barren saline soil.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgato gahvarāttasmāttvamindro devanāyakaḥ /
rājyaśriyaṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
निर्गतो गह्वरात्तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रो देवनायकः /
राज्यश्रियं च संप्राप्तः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: Emerging from that cavern, you, Indra, leader of the gods, / attained the splendor of the kingdom by the grace of the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva sāṃtvito dhātā jagāda ca janārdanam /
mama śāpo vṛthā na syādastu kālāntare mune //
meaning:
तेनैव सांत्वितो धाता जगाद च जनार्दनम् /
मम शापो वृथा न स्यादस्तु कालान्तरे मुने //
text_mt: Comforted by him alone, the creator said to Janārdana: / 'May my curse not be in vain; let it come to pass at another time, O sage!'

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavāṃstadvacaḥ śrutvā muneramitatejasaḥ /
prahṛṣṭo bhāvikāryajñastūṣṇīmeva tadā yayau //
meaning:
भगवांस्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा मुनेरमिततेजसः /
प्रहृष्टो भाविकार्यज्ञस्तूष्णीमेव तदा ययौ //
text_mt: Hearing that word of the sage of immeasurable splendor, the Blessed One, / pleased and knowing what was to happen, departed in silence then.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvantamimaṃ kālaṃ trilokīṃ pālayanbhavān /
eśvaryamadamattatvātkailāsādrimapīḍayata //
meaning:
एतावन्तमिमं कालं त्रिलोकीं पालयन्भवान् /
एश्वर्यमदमत्तत्वात्कैलासाद्रिमपीडयत //
text_mt: Protecting the three worlds for so long a time, / intoxicated with the arrogance of power, you oppressed Mount Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñena śivenātha preṣito bhagavānmuniḥ /
durvāsāstvanmadabhraṃśaṃ karttukāmaḥ śaśāpa ha //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञेन शिवेनाथ प्रेषितो भगवान्मुनिः /
दुर्वासास्त्वन्मदभ्रंशं कर्त्तुकामः शशाप ह //
text_mt: Then, sent by the omniscient Śiva, the venerable sage / Durvāsas, desiring to bring about the destruction of your arrogance, indeed cursed [you].

sanskrit_iast:
ekameva phalaṃ jātamubhayoḥ śāpayorapi /
adhunā paśyaniḥ śrīkantrailokyaṃ samajāyata //
meaning:
एकमेव फलं जातमुभयोः शापयोरपि /
अधुना पश्यनिः श्रीकन्त्रैलोक्यं समजायत //
text_mt: A single result arose from both of those curses; / now see, the three worlds have become bereft of fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
na yajñāḥ saṃpravarttante na dānāni ca vāsava /
na yamā nāpi niyamā na tapāsi ca kutracit //
meaning:
न यज्ञाः संप्रवर्त्तन्ते न दानानि च वासव /
न यमा नापि नियमा न तपासि च कुत्रचित् //
text_mt: No sacrifices are performed, nor gifts [given], O Vāsava; / there are no restraints, nor observances, nor ascetic austerities anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
viprāḥ sarve 'pi niḥśrīkā lobhopahatacetasaḥ /
niḥsttvā dhairyahīnāśca nāstikāḥ prāyaśo 'bhavan //
meaning:
विप्राः सर्वे ऽपि निःश्रीका लोभोपहतचेतसः /
निःस्त्त्वा धैर्यहीनाश्च नास्तिकाः प्रायशो ऽभवन् //
text_mt: All the brahmins are devoid of fortune, their minds ruined by greed; / they have mostly become devoid of vitality, lacking courage, and unbelievers.

sanskrit_iast:
nirauṣadhirasā bhūmirnivīrya jāyatetarām /
bhāskaro dhūsarākāraścandramāḥ kāntivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
निरौषधिरसा भूमिर्निवीर्य जायतेतराम् /
भास्करो धूसराकारश्चन्द्रमाः कान्तिवर्जितः //
text_mt: The earth has become completely devoid of the essence of medicinal herbs and devoid of vigor; / the sun has an ashen appearance, and the moon is bereft of luster.

sanskrit_iast:
nistejasko havirbhoktā manuddhūlikṛtākṛtiḥ /
na prasannā diśāṃ bhāgā nabho naiva ca nirmalam //
meaning:
निस्तेजस्को हविर्भोक्ता मनुद्धूलिकृताकृतिः /
न प्रसन्ना दिशां भागा नभो नैव च निर्मलम् //
text_mt: The consumer of oblations lacks brilliance, its form reduced to fine dust; / the quarters of space are not clear, nor is the sky spotless.

sanskrit_iast:
durbalā devatāḥ sarvā vibhāntyanyādṛśā iva /
vinaṣṭaprayamevāsti trailokyaṃ sacarācaram //
meaning:
दुर्बला देवताः सर्वा विभान्त्यन्यादृशा इव /
विनष्टप्रयमेवास्ति त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् //
text_mt: All the deities are weak, appearing as if altered; / the three worlds, with the moving and unmoving, are almost destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
itthaṃ kathayatoreva bṛhaspatipahendrayoḥ /
malakādyā mahādaityāḥ svargalokaṃ babādhire //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
इत्थं कथयतोरेव बृहस्पतिपहेन्द्रयोः /
मलकाद्या महादैत्याः स्वर्गलोकं बबाधिरे //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Even as Bṛhaspati and the great Indra were speaking thus, / the great Daityas, headed by Malaka, tormented the celestial realm.

sanskrit_iast:
nandanodyāna makhilaṃ cicchidurbalagarvitāḥ /
udyānapālakānsarvānāyudhaiḥ samatāḍayan //
meaning:
नन्दनोद्यान मखिलं चिच्छिदुर्बलगर्विताः /
उद्यानपालकान्सर्वानायुधैः समताडयन् //
text_mt: Arrogant with strength, they cut down the entire Nandana garden; / they struck all the keepers of the garden with weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
prākāramavabhidyaiva praviśya nagarāntaram /
mandirasthānsurānsarvānatyantaṃ paryapīḍayan //
meaning:
प्राकारमवभिद्यैव प्रविश्य नगरान्तरम् /
मन्दिरस्थान्सुरान्सर्वानत्यन्तं पर्यपीडयन् //
text_mt: Breaching the outer wall and entering within the city, / they exceedingly tormented all the gods residing in their palaces.

sanskrit_iast:
ājahurapsaroratnānyaśeṣāṇi viśeṣataḥ /
tato devāḥ samastāśca cakrurbhṛśamabādhitāḥ //
meaning:
आजहुरप्सरोरत्नान्यशेषाणि विशेषतः /
ततो देवाः समस्ताश्च चक्रुर्भृशमबाधिताः //
text_mt: They seized the precious jewels of apsarases without exception, especially; / then all the gods cried out intensely, sorely afflicted.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśaṃ ghoṣamākarmya vāsavaḥ projjhitāsanaḥ /
sarvairanugato devaiḥ palāyanaparo 'bhavat //
meaning:
तादृशं घोषमाकर्म्य वासवः प्रोज्झितासनः /
सर्वैरनुगतो देवैः पलायनपरो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Hearing such an uproar, Vāsava abandoned his seat, / and, followed by all the gods, became bent on flight.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṃ dhāma samabhyetya viṣaṇmavadano vṛṣā /
yathāvatkathayāmāsa nikhilaṃ daityaceṣṭitam //
meaning:
ब्राह्मं धाम समभ्येत्य विषण्मवदनो वृषा /
यथावत्कथयामास निखिलं दैत्यचेष्टितम् //
text_mt: Approaching the realm of Brahmā, his face downcast, Indra / recounted truthfully the entire deed of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhātāpi tadākarṇya sarvadevasamanvitam /
hataśrīkaṃ harihayamālokyedamuvāca ha //
meaning:
विधातापि तदाकर्ण्य सर्वदेवसमन्वितम् /
हतश्रीकं हरिहयमालोक्येदमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Hearing that, and seeing Harihaya, accompanied by all the gods, / stripped of his fortune, the creator spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
indratvamakhilairddevairmukundaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja /
daityārātirjagatkartā sa te śreyo vidhāsyati //
meaning:
इन्द्रत्वमखिलैर्द्देवैर्मुकुन्दं शरणं व्रज /
दैत्यारातिर्जगत्कर्ता स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति //
text_mt: “Indra, together with all the gods, take refuge in Mukunda; / he who is the enemy of the Daityas and maker of the world will bring about your welfare.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tena sahitaḥ svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ /
samastadevasahitaḥ kṣīrodadhimupāyayau //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तेन सहितः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पितामहः /
समस्तदेवसहितः क्षीरोदधिमुपाययौ //
text_mt: Having spoken thus, Brahmā the Grandsire himself, accompanied by him / and all the gods, went to the Ocean of Milk.

sanskrit_iast:
atha brahmādayo devā bhagavantaṃ janārdanam /
tuṣṭuvurvāgvariṣṭhābhiḥ sarvalokamaheśvaram //
meaning:
अथ ब्रह्मादयो देवा भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् /
तुष्टुवुर्वाग्वरिष्ठाभिः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Then the gods, led by Brahmā, praised the blessed Janārdana, / the great lord of all the worlds, with the most excellent words.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prasanno bhagavānvāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ /
jagāda sa kalāndevāñjagadrakṣaṇalaṃpaṭaḥ //
meaning:
अथ प्रसन्नो भगवान्वासुदेवः सनातनः /
जगाद स कलान्देवाञ्जगद्रक्षणलंपटः //
text_mt: Then the eternal blessed Vāsudeva was pleased, / and eager to protect the world, he spoke clearly to the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhavatāṃ suvidhāsyāmi tejasaivopabṛṃhamam /
yaducyate mayedānīṃ yuṣmābhista dvidhīyatām //
meaning:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भवतां सुविधास्यामि तेजसैवोपबृंहमम् /
यदुच्यते मयेदानीं युष्माभिस्त द्विधीयताम् //
text_mt: The Holy One said: / “I will well arrange the enhancement of your splendor. / What is spoken by me now, let that be carried out by you.

sanskrit_iast:
oṣadhipravarāḥ sarvāḥ kṣipata kṣīrasāgare /
asurairapi saṃdhāya samameva ca tairiha //
meaning:
ओषधिप्रवराः सर्वाः क्षिपत क्षीरसागरे /
असुरैरपि संधाय सममेव च तैरिह //
text_mt: Throw all the foremost herbs into the Ocean of Milk; / having made peace even with the Asuras, right alongside them here,

sanskrit_iast:
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā yoktraṃ ca vāsukim /
mayi sthite sahāye tu mathyatāmamṛtaṃ surāḥ //
meaning:
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा कृत्वा योक्त्रं च वासुकिम् /
मयि स्थिते सहाये तु मथ्यताममृतं सुराः //
text_mt: making Mandara the churning rod and making Vāsuki the churning rope, / while I stand by as your helper, O gods, churn the nectar of immortality!

sanskrit_iast:
samastadānavāścāpi vaktavyāḥ sāṃtvapūrvakam /
sāmānyameva yuṣmākamasmākaṃ ca phalaṃ tviti //
meaning:
समस्तदानवाश्चापि वक्तव्याः सांत्वपूर्वकम् /
सामान्यमेव युष्माकमस्माकं च फलं त्विति //
text_mt: All the Dānavas must also be spoken to with soothing words: / ‘The fruit is indeed common to you and to us.’

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamāne tu dugdhābdhau yā samutpadyate sudhā /
tatpānādbalino yūyamamartyāśca bhaviṣyatha //
meaning:
मथ्यमाने तु दुग्धाब्धौ या समुत्पद्यते सुधा /
तत्पानाद्बलिनो यूयममर्त्याश्च भविष्यथ //
text_mt: When the Ocean of Milk is churned, the nectar that is produced— / from drinking it, you will become strong and immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā daityāśca pīyūṣaṃ naitatprāpsyanti kiñcana /
kevalaṃ kleśavantaśca kariṣyāmi tathā hyaham //
meaning:
यथा दैत्याश्च पीयूषं नैतत्प्राप्स्यन्ति किञ्चन /
केवलं क्लेशवन्तश्च करिष्यामि तथा ह्यहम् //
text_mt: I will act in such a way that the Daityas / will not obtain any of this nectar and will only have their toil.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīvāsudevena kathitā nikhilāḥ surāḥ /
saṃdhānaṃ tvatulairdaityaiḥ kṛtavantastadā surāḥ /
nānāvidhauṣadhigaṇaṃ samānīya surāsurāḥ //
meaning:
इति श्रीवासुदेवेन कथिता निखिलाः सुराः /
संधानं त्वतुलैर्दैत्यैः कृतवन्तस्तदा सुराः /
नानाविधौषधिगणं समानीय सुरासुराः //
text_mt: Having been spoken to thus by the venerable Vāsudeva, all the gods / then made an alliance with the peerless Daityas. / Bringing together various kinds of herbs, the gods and Asuras,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrābdhipayasi kṣiptvā candramo 'dhikanirmalam /
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā yoktraṃ tu vāsukim /
prārebhire prayatnena manthituṃ yādasāṃ patim //
meaning:
श्रीराब्धिपयसि क्षिप्त्वा चन्द्रमो ऽधिकनिर्मलम् /
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा कृत्वा योक्त्रं तु वासुकिम् /
प्रारेभिरे प्रयत्नेन मन्थितुं यादसां पतिम् //
text_mt: threw them into the water of the Ocean of Milk, which was purer than the moon; / making Mandara the churning rod and Vāsuki the churning rope, / they began with great effort to churn the lord of aquatic creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsukeḥ pucchabhāge tu sahitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ /
śirobhāge tu daiteyā niyuktāstatra śauriṇā //
meaning:
वासुकेः पुच्छभागे तु सहिताः सर्वदेवताः /
शिरोभागे तु दैतेया नियुक्तास्तत्र शौरिणा //
text_mt: All the deities together were placed at the tail of Vāsuki, / while the Daityas were assigned to the head by Śauri.

sanskrit_iast:
balavanto 'pi te daityāstanmukhocchvāsapāvakaiḥ /
nirdagdhavapuṣaḥ sarve nistejaskāstadābhavan //
meaning:
बलवन्तो ऽपि ते दैत्यास्तन्मुखोच्छ्वासपावकैः /
निर्दग्धवपुषः सर्वे निस्तेजस्कास्तदाभवन् //
text_mt: Though powerful, all those Daityas, their bodies scorched / by the fires exhaled from his mouth, then became devoid of splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
pucchadeśe tu karṣanto muhurāpyāyitāḥ surāḥ /
anukūlena vātena viṣṇunā preritena tu //
meaning:
पुच्छदेशे तु कर्षन्तो मुहुराप्यायिताः सुराः /
अनुकूलेन वातेन विष्णुना प्रेरितेन तु //
text_mt: Pulling at the tail, the gods were constantly invigorated / by a favorable wind sent forth by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
ādikūrmākṛtiḥ śrīmānmadhye kṣīrapayonidheḥ /
bhramato mandarādrestu tasyā dhiṣṭānatāmagāt //
meaning:
आदिकूर्माकृतिः श्रीमान्मध्ये क्षीरपयोनिधेः /
भ्रमतो मन्दराद्रेस्तु तस्या धिष्टानतामगात् //
text_mt: Taking the form of the primordial tortoise, the glorious [Lord] in the midst of the Ocean of Milk / became the base for Mount Mandara as it spun.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye ca sarvadevānāṃ rūpeṇānyena mādhavaḥ /
cakarṣa vāsukiṃ vegāddaityamadhye pareṇa ca //
meaning:
मध्ये च सर्वदेवानां रूपेणान्येन माधवः /
चकर्ष वासुकिं वेगाद्दैत्यमध्ये परेण च //
text_mt: And in the midst of all the gods, Mādhava in another form / vigorously pulled Vāsuki, and in the midst of the Daityas in yet another form.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarūpeṇa taṃ śailaṃ vidhāryākrāntavāridhim /
apareṇa ca devarṣirmahatā tejasā muhuḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मरूपेण तं शैलं विधार्याक्रान्तवारिधिम् /
अपरेण च देवर्षिर्महता तेजसा मुहुः //
text_mt: Holding that mountain in the form of Brahmā as it pressed upon the sea, / and in another form, O divine sage, with great splendor constantly

sanskrit_iast:
upavṛṃhitavāndevānyena te balaśālinaḥ /
tejasā punaranyena balātkārasahena saḥ //
meaning:
उपवृंहितवान्देवान्येन ते बलशालिनः /
तेजसा पुनरन्येन बलात्कारसहेन सः //
text_mt: he invigorated the gods, by which they became powerful; / then with another splendor capable of enduring violent force, he,

sanskrit_iast:
upabṛṃhitavānnāgaṃ sarvaśaktijanārdanaḥ /
mathyamāne tatastasminkṣīrabdhau devadānavaiḥ //
meaning:
उपबृंहितवान्नागं सर्वशक्तिजनार्दनः /
मथ्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन्क्षीरब्धौ देवदानवैः //
text_mt: Janārdana, who possesses all powers, strengthened the serpent. / Then, as that Ocean of Milk was being churned by the gods and Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
āvirbabhūva purataḥ surabhiḥ surapūjitā /
mudaṃ jagmustadā devā daiteyāśca tapodhana //
meaning:
आविर्बभूव पुरतः सुरभिः सुरपूजिता /
मुदं जग्मुस्तदा देवा दैतेयाश्च तपोधन //
text_mt: Surabhi, worshipped by the gods, appeared before them; / the gods and the Daityas then rejoiced, O you rich in asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamāne punastasminkṣīrābdau devadānavaiḥ /
kimetaditi siddhānāṃ divi cintayatāṃ tadā //
meaning:
मथ्यमाने पुनस्तस्मिन्क्षीराब्दौ देवदानवैः /
किमेतदिति सिद्धानां दिवि चिन्तयतां तदा //
text_mt: As that Ocean of Milk was churned again by the gods and Dānavas, / while the Siddhas in heaven were wondering, “What is this?”,

sanskrit_iast:
utthitā vāruṇī devī madāllolavilocanā /
asurāṇāṃ purastātsā smayamānā vyatiṣṭhata //
meaning:
उत्थिता वारुणी देवी मदाल्लोलविलोचना /
असुराणां पुरस्तात्सा स्मयमाना व्यतिष्ठत //
text_mt: the goddess Vāruṇī arose, her eyes rolling from intoxication; / smiling, she stood before the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
jagṛhurnaiva tāṃ daityā asurāścābhavaṃstataḥ /
surā na vidyate yeṣāṃ tenaivāsuraśabditāḥ //
meaning:
जगृहुर्नैव तां दैत्या असुराश्चाभवंस्ततः /
सुरा न विद्यते येषां तेनैवासुरशब्दिताः //
text_mt: The Daityas did not accept her, and thus they became Asuras; / because there is no wine (surā) for them, they are called Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
athasā sarvadevānāmagrataḥ samatiṣṭhata /
jagṛhustāṃ mudā devāḥ sūcitāḥ parameṣṭhinā /
surāgrahaṇato 'pyete suraśabdena kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अथसा सर्वदेवानामग्रतः समतिष्ठत /
जगृहुस्तां मुदा देवाः सूचिताः परमेष्ठिना /
सुराग्रहणतो ऽप्येते सुरशब्देन कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Then she stood before all the gods; / instructed by Parameṣṭhin, the gods accepted her with joy; / because of accepting the wine (surā), they are celebrated by the word Sura.

sanskrit_iast:
mathyamāne tato bhūyaḥ pārijāto mahādrumaḥ /
āvirāsītsuṃgadhena parito vāsayañjagat //
meaning:
मथ्यमाने ततो भूयः पारिजातो महाद्रुमः /
आविरासीत्सुंगधेन परितो वासयञ्जगत् //
text_mt: As [the ocean] was churned further, the great pārijāta tree / appeared, perfuming the world all around with its fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
atyarthasuṃdarākārā dhīrāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ /
āvirbhūtāśca devarṣe sarvalokamanoharāḥ //
meaning:
अत्यर्थसुंदराकारा धीराश्चाप्सरसां गणाः /
आविर्भूताश्च देवर्षे सर्वलोकमनोहराः //
text_mt: Hosts of Apsarases of exceedingly beautiful form, resolute / and captivating to all the worlds, also appeared, O divine sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śītāṃśurudabhūttaṃ jagrāha maheśvaraḥ /
viṣajātaṃ tadutpannaṃ jagṛhurnāgajātayaḥ //
meaning:
ततः शीतांशुरुदभूत्तं जग्राह महेश्वरः /
विषजातं तदुत्पन्नं जगृहुर्नागजातयः //
text_mt: Then the cool-rayed moon arose, which Maheśvara took; / the kinds of serpents took the mass of poison that was produced then.

sanskrit_iast:
kaustubhākhyaṃ tato ratnamādade tajjanārdanaḥ /
tataḥ svapatragandhena madayantī mahauṣadhīḥ /
vijayā nāma saṃjajñe bhairavastāmupādade //
meaning:
कौस्तुभाख्यं ततो रत्नमाददे तज्जनार्दनः /
ततः स्वपत्रगन्धेन मदयन्ती महौषधीः /
विजया नाम संजज्ञे भैरवस्तामुपाददे //
text_mt: Then Janārdana took the jewel named Kaustubha; / then the great herb named Vijayā arose, intoxicating with the scent of its leaves, / and Bhairava took it.

sanskrit_iast:
tato divyāṃbaradharo devo dhanvantariḥ svayam /
upasthitaḥ kare bibhradamṛtāḍhyaṃ kamaṇḍalum //
meaning:
ततो दिव्यांबरधरो देवो धन्वन्तरिः स्वयम् /
उपस्थितः करे बिभ्रदमृताढ्यं कमण्डलुम् //
text_mt: Then the divine Dhanvantari himself, wearing celestial garments, / appeared, holding in his hand a water pot filled with the nectar of immortality.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso devā daityāśca sarvataḥ /
munayaścābhavaṃstuṣṭāstadānīṃ tapasāṃ nidhe //
meaning:
ततः प्रहृष्टमनसो देवा दैत्याश्च सर्वतः /
मुनयश्चाभवंस्तुष्टास्तदानीं तपसां निधे //
text_mt: Then the gods and Daityas everywhere were joyful in mind, / and the sages became pleased, O treasure of asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vikasitāṃbhojavāsinī varadāyinī /
utthitā padmahastā śrīstasmātkṣīramahārmavāt //
meaning:
ततो विकसितांभोजवासिनी वरदायिनी /
उत्थिता पद्महस्ता श्रीस्तस्मात्क्षीरमहार्मवात् //
text_mt: Then Śrī, who dwells on an open lotus, who grants boons, / arose from that great Ocean of Milk with a lotus in her hand.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrīsuktena śriyaṃ parām /
tuṣṭuvustuṣṭa hṛdayā gandharvāśca jaguḥ param //
meaning:
अथ तां मुनयः सर्वे श्रीसुक्तेन श्रियं पराम् /
तुष्टुवुस्तुष्ट हृदया गन्धर्वाश्च जगुः परम् //
text_mt: Then all the sages, their hearts delighted, praised the supreme Śrī / with the Śrīsūkta, and the Gandharvas sang supremely.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvājīpramukhāḥ sarve nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ /
gaṅgādyāḥ puṇyanadyaśca snānārthamupatasthire //
meaning:
विश्वाजीप्रमुखाः सर्वे ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः /
गङ्गाद्याः पुण्यनद्यश्च स्नानार्थमुपतस्थिरे //
text_mt: All the hosts of Apsarases, led by Viśvācī, danced, / and sacred rivers such as the Gaṅgā came forward for her bath.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau digdantinaścaiva medhyapātrasthitaṃ jalam /
ādāya snāpayāñcakrustāṃ śriyaṃ padmavāsinīm //
meaning:
अष्टौ दिग्दन्तिनश्चैव मेध्यपात्रस्थितं जलम् /
आदाय स्नापयाञ्चक्रुस्तां श्रियं पद्मवासिनीम् //
text_mt: And the eight elephants of the quarters, taking water held in pure vessels, / bathed that Śrī who dwells on the lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīṃ ca samutpannāṃ parārdhyā maikyajāṃ hareḥ /
padmamālāṃ dadau tasyai mūrtimānkṣīrasāgaraḥ //
meaning:
तुलसीं च समुत्पन्नां परार्ध्या मैक्यजां हरेः /
पद्ममालां ददौ तस्यै मूर्तिमान्क्षीरसागरः //
text_mt: The Ocean of Milk in person gave her a garland of lotuses, / and the precious Tulasī that had arisen, an object of supreme union for Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇāni ca divyāni viśvakarmā samarpayat /
divyamālyāṃ baradharā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā /
yayau vakṣasthalaṃ viṣṇoḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ramā //
meaning:
भूषणानि च दिव्यानि विश्वकर्मा समर्पयत् /
दिव्यमाल्यां बरधरा दिव्यभूषणभूषिता /
ययौ वक्षस्थलं विष्णोः सर्वेषां पश्यतां रमा //
text_mt: Viśvakarman presented divine ornaments; / wearing divine garlands and garments, adorned with divine ornaments, / Ramā went to the chest of Viṣṇu as all looked on.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasī tu dhṛtā tena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā /
paśyati sma ca sā devī viṣṇuvakṣathalālayā /
devāndayārdrayā dṛṣṭyā sarvalokamaheśvarī //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne amṛtamanthanaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
तुलसी तु धृता तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना /
पश्यति स्म च सा देवी विष्णुवक्षथलालया /
देवान्दयार्द्रया दृष्ट्या सर्वलोकमहेश्वरी //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने अमृतमन्थनं नाम नवमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The Tulasī was worn by the mighty Viṣṇu; / and that goddess, whose abode is on Viṣṇu's chest, / the sovereign lady of all the worlds, looked upon the gods with a glance moist with compassion.

Thus ends the ninth chapter, titled “The Churning for Nectar,” in the Lalitopākhyāna within the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the venerable and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
atha devā mahendrādyā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣmunā /
aṅgīkṛtā mahādhīrāḥ pramodaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
अथ देवा महेन्द्राद्या विष्णुना प्रभविष्मुना /
अङ्गीकृता महाधीराः प्रमोदं परमं ययुः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Then the gods, Mahendra and the rest, accepted / by the mighty Viṣṇu, highly steadfast, experienced supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
malakādyāstu te sarve daityā viṣṇuparāṅmukhāḥ /
saṃtyaktāśca śriyā devyā bhṛśamudvegamāgatāḥ //
meaning:
मलकाद्यास्तु ते सर्वे दैत्या विष्णुपराङ्मुखाः /
संत्यक्ताश्च श्रिया देव्या भृशमुद्वेगमागताः //
text_mt: All those Daityas, however, led by Malaka, averse to Viṣṇu / and abandoned by the goddess Śrī, were overwhelmed with great distress.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jagṛhire daityā dhanvantarikarasthitam /
paramāmṛtasārāḍhyaṃ kalaśaṃ kanakodbhavam /
athāsurāṇāṃ devānāmanyonyaṃ kalaho 'bhavat //
meaning:
ततो जगृहिरे दैत्या धन्वन्तरिकरस्थितम् /
परमामृतसाराढ्यं कलशं कनकोद्भवम् /
अथासुराणां देवानामन्योन्यं कलहो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Then the Daityas seized the golden pot / containing the supreme essence of nectar that was in Dhanvantari’s hand; / then a dispute arose between the Asuras and the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare viṣṇuḥ sarvalokaikarakṣakaḥ /
samyagārādhayāmāsalalitāṃ svaikyarūpiṇīm //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुः सर्वलोकैकरक्षकः /
सम्यगाराधयामासललितां स्वैक्यरूपिणीम् //
text_mt: In the meantime, Viṣṇu, the sole protector of all the worlds, / duly worshipped Lalitā, whose form is identical with his own.

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca raṇaṃ vīkṣya sudāruṇam /
brahmā nijapadaṃ prāpa śaṃbhuḥ kailāsamāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
सुराणामसुराणां च रणं वीक्ष्य सुदारुणम् /
ब्रह्मा निजपदं प्राप शंभुः कैलासमास्थितः //
text_mt: Seeing the terrible battle between the gods and Asuras, / Brahmā went to his own abode and Śambhu retired to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
malakaṃ yodhayāmāsa daityānāmadhipaṃ vṛṣā /
asuraiśca surāḥ sarve sāṃparāyamakurvata //
meaning:
मलकं योधयामास दैत्यानामधिपं वृषा /
असुरैश्च सुराः सर्वे सांपरायमकुर्वत //
text_mt: Vṛṣan fought Malaka, the lord of the Daityas, / and all the gods engaged in battle with the Asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānapi yogīndraḥ samārādhya maheśvarīm /
tadekadhyānayogena tadrūpaḥ samajāyata //
meaning:
भगवानपि योगीन्द्रः समाराध्य महेश्वरीम् /
तदेकध्यानयोगेन तद्रूपः समजायत //
text_mt: The Blessed One too, the lord of yogins, having worshipped the Great Goddess, / through the yoga of meditation solely upon Her, assumed Her very form.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃmohinī sā tu sākṣācchṛṅgāranāyikā /
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā //
meaning:
सर्वसंमोहिनी सा तु साक्षाच्छृङ्गारनायिका /
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता //
text_mt: She indeed was the enchantress of all, the very goddess of love incarnate, / rich in every amorous attire, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca nivārya raṇamulvaṇam /
mandasmitena daiteyānmohayantī jagada ha //
meaning:
सुराणामसुराणां च निवार्य रणमुल्वणम् /
मन्दस्मितेन दैतेयान्मोहयन्ती जगद ह //
text_mt: Having halted the fierce battle between the gods and the asuras, / enchanting the sons of Diti with a gentle smile, she said:

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ yuddhena kiṃ śastrermarmasthānavibhedibhiḥ /
niṣṭhuraiḥ kiṃ vṛthālāpaiḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣaṇahetubhiḥ //
meaning:
अलं युद्धेन किं शस्त्रेर्मर्मस्थानविभेदिभिः /
निष्ठुरैः किं वृथालापैः कण्ठशोषणहेतुभिः //
text_mt: “Enough with fighting! What use are weapons that pierce vital spots? / What use are harsh words spoken in vain that only dry the throat?

sanskrit_iast:
ahamevātra madhyasthā yuṣmākaṃ ca divaukasām /
yūyaṃ tathāmī nitarāmatra hi kleśabhāginaḥ //
meaning:
अहमेवात्र मध्यस्था युष्माकं च दिवौकसाम् /
यूयं तथामी नितरामत्र हि क्लेशभागिनः //
text_mt: I alone will be the mediator here between you and the celestials; / you and they alike are suffering exceedingly in this struggle.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ samamevādya dāsyāmyamṛtamadbhutam /
mama haste pradātavyaṃ sudhāpātramanuttamam //
meaning:
सर्वेषां सममेवाद्य दास्याम्यमृतमद्भुतम् /
मम हस्ते प्रदातव्यं सुधापात्रमनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Today I will distribute the wondrous nectar equally among you all; / you must place the peerless vessel of nectar into my hand.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā daityāstadvākyamohitāḥ /
pīyūṣakalaśaṃ tasyai daduste mugdhacetasaḥ //
meaning:
इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा दैत्यास्तद्वाक्यमोहिताः /
पीयूषकलशं तस्यै ददुस्ते मुग्धचेतसः //
text_mt: Hearing her words, the daityas, enchanted by her speech, / their minds infatuated, handed the jar of nectar over to her.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tatpātraṃ samādāya jaganmohanarūpiṇī /
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca vṛthakpaṅktiṃ cakāra ha //
meaning:
सा तत्पात्रं समादाय जगन्मोहनरूपिणी /
सुराणामसुराणां च वृथक्पङ्क्तिं चकार ह //
text_mt: Taking that vessel, she whose form enchanted the universe / arranged separate rows for the gods and for the asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayoḥ paṅktyośca madhyasthāstānuvāca surāsurān /
tūṣṇīṃ bhavantu sarve 'pi kramaśo dīyate mayā //
meaning:
द्वयोः पङ्क्त्योश्च मध्यस्थास्तानुवाच सुरासुरान् /
तूष्णीं भवन्तु सर्वे ऽपि क्रमशो दीयते मया //
text_mt: Standing between the two rows, she said to those gods and asuras: / “Let all be quiet; it will be distributed by me in turn.”

sanskrit_iast:
tadvākyamurarīcakruste sarve samavāyinaḥ /
sā tu saṃmohitāśleṣalokā dātuṃ pracakrame //
meaning:
तद्वाक्यमुररीचक्रुस्ते सर्वे समवायिनः /
सा तु संमोहिताश्लेषलोका दातुं प्रचक्रमे //
text_mt: All those assembled agreed to her words; / and she, who had enchanted all the worlds, began to distribute [it].

sanskrit_iast:
kvaṇatkanakadarvīkā kvaṇanmaṅgalakaṅkaṇā /
kamanīyavibhūṣāḍhyā kalā sā paramā babhau //
meaning:
क्वणत्कनकदर्वीका क्वणन्मङ्गलकङ्कणा /
कमनीयविभूषाढ्या कला सा परमा बभौ //
text_mt: With a tinkling golden ladle, with jingling auspicious bracelets, / rich in lovely ornaments, that supreme portion shone brightly.

sanskrit_iast:
vāme vāme karāṃbhoje sudhākalaśamujjvalam /
sudhāṃ tāṃ devatāpaṅktau pūrvaṃ darvyā tadādiśat //
meaning:
वामे वामे करांभोजे सुधाकलशमुज्ज्वलम् /
सुधां तां देवतापङ्क्तौ पूर्वं दर्व्या तदादिशत् //
text_mt: Holding the radiant jar of nectar in her left lotus-hand, / she first served that nectar with the ladle to the row of deities.

sanskrit_iast:
diśantī kramaśāstatra candrabhāskarasūcitam /
darvīkareṇa ciccheda saiṃhikeyaṃ tu madhyagam /
pītāmṛtaśiromātraṃ tasya vyoma jagāma ca //
meaning:
दिशन्ती क्रमशास्तत्र चन्द्रभास्करसूचितम् /
दर्वीकरेण चिच्छेद सैंहिकेयं तु मध्यगम् /
पीतामृतशिरोमात्रं तस्य व्योम जगाम च //
text_mt: As she was serving them in turn, pointed out by the moon and the sun, / with the hand holding the ladle she cut off the son of Siṃhikā who sat among them; / and his head alone, having drunk the nectar, rose into the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvāpyasurāstatra tūṣṇīmāsanvimohitāḥ /
evaṃ krameṇa tatsarvaṃ vibudhebhyo vitīrya sā /
asurāṇāṃ puraḥ pātraṃ sānināya tirodadhe //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वाप्यसुरास्तत्र तूष्णीमासन्विमोहिताः /
एवं क्रमेण तत्सर्वं विबुधेभ्यो वितीर्य सा /
असुराणां पुरः पात्रं सानिनाय तिरोदधे //
text_mt: Even on seeing that, the asuras there remained silent, completely bewitched; / thus, having distributed all of it to the gods in order, / she brought the vessel before the asuras and vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
riktapātraṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve daiteyadānavāḥ /
udvelaṃ kevalaṃ krodhaṃ prāptā yuddhacikīrṣayā //
meaning:
रिक्तपात्रं तु तं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे दैतेयदानवाः /
उद्वेलं केवलं क्रोधं प्राप्ता युद्धचिकीर्षया //
text_mt: Seeing that vessel empty, all the sons of Diti and Dānavas / fell into boundless rage, eager to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve sudhāpānādbalottarāḥ /
durvalairasuraiḥ sārdhaṃ samayuddhyanta sāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादयः सुराः सर्वे सुधापानाद्बलोत्तराः /
दुर्वलैरसुरैः सार्धं समयुद्ध्यन्त सायुधाः //
text_mt: All the gods, Indra and the others, superior in strength from drinking the nectar, / fought, armed with weapons, alongside the weakened asuras.

sanskrit_iast:
te vidhyamānāḥ śataśo dānavendrāḥ surottamaiḥ /
digantānkaticijjagmuḥ pātālaṃ katicidyayuḥ //
meaning:
ते विध्यमानाः शतशो दानवेन्द्राः सुरोत्तमैः /
दिगन्तान्कतिचिज्जग्मुः पातालं कतिचिद्ययुः //
text_mt: Pierced by the hundreds by the foremost gods, / some of the lords of the Dānavas fled to the ends of the earth, and some went to Pātāla.

sanskrit_iast:
daityaṃ malakanāmānaṃ vijitya vibudheśvaraḥ /
ātmīyāṃ śriyamājahre śrīkaṭākṣa samīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
दैत्यं मलकनामानं विजित्य विबुधेश्वरः /
आत्मीयां श्रियमाजह्रे श्रीकटाक्ष समीक्षितः //
text_mt: Having conquered the daitya named Malaka, the lord of the gods, / gazed upon by the side-glance of Śrī, recovered his own prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ siṃhāsanaṃ prāpya mahendraḥ surasevitaḥ /
trailokyaṃ pālayāmāsa pūrvavatpūrvadevajit //
meaning:
पुनः सिंहासनं प्राप्य महेन्द्रः सुरसेवितः /
त्रैलोक्यं पालयामास पूर्ववत्पूर्वदेवजित् //
text_mt: Having regained his throne, served by the gods, the great Indra, / the conqueror of the elder gods, protected the three worlds as before.

sanskrit_iast:
nirbhayā nikhilā devāstrailokye sacarācare /
yathākāmaṃ caranti sma sarvadā hṛṣṭacetasaḥ //
meaning:
निर्भया निखिला देवास्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे /
यथाकामं चरन्ति स्म सर्वदा हृष्टचेतसः //
text_mt: All the gods, freed from fear throughout the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings, / roamed at will, ever joyful in heart.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tadakhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā mohinīcaritaṃ muniḥ /
vismitaḥ kāmacārī tu kailāsaṃ nārado gataḥ //
meaning:
तदा तदखिलं दृष्ट्वा मोहिनीचरितं मुनिः /
विस्मितः कामचारी तु कैलासं नारदो गतः //
text_mt: Then, having seen all that deed of Mohinī, the sage Nārada, / roaming at will and filled with wonder, went to Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
nandinā ca kṛtānujñaḥ praṇamya parameśvaram /
tena saṃbhāvyamāno 'sau tuṣṭo viṣṭaramāsta saḥ //
meaning:
नन्दिना च कृतानुज्ञः प्रणम्य परमेश्वरम् /
तेन संभाव्यमानो ऽसौ तुष्टो विष्टरमास्त सः //
text_mt: Permitted by Nandin and having bowed to the Supreme Lord, / honoured by him, he gladly sat down upon a seat.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanasthaṃ mahādevo muniṃ svecchāvihāriṇam /
papraccha pārvatījāniḥ svacchasphaṭikasannibhaḥ //
meaning:
आसनस्थं महादेवो मुनिं स्वेच्छाविहारिणम् /
पप्रच्छ पार्वतीजानिः स्वच्छस्फटिकसन्निभः //
text_mt: To the sage seated upon the seat, who roamed at his own pleasure, / Mahādeva, the husband of Pārvatī, resembling clear crystal, asked:

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavansarvavṛttajña pavitrīkṛtaviṣṭara /
kalahapriya devarṣe kiṃ vṛttaṃ tatra nākinām //
meaning:
भगवन्सर्ववृत्तज्ञ पवित्रीकृतविष्टर /
कलहप्रिय देवर्षे किं वृत्तं तत्र नाकिनाम् //
text_mt: “O Blessed One, knower of all events, who sanctify your seat, / O divine sage fond of disputes, what took place there among the celestials?

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ vā vijayaḥ samajāyata /
kiṃ vāpyamṛtavṛttāntaṃ viṣṇunā vāpi kiṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
सुराणामसुराणां वा विजयः समजायत /
किं वाप्यमृतवृत्तान्तं विष्णुना वापि किं कृतम् //
text_mt: Did victory fall to the gods or to the asuras? / What became of the nectar, or what was done by Viṣṇu?”

sanskrit_iast:
iti pṛṣṭo maheśena nārado munisattamaḥ /
uvāca vismayāviṣṭaḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
इति पृष्टो महेशेन नारदो मुनिसत्तमः /
उवाच विस्मयाविष्टः प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणः //
text_mt: Thus questioned by Maheśa, Nārada, the best of sages, / filled with wonder, his face and eyes serene, replied:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ jānāsi bhagavansarvajño 'si yatastataḥ /
tathāpi paripṛṣṭena mayā tadvakṣyate 'dhunā //
meaning:
सर्वं जानासि भगवन्सर्वज्ञो ऽसि यतस्ततः /
तथापि परिपृष्टेन मया तद्वक्ष्यते ऽधुना //
text_mt: “You know everything, O Blessed One, since you are omniscient; / nevertheless, since I am asked, I shall now tell it.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśe samare ghore sati daityadivaukasām /
ādinārāyamaḥ śrīmānmohinīrūpamādadhe //
meaning:
तादृशे समरे घोरे सति दैत्यदिवौकसाम् /
आदिनारायमः श्रीमान्मोहिनीरूपमादधे //
text_mt: While such a dreadful battle between the daityas and the celestials was underway, / the glorious Ādinārāyaṇa assumed the form of Mohinī.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmudāravibhūṣāḍhyāṃ mūrtāṃ śṛṅgāradevatām /
surāsurāḥ samālokya viratāḥ samarodhyamāt //
meaning:
तामुदारविभूषाढ्यां मूर्तां शृङ्गारदेवताम् /
सुरासुराः समालोक्य विरताः समरोध्यमात् //
text_mt: Beholding her, rich in magnificent ornaments, the deity of erotic love incarnate, / the gods and asuras desisted from their efforts in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmāyāmohitā daityāḥ sudhāpātraṃ ca yācitāḥ /
kṛtvā tāmeva madhyasthāmarpayāmāsurañjasā //
meaning:
तन्मायामोहिता दैत्याः सुधापात्रं च याचिताः /
कृत्वा तामेव मध्यस्थामर्पयामासुरञ्जसा //
text_mt: Bewitched by her māyā, when requested for the vessel of nectar, / making her the mediator, the daityas handed it over directly.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devī tadādāya mandasmitamanoharā /
devebhya eva pīyūṣamaśeṣaṃ vitatāra sā //
meaning:
तदा देवी तदादाय मन्दस्मितमनोहरा /
देवेभ्य एव पीयूषमशेषं विततार सा //
text_mt: Then, taking it, the goddess, charming with a gentle smile, / distributed the entire nectar only to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tirohitāmadṛṣṭvā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ ca pātrakam /
jvalanmanyumukhā daityā yuddhāya punarutthitāḥ //
meaning:
तिरोहितामदृष्ट्वा तां दृष्ट्वा शून्यं च पात्रकम् /
ज्वलन्मन्युमुखा दैत्या युद्धाय पुनरुत्थिताः //
text_mt: Not seeing her when she vanished, and seeing the vessel empty, / their faces blazing with fury, the daityas rose again for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
amarairamṛtāsvādādatyulvaṇaparākramaiḥ /
parājitā mahādaityā naṣṭāḥ pātālamabhyayuḥ //
meaning:
अमरैरमृतास्वादादत्युल्वणपराक्रमैः /
पराजिता महादैत्या नष्टाः पातालमभ्ययुः //
text_mt: Defeated by the immortals, who possessed exceedingly fierce prowess from tasting the nectar, / the great daityas perished and fled to Pātāla.”

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ vṛttāntamākarṇya bhavānīpatikhyayaḥ /
nāradaṃ preṣayitvāśu taduktaṃ satataṃ smaran //
meaning:
इमं वृत्तान्तमाकर्ण्य भवानीपतिख्ययः /
नारदं प्रेषयित्वाशु तदुक्तं सततं स्मरन् //
text_mt: Hearing this report, the husband of Bhavānī, / having quickly dismissed Nārada, constantly remembered what he had said.

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātaḥ pramathaiḥ sarvaiḥ skandanandivināyakaiḥ /
pārvatīsahito viṣṇumājagāma savismayaḥ //
meaning:
अज्ञातः प्रमथैः सर्वैः स्कन्दनन्दिविनायकैः /
पार्वतीसहितो विष्णुमाजगाम सविस्मयः //
text_mt: Unnoticed by all the pramathas, by Skanda, Nandin, and Vināyaka, / together with Pārvatī he went, full of wonder, to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodatīragaṃ dṛṣṭvā sastrīkaṃ vṛṣavāhanam /
bhogibhogāsanādviṣṇuḥ samutthāya samāgataḥ //
meaning:
क्षीरोदतीरगं दृष्ट्वा सस्त्रीकं वृषवाहनम् /
भोगिभोगासनाद्विष्णुः समुत्थाय समागतः //
text_mt: Seeing the rider of the bull arrived at the shore of the ocean of milk with his wife, / Viṣṇu rose from his seat upon the serpent’s coils and came forward.

sanskrit_iast:
vāhanādavaruhyeśaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ sthitam /
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śīghramāgatya saṃpūjyārghyādito mudā //
meaning:
वाहनादवरुह्येशः पार्वत्या सहितः स्थितम् /
तं दृष्ट्वा शीघ्रमागत्य संपूज्यार्घ्यादितो मुदा //
text_mt: Having descended from his mount, the Lord stood with Pārvatī; / seeing him, [Acyuta] quickly approached and worshipped him joyfully with water offerings and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
sasnehaṃ gāḍhamāliṅgya bhavānīpatimacyutaḥ /
tadāgamanakāryaṃ ca pṛṣṭavānviṣṭaraśravāḥ //
meaning:
सस्नेहं गाढमालिङ्ग्य भवानीपतिमच्युतः /
तदागमनकार्यं च पृष्टवान्विष्टरश्रवाः //
text_mt: Acyuta, the one with lotus-grass ears, having embraced the husband of Bhavānī tightly and affectionately, / asked the purpose of his coming.

sanskrit_iast:
tamuvāca mahādevo bhagavanpuruṣottama /
mahāyogeśvara śrīmansarvasaubhāgyasundaram //
meaning:
तमुवाच महादेवो भगवन्पुरुषोत्तम /
महायोगेश्वर श्रीमन्सर्वसौभाग्यसुन्दरम् //
text_mt: Mahādeva said to him: “O Blessed One, Supreme Person, / O glorious lord of great yoga, beautiful with all auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃmohajanakamavāṅmanasagocaram /
yadrūpaṃ bhavatopāttaṃ tanmahyaṃ saṃpradarśaya //
meaning:
सर्वसंमोहजनकमवाङ्मनसगोचरम् /
यद्रूपं भवतोपात्तं तन्मह्यं संप्रदर्शय //
text_mt: that form which was assumed by you, causing infatuation in everyone / and beyond the reach of speech and mind—display that to me!

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpaṃ śṛṅgārasyādhidaivatam /
avaśyaṃ darśanīyaṃ me tvaṃ hi prārthitakāmadhṛk //
meaning:
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपं शृङ्गारस्याधिदैवतम् /
अवश्यं दर्शनीयं मे त्वं हि प्रार्थितकामधृक् //
text_mt: I desire to see your form, the presiding deity of erotic love; / it must certainly be shown to me, for you fulfil what is requested.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃprārthitaḥ śaśvanmahādevena tena saḥ /
yaddhyānavaibhavāllabdhaṃ rūpamadvaitamadbhutam //
meaning:
इति संप्रार्थितः शश्वन्महादेवेन तेन सः /
यद्ध्यानवैभवाल्लब्धं रूपमद्वैतमद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Thus requested repeatedly by that Mahādeva, / that wondrous, peerless form obtained through the power of meditation—

sanskrit_iast:
tadevānanyamanasā dhyātvā kiñcidvihasya saḥ /
tathāstviti tiro 'dhatta mahāyogeśvaro hariḥ //
meaning:
तदेवानन्यमनसा ध्यात्वा किञ्चिद्विहस्य सः /
तथास्त्विति तिरो ऽधत्त महायोगेश्वरो हरिः //
text_mt: meditating on that very [form] with a single-pointed mind, smiling slightly, / saying ‘So be it,’ Hari, the lord of great yoga, vanished.

sanskrit_iast:
śarvo 'pi sarvataścakṣurmuhurvyāpārayankvacit /
adṛṣṭapūrvamārāmamabhirāmaṃ vyalokayat //
meaning:
शर्वो ऽपि सर्वतश्चक्षुर्मुहुर्व्यापारयन्क्वचित् /
अदृष्टपूर्वमाराममभिरामं व्यलोकयत् //
text_mt: Śarva too, casting his eyes all around repeatedly, / looked upon a delightful pleasure garden never seen before,

sanskrit_iast:
vikasatkusumaśreṇīvinodimadhupālikam /
caṃpakastabakāmodasurabhīkṛtadiktaṭam //
meaning:
विकसत्कुसुमश्रेणीविनोदिमधुपालिकम् /
चंपकस्तबकामोदसुरभीकृतदिक्तटम् //
text_mt: delighting rows of honeybees with clusters of blossoming flowers, / its horizons perfumed with the fragrance of campaka bouquets,

sanskrit_iast:
mākandavṛndamādhvīkamādyadullolakokilam /
aśokamaṇḍalīkāṇḍasatāṇḍavaśikhaṇḍikam //
meaning:
माकन्दवृन्दमाध्वीकमाद्यदुल्लोलकोकिलम् /
अशोकमण्डलीकाण्डसताण्डवशिखण्डिकम् //
text_mt: where excited cuckoos were intoxicated by the honey of mango groves, / where peacocks performed joyful tāṇḍava dances in bower-like clusters of aśoka trees,

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛṅgālinavajhaṅkārajitavallakinisvanam /
pāṭalodārasaurabhyapāṭalīkusumojjvalam //
meaning:
भृङ्गालिनवझङ्कारजितवल्लकिनिस्वनम् /
पाटलोदारसौरभ्यपाटलीकुसुमोज्ज्वलम् //
text_mt: surpassing the sound of the lute with the fresh humming of swarms of bees, / radiant with trumpet-flower blossoms of noble pink fragrance,

sanskrit_iast:
tamālatālahintālakṛtamālāvilāsitam /
paryantadīrghikādīrghapaṅkajaśrīpariṣkṛtam //
meaning:
तमालतालहिन्तालकृतमालाविलासितम् /
पर्यन्तदीर्घिकादीर्घपङ्कजश्रीपरिष्कृतम् //
text_mt: graced with tamāla, tāla, hintāla, and kṛtamāla trees, / adorned with the beauty of long lotuses in surrounding ponds.

sanskrit_iast:
vātapātacalaccārupallavotphullapuṣpakam /
santānaprasavāmodasantānādhikavāsitam //
meaning:
वातपातचलच्चारुपल्लवोत्फुल्लपुष्पकम् /
सन्तानप्रसवामोदसन्तानाधिकवासितम् //
text_mt: with blossoming flowers and lovely sprouts moving in the wind's rush, / scented profusely with the fragrant flow of Santāna blossoms.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sarvatra puṣpāḍhye sarvalokamanohare /
pārijātatarormūle kāntā kācidadṛśyata //
meaning:
तत्र सर्वत्र पुष्पाढ्ये सर्वलोकमनोहरे /
पारिजाततरोर्मूले कान्ता काचिददृश्यत //
text_mt: There, rich in flowers everywhere and captivating to all worlds, / a certain lovely woman was seen at the foot of a pārijāta tree.

sanskrit_iast:
bālārkapāṭalākārā navayauvanadarpitā /
ākṛṣṭapadmarāgābhā caraṇābjanakhacchadā //
meaning:
बालार्कपाटलाकारा नवयौवनदर्पिता /
आकृष्टपद्मरागाभा चरणाब्जनखच्छदा //
text_mt: Reddish like the morning sun, proud in her fresh youth, / having the luster of extracted rubies on the coverings of her lotus-feet's nails,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvakaśrīvinikṣepapādalauhityavāhinī /
kalaniḥsvanamañjīrapadapadmamanoharā //
meaning:
यावकश्रीविनिक्षेपपादलौहित्यवाहिनी /
कलनिःस्वनमञ्जीरपदपद्ममनोहरा //
text_mt: bearing the redness of feet imbued with the beauty of red lac, / captivating with her lotus feet adorned with softly tinkling anklets,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgavīratūṇīradarponmadanajaṅghikā /
kariśuṇḍākadalikākāntitulyoruśobhinī //
meaning:
अनङ्गवीरतूणीरदर्पोन्मदनजङ्घिका /
करिशुण्डाकदलिकाकान्तितुल्योरुशोभिनी //
text_mt: with shanks that maddened the pride of the quiver of the hero Love, / splendid with thighs matching the charm of an elephant's trunk and a banana tree,

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇena dukūlena susparśena tanīyasā /
alaṅkṛtanitaṃbāḍhyā jaghanābhogabhāsurā //
meaning:
अरुणेन दुकूलेन सुस्पर्शेन तनीयसा /
अलङ्कृतनितंबाढ्या जघनाभोगभासुरा //
text_mt: rich in large hips adorned with an extremely fine red silk garment pleasing to the touch, / radiant with the broad expanse of her buttocks,

sanskrit_iast:
navamāṇikyasannaddhahemakāñjīvirājitā /
natanābhimahāvarttatrivalyūrmiprabhājharā //
meaning:
नवमाणिक्यसन्नद्धहेमकाञ्जीविराजिता /
नतनाभिमहावर्त्तत्रिवल्यूर्मिप्रभाझरा //
text_mt: shining with a golden girdle fastened with fresh rubies, / with a flow of brilliance from the three folds [above] her deep, great whirlpool-like navel,

sanskrit_iast:
stanakuḍmalahindolamuktādāmaśatāvṛtā /
atipīvaravakṣojabhārabhaṅguramadhyabhūḥ //
meaning:
स्तनकुड्मलहिन्दोलमुक्तादामशतावृता /
अतिपीवरवक्षोजभारभङ्गुरमध्यभूः //
text_mt: covered with hundreds of pearl strings swinging upon the buds of her breasts, / her middle region bending under the weight of her exceedingly plump breasts,

sanskrit_iast:
śirīṣakomalabhujā kaṅkaṇāṅgadaśālinī /
sormikāṃ gulimanmṛṣṭaśaṅkhasundarakandharā //
meaning:
शिरीषकोमलभुजा कङ्कणाङ्गदशालिनी /
सोर्मिकां गुलिमन्मृष्टशङ्खसुन्दरकन्धरा //
text_mt: with arms tender as the śirīṣa flower, adorned with bracelets and armlets, / with rings on her fingers, and a neck lovely like a well-polished conch,

sanskrit_iast:
mukhadarpaṇavṛttābhacubukāpāṭalāgharā /
śucibhiḥ paṅktibhiḥ śuddhairvidyārūpairvibhāsvaraiḥ //
meaning:
मुखदर्पणवृत्ताभचुबुकापाटलाघरा /
शुचिभिः पङ्क्तिभिः शुद्धैर्विद्यारूपैर्विभास्वरैः //
text_mt: with a chin resembling the roundness of a hand-mirror, with red lower lip, / and with gleaming, pure rows [of teeth] embodying luminous Vidyās,

sanskrit_iast:
kundakuḍmalasacchāyairdantairdarśitacandrikā /
sthūlamauktikasannaddhanāsābharaṇabhāsurā //
meaning:
कुन्दकुड्मलसच्छायैर्दन्तैर्दर्शितचन्द्रिका /
स्थूलमौक्तिकसन्नद्धनासाभरणभासुरा //
text_mt: revealing moonlight by her teeth that shared the beauty of kunda buds, / radiant with a nose ornament set with a large pearl,

sanskrit_iast:
ketakāntarddaladroṇidīrghadīrghavilocanā /
ardhendutulitāphāle samyakkḷptālakacchaṭā //
meaning:
केतकान्तर्द्दलद्रोणिदीर्घदीर्घविलोचना /
अर्धेन्दुतुलिताफाले सम्यक्कॢप्तालकच्छटा //
text_mt: with very long eyes resembling the inside of the spathe of a ketaka petal, / with neatly arranged curls of hair upon a forehead rivaling the half-moon,

sanskrit_iast:
pālīvataṃsamāṇikyakuṇḍalāmaṇḍitaśrutiḥ /
navakarpūrakastūrīrasāmoditavīṭikā //
meaning:
पालीवतंसमाणिक्यकुण्डलामण्डितश्रुतिः /
नवकर्पूरकस्तूरीरसामोदितवीटिका //
text_mt: her ears adorned with ruby ear-ornaments resembling rings, / her betel roll perfumed with fresh camphor and musk essence,

sanskrit_iast:
śaraccaruniśānāthamaṇḍalīmadhurānanā /
sphuratkastūritilakā nīlakuntalasaṃhatiḥ //
meaning:
शरच्चरुनिशानाथमण्डलीमधुरानना /
स्फुरत्कस्तूरितिलका नीलकुन्तलसंहतिः //
text_mt: her face sweet as the disc of the lovely autumn moon, / with a gleaming musk mark on her forehead, and a mass of black hair,

sanskrit_iast: sīmantarekhāvinyastasiṃdūraśreṇibhāsurā //
meaning: सीमन्तरेखाविन्यस्तसिंदूरश्रेणिभासुरा //
text_mt: radiant with the line of red vermilion applied along the parting of her hair,

sanskrit_iast:
spharaccandrakalottaṃsamadalolavilocanā /
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇamaṇḍitā //
meaning:
स्फरच्चन्द्रकलोत्तंसमदलोलविलोचना /
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणमण्डिता //
text_mt: with eyes unsteady with passion and adorned with a gleaming crescent moon, / rich in every erotic adornment, embellished with every ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmimāṃ kandukakrīḍālolāmālolabhūṣaṇām /
dṛṣṭvā kṣipramumāṃ tyaktvā so 'nvadhāvadatheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तामिमां कन्दुकक्रीडालोलामालोलभूषणाम् /
दृष्ट्वा क्षिप्रमुमां त्यक्त्वा सो ऽन्वधावदथेश्वरः //
text_mt: Seeing her engaged in playing with a ball, her ornaments trembling, / the Lord instantly abandoned Umā and ran after her.

sanskrit_iast:
umāpi taṃ samovekṣya dhāvantaṃ cātmanaḥ priyam /
svātmānaṃ svātmarsondaryaṃ nindantī cātivismitā /
tasthāvavāṅmukhī tūṣṇīṃ lajjāsūyāsamanvitā //
meaning:
उमापि तं समोवेक्ष्य धावन्तं चात्मनः प्रियम् /
स्वात्मानं स्वात्मर्सोन्दर्यं निन्दन्ती चातिविस्मिता /
तस्थाववाङ्मुखी तूष्णीं लज्जासूयासमन्विता //
text_mt: Umā too, seeing her husband running, / censured herself and her own beauty, exceedingly astonished; / she stood silent with face cast down, filled with shame and indignation.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā kathamapyenāmāliliga muhurmuhuḥ /
uddhūyoddhūya sāpyevaṃ dhāvati sma sudūrataḥ //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा कथमप्येनामालिलिग मुहुर्मुहुः /
उद्धूयोद्धूय साप्येवं धावति स्म सुदूरतः //
text_mt: Catching her somehow, he embraced her again and again; / shaking him off repeatedly, she ran far away.

sanskrit_iast:
punargṛhītvā tāmīśaḥ kāmaṃ kāmavaśīsṛtaḥ /
āśrliṣṭaṃ cātivegena tadvīryaṃ pracyutaṃ tadā //
meaning:
पुनर्गृहीत्वा तामीशः कामं कामवशीसृतः /
आश्र्लिष्टं चातिवेगेन तद्वीर्यं प्रच्युतं तदा //
text_mt: Subdued by passion, the Lord caught her again at will; / and as she was embraced with great force, his semen fell then.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samutthito devo mahāśāstā mahābalaḥ /
anekakoṭidaityendragarvanirvāpaṇakṣamaḥ //
meaning:
ततः समुत्थितो देवो महाशास्ता महाबलः /
अनेककोटिदैत्येन्द्रगर्वनिर्वापणक्षमः //
text_mt: From that arose the god Mahāśāstā, of great might, / capable of extinguishing the pride of many crores of demon chiefs.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvīryabindusaṃsparśātsā bhūmistatratatra ca /
rajatasvarmavarṇābhūllakṣaṇādvindhyamardana //
meaning:
तद्वीर्यबिन्दुसंस्पर्शात्सा भूमिस्तत्रतत्र च /
रजतस्वर्मवर्णाभूल्लक्षणाद्विन्ध्यमर्दन //
text_mt: From the contact with drops of that semen, that ground here and there / became the color of silver and gold instantly, O crusher of the Vindhya!

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivāntardadhe sāpi devatā viśvamohinī /
nivṛttaḥ sa girīśo 'pi giriṃ gaurīsakho yayau //
meaning:
तथैवान्तर्दधे सापि देवता विश्वमोहिनी /
निवृत्तः स गिरीशो ऽपि गिरिं गौरीसखो ययौ //
text_mt: Just then that goddess who enchants the universe disappeared; / and the Lord of the mountain, having turned back, went to the mountain along with Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
athādbhutamidaṃ vakṣye lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu /
yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ mamaiva tdṛdayesthitam //
meaning:
अथाद्भुतमिदं वक्ष्ये लोपामुद्रापते शृणु /
यन्न कस्यचिदाख्यातं ममैव त्दृदयेस्थितम् //
text_mt: Now I shall tell this wonder, listen, O husband of Lopāmudrā, / which has not been told to anyone, but remained in my very heart.

sanskrit_iast:
purā bhaṇḍāsuro nāma sarvadaityaśikhāmaṇiḥ /
pūrvaṃ devānbahuvidhānyaḥ śāstā svecchayā paṭuḥ //
meaning:
पुरा भण्डासुरो नाम सर्वदैत्यशिखामणिः /
पूर्वं देवान्बहुविधान्यः शास्ता स्वेच्छया पटुः //
text_mt: Long ago, there was an Asura named Bhaṇḍa, the crest-jewel of all Daityas, / who previously ruled skillfully at will over the diverse gods.

sanskrit_iast:
viśukraṃ nāma daiteyaṃ vargasaṃrakṣaṇakṣamam /
śukratulyaṃ vicārajñaṃ dakṣāṃsena sasarja saḥ //
meaning:
विशुक्रं नाम दैतेयं वर्गसंरक्षणक्षमम् /
शुक्रतुल्यं विचारज्ञं दक्षांसेन ससर्ज सः //
text_mt: From his right shoulder he created a Daitya named Viśukra, / capable of protecting his company, equal to Śukra and discerning in judgment.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāṃsena viṣāṅgaṃ ca sṛṣṭavānduṣṭaśekharam /
dhūminīnāmadheyāṃ ca bhaginīṃ bhaṇḍadānavaḥ //
meaning:
वामांसेन विषाङ्गं च सृष्टवान्दुष्टशेखरम् /
धूमिनीनामधेयां च भगिनीं भण्डदानवः //
text_mt: And from his left shoulder he created Viṣāṅga, the crown of the wicked, / and the Dānava Bhaṇḍa created a sister named Dhūminī.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātṛbhyāmugravīryābhyāṃ sahito nihatāhitaḥ /
brahmāṇḍaṃ khaṇḍayāmāsa śauryavīryasamucchritaḥ //
meaning:
भ्रातृभ्यामुग्रवीर्याभ्यां सहितो निहताहितः /
ब्रह्माण्डं खण्डयामास शौर्यवीर्यसमुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Together with his two brothers of fierce prowess, his enemies slain, / exalted by his heroism and valor, he shattered the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā dīptatejasam /
palāyanaparāḥ sadyaḥ sve sve dhāmni sadāvasan //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाश्च तं दृष्ट्वा दीप्ततेजसम् /
पलायनपराः सद्यः स्वे स्वे धाम्नि सदावसन् //
text_mt: Seeing him blazing with splendor, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa / took to flight and lived constantly, each in his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tadānīmeva tadbāhumaṃmarddana vimūrcchitāḥ /
śvasituṃ cāpi paṭavo nābhavannākināṃ gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
तदानीमेव तद्बाहुमंमर्द्दन विमूर्च्छिताः /
श्वसितुं चापि पटवो नाभवन्नाकिनां गणाः //
text_mt: Right then, crushed by his arms and fainting, / the hosts of heaven-dwellers were not even able to breathe.

sanskrit_iast:
kecitpātālagarbheṣu kecidaṃbudhivāriṣu /
keciddigantakoṇeṣu kecitkuñjeṣu bhūbhṛtām //
meaning:
केचित्पातालगर्भेषु केचिदंबुधिवारिषु /
केचिद्दिगन्तकोणेषु केचित्कुञ्जेषु भूभृताम् //
text_mt: Some in the depths of Pātāla, some in the ocean's waters, / some in the corners of the directions, some in the bowers of mountains,

sanskrit_iast:
vilīnā bhṛśavitrastāstyaktadārasutastriyaḥ /
bhraṣṭādhikārā ṛbhavo viceruśchannaveṣakāḥ //
meaning:
विलीना भृशवित्रस्तास्त्यक्तदारसुतस्त्रियः /
भ्रष्टाधिकारा ऋभवो विचेरुश्छन्नवेषकाः //
text_mt: vanished, exceedingly terrified, leaving their wives and sons; / their authorities lost, the gods wandered in disguised forms.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣānmahoragānsiddhānsādhyānsamaradurmadān /
brahmāṇaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca rudraṃ vajriṇameva ca /
matvā tṛṇāyitānsarvāṃllokānbhaṇḍaḥ śaśāsaha //
meaning:
यक्षान्महोरगान्सिद्धान्साध्यान्समरदुर्मदान् /
ब्रह्माणं पद्मनाभं च रुद्रं वज्रिणमेव च /
मत्वा तृणायितान्सर्वांल्लोकान्भण्डः शशासह //
text_mt: Considering Yakṣas, great serpents, Siddhas, and Sādhyas arrogant in battle, / Brahmā, the lotus-navelled [Viṣṇu], Rudra, and the wielder of the thunderbolt all as mere blades of grass, Bhaṇḍa ruled the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhaṇḍāsuraṃ hantuṃ trailokyaṃ cāpi rakṣitum /
tṛtīyamudabhūdrūpaṃ mahāyāgānalānmune //
meaning:
अथ भण्डासुरं हन्तुं त्रैलोक्यं चापि रक्षितुम् /
तृतीयमुदभूद्रूपं महायागानलान्मुने //
text_mt: Then, O sage, to slay Bhaṇḍāsura and to protect the three worlds, / a third form arose from the fire of the great sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
yadrūpaśālinīmāhurlalitā paradevatām /
pāśāṅkuśadhanurvāṇapariṣkṛtacaturbhujām //
meaning:
यद्रूपशालिनीमाहुर्ललिता परदेवताम् /
पाशाङ्कुशधनुर्वाणपरिष्कृतचतुर्भुजाम् //
text_mt: possessing which form they call the supreme deity Lalitā, / her four arms adorned with the noose, the goad, the bow, and arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
sā devī parama śaktiḥ parabrahmasvarūpiṇī /
jaghāna bhaṇḍadaityendraṃ yuddhe yuddhaviśāradā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne mohinīprādurbhāvamalakāsuravadho nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ
samāptaścopoddhātakhaṇḍaḥ /
meaning:
सा देवी परम शक्तिः परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणी /
जघान भण्डदैत्येन्द्रं युद्धे युद्धविशारदा //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मोहिनीप्रादुर्भावमलकासुरवधो नाम दशमो ऽध्यायः
समाप्तश्चोपोद्धातखण्डः /
text_mt:
She, the goddess, the supreme power whose essence is the supreme Brahman, / skilled in warfare, slew the Daitya king Bhaṇḍa in battle.

Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled 'The Manifestation of Mohinī and the Slaying of Malakāsura', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa; / and the Upoddhātakhaṇḍa is complete.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
kathaṃ bhaṇḍāsuro jātaḥ kathaṃ vā tripurāṃbikā /
kathaṃ babhañja taṃ saṃkhye tatsarvaṃ vada vistarāt //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
कथं भण्डासुरो जातः कथं वा त्रिपुरांबिका /
कथं बभञ्ज तं संख्ये तत्सर्वं वद विस्तरात् //
text_mt: Agastya said: / How was Bhaṇḍāsura born, or how was the mother Tripurā [born]? / How did she crush him in battle? Tell all that in detail.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
purā dākṣāyaṇīṃ tyaktvā pituryajñavināśanam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
पुरा दाक्षायणीं त्यक्त्वा पितुर्यज्ञविनाशनम् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Long ago, having abandoned Dākṣāyaṇī, which destroyed her father's sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānamātmanā paśyañjñānānandarasātmakaḥ /
upāsyamāno munibhiradvandvaguṇalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
आत्मानमात्मना पश्यञ्ज्ञानानन्दरसात्मकः /
उपास्यमानो मुनिभिरद्वन्द्वगुणलक्षणः //
text_mt: beholding the Self through the Self, whose essence is the nectar of knowledge and bliss, / worshipped by sages, characterized by qualities free from dualities,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgākūle himavataḥ paryante praviveśa ha /
sāpi śaṅkaramā rādhya cirakālaṃ manasvinī //
meaning:
गङ्गाकूले हिमवतः पर्यन्ते प्रविवेश ह /
सापि शङ्करमा राध्य चिरकालं मनस्विनी //
text_mt: he entered [the forest] on the bank of the Gaṅgā near the Himavat. / She too, having propitiated Śaṅkara for a long time, high-minded,

sanskrit_iast: yogena svāṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā sutāsīddhimabhūbhṛtaḥ //
meaning: योगेन स्वां तनुं त्यक्त्वा सुतासीद्धिमभूभृतः //
text_mt: abandoned her body through yoga and became the daughter of the King of Snows.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śailo nāradācchrutvā rudrāṇīti svakanyākām /
tasya śuśrūṣaṇārthāya sthāpayāmāsa cāntike //
meaning:
स शैलो नारदाच्छ्रुत्वा रुद्राणीति स्वकन्याकाम् /
तस्य शुश्रूषणार्थाय स्थापयामास चान्तिके //
text_mt: Hearing from Nārada that his daughter was Rudrāṇī, / the mountain placed her near him to attend upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare devāstārakeṇa hi pīḍitāḥ /
brahmaṇoktāḥ samāhūya madanaṃ cedamabruvan //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवास्तारकेण हि पीडिताः /
ब्रह्मणोक्ताः समाहूय मदनं चेदमब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Meanwhile, the gods, oppressed indeed by Tāraka, / instructed by Brahmā, summoned Madana and said this:

sanskrit_iast:
sargādau bhagavānbrahma sṛjamāno 'khilāḥ prajāḥ /
na nirvṛtirabhūttasya kadācidapi mānase /
tapaścacāra suciraṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
सर्गादौ भगवान्ब्रह्म सृजमानो ऽखिलाः प्रजाः /
न निर्वृतिरभूत्तस्य कदाचिदपि मानसे /
तपश्चचार सुचिरं मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः //
text_mt: "At the beginning of creation, when the lord Brahmā was creating all creatures, / he found no delight at all in his mind; / he performed severe penance for a very long time through deeds of mind, speech, and body.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānsalakṣmīko janārdanaḥ /
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa varadaḥ sarvadehinām //
meaning:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवान्सलक्ष्मीको जनार्दनः /
वरेण च्छन्दयामास वरदः सर्वदेहिनाम् //
text_mt: Then the blessed Janārdana with Lakṣmī, the giver of boons to all embodied beings, / was pleased and offered him a boon according to his wish.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca /
yadi tuṣṭo 'si bhagavannanāyāsena vai jagat /
carācarayutaṃ caitatsṛjāmi tvatprasādataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच /
यदि तुष्टो ऽसि भगवन्ननायासेन वै जगत् /
चराचरयुतं चैतत्सृजामि त्वत्प्रसादतः //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'If you are pleased, O Lord, by your grace I shall effortlessly create / this world with its moving and unmoving beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
evamukto vidhātrā tu mahāla kṣmīmudaikṣata /
tadā prādurabhūstvaṃ hi jaganmohanarūpadhṛk //
meaning:
एवमुक्तो विधात्रा तु महाल क्ष्मीमुदैक्षत /
तदा प्रादुरभूस्त्वं हि जगन्मोहनरूपधृक् //
text_mt: Addressed thus by the Creator, he looked toward Mahālakṣmī; / then indeed you were manifested, bearing a form that enchants the world.

sanskrit_iast:
tavāyudhārthaṃ dattaṃ ca puṣpabāṇekṣukārmukam /
vijayatvamajeyatvaṃ prādā tpramudito hariḥ //
meaning:
तवायुधार्थं दत्तं च पुष्पबाणेक्षुकार्मुकम् /
विजयत्वमजेयत्वं प्रादा त्प्रमुदितो हरिः //
text_mt: And for your weapons, the arrows of flowers and the sugarcane bow were given; / delighted, Hari bestowed victory and invincibility [upon you].

sanskrit_iast:
asau sṛjati bhūtāni kāraṇena svakarmaṇā /
sākṣibhūtaḥ svajanato bhavānbhajatu nirvṛntim //
meaning:
असौ सृजति भूतानि कारणेन स्वकर्मणा /
साक्षिभूतः स्वजनतो भवान्भजतु निर्वृन्तिम् //
text_mt: "He creates beings through their own past action as the cause; / as a witness among your own people, may you enjoy contentment."

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa dattavaro brahmā tvayi vinyasya tadbharam /
manaso nirvṛtiṃ prāpya vartate 'dyāpi manmatha //
meaning:
एष दत्तवरो ब्रह्मा त्वयि विन्यस्य तद्भरम् /
मनसो निर्वृतिं प्राप्य वर्तते ऽद्यापि मन्मथ //
text_mt: Brahmā, having granted this boon and placed that burden upon you, / has attained peace of mind and remains so even today, O Manmatha.

sanskrit_iast: amoghaṃ balavīryaṃ te na te moghaḥ parākramaḥ //
meaning: अमोघं बलवीर्यं ते न ते मोघः पराक्रमः //
text_mt: Unfailing is your strength and power; never in vain is your valor.

sanskrit_iast:
sukumārāṇyamoghāni kusumāstrāṇi te sadā /
brahmadattavaro 'yaṃ hi tārako nāma dānavaḥ //
meaning:
सुकुमाराण्यमोघानि कुसुमास्त्राणि ते सदा /
ब्रह्मदत्तवरो ऽयं हि तारको नाम दानवः //
text_mt: Delicate yet always unfailing are your flower-arrows; / indeed, this Dānava named Tāraka has received a boon from Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
bādhate sakalāṃllokānasmānapi viśeṣataḥ /
śivaputrādṛte 'nyatra na bhayaṃ tasya vidyate //
meaning:
बाधते सकलांल्लोकानस्मानपि विशेषतः /
शिवपुत्रादृते ऽन्यत्र न भयं तस्य विद्यते //
text_mt: He torments all the worlds, and us in particular; / except from a son of Śiva, he has no fear from anywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
tvāṃ vināsminmahākārye na kaścitpravadedapi /
svakarācca bhavetkāryaṃ bhavato nānyataḥ kvacit //
meaning:
त्वां विनास्मिन्महाकार्ये न कश्चित्प्रवदेदपि /
स्वकराच्च भवेत्कार्यं भवतो नान्यतः क्वचित् //
text_mt: Without you, no one could even speak of this great task; / the task must be accomplished by your own hand, not from anywhere else.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmyaikyadhayānanirataḥ śivo gauryā samanvitaḥ /
himācalatale ramye vartate munibhirvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
आत्म्यैक्यधयाननिरतः शिवो गौर्या समन्वितः /
हिमाचलतले रम्ये वर्तते मुनिभिर्वृतः //
text_mt: Intent on meditation on the oneness of the Self, Śiva, accompanied by Gaurī, / stays at the lovely foot of the Himālaya, surrounded by sages.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ niyojaya gauryāṃ tu janiṣyati ca tatsutaḥ /
īṣatkāryamidaṃ kṛtvā trāyasvāsmānmahābala //
meaning:
तं नियोजय गौर्यां तु जनिष्यति च तत्सुतः /
ईषत्कार्यमिदं कृत्वा त्रायस्वास्मान्महाबल //
text_mt: Direct him toward Gaurī, and his son will be born; / having accomplished this small task, protect us, O one of great strength!

sanskrit_iast:
evamabhyarthito devaiḥ stūyamāno muhurmuhuḥ /
jagāmātmavināśāya yato himavatastaṭam //
meaning:
एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैः स्तूयमानो मुहुर्मुहुः /
जगामात्मविनाशाय यतो हिमवतस्तटम् //
text_mt: Thus entreated by the gods and praised repeatedly, / he went toward the slope of the Himavat for his own destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
kimapyārādhayāntaṃ tu dhyānasaṃmīlitekṣaṇam /
dadarśeśānamāsīnaṃ kusumaṣurudāyudhaḥ //
meaning:
किमप्याराधयान्तं तु ध्यानसंमीलितेक्षणम् /
ददर्शेशानमासीनं कुसुमषुरुदायुधः //
text_mt: He who has flowers as arrows, raising his weapon, saw the Lord seated, / worshipping something indefinable, his eyes closed in meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
etasminnantare tatra himavattanayā śivam /
ārirādhayiṣuścā gādbibhrāṇā rūpamadbhutam //
meaning:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र हिमवत्तनया शिवम् /
आरिराधयिषुश्चा गाद्बिभ्राणा रूपमद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Meanwhile, the daughter of Himavat came there, / wishing to attend upon Śiva, bearing a wondrous form.

sanskrit_iast:
sametya śambhuṃ girijāṃ gandhapuṣpopahārakaiḥ /
śuśrūṣaṇaparāṃ tatra dadarśātibalaḥ smaraḥ //
meaning:
समेत्य शम्भुं गिरिजां गन्धपुष्पोपहारकैः /
शुश्रूषणपरां तत्र ददर्शातिबलः स्मरः //
text_mt: Smara, possessing immense power, saw Girijā approaching Śambhu, / intent on serving him there with offerings of perfumes and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānānnātidūre 'sya saṃsthitaḥ /
sumanomārgaṇairagryaissa vivyādha maheśvaram //
meaning:
अदृश्यः सर्वभूतानान्नातिदूरे ऽस्य संस्थितः /
सुमनोमार्गणैरग्र्यैस्स विव्याध महेश्वरम् //
text_mt: Invisible to all beings, standing not very far from him, / he pierced Maheśvara with excellent flower-arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
vismṛtya sa hi kāryāṇi bāṇaviddho 'ntike sthitām /
gaurīṃ vilokayāmāsa manmathāviṣṭacetanaḥ //
meaning:
विस्मृत्य स हि कार्याणि बाणविद्धो ऽन्तिके स्थिताम् /
गौरीं विलोकयामास मन्मथाविष्टचेतनः //
text_mt: Forgetting his undertakings, pierced by the arrows, his mind overcome by Manmatha, / he looked upon Gaurī standing nearby.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtimālaṃbya tu punaḥ kimetaditi cintayan /
dadarśāgre tu sannaddhaṃ manmathaṃ kusumāyudham //
meaning:
धृतिमालंब्य तु पुनः किमेतदिति चिन्तयन् /
ददर्शाग्रे तु सन्नद्धं मन्मथं कुसुमायुधम् //
text_mt: Recovering his composure, however, wondering, "What is this?", / he saw Manmatha in front of him, armed with flower-weapons, ready [for action].

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kupitaḥ śūlī trailokyadahanakṣamaḥ /
tārtīyaṃ cakṣurunmīlya dadāha makaradhvajam //
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा कुपितः शूली त्रैलोक्यदहनक्षमः /
तार्तीयं चक्षुरुन्मील्य ददाह मकरध्वजम् //
text_mt: Seeing him, the trident-bearer, capable of burning up the three worlds, became enraged; / opening his third eye, he burned Makaradhvaja to ashes.

sanskrit_iast:
śivenaivamavajñātā duḥkhitā śailakanyakā /
anujñayā tataḥ pitrostapaḥ kartumagādvanam //
meaning:
शिवेनैवमवज्ञाता दुःखिता शैलकन्यका /
अनुज्ञया ततः पित्रोस्तपः कर्तुमगाद्वनम् //
text_mt: Slighted thus by Śiva, the grief-stricken daughter of the mountain, / with the permission of her parents, then went to the forest to perform austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tadbhasma saṃvīkṣya citrakarmā gaṇeśvaraḥ /
tadbhasmanā tu puruṣaṃ citrākāraṃ cakāra saḥ //
meaning:
अथ तद्भस्म संवीक्ष्य चित्रकर्मा गणेश्वरः /
तद्भस्मना तु पुरुषं चित्राकारं चकार सः //
text_mt: Then Citrakarmā, a leader of the Gaṇas, seeing those ashes, / fashioned with those ashes a man of wondrous form.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ vicitratanuṃ rudro dadarśāgre tu pūruṣam /
tatkṣaṇājjāta jīvo 'bhūnmūrtimāniva manmathaḥ /
mahābalo 'titejasvī madhyāhnārkasamaprabhaḥ //
meaning:
तं विचित्रतनुं रुद्रो ददर्शाग्रे तु पूरुषम् /
तत्क्षणाज्जात जीवो ऽभून्मूर्तिमानिव मन्मथः /
महाबलो ऽतितेजस्वी मध्याह्नार्कसमप्रभः //
text_mt: Rudra saw before him that man of wondrous form; / that very moment he came to life, like Manmatha incarnate, / of great strength, exceedingly radiant, shining like the midday sun.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ citrakarmā bāhubhyāṃ samāliṅgya mudānvitaḥ /
stuhi vāla mahādevaṃ sa tu sarvārthasiddhidaḥ //
meaning:
तं चित्रकर्मा बाहुभ्यां समालिङ्ग्य मुदान्वितः /
स्तुहि वाल महादेवं स तु सर्वार्थसिद्धिदः //
text_mt: Embracing him with both arms, Citrakarmā, filled with joy, [said:] / "Praise Mahādeva, O boy; he grants the accomplishment of all aims!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā śatarudrīyamupādiśadameyadhīḥ /
nanāma śataśo rudraṃ śatarudriyamājapan //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा शतरुद्रीयमुपादिशदमेयधीः /
ननाम शतशो रुद्रं शतरुद्रियमाजपन् //
