kaṃpamānā khaḍgalatā vyarucattatkare dhṛtā /
kuṭilā kālanāthasya bhṛkuṭīva bhayaṅkarā //
meaning:
कंपमाना खड्गलता व्यरुचत्तत्करे धृता /
कुटिला कालनाथस्य भृकुटीव भयङ्करा //
text_mt: Quivering in her hand, her slender sword gleamed, / fearsome like the curved knit brow of the Lord of Death.

sanskrit_iast:
utpātavātasaṃpātāccalitā iva parvatāḥ /
tāmanvagā yayuḥ koṭisaṃkhyākāḥ kuñjarottamāḥ //
meaning:
उत्पातवातसंपाताच्चलिता इव पर्वताः /
तामन्वगा ययुः कोटिसंख्याकाः कुञ्जरोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Like mountains set in motion by the impact of cataclysmic winds, / millions of supreme elephants followed after her.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitādevyā śrīpāśāyudhasaṃbhavā /
atitvaritavikrāntiraśvārūḍhācalatpuraḥ //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितादेव्या श्रीपाशायुधसंभवा /
अतित्वरितविक्रान्तिरश्वारूढाचलत्पुरः //
text_mt: Then, born from the sacred noose-weapon of the goddess Śrī Lalitā, / Aśvārūḍhā, whose valour is exceedingly swift, advanced in the vanguard.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā saha hayaprāyaṃ sainyaṃ heṣātaraṅgitam /
vyacaratkhurakuddālavidāritamahītalam //
meaning:
तया सह हयप्रायं सैन्यं हेषातरङ्गितम् /
व्यचरत्खुरकुद्दालविदारितमहीतलम् //
text_mt: Together with her, an army composed mostly of horses, billowing with neighing, / tore up the surface of the earth with their spade-like hooves.

sanskrit_iast:
vanāyujāśca kāṃbojāḥ pāradāḥ siṃdhudeśajāḥ /
ṭaṅkaṇāḥ parvatīyāśca pārasīkāstathā pare //
meaning:
वनायुजाश्च कांबोजाः पारदाः सिंधुदेशजाः /
टङ्कणाः पर्वतीयाश्च पारसीकास्तथा परे //
text_mt: Born in Vanāyu, Kāmboja, Pārada, and the land of Sindhu, / from Ṭaṅkaṇa, from the mountains, and others from Pārasīka;

sanskrit_iast:
ajāneyā ghaṭṭadharā daradāḥ kāla vandijāḥ /
vālmīkayāvanodbhūtā gāndharvāścātha ye hayāḥ //
meaning:
अजानेया घट्टधरा दरदाः काल वन्दिजाः /
वाल्मीकयावनोद्भूता गान्धर्वाश्चाथ ये हयाः //
text_mt: Thoroughbreds, Ghaṭṭadharas, Daradas, born in Kālavandi, / born in Vālmīka and Yavana, and those horses from Gandhāra;

sanskrit_iast:
prāgdeśajātāḥ kairātā prāntadeśodbhavāstathā /
vinītāḥ sādhuvoḍhāro veginaḥ sthiracetasaḥ //
meaning:
प्राग्देशजाताः कैराता प्रान्तदेशोद्भवास्तथा /
विनीताः साधुवोढारो वेगिनः स्थिरचेतसः //
text_mt: Born in the eastern land, Kirāta horses, and those born in border regions, / well-trained, carrying their riders well, swift, and steady of mind;

sanskrit_iast:
svāmicittaviśeṣajñā mahāyuddhasahiṣṇavaḥ /
lakṣaṇairbahubhiryuktā jitakrodhā jitaśramāḥ //
meaning:
स्वामिचित्तविशेषज्ञा महायुद्धसहिष्णवः /
लक्षणैर्बहुभिर्युक्ता जितक्रोधा जितश्रमाः //
text_mt: Knowing the particular mind of their master, enduring great battle, / endowed with many auspicious marks, having overcome anger and conquered fatigue;

sanskrit_iast: pañcadhārāsu śakṣaḍhyā vinītāśca plavānvitāḥ //
meaning: पञ्चधारासु शक्षढ्या विनीताश्च प्लवान्विताः //
text_mt: Skilled in the five gaits, well-disciplined, and possessing [great] leaps;

sanskrit_iast:
phalaśuktiśriyā yuktāḥ śvetaśuktisamanvitāḥ /
devapadmaṃ devamaṇiṃ devasvastikameva ca //
meaning:
फलशुक्तिश्रिया युक्ताः श्वेतशुक्तिसमन्विताः /
देवपद्मं देवमणिं देवस्वस्तिकमेव च //
text_mt: Endowed with the splendour of the fruit-pearl-oyster, possessing the white pearl-oyster, / having the divine lotus, the divine jewel, and the divine svastika,

sanskrit_iast:
atha svastikaśuktiśca gaḍuraṃ puṣpagaṇḍikām /
etāni śubhalakṣmāṇi jyarājyapradāni ca /
vahanto vātajavanā vājinastāṃ samanvayuḥ //
meaning:
अथ स्वस्तिकशुक्तिश्च गडुरं पुष्पगण्डिकाम् /
एतानि शुभलक्ष्माणि ज्यराज्यप्रदानि च /
वहन्तो वातजवना वाजिनस्तां समन्वयुः //
text_mt: And the svastika-pearl-oyster, the gaḍura, and the puṣpagaṇḍikā— / bearing these auspicious marks that bestow victory and kingdom, / the swift-as-wind horses followed her.

sanskrit_iast:
aparājitanāmānamatitejasvinaṃ calam /
atyantottuṅgavarṣmāṇaṃ kavikāvilasanmukham //
meaning:
अपराजितनामानमतितेजस्विनं चलम् /
अत्यन्तोत्तुङ्गवर्ष्माणं कविकाविलसन्मुखम् //
text_mt: Upon [a horse] named Aparājita, exceedingly radiant, restless, / of immensely lofty stature, whose mouth shone with the bit,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvadvaye 'pi patitasphuratkesaramaṇḍalam /
sthūlavāladhivikṣepakṣipyamāṇapayodharam //
meaning:
पार्श्वद्वये ऽपि पतितस्फुरत्केसरमण्डलम् /
स्थूलवालधिविक्षेपक्षिप्यमाणपयोधरम् //
text_mt: Whose quivering circle of mane fell upon both flanks, / who tossed clouds aside with the sweep of his thick tail,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅghākāṇḍasamunnaddhamaṇikiṅkiṇibhāsuram /
vādayantamivoccaṇḍaiḥ khuraniṣṭhurakuṭṭanaiḥ //
meaning:
जङ्घाकाण्डसमुन्नद्धमणिकिङ्किणिभासुरम् /
वादयन्तमिवोच्चण्डैः खुरनिष्ठुरकुट्टनैः //
text_mt: Radiant with jewelled small bells bound to his shanks, / who seemed to play, with the fierce pounding of his hooves,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmaṇḍalamahāvādyaṃ vijayasya samṛddhaye /
ghoṣamāṇaṃ prati muhuḥ saṃdarśitagatikramam //
meaning:
भूमण्डलमहावाद्यं विजयस्य समृद्धये /
घोषमाणं प्रति मुहुः संदर्शितगतिक्रमम् //
text_mt: A great instrument upon the orb of the earth for the increase of victory, / repeatedly displaying the sequence of his paces as he sounded,

sanskrit_iast:
ālolacāmaravyājādvahantaṃ pakṣatī iva /
bhāṇḍairmanoharairyuktaṃ ghargharījālamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
आलोलचामरव्याजाद्वहन्तं पक्षती इव /
भाण्डैर्मनोहरैर्युक्तं घर्घरीजालमण्डितम् //
text_mt: Seeming to bear two wings under the guise of waving chowries, / adorned with charming trappings and embellished with a web of tiny jingling bells—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ ghoṣasya kapaṭāddhuṅkurvatīmi vāsurān /
aśvārūḍhā mahādevī samārūḍhā hayaṃ yayau //
meaning:
एषां घोषस्य कपटाद्धुङ्कुर्वतीमि वासुरान् /
अश्वारूढा महादेवी समारूढा हयं ययौ //
text_mt: Upon this horse, who seemed to shout in defiance at the Asuras through the guise of his neighing, / the great goddess Aśvārūḍhā mounted and advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirvāhubhiḥ pāśamaṅkuśaṃ vetrameva ca /
hayavalgāṃ ca dadhatī bahuvikramaśobhinī //
meaning:
चतुर्भिर्वाहुभिः पाशमङ्कुशं वेत्रमेव च /
हयवल्गां च दधती बहुविक्रमशोभिनी //
text_mt: Holding with her four arms the noose, the goad, the cane, / and the horse's reins, shining with great prowess,

sanskrit_iast:
taruṇādityasaṅkāśā jvalatkāñcītaraṅgiṇī /
sañcacāla hayārūḍhā nartayantīva vājinam //
meaning:
तरुणादित्यसङ्काशा ज्वलत्काञ्चीतरङ्गिणी /
सञ्चचाल हयारूढा नर्तयन्तीव वाजिनम् //
text_mt: Resembling the morning sun, her radiant girdle billowing, / she rode mounted on her horse, as if making her steed dance.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīdaṇḍanāthāyā niryāṇapaṭahadhvaniḥ /
uddaṇḍasindhunisvānaścakāra badhiraṃ jagat //
meaning:
अथ श्रीदण्डनाथाया निर्याणपटहध्वनिः /
उद्दण्डसिन्धुनिस्वानश्चकार बधिरं जगत् //
text_mt: Then the sound of the departure-kettledrum of Śrī Daṇḍanāthā, / loud as the roaring ocean, deafened the world.

sanskrit_iast:
vajrabāṇaiḥ kaṭhoraiścabhindantyaḥ kakubho daśa /
anyuddhatabhujāśmānaḥ śaktayaḥ kāściducchritāḥ //
meaning:
वज्रबाणैः कठोरैश्चभिन्दन्त्यः ककुभो दश /
अन्युद्धतभुजाश्मानः शक्तयः काश्चिदुच्छ्रिताः //
text_mt: Splitting the ten directions with hard thunderbolt-arrows, / certain exalted Śaktis advanced with raised stone-like arms.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścicchrīdaṇḍanāthāyāḥ senānāsīrasaṅgatāḥ /
khaḍgaṃ phalakamādāya pupluvuścaṇḍasaktayaḥ //
meaning:
काश्चिच्छ्रीदण्डनाथायाः सेनानासीरसङ्गताः /
खड्गं फलकमादाय पुप्लुवुश्चण्डसक्तयः //
text_mt: Certain fierce Śaktis, joining the vanguard of Śrī Daṇḍanāthā's army, / leaped forward taking up sword and shield.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantasainyasambādhaṃ vetrasaṃtāḍanaiḥ śataiḥ /
nivārayantyo vetriṇyo vyucchalanti smaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
अत्यन्तसैन्यसम्बाधं वेत्रसंताडनैः शतैः /
निवारयन्त्यो वेत्रिण्यो व्युच्छलन्ति स्मशक्तयः //
text_mt: The cane-bearing Śaktis bounded forth, / warding off the intense crush of the army with hundreds of blows of their canes.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tuṅgadhvajaśreṇīrmahiṣāṅkā mṛgāṅkikām /
sihāṅkāścaiva bibhrāṇāḥ śaktayo vyacalanpurā //
meaning:
अथ तुङ्गध्वजश्रेणीर्महिषाङ्का मृगाङ्किकाम् /
सिहाङ्काश्चैव बिभ्राणाः शक्तयो व्यचलन्पुरा //
text_mt: Then, bearing rows of tall banners emblazoned with the buffalo, the deer, / and the lion, the Śaktis marched in front.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śrīdaṇḍanāthāyāḥ śvetacchatraṃ sahasraśaḥ /
sphuratkarāḥ pracalitāḥ śaktayaḥ kāścidādaduḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne sasenavijayayātrā nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
ततः श्रीदण्डनाथायाः श्वेतच्छत्रं सहस्रशः /
स्फुरत्कराः प्रचलिताः शक्तयः काश्चिदाददुः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ससेनविजययात्रा नाम षोडशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thereupon, thousands of Śaktis, hands flashing, / set forth carrying white umbrellas for Śrī Daṇḍanāthā.

Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'The Triumphal March with the Army', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya in the Latter Part of the great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍanāthāviniryāṇe saṃkhyātītaiḥ sitaprabhaiḥ /
chatrairgaganamāreje niḥsaṃkhyāśaśimaṇḍitam //
meaning:
दण्डनाथाविनिर्याणे संख्यातीतैः सितप्रभैः /
छत्रैर्गगनमारेजे निःसंख्याशशिमण्डितम् //
text_mt: Upon Daṇḍanāthā's departure, the sky shone with countless bright white umbrellas / as though filled with innumerable discs of the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyasaktairthavalacchatrairantarghanībhavat /
timiraṃ nunude bhūyastatkāṇḍamaṇirociṣā //
meaning:
अन्योन्यसक्तैर्थवलच्छत्रैरन्तर्घनीभवत् /
तिमिरं नुनुदे भूयस्तत्काण्डमणिरोचिषा //
text_mt: The darkness growing dense within the cluster of white umbrellas closely joined together / was dispelled once more by the radiance of the jewels on their shafts.

sanskrit_iast:
vajraprabhādhagadhagacchāyāpūritadiṅmukhāḥ /
tālavṛntāḥ śatavidhāḥ kroḍamukhyā bale 'calan //
meaning:
वज्रप्रभाधगधगच्छायापूरितदिङ्मुखाः /
तालवृन्ताः शतविधाः क्रोडमुख्या बले ऽचलन् //
text_mt: With fan-palms of a hundred kinds filling the directions with shadows glittering like lightning, / the boar-faced goddess advanced amidst her army.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍo daṇḍādayastīvrābhairavāḥ śulapāṇayaḥ /
jvalatkeśāpiśaṅgābhāstaḍidbhāsuradiṅmukhāḥ //
meaning:
चण्डो दण्डादयस्तीव्राभैरवाः शुलपाणयः /
ज्वलत्केशापिशङ्गाभास्तडिद्भासुरदिङ्मुखाः //
text_mt: The fierce Bhairavas, such as Caṇḍa, Daṇḍa, and others, armed with tridents, / having blazing hair of reddish-yellow hue, illuminating the quarters like lightning,

sanskrit_iast:
dahatya iva daityaughāṃstīkṣṇairmārgaṇavahnibhiḥ /
pracelurdaṇḍanāthāyāssenā nāsīradhāvitāḥ //
meaning:
दहत्य इव दैत्यौघांस्तीक्ष्णैर्मार्गणवह्निभिः /
प्रचेलुर्दण्डनाथायास्सेना नासीरधाविताः //
text_mt: As if consuming the hosts of Daityas with the sharp fires of their arrows, / marched forward, rushing to the front of Daṇḍanāthā's army.

sanskrit_iast:
atha potrīmukhīdevīsamānākṛtibhūṣaṇāḥ /
tatsamānāyudhakarāstatsamānasvavāhanāḥ //
meaning:
अथ पोत्रीमुखीदेवीसमानाकृतिभूषणाः /
तत्समानायुधकरास्तत्समानस्ववाहनाः //
text_mt: Then [goddesses] having forms and ornaments identical to Goddess Potrīmukhī, / with identical weapons in their hands and identical mounts of their own,

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣmadaṃṣṭa3viniṣṭhyūtavahridhūmāmitāṃbarāḥ /
tamālaśyāmalākārāḥ kapilāḥ krūralocanāḥ //
meaning:
तीक्ष्मदंष्ट3विनिष्ठ्यूतवह्रिधूमामितांबराः /
तमालश्यामलाकाराः कपिलाः क्रूरलोचनाः //
text_mt: Spitting out from their sharp tusks smoke and fire that filled the sky, / dark in appearance like tamāla trees, tawny-haired, with cruel eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasramahiṣārūḍhāḥ praceluḥ sūkarānanāḥ /
atha śrīdaṇḍanāthā ca karicakrarathottamāt //
meaning:
सहस्रमहिषारूढाः प्रचेलुः सूकराननाः /
अथ श्रीदण्डनाथा च करिचक्ररथोत्तमात् //
text_mt: Boar-faced, mounted upon thousands of buffaloes, marched forward. / Then the venerable Daṇḍanāthā, from the supreme chariot Karicakra,

sanskrit_iast:
avaruhya mahāsiṃhamāruroha svavāhanam /
vajraghoṣa iti khyātaṃ dhūtakesaramaṇḍalam //
meaning:
अवरुह्य महासिंहमारुरोह स्ववाहनम् /
वज्रघोष इति ख्यातं धूतकेसरमण्डलम् //
text_mt: Descended and mounted her own vehicle, a great lion / known as Vajraghoṣa, whose mane shook,

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāsyaṃ vikaṭākāraṃ viśaṅkaṭavilocanam /
daṃṣṭrākaṭakaṭatkārabadhirīkṛtadiktaṭam //
meaning:
व्यक्तास्यं विकटाकारं विशङ्कटविलोचनम् /
दंष्ट्राकटकटत्कारबधिरीकृतदिक्तटम् //
text_mt: With open mouth, formidable shape, and wide eyes, / deafening the regions of the quarters with the gnashing of its fangs,

sanskrit_iast:
ādikūrmakaṭhorāsthi kharparapratimairnakhaiḥ /
vibantamiva bhūcakramāpātālaṃ nimajjibhiḥ //
meaning:
आदिकूर्मकठोरास्थि खर्परप्रतिमैर्नखैः /
विबन्तमिव भूचक्रमापातालं निमज्जिभिः //
text_mt: With claws resembling the shell-pieces of the hard bone of the Primeval Tortoise, / tearing the orb of the earth as they plunged down to Pātāla,

sanskrit_iast:
yojanatrayamuttuṅgaṃ vagāduddhūtavāladhim /
siṃhavāhanamāruhya vyacaladdaṇḍanāyikā //
meaning:
योजनत्रयमुत्तुङ्गं वगादुद्धूतवालधिम् /
सिंहवाहनमारुह्य व्यचलद्दण्डनायिका //
text_mt: Three yojanas tall, its tail raised and swinging; / mounting this lion vehicle, Daṇḍanāyikā advanced.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāmasurasaṃhāre pravṛttāyāṃ jvalatkrudhi /
udvegaṃ bahulaṃ prāpa trailokyaṃ sacarācaram //
meaning:
तस्यामसुरसंहारे प्रवृत्तायां ज्वलत्क्रुधि /
उद्वेगं बहुलं प्राप त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् //
text_mt: As she set out to destroy the Asuras, her anger blazing, / the three worlds, both moving and unmoving, were seized with great agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
kimasau dhakṣyati ruṣā viśvamadyaiva potriṇī /
kiṃ vā musalaghātena bhūmiṃ dvedhā kariṣyati //
meaning:
किमसौ धक्ष्यति रुषा विश्वमद्यैव पोत्रिणी /
किं वा मुसलघातेन भूमिं द्वेधा करिष्यति //
text_mt: “Will this boar-faced goddess consume the universe in her fury this very day? / Or will she cleave the earth in two with a blow of her pestle?

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā halanirghātaiḥ kṣobhayiṣyati vāridhīn /
iti trastahṛdaḥ sarve gagane nākināṃ gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
अथ वा हलनिर्घातैः क्षोभयिष्यति वारिधीन् /
इति त्रस्तहृदः सर्वे गगने नाकिनां गणाः //
text_mt: Or will she agitate the oceans with the impacts of her plough?” / Thus terrified in heart, all the hosts of gods in the sky

sanskrit_iast:
dūrādrutaṃ vimānaiśca satrāsaṃ dadṛśurgatāḥ /
vavandire ca tā devā baddhāñjalipuṭānvitāḥ /
muhurdvādaśanāmāni kīrtayanto nabhastale //
meaning:
दूराद्रुतं विमानैश्च सत्रासं ददृशुर्गताः /
ववन्दिरे च ता देवा बद्धाञ्जलिपुटान्विताः /
मुहुर्द्वादशनामानि कीर्तयन्तो नभस्तले //
text_mt: Went in their aerial chariots and watched from afar in haste and fear; / and the gods bowed with hands folded in supplication, / repeatedly praising her twelve names in the vault of heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
kāni dvādaśanāmāni tasyā devyā vada prabho /
aśvānana mahāprājña yeṣu me kautukaṃ mahat //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
कानि द्वादशनामानि तस्या देव्या वद प्रभो /
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ येषु मे कौतुकं महत् //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Tell me, O Lord, what are the twelve names of that goddess? / O horse-faced one of great wisdom, in which I have great curiosity!

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
śṛṇu dvādaśanāmāni tasyā devyā ghaṭodbhava /
yadākarṇanamātreṇa prasannā sā bhaviṣyati /
pañcamī daṇḍanāthā ca saṃketā samayeśvarī //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
शृणु द्वादशनामानि तस्या देव्या घटोद्भव /
यदाकर्णनमात्रेण प्रसन्ना सा भविष्यति /
पञ्चमी दण्डनाथा च संकेता समयेश्वरी //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Hear the twelve names of that goddess, O pot-born one, / merely by hearing which she becomes pleased: / Pañcamī, Daṇḍanāthā, Saṃketā, Samayeśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā samayasaṃketā vārāhī potriṇī tathā /
vārtālī ca mahāsenāpyājñā cakreśvarī tathā //
meaning:
तथा समयसंकेता वाराही पोत्रिणी तथा /
वार्ताली च महासेनाप्याज्ञा चक्रेश्वरी तथा //
text_mt: likewise Samayasaṃketā, Vārāhī, and Potriṇī, / Vārtālī, Mahāsenā, Ājñā, Cakreśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
arighnī ceti samproktaṃ nāmadvādaśakaṃ mune /
nāmadvādaśakābhikhyavajrapañjaramadhyagaḥ /
saṃkaṭe duḥkhamāpnoti na kadācana mānavaḥ //
meaning:
अरिघ्नी चेति सम्प्रोक्तं नामद्वादशकं मुने /
नामद्वादशकाभिख्यवज्रपञ्जरमध्यगः /
संकटे दुःखमाप्नोति न कदाचन मानवः //
text_mt: and Arighnī: thus the twelve names have been declared, O sage. / Standing within the adamantine cage known as the twelve names, / a man never meets with suffering in calamity.

sanskrit_iast:
etairnāmabhirabhrasthāḥ saṃketāṃ bahu tuṣṭuvuḥ /
teṣāmanugrahārthāya pracacālaca sā punaḥ //
meaning:
एतैर्नामभिरभ्रस्थाः संकेतां बहु तुष्टुवुः /
तेषामनुग्रहार्थाय प्रचचालच सा पुनः //
text_mt: Standing in the sky, they praised Saṃketā abundantly with these names; / and for the sake of granting them grace, she set out again.

sanskrit_iast:
atha saṃketayoginyā mantranāthā padaspṛśaḥ /
niryāṇasūcanakarī divi dadhvāna kāhalī //
meaning:
अथ संकेतयोगिन्या मन्त्रनाथा पदस्पृशः /
निर्याणसूचनकरी दिवि दध्वान काहली //
text_mt: Then the horn indicating departure sounded in heaven / for Mantranāthā, who touches the feet of the Saṃketayoginī.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgāraprāyabhūṣāṇāṃ śārdūlaśyāmalatviṣām /
vīṇāsaṃyatapāṇīnāṃ śaktīnāṃ niryayau balam //
meaning:
शृङ्गारप्रायभूषाणां शार्दूलश्यामलत्विषाम् /
वीणासंयतपाणीनां शक्तीनां निर्ययौ बलम् //
text_mt: The army of śaktis went forth, / adorned mostly with erotic ornaments, / lustrous with the dark hue of tigers, their hands holding vīṇās.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścadgāyanti nṛtyanti mattakokilaniḥsvanāḥ /
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādyāḥ savilāsapadakramāḥ //
meaning:
काश्चद्गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति मत्तकोकिलनिःस्वनाः /
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गाद्याः सविलासपदक्रमाः //
text_mt: Some were singing, some dancing, their voices like intoxicated cuckoos, / with vīṇās, flutes, mṛdaṅgas, and other instruments, their footsteps graceful.

sanskrit_iast:
praceluḥ śaktayaḥ śyāmā harṣayantyo jagajjanān /
mayūravāhanāḥ kāścitkaticiddhaṃsavāhanāḥ //
meaning:
प्रचेलुः शक्तयः श्यामा हर्षयन्त्यो जगज्जनान् /
मयूरवाहनाः काश्चित्कतिचिद्धंसवाहनाः //
text_mt: The dark śaktis marched forth, delighting the folk of the world; / some rode peacocks, some rode swans,

sanskrit_iast:
katicinnakulārūḍhāḥ katicitkokilāsanāḥ /
sarvāśca śyāmalākārāḥ kāścitkarṇīrathasthitāḥ //
meaning:
कतिचिन्नकुलारूढाः कतिचित्कोकिलासनाः /
सर्वाश्च श्यामलाकाराः काश्चित्कर्णीरथस्थिताः //
text_mt: some were mounted on mongooses, some seated on cuckoos; / all were dark of form, and some stood upon sedan chairs.

sanskrit_iast:
kādaṃbamadhumattāśca kāścidārūḍhasaindhavāḥ /
mantranāthāṃ puraskṛtya saṃpraceluḥ puraḥ puraḥ //
meaning:
कादंबमधुमत्ताश्च काश्चिदारूढसैन्धवाः /
मन्त्रनाथां पुरस्कृत्य संप्रचेलुः पुरः पुरः //
text_mt: Intoxicated with kadaṃba honey, and some mounted on horses, / they advanced ahead and ahead, placing Mantranāthā at their head.

sanskrit_iast:
athāruhya samuttuṅgadhvajacakraṃ mahāratham /
bālārkavarṇakavacā madālolavilocanā //
meaning:
अथारुह्य समुत्तुङ्गध्वजचक्रं महारथम् /
बालार्कवर्णकवचा मदालोलविलोचना //
text_mt: Then, having mounted the great chariot whose flagstaff-cakra rose high, / clad in armor the color of the rising sun, her eyes fluttering with intoxication,

sanskrit_iast:
īṣatprasvedakaṇikāmanoharamukhāṃbujā /
prekṣayantī kaṭākṣaudhauḥ kiñcidbhrūvallitāṇḍavaiḥ //
meaning:
ईषत्प्रस्वेदकणिकामनोहरमुखांबुजा /
प्रेक्षयन्ती कटाक्षौधौः किञ्चिद्भ्रूवल्लिताण्डवैः //
text_mt: her lotus face charming with tiny drops of sweat, / gazing with streams of side-glances through slight dances of her creeper-like brows,

sanskrit_iast:
samastamapi tatsainyaṃ śaktīnāmuddhatoddhatam /
picchatrikoṇacchatreṇa birudena mahīyasā //
meaning:
समस्तमपि तत्सैन्यं शक्तीनामुद्धतोद्धतम् /
पिच्छत्रिकोणच्छत्रेण बिरुदेन महीयसा //
text_mt: at the entire fierce and haughty army of śaktis, / accompanied by a peacock-feather triangular umbrella, a glorious emblem of honor,

sanskrit_iast:
āsāṃ madhye na cānyāsāṃ śaktīnāmujjvalodayā /
nirjagāma ghanaśyāmaśyāmalā mantranāyikā //
meaning:
आसां मध्ये न चान्यासां शक्तीनामुज्ज्वलोदया /
निर्जगाम घनश्यामश्यामला मन्त्रनायिका //
text_mt: in the midst of these—and no other—śaktis, radiant in her rising, / Mantranāyikā went forth, dark as a rain-cloud.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ ṣoḍaśabhirnāmabhirnākavāsinaḥ /
tāni ṣoḍaśanāmāni śṛṇu kuṃbhasamudbhava //
meaning:
तां तुष्टुवुः षोडशभिर्नामभिर्नाकवासिनः /
तानि षोडशनामानि शृणु कुंभसमुद्भव //
text_mt: The dwellers of heaven praised her with sixteen names. / Hear those sixteen names, O pot-born one:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgītayoginī śyāmā śyāmalā mantranāyikā /
mantriṇī saciveśī ca pradhāneśī śukapriyā //
meaning:
संगीतयोगिनी श्यामा श्यामला मन्त्रनायिका /
मन्त्रिणी सचिवेशी च प्रधानेशी शुकप्रिया //
text_mt: Saṃgītayoginī, Śyāmā, Śyāmalā, Mantranāyikā, / Mantriṇī, Saciveśī, Pradhāneśī, Śukapriyā,

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāvatī vaiṇikī ca mudriṇī priyakapriyā /
nipapriyā kadaṃbeśī kadaṃbavanavāsinī //
meaning:
वीणावती वैणिकी च मुद्रिणी प्रियकप्रिया /
निपप्रिया कदंबेशी कदंबवनवासिनी //
text_mt: Vīṇāvatī, Vaiṇikī, Mudriṇī, Priyakapriyā, / Nipapriyā, Kadaṃbeśī, Kadaṃbavanavāsinī,

sanskrit_iast:
sadāmadā ca nāmāni ṣoḍaśaitāni kuṃbhaja /
etairyaḥ saciveśānīṃ sakṛtstauti śarīravān /
tasya trailokyamakhilaṃ haste tiṣṭhatyasaṃśayam //
meaning:
सदामदा च नामानि षोडशैतानि कुंभज /
एतैर्यः सचिवेशानीं सकृत्स्तौति शरीरवान् /
तस्य त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हस्ते तिष्ठत्यसंशयम् //
text_mt: and Sadāmadā: these are the sixteen names, O pot-born one. / Whosoever among embodied beings praises Saciveśānī once with these, / the entire threefold world rests in his hand, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrināthā yatrayatra kaṭākṣaṃ vikiratyasau /
tatratatra gatāśaṅkaṃ śatrusainyaṃ patatyalam //
meaning:
मन्त्रिनाथा यत्रयत्र कटाक्षं विकिरत्यसौ /
तत्रतत्र गताशङ्कं शत्रुसैन्यं पतत्यलम् //
text_mt: Wherever Mantrināthā casts her side-glance, / there the enemy army falls abundantly, all apprehension gone.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāparameśānyā rājyacarcā tu yāvatī /
śaktīnāmapi carcā yā sā sarvatra jayapradā //
meaning:
ललितापरमेशान्या राज्यचर्चा तु यावती /
शक्तीनामपि चर्चा या सा सर्वत्र जयप्रदा //
text_mt: Whatever governance Lalitā, the Supreme Sovereign, possesses, / and whatever governance the śaktis possess, it grants victory everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
atha saṃgītayoginyāḥ karasthācchukapotakāt /
nirjagāma dhanurvedo vahansajjaṃśarāsanam //
meaning:
अथ संगीतयोगिन्याः करस्थाच्छुकपोतकात् /
निर्जगाम धनुर्वेदो वहन्सज्जंशरासनम् //
text_mt: Then, from the young parrot perched upon the hand of the Saṃgītayoginī, / Dhanurveda emerged, bearing a strung bow.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbāhuyuto vīrastriśirāstrivilocanaḥ /
namaskṛtya pradhāneśīmidamāha sa bhaktimān //
meaning:
चतुर्बाहुयुतो वीरस्त्रिशिरास्त्रिविलोचनः /
नमस्कृत्य प्रधानेशीमिदमाह स भक्तिमान् //
text_mt: Possessed of four arms, heroic, three-headed, and three-eyed, / having bowed down to Pradhāneśī, the devout one spoke this:

sanskrit_iast:
devi bhaṇḍāsuredrasya yuddhāya tvaṃ pravarttase /
atastava mayā sāhyaṃ kartavyaṃ mantrināyike //
meaning:
देवि भण्डासुरेद्रस्य युद्धाय त्वं प्रवर्त्तसे /
अतस्तव मया साह्यं कर्तव्यं मन्त्रिनायिके //
text_mt: "O goddess, you are setting forth to do battle with the demon-king Bhaṇḍa; / therefore, assistance must be rendered by me, O Mantrināyikā.

sanskrit_iast:
catrajīvamimaṃ nāma kodaṇḍaṃ sumahattaram /
gṛhāṇa jagatāmaṃba dānavānāṃ nibarhaṇam //
meaning:
चत्रजीवमिमं नाम कोदण्डं सुमहत्तरम् /
गृहाण जगतामंब दानवानां निबर्हणम् //
text_mt: Take this exceedingly great bow named Citrajīva, / O Mother of the worlds, which destroys the dānavas!

sanskrit_iast:
imau cākṣayabāṇāḍhyau tūṇīrau svarṇacitritau /
gṛhāṇa daityanāśāya mamānugrahahetave //
meaning:
इमौ चाक्षयबाणाढ्यौ तूणीरौ स्वर्णचित्रितौ /
गृहाण दैत्यनाशाय ममानुग्रहहेतवे //
text_mt: And take these two quivers decorated with gold, filled with inexhaustible arrows, / for the destruction of the daityas and for the sake of blessing me!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti praṇamya śirasā dhanurvedena bhaktitaḥ /
arpitāṃścāpatūṇīrāñjagrāha priyakapriyā //
meaning:
इति प्रणम्य शिरसा धनुर्वेदेन भक्तितः /
अर्पितांश्चापतूणीराञ्जग्राह प्रियकप्रिया //
text_mt: Thus bowing with his head in devotion, / Priyakapriyā accepted the bow and quivers offered by Dhanurveda.

sanskrit_iast:
citrajīvaṃ mahācāpamādāya ca śūkapriyā /
visphāraṃ janayāmāsa maurvīmudvādya bhūriśaḥ //
meaning:
चित्रजीवं महाचापमादाय च शूकप्रिया /
विस्फारं जनयामास मौर्वीमुद्वाद्य भूरिशः //
text_mt: Taking the great bow Citrajīva, Śukapriyā / produced a loud twang, repeatedly plucking the bowstring.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃgītayoginī cāpadhvaninā pūritaṃ jagat /
nākālayānāṃ ca manona yanānandasaṃpadā //
meaning:
संगीतयोगिनी चापध्वनिना पूरितं जगत् /
नाकालयानां च मनोन यनानन्दसंपदा //
text_mt: The world was filled with the sound of the bow of the Saṃgītayoginī, / and the minds of the dwellers of heaven were filled with a wealth of visual delight.

sanskrit_iast:
yantriṇī ceti dve tasyāḥ paricārike /
śukaṃ vīṇāṃ ca sahasā vahantyau pariceratuḥ //
meaning:
यन्त्रिणी चेति द्वे तस्याः परिचारिके /
शुकं वीणां च सहसा वहन्त्यौ परिचेरतुः //
text_mt: […] and Yantriṇī, her two attendants, / quickly attended upon her, carrying the parrot and the vīṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
ālolavalayakvāṇavardhiṣṇuguṇanisvanam /
dhārayantī ghanaśyāmā cakārātimanoharam //
meaning:
आलोलवलयक्वाणवर्धिष्णुगुणनिस्वनम् /
धारयन्ती घनश्यामा चकारातिमनोहरम् //
text_mt: Holding [the bow], she who is dark as a rain-cloud made [it] exceedingly captivating, / the twang of the string swelling with the jingling of her tremulous bracelets.

sanskrit_iast:
citrajīvaśarāsena bhūṣitā gītayoginī /
kadaṃbinīva ruruce kadambacchatrakārmukā //
meaning:
चित्रजीवशरासेन भूषिता गीतयोगिनी /
कदंबिनीव रुरुचे कदम्बच्छत्रकार्मुका //
text_mt: Adorned with the Citrajīva bow, Gītayoginī / shone like a bank of clouds with an umbrella and bow of kadamba [blossoms].

sanskrit_iast:
kālīkaṭākṣavattīkṣṇo nṛtyadbhujagabhīṣaṇaḥ /
ullasandakṣiṇe pāṇau vilalāsa śilīmukhaḥ //
meaning:
कालीकटाक्षवत्तीक्ष्णो नृत्यद्भुजगभीषणः /
उल्लसन्दक्षिणे पाणौ विललास शिलीमुखः //
text_mt: Sharp as the side-glance of Kālī, terrifying as a dancing serpent, / an arrow glittered, shining in her right hand.

sanskrit_iast:
geyacakrarathārūḍhāṃ tāṃ paścācca siṣevire /
tadvacchyāmalaśobhāḍhyā devyo bāṇadhanurdharāḥ //
meaning:
गेयचक्ररथारूढां तां पश्चाच्च सिषेविरे /
तद्वच्छ्यामलशोभाढ्या देव्यो बाणधनुर्धराः //
text_mt: And behind her, mounted on the Geyacakra chariot, / goddesses endowed with dark splendor, bearing bows and arrows, attended upon her—

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣauhiṇīsaṃkhyāstīvravegā madālasāḥ /
āpūrayantyaḥ kakubhaṃ kalaiḥ kilikilāravaiḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne daṇḍanāthāśyāmalāsenāyātrā nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सहस्राक्षौहिणीसंख्यास्तीव्रवेगा मदालसाः /
आपूरयन्त्यः ककुभं कलैः किलिकिलारवैः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने दण्डनाथाश्यामलासेनायात्रा नाम सप्तदशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
a thousand akṣauhiṇīs in number, of fierce speed, languid with intoxication, / filling the quarters of the sky with melodious shouts of joy.

Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'The March of the Armies of Daṇḍanāthā and Śyāmalā', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
atha rājanāyikā śritājvalitāṅkuśā phaṇisamānapāśabhṛt /
kalanikvaṇadvalayamaikṣvaṃ dhanurdadhatī pradīptakusumeṣupañcakā //
meaning:
अथ राजनायिका श्रिताज्वलिताङ्कुशा फणिसमानपाशभृत् /
कलनिक्वणद्वलयमैक्ष्वं धनुर्दधती प्रदीप्तकुसुमेषुपञ्चका //
text_mt: Then Rājanāyikā, holding a blazing goad, holding a noose resembling a serpent, / bearing a sugarcane bow with gently tinkling bracelets, and holding the five flaming flower-arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
udayatsahatsramahasā sahasrato 'pyatipāṭalaṃ nijavapuḥ prabhājharam /
kiratī diśāsu vadanasya kāntibhiḥ sṛjatīva candramayamabhramaṇḍalam //
meaning:
उदयत्सहत्स्रमहसा सहस्रतो ऽप्यतिपाटलं निजवपुः प्रभाझरम् /
किरती दिशासु वदनस्य कान्तिभिः सृजतीव चन्द्रमयमभ्रमण्डलम् //
text_mt: scattering into the directions a stream of radiance from her own body, far redder than a thousand rising suns, / as if creating a sky-orb composed of moons by the splendors of her face,

sanskrit_iast:
daśayojanāyatimātā jagattrayīmabhivṛṇvatā viśadamauktikātmanā /
dhavalātapatravalayena bhāsurā śaśimaṇḍalasya sakhitāmupeyuṣā //
meaning:
दशयोजनायतिमाता जगत्त्रयीमभिवृण्वता विशदमौक्तिकात्मना /
धवलातपत्रवलयेन भासुरा शशिमण्डलस्य सखितामुपेयुषा //
text_mt: shining with a circle of a white parasol, ten yojanas in extent, / covering the three worlds, made of pure pearls, attaining friendship with the disc of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
abhivījitā ca maṇikāntaśobhinā vijayādimukhyaparicārikāgaṇaiḥ /
navacandrikālaharikāntikandalīcatureṇa cāmaracatuṣṭayena ca //
meaning:
अभिवीजिता च मणिकान्तशोभिना विजयादिमुख्यपरिचारिकागणैः /
नवचन्द्रिकालहरिकान्तिकन्दलीचतुरेण चामरचतुष्टयेन च //
text_mt: fanned by the host of principal attendants beginning with Vijayā, radiant with lovely gems, / and by four chowries skilled at sprouting sprays of brilliance like waves of fresh moonlight,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyaikarājyapadavīmabhisūcayantī sāmrājyacihnaśatamaṇḍitasainyadeśā /
saṃgītavādyaracanābhirathāmarīṇāṃ saṃstūyamānavibhavā viśadaprakāśā //
meaning:
शक्त्यैकराज्यपदवीमभिसूचयन्ती साम्राज्यचिह्नशतमण्डितसैन्यदेशा /
संगीतवाद्यरचनाभिरथामरीणां संस्तूयमानविभवा विशदप्रकाशा //
text_mt: manifesting the status of sole sovereignty over the śaktis, her army-realm adorned with hundreds of signs of imperial rule, / her majesty praised by immortal women with arrangements of music and instruments, her splendor clear,

sanskrit_iast: vācāmagocaramagocarameva buddherīdṛktayā na kalanīyamananyatulyam //
meaning: वाचामगोचरमगोचरमेव बुद्धेरीदृक्तया न कलनीयमनन्यतुल्यम् //
text_mt: beyond the range of words, beyond the very range of intellect, not to be conceived in such a manner, peerless,

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyagarbhaparipūritaśakticakrasāmrājyasaṃpadabhimānamabhispṛśantī /
ābaddhabhaktivipulāñjaliśekharāṇāmārādahaṃprathamikā kṛtasevanānām //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यगर्भपरिपूरितशक्तिचक्रसाम्राज्यसंपदभिमानमभिस्पृशन्ती /
आबद्धभक्तिविपुलाञ्जलिशेखराणामारादहंप्रथमिका कृतसेवनानाम् //
text_mt: touching the pride of the imperial wealth of the cakra of śaktis that filled the interior of the three worlds, / served from near at hand by those competing to be first, who bound high añjalis of devotion upon their heads,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmeśaviṣṇuvṛṣamukhyasurottamānāṃ vaktrāṇivarṣitanutīni kaṭākṣayantī /
uddīptapuṣpaśarapañcakataḥ samutthaijyotirmayaṃ tribhuvanaṃ sahasā dadhānā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मेशविष्णुवृषमुख्यसुरोत्तमानां वक्त्राणिवर्षितनुतीनि कटाक्षयन्ती /
उद्दीप्तपुष्पशरपञ्चकतः समुत्थैज्योतिर्मयं त्रिभुवनं सहसा दधाना //
text_mt: side-glancing at the faces showering praise of the foremost gods headed by Brahmā, Īśa, Viṣṇu, and the Bull[-bannered Śiva], / suddenly holding the three worlds filled with light arising from her five blazing flower-arrows—

sanskrit_iast:
vidyutsamadyutibhirapsarasāṃ samūhairvikṣipyamāṇajayamaṅgalalājavarṣā /
kāmeśvarīprabhṛtibhiḥ kamanīyabhābhiḥ saṃgrāmaveṣaracanāsumanoharābhiḥ //
meaning:
विद्युत्समद्युतिभिरप्सरसां समूहैर्विक्षिप्यमाणजयमङ्गललाजवर्षा /
कामेश्वरीप्रभृतिभिः कमनीयभाभिः संग्रामवेषरचनासुमनोहराभिः //
text_mt: Shower of auspicious parched grain tossed by crowds of Apsarases with lightning-like luster, / with Kāmeśvarī and the others of lovely radiance, exceedingly enchanting in their array of battle-attire,

sanskrit_iast:
dīptāyudhadyutitiraskṛta bhāskarābhirnityābhiraṅghrisavidhe samupākyamānā /
śrīcakranāmatilakaṃ daśayojanātituṅgadhvajollikhitameghakadaṃbamuccaiḥ //
meaning:
दीप्तायुधद्युतितिरस्कृत भास्कराभिर्नित्याभिरङ्घ्रिसविधे समुपाक्यमाना /
श्रीचक्रनामतिलकं दशयोजनातितुङ्गध्वजोल्लिखितमेघकदंबमुच्चैः //
text_mt: attended close to her feet by the Nityās whose weapons' luster eclipsed the sun, / while high aloft, the crowning emblem named the Śrīcakra, having a pennant ten yojanas high, brushed the mass of clouds,

sanskrit_iast:
tīvrābhirāvaṇasuśaktiparaṃparabhiryuktaṃ rathaṃ samarakarmaṇi cālayantī /
prodyatpiśaṅgarucibhāgamalāṃśukena vītāmanohararucissamare vyabhāsīt //
meaning:
तीव्राभिरावणसुशक्तिपरंपरभिर्युक्तं रथं समरकर्मणि चालयन्ती /
प्रोद्यत्पिशङ्गरुचिभागमलांशुकेन वीतामनोहररुचिस्समरे व्यभासीत् //
text_mt: driving in the work of battle her chariot equipped with succession after succession of fierce, splendid Śaktis, / clad in a garment of flawless cloth possessing a rising reddish-yellow glow, she shone with enchanting radiance in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcādhikairviśatināmaratnaiḥ prapañcapāpapraśamātidakṣaiḥ /
saṃstūyamānā lalitā marudbhiḥ saṃgrāmamuddiśya samuccacāla //
meaning:
पञ्चाधिकैर्विशतिनामरत्नैः प्रपञ्चपापप्रशमातिदक्षैः /
संस्तूयमाना ललिता मरुद्भिः संग्राममुद्दिश्य समुच्चचाल //
text_mt: Praised by the Maruts with twenty-five gem-like names / most capable of quelling the sins of worldly manifestation, Lalitā set forth toward the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
vījivaktra mahābuddhe pañcaviṃśatināmabhiḥ /
lalitāparameśānyā dehi karṇarasāyanam //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
वीजिवक्त्र महाबुद्धे पञ्चविंशतिनामभिः /
ललितापरमेशान्या देहि कर्णरसायनम् //
text_mt: Agastya said: / O horse-faced one of vast intellect, grant as an elixir to the ears / the twenty-five names of the supreme sovereign Lalitā!

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
siṃhāsanā śrīlalitā mahārājñī parāṅkuśā /
cāpinī tripurā caiva mahātripurasundarī //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
सिंहासना श्रीललिता महाराज्ञी पराङ्कुशा /
चापिनी त्रिपुरा चैव महात्रिपुरसुन्दरी //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Siṃhāsanā, Śrīlalitā, Mahārājñī, Parāṅkuśā, / Cāpinī, Tripurā, and Mahātripurasundarī,

sanskrit_iast:
sundarī cakranāthā ca sāmrājī cakriṇī tathā /
cakreśvarī mahādevī kāmeśī parameśvarī //
meaning:
सुन्दरी चक्रनाथा च साम्राजी चक्रिणी तथा /
चक्रेश्वरी महादेवी कामेशी परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: Sundarī, Cakranāthā, Sāmrājñī, and Cakriṇī, / Cakreśvarī, Mahādevī, Kāmeśī, Parameśvarī,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarājapriyā kāmakoṭigā cakravartinī /
mahāvidyā śivānaṅgavallabhā sarvapāṭalā //
meaning:
कामराजप्रिया कामकोटिगा चक्रवर्तिनी /
महाविद्या शिवानङ्गवल्लभा सर्वपाटला //
text_mt: Kāmarājapriyā, Kāmakoṭigā, Cakravartinī, / Mahāvidyā, Śivā, Anaṅgavallabhā, Sarvapāṭalā,

sanskrit_iast:
kulanāthāmnāyanāthā sarvāmnāyanivāsinī /
śṛṅgāranāyikā ceti pañcaviṃśatināmabhiḥ //
meaning:
कुलनाथाम्नायनाथा सर्वाम्नायनिवासिनी /
शृङ्गारनायिका चेति पञ्चविंशतिनामभिः //
text_mt: Kulanāthā, Āmnāyanāthā, Sarvāmnāyanivāsinī, / and Śṛṅgāranāyikā—with these twenty-five names,

sanskrit_iast:
stuvanti ye mahābhāgāṃ lalitāṃ parameśvarīm /
te prāpnuvanti saubhāgyamaṣṭau siddhīrmahadyaśaḥ //
meaning:
स्तुवन्ति ये महाभागां ललितां परमेश्वरीम् /
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति सौभाग्यमष्टौ सिद्धीर्महद्यशः //
text_mt: those who praise the illustrious supreme sovereign Lalitā / attain good fortune, the eight supernatural powers, and great renown.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pracaṇḍasaṃraṃbhaṃ cālayantī mahadbalam /
bhaṇḍāsuraṃ prati kruddhā cacāla lalitāṃbikā //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne lalitāparameśvarīsenājaya yātrā nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इत्थं प्रचण्डसंरंभं चालयन्ती महद्बलम् /
भण्डासुरं प्रति क्रुद्धा चचाल ललितांबिका //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने ललितापरमेश्वरीसेनाजय यात्रा नामाष्टादशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus mobilizing that great force with fierce impetuosity, / Mother Lalitā, enraged against the demon Bhaṇḍa, marched forth.

Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named ‘The Victory March of the Supreme Sovereign Lalitā’s Army’, in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
cakrarājarathendrasya yāḥparvaṇi samāśritāḥ /
devatā prakaṭābhikhyāstāsāmākhyāṃ nivedaya //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
चक्रराजरथेन्द्रस्य याःपर्वणि समाश्रिताः /
देवता प्रकटाभिख्यास्तासामाख्यां निवेदय //
text_mt: Agastya said: / The deities situated on the steps of the foremost chariot of the Cakrarāja, / known as the Prakaṭa deities—reveal their names,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyāśca tāsāmakhilā varṇabhedāṃśca śobhanān /
āyudhāni ca divyāni kathayasva hayānana //
meaning:
संख्याश्च तासामखिला वर्णभेदांश्च शोभनान् /
आयुधानि च दिव्यानि कथयस्व हयानन //
text_mt: and all their numbers, their splendid distinctions of color, / and their divine weapons; declare them, O horse-faced one!

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
navamaṃ parva dīptasya rathasya samupasthitāḥ /
taśa proktā siddhidevyastāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
नवमं पर्व दीप्तस्य रथस्य समुपस्थिताः /
तश प्रोक्ता सिद्धिदेव्यस्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Stationed on the ninth step of that blazing chariot / are ten goddesses of supernatural powers; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimā mahimācaiva laghimā garimā tathā /
īśitā vaśitā caiva prāptiḥ siddhiśca saptamī //
meaning:
अणिमा महिमाचैव लघिमा गरिमा तथा /
ईशिता वशिता चैव प्राप्तिः सिद्धिश्च सप्तमी //
text_mt: Aṇimā, Mahimā, Laghimā, and Garimā, / Īśitā, Vaśitā, and Prāpti as the seventh siddhi,

sanskrit_iast:
prākāmyamuktisiddhiśca sarvakāmābhidhāparā /
etādevyaścaturbāhvyo japākusumasaṃnibhāḥ //
meaning:
प्राकाम्यमुक्तिसिद्धिश्च सर्वकामाभिधापरा /
एतादेव्यश्चतुर्बाह्व्यो जपाकुसुमसंनिभाः //
text_mt: Prākāmya, Muktisiddhi, and the supreme one named Sarvakāmā. / These four-armed goddesses resemble hibiscus flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇikapālaṃ ca triśūlaṃ siddhikajjalam /
dadhānā dayayā pūrṇā yogibhiśca niṣevitāḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिकपालं च त्रिशूलं सिद्धिकज्जलम् /
दधाना दयया पूर्णा योगिभिश्च निषेविताः //
text_mt: holding the wish-fulfilling jewel, a skull-bowl, a trident, and the collyrium of supernatural powers, / they are filled with compassion and attended upon by yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pūrvārddhabhāge ca brahmādyā aṣṭa śaktayaḥ /
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣmavī tathā /
vārāhī caiva māṃhendrī cāmuṇḍā caiva saptamī //
meaning:
तत्र पूर्वार्द्धभागे च ब्रह्माद्या अष्ट शक्तयः /
ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्मवी तथा /
वाराही चैव मांहेन्द्री चामुण्डा चैव सप्तमी //
text_mt: And there, in the eastern half, are the eight Śaktis beginning with Brahmā: / Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, / Vārāhī, Māhendrī, and Cāmuṇḍā as the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmīraṣṭamī ca dvibhujāḥ śoṇavigrahāḥ /
kapālamutpalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇā raktavāsasaḥ //
meaning:
महालक्ष्मीरष्टमी च द्विभुजाः शोणविग्रहाः /
कपालमुत्पलं चैव बिभ्राणा रक्तवाससः //
text_mt: and Mahālakṣmī as the eighth; two-armed, with red-hued bodies, / bearing a skull-bowl and a blue lotus, clad in red garments.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vānya prakāreṇa keciddhyānaṃ pacakṣate /
brahmādisadṛśākārā brahmādisadṛśāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
अथ वान्य प्रकारेण केचिद्ध्यानं पचक्षते /
ब्रह्मादिसदृशाकारा ब्रह्मादिसदृशायुधाः //
text_mt: Or else, according to another manner, some declare their meditation: / having forms resembling Brahmā and the others, weapons resembling Brahmā and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāṃ paraṃ cihnaṃ dhārayantyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ /
tāsāmūrdhvasthānagatāṃ mudrā devyo mahattarāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनां परं चिह्नं धारयन्त्यः प्रकीर्तिताः /
तासामूर्ध्वस्थानगतां मुद्रा देव्यो महत्तराः //
text_mt: they are proclaimed as bearing the supreme emblems of Brahmā and the rest. / Located in the upper position above them are the exalted Mudrā goddesses:

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāviracanāyuktairhastaiḥ kamalakāntibhiḥ /
dāḍimīpuṣpasaṅkāśāḥ pītāṃbaramanoharāḥ //
meaning:
मुद्राविरचनायुक्तैर्हस्तैः कमलकान्तिभिः /
दाडिमीपुष्पसङ्काशाः पीतांबरमनोहराः //
text_mt: with hands formed in the shapes of mudrās, possessing the beauty of lotuses, / resembling pomegranate blossoms, captivating in yellow garments,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhujā bhujadvandvadhṛtacarmakṛpāṇakāḥ /
madaraktavilolākṣyastāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu //
meaning:
चतुर्भुजा भुजद्वन्द्वधृतचर्मकृपाणकाः /
मदरक्तविलोलाक्ष्यस्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु //
text_mt: four-armed, bearing shields and swords in a pair of arms, / with restless eyes reddened by intoxicating passion; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā /
sarvākarṣaṇakṛnmudrā tathā sarvavaśaṅkarī //
meaning:
सर्वसंक्षोभिणी चैव सर्वविद्राविणी तथा /
सर्वाकर्षणकृन्मुद्रा तथा सर्ववशङ्करी //
text_mt: Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī, Sarvavidrāviṇī, / the mudrā Sarvākarṣaṇakṛt, and Sarvavaśaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvonmādanamudrā ca yaṣṭiḥ sarvamahāṅkuśā /
sarvakhecarikā mudrā sarvabījā tathāparā //
meaning:
सर्वोन्मादनमुद्रा च यष्टिः सर्वमहाङ्कुशा /
सर्वखेचरिका मुद्रा सर्वबीजा तथापरा //
text_mt: Sarvonmādanamudrā, the staff Sarvamahāṅkuśā, / the mudrā Sarvakhecarī, another named Sarvabījā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayoniśca navamī tathā sarvatriśaṇḍikā /
siddhibrāhayādimudrāstā etāḥ prakaṭaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वयोनिश्च नवमी तथा सर्वत्रिशण्डिका /
सिद्धिब्राहयादिमुद्रास्ता एताः प्रकटशक्तयः //
text_mt: Sarvayoni as the ninth, and Sarvatrikhaṇḍikā. / These mudrās, together with the Siddhis, Brāhmī, and the rest, are the Prakaṭa Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsurasya saṃhāraṃ kartuṃ raktarathe sthitāḥ /
yā guptākhyāḥ pūrvamuktāstāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu //
meaning:
भण्डासुरस्य संहारं कर्तुं रक्तरथे स्थिताः /
या गुप्ताख्याः पूर्वमुक्तास्तासां नामानि मच्छृणु //
text_mt: Stationed on the red chariot to bring about the destruction of the demon Bhaṇḍa, / those previously mentioned under the name Guptā—hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākarṣaṇikā caiva buddhyākarṣaṇikā kalā /
ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī ca śabdākarṣaṇikā kalā //
meaning:
कामाकर्षणिका चैव बुद्ध्याकर्षणिका कला /
अहङ्काराकर्षिणी च शब्दाकर्षणिका कला //
text_mt: Kāmākarṣaṇikā, the digit Buddhyākarṣaṇikā, / Ahaṅkārākarṣiṇī, and the digit Śabdākarṣaṇikā,

sanskrit_iast:
sparśākarṣaṇikā nityā rūpākarṣaṇikā kalā /
rasākarṣaṇikā nityā gandhākarṣaṇikā kalā //
meaning:
स्पर्शाकर्षणिका नित्या रूपाकर्षणिका कला /
रसाकर्षणिका नित्या गन्धाकर्षणिका कला //
text_mt: the Nityā Sparśākarṣaṇikā, the digit Rūpākarṣaṇikā, / the Nityā Rasākarṣaṇikā, the digit Gandhākarṣaṇikā,

sanskrit_iast:
cittākarṣaṇikā nityā dhairyākarṣaṇikā kalā /
smṛtyā karṣaṇikā nityā nāmākarṇaṇikā kalā //
meaning:
चित्ताकर्षणिका नित्या धैर्याकर्षणिका कला /
स्मृत्या कर्षणिका नित्या नामाकर्णणिका कला //
text_mt: the Nityā Cittākarṣaṇikā, the digit Dhairyākarṣaṇikā, / the Nityā Smṛtyākarṣaṇikā, the digit Nāmākarṣaṇikā,

sanskrit_iast:
bījākarṣaṇikā nityā cātmakarṣaṇikā kalā /
amṛtākarṣaṇī nityā śarīrākarṣiṇī kalā //
meaning:
बीजाकर्षणिका नित्या चात्मकर्षणिका कला /
अमृताकर्षणी नित्या शरीराकर्षिणी कला //
text_mt: the Nityā Bījākarṣaṇikā, the digit Ātmākarṣaṇikā, / the Nityā Amṛtākarṣiṇī, and the digit Śarīrākarṣiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ ṣoḍaśa śītāṃśukalārūpāśca śaktayaḥ /
aṣṭamaṃ parva samprāptā guptā nāmnā prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
एताः षोडश शीतांशुकलारूपाश्च शक्तयः /
अष्टमं पर्व सम्प्राप्ता गुप्ता नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: These sixteen Śaktis embody the digits of the cool-rayed moon; / stationed on the eighth step, they are renowned by the name Guptā.

sanskrit_iast:
vidrumadrumasaṅkāśā mandasmita manoharāḥ /
caturbhujāstrinetrāśca candrārkamukujojjvalāḥ //
meaning:
विद्रुमद्रुमसङ्काशा मन्दस्मित मनोहराः /
चतुर्भुजास्त्रिनेत्राश्च चन्द्रार्कमुकुजोज्ज्वलाः //
text_mt: Resembling coral trees, captivating with gentle smiles, / four-armed, three-eyed, radiant with crowns bearing the moon and sun,

sanskrit_iast:
cāpabāṇau carmakhaḍgau dadhānā divyakāntayaḥ /
bhaṇḍāsuravadhārthāya pravṛttāḥ kumbhasambhava //
meaning:
चापबाणौ चर्मखड्गौ दधाना दिव्यकान्तयः /
भण्डासुरवधार्थाय प्रवृत्ताः कुम्भसम्भव //
text_mt: bearing bow, arrow, shield, and sword, of divine radiance, / they set forth for the slaying of the demon Bhaṇḍa, O pot-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyantanajvaladdīpaprakhyacakrarathasya tu /
saptame parvaṇi kṛtāvāsā guptatarābhidhāḥ //
meaning:
सायन्तनज्वलद्दीपप्रख्यचक्ररथस्य तु /
सप्तमे पर्वणि कृतावासा गुप्ततराभिधाः //
text_mt: Now, having made their abode on the seventh step / of the chariot-cakra that resembles a lamp burning in the evening, those named Guptatarā [stand]:

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgamadanānaṅgamadanāturayā saha /
anaṅgalekhā cānaṅgavegānaṅgāṅkuśāpi ca //
meaning:
अनङ्गमदनानङ्गमदनातुरया सह /
अनङ्गलेखा चानङ्गवेगानङ्गाङ्कुशापि च //
text_mt: Anaṅgamadanā, together with Anaṅgamadanāturā, / Anaṅgalekhā, Anaṅgavegā, Anaṅgāṅkuśā,

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgamāligyaparā etā devyo japātviṣaḥ /
ikṣucāpaṃ puṣpaśarānpuṣpakandukamutpalam //
meaning:
अनङ्गमालिग्यपरा एता देव्यो जपात्विषः /
इक्षुचापं पुष्पशरान्पुष्पकन्दुकमुत्पलम् //
text_mt: and the supreme Anaṅgamālinī. These goddesses have the luster of hibiscus flowers; / holding a sugarcane bow, flower arrows, a flower ball, and a blue lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratyo 'dabhravikrāntiśālinyo lalitājñayā /
bhaṇḍāsuramabhikruddhāḥ prajvalantya iva sthitāḥ //
meaning:
बिभ्रत्यो ऽदभ्रविक्रान्तिशालिन्यो ललिताज्ञया /
भण्डासुरमभिक्रुद्धाः प्रज्वलन्त्य इव स्थिताः //
text_mt: endowed with immense prowess by Lalitā's command, / they stood as if blazing with rage against the demon Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cakrarathendrasya ṣaṣṭhaṃ parva samāśritāḥ /
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyāḥ sampradāyākhyayā yutāḥ //
meaning:
अथ चक्ररथेन्द्रस्य षष्ठं पर्व समाश्रिताः /
सर्वसंक्षोभिणीमुख्याः सम्प्रदायाख्यया युताः //
text_mt: Now, stationed on the sixth step of the foremost chariot-cakra / are those headed by Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī, designated by the name Sampradāya.

sanskrit_iast:
veṇīkṛtakacastomāḥ siṃdūratilakojjvalāḥ /
atitīvrasvabhāvāśca kālānalasamatviṣaḥ //
meaning:
वेणीकृतकचस्तोमाः सिंदूरतिलकोज्ज्वलाः /
अतितीव्रस्वभावाश्च कालानलसमत्विषः //
text_mt: With masses of hair braided, radiant with red sindūra marks, / of exceedingly fierce disposition, having a luster like the fire of cosmic dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnibāṇaṃ vahnicāpaṃ vahnirūpamasiṃ tathā /
vahnicakrākhyāphalakaṃ dadhānā dīptavigrahāḥ //
meaning:
वह्निबाणं वह्निचापं वह्निरूपमसिं तथा /
वह्निचक्राख्याफलकं दधाना दीप्तविग्रहाः //
text_mt: bearing an arrow of fire, a bow of fire, a sword of the nature of fire, / and a shield named fire-cakra, their bodies are radiant with light.

sanskrit_iast:
asurendraṃ prati kruddhāḥ kāmabhasmasamudbhavāḥ /
ājñāśaktaya evaitā lalitāyā mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
असुरेन्द्रं प्रति क्रुद्धाः कामभस्मसमुद्भवाः /
आज्ञाशक्तय एवैता ललिताया महौजसः //
text_mt: Enraged against the lord of demons, arisen from the ashes of Kāma, / these are indeed the command-Śaktis of Lalitā, possessing great splendor:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathā /
sarvākarṣaṇikā śaktiḥ sarvāhlādinikā tathā //
meaning:
सर्वसंक्षोभिणी चैव सर्वविद्राविणी तथा /
सर्वाकर्षणिका शक्तिः सर्वाह्लादिनिका तथा //
text_mt: Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī, Sarvavidrāviṇī, / the Śakti Sarvākarṣaṇikā, and Sarvāhlādinikā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃmohinīśaktiḥ sarvastambhanaśaktikā /
sarvajṛṃbhaṇaśaktiśca sarvonmādanaśaktikā //
meaning:
सर्वसंमोहिनीशक्तिः सर्वस्तम्भनशक्तिका /
सर्वजृंभणशक्तिश्च सर्वोन्मादनशक्तिका //
text_mt: the Śakti Sarvasaṃmohinī, the Śakti Sarvastambhanā, / the Śakti Sarvajṛmbhaṇā, and the Śakti Sarvonmādanā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvārthasādhikā śaktiḥ sarvasampattipūraṇī /
sarvamantramayī śaktiḥ sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī //
meaning:
सर्वार्थसाधिका शक्तिः सर्वसम्पत्तिपूरणी /
सर्वमन्त्रमयी शक्तिः सर्वद्वन्द्वक्षयङ्करी //
text_mt: the Śakti Sarvārthasādhikā, Sarvasampattipūraṇī, / the Śakti Sarvamantramayī, and Sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ tu sampradāyānāṃ nāmāni kathitāni vai /
atha pañcamaparvasthāḥ kulottīrṇā iti smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
एवं तु सम्प्रदायानां नामानि कथितानि वै /
अथ पञ्चमपर्वस्थाः कुलोत्तीर्णा इति स्मृताः //
text_mt: Thus indeed the names of the [yoginī] lineages have been spoken. / Now those situated on the fifth tier are known as the Kulottīrṇās.

sanskrit_iast:
tāśca saptaṭikasaṅkāśāḥ paraśuṃ pāśameva ca /
gadāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ maṇiṃ caiva dadhānā dīptavigrahāḥ //
meaning:
ताश्च सप्तटिकसङ्काशाः परशुं पाशमेव च /
गदां घण्टां मणिं चैव दधाना दीप्तविग्रहाः //
text_mt: Resembling crystals, they bear a battle-axe and a noose, / a mace, a bell, and a jewel, their bodies blazing.

sanskrit_iast:
devadviṣamati kruddhā bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanāḥ /
etāsāmapi nāmāni samākarmaya kumbhaja //
meaning:
देवद्विषमति क्रुद्धा भ्रुकुटीकुटिलाननाः /
एतासामपि नामानि समाकर्मय कुम्भज //
text_mt: Furious toward the enemies of the gods, their faces curved with knit brows: / hear also their names, O pot-born [Agastya]!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhipradā devī sarvasampatpradā tathā /
sarvapriyaṅkarī devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī //
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा देवी सर्वसम्पत्प्रदा तथा /
सर्वप्रियङ्करी देवी सर्वमङ्गलकारिणी //
text_mt: The goddess Sarvasiddhipradā, and likewise Sarvasampatpradā, / the goddess Sarvapriyaṅkarī, Sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī,

sanskrit_iast: sarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocinī //
meaning: सर्वकामप्रदा देवी सर्वदुःखविमोचिनी //
text_mt: the goddess Sarvakāmapradā, Sarvaduḥkhavimocinī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamṛtyupraśaminī sarvavighnanivāriṇī /
sarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī //
meaning:
सर्वमृत्युप्रशमिनी सर्वविघ्ननिवारिणी /
सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी देवी सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनी //
text_mt: Sarvamṛtyupraśaminī, Sarvavighnanivāriṇī, / the goddess Sarvāṅgasundarī, [and] Sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaintāḥ kathitā devyo dayayā pūritāśayāḥ /
cakre turīyaparvasthā muktāhārasamatviṣaḥ //
meaning:
दशैन्ताः कथिता देव्यो दयया पूरिताशयाः /
चक्रे तुरीयपर्वस्था मुक्ताहारसमत्विषः //
text_mt: These ten goddesses are spoken of, their hearts filled with compassion. / Situated on the fourth tier of the cakra, having the luster of pearl necklaces,

sanskrit_iast:
nigarbhayoginīnāmnā prathitā daśa kīrtitāḥ /
sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradā tathā //
meaning:
निगर्भयोगिनीनाम्ना प्रथिता दश कीर्तिताः /
सर्वज्ञा सर्वशक्तिश्च सर्वैश्वर्यप्रदा तथा //
text_mt: ten are celebrated by the name Nigarbhayoginīs: / Sarvajñā, Sarvaśakti, and likewise Sarvaiśvaryapradā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñānamayī devī sarvavyādhivināśinī /
sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathā //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञानमयी देवी सर्वव्याधिविनाशिनी /
सर्वाधारस्वरूपा च सर्वपापहरा तथा //
text_mt: the goddess Sarvajñānamayī, Sarvavyādhivināśinī, / she who is Sarvādhārasvarūpā, and likewise Sarvapāpaharā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānandamayī devī sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī /
daśamī devatājñeyā sarveṣsitaphalapradā //
meaning:
सर्वानन्दमयी देवी सर्वरक्षास्वरूपिणी /
दशमी देवताज्ञेया सर्वेष्सितफलप्रदा //
text_mt: the goddess Sarvānandamayī, Sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī; / the tenth deity should be known as Sarvepsitaphalapradā.

sanskrit_iast:
etāścaturbhujā jñeyā vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca tomaram /
cakraṃ caivābhibibhrāṇā bhaṇḍāsuravadhodyatāḥ //
meaning:
एताश्चतुर्भुजा ज्ञेया वज्रं शक्तिं च तोमरम् /
चक्रं चैवाभिबिभ्राणा भण्डासुरवधोद्यताः //
text_mt: These should be known as four-armed, bearing a thunderbolt, a spear, a dart, / and a discus, ready for the slaying of the asura Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cakrarathendrasya tṛtīyaṃ parvasaṃśritāḥ /
rahasyayoginīnāmnā prakhyātā vāgadhīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
अथ चक्ररथेन्द्रस्य तृतीयं पर्वसंश्रिताः /
रहस्ययोगिनीनाम्ना प्रख्याता वागधीश्वराः //
text_mt: Now, stationed upon the third tier of the supreme chariot of the cakra, / celebrated by the name Rahasyayoginīs, are the presiding deities of speech.

sanskrit_iast:
raktāśokaprasūnābhābāṇakārmukapāṇayaḥ /
kavacacchannasarvāṅgayo vīṇāpustakaśobhitāḥ //
meaning:
रक्ताशोकप्रसूनाभाबाणकार्मुकपाणयः /
कवचच्छन्नसर्वाङ्गयो वीणापुस्तकशोभिताः //
text_mt: Having the luster of red Aśoka blossoms, holding arrows and bows in their hands, / their whole bodies covered in armor, adorned with vīṇās and books:

sanskrit_iast:
vaśinī caiva kāmeśī bhoginī vimalā tathā /
aruṇāca javinyākhyā sarveśī kaulinī tathā //
meaning:
वशिनी चैव कामेशी भोगिनी विमला तथा /
अरुणाच जविन्याख्या सर्वेशी कौलिनी तथा //
text_mt: Vaśinī, Kāmeśī, Bhoginī, and likewise Vimalā, / Aruṇā, the one named Javinī, Sarveśī, and likewise Kaulinī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāvetāḥ smṛtā devyo daityasaṃhārahetavaḥ /
atha cakrarathendrasya dvitīyaṃ parvasaṃśritāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टावेताः स्मृता देव्यो दैत्यसंहारहेतवः /
अथ चक्ररथेन्द्रस्य द्वितीयं पर्वसंश्रिताः //
text_mt: These eight goddesses are remembered as the cause of the destruction of the Daityas. / Now, stationed upon the second tier of the supreme chariot of the cakra,

sanskrit_iast:
cāpabāṇau pānapātraṃ māturuṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikām /
tisrastripīṭhanilayā aṣṭabāhusamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
चापबाणौ पानपात्रं मातुरुङ्गं कृपाणिकाम् /
तिस्रस्त्रिपीठनिलया अष्टबाहुसमन्विताः //
text_mt: holding bow and arrow, a drinking cup, a citron fruit, and a dagger, / three [goddesses] dwell in the three pīṭhas, endowed with eight arms;

sanskrit_iast:
palakaṃ nāgapāśaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ caiva mahādhvanim /
vibhrāṇā madirāmattā atiguptarahasyakāḥ //
meaning:
पलकं नागपाशं च घण्टां चैव महाध्वनिम् /
विभ्राणा मदिरामत्ता अतिगुप्तरहस्यकाः //
text_mt: holding a shield, a serpent-noose, and a bell of great sound, / intoxicated with wine, [they are] the most secret and esoteric ones:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśī caiva vajreśī bhagamālinyathāparā /
tisra etāḥ smṛtā devyo bhaṇḍe kopasamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
कामेशी चैव वज्रेशी भगमालिन्यथापरा /
तिस्र एताः स्मृता देव्यो भण्डे कोपसमन्विताः //
text_mt: Kāmeśī, Vajreśī, and then the other, Bhagamālinī. / These three goddesses are remembered, filled with wrath toward Bhaṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāsamamāhātmyā lalitāsamatejasaḥ /
etāstu nityaṃ śrīdevyā antaraṅgāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
ललितासममाहात्म्या ललितासमतेजसः /
एतास्तु नित्यं श्रीदेव्या अन्तरङ्गाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: possessing majesty equal to Lalitā, possessing splendor equal to Lalitā. / These are celebrated as the intimate companions of the auspicious Goddess at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
athānandamahāpīṭhe rathamadhyamaparvaṇi /
parito racitāvāsāḥ proktāḥ pañcadaśākṣarāḥ //
meaning:
अथानन्दमहापीठे रथमध्यमपर्वणि /
परितो रचितावासाः प्रोक्ताः पञ्चदशाक्षराः //
text_mt: Now, upon the great pīṭha of bliss, on the central tier of the chariot, / with residences arranged all around, are spoken the fifteen-syllabled ones,

sanskrit_iast:
tithinityāḥ kālarūpā viśvaṃ vyāpyaiva saṃsthitāḥ /
bhaṇḍāsurādidaityeṣu prakṣubdhabhrukuṭītaṭāḥ //
meaning:
तिथिनित्याः कालरूपा विश्वं व्याप्यैव संस्थिताः /
भण्डासुरादिदैत्येषु प्रक्षुब्धभ्रुकुटीतटाः //
text_mt: the Nityās of the lunar days, who are forms of time, abiding pervading the entire universe, / their knit brows trembling with fury against the Daityas headed by the asura Bhaṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
devīsamanijākārā devīsamanijāyudhāḥ /
jagatāmupakārāya vartamānā yugeyuge //
meaning:
देवीसमनिजाकारा देवीसमनिजायुधाः /
जगतामुपकाराय वर्तमाना युगेयुगे //
text_mt: having forms equal to the Goddess, having weapons equal to the Goddess, / operating age after age for the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ nāmāni mattastvamavadhārayakumbhaja /
kāmeśī bhagamālā ca nityaklinnā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
तासां नामानि मत्तस्त्वमवधारयकुम्भज /
कामेशी भगमाला च नित्यक्लिन्ना तथैव च //
text_mt: Learn their names from me, O pot-born [Agastya]: / Kāmeśī, Bhagamālā, and likewise Nityaklinnā,

sanskrit_iast:
bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinyo mahāvajreśvarī tathā /
datī ca tvaritā devī navamī kulasundarī //
meaning:
भेरुण्डा वह्निवासिन्यो महावज्रेश्वरी तथा /
दती च त्वरिता देवी नवमी कुलसुन्दरी //
text_mt: Bheruṇḍā, Vahnivāsinī, and Mahāvajreśvarī, / Dūtī, the goddess Tvaritā, the ninth Kulasundarī,

sanskrit_iast:
nityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā /
jvālāmālinikācitre daśa pañca ca kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
नित्या नीलपताका च विजया सर्वमङ्गला /
ज्वालामालिनिकाचित्रे दश पञ्च च कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Nityā, Nīlapatākā, Vijayā, Sarvamaṅgalā, / Jvālāmālinī, and Citrā: thus fifteen are celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
etābhiḥ sahitā devī sadā sevaikabuddhibhiḥ /
duṣṭaṃ bhaṇḍāsuraṃ jetuṃ niryayau parameśvarī //
meaning:
एताभिः सहिता देवी सदा सेवैकबुद्धिभिः /
दुष्टं भण्डासुरं जेतुं निर्ययौ परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: Accompanied by these, whose minds are always single-pointed in service, / the Supreme Goddess set forth to conquer the evil asura Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrināthā mahācakre gītiṃ cakre rathottame /
saptaparvāṇi coktāni tatra devyāśca tāḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
मन्त्रिनाथा महाचक्रे गीतिं चक्रे रथोत्तमे /
सप्तपर्वाणि चोक्तानि तत्र देव्याश्च ताः शृणु //
text_mt: The sovereign Mantriṇī is in the great cakra, the supreme chariot named Geyacakra. / Seven tiers are declared there; hear of those goddesses belonging to her:

sanskrit_iast:
geyacakrarathe parvamadhyapīḍhaniketanā /
saṃgītayoginī proktā śrīdevyā ativallabhā //
meaning:
गेयचक्ररथे पर्वमध्यपीढनिकेतना /
संगीतयोगिनी प्रोक्ता श्रीदेव्या अतिवल्लभा //
text_mt: In the Geyacakra chariot, having her abode in the central pīṭha of the tier, / Saṃgītayoginī is spoken of, dearly beloved of the auspicious Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva prathamaṃ parva mantriṇyāstu nivāsabhūḥ /
atha dvitīyaparvasthā geyacakre rathottame //
meaning:
तदेव प्रथमं पर्व मन्त्रिण्यास्तु निवासभूः /
अथ द्वितीयपर्वस्था गेयचक्रे रथोत्तमे //
text_mt: That very first tier is the dwelling place of Mantriṇī. / Now, stationed upon the second tier in the supreme Geyacakra chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
ratiḥ prītirmanojā ca vīṇākārmukapāṇayaḥ /
tamālaśyāmalākārā dānavonmūlanakṣamāḥ //
meaning:
रतिः प्रीतिर्मनोजा च वीणाकार्मुकपाणयः /
तमालश्यामलाकारा दानवोन्मूलनक्षमाः //
text_mt: are Rati, Prīti, and Manojā, holding vīṇās and bows in hand, / dark like tamāla trees in appearance, capable of uprooting the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaparvasaṃrūḍhā manobhūbāṇadevatā /
drāviṇī śoṣiṇī caiva bandhinī mohinī tathā //
meaning:
तृतीयपर्वसंरूढा मनोभूबाणदेवता /
द्राविणी शोषिणी चैव बन्धिनी मोहिनी तथा //
text_mt: Mounted upon the third tier are the deities of the arrows of the mind-born [Kāma]: / Drāviṇī, Śoṣiṇī, Bandhinī, Mohinī,

sanskrit_iast:
unmādinīti pañcaitā dīptakārmukapāṇayaḥ /
tatra parvaṇyadhastāttu vartamānā mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
उन्मादिनीति पञ्चैता दीप्तकार्मुकपाणयः /
तत्र पर्वण्यधस्तात्तु वर्तमाना महौजसः //
text_mt: and Unmādinī: these five, holding blazing bows in hand. / Stationed directly below on that tier are the ones of great splendor:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmarājaśca kandarpauṃ manmatho makaradhvajaḥ /
manobhavaḥ pañcamaḥ syādete trailokyamohanāḥ //
meaning:
कामराजश्च कन्दर्पौं मन्मथो मकरध्वजः /
मनोभवः पञ्चमः स्यादेते त्रैलोक्यमोहनाः //
text_mt: Kāmarāja, Kandarpa, Manmatha, Makaradhvaja, / and Manobhava is the fifth: these bewitch the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
kastūrītilakollāsibhālāmuktāvirājitāḥ /
kavacacchannasarvāṅgāḥ palāśaprasavatviṣaḥ //
meaning:
कस्तूरीतिलकोल्लासिभालामुक्ताविराजिताः /
कवचच्छन्नसर्वाङ्गाः पलाशप्रसवत्विषः //
text_mt: Their foreheads shine with musk marks, adorned with pearls, / all their limbs covered in armor, possessing the luster of palāśa blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakāmā ime proktā bhaṇḍāsuravadhārthinaḥ /
jeyacakrarathendrasya caturthaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चकामा इमे प्रोक्ता भण्डासुरवधार्थिनः /
जेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चतुर्थं पर्व संश्रिताः //
text_mt: these Five Kāmas are declared, intent upon the slaying of the asura Bhaṇḍa. / Stationed on the fourth tier of the supreme chariot Geyacakra

sanskrit_iast:
brahmīmukhyāstu pūrvoktāścaṇḍikā tvaṣṭamī parā /
tatra parvaṇyadhastācca lakṣmīścaiva sarasvatī //
meaning:
ब्रह्मीमुख्यास्तु पूर्वोक्ताश्चण्डिका त्वष्टमी परा /
तत्र पर्वण्यधस्ताच्च लक्ष्मीश्चैव सरस्वती //
text_mt: are those headed by Brāhmī previously mentioned, with Caṇḍikā as the supreme eighth. / And directly below on that tier are Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
ratiḥ prītiḥ kīrtiśāntī puṣṭistuṣṭiśca śaktayaḥ /
etāścakrodharaktākṣyo daityaṃ hantuṃ mahābalam //
meaning:
रतिः प्रीतिः कीर्तिशान्ती पुष्टिस्तुष्टिश्च शक्तयः /
एताश्चक्रोधरक्ताक्ष्यो दैत्यं हन्तुं महाबलम् //
text_mt: Rati, Prīti, Kīrti, Śānti, Puṣṭi, and Tuṣṭi—these śaktis / having eyes red with anger, in order to slay the Daitya of great might,

sanskrit_iast:
kuntacakradharāḥ proktāḥ kumāryaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava /
pañcamaṃ parva saṃprāptā vāmādyāḥ ṣoḍaśāparāḥ //
meaning:
कुन्तचक्रधराः प्रोक्ताः कुमार्यः कुंभसंभव /
पञ्चमं पर्व संप्राप्ता वामाद्याः षोडशापराः //
text_mt: bearing spears and discuses, are spoken of as maidens, O pot-born [Agastya]. / Attaining the fifth tier are sixteen others, headed by Vāmā,

sanskrit_iast:
gītiṃ cakrū rathendrasya tāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu /
vāmā jyeṣṭā ca raudrī ca śāntiḥ śraddhā sarasvatī //
meaning:
गीतिं चक्रू रथेन्द्रस्य तासां नामानि मच्छृणु /
वामा ज्येष्टा च रौद्री च शान्तिः श्रद्धा सरस्वती //
text_mt: of the supreme chariot Geyacakra; hear their names from me: / Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Śānti, Śraddhā, Sarasvatī,

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhūśāktiśca lakṣmīśca sṛṣṭiścaiva tu mohinī /
tathā pramāthinī cāśvasinī vīcistathaiva ca //
meaning:
श्रीभूशाक्तिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च सृष्टिश्चैव तु मोहिनी /
तथा प्रमाथिनी चाश्वसिनी वीचिस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Śrī, Bhūśakti, Lakṣmī, Sṛṣṭi, and Mohinī, / likewise Pramāthinī, Āśvasinī, and also Vīci,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyunmālinyatha surānandātho nāgabuddhikā /
etāstu kuravindābhā jagatkṣobhaṇalaṃpaṭāḥ //
meaning:
विद्युन्मालिन्यथ सुरानन्दाथो नागबुद्धिका /
एतास्तु कुरविन्दाभा जगत्क्षोभणलंपटाः //
text_mt: then Vidyunmālinī, then Surānandā, then Nāgabuddhikā. / Having the luster of ruby, intent upon agitating the world,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsarasamannāhamādadhānāḥ padepade /
vajrakaṅkaṭasaṃchannā aṭṭahāsojjvalāḥ pare /
vajradaṇḍau śataghnīṃ ca saṃbibhrāṇā bhuśuṇḍikāḥ //
meaning:
महासरसमन्नाहमादधानाः पदेपदे /
वज्रकङ्कटसंछन्ना अट्टहासोज्ज्वलाः परे /
वज्रदण्डौ शतघ्नीं च संबिभ्राणा भुशुण्डिकाः //
text_mt: assuming great, splendid armor at every step, / covered in diamond coats of mail, dazzling with loud laughter, supreme, / bearing diamond-staves, śataghnīs, and bhuśuṇḍis.

sanskrit_iast:
atha gītirathendrasya ṣaṣṭhaṃ parva samāśritāḥ /
asitāṅgaprabhṛtayo bhairavāḥ śastrabhīṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
अथ गीतिरथेन्द्रस्य षष्ठं पर्व समाश्रिताः /
असिताङ्गप्रभृतयो भैरवाः शस्त्रभीषणाः //
text_mt: Now, stationed upon the sixth tier of the supreme chariot Geyacakra / are the Bhairavas, terrifying with weapons, headed by Asitāṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
triśikhaṃ pānapātraṃ ca bibhrāṇā nīlavarcasaḥ /
asitāṅgo ruruścaṇḍaḥ krodha unmattabhairavaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिशिखं पानपात्रं च बिभ्राणा नीलवर्चसः /
असिताङ्गो रुरुश्चण्डः क्रोध उन्मत्तभैरवः //
text_mt: bearing a trident and a drinking vessel, possessing dark blue radiance: / Asitāṅga, Ruru, Caṇḍa, Krodha, Unmattabhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
kapālī bhīṣaṇaścaiva saṃhāraścāṣṭa bhairavāḥ /
atha gītirathendrasya saptamaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ //
meaning:
कपाली भीषणश्चैव संहारश्चाष्ट भैरवाः /
अथ गीतिरथेन्द्रस्य सप्तमं पर्व संश्रिताः //
text_mt: Kapālī, Bhīṣaṇa, and Saṃhāra: the eight Bhairavas. / Now, stationed upon the seventh tier of the supreme chariot Geyacakra,

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgī siddhalakṣmīśca mahāmātaṅgikāpi ca /
mahatī siddhalakṣmīśca śoṇā bāṇadhanurdharāḥ //
meaning:
मातङ्गी सिद्धलक्ष्मीश्च महामातङ्गिकापि च /
महती सिद्धलक्ष्मीश्च शोणा बाणधनुर्धराः //
text_mt: are Mātaṅgī, Siddhalakṣmī, Mahāmātaṅgikā, / and Mahatī Siddhalakṣmī—crimson, holding arrows and bows.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva parvaṇo 'dhastādgaṇapaḥ kṣetrapastathā /
durgāṃbā baṭukaśceṃva sarve te śastrapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव पर्वणो ऽधस्ताद्गणपः क्षेत्रपस्तथा /
दुर्गांबा बटुकश्चेंव सर्वे ते शस्त्रपाणयः //
text_mt: Directly below that very tier are Gaṇapa, Kṣetrapa, / Mother Durgā, and Baṭuka, all of them armed with weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva parvaṇo 'dhastāllakṣmīścaiva sarasvatī /
śaṅkhaḥ padmo nidhiścaiva te sarve śastrapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव पर्वणो ऽधस्ताल्लक्ष्मीश्चैव सरस्वती /
शङ्खः पद्मो निधिश्चैव ते सर्वे शस्त्रपाणयः //
text_mt: Right below that tier are Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī, / the conch and lotus treasures: all of them armed with weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
lokadviṣaṃ prati kruddhā bhaṇḍaṃ caṇḍaparākramam /
śakrādayaśca viṣmvantā daśa dikcakranāyakāḥ //
meaning:
लोकद्विषं प्रति क्रुद्धा भण्डं चण्डपराक्रमम् /
शक्रादयश्च विष्म्वन्ता दश दिक्चक्रनायकाः //
text_mt: furious against the enemy of the worlds, Bhaṇḍa of fierce valor; / and the ten leaders of the circle of directions, headed by Śakra and ending with Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktirūpāstatra parvaṇyadhastātkṛtasaṃśrayāḥ /
vajre śaktiṃ kāladaṇḍamakiṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā //
meaning:
शक्तिरूपास्तत्र पर्वण्यधस्तात्कृतसंश्रयाः /
वज्रे शक्तिं कालदण्डमकिं पाशं ध्वजं तथा //
text_mt: Taking the form of Śaktis, they have taken refuge there on the step below, / holding a spear, a staff of death, fire, a noose, and a flag,

sanskrit_iast:
gadāṃ triśūlaṃ darbhāstraṃ vajraṃ ca dadhatastvamī /
sevante mantrināthāṃ tāṃ nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitāḥ //
meaning:
गदां त्रिशूलं दर्भास्त्रं वज्रं च दधतस्त्वमी /
सेवन्ते मन्त्रिनाथां तां नित्यं भक्तिसमन्विताः //
text_mt: as well as a mace, a trident, a darbha weapon, and a thunderbolt; / filled with devotion, they continually attend upon that Mantrināthā,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsurāndurdurūḍhānnihantuṃ viśvakaṇṭakān /
mantrināthāśrayadvārā lalitājñāpanotsukāḥ //
meaning:
भण्डासुरान्दुर्दुरूढान्निहन्तुं विश्वकण्टकान् /
मन्त्रिनाथाश्रयद्वारा ललिताज्ञापनोत्सुकाः //
text_mt: eager to receive Lalitā's command through the mediation of Mantrināthā / in order to slay the insolent demons of Bhaṇḍa, the thorns of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
gīticakrarathopānte dikpālāḥ saṃśrayaṃ daduḥ /
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ mantriṇī dvārataḥ kṛtā //
meaning:
गीतिचक्ररथोपान्ते दिक्पालाः संश्रयं ददुः /
सर्वेषां चैव देवानां मन्त्रिणी द्वारतः कृता //
text_mt: Beside the chariot of the Gīticakra, the world guardians found refuge. / For all the gods, an approach was made through Mantriṇī:

sanskrit_iast:
vijñāpanā mahādevyāḥ kāryasiddhiṃ prayacchati /
rākṣī vijñāpanā ceti pradhānadvārataḥ kṛtā //
meaning:
विज्ञापना महादेव्याः कार्यसिद्धिं प्रयच्छति /
राक्षी विज्ञापना चेति प्रधानद्वारतः कृता //
text_mt: a petition made to the Great Goddess grants the accomplishment of one's purpose; / a petition made through the principal gate [serves as] a protectress.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā khalu phalaprāptiḥ sevakānāṃ hi jāyate /
anyathā kathameteṣāṃ sāmarthyaṃ jvalitaujasaḥ //
meaning:
यथा खलु फलप्राप्तिः सेवकानां हि जायते /
अन्यथा कथमेतेषां सामर्थ्यं ज्वलितौजसः //
text_mt: For in this way servants indeed attain their fruit. / How else could these possess the capacity, radiant with splendor though they are,

sanskrit_iast:
apadhṛṣyaprabhāvāyāḥ śrīdevyā upasarpaṇe /
sā hi saṃgītavidyeti śrīdevyā ativallabhā //
meaning:
अपधृष्यप्रभावायाः श्रीदेव्या उपसर्पणे /
सा हि संगीतविद्येति श्रीदेव्या अतिवल्लभा //
text_mt: to approach the Śrīdevī, whose power is invincible? / For she is the science of music, exceedingly dear to the Śrīdevī,

sanskrit_iast:
nātilaṅghati ca kvāpi taduktaṃ kāryasiddhiṣu /
śrīdevyāḥśaktisāmrājye sarvakarmāṇi mantriṇī //
meaning:
नातिलङ्घति च क्वापि तदुक्तं कार्यसिद्धिषु /
श्रीदेव्याःशक्तिसाम्राज्ये सर्वकर्माणि मन्त्रिणी //
text_mt: and [the Śrīdevī] never overrules whatever she says regarding the accomplishment of tasks. / In the Śrīdevī's empire of Śakti, Mantriṇī is capable

sanskrit_iast:
akarttumanyathā kartuṃ kartuṃ caiva pragalbhate /
tasmātsarve 'pi dikpālāḥ śrīdevyā jayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ /
tasyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyāḥ sevāmeva vitanvate //
meaning:
अकर्त्तुमन्यथा कर्तुं कर्तुं चैव प्रगल्भते /
तस्मात्सर्वे ऽपि दिक्पालाः श्रीदेव्या जयकाङ्क्षिणः /
तस्याः प्रधानभूतायाः सेवामेव वितन्वते //
text_mt: of doing, undoing, and altering all deeds. / Therefore, all the world guardians, desiring the Śrīdevī's victory, / render service solely to her, the foremost one.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīlalitādevyāścakrarājarathottame /
parvasthitānāṃ devīnāṃ nāmāni kathitānyalam //
meaning:
इति श्रीललितादेव्याश्चक्रराजरथोत्तमे /
पर्वस्थितानां देवीनां नामानि कथितान्यलम् //
text_mt: Thus the names of the goddesses dwelling on the tiers of the excellent chariot of the Cakrarāja, / belonging to the glorious goddess Lalitā, have been fully told.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsurasya saṃhāre tasyā divyāyudhānyapi /
proktāni geyacakrasya parvadevyāśca kīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
भण्डासुरस्य संहारे तस्या दिव्यायुधान्यपि /
प्रोक्तानि गेयचक्रस्य पर्वदेव्याश्च कीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Her divine weapons in the destruction of the demon Bhaṇḍa were also recounted, / and the step-goddesses of the Geyacakra were celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
imāni sarvadevīnāṃ nāmānyākarṇayanti ye /
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste syurvijayino narāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopakhyāne śrīcakrarājarathajñeyacakrarathaparvasthadevatānāmaprakāśanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इमानि सर्वदेवीनां नामान्याकर्णयन्ति ये /
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते स्युर्विजयिनो नराः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपख्याने श्रीचक्रराजरथज्ञेयचक्ररथपर्वस्थदेवतानामप्रकाशनं नामैकोनविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those men who listen to these names of all the goddesses / are freed from all sins and will become victorious.

Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, titled 'The Declaration of the Deities Residing on the Tiers of the Chariot of the Śrīcakrarāja and the Geyacakraratha,' in the conversation between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
kiricakrarathendrasya pañcaparvasamāśritāḥ /
devatāśca śṛṇu prājña nāma yacchṛṇvatāṃ jayaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य पञ्चपर्वसमाश्रिताः /
देवताश्च शृणु प्राज्ञ नाम यच्छृण्वतां जयः //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
Listen, O wise one, to the deities residing on the five tiers / of the supreme chariot of the Kiricakra, hearing whose names brings victory.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ parvabindvākhyaṃ saṃprāptā daṇḍanāyikā /
sā tatra jagaduddaṇḍakaṇṭakavrātaghasmarī //
meaning:
प्रथमं पर्वबिन्द्वाख्यं संप्राप्ता दण्डनायिका /
सा तत्र जगदुद्दण्डकण्टकव्रातघस्मरी //
text_mt: Reaching the first tier named Bindu is the Daṇḍanāyikā; / she is there devouring the host of unruly thorns of the world,

sanskrit_iast: nānāvidhābhirjvālābhirnartayantī jayaśriyam //
meaning: नानाविधाभिर्ज्वालाभिर्नर्तयन्ती जयश्रियम् //
text_mt: making the goddess of victory dance with various flames,

sanskrit_iast:
uddaṇḍapotranirghātanirbhinnoddhatadānavāḥ /
daṃṣṭrābālamṛgāṅkāṃśuvibhāvanavibhāvarī //
meaning:
उद्दण्डपोत्रनिर्घातनिर्भिन्नोद्धतदानवाः /
दंष्ट्राबालमृगाङ्कांशुविभावनविभावरी //
text_mt: shattering insolent Dānavas with blows of her mighty snout, / a night illumined by the rays of the crescent moon of her tusks,

sanskrit_iast:
prāvṛṣeṇyapayovāhavyūhanīlavapurllatā /
kiricakrarathendrasya sālaṅkārāyate sadā /
potriṇī putritāśeṣaviśvāvartakadaṃbikā //
meaning:
प्रावृषेण्यपयोवाहव्यूहनीलवपुर्ल्लता /
किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य सालङ्कारायते सदा /
पोत्रिणी पुत्रिताशेषविश्वावर्तकदंबिका //
text_mt: her creeper-like dark body resembling a cluster of rainy clouds, / continually serving as the ornament of the supreme chariot of the Kiricakra— / Potriṇī, who treats the entire revolving universe like a daughter.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva rathanābhasya dvitīyaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ /
jṛṃbhinī mohinī caiva staṃbhinī tisra eva hi /
utphulladāḍimīprakhyaṃ sarvadānavamardanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव रथनाभस्य द्वितीयं पर्व संश्रिताः /
जृंभिनी मोहिनी चैव स्तंभिनी तिस्र एव हि /
उत्फुल्लदाडिमीप्रख्यं सर्वदानवमर्दनाः //
text_mt: Residing on the second tier of that chariot's hub / are Jṛmbhiṇī, Mohinī, and Stambhiṇī—just three— / resembling blooming pomegranates, crushers of all Dānavas,

sanskrit_iast:
musalaṃ ca halaṃ hālāpātraṃ maṇigaṇarpitam /
jvalanmāṇikyavalayairbi bhrāṇāḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ //
meaning:
मुसलं च हलं हालापात्रं मणिगणर्पितम् /
ज्वलन्माणिक्यवलयैर्बि भ्राणाः पाणिपल्लवैः //
text_mt: holding a pestle, a plow, and a vessel of liquor set with heaps of gems / in their sprout-like hands adorned with blazing ruby bracelets,

sanskrit_iast:
atitīkṣṇakarālākṣyo jvālābhirdaityasainikān /
dahantya iva niḥśaṅkaṃ sevante sūkarānanām //
meaning:
अतितीक्ष्णकरालाक्ष्यो ज्वालाभिर्दैत्यसैनिकान् /
दहन्त्य इव निःशङ्कं सेवन्ते सूकराननाम् //
text_mt: with extremely sharp and terrifying eyes, as if fearlessly burning / the demon soldiers with their flames, they attend upon the Boar-Faced One.

sanskrit_iast:
kiricakrarathendrasya tṛtīyaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ /
andhinyādyāḥ pañca devyo devīyantrakṛtāspadāḥ //
meaning:
किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य तृतीयं पर्व संश्रिताः /
अन्धिन्याद्याः पञ्च देव्यो देवीयन्त्रकृतास्पदाः //
text_mt: Residing on the third tier of the supreme chariot of the Kiricakra / are the five goddesses beginning with Andhinī, dwelling in the goddess's yantra;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭhoreṇāṭṭahāsena bhindantyo bhuvanatrayam /
jvālā iva tu kalpagneraṅganāveṣamāśritāḥ //
meaning:
कठोरेणाट्टहासेन भिन्दन्त्यो भुवनत्रयम् /
ज्वाला इव तु कल्पग्नेरङ्गनावेषमाश्रिताः //
text_mt: shattering the three worlds with their harsh, loud laughter, / like flames of the fire of dissolution that have assumed the form of women,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsurasya sarveṣāṃ sainyānāṃ rudhiraplutim /
lilikṣamāṇā jihvābhirlelihānābhirujjvalāḥ //
meaning:
भण्डासुरस्य सर्वेषां सैन्यानां रुधिरप्लुतिम् /
लिलिक्षमाणा जिह्वाभिर्लेलिहानाभिरुज्ज्वलाः //
text_mt: desiring to lick up with their darting tongues the flood of blood / of all the armies of the demon Bhaṇḍa, radiant,

sanskrit_iast:
sevanteṃ satataṃ daṇḍanāthāmuddaṇḍavikramām /
kiricakrarathendrasya caturthaṃ parva saṃśritāḥ //
meaning:
सेवन्तें सततं दण्डनाथामुद्दण्डविक्रमाम् /
किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चतुर्थं पर्व संश्रिताः //
text_mt: they continually serve Daṇḍanāthā of mighty valor. / Residing on the fourth tier of the supreme chariot of the Kiricakra

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyāḥ pañcamīvarjyā aṣṭamīravarjitā api /
ṣaḍeva devyaḥ ṣaṭcakrajvalajjvālākalevarāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्याः पञ्चमीवर्ज्या अष्टमीरवर्जिता अपि /
षडेव देव्यः षट्चक्रज्वलज्ज्वालाकलेवराः //
text_mt: are Brahmā and the others, excluding the fifth and the eighth; / exactly six goddesses, their bodies composed of the blazing flames of the six cakras,

sanskrit_iast:
mahatā vikramaugheṇa vibantya iva dānavān /
ājñayā daṇḍanāthāyāstaṃ pradeśamupāsate //
meaning:
महता विक्रमौघेण विबन्त्य इव दानवान् /
आज्ञया दण्डनाथायास्तं प्रदेशमुपासते //
text_mt: as if drinking down the Dānavas with a great surge of valor, / worship that place by the command of Daṇḍanāthā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva parvaṇo 'dhastāttvaritāḥ sthānamāśritāḥ /
yakṣiṇī śaṅkhinī caiva lākinī hākinī tathā //
meaning:
तस्यैव पर्वणो ऽधस्तात्त्वरिताः स्थानमाश्रिताः /
यक्षिणी शङ्खिनी चैव लाकिनी हाकिनी तथा //
text_mt: Below that tier, swiftly taking their place, / are Yakṣiṇī, Śaṅkhinī, Lākinī, Hākinī,

sanskrit_iast:
śākinī ḍākinī caiva tāsāmaikyasvarūpiṇī /
hākinī saptamītyetāścaṇḍadordaṇḍavikramāḥ //
meaning:
शाकिनी डाकिनी चैव तासामैक्यस्वरूपिणी /
हाकिनी सप्तमीत्येताश्चण्डदोर्दण्डविक्रमाः //
text_mt: Śākinī, and Ḍākinī, and Hākinī as the seventh, / embodying their unity—these of fierce and mighty arms,

sanskrit_iast:
pibantya iva bhūtāni pibantya iva medinīm /
tvacaṃ raktaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ medo 'sthi ca virodhinām //
meaning:
पिबन्त्य इव भूतानि पिबन्त्य इव मेदिनीम् /
त्वचं रक्तं तथा मांसं मेदो ऽस्थि च विरोधिनाम् //
text_mt: as if drinking the creatures, as if drinking the earth, / drinking the skin, blood, flesh, fat, and bone of adversaries,

sanskrit_iast:
majjānamatha śukraṃ ca pibantayo vikaṭānanāḥ /
niṣṭhuraiḥ siṃhanādaiśca pūrayantyo diśo daśa //
meaning:
मज्जानमथ शुक्रं च पिबन्तयो विकटाननाः /
निष्ठुरैः सिंहनादैश्च पूरयन्त्यो दिशो दश //
text_mt: as well as marrow and semen, terrifying-faced, / filling the ten directions with ruthless lion roars,

sanskrit_iast:
dhātunāthā iti proktā aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhidāḥ /
mohane māraṇe caiva staṃbhane tāḍane tathā //
meaning:
धातुनाथा इति प्रोक्ता अणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धिदाः /
मोहने मारणे चैव स्तंभने ताडने तथा //
text_mt: called the Dhātunāthās, granters of the eight supernatural powers beginning with Aṇimā; / in stupefying, slaying, paralyzing, and striking,

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣaṇe duṣṭadaityānāmāmūlaṃ ca nikṛntane /
paṇḍitāḥ khaṇḍitāśeṣavipado bhaktiśāliṣu //
meaning:
भक्षणे दुष्टदैत्यानामामूलं च निकृन्तने /
पण्डिताः खण्डिताशेषविपदो भक्तिशालिषु //
text_mt: in devouring the wicked demons and eradicating them to the root, / they are expert, having destroyed every misfortune among the devoted;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātunāthā itiproktāḥ sarvadhātuṣu saṃsthitāḥ /
saptāpi vāridhīnūrmimālāsaṃcuṃbitāṃbarān //
meaning:
धातुनाथा इतिप्रोक्ताः सर्वधातुषु संस्थिताः /
सप्तापि वारिधीनूर्मिमालासंचुंबितांबरान् //
text_mt: called the Dhātunāthās, residing in all the bodily elements, / capable with immense daring of drinking dry even the seven oceans,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇardhenaiva niṣpātuṃ niṣpannabahusāhasāḥ /
śakaṭā kāradantāśca bhayaṅkaravilocanāḥ //
meaning:
क्षणर्धेनैव निष्पातुं निष्पन्नबहुसाहसाः /
शकटा कारदन्ताश्च भयङ्करविलोचनाः //
text_mt: whose garlands of waves kiss the sky, in only half a moment; / with cart-shaped teeth and terrifying eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
svasvāminīdrohakṛtāṃ svakīyasamayadruhām /
vaidikadrohaṇādeva drohiṇāṃ vīravairiṇām //
meaning:
स्वस्वामिनीद्रोहकृतां स्वकीयसमयद्रुहाम् /
वैदिकद्रोहणादेव द्रोहिणां वीरवैरिणाम् //
text_mt: equal to devouring the wicked demons who betray their own mistress, / who betray their own tradition, who act as enemies against heroic warriors out of hatred for the Veda,

sanskrit_iast:
yajñadrohakṛtāṃ duṣṭadaityānāṃ bhakṣaṇe samāḥ /
nityameva ca sevante potriṇīṃ daṇḍanāyikām //
meaning:
यज्ञद्रोहकृतां दुष्टदैत्यानां भक्षणे समाः /
नित्यमेव च सेवन्ते पोत्रिणीं दण्डनायिकाम् //
text_mt: and who sabotage the sacrifices, / they continually attend upon Potriṇī, the Daṇḍanāyikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva parvaṇaḥ pārśve dvitīye divyamandire /
krodhinī staṃbhinī khyāte vartete devate ubhe //
meaning:
तस्यैव पर्वणः पार्श्वे द्वितीये दिव्यमन्दिरे /
क्रोधिनी स्तंभिनी ख्याते वर्तेते देवते उभे //
text_mt: Beside that same tier, in a second divine chamber, / are the two goddesses known as Krodhinī and Stambhiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmare vījayantyau ca lolakaṅkaṇadorlate /
devadviṣāṃ camūraktahālāpānamahoddhate //
meaning:
चामरे वीजयन्त्यौ च लोलकङ्कणदोर्लते /
देवद्विषां चमूरक्तहालापानमहोद्धते //
text_mt: fanning chowries with their creeper-like arms adorned with dangling bracelets, / wildly elated by drinking the wine of blood from the army of the gods' enemies,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā vighūrṇamānākṣyau sadā prahasitānane /
atha tasya rathendrasya kiricakrāśritasya ca //
meaning:
सदा विघूर्णमानाक्ष्यौ सदा प्रहसितानने /
अथ तस्य रथेन्द्रस्य किरिचक्राश्रितस्य च //
text_mt: their eyes always rolling, their faces always laughing. / Now, of that supreme chariot associated with the Kiricakra,

sanskrit_iast:
pārśvadvayakṛtāvāsamāyudhadvandvamuttamam /
halaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva devatārūpamāsthitam //
meaning:
पार्श्वद्वयकृतावासमायुधद्वन्द्वमुत्तमम् /
हलं च मुसलं चैव देवतारूपमास्थितम् //
text_mt: having taken up abode on both flanks is an excellent pair of weapons: / the plow and the pestle, having assumed the form of deities,

sanskrit_iast:
svakīyamukuṭasthāne svakīyāyudhavigraham /
ābibhrāṇaṃ jaga ṣighasmaraṃ vibudhaiḥ smṛtam //
meaning:
स्वकीयमुकुटस्थाने स्वकीयायुधविग्रहम् /
आबिभ्राणं जग षिघस्मरं विबुधैः स्मृतम् //
text_mt: wearing their own weapon-form in place of a crown, / devouring the universe, remembered by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
etadāyudhayugmena lalitā daḍanāyikā /
khaṇḍayiṣyati saṃgrāmaṃ viṣaṅgaṃ nāmadānaham //
meaning:
एतदायुधयुग्मेन ललिता दडनायिका /
खण्डयिष्यति संग्रामं विषङ्गं नामदानहम् //
text_mt: With this pair of weapons, Lalitā's Daṇḍanāyikā / will cleave the demon named Viṣaṅga in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva parvaṇo daṇḍanāthāyā agrasīmani /
varttamāno mahābhīmaḥ siṃho nādairdhvanannabhaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव पर्वणो दण्डनाथाया अग्रसीमनि /
वर्त्तमानो महाभीमः सिंहो नादैर्ध्वनन्नभः //
text_mt: At the front boundary of Daṇḍanāthā on that same tier / stands a formidable lion, making the sky resound with roars,

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭrākaṭakaṭātkāra badhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ /
caṇḍoccaṇḍa iti khyātaścaturhastastrilocanaḥ //
meaning:
दंष्ट्राकटकटात्कार बधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः /
चण्डोच्चण्ड इति ख्यातश्चतुर्हस्तस्त्रिलोचनः //
text_mt: deafening the quarters with the chattering of his fangs, / known as Caṇḍoccaṇḍa, four-armed and three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlakhaḍgapretapāśāndadhāno dīptavigrahaḥ /
sadā saṃsevate devīṃ paśyanneva hi potriṇīm //
meaning:
शूलखड्गप्रेतपाशान्दधानो दीप्तविग्रहः /
सदा संसेवते देवीं पश्यन्नेव हि पोत्रिणीम् //
text_mt: holding a trident, a sword, a corpse, and a noose, of blazing form, / constantly serving the goddess, simply gazing upon Potriṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
kiricakrarathendrasya ṣaṣṭaṃ parva samāśritāḥ /
vārttālyādyā aṣṭa devyo dikṣvaṣṭāsūpaviśrutāḥ //
meaning:
किरिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य षष्टं पर्व समाश्रिताः /
वार्त्ताल्याद्या अष्ट देव्यो दिक्ष्वष्टासूपविश्रुताः //
text_mt: Residing on the sixth tier of the supreme chariot of the Kiricakra / are the eight goddesses beginning with Vārttālī, renowned throughout the eight directions.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaparvataniṣpātaghoranirghātaniḥsvanāḥ /
aṣṭanāgasphuradbhūṣā anaṣṭabalatejasaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टपर्वतनिष्पातघोरनिर्घातनिःस्वनाः /
अष्टनागस्फुरद्भूषा अनष्टबलतेजसः //
