text_mt: The sons of the Daitya were exceedingly amazed / beholding the nine-year-old standing on the covered chariot, discharging a circle of arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇekṣaṇe bālikayā kriyamāṇaṃ mahāraṇam /
vyajijñapanmahārājñyai bhramantyaḥ paricārikāḥ //
meaning:
क्षणेक्षणे बालिकया क्रियमाणं महारणम् /
व्यजिज्ञपन्महाराज्ञ्यै भ्रमन्त्यः परिचारिकाः //
text_mt: The attendant women, hurrying back and forth, reported at every moment / to the Great Queen the great battle being fought by the young girl.

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe ca na tāṃ vijahatū raṇe /
prekṣakatva manuprāpte tṛṣṇīmeva babhūvatuḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे च न तां विजहतू रणे /
प्रेक्षकत्व मनुप्राप्ते तृष्णीमेव बभूवतुः //
text_mt: And Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā did not leave her side in the fight; / having taken on the role of onlookers, they remained completely silent.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ daityaputrāṇāmekarūpā kumārikā /
pratyekabhinnā dadṛśe biṃbamāleva bhāsvataḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां दैत्यपुत्राणामेकरूपा कुमारिका /
प्रत्येकभिन्ना ददृशे बिंबमालेव भास्वतः //
text_mt: To all the sons of the Daitya, the maiden of uniform form / appeared distinct to each, like the manifold reflected discs of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyakairagnicūḍālaisteṣāṃ marmāṇi bhindatī /
raktotpalamiva krodhasaṃraktaṃ bibhratī mukham //
meaning:
सायकैरग्निचूडालैस्तेषां मर्माणि भिन्दती /
रक्तोत्पलमिव क्रोधसंरक्तं बिभ्रती मुखम् //
text_mt: Piercing their vital spots with arrows crested with fire, / she bore a face reddened with anger like a red lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
āścaryaṃ bruvato vyomni paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām /
sādhuvādairbahuvidhairmatriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ //
meaning:
आश्चर्यं ब्रुवतो व्योम्नि पश्यतां त्रिदिवौकसाम् /
साधुवादैर्बहुविधैर्मत्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः //
text_mt: While the sky-dwellers, looking on, cried out, “Wonderful!” in the sky, / and with manifold plaudits from Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā,

sanskrit_iast:
arcyamānā raṇaṃ cakre laghuhastā kumārikā /
dvitīyaṃ yuddhadivasaṃ samastamapi sā raṇe //
meaning:
अर्च्यमाना रणं चक्रे लघुहस्ता कुमारिका /
द्वितीयं युद्धदिवसं समस्तमपि सा रणे //
text_mt: the nimble-handed maiden waged battle, being thus honored. / For the entire second day of battle she in the fight

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśayāmāsa balaṃ lalitāduhitā nijam /
astrapratyastramokṣeṇa tānsarvānapi bhindatī //
meaning:
प्रकाशयामास बलं ललितादुहिता निजम् /
अस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रमोक्षेण तान्सर्वानपि भिन्दती //
text_mt: displayed her own strength, the daughter of Lalitā, / piercing all of them by releasing weapons and counter-weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇāstramokṣeṇa maharājñīkumārikā /
dviśatyakṣauhiṇīsainyaṃ bhasmasādakarotkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
नारायणास्त्रमोक्षेण महराज्ञीकुमारिका /
द्विशत्यक्षौहिणीसैन्यं भस्मसादकरोत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: By discharging the Nārāyaṇa weapon, the maiden daughter of the Great Queen / reduced an army of two hundred akṣauhiṇīs to ashes in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣauhiṇīnāṃ kṣayataḥ kṣaṇātkopamupāgatāḥ /
ākṛṣṭagurudhanvānaste 'patannekahelayā //
meaning:
अक्षौहिणीनां क्षयतः क्षणात्कोपमुपागताः /
आकृष्टगुरुधन्वानस्ते ऽपतन्नेकहेलया //
text_mt: Becoming enraged in an instant owing to the destruction of the akṣauhiṇīs, / with heavy bows drawn, they charged down together with singular ease.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kalakale jāte śaktīnāṃ ca divaukasām /
yugapattriṃśato bāṇānasṛjatsā kumārikā //
meaning:
ततः कलकले जाते शक्तीनां च दिवौकसाम् /
युगपत्त्रिंशतो बाणानसृजत्सा कुमारिका //
text_mt: Then, as a tumultuous clamor arose among the Śaktis and the sky-dwellers, / the maiden released thirty arrows simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast:
hastalāghavamāśritya muktaiścandrārdhasāyakaiḥ /
triṃśatā triṃśato bhaṇḍaputrāṇā sāhataṃ śiraḥ //
meaning:
हस्तलाघवमाश्रित्य मुक्तैश्चन्द्रार्धसायकैः /
त्रिंशता त्रिंशतो भण्डपुत्राणा साहतं शिरः //
text_mt: Relying on the swiftness of her hand, by means of thirty crescent-headed arrows discharged, / the heads of the thirty sons of Bhaṇḍa were struck off by her.

sanskrit_iast:
iti bhaṇḍasya putreṣu prāpteṣu yamasādanam /
atyantavismayāviṣṭā vabṛṣuḥ puṣpamabhragāḥ //
meaning:
इति भण्डस्य पुत्रेषु प्राप्तेषु यमसादनम् /
अत्यन्तविस्मयाविष्टा वबृषुः पुष्पमभ्रगाः //
text_mt: When the sons of Bhaṇḍa had thus reached the abode of Yama, / those moving in the clouds, seized with extreme wonder, rained down flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca putrī mahārājñyāḥ vidhvastāsuramainikā /
mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthābhyāmāliṅgyata bhṛśaṃ mudā //
meaning:
सा च पुत्री महाराज्ञ्याः विध्वस्तासुरमैनिका /
मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथाभ्यामालिङ्ग्यत भृशं मुदा //
text_mt: And that daughter of the Great Queen, who had crushed the Asura army, / was embraced with immense joy by Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ parākramonmeṣairnṛtyantyojayadāyibhiḥ /
śaktayastumulaṃ cakruḥ sādhuvādairjagattrayam //
meaning:
तस्याः पराक्रमोन्मेषैर्नृत्यन्त्योजयदायिभिः /
शक्तयस्तुमुलं चक्रुः साधुवादैर्जगत्त्रयम् //
text_mt: Dancing at the manifestations of her prowess that brought victory, / the Śaktis filled the three worlds with a tumultuous roar of acclaim.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāśca śaktisenānyo daṇḍanāthāpuraḥsarāḥ /
tadāścaryaṃ mahārājñyai nivedayitumudgatāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाश्च शक्तिसेनान्यो दण्डनाथापुरःसराः /
तदाश्चर्यं महाराज्ञ्यै निवेदयितुमुद्गताः //
text_mt: And all the leaders of the Śakti armies, headed by Daṇḍanāthā, / went up to report that wondrous deed to the Great Queen.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhirnivedyamānāni sā devī lalitāṃbikā /
putrībhujāvadānāni śrutvā prītiṃ samāyayau //
meaning:
ताभिर्निवेद्यमानानि सा देवी ललितांबिका /
पुत्रीभुजावदानानि श्रुत्वा प्रीतिं समाययौ //
text_mt: Hearing the glorious deeds of her daughter’s arms / being related by them, the venerable mother, goddess Lalitā, attained great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
samastamapi taccakraṃ śaktīnāṃ tatparākramaiḥ /
adṛṣṭapūrvairdeveṣu vismayasya vaśaṃ gatam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne bhaṇḍaputravadho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
समस्तमपि तच्चक्रं शक्तीनां तत्पराक्रमैः /
अदृष्टपूर्वैर्देवेषु विस्मयस्य वशं गतम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने भण्डपुत्रवधो नाम षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
The entire cakra of the Śaktis was overwhelmed with wonder / at her prowess, the likes of which had never been seen before among the gods.

Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named “The Slaying of the Sons of Bhaṇḍa,” in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
atha naṣṭeṣu putreṣu śokānalapariplutaḥ /
vilalāpa sa daityendro matvā jātaṃ kulakṣayam //
meaning:
अथ नष्टेषु पुत्रेषु शोकानलपरिप्लुतः /
विललाप स दैत्येन्द्रो मत्वा जातं कुलक्षयम् //
text_mt: Then, when his sons were destroyed, flooded with the fire of grief, / that Daitya lord lamented, realizing that the destruction of his family had occurred:

sanskrit_iast:
hā putrā hā guṇodārā hā madekaparāyaṇāḥ /
hā mannetrasudhāpūrā hā matkulavivardhanāḥ //
meaning:
हा पुत्रा हा गुणोदारा हा मदेकपरायणाः /
हा मन्नेत्रसुधापूरा हा मत्कुलविवर्धनाः //
text_mt: “Alas, my sons! Alas, noble in virtues! Alas, devoted solely to me! / Alas, floods of nectar to my eyes! Alas, expanders of my race!

sanskrit_iast:
hā samastasuraśreṣṭhamadabhañjanatatparāḥ /
hā samastasurastrīṇāmantarmohanamanmathāḥ //
meaning:
हा समस्तसुरश्रेष्ठमदभञ्जनतत्पराः /
हा समस्तसुरस्त्रीणामन्तर्मोहनमन्मथाः //
text_mt: Alas, you who were intent on crushing the pride of all the foremost gods! / Alas, Kāmadevas enchanting the hearts of all the wives of the gods!

sanskrit_iast:
diśata prītivācaṃ me mamāṅke valgatādhunā /
kimidānīmimaṃ tātamavamucya sukhaṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
दिशत प्रीतिवाचं मे ममाङ्के वल्गताधुना /
किमिदानीमिमं तातमवमुच्य सुखं गताः //
text_mt: Grant me words of affection; frolic now in my lap! / Why have you now abandoned this father and gone to [your] rest?

sanskrit_iast:
yuṣmānvinā na śobhante mama rājyāni putrakāḥ /
riktāni mama gehāni riktā rājasabhāpi me //
meaning:
युष्मान्विना न शोभन्ते मम राज्यानि पुत्रकाः /
रिक्तानि मम गेहानि रिक्ता राजसभापि मे //
text_mt: Without you, my kingdoms do not shine, my little sons! / Empty are my mansions; empty also is my royal court!”

sanskrit_iast:
kathamevaṃ viniḥśeṣaṃ hatāyūyaṃ durāśayāḥ /
apradhṛṣyabhujāsattvānbhavato matkulāṅkurān /
kathamekapade duṣṭā vanitā saṃgare 'vadhīt //
meaning:
कथमेवं विनिःशेषं हतायूयं दुराशयाः /
अप्रधृष्यभुजासत्त्वान्भवतो मत्कुलाङ्कुरान् /
कथमेकपदे दुष्टा वनिता संगरे ऽवधीत् //
text_mt: “How have you all been completely slain, evil-minded [fate]? / How did a wicked woman in an instant kill you in battle, / whose arm-might was unassailable, the shoots of my dynasty?

sanskrit_iast:
mama naṣṭāni saukhyāni mama naṣṭāḥ kulastriyaḥ /
itaḥ paraṃ kule kṣīṇe sāhasāni sukhāni ca //
meaning:
मम नष्टानि सौख्यानि मम नष्टाः कुलस्त्रियः /
इतः परं कुले क्षीणे साहसानि सुखानि च //
text_mt: My pleasures are lost, the women of my family are lost; / henceforth, when the lineage has dwindled, daring deeds and joys [are gone].

sanskrit_iast:
bhavataḥ sukṛtairlabdhvā mama pūrvajanuḥkṛtaiḥ /
nāśo 'yaṃ bhavatāmadya jāto naṣṭastato 'smyaham //
meaning:
भवतः सुकृतैर्लब्ध्वा मम पूर्वजनुःकृतैः /
नाशो ऽयं भवतामद्य जातो नष्टस्ततो ऽस्म्यहम् //
text_mt: Having obtained you through the merits of my former lives, / this destruction has come upon you today, and through that, I am ruined!

sanskrit_iast:
hā hato 'smi vipanno 'smi mandabhāgyo 'smi putrakāḥ /
iti śokātsa paryasyanpralapanmuktamūrdhajaḥ /
mūrcchayā luptahṛdayo niṣpapāta nupāsanāt //
meaning:
हा हतो ऽस्मि विपन्नो ऽस्मि मन्दभाग्यो ऽस्मि पुत्रकाः /
इति शोकात्स पर्यस्यन्प्रलपन्मुक्तमूर्धजः /
मूर्च्छया लुप्तहृदयो निष्पपात नुपासनात् //
text_mt: Alas, I am undone! I am ruined! I am ill-fated, O my sons!” / Tossing about and lamenting thus from grief, his hair disheveled, / his senses lost in a swoon, he fell down from the royal seat.

sanskrit_iast:
viśukraśca viṣaṅgaśca kuṭilākṣaśca saṃsadi /
bhaṇḍamāśvāsayāmāsurdaivasya kuṭilakramaiḥ //
meaning:
विशुक्रश्च विषङ्गश्च कुटिलाक्षश्च संसदि /
भण्डमाश्वासयामासुर्दैवस्य कुटिलक्रमैः //
text_mt: Then Viśukra, Viṣaṅga, and Kuṭilākṣa in the assembly / comforted Bhaṇḍa with the crooked ways of fate.

sanskrit_iast:
viśukra uvāca
devaki prākṛta iva prāptaḥ śokasya vaśyatām /
lapasi tve prati sutānprāptamṛtyūnmahāhave //
meaning:
विशुक्र उवाच
देवकि प्राकृत इव प्राप्तः शोकस्य वश्यताम् /
लपसि त्वे प्रति सुतान्प्राप्तमृत्यून्महाहवे //
text_mt: Viśukra said: / “O Lord, why do you fall under the sway of grief like a common man / and weep over your sons who have met their death in the great battle?

sanskrit_iast:
dharmavānvihitaḥ panthā vīrāṇāmeṣa śāśvataḥ /
aśocyamāhave mṛtyuṃ prāpnuvanti yadarhitam //
meaning:
धर्मवान्विहितः पन्था वीराणामेष शाश्वतः /
अशोच्यमाहवे मृत्युं प्राप्नुवन्ति यदर्हितम् //
text_mt: This is the eternal, righteous path ordained for heroes, / that they attain a death in battle that is not to be mourned and is honored.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva vināśāya śalyavadbādhate manaḥ /
yatstrī samāgatya haṭhānni hanti subhaṭānraṇe //
meaning:
एतदेव विनाशाय शल्यवद्बाधते मनः /
यत्स्त्री समागत्य हठान्नि हन्ति सुभटान्रणे //
text_mt: Yet this alone pierces the mind like a dart, driving it to ruin, / that a woman, coming forward, forcibly slays great warriors in battle.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte tena daityena putraśoko vyamucyata /
bhaṇḍena caṇḍakālāgnisadṛśaḥ krodha ādadhe //
meaning:
इत्युक्ते तेन दैत्येन पुत्रशोको व्यमुच्यत /
भण्डेन चण्डकालाग्निसदृशः क्रोध आदधे //
text_mt: When this was spoken by that Daitya, [Bhaṇḍa's] grief for his sons was abandoned, / and Bhaṇḍa conceived an anger resembling the fierce fire of cosmic destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
sa kośātkṣipramuddhṛtya khaḍgamugraṃ yamopamam /
visphāritākṣiyugalo bhṛśaṃ jajvāla tejasā //
meaning:
स कोशात्क्षिप्रमुद्धृत्य खड्गमुग्रं यमोपमम् /
विस्फारिताक्षियुगलो भृशं जज्वाल तेजसा //
text_mt: Quickly drawing from its sheath a fierce sword resembling Yama, / with both eyes wide open, he blazed exceedingly with fury.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīmeva tāṃ duṣṭāṃ khaḍgenānena khaṇḍaśaḥ /
śakalīkṛtya samare śramaṃ prāpsyāmi bandhubhiḥ //
meaning:
इदानीमेव तां दुष्टां खड्गेनानेन खण्डशः /
शकलीकृत्य समरे श्रमं प्राप्स्यामि बन्धुभिः //
text_mt: “Right now, cutting that wicked woman into pieces with this sword / and hacking her to bits in battle, I shall find rest together with my kinsmen!”

sanskrit_iast:
iti roṣaskhaladvarṇaḥ śvasanniva bhujaṅgamaḥ /
khaḍgaṃ vidhunvannutthāya pracacālā timattavat //
meaning:
इति रोषस्खलद्वर्णः श्वसन्निव भुजङ्गमः /
खड्गं विधुन्वन्नुत्थाय प्रचचाला तिमत्तवत् //
text_mt: Thus, with his speech faltering from rage, hissing like a serpent, / shaking his sword, he rose up and advanced like one intoxicated.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ nirudhya ca saṃbhrāntāḥ sarve dānavapuṅgavāḥ /
vācamūcuratikrodhājjvalanto lalitāṃ prati //
meaning:
तं निरुध्य च संभ्रान्ताः सर्वे दानवपुङ्गवाः /
वाचमूचुरतिक्रोधाज्ज्वलन्तो ललितां प्रति //
text_mt: Checking him, all the foremost of the Dānavas, agitated, / blazing with extreme wrath toward Lalitā, addressed these words:

sanskrit_iast:
na tadarthe tvayā kāryaḥ svāminsaṃbhrama īdṛśaḥ /
asmābhiḥ svabalairyuktai raṇotsāho vidhīyate //
meaning:
न तदर्थे त्वया कार्यः स्वामिन्संभ्रम ईदृशः /
अस्माभिः स्वबलैर्युक्तै रणोत्साहो विधीयते //
text_mt: “O master, you should not show such agitation on her account; / joining together with our own forces, we shall undertake the zeal of battle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavadājñālavaṃ prāpya samastabhuvanaṃ haṭhāt /
vimarddayitumīśāḥ smaḥ kimu tāṃ mugdhabhāminīm //
meaning:
भवदाज्ञालवं प्राप्य समस्तभुवनं हठात् /
विमर्द्दयितुमीशाः स्मः किमु तां मुग्धभामिनीम् //
text_mt: Obtaining but a fraction of your command, we are capable of crushing / the entire world by force—what to say of that foolish woman?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ cūṣayāmaḥ saptābdhīnkṣodayāmo 'tha vā girīn /
adharottaramevaitattrailokyaṃ karavāma vā //
meaning:
किं चूषयामः सप्ताब्धीन्क्षोदयामो ऽथ वा गिरीन् /
अधरोत्तरमेवैतत्त्रैलोक्यं करवाम वा //
text_mt: Shall we drink up the seven oceans, or shall we pulverize the mountains? / Or shall we turn these three worlds completely upside down?

sanskrit_iast:
chinadāma surānsarvānbhinadāma tadālayān /
pinṣāma haritpālānājñāṃ dehi mahāmate //
meaning:
छिनदाम सुरान्सर्वान्भिनदाम तदालयान् /
पिन्षाम हरित्पालानाज्ञां देहि महामते //
text_mt: Shall we cut down all the gods, break their abodes, / and crush the guardians of the directions? Give your command, O noble-minded one!”

sanskrit_iast:
ityudīrita mākarṇya mahāhaṅkāragarvitam /
uvāca vacanaṃ kruddhaḥ pratighāruṇalocanaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युदीरित माकर्ण्य महाहङ्कारगर्वितम् /
उवाच वचनं क्रुद्धः प्रतिघारुणलोचनः //
text_mt: Hearing what had been uttered, puffed up with great pride, / [Bhaṇḍa], enraged, his eyes red with fury, spoke this word:

sanskrit_iast:
viśukra bhavatā gatvā māyāntārhitavarṣmaṇā /
jayavighnaṃ mahāyantraṃ karttavyaṃ kaṭake dviṣām //
meaning:
विशुक्र भवता गत्वा मायान्तार्हितवर्ष्मणा /
जयविघ्नं महायन्त्रं कर्त्तव्यं कटके द्विषाम् //
text_mt: “Viśukra, you must go with your body concealed by magic / and construct the great Jayavighna yantra in the camp of the enemies.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā viśukro roṣarūṣitaḥ /
māyātirohitavapurjagāma lalitābalam //
meaning:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विशुक्रो रोषरूषितः /
मायातिरोहितवपुर्जगाम ललिताबलम् //
text_mt: Hearing his command, Viśukra, smeared with rage, / concealing his body with magic, went to Lalitā's army.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminprayātumudyukte suryo 'staṃ samupāgataḥ /
paryastakiraṇastomapāṭalīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्प्रयातुमुद्युक्ते सुर्यो ऽस्तं समुपागतः /
पर्यस्तकिरणस्तोमपाटलीकृतदिङ्मुखः //
text_mt: As he prepared to set forth, the sun sank into the western mountain, / reddening the faces of the quarters with its mass of scattered rays.

sanskrit_iast:
anurāgavatī saṃdhyā prayāntaṃ bhānumālinam /
anuvavrāja pātālakuñje rantumivotsukā //
meaning:
अनुरागवती संध्या प्रयान्तं भानुमालिनम् /
अनुवव्राज पातालकुञ्जे रन्तुमिवोत्सुका //
text_mt: The loving twilight followed the departing sun, / as if eager to sport [with him] in the bower of the netherworld.

sanskrit_iast:
vegātprapatato bhānordehasaṃgātsamutthitāḥ /
caramābdheriva payaḥkaṇāstārā virejire //
meaning:
वेगात्प्रपततो भानोर्देहसंगात्समुत्थिताः /
चरमाब्धेरिव पयःकणास्तारा विरेजिरे //
text_mt: Rising from the contact with the body of the sun falling swiftly, / the stars shone like droplets of water from the western ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
athāsasāda bahulaṃ tamaḥ kajjalamecakam /
sārthaṃ karttumivodyuktaṃ savarṇasyāsidurdhiyā //
meaning:
अथाससाद बहुलं तमः कज्जलमेचकम् /
सार्थं कर्त्तुमिवोद्युक्तं सवर्णस्यासिदुर्धिया //
text_mt: Then thick darkness, black as collyrium, arrived, / as if striving to assist that evil-minded one who shared its dark nature.

sanskrit_iast:
māyārathaṃ samārūḍho gūḍhaśarvarasaṃvṛtaḥ /
adṛśyavapurāpede lalitākaṭakaṃ khalaḥ //
meaning:
मायारथं समारूढो गूढशर्वरसंवृतः /
अदृश्यवपुरापेदे ललिताकटकं खलः //
text_mt: Mounted on a magical chariot and enveloped in deep night, / his body invisible, that villain reached the camp of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra gatvā jvalajjvālaṃ vahniprākāramaṇḍalam /
śatayojanavistārāmālokayat durmatiḥ //
meaning:
तत्र गत्वा ज्वलज्ज्वालं वह्निप्राकारमण्डलम् /
शतयोजनविस्तारामालोकयत् दुर्मतिः //
text_mt: Having gone there, the evil-minded one beheld / a circle of fire-walls of blazing flames, a hundred yojanas in extent.

sanskrit_iast:
parito vibhramañśālamavakāśamavāpnuvan /
dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāsādya nidadhyau kṣaṇamuddhataḥ //
meaning:
परितो विभ्रमञ्शालमवकाशमवाप्नुवन् /
दक्षिणं द्वारमासाद्य निदध्यौ क्षणमुद्धतः //
text_mt: Roaming all around the rampart and finding an opening, / he reached the southern gate and, haughty, gazed for a moment.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpaśyanmahāsattvāssāvadhānā dhṛtāyudhāḥ /
ārūḍhayānāḥ sanaddhavarmāṇo dvāradeśataḥ //
meaning:
तत्रापश्यन्महासत्त्वास्सावधाना धृतायुधाः /
आरूढयानाः सनद्धवर्माणो द्वारदेशतः //
text_mt: There he saw great-spirited ones, alert, holding weapons, / mounted on chariots, wearing armor, at the region of the gate:

sanskrit_iast:
staṃbhinīpramukhāḥ śaktīrviśatyakṣauhiṇīyutāḥ /
sarvadā dvārarakṣārthaṃ nirdiṣṭā daṇḍanāthayā //
meaning:
स्तंभिनीप्रमुखाः शक्तीर्विशत्यक्षौहिणीयुताः /
सर्वदा द्वाररक्षार्थं निर्दिष्टा दण्डनाथया //
text_mt: the Śaktis headed by Stambhinī, accompanied by twenty akṣauhiṇīs, / appointed by Daṇḍanāthā to guard the gate at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
vilokya vismayāviṣṭo vicārya ca ciraṃ tadā /
śālasya bahirevāsau sthitvā yantraṃ samātanot //
meaning:
विलोक्य विस्मयाविष्टो विचार्य च चिरं तदा /
शालस्य बहिरेवासौ स्थित्वा यन्त्रं समातनोत् //
text_mt: Beholding them, filled with wonder and pondering for a long time, / he stayed outside the rampart and prepared the yantra.

sanskrit_iast:
gavyūtimātrakāyāme tatsamānapravistare /
śilāpaṭṭe sumahati prālikhadyantramuttamam //
meaning:
गव्यूतिमात्रकायामे तत्समानप्रविस्तरे /
शिलापट्टे सुमहति प्रालिखद्यन्त्रमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Upon a very large slab of stone, one gavyūti in length / and of equal width, he inscribed the supreme yantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭadikṣvaṣṭaśūlena saṃhārākṣaramaulinā /
aṣṭabhirdaivataiścaiva yuktaṃ yantraṃ samālikhat //
meaning:
अष्टदिक्ष्वष्टशूलेन संहाराक्षरमौलिना /
अष्टभिर्दैवतैश्चैव युक्तं यन्त्रं समालिखत् //
text_mt: In the eight directions, with eight tridents crested with the syllables of destruction, / he inscribed the yantra endowed with eight deities.

sanskrit_iast:
alasā kṛpaṇā dīnā nitandrāca pramīlikā /
klībā ca nirahaṅkārā cetyaṣṭau devatāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अलसा कृपणा दीना नितन्द्राच प्रमीलिका /
क्लीबा च निरहङ्कारा चेत्यष्टौ देवताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Alasā, Kṛpaṇā, Dīnā, Nidtandrā, Pramīlikā, / Klībā, and Nirahaṅkārā—these are considered the eight deities.

sanskrit_iast:
devatāṣṭakametaśca śūlāṣṭakapuṭopari /
niyojya likhitaṃ yantraṃ māyāvī samamantrayat //
meaning:
देवताष्टकमेतश्च शूलाष्टकपुटोपरि /
नियोज्य लिखितं यन्त्रं मायावी सममन्त्रयत् //
text_mt: Placing this group of eight deities upon the compartments of the eight tridents, / the sorcerer inscribed the yantra and consecrated it with mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ vidhāya mantrasya balibhiśchāgalādibhiḥ /
tadyantraṃ cārikaṭake prākṣipatsamare 'suraḥ //
meaning:
पूजां विधाय मन्त्रस्य बलिभिश्छागलादिभिः /
तद्यन्त्रं चारिकटके प्राक्षिपत्समरे ऽसुरः //
text_mt: Having performed the worship of the mantra with offerings of goats and the like, / the Asura hurled that yantra into the enemy camp in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
pākārasya bahirbhāge vartinā tena durdhiyā /
kṣiptamullaṅghya ca raṇe papāta kaṭakāntare //
meaning:
पाकारस्य बहिर्भागे वर्तिना तेन दुर्धिया /
क्षिप्तमुल्लङ्घ्य च रणे पपात कटकान्तरे //
text_mt: Hurled by that evil-minded one standing outside the rampart, / it bounded over in the battle and fell within the camp.

sanskrit_iast:
tadyantrasya vikāreṇa kaṭakasthāstuśaktayaḥ /
vimuktaśastrasaṃnyāsamāsthitā dīnamānasāḥ //
meaning:
तद्यन्त्रस्य विकारेण कटकस्थास्तुशक्तयः /
विमुक्तशस्त्रसंन्यासमास्थिता दीनमानसाः //
text_mt: By the malignant influence of that yantra, the Śaktis stationed in the camp, / throwing down their weapons and taking to renunciation, became dejected in mind:

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ hatairasuraiḥ kāryaṃ śastrāśastrikramairalam /
jayasiddhaphalaṃ kiṃ vā prāṇihiṃsā ca pāpadā //
meaning:
किं हतैरसुरैः कार्यं शस्त्राशस्त्रिक्रमैरलम् /
जयसिद्धफलं किं वा प्राणिहिंसा च पापदा //
text_mt: “What is to be gained by slain Asuras? Enough of the exchanges of weapons! / What fruit is there in attaining victory? Moreover, violence to living beings brings sin.

sanskrit_iast:
amarāṇāṃ kṛte ko 'yaṃ kimasmākaṃ bhaviṣyati /
vṛthā kalakalaṃ kṛtvā na phalaṃ yuddhakarmaṇā //
meaning:
अमराणां कृते को ऽयं किमस्माकं भविष्यति /
वृथा कलकलं कृत्वा न फलं युद्धकर्मणा //
text_mt: For whose sake is this done for the immortals? What will become of us? / Having made a clamor in vain, no fruit comes from the act of fighting.

sanskrit_iast:
kā svāminī mahārājñī kā vāsau daṇḍanāyikā /
kā vā sā mantriṇī śyāmā bhṛtyatvaṃ no 'tha kīdṛśam //
meaning:
का स्वामिनी महाराज्ञी का वासौ दण्डनायिका /
का वा सा मन्त्रिणी श्यामा भृत्यत्वं नो ऽथ कीदृशम् //
text_mt: Who is the mistress, the Great Queen? Who is that Daṇḍanāyikā? / Who is that dark Mantriṇī? And what sort of servitude is ours?

sanskrit_iast:
iha sarvābhirasmābhirbhṛtyabhūtābhirekikā /
vanitā svāminīkṛtye kiṃ phalaṃ mokṣyate param //
meaning:
इह सर्वाभिरस्माभिर्भृत्यभूताभिरेकिका /
वनिता स्वामिनीकृत्ये किं फलं मोक्ष्यते परम् //
text_mt: If a single woman is made mistress by all of us who have become servants here, / what supreme reward will be enjoyed?

sanskrit_iast:
pareṣāṃ marmabhidurairāyudhairna prayojanam /
yuddhaṃ śāmyatu cāsmākaṃ dehaśastrakṣatipradam //
meaning:
परेषां मर्मभिदुरैरायुधैर्न प्रयोजनम् /
युद्धं शाम्यतु चास्माकं देहशस्त्रक्षतिप्रदम् //
text_mt: There is no purpose with weapons that pierce the vital spots of others; / let our battle cease, which causes wounds to our bodies from weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddhe ca maraṇaṃ bhāvi vṛthā syurjīvitāni naḥ /
yuddhe mṛtyurbhavedeva iti tatra pramaiva kā //
meaning:
युद्धे च मरणं भावि वृथा स्युर्जीवितानि नः /
युद्धे मृत्युर्भवेदेव इति तत्र प्रमैव का //
text_mt: In battle death will surely come, and our lives would be in vain; / indeed, death will inevitably occur in battle—what proof is even needed there?

sanskrit_iast:
utsāhena phalaṃ nāsti nidraivaikā sukhāvahā /
ālasyasadṛśaṃ nāsti cittaviśrāntidāyakam //
meaning:
उत्साहेन फलं नास्ति निद्रैवैका सुखावहा /
आलस्यसदृशं नास्ति चित्तविश्रान्तिदायकम् //
text_mt: There is no fruit in zeal; sleep alone brings happiness; / there is nothing like indolence that gives rest to the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
etādṛśīśca no jñātvā sā rājñī kiṃ kariṣyati /
tasyā rājñītvamapi naḥ samavāyena kalpitam //
meaning:
एतादृशीश्च नो ज्ञात्वा सा राज्ञी किं करिष्यति /
तस्या राज्ञीत्वमपि नः समवायेन कल्पितम् //
text_mt: And knowing us to be like this, what will that queen do? / Even her queenship was conceived through our assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ copekṣitāsmābhiḥ sā vinaṣṭabalā bhavet /
naṣṭa sattvā ca sā rājñī kānnaḥ śikṣāṃ kariṣyati //
meaning:
एवं चोपेक्षितास्माभिः सा विनष्टबला भवेत् /
नष्ट सत्त्वा च सा राज्ञी कान्नः शिक्षां करिष्यति //
text_mt: And thus neglected by us, she will become bereft of power; / when that queen has lost her strength, what punishment can she inflict on us?”

sanskrit_iast:
evameva raṇāraṃbhaṃ vimucya vidhutāyudhāḥ /
śaktayo nidrayā dvāre ghūrṇamānā ivābhavan //
meaning:
एवमेव रणारंभं विमुच्य विधुतायुधाः /
शक्तयो निद्रया द्वारे घूर्णमाना इवाभवन् //
text_mt: Abandoning the undertaking of battle and casting aside their weapons in this very manner, / the Śaktis at the gate became as though reeling with sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra māndyaṃ kāryeṣu mahadālasyamāgatam /
śithilaṃ cābhavatsarvaṃ śaktīnāṃ kaṭakaṃ mahat //
meaning:
सर्वत्र मान्द्यं कार्येषु महदालस्यमागतम् /
शिथिलं चाभवत्सर्वं शक्तीनां कटकं महत् //
text_mt: Everywhere slowness in actions, great indolence appeared, / and the entire great camp of the Śaktis became listless.

sanskrit_iast: jayavighnaṃ mahāyantramiti kṛtvā sa dānavaḥ //
meaning: जयविघ्नं महायन्त्रमिति कृत्वा स दानवः //
text_mt: Having thus made the great yantra [called] Jayavighna, that Dānava,

sanskrit_iast:
nirvidya tatprabhāveṇa kaṭakaṃ pramimanthiṣuḥ /
dvitīyayuddhadivasasyārdharātre gate sati //
meaning:
निर्विद्य तत्प्रभावेण कटकं प्रमिमन्थिषुः /
द्वितीययुद्धदिवसस्यार्धरात्रे गते सति //
text_mt: discerning [their state] by its power, wished to crush the camp / when the midnight of the second battle-day had passed.

sanskrit_iast:
nismṛtya nagarādbhūyastriṃśadakṣauhiṇīvṛtaḥ /
ājagāma punardaityo viśukraḥ kaṭakaṃ dviṣām //
meaning:
निस्मृत्य नगराद्भूयस्त्रिंशदक्षौहिणीवृतः /
आजगाम पुनर्दैत्यो विशुक्रः कटकं द्विषाम् //
text_mt: Marching out from the city again, accompanied by thirty akṣauhiṇīs, / the Daitya Viśukra returned to the camp of his foes.

sanskrit_iast:
aśrūyanta tatastasya raṇaniḥsāṇanisvanāḥ /
tathāpi tā nirudyogāḥ śaktayaḥ kaṭake 'bhavan //
meaning:
अश्रूयन्त ततस्तस्य रणनिःसाणनिस्वनाः /
तथापि ता निरुद्योगाः शक्तयः कटके ऽभवन् //
text_mt: Then the sounds of his war-kettledrums were heard; / even so, the Śaktis in the camp remained inactive.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā mahānubhāvatvādvikārairvighnayantrajaiḥ /
aspṛṣṭe mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe cintāmavā patuḥ //
meaning:
तदा महानुभावत्वाद्विकारैर्विघ्नयन्त्रजैः /
अस्पृष्टे मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे चिन्तामवा पतुः //
text_mt: Then, untouched by the alterations born of the Vighnayantra due to their great majesty, / Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā fell into anxiety:

sanskrit_iast:
aho bata mahatkaṣṭamidamāpatitaṃ bhayam /
kasya vātha vikāreṇa sainikā nirgatodyamāḥ //
meaning:
अहो बत महत्कष्टमिदमापतितं भयम् /
कस्य वाथ विकारेण सैनिका निर्गतोद्यमाः //
text_mt: “Ah, alas, a great distress, this danger has befallen [us]! / Or by whose alteration have the soldiers lost all initiative?

sanskrit_iast:
nirastāyudhasaṃraṃbhā nidrātandrāvighūrṇitāḥ /
na mānayanti vākyāni rārcayanti maheśvarīm /
audāsīnyaṃ vitanvanti śaktayo nispṛhā imāḥ //
meaning:
निरस्तायुधसंरंभा निद्रातन्द्राविघूर्णिताः /
न मानयन्ति वाक्यानि रार्चयन्ति महेश्वरीम् /
औदासीन्यं वितन्वन्ति शक्तयो निस्पृहा इमाः //
text_mt: Abandoning their readiness with weapons, rolling [their eyes] in sleep and languor, / they heed no words, nor do they worship Maheśvarī; / these Śaktis, free from desire, display complete apathy.”

sanskrit_iast:
iti te mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthe cintāparāyaṇe /
cakrasyandanamārūḍhe mahārājñīṃ samūcatuḥ //
meaning:
इति ते मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथे चिन्तापरायणे /
चक्रस्यन्दनमारूढे महाराज्ञीं समूचतुः //
text_mt: Thus engrossed in anxiety, those two, Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā, / mounted upon their chariot, addressed the Great Queen:

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṇyuvāca
devi sakya vikāro 'yaṃ śaktayo vigatodyamāḥ /
na śṛṇvanti mahārājñi tavājñāṃ viśvapālitām //
meaning:
मन्त्रिण्युवाच
देवि सक्य विकारो ऽयं शक्तयो विगतोद्यमाः /
न शृण्वन्ति महाराज्ञि तवाज्ञां विश्वपालिताम् //
text_mt: Mantriṇī said: / “O Goddess, whose alteration is this? The Śaktis have lost their initiative; / they do not listen, O Great Queen, to your command, which protects the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyaṃ ca viraktāstāḥ parācyaḥ sarvakarmasu /
nidrātandrāmukulitā durvākyāni vitanvate //
meaning:
अन्योन्यं च विरक्तास्ताः पराच्यः सर्वकर्मसु /
निद्रातन्द्रामुकुलिता दुर्वाक्यानि वितन्वते //
text_mt: They are disaffected toward one another, turned away from all duties; / with eyes half-closed in sleep and languor, they utter insolent words:

sanskrit_iast:
kā daṇḍinī mantriṇī kā mahārājñīti kā punaḥ /
yuddhaṃ ca kīdṛśamiti kṣepaṃ bhūri vitanvate //
meaning:
का दण्डिनी मन्त्रिणी का महाराज्ञीति का पुनः /
युद्धं च कीदृशमिति क्षेपं भूरि वितन्वते //
text_mt: ‘Who is Daṇḍinī? Who is Mantriṇī? And who is the Great Queen? / And what sort of battle is this?’ Thus they utter abundant abuse.

sanskrit_iast:
asminnevāntare śatrurāgacchati mahābalaḥ /
uddaṇḍabherīnisvānairvibhindanniva rodasī //
meaning:
अस्मिन्नेवान्तरे शत्रुरागच्छति महाबलः /
उद्दण्डभेरीनिस्वानैर्विभिन्दन्निव रोदसी //
text_mt: At this very moment the enemy is advancing, endowed with great strength, / as though cleaving heaven and earth with the loud sounds of his raised war-drums.

sanskrit_iast:
atra yatprāptarūpaṃ tanmahārājñi prapadyatām /
ityuktvā saha daṇḍinyā mantriṇī praṇatiṃ vyadhāt //
meaning:
अत्र यत्प्राप्तरूपं तन्महाराज्ञि प्रपद्यताम् /
इत्युक्त्वा सह दण्डिन्या मन्त्रिणी प्रणतिं व्यधात् //
text_mt: Let whatever is appropriate here, O Great Queen, be undertaken.” / Having spoken thus together with Daṇḍinī, Mantriṇī made her prostration.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sā lalitā devī kāmeśvaramukhaṃ prati /
dattadṛṣṭaḍiḥ samahasadatiraktaradāvaliḥ //
meaning:
ततः सा ललिता देवी कामेश्वरमुखं प्रति /
दत्तदृष्टडिः समहसदतिरक्तरदावलिः //
text_mt: Then that goddess Lalitā turned her gaze toward the face of Kāmeśvara / and smiled, with rows of teeth exceedingly crimson.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ smitaprabhāpuñje kuñjarākṛtimānmukhe /
kaṭakroḍagaladdānaḥ kaścideva vyajṛṃbhata //
meaning:
तस्याः स्मितप्रभापुञ्जे कुञ्जराकृतिमान्मुखे /
कटक्रोडगलद्दानः कश्चिदेव व्यजृंभत //
text_mt: From the mass of the radiance of her smile, there manifested someone in her presence / who possessed the form of an elephant, with rut flowing down the hollow of his temples:

sanskrit_iast:
japāpaṭalapāṭalyo bālacandravapurdharaḥ /
bījapūragadāmikṣucāpaṃ śūlaṃ sudarśanam //
meaning:
जपापटलपाटल्यो बालचन्द्रवपुर्धरः /
बीजपूरगदामिक्षुचापं शूलं सुदर्शनम् //
text_mt: having the pink hue of a heap of China roses, bearing the form of the crescent moon, / holding a citron, a mace, a sugarcane bow, a trident, Sudarśana,

sanskrit_iast:
abjapāśotpalavrīhimañjarīvaradāṃ kuśān /
ratnakuṃbhaṃ ca daśabhiḥ svakairhastaiḥ samudvahan //
meaning:
अब्जपाशोत्पलव्रीहिमञ्जरीवरदां कुशान् /
रत्नकुंभं च दशभिः स्वकैर्हस्तैः समुद्वहन् //
text_mt: a lotus, a noose, a blue lotus, a cluster of paddy ears, the gesture of granting boons, a goad, / and a jewel jar in his ten own hands,

sanskrit_iast:
tundilaścandracūḍālo mandrabṛṃhitanisvanaḥ /
siddhilakṣmīsamāśliṣṭaḥ praṇanāma maheśvarīm //
meaning:
तुन्दिलश्चन्द्रचूडालो मन्द्रबृंहितनिस्वनः /
सिद्धिलक्ष्मीसमाश्लिष्टः प्रणनाम महेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: pot-bellied, crowned with the moon, his roar a deep rumbling, / embraced by Siddhilakṣmī, he bowed down to Maheśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā kṛtāśīḥ sa mahāngaṇanātho gajānanaḥ /
jayavighnamahāyantraṃbhettuṃ vegādviniryayau //
meaning:
तया कृताशीः स महान्गणनाथो गजाननः /
जयविघ्नमहायन्त्रंभेत्तुं वेगाद्विनिर्ययौ //
text_mt: Blessed by her, that great Gaṇanātha, the elephant-faced one, / rushed forth with speed to break the great Jayavighnayantra.

sanskrit_iast:
antarevahi śālasya bhramaddantāvalānanaḥ /
nibhṛtaṃ kutracillagnaṃ jayavighnaṃ vyalokayat //
meaning:
अन्तरेवहि शालस्य भ्रमद्दन्तावलाननः /
निभृतं कुत्रचिल्लग्नं जयविघ्नं व्यलोकयत् //
text_mt: Roaming about inside the boundary wall, the elephant-faced one / saw the Jayavighna fixed secretly in a certain place.

sanskrit_iast:
sa devo ghoranirghātairduḥsahairdantapātanaiḥ /
kṣaṇāccūrmīkaroti sma jayavighnamahāśilām //
meaning:
स देवो घोरनिर्घातैर्दुःसहैर्दन्तपातनैः /
क्षणाच्चूर्मीकरोति स्म जयविघ्नमहाशिलाम् //
text_mt: With terrible thunder-like blows and unbearable strikes of his tusk, that god / reduced to powder in an instant that great stone of the Jayavighna.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitābhirduṣṭābhirdevatābhiḥ sahaiva saḥ /
parāgaśeṣatāṃ nītvā tadyantraṃ prakṣipaddivi //
meaning:
तत्र स्थिताभिर्दुष्टाभिर्देवताभिः सहैव सः /
परागशेषतां नीत्वा तद्यन्त्रं प्रक्षिपद्दिवि //
text_mt: Together with the evil deities stationed in it, / he reduced that yantra to mere dust and hurled it into the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kilakilārāvaṃ kṛtvā'lasyavivarjitāḥ /
udyatāḥ samaraṃ kartuṃ śaktayaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
ततः किलकिलारावं कृत्वाऽलस्यविवर्जिताः /
उद्यताः समरं कर्तुं शक्तयः शस्त्रपाणयः //
text_mt: Then, raising a shout of joy, freed from indolence, / the Śaktis, weapons in hand, stood ready to do battle.

sanskrit_iast:
sa detivadanaḥ kaṇṭhakalitākuṇṭhanisvanaḥ /
jayayantraṃ hi tatsṛṣṭaṃ tathā rātrau vyanāśayat //
meaning:
स देतिवदनः कण्ठकलिताकुण्ठनिस्वनः /
जययन्त्रं हि तत्सृष्टं तथा रात्रौ व्यनाशयत् //
text_mt: He, the elephant-faced one, with unhindered sounds issuing from his throat, / thus destroyed that night the Jayayantra that had been created.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ vṛttāntamākarṇya bhaṇḍaḥ sa kṣobhamāyayau /
sasarjaya bahūnātmarūpāndantāvalānanān //
meaning:
इमं वृत्तान्तमाकर्ण्य भण्डः स क्षोभमाययौ /
ससर्जय बहूनात्मरूपान्दन्तावलाननान् //
text_mt: Hearing of this occurrence, that Bhaṇḍa became agitated. / He [then, Gaṇanātha,] created many elephant-faced ones who had his own form.

sanskrit_iast:
te kaṭakroḍavigalanmadasaurabhacañcalaiḥ /
cañcarīkakulairagre gīyamānamahodayāḥ //
meaning:
ते कटक्रोडविगलन्मदसौरभचञ्चलैः /
चञ्चरीककुलैरग्रे गीयमानमहोदयाः //
text_mt: Their great prosperity was sung in front of them by swarms of bees / trembling with delight at the fragrance of rut flowing down the hollow of their temples.

sanskrit_iast:
sphuraddāḍimakiñjalkavikṣepakararociṣaḥ /
sadā ratnākarānekahelayā pātumudyatāḥ //
meaning:
स्फुरद्दाडिमकिञ्जल्कविक्षेपकररोचिषः /
सदा रत्नाकरानेकहेलया पातुमुद्यताः //
text_mt: Shining with the luster of hands scattering the filaments of blossoming pomegranates, / ever eager to drink up the oceans in sport,

sanskrit_iast:
āmodapramukhā ṛddhimukhyaśaktiniṣevitāḥ /
āmodaśca pramodaśca mumukho durmukhastathā //
meaning:
आमोदप्रमुखा ऋद्धिमुख्यशक्तिनिषेविताः /
आमोदश्च प्रमोदश्च मुमुखो दुर्मुखस्तथा //
text_mt: attended by powers headed by Ṛddhi, and led by Āmoda: / Āmoda, Pramoda, Sumukha, and likewise Durmukha,

sanskrit_iast:
arighno vighnakarttā ca ṣaḍete vighnanāyakāḥ /
te saptakoṭisaṃkhyānāṃ heraṃbāṇāmadhīśvarāḥ //
meaning:
अरिघ्नो विघ्नकर्त्ता च षडेते विघ्ननायकाः /
ते सप्तकोटिसंख्यानां हेरंबाणामधीश्वराः //
text_mt: Arighna, and Vighnakartṛ: these are the six commanders of obstacles. / They are the rulers of seven crores of Herambas.

sanskrit_iast:
te puraścalitāstasya mahāgaṇapate raṇe /
agniprākāravalayādvinirgatya gajānanāḥ //
meaning:
ते पुरश्चलितास्तस्य महागणपते रणे /
अग्निप्राकारवलयाद्विनिर्गत्य गजाननाः //
text_mt: Those elephant-faced ones marched forward in battle before that Mahāgaṇapati, / coming forth from the ring of the rampart of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
krodhahuṅkāratumulāḥ pratya padyanta dānavān /
punaḥ pracaṇḍaphūtkārabadhirīkṛtaviṣṭapāḥ //
meaning:
क्रोधहुङ्कारतुमुलाः प्रत्य पद्यन्त दानवान् /
पुनः प्रचण्डफूत्कारबधिरीकृतविष्टपाः //
text_mt: Tumultuous with roars of rage, they attacked the Dānavas; / deafening the world again with fierce puffing breaths,

sanskrit_iast:
papāta daityasainyeṣu gaṇacakracamūgaṇaḥ /
acchidanniśitairbāṇairgaṇanāthaḥ sa dānavān //
meaning:
पपात दैत्यसैन्येषु गणचक्रचमूगणः /
अच्छिदन्निशितैर्बाणैर्गणनाथः स दानवान् //
text_mt: the host of the army of the Gaṇa-troop fell upon the Daitya forces. / That Gaṇanātha cut down the Dānavas with sharp arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇanāthena tasyābhūdviśukrasya mahaujasaḥ /
yuddhamuddhatahuṅkārabhinnakārmukaniḥsvanam //
meaning:
गणनाथेन तस्याभूद्विशुक्रस्य महौजसः /
युद्धमुद्धतहुङ्कारभिन्नकार्मुकनिःस्वनम् //
text_mt: Between that Gaṇanātha and Viśukra of great might / there took place a battle, with sounds of bows broken amidst haughty roars.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrukuṭī kuṭile cakre daṣṭoṣṭhamatipāṭalam /
viśukro yudhi bibhrāṇaḥ samayudhyata tena saḥ //
meaning:
भ्रुकुटी कुटिले चक्रे दष्टोष्ठमतिपाटलम् /
विशुक्रो युधि बिभ्राणः समयुध्यत तेन सः //
text_mt: Contracting his eyebrows, biting his excessively red lower lip, / Viśukra fought with him in the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
śastrāghaṭṭananisvānair huṃkāraiśca suradviṣām /
daityasaptikhurakrīḍatkuddālīkūṭanisvanaiḥ //
meaning:
शस्त्राघट्टननिस्वानैर् हुंकारैश्च सुरद्विषाम् /
दैत्यसप्तिखुरक्रीडत्कुद्दालीकूटनिस्वनैः //
text_mt: With the sounds of weapon collisions and the roars of the enemies of the gods, / with the clatter of the spades [of stones] struck by the hooves of the Daityas' steeds,

sanskrit_iast:
phetkāraiśca gacendrāṇāṃ bhayenākrandanairapi /
heṣayā ca hayaśreṇyā rathacakrasvanairapi //
meaning:
फेत्कारैश्च गचेन्द्राणां भयेनाक्रन्दनैरपि /
हेषया च हयश्रेण्या रथचक्रस्वनैरपि //
text_mt: with the screams of lordly elephants and their cries of fear, / with the neighing of lines of horses and the rumbling of chariot wheels,

sanskrit_iast: dhanuṣāṃ guṇanissvānaiścakracītkaraṇairapi //
meaning: धनुषां गुणनिस्स्वानैश्चक्रचीत्करणैरपि //
text_mt: with the twanging sounds of bowstrings and the whirring of discs,

sanskrit_iast:
śarasātkāraghoṣaiśca vīrabhāṣākadaṃbakaiḥ /
aṭṭahāsairmahendrāṇāṃ siṃhanādaiścabhūriśaḥ //
meaning:
शरसात्कारघोषैश्च वीरभाषाकदंबकैः /
अट्टहासैर्महेन्द्राणां सिंहनादैश्चभूरिशः //
text_mt: with the whistling noise of arrows and the heaps of words spoken by heroes, / with the loud laughter of great leaders and abundant lion-roars,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣubhyaddigantaraṃ tatra vavṛdhe yuddhamuddhatam /
triṃśadakṣauhiṇī senā viśukrasya durātmanaḥ //
meaning:
क्षुभ्यद्दिगन्तरं तत्र ववृधे युद्धमुद्धतम् /
त्रिंशदक्षौहिणी सेना विशुक्रस्य दुरात्मनः //
text_mt: the fierce battle raged there, shaking the quarters of the sky. / The army of thirty akṣauhiṇīs of the wicked Viśukra

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ yodhayā māsurgaṇanāthā mahārathāḥ /
dantairmarma vibhindanto viṣṭaṃyataśca śuṇḍayā //
meaning:
प्रत्येकं योधया मासुर्गणनाथा महारथाः /
दन्तैर्मर्म विभिन्दन्तो विष्टंयतश्च शुण्डया //
text_mt: the Gaṇanāthas, great car-warriors, fought individually, / piercing vital parts with their tusks and restraining [foes] with their trunks,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhayantaḥ karṇatālaiḥ puṣkalāvarttakopamaiḥ /
nāsāśvāsaiśca paruṣairvikṣipantaḥ patākinīm //
meaning:
क्रोधयन्तः कर्णतालैः पुष्कलावर्त्तकोपमैः /
नासाश्वासैश्च परुषैर्विक्षिपन्तः पताकिनीम् //
text_mt: enraging [them] with the flapping of their ears resembling Puṣkalāvarta clouds, / and scattering the army with the harsh blasts of their nostrils,

sanskrit_iast:
urobhirmardayantaśca śailavaprasamaprabhaiḥ /
piṃṣantaśca padāghātaiḥ pīnairghnantastathodaraiḥ //
meaning:
उरोभिर्मर्दयन्तश्च शैलवप्रसमप्रभैः /
पिंषन्तश्च पदाघातैः पीनैर्घ्नन्तस्तथोदरैः //
text_mt: crushing [them] with chests possessing the radiance of mountain slopes, / grinding [them] with blows of their feet, and striking them with their stout bellies,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhindantaśca śūlena kṛttantaścakrapātanaiḥ /
śaṅkhasvanena mahatā trāsayanto varūthinīm //
meaning:
विभिन्दन्तश्च शूलेन कृत्तन्तश्चक्रपातनैः /
शङ्खस्वनेन महता त्रासयन्तो वरूथिनीम् //
text_mt: piercing with the trident and slicing with discharges of the disc, / terrifying the army with the great blare of the conch.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇanāthamukhodbhūtā gajavakrāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
dhūlīśeṣaṃ samastaṃ tatsainyaṃ cakrurmahodyatāḥ //
meaning:
गणनाथमुखोद्भूता गजवक्राः सहस्रशः /
धूलीशेषं समस्तं तत्सैन्यं चक्रुर्महोद्यताः //
text_mt: Born from the face of the Gaṇanātha, thousands of elephant-faced ones, / highly zealous, turned that entire army into mere dust.

sanskrit_iast:
atha krodhasamāviṣṭo nijasainyapurogamaḥ /
preṣayāmāsa devasya gajāsura masau punaḥ //
meaning:
अथ क्रोधसमाविष्टो निजसैन्यपुरोगमः /
प्रेषयामास देवस्य गजासुर मसौ पुनः //
text_mt: Then, seized by rage, the leader of his own army, / that [Viśukra] dispatched Gajāsura against the god.

sanskrit_iast:
pracaṇḍasiṃhanādena gajadaityena durdhiyā /
saptākṣauhiṇiyuktena yuyudhe sa gaṇeśvaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रचण्डसिंहनादेन गजदैत्येन दुर्धिया /
सप्ताक्षौहिणियुक्तेन युयुधे स गणेश्वरः //
text_mt: With a fierce lion-roar, with that evil-minded elephant-demon / accompanied by seven akṣauhiṇīs, that Gaṇeśvara fought.

sanskrit_iast:
hīyamānaṃ samālokya gajāsurabhujābalam /
vardhamānaṃ ca tadvīryaṃ viśukraḥ prapalāyitaḥ //
meaning:
हीयमानं समालोक्य गजासुरभुजाबलम् /
वर्धमानं च तद्वीर्यं विशुक्रः प्रपलायितः //
text_mt: Seeing the arm-strength of Gajāsura waning / and the other's valor increasing, Viśukra fled.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eka eva vīredraḥ pracalannākhuvāhanaḥ /
saptākṣauhiṇikāyuktaṃ gajāsuramamardayat //
meaning:
स एक एव वीरेद्रः प्रचलन्नाखुवाहनः /
सप्ताक्षौहिणिकायुक्तं गजासुरममर्दयत् //
text_mt: That foremost of heroes, alone, advancing on his rat mount, / crushed Gajāsura together with his seven akṣauhiṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
gajāsure ca nihate viśukre prapalāyite /
lalitāntikamāpede mahāgamapatirmṛdhāt //
meaning:
गजासुरे च निहते विशुक्रे प्रपलायिते /
ललितान्तिकमापेदे महागमपतिर्मृधात् //
text_mt: And when Gajāsura was slain and Viśukra had fled, / the great lord of gaṇas went to Lalitā from the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
kālarātriśca daityānāṃ sā rātrirviratiṃ gatā /
lalitā cāti muditā babhūvāsya parākramaiḥ //
meaning:
कालरात्रिश्च दैत्यानां सा रात्रिर्विरतिं गता /
ललिता चाति मुदिता बभूवास्य पराक्रमैः //
text_mt: And that night, which was a night of doom for the Daityas, came to an end; / and Lalitā was exceedingly delighted by his valorous deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
vitatāra mahārājñīprīyamāṇā gaṇeśituḥ /
sarvadaivatapūjāyāḥ pūrvapūjyatvamuttamam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne gaṇanāthaparākramo nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
विततार महाराज्ञीप्रीयमाणा गणेशितुः /
सर्वदैवतपूजायाः पूर्वपूज्यत्वमुत्तमम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डपुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने गणनाथपराक्रमो नाम सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Pleasured, the great Queen bestowed upon the lord of gaṇas / the supreme privilege of receiving the first worship in the worship of all deities.

Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named "The Prowess of the Lord of Gaṇas," in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
raṇebhagnaṃ mahādaityaṃ bhaṇḍadaityaḥ sahodaram /
senānāṃ kadanaṃ śrutvā santapto bahucintayā //
meaning:
रणेभग्नं महादैत्यं भण्डदैत्यः सहोदरम् /
सेनानां कदनं श्रुत्वा सन्तप्तो बहुचिन्तया //
text_mt: Hearing of his brother, the great Daitya, broken in battle, / and the slaughter of the armies, the Daitya Bhaṇḍa was tormented with much grief.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhāvapi sametau tau yuktau sarvaiścasainikaiḥ /
preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya bhaṇḍadaityaḥ sahodarau //
meaning:
उभावपि समेतौ तौ युक्तौ सर्वैश्चसैनिकैः /
प्रेषयामास युद्धाय भण्डदैत्यः सहोदरौ //
text_mt: The Daitya Bhaṇḍa dispatched both of his brothers together, / accompanied by all their soldiers, to the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvubhau paramakruddhau bhaṇḍadaityena deśitau /
viṣaṅgaśca viśukraśca mahodyama mavāpanuḥ //
meaning:
तावुभौ परमक्रुद्धौ भण्डदैत्येन देशितौ /
विषङ्गश्च विशुक्रश्च महोद्यम मवापनुः //
text_mt: Both Viṣaṅga and Viśukra, extremely enraged / and commanded by the Daitya Bhaṇḍa, undertook a mighty effort.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭhasahitaṃ tatra yuvarājaṃ mahābalam /
viśukramanuvavrāja senā trailokyakampinī //
meaning:
कनिष्ठसहितं तत्र युवराजं महाबलम् /
विशुक्रमनुवव्राज सेना त्रैलोक्यकम्पिनी //
text_mt: Then, an army making the three worlds tremble followed Viśukra, / the crown prince of great might, together with his younger brother.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣauhiṇīcatuḥśatyā senānāmāvṛtaśca saḥ /
yuvarājaḥ pravavṛdhe pratāpena mahīyasā //
meaning:
अक्षौहिणीचतुःशत्या सेनानामावृतश्च सः /
युवराजः प्रववृधे प्रतापेन महीयसा //
text_mt: And surrounded by four hundred akṣauhiṇīs of armies, / the crown prince advanced with immense splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkajitprabhṛtayo bhāgineyā daśoddhatāḥ /
bhaṇḍasya ca bhaginyāntu dhūminyāṃ jātayonayaḥ //
meaning:
उलूकजित्प्रभृतयो भागिनेया दशोद्धताः /
भण्डस्य च भगिन्यान्तु धूमिन्यां जातयोनयः //
text_mt: The ten haughty nephews [of Bhaṇḍa], Ulūkajit and others, / born from the womb of Dhūminī, the sister of Bhaṇḍa,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāstraśikṣā bhaṇḍena mātulena mahīyasā /
vikrameṇa valantaste senānāthāḥ pratasthire //
meaning:
कृतास्त्रशिक्षा भण्डेन मातुलेन महीयसा /
विक्रमेण वलन्तस्ते सेनानाथाः प्रतस्थिरे //
text_mt: who had been trained in weapons by Bhaṇḍa, their mighty maternal uncle, / marched out as army commanders, sweeping along with valorous might.

sanskrit_iast:
prodgataiścāpanirghoṣairghoṣayanto diśo daśa /
dvayormātulayoḥ prītiṃ bhāgineyā vitenire //
meaning:
प्रोद्गतैश्चापनिर्घोषैर्घोषयन्तो दिशो दश /
द्वयोर्मातुलयोः प्रीतिं भागिनेया वितेनिरे //
text_mt: Making the ten directions resound with the arising twangs of their bows, / the nephews brought delight to their two maternal uncles.

sanskrit_iast:
ārūḍhayānāḥ pratyekagāḍhāhaṅkāraśālinaḥ /
ākṛṣṭagurudhanvāno viśukramanuvavrajuḥ //
meaning:
आरूढयानाः प्रत्येकगाढाहङ्कारशालिनः /
आकृष्टगुरुधन्वानो विशुक्रमनुवव्रजुः //
text_mt: Mounted on vehicles, possessed of profound pride individually, / with their heavy bows drawn, they followed Viśukra.

sanskrit_iast:
yauvarājyaprabhācihnacchatracāmaraśobhitaḥ /
ārūḍhavāraṇaḥ prāpa viśukro yuddhamedinīm //
meaning:
यौवराज्यप्रभाचिह्नच्छत्रचामरशोभितः /
आरूढवारणः प्राप विशुक्रो युद्धमेदिनीम् //
text_mt: Adorned with parasols and chowries, the insignia of the splendour of the heir-apparent, / mounted upon an elephant, Viśukra reached the battleground.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kalakalārāvakāriṇyā senayā vṛtaḥ /
viśukraḥ paṭu dadhvāna siṃhanādaṃ bhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
ततः कलकलारावकारिण्या सेनया वृतः /
विशुक्रः पटु दध्वान सिंहनादं भयङ्करम् //
text_mt: Surrounded then by an army making a clamorous roar, / Viśukra let out a loud, terrifying lion-roar.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkṣobhātkṣubhitasvāntāḥ śaktayaḥ saṃbhramoddhatāḥ /
agniprākāravalayānnirjagamurbaddhapaṅkayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्क्षोभात्क्षुभितस्वान्ताः शक्तयः संभ्रमोद्धताः /
अग्निप्राकारवलयान्निर्जगमुर्बद्धपङ्कयः //
text_mt: Agitated in mind by that commotion, the Śaktis, aroused in flurry, / emerged in formed ranks from the enclosure of the rampart of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
taḍinmayamivākāśaṃ kurvantyaḥ svasvarociṣā /
raktāmvujāvṛtamiva vyomacakraṃ raṇonmukhāḥ //
meaning:
तडिन्मयमिवाकाशं कुर्वन्त्यः स्वस्वरोचिषा /
रक्ताम्वुजावृतमिव व्योमचक्रं रणोन्मुखाः //
text_mt: making the sky as if made of lightning by their individual radiances, / and the vault of the heavens as if covered with red lotuses, eager for battle.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhaṇḍakanīyāṃsāvāgatau yuddhadurmadau /
niśamya yugapadyoddhaṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyake //
meaning:
अथ भण्डकनीयांसावागतौ युद्धदुर्मदौ /
निशम्य युगपद्योद्धं मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायके //
text_mt: Then, hearing that Bhaṇḍa's two younger brothers had arrived, arrogant for war, / the Mantriṇī and the Daṇḍanāyakā, in order to fight simultaneously,

sanskrit_iast:
kiricakaṃ jñeyacakramārūḍhe rathaśekharam /
dhṛtātapatravalaye cāmarābhyāṃ ca vījite //
meaning:
किरिचकं ज्ञेयचक्रमारूढे रथशेखरम् /
धृतातपत्रवलये चामराभ्यां च वीजिते //
text_mt: mounted upon the crests of their chariots—the Kiricakra and the Geyacakra— / over which parasols were held and fans of chowries were waved,

sanskrit_iast:
apsarobhiḥ pranṛttābhirgīyamānamahodaye /
nirjagamatū raṇaṃ kartumubhābhyāṃ lalitājñayā //
meaning:
अप्सरोभिः प्रनृत्ताभिर्गीयमानमहोदये /
निर्जगमतू रणं कर्तुमुभाभ्यां ललिताज्ञया //
text_mt: their great prosperity being sung by apsarases dancing forward, / went forth by Lalitā's command to wage battle against both.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīcakraratharājasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ niveśite /
śatākṣauhiṇikāṃ senāṃ varjayitvāstrabhīṣaṇam //
meaning:
श्रीचक्ररथराजस्य रक्षणार्थं निवेशिते /
शताक्षौहिणिकां सेनां वर्जयित्वास्त्रभीषणम् //
text_mt: Except for the army of one hundred akṣauhiṇīs, dreadful with weapons, / stationed for the protection of the king of chariots, the Śrīcakra,

sanskrit_iast:
anyatsarvaṃ camujālaṃ nirjagāma raṇonmukhī /
purataḥ prācaladdaṇḍanāthā rathaniṣeduṣī //
meaning:
अन्यत्सर्वं चमुजालं निर्जगाम रणोन्मुखी /
पुरतः प्राचलद्दण्डनाथा रथनिषेदुषी //
text_mt: the entire rest of the mass of forces went forth, eager for battle. / In front moved Daṇḍanāthā, seated in her chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
ekayaiva karāṅgulyā ghūrṇayantī halāyudham /
musalaṃ cānyahastena bhrāmayantī muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
एकयैव कराङ्गुल्या घूर्णयन्ती हलायुधम् /
मुसलं चान्यहस्तेन भ्रामयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: spinning her plough weapon with only a single finger, / and twirling her pestle again and again with her other hand;

sanskrit_iast:
taralendukalācūḍāsphuratpotramukhāmbujā /
puraḥ prahartrī samare sarvadā vikramoddhatā /
asyā anupracalitā geyacakrarathasthitā //
meaning:
तरलेन्दुकलाचूडास्फुरत्पोत्रमुखाम्बुजा /
पुरः प्रहर्त्री समरे सर्वदा विक्रमोद्धता /
अस्या अनुप्रचलिता गेयचक्ररथस्थिता //
text_mt: the lotus of her snout-face shining with the crest of a crescent moon; / striking first in battle, always swollen with valorous might. / Behind her moved [Mantriṇī], standing in her Geyacakra chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuṣo dhvaninā viśvaṃ pūrayantī mahoddhatā /
veṇīkṛtakacanyastavilasaccandrapallavā //
meaning:
धनुषो ध्वनिना विश्वं पूरयन्ती महोद्धता /
वेणीकृतकचन्यस्तविलसच्चन्द्रपल्लवा //
text_mt: filling the universe with the twang of her bow, exceedingly haughty, / having a gleaming crescent moon placed upon her braided hair,

sanskrit_iast:
sphurattritayanetreṇa sindūratilakatviṣā /
pāṇinā padmaramyeṇa maṇikaṅkaṇacāruṇā //
meaning:
स्फुरत्त्रितयनेत्रेण सिन्दूरतिलकत्विषा /
पाणिना पद्मरम्येण मणिकङ्कणचारुणा //
text_mt: with three flashing eyes, glowing with a mark of vermilion, / with a hand lovely as a lotus and charming with a jewelled bracelet,

sanskrit_iast:
tūṇīramukhataḥ kṛṣṭaṃ bhrāmayantī śilīmukham /
jaya vardhasvavardhasvetyatiharṣasamākule //
meaning:
तूणीरमुखतः कृष्टं भ्रामयन्ती शिलीमुखम् /
जय वर्धस्ववर्धस्वेत्यतिहर्षसमाकुले //
text_mt: twirling an arrow drawn forth from the mouth of her quiver; / while divine sages, dancing in great tumult of joy, [crying] "Be victorious! Grow! Grow!"

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyadbhirdivyamunibhirvarddhitāśīrvaco 'mṛtaiḥ /
geyacakrarathendrasya cakranemivighaṭṭanaiḥ //
meaning:
नृत्यद्भिर्दिव्यमुनिभिर्वर्द्धिताशीर्वचो ऽमृतैः /
गेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य चक्रनेमिविघट्टनैः //
text_mt: magnified her with the nectar of benedictory words; / and by the collisions of the felly of the wheel of that lord of chariots, the Geyacakra,

sanskrit_iast:
dārayantī kṣititalaṃ daityānāṃ hṛdayaiḥ saha /
lokātiśāyitā viśvamanomohanakāriṇā /
gītibandhenāmarībhirbahvībhirgītavaibhavā //
meaning:
दारयन्ती क्षितितलं दैत्यानां हृदयैः सह /
लोकातिशायिता विश्वमनोमोहनकारिणा /
गीतिबन्धेनामरीभिर्बह्वीभिर्गीतवैभवा //
text_mt: she tore open the surface of the earth together with the hearts of the Daityas; / extraordinary in the world, her majesty sung by numerous celestial women / with musical compositions that enchanted the minds of the universe;

sanskrit_iast:
akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇāmaṣṭakaṃ samaroddhatam /
karṣatī kalpaviśleṣanirmaryādābdhisaṃnibham //
meaning:
अक्षौहिणीसहस्राणामष्टकं समरोद्धतम् /
कर्षती कल्पविश्लेषनिर्मर्यादाब्धिसंनिभम् //
text_mt: drawing along eight thousand akṣauhiṇīs fierce in battle, / resembling the ocean overflowing its bounds at the dissolution of an eon.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ śakticamūcakre kāścitkanakarociṣaḥ /
kāściddāḍimasaṃkāśāḥ kāścijjīmūtarociṣaḥ //
meaning:
तस्याः शक्तिचमूचक्रे काश्चित्कनकरोचिषः /
काश्चिद्दाडिमसंकाशाः काश्चिज्जीमूतरोचिषः //
text_mt: In her host of Śaktis, some had the splendour of gold, / some resembled pomegranates, and some had the lustre of storm clouds;

sanskrit_iast:
anyāḥ siṃdūrarucayaḥ parāḥ pāṭalapāṭalāḥ /
kācādrikāmbarāḥ kāścitparāḥ śyāmalakomalāḥ //
meaning:
अन्याः सिंदूररुचयः पराः पाटलपाटलाः /
काचाद्रिकाम्बराः काश्चित्पराः श्यामलकोमलाः //
text_mt: others had the lustre of vermilion, others were pale pink, / some had garments [radiant] as a crystal mountain, others were dark and tender;

sanskrit_iast:
anyāstu hīrakaprakhyāḥ parā gārutmatopamāḥ /
viruddhaiḥ pañcabhirbāṇairmiśritaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
अन्यास्तु हीरकप्रख्याः परा गारुत्मतोपमाः /
विरुद्धैः पञ्चभिर्बाणैर्मिश्रितैः शतकोटिभिः //
text_mt: others resembled diamonds, and others were like emeralds; / displaying bodily radiance with conflicting groups of five arrows / mixed in hundreds of millions,

sanskrit_iast:
vyañjayantyo deharucaṃ katicidvividhāyudhāḥ /
asaṃkhyāḥ śaktayaścelurdaṇḍinyāssainike tathā //
meaning:
व्यञ्जयन्त्यो देहरुचं कतिचिद्विविधायुधाः /
असंख्याः शक्तयश्चेलुर्दण्डिन्यास्सैनिके तथा //
text_mt: some with various weapons, / innumerable Śaktis advanced, and likewise in the army of Daṇḍinī.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva sainyasannāho mantriṇyāḥ kumbhasambhava /
yathā bhūṣaṇaveṣādi yathā prabhāvalakṣaṇam //
meaning:
तथैव सैन्यसन्नाहो मन्त्रिण्याः कुम्भसम्भव /
यथा भूषणवेषादि यथा प्रभावलक्षणम् //
text_mt: Just so was the equipment of Mantriṇī's army, O pitcher-born [Agastya], / as was their ornament, dress, and marks of glory;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā sadguṇaśālitvaṃ yathā cāśritalakṣaṇam /
yathā daityaughasaṃhāro yathā sarvaiśca pūjitā //
meaning:
यथा सद्गुणशालित्वं यथा चाश्रितलक्षणम् /
यथा दैत्यौघसंहारो यथा सर्वैश्च पूजिता //
text_mt: as was their endowment with noble virtues, and their care of dependants; / as was their destruction of the hosts of Daityas, and their veneration by all;

sanskrit_iast:
yathā śaktirmahārājñyā deḍinyaśca tathākhilam /
viśeṣastu paraṃ tasyāḥ sācivye tatkare sthitam /
mahārājñīvitīrṇaṃ tadājñāmudrāṅgulīyakam //
meaning:
यथा शक्तिर्महाराज्ञ्या देडिन्यश्च तथाखिलम् /
विशेषस्तु परं तस्याः साचिव्ये तत्करे स्थितम् /
महाराज्ञीवितीर्णं तदाज्ञामुद्राङ्गुलीयकम् //
text_mt: as was the power of the great Queen and of Daṇḍinī, so was everything. / But the only distinction was this: in her ministry, on her hand rested / that signet-ring of command bestowed by the great Queen.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pracalite sainye mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ /
tadbhārabhaṅgurā bhūmirdelālīlāmalaṃbata //
meaning:
इत्थं प्रचलिते सैन्ये मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः /
तद्भारभङ्गुरा भूमिर्देलालीलामलंबत //
text_mt: As the army of Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā thus set forth, / the earth, bending under that weight, assumed the play of a swing.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam /
uddhūtadhūlijaṃbālībhūtasaptārṇavījalam //
meaning:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् /
उद्धूतधूलिजंबालीभूतसप्तार्णवीजलम् //
text_mt: Then a tumultuous, hair-raising battle commenced, / in which the waters of the seven oceans were turned into mud by the raised dust.

sanskrit_iast:
hayasthairhayasādinyo rathasthai rathasaṃsthitāḥ /
ādhoraṇairhastipakāḥ khaḍgaiḥ padgāśca saṅgatāḥ //
meaning:
हयस्थैर्हयसादिन्यो रथस्थै रथसंस्थिताः /
आधोरणैर्हस्तिपकाः खड्गैः पद्गाश्च सङ्गताः //
text_mt: Horsewomen clashed with those mounted on horses, charioteers with those standing in chariots, / elephant drivers with elephant keepers, and foot-soldiers with swords [with foot-soldiers].

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍanāthāviṣaṅgeṇa samayudhyanta saṅgare /
viśukreṇa samaṃ śyāmā vikṛṣṭamaṇikārmukā //
meaning:
दण्डनाथाविषङ्गेण समयुध्यन्त सङ्गरे /
विशुक्रेण समं श्यामा विकृष्टमणिकार्मुका //
text_mt: Daṇḍanāthā fought in the battle with Viṣaṅga; / Śyāmā, with her jewelled bow drawn, [fought] with Viśukra;

sanskrit_iast:
aśvarūḍhā cakāroccaiḥ saholūkajitā raṇam /
sampadīśāca jagrāha puruṣeṇa yuyutsayā //
meaning:
अश्वरूढा चकारोच्चैः सहोलूकजिता रणम् /
सम्पदीशाच जग्राह पुरुषेण युयुत्सया //
text_mt: Aśvārūḍhā fought vehemently with Ulūkajit; / and Sampadīśā engaged Puruṣa in battle, eager to fight;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣeṇa nakulī devī samāhvāsta yuyutsayā /
kuntiṣeṇena samaraṃ mahāmāyā tadākarot //
meaning:
विषेण नकुली देवी समाह्वास्त युयुत्सया /
कुन्तिषेणेन समरं महामाया तदाकरोत् //
text_mt: the goddess Nakulī challenged Viṣeṇa, eager to fight; / Mahāmāyā then engaged in combat with Kuntiṣeṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
maladena samaṃ cakre yuddhamunmattabhairavī /
laghuśyāmā cakāroccaiḥ kuśūreṇa samaṃ raṇam //
meaning:
मलदेन समं चक्रे युद्धमुन्मत्तभैरवी /
लघुश्यामा चकारोच्चैः कुशूरेण समं रणम् //
text_mt: Unmattabhairavī fought with Malada; / Laghuśyāmā fought fiercely with Kuśūra;

sanskrit_iast:
svapneśī maṅgalākhyena daityendreṇa raṇaṃvyadhāt /
vāgvādinī tu jaghaṭe drughaṇena samaṃ raṇe //
meaning:
स्वप्नेशी मङ्गलाख्येन दैत्येन्द्रेण रणंव्यधात् /
वाग्वादिनी तु जघटे द्रुघणेन समं रणे //
text_mt: Svapneśī waged battle with the Daitya lord named Maṅgala; / Vāgvādinī clashed in combat with Drughaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kolāṭena ca duṣṭena caṇḍakālyakarodraṇam /
akṣauhiṇībhirdaityānāṃ śatākṣauhiṇikāstathā /
mahāntaṃ samare cakruranyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ //
meaning:
कोलाटेन च दुष्टेन चण्डकाल्यकरोद्रणम् /
अक्षौहिणीभिर्दैत्यानां शताक्षौहिणिकास्तथा /
महान्तं समरे चक्रुरन्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः //
text_mt: and Caṇḍakālī fought with the wicked Kolāṭa. / In this way, with akṣauhiṇīs of Daityas, the hundreds of akṣauhiṇīs [of Śaktis], / frenzied with rage, fought a mighty [battle] with one another.

sanskrit_iast:
pravartamāne samare viśukro duṣṭadānavaḥ /
vardhamānāṃ śakticamūṃ hīyamānāṃ nijāṃ camūm //
meaning:
प्रवर्तमाने समरे विशुक्रो दुष्टदानवः /
वर्धमानां शक्तिचमूं हीयमानां निजां चमूम् //
text_mt: While the battle was underway, the wicked Dānava Viśukra / [saw] the army of the Śaktis growing and his own army diminishing.

sanskrit_iast:
avalokya ruṣāviṣṭaḥ sa kṛṣṭagurukārmukaḥ /
śaktisainye samaste 'pi tṛṣāstraṃ pramumoca ha //
meaning:
अवलोक्य रुषाविष्टः स कृष्टगुरुकार्मुकः /
शक्तिसैन्ये समस्ते ऽपि तृषास्त्रं प्रमुमोच ह //
text_mt: Seeing this, overcome with rage, he drew his heavy bow / and released the thirst-missile against the entire army of the Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
tena dāvānalajvālādīptena mathitaṃ balam /
tṛtīye yuddhadivase yāmamātraṃ gate ravau /
viśukramuktatarṣāstravyākulāḥ śaktayo 'van //
meaning:
तेन दावानलज्वालादीप्तेन मथितं बलम् /
तृतीये युद्धदिवसे याममात्रं गते रवौ /
विशुक्रमुक्ततर्षास्त्रव्याकुलाः शक्तयो ऽवन् //
text_mt: By it, ablaze like the flames of a forest fire, the force was crushed. / On the third day of battle, when only one yāma of the sun had passed, / the Śaktis were confounded by the thirst-missile released by Viśukra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣobhayannindriyagrāmaṃ tālumūlaṃ viśoṣayan /
rūkṣayankarṇakuharamaṅgadaurvalyamāhavan //
meaning:
क्षोभयन्निन्द्रियग्रामं तालुमूलं विशोषयन् /
रूक्षयन्कर्णकुहरमङ्गदौर्वल्यमाहवन् //
text_mt: Agitating the host of sense organs, parching the root of the palate, / drying up the cavities of the ears, causing weakness in the limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
pātayanpṛthivīpṛṣṭhe dehaṃ visraṃsitāyudham /
āvirbabhūva śaktīnāmatitīvrastṛṣājvaraḥ //
meaning:
पातयन्पृथिवीपृष्ठे देहं विस्रंसितायुधम् /
आविर्बभूव शक्तीनामतितीव्रस्तृषाज्वरः //
text_mt: felling bodies to the surface of the earth with their weapons dropped, / an exceedingly fierce fever of thirst manifested among the Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
yuddheṣvanudyamakṛtā sarvotsāhavirodhinā /
tarṣeṇa tena kvathitaṃ śaktisainyaṃ vilokyasā /
mantriṇī saha potriṇyā bhṛśaṃ cintāmavāpa ha //
meaning:
युद्धेष्वनुद्यमकृता सर्वोत्साहविरोधिना /
तर्षेण तेन क्वथितं शक्तिसैन्यं विलोक्यसा /
मन्त्रिणी सह पोत्रिण्या भृशं चिन्तामवाप ह //
text_mt: Seeing the army of the Śaktis boiled by that thirst, / which produced inaction in battle and countered all enthusiasm, / Mantriṇī, together with Potriṇī, felt deep anxiety.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca tāṃ daṇḍanāthāmatyāhitaviśaṅkinīm /
rathasthitā rathagatā tatpratī kārakarmaṇe /
sakhi potriṇi duṣṭasya tarṣāstramidamāgatam //
meaning:
उवाच तां दण्डनाथामत्याहितविशङ्किनीम् /
रथस्थिता रथगता तत्प्रती कारकर्मणे /
सखि पोत्रिणि दुष्टस्य तर्षास्त्रमिदमागतम् //
text_mt: Standing in her chariot, she spoke to Daṇḍanāthā, / who stood in her chariot and feared disaster, in order to counteract it: / “O friend Potriṇī, this thirst-missile of the wicked one has arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
śithilīkurute sainyamasmākaṃ hā vidheḥ kramaḥ /
viśuṣkatālumūlānāṃ vibhraṣṭāyudhatejasām /
śaktīnāṃ maṇḍalenātra samare samupekṣitam //
meaning:
शिथिलीकुरुते सैन्यमस्माकं हा विधेः क्रमः /
विशुष्कतालुमूलानां विभ्रष्टायुधतेजसाम् /
शक्तीनां मण्डलेनात्र समरे समुपेक्षितम् //
text_mt: It weakens our army; alas, the course of fate! / With the roots of their palates dried up, the splendour of their weapons lost, / the circle of Śaktis here has become negligent in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
na kāpi kurute yuddhaṃ na dhārayati cāyudham /
viśuṣkatālumūlatvā dvaktumapyāli na kṣamāḥ //
meaning:
न कापि कुरुते युद्धं न धारयति चायुधम् /
विशुष्कतालुमूलत्वा द्वक्तुमप्यालि न क्षमाः //
text_mt: None of them fights, nor does any hold a weapon. / Because the roots of their palates are parched, O friend, they are not even able to speak.

sanskrit_iast:
īdṛśīnno gatiṃ śrutvā kiṃ vakṣyati maheśvarī /
kṛtā cāpakṛtirdaityairupāyaḥ pravicintyatām //
meaning:
ईदृशीन्नो गतिं श्रुत्वा किं वक्ष्यति महेश्वरी /
कृता चापकृतिर्दैत्यैरुपायः प्रविचिन्त्यताम् //
text_mt: Hearing of such a state of ours, what will the Great Goddess say? / Harm has been done by the Daityas; let a remedy be devised.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra dvyaṣṭasāhasrākṣauhiṇyamatra potriṇi /
ekāpi śaktirnaivāsti yā tarṣeṇa na pīḍitā //
meaning:
सर्वत्र द्व्यष्टसाहस्राक्षौहिण्यमत्र पोत्रिणि /
एकापि शक्तिर्नैवास्ति या तर्षेण न पीडिता //
text_mt: Everywhere in this army of thirty-two thousand akṣauhiṇīs, O Potriṇī, / there is not even a single Śakti who is not afflicted by thirst.

sanskrit_iast:
atraivāvasare dṛṣṭvā muktaśastrāṃ patākinīm /
randhraprahāriṇo hanta bāṇairnighnanti dānavāḥ //
meaning:
अत्रैवावसरे दृष्ट्वा मुक्तशस्त्रां पताकिनीम् /
रन्ध्रप्रहारिणो हन्त बाणैर्निघ्नन्ति दानवाः //
text_mt: Seeing our army with weapons cast aside at this very moment, / the Dānavas, striking at our weak points, alas, strike us down with arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
atropāyastvayā kāryo mayā ca samarodyame /
tvadīyarathaparvastho yo 'sti śītamahārṇavaḥ //
meaning:
अत्रोपायस्त्वया कार्यो मया च समरोद्यमे /
त्वदीयरथपर्वस्थो यो ऽस्ति शीतमहार्णवः //
text_mt: Here a remedy must be performed by you and by me in the endeavour of battle. / The great cool ocean that resides on a level of your chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
tamādiśa samastānāṃ śaktīnāṃ tarṣanuttaye /
nālpaiḥ pānīyapānādyairetāsāṃ tarṣasaṃkṣayaḥ //
meaning:
तमादिश समस्तानां शक्तीनां तर्षनुत्तये /
नाल्पैः पानीयपानाद्यैरेतासां तर्षसंक्षयः //
text_mt: summon it to dispel the thirst of all the Śaktis. / The destruction of their thirst cannot come about by drinking small amounts of water and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva madirāsiṃdhuḥ śaktyaughaṃ tarpayiṣyati /
tamādiśa mahātmānaṃ samarotsāhakāriṇam /
sarvatarṣapraśamanaṃ mahābalavivardhanam //
meaning:
स एव मदिरासिंधुः शक्त्यौघं तर्पयिष्यति /
तमादिश महात्मानं समरोत्साहकारिणम् /
सर्वतर्षप्रशमनं महाबलविवर्धनम् //
text_mt: That ocean of liquor alone will satisfy the flood of Śaktis. / Command that great-souled one, who rouses enthusiasm for battle, / who calms all thirst, and greatly increases strength.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte daṇḍanāthā sā sadupāyena harṣitā /
ājuhāva sudhāsiṃdhumājñāṃ cakreśvarī raṇe //
meaning:
इत्युक्ते दण्डनाथा सा सदुपायेन हर्षिता /
आजुहाव सुधासिंधुमाज्ञां चक्रेश्वरी रणे //
text_mt: When this was said, Daṇḍanāthā, delighted by the noble remedy, / and Cakreśvarī summoned the ocean of nectar by command in the battle.

sanskrit_iast: sa madālasaraktākṣo hemābhaḥ sragvibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning: स मदालसरक्ताक्षो हेमाभः स्रग्विभूषितः //
text_mt: He, with red eyes languid from intoxication, golden in hue, adorned with garlands,

sanskrit_iast: praṇamya daṇḍanāthāṃ tāṃ tadājñāparipārakaḥ //
meaning: प्रणम्य दण्डनाथां तां तदाज्ञापरिपारकः //
text_mt: bowed down to Daṇḍanāthā, fulfilling her command.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā taruṇādityapāṭalam /
kvacittāpicchavacchyāmaṃ kvacicca dhavaladyutim //
meaning:
आत्मानं बहुधा कृत्वा तरुणादित्यपाटलम् /
क्वचित्तापिच्छवच्छ्यामं क्वचिच्च धवलद्युतिम् //
text_mt: Making himself multiform, crimson as the newly risen sun, / somewhere dark as the tāpiccha blossom, and somewhere of white brilliance,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiśo madhurādhārā karihastasamākṛtīḥ /
vavarṣa siṃdhurājo 'yaṃ vāyunā bahulīkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
कोटिशो मधुराधारा करिहस्तसमाकृतीः /
ववर्ष सिंधुराजो ऽयं वायुना बहुलीकृतः //
text_mt: showering by the millions sweet streams shaped like elephants' trunks, / this king of oceans, multiplied by the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkalāvartakādyaistu kalapakṣayabalāhakaiḥ /
niṣicyamāno madhye 'bdhiḥ śaktisainye papāta ha //
meaning:
पुष्कलावर्तकाद्यैस्तु कलपक्षयबलाहकैः /
निषिच्यमानो मध्ये ऽब्धिः शक्तिसैन्ये पपात ह //
text_mt: poured forth by the clouds of the end of a cosmic age such as Puṣkalāvartaka and others, / the ocean fell into the midst of the army of the Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
yadgandhāghrāmamātreṇa mṛta uttiṣṭhate sphuṭam /
durbalaḥ prabalaśca syāttadvavarṣa surāṃbudhiḥ //
meaning:
यद्गन्धाघ्राममात्रेण मृत उत्तिष्ठते स्फुटम् /
दुर्बलः प्रबलश्च स्यात्तद्ववर्ष सुरांबुधिः //
text_mt: By merely smelling the fragrance of which the dead surely rise, / and the weak become strong, so rained the ocean of spirituous liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
parārddhasaṃkhyātītāstā madhudhārāparaṃparāḥ /
prapibantyaḥ pipāsārtairmukhaiḥ śaktaya utthitāḥ //
meaning:
परार्द्धसंख्यातीतास्ता मधुधारापरंपराः /
प्रपिबन्त्यः पिपासार्तैर्मुखैः शक्तय उत्थिताः //
text_mt: Drinking those continuous streams of wine numbering beyond billions, / the Śaktis, with mouths tormented by thirst, rose up.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā sā madirāsiṃdhuvṛṣṭirdaityeṣu no patet /
tathā sainyasya parito mahāprākāramaṇḍalam //
meaning:
यथा सा मदिरासिंधुवृष्टिर्दैत्येषु नो पतेत् /
तथा सैन्यस्य परितो महाप्राकारमण्डलम् //
text_mt: So that that shower of the ocean of wine would not fall upon the Daityas, / a great ring of ramparts all around the army

sanskrit_iast:
laghuhastatayā muktaiḥ śarajātaiḥ sahasraśaḥ /
cakāra vismayakarī kadaṃbavanavāsinī //
meaning:
लघुहस्ततया मुक्तैः शरजातैः सहस्रशः /
चकार विस्मयकरी कदंबवनवासिनी //
text_mt: the dweller in the Kadamba forest, causing wonder, constructed / with thousands of hosts of arrows released with light-handed speed.

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā tena sarve 'pi vismitā maruto 'bhavan /
atha tāḥ śaktayo bhūri pibanti sma raṇāntare //
meaning:
कर्मणा तेन सर्वे ऽपि विस्मिता मरुतो ऽभवन् /
अथ ताः शक्तयो भूरि पिबन्ति स्म रणान्तरे //
text_mt: All the Maruts were astonished by that deed. / Then those Śaktis drank copiously in the midst of battle

sanskrit_iast:
vividhā madirādhārā balotsāhavivardhanīḥ /
yasyā yasyā manaḥprītī ruciḥ svādo yathāyathā //
meaning:
विविधा मदिराधारा बलोत्साहविवर्धनीः /
यस्या यस्या मनःप्रीती रुचिः स्वादो यथायथा //
text_mt: the diverse streams of wine that increased strength and enthusiasm, / according to the mental delight, inclination, and taste of each.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīye yuddhadivase praharadvitayāvadhi /
saṃtataṃ madhyadhārābhiḥ pravavarṣa surāṃbudhiḥ //
meaning:
तृतीये युद्धदिवसे प्रहरद्वितयावधि /
संततं मध्यधाराभिः प्रववर्ष सुरांबुधिः //
text_mt: On the third day of battle, for the duration of two watches, / the ocean of spirituous liquor rained continuously with central streams:

sanskrit_iast:
gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca varā kādaṃbarī tathā /
haitālī lāṅgaleyā ca tālajātāstathā surāḥ //
meaning:
गौडी पैष्टी च माध्वी च वरा कादंबरी तथा /
हैताली लाङ्गलेया च तालजातास्तथा सुराः //
text_mt: distilled from molasses, flour, and honey, as well as the excellent kādambarī, / the haitālī, lāṅgaleyā, and liquors born of palms;

sanskrit_iast:
kalpavṛkṣodbhavā divyā nānādeśasamudbhavāḥ /
susvādusaurabhādyāśca śubhagandhasukhapradāḥ //
meaning:
कल्पवृक्षोद्भवा दिव्या नानादेशसमुद्भवाः /
सुस्वादुसौरभाद्याश्च शुभगन्धसुखप्रदाः //
text_mt: divine liquors born of wish-fulfilling trees, and those produced in various regions, / possessing delicious taste and fragrance, bestowing pleasure through auspicious aroma;

sanskrit_iast:
bakulaprasavāmodā dhvanantyo budbudojjvalāḥ /
kaṭukāśca kaṣāyāśca madhurāstiktatāspṛśaḥ //
meaning:
बकुलप्रसवामोदा ध्वनन्त्यो बुद्बुदोज्ज्वलाः /
कटुकाश्च कषायाश्च मधुरास्तिक्ततास्पृशः //
text_mt: fragrant with the scent of bakula flowers, bubbling loudly and gleaming, / bitter, astringent, sweet, and touching upon the pungent;

sanskrit_iast:
bahuvarmasamāviṣṭāśchedinīḥ picchalāstathā /
īṣadamlāśca kaṭvamlā madhurāmlāstathā parāḥ //
meaning:
बहुवर्मसमाविष्टाश्छेदिनीः पिच्छलास्तथा /
ईषदम्लाश्च कट्वम्ला मधुराम्लास्तथा पराः //
text_mt: covered with thick froths, breaking phlegm, viscous, / slightly sour, bitter-sour, and others sweet and sour;

sanskrit_iast:
śastrakṣatarugāhantrī cāsthisaṃdhānadāyinī /
raṇabhramaharā śītā laghvyastadvatkavoṣṭhakāḥ //
meaning:
शस्त्रक्षतरुगाहन्त्री चास्थिसंधानदायिनी /
रणभ्रमहरा शीता लघ्व्यस्तद्वत्कवोष्ठकाः //
text_mt: healing the pain of weapon wounds, providing the knit of bones, / dispelling battlefield dizziness, cool, light, and likewise lukewarm;

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtāpahāriṇīścaiva vāruṇīstā jayapradāḥ /
nānāvidhāḥ surādhārā vavarṣa madirārṇavaḥ //
meaning:
संतापहारिणीश्चैव वारुणीस्ता जयप्रदाः /
नानाविधाः सुराधारा ववर्ष मदिरार्णवः //
text_mt: removing torment, and those victory-granting varuṇa-brews— / diverse streams of liquor did the ocean of wine shower down.

sanskrit_iast:
avicchinnaṃ yāmamātramekaikā tatra yoginī /
airāvatakara prakhyāṃ surādhārāṃ mudā papau //
meaning:
अविच्छिन्नं याममात्रमेकैका तत्र योगिनी /
ऐरावतकर प्रख्यां सुराधारां मुदा पपौ //
text_mt: Without interruption for the space of a single watch, each yoginī there / joyfully drank the stream of liquor resembling the trunk of Airāvata.

sanskrit_iast:
uttānaṃ vadanaṃ kṛtvā vilolarasanāścalam /
śaktayaḥ prapapuḥ sīdhu mudā mīlitalocanāḥ //
meaning:
उत्तानं वदनं कृत्वा विलोलरसनाश्चलम् /
शक्तयः प्रपपुः सीधु मुदा मीलितलोचनाः //
text_mt: Lifting their faces upward, their active tongues restless, / the Śaktis joyfully drank the liquor with closed eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bahuvidhaṃ mādhvīdhārāpātaiḥ sudhāṃbudhiḥ /
āgatastarpayitvā tu divyarūpaṃ samāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं बहुविधं माध्वीधारापातैः सुधांबुधिः /
आगतस्तर्पयित्वा तु दिव्यरूपं समास्थितः //
text_mt: Thus, having satisfied them in manifold ways with streams of wine falling, / the ocean of nectar, assuming a divine form,

sanskrit_iast:
punargatvā daṇḍanāthāṃ praṇamya sa surāṃbudhiḥ /
snigdhagaṃbhīraghoṣeṇa vākyaṃ cedamuvāca tām //
meaning:
पुनर्गत्वा दण्डनाथां प्रणम्य स सुरांबुधिः /
स्निग्धगंभीरघोषेण वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ताम् //
text_mt: approached Daṇḍanāthā again, bowed down to her, / and that ocean of liquor spoke these words to her in a voice soft and deep:

sanskrit_iast:
devi paśya mahārājñi daṇḍamaṇḍalanāyike /
mayā saṃtarpitā mugdharūpā śaktivarūthinī //
meaning:
देवि पश्य महाराज्ञि दण्डमण्डलनायिके /
मया संतर्पिता मुग्धरूपा शक्तिवरूथिनी //
text_mt: “O Goddess, look, O Great Queen, leader of the array with the staff: / by me the charming army of the Śaktis has been fully satisfied.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścinnṛtyanti gāyantyo kalakvaṇitamekhalāḥ /
nṛtyantīnāṃ puraḥ kāścitkaratālaṃ vitanvate //
meaning:
काश्चिन्नृत्यन्ति गायन्त्यो कलक्वणितमेखलाः /
नृत्यन्तीनां पुरः काश्चित्करतालं वितन्वते //
text_mt: Some are dancing and singing, their girdles softly jingling; / some clap their hands before those who are dancing.

sanskrit_iast:
kāściddhasaṃti vyāvalgadvalguvakṣojamaṇḍalāḥ /
patantyanyonyamaṅgeṣu kāścidānandamantharāḥ //
meaning:
काश्चिद्धसंति व्यावल्गद्वल्गुवक्षोजमण्डलाः /
पतन्त्यन्योन्यमङ्गेषु काश्चिदानन्दमन्थराः //
text_mt: Some laugh with their lovely breasts undulating; / languid with bliss, some fall upon one another’s limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
kāścidvalganti ca śroṇivigalanmekhalāṃbarāḥ /
kāścidutthāya saṃnaddhā ghūrṇayanti nirāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
काश्चिद्वल्गन्ति च श्रोणिविगलन्मेखलांबराः /
काश्चिदुत्थाय संनद्धा घूर्णयन्ति निरायुधाः //
text_mt: Some leap about, their waist-girdles and garments slipping; / some, rising up ready for battle, reel about without weapons.”

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ nirdiśyamānāstāḥ śaktī maireya siṃdhunāṃ /
avalokya bhṛśaṃ tuṣṭā daṇḍinī tamuvāca ha //
meaning:
इत्थं निर्दिश्यमानास्ताः शक्ती मैरेय सिंधुनां /
अवलोक्य भृशं तुष्टा दण्डिनी तमुवाच ह //
text_mt: Beholding those Śaktis thus pointed out by the ocean of liquor, / Daṇḍinī, exceedingly pleased, spoke to him:

sanskrit_iast:
parituṣṭāsmi madyābdhe tvayā sāhyamanuṣṭhitam /
devakāryamida kiñca nirvighnitamidaṃ kṛtam //
meaning:
परितुष्टास्मि मद्याब्धे त्वया साह्यमनुष्ठितम् /
देवकार्यमिद किञ्च निर्विघ्नितमिदं कृतम् //
text_mt: “I am well pleased, O ocean of wine; assistance was rendered by you, / and this work of the gods has been made free of obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ paraṃ matprasādāddvāpare yājñikairmakhe /
somapānavadatyantamupayojyo bhaviṣyasi //
meaning:
अतः परं मत्प्रसादाद्द्वापरे याज्ञिकैर्मखे /
सोमपानवदत्यन्तमुपयोज्यो भविष्यसि //
text_mt: Therefore, through my grace, you shall be used exceedingly by sacrificers in the rite / during the Dvāpara age, like the drinking of soma.

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa pūtaṃ tvāṃ yāge pāsyantyakhiladevatāḥ /
yāgeṣu mantrapūtena pītena bhavatā janāḥ //
meaning:
मन्त्रेण पूतं त्वां यागे पास्यन्त्यखिलदेवताः /
यागेषु मन्त्रपूतेन पीतेन भवता जनाः //
text_mt: Purified by mantra, all the deities shall drink you in sacrifice. / When you are drunk, purified by mantras in sacrifices, people

sanskrit_iast:
siddhimṛddhiṃ balaṃ svargamapavargaṃ ca bibhratu /
maheśvarī mahādevo baladevaśca bhārgavaḥ /
dattātreyo vidhirviṣṇustvāṃ pāsyanti mahājanāḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धिमृद्धिं बलं स्वर्गमपवर्गं च बिभ्रतु /
महेश्वरी महादेवो बलदेवश्च भार्गवः /
दत्तात्रेयो विधिर्विष्णुस्त्वां पास्यन्ति महाजनाः //
text_mt: shall obtain accomplishment, prosperity, strength, heaven, and liberation. / The Great Goddess, Mahādeva, Baladeva, Bhārgava, / Dattātreya, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu—these great beings shall drink you.

sanskrit_iast: yāge samarcitastvaṃ tu sarvasiddhiṃ pradāsyasi //
meaning: यागे समर्चितस्त्वं तु सर्वसिद्धिं प्रदास्यसि //
text_mt: Worshipped in sacrifice, you shall grant all accomplishment.”

sanskrit_iast: itthaṃ varapradānena toṣayitvā surāṃbudhim //
meaning: इत्थं वरप्रदानेन तोषयित्वा सुरांबुधिम् //
text_mt: Thus having gratified the ocean of liquor by granting a boon,

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṇīṃ tvarayāmāsa punaryuddhāya daṇḍinī /
punaḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ śaktīnāṃ dānavaiḥ saha //
meaning:
मन्त्रिणीं त्वरयामास पुनर्युद्धाय दण्डिनी /
पुनः प्रववृते युद्धं शक्तीनां दानवैः सह //
text_mt: Daṇḍinī urged Mantriṇī once again to battle. / The battle of the Śaktis with the Dānavas began afresh.

sanskrit_iast:
mudāṭṭahāsanirbhinnadigaṣṭakadharā dharam /
pratyagramadirāmattāḥ pāṭalīkṛtalocanāḥ /
śaktayo daityacakreṣu nyapatannekahelayā //
meaning:
मुदाट्टहासनिर्भिन्नदिगष्टकधरा धरम् /
प्रत्यग्रमदिरामत्ताः पाटलीकृतलोचनाः /
शक्तयो दैत्यचक्रेषु न्यपतन्नेकहेलया //
text_mt: Splitting the mountains of the eight directions with loud laughter of joy, / intoxicated with fresh liquor, their eyes reddened, / the Śaktis fell upon the ranks of the Daityas all at once as in sport.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayena dvayamāreje śaktīnāṃ samadaśriyām /
madarāgeṇa cakṣūṃṣi daityaraktena śastrikā //
meaning:
द्वयेन द्वयमारेजे शक्तीनां समदश्रियाम् /
मदरागेण चक्षूंषि दैत्यरक्तेन शस्त्रिका //
text_mt: A pair shone forth by means of a pair among the Śaktis endowed with intoxicated splendour: / their eyes by the flush of intoxication, and their swords by the blood of the Daityas.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ śaktisuradviṣām /
yathā mṛtyuravitrastaḥ prajāḥ saṃharate svayam //
meaning:
तथा बभूव तुमुलं युद्धं शक्तिसुरद्विषाम् /
यथा मृत्युरवित्रस्तः प्रजाः संहरते स्वयम् //
text_mt: So tumultuous became the battle between the Śaktis and the enemies of the gods, / just as Death himself, unafraid, destroys creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskhalatpadavinyāsā madenāraktadṛṣṭayaḥ /
skhaladakṣarasaṃdarbhavīrabhāṣā raṇoddhatāḥ //
meaning:
संस्खलत्पदविन्यासा मदेनारक्तदृष्टयः /
स्खलदक्षरसंदर्भवीरभाषा रणोद्धताः //
text_mt: With stumbling foot-steps, their gazes reddened by intoxication, / their heroic speech composed of stumbling syllables, arrogant in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
kadaṃbagolakākārā dṛṣṭasarvāṅgadṛṣṭayaḥ /
yuvarājasya sainyāni śaktyaḥ samānāśayan //
meaning:
कदंबगोलकाकारा दृष्टसर्वाङ्गदृष्टयः /
युवराजस्य सैन्यानि शक्त्यः समानाशयन् //
text_mt: resembling balls of kadamba flowers, their glances cast over every limb, / the Śaktis completely destroyed the armies of the crown prince.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣauhiṇīśataṃ tatra daṇḍinī sā vyadārayat /
akṣauhiṇīsārddhaśata nāśayāmāsa mantriṇī //
meaning:
अक्षौहिणीशतं तत्र दण्डिनी सा व्यदारयत् /
अक्षौहिणीसार्द्धशत नाशयामास मन्त्रिणी //
text_mt: There Daṇḍinī tore apart a hundred akṣauhiṇīs; / Mantriṇī destroyed one hundred and fifty akṣauhiṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvārūḍhāprabhṛtayo madāruṇavilocanāḥ /
akṣauhiṇīsārdhaśataṃ nityurantakamandiram //
meaning:
अश्वारूढाप्रभृतयो मदारुणविलोचनाः /
अक्षौहिणीसार्धशतं नित्युरन्तकमन्दिरम् //
text_mt: Aśvārūḍhā and the others, their eyes red with intoxication, / sent a hundred and fifty akṣauhiṇīs to the abode of the god of death.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkuśenātitīkṣṇena turagā rohiṇī raṇe /
ulūkajitamunmathya paralokātithiṃ vyadhāt //
meaning:
अङ्कुशेनातितीक्ष्णेन तुरगा रोहिणी रणे /
उलूकजितमुन्मथ्य परलोकातिथिं व्यधात् //
text_mt: With a very sharp goad, the mare-mounted [goddess] in battle / crushed Ulūkajit and made him a guest in the other world.

sanskrit_iast:
sampatkarīprabhṛtayaḥ śaktidaṇḍādhināyikāḥ /
paruṣeṇa mukhānyanyānyavaruddhāvyadārayan //
meaning:
सम्पत्करीप्रभृतयः शक्तिदण्डाधिनायिकाः /
परुषेण मुखान्यन्यान्यवरुद्धाव्यदारयन् //
text_mt: Sampatkarī and the other Śakti commanders of the force / harshly tore open the faces of other [foes] that were barred.

sanskrit_iast:
astaṃ gate savitari dhvastasarvabalaṃ tataḥ /
viśukraṃ yodhayāmāsa śyāmalā kopaśālinī //
meaning:
अस्तं गते सवितरि ध्वस्तसर्वबलं ततः /
विशुक्रं योधयामास श्यामला कोपशालिनी //
text_mt: When the sun had set, the furious Śyāmalā / then fought Viśukra, whose entire army had been destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
astrapratya stramokṣeṇa bhīṣaṇena divaukasām /
mahatā raṇakṛtyena yodhayāmāsa mantriṇī //
meaning:
अस्त्रप्रत्य स्त्रमोक्षेण भीषणेन दिवौकसाम् /
महता रणकृत्येन योधयामास मन्त्रिणी //
text_mt: With discharges of missiles and counter-missiles terrifying to the dwellers of heaven, / with a great engagement in battle, Mantriṇī fought him.

sanskrit_iast:
āyudhāni sutīkṣṇāni viśukrasya mahaujasaḥ /
kramaśaḥ khaṇḍayantī sā ketanaṃ rathasārathim //
meaning:
आयुधानि सुतीक्ष्णानि विशुक्रस्य महौजसः /
क्रमशः खण्डयन्ती सा केतनं रथसारथिम् //
text_mt: Gradually shattering the very sharp weapons / of the exceedingly mighty Viśukra, as well as his banner, chariot, and charioteer,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurguṇaṃ dhanurdaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍayantī śilīmukhaiḥ /
astreṇa brahmaśirasā jvalatpāvakarociṣā //
meaning:
धनुर्गुणं धनुर्दण्डं खण्डयन्ती शिलीमुखैः /
अस्त्रेण ब्रह्मशिरसा ज्वलत्पावकरोचिषा //
text_mt: shattering the bowstring and the staff of his bow with arrows, / with the brahmaśiras missile blazing with the lustre of fire,

sanskrit_iast:
viśukraṃ mardayāmāsa so 'patacchūrṇavigrahaḥ /
viṣaṅgaṃ ca mahādaityaṃ daṇḍanāthā madoddhatā //
meaning:
विशुक्रं मर्दयामास सो ऽपतच्छूर्णविग्रहः /
विषङ्गं च महादैत्यं दण्डनाथा मदोद्धता //
text_mt: she crushed Viśukra; his body pounded to powder, he fell. / And Daṇḍanāthā, haughty with intoxication, [engaged] the great Daitya Viṣaṅga;

sanskrit_iast:
yodhayāmāsa caṇḍana musalena vinighnatī /
sacāpi duṣṭo danujaḥ kāladaṇḍanibhāṃ gadām /
udyamya bāhunā yuddhaṃ cakārāśeṣabhīṣaṇam //
meaning:
योधयामास चण्डन मुसलेन विनिघ्नती /
सचापि दुष्टो दनुजः कालदण्डनिभां गदाम् /
उद्यम्य बाहुना युद्धं चकाराशेषभीषणम् //
text_mt: striking him down with a fierce pestle, she fought him. / And that wicked Danuja, lifting with his arm / a mace resembling the staff of death, fought a battle terrifying to all.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyamaṅgaṃ mṛdnantau gadāyuddhapravartinau /
caṇḍāṭṭahāsamukharau paribhramaṇakāriṇau //
meaning:
