अन्योन्यमङ्गं मृद्नन्तौ गदायुद्धप्रवर्तिनौ /
चण्डाट्टहासमुखरौ परिभ्रमणकारिणौ //
text_mt: Crushing each other's limbs, engaging in mace-combat, / resonant with fierce loud laughter, wheeling about,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvāṇau vividhāṃścārānghūrṇantau tūrmaveṣṭinau /
anyonyadaṇḍahananairmohayantau muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
कुर्वाणौ विविधांश्चारान्घूर्णन्तौ तूर्मवेष्टिनौ /
अन्योन्यदण्डहननैर्मोहयन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: performing various maneuvers, whirling around, enveloped by waves [of dust], / bewildering one another again and again with blows from their respective clubs,

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyaprahṛtau randhramīkṣamāṇau mahoddhatau /
mahāmusaladaṇḍāgraghaṭṭanakṣobhitāṃbarau /
ayudhyetāṃ durādharṣauṃ daṇḍinīdaityaśekharau //
meaning:
अन्योन्यप्रहृतौ रन्ध्रमीक्षमाणौ महोद्धतौ /
महामुसलदण्डाग्रघट्टनक्षोभितांबरौ /
अयुध्येतां दुराधर्षौं दण्डिनीदैत्यशेखरौ //
text_mt: watching for an opening in the other's strikes, exceedingly arrogant, / shaking the sky with the collision of the ends of their great pestle and staff, / the two invincible ones—Daṇḍinī and the crown of the Daityas—fought.

sanskrit_iast:
athārddharātrisamayaparyantaṃ kṛtasaṃgarā /
saṃkruddhā hantumārebhe viṣaṅgaṃ daṇḍanāyikā //
meaning:
अथार्द्धरात्रिसमयपर्यन्तं कृतसंगरा /
संक्रुद्धा हन्तुमारेभे विषङ्गं दण्डनायिका //
text_mt: Then, having waged combat until the time of midnight, / the enraged Daṇḍanāyikā set out to slay Viṣaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ mūrdhani nimagnena halenākṛṣya vairiṇam /
kaṭhoraṃ tāḍanaṃ cakre musalenātha potriṇī //
meaning:
तं मूर्धनि निमग्नेन हलेनाकृष्य वैरिणम् /
कठोरं ताडनं चक्रे मुसलेनाथ पोत्रिणी //
text_mt: Dragging that enemy with her plough plunged into his head, / Potriṇī then dealt a harsh blow with her pestle.

sanskrit_iast:
tato musalaghātena tyaktaprāṇo mahāsuraḥ /
cūrṇitena śatāṅgena samaṃ bhūtalamāśrayat //
meaning:
ततो मुसलघातेन त्यक्तप्राणो महासुरः /
चूर्णितेन शताङ्गेन समं भूतलमाश्रयत् //
text_mt: Then, by the stroke of the pestle, the great Asura departed this life / and took to the earth along with his shattered chariot.

sanskrit_iast:
iti kṛtvā mahatkarma mantriṇīdaṇḍanāyike /
tatraiva taṃ niśā śeṣaṃ ninyatuḥ śibiraṃ prati //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopakhyāne viśukraviṣaṅgavadho nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति कृत्वा महत्कर्म मन्त्रिणीदण्डनायिके /
तत्रैव तं निशा शेषं निन्यतुः शिबिरं प्रति //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपख्याने विशुक्रविषङ्गवधो नामाष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Having accomplished this great feat, Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāyikā / spent the remainder of that night right there, returning towards the camp.

Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'The Slaying of Viśukra and Viṣaṅga', in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
aśvānana mahāprājña varṇitaṃ mantriṇībalam /
viṣaṅgasya vadho yuddhe varṇito daṇḍanāthayā //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ वर्णितं मन्त्रिणीबलम् /
विषङ्गस्य वधो युद्धे वर्णितो दण्डनाथया //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Horse-faced One, O highly wise one, the force of Mantriṇī has been described, / and the slaying of Viṣaṅga in battle by Daṇḍanāthā has been recounted.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyāḥ śrotumicchāmi raṇacakre parākramam /
sodarasyāpadaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaṇḍaḥ kimakarocchucā //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्याः श्रोतुमिच्छामि रणचक्रे पराक्रमम् /
सोदरस्यापदं दृष्ट्वा भण्डः किमकरोच्छुचा //
text_mt: I wish to hear of the prowess of the auspicious Goddess in the wheel of battle. / Having seen the calamity of his brothers, what did Bhaṇḍa do in his grief?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ tasya raṇotsāhaḥ kaiḥ samaṃ samayudhyata /
sahāyāḥ ke 'bhavaṃstasya hatabhrātṛtanūbhuvaḥ //
meaning:
कथं तस्य रणोत्साहः कैः समं समयुध्यत /
सहायाः के ऽभवंस्तस्य हतभ्रातृतनूभुवः //
text_mt: What was his eagerness for battle, and with whom did he fight? / Who were the allies of him whose brothers and sons were slain?

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
idaṃ śṛṇu mahāprājña sarvapāpanikṛntanam /
lalitācaritaṃ puṇyamaṇimādigumapradam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
इदं शृणु महाप्राज्ञ सर्वपापनिकृन्तनम् /
ललिताचरितं पुण्यमणिमादिगुमप्रदम् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Hear this, O highly wise one, which cuts down all sins, / the auspicious story of Lalitā, which bestows the virtues of aṇimā and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣuvāyanakāleṣu puṇyeṣu samayeṣu ca /
siddhidaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ kīrtidaṃ pañcaparvasu //
meaning:
वैषुवायनकालेषु पुण्येषु समयेषु च /
सिद्धिदं सर्वपापघ्नं कीर्तिदं पञ्चपर्वसु //
text_mt: bestowing accomplishments, destroying all sins, and conferring renown / during the equinoxes, solstices, and auspicious occasions, as well as on the five sacred days.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā hatau raṇe tatra śrutvā nijasahodarau /
śokena mahatāviṣṭo bhaṇḍaḥ pravilalāpa saḥ //
meaning:
तदा हतौ रणे तत्र श्रुत्वा निजसहोदरौ /
शोकेन महताविष्टो भण्डः प्रविललाप सः //
text_mt: Then, hearing that his two brothers had been slain there in battle, / overcome by immense grief, Bhaṇḍa lamented aloud.

sanskrit_iast:
vikīrmakeśo dharaṇau mūrchitaḥ patitastadā /
na lebhe kiñcidāśvāsaṃ bhrātṛvyasanakarśitaḥ //
meaning:
विकीर्मकेशो धरणौ मूर्छितः पतितस्तदा /
न लेभे किञ्चिदाश्वासं भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः //
text_mt: With dishevelled hair, he then fell swooning to the earth; / tormented by the misfortune of his brothers, he found no solace at all.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punaḥ pravilapankuṭilākṣeṇa bhūriśaḥ /
āśvāsyāmānaḥ śokena yuktaḥ kopamavāpa saḥ //
meaning:
पुनः पुनः प्रविलपन्कुटिलाक्षेण भूरिशः /
आश्वास्यामानः शोकेन युक्तः कोपमवाप सः //
text_mt: Lamenting repeatedly, being consoled many times / by Kuṭilākṣa, he, filled with sorrow, became possessed by rage.

sanskrit_iast:
phālaṃ vahannatikrūraṃ bhramadbhrukuṭibhīṣaṇam /
aṅgārapāṭalākṣaśca niḥśvasankṛṣṇasarpavat //
meaning:
फालं वहन्नतिक्रूरं भ्रमद्भ्रुकुटिभीषणम् /
अङ्गारपाटलाक्षश्च निःश्वसन्कृष्णसर्पवत् //
text_mt: Bearing a very cruel forehead, terrifying with knitting eyebrows, / with eyes red as glowing coals, hissing like a black cobra,

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca kuṭilākṣaṃ drāksamastapṛtanāpatim /
kṣipraṃ muhurmuhuḥ spṛṣṭvā dhunvānaḥ karavālikām //
meaning:
उवाच कुटिलाक्षं द्राक्समस्तपृतनापतिम् /
क्षिप्रं मुहुर्मुहुः स्पृष्ट्वा धुन्वानः करवालिकाम् //
text_mt: brandishing his sword, touching it swiftly again and again, / he spoke quickly to Kuṭilākṣa, the commander of all the armies,

sanskrit_iast: krodhahuṅkāramātanvangarjannutpātameghavat //
meaning: क्रोधहुङ्कारमातन्वन्गर्जन्नुत्पातमेघवत् //
text_mt: emitting roars of anger, thundering like a storm-cloud of doom:

sanskrit_iast:
yayaiva dṛṣṭayā māyābalādyuddhe vināśitāḥ /
bhrātaro mama putrāśca senānāthāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
ययैव दृष्टया मायाबलाद्युद्धे विनाशिताः /
भ्रातरो मम पुत्राश्च सेनानाथाः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: "By whose mere sight my brothers, sons, / and thousands of army commanders were destroyed in battle through the power of illusion—

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāḥ striyāḥ pramattāyāḥ kaṇṭhotthaiḥ śoṇitadravaiḥ /
bhrātṛputramahāśokavahniṃ nirvāpayāmyaham //
meaning:
तस्याः स्त्रियाः प्रमत्तायाः कण्ठोत्थैः शोणितद्रवैः /
भ्रातृपुत्रमहाशोकवह्निं निर्वापयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: with the streams of blood springing from the throat of that wanton woman / I shall quench the fire of great grief for my brothers and sons!

sanskrit_iast:
gaccha re kuṭilākṣa tvaṃ sajjīkuru patākinīm /
ityuktvā kaṭhinaṃ varma vajrapātasahaṃ mahat //
meaning:
गच्छ रे कुटिलाक्ष त्वं सज्जीकुरु पताकिनीम् /
इत्युक्त्वा कठिनं वर्म वज्रपातसहं महत् //
text_mt: Go, Kuṭilākṣa, make ready the army!" / Having said this, putting on his hard, vast armor able to withstand a thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhāno bhujamadhyena badhnanpṛṣṭha tatheṣudhī /
uddāmamaurviniḥśvāsakaṭhoraṃ bhrāmayandhanuḥ //
meaning:
दधानो भुजमध्येन बध्नन्पृष्ठ तथेषुधी /
उद्दाममौर्विनिःश्वासकठोरं भ्रामयन्धनुः //
text_mt: fastening the quivers across his arms and onto his back, / whirling his bow that was formidable with the whistling twang of its violent bowstring,

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgniriva saṃkruddho nirjagāma nijātpurāt /
tālajaṅghādikaiḥ sārddhaṃpūrvadvāre niveśite //
meaning:
कालाग्निरिव संक्रुद्धो निर्जगाम निजात्पुरात् /
तालजङ्घादिकैः सार्द्धंपूर्वद्वारे निवेशिते //
text_mt: enraged like the fire of cosmic dissolution, he marched out from his city / together with Tālajaṅgha and others stationed at the eastern gate,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhirdhṛtaśastraughairdhṛtavarmabhiruddhataiḥ /
pañcatriṃśaccamūnāthaiḥ kuṭilākṣapuraḥsaraiḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्भिर्धृतशस्त्रौघैर्धृतवर्मभिरुद्धतैः /
पञ्चत्रिंशच्चमूनाथैः कुटिलाक्षपुरःसरैः //
text_mt: with four [commanders] bearing masses of weapons, clad in armor, haughty, / and thirty-five division commanders led by Kuṭilākṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasenāpatīndreṇa kuṭilākṣeṇa sa krudhā /
militena ca bhaṇḍena catvāriṃśaccamūvarāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वसेनापतीन्द्रेण कुटिलाक्षेण स क्रुधा /
मिलितेन च भण्डेन चत्वारिंशच्चमूवराः //
text_mt: With Kuṭilākṣa, the supreme general of all armies, / and Bhaṇḍa joined together in wrath, forty choice divisions,

sanskrit_iast:
dīptāyudhā dīptakeśā nirjagmurdīptakaṅkaṭāḥ /
dvisahasrākṣauhiṇīnāṃ pañcāśītiḥ parārdhikā //
meaning:
दीप्तायुधा दीप्तकेशा निर्जग्मुर्दीप्तकङ्कटाः /
द्विसहस्राक्षौहिणीनां पञ्चाशीतिः परार्धिका //
text_mt: with flashing weapons, blazing hair, and gleaming armor, went forth; / an upper limit of two thousand and eighty-five akṣauhiṇīs

sanskrit_iast:
tadenamanvagādekahelayā mathituṃ dviṣaḥ /
bhaṇḍāsure viniryāte sarvasainikasaṃkule //
meaning:
तदेनमन्वगादेकहेलया मथितुं द्विषः /
भण्डासुरे विनिर्याते सर्वसैनिकसंकुले //
text_mt: followed him as one to crush the foes. / When Bhaṇḍāsura marched out accompanied by all his soldiers,

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyake nagare tatra strīmātramavaśeṣitam /
ābhilo nāma daityendro rathavaryo mahārathaḥ /
sahasrayugyasiṃhāḍhyamāruroha raṇoddhataḥ //
meaning:
शून्यके नगरे तत्र स्त्रीमात्रमवशेषितम् /
आभिलो नाम दैत्येन्द्रो रथवर्यो महारथः /
सहस्रयुग्यसिंहाढ्यमारुरोह रणोद्धतः //
text_mt: only women remained behind in that desolate city. / The lord of Daityas named Ābhila, the best of chariot-warriors, a mahāratha, / haughty in battle, mounted [a chariot] yoked to a thousand lions.

sanskrit_iast:
tatvare vijvalajjvālākālāgniriva dīptimān /
ghātako nāma vai khaḍgaścandrahāsasamākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
तत्वरे विज्वलज्ज्वालाकालाग्निरिव दीप्तिमान् /
घातको नाम वै खड्गश्चन्द्रहाससमाकृतिः //
text_mt: He made haste, blazing like the fire of cosmic dissolution with flaming tongues; / his sword named Ghātaka had the form of Candrahāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
itastataścalantīnāṃ senānāṃ dhūlirutthitā /
voḍhuṃ tāsāṃ bharaṃ bhūmirakṣameva divaṃ yayau //
meaning:
इतस्ततश्चलन्तीनां सेनानां धूलिरुत्थिता /
वोढुं तासां भरं भूमिरक्षमेव दिवं ययौ //
text_mt: The dust raised by the armies moving here and there / rose to the sky, as if the earth were unable to bear their weight.

sanskrit_iast:
kecidbhūmeraparyāptāḥ pracelurvyomavartmanā /
keṣāñcitskandhamārūḍhāḥ keciccelurmahārathāḥ //
meaning:
केचिद्भूमेरपर्याप्ताः प्रचेलुर्व्योमवर्त्मना /
केषाञ्चित्स्कन्धमारूढाः केचिच्चेलुर्महारथाः //
text_mt:
Some, finding no room on the ground, advanced through the pathway of the sky;
mounting the shoulders of others, some great chariot-warriors proceeded.

sanskrit_iast:
na dikṣu na ca bhūcakre na vyomani ca te mamuḥ /
duḥkhadukhena te celuranyonyāśleṣapīḍitāḥ //
meaning:
न दिक्षु न च भूचक्रे न व्योमनि च ते ममुः /
दुःखदुखेन ते चेलुरन्योन्याश्लेषपीडिताः //
text_mt:
They could not be contained in the directions, nor upon the earth’s circle, nor in the sky;
they moved with great difficulty, crushed by embracing one another.

sanskrit_iast:
atyanta senāsaṃmardādrathacakrairvicūrṇitāḥ /
kecitpādena nāgānāṃ marditā nyapatanbhuvi //
meaning:
अत्यन्त सेनासंमर्दाद्रथचक्रैर्विचूर्णिताः /
केचित्पादेन नागानां मर्दिता न्यपतन्भुवि //
text_mt:
Crushed by chariot wheels in the extreme pressing of the army,
others, trampled by the feet of elephants, fell to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pracalitā tena samaṃ sarvaiśca sainikaiḥ /
vajraniṣpeṣasadṛśo meghanādo vyadhīyata //
meaning:
इत्थं प्रचलिता तेन समं सर्वैश्च सैनिकैः /
वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशो मेघनादो व्यधीयत //
text_mt:
Thus marching forth together with all those soldiers,
a roar like thunder, resembling the crash of a thunderbolt, was produced by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tenātīva kaṭhoreṇa siṃhanādena bhūyasā /
bhaṇḍadaityamukhotthena vidīrṇamabhavajjagat //
meaning:
तेनातीव कठोरेण सिंहनादेन भूयसा /
भण्डदैत्यमुखोत्थेन विदीर्णमभवज्जगत् //
text_mt:
By that exceedingly harsh, immense lion’s roar
arising from the mouth of the Daitya Bhaṇḍa, the world was torn asunder.

sanskrit_iast:
sāgarāḥ śoṣamāpannāścandrākārai prapalāyitau /
uḍūni nyapatanvyomno bhūmirdelāyitābhavat //
meaning:
सागराः शोषमापन्नाश्चन्द्राकारै प्रपलायितौ /
उडूनि न्यपतन्व्योम्नो भूमिर्देलायिताभवत् //
text_mt:
The oceans dried up; the sun and moon fled away;
the stars fell from the sky; the earth trembled.

sanskrit_iast:
diṅnāgāścābhavaṃstrastā mūrcchitāśca divaukasaḥ /
śaktīnāṃ kaṭakaṃ cāsīdakāṇḍatrāsavihvalam //
meaning:
दिङ्नागाश्चाभवंस्त्रस्ता मूर्च्छिताश्च दिवौकसः /
शक्तीनां कटकं चासीदकाण्डत्रासविह्वलम् //
text_mt:
The elephants of the quarters became terrified, and the celestials fainted;
and the army of the Śaktis became overcome with sudden dread.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇānsaṃdhārayāmāsuḥ kathañcinmadhya āhave /
śaktayo bhayavibhraṣṭānyāyudhāni punardadhuḥ //
meaning:
प्राणान्संधारयामासुः कथञ्चिन्मध्य आहवे /
शक्तयो भयविभ्रष्टान्यायुधानि पुनर्दधुः //
text_mt:
With difficulty they retained their breath of life in the midst of the battle;
the Śaktis picked up once again their weapons that had dropped from fear.

sanskrit_iast:
vahniprākāravalayaṃ praśāntaṃ punarutthitam /
daityendrasiṃhanādena camūnāthadhanuḥsvanaiḥ //
meaning:
वह्निप्राकारवलयं प्रशान्तं पुनरुत्थितम् /
दैत्येन्द्रसिंहनादेन चमूनाथधनुःस्वनैः //
text_mt:
The rampart-circle of fire, which had been extinguished, flared up again
at the lion’s roar of the Daitya lord and the twanging sounds of the bows of the army commanders.

sanskrit_iast:
krandanaiścāpi yoddhṝṇāmabhūcchabdamayaṃ jagat /
tena nādena mahatā bhaṇḍadaityavinirgamam /
niścitya lalitā devī svayaṃ yoddhuṃ pracakrame //
meaning:
क्रन्दनैश्चापि योद्धॄणामभूच्छब्दमयं जगत् /
तेन नादेन महता भण्डदैत्यविनिर्गमम् /
निश्चित्य ललिता देवी स्वयं योद्धुं प्रचक्रमे //
text_mt:
And with the cries of the warriors, the world became filled with sound.
Ascertaining by that mighty sound the departure of the Daitya Bhaṇḍa,
the goddess Lalitā herself set out to fight.

sanskrit_iast:
aśakyamanyaśaktīnāmākalayya mahāhavam /
bhaṇḍadaityena duṣṭena svayamudyogamāsthitā //
meaning:
अशक्यमन्यशक्तीनामाकलय्य महाहवम् /
भण्डदैत्येन दुष्टेन स्वयमुद्योगमास्थिता //
text_mt:
Considering the great battle impossible for the other Śaktis,
she made the effort herself against the wicked Daitya Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrarājarathastasyāḥ pracacāla mahodayaḥ /
caturvedamahācakrapuruṣārthamahābhayaḥ //
meaning:
चक्रराजरथस्तस्याः प्रचचाल महोदयः /
चतुर्वेदमहाचक्रपुरुषार्थमहाभयः //
text_mt:
Her chariot, the Cakrarāja, exceedingly splendid, set forth,
possessing the great wheels of the four Vedas, terrifying to the ends of human life.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandadhvajasaṃyukto navabhiḥ parvabhiryutaḥ /
navaparvasthadevībhirākṛṣṭagurudhanvibhiḥ //
meaning:
आनन्दध्वजसंयुक्तो नवभिः पर्वभिर्युतः /
नवपर्वस्थदेवीभिराकृष्टगुरुधन्विभिः //
text_mt:
Endowed with the banner of bliss, equipped with nine steps,
with the goddesses stationed on the nine steps drawing their heavy bows,

sanskrit_iast:
parārdhādhikasaṃkhyātaparivārasamṛddhibhiḥ /
parvasthāneṣu sarveṣu pālitaḥ sarvato diśam //
meaning:
परार्धाधिकसंख्यातपरिवारसमृद्धिभिः /
पर्वस्थानेषु सर्वेषु पालितः सर्वतो दिशम् //
text_mt:
surpassed by more than a parārdha of retinue in wealth,
guarded in all directions at all the step-stations,

sanskrit_iast:
daśayojanamunnaddhaścaturyojana vistṛtaḥ /
mahārājñīcakrarājo rathendraḥ pracalanbabhau //
meaning:
दशयोजनमुन्नद्धश्चतुर्योजन विस्तृतः /
महाराज्ञीचक्रराजो रथेन्द्रः प्रचलन्बभौ //
text_mt:
ten yojanas high, four yojanas wide,
the king of chariots of the Mahārājñī, the Cakrarāja, shone as it moved.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminpracalite juṣṭe śyāmayā daṇḍanāthayā /
geyacakraṃ tu bālāgre kiricakraṃ tu bṛṣṭhataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मिन्प्रचलिते जुष्टे श्यामया दण्डनाथया /
गेयचक्रं तु बालाग्रे किरिचक्रं तु बृष्ठतः //
text_mt:
When that [chariot] advanced, attended by Śyāmā and Daṇḍanāthā,
the Geyacakra was in front of Bālā, and the Kiricakra was behind.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāsāmapi śaktīnāṃ vāhanāni parārddhaśaḥ /
nṛsiṃhoṣṭranaravyālamṛgapakṣihayāstathā //
meaning:
अन्यासामपि शक्तीनां वाहनानि परार्द्धशः /
नृसिंहोष्ट्रनरव्यालमृगपक्षिहयास्तथा //
text_mt:
The mounts of the other Śaktis also numbered in parārdhas:
man-lions, camels, men, serpents, deer, birds, and horses,

sanskrit_iast:
gajabheruṇḍaśarabha vyāghravātamṛgāstathā /
etādṛśaśca tiryañco 'pyanye vāhanatāṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
गजभेरुण्डशरभ व्याघ्रवातमृगास्तथा /
एतादृशश्च तिर्यञ्चो ऽप्यन्ये वाहनतां गताः //
text_mt:
elephants, bheruṇḍa birds, śarabhas, tigers, antelopes,
and other such animals too served as mounts.

sanskrit_iast:
muhuruccāvacāḥ śaktīrbhaṇḍāsuravadhodyatāḥ /
yojanāyāmavistāramapi taddvāramaṇḍalam /
vahniprākāracakrasya na paryāptaṃ camūpateḥ //
meaning:
मुहुरुच्चावचाः शक्तीर्भण्डासुरवधोद्यताः /
योजनायामविस्तारमपि तद्द्वारमण्डलम् /
वह्निप्राकारचक्रस्य न पर्याप्तं चमूपतेः //

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālinikā nityā dvārasyātyantavistṛtim /
vitatāna samastānāṃ sainyānāṃ nirgamaiṣiṇī //
meaning:
ज्वालामालिनिका नित्या द्वारस्यात्यन्तविस्तृतिम् /
विततान समस्तानां सैन्यानां निर्गमैषिणी //
text_mt:
Jvālāmālinikā, the Nityā, wishing for the egress of all the armies,
expanded the doorway to an immense width.

sanskrit_iast:
atha sā jagatāṃ mātā mahārājñī mahodayā /
nirjagāmā gnipuratā varadvārātpratāpinī //
meaning:
अथ सा जगतां माता महाराज्ञी महोदया /
निर्जगामा ग्निपुरता वरद्वारात्प्रतापिनी //
text_mt:
Then she, the mother of the worlds, the glorious Mahārājñī,
went forth from that excellent doorway before the City of Fire, radiant with majesty.

sanskrit_iast:
devadundubhayo neduḥ patitāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ /
mahāmuktātapatraṃ taddivi dīptamadṛśyata //
meaning:
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पतिताः पुष्पवृष्टयः /
महामुक्तातपत्रं तद्दिवि दीप्तमदृश्यत //
text_mt:
The divine drums sounded; showers of flowers fell;
the great pearl-umbrella was seen shining in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
nimittāni prasannāni śaṃsakāni jayaśriyāḥ /
abhavaṃllalitāsainye utpātāstu dviṣāṃ bale //
meaning:
निमित्तानि प्रसन्नानि शंसकानि जयश्रियाः /
अभवंल्ललितासैन्ये उत्पातास्तु द्विषां बले //
text_mt:
Auspicious omens proclaiming the glory of victory
appeared in Lalitā's army, but portents appeared in the enemy’s host.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ sena yorubhayorapi /
prasarpadviśikhaiḥ stomabaddhāndhatamasacchaṭam //
meaning:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं सेन योरुभयोरपि /
प्रसर्पद्विशिखैः स्तोमबद्धान्धतमसच्छटम् //
text_mt:
Then the battle commenced between both armies,
its masses of flying arrows casting a dense veil of blinding darkness,

sanskrit_iast:
hanyamānagajastomasṛtaśoṇitabindubhiḥ /
hnīyamāṇaśiraśchannadaityaśvetātapatrakam //
meaning:
हन्यमानगजस्तोमसृतशोणितबिन्दुभिः /
ह्नीयमाणशिरश्छन्नदैत्यश्वेतातपत्रकम् //
text_mt:
with drops of blood flowing from the mass of slain elephants,
and the white umbrellas of the Daityas covered with severed heads.

sanskrit_iast:
na diśo na nabho nāgā na bhūmirna ca kiñcana /
dṛśyate kevalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ rajomātraṃ ca sūrcchitam //
meaning:
न दिशो न नभो नागा न भूमिर्न च किञ्चन /
दृश्यते केवलं दृष्टं रजोमात्रं च सूर्च्छितम् //
text_mt:
Neither the quarters, nor the sky, nor the mountains, nor the earth, nor anything at all
could be seen; only raging dust was visible.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛtyatkabandhanivahāvirbhūtataṭapādapam /
daityakeśasahasraistu śaivālāṅkurakomalā //
meaning:
नृत्यत्कबन्धनिवहाविर्भूततटपादपम् /
दैत्यकेशसहस्रैस्तु शैवालाङ्कुरकोमला //
text_mt:
With the trees on the banks manifested by the host of dancing headless trunks,
soft with the sprouts of moss that were the thousands of Daityas’ hair,

sanskrit_iast:
śvetātapatrayavalayaśvetapaṅkajabhāsurā /
cakrakṛttakarigrāmapādakūrmaparaṃparā //
meaning:
श्वेतातपत्रयवलयश्वेतपङ्कजभासुरा /
चक्रकृत्तकरिग्रामपादकूर्मपरंपरा //
text_mt:
shining with white lotuses that were the circles of white umbrellas,
with a succession of tortoises that were the legs of troops of elephants severed by cakras,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktidhvastamahādaityagalagaṇḍaśiloccayā /
vilūnakāṇḍaiḥ patitaiḥ saphenā balacāmaraiḥ //
meaning:
शक्तिध्वस्तमहादैत्यगलगण्डशिलोच्चया /
विलूनकाण्डैः पतितैः सफेना बलचामरैः //
text_mt:
with heaps of stones that were the throats and temples of great Daityas destroyed by the Śaktis,
foamy with army chowries whose handles were severed and fallen,

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇāsivallarījālairnibiḍīkṛtatīrabhūḥ /
daityavīrekṣamaśreṇimuktiṃsapuṭabhāsurā //
meaning:
तीक्ष्णासिवल्लरीजालैर्निबिडीकृततीरभूः /
दैत्यवीरेक्षमश्रेणिमुक्तिंसपुटभासुरा //
text_mt:
its riverbank made dense by webs of creeping sharp swords,
radiant with oysters yielding pearls in the form of the eyes of Daitya heroes,

sanskrit_iast:
daityavāhanasaṃghātana kramīnaśatākulā /
prāvahacchoṇitanadī senayoryudhyamānayoḥ //
meaning:
दैत्यवाहनसंघातन क्रमीनशताकुला /
प्रावहच्छोणितनदी सेनयोर्युध्यमानयोः //
text_mt:
crowded with hundreds of crocodiles and fish that were the masses of Daitya mounts—
thus a river of blood flowed between the two fighting armies.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ mṛtyośca trāsadāyakam /
caturthayuddhadivase prātarā rabhyabhīṣaṇam /
praharadvayaparyantaṃ senayorubhayorapi //
meaning:
इत्थं प्रववृते युद्धं मृत्योश्च त्रासदायकम् /
चतुर्थयुद्धदिवसे प्रातरा रभ्यभीषणम् /
प्रहरद्वयपर्यन्तं सेनयोरुभयोरपि //
text_mt:
In this way the dreadful battle, bringing terror even to Death,
proceeded between the two armies on the fourth day of fighting,
starting from the morning and lasting for two watches.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śrīlalitādevyā bhaṇḍasyāthābhavadraṇaḥ /
astrapratyastrasaṃkṣobhaistumulīkṛtadiktaṭaḥ //
meaning:
ततः श्रीललितादेव्या भण्डस्याथाभवद्रणः /
अस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रसंक्षोभैस्तुमुलीकृतदिक्तटः //
text_mt:
Then the fight took place between the glorious goddess Lalitā and Bhaṇḍa,
the corners of the quarters made turbulent by the clash of weapons and counter-weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurjyātalaṭaṅkārahuṅkārairatibhīṣaṇaḥ /
tūṇīravadanātkṛṣṭadhanurvaraviniḥ sṛtaiḥ /
vimuktairviśiśairbhīmairāhave prāṇahāribhiḥ //
meaning:
धनुर्ज्यातलटङ्कारहुङ्कारैरतिभीषणः /
तूणीरवदनात्कृष्टधनुर्वरविनिः सृतैः /
विमुक्तैर्विशिशैर्भीमैराहवे प्राणहारिभिः //
text_mt:
exceedingly terrifying with the twang of bowstrings and hums of wrath,
with formidable life-robbing arrows discharged in battle,
drawn from the mouths of quivers and loosed from excellent bows.

sanskrit_iast:
hastalāghavavegena na prājñāyata kiñcana /
mahārājñīkarāṃbhojavyāpāraṃ śaramokṣaṇe /
śṛṇu sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi kumbhasaṃbhava saṅgare //
meaning:
हस्तलाघववेगेन न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन /
महाराज्ञीकरांभोजव्यापारं शरमोक्षणे /
शृणु सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि कुम्भसंभव सङ्गरे //

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhāne tvekadhā tasya daśadhā cāpanirgame /
śatadhā gagane daityasainyaprāptau sahasradhā /
daityāṅgasaṃge saṃprāptāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāḥ śilīmukhāḥ //
meaning:
संधाने त्वेकधा तस्य दशधा चापनिर्गमे /
शतधा गगने दैत्यसैन्यप्राप्तौ सहस्रधा /
दैत्याङ्गसंगे संप्राप्ताः कोटिसंख्याः शिलीमुखाः //
text_mt:
Single at the time of aiming, tenfold at its departure from the bow,
hundredfold in the sky, thousandfold on reaching the Daitya army,
and in the contact with the Daityas’ bodies, the arrows numbered in tens of millions.

sanskrit_iast:
parāndhakāraṃ sṛjatī bhindatī rodasī śaraiḥ /
marmābhinatpracaṇḍasya mahārājñī maheṣubhiḥ //
meaning:
परान्धकारं सृजती भिन्दती रोदसी शरैः /
मर्माभिनत्प्रचण्डस्य महाराज्ञी महेषुभिः //
text_mt:
Creating extreme darkness, splitting heaven and earth with her arrows,
the Mahārājñī pierced the vital parts of the fierce [Bhaṇḍa] with great shafts.

sanskrit_iast:
vahatkopāruṇaṃ netraṃ tato bhaṇḍaḥ sa dānavaḥ /
vavaṣa śarajālena mahatā laliteśvarīm //
meaning:
वहत्कोपारुणं नेत्रं ततो भण्डः स दानवः /
ववष शरजालेन महता ललितेश्वरीम् //
text_mt:
Then that Dānava Bhaṇḍa, his eyes red with rage,
rained a vast shower of arrows upon the sovereign Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
andhatāmisrakaṃ nāma mahāstraṃ pramumoca saḥ /
mahātaraṇibāṇena tannunoda maheśvarī //
meaning:
अन्धतामिस्रकं नाम महास्त्रं प्रमुमोच सः /
महातरणिबाणेन तन्नुनोद महेश्वरी //
text_mt:
He discharged the great weapon called Andhatāmisraka;
the great goddess dispelled it with the great Tāraṇi arrow.

sanskrit_iast:
pākhaṇḍāstraṃ mahāvīro bhaṇḍaḥ pramumuce raṇe /
gāyatryastraṃ tasya nutyai sasarja jagadaṃbikā //
meaning:
पाखण्डास्त्रं महावीरो भण्डः प्रमुमुचे रणे /
गायत्र्यस्त्रं तस्य नुत्यै ससर्ज जगदंबिका //
text_mt:
The mighty hero Bhaṇḍa discharged the Pākhaṇḍa weapon in battle;
to dispel it, the mother of the universe released the Gāyattrī weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
andhāstramasṛjadbhaṇḍaḥ śaktidṛṣṭivināśanam /
cākṣuṣmatamahāstreṇa śamayāyāsa tatprasūḥ //
meaning:
अन्धास्त्रमसृजद्भण्डः शक्तिदृष्टिविनाशनम् /
चाक्षुष्मतमहास्त्रेण शमयायास तत्प्रसूः //
text_mt:
Bhaṇḍa released the Andha weapon, which destroys the vision of the Śaktis;
with the great Cākṣuṣmata weapon, their mother pacified it.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktināśābhidhaṃ bhaṇḍo mumocāstraṃ mahāraṇe /
viśvāvasorathāstreṇa tasya darpamapākarot //
meaning:
शक्तिनाशाभिधं भण्डो मुमोचास्त्रं महारणे /
विश्वावसोरथास्त्रेण तस्य दर्पमपाकरोत् //
text_mt:
Bhaṇḍa discharged the weapon named Śaktināśa in that great battle;
then with the weapon of Viśvāvasu, she destroyed his pride.

sanskrit_iast:
antakāstraṃ sasarjoccaiḥ saṃkruddho bhaḍadānavaḥ /
mahāmṛtyuñjayāstreṇa nāśayāmāsa tadbalam //
meaning:
अन्तकास्त्रं ससर्जोच्चैः संक्रुद्धो भडदानवः /
महामृत्युञ्जयास्त्रेण नाशयामास तद्बलम् //
text_mt:
Enraged, the Dānava Bhaṇḍa hurled forth the Antaka weapon;
with the Mahāmṛtyuñjaya weapon, she destroyed its power.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāstrasmṛtināśākhyamastraṃ bhaṇḍo vyamuñcata /
dhāraṇāstreṇa cakreśī tadbalaṃ samanāśayat //
meaning:
सर्वास्त्रस्मृतिनाशाख्यमस्त्रं भण्डो व्यमुञ्चत /
धारणास्त्रेण चक्रेशी तद्बलं समनाशयत् //
text_mt:
Bhaṇḍa released the weapon named Sarvāstrasmṛtināśa;
with the Dhāraṇā weapon, the mistress of the cakra completely destroyed its power.

sanskrit_iast:
bhayāstramasṛjadbhaṇḍaḥ śaktīnāṃ bhītidāyakam /
abhayaṅkaramaindrāstraṃ mumuce jagadaṃbikā //
meaning:
भयास्त्रमसृजद्भण्डः शक्तीनां भीतिदायकम् /
अभयङ्करमैन्द्रास्त्रं मुमुचे जगदंबिका //
text_mt:
Bhaṇḍa discharged the Bhaya weapon, which strikes fear into the Śaktis;
the mother of the universe released the fear-dispelling Aindra weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
mahārogāstramasṛjacchaktisenāsu dānavaḥ /
rājayakṣmādayo rogāstato 'bhūvansahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
महारोगास्त्रमसृजच्छक्तिसेनासु दानवः /
राजयक्ष्मादयो रोगास्ततो ऽभूवन्सहस्रशः //
text_mt:
The Dānava released the Mahāroga weapon against the armies of the Śaktis;
from that, diseases such as consumption arose by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
tannivāraṇasiddhyarthaṃ lalitā parameśvarī /
nāmatrayamahāmantramahāstraṃ sā mumoca ha //
meaning:
तन्निवारणसिद्ध्यर्थं ललिता परमेश्वरी /
नामत्रयमहामन्त्रमहास्त्रं सा मुमोच ह //
text_mt: To accomplish their counteraction, the supreme sovereign Lalitā / discharged the great missile of the great mantra of three names.

sanskrit_iast:
acyutaścāpyanantaśca govindastu śarotthitāḥ /
huṅkāramātrato dagdhvārogāṃstānanayanmudam //
meaning:
अच्युतश्चाप्यनन्तश्च गोविन्दस्तु शरोत्थिताः /
हुङ्कारमात्रतो दग्ध्वारोगांस्ताननयन्मुदम् //
text_mt: Acyuta, Ananta, and Govinda arose from her arrows; / burning those diseases with a mere roar, they brought joy.

sanskrit_iast:
natvā ca tāṃ maheśānīṃ tadbhaktavyādhimardanam /
vidhātuṃ triṣu lokeṣu niyuktāḥ svapadaṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
नत्वा च तां महेशानीं तद्भक्तव्याधिमर्दनम् /
विधातुं त्रिषु लोकेषु नियुक्ताः स्वपदं ययुः //
text_mt: Bowing to that great sovereign goddess, they were appointed / to crush diseases of her devotees in the three worlds, and went to their own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
āyurnāśanamastraṃ tu muktavānbhaṇḍadānavaḥ /
kālasaṃkarṣaṇīrūpamastraṃ rājñī vyamuñcata //
meaning:
आयुर्नाशनमस्त्रं तु मुक्तवान्भण्डदानवः /
कालसंकर्षणीरूपमस्त्रं राज्ञी व्यमुञ्चत //
text_mt: Then the demon Bhaṇḍa released the life-destroying missile; / the queen discharged the missile having the form of Kālasaṃkarṣaṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsurāstramuddāmaṃ vyasṛjadbhaṇḍadānavaḥ /
tataḥ sahasraśo jātā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
महासुरास्त्रमुद्दामं व्यसृजद्भण्डदानवः /
ततः सहस्रशो जाता महाकाया महाबलाः //
text_mt: The demon Bhaṇḍa discharged the unchecked missile of great asuras; / from it thousands arose, of gigantic bodies and immense strength:

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśca kaiṭabhaścaiva mahiṣāsura eva ca /
dhūmralocanadaityaśca caṇḍamuṇḍādayo 'surāḥ //
meaning:
मधुश्च कैटभश्चैव महिषासुर एव च /
धूम्रलोचनदैत्यश्च चण्डमुण्डादयो ऽसुराः //
text_mt: Madhu and Kaiṭabha, Mahiṣāsura, / the daitya Dhūmralocana, the asuras Caṇḍa, Muṇḍa, and the others,

sanskrit_iast:
cikṣubhaścāmaraścaiva raktabījo 'surastathā /
śumbhaścaiva niśumbhaśca kālakeyā mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
चिक्षुभश्चामरश्चैव रक्तबीजो ऽसुरस्तथा /
शुम्भश्चैव निशुम्भश्च कालकेया महाबलाः //
text_mt: Cikṣubha, Cāmara, and the asura Raktabīja, / Śumbha and Niśumbha, and the mighty Kālakeyas,

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmrābhidhānāśca pare tasmādastrātsamutthitāḥ /
te sarve dānavaśreṣṭhāḥ kaṭhoraiḥ śastramaṇḍalaiḥ //
meaning:
धूम्राभिधानाश्च परे तस्मादस्त्रात्समुत्थिताः /
ते सर्वे दानवश्रेष्ठाः कठोरैः शस्त्रमण्डलैः //
text_mt: and others named Dhūmra arose from that missile. / All those foremost of dānavas, with severe arrays of weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktisenāṃ mardayanto narddantaśca bhayaṅkaram /
hāheti krandamānāścaśaktayo daityamarditāḥ //
meaning:
शक्तिसेनां मर्दयन्तो नर्द्दन्तश्च भयङ्करम् /
हाहेति क्रन्दमानाश्चशक्तयो दैत्यमर्दिताः //
text_mt: crushing the army of Śaktis and roaring frightfully— / and the Śaktis, crushed by the daityas, crying 'Alas, alas!'

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ pāhi pāhīti satvaram /
atha devī bhṛśaṃ kruddhā ruṣāṭṭahāsamātanot //
meaning:
ललितां शरणं प्राप्ताः पाहि पाहीति सत्वरम् /
अथ देवी भृशं क्रुद्धा रुषाट्टहासमातनोत् //
text_mt: took refuge with Lalitā, [calling] quickly: 'Protect us, protect us!' / Then the goddess, violently enraged, let out a loud laugh in fury.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samutthitā kāciddurgā nāma yaśasvinī /
samastadevatejobhirnirmitā viśvarūpiṇī //
meaning:
ततः समुत्थिता काचिद्दुर्गा नाम यशस्विनी /
समस्तदेवतेजोभिर्निर्मिता विश्वरूपिणी //
text_mt: Then there arose a certain glorious one named Durgā, / fashioned from the fiery energies of all the gods, having all forms,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ ca śūlinā dattaṃ cakraṃ cakrisamarpitam /
śaṅkhaṃ varuṇadattaśca śaktiṃ dattāṃ havirbhujā //
meaning:
शूलं च शूलिना दत्तं चक्रं चक्रिसमर्पितम् /
शङ्खं वरुणदत्तश्च शक्तिं दत्तां हविर्भुजा //
text_mt: with the trident given by the Trident-Bearer, the discus bestowed by the Discus-Wielder, / the conch given by Varuṇa, and the spear given by the consumer of oblations,

sanskrit_iast:
cāpamakṣayatūṇīrau maruddattau mahāmṛdhe /
vajridattaṃ ca kuliśaṃ caṣakandhanadārpitam //
meaning:
चापमक्षयतूणीरौ मरुद्दत्तौ महामृधे /
वज्रिदत्तं च कुलिशं चषकन्धनदार्पितम् //
text_mt: the bow and two inexhaustible quivers given by the Wind-god in the great battle, / the thunderbolt given by the Thunderbolt-Wielder, and the drinking cup presented by the Lord of Wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
kāladaṇḍaṃ mahādaṇḍaṃ pāśaṃ pāśadharārpitam /
brahmadattāṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ca ghaṇṭāmairāvatārpitām //
meaning:
कालदण्डं महादण्डं पाशं पाशधरार्पितम् /
ब्रह्मदत्तां कुण्डिकां च घण्टामैरावतार्पिताम् //
text_mt: the staff of Time, a mighty staff, the noose presented by the Noose-Bearer, / the water pot given by Brahmā, and the bell presented by Airāvata,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyudattau khaḍgakheṭau hāraṃ jaladhinārpitam /
viśvakarmapradattāni bhūṣaṇāni ca bibhratī //
meaning:
मृत्युदत्तौ खड्गखेटौ हारं जलधिनार्पितम् /
विश्वकर्मप्रदत्तानि भूषणानि च बिभ्रती //
text_mt: the sword and shield given by Death, the necklace presented by the ocean, / and wearing ornaments bestowed by Viśvakarman,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgaiḥ sahasrakiraṇaśreṇibhāsuraraśmibhiḥ /
āyudhāni samastāni dīpayanti mahodayaiḥ //
meaning:
अङ्गैः सहस्रकिरणश्रेणिभासुररश्मिभिः /
आयुधानि समस्तानि दीपयन्ति महोदयैः //
text_mt: with limbs whose beams shone like arrays of a thousand rays, / illuminating all the weapons with great radiance,

sanskrit_iast:
anyadattairathānyaiśca śobhamānā paricchadaiḥ /
siṃhavāhanamāruhya yuddhaṃ nārāyaṇīvyadhāt //
meaning:
अन्यदत्तैरथान्यैश्च शोभमाना परिच्छदैः /
सिंहवाहनमारुह्य युद्धं नारायणीव्यधात् //
text_mt: and splendid with other accoutrements given by other [gods]; / mounting her lion vehicle, Nārāyaṇī waged battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā te mahiṣaprakhyā dānavā vinipātitāḥ /
caṇḍikāsaptaśatyāṃ tu yathā karma purākarot //
meaning:
तथा ते महिषप्रख्या दानवा विनिपातिताः /
चण्डिकासप्तशत्यां तु यथा कर्म पुराकरोत् //
text_mt: Thus those dānavas resembling Mahiṣa were struck down, / just as she performed her deed long ago in the Caṇḍikāsaptaśatī;

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva samarañcakre mahiṣādimadāpaham /
tatkṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma lalitāṃ praṇanāma sā //
meaning:
तथैव समरञ्चक्रे महिषादिमदापहम् /
तत्कृत्वा दुष्करं कर्म ललितां प्रणनाम सा //
text_mt: in the very same way she fought the battle, removing the pride of Mahiṣa and the rest. / Having performed that difficult deed, she bowed to Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
mūkāstramasṛdduṣṭaḥ śaktisenāsu dānavaḥ /
mahāvāgvā dinī nāma sasarjāstraṃ jagatprasūḥ //
meaning:
मूकास्त्रमसृद्दुष्टः शक्तिसेनासु दानवः /
महावाग्वा दिनी नाम ससर्जास्त्रं जगत्प्रसूः //
text_mt: The wicked demon discharged the dumb-making missile into the Śakti armies; / the mother of the universe released the missile named Mahāvāgvādinī.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyārūpasya vedasya taskarānasurādhamān /
sasarja tatra samare durmado bhaṇḍadānavaḥ //
meaning:
विद्यारूपस्य वेदस्य तस्करानसुराधमान् /
ससर्ज तत्र समरे दुर्मदो भण्डदानवः //
text_mt: Thieves of the Veda in the form of knowledge, the lowest of asuras, / the arrogant demon Bhaṇḍa released there in the battle.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastāṅguṣṭhanakhānmahārājñyā tiraskṛtaḥ /
arṇavāstraṃ mahādīro bhaṇḍadaityo raṇe 'sṛjat //
meaning:
दक्षहस्ताङ्गुष्ठनखान्महाराज्ञ्या तिरस्कृतः /
अर्णवास्त्रं महादीरो भण्डदैत्यो रणे ऽसृजत् //
text_mt: Repelled by the great queen from the nail of her right thumb, / the exceedingly bold daitya Bhaṇḍa released the ocean-missile in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
tatroddāmapayaḥ pūre śaktisainyaṃ mamajaja ca /
atha śrīlalitādakṣahastatarjanikānakhāt /
ādikūrmaḥ samutpanno yojanāyatavistaraḥ //
meaning:
तत्रोद्दामपयः पूरे शक्तिसैन्यं ममजज च /
अथ श्रीललितादक्षहस्ततर्जनिकानखात् /
आदिकूर्मः समुत्पन्नो योजनायतविस्तरः //
text_mt: There, in that unchecked flood of water, the army of Śaktis began to drown; / then from the nail of the right index finger of glorious Lalitā / arose the Primeval Tortoise, extending for leagues in breadth.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtāstena mahābhogakharpareṇa prathīyasā /
śaktayo harṣamāpannāḥ sāgarāstrabhayaṃ jahuḥ //
meaning:
धृतास्तेन महाभोगखर्परेण प्रथीयसा /
शक्तयो हर्षमापन्नाः सागरास्त्रभयं जहुः //
text_mt: They were supported by his vast, great-coiled shell; / filled with joy, the Śaktis abandoned the fear of the ocean-missile,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsāmudraṃ ca bhagavānsakalaṃ salilaṃ papau /
hairaṇyākṣaṃ mahāstraṃ tu vijahau duṣṭadānavaḥ //
meaning:
तत्सामुद्रं च भगवान्सकलं सलिलं पपौ /
हैरण्याक्षं महास्त्रं तु विजहौ दुष्टदानवः //
text_mt: and the Lord drank up all that oceanic water. / Then the wicked demon cast the great missile of Hiraṇyākṣa;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsahasraśo jātā hiraṇyākṣā gadāyudhāḥ /
tairhanyamāne śaktīnāṃ sainye santrā savihvale /
itastataḥ pracalite śithile raṇakarmaṇi //
meaning:
तस्मात्सहस्रशो जाता हिरण्याक्षा गदायुधाः /
तैर्हन्यमाने शक्तीनां सैन्ये सन्त्रा सविह्वले /
इतस्ततः प्रचलिते शिथिले रणकर्मणि //
text_mt: from it thousands of Hiraṇyākṣas were born, armed with maces. / As the army of Śaktis was being slain by them, agitated with terror, / wandering here and there, and slackened in the work of battle,

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitādakṣahastamadhyāṅgulīnakhāt /
mahāvarāhaḥ samabhūcchvetaḥ kailāsasaṃnibhaḥ //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितादक्षहस्तमध्याङ्गुलीनखात् /
महावराहः समभूच्छ्वेतः कैलाससंनिभः //
text_mt: then from the nail of the middle finger of glorious Lalitā's right hand / arose the Great Boar, white, resembling Mount Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
tena vajrasamānena potriṇābhividāritāḥ /
koṭiśaste hiraṇyākṣā mardyamānāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
तेन वज्रसमानेन पोत्रिणाभिविदारिताः /
कोटिशस्ते हिरण्याक्षा मर्द्यमानाः क्षयं गताः //
text_mt: Ripped open by that boar [with tusks] like thunderbolts, / those tens of millions of Hiraṇyākṣas, being crushed, met destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
athabhaṇḍastvatikrodhādbhukuṭīṃ vitatāna ha /
tasya bhrukuṭito jātā hiraṇyāḥ koṭisaṃkhyakāḥ //
meaning:
अथभण्डस्त्वतिक्रोधाद्भुकुटीं विततान ह /
तस्य भ्रुकुटितो जाता हिरण्याः कोटिसंख्यकाः //
text_mt: Then Bhaṇḍa, indeed, out of extreme wrath knit his brows; / from his knitting of the brows tens of millions of Hiraṇyas were born.

sanskrit_iast:
jvaladādityavaddīptā dīpapraharaṇāśva te /
amardayaccaktisainyaṃ prahlādaṃ cāpyamardayan //
meaning:
ज्वलदादित्यवद्दीप्ता दीपप्रहरणाश्व ते /
अमर्दयच्चक्तिसैन्यं प्रह्लादं चाप्यमर्दयन् //
text_mt: Blazing like the burning sun, bearing blazing weapons, / they crushed the army of Śaktis, and they crushed Prahlāda as well.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prahlādo 'sti śaktīnāṃ paramānandalakṣaṇaḥ /
sa eva bālakobhūtvā hiraṇyaparipīḍitaḥ //
meaning:
यः प्रह्लादो ऽस्ति शक्तीनां परमानन्दलक्षणः /
स एव बालकोभूत्वा हिरण्यपरिपीडितः //
text_mt: That Prahlāda who belongs to the Śaktis, characterized by supreme bliss, / became a boy and was tormented by the Hiraṇyas.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastena rājñī kṛpāmagāt /
atha śaktyā nandarūpaṃ prahlādaṃ parirakṣitum //
meaning:
ललितां शरणं प्राप्तस्तेन राज्ञी कृपामगात् /
अथ शक्त्या नन्दरूपं प्रह्लादं परिरक्षितुम् //
text_mt: He took refuge with Lalitā, and by that the queen was moved to compassion. / Then, to protect Prahlāda whose nature is the bliss of Śakti,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastānāmikāgraṃ dhunoti sma maheśvarī /
tasmād dhūtasaṭājālaḥ prajvalallocanatrayaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षहस्तानामिकाग्रं धुनोति स्म महेश्वरी /
तस्माद् धूतसटाजालः प्रज्वलल्लोचनत्रयः //
text_mt: the great sovereign goddess shook the tip of the ring finger of her right hand; / from it [arose] Janārdana, with his mass of mane shaking, his three eyes blazing,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhāsyaḥ puruṣā kāraḥ kaṇṭhasyādho janārdanaḥ /
nakhāyudhaḥ kālarudrarūpī ghorāṭṭahāsavān //
meaning:
सिंहास्यः पुरुषा कारः कण्ठस्याधो जनार्दनः /
नखायुधः कालरुद्ररूपी घोराट्टहासवान् //
text_mt: lion-faced, of human form below the neck, / having nails as weapons, possessing the form of Kālarudra, with a terrible loud laugh,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasaṃkhyadordaṇḍo lalitājñānupālakaḥ /
hiraṇyakaśipūnsarvānbhaṇḍabhrukuṭisaṃbhavān //
meaning:
सहस्रसंख्यदोर्दण्डो ललिताज्ञानुपालकः /
हिरण्यकशिपून्सर्वान्भण्डभ्रुकुटिसंभवान् //
text_mt: having a thousand staff-like arms, obedient to the command of Lalitā. / All the Hiraṇyakaśipus born from the knit brow of Bhaṇḍa

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇādvidārayāmāsa nakhaiḥ kuliśakarkaśaiḥ /
balīndrāstraṃ mahāghoraṃ sarvadaivatanāśanam /
amuñcallalitā devī pratibhaṇḍamahāsuram //
meaning:
क्षणाद्विदारयामास नखैः कुलिशकर्कशैः /
बलीन्द्रास्त्रं महाघोरं सर्वदैवतनाशनम् /
अमुञ्चल्ललिता देवी प्रतिभण्डमहासुरम् //
text_mt: he tore apart in an instant with nails harsh as thunderbolts. / Lalitā the goddess released the extremely terrible missile of the lord of Bali, / which destroys all gods, against Bhaṇḍa the great asura.

sanskrit_iast:
tadastradarpanāśāya vāmanāḥ śataśo 'bhavan /
mahārājñīdakṣahastakaniṣṭhāgrānmahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
तदस्त्रदर्पनाशाय वामनाः शतशो ऽभवन् /
महाराज्ञीदक्षहस्तकनिष्ठाग्रान्महौजसः //
text_mt: To destroy the pride of that missile, hundreds of Vāmanas arose, / of great splendor, from the tip of the little finger of the great queen's right hand;

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇekṣaṇe vardhamānāḥ pāśahastā mahābalāḥ /
balīndrānastrasaṃbhūtānbadhnantaḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ //
meaning:
क्षणेक्षणे वर्धमानाः पाशहस्ता महाबलाः /
बलीन्द्रानस्त्रसंभूतान्बध्नन्तः पाशबन्धनैः //
text_mt: growing larger moment by moment, holding nooses in their hands, endowed with great strength, / binding with bonds of nooses the lords of Bali produced by the missile,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastakaniṣṭhāgrājjātāḥ kāmeśayoṣitaḥ /
mahākāyā mahotsāhāstadastraṃ samanāśayan //
meaning:
दक्षहस्तकनिष्ठाग्राज्जाताः कामेशयोषितः /
महाकाया महोत्साहास्तदस्त्रं समनाशयन् //
text_mt: born from the tip of the little finger of the right hand of Kāmeśa's consort, / of gigantic bodies and great valor, they utterly destroyed that missile.

sanskrit_iast:
haihayāstraṃ samasṛjadbhaṇḍadaityo raṇājire /
tasmātsahasraśojātāḥ sahasrārjunakoṭayaḥ //
meaning:
हैहयास्त्रं समसृजद्भण्डदैत्यो रणाजिरे /
तस्मात्सहस्रशोजाताः सहस्रार्जुनकोटयः //
text_mt: The daitya Bhaṇḍa released the Haihaya missile on the battleground; / from it thousands of tens of millions of thousand-armed Arjunas arose.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitāvāmahastāṅguṣṭanakhāditaḥ /
prajvalanbhārgavo rāmaḥ sakrodhaḥ siṃhanādavān //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितावामहस्ताङ्गुष्टनखादितः /
प्रज्वलन्भार्गवो रामः सक्रोधः सिंहनादवान् //
text_mt: Then from the nail of the thumb of glorious Lalitā's left hand, / blazing, the enraged Bhārgava Rāma, roaring like a lion,

sanskrit_iast:
dhārayā dārayannetānkuṭhārasya kaṭhorayā /
sahasrārjunasaṃkhyātānkṣaṇādeva vyanāśayan //
meaning:
धारया दारयन्नेतान्कुठारस्य कठोरया /
सहस्रार्जुनसंख्यातान्क्षणादेव व्यनाशयन् //
text_mt: splitting them with the sharp edge of his battle-axe, / destroyed in a mere instant those counted as the thousand-armed Arjunas.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kruddho bhaṇḍadaityaḥ krodhāddhuṅkāramātanot /
tasmāddhuṅkārato jātaścandrahāsakṛpāṇavān //
meaning:
अथ क्रुद्धो भण्डदैत्यः क्रोधाद्धुङ्कारमातनोत् /
तस्माद्धुङ्कारतो जातश्चन्द्रहासकृपाणवान् //
text_mt: Then the enraged daitya Bhaṇḍa let out a roar in anger; / from that roar was born [Rāvaṇa], wielding the Candrahāsa sword,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrākṣauhiṇīrakṣaḥsenayā parivāritaḥ /
kaniṣṭhaṃ kuṃbhakarṇaṃ ca meghanādaṃ ca nandanam /
gṛhītvā śaktisainyaṃ tadatidūramamardayat //
meaning:
सहस्राक्षौहिणीरक्षःसेनया परिवारितः /
कनिष्ठं कुंभकर्णं च मेघनादं च नन्दनम् /
गृहीत्वा शक्तिसैन्यं तदतिदूरममर्दयत् //
text_mt: surrounded by an army of rākṣasas of a thousand akṣauhiṇīs; / taking his younger brother Kumbhakarṇa and his son Meghanāda, / he crushed that army of Śaktis far and wide.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitāvāmahastatarjanikānakhāt /
kodaṇḍarāmaḥ samabhūllakṣmaṇena samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितावामहस्ततर्जनिकानखात् /
कोदण्डरामः समभूल्लक्ष्मणेन समन्वितः //
text_mt: Then from the nail of the index finger of glorious Lalitā's left hand / arose Kodaṇḍarāma, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāmukuṭavānvallībandhdhatūṇīrapṛṣṭabhūḥ /
nīlotpaladalaśyāmo dhanurvisphārayanmuhuḥ //
meaning:
जटामुकुटवान्वल्लीबन्ध्धतूणीरपृष्टभूः /
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामो धनुर्विस्फारयन्मुहुः //
text_mt: having a diadem of matted hair, the back of his body bearing a quiver tied with creepers, / dark as the petal of a blue lotus, repeatedly twanging his bow.

sanskrit_iast:
nāśayāmāsa divyāstraiḥ kṣaṇādrākṣasasainikam /
mardayāmāsa paulastyaṃ kuṃbhakarṇaṃ ca sodaram /
lakṣmaṇo meghanādaṃ ca mahāvīramanāśayat //
meaning:
नाशयामास दिव्यास्त्रैः क्षणाद्राक्षससैनिकम् /
मर्दयामास पौलस्त्यं कुंभकर्णं च सोदरम् /
लक्ष्मणो मेघनादं च महावीरमनाशयत् //
text_mt: With divine weapons he destroyed the rākṣasa army in an instant; / he crushed Paulastya, and his brother Kumbhakarṇa, / and Lakṣmaṇa slew the great hero Meghanāda.

sanskrit_iast:
dvividāstraṃ mahābhīmamasṛjadbhaṇḍadānavaḥ /
tasmādanekaśo jātāḥ kapayaḥ piṅgalocanāḥ //
meaning:
द्विविदास्त्रं महाभीममसृजद्भण्डदानवः /
तस्मादनेकशो जाताः कपयः पिङ्गलोचनाः //
text_mt: The dānava Bhaṇḍa released the terrifying Dvivida weapon; / from it were born countless monkeys with tawny eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
krodhenātyantatā mrāsyāḥ pratyekaṃ hanumatsamāḥ /
vyanāśayacchaktisainyaṃ krūrakreṅkārakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
क्रोधेनात्यन्तता म्रास्याः प्रत्येकं हनुमत्समाः /
व्यनाशयच्छक्तिसैन्यं क्रूरक्रेङ्कारकारिणः //
text_mt: their faces exceedingly red with fury, each equal to Hanumat; / emitting harsh shrieks, they destroyed the army of Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitāvāmahastamadhyāṅgulīnakhāt /
āvirbabhūva tālāṅkaḥ krodhamadhyāruṇekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितावामहस्तमध्याङ्गुलीनखात् /
आविर्बभूव तालाङ्कः क्रोधमध्यारुणेक्षणः //
text_mt: Then, from the fingernail of Śrī Lalitā's left middle finger, / the palm-bannered [Balarāma] appeared, his eyes reddened in the midst of anger,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlāṃbarapinaddhāṅgaḥ kailāsācalanirmalaḥ /
dvividāstrasamudbhūtānkapīnsarnvānvyanāśayan //
meaning:
नीलांबरपिनद्धाङ्गः कैलासाचलनिर्मलः /
द्विविदास्त्रसमुद्भूतान्कपीन्सर्न्वान्व्यनाशयन् //
text_mt: his body clad in blue garments, pure as Mount Kailāsa; / he destroyed all the monkeys born of the Dvivida weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāsuraṃ nāma mahatsasarjāstraṃ mahābalaḥ /
tasmādastrātsamudbhūtā bahavo nṛpadānavāḥ //
meaning:
राजासुरं नाम महत्ससर्जास्त्रं महाबलः /
तस्मादस्त्रात्समुद्भूता बहवो नृपदानवाः //
text_mt: That mighty one discharged the great weapon named Rājāsura; / from that weapon were born many kingly dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
śiśupālo dantavaktraḥ śālvaḥ kāśīpatistathā /
paiṇḍrako vāsudevaśca rukmī ḍiṃbhakahaṃsakau //
meaning:
शिशुपालो दन्तवक्त्रः शाल्वः काशीपतिस्तथा /
पैण्ड्रको वासुदेवश्च रुक्मी डिंभकहंसकौ //
text_mt: Śiśupāla, Dantavaktra, Śālva, and the king of Kāśī, / Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva, Rukmin, Ḍimbhaka, and Haṃsa,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbaraśca pralaṃbaśca tathā bāṇāsuro 'pi ca /
kaṃsaścāṇūramallaśca muṣṭikotpalaśekharau //
meaning:
शंबरश्च प्रलंबश्च तथा बाणासुरो ऽपि च /
कंसश्चाणूरमल्लश्च मुष्टिकोत्पलशेखरौ //
text_mt: Śambara, Pralamba, and also the asura Bāṇa, / Kaṃsa, the wrestler Cāṇūra, Muṣṭika, and Utpalaśekhara,

sanskrit_iast:
ariṣṭo dhenukaḥ keśī kāliyo yamalārjunau /
pūtanā śakaṭaścaiva tṛṇāvartādayo 'surāḥ //
meaning:
अरिष्टो धेनुकः केशी कालियो यमलार्जुनौ /
पूतना शकटश्चैव तृणावर्तादयो ऽसुराः //
text_mt: Ariṣṭa, Dhenuka, Keśin, Kāliya, the twin Yamalārjunas, / Pūtanā, Śakaṭa, and the asuras headed by Tṛṇāvarta,

sanskrit_iast:
narakākhyo mahāvīro viṣṇurūpī murāsuraḥ /
aneke saha senābhirutthitāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ //
meaning:
नरकाख्यो महावीरो विष्णुरूपी मुरासुरः /
अनेके सह सेनाभिरुत्थिताः शस्त्रपाणयः //
text_mt: the great hero named Naraka, and the asura Mura in the form of Viṣṇu— / many arose, weapons in hand, together with their armies.

sanskrit_iast:
tānvināśayituṃsarvānvāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ /
śrīdevīvāmahastābjānāmikānakhasaṃbhavaḥ //
meaning:
तान्विनाशयितुंसर्वान्वासुदेवः सनातनः /
श्रीदेवीवामहस्ताब्जानामिकानखसंभवः //
text_mt: To destroy them all, the eternal Vāsudeva / arose from the fingernail of the ring finger of the blessed Goddess's left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvyūhaṃ samātene catvāraste tato 'bhavan /
vāsudevo dvitīyastu saṃkarṣaṇa iti smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्व्यूहं समातेने चत्वारस्ते ततो ऽभवन् /
वासुदेवो द्वितीयस्तु संकर्षण इति स्मृतः //
text_mt: He deployed the fourfold manifestation; from him they became four: / Vāsudeva, and the second is known as Saṃkarṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca te sarve prīdyatāyudhāḥ /
tānaśeṣāndurācārānbhūmabhorapravartakān //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धश्च ते सर्वे प्रीद्यतायुधाः /
तानशेषान्दुराचारान्भूमभोरप्रवर्तकान् //
text_mt: Pradyumna, and Aniruddha; all of them, raising their weapons, / completely [destroyed] those wicked ones, perpetrators of terrible deeds on earth,

sanskrit_iast: nāśayāmāsururvīśaveṣacchannānmahāsurān //
meaning: नाशयामासुरुर्वीशवेषच्छन्नान्महासुरान् //
text_mt: the great asuras disguised in the garb of kings.

sanskrit_iast:
atha teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu saṃkruddho bhaṇḍradānavaḥ /
dharmaviplāvakaṃ ghoraṃ kalyastraṃ samamuñcata //
meaning:
अथ तेषु विनष्टेषु संक्रुद्धो भण्ड्रदानवः /
धर्मविप्लावकं घोरं कल्यस्त्रं सममुञ्चत //
text_mt: Then, when they were destroyed, the furious dānava Bhaṇḍa / hurled the dread Kali weapon, which destroys righteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kalyastratojātā āndhrāḥ puṇḍāśca bhūmipāḥ /
kirātāḥ śabarā hūṇā yavanāḥ pāpavṛttayaḥ //
meaning:
ततः कल्यस्त्रतोजाता आन्ध्राः पुण्डाश्च भूमिपाः /
किराताः शबरा हूणा यवनाः पापवृत्तयः //
text_mt: Then from the Kali weapon were born Āndhra and Puṇḍra kings, / Kirātas, Śabaras, Hūṇas, and Yavanas of evil conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
veda viplāvakā dharmadrohiṇaḥ prāṇahiṃsakāḥ /
varṇāśrameṣu sāṃkaryakāriṇo malināṅgakāḥ /
lalitāśaktisainyāni bhūyobhūyo vyamardayan //
meaning:
वेद विप्लावका धर्मद्रोहिणः प्राणहिंसकाः /
वर्णाश्रमेषु सांकर्यकारिणो मलिनाङ्गकाः /
ललिताशक्तिसैन्यानि भूयोभूयो व्यमर्दयन् //
text_mt: subverters of the Vedas, betrayers of righteousness, killers of living beings, / perpetrators of confusion among castes and stages of life, foul-bodied; / they repeatedly crushed the armies of Lalitā's Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīlalitāvāmahastapadmasya bhāsvataḥ /
kaniṣṭhikānakhodbhūtaḥ kalkirnāma janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
अथ श्रीललितावामहस्तपद्मस्य भास्वतः /
कनिष्ठिकानखोद्भूतः कल्किर्नाम जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Then, from the fingernail of the shining little finger of Śrī Lalitā's left hand lotus, / Janārdana named Kalkin arose.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvārūḍhaḥ pratīpta śrīraṭṭahāsaṃ cakāra saḥ /
tasyaiva dhvaninā sarve vajraniṣpeṣabandhunā //
meaning:
अश्वारूढः प्रतीप्त श्रीरट्टहासं चकार सः /
तस्यैव ध्वनिना सर्वे वज्रनिष्पेषबन्धुना //
text_mt: Mounted on a horse, blazing with splendour, he uttered a loud laugh; / by that very sound, which resembled the crash of a thunderbolt,

sanskrit_iast:
kirātā mūrcchitā neśuḥ śaktayaścāpi harṣitāḥ /
daśāvatāranāthāste kṛtvedaṃ karma duṣkaram //
meaning:
किराता मूर्च्छिता नेशुः शक्तयश्चापि हर्षिताः /
दशावतारनाथास्ते कृत्वेदं कर्म दुष्करम् //
text_mt: the Kirātas fainted and perished, and the Śaktis rejoiced. / Those lords of the ten incarnations, having performed this difficult feat,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāṃ tāṃ namaskṛtya baddhāñjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ /
pratikalpaṃ dharmarakṣāṃ kartuṃ matsyā dijanmabhiḥ /
lalitāṃbāniyuktāste vaikuṇṭhāya pratasthire //
meaning:
ललितां तां नमस्कृत्य बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः स्थिताः /
प्रतिकल्पं धर्मरक्षां कर्तुं मत्स्या दिजन्मभिः /
ललितांबानियुक्तास्ते वैकुण्ठाय प्रतस्थिरे //
text_mt: bowed to Lalitā and stood with folded hands; / appointed by mother Lalitā to protect righteousness in every kalpa / through their births as the fish and the rest, they departed for Vaikuṇṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ samasteṣvastraṃṣu nāśiteṣu durāśayaḥ /
mahāmohāstramasṛjacchaktayastena mūrchitāḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं समस्तेष्वस्त्रंषु नाशितेषु दुराशयः /
महामोहास्त्रमसृजच्छक्तयस्तेन मूर्छिताः //
text_mt: When all the weapons were thus destroyed, the evil-minded one / hurled the Mahāmoha weapon; by it the Śaktis were stupefied.

sanskrit_iast:
śāṃbhavāstraṃ visṛjyāṃbā mahāmohāstramakṣiṇot /
astrapratyastradhārābhiritthaṃ jāte mahāhave /
astaśailaṅgabhastīśo gantumārabhatāruṇaḥ //
meaning:
शांभवास्त्रं विसृज्यांबा महामोहास्त्रमक्षिणोत् /
अस्त्रप्रत्यस्त्रधाराभिरित्थं जाते महाहवे /
अस्तशैलङ्गभस्तीशो गन्तुमारभतारुणः //
text_mt: Discharging the Śāmbhava weapon, the Mother destroyed the Mahāmoha weapon. / While the great battle thus took place with streams of weapons and counter-weapons, / the red sun began to sink toward the setting mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nārāyaṇāstreṇa sā devī lalitāṃbikā /
sarvā akṣauhiṇīstasya bhasmasādakarodraṇe //
meaning:
अथ नारायणास्त्रेण सा देवी ललितांबिका /
सर्वा अक्षौहिणीस्तस्य भस्मसादकरोद्रणे //
text_mt: Then with the Nārāyaṇa weapon that goddess, mother Lalitā, / reduced all his akṣauhiṇīs to ashes in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
atha pāśupatāstreṇa dīptakālānalatviṣā /
catvāriṃśaccamūnāthānmahārājñī vyamardayat //
meaning:
अथ पाशुपतास्त्रेण दीप्तकालानलत्विषा /
चत्वारिंशच्चमूनाथान्महाराज्ञी व्यमर्दयत् //
text_mt: Then with the Pāśupata weapon, blazing with the splendour of the fire of cosmic dissolution, / the Great Queen crushed his forty army commanders.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikaśeṣaṃ taṃ duṣṭaṃ nihatāśeṣabāndhavam /
krodhena prajvalantaṃ ca jagadviplavakāriṇam //
meaning:
अथैकशेषं तं दुष्टं निहताशेषबान्धवम् /
क्रोधेन प्रज्वलन्तं च जगद्विप्लवकारिणम् //
text_mt: Then that wicked one, the sole survivor, all his kinsmen slain, / blazing with fury, the destroyer of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsuraṃ mahāsattvaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ caṇḍaparākramam /
mahākāmeśvarāstreṇa sahasrādityavarcasā /
gatāsumakaronmātā lalitā parameśvarī //
meaning:
महासुरं महासत्त्वं भण्डं चण्डपराक्रमम् /
महाकामेश्वरास्त्रेण सहस्रादित्यवर्चसा /
गतासुमकरोन्माता ललिता परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: the great asura Bhaṇḍa of immense strength and fierce valour— / with the Mahākāmeśvara weapon, blazing with the brilliance of a thousand suns, / the Mother, the supreme ruler Lalitā, deprived him of life.

sanskrit_iast:
tadastrajvālayākrāntaṃ śūnyakaṃ tasya paṭṭanam /
sastrīkaṃ ca sabālaṃ ca sagoṣṭhaṃ dhanadhānyakam //
meaning:
तदस्त्रज्वालयाक्रान्तं शून्यकं तस्य पट्टनम् /
सस्त्रीकं च सबालं च सगोष्ठं धनधान्यकम् //
text_mt: Pervaded by the flames of that weapon, his city of Śūnyaka— / with its women, children, cattle-pens, wealth, and grain—

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdhamāsītsahasā sthalamātramaśiṣyata /
bhaṇḍasya saṃkṣayeṇāsīttrailokyaṃ harṣanartitam //
meaning:
निर्दग्धमासीत्सहसा स्थलमात्रमशिष्यत /
भण्डस्य संक्षयेणासीत्त्रैलोक्यं हर्षनर्तितम् //
text_mt: was suddenly burnt to ashes; only the bare ground remained. / With the destruction of Bhaṇḍa, the three worlds danced with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vidhāya surakāryamanindyaśīlā śrīcakrarājarathamaṇḍalamaṇḍanaśrīḥ /
kāmeśvarī trijagatāṃ jananī babhāse vidyotamānavibhavā vijyaśriyāḍhyā //
meaning:
इत्थं विधाय सुरकार्यमनिन्द्यशीला श्रीचक्रराजरथमण्डलमण्डनश्रीः /
कामेश्वरी त्रिजगतां जननी बभासे विद्योतमानविभवा विज्यश्रियाढ्या //
text_mt: Having thus fulfilled the purpose of the gods, she of irreproachable conduct, the splendour adorning the circle of the chariot of Śrī Cakra's king, / Kāmeśvarī, the mother of the three worlds, shone forth, her glory blazing, rich in the splendour of victory.

sanskrit_iast:
sainyaṃ samastamapi saṅgarakarmakhinnaṃ bhaṇḍāsuraprabalabāṇakṛśānutaptam /
astaṃ gate savitari prathitaprabhāvā śrīdevatā śibiramātmana ānināya //
meaning:
सैन्यं समस्तमपि सङ्गरकर्मखिन्नं भण्डासुरप्रबलबाणकृशानुतप्तम् /
अस्तं गते सवितरि प्रथितप्रभावा श्रीदेवता शिबिरमात्मन आनिनाय //
text_mt: When the sun had set, the blessed deity of celebrated majesty / led back to her camp her entire army, weary from the work of battle, / scorched by the fire of the powerful arrows of the asura Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhaṇḍadānavavadhaṃ lalitāṃbayemaṃ kḷptaṃ sakṛtpaṭhati tasya tapodhanendra /
nāśaṃ prayānti kadanāni dṛtāṣṭasiddherbhuktiśca muktirapi vartata eva haste //
meaning:
यो भण्डदानववधं ललितांबयेमं कॢप्तं सकृत्पठति तस्य तपोधनेन्द्र /
नाशं प्रयान्ति कदनानि दृताष्टसिद्धेर्भुक्तिश्च मुक्तिरपि वर्तत एव हस्ते //
text_mt: Whoever recites even once this slaying of the dānava Bhaṇḍa, arranged by Mother Lalitā, / for him, O best of ascetics, afflictions perish, the eight supernormal powers are secured, and enjoyment as well as liberation are in his very hand.

sanskrit_iast:
imaṃ pavitraṃ lalitāparākramaṃ samastapāpaghnamaśeṣasiddhidam /
paṭhanti puṇyeṣu dineṣu ye narā bhajanti te bhāgyasamṛddhimuttamām //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne bhaṇḍāsuravadho nāmaikonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इमं पवित्रं ललितापराक्रमं समस्तपापघ्नमशेषसिद्धिदम् /
पठन्ति पुण्येषु दिनेषु ये नरा भजन्ति ते भाग्यसमृद्धिमुत्तमाम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डपुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने भण्डासुरवधो नामैकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those men who recite on sacred days this holy valour of Lalitā, / which destroys all sins and grants every supernormal power, / obtain the highest abundance of good fortune.

Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, named "The Slaying of the Asura Bhaṇḍa," in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the last section of the holy Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
aśvānana mahāprājña śrutamākhyānamuttamam /
vikramo lalitādevyā viśiṣṭo varṇitastvayā //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ श्रुतमाख्यानमुत्तमम् /
विक्रमो ललितादेव्या विशिष्टो वर्णितस्त्वया //
text_mt: Agastya said: / O horse-faced one, O greatly wise one, the excellent narrative has been heard; / the extraordinary valour of the goddess Lalitā has been described by you.

sanskrit_iast:
caritairanaghairdevyāḥ suprīto 'smi hayānana /
śrutā sā mahatīśaktirmantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ //
meaning:
चरितैरनघैर्देव्याः सुप्रीतो ऽस्मि हयानन /
श्रुता सा महतीशक्तिर्मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः //
text_mt: I am well pleased by the faultless deeds of the Goddess, O horse-faced one! / Heard, too, is the great power of Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātkimakarottatra yuddhānantaramaṃbikā /
caturthadinaśarvaryāṃ vibhātāyāṃ hayānana //
meaning:
पश्चात्किमकरोत्तत्र युद्धानन्तरमंबिका /
चतुर्थदिनशर्वर्यां विभातायां हयानन //
text_mt: What did the Mother do there afterwards, after the battle, / when the night of the fourth day had dawned, O horse-faced one?

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
śṛṇu kumbhaja tatprājña yattayā jagadaṃbayā /
paścādācaritaṃ karma nihate bhaṇḍadānave //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
शृणु कुम्भज तत्प्राज्ञ यत्तया जगदंबया /
पश्चादाचरितं कर्म निहते भण्डदानवे //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Hear, O pot-born one, O wise one, that deed which was performed by her, / the mother of the universe, afterwards, when the dānava Bhaṇḍa was slain:

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīnāmakhilaṃ sainyaṃ daityayudhaśatārditam /
muhurāhlādayāmāsa locanairamṛtāplutaiḥ //
meaning:
शक्तीनामखिलं सैन्यं दैत्ययुधशतार्दितम् /
मुहुराह्लादयामास लोचनैरमृताप्लुतैः //
text_mt: She repeatedly delighted the entire army of the Śaktis, afflicted by hundreds of daitya weapons, / with her eyes overflowing with nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāparameśānyāḥ kaṭākṣāmṛtadhārayā /
jahuryuddhapariśrāntiṃ śaktayaḥ prītimānasāḥ //
meaning:
ललितापरमेशान्याः कटाक्षामृतधारया /
जहुर्युद्धपरिश्रान्तिं शक्तयः प्रीतिमानसाः //
text_mt: Through the stream of the nectar of Lalitā Parameśānī's sidelong glance, / the Śaktis cast off the fatigue of battle, their minds filled with joy.

sanskrit_iast:
asminnavasare devā bhaṇḍamardanatoṣitāḥ /
sarve 'pi sevituṃ prāptā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ //
meaning:
अस्मिन्नवसरे देवा भण्डमर्दनतोषिताः /
सर्वे ऽपि सेवितुं प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः //
text_mt: At this moment, the gods, delighted by the crushing of Bhaṇḍa, / all arrived to pay homage, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śakrādyāstridaśāstathā /
ādityā vasavo rudrā marutaḥ sādhyadevatāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च शक्राद्यास्त्रिदशास्तथा /
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा मरुतः साध्यदेवताः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and the thirty gods headed by Śakra, / the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Maruts, the Sādhya deities,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāḥ kiṃpuruṣā yakṣā nirṛtyādyā niśācarāḥ /
prahlādādyā mahādaityāḥ sarve 'pyaṇḍanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धाः किंपुरुषा यक्षा निरृत्याद्या निशाचराः /
प्रह्लादाद्या महादैत्याः सर्वे ऽप्यण्डनिवासिनः //
text_mt: the Siddhas, Kimpuruṣas, Yakṣas, night-wanderers headed by Nirṛti, / the great daityas headed by Prahlāda, and all the inhabitants of the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast: āgatya tuṣṭuvuḥ prītyā siṃhāsanamaheśvarīm //
meaning: आगत्य तुष्टुवुः प्रीत्या सिंहासनमहेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: Having arrived, they praised the Great Ruler of the Throne with love.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyā ūcuḥ
namonamaste jagadekanāthe namonamaḥ śrītripurābhidhāne /
namonamo bhaṇḍamahāsuraghne namo 'stu kāmeśvari vāmakeśi //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्या ऊचुः
नमोनमस्ते जगदेकनाथे नमोनमः श्रीत्रिपुराभिधाने /
नमोनमो भण्डमहासुरघ्ने नमो ऽस्तु कामेश्वरि वामकेशि //
text_mt:
Brahmā and the other [gods] said:
Salutations, salutations to you, sole sovereign of the universe! Salutations, salutations to you whose name is Śrītripurā! / Salutations, salutations to you, slayer of the great Asura Bhaṇḍa! O Kāmeśvarī, O Vāmakeśī, reverence be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇe cintitadānadakṣe 'cintaye cirākārataraṅgamāle /
citrāmbare citrajagatprasūte citrākhyanitye sukhade namaste //
meaning:
चिन्तामणे चिन्तितदानदक्षे ऽचिन्तये चिराकारतरङ्गमाले /
चित्राम्बरे चित्रजगत्प्रसूते चित्राख्यनित्ये सुखदे नमस्ते //
text_mt: O wish-fulfilling jewel, expert in granting what is desired! Inconceivable one, garland of eternal undulating forms! / You whose garments are wonderful, who gave birth to the wondrous world, Nityā named Citrā, giver of bliss, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣaprade mugdhaśaśāṅkacūḍe mugdhasmite mohanabhedadakṣe /
mudreśvarīcarcitarājatantre mudrāpriye devi namonamaste //
meaning:
मोक्षप्रदे मुग्धशशाङ्कचूडे मुग्धस्मिते मोहनभेददक्षे /
मुद्रेश्वरीचर्चितराजतन्त्रे मुद्राप्रिये देवि नमोनमस्ते //
text_mt: Giver of liberation, crested with the enchanting crescent moon, having a charming smile, skilled at piercing delusion! / Sovereign of seals, anointed by royal ritual, lover of the mudrās, O Goddess, salutations, salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
krūrāntakadhvaṃsini komalāṅge kopeṣu kālīṃ tanumādadhāne /
kroḍānane pālitasainyacakre kroḍīkṛtāśeṣabhaye namaste //
meaning:
क्रूरान्तकध्वंसिनि कोमलाङ्गे कोपेषु कालीं तनुमादधाने /
क्रोडानने पालितसैन्यचक्रे क्रोडीकृताशेषभये नमस्ते //
text_mt: Destroyer of the cruel god of death, tender-limbed, assuming the form of Kālī in your wrath! / Boar-faced one, protectress of the host of armies, who gathers all fears into your embrace, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgadevīparivārakṛṣṇe ṣaḍaṅgayuktaśrutivākyamṛgye /
ṣaṭcakrasaṃsthe ca ṣaḍūrmiyukte ṣaḍbhāvarūpe lalite namaste //
meaning:
षडङ्गदेवीपरिवारकृष्णे षडङ्गयुक्तश्रुतिवाक्यमृग्ये /
षट्चक्रसंस्थे च षडूर्मियुक्ते षड्भावरूपे ललिते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Accompanied by the retinue of the six limb-goddesses, sought after by the words of the Vedas endowed with the six aṅgas! / Stationed in the six cakras, bearing the six waves [of existence], having the form of the six states of being, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
kāme śive mukhyasamastanitye kāntāsanānte kamalāyatākṣi /
kāmaprade kāmini kāmaśaṃbhoḥ kāmye kalānāmadhipe namaste //
meaning:
कामे शिवे मुख्यसमस्तनित्ये कान्तासनान्ते कमलायताक्षि /
कामप्रदे कामिनि कामशंभोः काम्ये कलानामधिपे नमस्ते //
text_mt: O desire, auspicious one, foremost of all Nityās, resting upon the beloved throne, having long lotus eyes! / Granting desire, loving consort of Kāmaśaṃbhu, the desirable one, mistress of the arts, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
divyauṣadhādye nagaraugharūpe divye dinādhīśasahasrakānte /
dedīpyamāne dayayā sanāthe devādhidevapramade namaste //
meaning:
दिव्यौषधाद्ये नगरौघरूपे दिव्ये दिनाधीशसहस्रकान्ते /
देदीप्यमाने दयया सनाथे देवाधिदेवप्रमदे नमस्ते //
text_mt: Beginning with divine herbs, embodied as an expanse of cities, divine one, radiant as a thousand suns! / Blazing forth, endowed with compassion, source of joy to the supreme Lord of gods, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sadāṇimādyaṣṭakasevanīye sadāśivātmojjvalamañcavāse /
sabhye sadekāla yapādapūjye savitri lokasya namonamaste //
meaning:
सदाणिमाद्यष्टकसेवनीये सदाशिवात्मोज्ज्वलमञ्चवासे /
सभ्ये सदेकाल यपादपूज्ये सवित्रि लोकस्य नमोनमस्ते //
text_mt: Ever to be served by the eight [powers] beginning with Aṇimā, dwelling on the radiant couch that is Sadāśiva! / Graceful one, whose feet are to be worshipped in all times, mother of the world, salutations, salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmīmukhairmātṛgaṇairniṣevye brahmapriye brāhmaṇabandhametri /
brahmāmṛtasrotasi rājahaṃsibrahmeśvari śrīlalite namaste //
meaning:
ब्राह्मीमुखैर्मातृगणैर्निषेव्ये ब्रह्मप्रिये ब्राह्मणबन्धमेत्रि /
ब्रह्मामृतस्रोतसि राजहंसिब्रह्मेश्वरि श्रीललिते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Served by the host of mothers beginning with Brāhmī, beloved of Brahmā, kin and friend to Brahmins! / Royal swan in the stream of the nectar of Brahman, supreme mistress of Brahmā, O Śrīlalitā, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyasamastamudrāsaṃsevite saṃsaraṇaprahantri /
saṃsāralīlākṛtisārasākṣi sadā namaste lalite 'dhināthe /
nitye kalāṣoḍaśakena nāmākarṣiṇyadhīśi pramathena sevye //
meaning:
संक्षोभिणीमुख्यसमस्तमुद्रासंसेविते संसरणप्रहन्त्रि /
संसारलीलाकृतिसारसाक्षि सदा नमस्ते ललिते ऽधिनाथे /
नित्ये कलाषोडशकेन नामाकर्षिण्यधीशि प्रमथेन सेव्ये //
text_mt: Served by all the seals beginning with Saṃkṣobhiṇī, destroyer of worldly wandering! / Essential witness of the play of worldly existence, reverence always to you, O Lalitā, supreme ruler! / Eternal one, with the sixteen Kalās, mistress who draws names, served by the attendants of Śiva!

sanskrit_iast:
nitye nirātaṅkadayāprapañce nīlālakaśreṇi namonamaste /
anaṅgapuṣpādibhirunnadābhiranaṅgadevībhirajasrasevye /
abhavyahantryakṣararāśirūpe hatārivarge lalite namaste //
meaning:
नित्ये निरातङ्कदयाप्रपञ्चे नीलालकश्रेणि नमोनमस्ते /
अनङ्गपुष्पादिभिरुन्नदाभिरनङ्गदेवीभिरजस्रसेव्ये /
अभव्यहन्त्र्यक्षरराशिरूपे हतारिवर्गे ललिते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Eternal one, who unfold compassion free from fear, having tresses of black locks, salutations, salutations to you! / Constantly served by the proud Anaṅga goddesses beginning with Anaṅgapuṣpā! / Destroyer of misfortune, embodied as the multitude of letters, destroyer of the host of enemies, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyacaturdaśārcirmālāvṛtodāramahāpradīpte /
ātmānamābibhrati vibhramāḍhye śubhrāśraye śubhrapade namaste //
meaning:
संक्षोभिणीमुख्यचतुर्दशार्चिर्मालावृतोदारमहाप्रदीप्ते /
आत्मानमाबिभ्रति विभ्रमाढ्ये शुभ्राश्रये शुभ्रपदे नमस्ते //
text_mt: Encircled by the fourteen radiant flames beginning with Saṃkṣobhiṇī, of noble and supreme splendor! / Upholding yourself, full of grace, resting upon purity, stationed in the pure abode, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
saśarvasiddhādi kaśaktivandye sarvajñavijñātapadāravinde /
sarvādhike sarvagate samastasiddhiprade śrīlalite namaste //
meaning:
सशर्वसिद्धादि कशक्तिवन्द्ये सर्वज्ञविज्ञातपदारविन्दे /
सर्वाधिके सर्वगते समस्तसिद्धिप्रदे श्रीललिते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Revered by the powers beginning with Sarvasiddhipradā, whose lotus feet are known to the all-knowing! / Transcending all, pervasive in all, bestower of all siddhis, O Śrīlalitā, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñajātaprathamābhiranyadevī bhirapyāśritacakrabhūme /
sarvāmarākāṅkṣitapūrayitri sarvasya lokasya savitri pāhi //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञजातप्रथमाभिरन्यदेवी भिरप्याश्रितचक्रभूमे /
सर्वामराकाङ्क्षितपूरयित्रि सर्वस्य लोकस्य सवित्रि पाहि //
text_mt: Whose cakra domain is resorted to by the other goddesses beginning with the foremost born of Sarvajñā! / Fulfiller of the desires of all the immortals, mother of the entire world, protect [us]!

sanskrit_iast:
vande vaśinyādikavāgvibhūte varddhiṣṇucakra dyutivāhavāhe /
balāhakaśyāmakace vaco 'bdhe varaprade suṃdari pāhi viśvam //
meaning:
वन्दे वशिन्यादिकवाग्विभूते वर्द्धिष्णुचक्र द्युतिवाहवाहे /
बलाहकश्यामकचे वचो ऽब्धे वरप्रदे सुंदरि पाहि विश्वम् //
text_mt: I praise you, whose powers of speech begin with Vaśinī, who bear the radiance of the expanding cakra! / Having hair dark as rainclouds, ocean of speech, grantor of boons, O beautiful one, protect the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
bāṇādidivyāyudhasārvabhaume bhaṇḍāsurānīkavanāntadāve /
atyugratejojjvalitāṃburāśe prasevyamāne parito namaste //
meaning:
बाणादिदिव्यायुधसार्वभौमे भण्डासुरानीकवनान्तदावे /
अत्युग्रतेजोज्ज्वलितांबुराशे प्रसेव्यमाने परितो नमस्ते //
text_mt: Sovereign over divine weapons beginning with the arrows, a forest-fire to the forest of Asura Bhaṇḍa's army! / Ocean ignited with fierce splendor, served on every side, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśi vajreśi bhageśyarūpe kanye kale kālavilopadakṣe /
kathāviśeṣīkṛtadaityasainye kāmeśayānte kamale namaste //
meaning:
कामेशि वज्रेशि भगेश्यरूपे कन्ये कले कालविलोपदक्षे /
कथाविशेषीकृतदैत्यसैन्ये कामेशयान्ते कमले नमस्ते //
text_mt: Kāmeśī, Vajreśī, possessing the form of Bhageśī, maiden, digit [of the moon], skilled at dissolving Time! / You who reduced the army of Daityas to mere tales, resting on Kāmeśvara's lap, lotus-seated one, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
bindusthite bindukalaikarūpe bindvātmike bṛṃhitacitprakāśe /
bṛhatkucaṃbhojavilolahāre bṛhatprabhāve lalite namaste //
meaning:
बिन्दुस्थिते बिन्दुकलैकरूपे बिन्द्वात्मिके बृंहितचित्प्रकाशे /
बृहत्कुचंभोजविलोलहारे बृहत्प्रभावे ललिते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Stationed in the bindu, of the sole form of the digit of the bindu, composed of the bindu, who magnify the light of consciousness! / With a swaying necklace upon your large lotus breasts, of vast majesty, O Lalitā, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvarotsaṃgasadānivāse kālātmike devi kṛtānukaṃpe /
kalpāvasānotthita kālirūpe kāmaprade kalpalate namaste //
meaning:
कामेश्वरोत्संगसदानिवासे कालात्मिके देवि कृतानुकंपे /
कल्पावसानोत्थित कालिरूपे कामप्रदे कल्पलते नमस्ते //
text_mt: Ever dwelling on the lap of Kāmeśvara, embodied as Time, O Goddess, full of compassion! / Having the form of Kālī arisen at the end of the kalpa, granter of desires, wishing-vine, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
savāruṇe sāṃdrasudhāṃśuśīte sāraṅgaśāvākṣi sarojavaktre /
sārasya sārasya sadaikabhūme samastavidyeśvari saṃnatiste //
meaning:
सवारुणे सांद्रसुधांशुशीते सारङ्गशावाक्षि सरोजवक्त्रे /
सारस्य सारस्य सदैकभूमे समस्तविद्येश्वरि संनतिस्ते //
text_mt: Joined with red wine, cool as the abundant moon, with eyes like a fawn's, lotus-faced! / Sole eternal ground of essential sweetness, mistress of all lore, salutation to you!

sanskrit_iast:
tava prabhāveṇa cidagnijāyāṃ śrīśaṃbhunāthaprakaḍīkṛtāyāḥ /
bhaṇḍāsurādyāḥ samare pracaṇḍā hatā jagatkaṇṭakatāṃ prayātāḥ //
meaning:
तव प्रभावेण चिदग्निजायां श्रीशंभुनाथप्रकडीकृतायाः /
भण्डासुराद्याः समरे प्रचण्डा हता जगत्कण्टकतां प्रयाताः //
text_mt: By your power, O you who were born from the fire of consciousness and made manifest by Lord Śambhu, / the fierce Asura Bhaṇḍa and others, who had become thorns to the world, were slain in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
navyāni sarvāṇi vapūṃṣi kṛtvā hi sāṃdrakāruṇyasudhāplavairnnaḥ /
tvayā samastaṃ bhuvanaṃ saharṣaṃ sujīvitaṃ suṃdari sabhyalabhye //
meaning:
नव्यानि सर्वाणि वपूंषि कृत्वा हि सांद्रकारुण्यसुधाप्लवैर्न्नः /
त्वया समस्तं भुवनं सहर्षं सुजीवितं सुंदरि सभ्यलभ्ये //
text_mt: Making all our bodies new through inundations of the nectar of deep compassion, / the entire world has been happily brought back to life by you, O beautiful one, attainable by the noble!

sanskrit_iast:
śrīśaṃbhunāthasya mahāśayasya dvitīyatejaḥ prasarātmake yaḥ /
sthāṇvāśrame kḷptatayā viraktaḥ satīviyogena virastabhogaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीशंभुनाथस्य महाशयस्य द्वितीयतेजः प्रसरात्मके यः /
स्थाण्वाश्रमे कॢप्ततया विरक्तः सतीवियोगेन विरस्तभोगः //
text_mt: He who is the extension of the second splendor of the noble Lord Śambhu, / who, resolute in the hermitage of Sthāṇu, was detached and had given up pleasure through separation from Satī—

sanskrit_iast:
tenādrivaṃśe dhṛtajanmalābhāṃ kanyāmumāṃ yojayituṃ pravṛttāḥ /
evaṃ smaraṃ preritavanta eva tasyāntikaṃ ghora tapaḥsthitasya //
meaning:
तेनाद्रिवंशे धृतजन्मलाभां कन्यामुमां योजयितुं प्रवृत्ताः /
एवं स्मरं प्रेरितवन्त एव तस्यान्तिकं घोर तपःस्थितस्य //
text_mt: it was to unite him with the maiden Umā, who had taken birth in the mountain family, / that [the gods] dispatched Smara to his presence as he stood performing severe austerities.

sanskrit_iast:
tenātha vairāgyatapovighātakrodhena lālāṭakṛśānudagdhaḥ /
bhasmāvaśeṣo madanastato 'bhūttato hi bhaṇḍāsura eṣa jātaḥ //
meaning:
तेनाथ वैराग्यतपोविघातक्रोधेन लालाटकृशानुदग्धः /
भस्मावशेषो मदनस्ततो ऽभूत्ततो हि भण्डासुर एष जातः //
text_mt: Then, through anger at the interruption of his austerities and detachment, Madana was burned by the fire of his forehead-eye / and was reduced to ashes; and from that [heap of ashes] this Asura Bhaṇḍa was born.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vadhastasya durāśayasya kṛto bhavatyā raṇadurmadasya /
athāsmadarthe tvatanussajātastvaṃ kāmasaṃjīvanamāśukuryāḥ //
meaning:
ततो वधस्तस्य दुराशयस्य कृतो भवत्या रणदुर्मदस्य /
अथास्मदर्थे त्वतनुस्सजातस्त्वं कामसंजीवनमाशुकुर्याः //
text_mt: Then the slaying of that evil-minded one, furious in battle, was accomplished by you. / Now, on our behalf, your own portion having been born, may you quickly revive Kāma.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ ratirbhartṛviyogakhinnā vaidhavyamatyantamabhavyamāpa /
punastvadutpāditakāmasaṃgādbhaviṣyati śrīlalite sanāthā //
meaning:
इयं रतिर्भर्तृवियोगखिन्ना वैधव्यमत्यन्तमभव्यमाप /
पुनस्त्वदुत्पादितकामसंगाद्भविष्यति श्रीललिते सनाथा //
text_mt: This Rati, afflicted by separation from her husband, has fallen into utter and dire widowhood; / through union with Kāma produced anew by you, O Śrīlalitā, she will again have a protector.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā tu dṛṣṭena manobhavena saṃmohitaḥ pūrvavadindumauliḥ /
ciraṃ kṛtātyantamahāsaparyā tāṃ pārvatīṃ drākpariṇeṣyatīśaḥ //
meaning:
तया तु दृष्टेन मनोभवेन संमोहितः पूर्ववदिन्दुमौलिः /
चिरं कृतात्यन्तमहासपर्या तां पार्वतीं द्राक्परिणेष्यतीशः //
text_mt: Bewitched as before by Manobhava seen by her, the moon-crested Lord / will quickly marry that Pārvatī, who has long performed supreme worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tayośca saṃgādbhavitā kumāraḥ samastagīrvāṇacamūvinetā /
tenaiva vīreṇa raṇe nirasya sa tārako nāma surārirājaḥ //
meaning:
तयोश्च संगाद्भविता कुमारः समस्तगीर्वाणचमूविनेता /
तेनैव वीरेण रणे निरस्य स तारको नाम सुरारिराजः //
text_mt: And from their union Kumāra will be born, the commander of the entire army of the gods; / by that very hero, that king of the enemies of the gods named Tāraka, defeated in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
yo bhaṇḍadaityasya durāśayasya mitraṃ sa lokatrayadhūmaketuḥ /
śrīkaṇṭhaputraiṇa raṇe hataścetprāṇapratiṣṭhaiva tadā bhavennaḥ //
meaning:
यो भण्डदैत्यस्य दुराशयस्य मित्रं स लोकत्रयधूमकेतुः /
श्रीकण्ठपुत्रैण रणे हतश्चेत्प्राणप्रतिष्ठैव तदा भवेन्नः //
text_mt: who was a friend of that evil-minded Daitya Bhaṇḍa and a comet of disaster to the three worlds, / will be slain; if he is killed in battle by the son of Śrīkaṇṭha, then our lives will be firmly restored.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttvamaṃbatripure janānāṃ mānāpahaṃ manmathavīravaryam /
utpādyaratyā vidhavātvaduḥkhamapākuru vyākulakuntalāyāḥ //
meaning:
तस्मात्त्वमंबत्रिपुरे जनानां मानापहं मन्मथवीरवर्यम् /
उत्पाद्यरत्या विधवात्वदुःखमपाकुरु व्याकुलकुन्तलायाः //
text_mt: Therefore, O Mother Tripurā, create the best of heroes, Manmatha, who destroys the pride of men, / and remove the grief of widowhood from Rati whose hair is disheveled.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā tvanāthā bhavatīṃ prapannā bhartṛpraṇāśena kṛśāṅgayaṣṭiḥ /
namaskaroti tripurābhidhāne tadatra kāruṇyakalāṃ vidhehi //
meaning:
एषा त्वनाथा भवतीं प्रपन्ना भर्तृप्रणाशेन कृशाङ्गयष्टिः /
नमस्करोति त्रिपुराभिधाने तदत्र कारुण्यकलां विधेहि //
text_mt: This helpless woman has taken refuge in you, her slender body wasted by the destruction of her husband; / she bows to you, named Tripurā; therefore, bestow a fraction of your compassion here.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
iti stutvā maheśānī brahmādyā vibudhottamāḥ /
tāṃ ratiṃ darśayamāsurmalināṃ śokakarśitam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
इति स्तुत्वा महेशानी ब्रह्माद्या विबुधोत्तमाः /
तां रतिं दर्शयमासुर्मलिनां शोककर्शितम् //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
Having thus praised the supreme ruler, Brahmā and the other foremost gods / showed to her that Rati, who was soiled and emaciated by grief.

sanskrit_iast:
sā paryaśrumukhī kīrṇakuntalā dhūlidhūsarā /
nanāma jagadaṃbāṃ vai vaidhavyatyaktabhūṣaṇā //
meaning:
सा पर्यश्रुमुखी कीर्णकुन्तला धूलिधूसरा /
ननाम जगदंबां वै वैधव्यत्यक्तभूषणा //
text_mt: Her face filled with tears, her tresses scattered, grey with dust, / having cast off her ornaments due to widowhood, she bowed down to the Mother of the Universe.

sanskrit_iast:
atha taddarśanotpannakāruṇyā parameśvarī /
tataḥ kaṭākṣādutpannaḥ smayamānasukhāṃbujaḥ //
meaning:
अथ तद्दर्शनोत्पन्नकारुण्या परमेश्वरी /
ततः कटाक्षादुत्पन्नः स्मयमानसुखांबुजः //
text_mt: Then compassion arose in the supreme Goddess at the sight of her; / and from her side-glance was born he whose lotus face was smiling,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadehādhikarucirmanmatho madameduraḥ /
dvibhujaḥ sarvabhūṣāḍhyaḥ puṣpeṣuḥ puṣpakārmukaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वदेहाधिकरुचिर्मन्मथो मदमेदुरः /
द्विभुजः सर्वभूषाढ्यः पुष्पेषुः पुष्पकार्मुकः //
text_mt: Manmatha, far more radiant than his former body, overflowing with pride, / two-armed, adorned with all ornaments, with flower-arrows and a flower-bow,

sanskrit_iast:
ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim /
atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare /
majjantī nijabhartāramavarokya mudaṃ gatā //
meaning:
आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् /
अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे /
मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवरोक्य मुदं गता //
text_mt: delighting Rati, the beloved of his previous birth, with his side-glance. / Then Goddess Rati too, plunging into a vast ocean of joy / upon seeing her husband, was filled with delight.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandayankaṭākṣeṇa pūrvajanmapriyāṃ ratim /
atha sāpi ratirdevī mahatyānandasāgare /
majjantī nijabhartāramavalokya mudaṃ gatā //
meaning:
आनन्दयन्कटाक्षेण पूर्वजन्मप्रियां रतिम् /
अथ सापि रतिर्देवी महत्यानन्दसागरे /
मज्जन्ती निजभर्तारमवलोक्य मुदं गता //
text_mt: Delighting with a side-glance Rati, his beloved from his previous birth. / Then even the goddess Rati, plunging into a great ocean of joy, / reached happiness upon seeing her own husband.

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmale snāpayitvaināṃ vastrakāñcyādibhūṣaṇaiḥ /
alaṅkṛtya yathāpūrvaṃ śīghramānīyatāmiha //
meaning:
श्यामले स्नापयित्वैनां वस्त्रकाञ्च्यादिभूषणैः /
अलङ्कृत्य यथापूर्वं शीघ्रमानीयतामिह //
text_mt: "O Śyāmalā, having bathed her and adorned her / with garments, girdles, and other ornaments as before, let her be brought here quickly!"

sanskrit_iast:
tadājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā śyāmā sarvaṃ tathākarota /
brahmarṣibhirvasiṣṭhādyairvaivāhi kavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तदाज्ञां शिरसा धृत्वा श्यामा सर्वं तथाकरोत /
ब्रह्मर्षिभिर्वसिष्ठाद्यैर्वैवाहि कविधानतः //
text_mt: Bearing her command upon her head, Śyāmā did everything accordingly. / By means of the brahmin seers led by Vasiṣṭha, according to the rites of marriage,

sanskrit_iast:
kārayāmāsa daṃpatyoḥ pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam /
apsarobhiśca sarvābhirnṛtyagītādisaṃyutam //
meaning:
कारयामास दंपत्योः पाणिग्रहणमङ्गलम् /
अप्सरोभिश्च सर्वाभिर्नृत्यगीतादिसंयुतम् //
text_mt: She had the auspicious clasping of hands performed for the married couple, / accompanied by dancing, singing, and other festivities by all the apsarases.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddṛṣṭvā mahendrādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ /
sādhusādhviti śaṃsaṃtastuṣṭuvurlalitāṃbikām //
meaning:
एतद्दृष्ट्वा महेन्द्राद्या ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः /
साधुसाध्विति शंसंतस्तुष्टुवुर्ललितांबिकाम् //
text_mt: Having seen this, Mahendra and the other [gods], and the seers rich in asceticism, / praising, saying "Well done! Well done!", lauded Mother Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ vimuñcantaḥ sarve santuṣṭamānasāḥ /
babhūvustau mahābhaktyā praṇamya laliteśvarīm //
meaning:
पुष्पवृष्टिं विमुञ्चन्तः सर्वे सन्तुष्टमानसाः /
बभूवुस्तौ महाभक्त्या प्रणम्य ललितेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: Releasing a shower of flowers, all their minds were satisfied. / Bowing with great devotion to Laliteśvarī, both of them

sanskrit_iast:
tatpārśve tu samāgatya baddhāñjalipuṭau sthitau /
atha kandarpavīro 'pi namaskṛtya maheśvarīm /
vyajñāpayadidaṃ vākyaṃ bhaktinirbharamānasaḥ //
meaning:
तत्पार्श्वे तु समागत्य बद्धाञ्जलिपुटौ स्थितौ /
अथ कन्दर्पवीरो ऽपि नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरीम् /
व्यज्ञापयदिदं वाक्यं भक्तिनिर्भरमानसः //
text_mt: Came to her side and stood with cupped hands folded in reverence. / Then the heroic Kandarpa also, having bowed down to Maheśvarī, / addressed this speech, his mind overflowing with devotion:

sanskrit_iast:
yaddagdhamīśanetreṇa vapurme lalitāṃbike /
tattvadīyakaṭākṣasya prasādātpunarāgatam //
meaning:
यद्दग्धमीशनेत्रेण वपुर्मे ललितांबिके /
तत्त्वदीयकटाक्षस्य प्रसादात्पुनरागतम् //
text_mt: "That body of mine which was burned by the eye of the Lord, O Mother Lalitā, / has returned once more by the grace of your side-glance.

sanskrit_iast:
tava putro 'smi dāso 'smi kvāpi kṛtye niyuṅkṣva mām /
ityuktā parameśānī tamāha makaradhvajam //
meaning:
तव पुत्रो ऽस्मि दासो ऽस्मि क्वापि कृत्ये नियुङ्क्ष्व माम् /
