इत्युक्ता परमेशानी तमाह मकरध्वजम् //
text_mt: I am your son, I am your servant; assign me to some task!" / Thus addressed, the Supreme Sovereign spoke to that god who has the makara on his banner:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyuvāca
vatsāgaccha manojanmanna bhayaṃ tava vidyate /
matprasādājjagatsarvaṃ mohayāvyāhatāśuga //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्युवाच
वत्सागच्छ मनोजन्मन्न भयं तव विद्यते /
मत्प्रसादाज्जगत्सर्वं मोहयाव्याहताशुग //
text_mt: The holy Goddess said: / "Come, child born from the mind, there is no fear for you. / By my grace, enchant the entire universe, O you of unimpeded arrows!

sanskrit_iast:
tadbāṇapātanājjātadhairyaviplava īśvaraḥ /
parvatasya sutāṃ gaurīṃ pariṇeṣyati satvaram //
meaning:
तद्बाणपातनाज्जातधैर्यविप्लव ईश्वरः /
पर्वतस्य सुतां गौरीं परिणेष्यति सत्वरम् //
text_mt: Through the falling of your arrows, the Lord, with his fortitude shattered, / will quickly marry Gaurī, the daughter of the mountain.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrakoṭayaḥ kāmā matprasādāttvadudbhavāḥ /
sarveṣāṃ dehamāviśya dāsyanti ratimuttamām //
meaning:
सहस्रकोटयः कामा मत्प्रसादात्त्वदुद्भवाः /
सर्वेषां देहमाविश्य दास्यन्ति रतिमुत्तमाम् //
text_mt: Ten million Kāmas, born from you by my grace, / having entered the bodies of all, will grant supreme pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
matprasādena vairāgyātsaṃkruddho 'pi sa īśvaraḥ /
dehadāhaṃ vidhātuṃ te na samartho bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
मत्प्रसादेन वैराग्यात्संक्रुद्धो ऽपि स ईश्वरः /
देहदाहं विधातुं ते न समर्थो भविष्यति //
text_mt: By my grace, even if that Lord becomes utterly enraged through dispassion, / he will not be capable of burning your body.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyamūrtiḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhavamohanaḥ /
svabhāryāvirahāśaṅkī dehasyārdhaṃ pradāsyati /
prayāto 'sau kātarātmā tvadbāṇāhatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
अदृश्यमूर्तिः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भवमोहनः /
स्वभार्याविरहाशङ्की देहस्यार्धं प्रदास्यति /
प्रयातो ऽसौ कातरात्मा त्वद्बाणाहतमानसः //
text_mt: Invisible in form to all living beings, enchanting the world, / anxious over separation from his wife, his mind struck by your arrows, / he will become agitated and will give up half of his body.

sanskrit_iast:
adya prabhṛti kandarpa matprasādānmahīyasaḥ /
tvannindāṃ ye kariṣyanti tvayi vā vimukhāśayāḥ /
avaśyaṃ klībataiva syātteṣāṃ janmanijanmani //
meaning:
अद्य प्रभृति कन्दर्प मत्प्रसादान्महीयसः /
त्वन्निन्दां ये करिष्यन्ति त्वयि वा विमुखाशयाः /
अवश्यं क्लीबतैव स्यात्तेषां जन्मनिजन्मनि //
text_mt: From this day forward, O Kandarpa, by my highest grace, / those who censure you, or whose minds are turned away from you, / shall inevitably become eunuchs in birth after birth.

sanskrit_iast:
ye pāpiṣṭhā durātmāno madbhaktadrohiṇaśca hi /
tānagamyāsu nārīṣu pātayitvā vināśaya //
meaning:
ये पापिष्ठा दुरात्मानो मद्भक्तद्रोहिणश्च हि /
तानगम्यासु नारीषु पातयित्वा विनाशय //
text_mt: Those wicked, evil-natured people who are hostile toward my devotees— / destroy them by causing them to fall among forbidden women!

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ madīya pūjāsu madbhakteṣvādṛtaṃ manaḥ /
teṣāṃ kāmasukhaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpādaya samīpsitam //
meaning:
येषां मदीय पूजासु मद्भक्तेष्वादृतं मनः /
तेषां कामसुखं सर्वं संपादय समीप्सितम् //
text_mt: Those whose minds are devoted to worship of me and toward my devotees— / bring about for them all desired pleasure of love!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīlalitādevyā kṛtājñāvacanaṃ smaraḥ /
tatheti śirasā bibhratsāṃjalirniryayau tataḥ //
meaning:
इति श्रीललितादेव्या कृताज्ञावचनं स्मरः /
तथेति शिरसा बिभ्रत्सांजलिर्निर्ययौ ततः //
text_mt: Thus bearing the command spoken by the holy goddess Lalitā / upon his head, saying "So be it," Smara departed with folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyānaṅgasya sarvebhyo romakūpebhya utthitāḥ /
bahavaḥ śobhanākārā madanā viśvamohanāḥ //
meaning:
तस्यानङ्गस्य सर्वेभ्यो रोमकूपेभ्य उत्थिताः /
बहवः शोभनाकारा मदना विश्वमोहनाः //
text_mt: From all the hair follicles of that bodiless god arose / many Madanas of lovely form, captivating the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tairvimohya samastaṃ ca jagaccakraṃ manobhavaḥ /
punaḥ sthāṇvāśramaṃ prāpa candramaulerjigīṣayā //
meaning:
तैर्विमोह्य समस्तं च जगच्चक्रं मनोभवः /
पुनः स्थाण्वाश्रमं प्राप चन्द्रमौलेर्जिगीषया //
text_mt: Having enchanted the entire cycle of the world through them, the mind-born god / reached the hermitage of Sthāṇu once more, desiring to conquer the moon-crested god.

sanskrit_iast:
vasaṃtena ca mitreṇa senānyā śītarociṣā /
rāgeṇa pīṭhamardena mandānilarayeṇa ca //
meaning:
वसंतेन च मित्रेण सेनान्या शीतरोचिषा /
रागेण पीठमर्देन मन्दानिलरयेण च //
text_mt: With Spring as his friend, with the cold-rayed moon as his army commander, / with passion as his companion, and with the swiftness of the gentle breeze,

sanskrit_iast:
puṃskokilagalatsvānakāhalībhiśca saṃyutaḥ /
śṛṅgāravīrasaṃpanno ratyāliṅgitavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
पुंस्कोकिलगलत्स्वानकाहलीभिश्च संयुतः /
शृङ्गारवीरसंपन्नो रत्यालिङ्गितविग्रहः //
text_mt: And accompanied by the trumpets of the flowing cries of the male cuckoos, / endowed with erotic and heroic sentiment, his body embraced by Rati,

sanskrit_iast:
jaitra śarāsanaṃ dhunvanpravīrāṇāṃ purogamaḥ /
madanārerabhimukhaṃ prāpya nibhaya āsthitaḥ //
meaning:
जैत्र शरासनं धुन्वन्प्रवीराणां पुरोगमः /
मदनारेरभिमुखं प्राप्य निभय आस्थितः //
text_mt: Brandishing his victorious bow, foremost among heroes, / arriving directly before the enemy of Madana, he stood fearlessly.

sanskrit_iast:
taponiṣṭhaṃ candracūḍaṃ tāḍayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ /
atha kandarpabāṇaudhaistāḍitaścandraśekharaḥ /
dūrīcakāra vairāgyaṃ tapastattyāja duṣkaram //
meaning:
तपोनिष्ठं चन्द्रचूडं ताडयामास सायकैः /
अथ कन्दर्पबाणौधैस्ताडितश्चन्द्रशेखरः /
दूरीचकार वैराग्यं तपस्तत्त्याज दुष्करम् //
text_mt: He struck with arrows the moon-crested god intent on asceticism. / Then Candraśekhara, struck by the streams of Kandarpa's arrows, / cast dispassion far away and abandoned that difficult asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
niyamānakhilāṃstyaktvā tyaktadhairyaḥ śivaḥ kṛtaḥ /
tāmeva pārvatīṃ dhyātvā bhūyobhūyaḥ smarāturaḥ //
meaning:
नियमानखिलांस्त्यक्त्वा त्यक्तधैर्यः शिवः कृतः /
तामेव पार्वतीं ध्यात्वा भूयोभूयः स्मरातुरः //
text_mt: Having abandoned all his vows, Śiva was made bereft of fortitude; / meditating again and again on that very Pārvatī, afflicted by love,

sanskrit_iast:
niśaśvāsa vahañśarvaḥ pāṇḍuraṃ gaṇḍamaṇḍalam /
bāṣpāyamāṇo virahī saṃtapto dhairyaviplavāt /
bhūyobhūyo girisutāṃ pūrvadṛṣṭāmanusmaran //
meaning:
निशश्वास वहञ्शर्वः पाण्डुरं गण्डमण्डलम् /
बाष्पायमाणो विरही संतप्तो धैर्यविप्लवात् /
भूयोभूयो गिरिसुतां पूर्वदृष्टामनुस्मरन् //
text_mt: Śarva sighed, bearing a pale orb of the cheek; / shedding tears, suffering separation, tormented by the ruin of his steadfastness, / remembering again and again the daughter of the mountain whom he had seen before.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgabāṇadahanaistapyamānasya śūlinaḥ /
na candrarekhā no gaṅgā dehatāpacchide 'bhavat //
meaning:
अनङ्गबाणदहनैस्तप्यमानस्य शूलिनः /
न चन्द्ररेखा नो गङ्गा देहतापच्छिदे ऽभवत् //
text_mt: For the wielder of the trident burning with the fires of the bodiless god's arrows, / neither the crescent moon nor the Gaṅgā relieved the fever of his body.

sanskrit_iast:
nandibhṛṅgimahākālapramukhairgaṇamaṇḍalaiḥ /
āhṛte puṣpaśayane viluloṭha muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
नन्दिभृङ्गिमहाकालप्रमुखैर्गणमण्डलैः /
आहृते पुष्पशयने विलुलोठ मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: Upon the flower bed brought by the hosts of gaṇas led by Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, and Mahākāla, / he rolled over and over again.

sanskrit_iast:
nandino hastamālaṃbya puṣpatalpāntarātpunaḥ /
puṣpatalpāntaraṃ gatvā vyaceṣṭata muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
नन्दिनो हस्तमालंब्य पुष्पतल्पान्तरात्पुनः /
पुष्पतल्पान्तरं गत्वा व्यचेष्टत मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: Leaning on the hand of Nandin, going from one bed of flowers / to another bed of flowers, he tossed about again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
na puṣpaśayanenendukhaṇḍanirgalitāmṛte /
na himānīpayasi vā nivṛttastadvapurjvaraḥ //
meaning:
न पुष्पशयनेनेन्दुखण्डनिर्गलितामृते /
न हिमानीपयसि वा निवृत्तस्तद्वपुर्ज्वरः //
text_mt: Neither by the flower bed, nor by nectar dripping from the crescent moon, / nor by icy water was the fever of his body allayed.

sanskrit_iast:
sa taneratanujvālāṃ śamayiṣyanmuhurmuhuḥ /
śilībhūtānhimapayaḥ paṭṭānadhyavasacchivaḥ /
bhūyaḥ śailasutārūpaṃ citrapaṭṭe nakhairlikhat //
meaning:
स तनेरतनुज्वालां शमयिष्यन्मुहुर्मुहुः /
शिलीभूतान्हिमपयः पट्टानध्यवसच्छिवः /
भूयः शैलसुतारूपं चित्रपट्टे नखैर्लिखत् //
text_mt: Wishing to extinguish the intense burning of his body again and again, / Śiva sat upon slabs of frozen snow-water; / repeatedly he drew the form of the mountain's daughter on a picture board with his nails.

sanskrit_iast:
tadālokanato 'dūramanaṅgārtimavardhayat /
tāmālikhya hriyā namrāṃ vīkṣamāṇāṃ kaṭākṣataḥ //
meaning:
तदालोकनतो ऽदूरमनङ्गार्तिमवर्धयत् /
तामालिख्य ह्रिया नम्रां वीक्षमाणां कटाक्षतः //
text_mt: From the sight of that, he increased the torment of love before long; / having painted her bowed with modesty, looking with a side-glance,

sanskrit_iast:
taccitrapaṭṭamaṅgeṣu romaharṣeṣu cākṣipat /
cintāsaṃgena mahatā mahātyā ratisaṃpadā /
bhūyasā smaratāpena vivyathe viṣamekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
तच्चित्रपट्टमङ्गेषु रोमहर्षेषु चाक्षिपत् /
चिन्तासंगेन महता महात्या रतिसंपदा /
भूयसा स्मरतापेन विव्यथे विषमेक्षणः //
text_mt: He pressed that picture board against his limbs and his bristling hair. / Through the great association of anxieties, and the great wealth of passion, / the uneven-eyed god suffered through excessive torment of love.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmeva sarvataḥ paśyaṃstasyāmeva mano diśan /
tathaiva saṃllapansārdhamunmādenopapannayā //
meaning:
तामेव सर्वतः पश्यंस्तस्यामेव मनो दिशन् /
तथैव संल्लपन्सार्धमुन्मादेनोपपन्नया //
text_mt: Seeing only her everywhere, directing his mind only toward her, / he conversed as though with her made present by his madness.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmātrabhūtahṛdayastaccittastatparāyaṇaḥ /
tatkathāsudhayā nītasamastarajanīdinaḥ //
meaning:
तन्मात्रभूतहृदयस्तच्चित्तस्तत्परायणः /
तत्कथासुधया नीतसमस्तरजनीदिनः //
text_mt: His heart consisting only of her, his thoughts fixed on her, entirely devoted to her, / he passed all nights and days with the nectar of talk about her.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchīlavarṇana ratastadrūpālokanotsukaḥ /
taccārubhogasaṃkalpamālākarasumālikaḥ /
tanmayatvamanuprāptastatāpātitarāṃ śivaḥ //
meaning:
तच्छीलवर्णन रतस्तद्रूपालोकनोत्सुकः /
तच्चारुभोगसंकल्पमालाकरसुमालिकः /
तन्मयत्वमनुप्राप्तस्ततापातितरां शिवः //
text_mt: Delighting in describing her character, eager to behold her form, / a maker of garlands for the wishes of delightful union with her, / Śiva, having attained oneness with her, suffered exceedingly.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ manobhava rujamacikitsyāṃ sa dhūrjaṭiḥ /
avalokya vivāhāya bhṛśamudyamavānabhūt //
meaning:
इमां मनोभव रुजमचिकित्स्यां स धूर्जटिः /
अवलोक्य विवाहाय भृशमुद्यमवानभूत् //
text_mt: Seeing this incurable sickness born of love, / that matted-haired god made a great effort toward marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vimohya taṃ devaṃ kandarpo lalitājñayā /
atha tāṃ parvatasutāmāśugairabhyatāpayat //
meaning:
इत्थं विमोह्य तं देवं कन्दर्पो ललिताज्ञया /
अथ तां पर्वतसुतामाशुगैरभ्यतापयत् //
text_mt: Having thus enchanted that god by the command of Lalitā, / Kandarpa then afflicted that daughter of the mountain with his swift arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtavirahajvālāmalinaiḥ śvasitānalaiḥ /
śuṣyamāṇādharadalo bhṛśaṃ pāṇḍukapolabhūḥ //
meaning:
प्रभूतविरहज्वालामलिनैः श्वसितानलैः /
शुष्यमाणाधरदलो भृशं पाण्डुकपोलभूः //
text_mt: With fires of sighs blackened by abundant flames of separation, / the petal of her lower lip drying up, the region of her cheeks exceedingly pale,

sanskrit_iast:
nāhāre vā na śayane na svāpe dhṛtimicchati /
makhīsahasraiḥ siṣice nityaṃ śītopacārakaiḥ //
meaning:
नाहारे वा न शयने न स्वापे धृतिमिच्छति /
मखीसहस्रैः सिषिचे नित्यं शीतोपचारकैः //
text_mt: She desired no pleasure in food, nor in the bed, nor in sleep; / she was constantly sprinkled with cooling remedies by thousands of female friends.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ punastapyamānā punareva ca vihvalā /
na jagāma rujāśānti manmathāgnermahīyasaḥ //
meaning:
पुनः पुनस्तप्यमाना पुनरेव च विह्वला /
न जगाम रुजाशान्ति मन्मथाग्नेर्महीयसः //
text_mt: Tormented again and again, and agitated again and again, / she found no alleviation of the illness from the mighty fire of Manmatha.

sanskrit_iast:
na nidrāṃ pārvatī bheje viraheṇopatāpitā /
svatanostāpanenāsau pituḥ khedamavardhayat //
meaning:
न निद्रां पार्वती भेजे विरहेणोपतापिता /
स्वतनोस्तापनेनासौ पितुः खेदमवर्धयत् //
text_mt: Tormented by separation, Pārvatī found no sleep; / by the burning of her own body, she increased the grief of her father.

sanskrit_iast:
apratīkārapuruṣaṃ virahaṃ tuhituḥ śive /
avalokya sa śailendro mahāduḥkhamavāptavān //
meaning:
अप्रतीकारपुरुषं विरहं तुहितुः शिवे /
अवलोक्य स शैलेन्द्रो महादुःखमवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Seeing that the separation of his daughter from Śiva had no remedy by any man, / that lord of the mountains attained great sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadre tvaṃ tapasā devaṃ toṣayitvā maheśvaram /
bhārtāraṃ taṃ samṛccheti pitrā sampreritātha sā //
meaning:
भद्रे त्वं तपसा देवं तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम् /
भार्तारं तं समृच्छेति पित्रा सम्प्रेरिताथ सा //
text_mt: "O auspicious one, having pleased the god Maheśvara through asceticism, / obtain him as your husband!" Then, thus urged by her father,

sanskrit_iast:
himavacchailaśikhare gaurīśikharanāmani /
vakāra patilābhāya pārvatī duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ //
meaning:
हिमवच्छैलशिखरे गौरीशिखरनामनि /
वकार पतिलाभाय पार्वती दुष्करं तपः //
text_mt: On the peak of Mount Himavat known by the name of Gaurīśikhara, / Pārvatī undertook difficult asceticism to obtain a husband.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśireṣu jalāvāsā grīṣme dahanamadhyagā /
arke niviṣṭadṛṣṭiśca sughoraṃ tapa āsthitā //
meaning:
शिशिरेषु जलावासा ग्रीष्मे दहनमध्यगा /
अर्के निविष्टदृष्टिश्च सुघोरं तप आस्थिता //
text_mt: Dwelling in water during the winters, standing amidst fires in the summer, / and fixing her gaze on the sun, she undertook most terrible asceticism.

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva tapasā tuṣṭaḥ sānnidhyaṃ dattavāñchivaḥ /
aṅgīcakāra tāṃ bhāryāṃ vaivāhikavidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तेनैव तपसा तुष्टः सान्निध्यं दत्तवाञ्छिवः /
अङ्गीचकार तां भार्यां वैवाहिकविधानतः //
text_mt: Pleased by that very asceticism, Śiva granted his presence; / he accepted her as his wife according to the marriage rites.

sanskrit_iast:
athādripatinā dattāṃ tanayāṃ nalinekṣaṇām /
saptarṣidvārataḥ pūrvaṃ prārthitāmudavoḍha saḥ //
meaning:
अथाद्रिपतिना दत्तां तनयां नलिनेक्षणाम् /
सप्तर्षिद्वारतः पूर्वं प्रार्थितामुदवोढ सः //
text_mt: Then he married that lotus-eyed daughter given by the lord of mountains, / who had formerly been asked for through the Seven Sages.

sanskrit_iast:
tayā ca ramamāṇo 'sau bahukālaṃ maheśvaraḥ /
oṣadhīprasthanagare śvaśurasya gṛhe 'vasat //
meaning:
तया च रममाणो ऽसौ बहुकालं महेश्वरः /
ओषधीप्रस्थनगरे श्वशुरस्य गृहे ऽवसत् //
text_mt: Sporting with her for a long time, the great lord / resided in his father-in-law's house in the city of Oṣadhīprastha.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ kailāsamāgatya samastaiḥ pramathaiḥ saha /
pārvatīmānināyādrināthasya prītimāvahat //
meaning:
पुनः कैलासमागत्य समस्तैः प्रमथैः सह /
पार्वतीमानिनायाद्रिनाथस्य प्रीतिमावहत् //
text_mt: Returning to Kailāsa along with all his Pramathas, / he brought Pārvatī along, bringing joy to the lord of mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
ramamāṇastayā sārthaṃ kailāse mandare tathā /
vindhyādrau hemaśaile ca malaye pāriyātrake //
meaning:
रममाणस्तया सार्थं कैलासे मन्दरे तथा /
विन्ध्याद्रौ हेमशैले च मलये पारियात्रके //
text_mt: Sporting with her on Kailāsa and on Mandara, / on the Vindhya mountain, on the golden mountain [Meru], on Malaya and Pāriyātra,

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidheṣu sthāneṣu ratiṃ prāpa maheśvaraḥ /
atha tasyāṃ sasarjograṃ vīryaṃ sā soḍhumakṣamā //
meaning:
नानाविधेषु स्थानेषु रतिं प्राप महेश्वरः /
अथ तस्यां ससर्जोग्रं वीर्यं सा सोढुमक्षमा //
text_mt: in various places the great lord found delight. / Then he discharged his fierce semen into her, but unable to bear it,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvyatyajatsāpi vahnau kṛttikāsu sa cākṣipat /
tāśca gaṅgājale 'muñcansā caiva śarakānane //
meaning:
भुव्यत्यजत्सापि वह्नौ कृत्तिकासु स चाक्षिपत् /
ताश्च गङ्गाजले ऽमुञ्चन्सा चैव शरकानने //
text_mt: she cast it upon the earth; the earth cast it into the fire, and he cast it into the Kṛttikās; / they released it into the waters of the Gaṅgā, and she into a forest of reeds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrodbhūto mahāvīro mahāsenaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ /
gaṅgāyāścāntikaṃ nīto dhūrjaṭirvṛddhi māgamat //
meaning:
तत्रोद्भूतो महावीरो महासेनः षडाननः /
गङ्गायाश्चान्तिकं नीतो धूर्जटिर्वृद्धि मागमत् //
text_mt: Born there, the mighty hero, Mahāsena, the six-faced one, / was brought near to the Gaṅgā, and Dhūrjaṭi's [son] grew up.

sanskrit_iast:
sa vardhamāno divasedivase tīvravikramaḥ /
śikṣito nijatātena sarvā vidyā avāptavān //
meaning:
स वर्धमानो दिवसेदिवसे तीव्रविक्रमः /
शिक्षितो निजतातेन सर्वा विद्या अवाप्तवान् //
text_mt: Growing day by day, of fierce prowess, / instructed by his own father, he mastered all sciences.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tātakṛtānujñaḥ surasainyapatirbhavan /
tārakaṃ mārayāmāsa samastaiḥ saha dānavaiḥ //
meaning:
अथ तातकृतानुज्ञः सुरसैन्यपतिर्भवन् /
तारकं मारयामास समस्तैः सह दानवैः //
text_mt: Then, having received his father's permission, becoming the commander of the army of gods, / he slew Tāraka along with all the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastārakadaityendravadhasantoṣaśālinā /
śakreṇa dattāṃ sa guho devasenāmupānayat //
meaning:
ततस्तारकदैत्येन्द्रवधसन्तोषशालिना /
शक्रेण दत्तां स गुहो देवसेनामुपानयत् //
text_mt: Then Guha married Devasenā, / who was given by Śakra, who was filled with joy at the slaying of the Daitya king Tāraka.

sanskrit_iast:
sā śakratanayā devasenā nāma yaśasvinī /
āsādyaramaṇaṃ skandamānandaṃ mṛśamādadhau //
meaning:
सा शक्रतनया देवसेना नाम यशस्विनी /
आसाद्यरमणं स्कन्दमानन्दं मृशमादधौ //
text_mt: That illustrious daughter of Śakra named Devasenā, / having obtained Skanda as her husband, experienced great bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ saṃmohitāśeṣaviśvacakro manobhavaḥ /
devakāryaṃ susampādya jagāma śrīpuraṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
इत्थं संमोहिताशेषविश्वचक्रो मनोभवः /
देवकार्यं सुसम्पाद्य जगाम श्रीपुरं पुनः //
text_mt: Thus the mind-born [Kāma], having enchanted the entire circle of the world / and duly accomplished the work of the gods, went once again to Śrīpura.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra śrīnagare puṇye lalitā parameśvarī /
vartate jagatāmṛddhyai tatra tāṃ sevituṃ yayau //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne madanapunarbhavo nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यत्र श्रीनगरे पुण्ये ललिता परमेश्वरी /
वर्तते जगतामृद्ध्यै तत्र तां सेवितुं ययौ //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मदनपुनर्भवो नाम त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
To that holy city of Śrīpura where the supreme goddess Lalitā / resides for the prosperity of the worlds, he went to worship her.

Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named 'The Rebirth of Madana', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
kimidaṃ śrīpuraṃ nāma kena rūpeṇa vartate /
kena vānirmitaṃ pūrva tatsarvaṃ me nivadaya //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
किमिदं श्रीपुरं नाम केन रूपेण वर्तते /
केन वानिर्मितं पूर्व तत्सर्वं मे निवदय //
text_mt: Agastya said: / What is this city named Śrīpura? In what form does it exist? / By whom was it previously constructed? Tell me all of that.

sanskrit_iast:
kiyatpramāṇaṃ kiṃ varṇaṃ kathayasva mama prabho /
tvameva sarvasandehapaṅkaśoṣaṇabhāskaraḥ //
meaning:
कियत्प्रमाणं किं वर्णं कथयस्व मम प्रभो /
त्वमेव सर्वसन्देहपङ्कशोषणभास्करः //
text_mt: What is its extent? What is its color? Tell me, O lord; / you alone are the sun that dries up the mud of all my doubts.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
yathā cakrarathaṃ prāpya pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutam /
mahāyāgānalotpannā lalitā parameśvarī //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
यथा चक्ररथं प्राप्य पूर्वोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतम् /
महायागानलोत्पन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / When the supreme goddess Lalitā, born from the fire of the great sacrifice, / mounted the chariot of the cakra endowed with the characteristics previously described,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā vaivāhikīṃ līlāṃ brahmādyaiḥ prārthitā punaḥ /
vyajeṣṭa bhaṇḍanāmānamasuraṃ lokakaṇṭakam //
meaning:
कृत्वा वैवाहिकीं लीलां ब्रह्माद्यैः प्रार्थिता पुनः /
व्यजेष्ट भण्डनामानमसुरं लोककण्टकम् //
text_mt: having engaged in the sport of marriage and being entreated again by Brahmā and the others, / conquered the Asura named Bhaṇḍa, the thorn of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā devā mahendrādyāḥ santoṣaṃ bahu bhejire /
atha kāmeśvarasyāpi lalitāyāśca śobhanam /
nityopabhogasarvārthaṃ mandiraṃ kartumutsukāḥ //
meaning:
तदा देवा महेन्द्राद्याः सन्तोषं बहु भेजिरे /
अथ कामेश्वरस्यापि ललितायाश्च शोभनम् /
नित्योपभोगसर्वार्थं मन्दिरं कर्तुमुत्सुकाः //
text_mt: then the gods, headed by Mahendra, experienced great delight. / Eager to build a splendid palace for Kāmeśvara / and for Lalitā, for all purposes of perpetual enjoyment,

sanskrit_iast:
kumārā lalitādevyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ /
vardhakiṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ surāṇāṃ śilpakovidam //
meaning:
कुमारा ललितादेव्या ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः /
वर्धकिं विश्वकर्माणं सुराणां शिल्पकोविदम् //
text_mt: the sons of goddess Lalitā—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara—/ [called] the architect Viśvakarman, skilled in the craft of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
surāṇāṃ śilpanaṃ ca mayaṃ māyāvicakṣaṇam /
āhūya kṛtasatkārānūcire lalitājñayā //
meaning:
सुराणां शिल्पनं च मयं मायाविचक्षणम् /
आहूय कृतसत्कारानूचिरे ललिताज्ञया //
text_mt: and Maya, the craftsman of the gods and expert in illusion. / Having summoned them and rendered honor, they spoke to them by the command of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
adhikāripuruṣā ūcuḥ
bho viśvakarmañchilpajña bhobho maya mahodaya /
bhavantau sarvaśāstrajñau ghaṭanāmārgakovidau //
meaning:
अधिकारिपुरुषा ऊचुः
भो विश्वकर्मञ्छिल्पज्ञ भोभो मय महोदय /
भवन्तौ सर्वशास्त्रज्ञौ घटनामार्गकोविदौ //
text_mt: The sovereign beings said: / O Viśvakarman, knower of craft! O Maya of great dignity! / You two know all the treatises and are skilled in the methods of construction,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpamātreṇa mahāśilpakalpaviśāradau /
yuvābhyāṃ lalitādevyā nityajñānamahodadheḥ //
meaning:
संकल्पमात्रेण महाशिल्पकल्पविशारदौ /
युवाभ्यां ललितादेव्या नित्यज्ञानमहोदधेः //
text_mt: adept in great design and craftsmanship by mere intention. / By you two, for goddess Lalitā, the great ocean of eternal wisdom,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśīkṣetramadhyeṣu tatkṣetrasamasaṃkhyayā /
kartavyā śrīnagaryo hi nānāratnairalaṅkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
षोडशीक्षेत्रमध्येषु तत्क्षेत्रसमसंख्यया /
कर्तव्या श्रीनगर्यो हि नानारत्नैरलङ्कृताः //
text_mt: among the sixteen sacred sites, equal in number to those sites, / the cities of Śrīpura must be built, adorned with various jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
yatra ṣoḍaśadhā bhinnā lalitā parameśvarī /
viśvatrāṇāya satataṃ nivāsaṃ racayiṣyati //
meaning:
यत्र षोडशधा भिन्ना ललिता परमेश्वरी /
विश्वत्राणाय सततं निवासं रचयिष्यति //
text_mt: where, divided sixteenfold, the supreme goddess Lalitā / will continually make her dwelling for the protection of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
asmākaṃ hi priyamidaṃ marutāmapica priyam /
sarvalokapriyaṃ caitattannāmnaiva viracyatām //
meaning:
अस्माकं हि प्रियमिदं मरुतामपिच प्रियम् /
सर्वलोकप्रियं चैतत्तन्नाम्नैव विरच्यताम् //
text_mt: For this is dear to us, and dear to the gods as well; / it is dear to all the worlds—let it be constructed under that very name.

sanskrit_iast:
iti kāraṇadevānāṃ vacanaṃ suniśamya tau /
viśvakarmamayau natvā vyabhāṣetāṃ tathāstviti //
meaning:
इति कारणदेवानां वचनं सुनिशम्य तौ /
विश्वकर्ममयौ नत्वा व्यभाषेतां तथास्त्विति //
text_mt: Having heard this speech of the causal deities, both of them, / Viśvakarman and Maya, bowed down and replied, 'So be it.'

sanskrit_iast:
punarnatvā pṛṣṭavantau tau tānkāraṇa pūruṣān /
keṣu kṣetreṣu kartavyāḥ śrīnagaryo mahodayāḥ //
meaning:
पुनर्नत्वा पृष्टवन्तौ तौ तान्कारण पूरुषान् /
केषु क्षेत्रेषु कर्तव्याः श्रीनगर्यो महोदयाः //
text_mt: Bowing once more, the two asked those causal persons: / In which sacred sites should the majestic cities of Śrīpura be built?

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyāḥ paripṛṣṭāste procustau śilpinau punaḥ /
kṣetrāṇāṃ pravibhāgaṃ tu kalpayantau yathocitam //
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्याः परिपृष्टास्ते प्रोचुस्तौ शिल्पिनौ पुनः /
क्षेत्राणां प्रविभागं तु कल्पयन्तौ यथोचितम् //
text_mt: Thus questioned, Brahmā and the others spoke again to the two craftsmen, / apportioning the division of the sacred sites as was appropriate.

sanskrit_iast:
kāraṇapuruṣā ūcuḥ
prathamaṃ merupṛṣṭhe tu niṣadhe ca mahīdhare /
hemakūṭe himagirau pañcame gandhamādane //
meaning:
कारणपुरुषा ऊचुः
प्रथमं मेरुपृष्ठे तु निषधे च महीधरे /
हेमकूटे हिमगिरौ पञ्चमे गन्धमादने //
text_mt: The causal persons said: / First, on the back of Meru, and on the Niṣadha mountain, / on Hemakūṭa, on the Himavat mountain, and fifth on Gandhamādana,

sanskrit_iast:
nīle meṣe ca śṛṅgāre mahendre ca mahāgirau /
kṣetrāṇi hi navaitāni bhaumāni viditānyatha //
meaning:
नीले मेषे च शृङ्गारे महेन्द्रे च महागिरौ /
क्षेत्राणि हि नवैतानि भौमानि विदितान्यथ //
text_mt: on Nīla, Meṣa, Śṛṅgāra, and the great mountain Mahendra; / these nine are known as the terrestrial sites.

sanskrit_iast:
audakāni tu saptaiva proktānyakhila sindhuṣu /
lavaṇo 'bdhīkṣusārābdhiḥ surābdhirghṛtasāgaraḥ //
meaning:
औदकानि तु सप्तैव प्रोक्तान्यखिल सिन्धुषु /
लवणो ऽब्धीक्षुसाराब्धिः सुराब्धिर्घृतसागरः //
text_mt: The aquatic ones are declared to be seven among all the oceans: / the salt ocean, the sugarcane-juice ocean, the wine ocean, the ghee ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
dadhisindhuḥ kṣīrasindhurjalasindhuśca saptamaḥ /
pūrvoktā nava śailendrāḥ paścātsapta ca sindhavaḥ //
meaning:
दधिसिन्धुः क्षीरसिन्धुर्जलसिन्धुश्च सप्तमः /
पूर्वोक्ता नव शैलेन्द्राः पश्चात्सप्त च सिन्धवः //
text_mt: the curd ocean, the milk ocean, and the fresh-water ocean as the seventh. / The previously mentioned nine lords of mountains and the seven oceans thereafter—

sanskrit_iast:
ātdṛtya ṣoḍaśa kṣetrāṇyaṃbāśrīpurakḷptaye /
yeṣu divyāni veśmāni lalitāyā mahaujasaḥ /
sṛjataṃ divyaghaṭanāpaṇḍitau śilpinau yuvām //
meaning:
आत्दृत्य षोडश क्षेत्राण्यंबाश्रीपुरकॢप्तये /
येषु दिव्यानि वेश्मानि ललिताया महौजसः /
सृजतं दिव्यघटनापण्डितौ शिल्पिनौ युवाम् //
text_mt: taking into account these sixteen sites for the construction of the Mother's Śrīpura, / in which are the divine abodes of Lalitā of great splendor, / may you two craftsmen, skilled in divine construction, create them.

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣu kṣetreṣu kḷptāni ghnantyā devyā mahāsurān /
nāmāni nityānāmnaiva prathitāni na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
येषु क्षेत्रेषु कॢप्तानि घ्नन्त्या देव्या महासुरान् /
नामानि नित्यानाम्नैव प्रथितानि न संशयः //
text_mt: The names fashioned in those sites where the goddess slew the great Asuras / have become renowned by the very name of the Nityās, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
sā hi nityāsvarūpeṇa kālavyāptikarī parā /
sarvaṃ kalayate devī kalanāṅkatayā jagat //
meaning:
सा हि नित्यास्वरूपेण कालव्याप्तिकरी परा /
सर्वं कलयते देवी कलनाङ्कतया जगत् //
text_mt: For in the form of the Nityā, the supreme goddess pervades time; / she holds and measures the entire universe by the marking of time.

sanskrit_iast:
nityānāca mahārājñī nityā yatra na tadbhidā /
atastadīyanāmnā tu sanāmā prathitā purā //
meaning:
नित्यानाच महाराज्ञी नित्या यत्र न तद्भिदा /
अतस्तदीयनाम्ना तु सनामा प्रथिता पुरा //
text_mt: And the great queen of the Nityās is the Nityā wherein there is no differentiation; / therefore, by her name, [the cities] became renowned of old with that appellation:

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvarīpurī caiva bhagamālāpurī tathā /
nityaklinnāpurītyādināmāni prathitānyalam //
meaning:
कामेश्वरीपुरी चैव भगमालापुरी तथा /
नित्यक्लिन्नापुरीत्यादिनामानि प्रथितान्यलम् //
text_mt: Kāmeśvarīpurī, Bhagamālāpurī, / Nityaklinnāpurī, and so forth, are the widely celebrated names.

sanskrit_iast:
ato nāmāni varṇena yogye puṇyatame dine /
mahāśilpaprakāreṇa purīṃ racayatāṃ śubhām //
meaning:
अतो नामानि वर्णेन योग्ये पुण्यतमे दिने /
महाशिल्पप्रकारेण पुरीं रचयतां शुभाम् //
text_mt: Therefore, on an auspicious and most holy day, according to the color and name, / construct the auspicious city according to the method of great craftsmanship.

sanskrit_iast:
iti kāraṇakṛtyendrairbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ /
proktau tau śrīpurīstheṣu teṣu kṣetreṣu cakratuḥ //
meaning:
इति कारणकृत्येन्द्रैर्ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरैः /
प्रोक्तौ तौ श्रीपुरीस्थेषु तेषु क्षेत्रेषु चक्रतुः //
text_mt: Thus addressed by the causal lords Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, / those two built [the cities] in those sites belonging to Śrīpura.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrīpuravistāraṃ purādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ /
kathayāmyahamādhārya lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu //
meaning:
अथ श्रीपुरविस्तारं पुराधिष्ठातृदेवताः /
कथयाम्यहमाधार्य लोपामुद्रापते शृणु //
text_mt: Now I shall describe the extent of Śrīpura and its presiding deities / taking it as support; listen, O husband of Lopāmudrā!

sanskrit_iast:
yo merurakhilādhārastuṅgaścānantayojanaḥ /
caturdaśajagaccakrasaṃprotanijavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
यो मेरुरखिलाधारस्तुङ्गश्चानन्तयोजनः /
चतुर्दशजगच्चक्रसंप्रोतनिजविग्रहः //
text_mt: That Meru which is the support of all, lofty, of endless yojanas, / whose own body is threaded through the circle of the fourteen worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya catvāri śṛṅgāṇi śakranairṛtavāyuṣu /
madhyasthaleṣu jātāni procchrāyasteṣu kathyate //
meaning:
तस्य चत्वारि शृङ्गाणि शक्रनैरृतवायुषु /
मध्यस्थलेषु जातानि प्रोच्छ्रायस्तेषु कथ्यते //
text_mt: has four peaks arisen in the east, south-west, north-west, / and central regions; their height is now described.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktaśṛṅgatritayaṃ śatayojanamunnatam /
śatayojanavistāraṃ teṣu lokāstrayo matāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तशृङ्गत्रितयं शतयोजनमुन्नतम् /
शतयोजनविस्तारं तेषु लोकास्त्रयो मताः //
text_mt: The previously mentioned triad of peaks is one hundred yojanas high / and one hundred yojanas wide; upon them three worlds are recognized:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaloko viṣṇulokaḥ śivalokastathaiva ca /
eteṣāṃ gṛhavinyāsānvakṣyāmyavasarāntare //
meaning:
ब्रह्मलोको विष्णुलोकः शिवलोकस्तथैव च /
एतेषां गृहविन्यासान्वक्ष्याम्यवसरान्तरे //
text_mt: the world of Brahmā, the world of Viṣṇu, and likewise the world of Śiva; / the arrangement of their houses I will explain on another occasion.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye sthitasya śṛṅgasya vistāraṃ cocchrayaṃ śṛṇu /
catuḥśataṃ yojanānāmucchritaṃ vistṛtaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मध्ये स्थितस्य शृङ्गस्य विस्तारं चोच्छ्रयं शृणु /
चतुःशतं योजनानामुच्छ्रितं विस्तृतं तथा //
text_mt: Hear the width and the height of the peak situated in the middle: / it is elevated four hundred yojanas, and equally extensive.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva śṛṅge mahati śilpibhyāṃ śrīpuraṃ kṛtam /
catuḥśataṃ yojanānāṃ vistṛta kumbhasaṃbhava //
meaning:
तत्रैव शृङ्गे महति शिल्पिभ्यां श्रीपुरं कृतम् /
चतुःशतं योजनानां विस्तृत कुम्भसंभव //
text_mt: On that very great peak, the two architects constructed Śrīpura, / four hundred yojanas wide, O jar-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāyaṃ pravibhāgaste pravivicya pradarśyate /
prākāraḥ prathamaḥ proktaḥ kālāyasavinirmitaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रायं प्रविभागस्ते प्रविविच्य प्रदर्श्यते /
प्राकारः प्रथमः प्रोक्तः कालायसविनिर्मितः //
text_mt: There, this division is shown to you in detailed analysis: / the first rampart is declared to be fashioned of iron.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭdaśādhikasāhasrayojanāyataveṣṭanaḥ /
caturdikṣu dvāryutaśca caturyojanamucchritaḥ //
meaning:
षट्दशाधिकसाहस्रयोजनायतवेष्टनः /
चतुर्दिक्षु द्वार्युतश्च चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Its circumference extends sixteen thousand yojanas; / it is endowed with gates in the four directions, and is four yojanas high.

sanskrit_iast:
śālamūlaparīṇāho yojanāyutamabdhipa /
śālāgrasya tu gavyūternaddhavātāyanaṃ pṛthak //
meaning:
शालमूलपरीणाहो योजनायुतमब्धिप /
शालाग्रस्य तु गव्यूतेर्नद्धवातायनं पृथक् //
text_mt: The width at the base of the rampart is ten thousand yojanas, O protector of the ocean; / moreover, individual lattice-windows are affixed on each gavyūti of the rampart's top.

sanskrit_iast:
śāladvārasya caunnatyamekayojanamāśritam /
dvāredvāre kapāṭe dve gavyūtyardhapravistare //
meaning:
शालद्वारस्य चौन्नत्यमेकयोजनमाश्रितम् /
द्वारेद्वारे कपाटे द्वे गव्यूत्यर्धप्रविस्तरे //
text_mt: The height of the rampart-gate amounts to one yojana; / at every gate there are two door-leaves, half a gavyūti in width,

sanskrit_iast:
ekayojanamunnaddhe kālāyasa vinirmite /
ubhayorargalā cetthamardhakrośasamāyatā //
meaning:
एकयोजनमुन्नद्धे कालायस विनिर्मिते /
उभयोरर्गला चेत्थमर्धक्रोशसमायता //
text_mt: one yojana high, and made of iron; / and for both, the bolt is likewise half a krośa in length.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ caturṣu dvāreṣu sadṛśaṃ parikīrtitam /
gopurasya tu saṃsthānaṃ kathaye kuṃbhasaṃbhava //
meaning:
एवं चतुर्षु द्वारेषु सदृशं परिकीर्तितम् /
गोपुरस्य तु संस्थानं कथये कुंभसंभव //
text_mt: Thus it is proclaimed to be identical across the four gates. / But now I shall explain the arrangement of the gate-tower, O jar-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktasya tu śālasya mūle yojanasaṃmite /
pārśvadvaye yojane dve dve samādāya nirmite //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तस्य तु शालस्य मूले योजनसंमिते /
पार्श्वद्वये योजने द्वे द्वे समादाय निर्मिते //
text_mt: At the base of the aforesaid rampart measuring one yojana, / two yojanas are taken on each of the two flanks and constructed,

sanskrit_iast:
vistāramapi tāvantaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvāragarbhitam /
pārśvadvayaṃ yojane dve madhye śālasya yojanam //
meaning:
विस्तारमपि तावन्तं संप्राप्तं द्वारगर्भितम् /
पार्श्वद्वयं योजने द्वे मध्ये शालस्य योजनम् //
text_mt: reaching an equal width, containing the gate: / two yojanas on both flanks, and one yojana for the rampart in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
melayitvā pañca mune yojanāni pramāṇataḥ /
pārśvadvayena sārdhena krośayugmena saṃyutam //
meaning:
मेलयित्वा पञ्च मुने योजनानि प्रमाणतः /
पार्श्वद्वयेन सार्धेन क्रोशयुग्मेन संयुतम् //
text_mt: Putting them together, O sage, it measures five yojanas; / along with both flanks, it is joined with a pair of krośas and a half.

sanskrit_iast:
melayitvā pañcasaṃkhyāyojanānyāyatastathā /
evaṃ prākāratastatra gopuraṃ racitaṃ mune //
meaning:
मेलयित्वा पञ्चसंख्यायोजनान्यायतस्तथा /
एवं प्राकारतस्तत्र गोपुरं रचितं मुने //
text_mt: Combining [these], its length is likewise five yojanas in number; / thus the gate-tower was constructed there from the rampart, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādgopuramūlasya veṣṭo viṃśatiyojanaḥ /
uparyupari veṣṭasya hrāsa eva prakīrtyate //
meaning:
तस्माद्गोपुरमूलस्य वेष्टो विंशतियोजनः /
उपर्युपरि वेष्टस्य ह्रास एव प्रकीर्त्यते //
text_mt: Therefore the circumference at the base of the gate-tower is twenty yojanas; / a diminishing of the circumference higher and higher up is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
gopurasyonnatiḥ proktāpañcaviṃśatiyojanā /
yojaneyojane dvāraṃ sakapāṭaṃ manoharam //
meaning:
गोपुरस्योन्नतिः प्रोक्तापञ्चविंशतियोजना /
योजनेयोजने द्वारं सकपाटं मनोहरम् //
text_mt: The height of the gate-tower is declared to be twenty-five yojanas; / at every yojana there is an enchanting gate with leaves.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmikāścāpi tāvantyo yathordhvaṃ hrāsasaṃyutāḥ /
gopurāgrasya nistāro yojanaṃ hi samāśritaḥ //
meaning:
भूमिकाश्चापि तावन्त्यो यथोर्ध्वं ह्राससंयुताः /
गोपुराग्रस्य निस्तारो योजनं हि समाश्रितः //
text_mt: And there are as many storeys, diminishing upward in order; / the breadth at the top of the gate-tower indeed amounts to a yojana,

sanskrit_iast:
āyāmo 'pi ca tāvānvai tatra trimukuṭaṃ smṛtam /
mukuṭasya tu vistāraḥ krośamāno ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
आयामो ऽपि च तावान्वै तत्र त्रिमुकुटं स्मृतम् /
मुकुटस्य तु विस्तारः क्रोशमानो घटोद्भव //
text_mt: and its length is also of that extent; three pinnacles are traditionally remembered there. / But the width of a pinnacle measures a krośa, O jar-born one;

sanskrit_iast:
krośadvayaṃ samunnaddhaṃ hrāsaṃ gopuravanmune /
mukuṭasyāntare kṣoṇī krośārdhena ca saṃmitā //
meaning:
क्रोशद्वयं समुन्नद्धं ह्रासं गोपुरवन्मुने /
मुकुटस्यान्तरे क्षोणी क्रोशार्धेन च संमिता //
text_mt: it rises two krośas high, tapering like the gate-tower, O sage. / The ground between the pinnacles measures half a krośa.

sanskrit_iast:
mukuṭaṃ paścime prācyāṃ dakṣiṇe dvāragopure /
dakṣottarastu mukuṭāḥ paścimadvāragopure //
meaning:
मुकुटं पश्चिमे प्राच्यां दक्षिणे द्वारगोपुरे /
दक्षोत्तरस्तु मुकुटाः पश्चिमद्वारगोपुरे //
text_mt: There is a pinnacle on the west and on the east of the southern gate-tower; / but the pinnacles on the western gate-tower are on the south and north.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇadvāravatproktā uttaradvāḥkirīṭikāḥ /
paścimadvāravatpūrvadvāre mukuṭakalpanā //
meaning:
दक्षिणद्वारवत्प्रोक्ता उत्तरद्वाःकिरीटिकाः /
पश्चिमद्वारवत्पूर्वद्वारे मुकुटकल्पना //
text_mt: The crests of the northern gate are declared to be like those of the southern gate; / the arrangement of pinnacles on the eastern gate is like that of the western gate.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāyasākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane /
antare kāṃsyaśālasya pūrvavadgopuro 'nvitaḥ //
meaning:
कालायसाख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
अन्तरे कांस्यशालस्य पूर्ववद्गोपुरो ऽन्वितः //
text_mt: Within the rampart named Iron, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas, / inside is the bronze rampart, furnished with gate-towers as before.

sanskrit_iast:
śālamūlapramāṇaṃ ca pūrvavatparikīrtitam /
kāṃsyaśālo 'pi pūrvādidikṣu dvārasamanvintaḥ //
meaning:
शालमूलप्रमाणं च पूर्ववत्परिकीर्तितम् /
कांस्यशालो ऽपि पूर्वादिदिक्षु द्वारसमन्विन्तः //
text_mt: The dimension of the base of the rampart is declared to be as before; / the bronze rampart also is furnished with gates in the east and other directions.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāredvāre gopurāṇi parvalakṣaṇabhāñji ca /
kālāyasasya kāṃsyasya yoṃ'tardeśaḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
द्वारेद्वारे गोपुराणि पर्वलक्षणभाञ्जि च /
कालायसस्य कांस्यस्य योंऽतर्देशः समन्ततः //
text_mt: At every gate there are gate-towers possessing the characteristics of the nodes. / The intermediate space all around between the iron [rampart] and the bronze [rampart]

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvṛkṣamahodyānaṃ tatproktaṃ kumbhasaṃbhava /
udbhijjādyaṃ yāvadasti tatsarvaṃ tatra vartate //
meaning:
नानावृक्षमहोद्यानं तत्प्रोक्तं कुम्भसंभव /
उद्भिज्जाद्यं यावदस्ति तत्सर्वं तत्र वर्तते //
text_mt: is declared to be a great orchard of various trees, O jar-born one; / whatever plants and vegetation exist, all of that is present there.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃsahasrāstaravaḥ sadāpuṣpāḥ sadāphalāḥ /
sadāpallavaśobhāḍhyāḥ sadā saurabhasaṃkulāḥ //
meaning:
परंसहस्रास्तरवः सदापुष्पाः सदाफलाः /
सदापल्लवशोभाढ्याः सदा सौरभसंकुलाः //
text_mt: There are more than a thousand trees, ever flowering, ever fruiting, / ever rich in the beauty of sprouts, and ever dense with fragrance:

sanskrit_iast:
cūtāḥ kaṅkolakā lodhrā bakulāḥ karṇikārakāḥ /
śiṃśapāśca śirīṣāśca devadārunameravaḥ //
meaning:
चूताः कङ्कोलका लोध्रा बकुलाः कर्णिकारकाः /
शिंशपाश्च शिरीषाश्च देवदारुनमेरवः //
text_mt: cūtas, kaṅkolakas, lodhras, bakulas, karṇikārakas, / śiṃśapās, śirīṣas, and devadāru and nameru trees,

sanskrit_iast:
punnāgā nāgabhadrāśca mucukundāśca kaṭphalāḥ /
elālavaṅgāstakkolāstathā karpūraśākhinaḥ //
meaning:
पुन्नागा नागभद्राश्च मुचुकुन्दाश्च कट्फलाः /
एलालवङ्गास्तक्कोलास्तथा कर्पूरशाखिनः //
text_mt: punnāgas, nāgabhadras, mucukundas, kaṭphalas, / cardamoms, cloves, takkolas, and camphor trees,

sanskrit_iast:
pīlavaḥ kākatuṇḍyaśca śālakāścāsanāstathā /
kāñcanārāśca lakucāḥ panasā hiṅgulāstathā //
meaning:
पीलवः काकतुण्ड्यश्च शालकाश्चासनास्तथा /
काञ्चनाराश्च लकुचाः पनसा हिङ्गुलास्तथा //
text_mt: pīlus, kākatuṇḍīs, śālakas, asanas, / kāñcanāras, lakucas, jackfruits, and hiṅgulas,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭalāśca phalinyaśca jaṭilyo jaghanephalāḥ /
gaṇikāśca kuraṇṭāśca bandhujīvāśca dāḍimāḥ //
meaning:
पाटलाश्च फलिन्यश्च जटिल्यो जघनेफलाः /
गणिकाश्च कुरण्टाश्च बन्धुजीवाश्च दाडिमाः //
text_mt: pāṭalās, phalins, jaṭilīs, jaghanephalās, / gaṇikās, kuraṇṭas, bandhujīvas, and pomegranates,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvakarṇā hastikarṇāścāṃpeyāḥ kanakadrumāḥ /
yūthikāstālaparṇyaśca tulasyaśca sadāphalāḥ //
meaning:
अश्वकर्णा हस्तिकर्णाश्चांपेयाः कनकद्रुमाः /
यूथिकास्तालपर्ण्यश्च तुलस्यश्च सदाफलाः //
text_mt: aśvakarṇas, hastikarṇas, campakas, golden trees, / yūthikās, tālaparṇīs, and ever-fruitful tulasīs,

sanskrit_iast:
tālāstamālahintālakharjūrāḥ śarabarburāḥ /
ikṣavaḥ kṣīriṇaścaiva śleṣmāntakavibhītakāḥ //
meaning:
तालास्तमालहिन्तालखर्जूराः शरबर्बुराः /
इक्षवः क्षीरिणश्चैव श्लेष्मान्तकविभीतकाः //
text_mt: palmyras, tamālas, hintālas, date palms, reeds, babbūlas, / sugarcanes, milky trees, śleṣmāntakas, and vibhītakas,

sanskrit_iast:
harītkyastvavākpuṣpyo ghoṇṭālyaḥ svargapuṣpikāḥ /
bhallātakāśca khadirāḥ śākhoṭāścandanadrumāḥ //
meaning:
हरीत्क्यस्त्ववाक्पुष्प्यो घोण्टाल्यः स्वर्गपुष्पिकाः /
भल्लातकाश्च खदिराः शाखोटाश्चन्दनद्रुमाः //
text_mt: harītakīs, avākpuṣpīs, ghoṇṭālīs, svargapuṣpikās, / bhallātakas, khadiras, śākhoṭas, and sandalwood trees,

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgurudrumāḥ kālaskandhāściñcā vadāstathā /
uduṃbarārjunāśvatthāḥ śamīvṛkṣā dhruvādrumāḥ //
meaning:
कालागुरुद्रुमाः कालस्कन्धाश्चिञ्चा वदास्तथा /
उदुंबरार्जुनाश्वत्थाः शमीवृक्षा ध्रुवाद्रुमाः //
text_mt: black aloe trees, kālaskandhas, tamarinds, banyans, / udumbaras, arjunas, aśvatthas, śamī trees, dhruvā trees,

sanskrit_iast:
rucakāḥ kuṭajāḥ saptaparṇāśca kṛtamālakāḥ /
kapitthāstintiṇī caivetyevamādhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
रुचकाः कुटजाः सप्तपर्णाश्च कृतमालकाः /
कपित्थास्तिन्तिणी चैवेत्येवमाध्याः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: rucakas, kuṭajas, saptaparṇas, kṛtamālakas, / kapitthas, and wood-apples, and thus thousands of such [trees],

sanskrit_iast:
nānāṛtusamāviṣṭā devyāḥ śṛṅgārahetavaḥ /
nānāvṛkṣamahotsedhā vartante varaśākhinaḥ //
meaning:
नानाऋतुसमाविष्टा देव्याः शृङ्गारहेतवः /
नानावृक्षमहोत्सेधा वर्तन्ते वरशाखिनः //
text_mt: pervaded by the various seasons, the causes of the Goddess's love sports; / great trees of various sorts stand as excellent branches.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṃsyaśālasyāntarole saptayojanadūrataḥ /
caturasrastāmraśālaḥ siṃdhuyojanamunnataḥ //
meaning:
कांस्यशालस्यान्तरोले सप्तयोजनदूरतः /
चतुरस्रस्ताम्रशालः सिंधुयोजनमुन्नतः //
text_mt: In the interior of the bronze rampart, at a distance of seven yojanas, / stands the square copper rampart, four yojanas high.

sanskrit_iast:
anayorantarakṣoṇī proktā kalpakavāṭikā /
karpūragandhibhiścāruratnabījasamanvitaiḥ //
meaning:
अनयोरन्तरक्षोणी प्रोक्ता कल्पकवाटिका /
कर्पूरगन्धिभिश्चारुरत्नबीजसमन्वितैः //
text_mt: The intermediate ground between the two is proclaimed as the Kalpaka Garden; / the trees are bearing fruit with camphor-scented fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcanatvaksuruciraiḥ phalaistaiḥ phalitā drumāḥ /
pītāṃbarāṇi divyāni pravālānyeva śākhiṣu //
meaning:
काञ्चनत्वक्सुरुचिरैः फलैस्तैः फलिता द्रुमाः /
पीतांबराणि दिव्यानि प्रवालान्येव शाखिषु //
text_mt: endowed with lovely gem-like seeds and pleasing golden bark; / the sprouts on the trees are heavenly yellow garments.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaṃ syānmadhurasaḥ puṣpāṇi ca vibhūṣaṇam /
īdṛśā vahavastatra kalpavṛkṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अमृतं स्यान्मधुरसः पुष्पाणि च विभूषणम् /
ईदृशा वहवस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Their sweet nectar-juice is ambrosia, and their flowers are ornaments; / many wish-granting trees of this kind are celebrated there.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā kakṣā dvitīyā syānkalpavāpīti nāmataḥ /
tāmraśālasyāntarāle nāgaśālaḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
एषा कक्षा द्वितीया स्यान्कल्पवापीति नामतः /
ताम्रशालस्यान्तराले नागशालः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: This is the second enclosure, known by the name of Kalpavāpī. / In the interior of the copper rampart, the lead rampart is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
anayorubhayostiryagadeśaḥ syātsaptayojanaḥ /
tatra saṃtānavāṭī syānkalpavāpīsamākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
अनयोरुभयोस्तिर्यगदेशः स्यात्सप्तयोजनः /
तत्र संतानवाटी स्यान्कल्पवापीसमाकृतिः //
text_mt: The transverse space between these two is seven yojanas; / there is the Saṃtāna Garden, similar in form to the Kalpavāpī.

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhye mahī proktā haricandanavāṭikā /
kalpavāṭīsamākārā phalapuṣpasamākulā //
meaning:
तयोर्मध्ये मही प्रोक्ता हरिचन्दनवाटिका /
कल्पवाटीसमाकारा फलपुष्पसमाकुला //
text_mt: Between the two, the ground is declared to be the Haricandana Garden, / similar in form to the Kalpa Garden, dense with fruits and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣu sarveṣu śāleṣu pūrvavaddvārakalpanam /
pūrvavadgopurāṇāṃ ca mukuṭānāṃ ca kalpanam //
meaning:
एषु सर्वेषु शालेषु पूर्ववद्द्वारकल्पनम् /
पूर्ववद्गोपुराणां च मुकुटानां च कल्पनम् //
text_mt: In all these ramparts, the arrangement of gates is as before, / and the arrangement of gate-towers and pinnacles is as before,

sanskrit_iast:
gopuradvārakḷptaṃ ca dvāre dvāre ca saṃmitiḥ /
ārakūṭasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ //
meaning:
गोपुरद्वारकॢप्तं च द्वारे द्वारे च संमितिः /
आरकूटस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः //
text_mt: along with the gate-tower design and dimensions at every gate. / In the interior of the brass [rampart], at a distance of seven yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcalohamayaḥ śālaḥ pūrvaśālasamākṛtiḥ /
tayormadhye mahī proktā mandāradrumavāṭikā //
meaning:
पञ्चलोहमयः शालः पूर्वशालसमाकृतिः /
तयोर्मध्ये मही प्रोक्ता मन्दारद्रुमवाटिका //
text_mt: is the rampart made of the five metals, similar in appearance to the previous rampart; / between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Mandāra-tree Garden.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcalohasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ /
raupyaśālastu saṃproktaḥ pūrvoktairlakṣaṇairyutaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चलोहस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः /
रौप्यशालस्तु संप्रोक्तः पूर्वोक्तैर्लक्षणैर्युतः //
text_mt: In the interior of the five-metal [rampart], at a distance of seven yojanas, / the silver rampart is proclaimed, endowed with the aforesaid characteristics;

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhyamahī proktā pārijātadruvāṭikā /
divyāmodasusaṃpūrṇā phalapuṣpabharojjvalā //
meaning:
तयोर्मध्यमही प्रोक्ता पारिजातद्रुवाटिका /
दिव्यामोदसुसंपूर्णा फलपुष्पभरोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Pārijāta-tree Garden, / filled with divine fragrance, radiant with an abundance of fruits and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
raupyaśālasyāntarāle saptayojanavistaraḥ /
hemaśālaḥ prakathitaḥ pūrvavaddvāraśobhitaḥ //
meaning:
रौप्यशालस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनविस्तरः /
हेमशालः प्रकथितः पूर्ववद्द्वारशोभितः //
text_mt: In the interior of the silver rampart, seven yojanas in width, / the gold rampart is celebrated, adorned with gates as before;

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhye mahīproktā kadambataruvāṭikā /
tatra divyā nīpavṛkṣā yojanadvayamunnatāḥ //
meaning:
तयोर्मध्ये महीप्रोक्ता कदम्बतरुवाटिका /
तत्र दिव्या नीपवृक्षा योजनद्वयमुन्नताः //
text_mt: between the two, the ground is proclaimed as the Kadamba-tree Garden. / There, divine nīpa trees rise two yojanas high,

sanskrit_iast:
sadaiva madirāspandā meduraprasavojjvalāḥ /
yebhyaḥ kādaṃbarī nāma yoginī bhogadāyinī //
meaning:
सदैव मदिरास्पन्दा मेदुरप्रसवोज्ज्वलाः /
येभ्यः कादंबरी नाम योगिनी भोगदायिनी //
text_mt: always exuding intoxicating liquor, radiant with dense blossoms, / from which [emanates] the Yoginī named Kādambarī, bestower of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
viśiṣṭā madirodyānā mantriṇyāḥ satataṃ priyā /
te nīpavṛkṣāḥ succhāyāḥ patralāḥ pallavākulāḥ /
āmodalolabhṛṅgālījhaṅkāraiḥ pūritodarāḥ //
meaning:
विशिष्टा मदिरोद्याना मन्त्रिण्याः सततं प्रिया /
ते नीपवृक्षाः सुच्छायाः पत्रलाः पल्लवाकुलाः /
आमोदलोलभृङ्गालीझङ्कारैः पूरितोदराः //
text_mt:
Distinguished, possessing an orchard of intoxicating drink, ever dear to the Mantriṇī,
those kadamba trees are beautifully shaded, leafy, and laden with fresh sprouts,
their hollows filled with the humming swarms of bees restless with fragrance.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva mantriṇīnāthāyā mandiraṃ sumanoharam /
kadaṃbavanavāṭyāstu vidikṣujvalanāditaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव मन्त्रिणीनाथाया मन्दिरं सुमनोहरम् /
कदंबवनवाट्यास्तु विदिक्षुज्वलनादितः //
text_mt:
Right there stands the delightful palace of the mistress Mantriṇī.
In the intermediate directions of the kadamba grove, beginning with the southeast (the direction of Agni),

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri mandirāṇyuccaiḥ kalpitānyādiśilpinā /
ekaikasya tu ge7sya vistāraḥ pañcayojanaḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारि मन्दिराण्युच्चैः कल्पितान्यादिशिल्पिना /
एकैकस्य तु गे7स्य विस्तारः पञ्चयोजनः //
text_mt:
four lofty palaces were fashioned by the primordial craftsman [Maya].
The breadth of each individual mansion is five yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcayojanamāyāmaḥ saptāvaraṇataḥ sthitiḥ /
evamanyavidikṣu syussarvatra priyakadrumāḥ /
nivāsanagarī seyaṃ śyāmāyāḥ parikīrtitā //
meaning:
पञ्चयोजनमायामः सप्तावरणतः स्थितिः /
एवमन्यविदिक्षु स्युस्सर्वत्र प्रियकद्रुमाः /
निवासनगरी सेयं श्यामायाः परिकीर्तिता //

sanskrit_iast:
senārthaṃ nagarī tvanyā mahāpadmāṭavīsthale /
yadatraiva gṛha tasyā bahuyojanadūrataḥ //
meaning:
सेनार्थं नगरी त्वन्या महापद्माटवीस्थले /
यदत्रैव गृह तस्या बहुयोजनदूरतः //
text_mt:
There is another city for the army in the region of the great lotus grove,
since her dwelling here is separated from it by many yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyā nityasevā tu matriṇyā na ghaṭiṣyate /
ataścitāmaṇigṛhopānte 'pi bhavanaṃ kṛtam /
tasyāḥ śrīmantranāthāyāḥ suratvaṣṭrā mayena ca //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्या नित्यसेवा तु मत्रिण्या न घटिष्यते /
अतश्चितामणिगृहोपान्ते ऽपि भवनं कृतम् /
तस्याः श्रीमन्त्रनाथायाः सुरत्वष्ट्रा मयेन च //

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpure mantreṇī devyā mandirasya guṇānbahun /
varṇayiṣyati ko nāma yo dvijihvāsahasravān //
meaning:
श्रीपुरे मन्त्रेणी देव्या मन्दिरस्य गुणान्बहुन् /
वर्णयिष्यति को नाम यो द्विजिह्वासहस्रवान् //
text_mt:
Who indeed could describe the many excellent qualities of the palace of the Mantriṇī Devī in Śrīpura,
[even] one who possesses a thousand split tongues?

sanskrit_iast:
kādaṃbarīmadātāmranayanāḥ kalavīṇayā /
gāyantyastatra khelanti mānyamātaṅgakanyakāḥ //
meaning:
कादंबरीमदाताम्रनयनाः कलवीणया /
गायन्त्यस्तत्र खेलन्ति मान्यमातङ्गकन्यकाः //
text_mt:
With eyes slightly reddened from intoxicating kādambarī wine,
singing to the melodious vīṇā, the venerable daughters of Mātaṅga play there.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
mātaṅgo nāma kaḥproktastasya kanyāḥ kathaṃ ca tāḥ /
sevante mantriṇīnāthāṃ sadā madhumadālasāḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
मातङ्गो नाम कःप्रोक्तस्तस्य कन्याः कथं च ताः /
सेवन्ते मन्त्रिणीनाथां सदा मधुमदालसाः //
text_mt:
Agastya said:
Who is the one named Mātaṅga, and how do those daughters of his
serve the mistress Mantriṇī, ever languid with the intoxication of wine?

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
mataṅgo nāma tapasāmekarāśistapodhanaḥ /
mahāprabhāvasaṃpanno jagatsarjanalaṃpaṭaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
मतङ्गो नाम तपसामेकराशिस्तपोधनः /
महाप्रभावसंपन्नो जगत्सर्जनलंपटः //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
Mataṅga was an ascetic, an unequalled mass of austerities,
endowed with great majesty, eager to create a universe,

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥ śaktyāttadhiyā ca sarvatrājñāpravarttakaḥ /
tasya putrastu mātaṅgo mudriṇīṃ mantrināyikām //
meaning:
तपः शक्त्यात्तधिया च सर्वत्राज्ञाप्रवर्त्तकः /
तस्य पुत्रस्तु मातङ्गो मुद्रिणीं मन्त्रिनायिकाम् //
text_mt:
and by the power of his austerity and his acquired wisdom, he enforced his command everywhere.
His son was Mātaṅga, who, with firm intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
.
ghoraistapobhiratyarthaṃ pūrayāmāsa dhīradhīḥ /
mataṅgamuniputreṇa suciraṃ samupāsitā //
meaning:
.
घोरैस्तपोभिरत्यर्थं पूरयामास धीरधीः /
मतङ्गमुनिपुत्रेण सुचिरं समुपासिता //
text_mt:
.
With terrible austerities, he of steady mind completely fulfilled [it],
worshiped for a long time by the son of the sage Mataṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
mantriṇī kṛtasānnidhyā vṛṇīṣva varamityaśāt /
so 'pisarvamuniśreṣṭho mātaṅgastapasāṃ nidhiḥ /
uvāca tāṃ puro dattasānnidhyāṃ śyāmalāṃbikām //
meaning:
मन्त्रिणी कृतसान्निध्या वृणीष्व वरमित्यशात् /
सो ऽपिसर्वमुनिश्रेष्ठो मातङ्गस्तपसां निधिः /
उवाच तां पुरो दत्तसान्निध्यां श्यामलांबिकाम् //
text_mt:
the Mantriṇī, making herself manifest, commanded: ‘Choose a boon!’
And he too, the foremost among all sages, Mātaṅga, a treasure of austerities,
spoke to that mother Śyāmalā who had granted her presence before him.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgamahāmuniruvāca
devī tvatsmṛtimātreṇa sarvāśca mama siddhayaḥ /
jātā evāṇimādyāstāḥ sarvāścānyā vibhūtayaḥ //
meaning:
मातङ्गमहामुनिरुवाच
देवी त्वत्स्मृतिमात्रेण सर्वाश्च मम सिद्धयः /
जाता एवाणिमाद्यास्ताः सर्वाश्चान्या विभूतयः //
text_mt:
The great sage Mātaṅga said:
O Devī, merely by remembering you, all my supernatural attainments—
those beginning with animan—have indeed arisen, as well as all other riches.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpaṇīyanna me kiñcidastyaṃbabhuvanatraye /
sarvataḥ prāptakālasya bhavatyāścaritasmṛteḥ //
meaning:
प्रापणीयन्न मे किञ्चिदस्त्यंबभुवनत्रये /
सर्वतः प्राप्तकालस्य भवत्याश्चरितस्मृतेः //
text_mt:
There is nothing in the three worlds for me to obtain, O Mother,
since all desires have been attained by remembering your deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
athāpi tava sāṃnidhyamidaṃ no niṣphalaṃ bhavet /
evaṃ paraṃ prārthaye 'haṃ taṃ varaṃ pūrayāṃbike //
meaning:
अथापि तव सांनिध्यमिदं नो निष्फलं भवेत् /
एवं परं प्रार्थये ऽहं तं वरं पूरयांबिके //
text_mt:
Nevertheless, this presence of yours must not be in vain.
This alone I ask, O Mother; fulfill that boon!

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ himavatā sārthaṃ sauhārdaṃ parihāsavān /
krīḍāmattena cāvācyaistatra tena pragalbhitam //
meaning:
पूर्वं हिमवता सार्थं सौहार्दं परिहासवान् /
क्रीडामत्तेन चावाच्यैस्तत्र तेन प्रगल्भितम् //
text_mt:
Formerly, having friendship and teasing jest with Himavat,
he, intoxicated with sporting, spoke insolently there with words that ought not to be said:

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅgaurīgururiti ślāghāmātmani tenivān /
tadvākyaṃ mama naivābhūdyatastatrādhiko guṇaḥ //
meaning:
अहङ्गौरीगुरुरिति श्लाघामात्मनि तेनिवान् /
तद्वाक्यं मम नैवाभूद्यतस्तत्राधिको गुणः //
text_mt:
He boasted in himself, saying, ‘I am the father of Gaurī!’
No such statement was possible for me, because he possessed greater excellence in that regard.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayorguṇasāmye tu mitrayoradhike guṇe /
ekasya kāraṇājjāte tatrānyasya spṛhā bhavet //
meaning:
उभयोर्गुणसाम्ये तु मित्रयोरधिके गुणे /
एकस्य कारणाज्जाते तत्रान्यस्य स्पृहा भवेत् //
text_mt:
Between two friends of equal merit, when a superior quality
arises in one due to some cause, desire for that arises in the other.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīgurutvaślāghārthaṃ prāptakāmo 'pyahaṃ tapaḥ /
kṛtavānmantriṇīnāthe tattvaṃmattanayā bhava //
meaning:
गौरीगुरुत्वश्लाघार्थं प्राप्तकामो ऽप्यहं तपः /
कृतवान्मन्त्रिणीनाथे तत्त्वंमत्तनया भव //
text_mt:
For the sake of the glory of being the father of Gaurī, though all my desires were attained,
I performed austerity, O mistress Mantriṇī: therefore, become my daughter!

sanskrit_iast:
yato mannāmavikhyātā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ /
ityuktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mātaṅgasya mahāmuneḥ /
tathāstviti tiroghat sa ca prīto 'bhavanmuniḥ //
meaning:
यतो मन्नामविख्याता भविष्यसि न संशयः /
इत्युक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा मातङ्गस्य महामुनेः /
तथास्त्विति तिरोघत् स च प्रीतो ऽभवन्मुनिः //
text_mt:
Since you will undoubtedly become renowned by my name.’
Having heard this statement spoken by the great sage Mātaṅga,
saying ‘So be it!’, she vanished, and the sage was delighted.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgasya maharṣestu tasya svapne tadā mudā /
tāpicchamañjarīmekāṃ dadau karṇāvataṃsataḥ //
meaning:
मातङ्गस्य महर्षेस्तु तस्य स्वप्ने तदा मुदा /
तापिच्छमञ्जरीमेकां ददौ कर्णावतंसतः //
text_mt:
Then, in a dream of that great ṛṣi Mātaṅga, she joyfully
gave him a cluster of tāpiccha flowers from her ear ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsvapnasya prabhāveṇa mātaṅgasya sadharmiṇī /
nāmnā siddhimatī garbhe laghuśyāmāmadhārayat //
meaning:
तत्स्वप्नस्य प्रभावेण मातङ्गस्य सधर्मिणी /
नाम्ना सिद्धिमती गर्भे लघुश्यामामधारयत् //
text_mt:
By the power of that dream, the lawful wife of Mātaṅga,
named Siddhimatī, bore Laghuśyāmā in her womb.

sanskrit_iast:
tata eva samutpannā mātaṅgī tena kīrtitāḥ /
laghuśyāmeti sā prokta śyāmā yanmūlakandabhūḥ //
meaning:
तत एव समुत्पन्ना मातङ्गी तेन कीर्तिताः /
लघुश्यामेति सा प्रोक्त श्यामा यन्मूलकन्दभूः //
text_mt:
Because she was born from him, she is celebrated as Mātaṅgī;
she is called Laghuśyāmā because Śyāmā is the root source of her being.

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgakanyakā hṛdyāḥ koṭīnāmapi koṭiśaḥ /
laghuśyāmā mahāśyāmāmātaṅgī vṛndasaṃyutāḥ /
aṅgaśaktitvamāpannāḥ sevante priyakapriyām //
meaning:
मातङ्गकन्यका हृद्याः कोटीनामपि कोटिशः /
लघुश्यामा महाश्यामामातङ्गी वृन्दसंयुताः /
अङ्गशक्तित्वमापन्नाः सेवन्ते प्रियकप्रियाम् //
text_mt:
Tens of millions of charming daughters of Mātaṅga,
accompanied by hosts of Laghuśyāmās, Mahāśyāmās, and Mātaṅgīs,
having attained the status of subsidiary powers, serve the one who loves the priyaka tree.

sanskrit_iast:
iti mātaṅgakanyānāmutpattiḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava /
kathitāḥ saptakakṣāśca śālā lohādinirmitāḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde saptakakṣyā mataṅgakanyāprādurbhāvo nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति मातङ्गकन्यानामुत्पत्तिः कुंभसंभव /
कथिताः सप्तकक्षाश्च शाला लोहादिनिर्मिताः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे सप्तकक्ष्या मतङ्गकन्याप्रादुर्भावो नामैकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus, O jar-born one [Agastya], the origin of the daughters of Mātaṅga
has been described, as well as the seven concentric courts and the ramparts built of iron and other materials.

Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named ‘The Manifestation of the Daughters of Mataṅga in the Seven Courts’, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
lohādisaptaśālānāṃ rakṣakā eva saṃti vai /
tannāmakīrtaya prājña yena me saṃśayacchidā //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
लोहादिसप्तशालानां रक्षका एव संति वै /
तन्नामकीर्तय प्राज्ञ येन मे संशयच्छिदा //

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
nānāvṛkṣamahodyāne vartate kuṃbhasaṃbhava /
mahākālaḥ sarvalokabhakṣakaḥ śyāmavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
नानावृक्षमहोद्याने वर्तते कुंभसंभव /
महाकालः सर्वलोकभक्षकः श्यामविग्रहः //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
In the great orchard of diverse trees, O jar-born one,
dwells Mahākāla, the devourer of all the worlds, of dark form,

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmakañcukadhārī ca madāruṇavilocanaḥ /
brahmāṇḍacaṣake pūrṇaṃ pibanviśvarasāyanam //
meaning:
श्यामकञ्चुकधारी च मदारुणविलोचनः /
ब्रह्माण्डचषके पूर्णं पिबन्विश्वरसायनम् //
text_mt:
wearing a dark coat of mail, with eyes reddened by intoxication,
drinking the universal elixir filled to the brim in the goblet of the cosmic egg,

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālīṃ ghanaśyāmāmanaṅgārdrāmapāṅgayan /
siṃhāsane samāsīnaḥ kalpānte kalanātmake //
meaning:
महाकालीं घनश्यामामनङ्गार्द्रामपाङ्गयन् /
सिंहासने समासीनः कल्पान्ते कलनात्मके //
text_mt:
glancing with the corners of his eyes at Mahākālī, who is dark as a raincloud and moist with desire,
seated on a lion-throne at the end of the kalpa, consisting of reckoning time,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitādhyānasaṃpanno lalitāpūjanotsukaḥ /
vitanvaṃllaritābhakteḥ svāyuṣo dīrgha dīrghatām /
kālamṛtyupramukhyaiśca kiṅkarairapi sevitaḥ //
meaning:
ललिताध्यानसंपन्नो ललितापूजनोत्सुकः /
वितन्वंल्लरिताभक्तेः स्वायुषो दीर्घ दीर्घताम् /
कालमृत्युप्रमुख्यैश्च किङ्करैरपि सेवितः //
text_mt:
endowed with meditation on Lalitā, eager to worship Lalitā,
extending the immense length of his life by devotion to Lalitā,
and served by attendants headed by Kāla and Mṛtyu.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālīmahākālau lalitājñāpravarttakau /
viśvaṃ kalayataḥ kṛtsnaṃ prathame 'dhvani vāsinau //
meaning:
महाकालीमहाकालौ ललिताज्ञाप्रवर्त्तकौ /
विश्वं कलयतः कृत्स्नं प्रथमे ऽध्वनि वासिनौ //
text_mt:
Mahākālī and Mahākāla, the executors of Lalitā's commands,
regulate the entire universe, dwelling in the first avenue.

sanskrit_iast:
kālacakraṃ mataṅgasya tasyaivāsanatāṃ gatām /
caturāvaraṇopetaṃ madhye bindumanoharam //
meaning:
कालचक्रं मतङ्गस्य तस्यैवासनतां गताम् /
चतुरावरणोपेतं मध्ये बिन्दुमनोहरम् //
text_mt:
The wheel of time (kālacakra) serves as the very seat of that [lord] of Mataṅga;
it is endowed with four enclosures, having a charming center (bindu) in the middle,

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇaṃpañcakoṇaṃ ca ṣoḍaśacchadapaṅkajam /
aṣṭārapaṅkajaṃ caivaṃ mahākālastu madhyagaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिकोणंपञ्चकोणं च षोडशच्छदपङ्कजम् /
अष्टारपङ्कजं चैवं महाकालस्तु मध्यगः //
text_mt:
a triangle, a pentagon, a sixteen-petaled lotus,
and an eight-spoked lotus; and Mahākāla is in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇe tu mahākālyā mahāsaṃdhyā mahāniśā /
etāstisro mahādevyo mahākālasya śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिकोणे तु महाकाल्या महासंध्या महानिशा /
एतास्तिस्रो महादेव्यो महाकालस्य शक्तयः //
text_mt:
In the triangle with Mahākālī are Mahāsaṃdhyā and Mahāniśā;
these three great goddesses are the powers (śaktis) of Mahākāla.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva pañcakoṇāgre pratyūṣaśca pitṛprasūḥ /
prāhṇāparāhṇamadhyāhnāḥ pañca kālasya śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव पञ्चकोणाग्रे प्रत्यूषश्च पितृप्रसूः /
प्राह्णापराह्णमध्याह्नाः पञ्च कालस्य शक्तयः //
text_mt:
Right there, at the tips of the pentagon, are Pratyūṣa and Pitṛprasū,
Prāhṇa, Aparāhṇa, and Madhyāhna—the five powers of time (kāla).

sanskrit_iast:
atha ṣoḍaśapatrābje sthitā śaktīrmune śṛṇu /
dinamiśrā tamisrā ca jyotsnī caiva tu pakṣiṇī //
meaning:
अथ षोडशपत्राब्जे स्थिता शक्तीर्मुने शृणु /
दिनमिश्रा तमिस्रा च ज्योत्स्नी चैव तु पक्षिणी //
text_mt:
Now listen, O sage, to the powers abiding on the sixteen-petaled lotus:
Dinamiśrā, Tamisrā, Jyotsnī, and Pakṣiṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
pradoṣā ca niśīthā ca praharā pūrṇimāpi ca /
rākā cānumatiścaiva tathaivāmāvasyikā punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रदोषा च निशीथा च प्रहरा पूर्णिमापि च /
राका चानुमतिश्चैव तथैवामावस्यिका पुनः //
text_mt:
Pradoṣā, Niśīthā, Praharā, and Pūrṇimā,
Rākā, Anumati, and likewise Amāvasyā again,

sanskrit_iast:
sinīvālī kuhūrbhadrā uparāgā ca ṣoḍaśī /
etā ṣoḍaśamātrasthāḥ śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सिनीवाली कुहूर्भद्रा उपरागा च षोडशी /
एता षोडशमात्रस्थाः शक्तयः षोडश स्मृताः //
text_mt:
Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Bhadrā, and the sixteenth, Uparāgā.
These are taught as the sixteen powers residing in the sixteen measure [petals].

sanskrit_iast:
kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣāśca kṣaṇāścaiva lavāstruṭiḥ /
muhurtāḥ kutapāhorā śuklapakṣastathaiva ca //
meaning:
कला काष्ठा निमेषाश्च क्षणाश्चैव लवास्त्रुटिः /
मुहुर्ताः कुतपाहोरा शुक्लपक्षस्तथैव च //
text_mt:
Kalā, Kāṣṭhā, Nimeṣa, Kṣaṇa, Lava, Truṭi,
Muhūrta, Kutapa, Ahorātra, and the bright fortnight (śuklapakṣa),

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣāyanāścaiva viṣuvā ca trayodaśī /
saṃvatsarā ca parivatsareḍāvatsarāpi ca //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षायनाश्चैव विषुवा च त्रयोदशी /
संवत्सरा च परिवत्सरेडावत्सरापि च //
text_mt:
the dark fortnight (kṛṣṇapakṣa), the solstices (ayana), the equinox (viṣuvat), and the thirteenth day (trayodaśī),
Saṃvatsara, Parivatsara, and Iḍāvatsara—

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥṣoḍaśa patrābjavāsinyaḥ śaktayaḥ smṛtāḥ /
idvatsarā tataścenduvatsarāvatsare 'pi ca //
meaning:
एताःषोडश पत्राब्जवासिन्यः शक्तयः स्मृताः /
इद्वत्सरा ततश्चेन्दुवत्सरावत्सरे ऽपि च //
text_mt:
these are remembered as the powers dwelling on the sixteen-petaled lotus.
Then Idvatsara and Induvatsara, and also Vatsara,

sanskrit_iast:
tithirvārāṃśca nakṣatraṃ yogāśca karaṇāni ca /
etāstu śaktayo nāgapatrāṃbhoruhasaṃsthitāḥ //
meaning:
तिथिर्वारांश्च नक्षत्रं योगाश्च करणानि च /
एतास्तु शक्तयो नागपत्रांभोरुहसंस्थिताः //
text_mt:
the lunar days (tithi), weekdays (vāra), lunar mansions (nakṣatra), conjunctions (yoga), and halves of a lunar day (karaṇa)—
these powers indeed are situated on the eight-petaled lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
kaliḥ kalpā ca kalanā kālī ceti catuṣṭayam /
dvārapālakatāṃ prāptaṃ kālaca krasya bhāsvataḥ //
meaning:
कलिः कल्पा च कलना काली चेति चतुष्टयम् /
द्वारपालकतां प्राप्तं कालच क्रस्य भास्वतः //
text_mt: Kali, Kalpā, Kalanā, and Kālī: this quartet / have attained the role of doorkeepers of the radiant Wheel of Time.

sanskrit_iast:
etā mahākāladevyo madaprahasitānanāḥ /
madirāpūrṇacaṣakamaśeṣaṃ cāruṇaprabham /
dadhānāḥ śyāmalākārāḥ sarvāḥ kālasya yoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
एता महाकालदेव्यो मदप्रहसिताननाः /
मदिरापूर्णचषकमशेषं चारुणप्रभम् /
दधानाः श्यामलाकाराः सर्वाः कालस्य योषितः //
text_mt: These goddesses of Mahākāla, whose faces laugh with intoxication, / hold a completely filled goblet of wine, glowing red; / all dark-complexioned in form, they are the women of Time.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāpūjanadhyānajapastotraparāyaṇāḥ /
niṣevante mahākālaṃ kālacakrāsanasthitam //
meaning:
ललितापूजनध्यानजपस्तोत्रपरायणाः /
निषेवन्ते महाकालं कालचक्रासनस्थितम् //
text_mt: Devoted to the worship, meditation, recitation, and praise of Lalitā, / they attend upon Mahākāla seated upon the throne of the Wheel of Time.

sanskrit_iast:
atha kalpakavaṭyāstu rakṣakaḥ kumbhasaṃbhava /
vasantarturmahātejā lalitāpriyakiṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
अथ कल्पकवट्यास्तु रक्षकः कुम्भसंभव /
वसन्तर्तुर्महातेजा ललिताप्रियकिङ्करः //
text_mt: Now, the protector of the grove of Kalpa trees, O pot-born one, / is the spring season, of great splendor, the beloved servant of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpasiṃhāsanāsīnaḥ puṣpamādhvīmadāruṇāḥ /
puṣpāyudhaḥ puṣpabhūṣaḥ puṣpacchatreṇa śobhitaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्पसिंहासनासीनः पुष्पमाध्वीमदारुणाः /
पुष्पायुधः पुष्पभूषः पुष्पच्छत्रेण शोभितः //
text_mt: Seated on a throne of flowers, reddened by the intoxication of flower-honey wine, / weaponed with flowers, adorned with flowers, he is beautified by a parasol of flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśrīrmādhavaśrīśca dve devyau tasya dīvyataḥ /
prasūnamadirāmatte prasūnaśaralālase //
meaning:
मधुश्रीर्माधवश्रीश्च द्वे देव्यौ तस्य दीव्यतः /
प्रसूनमदिरामत्ते प्रसूनशरलालसे //
text_mt: Madhuśrī and Mādhavaśrī are his two shining goddesses, / intoxicated with the wine of blossoms, longing for the flower-arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
santānavāṭikāpālo grīṣmartustīkṣṇalocanaḥ /
lalitākiṅkaro nityaṃ tasyāstvājñāpravartakaḥ //
meaning:
सन्तानवाटिकापालो ग्रीष्मर्तुस्तीक्ष्णलोचनः /
ललिताकिङ्करो नित्यं तस्यास्त्वाज्ञाप्रवर्तकः //
text_mt: The guardian of the Santāna grove is the summer season, keen-eyed, / ever a servant of Lalitā, carrying out her command.

sanskrit_iast:
śukra śrīśca śuciśrīśca tasya bhārye ubhe smṛte /
haricandanavāṭī tu mune varṣartunā sthitā //
meaning:
शुक्र श्रीश्च शुचिश्रीश्च तस्य भार्ये उभे स्मृते /
हरिचन्दनवाटी तु मुने वर्षर्तुना स्थिता //
text_mt: Śukraśrī and Śuciśrī are traditionally remembered as his two wives. / The Haricandana grove, O sage, is occupied by the rainy season.

sanskrit_iast:
sa varṣarnturmahātejā vidyutpaṅgalalocanaḥ /
vajrāṭṭahāsamukharo mattajīmūtavāhanaḥ //
meaning:
स वर्षर्न्तुर्महातेजा विद्युत्पङ्गललोचनः /
वज्राट्टहासमुखरो मत्तजीमूतवाहनः //
text_mt: That rainy season is of great majesty, with tawny eyes like lightning, / noisy with loud laughter like thunderbolts, riding an intoxicated cloud.

sanskrit_iast:
jīmūtakavacacchanno maṇikārmukadhārakaḥ /
lalitāpūjanadhyānajapastotraparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
जीमूतकवचच्छन्नो मणिकार्मुकधारकः /
ललितापूजनध्यानजपस्तोत्रपरायणः //
text_mt: Covered in armor of clouds, wielding a jewel-bow, / he is devoted to the worship, meditation, recitation, and praise of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
vartate vindhyamathana trailokyāhlādadāyakaḥ /
nabhaḥśrīśca nabhasyaśrīḥ svarasvārasvamālinī //
meaning:
वर्तते विन्ध्यमथन त्रैलोक्याह्लाददायकः /
नभःश्रीश्च नभस्यश्रीः स्वरस्वारस्वमालिनी //
text_mt: He abides, O crusher of the Vindhya, giving delight to the three worlds. / Nabhaḥśrī, Nabhasyaśrī, Svarasvā, Rasamālinī,

sanskrit_iast:
ambā dulā niraliścābhrayantī meghayantrikā /
varṣayantī cibuṇikā vāridhārā ca śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
अम्बा दुला निरलिश्चाभ्रयन्ती मेघयन्त्रिका /
वर्षयन्ती चिबुणिका वारिधारा च शक्तयः //
text_mt: Ambā, Dulā, Niralī, Abhrayantī, Meghayantrikā, / Varṣayantī, Cibuṇikā, and Vāridhārā are the powers;

sanskrit_iast:
varṣantyo dvādaśa proktā madāruṇavilocanāḥ /
tābhiḥ samaṃ sa varṣartuḥ śaktibhiḥ parameśvarīm //
meaning:
वर्षन्त्यो द्वादश प्रोक्ता मदारुणविलोचनाः /
ताभिः समं स वर्षर्तुः शक्तिभिः परमेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: twelve raining goddesses are mentioned, their eyes reddened with intoxication. / Together with these powers, the rainy season [serves] the Supreme Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
sadaiva saṃjapannāste nijotthaiḥ puṣpamaṇḍalaiḥ /
lalitābhaktadeśāṃstu bhūṣayansvasya sampadā //
meaning:
सदैव संजपन्नास्ते निजोत्थैः पुष्पमण्डलैः /
ललिताभक्तदेशांस्तु भूषयन्स्वस्य सम्पदा //
text_mt: Ever reciting [her mantra], he sits with heaps of flowers born of himself, / adorning the realms of Lalitā's devotees with his own abundance.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvairiṇāṃ tu vasudhāmanābṛṣṭyā nipīḍayan /
vartate satataṃ devīkiṅkarau jaladāgamaḥ //
meaning:
तद्वैरिणां तु वसुधामनाबृष्ट्या निपीडयन् /
वर्तते सततं देवीकिङ्करौ जलदागमः //
text_mt: Afflicting the earth of her enemies with drought, / the rainy season continuously abides as the servant of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
mandāravāṭikāyāṃ tu sadā śaradṛturvasan /
tāṃ kakṣāṃ rakṣati śrīmāṃllokacittaprasādanaḥ //
meaning:
मन्दारवाटिकायां तु सदा शरदृतुर्वसन् /
तां कक्षां रक्षति श्रीमांल्लोकचित्तप्रसादनः //
text_mt: Dwelling always in the Mandāra grove, the autumn season, / gladdening the hearts of the world, protects that enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
iṣaśrīśca tathorjaśrīstasyartoḥ prāṇanāyike /
tābyāṃ saṃjahratustoyaṃ nijotthaiḥ puṣpamaṇḍalaiḥ /
abhyarcayati sāmrājñīṃ śrīkāmeśvarayoṣitam //
meaning:
इषश्रीश्च तथोर्जश्रीस्तस्यर्तोः प्राणनायिके /
ताब्यां संजह्रतुस्तोयं निजोत्थैः पुष्पमण्डलैः /
अभ्यर्चयति साम्राज्ञीं श्रीकामेश्वरयोषितम् //
text_mt: Iṣaśrī and Ūrjaśrī are the two life-mistresses of that season. / With water brought by the two of them and heaps of flowers born of himself, / he worships the Empress, the woman of glorious Kāmeśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
hemantarturmahātejā himaśītalavigrahaḥ /
sadā prasannavadano lalitāpriyakiṅkaraḥ //
meaning:
हेमन्तर्तुर्महातेजा हिमशीतलविग्रहः /
सदा प्रसन्नवदनो ललिताप्रियकिङ्करः //
text_mt: The early winter season is of great splendor, possessing a body cold as snow, / with an ever-cheerful face, the beloved servant of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
nijotthaiḥ puṣpasaṃbhārairarcayanparameśvarīm /
pārijātasya vāṭīṃ tu rakṣati jvalanārdanaḥ //
meaning:
निजोत्थैः पुष्पसंभारैरर्चयन्परमेश्वरीम् /
पारिजातस्य वाटीं तु रक्षति ज्वलनार्दनः //
text_mt: Worshiping the Supreme Goddess with masses of flowers born of himself, / the suppressor of fire protects the grove of the Pārijāta.

sanskrit_iast:
sahaḥśrīśca sahasyaśrīstasya dve yoṣite śubhe /
kadambavanavāṭyāstu rakṣakaḥ śiśirākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
सहःश्रीश्च सहस्यश्रीस्तस्य द्वे योषिते शुभे /
कदम्बवनवाट्यास्तु रक्षकः शिशिराकृतिः //
text_mt: Sahaḥśrī and Sahasyaśrī are his two auspicious wives. / The protector of the Kadamba forest enclosure is late winter in form.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśirarturmuniśreṣṭha vartate kumbhasambhava /
sā kakṣyā tena sarvatra śīśirīkṛtabhūtalā //
meaning:
शिशिरर्तुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव /
सा कक्ष्या तेन सर्वत्र शीशिरीकृतभूतला //
text_mt: The late winter season abides, O best of sages, O pot-born one; / that enclosure has the surface of its earth cooled everywhere by him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvāsinī tataḥ śyāmā devatā śiśirākṛtiḥ /
tapaḥśrīśca tapasyaśrīstasya dve yoṣiduttame /
tābhyāṃ sahārcayatyaṃbāṃ lalitāṃ viśvapāvanīm //
meaning:
तद्वासिनी ततः श्यामा देवता शिशिराकृतिः /
तपःश्रीश्च तपस्यश्रीस्तस्य द्वे योषिदुत्तमे /
ताभ्यां सहार्चयत्यंबां ललितां विश्वपावनीम् //
text_mt: Dwelling there, the dark deity has the form of late winter. / Tapaḥśrī and Tapasyaśrī are his two excellent wives; / together with them he worships the Mother, Lalitā, the purifier of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
gandharvavadana śrīmannānāvṛkṣādisaptakaiḥ /
prathamodyānapālastu mahākālo mayā śritaḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
गन्धर्ववदन श्रीमन्नानावृक्षादिसप्तकैः /
प्रथमोद्यानपालस्तु महाकालो मया श्रितः //
text_mt: Agastya said: / O horse-faced one, O glorious one! By the seven trees and so forth, / Mahākāla as the protector of the first park has been heard by me.

sanskrit_iast:
caturāvaraṇaṃ cakraṃ tvayā tasya prakīrtitam /
ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāmanyeṣāṃ kalpakodyānavāṭiṣu /
pālakatvaṃ śrutaṃ tvattaścakradevyastu na śrutāḥ //
meaning:
चतुरावरणं चक्रं त्वया तस्य प्रकीर्तितम् /
षण्णामृतूनामन्येषां कल्पकोद्यानवाटिषु /
पालकत्वं श्रुतं त्वत्तश्चक्रदेव्यस्तु न श्रुताः //
text_mt: A cakra of four circuits was proclaimed by you for him. / The guardianship of the other six seasons in the parks of Kalpa trees / was heard from you, but the deities of the cakras were not heard.

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva vasantādicakrāvaraṇadevatāḥ /
krameṇa brūhi bhagavansarvajño 'si yato mahān //
meaning:
अत एव वसन्तादिचक्रावरणदेवताः /
क्रमेण ब्रूहि भगवन्सर्वज्ञो ऽसि यतो महान् //
text_mt: Therefore, O venerable one, describe in order the circuit deities of the cakra of spring and the others, / for you are the omniscient great one.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
ākarṇaya muniśreṣṭa tattaccakrasthadevatāḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
आकर्णय मुनिश्रेष्ट तत्तच्चक्रस्थदेवताः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Listen, O best of sages, to the deities situated in those respective cakras.

sanskrit_iast:
kālacakraṃ purā proktaṃ vāsantaṃ cakramucyate /
trikoṇaṃ pañcakoṇaṃ ca nāgacchadasaroruham /
ṣoḍaśāraṃ sarojaṃ ca daśāradvitayaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
कालचक्रं पुरा प्रोक्तं वासन्तं चक्रमुच्यते /
त्रिकोणं पञ्चकोणं च नागच्छदसरोरुहम् /
षोडशारं सरोजं च दशारद्वितयं पुनः //
text_mt: The Wheel of Time was explained before; the cakra of spring is now described: / a triangle, a pentagon, an eight-petaled lotus, / a sixteen-spoked lotus, and two sets of ten spokes,

sanskrit_iast:
caturasraṃ ca vijñeyaṃ saptāvaraṇasaṃyutam /
tanmadhye binducakrastho vasantarturmahādyuti //
meaning:
चतुरस्रं च विज्ञेयं सप्तावरणसंयुतम् /
तन्मध्ये बिन्दुचक्रस्थो वसन्तर्तुर्महाद्युति //
text_mt: and a square is to be known, possessed of seven circuits. / In the center of it, situated in the bindu-cakra, is the spring season of great splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
tadekadvayasaṃlagne madhuśrīmādhavaśriyau /
ubhābhyāṃ nijahastābhyāmubhayostanamekakam //
meaning:
तदेकद्वयसंलग्ने मधुश्रीमाधवश्रियौ /
उभाभ्यां निजहस्ताभ्यामुभयोस्तनमेककम् //
text_mt: Clinging to his two sides are Madhuśrī and Mādhavaśrī; / with his two hands, [holding] each single breast of the two of them,

sanskrit_iast:
nipīḍayansvahastasya yugalena sasaurabham /
sapuṣpamadirāpūrmacaṣakaṃ piśitaṃ vahan //
meaning:
निपीडयन्स्वहस्तस्य युगलेन ससौरभम् /
सपुष्पमदिरापूर्मचषकं पिशितं वहन् //
text_mt: squeezing, while with another pair of his hands he carries meat / and a fragrant goblet filled with flower-wine.

sanskrit_iast:
evameva tu sarvartudhyānaṃ vindhyaniṣūdana /
varṣartostu punardhyāne śaktidvitayamādimam /
aṅkasthitaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ śaktayo 'nyāḥ samīpagāḥ //
meaning:
एवमेव तु सर्वर्तुध्यानं विन्ध्यनिषूदन /
वर्षर्तोस्तु पुनर्ध्याने शक्तिद्वितयमादिमम् /
अङ्कस्थितं तु विज्ञेयं शक्तयो ऽन्याः समीपगाः //
text_mt: Just such is the visualization of all the seasons, O destroyer of the Vindhya; / but in the visualization of the rainy season, the primary pair of powers / is to be known as seated on his lap, while the other powers stand nearby.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vāsantacakrasthadevīḥ śṛṇu vadāmyam /
madhuśuklaprathamikā madhuśukladvitīyikā //
meaning:
अथ वासन्तचक्रस्थदेवीः शृणु वदाम्यम् /
मधुशुक्लप्रथमिका मधुशुक्लद्वितीयिका //
text_mt: Now hear the goddesses situated in the cakra of spring; I tell them: / Madhuśuklaprathamā, Madhuśukladvitīyā,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśuklatṛtīyā ca madhuśuklacaturthikā /
madhuśuklā pañcamī ca madhuśuklā ca ṣaṣṭhikā //
meaning:
मधुशुक्लतृतीया च मधुशुक्लचतुर्थिका /
मधुशुक्ला पञ्चमी च मधुशुक्ला च षष्ठिका //
text_mt: Madhuśuklatṛtīyā, Madhuśuklacaturthī, / Madhuśuklapañcamī, and Madhuśuklaṣaṣṭhī,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśuklā saptamī ca madhuśuklāṣṭamī punaḥ /
navamī madhuśuklā ca daśamī madhuśuklikā //
meaning:
मधुशुक्ला सप्तमी च मधुशुक्लाष्टमी पुनः /
नवमी मधुशुक्ला च दशमी मधुशुक्लिका //
text_mt: Madhuśuklasaptamī, and then Madhuśuklāṣṭamī, / Madhuśuklanavamī, and Madhuśukladaśamī,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśuklaikādaśī ca dvādaśī madhuśuklataḥ /
madhuśuklatrayodaśyāṃ madhuśuklā caturdaśī //
meaning:
मधुशुक्लैकादशी च द्वादशी मधुशुक्लतः /
मधुशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां मधुशुक्ला चतुर्दशी //
text_mt: Madhuśuklaikādaśī, and Twelfth from Madhuśukla, / on the Thirteenth of Madhuśukla, Madhuśuklacaturdaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
madhuśuklā paurṇamāsī prathamā madhukṛṣṇikā /
madhukṛṣṇā dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā madhukṛṣṇikā //
meaning:
मधुशुक्ला पौर्णमासी प्रथमा मधुकृष्णिका /
मधुकृष्णा द्वितीया च तृतीया मधुकृष्णिका //
text_mt: Madhuśuklapaurṇamāsī; [then] the first of Madhukṛṣṇa, / Madhukṛṣṇadvitīyā, and Madhukṛṣṇatṛtīyā,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthī madhukṛṣṇā ca madhukṛṣma ca pañcamī /
ṣaṣṭī tu madhukṛṣṇā syātsaptamī madhukṛṣmataḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थी मधुकृष्णा च मधुकृष्म च पञ्चमी /
षष्टी तु मधुकृष्णा स्यात्सप्तमी मधुकृष्मतः //
text_mt: Madhukṛṣṇacaturthī, and Madhukṛṣṇapañcamī, / the sixth would be Madhukṛṣṇa, the seventh from Madhukṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
madhukṛṣṇāṣṭamī caiva navamīmadhukṛṣṇataḥ /
daśamī madhukṛṣṇā ca vindhyadarpaniṣūdana //
meaning:
मधुकृष्णाष्टमी चैव नवमीमधुकृष्णतः /
दशमी मधुकृष्णा च विन्ध्यदर्पनिषूदन //
text_mt: and Madhukṛṣṇāṣṭamī, the ninth from Madhukṛṣṇa, / and Madhukṛṣṇadaśamī, O destroyer of the Vindhya's pride,

sanskrit_iast:
madhukṛṣṇaikādaśī tu dvādaśī madhukṛṣṇataḥ /
madhukṛṣṇatrayodaśyā madhukṛṣṇacaturdaśī //
meaning:
मधुकृष्णैकादशी तु द्वादशी मधुकृष्णतः /
मधुकृष्णत्रयोदश्या मधुकृष्णचतुर्दशी //
text_mt: Madhukṛṣṇaikādaśī, and Twelfth from Madhukṛṣṇa, / the Thirteenth of Madhukṛṣṇa, Madhukṛṣṇacaturdaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
madhvamā ceti vijñeyāstriṃśadetāstu śaktayaḥ /
evameva prakāreṇa mādhavākhyo paristhitāḥ //
meaning:
मध्वमा चेति विज्ञेयास्त्रिंशदेतास्तु शक्तयः /
एवमेव प्रकारेण माधवाख्यो परिस्थिताः //
text_mt: and Madhv-amāvāsyā: these thirty powers are to be known. / In this very manner are situated those named after Mādhava:

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapratipadādyāstu śaktayastriṃśadanyakāḥ /
militvā ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāstu khyātā vāsantaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लप्रतिपदाद्यास्तु शक्तयस्त्रिंशदन्यकाः /
मिलित्वा षष्टिसंख्यास्तु ख्याता वासन्तशक्तयः //
text_mt: beginning with the bright Pratipad, thirty other powers; / taken together, sixty is the number of powers famous for spring.

sanskrit_iast:
svaiḥ svairmantraistatra cakre pūjanīyā vidhānataḥ /
vāsantacakrarājasya saptāvaraṇabhūmayaḥ //
meaning:
स्वैः स्वैर्मन्त्रैस्तत्र चक्रे पूजनीया विधानतः /
वासन्तचक्रराजस्य सप्तावरणभूमयः //
text_mt: They are to be worshiped in that cakra according to rule with their own respective mantras. / There are seven circuit levels of the royal cakra of spring;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭiḥ syurdaivatāstāsu ṣaṣṭibhūmiṣu saṃsthitāḥ /
vibhajya cārcanīyāḥ syustattanmantraistu sādhakaiḥ //
meaning:
षष्टिः स्युर्दैवतास्तासु षष्टिभूमिषु संस्थिताः /
विभज्य चार्चनीयाः स्युस्तत्तन्मन्त्रैस्तु साधकैः //
text_mt: sixty deities abide in those sixty levels; / dividing them, they are to be worshiped by practitioners with their respective mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vāsantacakraṃ syāttathaivānyeṣu ca triṣu /
devatāstu paraṃ bhinnāḥ śukraśucyādibhedataḥ //
meaning:
तथा वासन्तचक्रं स्यात्तथैवान्येषु च त्रिषु /
देवतास्तु परं भिन्नाः शुक्रशुच्यादिभेदतः //
text_mt: As is the cakra of spring, so it is in the other three as well; / but the deities differ according to the divisions of Śukra, Śuci, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayaḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyātā grīṣmacakre mahodayāḥ /
evaṃ varṣādike cakre bhedānnabhavabhasyajān //
meaning:
शक्तयः षष्टिसंख्याता ग्रीष्मचक्रे महोदयाः /
एवं वर्षादिके चक्रे भेदान्नभवभस्यजान् //
text_mt: Sixty powers are enumerated in the cakra of summer, of great majesty; / thus in the cakra of the rains and the rest, born of the divisions of Nabhas and Nabhasya,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭi ṣaṣṭisu śaktīnāṃ cakrecakre pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
granthavistārabhītyā tu tatsaṃkhyānādviramyate //
meaning:
षष्टि षष्टिसु शक्तीनां चक्रेचक्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः /
ग्रन्थविस्तारभीत्या तु तत्संख्यानाद्विरम्यते //
text_mt: sixty powers are established in each cakra; / for fear of expanding the text, their enumeration is discontinued.

sanskrit_iast:
ārtavyāḥ śaktayastvetā lalitābhakta saukhyadāḥ /
lalitāpūjanadhyānajapastotraparāyaṇāḥ //
meaning:
आर्तव्याः शक्तयस्त्वेता ललिताभक्त सौख्यदाः /
ललितापूजनध्यानजपस्तोत्रपरायणाः //
text_mt: These seasonal Śaktis bestow happiness on the devotees of Lalitā, / devoted to the worship, meditation, japa, and praise of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
kalpādivāṭikācakre sañcarantyo madālasāḥ /
svasvapuṣpotthamadhubhistarpayantyo maheśvarīm //
meaning:
कल्पादिवाटिकाचक्रे सञ्चरन्त्यो मदालसाः /
स्वस्वपुष्पोत्थमधुभिस्तर्पयन्त्यो महेश्वरीम् //
