text_mt: Moving about languidly from intoxication in the enclosures of kalpa groves and the like, / they gratify Maheśvarī with the wines produced from their respective flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
militvā caiva saṃkhyātāḥ ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatrayam /
evaṃ saptasu śāleṣu pālikāścakradevatāḥ //
meaning:
मिलित्वा चैव संख्याताः षष्ट्युत्तरशतत्रयम् /
एवं सप्तसु शालेषु पालिकाश्चक्रदेवताः //
text_mt: United, their number is reckoned as three hundred and sixty. / Thus the guardian cakra deities in the seven enclosures

sanskrit_iast:
nāmakīrtanapūrvaṃ tu proktastubhyaṃ prapṛcchate /
anyeṣāmapi śālānāmupādānaṃ tu pūrakam /
vistāraṃ tatra śaktiṃ ca kathayāmyavadhāraya //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasamvāde lalitopākhyāne śrīnagaratripurāsaptakakṣāpālakadevatāprakāśana kathanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
नामकीर्तनपूर्वं तु प्रोक्तस्तुभ्यं प्रपृच्छते /
अन्येषामपि शालानामुपादानं तु पूरकम् /
विस्तारं तत्र शक्तिं च कथयाम्यवधारय //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसम्वादे ललितोपाख्याने श्रीनगरत्रिपुरासप्तकक्षापालकदेवताप्रकाशन कथनं नाम द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
have been declared by reciting their names to you as you asked. / Hear now as I explain the filling material of the other enclosures, / their extent, and the Śakti therein.

Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, named 'The Declaration of the Guardian Deities of the Seven Enclosures of Śrīnagara and Tripura,' in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
kathitaṃ saptaśālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śilpibhiḥ kṛtam /
atha ratnamayāḥ śālāḥ prakīrtyante 'vadhāraya //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
कथितं सप्तशालानां लक्षणं शिल्पिभिः कृतम् /
अथ रत्नमयाः शालाः प्रकीर्त्यन्ते ऽवधारय //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / The description of the seven enclosures made by the artisans has been told. / Now the jewel-made enclosures are proclaimed; listen attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇamayaśālasya puṣparāgamayasya ca /
saptayojanamātraṃ syānmadhyentaramudātdṛtam //
meaning:
सुवर्णमयशालस्य पुष्परागमयस्य च /
सप्तयोजनमात्रं स्यान्मध्येन्तरमुदात्दृतम् //
text_mt: Between the gold enclosure and the topaz enclosure, / the space between them is declared to be exactly seven yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra siddhāḥsiddhanāryaḥ khelanti madavihvalāḥ /
rasai rasāyanaiścāpi khaḍgaiḥ pādāñjanairapi //
meaning:
तत्र सिद्धाःसिद्धनार्यः खेलन्ति मदविह्वलाः /
रसै रसायनैश्चापि खड्गैः पादाञ्जनैरपि //
text_mt: There the Siddhas and Siddha women sport, overcome with joy, / with elixirs, rasāyanas, and also magical swords and foot-salves.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāyāṃ bhaktiyuktāstarpayanto mahājanān /
vasaṃti vividhāstatra pibanti madirārasān //
meaning:
ललितायां भक्तियुक्तास्तर्पयन्तो महाजनान् /
वसंति विविधास्तत्र पिबन्ति मदिरारसान् //
text_mt: Endowed with devotion to Lalitā, satisfying great persons, / diverse [beings] dwell there, drinking the essence of wine.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāgādiśālānāṃ pūrvavaddvārakḷptayaḥ /
puṣparāgādiśāleṣu kavāṭārgalagopuram /
puṣparāgādijaṃ jñeyamuccendvādityabhāsvaram //
meaning:
पुष्परागादिशालानां पूर्ववद्द्वारकॢप्तयः /
पुष्परागादिशालेषु कवाटार्गलगोपुरम् /
पुष्परागादिजं ज्ञेयमुच्चेन्द्वादित्यभास्वरम् //
text_mt: The arrangements of gates for the enclosures of topaz and the rest are as before. / In the enclosures of topaz and the rest, the gate-leaf, bolt, and gopura / should be known to be made of topaz and the like, radiant like the high moon and sun.

sanskrit_iast:
hemaprākāracakrasya puṣparāgamayasya ca /
antare yā svalī sāpi puṣparāgamayī smṛtā //
meaning:
हेमप्राकारचक्रस्य पुष्परागमयस्य च /
अन्तरे या स्वली सापि पुष्परागमयी स्मृता //
text_mt: The ground that lies between the cakra of the golden rampart / and that made of topaz is also traditionally known to consist of topaz.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣyamāṇamahāśālākakṣāsu nikhilāsvapi /
tadvarṇāḥ pakṣiṇastatra tadvarṇāni sarāṃsi ca //
meaning:
वक्ष्यमाणमहाशालाकक्षासु निखिलास्वपि /
तद्वर्णाः पक्षिणस्तत्र तद्वर्णानि सरांसि च //
text_mt: In all the spaces between the great enclosures that are about to be described, / the birds there are of that [same] color, and the lakes are of that [same] color,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvarmasalilā nadyastadvarṇāśca maṇidrumāḥ /
siddhajātiṣu ye devīmupāsya vividhaiḥ kramai /
tyaktavanto vapuḥ pūrvaṃ te siddhāstatra sāṃganāḥ //
meaning:
तद्वर्मसलिला नद्यस्तद्वर्णाश्च मणिद्रुमाः /
सिद्धजातिषु ये देवीमुपास्य विविधैः क्रमै /
त्यक्तवन्तो वपुः पूर्वं ते सिद्धास्तत्र सांगनाः //
text_mt: the rivers have water of that color, and the gem-trees are of that color. / Those among the classes of Siddhas who, having worshipped the goddess through various rites, / previously cast off their bodies, those Siddhas dwell there together with their women,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāmantrajaptāro lalitākramatatparāḥ /
te sarve lalitādevyā nāmakīrtanakāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
ललितामन्त्रजप्तारो ललिताक्रमतत्पराः /
ते सर्वे ललितादेव्या नामकीर्तनकारिणः //
text_mt: mutterers of the mantra of Lalitā, devoted to the ritual sequence of Lalitā, / all of them making recitation of the names of the goddess Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣparāgamahāśālāntare mārutayojane /
padmarāgamayaḥ śālaścaturasraḥ samantataḥ //
meaning:
पुष्परागमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
पद्मरागमयः शालश्चतुरस्रः समन्ततः //
text_mt: Within the distance of forty-nine yojanas from the great enclosure of topaz, / there is an enclosure made of ruby, four-sided on every side.

sanskrit_iast:
sthalī ca padmarāgaḍhyā gopurādyaṃ ca tanmayam /
tatra cāraṇadeśasthāḥ pūrvadehavināśataḥ /
siddhiṃ prāptā mahārājñīcaramāmbhojasevakāḥ //
meaning:
स्थली च पद्मरागढ्या गोपुराद्यं च तन्मयम् /
तत्र चारणदेशस्थाः पूर्वदेहविनाशतः /
सिद्धिं प्राप्ता महाराज्ञीचरमाम्भोजसेवकाः //
text_mt: The ground is rich in ruby, and the gopuras and the like are made of the same. / There, having cast off their former bodies, those dwelling in the land of the Cāraṇas / who have attained siddhi, servants of the lotus-feet of the Great Queen [dwell].

sanskrit_iast:
cāraṇīnāṃ striyaścāpi cārvaṅgyo madalālasāḥ /
gāyanti lalitādevyā gītibandhānmuhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
चारणीनां स्त्रियश्चापि चार्वङ्ग्यो मदलालसाः /
गायन्ति ललितादेव्या गीतिबन्धान्मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: The wives of the Cāraṇas as well, having beautiful limbs and languid from intoxication, / sing the metrical songs of the goddess Lalitā again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ madhyasthavedikāsthitāḥ /
bhartṛbhiḥ sahacāriṇyaḥ pibanti madhuraṃ madhu //
meaning:
तत्रैव कल्पवृक्षाणां मध्यस्थवेदिकास्थिताः /
भर्तृभिः सहचारिण्यः पिबन्ति मधुरं मधु //
text_mt: Right there, seated on platforms in the middle of wish-granting trees, / wandering together with their husbands, they drink sweet nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
padmarāgamahāśālāntare marutayojane /
gomedakamahāśālaḥ pūrvaśālāsamākṛtiḥ /
atituṅgo hīraśālastayormadhye ca hīrabhūḥ //
meaning:
पद्मरागमहाशालान्तरे मरुतयोजने /
गोमेदकमहाशालः पूर्वशालासमाकृतिः /
अतितुङ्गो हीरशालस्तयोर्मध्ये च हीरभूः //
text_mt: Within the distance of forty-nine yojanas from the great enclosure of ruby / is the great enclosure of gomedaka, of the same form as the previous enclosure. / [Then is] the very lofty diamond enclosure, and between the two is the diamond ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra devīṃ samabhyarcya pūrvajanmani kumbhaja /
vasantyapsarasāṃ vṛndaiḥ sākaṃ gandharvapuṅgavāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र देवीं समभ्यर्च्य पूर्वजन्मनि कुम्भज /
वसन्त्यप्सरसां वृन्दैः साकं गन्धर्वपुङ्गवाः //
text_mt: There, having worshipped the goddess in a previous birth, O jar-born one, / dwell foremost Gandharvas together with multitudes of Apsarases,

sanskrit_iast:
mahārājñīguṇagaṇāngāyanto vallakīsvanaiḥ /
kāmabhojaikarasikāḥ kāmasannibhavigrahāḥ /
sukumāraprakṛtayaḥ śrīdevībhaktiśālinaḥ //
meaning:
महाराज्ञीगुणगणान्गायन्तो वल्लकीस्वनैः /
कामभोजैकरसिकाः कामसन्निभविग्रहाः /
सुकुमारप्रकृतयः श्रीदेवीभक्तिशालिनः //
text_mt: singing the multitudes of virtues of the Great Queen to the sounds of lutes, / delighting only in the enjoyment of love, having bodies resembling the god of love, / of delicate nature, endowed with devotion to the glorious goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
gomedakasya śālastupūrvaśālasamākṛtiḥ /
tadantare yoginīnāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ ca koṭayaḥ /
kālasaṅkarṣaṇīmaṃbāṃ sevante tatra bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
गोमेदकस्य शालस्तुपूर्वशालसमाकृतिः /
तदन्तरे योगिनीनां भैरवाणां च कोटयः /
कालसङ्कर्षणीमंबां सेवन्ते तत्र भक्तितः //
text_mt: The enclosure of gomedaka, however, has the same form as the previous enclosure. / Within it, crores of Yoginīs and Bhairavas / worship the mother Kālasaṅkarṣaṇī there with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
gomedakamahāśālāntare mārutayojane /
urvaśī menakā caiva rambhā cālaṃbuṣā tathā //
meaning:
गोमेदकमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
उर्वशी मेनका चैव रम्भा चालंबुषा तथा //
text_mt: Within the distance of forty-nine yojanas from the great enclosure of gomedaka, / Urvaśī and Menakā, Rambhā and Alaṃbuṣā,

sanskrit_iast:
mañjughoṣā sukeśī ca pūrvacittirghṛtācikā /
kṛtasthalā ca viśvācī puñjikasthalayā saha //
meaning:
मञ्जुघोषा सुकेशी च पूर्वचित्तिर्घृताचिका /
कृतस्थला च विश्वाची पुञ्जिकस्थलया सह //
text_mt: Mañjughoṣā and Sukeśī, Pūrvacitti, Ghṛtācī, / Kṛtasthalā, Viśvācī, together with Puñjikasthalā,

sanskrit_iast:
tilottameti devānāṃ veśyā etādṛśo 'parāḥ /
gandharvaiḥ saha navyāni kalpavṛkṣama dhūni ca //
meaning:
तिलोत्तमेति देवानां वेश्या एतादृशो ऽपराः /
गन्धर्वैः सह नव्यानि कल्पवृक्षम धूनि च //
text_mt: and Tilottamā—such courtesans of the gods and others, / together with Gandharvas, [drink] fresh nectars of wish-granting trees,

sanskrit_iast:
pibantyo lalitādevīṃ dhyāyantyaśca muhurmuhuḥ /
svasaubhāgyavivṛddhyarthaṃ guṇayantyaśca tanmanum //
meaning:
पिबन्त्यो ललितादेवीं ध्यायन्त्यश्च मुहुर्मुहुः /
स्वसौभाग्यविवृद्ध्यर्थं गुणयन्त्यश्च तन्मनुम् //
text_mt: and drinking, meditating upon the goddess Lalitā again and again, / repeat her mantra for the increase of their own fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśasucotpannā sthāneṣvapsaraso 'khilāḥ /
tatraiva devīmarcantyo vasaṃti muditāśayāḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशसुचोत्पन्ना स्थानेष्वप्सरसो ऽखिलाः /
तत्रैव देवीमर्चन्त्यो वसंति मुदिताशयाः //
text_mt: All the Apsarases born in the fourteen origins / dwell right there with joyful minds, worshipping the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
caturdaśāpi janmāni tāsāmapsarasāṃ vibho /
kīrtaya tvaṃ mahāprājña sarvavidyāmahānidhe //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
चतुर्दशापि जन्मानि तासामप्सरसां विभो /
कीर्तय त्वं महाप्राज्ञ सर्वविद्यामहानिधे //
text_mt: Agastya said: / O all-pervading lord, proclaim all the fourteen births / of those Apsarases, O greatly wise one, great treasury of all knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
brāhmaṇo hṛdayaṃ kāmo mṛtyururvī ca mārutaḥ /
tapanasya karāścandrakaro vedāśca pāvakaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
ब्राह्मणो हृदयं कामो मृत्युरुर्वी च मारुतः /
तपनस्य कराश्चन्द्रकरो वेदाश्च पावकः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / The heart of Brahmā, desire, death, earth, and wind, / the rays of the sun, the ray of the moon, the Vedas, and fire,

sanskrit_iast:
saudāminī ca pīyūṣaṃ dakṣakanyā jalaṃ tathā /
janmanaḥ kāraṇānyetānyā mananti manīṣiṇaḥ //
meaning:
सौदामिनी च पीयूषं दक्षकन्या जलं तथा /
जन्मनः कारणान्येतान्या मनन्ति मनीषिणः //
text_mt: lightning, nectar, the daughter of Dakṣa, and water— / wise men declare these to be the causes of birth

sanskrit_iast:
gīrvāṇagaṇyanārīṇāṃ sphuratsaubhāgyasaṃpadām /
etāḥ samastā gandharvaiḥ sārdhamarcanti cakriṇīm //
meaning:
गीर्वाणगण्यनारीणां स्फुरत्सौभाग्यसंपदाम् /
एताः समस्ता गन्धर्वैः सार्धमर्चन्ति चक्रिणीम् //
text_mt: of the women reckoned among the gods, endowed with radiant wealth of fortune. / All of these, along with the Gandharvas, worship the goddess with the cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
kinnarāḥ saha nārībhistathā kiṃpuruṣā mune /
strībhiḥ saha madonmattā hīrakasthalamāśritāḥ //
meaning:
किन्नराः सह नारीभिस्तथा किंपुरुषा मुने /
स्त्रीभिः सह मदोन्मत्ता हीरकस्थलमाश्रिताः //
text_mt: Kinnaras with their women, and likewise Kiṃpuruṣas, O sage, / intoxicated with joy along with their wives, have resorted to the diamond ground.

sanskrit_iast:
mahārājñīmantrajāpairvidhūtāśeṣa kalmaṣāḥ /
nṛtyantaścaiva gāyanto vartante kuṃbhasaṃbhava //
meaning:
महाराज्ञीमन्त्रजापैर्विधूताशेष कल्मषाः /
नृत्यन्तश्चैव गायन्तो वर्तन्ते कुंभसंभव //
text_mt: With all their sins shaken off through japa of the mantras of the Great Queen, / dancing and singing, they remain there, O jar-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva hīrakakṣoṇyāṃ vajrā nāma nadī mune /
vajrakārairnibiḍitā bhāsamānā taṭadrumaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैव हीरकक्षोण्यां वज्रा नाम नदी मुने /
वज्रकारैर्निबिडिता भासमाना तटद्रुमैः //
text_mt: Right there on the diamond earth, O sage, is the river named Vajrā, / crowded with diamond-makers and shining with trees on its banks.

sanskrit_iast:
vajraratnaikasikatā vajradravamayodakā /
sadā vahati sā siṃdhuḥ paritastatra pāvanī //
meaning:
वज्ररत्नैकसिकता वज्रद्रवमयोदका /
सदा वहति सा सिंधुः परितस्तत्र पावनी //
text_mt: Having sands consisting only of diamond jewels and water made of liquefied diamond, / that purifying river constantly flows all around there.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāparameśānyāṃ bhakta ye mānavottamāḥ /
te tasyā udakaṃ pītvā vajrarūpakalevarāḥ /
dīrghāyuṣaśca nīrogā bhavanti kalaśodbhava //
meaning:
ललितापरमेशान्यां भक्त ये मानवोत्तमाः /
ते तस्या उदकं पीत्वा वज्ररूपकलेवराः /
दीर्घायुषश्च नीरोगा भवन्ति कलशोद्भव //
text_mt: The best among men who are devoted to Lalitā, the supreme sovereign, / having drunk its water, have bodies resembling diamond, / and become long-lived and free from illness, O pot-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsureṇa galite mukte vajre śatakratuḥ /
tarayāstīre tapastepe vajreśīṃ prati bhaktimān //
meaning:
भण्डासुरेण गलिते मुक्ते वज्रे शतक्रतुः /
तरयास्तीरे तपस्तेपे वज्रेशीं प्रति भक्तिमान् //
text_mt: When his thunderbolt slipped and was discharged by the demon Bhaṇḍa, the performer of a hundred sacrifices, / full of devotion to Vajreśī, performed asceticism on its bank.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjalāduditā devī vajraṃ dattvā baladviṣe /
punarantardadheso 'pi kṛtārthaḥsvargameyivān //
meaning:
तज्जलादुदिता देवी वज्रं दत्त्वा बलद्विषे /
पुनरन्तर्दधेसो ऽपि कृतार्थःस्वर्गमेयिवान् //
text_mt: The goddess, having arisen from that water and given the thunderbolt to the enemy of Bala, / vanished once more; and he, his purpose achieved, went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vajrākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane /
vaidūryaśāla uttuṅgaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ /
sthālī ca tatra vaidṛryanirmitā bhāsvarākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
अथ वज्राख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
वैदूर्यशाल उत्तुङ्गः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः /
स्थाली च तत्र वैदृर्यनिर्मिता भास्वराकृतिः //
text_mt: Then, within the distance of forty-nine yojanas from the enclosure called Vajra, / is the lofty enclosure of lapis lazuli, endowed with gopuras as before; / and the ground there, fashioned of lapis lazuli, has a radiant appearance.

sanskrit_iast:
pātālavāsino yeye śrīdevyarcanasādhakāḥ /
te siddhamūrtayastatra vasanti sukhamedurāḥ //
meaning:
पातालवासिनो येये श्रीदेव्यर्चनसाधकाः /
ते सिद्धमूर्तयस्तत्र वसन्ति सुखमेदुराः //
text_mt: Whichever practitioners of the worship of the glorious goddess dwell in Pātāla, / possessing perfected bodies, they dwell there, plump with happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣakarkeṭakamahāpadmavāsukiśaṅkhakāḥ /
takṣakaḥ śaṅkhacūḍaśca mahādanto mahāphaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शेषकर्केटकमहापद्मवासुकिशङ्खकाः /
तक्षकः शङ्खचूडश्च महादन्तो महाफणः //
text_mt: Śeṣa, Karkoṭaka, Mahāpadma, Vāsuki, Śaṅkha, / Takṣaka, Śaṅkhacūḍa, Mahādanta, Mahāphaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
ityevamādayastatra nāgā nāgāstrayo 'pi ca /
balīndrapramukhānāṃ ca daityānāṃ dharmavartinām /
gaṇastatra tathā nāgaiḥ sārdhaṃ vasati sāṃganāḥ //
meaning:
इत्येवमादयस्तत्र नागा नागास्त्रयो ऽपि च /
बलीन्द्रप्रमुखानां च दैत्यानां धर्मवर्तिनाम् /
गणस्तत्र तथा नागैः सार्धं वसति सांगनाः //
text_mt: and other serpents such as these, as well as the three serpent-destroyers; / and the host of the righteous Daityas led by the king Bali, / dwells there together with their women along with the Nāgas.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāmantra japtāro lalitāśāstradīkṣitāḥ /
lalitāpūjakā nityaṃ vasantyasurabhoginaḥ //
meaning:
ललितामन्त्र जप्तारो ललिताशास्त्रदीक्षिताः /
ललितापूजका नित्यं वसन्त्यसुरभोगिनः //
text_mt: Mutterers of the mantra of Lalitā, initiated into the scriptures of Lalitā, / worshippers of Lalitā, the Asuras and serpents dwell there eternally.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vaidūryakakṣāyāṃ nadyaḥ śiśirapāthasaḥ /
sarāṃsivimalāṃbhāṃsi sārasālaṅkṛtāni ca //
meaning:
तत्र वैदूर्यकक्षायां नद्यः शिशिरपाथसः /
सरांसिविमलांभांसि सारसालङ्कृतानि च //
text_mt: There, in the enclosure of cat's-eye gems, are rivers of cool water / and lakes of clear waters adorned with cranes.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanāni tu divyāni vaidūryamaṇimanti ca /
teṣu krīḍanti te nāgā asurāśca sahāṅganāḥ //
meaning:
भवनानि तु दिव्यानि वैदूर्यमणिमन्ति च /
तेषु क्रीडन्ति ते नागा असुराश्च सहाङ्गनाः //
text_mt: And there are celestial mansions studded with cat's-eye jewels; / in them those serpents and asuras sport together with their women.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidūryākhyamahāśālāntare mārutayojane /
indranīlamayaḥ śālaścakravāla ivāparaḥ //
meaning:
वैदूर्याख्यमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
इन्द्रनीलमयः शालश्चक्रवाल इवापरः //
text_mt: Within the great rampart called cat's-eye, at a distance of a wind-yojana, / is a rampart made of sapphire, like another horizon.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhyakakṣābhūmiśca nīlaratnamayī mune /
tatra nadyaśca madhurāḥ sarāṃsi śiśirāṇi ca /
nānāvidhāni bhogyāni vastūni sarasānyapi //
meaning:
तन्मध्यकक्षाभूमिश्च नीलरत्नमयी मुने /
तत्र नद्यश्च मधुराः सरांसि शिशिराणि च /
नानाविधानि भोग्यानि वस्तूनि सरसान्यपि //
text_mt: And the ground of the enclosure within it is made of blue gems, O sage; / there are sweet rivers and cool lakes, / and diverse, flavorful objects of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
ye bhūlokagatā martyā lalitāmantrasādhakāḥ /
te dehānte śakranīlakakṣyāṃ prāpya vasaṃti vai //
meaning:
ये भूलोकगता मर्त्या ललितामन्त्रसाधकाः /
ते देहान्ते शक्रनीलकक्ष्यां प्राप्य वसंति वै //
text_mt: Those mortals of the realm of earth who are practitioners of Lalitā's mantra / attain the sapphire enclosure at the end of their bodies and dwell there indeed.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra divyāni vastūni bhuñjānā vanitāsakhāḥ /
pibanto madhuraṃ madyaṃ nṛtyanto bhaktinirbharāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र दिव्यानि वस्तूनि भुञ्जाना वनितासखाः /
पिबन्तो मधुरं मद्यं नृत्यन्तो भक्तिनिर्भराः //
text_mt: There, enjoying celestial objects, accompanied by women, / drinking sweet liquor, dancing, filled with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
sarassu teṣu siṃdhūnāṃ kuleṣu kalaśodbhava /
latāgṛheṣu ramyeṣu mandireṣu maharddhiṣu //
meaning:
सरस्सु तेषु सिंधूनां कुलेषु कलशोद्भव /
लतागृहेषु रम्येषु मन्दिरेषु महर्द्धिषु //
text_mt: in those lakes, on the banks of the rivers, O pot-born [Agastya], / in delightful arbors of creepers and in temples of great opulence,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā japantaḥ śrīdevī paṭhantaścāpi tadguṇān /
nivasaṃti mahābhāgā nārībhiḥ pariveṣṭitāḥ //
meaning:
सदा जपन्तः श्रीदेवी पठन्तश्चापि तद्गुणान् /
निवसंति महाभागा नारीभिः परिवेष्टिताः //
text_mt: constantly repeating the mantra of Śrīdevī and reciting Her virtues, / those highly fortunate ones dwell, surrounded by women.

sanskrit_iast:
karmakṣaye punaryānti bhūloke mānuṣīṃ tanum /
pūrvavāsanayā yuktāḥ punararcanti cakriṇīm /
punaryānti śrīnagare śakranīlamahāsthalīm //
meaning:
कर्मक्षये पुनर्यान्ति भूलोके मानुषीं तनुम् /
पूर्ववासनया युक्ताः पुनरर्चन्ति चक्रिणीम् /
पुनर्यान्ति श्रीनगरे शक्रनीलमहास्थलीम् //
text_mt: When their karma is exhausted, they return to the realm of earth into human bodies; / endowed with their former latent impressions, they worship the Sovereign of the Cakra again, / and return again to the great sapphire plateau in the city of Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsthalasyaiva saṃparkādrāgadveṣasamudbhavaiḥ /
nīlairbhāvaiḥ sadā yuktā vartante manujā mune //
meaning:
तत्स्थलस्यैव संपर्काद्रागद्वेषसमुद्भवैः /
नीलैर्भावैः सदा युक्ता वर्तन्ते मनुजा मुने //
text_mt: Through contact with that very place, mortals abide there always endowed / with blue states of mind arising from attachment and aversion, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ye punarjñānino martyā nirdvandvā niyatendriyāḥ /
te mune vismayāviṣṭāḥ saṃviśanti maheśvarīm //
meaning:
ये पुनर्ज्ञानिनो मर्त्या निर्द्वन्द्वा नियतेन्द्रियाः /
ते मुने विस्मयाविष्टाः संविशन्ति महेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: Yet those mortals who possess knowledge, free from dualities, with senses restrained, / entered by astonishment, enter the Great Goddess, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
indranīlākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane /
muktāphalamayaḥśālaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रनीलाख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
मुक्ताफलमयःशालः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः //
text_mt: Within the rampart called sapphire, at a distance of a wind-yojana, / is a rampart made of pearls, furnished with gateways as before.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantabhāsvarā svacchā tayormadhye sthalī mune /
sarvāpi muktākhacitāḥ śiśirātimanoharāḥ //
meaning:
अत्यन्तभास्वरा स्वच्छा तयोर्मध्ये स्थली मुने /
सर्वापि मुक्ताखचिताः शिशिरातिमनोहराः //
text_mt: The ground between the two is exceedingly radiant and clear, O sage, / entirely inlaid with pearls, cool and extremely delightful.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmraparṇī mahāparṇī sadā muktāphalodakā /
evamādyā mahānadyaḥ pravaranti mahāsthale //
meaning:
ताम्रपर्णी महापर्णी सदा मुक्ताफलोदका /
एवमाद्या महानद्यः प्रवरन्ति महास्थले //
text_mt: The Tāmraparṇī and Mahāparṇī, whose waters are ever full of pearls, / such great rivers flow on that great ground.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ tīreṣu sarve 'pi devalokanivāsinaḥ /
vasaṃti pūrvajanuṣi śrīdevīmantrasādhakāḥ //
meaning:
तासां तीरेषु सर्वे ऽपि देवलोकनिवासिनः /
वसंति पूर्वजनुषि श्रीदेवीमन्त्रसाधकाः //
text_mt: On their banks dwell all the inhabitants of the celestial realm / who were practitioners of Śrīdevī's mantra in their former birth.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādyaṣṭasu bhāgeṣu lokāḥ śakrādigocarāḥ /
muktāśālasya paritaḥ saṃyujya dvāradeśakān //
meaning:
पूर्वाद्यष्टसु भागेषु लोकाः शक्रादिगोचराः /
मुक्ताशालस्य परितः संयुज्य द्वारदेशकान् //
text_mt: In the eight directions beginning with the east are the realms belonging to Śakra and the others, / connecting with the gateway areas all around the pearl rampart.

sanskrit_iast:
muktāśālasya nīlasya dvārayormadhyadeśataḥ /
pūrvabhāge śakralokastatkoṇe vahnilokabhūḥ //
meaning:
मुक्ताशालस्य नीलस्य द्वारयोर्मध्यदेशतः /
पूर्वभागे शक्रलोकस्तत्कोणे वह्निलोकभूः //
text_mt: Between the gateways of the pearl and sapphire ramparts, / in the eastern part is the realm of Śakra; in its corner is the realm of Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyabhāge yamapuraṃ tatra daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ /
sarvatra lalitāmantrajāpī tīvrasvabhāvavān //
meaning:
याम्यभागे यमपुरं तत्र दण्डधरः प्रभुः /
सर्वत्र ललितामन्त्रजापी तीव्रस्वभाववान् //
text_mt: In the southern part is the city of Yama; there the rod-bearing lord, / of fierce nature, chants Lalitā's mantra everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñādharo yamabhaṭaiścitraguptapurogamaiḥ /
sārdhaṃ niyamayatyeva śrīdevīsamayaṃ guhaḥ //
meaning:
आज्ञाधरो यमभटैश्चित्रगुप्तपुरोगमैः /
सार्धं नियमयत्येव श्रीदेवीसमयं गुहः //
text_mt: Carrying out the command, accompanied by Yama's soldiers headed by Citragupta, / the hidden one strictly enforces the sacred ordinance of Śrīdevī.

sanskrit_iast:
guhaśaptāndurācārāllaṃlitādveṣakāriṇaḥ /
kūḍabhaktiparānmūrkhāṃstabdhānatyantadarpitān //
meaning:
गुहशप्तान्दुराचाराल्लंलिताद्वेषकारिणः /
कूडभक्तिपरान्मूर्खांस्तब्धानत्यन्तदर्पितान् //
text_mt: Those cursed by Guha, of wicked conduct, haters of Lalitā, / devoted to deceitful piety, foolish, stiff and extremely arrogant,

sanskrit_iast:
mantracorānkumantrāṃśca kuvidyānaghasaṃśrayān /
nāstikānpāpaśīlāṃśca vṛthaiva prāṇihiṃsakān //
meaning:
मन्त्रचोरान्कुमन्त्रांश्च कुविद्यानघसंश्रयान् /
नास्तिकान्पापशीलांश्च वृथैव प्राणिहिंसकान् //
text_mt: thieves of mantras, users of evil mantras, practitioners of vile sciences, refuges of sin, / nihilists, evil-natured, and those who harm living beings in vain,

sanskrit_iast:
strīdviṣṭāṃllokavidviṣṭānpāṣaṇḍānāṃ hi pālinaḥ /
kālasūtre raurave ca kumbhīpāke ca kumbhaja //
meaning:
स्त्रीद्विष्टांल्लोकविद्विष्टान्पाषण्डानां हि पालिनः /
कालसूत्रे रौरवे च कुम्भीपाके च कुम्भज //
text_mt: haters of women, haters of the world, and protectors of heretics— / into Kālasūtra, Raurava, and Kumbhīpāka, O pot-born [Agastya],

sanskrit_iast:
asipatravane ghore kṛmibhakṣe pratāpane /
lālākṣepe sūcivedhe tathaivāṅgārapātane //
meaning:
असिपत्रवने घोरे कृमिभक्षे प्रतापने /
लालाक्षेपे सूचिवेधे तथैवाङ्गारपातने //
text_mt: into the dreadful Asipatravana, Kṛmibhakṣa, Pratāpana, / Lālākṣepa, Sūcivedha, and likewise into Aṅgārapātana,

sanskrit_iast:
evamādiṣu kaṣṭeṣu narakeṣu ghaṭodbhava /
pātayatyājñayā tasyāḥ śrīdevyāḥ sa mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
एवमादिषु कष्टेषु नरकेषु घटोद्भव /
पातयत्याज्ञया तस्याः श्रीदेव्याः स महौजसः //
text_mt: into such agonizing hells, O jar-born [Agastya], / does that one of great splendor cast [them] by order of that Śrīdevī.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva paścime bhāge nirṛtiḥ khaḍgadhārakaḥ /
rākṣasaṃ lokamāśritya vartate lalitārcakaḥ //
meaning:
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे निरृतिः खड्गधारकः /
राक्षसं लोकमाश्रित्य वर्तते ललितार्चकः //
text_mt: To the west of it is Nirṛti, bearer of the sword; / residing in the rākṣasa realm, he is a worshiper of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cottarabhāge tu dvārayorantasyale /
vāruṇaṃ lokamāśritya varuṇe vartate sadā //
meaning:
तस्य चोत्तरभागे तु द्वारयोरन्तस्यले /
वारुणं लोकमाश्रित्य वरुणे वर्तते सदा //
text_mt: To the north of it, in the space between the gateways, / residing in the realm of Varuṇa, Varuṇa always abides,

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇyāsvādanonmattaḥ śubhrāṅgo jhaṣavāhanaḥ /
sadā śrīdevatāmaṃ trajāpī śrīkramasādhakaḥ //
meaning:
वारुण्यास्वादनोन्मत्तः शुभ्राङ्गो झषवाहनः /
सदा श्रीदेवतामं त्रजापी श्रीक्रमसाधकः //
text_mt: intoxicated by the taste of vāruṇī liquor, fair-bodied, mounted on a fish, / constantly chanting the mantra of the divine Śrī, practicing the Śrīkrama.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevatādarśanasya dveṣiṇaḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ /
baddhvā nayatyadhomārgaṃ bhaktānāṃ bandhamocakaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीदेवतादर्शनस्य द्वेषिणः पाशबन्धनैः /
बद्ध्वा नयत्यधोमार्गं भक्तानां बन्धमोचकः //
text_mt: Binding the haters of the doctrine of the divine Śrī with the bonds of nooses, / he leads them to the downward path, while releasing the bonds of devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cottarakoṇeṣu vāyuloko mahādyutiḥ /
tatra vāyuśarīrāśca sadānandamahodayāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य चोत्तरकोणेषु वायुलोको महाद्युतिः /
तत्र वायुशरीराश्च सदानन्दमहोदयाः //
text_mt: In the northern corner from him is the realm of Vāyu of great luster; / there are those with bodies of wind, full of eternal bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhā divyarṣayaścaiva pavanābhyāsino 'pare /
gorakṣapramukhāścānye yogino yogatatparāḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धा दिव्यर्षयश्चैव पवनाभ्यासिनो ऽपरे /
गोरक्षप्रमुखाश्चान्ये योगिनो योगतत्पराः //
text_mt: siddhas, celestial seers, and others who practice breath control, / Gorakṣa and other principal yogins devoted to yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
etaiḥ saha mahāsattvaktatra śrīmāruteśvaraḥ /
sarvathā bhinnamūrtiśca vartate kumbhasambhava //
meaning:
एतैः सह महासत्त्वक्तत्र श्रीमारुतेश्वरः /
सर्वथा भिन्नमूर्तिश्च वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव //
text_mt: With them, that great-spirited lord of the wind, Śrīmāruteśvara, / abides in a completely distinct form, O pot-born [Agastya].

sanskrit_iast:
iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumṇā tasya śaktayaḥ /
tisro mārutanāthasya sadā madhumadālasāḥ //
meaning:
इडा च पिङ्गला चैव सुषुम्णा तस्य शक्तयः /
तिस्रो मारुतनाथस्य सदा मधुमदालसाः //
text_mt: Iḍā, Piṅgalā, and Suṣumṇā are his three powers; / these three of the lord of the wind are always languid with the intoxication of honey.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajahasto mṛgavare vāhane mahati sthitaḥ /
lalitāyajanadhyānakramapūjanatatparaḥ //
meaning:
ध्वजहस्तो मृगवरे वाहने महति स्थितः /
ललितायजनध्यानक्रमपूजनतत्परः //
text_mt: With banner in hand, mounted on a large, excellent deer as vehicle, / he is devoted to the worship, meditation, and regular ritual of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandapūritāṅgībhiranyābhiḥ śaktibhirvṛtaḥ /
sa māruteśvaraḥ śrīmānsadā japati cakriṇīm //
meaning:
आनन्दपूरिताङ्गीभिरन्याभिः शक्तिभिर्वृतः /
स मारुतेश्वरः श्रीमान्सदा जपति चक्रिणीम् //
text_mt: Surrounded by other powers whose limbs are filled with bliss, / that glorious lord of the wind constantly recites the mantra of the Sovereign of the Cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sattvena kalpānte trailokyaṃ sacarācaram /
parāgamayatāṃ nītvā vinodayati tatkṣaṇāt //
meaning:
तेन सत्त्वेन कल्पान्ते त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् /
परागमयतां नीत्वा विनोदयति तत्क्षणात् //
text_mt: With that power, at the end of an eon, turning the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings / into mere dust, he disperses them in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sattvasya siddhyarthaṃ tāmeva laliteśvarīm /
pūjayanbhāvayannāste sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य सत्त्वस्य सिद्ध्यर्थं तामेव ललितेश्वरीम् /
पूजयन्भावयन्नास्ते सर्वाभरणभूषितः //
text_mt: For the perfection of that power, he sits worshiping / and contemplating that very Laliteśvarī, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tallokapūrvabhāgasthe yakṣaloke mahādyutiḥ /
yakṣendro vasati śrīmāṃstaddvāradvandvamadhyagaḥ //
meaning:
तल्लोकपूर्वभागस्थे यक्षलोके महाद्युतिः /
यक्षेन्द्रो वसति श्रीमांस्तद्द्वारद्वन्द्वमध्यगः //
text_mt: In the realm of the yakṣas situated in the eastern part of that realm, / the glorious, exceedingly radiant king of yakṣas dwells, positioned between the pair of gateways.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhibhiśca navākārairṛddhivṛddhyādiśaktibhiḥ /
sahito lalitābhaktānpūrayandhanasampadā //
meaning:
निधिभिश्च नवाकारैरृद्धिवृद्ध्यादिशक्तिभिः /
सहितो ललिताभक्तान्पूरयन्धनसम्पदा //
text_mt: Together with the nine forms of treasures and powers such as Ṛddhi and Vṛddhi, / fulfilling Lalitā's devotees with wealth and prosperity,

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣībhiśca manojñābhiranukūlapravṛttibhiḥ /
vividhairmadhubhedaiśca sampūjayati cakriṇīm //
meaning:
यक्षीभिश्च मनोज्ञाभिरनुकूलप्रवृत्तिभिः /
विविधैर्मधुभेदैश्च सम्पूजयति चक्रिणीम् //
text_mt: and with charming yakṣa women of agreeable disposition, / he worships the Sovereign of the Cakra with various kinds of liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇibhadraḥ pūrṇabhadro maṇimānmāṇikandharaḥ /
ityevamādayo yakṣasenānyastatra saṃti vai //
meaning:
मणिभद्रः पूर्णभद्रो मणिमान्माणिकन्धरः /
इत्येवमादयो यक्षसेनान्यस्तत्र संति वै //
text_mt: Maṇibhadra, Pūrṇabhadra, Maṇimant, and Māṇikandhara— / such are indeed the commanders of the yakṣas there.

sanskrit_iast:
tallokapūrvabhāge tu rudraloko mahodayaḥ /
anardhyaratnakhacitastatra rudro 'dhidevatā //
meaning:
तल्लोकपूर्वभागे तु रुद्रलोको महोदयः /
अनर्ध्यरत्नखचितस्तत्र रुद्रो ऽधिदेवता //
text_mt: In the eastern part of that realm is the magnificent realm of Rudra, / inlaid with priceless gems; there Rudra is the presiding deity,

sanskrit_iast:
sadaiva manyunā dīptaḥ sadā baddhamaheṣudhiḥ /
svasamānairmahāsattvailoṅkanirvāhadakṣiṇaiḥ //
meaning:
सदैव मन्युना दीप्तः सदा बद्धमहेषुधिः /
स्वसमानैर्महासत्त्वैलोङ्कनिर्वाहदक्षिणैः //
text_mt: ever blazing with fury, his great quiver always strapped on, / surrounded by beings of great might equal to himself, skilled in governing the world,

sanskrit_iast:
adhijyakārmukairdakṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśāvaraṇasthitaiḥ /
āvṛtaḥ satataṃ vaktrairjapañchīdevatāmanum //
meaning:
अधिज्यकार्मुकैर्दक्षैः षोडशावरणस्थितैः /
आवृतः सततं वक्त्रैर्जपञ्छीदेवतामनुम् //
text_mt: with strung bows, adept, stationed in the sixteen enclosures, / constantly chanting the mantra of the divine Śrī with his mouths,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevīdhyānasampannaḥ śrīdevīpūjanotsukaḥ /
anekakoṭirudrāṇīgaṇamaṇḍitapārśvabhūḥ //
meaning:
श्रीदेवीध्यानसम्पन्नः श्रीदेवीपूजनोत्सुकः /
अनेककोटिरुद्राणीगणमण्डितपार्श्वभूः //
text_mt: absorbed in meditation on Śrīdevī, eager to worship Śrīdevī, / the flanks of his seat adorned by groups of many millions of Rudrāṇīs.

sanskrit_iast:
tāśca sarvāḥ pradīptāṅgyo navayauvanagarvitāḥ /
lalitādhyānaniranāḥ sadāsavamadālasāḥ //
meaning:
ताश्च सर्वाः प्रदीप्ताङ्ग्यो नवयौवनगर्विताः /
ललिताध्याननिरनाः सदासवमदालसाः //
text_mt: And all of them have blazing limbs, proud of their fresh youth, / engaged in meditation on Lalitā, always languid with the intoxication of wine.

sanskrit_iast:
tābhiśca sākaṃ sa śrīmānmahārudrastriśūlabhṛt /
hiraṇyabāhupramuśai rudrairanyairniṣevitaḥ //
meaning:
ताभिश्च साकं स श्रीमान्महारुद्रस्त्रिशूलभृत् /
हिरण्यबाहुप्रमुशै रुद्रैरन्यैर्निषेवितः //
text_mt: Together with them, that glorious Mahārudra, trident-bearer, / served by other Rudras headed by Hiraṇyabāhu,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitādarśanabhraṣṭānuddhatāngurudhikkṛtān /
śūlakoṭyā vinirbhidya netrotthaiḥ kaṭupāvakaiḥ //
meaning:
ललितादर्शनभ्रष्टानुद्धतान्गुरुधिक्कृतान् /
शूलकोट्या विनिर्भिद्य नेत्रोत्थैः कटुपावकैः //
text_mt: piercing with the tip of his trident those who have fallen away from the doctrine of Lalitā, arrogant, reproached by their gurus, / and with the harsh fires arising from his eyes

sanskrit_iast:
dahaṃsteṣā vadhūbhṛtyānprajāścaiva vināśayan /
ājñādharo mahāvīro lalitājñāprapālakaḥ //
meaning:
दहंस्तेषा वधूभृत्यान्प्रजाश्चैव विनाशयन् /
आज्ञाधरो महावीरो ललिताज्ञाप्रपालकः //
text_mt: burning them, destroying their wives, servants, and offspring, / the mighty hero obeys the command, guarding the ordinance of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraloke 'tirucire vartate kumbhasambhava /
mahārudrasya tasyarṣe parivārāḥ pramāthinaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रलोके ऽतिरुचिरे वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव /
महारुद्रस्य तस्यर्षे परिवाराः प्रमाथिनः //
text_mt:
O pot-born [Agastya], in the exceedingly charming world of Rudra
there dwell the crushing attendants of that Great Rudra, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
ye rudrāstānasaṃkhyātānko vā vaktuṃ paṭurbhavet /
ye rudrā adhibhūmyāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
ये रुद्रास्तानसंख्यातान्को वा वक्तुं पटुर्भवेत् /
ये रुद्रा अधिभूम्यां तु सहस्राणां सहस्रशः //
text_mt:
Who indeed could be capable of enumerating those countless Rudras?
Those Rudras upon the earth, indeed in their thousands of thousands,

sanskrit_iast:
diviye 'pi ca vartante sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ /
yeṣāmannamiṣaścava yeṣāṃ vātāstatheṣavaḥ //
meaning:
दिविये ऽपि च वर्तन्ते सहस्राणां सहस्रशः /
येषामन्नमिषश्चव येषां वातास्तथेषवः //
text_mt:
And those who abide in heaven, in their thousands of thousands,
whose arrows are food, and whose arrows are likewise the winds,

sanskrit_iast:
yeṣāṃ ca varṣamiṣavaḥ pradīptāḥ piṅgalekṣaṇāḥ /
arṇave cāntarikṣe ca vartamānā mahaujasaḥ //
meaning:
येषां च वर्षमिषवः प्रदीप्ताः पिङ्गलेक्षणाः /
अर्णवे चान्तरिक्षे च वर्तमाना महौजसः //
text_mt:
And whose arrows are rain, blazing, with tawny eyes,
dwelling in the ocean and in the atmosphere, endowed with great might,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāvanto madhuṣmanto nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ /
ye bhūtānāmadhibhuvo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ //
meaning:
जटावन्तो मधुष्मन्तो नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः /
ये भूतानामधिभुवो विशिखासः कपर्दिनः //
text_mt:
Bearing matted hair, sweet, blue-necked, very red,
who are the overlords of beings, hairless or wearing braided hair,

sanskrit_iast:
ye anneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān /
ye pathāṃ rathakā rudrā ye ca tīrthanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
ये अन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिबतो जनान् /
ये पथां रथका रुद्रा ये च तीर्थनिवासिनः //
text_mt:
Who pierce people in their food, and while they drink from vessels,
who are the Rudras who make chariots on paths, and who dwell at sacred fords,

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrasaṃkhyā ye cānye sṛkāvanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ /
lalitājñāpraṇetāro diśo rudrā vitasthire //
meaning:
सहस्रसंख्या ये चान्ये सृकावन्तो निषङ्गिणः /
ललिताज्ञाप्रणेतारो दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे //
text_mt:
And the other thousands who hold missiles and carry quivers—
those Rudras, enforcing the command of Lalitā, have stationed themselves in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve sumahātmānaḥ kṣaṇādviśvatrayīvahāḥ /
śrīdevyā dhyānaniṣaṇātāñchrīdevīmantrajāpinaḥ //
meaning:
ते सर्वे सुमहात्मानः क्षणाद्विश्वत्रयीवहाः /
श्रीदेव्या ध्याननिषणाताञ्छ्रीदेवीमन्त्रजापिनः //
text_mt:
All those very great souls uphold the three worlds in an instant;
seated in meditation upon the glorious goddess, chanting the mantra of the glorious goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevatāyāṃ bhaktāśca pālayanti kṛpālavaḥ /
ṣoḍaśāvaraṇaṃ cakraṃ muktāprākāramaṇḍale //
meaning:
श्रीदेवतायां भक्ताश्च पालयन्ति कृपालवः /
षोडशावरणं चक्रं मुक्ताप्राकारमण्डले //
text_mt:
And devoted to the glorious deity, the compassionate ones protect [all].
Taking their stand in the sixteen-enclosure cakra within the perimeter of pearls,

sanskrit_iast:
āśritya rudrāste sarve mahārudraṃ mahodayam /
hiraṇyabāhupramukhā jvalanmanyumupāsate //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne puṣparāgaprakārādibhuktākarāntasaptakakṣāntarakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
आश्रित्य रुद्रास्ते सर्वे महारुद्रं महोदयम् /
हिरण्यबाहुप्रमुखा ज्वलन्मन्युमुपासते //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने पुष्परागप्रकारादिभुक्ताकरान्तसप्तकक्षान्तरकथनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
All those Rudras, headed by Hiraṇyabāhu,
worship the exalted Great Rudra of blazing wrath.

Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, entitled "The Account of the Interstices of the Seven Enclosures Ending with the Pearl Rampart Beginning with the Topaz Rampart," in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
ṣoḍaśāvaraṇaṃ cakraṃ kiṃ tadrudrādhidaivatam /
tatra sthitāśca rudrāḥ ke kena nāmnā prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
षोडशावरणं चक्रं किं तद्रुद्राधिदैवतम् /
तत्र स्थिताश्च रुद्राः के केन नाम्ना प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
Agastya said:
What is that sixteen-enclosure cakra presiding over by Rudra?
And which Rudras reside there, celebrated by what name?

sanskrit_iast:
keṣvāvaraṇabiṃbeṣu kinnāmāno vasaṃti te /
yaugikaṃ rauḍhikaṃ nāma teṣāṃ brūhi kṛpānidhe //
meaning:
केष्वावरणबिंबेषु किन्नामानो वसंति ते /
यौगिकं रौढिकं नाम तेषां ब्रूहि कृपानिधे //
text_mt:
In which circular enclosures do they live, and with what names?
O treasure of compassion, tell me their etymological and conventional names.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
tatra rudrā layaḥ prokto muktājālakanirmitaḥ /
pañcayojanavistārastatsaṃkhyāyāmaśobhitaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
तत्र रुद्रा लयः प्रोक्तो मुक्ताजालकनिर्मितः /
पञ्चयोजनविस्तारस्तत्संख्यायामशोभितः //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
There, the abode of the Rudras is said to be constructed of pearl nets,
five yojanas in breadth, and adorned with the same measure in length.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśāvaraṇairyukto madhyapīṭhamanoharaḥ /
madhyapīṭhe mahārudro jvalanmanyustrilocanaḥ //
meaning:
षोडशावरणैर्युक्तो मध्यपीठमनोहरः /
मध्यपीठे महारुद्रो ज्वलन्मन्युस्त्रिलोचनः //
text_mt:
Endowed with sixteen enclosures, it has a captivating central seat;
on the central seat is the three-eyed Great Rudra of blazing wrath,

sanskrit_iast:
saccakārmukahastaśca sarvadā vartate mune /
trikoṇe kathitā rudrāstraya eva ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
सच्चकार्मुकहस्तश्च सर्वदा वर्तते मुने /
त्रिकोणे कथिता रुद्रास्त्रय एव घटोद्भव //
text_mt:
Holding a ready bow in his hand, ever abiding [there], O sage.
In the triangle, just three Rudras are mentioned, O pot-born one:

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇya bāhuḥ senānīrdiśāṃpatirathāparaḥ //
meaning: हिरण्य बाहुः सेनानीर्दिशांपतिरथापरः //
text_mt: Hiraṇyabāhu, Senānī, and another, Diśāṃpati.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāśca harikeśāśca tathā paśupatiḥ paraḥ /
śaṣpiñjarastviṣīmāṃśca pathīnāṃ patireva ca //
meaning:
वृक्षाश्च हरिकेशाश्च तथा पशुपतिः परः /
शष्पिञ्जरस्त्विषीमांश्च पथीनां पतिरेव च //
text_mt:
Vṛkṣa and Harikeśa, and next Paśupati,
Śaṣpiñjara, Tviṣīmat, and Pathīnāṃ Pati—

sanskrit_iast:
ete ṣaṭkoṇagāḥ kiṃ ca babhruśāstvaṣṭakoṇake /
vivyādhyannapatiścaiva harikeśopavītinau //
meaning:
एते षट्कोणगाः किं च बभ्रुशास्त्वष्टकोणके /
विव्याध्यन्नपतिश्चैव हरिकेशोपवीतिनौ //
text_mt:
These are situated in the hexagon. Furthermore, in the octagon: Babhruśa,
Vivvyādhin, Annapati, Harikeśa, and Upavītin,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭānāṃ patirapyanyo bhavo hetistathaiva ca /
daśāpatre tvāvaraṇe prathamo jagatāṃ patiḥ //
meaning:
पुष्टानां पतिरप्यन्यो भवो हेतिस्तथैव च /
दशापत्रे त्वावरणे प्रथमो जगतां पतिः //
text_mt:
Another is Puṣṭānāṃ Pati, and likewise Bhava and Heti.
In the ten-petalled enclosure, the first is Jagatāṃ Pati,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrātatāvinau kṣetrapatiḥ sūtastathāparaḥ /
ahaṃ tvanyo vanapatī rohitaḥ sthapatistathā //
meaning:
रुद्रातताविनौ क्षेत्रपतिः सूतस्तथापरः /
अहं त्वन्यो वनपती रोहितः स्थपतिस्तथा //
text_mt:
The two Rudrātātāvins, Kṣetrapati, and another is Sūta;
another is Ahaṃ, then Vanapati, Rohita, and Sthapati,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ patirapyanyaścaite sajjaśarāsanāḥ /
mantrī ca vāṇijaścaiva tathā kakṣapatiḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
वृक्षाणां पतिरप्यन्यश्चैते सज्जशरासनाः /
मन्त्री च वाणिजश्चैव तथा कक्षपतिः परः //
text_mt:
And another is Vṛkṣāṇāṃ Pati—and these have their bows strung—
and Mantrin, Vāṇija, and next Kakṣapati,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantistu caturthaḥ syātpañcamo vārivastataḥ /
oṣadhīnāṃ patiścaiva ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalaśasaṃbhava //
meaning:
भवन्तिस्तु चतुर्थः स्यात्पञ्चमो वारिवस्ततः /
ओषधीनां पतिश्चैव षष्ठः कलशसंभव //
text_mt:
Bhavat should be the fourth, then Vārivas as the fifth,
and the sixth is Oṣadhīnāṃ Pati, O pot-born one.

sanskrit_iast:
uccairghoṣākrandayantau patīnāṃ ca patistathā /
kṛtsnavītaśca dhāvaṃśca sattvānāṃ patireva ca //
meaning:
उच्चैर्घोषाक्रन्दयन्तौ पतीनां च पतिस्तथा /
कृत्स्नवीतश्च धावंश्च सत्त्वानां पतिरेव च //
text_mt:
Uccairghoṣa and Ākrandayat, and then Patīnāṃ Pati,
Kṛtsnavīta, Dhāvat, and Sattvānāṃ Pati—

sanskrit_iast:
ete dvādaśa patrasthāḥ pañcamāvaraṇasthitāḥ /
sahamānaśca nirvyādhiravyādhīnāṃ patistathā //
meaning:
एते द्वादश पत्रस्थाः पञ्चमावरणस्थिताः /
सहमानश्च निर्व्याधिरव्याधीनां पतिस्तथा //
text_mt:
These twelve are situated in petals, abiding in the fifth enclosure.
Sahamāna, Nirvyādhi, and Avyādhīnāṃ Pati,

sanskrit_iast:
kakubhaśca niṣaṅgī ca stenānāṃ ca patistathā /
niceruśceti vijñeyāḥ ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇadevatāḥ //
meaning:
ककुभश्च निषङ्गी च स्तेनानां च पतिस्तथा /
निचेरुश्चेति विज्ञेयाः षष्ठावरणदेवताः //
text_mt:
Kakubha, Niṣaṅgin, and Stenānāṃ Pati,
and Niceru: these are to be known as the deities of the sixth enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ paricaro 'raṇyaḥ patiḥ kiṃ ca sṛkāviṣaḥ /
jighāṃsaṃto muṣṇatāṃ ca patayaḥ kuṃbhasaṃbhava //
meaning:
अधः परिचरो ऽरण्यः पतिः किं च सृकाविषः /
जिघांसंतो मुष्णतां च पतयः कुंभसंभव //
text_mt:
Adhaḥparicara, Araṇyapati, and Sṛkāviṣa,
Jighāṃsat, and Muṣṇatāṃ Pati, O pot-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
asīmantaśca suprājñastathā naktañcaro mune /
prakṛtīnāṃ patiścaiva uṣṇīṣī ca gireścaraḥ //
meaning:
असीमन्तश्च सुप्राज्ञस्तथा नक्तञ्चरो मुने /
प्रकृतीनां पतिश्चैव उष्णीषी च गिरेश्चरः //
text_mt:
Asīmanta, Suprājña, and Naktañcara, O sage,
Prakṛtīnāṃ Pati, Uṣṇīṣin, and Gireścara,

sanskrit_iast:
kuluñcānāṃ patiścaiveṣumantaḥ kalaśodbhava /
dhanvāvidaścātanvānapratipūrvadadhānakāḥ //
meaning:
कुलुञ्चानां पतिश्चैवेषुमन्तः कलशोद्भव /
धन्वाविदश्चातन्वानप्रतिपूर्वदधानकाः //
text_mt:
Kuluñcānāṃ Pati, and Iṣumat, O pot-born one,
Dhanvāvid, Ātanvāna, and Pratidhadhāna,

sanskrit_iast:
āyacchataḥ ṣoḍaśaite ṣoḍaśāranivāsinaḥ /
visṛjantastathāsyanto vidhyantaścāpi siṃdhupa //
meaning:
आयच्छतः षोडशैते षोडशारनिवासिनः /
विसृजन्तस्तथास्यन्तो विध्यन्तश्चापि सिंधुप //
text_mt:
And Āyacchat: these sixteen reside in the sixteen spokes.
Visṛjat, Asyat, and Vidhyat, O ocean-drinker,

sanskrit_iast:
āsīnāśca śayānāśca yanto jāgrata eva ca /
tiṣṭhantaścaiva dhāvantaḥ sabhyāścaiva samādhipāḥ //
meaning:
आसीनाश्च शयानाश्च यन्तो जाग्रत एव च /
तिष्ठन्तश्चैव धावन्तः सभ्याश्चैव समाधिपाः //
text_mt:
Āsīna, Śayāna, Yat, and Jāgrat,
Tiṣṭhat, Dhāvat, Sabhya, and Samādhipa,

sanskrit_iast:
aśvāścaivāśvapataya avyādhinyastathaiva ca /
vividhyanto gaṇādhyakṣā bṛhanto vindhyamarddana //
meaning:
अश्वाश्चैवाश्वपतय अव्याधिन्यस्तथैव च /
विविध्यन्तो गणाध्यक्षा बृहन्तो विन्ध्यमर्द्दन //
text_mt:
Aśva, Aśvapati, and Avyādhinī,
Vividhyat, Gaṇādhyakṣa, and Bṛhanta, O crusher of the Vindhya,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛtsaścāṣṭādaśavidhā devatā aṣṭamāvṛtau /
atha gṛtsādhipatayo vrātā vrātādhipāstathā //
meaning:
गृत्सश्चाष्टादशविधा देवता अष्टमावृतौ /
अथ गृत्साधिपतयो व्राता व्राताधिपास्तथा //
text_mt:
And Gṛtsa—these are the eighteen kinds of deities in the eighth enclosure.
Now the Gṛtsādhipatis, Vrātas, and Vrātādhipas,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇāśca gaṇapāścaiva viśvarupā virūpakāḥ /
mahāntaḥ kṣullakāścaiva rathinaścārathāḥ pare //
meaning:
गणाश्च गणपाश्चैव विश्वरुपा विरूपकाः /
महान्तः क्षुल्लकाश्चैव रथिनश्चारथाः परे //
text_mt:
Gaṇas, Gaṇapas, Viśvarūpa, Virūpaka,
Mahat, Kṣullaka, Rathin, and the other, Aratha,

sanskrit_iast:
rathāśca rathapattyākhyāḥ senāḥ senānya eva ca /
kṣattāraḥ saṃgrahī tārastakṣāṇo rathakārakāḥ //
meaning:
रथाश्च रथपत्त्याख्याः सेनाः सेनान्य एव च /
क्षत्तारः संग्रही तारस्तक्षाणो रथकारकाः //
text_mt:
Rathas, those called Rathapati, Senās, Senānīs,
Kṣattṛs, Saṃgrahītṛs, Takṣans, Rathakāras,

sanskrit_iast:
kulālaśceti rudrāste navamāvṛtidevatāḥ /
karmārāścaiva puñjiṣṭhā niṣādāśceṣukṛdgaṇāḥ //
meaning:
कुलालश्चेति रुद्रास्ते नवमावृतिदेवताः /
कर्माराश्चैव पुञ्जिष्ठा निषादाश्चेषुकृद्गणाः //
text_mt:
And Kulālas: these Rudras are the deities of the ninth enclosure.
Karmāras, Puñjiṣṭhas, Niṣādas, groups of Iṣukṛts,

sanskrit_iast:
dhanvakārā mṛgayavaḥ śvanayaḥ śvāna eva ca /
aśvāścaivaśvapatayo bhavo rudro ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
धन्वकारा मृगयवः श्वनयः श्वान एव च /
अश्वाश्चैवश्वपतयो भवो रुद्रो घटोद्भव //
text_mt:
Dhanvakāras, Mṛgayus, Śvanis, Śvāns,
Aśvas, Aśvapatis, Bhava, and Rudra, O pot-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
śarvaḥ paśupatirnīlagrīvaśca śitikaṇṭhakaḥ /
kapardī vyuptakeśaśca sahasrakṣastathāparaḥ //
meaning:
शर्वः पशुपतिर्नीलग्रीवश्च शितिकण्ठकः /
कपर्दी व्युप्तकेशश्च सहस्रक्षस्तथापरः //
text_mt:
Śarva, Paśupati, Nīlagrīva, Śitikaṇṭha,
Kapardin, Vyuptakeśa, and another, Sahasrākṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
śatadhanvā ca giriśaḥ śipiviṣṭaśca kuṃbhaja /
mīḍhuṣṭama iti proktā rudrā daśamaśālagāḥ //
meaning:
शतधन्वा च गिरिशः शिपिविष्टश्च कुंभज /
मीढुष्टम इति प्रोक्ता रुद्रा दशमशालगाः //
text_mt:
Śatadhanvan, Giriśa, Śipiviṣṭa, O pot-born one,
and Mīḍhuṣṭama: these are declared as the Rudras stationed in the tenth wall.

sanskrit_iast:
athaikādaśacakrasthā iṣumaddhrasvavāmanāḥ /
bṛhaṃśca varṣīyāṃ ścaiva vṛddhaḥ samṛddhinā saha //
meaning:
अथैकादशचक्रस्था इषुमद्ध्रस्ववामनाः /
बृहंश्च वर्षीयां श्चैव वृद्धः समृद्धिना सह //
text_mt:
Now, those residing in the eleventh cakra are: Iṣumat, Hrasva, Vāmana,
Bṛhat, Varṣīyas, Vṛddha together with Samṛddhi,

sanskrit_iast:
agryaḥ prathama āśuścājironyaḥ śīghraśibhyakau /
urmyāvasvanyarudrau ca srotasyo divya eva ca //
meaning:
अग्र्यः प्रथम आशुश्चाजिरोन्यः शीघ्रशिभ्यकौ /
उर्म्यावस्वन्यरुद्रौ च स्रोतस्यो दिव्य एव च //
text_mt:
Agrya, Prathama, Āśu, Ajira, the other, Śīghra, Śibhya,
Urmya, the other Rudra, Vasvanya, Srotasya, Divya,

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhaścaiva kaniṣṭhaśca pūrvajāvarajau tathā /
madhyamaścāvagamyaśca jaghanyaśca ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठश्चैव कनिष्ठश्च पूर्वजावरजौ तथा /
मध्यमश्चावगम्यश्च जघन्यश्च घटोद्भव //
text_mt:
Jyeṣṭha, Kaniṣṭha, Pūrvaja, and Avaraja,
Madhyama, Avagamya, and Jaghanya, O pot-born one—

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatirākhyātā ete rudrā mahābalāḥ /
atha budhnyaḥ somyarudraḥ pratisarpakayāmyakau //
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिराख्याता एते रुद्रा महाबलाः /
अथ बुध्न्यः सोम्यरुद्रः प्रतिसर्पकयाम्यकौ //
text_mt:
These twenty-four are declared as Rudras of great strength.
Then Budhnya, the auspicious Rudra Somya, Pratisarpaka, Yāmya,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemyovocavakhalyaśca tataḥ ślokyāvasānyakau /
vanyaḥ kakṣyaḥ śravaścaiva tato 'nyastu pratiśravaḥ //
meaning:
क्षेम्योवोचवखल्यश्च ततः श्लोक्यावसान्यकौ /
वन्यः कक्ष्यः श्रवश्चैव ततो ऽन्यस्तु प्रतिश्रवः //
text_mt:
Kṣemya, Uccaiḥkhalya, then Ślokya and Avasānya,
Vanya, Kakṣya, Śravas, and another after that, Pratiśravas,

sanskrit_iast:
āśuṣeṇaścāśurathaḥ śūraśca tapasāṃ nidhe /
avabhindaśca varmī ca varūthī bilminā saha //
meaning:
आशुषेणश्चाशुरथः शूरश्च तपसां निधे /
अवभिन्दश्च वर्मी च वरूथी बिल्मिना सह //
text_mt:
Āśuṣeṇa, Āśuratha, and Śūra, O treasure of asceticism,
Avabhindat, Varmin, Varūthin along with Bilmin,

sanskrit_iast:
kavacī ca śrutaścaiva seno dundubhya eva ca /
āhananyaśca dhṛṣṇuśca te ca ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ /
dvādaśāvaraṇasthāste mahākāyā mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
कवची च श्रुतश्चैव सेनो दुन्दुभ्य एव च /
आहनन्यश्च धृष्णुश्च ते च षड्विंशतिः स्मृताः /
द्वादशावरणस्थास्ते महाकाया महाबलाः //
text_mt:
Kavacī, Śruta, Sena, Dundubhya,
Āhananya, and Dhṛṣṇu—they are remembered as twenty-six.
Dwelling in the twelfth enclosure, they have huge bodies and great strength.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhṛśāścaiva dūtāśca prahitāśca nipaṅgiṇaḥ /
anyastviṣudhimānanyastakṣṇeṣuśca tathā yudhi //
meaning:
प्रभृशाश्चैव दूताश्च प्रहिताश्च निपङ्गिणः /
अन्यस्त्विषुधिमानन्यस्तक्ष्णेषुश्च तथा युधि //
text_mt:
Prabhṛśa, Dūtas, Prahitas, and Niṣaṅgins,
another is Iṣudhimat, another is Tīkṣṇeṣu in battle,

sanskrit_iast:
svāyudhaśca sudhanvā ca stutyaḥ pathyaśca kuṃbhaja /
kāpyo nāḍhyastathā sūdhaḥ sarasyo vindhyamardana //
meaning:
स्वायुधश्च सुधन्वा च स्तुत्यः पथ्यश्च कुंभज /
काप्यो नाढ्यस्तथा सूधः सरस्यो विन्ध्यमर्दन //
text_mt: Svāyudha, Sudhanvan, Stutya, and Pathya, O pot-born [Agastya]! / Kāpya, Nāḍhya, Sūdha, and Sarāsya, O crusher of the Vindhya!

sanskrit_iast:
tataścānyo nādhamāno veśantaḥ kupya eva ca /
avadhavarṣyo 'varṣyaśca medhyo vidyutya eva ca //
meaning:
ततश्चान्यो नाधमानो वेशन्तः कुप्य एव च /
अवधवर्ष्यो ऽवर्ष्यश्च मेध्यो विद्युत्य एव च //
text_mt: And next, Nādhamāna, Veśanta, and Kupya, / Avadhāvarṣya, Avarṣya, Medhya, and Vidyutya,

sanskrit_iast:
idhryātapyau tathā vātyau reṣmyaścaiva tathāparaḥ /
vāstavyo vāstupaścaiva somaśceti mahābalāḥ //
meaning:
इध्र्यातप्यौ तथा वात्यौ रेष्म्यश्चैव तथापरः /
वास्तव्यो वास्तुपश्चैव सोमश्चेति महाबलाः //
text_mt: Idhrya, Ātapya, Vātya, and another named Reṣmya, / Vāstavya, Vāstupa, and Soma—these [are] the exceedingly mighty ones.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśāvaraṇagāñchṛṇu rudrāṃśca tānmune /
rudrastāmrāruṇaḥ śaṅgastathā paśupatirmune //
meaning:
त्रयोदशावरणगाञ्छृणु रुद्रांश्च तान्मुने /
रुद्रस्ताम्रारुणः शङ्गस्तथा पशुपतिर्मुने //
text_mt: Hear of those Rudras dwelling in the thirteenth enclosure, O sage: / Rudra, Tāmra, Aruṇa, Śaṅga, and Paśupati, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
ugro bhīmastathaivāgrevadhadūrevadhāvapi /
hantā caiva hanīyāṃśca vṛṣaśca harikeśakaḥ //
meaning:
उग्रो भीमस्तथैवाग्रेवधदूरेवधावपि /
हन्ता चैव हनीयांश्च वृषश्च हरिकेशकः //
text_mt: Ugra, Bhīma, as well as Agrevadha and Dūrevadha, / Hantṛ, Hanīyas, Vṛṣan, and Harikeśa;

sanskrit_iast:
tāraḥ śaṃbhurmayobhūśca śaṅkaraśca mayaskaraḥ /
śivaḥ śivataraścaiva tīrthyaḥ kulyastathaiva ca /
pāryo 'pāryaḥ prataraṇastathā cottaraṇo mune //
meaning:
तारः शंभुर्मयोभूश्च शङ्करश्च मयस्करः /
शिवः शिवतरश्चैव तीर्थ्यः कुल्यस्तथैव च /
पार्यो ऽपार्यः प्रतरणस्तथा चोत्तरणो मुने //
text_mt: Tāra, Śambhu, Mayobhū, Śaṅkara, Mayaskara, / Śiva, Śivatara, Tīrthya, Kulya, / Pārya, Apārya, Prataraṇa, and Uttaraṇa, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
ātaryaśca tathā labhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ phenyastathaiva ca /
caturdaśāvaraṇake kathitā rudradevatāḥ //
meaning:
आतर्यश्च तथा लभ्यः षष्ठः फेन्यस्तथैव च /
चतुर्दशावरणके कथिता रुद्रदेवताः //
text_mt: Ātarya, Labhya, the sixth, and Phenya— / [these] Rudra deities have been described in the fourteenth enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
sikatyaśca pravāhyaśca tatheriṇyastaponidhe /
prapathyaḥ kiṃśilaścaiva kṣayaṇastadanantaram //
meaning:
सिकत्यश्च प्रवाह्यश्च तथेरिण्यस्तपोनिधे /
प्रपथ्यः किंशिलश्चैव क्षयणस्तदनन्तरम् //
text_mt: Sikatya, Pravāhya, and Iriṇya, O treasure of austerity, / Prapathya, Kiṃśila, and immediately after, Kṣayaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kapardī ca pulastyaṃśca goṣṭhyo gṛhyastathaiva ca /
talpayo gehya stathā kāṭyo gahvareṣṭhorudīpakaḥ //
meaning:
कपर्दी च पुलस्त्यंश्च गोष्ठ्यो गृह्यस्तथैव च /
तल्पयो गेह्य स्तथा काट्यो गह्वरेष्ठोरुदीपकः //
text_mt: Kapardin, Pulastin, Goṣṭhya, and Gṛhya, / Talpya, Gehya, Kāṭya, and Gahvareṣṭha who is exceedingly brilliant;

sanskrit_iast:
niveṣṭyaścāpi pāntavyo rathanyaḥ śukya eva ca /
harītyalothā lopyāśca uryyasūrmyai tathā mune //
meaning:
निवेष्ट्यश्चापि पान्तव्यो रथन्यः शुक्य एव च /
हरीत्यलोथा लोप्याश्च उर्य्यसूर्म्यै तथा मुने //
text_mt: Niveṣṭya, Pāntavya, Rathanya, and Śukya, / Harītyala, Lophya, Urvya, and Sūrmya, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
payeyaśca parṇaśaśca tathā vaguramāṇakaḥ /
abhighnanāśiduścaiva prakhidana kirikāstathā //
meaning:
पयेयश्च पर्णशश्च तथा वगुरमाणकः /
अभिघ्ननाशिदुश्चैव प्रखिदन किरिकास्तथा //
text_mt: Payeyya, Parṇaśa, and Vāguramāṇaka, / Abhighnan, Āśidu, Prakhidant, and Kirika;

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ hṛdayaścaiva dvātriṃśadrudradevatāḥ /
vartate sāyudhāḥ prājña nityaṃ pañcādaśāvṛtau //
meaning:
देवानां हृदयश्चैव द्वात्रिंशद्रुद्रदेवताः /
वर्तते सायुधाः प्राज्ञ नित्यं पञ्चादशावृतौ //
text_mt: And Hṛdaya of the gods—these thirty-two Rudra deities / dwell equipped with weapons, O wise one, eternally in the fifteenth enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśe tvāvaraṇake pūrvādidvāravartinaḥ /
vikṣiṇatkāvicinvatkāstathā nirhatanāmakāḥ //
meaning:
षोडशे त्वावरणके पूर्वादिद्वारवर्तिनः /
विक्षिणत्काविचिन्वत्कास्तथा निर्हतनामकाः //
text_mt: Now in the sixteenth enclosure, abiding at the gates beginning with the east, / Vikṣiṇatkas, Vicinvatkas, and those named Nirhatas,

sanskrit_iast:
āmīvaktāśca niṣṭaptā mahārudramupāsate /
iti ṣoḍaśaśāleṣu sthitai rudraiḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
आमीवक्ताश्च निष्टप्ता महारुद्रमुपासते /
इति षोडशशालेषु स्थितै रुद्रैः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Āmīvaktas, and Niṣṭaptas worship the great Rudra. / Thus by the Rudras standing in their thousands across the sixteen enclosures,

sanskrit_iast:
sevitastu mahārudro lalitājñāpravartakaḥ /
vartate jagatāmṛddhyai muktāśāleśakoṇake //
meaning:
सेवितस्तु महारुद्रो ललिताज्ञाप्रवर्तकः /
वर्तते जगतामृद्ध्यै मुक्ताशालेशकोणके //
text_mt: the great Rudra is served, who carries out Lalitā's commands / [and] dwells for the prosperity of the worlds in the northeastern corner of the pearl rampart.

sanskrit_iast:
śatarudriyasaṃkhyātā ete rudrā mahābalāḥ /
lalitābhaktimampannānpālayanti divāniśam /
abhaktāṃllaritādevyāḥ pratyūhairyojayantyamī //
meaning:
शतरुद्रियसंख्याता एते रुद्रा महाबलाः /
ललिताभक्तिमम्पन्नान्पालयन्ति दिवानिशम् /
अभक्तांल्लरितादेव्याः प्रत्यूहैर्योजयन्त्यमी //
text_mt: These mighty Rudras, counted in the Śatarudrīya, / protect day and night those endowed with devotion to Lalitā; / they afflict those who are not devotees of goddess Lalitā with obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ śakrādidikpālā suktāśālaṃ samāśritāḥ /
lalitāparameśvaryāḥ sevāmeva vitanvate //
meaning:
इत्थं शक्रादिदिक्पाला सुक्ताशालं समाश्रिताः /
ललितापरमेश्वर्याः सेवामेव वितन्वते //
text_mt: In this way the guardians of the directions, beginning with Śakra, resorting to the pearl rampart, / perform their service to Lalitā, the Supreme Sovereign.

sanskrit_iast:
atha muktākhyaśālasyāntare mārutayojane /
śālomārakatābhikhyaścaturyojanamucchritaḥ //
meaning:
अथ मुक्ताख्यशालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
शालोमारकताभिख्यश्चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Now, within the pearl rampart, at a distance of forty-nine leagues, / is the rampart named after emerald, four leagues high.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavadgopurādīnā saṃsthānaiśca suśobhitaḥ /
tatra śrīdaṇḍanāthāyā dahanādividiggatāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्ववद्गोपुरादीना संस्थानैश्च सुशोभितः /
तत्र श्रीदण्डनाथाया दहनादिविदिग्गताः //
text_mt: It is beautifully adorned with gateway towers and the like, as before. / There, belonging to Śrī Daṇḍanāthā, situated in the directions beginning with the southeast,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro nilayāḥ proktā mantriṇīgṛhavistarāḥ /
gīticakrarathendrasya yāḥ parvāṇi samāśritāḥ //
meaning:
चत्वारो निलयाः प्रोक्ता मन्त्रिणीगृहविस्तराः /
गीतिचक्ररथेन्द्रस्य याः पर्वाणि समाश्रिताः //
text_mt: four abodes are proclaimed, equal in expanse to the mansion of the Mantriṇī. / The goddesses who resorted to the tiers of the foremost chariot, the Gīticakra,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsuramahāyuddhe tā devyastatra jāgrati /
sarvāḥ sthalyo marakataśreṇibhiḥ khacitāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
भण्डासुरमहायुद्धे ता देव्यस्तत्र जाग्रति /
सर्वाः स्थल्यो मरकतश्रेणिभिः खचिताः शुभाः //
text_mt: during the great battle against the demon Bhaṇḍa, are watchful there. / All the terraces are auspicious and inlaid with rows of emeralds.

sanskrit_iast:
hematālavanāḍhyāśca sarvavastusamākulāḥ /
tatradevyaḥ samastāśca daṇḍanāthāsamaśriyaḥ //
meaning:
हेमतालवनाढ्याश्च सर्ववस्तुसमाकुलाः /
तत्रदेव्यः समस्ताश्च दण्डनाथासमश्रियः //
text_mt: Rich with groves of golden palm trees, filled with every kind of object, / all the goddesses there possess splendor equal to Daṇḍanāthā.

sanskrit_iast:
haloddharṇahalāddharṇamusalāḥ sañcarantyapi /
saṃkhyātītāstālavṛkṣā navasvarṇavicitritāḥ //
meaning:
हलोद्धर्णहलाद्धर्णमुसलाः सञ्चरन्त्यपि /
संख्यातीतास्तालवृक्षा नवस्वर्णविचित्रिताः //
text_mt: Holding raised plows and brandished pestles, they move about. / The palm trees, beyond counting, are variegated with new gold,

sanskrit_iast:
yojanāyatakāṇḍāśca dalairyuktā viśaṅkaṭaiḥ /
hematvaco 'tisusnigdhāḥ sacchāyāḥ phalabhaṅgurāḥ //
meaning:
योजनायतकाण्डाश्च दलैर्युक्ता विशङ्कटैः /
हेमत्वचो ऽतिसुस्निग्धाः सच्छायाः फलभङ्गुराः //
text_mt: with trunks a league long, endowed with wide fronds, / bark of gold, exceedingly sleek, providing shade, and bending with fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
āmūlāgraṃ lambamānāstālā hālāghaṭākulāḥ /
vartante daṇḍanāthāyāḥ prītyarthaṃ śilpibhiḥ kṛtāḥ //
meaning:
आमूलाग्रं लम्बमानास्ताला हालाघटाकुलाः /
वर्तन्ते दण्डनाथायाः प्रीत्यर्थं शिल्पिभिः कृताः //
text_mt: Hanging down from root to crest, filled with jars of liquor, / the palm trees stand, fashioned by craftsmen for the delight of Daṇḍanāthā.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca tālarasāpūraṃ pītvāpītvā madākulāḥ /
jṛṃbhiṇyādyāścakradevyo hetukādyāśca bhairavāḥ //
meaning:
तं च तालरसापूरं पीत्वापीत्वा मदाकुलाः /
जृंभिण्याद्याश्चक्रदेव्यो हेतुकाद्याश्च भैरवाः //
text_mt: Drinking that abundant palm liquor again and again, intoxicated, / the cakra deities beginning with Jṛmbhiṇī and the Bhairavas beginning with Hetuka,

sanskrit_iast:
saptanigrahadevyaśca nṛtyanti madavihvalāḥ /
caturvidikṣu daṇḍinyā yatrayatra mahādṛśaḥ //
meaning:
सप्तनिग्रहदेव्यश्च नृत्यन्ति मदविह्वलाः /
चतुर्विदिक्षु दण्डिन्या यत्रयत्र महादृशः //
text_mt: and the seven deities of restraint dance, frantic with intoxication. / In the four directions of Daṇḍinī, wherever her great gazes [fall],

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pūrvādidigbhāge devīsadṛśavarcasaḥ /
unmattabhairavī cava svapneśī sarvatodiśam //
meaning:
तत्र पूर्वादिदिग्भागे देवीसदृशवर्चसः /
उन्मत्तभैरवी चव स्वप्नेशी सर्वतोदिशम् //
text_mt: there, in the cardinal directions beginning with the east, possessing radiance like the goddess, / are Unmattabhairavī and Svapneśī in all directions.

sanskrit_iast:
nivāso daṇḍanāthāyāḥ kevalaṃ tvābhimānikaḥ /
tasyāstu sevāvāso 'nyo mahāpadmāṭavīsthale /
tatkakṣātidavīyastvānsevārthaṃ tatra tadgṛhaḥ //
meaning:
निवासो दण्डनाथायाः केवलं त्वाभिमानिकः /
तस्यास्तु सेवावासो ऽन्यो महापद्माटवीस्थले /
तत्कक्षातिदवीयस्त्वान्सेवार्थं तत्र तद्गृहः //
text_mt: The residence of Daṇḍanāthā here is purely symbolic; / her abode of service is elsewhere, in the great lotus grove. / Because that enclosure is far distant, her mansion is placed there for the sake of service.

sanskrit_iast:
atho marakatākāre śāle tatsaptayojane /
prākāro vidrumākāraḥ prātararyamapāṭalaḥ //
meaning:
अथो मरकताकारे शाले तत्सप्तयोजने /
प्राकारो विद्रुमाकारः प्रातरर्यमपाटलः //
text_mt: Then, beyond the emerald enclosure, at a distance of seven leagues, / is an enclosure made of coral, pink like the morning sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthalāstu sakalā vidrumaireva nirmitāḥ /
tadvadvidrumasaṃkāśo brahmā nalinaviṣṭaraḥ //
meaning:
तत्र स्थलास्तु सकला विद्रुमैरेव निर्मिताः /
तद्वद्विद्रुमसंकाशो ब्रह्मा नलिनविष्टरः //
text_mt: All the grounds there are built solely of coral; / resembling coral like that, Brahmā, whose seat is a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmalokātsamāgatya sārddhaṃ sarvairmunīśvaraiḥ /
sadā śrīlalitādevyāḥ sevanārthamatandritaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मलोकात्समागत्य सार्द्धं सर्वैर्मुनीश्वरैः /
सदा श्रीललितादेव्याः सेवनार्थमतन्द्रितः //
text_mt: having arrived from the Brahmaloka together with all the foremost sages, / remains ever vigilant to serve Śrī Lalitādevī.

sanskrit_iast:
marīcyādyaiḥ prajāsṛgbhirvartate sākamabdhipa /
caturdaśāpi vidyāstā upavidyāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
मरीच्याद्यैः प्रजासृग्भिर्वर्तते साकमब्धिप /
चतुर्दशापि विद्यास्ता उपविद्याः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: He dwells together with Marīci and the other creators of beings, O ocean-drinker [Agastya]! / The fourteen branches of knowledge, the thousands of secondary branches of knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣṣaṣṭikalāścaiva śarīriṇyo mahattarāḥ /
prākāre vidrumākāre brahmalokasamāśritāḥ /
vartante jagatāmṛddhyai lalitā devatājñayā //
meaning:
चतुष्षष्टिकलाश्चैव शरीरिण्यो महत्तराः /
प्राकारे विद्रुमाकारे ब्रह्मलोकसमाश्रिताः /
वर्तन्ते जगतामृद्ध्यै ललिता देवताज्ञया //
text_mt: and the sixty-four arts, embodied and magnificent, / resorting to the Brahmaloka within the coral-fashioned rampart, / abide for the prosperity of the worlds by command of the deity Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vidrumaśālasyānatare mārutayojane /
māṇikyamaṇḍapasthāne parītaḥ sarvatodiśam /
vartate viṣṇulokastu lalitāsevanotsukaḥ //
meaning:
अथ विद्रुमशालस्यानतरे मारुतयोजने /
माणिक्यमण्डपस्थाने परीतः सर्वतोदिशम् /
वर्तते विष्णुलोकस्तु ललितासेवनोत्सुकः //
text_mt: Now, within the coral rampart, at a distance of forty-nine leagues, / in the pavilion of ruby, encircling on all sides, / lies the world of Viṣṇu, eager to serve Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vaiṣṇavaloke tu viṣṇuḥ sākṣātsanātanaḥ /
caturghā daśadhā caiva tathā dvādaśadhā punaḥ /
vibhinnamūrtiḥ satataṃ vartate mādhavaḥ sadā //
meaning:
तत्र वैष्णवलोके तु विष्णुः साक्षात्सनातनः /
चतुर्घा दशधा चैव तथा द्वादशधा पुनः /
विभिन्नमूर्तिः सततं वर्तते माधवः सदा //
text_mt: In that Vaiṣṇava world, Viṣṇu, the eternal himself, / Mādhava, always abides with distinct forms: / fourfold, tenfold, and twelvefold.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsuramahāyuddhe ye śrīdevīnakhodbhavāḥ /
daśāvatāradevāstu te 'pi māṇikyamaṇḍape //
meaning:
भण्डासुरमहायुद्धे ये श्रीदेवीनखोद्भवाः /
दशावतारदेवास्तु ते ऽपि माणिक्यमण्डपे //
text_mt: The gods of the ten incarnations, who sprang from the fingernails of the venerable Goddess / in the great battle against the demon Bhaṇḍa, they also [dwell] in the ruby pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvakakṣāntarebhyastu tatkakṣāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
uparyācchādanāmātraṃ māṇikyadṛṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वकक्षान्तरेभ्यस्तु तत्कक्षायां विशेषतः /
उपर्याच्छादनामात्रं माणिक्यदृषदां गणैः //
text_mt: Unlike the previous inner enclosures, this enclosure has a special feature: / its upper covering consists entirely of masses of ruby stones.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kakṣāntare devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ /
bhinno dvādaśamūrtyā ca pūrvādyāśāsurakṣati //
meaning:
तत्र कक्षान्तरे देवः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः /
भिन्नो द्वादशमूर्त्या च पूर्वाद्याशासुरक्षति //
text_mt: In that inner enclosure, the Lord bearing conch, discus, and mace, / differentiated into twelve forms, guards the directions beginning with the east.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmbūnadaprabhaścakrī pūrvasyāṃ diśi keśavaḥ /
paścānnārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhī nīlajīmūtasaṃnibhaḥ //
meaning:
जाम्बूनदप्रभश्चक्री पूर्वस्यां दिशि केशवः /
पश्चान्नारायणः शङ्खी नीलजीमूतसंनिभः //
text_mt: Shining like refined gold, bearing a discus, Keśava stands in the eastern quarter; / in the west, Nārāyaṇa bearing a conch, resembling a dark blue raincloud.

sanskrit_iast:
indīvaradalaśyā mo madhumānmādhavo 'vati /
govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve dhanvī candraprabho mahān //
meaning:
इन्दीवरदलश्या मो मधुमान्माधवो ऽवति /
गोविन्दो दक्षिणे पार्श्वे धन्वी चन्द्रप्रभो महान् //
text_mt: Dark as a blue lotus petal, gracious, Mādhava protects; / on the southern side stands Govinda, the great archer, radiant as the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
uttare haladhṛgviṣṇuḥ padmakiñjalkasaṃnibhaḥ /
āgneyyāmaravindābho musalī madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तरे हलधृग्विष्णुः पद्मकिञ्जल्कसंनिभः /
आग्नेय्यामरविन्दाभो मुसली मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: In the north is Viṣṇu holding a plow, resembling the filament of a lotus; / in the southeast, resembling a lotus, Madhusūdana wielding a pestle.

sanskrit_iast:
trivikramaḥ khaḍgapāṇirnairṛtye cvalanaprabhaḥ /
vāyavyāṃ vāmano vajrī taruṇāditya dīptimān //
meaning:
त्रिविक्रमः खड्गपाणिर्नैरृत्ये च्वलनप्रभः /
वायव्यां वामनो वज्री तरुणादित्य दीप्तिमान् //
text_mt: Trivikrama, sword in hand, brilliant as fire, is in the southwest; / in the northwest is Vāmana bearing a thunderbolt, shining like the morning sun.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānyāṃ puṇḍarīkābhaḥ śrīdharaḥ paṭṭiśāyudhaḥ /
vidyutprabho hṛṣīkeśo hyavācyāṃ diśi mudgarī //
meaning:
ईशान्यां पुण्डरीकाभः श्रीधरः पट्टिशायुधः /
विद्युत्प्रभो हृषीकेशो ह्यवाच्यां दिशि मुद्गरी //
text_mt: In the northeast is Śrīdhara, gleaming like a white lotus, armed with a paṭṭiśa; / Hṛṣīkeśa, radiant as lightning, holding a club, is in the southern quarter.

sanskrit_iast:
padmanābhaḥ śārṅgapāṇiḥ sahasrārkasamaprabhaḥ /
māṇikyamaṇḍapasthānamanulomyena veṣṭate //
meaning:
पद्मनाभः शार्ङ्गपाणिः सहस्रार्कसमप्रभः /
माणिक्यमण्डपस्थानमनुलोम्येन वेष्टते //
text_mt: Padmanābha, bow in hand, blazing like a thousand suns, / surrounds the ruby pavilion in clockwise order.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāyudhaḥ sarvaśaktiḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ /
indragopakasaṃkāśaḥ pāśahasto 'parājitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वायुधः सर्वशक्तिः सर्वज्ञः सर्वतोमुखः /
इन्द्रगोपकसंकाशः पाशहस्तो ऽपराजितः //
text_mt: Bearing all weapons, possessing all powers, omniscient, facing everywhere, / resembling a cochineal insect, holding a noose, Aparājita [stands].

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodarastu sarvātmā lalitābhaktinirbharaḥ /
māṇikyamaṇḍapasthānaṃ vilomena viveṣṭate //
meaning:
दामोदरस्तु सर्वात्मा ललिताभक्तिनिर्भरः /
माणिक्यमण्डपस्थानं विलोमेन विवेष्टते //
text_mt: Dāmodara, the Self of all, full of devotion to Lalitā, / surrounds the place of the ruby pavilion in reverse order.

sanskrit_iast:
iti dvādaśabhirdehairbhagavānambujekṣaṇaḥ /
māṇikyamaṇḍapagato viṣṇuloke virājate //
meaning:
इति द्वादशभिर्देहैर्भगवानम्बुजेक्षणः /
माणिक्यमण्डपगतो विष्णुलोके विराजते //
text_mt: Thus the lotus-eyed Lord, through his twelve bodies, / situated in the ruby pavilion, shines in Viṣṇu’s realm.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nānāratnaśālāntare mārutayojane /
sahasrastambhakaṃ nāma maṇḍapaṃ sumanoharam //
meaning:
अथ नानारत्नशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
सहस्रस्तम्भकं नाम मण्डपं सुमनोहरम् //
text_mt: Now, within the enclosure of various gems, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas, / is a most charming pavilion named Sahasrastambhaka.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāratnaistu khacitaṃ nānāratnairalaṅkṛtam /
nānāratnakṛtaśśālastuṅgastatrābhivartate //
meaning:
नानारत्नैस्तु खचितं नानारत्नैरलङ्कृतम् /
नानारत्नकृतश्शालस्तुङ्गस्तत्राभिवर्तते //
text_mt: Inlaid with various gems and adorned with various gems, / there stands a lofty enclosure-wall made of various jewels.

sanskrit_iast:
ekā paṅktiḥ sahasraistu stambhastiyakpravartate /
tādṛśāḥ paṅktayo bahvyaḥ stambhānāṃ tu caturdiśam //
meaning:
एका पङ्क्तिः सहस्रैस्तु स्तम्भस्तियक्प्रवर्तते /
तादृशाः पङ्क्तयो बह्व्यः स्तम्भानां तु चतुर्दिशम् //
text_mt: One row of pillars runs horizontally with a thousand [pillars]; / such rows of pillars are numerous on all four sides.

sanskrit_iast:
uparyācchādanaṃ cāpi pūrvavadratnadārubhiḥ /
śivalokastatra mahāñjāgarti sphuritadyutiḥ //
meaning:
उपर्याच्छादनं चापि पूर्ववद्रत्नदारुभिः /
शिवलोकस्तत्र महाञ्जागर्ति स्फुरितद्युतिः //
text_mt: The roof above is made, as before, with timbers of jewels; / there the great realm of Śiva is awake, radiating brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
śaivāgamā mūrtimantastatrāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ /
nandibhṛṅgimahākālapramukhāstatra cottamāḥ //
meaning:
शैवागमा मूर्तिमन्तस्तत्राष्टाविंशतिः स्मृताः /
नन्दिभृङ्गिमहाकालप्रमुखास्तत्र चोत्तमाः //
text_mt: The twenty-eight Śaiva Āgamas are remembered there as personified; / the foremost beings are there, headed by Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, and Mahākāla.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍviṃśattattvadevāśca gajavaktrāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
śivalokottame tasminsahasrastambhamaṇḍape //
meaning:
षड्विंशत्तत्त्वदेवाश्च गजवक्त्राः सहस्रशः /
शिवलोकोत्तमे तस्मिन्सहस्रस्तम्भमण्डपे //
text_mt: The deities of the twenty-six principles are there, and elephant-faced ones by the thousands; / in that best realm of Śiva, in the thousand-pillared pavilion,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmadhipaścandraśekharaḥ /
lalitājñāpālakaśca lalitājñāpravartakaḥ //
meaning:
ईशानः सर्वविद्यानामधिपश्चन्द्रशेखरः /
ललिताज्ञापालकश्च ललिताज्ञाप्रवर्तकः //
text_mt: the Lord [Śiva], master of all sciences, wearing the crescent moon on his crest, / who maintains the command of Lalitā and executes the command of Lalitā,

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāmantra jāpī ca nityamānandamānasaḥ /
śaivyā dṛṣṭyā svabhaktānāṃ lalitāmantrasiddhaye //
meaning:
ललितामन्त्र जापी च नित्यमानन्दमानसः /
शैव्या दृष्ट्या स्वभक्तानां ललितामन्त्रसिद्धये //
text_mt: muttering the mantra of Lalitā, his mind ever joyful, / with his Śaiva gaze, for the accomplishment of the Lalitā mantra of his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
antarbahistamaḥ puñjanirbhedanapaṭī yasīm /
mahāprakāśarūpāṃ tāṃ medhāśakti prakāśayan //
meaning:
अन्तर्बहिस्तमः पुञ्जनिर्भेदनपटी यसीम् /
महाप्रकाशरूपां तां मेधाशक्ति प्रकाशयन् //
text_mt: manifesting that power of intellect, whose nature is supreme illumination, / supremely skilled in shattering the mass of darkness within and without,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca sahasrastambhamaṇḍape /
vartamāno mahādeva devīḥ śrībhaktinirbharaḥ /
tattacchālānsamāśritya vartate kumbhasaṃbhavaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastya saṃvāde lalitopākhyāne dikpālādiśivalokāntarakathanaṃ nā catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
सर्वज्ञः सर्वकर्ता च सहस्रस्तम्भमण्डपे /
वर्तमानो महादेव देवीः श्रीभक्तिनिर्भरः /
तत्तच्छालान्समाश्रित्य वर्तते कुम्भसंभवः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्य संवादे ललितोपाख्याने दिक्पालादिशिवलोकान्तरकथनं ना चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
omniscient and the agent of all, residing in the thousand-pillared pavilion, / Mahādeva, full of holy devotion to the goddess, / resides having resorted to the respective enclosures, O jar-born one.

Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Intermediate Realms of Śiva and the Guardians of the Quarters,” in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
atha vāpītra yādīnāṃ kakṣyābhedānpracakṣmahe /
eṣāṃ śravaṇamātreṇa jāyate śrīmahodayaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
अथ वापीत्र यादीनां कक्ष्याभेदान्प्रचक्ष्महे /
एषां श्रवणमात्रेण जायते श्रीमहोदयः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Now we will explain the divisions of the enclosures of the triad of reservoirs and the rest; / by the mere hearing of these, great fortune arises.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrastambhaśālasyātaramārutayojane /
mano nāma mahāśālaḥ sarvaratnavicitritaḥ //
meaning:
सहस्रस्तम्भशालस्यातरमारुतयोजने /
मनो नाम महाशालः सर्वरत्नविचित्रितः //
text_mt: Within the enclosure of the thousand pillars, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas, / is the great enclosure-wall named Manas, variegated with all kinds of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavadgopuradvārakapāṭārgalasaṃyutaḥ /
tanmadhyakakṣyābhāgastu sarvāpyamṛtavāpikā //
meaning:
पूर्ववद्गोपुरद्वारकपाटार्गलसंयुतः /
तन्मध्यकक्ष्याभागस्तु सर्वाप्यमृतवापिका //
text_mt: furnished, as before, with city-gate towers, doors, and bolts; / the middle area between the walls is entirely a reservoir of nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
yatpītvā yoginaḥ siddhā vajrakāyā mahābalāḥ /
bhavanti puruṣāḥ prājñāstadeva hi rasāyanam //
meaning:
यत्पीत्वा योगिनः सिद्धा वज्रकाया महाबलाः /
भवन्ति पुरुषाः प्राज्ञास्तदेव हि रसायनम् //
text_mt: drinking which, yogins become accomplished, their bodies like vajra, possessed of great strength, / and men become wise, for that is indeed the elixir of life.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpyāmamṛtamayyāṃ tu vartate toyatāṃ gatam /
tadgandhāghrāṇamātreṇa siddhikāntāpatirbhavet //
meaning:
वाप्याममृतमय्यां तु वर्तते तोयतां गतम् /
तद्गन्धाघ्राणमात्रेण सिद्धिकान्तापतिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: It stands in that reservoir made of nectar, having assumed the state of water; / by the mere smelling of its fragrance, one becomes the lord of the beloved of accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
aspṛśannapi vindhayāre puruṣaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ /
ubhayoḥ śālayoḥ pārśve sudhāvāpītaṭadvaye //
meaning:
अस्पृशन्नपि विन्धयारे पुरुषः क्षीणकल्मषः /
उभयोः शालयोः पार्श्वे सुधावापीतटद्वये //
text_mt: Even without touching it, O subduer of the Vindhya, a man’s sins are destroyed. / On both sides of the two walls, along the two banks of the nectar reservoir,

sanskrit_iast:
adhakrośasamāyāmā anyāssarvāśca vāpikāḥ /
caturyojanadūraṃ tu talaṃ tasyā jalāntare //
meaning:
अधक्रोशसमायामा अन्यास्सर्वाश्च वापिकाः /
चतुर्योजनदूरं तु तलं तस्या जलान्तरे //
text_mt: all the other reservoirs have an extent of half a krośa; / its depth beneath the water is a distance of four yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
sopānāvalayastasyā nānāratnavicitritāḥ /
svarṇavarṇā ratnavarṇāstasyāṃ haṃsāśca sārasāḥ //
meaning:
सोपानावलयस्तस्या नानारत्नविचित्रिताः /
स्वर्णवर्णा रत्नवर्णास्तस्यां हंसाश्च सारसाः //
text_mt: Its series of steps are variegated with various gems; / in it are swans and sārasa cranes, golden-hued and jewel-hued.

sanskrit_iast:
āsphoṭyate taṭadvandvataraṅgairmandacañcalaiḥ /
pakṣiṇastajjalaṃ pītvā rasāyanamayaṃ navam //
meaning:
आस्फोट्यते तटद्वन्द्वतरङ्गैर्मन्दचञ्चलैः /
पक्षिणस्तज्जलं पीत्वा रसायनमयं नवम् //
text_mt: Both banks are gently lapped by undulating ripples; / birds, having drunk that water which is a fresh elixir,

sanskrit_iast:
ajarāmaratāṃ prāptāstatra vindhyaniṣūdana /
sadākūjitalakṣeṇa tatra kāraṇḍavadvijāḥ //
meaning:
अजरामरतां प्राप्तास्तत्र विन्ध्यनिषूदन /
सदाकूजितलक्षेण तत्र कारण्डवद्विजाः //
text_mt: attain freedom from old age and death there, O slayer of the Vindhya; / with perpetual cooing in hundreds of thousands, the kāraṇḍava water-birds there

sanskrit_iast:
japanti lalitādevyā mantrameva mahattaram /
parito vāpikācakrapariveṣaṇabhūyasā //
meaning:
जपन्ति ललितादेव्या मन्त्रमेव महत्तरम् /
परितो वापिकाचक्रपरिवेषणभूयसा //
text_mt: chant the supreme mantra of the goddess Lalitā. / Because it completely encircles the reservoir in abundance,

sanskrit_iast:
na tatra gantu mārgo 'sti naukāvāhanamantarā /
ājñayā kevalaṃ tatra mantriṇī daṇḍanāthayoḥ /
tārā nāma mahāśaktirvartate toraṇeśvarī //
meaning:
न तत्र गन्तु मार्गो ऽस्ति नौकावाहनमन्तरा /
आज्ञया केवलं तत्र मन्त्रिणी दण्डनाथयोः /
तारा नाम महाशक्तिर्वर्तते तोरणेश्वरी //
text_mt: there is no way to go there except by means of a boat. / Solely by the command of Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā, / the great Śakti named Tārā resides there as the mistress of the gateway.

sanskrit_iast:
bahvyastatrotpalaśyāmāstārāyāḥ paricārikāḥ /
ratnanaukāsahasreṇa khelantyo sarasījale //
meaning:
बह्व्यस्तत्रोत्पलश्यामास्तारायाः परिचारिकाः /
रत्ननौकासहस्रेण खेलन्त्यो सरसीजले //
text_mt: There are many female attendants of Tārā, dark like blue water-lilies, / sporting in the water of the lake with a thousand gem-studded boats.

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ pāramāyānti punaryānti paraṃ taṭam /
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādi vādayantyo muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
अपरं पारमायान्ति पुनर्यान्ति परं तटम् /
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गादि वादयन्त्यो मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt: They cross to the other shore and return again to the further bank, / repeatedly playing vīṇās, flutes, mṛdaṅgas, and other instruments.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiśastatra tārāyā nāvikyo navayauvanāḥ /
muhurgāyanti nṛtyanti devyāḥ puṇyatamaṃ yaśaḥ //
meaning:
कोटिशस्तत्र ताराया नाविक्यो नवयौवनाः /
मुहुर्गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति देव्याः पुण्यतमं यशः //
text_mt: There are crores of youthful boatwomen belonging to Tārā; / they constantly sing and dance the most holy glory of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
aritrapāṇayaḥ kāścitkāścicchūgāmbupāṇayaḥ /
pibantyastatsudhātoyaṃ saṃcarantyastarīśataiḥ //
meaning:
अरित्रपाणयः काश्चित्काश्चिच्छूगाम्बुपाणयः /
पिबन्त्यस्तत्सुधातोयं संचरन्त्यस्तरीशतैः //
text_mt: Some hold oars in their hands, some hold cups in their hands; / drinking that nectar-water, they travel in hundreds of boats.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ naukāvāhikānāṃ śaktīnāṃ śyāmalatviṣām /
pradhānabhūtā tārāṃbā jalaughaśamanakṣamā //
meaning:
तासां नौकावाहिकानां शक्तीनां श्यामलत्विषाम् /
प्रधानभूता तारांबा जलौघशमनक्षमा //
text_mt: Of those dark-complexioned Śaktis who propel the boats, / Mother Tārā is the foremost, capable of stilling the surging waters.

sanskrit_iast:
ājñāṃ vinā tayostārā mantriṇīdaṇḍadhārayoḥ /
trinetrasyāpi no datte vāpikāṃbhasi santaram //
meaning:
आज्ञां विना तयोस्तारा मन्त्रिणीदण्डधारयोः /
त्रिनेत्रस्यापि नो दत्ते वापिकांभसि सन्तरम् //
text_mt: Without the command of those two, Mantriṇī and Daṇḍadhārā, / Tārā does not allow even the three-eyed Lord to cross the water of the reservoir.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyantīnāṃ calantīnāṃ naukābhirmaṇicārubhiḥ /
mahārājñī mahaudāryaṃ patantīnāṃ padepade //
meaning:
गायन्तीनां चलन्तीनां नौकाभिर्मणिचारुभिः /
महाराज्ञी महौदार्यं पतन्तीनां पदेपदे //
text_mt: Singing and moving in boats lovely with jewels, / [praising] the supreme generosity of the Great Queen, stumbling at every step,

sanskrit_iast:
pibantīnāṃ madhu bhṛśaṃ māṇikyacaṣakodaraiḥ /
pratinaukaṃ maṇigṛhe vasantīnāṃ manohare //
meaning:
पिबन्तीनां मधु भृशं माणिक्यचषकोदरैः /
प्रतिनौकं मणिगृहे वसन्तीनां मनोहरे //
text_mt: drinking wine copiously from the hollows of ruby cups, / dwelling in delightful gem-built cabins on each boat,

sanskrit_iast:
tārātaraṇiśaktīnāṃ samavāyo 'tisundaraḥ /
kāścinnaukāḥ suvarṇāḍhyāḥ kāścidratnakṛtā mune //
meaning:
तारातरणिशक्तीनां समवायो ऽतिसुन्दरः /
काश्चिन्नौकाः सुवर्णाढ्याः काश्चिद्रत्नकृता मुने //
text_mt: the assembly of Tārā’s boat-Śaktis is exceedingly beautiful. / Some boats are enriched with gold, while some are made of jewels, O sage;

sanskrit_iast:
makarākāramāpannāḥ kāścinnaukā mṛgānanāḥ /
kāścitsiṃhāsanā nāvaḥ kāściddantāvalānanāḥ //
meaning:
मकराकारमापन्नाः काश्चिन्नौका मृगाननाः /
काश्चित्सिंहासना नावः काश्चिद्दन्तावलाननाः //
text_mt: some boats have taken the form of makaras, others have deer faces; / some boats have lion thrones, others have elephant faces.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vicitrarūpābhirnauṅkābhiḥ pariveṣṭitā /
tārāṃbāmahatīṃ naukāmadhigamya virājate //
meaning:
इत्थं विचित्ररूपाभिर्नौङ्काभिः परिवेष्टिता /
तारांबामहतीं नौकामधिगम्य विराजते //
text_mt: Surrounded thus by boats of diverse forms, / Mother Tārā shines, having boarded a magnificent boat.

sanskrit_iast:
anulomavilomābhyāṃ sañcāraṃ vāpikājale /
tanvānā satataṃ tārā kakṣyāmenāṃ hi rakṣati //
meaning:
अनुलोमविलोमाभ्यां सञ्चारं वापिकाजले /
तन्वाना सततं तारा कक्ष्यामेनां हि रक्षति //
text_mt: Continually moving forward and backward in the waters of the reservoir, / Tārā truly protects this enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
manaśālasyāntarāle saptayojanadūrataḥ /
buddhiśāla iti khyātaścaturyojanamucchritaḥ //
meaning:
मनशालस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजनदूरतः /
बुद्धिशाल इति ख्यातश्चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Within the Manas enclosure, at a distance of seven yojanas, / is the enclosure named Buddhi, four yojanas high.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhyakakṣyābhāge 'sti sarvāpyānandavāpikā /
tatra divyaṃ mahāmadyaṃ bakulāmodameduram /
prataptakanakacchāyaṃ tajjalatvena varttate //
meaning:
तन्मध्यकक्ष्याभागे ऽस्ति सर्वाप्यानन्दवापिका /
तत्र दिव्यं महामद्यं बकुलामोदमेदुरम् /
प्रतप्तकनकच्छायं तज्जलत्वेन वर्त्तते //
text_mt: In the middle area between the walls is the entire reservoir of bliss; / there, divine great wine, rich with the fragrance of bakula flowers / and having the hue of molten gold, exists as its water.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandavāpikāgādhāḥ pūrvavatparikīrttitāḥ /
sopānādikramaścaiva pakṣiṇāstatra pūrvavat //
meaning:
आनन्दवापिकागाधाः पूर्ववत्परिकीर्त्तिताः /
सोपानादिक्रमश्चैव पक्षिणास्तत्र पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: The depth of the reservoir of bliss is declared as before; / the arrangement of the steps and the birds there are just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tatratyaṃ salilaṃ madyaṃ pāyampāyaṃ taṭasthitāḥ /
viharanti madonmattāḥ śaktayo madapāṭalāḥ //
meaning:
तत्रत्यं सलिलं मद्यं पायम्पायं तटस्थिताः /
विहरन्ति मदोन्मत्ताः शक्तयो मदपाटलाः //
text_mt: Drinking that watery wine again and again, standing on the banks, / intoxicated Śaktis sport, their faces pink with intoxication.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣācca vāruṇī devī tatra naukādhināyikā /
yāṃ sudhāmālinīmāhuryāmā huramṛteśvarīm //
meaning:
साक्षाच्च वारुणी देवी तत्र नौकाधिनायिका /
