यां सुधामालिनीमाहुर्यामा हुरमृतेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: The goddess Vāruṇī in person is the supreme leader of the boats there, / she whom they call Sudhāmālinī, whom they call Amṛteśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
sā tatra maṇinaukāsthaśaktisenāsamāvṛtā /
īṣadālokamātreṇa trailokyamadadāyinī //
meaning:
सा तत्र मणिनौकास्थशक्तिसेनासमावृता /
ईषदालोकमात्रेण त्रैलोक्यमददायिनी //
text_mt: Surrounded there by an army of Śaktis situated in gem-boats, / she intoxicates the three worlds by a mere glance.

sanskrit_iast:
taruṇāditya saṅkāśa madāraktakapolabhūḥ /
pārijātaprasūnasrakparivītakacācitā //
meaning:
तरुणादित्य सङ्काश मदारक्तकपोलभूः /
पारिजातप्रसूनस्रक्परिवीतकचाचिता //
text_mt: The skin of her cheeks is flushed red with intoxication like the newly risen sun; / she is adorned with hair bound by garlands of pārijāta blossoms,

sanskrit_iast:
vahantī madirāpūrṇaṃ caṣakaṃ loladutpalam /
pakvaṃ piśitakhaṇḍaṃ ca maṇipātre tathānyake //
meaning:
वहन्ती मदिरापूर्णं चषकं लोलदुत्पलम् /
पक्वं पिशितखण्डं च मणिपात्रे तथान्यके //
text_mt: holding a cup full of wine with a moving blue lotus, / and a piece of cooked meat in another jewelled vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
vāruṇītaraṇiśreṇīnāyikā tatra rājate /
sāpyājñayaiva sarveṣāṃ mantriṇīdaṇḍanāthayoḥ /
dadāti vāpītaraṇaṃ trinetrasyāpi nānyathā //
meaning:
वारुणीतरणिश्रेणीनायिका तत्र राजते /
साप्याज्ञयैव सर्वेषां मन्त्रिणीदण्डनाथयोः /
ददाति वापीतरणं त्रिनेत्रस्यापि नान्यथा //
text_mt: Vāruṇī, the commander of the rows of boats, shines there; / she too, only by the command of Mantriṇī and Daṇḍanāthā for all, / grants passage across the reservoir, even to the three-eyed Lord, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
atha buddhimahāśālāntare mārutayojane /
ahaṅkāramahāśālaḥ pūrvavadgopurānvitaḥ //
meaning:
अथ बुद्धिमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
अहङ्कारमहाशालः पूर्ववद्गोपुरान्वितः //
text_mt: Now, within the great Buddhi enclosure, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas, / is the great Ahaṅkāra enclosure, furnished with city-gate towers as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tayostu śālayormadhye kakṣyābhūrakhilā mune /
vimarśavāpikā nāma sauṣumṇāmṛtarūpiṇī //
meaning:
तयोस्तु शालयोर्मध्ये कक्ष्याभूरखिला मुने /
विमर्शवापिका नाम सौषुम्णामृतरूपिणी //
text_mt: Between those two ramparts, O sage, the entire intervening space / is named the step-well of reflection (Vimarśavāpikā), consisting of the nectar of the suṣumṇā.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmahāyogināmantarmano mārutapūritam /
suṣumṇadaṇḍavivare jāgarti paramāmṛtam //
meaning:
तन्महायोगिनामन्तर्मनो मारुतपूरितम् /
सुषुम्णदण्डविवरे जागर्ति परमामृतम् //
text_mt: That supreme nectar awakes in the hollow of the shaft of the suṣumṇā, / when the inner mind of great yogins is filled with breath.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva tasyāḥ salilaṃ vāpikāyāstapodhana /
pūrvavattaṭasopānapakṣinaukā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
तदेव तस्याः सलिलं वापिकायास्तपोधन /
पूर्ववत्तटसोपानपक्षिनौका हि ताः स्मृताः //
text_mt: That very [nectar] is the water of that step-well, O ascetic; / the banks, steps, birds, and boats are mentioned as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra naukeśvarī devī klarukulletiviśrutā /
tamālaśyāmalākārā śyāmakañcukadhāriṇī //
meaning:
तत्र नौकेश्वरी देवी क्लरुकुल्लेतिविश्रुता /
तमालश्यामलाकारा श्यामकञ्चुकधारिणी //
text_mt: There the goddess who is mistress of boats, renowned as Kurukullā, / dark-complexioned like a tamāla tree, wearing a dark bodice,

sanskrit_iast:
naukeśvarībhiranyābhissvasamānābhirāvṛtā /
ratnāritrakarā nityamullasanmadamāṃsalā //
meaning:
नौकेश्वरीभिरन्याभिस्स्वसमानाभिरावृता /
रत्नारित्रकरा नित्यमुल्लसन्मदमांसला //
text_mt: surrounded by other boat-mistresses equal to herself, / holding a jewelled oar in her hand, constantly robust with overflowing intoxication,

sanskrit_iast:
parito bhrāmyati mune maṇinaukādhirohiṇī /
vāpikā payasāgādhā pūrvavatparikīrtitā //
meaning:
परितो भ्राम्यति मुने मणिनौकाधिरोहिणी /
वापिका पयसागाधा पूर्ववत्परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt: wanders all around, O sage, having boarded a jewel-boat. / The step-well is described as before, unfathomable with water.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṅkārasya śālasyāntare mārutayojane /
sūryabiṃbamahāśālaścaturyojana mucchritaḥ //
meaning:
अहङ्कारस्य शालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
सूर्यबिंबमहाशालश्चतुर्योजन मुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Within a distance of forty-nine yojanas from the rampart of ahaṅkāra, / the great rampart of the solar disc stands four yojanas high.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasyāpi mahānāsīdyadabhūdaruṇodayaḥ /
tanmadhyakakṣyā vasudhā khacitā kuravindakaiḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यस्यापि महानासीद्यदभूदरुणोदयः /
तन्मध्यकक्ष्या वसुधा खचिता कुरविन्दकैः //
text_mt: Even of the sun, it was the great [abode] whence the red dawn arose; / the ground in the intervening space between them is inlaid with rubies.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bālātapodgāre lalitā parameśvarī /
atitīvratapastaptvā sūryo 'labhata tāṃ dyutim //
meaning:
तत्र बालातपोद्गारे ललिता परमेश्वरी /
अतितीव्रतपस्तप्त्वा सूर्यो ऽलभत तां द्युतिम् //
text_mt: There, in that radiance of the morning sun, Lalitā is the supreme sovereign; / having performed extremely severe austerity, the sun obtained that brilliance.

sanskrit_iast:
graharāśigaṇāḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇyapi tārakāḥ /
te 'treva hi tapastaptvā lokabhāsakatāṃ gatāḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहराशिगणाः सर्वे नक्षत्राण्यपि तारकाः /
ते ऽत्रेव हि तपस्तप्त्वा लोकभासकतां गताः //
text_mt: All the hosts of planets and zodiacal signs, the lunar mansions, and the stars— / having performed austerity right here, they indeed attained the state of illuminating the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
mārtaṇḍabhairavastatra bhinno dvādaśadhā mune /
śaktibhistaijasībhiśca koṭisaṃkhyābhiranvitaḥ 35.45 /
mahāprakāśarūpaśca madāruṇavilocanaḥ /
kaṅkolitarukhaṇḍeṣu nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ /
vartate vindhyadarpāre pāre yastanmayasthitaḥ //
meaning:
मार्तण्डभैरवस्तत्र भिन्नो द्वादशधा मुने /
शक्तिभिस्तैजसीभिश्च कोटिसंख्याभिरन्वितः 35.45 /
महाप्रकाशरूपश्च मदारुणविलोचनः /
कङ्कोलितरुखण्डेषु नित्यं क्रीडारसोत्सुकः /
वर्तते विन्ध्यदर्पारे पारे यस्तन्मयस्थितः //
text_mt: Mārtaṇḍabhairava is there, divided twelvefold, O sage, / accompanied by blazing powers numbering in crores, / possessing the form of great light, with eyes red with intoxication, / ever eager for the delight of sport in the groves of kaṅkoli trees, / who resides on the farther shore, having overcome the pride of the Vindhya, absorbed in that.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāprakāśanāmrāsti tasya śaktirmahīyasī /
cakṣuṣmatyaparāśaktiśchāyā devī parā smṛtā //
meaning:
महाप्रकाशनाम्रास्ति तस्य शक्तिर्महीयसी /
चक्षुष्मत्यपराशक्तिश्छाया देवी परा स्मृता //
text_mt: His supreme power is named Mahāprakāśā; / another power is Cakṣuṣmatī, and the supreme goddess is recorded as Chāyā.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ tisṛbhi riṣṭābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritaḥ /
lalitāyā maheśānyāḥ sadā vidyā hṛdā japan //
meaning:
इत्थं तिसृभि रिष्टाभिः शक्तिभिः परिवारितः /
ललिताया महेशान्याः सदा विद्या हृदा जपन् //
text_mt: Surrounded thus by these three beloved powers, / he constantly recites in his heart the vidyā of Lalitā, the Great Mistress,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhaktānāmindriyāṇi bhāsvarāṇi prakāśayan /
bahirantastamojālaṃ samūlamavamardayan //
meaning:
तद्भक्तानामिन्द्रियाणि भास्वराणि प्रकाशयन् /
बहिरन्तस्तमोजालं समूलमवमर्दयन् //
text_mt: illuminating the radiant senses of her devotees, / utterly crushing the web of darkness, both outer and inner, down to its roots.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bālātapodgāre bhāti mārtaṇḍabhairavaḥ /
sūryabimbamahāśālāntare mārutayojane //
meaning:
तत्र बालातपोद्गारे भाति मार्तण्डभैरवः /
सूर्यबिम्बमहाशालान्तरे मारुतयोजने //
text_mt: There, in that radiance of the morning sun, shines Mārtaṇḍabhairava. / At a distance of forty-nine yojanas within the great rampart of the solar disc,

sanskrit_iast:
candrabimbamayaḥ śālaścaturyojanamucchritaḥ /
pūrvavadgopuradvārakapāṭārgalasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रबिम्बमयः शालश्चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः /
पूर्ववद्गोपुरद्वारकपाटार्गलसंयुतः //
text_mt: the rampart composed of the lunar disc stands four yojanas high, / provided, as before, with watchtower-gates, doors, and bolts.

sanskrit_iast: tanmadhyabhūḥ samastāpi candrikādvāramucyate //
meaning: तन्मध्यभूः समस्तापि चन्द्रिकाद्वारमुच्यते //
text_mt: The whole ground between them is called Candrikādvāra (Moonlight Gateway).

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva candrikādvāre tapastaptvā sudāruṇam /
atrinetrasamutpannaścandramāḥ kāntimāyayau //
meaning:
तत्रैव चन्द्रिकाद्वारे तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम् /
अत्रिनेत्रसमुत्पन्नश्चन्द्रमाः कान्तिमाययौ //
text_mt: Right there at Candrikādvāra, having performed severe austerity, / the moon, born from the eye of Atri, attained its loveliness.

sanskrit_iast:
atra śrīsomanāthākhyo vartate nirmalākṛtiḥ /
devastralokyatimiradhvaṃsī saṃsāravartakaḥ //
meaning:
अत्र श्रीसोमनाथाख्यो वर्तते निर्मलाकृतिः /
देवस्त्रलोक्यतिमिरध्वंसी संसारवर्तकः //
text_mt: Here resides the god named Śrī Somanātha, of immaculate form, / the destroyer of darkness in the three worlds, the cause of the cycle of existence.

sanskrit_iast:
pibañca ṣakasampūrṇaṃ nirmalaṃ candrikāmṛtam /
saptaviṃśatinakṣatraśaktibhiḥ parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
पिबञ्च षकसम्पूर्णं निर्मलं चन्द्रिकामृतम् /
सप्तविंशतिनक्षत्रशक्तिभिः परिवारितः //
text_mt: Drinking the pure nectar of moonlight that fills his goblet, / surrounded by the powers of the twenty-seven constellations,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā pūrṇanijākāro niṣkalaṅko nijākṛtiḥ /
tatraiva candrikādvāre vartate bhagavāñchaśī //
meaning:
सदा पूर्णनिजाकारो निष्कलङ्को निजाकृतिः /
तत्रैव चन्द्रिकाद्वारे वर्तते भगवाञ्छशी //
text_mt: always complete in his own form, stainless in his own appearance, / the lord moon resides right there at Candrikādvāra.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitāyā japaidhyānaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjāśatairapi /
aśvinyādiyutastatra kālaṃ nayati candramāḥ //
meaning:
ललिताया जपैध्यानैः स्तोत्रैः पूजाशतैरपि /
अश्विन्यादियुतस्तत्र कालं नयति चन्द्रमाः //
text_mt: Through recitations, meditations, hymns of praise, and hundreds of worships of Lalitā, / accompanied by Aśvinī and the others, the moon spends his time there.

sanskrit_iast:
anyāśca śaktayastārānāmadheyāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
santi tasyaiva nikaṭe sā kakṣā tatpra pūritā //
meaning:
अन्याश्च शक्तयस्तारानामधेयाः सहस्रशः /
सन्ति तस्यैव निकटे सा कक्षा तत्प्र पूरिता //
text_mt: And there are other powers named Tārās by the thousands / near him; that enclosure is filled by them.

sanskrit_iast:
atha candrasya śālasyāntare mārutayojane /
śṛṅgāro nāma śālo 'sti caturyojanamucchritaḥ //
meaning:
अथ चन्द्रस्य शालस्यान्तरे मारुतयोजने /
शृङ्गारो नाम शालो ऽस्ति चतुर्योजनमुच्छ्रितः //
text_mt: Now, at a distance of forty-nine yojanas within the rampart of the moon, / there is a rampart named Śṛṅgāra, four yojanas high,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārāgārarūpaistu kaustubhairiva nirmitaḥ /
mahāśṛṅgāraparikhā tanmadhye vasudhākhilā //
meaning:
शृङ्गारागाररूपैस्तु कौस्तुभैरिव निर्मितः /
महाशृङ्गारपरिखा तन्मध्ये वसुधाखिला //
text_mt: fashioned as if with kaustubha gems that are the abodes of erotic sentiment; / the entire ground between them is the great moat of Śṛṅgāra.

sanskrit_iast:
parikhāvalaye tatra śṛṅgārarasapūrite /
śṛṅgāraśaktayaḥ santi nānābhūṣaṇabhāsurāḥ //
meaning:
परिखावलये तत्र शृङ्गाररसपूरिते /
शृङ्गारशक्तयः सन्ति नानाभूषणभासुराः //
text_mt: In that ring of the moat filled with the fluid of erotic sentiment, / there are powers of erotic love, radiant with various ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra naukāsahasreṇa saṃcarantyo madoddhatāḥ /
upāsate sadā sattaṃ naukāsthaṃ kusumāyudham //
meaning:
तत्र नौकासहस्रेण संचरन्त्यो मदोद्धताः /
उपासते सदा सत्तं नौकास्थं कुसुमायुधम् //
text_mt: Moving about there in a thousand boats, haughty with intoxication, / they ever worship the good Flower-Weaponed God (Kāma) who sits in a boat.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu saṃmohayatyeva viśvaṃ sammohanādibhiḥ /
viśikhairakhilāṃllokāṃllalitājñāvaśaṃvadaḥ //
meaning:
स तु संमोहयत्येव विश्वं सम्मोहनादिभिः /
विशिखैरखिलांल्लोकांल्ललिताज्ञावशंवदः //
text_mt: He indeed bewilders the universe with his arrows, beginning with Fascination, / [bewildering] all the worlds, obedient to the command of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatprabhāveṇa saṃmūḍhā mahāpadmāṭavīsthalam /
vanituṃ śuddhaveṣāśca lalitābhaktinirbharāḥ /
sāvadhānena manasā yānti padmāṭadīsthalam //
meaning:
तत्प्रभावेण संमूढा महापद्माटवीस्थलम् /
वनितुं शुद्धवेषाश्च ललिताभक्तिनिर्भराः /
सावधानेन मनसा यान्ति पद्माटदीस्थलम् //
text_mt: Those who are not deluded by his power, pure in dress, / full of devotion to Lalitā, go with an attentive mind / to the site of the Great Lotus Forest (Mahāpadmāṭavī) to serve her.

sanskrit_iast:
na gantuṃ pārayatyeva surasiddhanarāḥ surāḥ /
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāstu śuddhacittāḥ svabhāvataḥ /
tadājñayā paraṃ yānti mahāpadmāṭavīsthalam //
meaning:
न गन्तुं पारयत्येव सुरसिद्धनराः सुराः /
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशास्तु शुद्धचित्ताः स्वभावतः /
तदाज्ञया परं यान्ति महापद्माटवीस्थलम् //
text_mt: Gods, Siddhas, and mortals cannot go at all; / but Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa, who are naturally pure in heart, / go to the site of the Great Lotus Forest solely by her command.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāriṇaśca rāgāndhābahusaṃkalpakalpanāḥ /
mahākulāśca puruṣā vikalpajñānadhūsarāḥ //
meaning:
संसारिणश्च रागान्धाबहुसंकल्पकल्पनाः /
महाकुलाश्च पुरुषा विकल्पज्ञानधूसराः //
text_mt: Men of the world, blinded by passion, full of numerous plans and conceits, / and men of great families, clouded by discursive thoughts,

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtarāgagahanāḥ prauḍhavyāmohadāyinīm /
mahāśṛṅgāraparikhāntarituṃ na vicakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
प्रभूतरागगहनाः प्रौढव्यामोहदायिनीम् /
महाशृङ्गारपरिखान्तरितुं न विचक्षणाः //
text_mt: lost in the dense thicket of profound passion, are not capable / of crossing the great moat of Śṛṅgāra, which bestows deep bewilderment.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādajeyasaindaryastrailokyajanamohanaḥ /
mahāśṛṅgāraparikhādhikārī vartate smaraḥ //
meaning:
यस्मादजेयसैन्दर्यस्त्रैलोक्यजनमोहनः /
महाशृङ्गारपरिखाधिकारी वर्तते स्मरः //
text_mt: Because Smara, of invincible beauty, the enchantress of the people of the three worlds, / is the officer in charge of the great moat of Śṛṅgāra,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya sarvamatikramya mahatāmapi mohanam /
mahāpadmāṭavīṃ gantuṃ na ko 'pi bhavati kṣamaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य सर्वमतिक्रम्य महतामपि मोहनम् /
महापद्माटवीं गन्तुं न को ऽपि भवति क्षमः //
text_mt: no one at all, surpassing him who bewilders even the great, / is capable of going to the Great Lotus Forest.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śṛṅgāraśālasyāntarāle saptayojane /
cintāmaṇigṛhaṃ nāma cakrarājamahālayaḥ //
meaning:
अथ शृङ्गारशालस्यान्तराले सप्तयोजने /
चिन्तामणिगृहं नाम चक्रराजमहालयः //
text_mt: Now, in the space of seven yojanas within the rampart of Śṛṅgāra, / is the house named Cintāmaṇi, the supreme palace of the king of cakras.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhyabhūḥ samastāpi parito ratnabhūṣitā /
mahāpadmāṭavī nāma sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī //
meaning:
तन्मध्यभूः समस्तापि परितो रत्नभूषिता /
महापद्माटवी नाम सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनी //
text_mt: The entire ground in its middle, adorned with jewels all around, / is called the Great Lotus Forest (Mahāpadmāṭavī), the giver of all fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgārākhyāmahākālaparyantaṃ gopuraṃ mune /
caturdikṣvapyevameva gopurāṇāṃ vyavasthitiḥ //
meaning:
शृङ्गाराख्यामहाकालपर्यन्तं गोपुरं मुने /
चतुर्दिक्ष्वप्येवमेव गोपुराणां व्यवस्थितिः //
text_mt: Up to the great rampart named Śṛṅgāra, O sage, there is a gateway; / such is the arrangement of the gateways in all four directions.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadikṣu taduktāni gopurāṇiśata mune /
śālāstu viṃśatiḥ proktāḥ pañcasaṃkhyādhikāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वदिक्षु तदुक्तानि गोपुराणिशत मुने /
शालास्तु विंशतिः प्रोक्ताः पञ्चसंख्याधिकाः शुभाः //
text_mt: A hundred gateways in all directions are thus described, O sage; / and the auspicious ramparts are stated to be twenty-five in number.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmapi śālānāṃ mūlaṃ yojanasaṃmitam /
padmāṭavīsthalaṃ vakṣye sāvadhāno mune śṛṇu //
meaning:
सर्वेषामपि शालानां मूलं योजनसंमितम् /
पद्माटवीस्थलं वक्ष्ये सावधानो मुने शृणु //
text_mt: The base of all the ramparts measures one yojana. / I shall describe the site of the Lotus Forest; listen attentively, O sage.

sanskrit_iast:
samastaratnakhacite tatra ṣaḍyojanāntare /
paritasthalapadmāni mahākāṇḍāni saṃti vai //
meaning:
समस्तरत्नखचिते तत्र षड्योजनान्तरे /
परितस्थलपद्मानि महाकाण्डानि संति वै //
text_mt: Within an interval of six yojanas there, inlaid with all jewels, / there are ground-lotuses with massive stems all around.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇḍāstu yojanāyāmā mṛdubhiḥ kaṇṭakairvṛtāḥ /
patrāṇi tāladaśakamātrāyāmāni saṃti vai //
meaning:
काण्डास्तु योजनायामा मृदुभिः कण्टकैर्वृताः /
पत्राणि तालदशकमात्रायामानि संति वै //
text_mt: The stems are indeed a yojana in length, covered with soft thorns; / the petals are indeed ten tālas in extent.

sanskrit_iast:
kesarāśca sarojānāṃ pañcatālasamāyatāḥ /
daśatālasamunnamraḥ karṇikāḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
केसराश्च सरोजानां पञ्चतालसमायताः /
दशतालसमुन्नम्रः कर्णिकाः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: The filaments of the lotuses are five tālas in length; / the pericarp is stated to be ten tālas high.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantakomalānyatra sadā vikasitāni ca /
navasaurabhahṛdyāni viśaṅkaṭadalāni ca /
bahuśaḥ saṃti padmāni koḍīnāmapi koḍiśaḥ //
meaning:
अत्यन्तकोमलान्यत्र सदा विकसितानि च /
नवसौरभहृद्यानि विशङ्कटदलानि च /
बहुशः संति पद्मानि कोडीनामपि कोडिशः //
text_mt: Here, exceedingly tender and ever blooming, / delightful with fresh fragrance, and having expansive petals, / there are many lotuses, numbering even in tens of millions.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpadmāḍavīkakṣyāpūrvabhāge ghaṭodbhava /
krośonnato vahnirūpo vartulākārasaṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
महापद्माडवीकक्ष्यापूर्वभागे घटोद्भव /
क्रोशोन्नतो वह्निरूपो वर्तुलाकारसंस्थितः //
text_mt: In the eastern part of the enclosure of the Great Lotus Forest, O pot-born [Agastya], / a krośa in height, in the form of fire, situated in a circular shape,

sanskrit_iast:
arddhayojanavistāraḥ kalābhirdaśabhiryutaḥ /
arghyapātramahādhāro vartate kumbhasambhava //
meaning:
अर्द्धयोजनविस्तारः कलाभिर्दशभिर्युतः /
अर्घ्यपात्रमहाधारो वर्तते कुम्भसम्भव //
text_mt: half a yojana wide, endowed with ten digits, / is the great vessel-stand for the arghya offering, O pot-born [sage].

sanskrit_iast:
tadādhārasya paritaḥ śaktayodīptavigrahāḥ /
dhūmrārciḥpramukhā bhānti kalā daśa vibhāvasoḥ //
meaning:
तदाधारस्य परितः शक्तयोदीप्तविग्रहाः /
धूम्रार्चिःप्रमुखा भान्ति कला दश विभावसोः //
text_mt: All around that stand shine the ten digits of the Fire god, / having radiant bodies, headed by Dhūmrārcis.

sanskrit_iast:
dīptatāruṇyalakṣmīkā nānālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ /
ādhārarūpaṃ śrīmantaṃ bhagavantaṃ havirbhujam /
pariṣvajyaiva parito vartante manmathālasāḥ //
meaning:
दीप्ततारुण्यलक्ष्मीका नानालङ्कारभूषिताः /
आधाररूपं श्रीमन्तं भगवन्तं हविर्भुजम् /
परिष्वज्यैव परितो वर्तन्ते मन्मथालसाः //
text_mt: Possessing the charm of blazing youth, adorned with various ornaments, / languid with love, they remain embracing all around / the glorious Lord Fire, who takes the form of the stand.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūmrārciruṣṇā jvalinī jvālinī visphuliṅginī /
suśrīḥsurūpā kapilā havyakavyavahetica /
etā daśakalāḥ proktā vahnerādhārarūpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
धूम्रार्चिरुष्णा ज्वलिनी ज्वालिनी विस्फुलिङ्गिनी /
सुश्रीःसुरूपा कपिला हव्यकव्यवहेतिच /
एता दशकलाः प्रोक्ता वह्नेराधाररूपिणः //
text_mt:
Dhūmrārciḥ, Uṣṇā, Jvalinī, Jvālinī, Visphuliṅginī,
Suśrīḥ, Surūpā, Kapilā, and Havyakavyavahā—
these are declared the ten kalās of Fire serving as the support.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādhāre sthito devaḥ pātrarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ /
sūryastrilokītimirapradhvaṃsaprathitodayaḥ //
meaning:
तत्राधारे स्थितो देवः पात्ररूपं समाश्रितः /
सूर्यस्त्रिलोकीतिमिरप्रध्वंसप्रथितोदयः //
text_mt:
Residing in that support, having assumed the form of the vessel,
is the god Sun, whose rising is famous for destroying the darkness of the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryātmakaṃ tu tatpātraṃ sārddhayojanamunnatam /
yojanāyāmavistāraṃ mahājyotiḥ prakāśitam //
meaning:
सूर्यात्मकं तु तत्पात्रं सार्द्धयोजनमुन्नतम् /
योजनायामविस्तारं महाज्योतिः प्रकाशितम् //
text_mt:
That vessel consisting of the Sun is one and a half yojanas high,
one yojana in length and width, and shines with great light.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpātrātparitaḥ saktavapuṣaḥ putrikā iva /
vartante dvādaśa kalā atibhāsvararociṣaḥ //
meaning:
तत्पात्रात्परितः सक्तवपुषः पुत्रिका इव /
वर्तन्ते द्वादश कला अतिभास्वररोचिषः //
text_mt:
Surrounding that vessel, like figurines adhering to its body,
are twelve kalās of exceedingly brilliant luster:

sanskrit_iast:
tapinī tāpinī dhūmrā marīcirjvalinī ruciḥ /
suṣumṇā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamā //
meaning:
तपिनी तापिनी धूम्रा मरीचिर्ज्वलिनी रुचिः /
सुषुम्णा भोगदा विश्वा बोधिनी धारिणी क्षमा //
text_mt:
Tapinī, Tāpinī, Dhūmrā, Marīci, Jvalinī, Ruci,
Suṣumṇā, Bhogadā, Viśvā, Bodhinī, Dhāriṇī, and Kṣamā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminpātre parānandakāraṇaṃ paramāmṛtam /
sarvauṃṣadhi rasāḍhyaṃ ca hṛdyasaurabhasaṃyutam //
meaning:
तस्मिन्पात्रे परानन्दकारणं परमामृतम् /
सर्वौंषधि रसाढ्यं च हृद्यसौरभसंयुतम् //
text_mt:
In that vessel is the supreme nectar, the cause of supreme bliss,
rich in the juices of all herbs, and endowed with delightful fragrance,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlotpalaiśca kahlārairamlānairatisaurabhaiḥ /
vāsyamānaṃ sadā hṛdyaṃ śītalaṃ laghu nirmalam //
meaning:
नीलोत्पलैश्च कह्लारैरम्लानैरतिसौरभैः /
वास्यमानं सदा हृद्यं शीतलं लघु निर्मलम् //
text_mt:
Ever scented by blue lotuses and unfading, highly fragrant kahlāra water-lilies,
charming, cool, light, and pure,

sanskrit_iast:
caladvīciśatodāraṃ lalitābyarcanocitam /
sadā śabdāyamānaṃ ca bhāsater'canakāraṇam //
meaning:
चलद्वीचिशतोदारं ललिताब्यर्चनोचितम् /
सदा शब्दायमानं च भासतेर्ऽचनकारणम् //
text_mt:
Magnificent with hundreds of moving waves, suitable for the worship of Lalitā,
ever sounding gently, it shines forth as the cause of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarghyamamṛtaṃ proktaṃ niśākarakalāmayam /
tasmiṃstanīyasīrnauṅkā maṇikḷptāḥ samāsthitāḥ /
niśākarakalā hṛdyāḥ krīḍanti navayauvanāḥ //
meaning:
तदर्घ्यममृतं प्रोक्तं निशाकरकलामयम् /
तस्मिंस्तनीयसीर्नौङ्का मणिकॢप्ताः समास्थिताः /
निशाकरकला हृद्याः क्रीडन्ति नवयौवनाः //
text_mt:
That offering of nectar is said to consist of the kalās of the Moon.
In it, seated in slender boats made of jewels,
the charming kalās of the Moon, endowed with fresh youth, disport themselves:

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtā mānadā pūṣṇā tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭī ratirdhṛtiḥ /
śaśinī candrikā kāntirjyotsnā śrīḥ prītiraṅgadā //
meaning:
अमृता मानदा पूष्णा तुष्टिः पुष्टी रतिर्धृतिः /
शशिनी चन्द्रिका कान्तिर्ज्योत्स्ना श्रीः प्रीतिरङ्गदा //
text_mt:
Amṛtā, Mānadā, Pūṣṇā, Tuṣṭi, Puṣṭi, Rati, Dhṛti,
Śaśinī, Candrikā, Kānti, Jyotsnā, Śrī, Prīti, Aṅgadā,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇā pūrṇāmṛtā ceti kalāḥ pīyūṣa rociṣaḥ /
navayauvanasaṃpūrṇāḥ sadā prahasitānanāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्णा पूर्णामृता चेति कलाः पीयूष रोचिषः /
नवयौवनसंपूर्णाः सदा प्रहसिताननाः //
text_mt:
Pūrṇā, and Pūrṇāmṛtā: these kalās of the nectar-rayed [Moon],
endowed with fresh youth, ever have laughing faces.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣṭirṛddhiḥ sthitirmedhā kāntirlakṣmīrdyutirdhṛtiḥ /
jarā siddhiriti proktāḥ krīḍanti brahmaṇaḥ kalāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्टिरृद्धिः स्थितिर्मेधा कान्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्द्युतिर्धृतिः /
जरा सिद्धिरिति प्रोक्ताः क्रीडन्ति ब्रह्मणः कलाः //
text_mt:
Puṣṭi, Ṛddhi, Sthiti, Medhā, Kānti, Lakṣmī, Dyuti, Dhṛti,
Jarā, and Siddhi: thus are declared the kalās of Brahmā that play there.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitiśca pālinī śāntiśceśvarī tatikāmike /
varadāhlādinī prītirdīrghā ceti hareḥ kalāḥ //
meaning:
स्थितिश्च पालिनी शान्तिश्चेश्वरी ततिकामिके /
वरदाह्लादिनी प्रीतिर्दीर्घा चेति हरेः कलाः //
text_mt:
Sthiti, Pālinī, Śānti, Īśvarī, Rati, Kāmikā,
Varadā, Āhlādinī, Prīti, and Dīrghā are the kalās of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
tīkṣṇā raudrī bhayā nidrā tandrā kṣutkrodhinī trapā /
utkārī mṛtyurapyetā roddhryastatra sthitāḥ kālāḥ //
meaning:
तीक्ष्णा रौद्री भया निद्रा तन्द्रा क्षुत्क्रोधिनी त्रपा /
उत्कारी मृत्युरप्येता रोद्ध्र्यस्तत्र स्थिताः कालाः //
text_mt:
Tīkṣṇā, Raudrī, Bhayā, Nidrā, Tandrā, Kṣudh, Krodhinī, Trapā,
Utkārī, and Mṛtyu: these restraining kalās of Kāla are also situated there.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarasya kalāḥ pītāḥ śvetāścaivāruṇāḥ sitāḥ /
catasreva proktāstu śaṅkarasya kalā atha //
meaning:
ईश्वरस्य कलाः पीताः श्वेताश्चैवारुणाः सिताः /
चतस्रेव प्रोक्तास्तु शङ्करस्य कला अथ //
text_mt:
The kalās of Īśvara are yellow, white, crimson, and bright;
and four kalās of Śaṅkara are declared:

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca tridyā śāntistathaiva ca /
indirā dīpikā caiva recikā caiva mocikā //
meaning:
निवृत्तिश्च प्रतिष्ठा च त्रिद्या शान्तिस्तथैव च /
इन्दिरा दीपिका चैव रेचिका चैव मोचिका //
text_mt:
Nivṛtti, Pratiṣṭhā, Vidyā, and likewise Śānti;
Indirā, Dīpikā, Recikā, and Mocikā,

sanskrit_iast:
parā sūkṣmā ca vindhyāre tathā sūkṣmāmṛtā kalā /
jñānāmṛtā vyādhinī ca vyāpinī vyomarūpikā /
etāṃ ṣoḍaśa saṃproktāstatra krīḍanti śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
परा सूक्ष्मा च विन्ध्यारे तथा सूक्ष्मामृता कला /
ज्ञानामृता व्याधिनी च व्यापिनी व्योमरूपिका /
एतां षोडश संप्रोक्तास्तत्र क्रीडन्ति शक्तयः //
text_mt:
Parā, Sūkṣmā, Vindhyā, Sūkṣmāmṛtā-kalā,
Jñānāmṛtā, Vyādhinī, Vyāpinī, and Vyomarūpikā—
these sixteen Śaktis declared disport there.

sanskrit_iast:
rudranaukāsamārūḍhāstataścetaśca cañcalāḥ /
śaktirupeṇa khelanti tatra vidyāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रनौकासमारूढास्ततश्चेतश्च चञ्चलाः /
शक्तिरुपेण खेलन्ति तत्र विद्याः सहस्रशः //
text_mt:
Mounted on boats of Rudra, restless hither and thither,
thousands of Vidyās play there in the form of Śaktis.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyasaṃśodhanārthāya kalpitāḥ parameṣṭhinā /
tadarghyamamṛtaṃ pītvā sadā mādyanti śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
अर्घ्यसंशोधनार्थाय कल्पिताः परमेष्ठिना /
तदर्घ्यममृतं पीत्वा सदा माद्यन्ति शक्तयः //
text_mt:
Ordained by Parameṣṭhin for the consecration of the arghya offering,
having drunk that offering of nectar, the Śaktis are ever exhilarated.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpadmāṭavīvāsā mahācakrasthitā api /
muhurmuhurnavanavaṃ muhuscābaddhasaurabham //
meaning:
महापद्माटवीवासा महाचक्रस्थिता अपि /
मुहुर्मुहुर्नवनवं मुहुस्चाबद्धसौरभम् //
text_mt:
Dwelling in the great lotus-forest and situated on the great cakra,
again and again [they bring] ever-fresh fragrance of tied blossoms.

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakumbhasahasraiśca suvarṇaghaṭakoṭibhiḥ /
āpūryāpūrya satataṃ tadarghyamamṛtaṃ mahat //
meaning:
रत्नकुम्भसहस्रैश्च सुवर्णघटकोटिभिः /
आपूर्यापूर्य सततं तदर्घ्यममृतं महत् //
text_mt:
Constantly filling again and again with thousands of jewel-jars
and tens of millions of golden pots, that great arghya offering of nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhasthānāṃ paricārakaśaktayaḥ /
aṇimādikaśaktīnāmarghyayanti madoddhatāḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहस्थानां परिचारकशक्तयः /
अणिमादिकशक्तीनामर्घ्ययन्ति मदोद्धताः //
text_mt:
The attendant Śaktis of the deities residing in the Cintāmaṇi palace,
haughty with intoxication, present the offering to the Śaktis of Aṇimā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpadmāṭavīkakṣyāpūrvabhāger'ghyakalpanam /
ittha samīritaṃ paścāttatrānyadapi kathyate //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne mahāpadmāṭavyārghyasthāpanakathanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
महापद्माटवीकक्ष्यापूर्वभागेर्ऽघ्यकल्पनम् /
इत्थ समीरितं पश्चात्तत्रान्यदपि कथ्यते //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने महापद्माटव्यार्घ्यस्थापनकथनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus has been described the preparation of the arghya offering in the eastern portion
of the enclosure of the great lotus-forest; next, the rest there will also be told.

Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Establishment of the Arghya in the Great Lotus-Forest,' in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya in the Latter Part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
cintāmaṇigṛhasyāgnidigbhāge kundamānakam /
yojanāyāmavistāraṃ yojanocchāsacātakam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
चिन्तामणिगृहस्याग्निदिग्भागे कुन्दमानकम् /
योजनायामविस्तारं योजनोच्छासचातकम् //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva said:
In the south-eastern direction of the Cintāmaṇi palace there is a fire-pit of like measure,
one yojana in length and breadth, and one yojana in depth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra jvalati cidvahniḥ sudhādhārāśatārcitaḥ /
paramaiśvaryajanakaḥ pāvano lalitājñayā //
meaning:
तत्र ज्वलति चिद्वह्निः सुधाधाराशतार्चितः /
परमैश्वर्यजनकः पावनो ललिताज्ञया //
text_mt:
There burns the fire of Consciousness, worshiped with a hundred streams of nectar,
generator of supreme sovereignty, purifying by the command of Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
anindhano mahājvālaḥ sudhayā tarpitākṛtiḥ /
kaṅkolīpallavacchāyastatra jvalati cicchikhī //
meaning:
अनिन्धनो महाज्वालः सुधया तर्पिताकृतिः /
कङ्कोलीपल्लवच्छायस्तत्र ज्वलति चिच्छिखी //
text_mt:
Fuel-less, having great flames, its form gratified with nectar,
possessing the hue of Kaṅkoli sprouts, the fire of Consciousness blazes there.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra hotrī mahādevī hotā kāmeśvaraḥ paraḥ /
ubhau tau nityahotārau rakṣataḥ sakalaṃ jagat //
meaning:
तत्र होत्री महादेवी होता कामेश्वरः परः /
उभौ तौ नित्यहोतारौ रक्षतः सकलं जगत् //
text_mt:
There the supreme goddess is the Hotrī-priestess, and supreme Kāmeśvara is the Hotṛ-priest;
those two, the eternal sacrificers, protect the entire world.

sanskrit_iast:
anuttaraparādhīnā lalitā saṃpravartitā /
lalitācoditaḥ kāmaḥ śaṅkareṇa pravartitaḥ //
meaning:
अनुत्तरपराधीना ललिता संप्रवर्तिता /
ललिताचोदितः कामः शङ्करेण प्रवर्तितः //
text_mt:
Dependent upon the supreme Anuttarā, Lalitā has set it in motion;
impelled by Lalitā, Kāma was set in motion by Śaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast: cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya rakṣobhāgembujāṭavau //
meaning: चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य रक्षोभागेम्बुजाटवौ //
text_mt: In the south-western quarter of the sovereign Cintāmaṇi palace, in the lotus-forest,

sanskrit_iast:
cakrarājarathaśreṣṭhastiṣṭhatyunnatavigrahaḥ /
navabhiḥ parvabhiryuktaḥ sarvaratnamayākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
चक्रराजरथश्रेष्ठस्तिष्ठत्युन्नतविग्रहः /
नवभिः पर्वभिर्युक्तः सर्वरत्नमयाकृतिः //
text_mt:
Stands the excellent chariot Cakrarāja, possessing an elevated frame,
endowed with nine tiers, made entirely of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
caturyojanavistāro daśayojanamunnataḥ /
yathottare hrāsayuktaḥ sthūlataḥ kūbarojjvalaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्योजनविस्तारो दशयोजनमुन्नतः /
यथोत्तरे ह्रासयुक्तः स्थूलतः कूबरोज्ज्वलः //
text_mt:
Four yojanas wide, ten yojanas high,
diminishing successively towards the top, shining with a thick carriage-pole,

sanskrit_iast:
caturvedamahācakraḥ puruṣārthamahāhayaḥ /
tattvairu pacaradbhiśca cāmarairabhimaṇḍitaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्वेदमहाचक्रः पुरुषार्थमहाहयः /
तत्त्वैरु पचरद्भिश्च चामरैरभिमण्डितः //
text_mt:
Having the four Vedas as its great wheels, the ends of human life as its great horses,
and adorned with whisk-fans attendant upon the cosmic principles.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktalakṣaṇairyukto muktācchatreṇa śobhitaḥ /
bhaṇḍāsuramahāyuddhe kṛtasāhasikakriyaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तलक्षणैर्युक्तो मुक्ताच्छत्रेण शोभितः /
भण्डासुरमहायुद्धे कृतसाहसिकक्रियः //
text_mt:
Endowed with the aforementioned characteristics, adorned with a pearl parasol,
it performed daring deeds in the great battle against the demon Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
vartate rathamūrdhanyaḥ śrīdevyāsanapāṭitaḥ /
cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya vāyubhāgembujāṭavau //
meaning:
वर्तते रथमूर्धन्यः श्रीदेव्यासनपाटितः /
चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य वायुभागेम्बुजाटवौ //
text_mt:
This foremost of chariots, fashioned as a seat for the glorious goddess, stands there.
In the north-western quarter of the sovereign Cintāmaṇi palace, in the lotus-forest,

sanskrit_iast:
geyacakrarathendrastu mantriṇyāḥ prāntatiṣṭhati /
cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya rudrabhāgembujāṭavau //
meaning:
गेयचक्ररथेन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रिण्याः प्रान्ततिष्ठति /
चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य रुद्रभागेम्बुजाटवौ //
text_mt:
The supreme chariot Geyacakra stands on the border of Mantriṇī;
and in the north-eastern quarter of the sovereign Cintāmaṇi palace, in the lotus-forest,

sanskrit_iast:
vallabho daṇḍanāthāyāḥ kiricakre mahārathaḥ /
etadrathatrayaṃ sarvakṣetraśrīpurapaktiṣu /
samānameva vijñeyamaṅgasthā devatā yathā //
meaning:
वल्लभो दण्डनाथायाः किरिचक्रे महारथः /
एतद्रथत्रयं सर्वक्षेत्रश्रीपुरपक्तिषु /
समानमेव विज्ञेयमङ्गस्था देवता यथा //
text_mt:
The great chariot Kiricakra, beloved of Daṇḍanāthā, [stands].
This triad of chariots should be known as identical in all the ranks
of the sacred fields of Śrīpura, like the deities residing on the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
ānalaṃ kuṇḍamāgneye yattiṣṭhati sadā jvalat /
taptametattu gāyatrī taptaṃ syāda bhayaṅkaram //
meaning:
आनलं कुण्डमाग्नेये यत्तिष्ठति सदा ज्वलत् /
तप्तमेतत्तु गायत्री तप्तं स्याद भयङ्करम् //
text_mt:
The fiery pit which stands ever blazing in the south-east—
this, heated by Gāyatrī, becomes terrible.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛṇisūryastu tatpaścād oṃkārasya ca mandiram /
devī turīyagāyatrī cakṣuṣmatyapi tāpasa //
meaning:
घृणिसूर्यस्तु तत्पश्चाद् ओंकारस्य च मन्दिरम् /
देवी तुरीयगायत्री चक्षुष्मत्यपि तापस //
text_mt:
Behind that is Ghṛṇisūrya, and the temple of the syllable Om;
the goddess Turīyagāyatrī, and also Cakṣuṣmatī, O ascetic,

sanskrit_iast:
atha gandharvarājaśca pariṣadrudra eva ca /
tārāṃbikā bhagavatī tatpaścādbhāgataḥ sthitāḥ //
meaning:
अथ गन्धर्वराजश्च परिषद्रुद्र एव च /
तारांबिका भगवती तत्पश्चाद्भागतः स्थिताः //
text_mt:
And then the Gandharva king, and the assembly of Rudras,
and the venerable Mother Tārā stand situated to the rear.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya rakṣobhāgaṃ samāśritaḥ /
nāmatraya pahāmantravācyo 'sti bhagavānhariḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य रक्षोभागं समाश्रितः /
नामत्रय पहामन्त्रवाच्यो ऽस्ति भगवान्हरिः //
text_mt:
Situated in the south-western quarter of the sovereign Cintāmaṇi palace
is the venerable Lord Hari, who is designated by the great mantra of three names.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāgaṇapatistasyottarasaṃśritaketanaḥ /
pañcākṣarīmantravācyastasya cāpyuttare śivaḥ //
meaning:
महागणपतिस्तस्योत्तरसंश्रितकेतनः /
पञ्चाक्षरीमन्त्रवाच्यस्तस्य चाप्युत्तरे शिवः //
text_mt:
Mahāgaṇapati has his abode to the north of him;
and to his north is Śiva, designated by the five-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mṛtyuñjayeśaśca vācyartryakṣaramātrataḥ /
sarasvatī dhāraṇākhyā hyasya cottaravāsinī //
meaning:
अथ मृत्युञ्जयेशश्च वाच्यर्त्र्यक्षरमात्रतः /
सरस्वती धारणाख्या ह्यस्य चोत्तरवासिनी //
text_mt:
Then Lord Mṛtyuñjaya, expressed by merely three syllables;
and Sarasvatī, known as Dhāraṇā, dwells to his north.

sanskrit_iast:
akārādikṣakārāntavarṇamūrtestu mandiram /
mātṛkāyā uttaratastasyāṃ vindhyaniṣūdana //
meaning:
अकारादिक्षकारान्तवर्णमूर्तेस्तु मन्दिरम् /
मातृकाया उत्तरतस्तस्यां विन्ध्यनिषूदन //
text_mt:
North of Mātṛkā, whose temple consists of the phonemes from 'a' to 'kṣa',
in that direction, O crusher of the Vindhya,

sanskrit_iast:
uttare sampadeśī vai kālasaṃkarṣaṇī tathā /
śrīmahāśambhunāthā ca devyāvirbhāvakāraṇam //
meaning:
उत्तरे सम्पदेशी वै कालसंकर्षणी तथा /
श्रीमहाशम्भुनाथा च देव्याविर्भावकारणम् //
text_mt:
To the north are Sampadeśī, and likewise Kālasaṃkarṣaṇī,
and Śrīmahāśambhunāthā, the cause of the appearance of the goddess;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīḥ parāṃbā ca viśadajyotsnā nirmalavigrahā /
uttarottarametāstu devatāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ //
meaning:
श्रीः परांबा च विशदज्योत्स्ना निर्मलविग्रहा /
उत्तरोत्तरमेतास्तु देवताः कृतमन्दिराः //
text_mt:
And Śrī Parāmbā, whose pure form is like clear moonlight.
These deities have their temples built successively to the north.

sanskrit_iast:
bālācaivānnapūrṇā ca hayārūḍhā tathaiva ca /
śrīpādukācatasrastaduttarottaramandirāḥ //
meaning:
बालाचैवान्नपूर्णा च हयारूढा तथैव च /
श्रीपादुकाचतस्रस्तदुत्तरोत्तरमन्दिराः //
text_mt:
Bālā, Annapūrṇā, Hayārūḍhā,
and the four Śrīpādukās have their temples successively north of them.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya vāyavyavasudhāditaḥ /
mahāpadmāṭavau tvanyā devatāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य वायव्यवसुधादितः /
महापद्माटवौ त्वन्या देवताः कृतमन्दिराः //
text_mt: Starting from the northwestern territory of the king of Cintāmaṇi mansions, / other deities have made their dwellings in the great lotus forest:

sanskrit_iast:
unmattabhairavī caiva svapnavārāhikā parā /
tiraskaraṇikāṃbā ca tathānyā pañcamī parā //
meaning:
उन्मत्तभैरवी चैव स्वप्नवाराहिका परा /
तिरस्करणिकांबा च तथान्या पञ्चमी परा //
text_mt: Unmattabhairavī indeed, and supreme Svapnavārāhikā, / and Mother Tiraskaraṇikā, as well as another fifth supreme [deity].

sanskrit_iast:
yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtagṛhā etā devyo mahodayāḥ /
śrīpūrtiśca mahādevī śrīmahāpādukāpi ca //
meaning:
यथापूर्वं कृतगृहा एता देव्यो महोदयाः /
श्रीपूर्तिश्च महादेवी श्रीमहापादुकापि च //
text_mt: These highly fortunate goddesses have their houses constructed as before, / and the great goddess Śrīpūrti, and also Śrīmahāpādukā;

sanskrit_iast:
yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtagṛhe dve ete devatottame /
śaṅkareṇa ṣaḍāmnāyasāgare pratipāditāḥ /
yā vidyāstāḥ samastāśca mahāpadmāṭavīsthale //
meaning:
यथापूर्वं कृतगृहे द्वे एते देवतोत्तमे /
शङ्करेण षडाम्नायसागरे प्रतिपादिताः /
या विद्यास्ताः समस्ताश्च महापद्माटवीस्थले //
text_mt: these two highest deities have their dwellings constructed as before. / And all the vidyās that were expounded by Śaṅkara in the ocean of the six Āmnāyas / [are situated] in the expanse of the great lotus forest.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ śrīraśmimālāyā maṇikḷptā gahāgṛhāḥ /
uccadhvajā uccaśālāssasopānāstapodhana //
meaning:
इत्थं श्रीरश्मिमालाया मणिकॢप्ता गहागृहाः /
उच्चध्वजा उच्चशालास्ससोपानास्तपोधन //
text_mt: In this manner, of the glorious garland of rays, deep mansions are fashioned of jewels, / with high banners, high halls, and stairs, O ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhendrasya pūrvadvāre samudrapa /
dakṣiṇe pārśvabhāgetu mantrināthāgṛhaṃ mahat //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहेन्द्रस्य पूर्वद्वारे समुद्रप /
दक्षिणे पार्श्वभागेतु मन्त्रिनाथागृहं महत् //
text_mt: At the eastern gate of the king of Cintāmaṇi mansions, O drinker of the ocean, / on the right side is the great dwelling of Mantrināthā.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmabhāge daṇḍanāthābhavanaṃ ratnanirmitam /
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmardhyasthānamya pūrvataḥ //
meaning:
वामभागे दण्डनाथाभवनं रत्ननिर्मितम् /
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानामर्ध्यस्थानम्य पूर्वतः //
text_mt: On the left side is the mansion of Daṇḍanāthā, made of jewels. / To the east of the offering-place of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavanaṃ dīpitāśeṣadikcakraṃ ratnaraśmibhiḥ /
samastā devatā etā lalitābhaktinirbharāḥ /
lalitāmantrajāpyāśca śrīdevīṃ samupāsate //
meaning:
भवनं दीपिताशेषदिक्चक्रं रत्नरश्मिभिः /
समस्ता देवता एता ललिताभक्तिनिर्भराः /
ललितामन्त्रजाप्याश्च श्रीदेवीं समुपासते //
text_mt: stands a mansion illuminating the entire circle of quarters with the rays of its gems. / All these deities, filled with devotion to Lalitā / and chanting Lalitā's mantra, worship the glorious goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvokta mardhyasthānaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ cārdhyakalpanam /
yāmyadvāraprabhṛtiṣu sarveṣvapi samaṃ smṛtam //
meaning:
पूर्वोक्त मर्ध्यस्थानं च पूर्वोक्तं चार्ध्यकल्पनम् /
याम्यद्वारप्रभृतिषु सर्वेष्वपि समं स्मृतम् //
text_mt: The previously stated offering-place and the previously stated arrangement of the offering / are known to be the same at all [gates], beginning with the southern gate.

sanskrit_iast:
atha cintāmaṇigṛhaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu mahāmune /
tacchrīpaṭṭanamadhyasthaṃ yojanadvayavismṛtam //
meaning:
अथ चिन्तामणिगृहं वक्ष्ये शृणु महामुने /
तच्छ्रीपट्टनमध्यस्थं योजनद्वयविस्मृतम् //
text_mt: Now I shall describe the Cintāmaṇi mansion; listen, O great sage: / situated in the center of that glorious city, it extends for two yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya cintāmaṇibhayī bhittiḥ kośasuvistṛtā /
cintāmaṇiśilābhiśca cchādinībhistathopari //
meaning:
तस्य चिन्तामणिभयी भित्तिः कोशसुविस्तृता /
चिन्तामणिशिलाभिश्च च्छादिनीभिस्तथोपरि //
text_mt: Its wall, consisting of cintāmaṇi, extends for a kośa; / and above it is covered with cintāmaṇi slabs

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvṛtā kūṭarūpeṇa tatratatra samunnatā /
gṛhabhittistathonnamrā caturyojanamānataḥ //
meaning:
संवृता कूटरूपेण तत्रतत्र समुन्नता /
गृहभित्तिस्तथोन्नम्रा चतुर्योजनमानतः //
text_mt: in the form of pinnacles, elevated here and there. / Likewise, the house-wall rises to a height of four yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśatiryojanaṃ tasyāśconnamrā bhūmirucyate /
tatordhvaṃ hrāsasaṃyuktaṃ sthaulyatrimukuṭojjvalā //
meaning:
विंशतिर्योजनं तस्याश्चोन्नम्रा भूमिरुच्यते /
ततोर्ध्वं ह्राससंयुक्तं स्थौल्यत्रिमुकुटोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: Its elevated base is said to be twenty yojanas; / above that, tapering in thickness, it shines with three crowns.

sanskrit_iast:
tāni cecchākriyājñānarūpāṇi mukuṭānyṛṣe /
sadā dedīpyamānāni cintāmaṇimayānyapi //
meaning:
तानि चेच्छाक्रियाज्ञानरूपाणि मुकुटान्यृषे /
सदा देदीप्यमानानि चिन्तामणिमयान्यपि //
text_mt: And those crowns, O sage, are in the form of will, action, and knowledge, / ever blazing and also made of cintāmaṇi.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhe sarvaṃ cintāmaṇimayaṃ smṛtam /
yasya dvārāṇi catvāri krośārdhāyāmabhāñji ca //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहे सर्वं चिन्तामणिमयं स्मृतम् /
यस्य द्वाराणि चत्वारि क्रोशार्धायामभाञ्जि च //
text_mt: In the Cintāmaṇi mansion everything is known to be composed of cintāmaṇi, / which has four gates half a krośa in height,

sanskrit_iast:
krośārddhārddhaṃ ca vistāro dvārāṇāṃ kathito mune /
dvāreṣu sarveṣu punaścintāmaṇigṛhāntare //
meaning:
क्रोशार्द्धार्द्धं च विस्तारो द्वाराणां कथितो मुने /
द्वारेषु सर्वेषु पुनश्चिन्तामणिगृहान्तरे //
text_mt: and the width of the gates is stated to be half of half a krośa, O sage. / Furthermore, in all the gates within the Cintāmaṇi mansion,

sanskrit_iast:
pihitā lalitā devyā mūtarlohitasindhuvat /
taruṇārkasahasrābhā candravacchītalā hyapi /
muhuḥ pravāharūpeṇa prasarantī mahāmune //
meaning:
पिहिता ललिता देव्या मूतर्लोहितसिन्धुवत् /
तरुणार्कसहस्राभा चन्द्रवच्छीतला ह्यपि /
मुहुः प्रवाहरूपेण प्रसरन्ती महामुने //
text_mt: [a light] covered by goddess Lalitā, like an ocean of liquid red, / resembling a thousand rising suns and yet cool like the moon, / repeatedly surges forth like a torrent, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāmnāya mayaṃ caiva pūrvadvāraṃ prakīrtitam /
dakṣiṇadvāradeśastu dakṣiṇāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वाम्नाय मयं चैव पूर्वद्वारं प्रकीर्तितम् /
दक्षिणद्वारदेशस्तु दक्षिणाम्नायलक्षणः //
text_mt: The eastern gate is proclaimed to consist of the eastern Āmnāya; / the region of the southern gate has the nature of the southern Āmnāya.

sanskrit_iast:
paścimadvāradeśastu paścimāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ /
uttaradvāradeśaḥ syāduttarāmnāyalakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
पश्चिमद्वारदेशस्तु पश्चिमाम्नायलक्षणः /
उत्तरद्वारदेशः स्यादुत्तराम्नायलक्षणः //
text_mt: The region of the western gate has the nature of the western Āmnāya; / the region of the northern gate has the nature of the northern Āmnāya.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛharājasyāntarāle bhittau khacitadaṇḍakāḥ /
ratnapradīpā bhāsvantaḥ koṭyarkasadṛśatviṣaḥ /
paritastatra vartante bhāsayanto gṛhāntaram //
meaning:
गृहराजस्यान्तराले भित्तौ खचितदण्डकाः /
रत्नप्रदीपा भास्वन्तः कोट्यर्कसदृशत्विषः /
परितस्तत्र वर्तन्ते भासयन्तो गृहान्तरम् //
text_mt: In the interior of that king of mansions, fastened to the walls on pillars, / luminous gem-lamps with the splendor of ten million suns / stand all around, illuminating the interior of the mansion.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇigṛhasyāsya madhyasthāne mahīyasi /
atyuccairvedikābhāge binducakraṃ mahāttaram //
meaning:
चिन्तामणिगृहस्यास्य मध्यस्थाने महीयसि /
अत्युच्चैर्वेदिकाभागे बिन्दुचक्रं महात्तरम् //
text_mt: In the exceedingly great central place of this Cintāmaṇi mansion, / on an exceptionally high altar section, lies the very great Binducakra.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāratnagṛhottuṅgabhintterbindośca madhyabhūḥ /
bhittiḥ krośaṃ parityajya krośatrayamudāhṛtam //
meaning:
चिन्तारत्नगृहोत्तुङ्गभिन्त्तेर्बिन्दोश्च मध्यभूः /
भित्तिः क्रोशं परित्यज्य क्रोशत्रयमुदाहृतम् //
text_mt: Leaving aside the wall of one krośa, the intermediate ground between / the lofty wall of the Cintāmaṇi mansion and the bindu is said to be three krośas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra krośatrayasthāne hyaṇimādyātmarociṣā /
krośatrayaṃ samastaṃ taddhastasaṃkhyāprakārataḥ /
caturviṃśatisāhasrahastaiḥ saṃmitamucyate //
meaning:
तत्र क्रोशत्रयस्थाने ह्यणिमाद्यात्मरोचिषा /
क्रोशत्रयं समस्तं तद्धस्तसंख्याप्रकारतः /
चतुर्विंशतिसाहस्रहस्तैः संमितमुच्यते //
text_mt: There, in that space of three krośas, by the intrinsic radiance of Aṇimā and the others, / that entire [space of] three krośas, reckoned according to the measure of cubits, / is said to measure twenty-four thousand cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
bindupīṭheśaparyamtaṃ caturdaśavibhedataḥ /
antare bhedite jāte hastasaṃkhyā mayocyate //
meaning:
बिन्दुपीठेशपर्यम्तं चतुर्दशविभेदतः /
अन्तरे भेदिते जाते हस्तसंख्या मयोच्यते //
text_mt: Up to the lord of the Bindupīṭha, divided into fourteen distinctions, / when the interior space is separated, the number of cubits is told by me.

sanskrit_iast:
padmāṭavīsthalāccintāmaṇiveśmāntaraṃ mune /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ tatra syuraṇimādayaḥ //
meaning:
पद्माटवीस्थलाच्चिन्तामणिवेश्मान्तरं मुने /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं तत्र स्युरणिमादयः //
text_mt: From the site of the lotus forest to the interior of the Cintāmaṇi mansion, O sage, / it rises twenty cubits; there Aṇimā and the others abide.

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimāntaravistāraścaturnalvasamanvitaḥ /
kiṣkuścatuḥśatī nalvakiṣkurhasta udīryate //
meaning:
अणिमान्तरविस्तारश्चतुर्नल्वसमन्वितः /
किष्कुश्चतुःशती नल्वकिष्कुर्हस्त उदीर्यते //
text_mt: The width within the enclosure of Aṇimā measures four nalvas. / Four hundred kiṣkus make a nalva; a kiṣku is declared to be a cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāntare 'ṇimādyāstu pūrvādikṛtamandirāḥ /
aṇimā mahimā caiva laghimā garimā tathā //
meaning:
तत्रान्तरे ऽणिमाद्यास्तु पूर्वादिकृतमन्दिराः /
अणिमा महिमा चैव लघिमा गरिमा तथा //
text_mt: In that space, Aṇimā and the others have their dwellings arranged starting from the east: / Aṇimā and Mahimā, Laghimā, and Garimā,

sanskrit_iast:
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca prākāmyaṃ muktireva ca /
icchā prāptiḥ sarvakāmetyetāḥ siddhaya uttamāḥ //
meaning:
ईशित्वं च वशित्वं च प्राकाम्यं मुक्तिरेव च /
इच्छा प्राप्तिः सर्वकामेत्येताः सिद्धय उत्तमाः //
text_mt: Īśitva, Vaśitva, Prākāmya, and Mukti, / Icchā, Prāpti, and Sarvakāmā: these are the superior siddhis.

sanskrit_iast:
rasasiddhirmokṣasiddhirbalasiddhistathaiva ca /
khaḍgasiddhiḥ pādukāyā siddhirañjanasiddhikaḥ //
meaning:
रससिद्धिर्मोक्षसिद्धिर्बलसिद्धिस्तथैव च /
खड्गसिद्धिः पादुकाया सिद्धिरञ्जनसिद्धिकः //
text_mt: The siddhi of elixirs, the siddhi of liberation, and likewise the siddhi of strength, / the sword-siddhi, the shoe-siddhi, and the collyrium-siddhi,

sanskrit_iast:
vāksiddhirlokasiddhiśca dehasiddhiranantaram /
etā aṣṭau siddhayastu bahvyo 'nyā yogisaṃmatāḥ //
meaning:
वाक्सिद्धिर्लोकसिद्धिश्च देहसिद्धिरनन्तरम् /
एता अष्टौ सिद्धयस्तु बह्व्यो ऽन्या योगिसंमताः //
text_mt: the speech-siddhi, the realm-siddhi, and next the bodily-siddhi: / these eight siddhis and many others are approved by the yogins.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāntare tu paritaḥ sevate parameśvarīm /
koṭiśaḥ siddhayastasminnaṇimādyantare mune //
meaning:
तत्रान्तरे तु परितः सेवते परमेश्वरीम् /
कोटिशः सिद्धयस्तस्मिन्नणिमाद्यन्तरे मुने //
text_mt: In that interior space all around, they serve the Supreme Goddess; / by the crores are the siddhis in that enclosure of Aṇimā and the others, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
navalāvaṇyasaṃpūrṇāḥ smayamānamukhāṃbujāḥ /
jvalaccintāmaṇi karāḥ madā ṣoḍaśavarṣikāḥ /
atyudāraprakṛtayaḥ khelanti madavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
नवलावण्यसंपूर्णाः स्मयमानमुखांबुजाः /
ज्वलच्चिन्तामणि कराः मदा षोडशवर्षिकाः /
अत्युदारप्रकृतयः खेलन्ति मदविह्वलाः //
text_mt: endowed with fresh beauty, their lotus-faces smiling, / with blazing cintāmaṇis in their hands, constantly looking sixteen years old, / of exceedingly noble nature, sporting playfully, intoxicated with delight.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṇimādyantarasyopariṣṭātsumanoharam /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram //
meaning:
तस्याणिमाद्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्सुमनोहरम् /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Above that enclosure of Aṇimā and the others, delightful, / rising twenty cubits, four nalvas in width,

sanskrit_iast:
caturdikṣu ca sopānapaṅktibhiḥ sumanoharam /
brahmādyaṃbaradhiṣṇyaṃ syāttatradevīḥ sthitāḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
चतुर्दिक्षु च सोपानपङ्क्तिभिः सुमनोहरम् /
ब्रह्माद्यंबरधिष्ण्यं स्यात्तत्रदेवीः स्थिताः शृणु //
text_mt: and delightful with flights of stairs on all four sides, / is the celestial abode of Brahmā and the others. Hear the goddesses stationed there:

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā /
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍāpyatha saptamī /
mahālakṣmīraṣṭamī tu tatraitāḥ kṛtamandirāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मी माहेश्वरी चैव कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा /
वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डाप्यथ सप्तमी /
महालक्ष्मीरष्टमी तु तत्रैताः कृतमन्दिराः //
text_mt: Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, and Vaiṣṇavī, / Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍā as the seventh, / and Mahālakṣmī as the eighth—these have made their dwellings there.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhāyudhāḍhyāśca nānāśaktiparicchadāḥ /
pūrvādidiśamārabhya prādakṣiṇyakṛtālayāḥ //
meaning:
नानाविधायुधाढ्याश्च नानाशक्तिपरिच्छदाः /
पूर्वादिदिशमारभ्य प्रादक्षिण्यकृतालयाः //
text_mt: Rich in weapons of various kinds, possessing various powers and retinue, / they have their abodes arranged clockwise, beginning from the eastern direction.

sanskrit_iast:
atha brāhyantarā tasyopariṣṭātkumbhasaṃbhava /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
mudrāntaramiti traidhaṃ tatra mudrāḥ kṛtālayāḥ //
meaning:
अथ ब्राह्यन्तरा तस्योपरिष्टात्कुम्भसंभव /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
मुद्रान्तरमिति त्रैधं तत्र मुद्राः कृतालयाः //
text_mt: Then above that enclosure of Brāhmī, O pot-born [Agastya], / rising twenty cubits, four nalvas in width, / is the enclosure of mudrās, threefold; there the mudrās have made their abode:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣobhadrāvaṇākarṣavaśyonmādamahāṅkuśāḥ /
khecarī bījayonyākhyā trikhaṇḍā daśamī punaḥ //
meaning:
संक्षोभद्रावणाकर्षवश्योन्मादमहाङ्कुशाः /
खेचरी बीजयोन्याख्या त्रिखण्डा दशमी पुनः //
text_mt: Saṃkṣobhaṇī, Drāvaṇī, Ākarṣiṇī, Vaśyā, Unmādinī, Mahāṅkuśā, / Khecarī, Bījamudrā, Yonimudrā, and Trikhaṇḍā as the tenth.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādidiśamārabhya mudrā etāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
atyantasundarākārā navayauvanavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वादिदिशमारभ्य मुद्रा एताः प्रतिष्ठिताः /
अत्यन्तसुन्दराकारा नवयौवनविह्वलाः //
text_mt: Beginning from the eastern direction, these mudrās are established, / of exceedingly beautiful form, impassioned with fresh youth,

sanskrit_iast:
kāntibhiḥ kamanīyābhiḥ pūrayantyo gṛhāntaram /
sevante muniśārdūla lalitāparameśvarīm //
meaning:
कान्तिभिः कमनीयाभिः पूरयन्त्यो गृहान्तरम् /
सेवन्ते मुनिशार्दूल ललितापरमेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: filling the interior of the mansion with captivating splendors; / they serve the supreme sovereign Lalitā, O tiger among sages.

sanskrit_iast:
antaraṃ trayametattu cakraṃ trailokyamohanam /
etasmiñchaktayo yāsu tā uktāḥ prakaṭābhidhāḥ //
meaning:
अन्तरं त्रयमेतत्तु चक्रं त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् /
एतस्मिञ्छक्तयो यासु ता उक्ताः प्रकटाभिधाः //
text_mt: These three intermediate enclosures form the Trailokyamohana cakra; / the powers that reside in this are called the Prakaṭa [Śaktis].

sanskrit_iast:
etasāṃ samadhiṣṭhātrī tripurā cakranāyikā /
taccakrapālanakarī mudrāsaṃkṣobhaṇātmikā //
meaning:
एतसां समधिष्ठात्री त्रिपुरा चक्रनायिका /
तच्चक्रपालनकरी मुद्रासंक्षोभणात्मिका //
text_mt: Their presiding ruler is Tripura, the mistress of the cakra; / the mudrā that protects that cakra has the nature of agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mudrāntarasyordhvaṃ proktā nityākalāṃ taram /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
parvataścaiva sopānamuttarottaramiṣyate //
meaning:
अथ मुद्रान्तरस्योर्ध्वं प्रोक्ता नित्याकलां तरम् /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
पर्वतश्चैव सोपानमुत्तरोत्तरमिष्यते //
text_mt: Then above the enclosure of mudrās is proclaimed the enclosure of the digits of the Nityās, / rising twenty cubits, four nalvas in width; / all around, a flight of stairs is desired rising higher and higher.

sanskrit_iast:
nityākalāntare tasminkāmākarṣaṇikāsukhāḥ /
paritaḥ kṛtasaṃsthānāḥ ṣoḍaśendukalātmikāḥ //
meaning:
नित्याकलान्तरे तस्मिन्कामाकर्षणिकासुखाः /
परितः कृतसंस्थानाः षोडशेन्दुकलात्मिकाः //
text_mt: In that enclosure of the digits of the Nityās, Kāmākarṣiṇikā and the others, / having the nature of the sixteen digits of the moon, are positioned all around,

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayantyo diśāṃ cakraṃ sudhāsyandaiḥ suśītalaiḥ /
tāsāṃ nāmāni mattastvamavadhāraya kumbhaja //
meaning:
तर्पयन्त्यो दिशां चक्रं सुधास्यन्दैः सुशीतलैः /
तासां नामानि मत्तस्त्वमवधारय कुम्भज //
text_mt: gratifying the circle of the directions with exceedingly cool streams of nectar. / Hear their names from me, O pot-born [Agastya]!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākarṣiṇikā nityā buddhyākarṣaṇikāparā /
rasākarṣaṇikā nityā gandhākarṣaṇikā kalā //
meaning:
कामाकर्षिणिका नित्या बुद्ध्याकर्षणिकापरा /
रसाकर्षणिका नित्या गन्धाकर्षणिका कला //
text_mt: The Nityā Kāmākarṣiṇikā, another Buddhyākarṣiṇikā, / the Nityā Rasākarṣiṇikā, the Kalā Gandhākarṣiṇikā,

sanskrit_iast:
cittākarṣaṇikā nityā dhairyākarṣaṇikā kalā /
smṛtyākarṣaṇikā nityā nāmākarṣaṇikā kalā //
meaning:
चित्ताकर्षणिका नित्या धैर्याकर्षणिका कला /
स्मृत्याकर्षणिका नित्या नामाकर्षणिका कला //
text_mt: the Nityā Cittākarṣiṇikā, the Kalā Dhairyākarṣiṇikā, / the Nityā Smṛtyākarṣiṇikā, the Kalā Nāmākarṣiṇikā,

sanskrit_iast:
bījākarṣaṇikā nityā cārthākarṣaṇikā kalā /
amṛtākarṣaṇī cānyā śarīrākarṣaṇī kalā //
meaning:
बीजाकर्षणिका नित्या चार्थाकर्षणिका कला /
अमृताकर्षणी चान्या शरीराकर्षणी कला //
text_mt: the Nityā Bījākarṣiṇikā, and the Kalā Arthākarṣiṇikā, / another, Amṛtākarṣaṇī, and the Kalā Śarīrākarṣaṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
etāstu guptayoginyastripureśī tu cakriṇī /
sarvāśāpūrikābhikhyā cakrādhiṣṭhānadevatā //
meaning:
एतास्तु गुप्तयोगिन्यस्त्रिपुरेशी तु चक्रिणी /
सर्वाशापूरिकाभिख्या चक्राधिष्ठानदेवता //
text_mt: these are the Guptayoginīs; Tripureśī is their Cakriṇī, / known as Sarvāśāpūrikā, the presiding deity of the cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
etaccakre pālikā tu mudrā drāviṇikābhidhā /
nityā kalāntarādūrdhvaṃ dhiṣṇya matyantasundaram //
meaning:
एतच्चक्रे पालिका तु मुद्रा द्राविणिकाभिधा /
नित्या कलान्तरादूर्ध्वं धिष्ण्य मत्यन्तसुन्दरम् //
text_mt: The guardian in this cakra is the mudrā named Drāviṇī. / Above the interval of the Nityā Kalās is an exceedingly beautiful precinct,

sanskrit_iast:
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
prāgvatsopānasaṃyuktaṃ sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇābhidham //
meaning:
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
प्राग्वत्सोपानसंयुक्तं सर्वसंक्षोभणाभिधम् //
text_mt: twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide, / provided with steps as before, named Sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāṣṭau śaktayastīvrā madāruṇavilocanāḥ /
navatāruṇyamaccāśca sevante parameśvarīm //
meaning:
तत्राष्टौ शक्तयस्तीव्रा मदारुणविलोचनाः /
नवतारुण्यमच्चाश्च सेवन्ते परमेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: There, eight fierce śaktis with eyes reddened by intoxication / and full of fresh youthfulness attend upon the Supreme Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
kusumā mekhalā caiva madanā madanāturā /
rekhā veginyaṅkuśā ca mālinyaṣṭau ca śaktayaḥ //
meaning:
कुसुमा मेखला चैव मदना मदनातुरा /
रेखा वेगिन्यङ्कुशा च मालिन्यष्टौ च शक्तयः //
text_mt: Kusumā, Mekhalā, Madanā, Madanāturā, / Rekhā, Veginī, Aṅkuśā, and Mālinī are the eight śaktis;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiśastatparīvāraḥ śaktayo 'naṅgapūrvikāḥ /
sarvasaṃkṣobhamidaṃ cakraṃ tadadhidevatā //
meaning:
कोटिशस्तत्परीवारः शक्तयो ऽनङ्गपूर्विकाः /
सर्वसंक्षोभमिदं चक्रं तदधिदेवता //
text_mt: their retinue consists of crores of śaktis beginning with Anaṅga. / This cakra is Sarvasaṃkṣobhaṇa; its presiding deity

sanskrit_iast:
suṃdarī nāma vijñeyā nāmnā guptatarāpi sā /
taccakrapālanakarī mudrākarṣaṇikā smṛtā //
meaning:
सुंदरी नाम विज्ञेया नाम्ना गुप्ततरापि सा /
तच्चक्रपालनकरी मुद्राकर्षणिका स्मृता //
text_mt: is to be known by the name Sundarī, also named Guptatarā; / the mudrā Ākarṣaṇikā is held to be the protectress of that cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
anaṅgaśaktyantarasyopariṣṭātkuṃbhasaṃbhava /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
saṃkṣobhiṇyādyantaraṃ syātsarvasaubhāgyadāyakam //
meaning:
अनङ्गशक्त्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्कुंभसंभव /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
संक्षोभिण्याद्यन्तरं स्यात्सर्वसौभाग्यदायकम् //
text_mt: Above the precinct of the Anaṅgaśaktis, O pot-born one, / twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide, / is the precinct of Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī and the others, which bestows all good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇīmukhyāstatra śaktaya uddhatāḥ /
caturdaśa vasaṃtyeva tāsāṃ nāmāni macchṛṇu //
meaning:
सर्वसंक्षोभिणीमुख्यास्तत्र शक्तय उद्धताः /
चतुर्दश वसंत्येव तासां नामानि मच्छृणु //
text_mt: Fourteen exalted śaktis, headed by Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī, / dwell right there; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī śaktiḥ sarvavidrāviṇī tathā /
sarvākarṣaṇikā śāktiḥ sarvāhlādanikā tathā //
meaning:
सर्वसंक्षोभिणी शक्तिः सर्वविद्राविणी तथा /
सर्वाकर्षणिका शाक्तिः सर्वाह्लादनिका तथा //
text_mt: the śakti Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī, likewise Sarvavidrāviṇī, / the śakti Sarvākarṣaṇikā, likewise Sarvāhlādanikā,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃmohinī śaktiḥ sarvastaṃbhanaśaktikā /
sarvajṛṃbhiṇikā śaktistathā sarvavaśaṅkarī //
meaning:
सर्वसंमोहिनी शक्तिः सर्वस्तंभनशक्तिका /
सर्वजृंभिणिका शक्तिस्तथा सर्ववशङ्करी //
text_mt: the śakti Sarvasaṃmohinī, the śakti Sarvastambhanā, / the śakti Sarvajṛmbhiṇikā, and likewise Sarvavaśaṅkarī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvarañjanaśaktiśca sarvonmādaniśaktikā /
sarvārthasādhikā śaktiḥ sarvasaṃpattipūriṇī //
meaning:
सर्वरञ्जनशक्तिश्च सर्वोन्मादनिशक्तिका /
सर्वार्थसाधिका शक्तिः सर्वसंपत्तिपूरिणी //
text_mt: and the śakti Sarvarañjanā, the śakti Sarvonmādanā, / the śakti Sarvārthasādhikā, Sarvasampattipūriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamantramayī śaktiḥ sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī /
etāśca saṃpradāyākhyāścakriṇīpuravāsinīḥ //
meaning:
सर्वमन्त्रमयी शक्तिः सर्वद्वन्द्वक्षयङ्करी /
एताश्च संप्रदायाख्याश्चक्रिणीपुरवासिनीः //
text_mt: the śakti Sarvamantramayī, and Sarvadvandvakṣayaṅkarī. / These are called the Saṃpradāyayoginīs, dwelling in the city of the Cakriṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāśca sarvavaśyākhyāstaccakre rakṣikā matāḥ /
koṭiśaḥ śaktayastatra tāsāṃ kiṅkaryya uddhṛtāḥ //
meaning:
मुद्राश्च सर्ववश्याख्यास्तच्चक्रे रक्षिका मताः /
कोटिशः शक्तयस्तत्र तासां किङ्कर्य्य उद्धृताः //
text_mt: And the mudrā named Sarvavaśyā is considered the guardian in that cakra; / crores of śaktis, raised up as their handmaidens, are there.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkṣobhiṇyādyantarasyopariṣṭātkuṃbhasaṃbhava /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
sarvasiddhādikānāṃ tu mandiraṃ viṣṭyamucyate //
meaning:
संक्षोभिण्याद्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्कुंभसंभव /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
सर्वसिद्धादिकानां तु मन्दिरं विष्ट्यमुच्यते //
text_mt: Above the precinct of Sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī and the others, O pot-born one, / twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide, / is declared the mansion, the precinct of Sarvasiddhidā and the others:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhipradā caiva sarvasaṃpatpradā tathā /
sarvapriyaṅkarī devī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī //
meaning:
सर्वसिद्धिप्रदा चैव सर्वसंपत्प्रदा तथा /
सर्वप्रियङ्करी देवी सर्वमङ्गलकारिणी //
text_mt: Sarvasiddhipradā, and likewise Sarvasampatpradā, / the goddess Sarvapriyaṅkarī, Sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradā devī sarvaduḥkhavimocanī /
sarvamṛtyupraśaminī sarvavighnanivāriṇī //
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदा देवी सर्वदुःखविमोचनी /
सर्वमृत्युप्रशमिनी सर्वविघ्ननिवारिणी //
text_mt: the goddess Sarvakāmapradā, Sarvaduḥkhavimocanī, / Sarvamṛtyupraśaminī, Sarvavighnanivāriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgasundarī devī sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī /
etā devyaḥ kalotkīrṇā yoginyo nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी देवी सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनी /
एता देव्यः कलोत्कीर्णा योगिन्यो नामतः स्मृताः //
text_mt: the goddess Sarvāṅgasundarī, and Sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī. / These goddesses carved with arts are known by name as Yoginīs;

sanskrit_iast:
cakriṇī śrīśca vijñeyā cakraṃ sarvārthasādhakam /
sarvonmādanamudrāśca cakrasya paripālikāḥ //
meaning:
चक्रिणी श्रीश्च विज्ञेया चक्रं सर्वार्थसाधकम् /
सर्वोन्मादनमुद्राश्च चक्रस्य परिपालिकाः //
text_mt: the Cakriṇī is to be known as Śrī, and the cakra as Sarvārthasādhaka; / and the Sarvonmādana mudrās are the guardians of the cakra.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasiddhyādyantarasyopariṣṭātkumbhasambhava /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram //
meaning:
सर्वसिद्ध्याद्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टात्कुम्भसम्भव /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Above the precinct of Sarvasiddhi and the others, O pot-born one, / twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñādyantaraṃ nāmnā sarvarakṣākaraṃ smṛtam /
cakraṃ mahattaraṃ divyaṃ sarvajñādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञाद्यन्तरं नाम्ना सर्वरक्षाकरं स्मृतम् /
चक्रं महत्तरं दिव्यं सर्वज्ञाद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: is recorded by name the precinct of Sarvajñā and the others, which effects all protection; / this cakra is very great and divine; Sarvajñā and the others are proclaimed:

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī /
sarvajñānamayī devī sarvavyādhivināśinī //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञा सर्वशक्तिश्च सर्वैश्वर्यप्रदायिनी /
सर्वज्ञानमयी देवी सर्वव्याधिविनाशिनी //
text_mt: Sarvajñā, Sarvaśakti, and Sarvaiśvaryapradāyinī, / the goddess Sarvajñānamayī, Sarvavyādhivināśinī,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādhārasvarūpā ca sarvapāpaharī tathā /
sarvānandamayī devī sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī //
meaning:
सर्वाधारस्वरूपा च सर्वपापहरी तथा /
सर्वानन्दमयी देवी सर्वरक्षास्वरूपिणी //
text_mt: she who is the embodiment of all support, and likewise Sarvapāpaharī, / the goddess Sarvānandamayī, she who is the embodiment of all protection,

sanskrit_iast: sarvepsitapradā caitā nirgarvā yoginīśvarāḥ //
meaning: सर्वेप्सितप्रदा चैता निर्गर्वा योगिनीश्वराः //
text_mt: and Sarvepsitapradā; these are the Yoginīśvaras, free from pride.

sanskrit_iast:
mālinī cakriṇī proktā mudrā sarvamahāṅkuśā /
iti cintāmaṇi gṛhe sarvajñādyantarāvadhi /
cakrāṇi kānicitproktānyanyānyapi mune śṛṇu //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne cintāmaṇigṛhāntarakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
मालिनी चक्रिणी प्रोक्ता मुद्रा सर्वमहाङ्कुशा /
इति चिन्तामणि गृहे सर्वज्ञाद्यन्तरावधि /
चक्राणि कानिचित्प्रोक्तान्यन्यान्यपि मुने शृणु //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने चिन्तामणिगृहान्तरकथनं नाम षट्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Mālinī is declared to be the Cakriṇī, and the mudrā is Sarvamahāṅkuśā. / Thus in the Cintāmaṇi Palace up to the precinct of Sarvajñā and the others, / some cakras have been told; hear also the others, O sage!

Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Precincts of the Cintāmaṇi Palace,' in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the Latter Section of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
sarvajñadyantarālasyopariṣṭātkalaśodbhava /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
सर्वज्ञद्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टात्कलशोद्भव /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Above the intermediate space of Sarvajñā and the others, O pitcher-born one, / twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide,

sanskrit_iast:
vaśinyādyantaraṃ jñeyaṃ prāgvatsopānamandiram /
sarvarogaharaṃ nāmnā taccakramiti viśrutam //
meaning:
वशिन्याद्यन्तरं ज्ञेयं प्राग्वत्सोपानमन्दिरम् /
सर्वरोगहरं नाम्ना तच्चक्रमिति विश्रुतम् //
text_mt: the precinct of Vaśinī and the others is to be known, a mansion with steps as before; / that cakra is renowned by the name Sarvarogahara.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśinyādyāstatra devyaḥ pūrvādidiganukramāt /
svaraistu rahitāstatra prathamā vaśinīśvarī //
meaning:
वशिन्याद्यास्तत्र देव्यः पूर्वादिदिगनुक्रमात् /
स्वरैस्तु रहितास्तत्र प्रथमा वशिनीश्वरी //
text_mt: Vaśinī and the other goddesses are there in order of the directions beginning with the east; / there, devoid of vowels, is the first, the sovereign Vaśinī;

sanskrit_iast:
kavargasahitā paścātkāmeśvaryākhyavāhmayī /
cavargajuṣṭā vāgīśī modinī syāttṛtīyakā //
meaning:
कवर्गसहिता पश्चात्कामेश्वर्याख्यवाह्मयी /
चवर्गजुष्टा वागीशी मोदिनी स्यात्तृतीयका //
text_mt: next, accompanied by the ka-series, is the embodiment of speech named Kāmeśvarī; / accompanied by the ca-series is Vāgīśī Modinī, who is the third;

sanskrit_iast:
ṭavargamaṇḍitākārā vimalākhyā sarasvatī /
tavargeṇa tathopetā pañcamī vākpradhāraṇā //
meaning:
टवर्गमण्डिताकारा विमलाख्या सरस्वती /
तवर्गेण तथोपेता पञ्चमी वाक्प्रधारणा //
text_mt: adorned with the ṭa-series in form is the Sarasvatī named Vimalā; / likewise, joined with the ta-series, the fifth is Vākpradhāraṇā;

sanskrit_iast:
pavargeṇa parisphītā ṣaṣṭhī tu jayinī matā /
yādivarṇacatuṣkoṇe sarvaiśvaryādivāṅmayī //
meaning:
पवर्गेण परिस्फीता षष्ठी तु जयिनी मता /
यादिवर्णचतुष्कोणे सर्वैश्वर्यादिवाङ्मयी //
text_mt: amplified with the pa-series, the sixth is considered to be Jayinī; / at the four corners are the letters beginning with ya, representing all sovereignty and speech;

sanskrit_iast:
sādhikākṣaraṣaṭkena kaulinī tvaṣṭamī matā /
etā devyo japaratā muktābharaṇamaṇḍitāḥ //
meaning:
साधिकाक्षरषट्केन कौलिनी त्वष्टमी मता /
एता देव्यो जपरता मुक्ताभरणमण्डिताः //
text_mt: endowed with the six remaining letters, the eighth is considered Kaulinī. / These goddesses, devoted to chanting, are adorned with pearl ornaments;

sanskrit_iast:
sadā sphuradgadyapadyalaharīlālitā matāḥ /
kāvyaiśca nāṭakaiścaiva madhuraiḥ karṇahāribhiḥ /
vinodayantyaḥ śrīdevīṃ vartante kumbhasambhavaḥ //
meaning:
सदा स्फुरद्गद्यपद्यलहरीलालिता मताः /
काव्यैश्च नाटकैश्चैव मधुरैः कर्णहारिभिः /
विनोदयन्त्यः श्रीदेवीं वर्तन्ते कुम्भसम्भवः //
text_mt: they are considered ever fond of waves of flashing prose and verse; / with sweet, ear-ravishing poems and dramas / they remain amusing the glorious Goddess, O pot-born one!

sanskrit_iast:
etā rahasyanāmnaiva khyātā vātāpitāpana /
nāyikā svasya cakrasya siddhānāmnā prakīrtitā //
meaning:
एता रहस्यनाम्नैव ख्याता वातापितापन /
नायिका स्वस्य चक्रस्य सिद्धानाम्ना प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt: These are famous by the very name Rahasya, O tormentor of Vātāpi; / the mistress of her own cakra is proclaimed by the name Siddhā;

sanskrit_iast:
asya cakrasya saṃrakṣākāriṇī khecarī matā /
vaśinyādyantarālasyopariṣṭādvindhyamardana //
meaning:
अस्य चक्रस्य संरक्षाकारिणी खेचरी मता /
वशिन्याद्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टाद्विन्ध्यमर्दन //
text_mt: Khecarī is regarded as the protectress of this cakra. / Above the precinct of Vaśinī and the others, O crusher of the Vindhya,

sanskrit_iast:
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
astraṃ cakramitijñeyaṃ tatra bāṇādidevatāḥ //
meaning:
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
अस्त्रं चक्रमितिज्ञेयं तत्र बाणादिदेवताः //
text_mt: twenty cubits high, four nalvas wide, / is to be known the Astra cakra; there are the deities of the arrows and the rest:

sanskrit_iast:
pañca bāṇeśvarīdevyaḥ pañca kāmeśvarāśugāḥ /
aṅkuśadvitayaṃ dīptamādistrīpuṃsayordvayoḥ //
meaning:
पञ्च बाणेश्वरीदेव्यः पञ्च कामेश्वराशुगाः /
अङ्कुशद्वितयं दीप्तमादिस्त्रीपुंसयोर्द्वयोः //
text_mt: the five Bāṇeśvarī goddesses, the five arrows of Kāmeśvara; / the two radiant goads of the two primordial ones, female and male;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurdvayaṃ ca vindhyāre nava puṇḍreṣu kalpitam /
pāśadvayaṃ ca dīptābhaṃ catvāryastrāṇi kumbhaja //
meaning:
धनुर्द्वयं च विन्ध्यारे नव पुण्ड्रेषु कल्पितम् /
पाशद्वयं च दीप्ताभं चत्वार्यस्त्राणि कुम्भज //
text_mt: and the two bows fashioned of fresh sugar cane, O enemy of the Vindhya, / and the two radiant nooses: [these are] the four weapons, O pot-born one;

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśvaryāstu catvāri catvāri śrīmaheśituḥ /
āhatyāṣṭāyudhānīti prajvalanti vibhānti ca //
meaning:
कामेश्वर्यास्तु चत्वारि चत्वारि श्रीमहेशितुः /
आहत्याष्टायुधानीति प्रज्वलन्ति विभान्ति च //
text_mt: four of Kāmeśvarī, and four of the glorious Supreme Lord; / altogether eight weapons blaze and shine thus.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṇḍāsuramahāyuddhe duṣṭadānavaśoṇitaiḥ /
pītairatīva tṛptānidivyāstrāṇyati jāgrati //
meaning:
भण्डासुरमहायुद्धे दुष्टदानवशोणितैः /
पीतैरतीव तृप्तानिदिव्यास्त्राण्यति जाग्रति //
text_mt: Extremely sated by drinking the blood of the wicked Danavas / in the great battle against Bhaṇḍāsura, these divine weapons are exceedingly vigilant.

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmāyudhānāṃ tu parivārāyudhānyalam /
vartante 'strāntare tatra teṣāṃ saṃkhyā tu koṭiśaḥ //
meaning:
एतेषामायुधानां तु परिवारायुधान्यलम् /
वर्तन्ते ऽस्त्रान्तरे तत्र तेषां संख्या तु कोटिशः //
text_mt: Moreover, abundant retinue weapons belonging to these weapons / exist within that weapon-precinct; their number indeed is in crores:

sanskrit_iast:
vajraśaktiḥ śataghnī ca bhuśuṇḍī musalaṃ tathā /
kṛpāṇaḥ paṭṭiśaṃ caiva mudgaraṃ bhindipālakam //
meaning:
वज्रशक्तिः शतघ्नी च भुशुण्डी मुसलं तथा /
कृपाणः पट्टिशं चैव मुद्गरं भिन्दिपालकम् //
text_mt: the vajra-spear, the śataghnī, the bhuśuṇḍī, and the pestle, / the scimitar, the paṭṭiśa, the club, and the bhindipāla;

sanskrit_iast:
evamādīni śastrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ /
aṣṭāyudhamahāśaktīḥ sevante madavihvalāḥ //
meaning:
एवमादीनि शस्त्राणि सहस्राणां सहस्रशः /
अष्टायुधमहाशक्तीः सेवन्ते मदविह्वलाः //
text_mt: these and other weapons, in thousands upon thousands, / overcome with fervor, attend upon the great śaktis of the eight weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śastrāntarālasyopari vātāpitāpana /
hastaviṃśatirunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
dhiṣṇyaṃ tu samayeśīnāṃ sthānaṃ ca tisṛṇāṃ matam //
meaning:
अथ शस्त्रान्तरालस्योपरि वातापितापन /
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
धिष्ण्यं तु समयेशीनां स्थानं च तिसृणां मतम् //
text_mt: Now, above the weapon-enclosure, O tormentor of Vātāpi, / twenty cubits in height, four nalvas in breadth, / is considered the abode of the Samayeśīs, the place of the three [goddesses].

sanskrit_iast:
kāmeśādyāstatra devyastisro 'nyā tu caturthikā /
saiva niḥśeṣaviśvānāṃ savitrī laliteśvarī //
meaning:
कामेशाद्यास्तत्र देव्यस्तिस्रो ऽन्या तु चतुर्थिका /
सैव निःशेषविश्वानां सवित्री ललितेश्वरी //
text_mt: The three goddesses there are headed by Kāmeśī, while the fourth / is none other than Laliteśvarī, the mother of all universes.

sanskrit_iast:
tisṛṇāṃ śṛṇu nāmāni kāmeśī prathamā matā /
vajreśī bhagamālā ca tāḥ sevante sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
तिसृणां शृणु नामानि कामेशी प्रथमा मता /
वज्रेशी भगमाला च ताः सेवन्ते सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Hear the names of the three: Kāmeśī is considered the first, / [then] Vajreśī and Bhagamālā; [goddesses] attend upon them by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ darśanānāṃ ca yā devyo vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ /
tāḥ sarvāstatra sevante kāmeśādimahodayāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां दर्शनानां च या देव्यो विविधाः स्मृताः /
ताः सर्वास्तत्र सेवन्ते कामेशादिमहोदयाः //
text_mt: Whatever various goddesses are handed down in all philosophical systems, / all of them, possessed of great splendor, attend there upon Kāmeśī and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
etāsāṃca prasaṃgeṣu nityānāṃ ca prasañjane /
cakriṇīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ śrīdevī pūraṇātmikā //
meaning:
एतासांच प्रसंगेषु नित्यानां च प्रसञ्जने /
चक्रिणीनां योगिनीनां श्रीदेवी पूरणात्मिका //
text_mt: And in the groups of these, and in the attachment of the Nityās, / of the Cakriṇīs and Yoginīs, the auspicious goddess is the fulfilling self.

sanskrit_iast:
yā kāmeśvaradevāṅkaśāyinī lalitāṃbikā /
kāmeśyādicaturthī sā nityānāṃ ṣoḍaśī matā //
meaning:
या कामेश्वरदेवाङ्कशायिनी ललितांबिका /
कामेश्यादिचतुर्थी सा नित्यानां षोडशी मता //
text_mt: The mother Lalitā who reclines upon the lap of the god Kāmeśvara, / she is the fourth after Kāmeśī and the others, and is considered the sixteenth of the Nityās.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginī cakradevīnāṃ navamī parikīrtitā /
samayeśyantarālasyopariṣṭādilvalāntaka //
meaning:
योगिनी चक्रदेवीनां नवमी परिकीर्तिता /
समयेश्यन्तरालस्योपरिष्टादिल्वलान्तक //
text_mt: She is proclaimed as the ninth Yoginī of the Cakra goddesses. / Above the enclosure of the Samayeśīs, O slayer of Ilvala,

sanskrit_iast:
nāthāntaramiti proktaṃ hastaviṃśatirunnatam /
caturnalvapravistāraṃ prāgvatsopānamaṇḍitam //
meaning:
नाथान्तरमिति प्रोक्तं हस्तविंशतिरुन्नतम् /
चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तारं प्राग्वत्सोपानमण्डितम् //
text_mt: is proclaimed the enclosure of the Nāthas, twenty cubits in height, / four nalvas in breadth, and adorned with stairs as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra nāthāmahādevyā yogaśāstrapravarttakāḥ /
sarveṣāṃ mantraguravaḥ sarvavidyāmahārṇavāḥ //
meaning:
तत्र नाथामहादेव्या योगशास्त्रप्रवर्त्तकाः /
सर्वेषां मन्त्रगुरवः सर्वविद्यामहार्णवाः //
text_mt: There dwell the Nāthas of the Great Goddess, the founders of the yoga treatises, / the mantra-gurus of all, the great oceans of all vidyās.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāro yāganāthāśca lokānāmiha guptaye /
sṛṣṭāḥ kāmaṃśadevena teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu //
meaning:
चत्वारो यागनाथाश्च लोकानामिह गुप्तये /
सृष्टाः कामंशदेवेन तेषां नामानि मे शृणु //
text_mt: And the four masters of sacrifice were created here by the god Kāmeśa / for the protection of the worlds; hear their names from me:

sanskrit_iast:
mitrī ca śoḍiśaścaiva caryākhyaḥ kumbhasambhava /
taiḥ sṛṣṭā bahavo lokārakṣārthaṃ pādukātmakāḥ //
meaning:
मित्री च शोडिशश्चैव चर्याख्यः कुम्भसम्भव /
तैः सृष्टा बहवो लोकारक्षार्थं पादुकात्मकाः //
text_mt: Mitrī, Ṣoḍiśa, and the one named Caryā, O pot-born one; / by them many [beings] whose essence is the sandals were created for the protection of the worlds:

sanskrit_iast:
divyavidyā mānavaughasiddhaughāḥ suratāpasāḥ /
prāptasālokyasārūpyasāyujyādikasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यविद्या मानवौघसिद्धौघाः सुरतापसाः /
प्राप्तसालोक्यसारूप्यसायुज्यादिकसिद्धयः //
text_mt: divine Vidyās, the streams of human and perfected masters, divine ascetics, / who have attained siddhi such as residing in the same world, having the same form, and intimate union.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānto guravastāṃstu sevante pracurā gurūn /
atha nāthāntarālasyopariṣṭāddhiṣṇyamuttamam //
meaning:
महान्तो गुरवस्तांस्तु सेवन्ते प्रचुरा गुरून् /
अथ नाथान्तरालस्योपरिष्टाद्धिष्ण्यमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: Numerous great gurus serve those gurus. / Now, above the enclosure of the Nāthas is an excellent abode,

sanskrit_iast:
hastaviṃśatirunnamaṃ caturnalvapravistaram /
nityāntaramiti proktaṃ nityāḥ pañcadaśātra vai //
meaning:
हस्तविंशतिरुन्नमं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् /
नित्यान्तरमिति प्रोक्तं नित्याः पञ्चदशात्र वै //
text_mt: twenty cubits in height, four nalvas in breadth, / proclaimed as the enclosure of the Nityās; indeed, fifteen Nityās are here:

sanskrit_iast:
atha kāmeśvarī nityā nityā ca bhagamālinī /
nityaklinnā api tathā bheruṇḍā vahnivāsinī //
meaning:
अथ कामेश्वरी नित्या नित्या च भगमालिनी /
नित्यक्लिन्ना अपि तथा भेरुण्डा वह्निवासिनी //
text_mt: namely, the Nityā Kāmeśvarī, the Nityā Bhagamālinī, / likewise Nityaklinnā, Bheruṇḍā, Vahnivāsinī,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvajreśvarī dūtī tvaritā kulasundarī /
nityā nīlapatākā ca vijayā sarvamaṅgalā //
meaning:
महावज्रेश्वरी दूती त्वरिता कुलसुन्दरी /
नित्या नीलपताका च विजया सर्वमङ्गला //
text_mt: Mahāvajreśvarī, Dūtī, Tvaritā, Kulasundarī, / the Nityā Nīlapatākā, Vijayā, Sarvamaṅgalā,

sanskrit_iast:
jvālāmālinikā citretyetāḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ /
etā devīsvarūpāḥ syurmahābalaparākramāḥ //
meaning:
ज्वालामालिनिका चित्रेत्येताः पञ्चदशोदिताः /
एता देवीस्वरूपाः स्युर्महाबलपराक्रमाः //
text_mt: Jvālāmālinikā, and Citrā—these fifteen are proclaimed. / These possess the goddess's own form and have great strength and valor.

sanskrit_iast:
prathamā mukhyatithitāṃ prāptā vyāpya jagattrayāḥ /
kālatritayarūpāśca kālagrāsavicakṣaṇāḥ //
meaning:
प्रथमा मुख्यतिथितां प्राप्ता व्याप्य जगत्त्रयाः /
कालत्रितयरूपाश्च कालग्रासविचक्षणाः //
text_mt: Having attained the chief lunar days, having pervaded the three worlds, / they embody the threefold time and are skilled in devouring time.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāmaśeṣāṇāṃ cirakālamupeyuṣām /
tattatkālaśatāyuṣyarūpā devyājñayā sthitāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनामशेषाणां चिरकालमुपेयुषाम् /
तत्तत्कालशतायुष्यरूपा देव्याज्ञया स्थिताः //
text_mt: For all beings beginning with Brahmā who have lived for a long time, / they abide by the goddess's command in the form of a lifespan of a hundred units of that respective time.

sanskrit_iast:
nityodyatā nirāntakāḥ śrīparāṅgasamudbhavāḥ /
sevante jagatāmṛddhyai lalitāṃ citsvarūpiṇīm //
meaning:
नित्योद्यता निरान्तकाः श्रीपराङ्गसमुद्भवाः /
सेवन्ते जगतामृद्ध्यै ललितां चित्स्वरूपिणीम् //
text_mt: Always active, free from distress, born from the body of the supreme goddess, / they worship Lalitā, whose nature is consciousness, for the prosperity of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāṃ bhavanatāṃ prāptā dīptāḥ pañcadaśeśvarāḥ /
visṛṣṭibinducakre tu ṣoḍaśyā bhavanaṃ matam //
meaning:
तासां भवनतां प्राप्ता दीप्ताः पञ्चदशेश्वराः /
विसृष्टिबिन्दुचक्रे तु षोडश्या भवनं मतम् //
text_mt: Those radiant fifteen rulers have reached the status of her dwellings. / But in the cakra of the emanated bindu, the dwelling of the sixteenth is acknowledged.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nityāntarālasyopariṣṭātkumbhasambhava /
aṅgadevyantaraṃ proktaṃ hastaviṃśātirunnatam //
meaning:
अथ नित्यान्तरालस्योपरिष्टात्कुम्भसम्भव /
अङ्गदेव्यन्तरं प्रोक्तं हस्तविंशातिरुन्नतम् //
text_mt: Now, above the enclosure of the Nityās, O pot-born one, / is proclaimed the enclosure of the limb deities, twenty cubits in height,

sanskrit_iast:
caturnalvapravistāraṃ prāgvatsopānamandiram /
tasminhṛdayadevyādyāḥ śaktayaḥ saṃti vai mune //
meaning:
चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तारं प्राग्वत्सोपानमन्दिरम् /
तस्मिन्हृदयदेव्याद्याः शक्तयः संति वै मुने //
text_mt: four nalvas in breadth, a temple with stairs as before. / In it, O sage, are indeed the Śaktis beginning with the heart-deity:

sanskrit_iast:
hṛddevī ca śirodevī śikhādevī tathaiva ca /
varmadevī dṛṣṭidevī śastradevī ṣaḍīritāḥ //
meaning:
हृद्देवी च शिरोदेवी शिखादेवी तथैव च /
वर्मदेवी दृष्टिदेवी शस्त्रदेवी षडीरिताः //
text_mt: the Heart deity, the Head deity, and likewise the Crest deity, / the Armor deity, the Eye deity, and the Weapon deity—six are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
atyantasannikṛṣṭāstāḥ śrīkāmeśvarasubhruvaḥ /
navalāvaṇyapūrṇāṅgyaḥ sāvadhānā dhṛtāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
अत्यन्तसन्निकृष्टास्ताः श्रीकामेश्वरसुभ्रुवः /
नवलावण्यपूर्णाङ्ग्यः सावधाना धृतायुधाः //
text_mt: Extremely close are they to the fair-browed [goddess] of the auspicious Kāmeśvara, / their bodies full of fresh beauty, vigilant, bearing weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
parito bindupīṭhe ca bhrāmyanto dṛptamūrtayaḥ /
lalitājñāpravartinyo vaśīnāṃ pīṭhavartikāḥ //
meaning:
परितो बिन्दुपीठे च भ्राम्यन्तो दृप्तमूर्तयः /
ललिताज्ञाप्रवर्तिन्यो वशीनां पीठवर्तिकाः //
text_mt: moving around the bindupīṭha with haughty forms, / carrying out Lalitā's commands, stationed at the pīṭha of the controllers.

sanskrit_iast:
athāṅgadevyantarasyopariṣṭānmaṇḍalākṛti /
bindunāda mahāpīṭhaṃ daśahastasamunnatam //
meaning:
अथाङ्गदेव्यन्तरस्योपरिष्टान्मण्डलाकृति /
बिन्दुनाद महापीठं दशहस्तसमुन्नतम् //
text_mt: Now, above the enclosure of the limb deities, circular in shape, / is the great pīṭha of bindu and nāda, ten cubits in height,

sanskrit_iast:
nalvāṣṭakapravistāramudyadādityasaṃnibham /
bindupīṭhamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śrīpīṭhamapi ceṣyate //
meaning:
नल्वाष्टकप्रविस्तारमुद्यदादित्यसंनिभम् /
बिन्दुपीठमिदं ज्ञेयं श्रीपीठमपि चेष्यते //
text_mt: eight nalvas in breadth, resembling the rising sun. / This is to be known as the bindupīṭha; it is also regarded as the śrīpīṭha;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpīṭhamiti jñeyaṃ vidyāpīṭhamapīṣyate /
ānandapīṭhamapi ca pañcāśatpīṭharūpadhṛk //
meaning:
महापीठमिति ज्ञेयं विद्यापीठमपीष्यते /
आनन्दपीठमपि च पञ्चाशत्पीठरूपधृक् //
text_mt: it is to be known as the mahāpīṭha; it is also regarded as the vidyāpīṭha / and the ānandapīṭha, assuming the forms of the fifty pīṭhas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śrīlalitādevyāḥ pañcabrahmamaye mahat /
jāgarti mañcaratnaṃ tu prapañcatrayamūlakam //
meaning:
तत्र श्रीललितादेव्याः पञ्चब्रह्ममये महत् /
जागर्ति मञ्चरत्नं तु प्रपञ्चत्रयमूलकम् //
text_mt: There, the great, jewel-like couch of the auspicious goddess Lalitā, / composed of the five Brahmans, the root of the threefold manifest creation, is ever awake.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya mañcasya pādāstu catvāraḥ parikīrtitāḥ /
daśahastasamunnamrā hastatritayaviṣṭhitāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य मञ्चस्य पादास्तु चत्वारः परिकीर्तिताः /
दशहस्तसमुन्नम्रा हस्तत्रितयविष्ठिताः //
text_mt: The legs of that couch are proclaimed to be four, / ten cubits in height, standing three cubits apart,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāneśvararūpatvamāgatāḥ /
śaktibhāvamanuprāptāḥ sadā śrīdhyānayogataḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानेश्वररूपत्वमागताः /
शक्तिभावमनुप्राप्ताः सदा श्रीध्यानयोगतः //
text_mt: having assumed the forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśāna, and Īśvara, / having attained the condition of Śakti through constant meditation upon the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
ekastu pañcapādaḥ syājjapākusumasannibhaḥ /
brahmātmakaḥ sa vijñeyo vahnidigbhāgamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
