एकस्तु पञ्चपादः स्याज्जपाकुसुमसन्निभः /
ब्रह्मात्मकः स विज्ञेयो वह्निदिग्भागमाश्रितः //
text_mt: One leg of the couch is like a hibiscus flower, / to be known as Brahmā in nature, resting in the quarter of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
caturtho mañcapādastu karṇikārakasāraruk /
īśvarātmā sa vijñeya īśadigbhāgamāśritaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थो मञ्चपादस्तु कर्णिकारकसाररुक् /
ईश्वरात्मा स विज्ञेय ईशदिग्भागमाश्रितः //
text_mt: And the fourth leg of the couch has the brilliance of the sap of the karṇikāra flower; / it is to be known as Īśvara in nature, resting in the quarter of Īśa.

sanskrit_iast:
ete sarve sāyudhāśca sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ /
uparyadhaḥstaṃbharūpā madhye puruṣarūpiṇaḥ //
meaning:
एते सर्वे सायुधाश्च सर्वालङ्कारभूषिताः /
उपर्यधःस्तंभरूपा मध्ये पुरुषरूपिणः //
text_mt: All these [legs] bear weapons and are adorned with all ornaments; / above and below they have the form of pillars, while in the middle they take the form of men.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdhyānamīlitākṣāśca śrīdhyānānniścalāṅgakāḥ /
teṣāmupari mañcasya phalakastu sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीध्यानमीलिताक्षाश्च श्रीध्यानान्निश्चलाङ्गकाः /
तेषामुपरि मञ्चस्य फलकस्तु सदाशिवः //
text_mt: Their eyes are closed in meditation upon the goddess; their limbs are motionless from meditation upon the goddess. / Above them, the plank of the couch is Sadāśiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vikāsidāḍimacchāyaścaturnalvapravistaraḥ /
nalvaṣaṭkāyāmavāṃśca sadābhāsvaramūrtimān //
meaning:
विकासिदाडिमच्छायश्चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरः /
नल्वषट्कायामवांश्च सदाभास्वरमूर्तिमान् //
text_mt: having the hue of a blooming pomegranate, four nalvas in breadth, / six nalvas in length, possessing an ever-luminous form.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgadevyantarāraṃbhānmañcasya phalakāvadhi /
cintāmaṇimayāṅgāni tattvarūpāṇi tāpasa //
meaning:
अङ्गदेव्यन्तरारंभान्मञ्चस्य फलकावधि /
चिन्तामणिमयाङ्गानि तत्त्वरूपाणि तापस //
text_mt: From the beginning of the enclosure of the limb deities up to the plank of the couch, / the parts made of cintāmaṇi stone embody the principles of reality, O ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
sopānāni vibhāsaṃte ṣaṭtriṃśadvai niveśanaiḥ /
ārohasya krameṇaiva sopānānyabhidadhmahe //
meaning:
सोपानानि विभासंते षट्त्रिंशद्वै निवेशनैः /
आरोहस्य क्रमेणैव सोपानान्यभिदध्महे //
text_mt: The stairs shine forth in thirty-six tiers; / in the order of ascent we declare the stairs:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmirāpo 'nalo vāyurākāśo gandha eva ca /
raso rūpaṃ sparśasaṃbdopasthapāyupadāni ca //
meaning:
भूमिरापो ऽनलो वायुराकाशो गन्ध एव च /
रसो रूपं स्पर्शसंब्दोपस्थपायुपदानि च //
text_mt: Earth, water, fire, wind, ether, and fragrance, / taste, form, touch, sound, genitals, anus, feet,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇivāgghrāṇajihvāścatvak cakṣuḥ śrotrameva ca /
ahaṅkāraśca buddhiśca manaḥ prakṛtipūruṣau //
meaning:
पाणिवाग्घ्राणजिह्वाश्चत्वक् चक्षुः श्रोत्रमेव च /
अहङ्कारश्च बुद्धिश्च मनः प्रकृतिपूरुषौ //
text_mt: hands, speech, nose, tongue, skin, eyes, and ears, / ego, intellect, mind, material nature, and the person,

sanskrit_iast:
niyatiḥ kālarāgau ca kalā vidye ca māyayā /
śuddhāvidyeśvarasadāśivaśaktiḥ śivā iti //
meaning:
नियतिः कालरागौ च कला विद्ये च मायया /
शुद्धाविद्येश्वरसदाशिवशक्तिः शिवा इति //
text_mt: destiny, time, attachment, limited capacity, pure knowledge, with cosmic illusion, / pure vidyā, Īśvara, Sadāśiva, Śakti, and Śiva—

sanskrit_iast:
etāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadākhyātāstattvasopānapaṅktayaḥ /
pūṣā sopānapaṅktiśca mañcapūrvadiśaṃśritāḥ //
meaning:
एताः षट्त्रिंशदाख्यातास्तत्त्वसोपानपङ्क्तयः /
पूषा सोपानपङ्क्तिश्च मञ्चपूर्वदिशंश्रिताः //
text_mt: these are declared to be the thirty-six rows of stairs of the principles of reality. / And the row of stairs [shining like] the sun rests on the eastern side of the couch.

sanskrit_iast:
atha mañcasyopariṣṭāddhaṃsatūlikatalpakaḥ /
hastamātraṃ samunnamraṃ caturnalvapravistaram //
meaning:
अथ मञ्चस्योपरिष्टाद्धंसतूलिकतल्पकः /
हस्तमात्रं समुन्नम्रं चतुर्नल्वप्रविस्तरम् //
text_mt: Now, above the couch is a bed of swansdown, / raised by a mere cubit, four nalvas in breadth,

sanskrit_iast:
pādopadhānamūrdhopadhāna dandvavirājitam /
gaḍḍakānāṃ catuḥ ṣaṣṭiśobhitaṃ pāṭalatviṣā //
meaning:
पादोपधानमूर्धोपधान दन्द्वविराजितम् /
गड्डकानां चतुः षष्टिशोभितं पाटलत्विषा //
text_mt: adorned with a pair of pillows for the feet and a pair for the head, / beautified by sixty-four bolsters of a pale red luster.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopariṣṭātkausuṃbhavasanenottaracchadaḥ /
śucinā mṛdunā kḷptaḥ padmarāgamaṇitviṣā //
meaning:
तस्योपरिष्टात्कौसुंभवसनेनोत्तरच्छदः /
शुचिना मृदुना कॢप्तः पद्मरागमणित्विषा //
text_mt: Above it, a bedcover of safflower-dyed cloth / is fashioned, pure, soft, with the luster of a ruby.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyopari vasanpūrvadiṅmukho dayayānvitaḥ /
śṛṅgāraveṣarucirassadā ṣoḍaśavārṣikaḥ //
meaning:
तस्योपरि वसन्पूर्वदिङ्मुखो दययान्वितः /
शृङ्गारवेषरुचिरस्सदा षोडशवार्षिकः //
text_mt: Dwelling upon it, facing the east, endowed with compassion, / charming in amorous attire, ever sixteen years of age,

sanskrit_iast:
udyadbhāskarabiṃbābhaścaturhastastrilocanaḥ /
hārakeyūramukuṭakaṭakādyairalaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उद्यद्भास्करबिंबाभश्चतुर्हस्तस्त्रिलोचनः /
हारकेयूरमुकुटकटकाद्यैरलङ्कृतः //
text_mt: shining like the orb of the rising sun, four-armed, three-eyed, / adorned with necklaces, armlets, diadem, bracelets, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
kamanīyasmitajyotsnāmaripūrṇakapolabhūḥ /
jāgarti bhagavānādidevaḥ kāmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
कमनीयस्मितज्योत्स्नामरिपूर्णकपोलभूः /
जागर्ति भगवानादिदेवः कामेश्वरः शिवः //
text_mt: the expanse of his cheeks filled with the moonlight of a lovely smile, / the blessed primal god, Kāmeśvara Śiva, stays awake.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyotsaṃge samāsīnā taruṇādityapāṭalā /
sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣā ca navayauvanadarpitā //
meaning:
तस्योत्संगे समासीना तरुणादित्यपाटला /
सदा षोडशवर्षा च नवयौवनदर्पिता //
text_mt: Seated upon his lap, pink as the rising sun, / eternally sixteen years of age, proud in her youthful prime,

sanskrit_iast:
amṛṣṭapadmarāgābhā candanābjanakhacchaṭā /
yāvakaśrīrnirvyapekṣā pādalauhityavāhinī //
meaning:
अमृष्टपद्मरागाभा चन्दनाब्जनखच्छटा /
यावकश्रीर्निर्व्यपेक्षा पादलौहित्यवाहिनी //
text_mt: radiant like polished rubies, with clusters of toenails like sandal and water-lilies, / she needs no red lac, for redness flows naturally from her feet.

sanskrit_iast:
kalanisvānamañjīrapatatkaṅkaṇamohanā /
anaṅgavaratūṇīradarponmathanajaṅghikā //
meaning:
कलनिस्वानमञ्जीरपतत्कङ्कणमोहना /
अनङ्गवरतूणीरदर्पोन्मथनजङ्घिका //
text_mt: She enchants with the tinkling sound of her anklets and sliding bracelets; / her shanks crush the pride of the excellent quivers of the Bodiless God [Kāma].

sanskrit_iast:
kariśuṇḍadoḥ kadalikākāntitulyoruśobhinī /
aruṇena dukūlena susparśena tanīyasā /
alaṅkṛtanitaṃbāḍhyā jaghanābhogabhāsurā //
meaning:
करिशुण्डदोः कदलिकाकान्तितुल्योरुशोभिनी /
अरुणेन दुकूलेन सुस्पर्शेन तनीयसा /
अलङ्कृतनितंबाढ्या जघनाभोगभासुरा //
text_mt: Her beautiful thighs rival the beauty of an elephant's trunk or a plantain tree; / her broad hips are adorned with a scarlet silk garment, / soft to the touch and very fine, and she shines with the fullness of her pelvis.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhorukagranthimatī ratnakāñcīvirājitā /
natanābhimahāvartatri valyūrmiprabhāsarit //
meaning:
अर्धोरुकग्रन्थिमती रत्नकाञ्चीविराजिता /
नतनाभिमहावर्तत्रि वल्यूर्मिप्रभासरित् //
text_mt: She wears a knotted half-petticoat and is adorned with a jewelled girdle; / her deep navel is a great whirlpool, and the three folds [of her belly] are waves of a river of radiance.

sanskrit_iast:
stanakuḍmalahindolamuktādāmaśatāvṛtā /
atipīvaravakṣojabhārabhaṅguramadhyabhūḥ //
meaning:
स्तनकुड्मलहिन्दोलमुक्तादामशतावृता /
अतिपीवरवक्षोजभारभङ्गुरमध्यभूः //
text_mt: Surrounded by a hundred pearl necklaces that swing upon the buds of her breasts, / her slender waist seems ready to break under the weight of her exceedingly full breasts.

sanskrit_iast: śirīṣadāmamṛdulacchadābhāṃścaturo bhujān //
meaning: शिरीषदाममृदुलच्छदाभांश्चतुरो भुजान् //
text_mt: [She has] four arms resembling tender sprigs from a garland of śirīṣa flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
keyūrakaṅkaṇaśreṇīmaṇḍitānsormikāṅgulīn /
vahantī patisaṃsṛṣṭaśaṅkhasundarakandharā //
meaning:
केयूरकङ्कणश्रेणीमण्डितान्सोर्मिकाङ्गुलीन् /
वहन्ती पतिसंसृष्टशङ्खसुन्दरकन्धरा //
text_mt: adorned with rows of armlets and bracelets, with rings upon her fingers; / her neck is as lovely as a conch shell touched by her husband.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhadarpaṇa vṛttābhacibukā pāṭalādharā /
śucibhiḥ paṅktiśuddhaisca vidyārūpairvibhāsvaraiḥ /
kundakuḍmalalakṣmīkairdantairdarśitacandrikā //
meaning:
मुखदर्पण वृत्ताभचिबुका पाटलाधरा /
शुचिभिः पङ्क्तिशुद्धैस्च विद्यारूपैर्विभास्वरैः /
कुन्दकुड्मललक्ष्मीकैर्दन्तैर्दर्शितचन्द्रिका //
text_mt: Her chin has the round sheen of a hand-mirror, and her lower lip is rose-red; / she displays moonbeams with her bright teeth resembling kunda buds, / pure, neatly arranged in rows, and shining like forms of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlamauktikasanaddhanānābharaṇabhāsurā /
ketakāntardalaśroṇī dīrghadīrghavilocanā //
meaning:
स्थूलमौक्तिकसनद्धनानाभरणभासुरा /
केतकान्तर्दलश्रोणी दीर्घदीर्घविलोचना //
text_mt: Resplendent with various ornaments set with large pearls, / she has very long eyes shaped like the inner petals of a ketaka blossom.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhendulalite bhāle samyakkḷptālakacchaṭā /
pālīvataṃ samāṇikyakuṇḍalāmaṇḍitaśrutiḥ //
meaning:
अर्धेन्दुललिते भाले सम्यक्कॢप्तालकच्छटा /
पालीवतं समाणिक्यकुण्डलामण्डितश्रुतिः //
text_mt: Upon her forehead, lovely as the crescent moon, locks of hair are exquisitely arranged; / her ears are adorned with boundary-like ear-ornaments and ruby earrings.

sanskrit_iast:
navakarpūrakastūrīsadāmoditavīṭikā /
śaraccañcanniśānāthamaṇḍalīmadhurānanā //
meaning:
नवकर्पूरकस्तूरीसदामोदितवीटिका /
शरच्चञ्चन्निशानाथमण्डलीमधुरानना //
text_mt: She continually enjoys a betel roll fragrant with fresh camphor and musk; / her sweet face resembles the circle of the autumn moon shining in the night.

sanskrit_iast:
cintāmaṇīnāṃ sāreṇa kḷptacārukirīṭikā /
sphurattilakaratnābhabhālanetravirājitā //
meaning:
चिन्तामणीनां सारेण कॢप्तचारुकिरीटिका /
स्फुरत्तिलकरत्नाभभालनेत्रविराजिता //
text_mt: She wears a lovely crown fashioned from the essence of cintāmaṇi gems; / her forehead eye shines like a gleaming jewel in a forehead mark.

sanskrit_iast:
gāḍhāndhakāranibiḍakṣāmakuntalasaṃhatiḥ /
sīmantareśāvinyastakindūraśreṇibhāsurā //
meaning:
गाढान्धकारनिबिडक्षामकुन्तलसंहतिः /
सीमन्तरेशाविन्यस्तकिन्दूरश्रेणिभासुरा //
text_mt: Her dense mass of fine hair is dark as thick darkness, / brightened by a line of vermilion placed along the part of her hair.

sanskrit_iast:
sphuraccandrakalottaṃsamadalolavilocanā /
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā //
meaning:
स्फुरच्चन्द्रकलोत्तंसमदलोलविलोचना /
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता //
text_mt: Her eyes tremble with passion beneath a crown of the glowing crescent moon; / rich in all the attire of love, she is adorned with every ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
samastalokamātā ca sadānandavivardhinī /
brahmaviṣṇugirīśeśasadāśivanidānabhūḥ //
meaning:
समस्तलोकमाता च सदानन्दविवर्धिनी /
ब्रह्मविष्णुगिरीशेशसदाशिवनिदानभूः //
text_mt: The Mother of all the worlds, she constantly increases bliss; / she is the primal ground of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Lord of Mountains [Śiva], Īśa, and Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
apāṅgariṅkhatkaruṇānirjharītarpitākhilā /
bhāsate sā bhagavatī pāpaghnī lalitāṃbikā //
meaning:
अपाङ्गरिङ्खत्करुणानिर्झरीतर्पिताखिला /
भासते सा भगवती पापघ्नी ललितांबिका //
text_mt: With the rippling cascade of compassion from the corners of her eyes she gratifies all; / she shines forth, the divine Lady Lalitāmbikā, destroyer of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
anyadaivatapūjānāṃ yasyāḥ pūjāphalaṃ viduḥ /
yasyāḥ pūjāphalaṃ prāhuyasyā eva hi pūjanam //
meaning:
अन्यदैवतपूजानां यस्याः पूजाफलं विदुः /
यस्याः पूजाफलं प्राहुयस्या एव हि पूजनम् //
text_mt: Wise men know the fruit of worshipping other deities to be the worship of her, / and the fruit of worshipping her they declare to be only the worship of her alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāśca lalitādevyā varṇayāmi kathaṃ punaḥ /
varṣakoṭisahasreṇāpyekāṃśo varṇyate na hi //
meaning:
तस्याश्च ललितादेव्या वर्णयामि कथं पुनः /
वर्षकोटिसहस्रेणाप्येकांशो वर्ण्यते न हि //
text_mt: How, then, can I describe that goddess Lalitā? / Even in a thousand crore of years, not a fraction of her can be described.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇyamānā hyavāgrūpā vācastasyāṃ kuto gatiḥ /
yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha //
meaning:
वर्ण्यमाना ह्यवाग्रूपा वाचस्तस्यां कुतो गतिः /
यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह //
text_mt: For she is beyond speech when described; how can words have access to her, / 'whence words recoil together with the mind, having failed to reach'?

sanskrit_iast:
bahunā kimihoktena tattvabhūtamidaṃ śṛṇu /
na pakṣapātānna snehānna mohādvā mayocyate //
meaning:
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन तत्त्वभूतमिदं शृणु /
न पक्षपातान्न स्नेहान्न मोहाद्वा मयोच्यते //
text_mt: What is the use of speaking much here? Listen to this which is the essential truth; / I speak not out of partiality, nor from affection, nor from delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃtu kalpataroḥ śākhā lekhinyastapasāṃ nidhe /
maṣīpātrāṇi sarve 'pi sapta saṃtu mahārṇavāḥ //
meaning:
संतु कल्पतरोः शाखा लेखिन्यस्तपसां निधे /
मषीपात्राणि सर्वे ऽपि सप्त संतु महार्णवाः //
text_mt: Though the branches of the wish-granting tree be pens, O receptacle of austerities, / and all the seven great oceans be inkpots,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā bhūmiḥ patratvamṛcchatu /
tasya lekhanakālo 'stu parārdhyādhikavatsaraiḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा भूमिः पत्रत्वमृच्छतु /
तस्य लेखनकालो ऽस्तु परार्ध्याधिकवत्सरैः //
text_mt: though the earth, fifty crore [yojanas] in extent, become the writing leaf, / and the time for writing be more than a parārdha of years;

sanskrit_iast:
likhantu sarve lokāśca pratyekaṃ koṭibāhavaḥ /
sarve bṛhaspatisamā vaktāro yadi kuṃbhaja //
meaning:
लिखन्तु सर्वे लोकाश्च प्रत्येकं कोटिबाहवः /
सर्वे बृहस्पतिसमा वक्तारो यदि कुंभज //
text_mt: though all living beings write, each possessing a crore of arms, / and all speakers be equal to Bṛhaspati, O Pot-born [Agastya],

sanskrit_iast:
athāpi tasyāḥ śrīdevyāḥ pādābjaikāṅgulidyuteḥ /
sahasrāṃśeṣvekaikāṃśavarṇanā na hi jāyate /
atha vā vṛttirakhilā niṣphalā tadguṇastutau //
meaning:
अथापि तस्याः श्रीदेव्याः पादाब्जैकाङ्गुलिद्युतेः /
सहस्रांशेष्वेकैकांशवर्णना न हि जायते /
अथ वा वृत्तिरखिला निष्फला तद्गुणस्तुतौ //
text_mt: even then, of the thousandth part of the splendour of a single toe of that auspicious goddess's lotus foot, / a description of a single part cannot be accomplished; / indeed, every attempt to praise her virtues is in vain.

sanskrit_iast:
bindupīṭhasya paritaścaturasravayā sthitā /
mahāmāyājavanikā laṃbate mecakaprabhā //
meaning:
बिन्दुपीठस्य परितश्चतुरस्रवया स्थिता /
महामायाजवनिका लंबते मेचकप्रभा //
text_mt: Around the bindupīṭha, standing in a four-sided shape, / hangs the curtain of Mahāmāyā, possessing a dark lustre.

sanskrit_iast:
devyā upari hastānāṃ viṃśatidvitayordhvataḥ /
indragopavitānaṃ tu baddhaṃ trailokyadurlabham //
meaning:
देव्या उपरि हस्तानां विंशतिद्वितयोर्ध्वतः /
इन्द्रगोपवितानं तु बद्धं त्रैलोक्यदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: Above the Goddess, at a height of twice twenty [forty] cubits, / is fastened a canopy of cochineal insects, rare in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrālaṅkārajālaṃ tu vartamānaṃ sudurlabham /
madvāṇī varṇayiṣyantī kaṇṭha eva hriyā hatā //
meaning:
तत्रालङ्कारजालं तु वर्तमानं सुदुर्लभम् /
मद्वाणी वर्णयिष्यन्ती कण्ठ एव ह्रिया हता //
text_mt: The multitude of ornaments present there is exceedingly rare; / my voice, attempting to describe it, is checked in my throat by shame.

sanskrit_iast:
saiva jānāti tatsarvaṃ tatratyamakhilaṃ guṇam /
manaso 'pi hi dūre tatsaubhāgyaṃ kenavarṇyate //
meaning:
सैव जानाति तत्सर्वं तत्रत्यमखिलं गुणम् /
मनसो ऽपि हि दूरे तत्सौभाग्यं केनवर्ण्यते //
text_mt: She alone knows all that and every excellence found there; / far beyond the reach of the mind, by whom can that splendour be described?

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bhaṇḍamahādaityavadhāya lalitāṃbikā /
prādurbhutā cidanalāddagdhaniḥśeṣadānavā //
meaning:
इत्थं भण्डमहादैत्यवधाय ललितांबिका /
प्रादुर्भुता चिदनलाद्दग्धनिःशेषदानवा //
text_mt: Thus, for the slaying of the great Daitya Bhaṇḍa, Lalitāmbikā / manifested from the fire of consciousness and burned all the Dānavas without remainder.

sanskrit_iast:
divyaśilpijanaiḥ kḷptaṃ ṣoḍaśakṣetraveśanam /
adhiṣṭhāya śrīnagaraṃ sadā rakṣati viṣṭapam //
meaning:
दिव्यशिल्पिजनैः कॢप्तं षोडशक्षेत्रवेशनम् /
अधिष्ठाय श्रीनगरं सदा रक्षति विष्टपम् //
text_mt: Presiding over Śrīnagara, a city of sixteen enclosures fashioned by divine artisans, / she eternally protects the world.

sanskrit_iast:
itthameva prakāreṇa śrīpurāṇyanyakānyapi /
na bhedako 'pi vinyāso nāmamātraṃ purāṃ bhidā //
meaning:
इत्थमेव प्रकारेण श्रीपुराण्यन्यकान्यपि /
न भेदको ऽपि विन्यासो नाममात्रं पुरां भिदा //
text_mt: In this very manner there are other Śrīpuras also; / there is no difference in their arrangement; the difference of the cities is in name alone.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvṛkṣamahodyānamārabhyetikrameṇa ye /
vadanti śrīpurakathāṃ te yānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
नानावृक्षमहोद्यानमारभ्येतिक्रमेण ये /
वदन्ति श्रीपुरकथां ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Those who recite the narrative of Śrīpura in proper order, beginning with the great park of various trees, / attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṇayanti pṛcchanti vicinvanti ca ye narāḥ /
ye pustake dhārayanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
आकर्णयन्ति पृच्छन्ति विचिन्वन्ति च ये नराः /
ये पुस्तके धारयन्ति ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Those men who listen, inquire, and reflect upon it, / and those who preserve it in a book, attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit_iast:
ye śrīpuraprakāreṇa tattatsthānavibhedataḥ /
kṛtvā śilpijanaiḥ sarvaṃ śrīdevyāyatanaṃ mahat /
saṃpādayanti ye bhaktāste yānti paramāṃ gatim //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne gṛharājāntarakathanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
ये श्रीपुरप्रकारेण तत्तत्स्थानविभेदतः /
कृत्वा शिल्पिजनैः सर्वं श्रीदेव्यायतनं महत् /
संपादयन्ति ये भक्तास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने गृहराजान्तरकथनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Those devotees who, according to the plan of Śrīpura with its different locations, / cause divine artisans to construct a great temple of the Goddess, / and complete it entirely, attain the supreme goal.

Thus ends the thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Interior of the Royal Palace', in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
śrutametanmahāvṛttamāvirbhāvādikaṃ mahat /
bhaṇḍāsuravadhaścaiva devyāḥ śrīnagarasthitiḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
श्रुतमेतन्महावृत्तमाविर्भावादिकं महत् /
भण्डासुरवधश्चैव देव्याः श्रीनगरस्थितिः //
text_mt: Agastya said: / I have heard this great history—her great manifestation and the rest, / the slaying of Bhaṇḍāsura, and the Goddess's residence in Śrīnagara.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi tasyā matrasya sādhanam /
tanmantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca sarvametannivedaya //
meaning:
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तस्या मत्रस्य साधनम् /
तन्मन्त्राणां लक्षणं च सर्वमेतन्निवेदय //
text_mt: Now I wish to hear the propitiation of her mantra, / and the characteristics of her mantras; please tell me all of this.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
sarvebhyo 'pi padārthebhyaḥ śābdaṃ vastu mahattaram /
sarvebhyo 'pi hi śabdebhyo vedarāśirmahānmune //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
सर्वेभ्यो ऽपि पदार्थेभ्यः शाब्दं वस्तु महत्तरम् /
सर्वेभ्यो ऽपि हि शब्देभ्यो वेदराशिर्महान्मुने //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Greater than all objects is the reality of sound; / and greater than all sounds, O sage, is the collection of the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvebhyo 'pi hi vedebhyo vedamantrā mahattarāḥ /
sarvebhyo vedamantrebhyo viṣṇumantrā mahattarāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेभ्यो ऽपि हि वेदेभ्यो वेदमन्त्रा महत्तराः /
सर्वेभ्यो वेदमन्त्रेभ्यो विष्णुमन्त्रा महत्तराः //
text_mt: Greater than all the Vedas are the Vedic mantras; / greater than all Vedic mantras are the mantras of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'pi daurgamantrāstu mahānto munipuṅgava /
tebhyo gāṇapatā mantrā mune vīrya mahattarāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽपि दौर्गमन्त्रास्तु महान्तो मुनिपुङ्गव /
तेभ्यो गाणपता मन्त्रा मुने वीर्य महत्तराः //
text_mt: Greater even than those are the mantras of Durgā, O best of sages; / greater in potency than those, O sage, are the mantras of Gaṇapati.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'pyarkasya mantrāstu tebhyaḥ śaivā mahattarāḥ /
tebhyo 'pi lakṣmīmantrāstu tebhyaḥ sārasvatā varāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽप्यर्कस्य मन्त्रास्तु तेभ्यः शैवा महत्तराः /
तेभ्यो ऽपि लक्ष्मीमन्त्रास्तु तेभ्यः सारस्वता वराः //
text_mt: Greater than those are the mantras of the Sun; greater than those are the mantras of Śiva; / greater even than those are the mantras of Lakṣmī; superior to those are the mantras of Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyo 'pi girijāmantrāstebhyaścāmnāyabhedajāḥ /
sarvāmnāyamanubhyo 'pi vārāhā manavo varāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यो ऽपि गिरिजामन्त्रास्तेभ्यश्चाम्नायभेदजाः /
सर्वाम्नायमनुभ्यो ऽपि वाराहा मनवो वराः //
text_mt: Greater even than those are the mantras of the Mountain-Daughter [Pārvatī], and greater still are those born from the different traditions [āmnāyas]; / superior even to the mantras of all traditions are the mantras of Vārāhī.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ śyāmāmanuvarā viśiṣṭā ilvalāntaka /
tebhyo 'pi lalitāmantrā daśabhedavibheditāḥ //
meaning:
तेभ्यः श्यामामनुवरा विशिष्टा इल्वलान्तक /
तेभ्यो ऽपि ललितामन्त्रा दशभेदविभेदिताः //
text_mt: Superior to those are the mantras of Śyāmā, O slayer of Ilvala; / and greater even than those are the mantras of Lalitā, divided into ten varieties.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu dvau manurājau tu variṣṭhau vindhyamardana /
lopāmudrā kāmarāja iti khyātimupāgatau //
meaning:
तेषु द्वौ मनुराजौ तु वरिष्ठौ विन्ध्यमर्दन /
लोपामुद्रा कामराज इति ख्यातिमुपागतौ //
text_mt: Among them, two kingly mantras are supreme, O crusher of the Vindhya: / they are renowned as the Lopāmudrā and the Kāmarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
hrādistu lopāmudrā syātkāmarājastu kādikāḥ /
haṃsādervācyatāṃ yātāḥ kāmarājo mahesvaraḥ //
meaning:
ह्रादिस्तु लोपामुद्रा स्यात्कामराजस्तु कादिकाः /
हंसादेर्वाच्यतां याताः कामराजो महेस्वरः //
text_mt: The Lopāmudrā begins with 'ha' [hādikā], while the Kāmarāja begins with 'ka' [kādikā]; / Kāmarāja is Maheśvara, expressed by the sounds beginning with 'haṃsa',

sanskrit_iast:
smarādervācyatāṃ yātā devī śrīlalitāṃbikā /
hādikādyormantrayostu bhedo varṇatrayodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
स्मरादेर्वाच्यतां याता देवी श्रीललितांबिका /
हादिकाद्योर्मन्त्रयोस्तु भेदो वर्णत्रयोद्भवः //
text_mt: while the Goddess, glorious Lalitāmbikā, is expressed by Smara and the rest; / the difference between the hādi and kādi mantras arises from three syllables.

sanskrit_iast:
tyośca kāmarājo 'yaṃ siddhido bhaktiśālinām /
śivena śaktyā kāmena kṣityā caiva tu māyayā //
meaning:
त्योश्च कामराजो ऽयं सिद्धिदो भक्तिशालिनाम् /
शिवेन शक्त्या कामेन क्षित्या चैव तु मायया //
text_mt: And of these two, this Kāmarāja grants accomplishment to the devoted; / [constituted] by Śiva, by Śakti, by Kāma, by Earth, and indeed by Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsena bhṛguṇā caiva kāmena śaśimaulinā /
śakreṇa bhuvaneśena candreṇa ca manobhuvā //
meaning:
हंसेन भृगुणा चैव कामेन शशिमौलिना /
शक्रेण भुवनेशेन चन्द्रेण च मनोभुवा //
text_mt: by Haṃsa, by Bhṛgu, and by Kāma, by the moon-crested one, / by Śakra, by Bhuvaneśa, by the moon, and by the mind-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣityā hṛllekhayā caiva prokto haṃsādimantrarāṭ /
kāmādimantrarājastu smarayoniḥ śriyo mukhe //
meaning:
क्षित्या हृल्लेखया चैव प्रोक्तो हंसादिमन्त्रराट् /
कामादिमन्त्रराजस्तु स्मरयोनिः श्रियो मुखे //
text_mt: by Earth, and by Hṛllekhā is proclaimed the king of mantras beginning with Haṃsa. / But the king of mantras beginning with Kāma has Smara and Yoni at the face of Śrī,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcatrikamahāvidyā lalitāṃbā pravācikām /
ye yajanti mahābhāgāsteṣāṃ sarvatra siddhaye //
meaning:
पञ्चत्रिकमहाविद्या ललितांबा प्रवाचिकाम् /
ये यजन्ति महाभागास्तेषां सर्वत्र सिद्धये //
text_mt: the great fifteen-syllabled vidyā denoting Mother Lalitā. / For the fortunate who worship [her, it brings] accomplishment everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
sadgurostu manuṃ prāpya tripañcārṇapariṣkṛtam /
samyaksaṃsādhayedvidvānvakṣyamāṇaprakārataḥ //
meaning:
सद्गुरोस्तु मनुं प्राप्य त्रिपञ्चार्णपरिष्कृतम् /
सम्यक्संसाधयेद्विद्वान्वक्ष्यमाणप्रकारतः //
text_mt: Having obtained the mantra adorned with fifteen syllables from a true guru, / the wise man should thoroughly master it in the manner to be described.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkrameṇa pravakṣyāmi sāvadhāno mune śṛṇu /
prātarutthāya śirasismṛtvā kamalamujjvalam //
meaning:
तत्क्रमेण प्रवक्ष्यामि सावधानो मुने शृणु /
प्रातरुत्थाय शिरसिस्मृत्वा कमलमुज्ज्वलम् //
text_mt: I shall explain that in proper sequence; listen attentively, O sage: / rising in the morning and contemplating on his head a radiant lotus

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrapatraśobhāḍhyaṃ sakeśarasukarṇikam /
tatra śrīmadguruṃ dhvātvā prasannaṃ karuṇāmayam //
meaning:
सहस्रपत्रशोभाढ्यं सकेशरसुकर्णिकम् /
तत्र श्रीमद्गुरुं ध्वात्वा प्रसन्नं करुणामयम् //
text_mt: rich in the splendor of a thousand petals, with filaments and a fine pericarp, / meditating there upon the venerable guru, gracious and full of compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
tatobahirvinirgatya kuryācchaucādikāḥ kriyāḥ /
athāgatya ca tailena sāmodena vilepitaḥ //
meaning:
ततोबहिर्विनिर्गत्य कुर्याच्छौचादिकाः क्रियाः /
अथागत्य च तैलेन सामोदेन विलेपितः //
text_mt: he should then go outside and perform purifying and other duties. / Then, returning, anointed with fragrant oil,

sanskrit_iast:
udvartitaśca susnātaḥ śuddhenoṣṇena vāriṇā /
āpo nisargataḥ pūtāḥ kiṃ punarvahnisaṃyutāḥ /
tasmāduṣṇodake snāyāttadabhāve yathodakam //
meaning:
उद्वर्तितश्च सुस्नातः शुद्धेनोष्णेन वारिणा /
आपो निसर्गतः पूताः किं पुनर्वह्निसंयुताः /
तस्मादुष्णोदके स्नायात्तदभावे यथोदकम् //
text_mt: rubbed down, and well-bathed with pure warm water— / water is by nature pure, how much more so when joined with fire? / Therefore he should bathe in warm water, or in whatever water is available in its absence—

sanskrit_iast:
paridhāya paṭau śuddhe kausumbhau vātha vāruṇau /
ācamya prayato vidvānhṛdi dhyāyanparāṃbikām //
meaning:
परिधाय पटौ शुद्धे कौसुम्भौ वाथ वारुणौ /
आचम्य प्रयतो विद्वान्हृदि ध्यायन्परांबिकाम् //
text_mt: wearing two clean garments, either safflower-dyed or deep red, / sipping water, restrained, the wise man meditating in his heart upon the supreme Mother,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tripuṇḍaṃ vā paṭṭavardhanameva vā /
agastyapatrākāraṃ vā dhṛtvā bhāle nijocitam /
antarhitaśca śuddhātmā sandhyāvandanamācaret //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वपुण्ड्रं त्रिपुण्डं वा पट्टवर्धनमेव वा /
अगस्त्यपत्राकारं वा धृत्वा भाले निजोचितम् /
अन्तर्हितश्च शुद्धात्मा सन्ध्यावन्दनमाचरेत् //
text_mt: bearing on his forehead his proper mark: an upright mark, a triple mark, / a paṭṭavardhana, or the shape of an Agastya leaf, / internally collected and pure of soul, he should perform the twilight adoration.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthapatrākāreṇa pātreṇa sakuśākṣatam /
sapuṣpacandanaṃ cārdhyaṃ mārtaṇḍāya samutkṣipet //
meaning:
अश्वत्थपत्राकारेण पात्रेण सकुशाक्षतम् /
सपुष्पचन्दनं चार्ध्यं मार्तण्डाय समुत्क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: With a vessel shaped like a peepal leaf, containing kuśa grass, unbroken rice, / flowers, and sandalwood, he should offer the water of honor to the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tathārdhyabhāvadevatvāllalitāyai trirardhyakam /
tarppayitvā yathāśakti mūlena laliteśvarīm //
meaning:
तथार्ध्यभावदेवत्वाल्ललितायै त्रिरर्ध्यकम् /
तर्प्पयित्वा यथाशक्ति मूलेन ललितेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: Similarly, since she is the deity who is the essence of the offering, he should offer water three times to Lalitā; / having made libations to the sovereign Lalitā according to his ability with the root mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣipitṛvargāṃśca tarpayitvā vidhānataḥ /
divākaramupāsthāya devīṃ ca ravibimbagām //
meaning:
देवर्षिपितृवर्गांश्च तर्पयित्वा विधानतः /
दिवाकरमुपास्थाय देवीं च रविबिम्बगाम् //
text_mt: and having made libations to the classes of gods, sages, and ancestors according to the rule, / worshipping the maker of day and the goddess abiding in the orb of the sun,

sanskrit_iast:
maunī viśuddhahṛdayaḥ praviśya makhamandiram /
cārukarpūrakastūrīcandanādivilepitaḥ //
meaning:
मौनी विशुद्धहृदयः प्रविश्य मखमन्दिरम् /
चारुकर्पूरकस्तूरीचन्दनादिविलेपितः //
text_mt: silent, with a purified heart, entering the sacrificial pavilion, / smeared with lovely camphor, musk, sandalwood, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṅgaśca cāruśṛṅgāraveṣadhṛk /
āmodikusumasragbhiravataṃsitakuntalaḥ //
meaning:
भूषणैर्भूषिताङ्गश्च चारुशृङ्गारवेषधृक् /
आमोदिकुसुमस्रग्भिरवतंसितकुन्तलः //
text_mt: his body adorned with ornaments, wearing lovely amorous attire, / his hair adorned with garlands of fragrant flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalpabhūṣaṇo vātha yathāvibhavabhūṣaṇaḥ /
pūjākhaṇḍe vakṣyamāṇānkṛtvā nyāsānanukramāt //
meaning:
संकल्पभूषणो वाथ यथाविभवभूषणः /
पूजाखण्डे वक्ष्यमाणान्कृत्वा न्यासाननुक्रमात् //
text_mt: or adorned mentally, or adorned according to his means, / having performed in sequence the ritual placements to be described in the section on worship,

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdvāsane samāsīno dhyāyecchrīnagaraṃ mahat /
nānāvṛkṣamahodyānamārabhya lalitāvadhi //
meaning:
मृद्वासने समासीनो ध्यायेच्छ्रीनगरं महत् /
नानावृक्षमहोद्यानमारभ्य ललितावधि //
text_mt: seated on a soft seat, he should meditate on the great Śrīnagara, / beginning from the great garden of various trees up to Lalitā.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyecchrīnagaraṃ divyaṃ bahirantarataḥ śuciḥ /
pūjākhaṇḍoktamārgema pūjāṃ kṛtvā vilakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
ध्यायेच्छ्रीनगरं दिव्यं बहिरन्तरतः शुचिः /
पूजाखण्डोक्तमार्गेम पूजां कृत्वा विलक्षणः //
text_mt: Pure outwardly and inwardly, he should meditate on the divine Śrīnagara; / having performed worship according to the path taught in the section on worship, the discerning man,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamālāṃ samādāya candrakastūrivāsitām /
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅkho vā japetsiṃhāsaneśvarīm /
ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣasaṃkhyāṃ tu japedvidyā prasīdati //
meaning:
अक्षमालां समादाय चन्द्रकस्तूरिवासिताम् /
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्खो वा जपेत्सिंहासनेश्वरीम् /
षट्त्रिंशल्लक्षसंख्यां तु जपेद्विद्या प्रसीदति //
text_mt: taking up a rosary perfumed with camphor and musk, / facing north or facing east, should recite [the mantra of] the ruler of the lion-throne; / he should recite it to the number of thirty-six hundred thousand, and the vidyā becomes propitious.

sanskrit_iast:
taddaśāṃśastu homaḥ syāttaddaśāṃśaṃ ca tarpaṇam /
taddaśāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ samudīritam //
meaning:
तद्दशांशस्तु होमः स्यात्तद्दशांशं च तर्पणम् /
तद्दशांशं ब्राह्मणानां भोजनं समुदीरितम् //
text_mt: One-tenth of that should be the fire offering, and one-tenth of that the water libation; / one-tenth of that is declared to be the feeding of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa siddhamantrastu kuryātkāmyajapaṃ punaḥ /
lakṣamātraṃ japitvā tu manuṣyānvaśamānayet //
meaning:
एवं स सिद्धमन्त्रस्तु कुर्यात्काम्यजपं पुनः /
लक्षमात्रं जपित्वा तु मनुष्यान्वशमानयेत् //
text_mt: Thus, having accomplished the mantra, he may again perform recitation for desired ends: / having recited it merely one hundred thousand times, he can bring men under control.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣadvitayajāpyena nārīḥ sarvā vaśaṃ nayet /
lakṣatritayajāpena sarvānvaśayate nṛpān //
meaning:
लक्षद्वितयजाप्येन नारीः सर्वा वशं नयेत् /
लक्षत्रितयजापेन सर्वान्वशयते नृपान् //
text_mt: By a recitation of two hundred thousand, he can bring all women under control; / by a recitation of three hundred thousand, he subjugates all kings.

sanskrit_iast:
caturlakṣajape jāte kṣubhyanti phaṇikanyakāḥ /
pañcalakṣajape jāte sarvāḥ pātālayoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्लक्षजपे जाते क्षुभ्यन्ति फणिकन्यकाः /
पञ्चलक्षजपे जाते सर्वाः पातालयोषितः //
text_mt: When four hundred thousand recitations are performed, serpent maidens are stirred; / when five hundred thousand recitations are performed, all women of the netherworld [are stirred].

sanskrit_iast:
bhūlokasundarīvargo vaśyaḥṣaḍlakṣajāpataḥ /
kṣubhyanti sapta lakṣeṇa svargalokamṛgīdṛśaḥ //
meaning:
भूलोकसुन्दरीवर्गो वश्यःषड्लक्षजापतः /
क्षुभ्यन्ति सप्त लक्षेण स्वर्गलोकमृगीदृशः //
text_mt: The multitude of beauties of the earthly realm is subdued by a recitation of six hundred thousand; / by seven hundred thousand, the doe-eyed maidens of heaven are stirred.

sanskrit_iast:
devayonibhavāḥ sarve 'pyaṣṭalakṣajapādvaśāḥ /
navalakṣeṇa gīrvāṇā nakhilānvaśamānayet //
meaning:
देवयोनिभवाः सर्वे ऽप्यष्टलक्षजपाद्वशाः /
नवलक्षेण गीर्वाणा नखिलान्वशमानयेत् //
text_mt: All who are of divine birth are subdued by a recitation of eight hundred thousand; / by nine hundred thousand, he can bring all gods under control.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaikādaśajāpyena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān /
lakṣadvādaśajāpena siddhīraṣṭau vaśaṃ nayet //
meaning:
लक्षैकादशजाप्येन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वरान् /
लक्षद्वादशजापेन सिद्धीरष्टौ वशं नयेत् //
text_mt: By a recitation of eleven hundred thousand, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara [are subdued]; / by a recitation of twelve hundred thousand, he can bring the eight supernatural powers under control.

sanskrit_iast:
indrasyendratvametena mantreṇa hyabhavatpurā /
viṣṇorviṣṇutvametena śivasya śivatāmunā //
meaning:
इन्द्रस्येन्द्रत्वमेतेन मन्त्रेण ह्यभवत्पुरा /
विष्णोर्विष्णुत्वमेतेन शिवस्य शिवतामुना //
text_mt: Indra's lordship of the gods came to be formerly by this mantra; / Viṣṇu's nature as Viṣṇu by this, and Śiva's nature as Śiva by this.

sanskrit_iast:
indoścandratvametena bhānorbhāskaratāmunā /
sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca tāstāḥ siddhaya ujjvalāḥ /
anena mantrarājena jātā ityavadhāraya //
meaning:
इन्दोश्चन्द्रत्वमेतेन भानोर्भास्करतामुना /
सर्वासां देवतानां च तास्ताः सिद्धय उज्ज्वलाः /
अनेन मन्त्रराजेन जाता इत्यवधारय //
text_mt: The moon's nature as the moon by this, the sun's nature as the sun by this; / and all the various brilliant attainments of all the deities / have arisen through this king of mantras: understand this!

sanskrit_iast:
etanmantrasya jāpī tu sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ /
trailokyasundarākāro manmathasyāpi mohakṛt //
meaning:
एतन्मन्त्रस्य जापी तु सर्वपापविवर्जितः /
त्रैलोक्यसुन्दराकारो मन्मथस्यापि मोहकृत् //
text_mt: The reciter of this mantra is freed from all sin, / having the form of the beauty of the three worlds, enchanting even the god of love himself,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhiḥ siddhibhiryuktaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvapūjitaḥ /
darśanādeva sarvaṣāmantarālasya pūrakaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाभिः सिद्धिभिर्युक्तः सर्वज्ञः सर्वपूजितः /
दर्शनादेव सर्वषामन्तरालस्य पूरकः //
text_mt: endowed with all supernatural powers, all-knowing, worshipped by all, / fulfilling all gaps merely by his sight,

sanskrit_iast:
vācā vācaspatisamaḥ śriyā śrīpatisānabhaḥ /
bale marutsamānaḥ syātsthiratve himavāniva //
meaning:
वाचा वाचस्पतिसमः श्रिया श्रीपतिसानभः /
बले मरुत्समानः स्यात्स्थिरत्वे हिमवानिव //
text_mt: equal in speech to Vācaspati, resembling the Lord of Śrī in splendor, / in strength he would be equal to the wind, and in steadfastness like the Himālaya,

sanskrit_iast:
aunnatye merutulyaḥ syādgāṃbhīryeṇa mahārṇavaḥ /
kṣaṇātkṣobhakaro mūrtyā grāmapallīpurādiṣu //
meaning:
औन्नत्ये मेरुतुल्यः स्याद्गांभीर्येण महार्णवः /
क्षणात्क्षोभकरो मूर्त्या ग्रामपल्लीपुरादिषु //
text_mt: in height he would be equal to Meru, in depth like the great ocean; / exciting agitation in an instant by his form in villages, hamlets, cities, and elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
īṣadbhūbhaṅgamātreṇa stambhako jṛṃbhakastathā /
uccāṭako mohakaśca mārako duṣṭacetasām //
meaning:
ईषद्भूभङ्गमात्रेण स्तम्भको जृंभकस्तथा /
उच्चाटको मोहकश्च मारको दुष्टचेतसाम् //
text_mt: By a mere slight knitting of his brows, he paralyzes and gapes, / expels, deludes, and slays the evil-minded.

sanskrit_iast:
kruddhaḥ prasīdati haṭhāttasya darśanaharṣitaḥ /
aṣṭādaśasu vidyāsu nirūḍhimabhigacchati //
meaning:
क्रुद्धः प्रसीदति हठात्तस्य दर्शनहर्षितः /
अष्टादशसु विद्यासु निरूढिमभिगच्छति //
text_mt: One who is enraged suddenly becomes pleased, delighted at his sight; / he attains mastery in the eighteen fields of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
mandākinīpūrasamā madhurā tasya bhāratī /
na tasyāviditaṃ kiñcitsarvaśāstreṣu kumbhaja //
meaning:
मन्दाकिनीपूरसमा मधुरा तस्य भारती /
न तस्याविदितं किञ्चित्सर्वशास्त्रेषु कुम्भज //
text_mt: His speech is sweet like the flood of the Mandākinī; / nothing among all the scriptures is unknown to him, O jar-born one!

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāni ca sarvāṇi kartu khaṇḍayituṃ paṭuḥ /
tattvañjānāti nikhilaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ ca gacchati //
meaning:
दर्शनानि च सर्वाणि कर्तु खण्डयितुं पटुः /
तत्त्वञ्जानाति निखिलं सर्वज्ञत्वं च गच्छति //
text_mt: Skilled at establishing and refuting all philosophical systems, / he knows the whole truth and attains omniscience.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā dayārdrahṛdayaṃ tasya sarveṣu jantuṣu /
tatkopāgnerviṣayatāṃ gantuṃ nālaṃ jagattrayī //
meaning:
सदा दयार्द्रहृदयं तस्य सर्वेषु जन्तुषु /
तत्कोपाग्नेर्विषयतां गन्तुं नालं जगत्त्रयी //
text_mt: His heart is always moist with compassion toward all living beings; / the three worlds are not capable of becoming the object of the fire of his wrath.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya darśanavelāyāṃ ślathannīvīnibandhanāḥ /
viśrastaraśanābandhā galatkuṇḍalasañcayāḥ //
meaning:
तस्य दर्शनवेलायां श्लथन्नीवीनिबन्धनाः /
विश्रस्तरशनाबन्धा गलत्कुण्डलसञ्चयाः //
text_mt: At the moment of seeing him, [women] have the knots of their garments loosening, / their girdle-fastenings slipping, their earrings falling away,

sanskrit_iast:
gharmavārikaṇaśreṇīmuktābhūṣitamūrtayaḥ /
atyantarāgataralavyāpāranayanāñcalāḥ //
meaning:
घर्मवारिकणश्रेणीमुक्ताभूषितमूर्तयः /
अत्यन्तरागतरलव्यापारनयनाञ्चलाः //
text_mt: their forms adorned with pearls in the form of drops of perspiration, / the corners of their eyes trembling in action through intense passion,

sanskrit_iast:
sraṃsamānakarāṃbhojamaṇikaṅkaṇapaṅktayaḥ /
ūrustambhena niṣpandā namitāsyāśca lajjayā //
meaning:
स्रंसमानकरांभोजमणिकङ्कणपङ्क्तयः /
ऊरुस्तम्भेन निष्पन्दा नमितास्याश्च लज्जया //
text_mt: the rows of gemmed bracelets slipping from their lotus hands, / motionless through stiffness of the thighs, their faces lowered in modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
dravatkandarpasadanāḥ pulakāṅkurabhūṣaṇāḥ /
anyamākāramiva ca prāptā mānasajanmanā //
meaning:
द्रवत्कन्दर्पसदनाः पुलकाङ्कुरभूषणाः /
अन्यमाकारमिव च प्राप्ता मानसजन्मना //
text_mt: their seats of desire melting, adorned with the sprouting of goosebumps, / as if having assumed another form through the mind-born one,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpyamānā ivoddāmarāgajvālākadaṃbakaiḥ /
vīkṣyamāṇā ivānaṅgaśarapāvakavṛṣṭibhiḥ //
meaning:
दीप्यमाना इवोद्दामरागज्वालाकदंबकैः /
वीक्ष्यमाणा इवानङ्गशरपावकवृष्टिभिः //
text_mt: as if blazing with masses of flames of unrestrained passion, / as if looked upon by rains of fire that are the arrows of the bodiless god,

sanskrit_iast:
utkaṇṭhayā tudyamānāḥ khidyamānā tanūṣmaṇā /
sicyamānāḥ śramajalaiḥ śucyamānāśca lajjayā //
meaning:
उत्कण्ठया तुद्यमानाः खिद्यमाना तनूष्मणा /
सिच्यमानाः श्रमजलैः शुच्यमानाश्च लज्जया //
text_mt: stung by longing, distressed by the heat of their bodies, / sprinkled with waters of fatigue, and pained by modesty,

sanskrit_iast:
kulaṃ jātiṃ ca śīlaṃ ca lajjāṃ ca parivārakam /
lokādbhayaṃ bandhubhayaṃ paralokabhaye tathā //
meaning:
कुलं जातिं च शीलं च लज्जां च परिवारकम् /
लोकाद्भयं बन्धुभयं परलोकभये तथा //
text_mt: family, caste, conduct, shame, retinue, / fear of the world, fear of relatives, and likewise fear of the next world—

sanskrit_iast:
muñcantyo hṛdi yācantyo bhavanti hariṇīdṛśaḥ /
araṇye pattane vāpi devālayamaṭheṣu vā /
yatra kutrāpi tiṣṭhantaṃ taṃ dhāvanti mṛgīdṛśaḥ //
meaning:
मुञ्चन्त्यो हृदि याचन्त्यो भवन्ति हरिणीदृशः /
अरण्ये पत्तने वापि देवालयमठेषु वा /
यत्र कुत्रापि तिष्ठन्तं तं धावन्ति मृगीदृशः //
text_mt: releasing these, yearning in their hearts, the doe-eyed women become [his]; / in a forest, in a city, or in temples and monasteries, / wherever he may stand, the doe-eyed women run to him.

sanskrit_iast:
atyāhato yathaivāṃbhobindurbhramati puṣkare /
tadvadbhramanti cittāni darśane tasya subhruvām //
meaning:
अत्याहतो यथैवांभोबिन्दुर्भ्रमति पुष्करे /
तद्वद्भ्रमन्ति चित्तानि दर्शने तस्य सुभ्रुवाम् //
text_mt: Just as a drop of water severely struck wanders on a lotus leaf, / even so wander the minds of the fair-browed women at the sight of him.

sanskrit_iast:
vinītānavanītānāṃ vidrāvaṇamahāphalam /
taṃ sevante samastānāṃ vidyānāmapi paṅktayaḥ //
meaning:
विनीतानवनीतानां विद्रावणमहाफलम् /
तं सेवन्ते समस्तानां विद्यानामपि पङ्क्तयः //
text_mt: Rows of all the sciences attend upon him, / yielding the great fruit of routing the undisciplined.

sanskrit_iast:
candrārkamaṇḍaladvandvakucamaṇḍalaśobhinī /
triloke lalanā tasya darśanādanurajyati /
anyāsāṃ tu varākīṇāṃ vaktavyaṃ kiṃ tapodhana //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्कमण्डलद्वन्द्वकुचमण्डलशोभिनी /
त्रिलोके ललना तस्य दर्शनादनुरज्यति /
अन्यासां तु वराकीणां वक्तव्यं किं तपोधन //
text_mt: The woman who is adorned by the twin discs of sun and moon as her breasts / in the three worlds is captivated simply by the sight of him; / what, then, is to be said of other wretched women, O ascetic?

sanskrit_iast:
pattaneṣu ca vīthīṣu catvareṣu vaneṣu ca /
tatkīrtighoṣaṇā puṇyā sadā dyusaddrumāyate //
meaning:
पत्तनेषु च वीथीषु चत्वरेषु वनेषु च /
तत्कीर्तिघोषणा पुण्या सदा द्युसद्द्रुमायते //
text_mt: In cities, streets, squares, and forests, / the holy proclamation of his fame constantly acts as the wish-fulfilling tree of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya darśanataḥ pāpa jālaṃ naśyati pāpinām /
tadguṇā eva ghokṣyante sarvatra kavipuṅgavaiḥ //
meaning:
तस्य दर्शनतः पाप जालं नश्यति पापिनाम् /
तद्गुणा एव घोक्ष्यन्ते सर्वत्र कविपुङ्गवैः //
text_mt: At the sight of him, the snare of sins of sinners is destroyed; / his virtues alone will be proclaimed everywhere by foremost poets.

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnairvarṇairāyudhaiśca bhinnairvāhanabhūṣaṇaiḥ /
ye dhyāyanti mahādevīṃ tāstāḥ siddhīrbhañjati te //
meaning:
भिन्नैर्वर्णैरायुधैश्च भिन्नैर्वाहनभूषणैः /
ये ध्यायन्ति महादेवीं तास्ताः सिद्धीर्भञ्जति ते //
text_mt: Those who meditate on the Great Goddess with different colors and weapons, / and with different mounts and ornaments, enjoy those various spiritual powers.

sanskrit_iast:
manorādimakhaṇḍastu kundendudhavaladyutiḥ /
ahaścakre jvalajjvālaścintanīyastu mūlake //
meaning:
मनोरादिमखण्डस्तु कुन्देन्दुधवलद्युतिः /
अहश्चक्रे ज्वलज्ज्वालश्चिन्तनीयस्तु मूलके //
text_mt: The first section of the mantra, having the white luster of jasmine and the moon, / blazing with flames in the day-cakra, is to be meditated upon in the mūlādhāra.

sanskrit_iast:
indragopaka saṃkāśo dvitīyo manukhaṇḍakaḥ /
nībhālanīye 'haścakre ābālāntajvalacchikhaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रगोपक संकाशो द्वितीयो मनुखण्डकः /
नीभालनीये ऽहश्चक्रे आबालान्तज्वलच्छिखः //
text_mt: The second section of the mantra, resembling an indragopa insect, / is to be contemplated in the day-cakra, its flame flaring up to the forehead.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bālādipadmasthadvidalāṃbujakoṭare /
nībhālanīyastārtīyakhaṇḍo duritakhaṇḍakaḥ //
meaning:
अथ बालादिपद्मस्थद्विदलांबुजकोटरे /
नीभालनीयस्तार्तीयखण्डो दुरितखण्डकः //
text_mt: Then, in the hollow of the two-petaled lotus located in the foremost lotus [at the crown], / the third section, which destroys distress, is to be contemplated.

sanskrit_iast:
muktā dhyeyā śaśijotsnā dhavalākṛtiraṃbikā /
raktasaṃdhyakarociḥ syādvaśīkaraṇakarmaṇi //
meaning:
मुक्ता ध्येया शशिजोत्स्ना धवलाकृतिरंबिका /
रक्तसंध्यकरोचिः स्याद्वशीकरणकर्मणि //
text_mt: The Mother is to be meditated upon as liberated, possessing the white form of moonlight; / in the rite of subjugation, she should have the glow of the red dusk.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasaṃpattilābhe tu śyāmalāṅgī vicintyate /
nīlā ca mūkīkaraṇe pītā staṃbhanakarmaṇi //
meaning:
सर्वसंपत्तिलाभे तु श्यामलाङ्गी विचिन्त्यते /
नीला च मूकीकरणे पीता स्तंभनकर्मणि //
text_mt: In obtaining all prosperity, she is meditated upon with dark limbs; / she is dark blue in the rite of striking dumb, and yellow in the rite of paralyzing.

sanskrit_iast:
kavitve viśadākārā sphaṭikopalanirmalā /
dhanalābhe suvarṇābhā cintyate lalitāṃbikā //
meaning:
कवित्वे विशदाकारा स्फटिकोपलनिर्मला /
धनलाभे सुवर्णाभा चिन्त्यते ललितांबिका //
text_mt: For poetic skill she has a clear form, pure as crystal stone; / for obtaining wealth, the Mother Lalitā is contemplated as shining like gold.

sanskrit_iast:
āmūlamābrahmabilaṃ jvalanmāṇikyadīpavat /
ye dhyāyanti mahāpuñjaṃ te syuḥ saṃsiddhasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
आमूलमाब्रह्मबिलं ज्वलन्माणिक्यदीपवत् /
ये ध्यायन्ति महापुञ्जं ते स्युः संसिद्धसिद्धयः //
text_mt: Those who meditate on that great mass [of light] from the root up to the aperture of Brahman / like a blazing ruby lamp, attain perfected powers.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bahuprakāreṇa dhyānabhedena kumbhaja /
nibhālayantaḥ śrīdevīṃ bhajanti mahatīṃ śriyam /
prāpyate sadbhirevaiṣā nāsadbhistu kadācana //
meaning:
एवं बहुप्रकारेण ध्यानभेदेन कुम्भज /
निभालयन्तः श्रीदेवीं भजन्ति महतीं श्रियम् /
प्राप्यते सद्भिरेवैषा नासद्भिस्तु कदाचन //
text_mt: Thus, contemplating the holy Goddess through different modes of meditation in many ways, O jar-born [Agastya], / they attain great glory. / She is attained only by the virtuous, never by the unvirtuous.

sanskrit_iast:
yaistu taptaṃ tapastīvraṃ tairevātmani dhyāyate /
tasya no paścimaṃ janma svayaṃ yo vā na śaṅkaraḥ /
na tena labhyate vidyā lalitā parameśvarī //
meaning:
यैस्तु तप्तं तपस्तीव्रं तैरेवात्मनि ध्यायते /
तस्य नो पश्चिमं जन्म स्वयं यो वा न शङ्करः /
न तेन लभ्यते विद्या ललिता परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: Only by those who have performed severe austerities is she meditated upon in the self; / by one for whom this is not the final birth, or who is not Śiva himself, / this knowledge of Lalitā, the Supreme Sovereign, is not obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃśe tu yasya kasyāpi bhavedeṣa manuryadi /
tadvaṃśyāḥ sarva eva syurmuktāstṛptā na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
वंशे तु यस्य कस्यापि भवेदेष मनुर्यदि /
तद्वंश्याः सर्व एव स्युर्मुक्तास्तृप्ता न संशयः //
text_mt: If this mantra should appear in anyone's lineage, / all of his descendants would be liberated and satisfied, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
guptādguptataraivaiṣā sarvaśāstreṣu niścitā /
vedāḥ samastaśāstrāṇi stuvanti laliteśvarīm //
meaning:
गुप्ताद्गुप्ततरैवैषा सर्वशास्त्रेषु निश्चिता /
वेदाः समस्तशास्त्राणि स्तुवन्ति ललितेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: She is established in all scriptures as more secret than the most secret; / the Vedas and all scriptures praise Laliteśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
paramātmeyameva syādiyameva parā gatiḥ /
iyameva mahattīrthamiyameva mahatphalam //
meaning:
परमात्मेयमेव स्यादियमेव परा गतिः /
इयमेव महत्तीर्थमियमेव महत्फलम् //
text_mt: She alone is the Supreme Self; she alone is the highest goal; / she alone is the great sacred place; she alone is the great fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ gāyanti munayo dhyāyanti sanakādayaḥ /
arcantīmāṃ suraśreṣṭhā brahmādyāḥ pañcasiddhidām //
meaning:
इमां गायन्ति मुनयो ध्यायन्ति सनकादयः /
अर्चन्तीमां सुरश्रेष्ठा ब्रह्माद्याः पञ्चसिद्धिदाम् //
text_mt: The sages sing of her, Sanaka and the others meditate upon her; / the best of the gods, Brahmā and the rest, worship her, the granter of the five perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
na prāpyate kucāritraiḥ kutsitaiḥ kuṭilāśayaiḥ /
daivabāhyairvṛthātarkairvṛthā vibhrānta buddhibhiḥ //
meaning:
न प्राप्यते कुचारित्रैः कुत्सितैः कुटिलाशयैः /
दैवबाह्यैर्वृथातर्कैर्वृथा विभ्रान्त बुद्धिभिः //
text_mt: She is not obtained by those of bad conduct, the vile, the crooked-minded, / those bereft of divine grace, those of futile dialectics, or those whose intellects are vainly bewildered;

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭairaśīlairucchiṣṭaiḥ kulabhraṣṭaiśca niṣṭhuraiḥ /
darśanadveṣibhiḥ pāpaśīlairācāranindakaiḥ //
meaning:
नष्टैरशीलैरुच्छिष्टैः कुलभ्रष्टैश्च निष्ठुरैः /
दर्शनद्वेषिभिः पापशीलैराचारनिन्दकैः //
text_mt: nor by the ruined, the unchaste, the defiled, those fallen from their family line, the cruel, / those hostile to philosophical systems, those of sinful conduct, or those who revile traditional observances;

sanskrit_iast:
uddhatairuddhatālāpairdāṃbhikairatimānibhiḥ /
etādṛśānāṃ martyānāṃ devānāṃ cātidurlabhā //
meaning:
उद्धतैरुद्धतालापैर्दांभिकैरतिमानिभिः /
एतादृशानां मर्त्यानां देवानां चातिदुर्लभा //
text_mt: nor by the arrogant, the loud-mouthed, the deceitful, or the excessively vain. / She is extremely difficult to attain for such mortals and gods.

sanskrit_iast:
devatānāṃ ca pūjyatvamasyāḥ proktaṃ ghaṭodbhava /
bhaṇḍāsura vadhāyaiṣā prādurbhūtā cidagnitaḥ //
meaning:
देवतानां च पूज्यत्वमस्याः प्रोक्तं घटोद्भव /
भण्डासुर वधायैषा प्रादुर्भूता चिदग्नितः //
text_mt: Her worshipfulness even by the deities has been declared, O jar-born [Agastya]; / she manifested from the fire of consciousness for the slaying of the demon Bhaṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
mahātripurasundaryā sūrtistejovijṛṃbhitā /
kāmākṣīti vidhātrā tu prastutā laliteśvarī //
meaning:
महात्रिपुरसुन्दर्या सूर्तिस्तेजोविजृंभिता /
कामाक्षीति विधात्रा तु प्रस्तुता ललितेश्वरी //
text_mt: The manifest form of Mahātripurasundarī is expanded with splendor; / as Kāmākṣī, Laliteśvarī was praised by the Creator.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyataḥ parayā bhaktyā tāṃ parāṃ lalitāṃbikām /
sadāśivasya manaso lālanāllalitābhidhā //
meaning:
ध्यायतः परया भक्त्या तां परां ललितांबिकाम् /
सदाशिवस्य मनसो लालनाल्ललिताभिधा //
text_mt: To him who meditates on that supreme Mother Lalitā with utmost devotion, / she is named Lalitā because she fondles the mind of Sadāśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyatkṛtavatī kṛtyaṃ tatsarvaṃ viniveditam /
pūjāvidhānamakhilaṃ śāstroktenaiva vartmanā /
khaṇḍāntare vadiṣyāmi tadvilāsaṃ mahādbhutam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne mantrarājasādhanaprakārakathanannāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
यद्यत्कृतवती कृत्यं तत्सर्वं विनिवेदितम् /
पूजाविधानमखिलं शास्त्रोक्तेनैव वर्त्मना /
खण्डान्तरे वदिष्यामि तद्विलासं महाद्भुतम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने मन्त्रराजसाधनप्रकारकथनन्नामाष्टत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Whatever deed she performed, all that has been related. / The entire procedure of worship according to the path taught in the scriptures / and her wondrous divine play I shall describe in another section.

Thus ends the thirty-eighth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Method of Accomplishing the King of Mantras,' in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious Brahmāṇḍa Mahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
anādyanantamavyaktaṃ vyaktānāmādikāraṇam /
ānandabodhaikarasaṃ tanmahanmanmahe mahaḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
अनाद्यनन्तमव्यक्तं व्यक्तानामादिकारणम् /
आनन्दबोधैकरसं तन्महन्मन्महे महः //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Beginningless and endless, unmanifest, the primeval cause of the manifest, / having the sole essence of bliss and consciousness—on that great splendor we meditate.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvānana mahāprājña vedavedāntavittama /
śrutametanmahāpuṇyaṃ lalitākhyānamuttamam //
meaning:
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ वेदवेदान्तवित्तम /
श्रुतमेतन्महापुण्यं ललिताख्यानमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: O horse-faced one, O great sage, best knower of the Vedas and Vedānta, / this greatly meritorious, supreme Lalitopākhyāna has been heard.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapūjyā tvayā proktā tripurā paradevatā /
pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇa pariṣkṛtacaturbhujā //
meaning:
सर्वपूज्या त्वया प्रोक्ता त्रिपुरा परदेवता /
पाशाङ्कुशधनुर्बाण परिष्कृतचतुर्भुजा //
text_mt: Tripurā, the supreme deity, has been declared by you as worshipful to all, / having four arms adorned with the noose, goad, bow, and arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā mantramiti proktaṃ śrīcakraṃ cakrūṣaṇam /
navāvaraṇamīśānī śrīparasyādhidaivatam //
meaning:
तस्या मन्त्रमिति प्रोक्तं श्रीचक्रं चक्रूषणम् /
नवावरणमीशानी श्रीपरस्याधिदैवतम् //
text_mt: Her mantra has been declared thus, and the Śrīcakra, ornament of wheels, / possessing nine enclosures, the supreme ruler and presiding deity of Śrīparā.

sanskrit_iast:
kāñcīpure pavitre 'sminmahīmaṇḍalamaṇḍale /
keyaṃ vibhāti kalyāṇī kāmākṣītyabhiviśrutā //
meaning:
काञ्चीपुरे पवित्रे ऽस्मिन्महीमण्डलमण्डले /
केयं विभाति कल्याणी कामाक्षीत्यभिविश्रुता //
text_mt: In this sacred city of Kāñcī, an ornament of the orb of the earth, / who is this auspicious one who shines, celebrated as Kāmākṣī,

sanskrit_iast:
dvibhujā vividhollāsavilasattanuvallarī /
adṛṣṭapūrvasaindaryā parajyotirmayī parā //
meaning:
द्विभुजा विविधोल्लासविलसत्तनुवल्लरी /
अदृष्टपूर्वसैन्दर्या परज्योतिर्मयी परा //
text_mt: two-armed, the creeper-like body radiating with various delights, / possessing never-before-seen beauty, consisting of supreme light, the transcendent?

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
agastyenaivamuktaḥ sanparānandādṛtekṣaṇaḥ /
dhyāyaṃstacca paraṃ tejo hayagrīvo mahāmanāḥ /
iti dhyātvā namaskṛtya tamagastyamathābravīt //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
अगस्त्येनैवमुक्तः सन्परानन्दादृतेक्षणः /
ध्यायंस्तच्च परं तेजो हयग्रीवो महामनाः /
इति ध्यात्वा नमस्कृत्य तमगस्त्यमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt: The bard said: / Thus addressed by Agastya, his eyes filled with supreme bliss, / meditating on that supreme splendor, the noble-minded Hayagrīva, / having thus meditated and bowed to that Agastya, then spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
rahasyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi lopāmudrāpate śṛṇu //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
रहस्यं संप्रवक्ष्यामि लोपामुद्रापते शृणु //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / I shall declare the secret; listen, O husband of Lopāmudrā!

sanskrit_iast:
ādyā yāṇutarā sā syāccitparā tvādikāraṇam /
antākhyeti tathā proktā svarūpāttattvacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
आद्या याणुतरा सा स्याच्चित्परा त्वादिकारणम् /
अन्ताख्येति तथा प्रोक्ता स्वरूपात्तत्त्वचिन्तकैः //
text_mt: The first is extremely subtle; she is the supreme consciousness, the primeval cause; / she is also called Antā by contemplators of reality, due to her essential nature.

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyābhūttataḥ śuddhaparādvibhujasaṃyutā /
dakṣahaste yogamudrāṃ vāmahaste tu pustakam //
meaning:
द्वितीयाभूत्ततः शुद्धपराद्विभुजसंयुता /
दक्षहस्ते योगमुद्रां वामहस्ते तु पुस्तकम् //
text_mt: Then the second arose, Śuddhaparā, endowed with two arms, / [holding] the yoga gesture in her right hand, and a book in her left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratī himakundendumuktāsamavapurdyutiḥ /
parāparā tṛtīyā syādbā lārkāyutasaṃmitā //
meaning:
बिभ्रती हिमकुन्देन्दुमुक्तासमवपुर्द्युतिः /
परापरा तृतीया स्याद्बा लार्कायुतसंमिता //
text_mt: bearing the body-luster resembling snow, jasmine, the moon, and pearls. / The third is Parāparā, like ten thousand rising suns,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā daśahastadhṛtāmbujā /
vāmorunyastahastā vā kirīṭārdhendubhūṣaṇā //
meaning:
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्ता दशहस्तधृताम्बुजा /
वामोरुन्यस्तहस्ता वा किरीटार्धेन्दुभूषणा //
text_mt: endowed with all ornaments, holding lotuses in ten hands, / or with her hand placed on her left thigh, adorned with a crown and the crescent moon.

sanskrit_iast:
paścāccaturbhujā jātā sā parā tripurāruṇā /
pāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍapañcabāṇalasatkarā //
meaning:
पश्चाच्चतुर्भुजा जाता सा परा त्रिपुरारुणा /
पाशाङ्कुशेक्षुकोदण्डपञ्चबाणलसत्करा //
text_mt: Afterwards, the four-armed one was born, that supreme, crimson Tripurā, / her hands gleaming with the noose, goad, sugarcane bow, and five arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
lalitā saiva kāmākṣī kāñcyāṃ vyaktimupāgatā /
sarasvatīramāgauryastāmevādyāmupāsate //
meaning:
ललिता सैव कामाक्षी काञ्च्यां व्यक्तिमुपागता /
सरस्वतीरमागौर्यस्तामेवाद्यामुपासते //
text_mt: That very Lalitā became manifest in Kāñcī as Kāmākṣī; / Sarasvatī, Ramā, and Gaurī worship that very primeval goddess.

sanskrit_iast: netradvayaṃ maheśasya kāśīkāñjīpuradvayam //
meaning: नेत्रद्वयं महेशस्य काशीकाञ्जीपुरद्वयम् //
text_mt: The two eyes of Maheśa are the two cities: Kāśī and Kāñcī.

sanskrit_iast:
vikhyātaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ śivasāṃnidhya kārakam /
kāñcīkṣetre purā dhātā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
विख्यातं वैष्णवं क्षेत्रं शिवसांनिध्य कारकम् /
काञ्चीक्षेत्रे पुरा धाता सर्वलोकपितामहः //
text_mt: A renowned Vaiṣṇava sacred place, it causes the presence of Śiva. / Anciently in the field of Kāñcī, the Creator, the grandfather of all the worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevīdarśanāyaiva tapastepe suduṣkaram /
ātmaikadhyānayuktasya tasyavratavato mune //
meaning:
श्रीदेवीदर्शनायैव तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम् /
आत्मैकध्यानयुक्तस्य तस्यव्रतवतो मुने //
text_mt: performed very difficult austerity solely for the vision of the holy Goddess. / While he observed this vow, intent on meditation on the self alone, O sage,

sanskrit_iast:
prādurāsītpuro lakṣmīḥ padmahastā parātparā /
padmāsane ca tiṣṭhantī viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā saha //
meaning:
प्रादुरासीत्पुरो लक्ष्मीः पद्महस्ता परात्परा /
पद्मासने च तिष्ठन्ती विष्णुना जिष्णुना सह //
text_mt: Lakṣmī manifested before him, holding a lotus, higher than the highest, / sitting on a lotus seat together with the victorious Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā /
siṃhāsaneśvarī khyātā sarvalokaikarakṣiṇī //
meaning:
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता /
सिंहासनेश्वरी ख्याता सर्वलोकैकरक्षिणी //
text_mt: richly clad in all erotic adornments, decorated with all ornaments, / renowned as the sovereign of the lion-throne, the sole protectress of all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvādbhutasaindaryāṃ parajyotirmayīṃ parām /
ādilakṣmīmiti khyātāṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdaye sthitām //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वाद्भुतसैन्दर्यां परज्योतिर्मयीं पराम् /
आदिलक्ष्मीमिति ख्यातां सर्वेषां हृदये स्थिताम् //
text_mt: Seeing her of wondrous beauty, consisting of supreme light, the transcendent, / celebrated as Ādilakṣmī, dwelling in the hearts of all,

sanskrit_iast:
yāmāhustripurāmeva brahmaviṣṇavīśamātaram /
kāmākṣīti prasiddhāṃ tāmastau ṣītpurmabhaktimān //
meaning:
यामाहुस्त्रिपुरामेव ब्रह्मविष्णवीशमातरम् /
कामाक्षीति प्रसिद्धां तामस्तौ षीत्पुर्मभक्तिमान् //
text_mt: whom they call Tripurā herself, the mother of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / famous as Kāmākṣī, he praised her with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca /
jaya devi jaganmātarjaya tripurasundari /
jaya śrīnāthasahaje jaya śrīsarvamaṅgale //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच /
जय देवि जगन्मातर्जय त्रिपुरसुन्दरि /
जय श्रीनाथसहजे जय श्रीसर्वमङ्गले //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / Victory, O Goddess! Mother of the universe, victory, O Tripurasundarī! / Victory, O sister of the Lord of Śrī! Victory, O all-auspicious Śrī!

sanskrit_iast:
jaya śrīkaruṇārāśe jaya śṛṅgāranāyike /
jayajayedhikasiddheśi jaya yogīndravandite //
meaning:
जय श्रीकरुणाराशे जय शृङ्गारनायिके /
जयजयेधिकसिद्धेशि जय योगीन्द्रवन्दिते //
text_mt: Victory, O heap of auspicious compassion! Victory, O heroine of erotic sentiment! / Victory, victory, O mistress of superior perfections! Victory, O you who are adored by the foremost yogins!

sanskrit_iast:
jayajaya jagadamba nityarūpe jayajaya sannutalokasaukhyadātri /
jayajaya himaśailakīrtanīye jayajaya śaṅkarakāmavāmanetri //
meaning:
जयजय जगदम्ब नित्यरूपे जयजय सन्नुतलोकसौख्यदात्रि /
जयजय हिमशैलकीर्तनीये जयजय शङ्करकामवामनेत्रि //
text_mt: Victory, victory, O Mother of the universe, whose form is eternal! Victory, victory, O giver of happiness to praised worlds! / Victory, victory, O you who are praised by the snow mountain! Victory, victory, O you who are the left eye of Śaṅkara's desire!

sanskrit_iast:
jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsapidhānānugrahānmuhuḥ /
yā karoti svasaṅkalpāttasyai devyai namonamaḥ //
meaning:
जगज्जन्मस्थितिध्वंसपिधानानुग्रहान्मुहुः /
या करोति स्वसङ्कल्पात्तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः //
text_mt: Who constantly carries out creation, maintenance, destruction, concealment, and grace toward the universe / by her own will—obeisance, obeisance to that Goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāṃkaryakāriṇaḥ pāpino janān /
nihantyādyātitīkṣṇāstraistasyai devyaidṛ //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाणां सांकर्यकारिणः पापिनो जनान् /
निहन्त्याद्यातितीक्ष्णास्त्रैस्तस्यै देव्यैदृ //
text_mt: Who, as the primordial [power], slays with extremely sharp weapons sinful people / who cause confusion among the classes and stages of life—to that Goddess [obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
nāgamaiśca na vedaiśca na śāstrairna ca yogibhiḥ /
dedyā yā ca svasaṃvedyā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ //
meaning:
नागमैश्च न वेदैश्च न शास्त्रैर्न च योगिभिः /
देद्या या च स्वसंवेद्या तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः //
text_mt: Who is not to be known through Āgamas, nor through Vedas, nor through śāstras, nor by yogins, / but is self-known—obeisance, obeisance to that Goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyāmnāyavedāntaistattvavidbhirmunīśvaraiḥ /
paraṃ brahmeti yā khyātā tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
रहस्याम्नायवेदान्तैस्तत्त्वविद्भिर्मुनीश्वरैः /
परं ब्रह्मेति या ख्याता तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Who is proclaimed as the supreme Brahman by the masters among sages, / knowers of reality, through secret scriptures and Upaniṣads—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayasthāpi sarveṣāṃ yā na kenāpi dṛśyate /
sūkṣmavijñānarūpāyaidṛ //
meaning:
हृदयस्थापि सर्वेषां या न केनापि दृश्यते /
सूक्ष्मविज्ञानरूपायैदृ //
text_mt: Who, though dwelling in the hearts of all, is seen by no one, / whose form is subtle consciousness—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ /
yaddhyānaikaparā nityaṃ tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च ईश्वरश्च सदाशिवः /
यद्ध्यानैकपरा नित्यं तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: On whom Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Īśvara, and Sadāśiva / are constantly and exclusively intent in meditation—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
yaccaraṇabhaktā indrādyā yadājñāmeva bibhrati /
sāmrājyasaṃpadīśāyai tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
यच्चरणभक्ता इन्द्राद्या यदाज्ञामेव बिभ्रति /
साम्राज्यसंपदीशायै तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Devoted to whose feet Indra and the others bear only her command, / who is sovereign over the wealth of empire—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
vedā niḥśvasitaṃ yasyā vīkṣitaṃ bhūtapañcakam /
smitaṃ carācaraṃ viśvaṃ tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
वेदा निःश्वसितं यस्या वीक्षितं भूतपञ्चकम् /
स्मितं चराचरं विश्वं तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Whose breath is the Vedas, whose glance is the five elements, / whose smile is the universe of moving and unmoving beings—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
sahasraśīrṣā bhogīndro dharitrīṃ tu yadājñayā /
dhatte sarvajanādhārāṃ tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
सहस्रशीर्षा भोगीन्द्रो धरित्रीं तु यदाज्ञया /
धत्ते सर्वजनाधारां तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: By whose command the thousand-headed lord of serpents / holds up the earth, the support of all people—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
jvalatyagnistapatyarkevāto vāti yadājñayā /
jñānaśaktisvarūpāyai tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
ज्वलत्यग्निस्तपत्यर्केवातो वाति यदाज्ञया /
ज्ञानशक्तिस्वरूपायै तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: By whose command fire burns, the sun scorches, and the wind blows, / whose essential nature is the power of knowledge—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatitattvāni māyākañcukapañcakam /
yanmayaṃ munayaḥ prāhustasyaidṛ //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानि मायाकञ्चुकपञ्चकम् /
यन्मयं मुनयः प्राहुस्तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Of whom the sages declare the twenty-five principles / and the five coverings of Māyā to consist—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktīśvarāścaiva śuddhabodhaḥ sadāśivaḥ /
yadunmeṣavibhedāḥ syustasyaidṛ //
meaning:
शिवशक्तीश्वराश्चैव शुद्धबोधः सदाशिवः /
यदुन्मेषविभेदाः स्युस्तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Of whose manifestation Śiva, Śakti, Īśvara, / pure consciousness, and Sadāśiva are variations—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
gururmantro devatā ca tathā prāṇāśca pañcadhā /
yā virājati cidrūpā tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
गुरुर्मन्त्रो देवता च तथा प्राणाश्च पञ्चधा /
या विराजति चिद्रूपा तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Who shines as the form of consciousness: the guru, the mantra, the deity, / and likewise the fivefold vital breaths—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvātmanāmantarātmā paramāndarūpiṇī /
śrīvidyeti smṛtā vā tu tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
सर्वात्मनामन्तरात्मा परमान्दरूपिणी /
श्रीविद्येति स्मृता वा तु तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: The inner self of all beings, whose form is supreme bliss, / who is remembered as Śrīvidyā, or Speech—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāni ca sarvāṇi yadaṅgāni vidurbudhāḥ /
tattanniyamayūpāyai tasyai devyai namonamaḥ //
meaning:
दर्शनानि च सर्वाणि यदङ्गानि विदुर्बुधाः /
तत्तन्नियमयूपायै तस्यै देव्यै नमोनमः //
text_mt: Whose limbs the wise know all philosophical systems to be, / who is the sacrificial post for those various rules—obeisance, obeisance to that Goddess!

sanskrit_iast:
yā bhāti sarvalokeṣu maṇimantrauṣa dhātmanā /
tattvopadeśarūpāyai tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
या भाति सर्वलोकेषु मणिमन्त्रौष धात्मना /
तत्त्वोपदेशरूपायै तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Who shines in all worlds in the form of jewels, mantras, and herbs, / whose form is the instruction of reality—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālapadārthātmā yadyadvastu yathā tathā /
tattadrūpeṇa yā bhāti tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
देशकालपदार्थात्मा यद्यद्वस्तु यथा तथा /
तत्तद्रूपेण या भाति तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: Whatever entity exists, as it is, consisting of space, time, and objects, / who shines in each respective form—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
he pratibhaṭākārā kalyāṇaguṇaśālinī /
viśvottīrṇeti cākhyātā tasyaidṛ //
meaning:
हे प्रतिभटाकारा कल्याणगुणशालिनी /
विश्वोत्तीर्णेति चाख्याता तस्यैदृ //
text_mt: O you whose form is unequaled, possessing auspicious qualities, / who are also declared to transcend the universe—to that [Goddess obeisance, obeisance]!

sanskrit_iast:
iti stutvā mahādevīṃ dhātā lokapitāmahaḥ /
bhūyobhūyo namaskṛtya sahasā śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
इति स्तुत्वा महादेवीं धाता लोकपितामहः /
भूयोभूयो नमस्कृत्य सहसा शरणं गतः //
text_mt: Having thus praised the Great Goddess, the creator, the grandfather of the worlds, / bowing again and again, immediately sought refuge [in her].

sanskrit_iast:
santuṣṭā sā tadā devī brahmāṇaṃ prekṣya saṃnatam /
varadā sarvalokānāṃ vṛṇīṣva varamityaśāt //
meaning:
सन्तुष्टा सा तदा देवी ब्रह्माणं प्रेक्ष्य संनतम् /
वरदा सर्वलोकानां वृणीष्व वरमित्यशात् //
text_mt: Then that Goddess, seeing Brahmā bowed down, was satisfied; / the giver of boons to all the worlds said: 'Choose a boon!'

sanskrit_iast:
brahmovāca /
bhaktyā tvaddarśanenaiva kṛtārtho 'smi na saṃśayaḥ /
tathāpi prārthaye kiñcillokānugrahakāmyayā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोवाच /
भक्त्या त्वद्दर्शनेनैव कृतार्थो ऽस्मि न संशयः /
तथापि प्रार्थये किञ्चिल्लोकानुग्रहकाम्यया //
text_mt: Brahmā said: / 'Through devotion, merely by the vision of you, I have achieved my goal, there is no doubt; / nevertheless, I ask something out of a desire to favor the worlds.'

sanskrit_iast:
karmabhūmau tu loke 'sminprāyo mūḍhā ime janāḥ /
teṣāmanugrahārthāya nityaṃ kurvatra saṃnidhim //
meaning:
कर्मभूमौ तु लोके ऽस्मिन्प्रायो मूढा इमे जनाः /
तेषामनुग्रहार्थाय नित्यं कुर्वत्र संनिधिम् //
text_mt: 'For in this world, in this realm of action, these people are mostly deluded; / for their favor, take up your permanent presence here.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatheti tasya taṃ kāmaṃ pūrayāmāsa vedhasaḥ /
atha dhātā punastasyā devyā vāsamakalpayat //
meaning:
तथेति तस्य तं कामं पूरयामास वेधसः /
अथ धाता पुनस्तस्या देव्या वासमकल्पयत् //
text_mt: Saying 'So be it,' she fulfilled that desire of the creator; / then the creator arranged once again a dwelling for that Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevīsodaraṃ natvā puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam /
tatsāṃnidhyaṃ sadā kāñcyāṃ prārthayāmāsa cādṛtaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीदेवीसोदरं नत्वा पुण्डरीकाक्षमच्युतम् /
तत्सांनिध्यं सदा काञ्च्यां प्रार्थयामास चादृतः //
text_mt: Bowing to the lotus-eyed, imperishable [Viṣṇu], the brother of the Goddess, / he respectfully requested his perpetual presence in Kāñcī as well.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastathā kariṣyāmītyabravīttaṃ janārdanaḥ /
atha tuṣṭo jagaddhātā punaḥ prāha maheśvarīm //
meaning:
ततस्तथा करिष्यामीत्यब्रवीत्तं जनार्दनः /
अथ तुष्टो जगद्धाता पुनः प्राह महेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: Thereupon Janārdana said to him: 'I will do so.' / Then, satisfied, the creator of the universe spoke again to the Great Goddess:

sanskrit_iast:
śivo 'pyatraiva sāṃnidhyaṃ tava prītyā karotviti /
atha śrītripurādakṣabhāgātkāmeśvaraḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
शिवो ऽप्यत्रैव सांनिध्यं तव प्रीत्या करोत्विति /
अथ श्रीत्रिपुरादक्षभागात्कामेश्वरः परः //
text_mt: 'May Śiva also establish his presence right here out of love for you.' / Then, from the right side of Śrī Tripurā, supreme Kāmeśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānaḥsarvavidyā nāmīśvaraḥ sarvadehinām /
āvirāsīnmahādevaḥ sākṣācchṛṅgāranāyakaḥ //
meaning:
ईशानःसर्वविद्या नामीश्वरः सर्वदेहिनाम् /
आविरासीन्महादेवः साक्षाच्छृङ्गारनायकः //
text_mt: the ruler of all sciences, the lord of all embodied beings, / Mahādeva, the visible hero of erotic sentiment, appeared.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ punaḥ śrīkāmākṣībhālanetrakaṭākṣataḥ /
kācidbālā prādurāsīnmahāgaurā mahojjvalā //
meaning:
ततः पुनः श्रीकामाक्षीभालनेत्रकटाक्षतः /
काचिद्बाला प्रादुरासीन्महागौरा महोज्ज्वला //
text_mt: Then again, from the side-glance of Śrī Kāmākṣī's forehead-eye, / a certain maiden appeared, extremely fair and intensely radiant,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā mahālāvaṇyaśevadhiḥ /
atha śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣo brahmaṇā saha sādaram //
meaning:
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या महालावण्यशेवधिः /
अथ श्रीपुण्डरीकाक्षो ब्रह्मणा सह सादरम् //
text_mt: abounding in every erotic ornament, a treasure-house of great loveliness. / Then the lotus-eyed [Viṣṇu], together with Brahmā, respectfully

sanskrit_iast:
kārayāmāsa kalyāṇamādistrīpuṃsayostayoḥ /
ākhaṇḍalādayo devā vasurudrādidevatāḥ //
meaning:
कारयामास कल्याणमादिस्त्रीपुंसयोस्तयोः /
आखण्डलादयो देवा वसुरुद्रादिदेवताः //
text_mt: celebrated the marriage of those two, the primordial woman and man. / The gods led by Indra, the deities led by the Vasus and Rudras,

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeyādimunayo vasiṣṭhādimunīśvarāḥ /
yogīndrāḥ sanakādyāśca nāradādyāḥ surarṣayaḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेयादिमुनयो वसिष्ठादिमुनीश्वराः /
योगीन्द्राः सनकाद्याश्च नारदाद्याः सुरर्षयः //
text_mt: the sages led by Mārkaṇḍeya, the lords of sages led by Vasiṣṭha, / the foremost yogins led by Sanaka, the celestial seers led by Nārada,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmadevaprabhṛtayo jīvanmuktāḥ śukādayaḥ /
yakṣakinnara gandharvasiddhavidyādharoragāḥ //
meaning:
वामदेवप्रभृतयो जीवन्मुक्ताः शुकादयः /
यक्षकिन्नर गन्धर्वसिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः //
text_mt: Vāmadeva and others, those liberated while living led by Śuka, / the yakṣas, kinnaras, gandharvas, siddhas, vidyādharas, and serpents,

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇāgraṇīrmahāśāstā durgādyāścaiva mātaraḥ /
yā yāstu devatāḥ proktāstāḥ sarvāḥ parameśvarīm //
meaning:
गणाग्रणीर्महाशास्ता दुर्गाद्याश्चैव मातरः /
या यास्तु देवताः प्रोक्तास्ताः सर्वाः परमेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: the leader of the Gaṇas, the great Śāstā, Durgā and the Mothers, / whatever deities are mentioned—all of them, standing on an auspicious seat and an aerial chariot,

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāsanavimānasthā nemuḥ prāñjalayastadā /
manasā nirmitaṃ dhātrā madhye nagaramadbhutam //
meaning:
भद्रासनविमानस्था नेमुः प्राञ्जलयस्तदा /
मनसा निर्मितं धात्रा मध्ये नगरमद्भुतम् //
text_mt: then bowed with folded hands to the Supreme Goddess. / In the middle of the wondrous city fashioned mentally by the creator,

sanskrit_iast:
mandiraṃ parameśānyā manoharatamaṃ śubham /
śrīmatā vāsudevena sodarema maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
मन्दिरं परमेशान्या मनोहरतमं शुभम् /
श्रीमता वासुदेवेन सोदरेम महेश्वरः //
text_mt: in the most delightful and auspicious temple of the Supreme Mistress, / the lord Bhava, the Great Lord, in the presence of the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
tatrodavoḍhatāṃ gaurīmupāgni bhagavānbhavaḥ /
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha //
meaning:
तत्रोदवोढतां गौरीमुपाग्नि भगवान्भवः /
देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिः पपात ह //
text_mt: married that Gaurī given by her brother, the venerable Vāsudeva. / Celestial drums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell.

sanskrit_iast:
dampatyorjagatāṃ patyoḥ pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam /
ko vā varṇayituṃ śakto yadi jihvāsahasravān //
meaning:
दम्पत्योर्जगतां पत्योः पाणिग्रहणमङ्गलम् /
को वा वर्णयितुं शक्तो यदि जिह्वासहस्रवान् //
text_mt: Who indeed would be able to describe the auspicious taking of hands / of that couple, the two lords of the worlds, even if possessing a thousand tongues?

sanskrit_iast:
ādiśrīmandirasyāsya vāyubhāge maheśituḥ /
vistṛtaṃ bhuvanaśreṣṭhaṃ kalpitaṃ parameṣṭhinā //
meaning:
आदिश्रीमन्दिरस्यास्य वायुभागे महेशितुः /
विस्तृतं भुवनश्रेष्ठं कल्पितं परमेष्ठिना //
text_mt: In the northwestern quarter of this primordial, splendid temple of the Great Lord, / a vast, excellent abode was prepared by Parameṣṭhin;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīgṛhasyāgnibhāge tu vicitraṃ viṣṇumandiram /
itthaṃ tā devatāstatra tisraḥ sannihitāḥ sadā //
meaning:
श्रीगृहस्याग्निभागे तु विचित्रं विष्णुमन्दिरम् /
इत्थं ता देवतास्तत्र तिस्रः सन्निहिताः सदा //
text_mt: and in the southeastern quarter of the splendid residence, a wondrous temple of Viṣṇu. / Thus those three deities are perpetually present there.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tatparau dampatī tu tau /
prāptau sabhāvanāgāraṃ tadā vidhijanārdanau //
meaning:
तदा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तत्परौ दम्पती तु तौ /
प्राप्तौ सभावनागारं तदा विधिजनार्दनौ //
text_mt: Then, having circumambulated [the fire], that couple, wholly devoted to it, / reached the hall of assembly; then the creator and Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
samāgamya ca sabhyānāṃ samāstānāṃyathāvidhi /
saṃskāraṃ vaidikairmantraiḥ kathayāmāsaturmudā //
meaning:
समागम्य च सभ्यानां समास्तानांयथाविधि /
संस्कारं वैदिकैर्मन्त्रैः कथयामासतुर्मुदा //
text_mt: having arrived, joyfully proclaimed to the assembled guests / the rite according to rule with Vedic mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyādilakṣmīḥ sarveṣāṃ purataḥ śrīpareśvarī /
virañciṃ dakṣiṇenākṣṇā vāmena harimaikṣata //
meaning:
आद्यादिलक्ष्मीः सर्वेषां पुरतः श्रीपरेश्वरी /
विरञ्चिं दक्षिणेनाक्ष्णा वामेन हरिमैक्षत //
text_mt: The primordial, original Lakṣmī, the auspicious Supreme Ruler in front of all, / looked upon Virañci with her right eye and upon Hari with her left.

sanskrit_iast:
kā nāma vāṇī mā nāma kamalā te ubhe tataḥ /
prādurbhūte prabhāpuñje pañjarānta iva sthite //
meaning:
का नाम वाणी मा नाम कमला ते उभे ततः /
प्रादुर्भूते प्रभापुञ्जे पञ्जरान्त इव स्थिते //
text_mt: Then those two—'Kā' named Vāṇī, and 'Mā' named Kamalā— / appeared in a mass of splendor, as if standing inside a cage.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevatānamacchīrṣabaddhāñjalipuṭāvubhau /
jaya kāmākṣikāmākṣītyūcatustāṃ praṇematuḥ //
meaning:
श्रीदेवतानमच्छीर्षबद्धाञ्जलिपुटावुभौ /
जय कामाक्षिकामाक्षीत्यूचतुस्तां प्रणेमतुः //
text_mt: With bowed heads and folded hands before the auspicious Goddess, / they both said, 'Victory, O Kāmākṣī, Kāmākṣī!' and bowed down to her.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrte ca gaṅgāyamune tatra sevārthamāgate /
tisraḥ koṭyor'dhakoṭī ca yā yāstīr thādhidevatāḥ //
meaning:
मूर्ते च गङ्गायमुने तत्र सेवार्थमागते /
तिस्रः कोट्योर्ऽधकोटी च या यास्तीर् थाधिदेवताः //
text_mt: Gaṅgā and Yamunā also arrived there in embodied form to render service, / and the three and a half crores of presiding deities of sacred fords,

sanskrit_iast:
sevārthaṃ tripurāṃbā yāstāstāḥ sarvāḥ samāgatāḥ /
tadā karābhyāmādāya cāmare bhāratīśriyau /
śrīdevīmupatasthāte vījayantyau yathocitam //
meaning:
सेवार्थं त्रिपुरांबा यास्तास्ताः सर्वाः समागताः /
तदा कराभ्यामादाय चामरे भारतीश्रियौ /
श्रीदेवीमुपतस्थाते वीजयन्त्यौ यथोचितम् //
text_mt: whatever ones there were, all came to serve the Mother Tripurā. / Then Bhāratī and Śrī, taking chowries in their hands, / attended upon the Goddess, fanning her as was fitting,

sanskrit_iast:
anarghyaratnakhacitakiṅkiṇīcitadorlate /
ādiśrīnayanotpanne te ubhe bhāratīśriyau //
meaning:
अनर्घ्यरत्नखचितकिङ्किणीचितदोर्लते /
आदिश्रीनयनोत्पन्ने ते उभे भारतीश्रियौ //
text_mt: their creeper-like arms adorned with tinkling bells inlaid with priceless gems; / both Bhāratī and Śrī were born from the eyes of the primordial Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvīkṣya sarvajanatā viśeṣeṇa visismiye /
tadā prabhṛti kalyāṇī kāmākṣītyabhidhāmiyāt /
taduccāraṇamātreṇa śrīdevī śaṃ prayacchati //
meaning:
संवीक्ष्य सर्वजनता विशेषेण विसिस्मिये /
तदा प्रभृति कल्याणी कामाक्षीत्यभिधामियात् /
तदुच्चारणमात्रेण श्रीदेवी शं प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Having beheld [it], all the people wondered exceedingly. / From that time on, the auspicious goddess obtained the name Kāmākṣī; / merely by its utterance, the holy goddess grants well-being.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākṣīti trayo varṇāḥ sarvamaṅgalahetavaḥ /
atha sā jagadīśānī vedavedāṅgapārage //
meaning:
कामाक्षीति त्रयो वर्णाः सर्वमङ्गलहेतवः /
अथ सा जगदीशानी वेदवेदाङ्गपारगे //
text_mt: The three syllables "Kā-mā-kṣī" are the cause of all auspiciousness. / Then that ruler of the universe commanded Sarasvatī: / "Reside constantly in Brahmā, who has reached the end of the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences."

sanskrit_iast:
vidhau nityaṃ niṣīdeti saṃdideśa sarasvatīm /
sāpi vāṇīśvarī gaṅgāhastanikṣiptacāmarā /
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ vidhāturmukhamāviśat //
meaning:
विधौ नित्यं निषीदेति संदिदेश सरस्वतीम् /
सापि वाणीश्वरी गङ्गाहस्तनिक्षिप्तचामरा /
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां विधातुर्मुखमाविशत् //
text_mt: She too, the goddess of speech, who had handed over her chowrie into Gaṅgā's hand, / entered the mouth of the creator while all the gods were looking on.

sanskrit_iast:
indirā ca mahālakṣmyā saṃdiṣṭā tuṣṭayā tathā /
yathocitanivāsāya viṣṇorvakṣasthalaṃ mudā /
tadājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā ramā viṣṇuśca bhaktitaḥ //
meaning:
इन्दिरा च महालक्ष्म्या संदिष्टा तुष्टया तथा /
यथोचितनिवासाय विष्णोर्वक्षस्थलं मुदा /
तदाज्ञां शिरसा धृत्वा रमा विष्णुश्च भक्तितः //
text_mt: And Indirā was likewise instructed by the pleased Mahālakṣmī / to reside appropriately and joyfully upon Viṣṇu's chest. / Bearing her command on their heads with devotion, Ramā and Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvubhau daṃpatī natvā mahātripurasundarīm /
prārthayāmāsaturbhūyastadāvaraṇadevatām //
meaning:
तावुभौ दंपती नत्वा महात्रिपुरसुन्दरीम् /
प्रार्थयामासतुर्भूयस्तदावरणदेवताम् //
text_mt: both of them, husband and wife, having bowed to Mahātripurasundarī, / repeatedly prayed to be surrounding deities of hers.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāstviti varaṃ dattvā tābhyāṃ tripurasundaram /
tadāvaraṇadevatvaṃ prāptau padmācyutau tadā //
meaning:
तथास्त्विति वरं दत्त्वा ताभ्यां त्रिपुरसुन्दरम् /
तदावरणदेवत्वं प्राप्तौ पद्माच्युतौ तदा //
text_mt: Having granted them the boon, saying "So be it," Tripurasundarī [conferred it], / and then Padmā and Acyuta attained the status of deities in her enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
svapīṭhottaramāsthāpya dakṣiṇe sthitavānsvayam /
athovāca mahāgaurīṃ tvamanyadrūpamācara /
tatra yāto mahāgauryāḥ pratibiṃbo manoharaḥ //
meaning:
स्वपीठोत्तरमास्थाप्य दक्षिणे स्थितवान्स्वयम् /
अथोवाच महागौरीं त्वमन्यद्रूपमाचर /
तत्र यातो महागौर्याः प्रतिबिंबो मनोहरः //
text_mt: Having installed [her] to the north of his own seat, he himself stood to the south. / Then he said to Mahāgaurī: "Assume another form." / There went forth an enchanting reflection of Mahāgaurī,

sanskrit_iast:
cakāsaddivyadehena mahāgaurīsamākṛtiḥ /
taruṇāruṇarājābhasaindaryacaraṇadvayaḥ //
meaning:
चकासद्दिव्यदेहेन महागौरीसमाकृतिः /
तरुणारुणराजाभसैन्दर्यचरणद्वयः //
text_mt: shining with a divine body, identical in form to Mahāgaurī, / whose pair of feet possessed the radiant beauty of the youthful morning sun,

sanskrit_iast:
kvaṇatkaṅkaṇamañjīratittirīkṛtapīṭhakaḥ /
vidyudullāsitasvānamanojñamaṇimekhalaḥ //
meaning:
क्वणत्कङ्कणमञ्जीरतित्तिरीकृतपीठकः /
विद्युदुल्लासितस्वानमनोज्ञमणिमेखलः //
text_mt: whose footstool was resounded by tinkling bangles and anklets, / possessing a pleasing jewelled girdle that flashed like lightning and made sweet sounds,

sanskrit_iast:
ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūravirājitabhujadvayaḥ /
muktāvaidūryamāṇikya nibaddhavarabandhanaḥ //
meaning:
रत्नकङ्कणकेयूरविराजितभुजद्वयः /
मुक्तावैदूर्यमाणिक्य निबद्धवरबन्धनः //
text_mt: whose pair of arms was adorned with jewelled bracelets and armlets, / bound with excellent ornaments inlaid with pearls, cat's-eyes, and rubies,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhrājamāno madhyena valitritayaśobhitaḥ /
jāhnavīsaridāvartaśobhinābhīvibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
विभ्राजमानो मध्येन वलित्रितयशोभितः /
जाह्नवीसरिदावर्तशोभिनाभीविभूषितः //
text_mt: radiant in her waist, adorned with three folds of skin, / embellished with a navel beautiful as an eddy in the river of the Gaṅgā,

sanskrit_iast:
pāṭīrapaṅkakarpūrakuṅkumālaṅkṛtastanaḥ /
āmuktamuktālaṅkārabhāsurastanakuñcukaḥ //
meaning:
पाटीरपङ्ककर्पूरकुङ्कुमालङ्कृतस्तनः /
आमुक्तमुक्तालङ्कारभासुरस्तनकुञ्चुकः //
