text_mt: whose breasts were anointed with sandalwood paste, camphor, and saffron, / whose bodice over her breasts shone with worn pearl ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
vinodena kaṭīdeśalaṃbamānasuśṛṅkhalaḥ /
māṇikyaśakalābaddhamudrikābhiralaṅkṛtaḥ //
meaning:
विनोदेन कटीदेशलंबमानसुशृङ्खलः /
माणिक्यशकलाबद्धमुद्रिकाभिरलङ्कृतः //
text_mt: having a beautiful chain playfully hanging down around her waist, / adorned with rings inlaid with pieces of ruby,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastāṃbujāsaktasnigdhojjavalamanoharaḥ /
ābhātyāprapadīnasragdivyākalpakadaṃbakaiḥ //
meaning:
दक्षहस्तांबुजासक्तस्निग्धोज्जवलमनोहरः /
आभात्याप्रपदीनस्रग्दिव्याकल्पकदंबकैः //
text_mt: charming, glossy, and radiant, clasping a lotus in her right hand, / shining with a garland reaching down to her feet and clusters of divine ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
dīptabhūṣaṇaratnāṃśurājirājitadiṅmukhaḥ /
taptahāṭakasaṃkḷptaratnagrībopaśobhitaḥ //
meaning:
दीप्तभूषणरत्नांशुराजिराजितदिङ्मुखः /
तप्तहाटकसंकॢप्तरत्नग्रीबोपशोभितः //
text_mt: illuminating the quarters of space with rows of rays from her radiant jewels and ornaments, / adorned with a jewelled necklace made of refined gold,

sanskrit_iast:
māṅgalyasūtraratnāṃśuśoṇimādharakandharaḥ /
pālīvataṃsamāṇikyatāṭaṅkaparibhūṣitaḥ //
meaning:
माङ्गल्यसूत्ररत्नांशुशोणिमाधरकन्धरः /
पालीवतंसमाणिक्यताटङ्कपरिभूषितः //
text_mt: the lower part of whose neck was reddened by the rays from the jewels of her auspicious marriage thread, / adorned with earrings of rubies and ear-ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
japāvidrumalāvaṇyalalitādharapallavaḥ /
dāḍimīphalabījābhadantapaṅktivirājitaḥ //
meaning:
जपाविद्रुमलावण्यललिताधरपल्लवः /
दाडिमीफलबीजाभदन्तपङ्क्तिविराजितः //
text_mt: whose sprout-like lower lip was lovely with the beauty of a hibiscus flower and coral, / adorned with a row of teeth resembling the seeds of a pomegranate,

sanskrit_iast:
mandamandasmitollāsikapolaphalakomalaḥ /
aupamyarahitodāranāsāmaṇimanoharaḥ //
meaning:
मन्दमन्दस्मितोल्लासिकपोलफलकोमलः /
औपम्यरहितोदारनासामणिमनोहरः //
text_mt: soft in the expanse of her cheeks, radiant with a gentle, gentle smile, / enchanting with an incomparable, noble nose-gem,

sanskrit_iast:
vilasattilapuṣpaśrīvimalonnata nāsikaḥ /
īṣadunmeṣamadhuranīlotpalavilocanaḥ //
meaning:
विलसत्तिलपुष्पश्रीविमलोन्नत नासिकः /
ईषदुन्मेषमधुरनीलोत्पलविलोचनः //
text_mt: with a spotless, prominent nose having the beauty of a blossoming sesame flower, / whose eyes were blue water lilies sweet in their slight opening,

sanskrit_iast:
navaprasūnacāpaśrīlalitabhrūvikāśakaḥ /
arddhendutulito bhāle pūrṇendurucirānanaḥ //
meaning:
नवप्रसूनचापश्रीललितभ्रूविकाशकः /
अर्द्धेन्दुतुलितो भाले पूर्णेन्दुरुचिराननः //
text_mt: revealing lovely eyebrows with the beauty of a bow made of fresh flowers, / with a forehead rivaling the half-moon, and a face pleasing as the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃdrasaurabhasaṃpannakastūrītilakojjvalaḥ /
mattālimālāvilasadalakāḍhyamukhāṃbujaḥ //
meaning:
सांद्रसौरभसंपन्नकस्तूरीतिलकोज्ज्वलः /
मत्तालिमालाविलसदलकाढ्यमुखांबुजः //
text_mt: bright with a musk tilaka full of thick fragrance, / whose lotus face was rich with curls shining like a swarm of intoxicated bees,

sanskrit_iast:
pārijātaprasūnasragvāhidhammillabandhanaḥ /
atyartharatnakhacitamukuṭāñcitamastakaḥ //
meaning:
पारिजातप्रसूनस्रग्वाहिधम्मिल्लबन्धनः /
अत्यर्थरत्नखचितमुकुटाञ्चितमस्तकः //
text_mt: with braided hair bound and bearing a garland of Pārijāta blossoms, / whose head was crowned with a diadem thickly inlaid with jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalāvaṇyavasatirbhavanaṃ vibhramāśriyaḥ /
śivo viṣṇuśca tatratyāḥ samastāśca mahājanāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वलावण्यवसतिर्भवनं विभ्रमाश्रियः /
शिवो विष्णुश्च तत्रत्याः समस्ताश्च महाजनाः //
text_mt: the dwelling of all beauty, the abode of graceful charm. / Śiva, Viṣṇu, and all the noble persons present there

sanskrit_iast:
biṃbasya tasya devyāśca abhedaṃ jagṛhustadā /
atha tarhi maheśānī svatantrā praviveśa ha //
meaning:
बिंबस्य तस्य देव्याश्च अभेदं जगृहुस्तदा /
अथ तर्हि महेशानी स्वतन्त्रा प्रविवेश ह //
text_mt: perceived at that time no difference between that reflection and the goddess. / Then the supreme sovereign lady, self-willed, entered it.

sanskrit_iast:
agrataḥ sarbadevānāmāśrayeṇa prapaśyatām /
bimbaṃ kṛtvātmanā bimbe saṃpraviśya sthitāṃ ca tām /
dṛṣṭvā bhūyo namaskṛtya punaḥ prārthitavānvidhiḥ //
meaning:
अग्रतः सर्बदेवानामाश्रयेण प्रपश्यताम् /
बिम्बं कृत्वात्मना बिम्बे संप्रविश्य स्थितां च ताम् /
दृष्ट्वा भूयो नमस्कृत्य पुनः प्रार्थितवान्विधिः //
text_mt: Before all the gods who were looking on with wonder, / having made a reflection of herself and having entered that reflection, / seeing her standing there and bowing once again, the creator prayed:

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇabrahme mahāśakte mahātripurasundari /
śrīkāmākṣīti vikhyāte namastubhyaṃ dinedine /
kiñcidvijñāpayāmyadya śṛṇu tatkṛpayā mama //
meaning:
पूर्णब्रह्मे महाशक्ते महात्रिपुरसुन्दरि /
श्रीकामाक्षीति विख्याते नमस्तुभ्यं दिनेदिने /
किञ्चिद्विज्ञापयाम्यद्य शृणु तत्कृपया मम //
text_mt: "O complete Brahman! O great power! O Mahātripurasundarī! / O goddess renowned as glorious Kāmākṣī! Salutation to you day after day. / Today I make a request; please listen to it out of your compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva tu mahāgauryā maheśasyobhayorapi /
śrīdevi nityakalyāṇi vivāhaḥ prativatsaram /
kartavyo jagatāmṛddhasevāyai ca divaukasām //
meaning:
अत्रैव तु महागौर्या महेशस्योभयोरपि /
श्रीदेवि नित्यकल्याणि विवाहः प्रतिवत्सरम् /
कर्तव्यो जगतामृद्धसेवायै च दिवौकसाम् //
text_mt: Right here, of both Mahāgaurī and the great lord, / O holy goddess, eternally auspicious one, the marriage / should be performed every year for the prosperity of the worlds and for the worship by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūloke 'sminmahādevi vimūḍhā janatā api /
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktito natvā prayāntu paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
भूलोके ऽस्मिन्महादेवि विमूढा जनता अपि /
तां दृष्ट्वा भक्तितो नत्वा प्रयान्तु परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: Even the deluded people in this mortal world, / having seen it and bowed with devotion, may attain the supreme destination."

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyākāśavāṇyā tu dadau tasyauttaraṃ parā /
visasarja ca sarvāṃstānsvaniketanivṛttaye //
meaning:
तथेत्याकाशवाण्या तु ददौ तस्यौत्तरं परा /
विससर्ज च सर्वांस्तान्स्वनिकेतनिवृत्तये //
text_mt: "So be it," the supreme goddess replied to him by a voice from the sky, / and she dismissed all of them to return to their own abodes.

sanskrit_iast:
tadadbhutatamaṃ śīlaṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā muhurmuhuḥ /
tāṃ namaskṛtya te sarve tato jagamuryathāgatam //
meaning:
तदद्भुततमं शीलं स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा मुहुर्मुहुः /
तां नमस्कृत्य ते सर्वे ततो जगमुर्यथागतम् //
text_mt: Remembering that most wondrous conduct again and again, / bowing down to her, they all departed thence just as they had come.

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahastu hṛṣṭātmā mukundena śivena ca /
sārdhaṃ śrīmandire tatra mantropetāṃ niveśya ca /
ārādhya vaidikaiḥ stotraiḥ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇanāma saḥ //
meaning:
पितामहस्तु हृष्टात्मा मुकुन्देन शिवेन च /
सार्धं श्रीमन्दिरे तत्र मन्त्रोपेतां निवेश्य च /
आराध्य वैदिकैः स्तोत्रैः साष्टाङ्गं प्रणनाम सः //
text_mt: Then the grandfather [Brahmā], delighted in mind, along with Mukunda and Śiva, / having installed her accompanied by mantras in that holy temple, / and having worshipped her with Vedic hymns, bowed down with eight limbs to the ground.

sanskrit_iast: athākāśagirā devī brahmāṇamidamabravīt //
meaning: अथाकाशगिरा देवी ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Then, through a voice from the sky, the goddess said this to Brahmā:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ ca svasthāne samādhāya samāhitaḥ /
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tatra sevāṃ kurudṛḍhāśaya //
meaning:
विष्णुं शिवं च स्वस्थाने समाधाय समाहितः /
प्रतिसंवत्सरं तत्र सेवां कुरुदृढाशय //
text_mt: "Having established Viṣṇu and Śiva in their proper places, with a concentrated mind / perform service there every year, firm in purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃvyaktamiha śrīśamitreśāṃbāsamanvitam /
śrīkāmagiripīṭhaṃ tu sākṣācchrīpuramadhyagam //
meaning:
स्वयंव्यक्तमिह श्रीशमित्रेशांबासमन्वितम् /
श्रीकामगिरिपीठं तु साक्षाच्छ्रीपुरमध्यगम् //
text_mt: Here, self-manifested, accompanied by the Mother, the Lord of Śrī, and Mitreśa, / lies the sacred Kāmagiri seat, situated directly in the center of the glorious city.

sanskrit_iast: vāmabhāge vṛtaṃ lakṣyaṃ viṣṇunānyatra sevinam //
meaning: वामभागे वृतं लक्ष्यं विष्णुनान्यत्र सेविनम् //
text_mt: Surrounded on the left side, visible, with Viṣṇu serving elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
cidānandākārarūpaṃ sarvapīṭhādhidaivatam /
adṛśyamūrtimavyaktamādadhāra yathā vidhi //
meaning:
चिदानन्दाकाररूपं सर्वपीठाधिदैवतम् /
अदृश्यमूर्तिमव्यक्तमादधार यथा विधि //
text_mt: Having the form of consciousness and bliss, the presiding deity of all seats, / having an invisible, unmanifest form, he maintained it according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanojñe sunakṣatre dalānāṃ hīrakorakaiḥ /
arciṣmadbhirapradhṛṣyairllokānāmabhivṛddhaye //
meaning:
श्रीमनोज्ञे सुनक्षत्रे दलानां हीरकोरकैः /
अर्चिष्मद्भिरप्रधृष्यैर्ल्लोकानामभिवृद्धये //
text_mt: Under a beautiful, auspicious constellation, with diamond buds as its petals, / radiant and invincible, for the prosperity of the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
idānīṃ tvaṃ tadabhyarcya yadhāvidhi vidhe mudā /
maṇḍalaṃ tvakhilaṃ kṛtvā nijalokaṃ hi pālaya //
meaning:
इदानीं त्वं तदभ्यर्च्य यधाविधि विधे मुदा /
मण्डलं त्वखिलं कृत्वा निजलोकं हि पालय //
text_mt: Now having worshipped it joyfully according to rule, O creator, / having completed the entire diagram, protect your own realm."

sanskrit_iast:
ityukto bhagavānbrahmā tathā kṛtvā tadīritam /
nikṣipya hṛdi tāṃ devīṃ nijaṃ dhāma jagāma saḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तो भगवान्ब्रह्मा तथा कृत्वा तदीरितम् /
निक्षिप्य हृदि तां देवीं निजं धाम जगाम सः //
text_mt: Thus addressed, Lord Brahmā, having done what she said / and having placed that goddess in his heart, went to his own abode.

sanskrit_iast:
iti te tattvataḥ proktaṃ kāmākṣīśīlamadbhutam /
sākṣādevamahālakṣmīmimāṃ viddhi ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
इति ते तत्त्वतः प्रोक्तं कामाक्षीशीलमद्भुतम् /
साक्षादेवमहालक्ष्मीमिमां विद्धि घटोद्भव //
text_mt: Thus the wondrous nature of Kāmākṣī has been recounted to you in truth; / know her to be Mahālakṣmī herself, O pitcher-born one!

sanskrit_iast:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi prayataḥ paṭhet /
tasya bhuktiśca muktiśca karasthā nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चापि प्रयतः पठेत् /
तस्य भुक्तिश्च मुक्तिश्च करस्था नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Whoever listens to this constantly, and whoever recites it with restraint, / worldly enjoyment and liberation are in his hand; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatisamo buddhyā sarvavidyādhipo bhavet /
ādirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānbhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या सर्वविद्याधिपो भवेत् /
आदिर्नारायणः श्रीमान्भगवान्भक्तवत्सलः //
text_mt: He becomes equal to Bṛhaspati in intellect and master of all lore. / Formerly, the primeval Nārāyaṇa, the glorious Lord who loves his devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
tapasā toṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā ca cirakālataḥ /
sārūpyamuktiṃ kṛpayā dattvā putrāya me prabhuḥ /
mahātripurasundaryā mahātmyaṃ samupādiśat //
meaning:
तपसा तोषितः पूर्वं मया च चिरकालतः /
सारूप्यमुक्तिं कृपया दत्त्वा पुत्राय मे प्रभुः /
महात्रिपुरसुन्दर्या महात्म्यं समुपादिशत् //
text_mt: was pleased by my asceticism over a long time; / having granted out of compassion liberation of equal form to my son, the Lord / taught the greatness of Mahātripurasundarī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastasmādahaṃ kiñcidvedmi vakṣye na cānyathā /
rahasyamantraṃ saṃvakṣyeśṛṇu taṃ tvaṃ samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तस्मादहं किञ्चिद्वेद्मि वक्ष्ये न चान्यथा /
रहस्यमन्त्रं संवक्ष्येशृणु तं त्वं समाहितः //
text_mt: Therefore, I know a little from that, and I will speak nothing otherwise; / I shall declare the secret mantra, listen to it attentively.

sanskrit_iast:
na brahmā na ca viṣṇurvā na rudraśca trayo 'pyamī /
mohitā māyayā yasyāsturīyastu sa ceśvaraḥ /
sadāśivo na jānāti kathaṃ prākṛtadevatāḥ //
meaning:
न ब्रह्मा न च विष्णुर्वा न रुद्रश्च त्रयो ऽप्यमी /
मोहिता मायया यस्यास्तुरीयस्तु स चेश्वरः /
सदाशिवो न जानाति कथं प्राकृतदेवताः //
text_mt: Neither Brahmā, nor Viṣṇu, nor Rudra—even these three / are deluded by her māyā; and the fourth lord, / Sadāśiva, does not know [her]—how then could the ordinary gods?

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivastu sarvātmā saccidānandavigrahaḥ /
akartumanyathā kartuṃ kartumasyā anugrahāt //
meaning:
सदाशिवस्तु सर्वात्मा सच्चिदानन्दविग्रहः /
अकर्तुमन्यथा कर्तुं कर्तुमस्या अनुग्रहात् //
text_mt: Sadāśiva is the self of all, his embodiment is being, consciousness, and bliss; / through her grace he is able to do, not to do, and to do otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā kaścittadevāhaṃ manyamāno maheśvaraḥ /
tanmāyāmohito bhūtvā tvavaśaḥ śavatāmagāt //
meaning:
सदा कश्चित्तदेवाहं मन्यमानो महेश्वरः /
तन्मायामोहितो भूत्वा त्ववशः शवतामगात् //
text_mt:
Thinking constantly, “I alone am that,” Maheśvara,
bewildered by her māyā, helplessly turned into a corpse.

sanskrit_iast:
saiva kāraṇameteṣāmutpattau ca laye 'pi ca /
kaścidatra viśeṣo 'sti vaktavyāṃśo 'pi taṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
सैव कारणमेतेषामुत्पत्तौ च लये ऽपि च /
कश्चिदत्र विशेषो ऽस्ति वक्तव्यांशो ऽपि तं शृणु //
text_mt: She alone is the cause of their arising and their dissolution as well. / There is a particular point to be spoken of here, so listen to it:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca turīyastvīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ /
caturṇāmapi sarveṣāmādi kartā sadāśivaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादीनां त्रयाणां च तुरीयस्त्वीश्वरः प्रभुः /
चतुर्णामपि सर्वेषामादि कर्ता सदाशिवः //
text_mt: Of the three beginning with Brahmā, Īśvara is the fourth lord, / and of all four of them, Sadāśiva is the primordial maker.

sanskrit_iast:
etadrahasyaṃ kathitaṃ tasyāścaritamadbhutam /
bhūya eva pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānamanāḥ śṛṇu //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतद्रहस्यं कथितं तस्याश्चरितमद्भुतम् /
भूय एव प्रवक्ष्यामि सावधानमनाः शृणु //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
This secret and her wondrous deed have been narrated. / I will tell you further still; listen with an attentive mind.

Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious Mahāpurāṇa, the Brahmāṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
śrīkāmakoṣṭhapīṭhasthā mahātripurasundarī /
kaṅkaṃ vilāsamakarotkāmākṣītyabhiviśrutā //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
श्रीकामकोष्ठपीठस्था महात्रिपुरसुन्दरी /
कङ्कं विलासमकरोत्कामाक्षीत्यभिविश्रुता //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Residing at the seat of the glorious Kāmakoṣṭhapīṭha, Mahātripurasundarī / performed what sports, renowned as Kāmākṣī?

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmākṣīti sā devī mahātripurasuṃdarī /
bhūmaṇḍalasthitā devī kiṃ karoti maheśvarī /
etasyāścaritaṃ divyaṃ vada me vadatāṃ vara //
meaning:
श्रीकामाक्षीति सा देवी महात्रिपुरसुंदरी /
भूमण्डलस्थिता देवी किं करोति महेश्वरी /
एतस्याश्चरितं दिव्यं वद मे वदतां वर //
text_mt: That goddess, glorious Kāmākṣī, Mahātripurasundarī— / what did that goddess, the Maheśvarī, do while residing on the earthly orb? / Speak to me of her divine history, O best of speakers!

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
atra sthitāpi sarveṣāṃ hṛdayasthā ghaṭodbhava /
tattatkarmānurūpaṃ sā pradatte dehināṃ phalam //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
अत्र स्थितापि सर्वेषां हृदयस्था घटोद्भव /
तत्तत्कर्मानुरूपं सा प्रदत्ते देहिनां फलम् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Even while residing there, O pot-born [sage], she dwells within the hearts of all; / she bestows upon embodied beings the fruit appropriate to their respective actions.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiñcidvartate loke sarvamasyā viceṣṭitam /
kiñciccintayate kaścitsvacchandaṃ vidadhātyasau //
meaning:
यत्किञ्चिद्वर्तते लोके सर्वमस्या विचेष्टितम् /
किञ्चिच्चिन्तयते कश्चित्स्वच्छन्दं विदधात्यसौ //
text_mt: Whatever exists in the world is entirely her activity. / Whatever anyone thinks, she independently brings about.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyā evāvatārāstu tripurādyāśca śaktayaḥ /
iyameva mahālakṣmīḥ sasarjāṇḍatrayaṃ purā //
meaning:
तस्या एवावतारास्तु त्रिपुराद्याश्च शक्तयः /
इयमेव महालक्ष्मीः ससर्जाण्डत्रयं पुरा //
text_mt: Her incarnations indeed are Tripurā and the other Śaktis. / She herself, as Mahālakṣmī, emitted the triad of eggs long ago,

sanskrit_iast:
paratrayāṇāmāvāsaṃ śaktīnāṃ tisṛṇāmapi /
ekasmādaṇḍato jātāvaṃbikāpuruṣottamau //
meaning:
परत्रयाणामावासं शक्तीनां तिसृणामपि /
एकस्मादण्डतो जातावंबिकापुरुषोत्तमौ //
text_mt: the abode of the supreme three and of the three Śaktis as well. / From one egg were born Ambikā and Puruṣottama;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīviriñcau tato 'nyasmādanya smācca girāśivau /
indirāṃ yojayāmāsa mukundena maheśvarī /
pārvatyā parameśānaṃ sarasvatyā pitāmaham //
meaning:
श्रीविरिञ्चौ ततो ऽन्यस्मादन्य स्माच्च गिराशिवौ /
इन्दिरां योजयामास मुकुन्देन महेश्वरी /
पार्वत्या परमेशानं सरस्वत्या पितामहम् //
text_mt: from another, Śrī and Viriñca; and from the other, Girā and Śiva. / The Maheśvarī united Indirā with Mukunda, / Pārvatī with Parameśāna, and Sarasvatī with Pitāmaha.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ sarva lokānāṃ sṛṣṭikārye nyayuṅkta sā /
vāsudevaṃ paritrāṇe saṃhāre ca trilocanam //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणं सर्व लोकानां सृष्टिकार्ये न्ययुङ्क्त सा /
वासुदेवं परित्राणे संहारे च त्रिलोचनम् //
text_mt: She appointed Brahmā to the task of creating all the worlds, / Vāsudeva to preservation, and the three-eyed [god] to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve 'pi mahālakṣmīṃ dhyāyantaḥ śarmadāṃ sadā /
brahmaloke ca vaikuṇṭhe kailāse ca vasaṃtyamī //
meaning:
ते सर्वे ऽपि महालक्ष्मीं ध्यायन्तः शर्मदां सदा /
ब्रह्मलोके च वैकुण्ठे कैलासे च वसंत्यमी //
text_mt: All of them, constantly meditating upon Mahālakṣmī, the giver of happiness, / reside in the world of Brahmā, in Vaikuṇṭha, and on Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
kadācitpārvatī devī kailāsaśikhare śubhe /
viharantī maheśasya pidhānaṃ netrayorvyadhāt //
meaning:
कदाचित्पार्वती देवी कैलासशिखरे शुभे /
विहरन्ती महेशस्य पिधानं नेत्रयोर्व्यधात् //
text_mt: Once, sporting on the auspicious peak of Kailāsa, / the goddess Pārvatī covered the eyes of Maheśa.

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryauṃ yatastasya netrāttasmājjagattrayam /
andhakārāvṛtamabhūdatejaskaṃ samantataḥ //
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यौं यतस्तस्य नेत्रात्तस्माज्जगत्त्रयम् /
अन्धकारावृतमभूदतेजस्कं समन्ततः //
text_mt: Since the moon and sun are his eyes, the three worlds / became enveloped in darkness and completely devoid of light.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca sakalā lokā styaktadevapitṛktiyāḥ /
iti karttavyatāmūḍhā na prajānanta kiñcana //
meaning:
ततश्च सकला लोका स्त्यक्तदेवपितृक्तियाः /
इति कर्त्तव्यतामूढा न प्रजानन्त किञ्चन //
text_mt: Thereupon all people abandoned the rites for the gods and the ancestors; / bewildered as to what should be done, they understood nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvā bhagavānrudraḥ pārvatīmidamabravīt /
tvayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ devi mama netrapidhānataḥ //
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वा भगवान्रुद्रः पार्वतीमिदमब्रवीत् /
त्वया पापं कृतं देवि मम नेत्रपिधानतः //
text_mt: Seeing that, the Lord Rudra spoke this to Pārvatī: / "A sin has been committed by you, O goddess, by covering my eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣayastyaktatapaso hatasandhyāśca vaidikāḥ /
sarvaṃ ca vaidikaṃ karma tvayā nāśitamaṃbike //
meaning:
ऋषयस्त्यक्ततपसो हतसन्ध्याश्च वैदिकाः /
सर्वं च वैदिकं कर्म त्वया नाशितमंबिके //
text_mt: The sages have abandoned their austerities, the twilight rites of the Vedic practitioners are ruined, / and every Vedic rite has been destroyed by you, O Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpāpasya śāntyarthaṃ tapaḥ kuru suduṣkaram /
gatvā kāśīṃ vrataṃ tatra kiñcitkālaṃ samācara //
meaning:
तस्मात्पापस्य शान्त्यर्थं तपः कुरु सुदुष्करम् /
गत्वा काशीं व्रतं तत्र किञ्चित्कालं समाचर //
text_mt: Therefore, for the expiation of the sin, perform severe austerity; / go to Kāśī and observe an ascetic vow there for some time.

sanskrit_iast:
paścātkāñcīpuraṃ gatvā kāmākṣīṃ tatra drakṣyasi /
ārādhayaitāṃ nityāṃ tvaṃ sarvapāpaharīṃ śivām //
meaning:
पश्चात्काञ्चीपुरं गत्वा कामाक्षीं तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि /
आराधयैतां नित्यां त्वं सर्वपापहरीं शिवाम् //
text_mt: Afterward, having gone to Kāñcīpura, you will see Kāmākṣī there. / Worship this eternal Śivā, the remover of all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīmagrataḥ kṛttvā kampākūle tapaḥ kuru /
ityādiśya mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
तुलसीमग्रतः कृत्त्वा कम्पाकूले तपः कुरु /
इत्यादिश्य महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: Setting a tulasī [plant] before you, perform austerity on the bank of the Kampā." / Having thus instructed her, Mahādeva vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kṛtavatīśānī bharturājñānuvartinī /
cireṇa tapasā kliṣṭāmananyahṛdayāṃ śivām //
meaning:
तथा कृतवतीशानी भर्तुराज्ञानुवर्तिनी /
चिरेण तपसा क्लिष्टामनन्यहृदयां शिवाम् //
text_mt: Īśānī did so, obedient to her husband's command. / As Śivā, single-minded of heart, was afflicted by long austerity,

sanskrit_iast:
agrataḥ kṛtasāṃnidhyā kāmākṣī vākyamabravīt /
vatse tapobhiratyugrairalaṃ prītāsmi suvrate //
meaning:
अग्रतः कृतसांनिध्या कामाक्षी वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
वत्से तपोभिरत्युग्रैरलं प्रीतास्मि सुव्रते //
text_mt: Kāmākṣī, making herself manifest before her, spoke these words: / "My child, enough with these fierce austerities! I am pleased, O woman of firm vows.

sanskrit_iast:
unmīlya nayane paścātpārvatī svapuraḥ sthitām /
bālārkāyutasaṃkāśāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām //
meaning:
उन्मील्य नयने पश्चात्पार्वती स्वपुरः स्थिताम् /
बालार्कायुतसंकाशां सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् //
text_mt: Then Pārvatī, opening her eyes, [saw] standing before her [the goddess] / resembling ten thousand rising suns, adorned with all ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭahārakeyūrakaṭakādyairalaṅkṛtām /
pāśāṅkuśekṣukodaṇḍapañcabāṇalasatkarām //
meaning:
किरीटहारकेयूरकटकाद्यैरलङ्कृताम् /
पाशाङ्कुशेक्षुकोदण्डपञ्चबाणलसत्कराम् //
text_mt: decorated with diadems, necklaces, armlets, bracelets, and the like, / her hands shining with the noose, the goad, the sugarcane bow, and the five arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
kirīṭamukuṭollāsicandrarekhāvibhūṣaṇām /
vidhātṛharirudreśasadāśivapadapradām //
meaning:
किरीटमुकुटोल्लासिचन्द्ररेखाविभूषणाम् /
विधातृहरिरुद्रेशसदाशिवपदप्रदाम् //
text_mt: adorned with the crescent moon shining on her crown and diadem, / bestowing the states of Vidhātṛ, Hari, Rudra, Īśa, and Sadāśiva,

sanskrit_iast:
saguṇaṃ brahmatāmāhuranuttarapadābhidhām /
prapañcadvayanirmāṇakāriṇīṃ tāṃ parāṃbikām //
meaning:
सगुणं ब्रह्मतामाहुरनुत्तरपदाभिधाम् /
प्रपञ्चद्वयनिर्माणकारिणीं तां परांबिकाम् //
text_mt: whom they declare to be the qualified Brahman, whose name is the supreme state, / the primordial Mother who makes the two manifests of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvātha mahārājñīṃ mahā nandapariplutā /
pulakācitasarvāṅgī harṣeṇotphullalocanā //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वाथ महाराज्ञीं महा नन्दपरिप्लुता /
पुलकाचितसर्वाङ्गी हर्षेणोत्फुल्ललोचना //
text_mt: Then, seeing the Great Queen, overwhelmed with great bliss, / all her limbs bristling with hair, her eyes blossoming with joy,

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikāmaṅgalādyaiśca sahasā svasakhījanaiḥ /
praṇipatya ca sāṣṭāṅgaṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām //
meaning:
चण्डिकामङ्गलाद्यैश्च सहसा स्वसखीजनैः /
प्रणिपत्य च साष्टाङ्गं कृत्वा चैव प्रदक्षिणाम् //
text_mt: along with Caṇḍikā, Maṅgalā, and the rest of her female companions, / prostrating with eight limbs and performing circumambulation,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhāñjalipuṭā bhūyaḥ praṇatā svaikyarūpiṇī /
tāmāha kṛpayā vīkṣya mahātripurasuṃdarī //
meaning:
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा भूयः प्रणता स्वैक्यरूपिणी /
तामाह कृपया वीक्ष्य महात्रिपुरसुंदरी //
text_mt: with folded hands, bowed down again, embodying oneness with her— / gazing upon her with grace, Mahātripurasundarī said to her,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhubhyāṃ saṃpariṣvajya sasnehamidamabravīt /
vatse labhasva bhartāraṃ rudraṃ svamanasepsitam //
meaning:
बाहुभ्यां संपरिष्वज्य सस्नेहमिदमब्रवीत् /
वत्से लभस्व भर्तारं रुद्रं स्वमनसेप्सितम् //
text_mt: embracing her with both arms and speaking this affectionately: / "My child, obtain the husband desired by your own mind, Rudra.

sanskrit_iast:
loke tvamapi rakṣārthaṃ mamājñāma nuvartaya /
ahaṃ tvamiti ko bhedastvamevāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
लोके त्वमपि रक्षार्थं ममाज्ञाम नुवर्तय /
अहं त्वमिति को भेदस्त्वमेवाहं न संशयः //
text_mt: For the protection of the world, follow my command as well. / What difference is there between 'I' and 'you'? You are I alone; there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ pāpaṃ tava kalyāṇi tvaṃ hi pāpanikṛntanī /
āmananti hi yogīndrāstvāmeva brahmarūpiṇīm //
meaning:
किं पापं तव कल्याणि त्वं हि पापनिकृन्तनी /
आमनन्ति हि योगीन्द्रास्त्वामेव ब्रह्मरूपिणीम् //
text_mt: What sin can be yours, O auspicious one? For you are the destroyer of sin. / Indeed, the lords of yogins proclaim you alone to be the embodiment of Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
līlāmātramidaṃ vatse paralokaviḍaṃbanam /
ityūciṣīṃ mahārājñīmabikāṃ sarvamaṅgalā /
bhaktyā praṇamya paśyantī parāṃ prītimupāyayau //
meaning:
लीलामात्रमिदं वत्से परलोकविडंबनम् /
इत्यूचिषीं महाराज्ञीमबिकां सर्वमङ्गला /
भक्त्या प्रणम्य पश्यन्ती परां प्रीतिमुपाययौ //
text_mt: This is mere sport, my child, an imitation of the mortal world." / When the Great Queen, the Mother, had thus spoken, Sarvamaṅgalā, / bowing down with devotion and gazing [upon her], attained supreme joy.

sanskrit_iast:
stuvatyāmeva pārvatyāṃ tadānīmeva sāparā /
praviṣṭā hṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ prahṛṣṭāyā mahāmune //
meaning:
स्तुवत्यामेव पार्वत्यां तदानीमेव सापरा /
प्रविष्टा हृदयं तस्याः प्रहृष्टाया महामुने //
text_mt: While Pārvatī was still praising her, at that very moment that supreme [Goddess] / entered into the heart of the joyous one, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vismayamāpannā cintayantī muhurmuhuḥ /
svapnaḥ kimeṣa dṛṣṭo vā mayā kimatha vā bhramaḥ //
meaning:
अथ विस्मयमापन्ना चिन्तयन्ती मुहुर्मुहुः /
स्वप्नः किमेष दृष्टो वा मया किमथ वा भ्रमः //
text_mt: Then, filled with wonder, she reflected again and again: / "Was this a dream that I saw, or was it a delusion?"

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vimṛśya paritaḥ prerayāmāsa locane /
jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ paścātsakhyāvālokya sasmite /
prasannavadanā sā tu praṇate vadati sma sā //
meaning:
इत्थं विमृश्य परितः प्रेरयामास लोचने /
जयां च विजयां पश्चात्सख्यावालोक्य सस्मिते /
प्रसन्नवदना सा तु प्रणते वदति स्म सा //
text_mt: Having reflected thus, she cast her eyes all around; / then, seeing her two companions Jayā and Vijayā smiling, / with a serene face, as they bowed down, she spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
etāvantamalaṃ kālaṃ kutra yāte yuvāṃ priye /
mayā dṛṣṭāṃ tu kāmākṣīṃ yuvāṃ cetkimapaśyatam //
meaning:
एतावन्तमलं कालं कुत्र याते युवां प्रिये /
मया दृष्टां तु कामाक्षीं युवां चेत्किमपश्यतम् //
text_mt: "Where had you two gone for all this time, dear ones? / Did you two happen to see Kāmākṣī, whom I have seen?"

sanskrit_iast:
sakhyau tu tadvacaḥ śrutvā praharṣotphullalocane /
puṣpāṇi pūjanārhāṇi nidhāyāgre samūcatuḥ //
meaning:
सख्यौ तु तद्वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचने /
पुष्पाणि पूजनार्हाणि निधायाग्रे समूचतुः //
text_mt: Hearing her words, the two friends, their eyes blossoming with joy, / placed flowers fit for worship in front of her and said together:

sanskrit_iast:
satyamevādhunā dṛṣṭā hyāvābhyāmapi sā parā /
na svapno na bhramo vāpi sākṣātte hṛdayaṃ gatā /
ityuktvā pārśvayostasyā niṣaṇṇe vinayānate //
meaning:
सत्यमेवाधुना दृष्टा ह्यावाभ्यामपि सा परा /
न स्वप्नो न भ्रमो वापि साक्षात्ते हृदयं गता /
इत्युक्त्वा पार्श्वयोस्तस्या निषण्णे विनयानते //
text_mt: "Truly, that supreme [Goddess] has just now been seen by the two of us as well. / It was neither a dream nor a delusion; she directly entered your heart." / Having spoken thus, bowed in humility, they sat at her sides.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāmramūle bhagavānbhavānīvirahārtimān /
gaurīsaṃprāptaye dadhyau kāmākṣīṃ niyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
एकाम्रमूले भगवान्भवानीविरहार्तिमान् /
गौरीसंप्राप्तये दध्यौ कामाक्षीं नियतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: At the foot of the mango tree, the Lord, suffering from the pain of separation from Bhavānī, / meditated with restrained senses on Kāmākṣī in order to attain Gaurī.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi kṛtasāṃnidhyā śrīvidyādevatā parā /
acaṣṭa kṛpayā tuṣṭā dhyāyantaṃ niścalaṃ śivam //
meaning:
तत्रापि कृतसांनिध्या श्रीविद्यादेवता परा /
अचष्ट कृपया तुष्टा ध्यायन्तं निश्चलं शिवम् //
text_mt: Having made her presence there too, the supreme deity Śrīvidyā, / pleased with compassion, looked upon Śiva meditating without wavering:

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ dhyānena kandarpadarpaghna tvaṃ mamājñayā /
aṅgīkuruṣva kandarpaṃ bhūyo macchāsane sthitam //
meaning:
अलं ध्यानेन कन्दर्पदर्पघ्न त्वं ममाज्ञया /
अङ्गीकुरुष्व कन्दर्पं भूयो मच्छासने स्थितम् //
text_mt: "Enough with meditation, O slayer of Kandarpa's pride! By my command, / accept Kandarpa once more, abiding under my rule.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāmrasaṃjñe matpīṭhe tvihaiva nivasansadā /
tvamevāgatya matprītyai saṃnidhau mama suvrata /
gaurīmanugṛhāṇa tvaṃ kaṃpānīranivāsinīm //
meaning:
एकाम्रसंज्ञे मत्पीठे त्विहैव निवसन्सदा /
त्वमेवागत्य मत्प्रीत्यै संनिधौ मम सुव्रत /
गौरीमनुगृहाण त्वं कंपानीरनिवासिनीम् //
text_mt: Ever residing right here in my seat known as Ekāmra, / you yourself, coming here for my pleasure in my presence, O you of firm vows, / show grace to Gaurī, who dwells on the waters of the Kampā.

sanskrit_iast:
tāpadvayaṃ jahīhyāśu yogajaṃ tadviyogajam /
ityuktvāntardadhe tasya hṛdaye paramā ramā //
meaning:
तापद्वयं जहीह्याशु योगजं तद्वियोगजम् /
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे तस्य हृदये परमा रमा //
text_mt: Cast off quickly the two torments—that born of yoga and that born of separation from her." / Having said this, the supreme Ramā vanished into his heart.

sanskrit_iast:
śivo vyutthāya sahasā dhīraḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ /
tasyā anugrahaṃ labdhvā sarvadevaniṣevitaḥ //
meaning:
शिवो व्युत्थाय सहसा धीरः संहृष्टमानसः /
तस्या अनुग्रहं लब्ध्वा सर्वदेवनिषेवितः //
text_mt: Rising quickly, the steadfast Śiva, delighted in mind, / having obtained her grace, served by all the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdidhyāyaṃśca tāmeva mahātripurasundarīm /
yadvilāsātsamutpannaṃ layaṃ yāti ca yatra vai //
meaning:
हृदिध्यायंश्च तामेव महात्रिपुरसुन्दरीम् /
यद्विलासात्समुत्पन्नं लयं याति च यत्र वै //
text_mt: and meditating in his heart on that very Mahātripurasundarī, / from whose playful sport it has arisen and in whom it dissolves,

sanskrit_iast:
jagaccarācaraṃ caitatprapañcadvitayātmakam /
bhūṣayantīṃ śivāṃ kampāmanukaṃpārdramānasām //
meaning:
जगच्चराचरं चैतत्प्रपञ्चद्वितयात्मकम् /
भूषयन्तीं शिवां कम्पामनुकंपार्द्रमानसाम् //
text_mt: this moving and unmoving world consisting of the twofold manifold, / [Śiva] accepted the auspicious Gaurī, whose mind was moist with compassion,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgīkṛtya tadā gaurī vaivāhikavidhānataḥ /
ādāya vṛṣamāruhya kailāsaśikharaṃ yayau //
meaning:
अङ्गीकृत्य तदा गौरी वैवाहिकविधानतः /
आदाय वृषमारुह्य कैलासशिखरं ययौ //
text_mt: who was adorning the Kampā, according to the wedding rites; / taking her and mounting the bull, he went to the peak of Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
punaranyaṃ mahaprājñaṃ samākarṇaya kumbhaja /
ādilakṣmyāḥ prabhāvaṃ tu kathayāmi tavānagha //
meaning:
पुनरन्यं महप्राज्ञं समाकर्णय कुम्भज /
आदिलक्ष्म्याः प्रभावं तु कथयामि तवानघ //
text_mt: Listen again, O highly wise pot-born [Agastya], to another [account]; / I shall relate to you, O sinless one, the power of Ādilakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
sabhāyāṃ brahmaṇo gatvā samāsedustrimurttayaḥ /
dikpālāśca surāḥ sarve sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ //
meaning:
सभायां ब्रह्मणो गत्वा समासेदुस्त्रिमुर्त्तयः /
दिक्पालाश्च सुराः सर्वे सनकाद्याश्च योगिनः //
text_mt: Having gone to Brahmā’s assembly hall, the three forms gathered together, / as well as the guardians of the directions, all the gods, and the yogins led by Sanaka,

sanskrit_iast:
devarṣayo nāradādyā vaśiṣṭhādyāśca tāpasāḥ /
te sarve sahitāstatra brahmaṇaśca kapardinaḥ /
dvayoḥ pañcamukhatvena bhedaṃ na vividustadā //
meaning:
देवर्षयो नारदाद्या वशिष्ठाद्याश्च तापसाः /
ते सर्वे सहितास्तत्र ब्रह्मणश्च कपर्दिनः /
द्वयोः पञ्चमुखत्वेन भेदं न विविदुस्तदा //
text_mt: the divine seers led by Nārada, and ascetics led by Vasiṣṭha. / All of them assembled there, because Brahmā and the wearer of matted hair (Śiva) / both had five faces, could not discern any difference between the two at that time.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyaṃ pṛṣṭavantaste brahmā kaḥ kaścaśaṅkaraḥ /
teṣāṃ saṃvadatāṃ madhye kṣipramantarhitaḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
अन्योन्यं पृष्टवन्तस्ते ब्रह्मा कः कश्चशङ्करः /
तेषां संवदतां मध्ये क्षिप्रमन्तर्हितः शिवः //
text_mt: They asked one another: 'Who is Brahmā and who is Śaṅkara?' / While they were discussing this among themselves, Śiva vanished swiftly.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pañcamukho brahmā sito nārāyaṇastayoḥ /
ubhayorapi saṃvādastvahaṃ brahmetyajāyata //
meaning:
तदा पञ्चमुखो ब्रह्मा सितो नारायणस्तयोः /
उभयोरपि संवादस्त्वहं ब्रह्मेत्यजायत //
text_mt: Then, between the five-faced Brahmā and the white Nārāyaṇa, / a debate arose between the two: 'I am Brahman!'

sanskrit_iast:
a5mannābhikamalājjātastvaṃ yanmamātmajaḥ /
sṛṣṭikartā tvahaṃ brahmā nāmasādharmyatastathā /
tvaṃ ca rudraśca me putrau sṛṣṭikarturubhau yuvām //
meaning:
अ5मन्नाभिकमलाज्जातस्त्वं यन्ममात्मजः /
सृष्टिकर्ता त्वहं ब्रह्मा नामसाधर्म्यतस्तथा /
त्वं च रुद्रश्च मे पुत्रौ सृष्टिकर्तुरुभौ युवाम् //
text_mt: 'Since you were born from my navel-lotus, you are my son; / and I am Brahmā, the creator, by identity of name. / Both you and Rudra are my sons; you two are [agents] of me, the creator.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti māyāmohitayorubhayorantare tadā /
tayośca svasya māhātmyamahaṃ brahmeti darśayan /
prādurāsīnmahājyotistaṃbharūpo maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
इति मायामोहितयोरुभयोरन्तरे तदा /
तयोश्च स्वस्य माहात्म्यमहं ब्रह्मेति दर्शयन् /
प्रादुरासीन्महाज्योतिस्तंभरूपो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: While the two were thus deluded by Māyā, between them then, / showing to them his own greatness, that 'I am Brahman,' / Maheśvara manifested in the form of a great pillar of light.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvaivainaṃ maheśānaṃ viṣṇustūṣṇīṃ tataḥ sthitaḥ /
pañcavaktrastato brahmā hyavamatyaivamāsthitaḥ /
brahmaṇaḥ śirasāmūrdhvaṃ jyotiścakramabhūtpuraḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञात्वैवैनं महेशानं विष्णुस्तूष्णीं ततः स्थितः /
पञ्चवक्त्रस्ततो ब्रह्मा ह्यवमत्यैवमास्थितः /
ब्रह्मणः शिरसामूर्ध्वं ज्योतिश्चक्रमभूत्पुरः //
text_mt: Recognising this one as Maheśāna, Viṣṇu then remained silent. / Then the five-faced Brahmā stood there, disregarding [him] thus. / Above Brahmā’s heads, a wheel of light appeared in front.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye saṃsthito devaḥ prādurāsomayā saha /
ūrdhvamaikṣatha bhūyastamavamatya vaco 'bravīt //
meaning:
तन्मध्ये संस्थितो देवः प्रादुरासोमया सह /
ऊर्ध्वमैक्षथ भूयस्तमवमत्य वचो ऽब्रवीत् //
text_mt: Stationed in its midst, the god appeared together with Umā. / Brahmā looked upward and again, disregarding him, spoke words [of scorn].

sanskrit_iast:
tanniśamya bhṛśaṃ krodhamavāpa tripurāntakaḥ /
viṣṇumevaṃ tadālokya krodhenaiva vikārataḥ //
meaning:
तन्निशम्य भृशं क्रोधमवाप त्रिपुरान्तकः /
विष्णुमेवं तदालोक्य क्रोधेनैव विकारतः //
text_mt: Hearing that, the ender of Tripura became exceedingly enraged. / Looking at Viṣṇu thus, through transformation caused by rage alone,

sanskrit_iast:
tayoreva samutpanno bhairavaḥ krodhasaṃyutaḥ /
mūrdhānamekaṃ ciccheda nakhenaiva tadā vidheḥ /
hāheti tatra sarve 'pi krandantaśca palāyitāḥ //
meaning:
तयोरेव समुत्पन्नो भैरवः क्रोधसंयुतः /
मूर्धानमेकं चिच्छेद नखेनैव तदा विधेः /
हाहेति तत्र सर्वे ऽपि क्रन्दन्तश्च पलायिताः //
text_mt: Bhairava was born from the two of them, endowed with fury; / with his fingernail he severed one of Vidhi’s heads then and there. / Crying 'Alas! Alas!', everyone there fled in terror.

sanskrit_iast:
atha brahmakapālaṃ tu nakhalagnaṃ sa bhairavaḥ /
bhūyobhūyo dhunoti sma tathāpi na mumoca tam //
meaning:
अथ ब्रह्मकपालं तु नखलग्नं स भैरवः /
भूयोभूयो धुनोति स्म तथापि न मुमोच तम् //
text_mt: Then Bhairava shook Brahmā's skull stuck to his nail / again and again, but even so it did not release him.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbrahmahatyāmuktyarthaṃ cacāra dharaṇītale /
puṇyakṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi gaṅgādyāśca mahānadīḥ //
meaning:
तद्ब्रह्महत्यामुक्त्यर्थं चचार धरणीतले /
पुण्यक्षेत्राणि सर्वाणि गङ्गाद्याश्च महानदीः //
text_mt: To be freed from that killing of a Brahmin, he wandered over the surface of the earth, / visiting all holy places and the great rivers such as the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca tābhirvimukto 'bhūtkapālī brahmahatyayā /
viṣaṇṇavadano dīno niḥśrīka iva lakṣitaḥ /
cireṇa prāptavānkāñcīṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamoṣitām //
meaning:
न च ताभिर्विमुक्तो ऽभूत्कपाली ब्रह्महत्यया /
विषण्णवदनो दीनो निःश्रीक इव लक्षितः /
चिरेण प्राप्तवान्काञ्चीं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमोषिताम् //
text_mt: And the bearer of the skull was not freed by them from the killing of a Brahmin; / with a dejected face, miserable, seeming as if bereft of splendor, / after a long time he reached Kāñcī, which had formerly been inhabited by Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bhikṣāmaṭannityaṃ sevamānaḥ parā śriyam /
pañcatīrthe pratidinaṃ snātvā bhūlakṣaṇāṅkite //
meaning:
तत्र भिक्षामटन्नित्यं सेवमानः परा श्रियम् /
पञ्चतीर्थे प्रतिदिनं स्नात्वा भूलक्षणाङ्किते //
text_mt: There, constantly wandering for alms, serving supreme Śrī, / bathing every day in the Pañcatīrtha, marked by auspicious signs on earth,

sanskrit_iast:
kañcitkālamuvāsātha prabhrānta iva bilvalaḥ /
kāñcīkṣetranivāsena krameṇa prayatāśayaḥ //
meaning:
कञ्चित्कालमुवासाथ प्रभ्रान्त इव बिल्वलः /
काञ्चीक्षेत्रनिवासेन क्रमेण प्रयताशयः //
text_mt: he dwelt for some time like one wandering and bewildered. / By his residence in the holy site of Kāñcī, his mind gradually purified,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdhūtanikhilātaṅkaḥ śrīdevīṃ manasā vān /
uttare sevituṃ lakṣmyā vāsudevena dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
निर्धूतनिखिलातङ्कः श्रीदेवीं मनसा वान् /
उत्तरे सेवितुं लक्ष्म्या वासुदेवेन दक्षिणे //
text_mt: with all distress shaken off, he fixed his mind upon Śrīdevī, / served by Lakṣmī on the north and by Vāsudeva on the south.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmakoṣṭhamāgatya purastāttasya saṃsthitaḥ /
ādilakṣmīpadadhyānamātatāna yatātmavān //
meaning:
श्रीकामकोष्ठमागत्य पुरस्तात्तस्य संस्थितः /
आदिलक्ष्मीपदध्यानमाततान यतात्मवान् //
text_mt: Having arrived at Śrīkāmakoṣṭha, stationed in front of it, / the self-controlled one undertook meditation on the feet of Ādilakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dīpo nivātastho nistaraṅgo yathāṃbudhiḥ /
tathāntarvāyurodhena na cacālā caleśvaraḥ //
meaning:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो निस्तरङ्गो यथांबुधिः /
तथान्तर्वायुरोधेन न चचाला चलेश्वरः //
text_mt: Just as a lamp standing in a windless place, or the ocean without waves, / so, by restraint of the internal breath, the lord of the mountain (Śiva) did not waver.

sanskrit_iast:
tailadhārāvadacchinnāmanavacchinnabhairavaḥ /
vitene śailatanayānāthaśrīdhyānasantatim /
na brahmā naiva viṣṇurvā na siddhaḥ kapilo 'pi vā //
meaning:
तैलधारावदच्छिन्नामनवच्छिन्नभैरवः /
वितेने शैलतनयानाथश्रीध्यानसन्ततिम् /
न ब्रह्मा नैव विष्णुर्वा न सिद्धः कपिलो ऽपि वा //
text_mt: Continuous like a stream of oil, unbroken, Bhairava, / the lord of the daughter of the mountain, extended a continuous succession of meditation on Śrī; / neither Brahmā, nor Viṣṇu, nor the Siddha Kapila,

sanskrit_iast:
nānye ca sanakādyā ye munayo vā śukādayaḥ /
tayā samādhiniṣṭhāyāṃ na samarthāḥ kathañcana //
meaning:
नान्ये च सनकाद्या ये मुनयो वा शुकादयः /
तया समाधिनिष्ठायां न समर्थाः कथञ्चन //
text_mt: nor others such as Sanaka and his companions, or sages such as Śuka, / were in any way capable of such absorption in meditative trance.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śrībhāvayogena śrībhāvaṃ prāptavāñśivaḥ /
tataḥ prasannā śrīdevī prabhāmaṇḍalavartinī /
ardharātre puraḥ sthitvā vācaṃ provāca vāṅmayī //
meaning:
अथ श्रीभावयोगेन श्रीभावं प्राप्तवाञ्शिवः /
ततः प्रसन्ना श्रीदेवी प्रभामण्डलवर्तिनी /
अर्धरात्रे पुरः स्थित्वा वाचं प्रोवाच वाङ्मयी //
text_mt: Then, through the yoga of devotion to Śrī, Śiva attained the state of Śrī. / Thereupon Śrīdevī, gracious, abiding in an orb of radiance, / stood before him at midnight and spoke these words of speech:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭha sarvapāpaghna kiṃ pāpaṃ tava vidyate /
madrūpastvaṃ kathaṃ dehaḥ seyaṃ lokaviḍambanā //
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठ सर्वपापघ्न किं पापं तव विद्यते /
मद्रूपस्त्वं कथं देहः सेयं लोकविडम्बना //
text_mt: 'O Śrīkaṇṭha, destroyer of all sins, what sin exists for you? / You are identical with my own form; how could there be a [sinful] body? This is a mere worldly imitation.

sanskrit_iast:
śvobhūte brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣaṇānmukto bhaviṣyasi /
ityuktvāntardadhe tatra mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarī //
meaning:
श्वोभूते ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षणान्मुक्तो भविष्यसि /
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे तत्र महासिंहासनेश्वरी //
text_mt: Tomorrow at dawn, in an instant, you will be freed from the killing of a Brahmin.' / Having said this, the sovereign of the great throne vanished there.

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavo 'pi prahṛṣṭātmā kṛtārthaḥ śrīvilokanāt /
vinīya taṃ niśāśeṣaṃ śrīdhyānaikaparāyaṇaḥ //
meaning:
भैरवो ऽपि प्रहृष्टात्मा कृतार्थः श्रीविलोकनात् /
विनीय तं निशाशेषं श्रीध्यानैकपरायणः //
text_mt: Bhairava too, his soul delighted, having achieved his goal from seeing Śrī, / passed the remainder of that night wholly dedicated to meditation on Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ pañcamahātīrthe snātvā sandhyāmupāsya ca /
punaḥ punardhūnute sma karalagnaṃ kapālakam //
meaning:
प्रातः पञ्चमहातीर्थे स्नात्वा सन्ध्यामुपास्य च /
पुनः पुनर्धूनुते स्म करलग्नं कपालकम् //
text_mt: In the morning, having bathed in the five great holy waters and performed his twilight worship, / he shook the skull clinging to his hand again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi tattu nāsraṃsatsa nirvedaṃ paraṃ gataḥ /
svapnaḥ kimeṣa māyā vā mānasabhrāntireva vā //
meaning:
तथापि तत्तु नास्रंसत्स निर्वेदं परं गतः /
स्वप्नः किमेष माया वा मानसभ्रान्तिरेव वा //
text_mt: Yet even then it did not slip off; he fell into extreme despondency: / 'Is this a dream, or an illusion, or a mere delusion of the mind?'

sanskrit_iast:
muhurevaṃ vicintyeśaḥ śokavyākulamānasaḥ /
svayameva nigṛhyātha śokaṃ dhīrāgraṇīḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
मुहुरेवं विचिन्त्येशः शोकव्याकुलमानसः /
स्वयमेव निगृह्याथ शोकं धीराग्रणीः शिवः //
text_mt: Reflecting thus repeatedly, the lord’s mind became distressed with sorrow. / Then, checking that grief by himself, Śiva, foremost among the steadfast,

sanskrit_iast:
tulasīmaṇḍalaṃ natvā pūjayitvā puraḥ sthitaḥ /
nigṛhītendriyagrāmaḥ samādhistho 'bhavatpunaḥ //
meaning:
तुलसीमण्डलं नत्वा पूजयित्वा पुरः स्थितः /
निगृहीतेन्द्रियग्रामः समाधिस्थो ऽभवत्पुनः //
text_mt: bowed to the tulasī enclosure, worshipped it, and standing before it / with his senses restrained, entered meditation again.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmamātre gate devī punaḥ sāṃnidhyamāgatā /
alaṃ samādhinā śambho nimajjātra sarovare //
meaning:
याममात्रे गते देवी पुनः सांनिध्यमागता /
अलं समाधिना शम्भो निमज्जात्र सरोवरे //
text_mt: When just one watch [of the day] had passed, the goddess came into his presence again: / 'Enough with meditation, O Śambhu! Plunge into the lake here!'

sanskrit_iast:
ityā diśya tiro 'dhatta so 'pi cintāmupāgamat /
iyaṃ ca māyā svapno vā kiṃ karttavyaṃ mayātha vā //
meaning:
इत्या दिश्य तिरो ऽधत्त सो ऽपि चिन्तामुपागमत् /
इयं च माया स्वप्नो वा किं कर्त्तव्यं मयाथ वा //
text_mt: Having thus instructed him, she vanished; he too was seized with anxiety: / 'Is this an illusion or a dream, or what should be done by me now?

sanskrit_iast:
śvobhūte brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣaṇānmukto bhaviṣyasi /
ityuktaṃ śrīparādevyā yāmātītamidaṃ dinam //
meaning:
श्वोभूते ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षणान्मुक्तो भविष्यसि /
इत्युक्तं श्रीपरादेव्या यामातीतमिदं दिनम् //
text_mt: "Tomorrow at dawn you will be freed from the killing of a Brahmin in an instant"— / so it was spoken by Śrī Parādevī, but this day has already passed by a watch!'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvaṃ ca mithyaivetyadhikaṃ cintayāvṛtaḥ /
bhagavānvyo mavāṇyā tu nimajjāpsviti garjitam //
meaning:
एवं सर्वं च मिथ्यैवेत्यधिकं चिन्तयावृतः /
भगवान्व्यो मवाण्या तु निमज्जाप्स्विति गर्जितम् //
text_mt: Thinking thus that all was false, overcome with greater anxiety, / the Lord heard a roar from a voice in the sky: 'Plunge into the waters!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrutvā śaṅkāṃ samutsṛjya tattvaṃ niścitya śaṅkaraḥ /
nimamajja sarasyāṃ tu gaṅgāyāṃ punarutthitaḥ //
meaning:
श्रुत्वा शङ्कां समुत्सृज्य तत्त्वं निश्चित्य शङ्करः /
निममज्ज सरस्यां तु गङ्गायां पुनरुत्थितः //
text_mt: Hearing it, casting aside doubt, and resolving upon the truth, Śaṅkara / plunged into the lake and rose up again in the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kāśīṃ samālokya kimetaditi cintayan /
sa muhurtaṃ sthitastūṣṇīṃ nakhalīnakapālakaḥ //
meaning:
तत्र काशीं समालोक्य किमेतदिति चिन्तयन् /
स मुहुर्तं स्थितस्तूष्णीं नखलीनकपालकः //
text_mt: Seeing Kāśī there, thinking 'What is this?', / he stood silently for an hour, the skull still clinging to his nail.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭanta pamudvīkṣya taraṇiṃ taruṇondubhṛt /
bhikṣārthaṃ nagarīmenāṃ praviveśa vaśī śivaḥ //
meaning:
ललाटन्त पमुद्वीक्ष्य तरणिं तरुणोन्दुभृत् /
भिक्षार्थं नगरीमेनां प्रविवेश वशी शिवः //
text_mt: Observing the sun scorching the forehead, the bearer of the young moon, / the self-controlled Śiva, entered this city for alms.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇi kānicidgatvā pratolyāṃ paryaṭanbhavaḥ /
so 'paśyadagrataḥ kāñcitkāñcīṃ śrīdevatākṛtim //
meaning:
गृहाणि कानिचिद्गत्वा प्रतोल्यां पर्यटन्भवः /
सो ऽपश्यदग्रतः काञ्चित्काञ्चीं श्रीदेवताकृतिम् //
text_mt: Having gone to a few houses, wandering along the street, Bhava / saw before him someone shaped like the divine Śrī, a woman of Kāñcī.

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣāṃ jyotirmayīṃ tasmai dattvā kṣipraṃ tirodadhe /
kṣaṇādbrahmakapālaṃ tatpracyutaṃ tannakhāgrataḥ //
meaning:
भिक्षां ज्योतिर्मयीं तस्मै दत्त्वा क्षिप्रं तिरोदधे /
क्षणाद्ब्रह्मकपालं तत्प्रच्युतं तन्नखाग्रतः //
text_mt: Giving him luminous alms, she vanished swiftly; / in an instant that skull of Brahmā fell away from the tip of his nail.

sanskrit_iast:
taddṛṣṭvādbhutamīśānaḥ kāmākṣī śīlamuttamam /
prasannavadanāṃbhojo bahu mene muhuḥ param //
meaning:
तद्दृष्ट्वाद्भुतमीशानः कामाक्षी शीलमुत्तमम् /
प्रसन्नवदनांभोजो बहु मेने मुहुः परम् //
text_mt: Seeing that wonder, the supreme character of Kāmākṣī, / Īśāna, his lotus face brightened, praised it highly again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
purī kāñcī purī puṇyā nadī kaṃpā nadī parā /
devatā saiva kāmākṣītyāsītsaṃbhāvanā puraḥ //
meaning:
पुरी काञ्ची पुरी पुण्या नदी कंपा नदी परा /
देवता सैव कामाक्षीत्यासीत्संभावना पुरः //
text_mt: 'The city of Kāñcī is the holy city, the Kampā river is the supreme river, / and that very deity is Kāmākṣī'—such was his appreciation thereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ devīprabhāveṇa vimuktaḥ saṃkaṭāddharaḥ /
svasthaḥ svasthānamagamacchlāghamānaḥ parāṃ śriyam //
meaning:
इत्थं देवीप्रभावेण विमुक्तः संकटाद्धरः /
स्वस्थः स्वस्थानमगमच्छ्लाघमानः परां श्रियम् //
text_mt: In this way, freed from the crisis by the power of the Goddess, / Hara, healthy and calm, went to his own abode, praising that supreme splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
punaranyatpravakṣyāmi vilāsaṃ śṛṇu kumbhaja /
prabhāvaṃ śrīmahādevyāḥ kāmadaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sadā //
meaning:
पुनरन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि विलासं शृणु कुम्भज /
प्रभावं श्रीमहादेव्याः कामदं शृण्वतां सदा //
text_mt: Listen, O jar-born [Agastya], I shall tell another pastime: / the power of the venerable Great Goddess, which ever grants desires to those who listen.

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmānnāmnā daśaratho nṛpaḥ /
santānarahito 'tiṣṭhadbahukālaṃ śucākulaḥ //
meaning:
अयोध्याधिपतिः श्रीमान्नाम्ना दशरथो नृपः /
सन्तानरहितो ऽतिष्ठद्बहुकालं शुचाकुलः //
text_mt: The glorious King Daśaratha, ruler of Ayodhyā, / remained childless for a long time, overcome with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyāhūya matimānvaśiṣṭhaṃ svapurohitam /
uvācācārasaṃśuddhaḥ sarvaśāstrārthavedinam //
meaning:
रहस्याहूय मतिमान्वशिष्ठं स्वपुरोहितम् /
उवाचाचारसंशुद्धः सर्वशास्त्रार्थवेदिनम् //
text_mt: Summoning his family priest Vasiṣṭha in secret, the intelligent [king], / pure in conduct, spoke to the one who knew the meaning of all sacred treatises:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnātha bahavo 'tītāḥ kālānādhigataḥ sutaḥ /
saṃtatermama saṃtāpaḥ saṃtataṃ vardhatetarām /
kiṃ kurve yadi saṃtānasaṃpatsyāttannivedaya //
meaning:
श्रीनाथ बहवो ऽतीताः कालानाधिगतः सुतः /
संततेर्मम संतापः संततं वर्धतेतराम् /
किं कुर्वे यदि संतानसंपत्स्यात्तन्निवेदय //
text_mt: “O lord of fortune, much time has passed, and no son has been obtained. / My sorrow over offspring continuously increases all the more. / What should I do so that abundance of offspring may come to be? Tell me that.”

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭha uvāca
mama vaṃśa mahārāja rahasyaṃ kathayāmi te /
ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī kāñcī hyavantikā /
etā puṇyatamāḥ proktāḥ purīṇāmuttamottamāḥ //
meaning:
वशिष्ठ उवाच
मम वंश महाराज रहस्यं कथयामि ते /
अयोध्या मथुरा माया काशी काञ्ची ह्यवन्तिका /
एता पुण्यतमाः प्रोक्ताः पुरीणामुत्तमोत्तमाः //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha said: / “In my lineage, O great king, I shall tell you a secret: / Ayodhyā, Mathurā, Māyā, Kāśī, Kāñcī, and Avantikā— / these are declared the holiest, the best among cities.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ sāṃnidhyamātreṇa mahātripurasundarīm /
arcayanti hyayodhyāyāṃ manuṣyā adhidevatām //
meaning:
अस्याः सांनिध्यमात्रेण महात्रिपुरसुन्दरीम् /
अर्चयन्ति ह्ययोध्यायां मनुष्या अधिदेवताम् //
text_mt: By the mere presence of this [city], men in Ayodhyā worship / Mahātripurasundarī as their presiding deity.

sanskrit_iast:
naitasyāḥ sadṛśī kāciddevatā vidyate parā /
enāmevarcayantyanye sarve śrīdevatāṃ nṛpa //
meaning:
नैतस्याः सदृशी काचिद्देवता विद्यते परा /
एनामेवर्चयन्त्यन्ये सर्वे श्रीदेवतां नृप //
text_mt: There is no supreme deity equal to her. / All others worship only this divine Goddess of Fortune, O king.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ sastrīkāḥ sarvadā sadā /
nārikelaphalālībhiḥ panasaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाद्याः सस्त्रीकाः सर्वदा सदा /
नारिकेलफलालीभिः पनसैः कदलीफलैः //
text_mt: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśa, and the others, accompanied by their wives, always and ever / [worship her] with rows of coconuts, jackfruits, and bananas,

sanskrit_iast:
madhvājyaśarkarāprājyairmahāpāyasarāśibhiḥ /
siddhadravyaviśeṣaiśca pūjayettripurāṃbikām /
abhīṣṭamacireṇaiva saṃpradāsyati saiva naḥ //
meaning:
मध्वाज्यशर्कराप्राज्यैर्महापायसराशिभिः /
सिद्धद्रव्यविशेषैश्च पूजयेत्त्रिपुरांबिकाम् /
अभीष्टमचिरेणैव संप्रदास्यति सैव नः //
text_mt: with copious honey, clarified butter, and sugar, with great heaps of rice-pudding, / and with particular perfected substances. One should worship Mother Tripurā; / she herself will swiftly grant us our desire.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktavantamabhyarcya gurumiṣṭairupāyanaiḥ /
svāṅgajaprāptaye bhūyo visasarja viśāṃpatiḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्तवन्तमभ्यर्च्य गुरुमिष्टैरुपायनैः /
स्वाङ्गजप्राप्तये भूयो विससर्ज विशांपतिः //
text_mt: Having honored his guru who had spoken thus with desirable gifts, / the ruler of men sent him away again in order to obtain a son born of his own body.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gurūktarītyaiva lalitāṃ parameśvarīm /
arcayāmāsa rājendro bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ //
meaning:
ततो गुरूक्तरीत्यैव ललितां परमेश्वरीम् /
अर्चयामास राजेन्द्रो भक्त्या परमया युतः //
text_mt: Then, in the very manner spoken by his guru, the supreme king / worshipped the supreme ruler Lalitā, endowed with supreme devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pratidinaṃ pūjāṃ vidhāya prītamānasaḥ /
ayodhyādevatādhāmāmaśiṣattatra saṅgataḥ //
meaning:
एवं प्रतिदिनं पूजां विधाय प्रीतमानसः /
अयोध्यादेवताधामामशिषत्तत्र सङ्गतः //
text_mt: Thus performing the worship every day with a delighted mind, / he, remaining there, governed the realm of the deity of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
ardharātre vyatīte tu nibhṛtollāsadīpike /
kiñcinnidrālasasyāsya puratastripurāṃbikā //
meaning:
अर्धरात्रे व्यतीते तु निभृतोल्लासदीपिके /
किञ्चिन्निद्रालसस्यास्य पुरतस्त्रिपुरांबिका //
text_mt: When midnight had passed and the lamps were shining steadily, / as he was somewhat languid with sleep, Mother Tripurā appeared before him,

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāṅkuśadhanurbāṇapariṣkṛtacaturbhujā /
sarvaśṛṅgāraveṣāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā /
sthitvā vācamuvācemāṃ mandamindumatīsutam //
meaning:
पाशाङ्कुशधनुर्बाणपरिष्कृतचतुर्भुजा /
सर्वशृङ्गारवेषाढ्या सर्वाभरणभूषिता /
स्थित्वा वाचमुवाचेमां मन्दमिन्दुमतीसुतम् //
text_mt: her four arms adorned with the noose, the goad, the bow, and arrows, / rich in all the attire of erotic passion, adorned with all ornaments. / Standing there, she spoke these words softly to the son of Indumatī:

sanskrit_iast:
asti paṅktiratha śrīmanputrabhāgyaṃ tavānagha /
viśvāsaghātakarmāṇi saṃti pūrvakṛtāni te //
meaning:
अस्ति पङ्क्तिरथ श्रीमन्पुत्रभाग्यं तवानघ /
विश्वासघातकर्माणि संति पूर्वकृतानि ते //
text_mt: “O Daśaratha, O glorious and sinless one, the fortune of a son is yours. / Yet deeds involving breach of trust were performed by you in the past.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśāṃ karmaṇāṃ śāntyai gatvā kāñcīpuraṃ varam /
snātvā kampāsarasyāṃ ca tatra māṃ paśya pāvanīm //
meaning:
तादृशां कर्मणां शान्त्यै गत्वा काञ्चीपुरं वरम् /
स्नात्वा कम्पासरस्यां च तत्र मां पश्य पावनीम् //
text_mt: For the pacification of such deeds, go to the excellent city of Kāñcī, / bathe in the Kampā pool, and see me there, the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye kāñcīpurasya tvaṃ kandarākāśamadhyagam /
kāmakoṣṭhaṃ vipāpmāpi saptadvārabilānvitam //
meaning:
मध्ये काञ्चीपुरस्य त्वं कन्दराकाशमध्यगम् /
कामकोष्ठं विपाप्मापि सप्तद्वारबिलान्वितम् //
text_mt: In the middle of Kāñcīpura, go to the interior of the cavity's space, / the Kāmakoṣṭha, which has a hole with seven gates, being freed from sin,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmrājyasūcakaṃ puṃsāṃ trayāṇāmapi siddhidam /
prāṅmukhī tatra varte 'haṃ mahāsiṃhāsaneśvarī //
meaning:
साम्राज्यसूचकं पुंसां त्रयाणामपि सिद्धिदम् /
प्राङ्मुखी तत्र वर्ते ऽहं महासिंहासनेश्वरी //
text_mt: indicating sovereign empire to men and granting success to all three [worlds]. / Facing east, I dwell there, the ruler on the great lion-throne,

sanskrit_iast:
mahālakṣmīsvarūpeṇa dvibhujā padmadhāriṇī /
cakreśvarī mahārājñī hyadṛśyā sthūlacakṣuṣām //
meaning:
महालक्ष्मीस्वरूपेण द्विभुजा पद्मधारिणी /
चक्रेश्वरी महाराज्ञी ह्यदृश्या स्थूलचक्षुषाम् //
text_mt: in the form of Mahālakṣmī, two-armed, holding a lotus, / the Cakreśvarī, the great queen, invisible to physical eyes.

sanskrit_iast:
mamākṣijā mahāgaurī vartate mama dakṣiṇe /
saundaryasārasīmā sā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā //
meaning:
ममाक्षिजा महागौरी वर्तते मम दक्षिणे /
सौन्दर्यसारसीमा सा सर्वाभरणभूषिता //
text_mt: Mahāgaurī, born from my eye, resides on my right; / she is the limit of the essence of beauty, adorned with all ornaments.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā ca kalpitā'vāsā dvibhujā padmadhāriṇī /
mahālakṣmīsvarūpeṇa kiṃ vā kṛtyātmanā sthitā //
meaning:
मया च कल्पिताऽवासा द्विभुजा पद्मधारिणी /
महालक्ष्मीस्वरूपेण किं वा कृत्यात्मना स्थिता //
text_mt: And an abode was fashioned by me, two-armed, holding a lotus, / in the form of Mahālakṣmī, or standing with the nature of ritual action.

sanskrit_iast:
āpīṭhamauliparyantaṃ paśya tastāṃ mamāṃśajām /
pātakānyāśu naśyanti kiṃ punastūpapātakam //
meaning:
आपीठमौलिपर्यन्तं पश्य तस्तां ममांशजाम् /
पातकान्याशु नश्यन्ति किं पुनस्तूपपातकम् //
text_mt: Look upon her who is born from a portion of me, from the pedestal up to the crown; / sins are destroyed swiftly—what need then to mention minor sins?

sanskrit_iast:
kuvāsanā kubuddhiśca kutarkanicayaśca yaḥ /
kudehaśca kubhāvaśca nāstikatvaṃ layaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
कुवासना कुबुद्धिश्च कुतर्कनिचयश्च यः /
कुदेहश्च कुभावश्च नास्तिकत्वं लयं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: Bad latent impressions, bad intellect, the mass of fallacious reasoning, / a bad body, bad disposition, and atheism will dissolve.

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣva me mahāpūjāṃ sitāmadhvājyapāyasaiḥ /
vividhairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca padārthaiḥ ṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ //
meaning:
कुरुष्व मे महापूजां सितामध्वाज्यपायसैः /
विविधैर्भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च पदार्थैः षड्रसान्वितैः //
text_mt: Perform a great worship for me with white sugar, honey, clarified butter, and rice-pudding, / with various dishes to chew and to eat, and items endowed with the six tastes.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva suprasannāhaṃ pūrayiṣyāmi te varam /
upadiśyeti samrājñī divyamūrtistirodadhe //
meaning:
तत्रैव सुप्रसन्नाहं पूरयिष्यामि ते वरम् /
उपदिश्येति सम्राज्ञी दिव्यमूर्तिस्तिरोदधे //
text_mt: Right there, exceedingly pleased, I will fulfill your boon.” / Having thus instructed him, the empress of divine form disappeared.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāpi sahasotthāya kimetaditi vismitaḥ /
devīmudbodhya kausalyāṃ śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitām //
meaning:
राजापि सहसोत्थाय किमेतदिति विस्मितः /
देवीमुद्बोध्य कौसल्यां शुभलक्षणलक्षिताम् //
text_mt: The king also, rising up suddenly, amazed, thinking 'What is this?', / awakened Queen Kausalyā, who was marked with auspicious characteristics,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyai tadrātrivṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa sādaram /
tatsamā karṇya sā devī santoṣamabhajattadā //
meaning:
तस्यै तद्रात्रिवृत्तान्तं कथयामास सादरम् /
तत्समा कर्ण्य सा देवी सन्तोषमभजत्तदा //
text_mt: and respectfully related to her that night’s event. / Having heard it, the queen then experienced great joy.

sanskrit_iast:
prāptaharṣo nṛpaḥ prātastayā dayitayā saha /
anīkasacivopetaḥ kāñcīpuramupāgamat //
meaning:
प्राप्तहर्षो नृपः प्रातस्तया दयितया सह /
अनीकसचिवोपेतः काञ्चीपुरमुपागमत् //
text_mt: Filled with delight, the king set out in the morning with his beloved, / accompanied by his army and ministers, and approached the city of Kāñcī.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā kaṃpātaraṅgiṇyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devīṃ ca pāvanīm /
pañcatīrthe tataḥ snātvā devyā kausalyayā nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
स्नात्वा कंपातरङ्गिण्यां दृष्ट्वा देवीं च पावनीम् /
पञ्चतीर्थे ततः स्नात्वा देव्या कौसल्यया नृपः //
text_mt: Bathing in the river Kampā and beholding the purifying Goddess, / the king, having then bathed in the Pañcatīrtha with Queen Kausalyā,

sanskrit_iast:
gobhūvastra hiraṇyādyaistattīrthakṣetravāsinaḥ /
prīṇayitvā sapatnīkastathā tadbhaktipūjakān //
meaning:
गोभूवस्त्र हिरण्याद्यैस्तत्तीर्थक्षेत्रवासिनः /
प्रीणयित्वा सपत्नीकस्तथा तद्भक्तिपूजकान् //
text_mt: gratified the dwellers of that sacred ford and field with cattle, land, clothes, gold, and other gifts, / together with his wife, and likewise those devoted worshippers.

sanskrit_iast:
athālayaṃ samāviśya mahābhaktyā nṛpottamaḥ /
pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā vinayena samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
अथालयं समाविश्य महाभक्त्या नृपोत्तमः /
प्रदक्षिणत्रयं कृत्वा विनयेन समन्वितः //
text_mt: Then, entering the temple with great devotion, that best of kings, / accompanied by humility, performed three circumambulations.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃnidhimāgatya devyā kausalyayā saha /
śrīkāmakoṣṭhanilayaṃ mahātripurasundarīm //
meaning:
ततः संनिधिमागत्य देव्या कौसल्यया सह /
श्रीकामकोष्ठनिलयं महात्रिपुरसुन्दरीम् //
text_mt: Then, approaching her presence together with Queen Kausalyā, / [he saw] Mahātripurasundarī whose abode is the glorious Kāmakoṣṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
trimūrtijananīmaṃbāṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīcakrarūpiṇīm /
praṇipatya tu sāṣṭāṅgaṃ bhāryayā saha bhaktimān //
meaning:
त्रिमूर्तिजननीमंबां दृष्ट्वा श्रीचक्ररूपिणीम् /
प्रणिपत्य तु साष्टाङ्गं भार्यया सह भक्तिमान् //
text_mt: the Mother, the mother of the Trinity, having the form of the Śrīcakra. / Having bowed down with the eight-limbed prostration together with his wife, full of devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
svapure traipure dhāmni purekṣvākupravartite /
durvāsā saśiṣyeṇa pūjārthaṃ pūrvakalpite //
meaning:
स्वपुरे त्रैपुरे धाम्नि पुरेक्ष्वाकुप्रवर्तिते /
दुर्वासा सशिष्येण पूजार्थं पूर्वकल्पिते //
text_mt: in his own city, in the shrine of Tripura previously established by Ikṣvāku, / arranged beforehand by Durvāsas together with his disciple for worship,

sanskrit_iast:
dāsīdāsadhvajārohagṛhotsavasamanvite /
tatra svaguruṇoktaṃ ca kṛtvā svātmārghapūjanam //
meaning:
दासीदासध्वजारोहगृहोत्सवसमन्विते /
तत्र स्वगुरुणोक्तं च कृत्वा स्वात्मार्घपूजनम् //
text_mt: endowed with female and male servants, the raising of the flag, and household festivals, / having performed there the worship with offerings of the self as stated by his guru,

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau svapne tu yadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānsvapure mahaḥ /
tadevātrāpi saṃdadhyau sannidhau rājasattamaḥ //
meaning:
रात्रौ स्वप्ने तु यद्रूपं दृष्टवान्स्वपुरे महः /
तदेवात्रापि संदध्यौ सन्निधौ राजसत्तमः //
text_mt: the form of light that he had seen in the dream at night in his own city— / that very form the best of kings meditated upon there in her presence.

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ dhyātvā mahārājaḥ suvāsāṃsi bahūni ca /
divyānyāyatanānyasyai dattvā stotraṃ cakāra ha //
meaning:
चिरं ध्यात्वा महाराजः सुवासांसि बहूनि च /
दिव्यान्यायतनान्यस्यै दत्त्वा स्तोत्रं चकार ह //
text_mt: Having meditated for a long time, the great king presented many fine garments / and divine sanctuaries to her, and then recited a hymn of praise:

sanskrit_iast:
pādāgralaṃbiparamābharaṇābhirāmemañjīraratnarucimañjulapādapadme /
pītāṃbarasphuritapeśalahemakāñci keyūrakaṅkaṇapariṣkṛtabāhuvalli //
meaning:
पादाग्रलंबिपरमाभरणाभिरामेमञ्जीररत्नरुचिमञ्जुलपादपद्मे /
पीतांबरस्फुरितपेशलहेमकाञ्चि केयूरकङ्कणपरिष्कृतबाहुवल्लि //
text_mt: “O you whose lotus-feet are charming with the luster of gems on anklets, delightful with supreme ornaments hanging to the tips of your feet, / whose slender golden girdle glitters on yellow garments, whose creeper-like arms are adorned with armlets and bracelets,

sanskrit_iast:
puṇḍrekṣucāpavilasanmṛduvāmapāṇe ratnormikāsumaśarāñcitadakṣahaste /
vakṣojamaṇḍalavilāsivalakṣahāri pāśāṅkuśāṅgadalasadbhujaśobhitāṅgi //
meaning:
पुण्ड्रेक्षुचापविलसन्मृदुवामपाणे रत्नोर्मिकासुमशराञ्चितदक्षहस्ते /
वक्षोजमण्डलविलासिवलक्षहारि पाशाङ्कुशाङ्गदलसद्भुजशोभिताङ्गि //
text_mt: whose soft left hand is splendid with the sugarcane bow, whose right hand is adorned with flower-arrows and gemmed rings, / wearing a radiant white necklace adorning the circle of your breasts, your limbs beautified by arms gleaming with noose, goad, and armlets,

sanskrit_iast:
vaktraśriyā vijitaśāradacandrabiṃbe tāṭaṅkaratnakaramaṇḍitagaṇḍabhāge /
vāme kare sarasijaṃ subisaṃ dadhāne kāruṇyanirjharadapāṅgayute maheśi //
meaning:
वक्त्रश्रिया विजितशारदचन्द्रबिंबे ताटङ्करत्नकरमण्डितगण्डभागे /
वामे करे सरसिजं सुबिसं दधाने कारुण्यनिर्झरदपाङ्गयुते महेशि //
text_mt: who has conquered the disc of the autumn moon with the beauty of your face, whose cheeks are adorned with the rays of jewel earrings, / holding a lotus with an excellent stalk in your left hand, endowed with side-glances granting a cascade of compassion, O Great Ruler,

sanskrit_iast:
māṇikyasūtramaṇibhāsurakaṃbukaṇṭhi bhālasthacandraśakalojjavalitālakāḍhye /
mandasmitasphuraṇaśālini mañjunāse netraśriyā vijitanīlasarojapatre //
meaning:
माणिक्यसूत्रमणिभासुरकंबुकण्ठि भालस्थचन्द्रशकलोज्जवलितालकाढ्ये /
मन्दस्मितस्फुरणशालिनि मञ्जुनासे नेत्रश्रिया विजितनीलसरोजपत्रे //
text_mt: whose conch-like neck shines with a necklace of rubies, rich in curling locks illuminated by the crescent moon on your forehead, / endowed with the radiance of a gentle smile, with a lovely nose, who has surpassed the blue lotus petal with the splendor of your eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
subhrūlate suvadane sulalāṭacitre yogīndramānasasarojanivāsahaṃsi /
ratnānubaddhatapanīyamahākirīṭe sarvāṅgasundari samastasurendravandye //
meaning:
सुभ्रूलते सुवदने सुललाटचित्रे योगीन्द्रमानससरोजनिवासहंसि /
रत्नानुबद्धतपनीयमहाकिरीटे सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि समस्तसुरेन्द्रवन्द्ये //
text_mt: with beautiful creeper-like brows, an exquisite face, and fine paintings on your forehead, a female swan dwelling in the lotus-mind of the lord of yogins, / wearing a great crown of refined gold inlaid with gems, beautiful in all your limbs, praised by all lords of the gods!”

sanskrit_iast:
kāṅkṣānurūpavarade karuṇārdracitte sāmrājyasampadabhimānini cakranāthe /
indrādidevaparisevitapādapadme siṃhāsaneśvarī pare mayi saṃnidadhyāḥ //
meaning:
काङ्क्षानुरूपवरदे करुणार्द्रचित्ते साम्राज्यसम्पदभिमानिनि चक्रनाथे /
इन्द्रादिदेवपरिसेवितपादपद्मे सिंहासनेश्वरी परे मयि संनिदध्याः //
text_mt: O giver of boons according with desires, whose heart is tender with compassion, proud ruler of the imperial fortune, mistress of the cakra, / whose lotus feet are attended by Indra and the other gods, supreme mistress of the lion-throne, please be present in me!

sanskrit_iast:
iti statvā sa bhūpālo bahirnirgatya bhaktitaḥ /
tasyāstu dakṣiṇe bhāge mahāgaurīṃ dadarśa ha //
meaning:
इति स्तत्वा स भूपालो बहिर्निर्गत्य भक्तितः /
तस्यास्तु दक्षिणे भागे महागौरीं ददर्श ह //
text_mt: Having thus praised her and stepped outside in devotion, that king / saw Mahāgaurī on her southern side.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau kṛtvā cāsyāḥ stutiṃ punaḥ /
dattvā cāsyai mahārhāṇi vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca //
meaning:
प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ कृत्वा चास्याः स्तुतिं पुनः /
दत्त्वा चास्यै महार्हाणि वासांसि विविधानि च //
text_mt: Bowing like a stick upon the earth, he offered praise to her again, / and gave her precious garments of various kinds,

sanskrit_iast:
amulyāni mahārhāṇi bhūṣaṇāni mahānti ca /
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nirgatya saha bhāryayā //
meaning:
अमुल्यानि महार्हाणि भूषणानि महान्ति च /
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य निर्गत्य सह भार्यया //
text_mt: and vast, priceless, and precious ornaments. / Then, having circumambulated [her], he went out with his wife.

sanskrit_iast:
svagurūktavidhānena mahāpūjāṃ vidhāya ca /
tāmeva cintayaṃstatra saptarātramuvāsa saḥ //
meaning:
स्वगुरूक्तविधानेन महापूजां विधाय च /
तामेव चिन्तयंस्तत्र सप्तरात्रमुवास सः //
text_mt: Having performed a great worship according to the rule prescribed by his guru, / he dwelt there for seven nights meditating only upon her.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭame divase devīṃ natvā bhaktyā vilokayan /
ambābhīṣṭaṃ pradehīti prārthayāmāsa cetasā //
meaning:
अष्टमे दिवसे देवीं नत्वा भक्त्या विलोकयन् /
अम्बाभीष्टं प्रदेहीति प्रार्थयामास चेतसा //
text_mt: On the eighth day, having bowed to the goddess and gazing upon her with devotion, / he prayed in his heart, 'O Mother, grant my wish!'

sanskrit_iast:
suprasannā ca kāmākṣī sāṃtarikṣagirāvadat /
bhaviṣyanti madaṃśāste catvārastanayā nṛpa //
meaning:
सुप्रसन्ना च कामाक्षी सांतरिक्षगिरावदत् /
भविष्यन्ति मदंशास्ते चत्वारस्तनया नृप //
text_mt: Extremely pleased, Kāmākṣī spoke with a voice from the sky: / 'O king, four sons shall be born to you as portions of myself.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityudīritamākarṇya pramodavikasanmukhaḥ /
śriyaṃ praṇamya sāṣṭāṅgamanananyaśaraṇaḥ parām //
meaning:
इत्युदीरितमाकर्ण्य प्रमोदविकसन्मुखः /
श्रियं प्रणम्य साष्टाङ्गमननन्यशरणः पराम् //
text_mt: Hearing this uttered, his face blooming with joy, / having no other refuge, he prostrated himself with eight limbs before the supreme Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
āmantrya manasaivāṃbāṃ sastrīkaḥ saha mantribhiḥ /
ayodhyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpadindumatyāstu nandanaḥ //
meaning:
आमन्त्र्य मनसैवांबां सस्त्रीकः सह मन्त्रिभिः /
अयोध्यां नगरीं प्रापदिन्दुमत्यास्तु नन्दनः //
text_mt: Taking leave of the Mother in his mind, the son of Indumatī, / accompanied by his wife and together with his ministers, reached the city of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabhāvā kāmākṣī sarvalokahitaiṣiṇī /
sarveṣāmapi bhaktānāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ pūrayatyalam //
meaning:
एवं प्रभावा कामाक्षी सर्वलोकहितैषिणी /
सर्वेषामपि भक्तानां काङ्क्षितं पूरयत्यलम् //
text_mt: Of such power is Kāmākṣī, wishing well to all worlds; / she fully satisfies the desire of all her devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
enāṃ lokeṣu bahavaḥ kāmākṣīṃ paradevatām /
upāsya vidhivadbhaktyā prāptāḥ kāmānaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
एनां लोकेषु बहवः कामाक्षीं परदेवताम् /
उपास्य विधिवद्भक्त्या प्राप्ताः कामानशेषतः //
text_mt: In the worlds, many, having worshipped this supreme deity Kāmākṣī / according to the rules and with devotion, have attained all their desires.

sanskrit_iast:
adyāpi prāpnuvantyeva bhaktimantaḥ phalaṃ mune /
aneke ca bhaviṣyanti kāmākṣyāḥ karuṇādṛśaḥ //
meaning:
अद्यापि प्राप्नुवन्त्येव भक्तिमन्तः फलं मुने /
अनेके च भविष्यन्ति कामाक्ष्याः करुणादृशः //
text_mt: Even today, the devoted surely obtain their fruit, O sage, / and many will receive the glances of Kāmākṣī's compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
māhātmyamasyāḥ śrīdevyāḥ ko vā varṇayituṃ kṣamaḥ /
nāhaṃ na śambhurna brahmā na viṣṇuḥ kimutāpare //
meaning:
माहात्म्यमस्याः श्रीदेव्याः को वा वर्णयितुं क्षमः /
नाहं न शम्भुर्न ब्रह्मा न विष्णुः किमुतापरे //
text_mt: Who indeed is capable of describing the majesty of this Śrīdevī? / Not I, not Śambhu, not Brahmā, not Viṣṇu—what then of others?

sanskrit_iast:
iti te kathitaṃ kiñcitkāmākṣyāḥ śīlamujjvalam /
śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cāpi sarvapāpaharaṃ smṛtam //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍe mahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
इति ते कथितं किञ्चित्कामाक्ष्याः शीलमुज्ज्वलम् /
शृण्वतां पठतां चापि सर्वपापहरं स्मृतम् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डे महापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Thus the radiant conduct of Kāmākṣī has been briefly related to you; / for those who hear it and read it, it is considered the destroyer of all sins.

Thus ends the fortieth chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the latter section of the glorious and great Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
kīdṛśaṃ yantrametasyā mantrovā kīdṛśo varaḥ /
upadeṣṭā ca kīdṛksyācchiṣyo vā kīdṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
कीदृशं यन्त्रमेतस्या मन्त्रोवा कीदृशो वरः /
उपदेष्टा च कीदृक्स्याच्छिष्यो वा कीदृशः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Agastya said: / What kind of yantra is hers, and what kind is the excellent mantra? / What kind of teacher should there be, or what kind of disciple is prescribed?

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñastvaṃ hayagrīva sākṣātparamapūruṣaḥ /
svāminmayi kṛpādṛṣṭyā sarvametannivedaya //
meaning:
सर्वज्ञस्त्वं हयग्रीव साक्षात्परमपूरुषः /
स्वामिन्मयि कृपादृष्ट्या सर्वमेतन्निवेदय //
text_mt: You are omniscient, Hayagrīva, the supreme spirit manifest! / O Lord, reveal all this to me with a look of compassion.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
mantraṃ śrīcakragevāsyāḥ seyaṃ hi tripurāṃbikā /
saiṣaiva hi mahālakṣmīḥ sphuraccaivātmanaḥ purā //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
मन्त्रं श्रीचक्रगेवास्याः सेयं हि त्रिपुरांबिका /
सैषैव हि महालक्ष्मीः स्फुरच्चैवात्मनः पुरा //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Her mantra is situated in the Śrīcakra; for she is mother Tripurā herself. / She is indeed Mahālakṣmī herself; formerly, shining from her own self,

sanskrit_iast:
pasyati sma tadā cakraṃ jyotirmayavijṛṃbhitam /
asya cakrasya māhātmyamaparijñeyameva hi //
meaning:
पस्यति स्म तदा चक्रं ज्योतिर्मयविजृंभितम् /
अस्य चक्रस्य माहात्म्यमपरिज्ञेयमेव हि //
text_mt: she then saw the cakra, manifested as full of light. / The greatness of this cakra is truly unfathomable.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣātsaiva mahālakṣmīḥ śrīcakramiti tattvataḥ /
yadabhyarcya mahāviṣṇuḥ sarvalokavimohanam /
kāmasaṃmohinīrūpaṃ bheje rājīvalocanaḥ //
meaning:
साक्षात्सैव महालक्ष्मीः श्रीचक्रमिति तत्त्वतः /
यदभ्यर्च्य महाविष्णुः सर्वलोकविमोहनम् /
कामसंमोहिनीरूपं भेजे राजीवलोचनः //
text_mt: In truth, the Śrīcakra is directly Mahālakṣmī herself, / by worshipping which the lotus-eyed Mahāviṣṇu assumed / the form that bewitches desire, captivating all the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
arcayitvā tadīśānaḥ sarvavidyeśvaro 'bhavat /
tadārādhya viśeṣeṇa brahmā brahmāṇḍasūrabhūt /
munīnāṃ mohanaścāsītsmaro yadvarivasyayā //
meaning:
अर्चयित्वा तदीशानः सर्वविद्येश्वरो ऽभवत् /
तदाराध्य विशेषेण ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माण्डसूरभूत् /
मुनीनां मोहनश्चासीत्स्मरो यद्वरिवस्यया //
text_mt: Having worshipped it, Īśāna became the master of all knowledge. / Having revered it especially, Brahmā became the progenitor of the cosmic egg; / and Smara, through serving it, became the bewitcher of sages.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyāḥ purataścakraṃ hemaraupyādinirmitam /
nidhāya gandhairabhyarcya ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyayā //
meaning:
श्रीदेव्याः पुरतश्चक्रं हेमरौप्यादिनिर्मितम् /
निधाय गन्धैरभ्यर्च्य षोडशाक्षरविद्यया //
text_mt: Having placed before Śrīdevī the cakra fashioned of gold, silver, or the like, / and having worshipped it with perfumes using the sixteen-syllable Vidyā,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyahaṃ tulasīpatraiḥ pavitrairmaṅgalākṛtiḥ /
sahasrairmūlamantreṇa śrīdevīdhyānasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
प्रत्यहं तुलसीपत्रैः पवित्रैर्मङ्गलाकृतिः /
सहस्रैर्मूलमन्त्रेण श्रीदेवीध्यानसंयुतः //
text_mt: daily with sacred tulasī leaves, of auspicious form, / by thousands with the root mantra, absorbed in meditation on Śrīdevī,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayitvā ca madhvājyaśarkarāpāyasaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
anavadyaiśca naivedyairmāṣāpūpairmanoharaiḥ //
meaning:
अर्चयित्वा च मध्वाज्यशर्करापायसैः शुभैः /
अनवद्यैश्च नैवेद्यैर्माषापूपैर्मनोहरैः //
text_mt: and having worshipped with honey, ghee, sugar, auspicious milk-rice, / blameless food-offerings, and delightful māṣa-cakes,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prīṇati mahālakṣmīṃ matimānmaṇḍalatraye /
mahasā tasya sāṃnidhyamādhatte parameśvarī //
meaning:
यः प्रीणति महालक्ष्मीं मतिमान्मण्डलत्रये /
महसा तस्य सांनिध्यमाधत्ते परमेश्वरी //
text_mt: the wise person who pleases Mahālakṣmī for three maṇḍalas— / the supreme goddess establishes her presence with splendor for him.

sanskrit_iast:
manasā vāñchitaṃ yacca prasannā tatprapūrayet /
dhavalai kusumaiścakramuktarītyā tu yor'cayet //
meaning:
मनसा वाञ्छितं यच्च प्रसन्ना तत्प्रपूरयेत् /
धवलै कुसुमैश्चक्रमुक्तरीत्या तु योर्ऽचयेत् //
text_mt: And whatever is wished in the mind, she, being pleased, will fulfill. / Whoever worships the cakra according to the stated method with white flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva rasanābhāge nityaṃ nṛtyati bhāratī /
pāṭalaiḥ kusumaiścakraṃ yor'cayeduktamārgataḥ /
sārvabhaumaṃ ca rājānaṃ dāsavadvaśayedasau //
meaning:
तस्यैव रसनाभागे नित्यं नृत्यति भारती /
पाटलैः कुसुमैश्चक्रं योर्ऽचयेदुक्तमार्गतः /
सार्वभौमं च राजानं दासवद्वशयेदसौ //
text_mt: on the tip of his tongue Sarasvatī dances constantly. / Whoever worships the cakra by the prescribed path with pāṭala flowers / subjugates even an emperor like a servant.

sanskrit_iast:
pītavarṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūrvavatpūjayecca yaḥ /
tasya vakṣasthale nityaṃ sākṣācchrīrvasati dhruvam //
meaning:
पीतवर्णैः शुभैः पुष्पैः पूर्ववत्पूजयेच्च यः /
तस्य वक्षस्थले नित्यं साक्षाच्छ्रीर्वसति ध्रुवम् //
text_mt: And whoever worships as before with auspicious yellow-colored flowers, / on his chest Śrī in person dwells continually and surely.

sanskrit_iast:
durgandhairgandhahīnaiśca suvarṇairapi nārcayet /
sugandhaireva kusumaiḥ puṣpaiścābhyarcaryocchavām //
meaning:
दुर्गन्धैर्गन्धहीनैश्च सुवर्णैरपि नार्चयेत् /
सुगन्धैरेव कुसुमैः पुष्पैश्चाभ्यर्चर्योच्छवाम् //
text_mt: One should not worship even with gold if it is foul-smelling or scentless; / one should worship the goddess who rejoices only with fragrant flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmākṣyaiva mahālakṣmīścakraṃ śrīcakrameva hi /
śrīvidyaiṣā parā vidyā nāyikā gurunāyikā //
meaning:
कामाक्ष्यैव महालक्ष्मीश्चक्रं श्रीचक्रमेव हि /
श्रीविद्यैषा परा विद्या नायिका गुरुनायिका //
text_mt: Kāmākṣī is Mahālakṣmī, and the cakra is the Śrīcakra indeed; / this Śrīvidyā is the supreme Vidyā, the mistress, the teacher-mistress.

sanskrit_iast:
etasyā mantrarājastu śrīvidyaiva tapodhana /
kāmarājāntamantrānte śrībījena samanvitaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्या मन्त्रराजस्तु श्रीविद्यैव तपोधन /
कामराजान्तमन्त्रान्ते श्रीबीजेन समन्वितः //
text_mt: Her king of mantras is Śrīvidyā itself, O ascetic, / accompanied by the seed-syllable of Śrī at the end of the mantra ending in the Kāmarāja.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyeyaṃ śrīvidyeti prakīrtitā /
itthaṃ rahasyamākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ //
meaning:
षोडशाक्षरविद्येयं श्रीविद्येति प्रकीर्तिता /
इत्थं रहस्यमाख्यातं गोपनीयं प्रयत्नतः //
text_mt: This sixteen-syllable vidyā is proclaimed as Śrīvidyā. / Thus the secret has been declared, to be concealed with great effort.

sanskrit_iast:
tisṛṇāmapi mūrtīnāṃ śaktirvidyeyamīritā /
sarveṣā mapi mantrāṇāṃ vidyaiṣā prāṇarūpiṇī //
meaning:
तिसृणामपि मूर्तीनां शक्तिर्विद्येयमीरिता /
सर्वेषा मपि मन्त्राणां विद्यैषा प्राणरूपिणी //
text_mt: This vidyā is declared to be the power of all three forms; / this vidyā embodies the life-breath of all mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pāraṃparyeṇa vijñātā vidyeyaṃ bandhamocinī /
saṃsmṛtā pāpaharaṇī jarāmṛtyuvināśinī //
meaning:
पारंपर्येण विज्ञाता विद्येयं बन्धमोचिनी /
संस्मृता पापहरणी जरामृत्युविनाशिनी //
text_mt: Known through traditional succession, this vidyā is the releaser from bondage; / when remembered, it removes sin and destroys old age and death.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitā duḥkhadaurbhāgyavyādhidāridrayanāśinī /
stutā vighnaughaśaminī dhyātā sarvārthasiddhidā //
meaning:
पूजिता दुःखदौर्भाग्यव्याधिदारिद्रयनाशिनी /
स्तुता विघ्नौघशमिनी ध्याता सर्वार्थसिद्धिदा //
text_mt: When worshipped, it destroys sorrow, misfortune, disease, and poverty; / when praised, it stills the flood of obstacles; when meditated upon, it grants the attainment of all ends.

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāviśeṣatattvajño dīkṣākṣapitakalmaṣaḥ /
bhajedyaḥ parameśānīmabhīṣṭaphalamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
मुद्राविशेषतत्त्वज्ञो दीक्षाक्षपितकल्मषः /
भजेद्यः परमेशानीमभीष्टफलमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Knowing the reality of the specific seals, his impurities burned away by initiation, / whoever worships the supreme goddess will attain the desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
dhavalāṃbarasaṃvītāṃ dhavalāvāsamadhyagām /
pūjayeddhavalaiḥ puṣpairbrahmacaryayuto naraḥ //
meaning:
धवलांबरसंवीतां धवलावासमध्यगाम् /
पूजयेद्धवलैः पुष्पैर्ब्रह्मचर्ययुतो नरः //
text_mt: Clothed in white garments, situated in the midst of a white dwelling, / a man endowed with celibacy should worship her with white flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
dhavalaiścaiva naivedyairdadhikṣīraudanādibhiḥ /
saṃkalpadhavalairvāpi pūjayetparameśvarīm //
meaning:
धवलैश्चैव नैवेद्यैर्दधिक्षीरौदनादिभिः /
संकल्पधवलैर्वापि पूजयेत्परमेश्वरीम् //
text_mt: and with white food-offerings: curd, milk-rice, and the like, / or with things made white by intention, he should worship the supreme goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīrvālantryakṣībījaiḥ kramātkhaṇḍeṣu yojitām /
ṣoḍaśākṣaravidyāṃ tāmarcayecchuddhamānasaḥ //
meaning:
श्रीर्वालन्त्र्यक्षीबीजैः क्रमात्खण्डेषु योजिताम् /
षोडशाक्षरविद्यां तामर्चयेच्छुद्धमानसः //
text_mt: With a pure mind, one should worship that sixteen-syllable vidyā / conjoined in successive sections with the seed-syllables of Śrī, Vāk, and Tryakṣī,

sanskrit_iast: anulomavilomena prajapanmātrikākṣaraiḥ //
meaning: अनुलोमविलोमेन प्रजपन्मात्रिकाक्षरैः //
text_mt: chanting [it] in direct and reverse order with the letters of the alphabet,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvayanneva devāgre śrīdevīṃ dīparūpiṇīm /
manasopāṃśunā vāpi nigadenāpi tāpasa //
meaning:
भावयन्नेव देवाग्रे श्रीदेवीं दीपरूपिणीम् /
मनसोपांशुना वापि निगदेनापि तापस //
text_mt: contemplating Śrīdevī in the form of a lamp before the deity, / mentally, in a whisper, or aloud, O ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevīnyāsasahitaḥ śrīdevīkṛtavigrahaḥ /
ekalakṣajapenaiva mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
श्रीदेवीन्याससहितः श्रीदेवीकृतविग्रहः /
एकलक्षजपेनैव महापापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Accompanied by the ritual placement of Śrīdevī, having his body made into that of Śrīdevī, / by the recitation of a single hundred thousand [mantras] one is freed from heinous sins.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣadvayena devarṣe saptajanmakṛtānyapi /
pāpāni nāśayatyeva sādhakasya parā kalā //
meaning:
लक्षद्वयेन देवर्षे सप्तजन्मकृतान्यपि /
पापानि नाशयत्येव साधकस्य परा कला //
text_mt: With two hundred thousand, O divine sage, the supreme part / surely destroys the sins committed even in seven births for the practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣatritayajāpena sahasrajanipātakaiḥ /
mucyate nātra saṃdeho nirmalo nitarāṃ mune /
kramātṣoḍaśalakṣeṇa devīsāṃnidhyamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
लक्षत्रितयजापेन सहस्रजनिपातकैः /
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहो निर्मलो नितरां मुने /
क्रमात्षोडशलक्षेण देवीसांनिध्यमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: With the recitation of three hundred thousand, he is freed from sins of a thousand births, / there is no doubt about this, completely spotless, O sage; / in due course, with sixteen hundred thousand, he attains the presence of the goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā traikālikī nityaṃ japastarpaṇameva ca /
homo brāhmaṇabhuktiśca puraścaraṇamucyate //
meaning:
पूजा त्रैकालिकी नित्यं जपस्तर्पणमेव च /
होमो ब्राह्मणभुक्तिश्च पुरश्चरणमुच्यते //
text_mt: Worship three times a day constantly, recitation, libation, / fire oblation, and the feeding of brāhmaṇas are called the preliminary rite.

sanskrit_iast:
homatarpaṇayoḥ svāhā nyāsapūjanayornamaḥ /
mantrānte pūjayeddevīṃ japakāle yathocitam //
meaning:
होमतर्पणयोः स्वाहा न्यासपूजनयोर्नमः /
मन्त्रान्ते पूजयेद्देवीं जपकाले यथोचितम् //
text_mt: At oblation and libation 'svāhā' [is uttered], at ritual placement and worship 'namaḥ'; / at the end of the mantra, one should worship the goddess at the time of recitation as appropriate.

sanskrit_iast:
japāddaśāṃśo homaḥ syāttaddaśāṃśaṃ tu tarpaṇam /
taddaśāṃśaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ vindhyamardana //
meaning:
जपाद्दशांशो होमः स्यात्तद्दशांशं तु तर्पणम् /
तद्दशांशं ब्राह्मणानां भोजनं विन्ध्यमर्दन //
