text_mt: The fire offering should be one-tenth of the recitation; the water oblation, however, should be one-tenth of that. / Feeding the brāhmaṇas is one-tenth of that, O crusher of the Vindhya!

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālopaghāte tu yadyadaṅgaṃ vihīyate /
tatsaṃkhyādviguṇaṃ japtvā puraścaryāṃ samāpayet //
meaning:
देशकालोपघाते तु यद्यदङ्गं विहीयते /
तत्संख्याद्विगुणं जप्त्वा पुरश्चर्यां समापयेत् //
text_mt: If any part is omitted because of an impediment of place or time, / one should complete the preliminary ritual by reciting twice that number.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāmyaprayogārthaṃ punarlakṣatrayaṃ japet /
vratastho nirvikāraśca trikālaṃ pūjanerataḥ /
paścādvaśyādikarmāṇi kurvansiddhimavāpsyati //
meaning:
ततः काम्यप्रयोगार्थं पुनर्लक्षत्रयं जपेत् /
व्रतस्थो निर्विकारश्च त्रिकालं पूजनेरतः /
पश्चाद्वश्यादिकर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यति //
text_mt: Then, for the purpose of desire-driven applications, one should again recite [the mantra] three hundred thousand times, / observing vows, free from agitation, and engaged in worship at the three junctures of the day. / Performing rites such as subjugation afterward, one will attain success.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya cakramadhyastho mantrī cintayate yadā /
sarvamātmānamaruṇaṃ sādhyamapyaruṇīkṛtam //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य चक्रमध्यस्थो मन्त्री चिन्तयते यदा /
सर्वमात्मानमरुणं साध्यमप्यरुणीकृतम् //
text_mt: Stationed in the center of the cakra after worshipping, when the mantrin visualizes / his entire self as red and the person to be affected made red as well,

sanskrit_iast:
tato bhavati vindhyāre sarvasaubhāgyasundaraḥ /
vallabhaḥ sarvalokānāṃ vaśayennātrasaṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
ततो भवति विन्ध्यारे सर्वसौभाग्यसुन्दरः /
वल्लभः सर्वलोकानां वशयेन्नात्रसंशयः //
text_mt: then, O enemy of the Vindhya, he becomes handsome with all good fortune, / dear to all people, and he would surely subjugate [them]; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rocanākuṅkumābhyāṃ tu samabhāgaṃ tu candanam /
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā tilakaṃ kārayed budhaḥ //
meaning:
रोचनाकुङ्कुमाभ्यां तु समभागं तु चन्दनम् /
शतमष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा तिलकं कारयेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Sandalwood in equal parts with yellow pigment and saffron: / having recited [the mantra] over it one hundred and eight times, the wise man should apply a forehead mark.

sanskrit_iast:
tato yamīkṣate vakti spṛśate cintayecca yam /
ardhena ca śarīreṇa sa vaśaṃ yāti dāsavat //
meaning:
ततो यमीक्षते वक्ति स्पृशते चिन्तयेच्च यम् /
अर्धेन च शरीरेण स वशं याति दासवत् //
text_mt: Then whomever he looks upon, speaks to, touches, or thinks of / goes under his control like a slave, even with half his body.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gandhaṃ pānaṃ vastraṃ tapodhana /
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā yasyai saṃproṣyate striyai /
sadya ākṛṣyate sā tu vimūḍhahṛdayā satī //
meaning:
तथा पुष्पं फलं गन्धं पानं वस्त्रं तपोधन /
शतमष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा यस्यै संप्रोष्यते स्त्रियै /
सद्य आकृष्यते सा तु विमूढहृदया सती //
text_mt: Likewise, having recited [the mantra] one hundred and eight times over a flower, fruit, perfume, drink, or garment, O ascetic, / on whatever woman it is sprinkled, / she, with a bewildered heart, is drawn immediately, even if she is chaste.

sanskrit_iast:
likhedrocana yaikānte pratimāmavanītale /
surūpāṃ ca saśṛṅgāraveṣābharaṇamaṇḍitām //
meaning:
लिखेद्रोचन यैकान्ते प्रतिमामवनीतले /
सुरूपां च सशृङ्गारवेषाभरणमण्डिताम् //
text_mt: One should draw with yellow pigment, in a solitary place on the surface of the earth, an image / beautiful and adorned with erotic dress and ornaments,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhālagalahṛnnābhijānumaṇḍalayojitam /
janmanāmamahāvidyāmaṅkuśāntarvidarbhitam //
meaning:
तद्भालगलहृन्नाभिजानुमण्डलयोजितम् /
जन्मनाममहाविद्यामङ्कुशान्तर्विदर्भितम् //
text_mt: joined at its forehead, neck, heart, navel, and knee-circles / with the birth-name and the great vidyā, interwoven within the goad [syllable].

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāṅgasaṃdhisaṃlīnāmālikhya madanākṣaraiḥ /
tadāśābhimukho bhūtvā tripurīkṛtavigrahaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वाङ्गसंधिसंलीनामालिख्य मदनाक्षरैः /
तदाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा त्रिपुरीकृतविग्रहः //
text_mt: Having inscribed it all over, nestled in all the bodily joints with the syllables of Kama, / turning to face her direction, having one's body transformed into Tripura,

sanskrit_iast:
baddhvā tu kṣobhiṇīṃ mudrāṃ vidyāmaṣṭaśataṃ japet /
saṃyojya dahanāgāre candrasūryaprabhākule //
meaning:
बद्ध्वा तु क्षोभिणीं मुद्रां विद्यामष्टशतं जपेत् /
संयोज्य दहनागारे चन्द्रसूर्यप्रभाकुले //
text_mt: and having bound the Agitating seal, one should recite the vidyā one hundred and eight times, / uniting [her] in the fire-abode filled with the splendor of the moon and sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tato vihvalitāpāṅgīmanaṅgaśarapīḍitām /
prajvalanmadanonmeṣaprasphurajjaghanasthalām //
meaning:
ततो विह्वलितापाङ्गीमनङ्गशरपीडिताम् /
प्रज्वलन्मदनोन्मेषप्रस्फुरज्जघनस्थलाम् //
text_mt: Then, [one should visualize] her whose glances are languid, afflicted by the arrows of the Bodiless One, / the region of whose hips quivers from the blazing awakening of passion,

sanskrit_iast:
śakticakre lasadraśmivalanākavalīkṛtām /
dūrīkṛtasucāritrāṃ viśālanayanāmbujām //
meaning:
शक्तिचक्रे लसद्रश्मिवलनाकवलीकृताम् /
दूरीकृतसुचारित्रां विशालनयनाम्बुजाम् //
text_mt: engulfed by the whirling of gleaming rays in the wheel of śaktis, / whose good conduct has been cast aside, whose lotus-like eyes are wide,

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṭanayanāṃ naṣṭadhairyasaṃlīnavrīḍanām /
mantrayantrauṣadhamahāmudrānigaḍabandhanām /
dūrīkṛtasucāritrāṃ viśālanayanāmbujām //
meaning:
आकृष्टनयनां नष्टधैर्यसंलीनव्रीडनाम् /
मन्त्रयन्त्रौषधमहामुद्रानिगडबन्धनाम् /
दूरीकृतसुचारित्रां विशालनयनाम्बुजाम् //
text_mt: whose eyes are drawn, whose modesty has dissolved as her firmness is lost, / bound in the fetters of mantras, diagrams, herbal remedies, and great seals, / whose good conduct has been cast aside, whose lotus-like eyes are wide,

sanskrit_iast:
mano 'dhikamahāmantrajapamānāṃ hṛtāṃśukām /
vimūḍhāmiva vikṣubdhāmiva pluṣṭāmivādbhutām //
meaning:
मनो ऽधिकमहामन्त्रजपमानां हृतांशुकाम् /
विमूढामिव विक्षुब्धामिव प्लुष्टामिवाद्भुताम् //
text_mt: chanting the great mantra beyond the mind, her garments stripped away, / as if utterly bewildered, as if agitated, as if singed, extraordinary,

sanskrit_iast:
likhitāmiva niḥsaṃjñāmiva pramathitāmiva /
nilīnāmiva niśceṣṭāmivānyatvaṃ gatāmiva //
meaning:
लिखितामिव निःसंज्ञामिव प्रमथितामिव /
निलीनामिव निश्चेष्टामिवान्यत्वं गतामिव //
text_mt: as if painted, as if unconscious, as if crushed, / as if vanished, as if motionless, as if altered into another state—

sanskrit_iast:
bhramanmantrāniloddhūtaveṇupatrākṛtiṃ ca khe /
bhramantīṃ bhāvayennārīṃ yojanānāṃ śatādapi //
meaning:
भ्रमन्मन्त्रानिलोद्धूतवेणुपत्राकृतिं च खे /
भ्रमन्तीं भावयेन्नारीं योजनानां शतादपि //
text_mt: taking the shape of a bamboo leaf swept up by the wind of the wandering mantra, / one should visualize the woman wandering in the sky, even from a hundred yojanas away.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhyagatāṃ pṛthvīṃ saśailavanakānanām /
catuḥsamudraparyantaṃ jvalantīṃ cintayettataḥ //
meaning:
चक्रमध्यगतां पृथ्वीं सशैलवनकाननाम् /
चतुःसमुद्रपर्यन्तं ज्वलन्तीं चिन्तयेत्ततः //
text_mt: One should then visualize the earth, situated in the center of the cakra, / with its mountains, forests, and woods, as far as the four oceans, blazing.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena jāyate madanopamaḥ /
dṛṣṭvā karṣayate lokaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva kurute vaśam //
meaning:
षण्मासाभ्यासयोगेन जायते मदनोपमः /
दृष्ट्वा कर्षयते लोकं दृष्ट्वैव कुरुते वशम् //
text_mt: By practicing this for six months, one becomes like Kāma; / merely seeing [him], he attracts the world; merely seeing [him], he brings it under control.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣobhayennārīṃ dṛṣṭvaiva harate viṣam /
dṛṣṭvā karīti vāgīśaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ vimohayet /
dṛṣṭvā cāturthikādīṃśca jvarānnāśayate kṣaṇāt //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा संक्षोभयेन्नारीं दृष्ट्वैव हरते विषम् /
दृष्ट्वा करीति वागीशं दृष्ट्वा सर्वं विमोहयेत् /
दृष्ट्वा चातुर्थिकादींश्च ज्वरान्नाशयते क्षणात् //
text_mt: Merely looking, he agitates a woman; merely looking, he removes poison; / merely looking, he makes one a master of speech; merely looking, he bewilders everything; / and merely looking, he destroys fevers such as the quartan fever in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
pītadravyeṇa likhitaṃ cakraṃ gūḍhaṃ tu dhārayet /
vākstaṃbhaṃ vādināṃ kṣipraṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पीतद्रव्येण लिखितं चक्रं गूढं तु धारयेत् /
वाक्स्तंभं वादिनां क्षिप्रं कुरुते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: One should wear, concealed, the cakra written with yellow substance; / it swiftly brings about the paralysis of the speech of debaters; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
mahānīlīrasenāpi śatrunāmayutaṃ likhet /
dakṣiṇābhimukho vahnau dagdhvā mārayate ripūn //
meaning:
महानीलीरसेनापि शत्रुनामयुतं लिखेत् /
दक्षिणाभिमुखो वह्नौ दग्ध्वा मारयते रिपून् //
text_mt: Or one may write the enemy's name ten thousand times with the juice of the great indigo; / facing south, having burned it in fire, one slays enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣāśvapurīṣābhyāṃ gomūtrairnāma ṭaṅkitam /
āranālasthitaṃ cakraṃ vidveṣaṃ kurute dviṣām //
meaning:
महिषाश्वपुरीषाभ्यां गोमूत्रैर्नाम टङ्कितम् /
आरनालस्थितं चक्रं विद्वेषं कुरुते द्विषाम् //
text_mt: The name inscribed with buffalo dung, horse dung, and cow's urine: / the cakra placed in sour fermented gruel causes hatred among enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
yuktvā rocanayā nāma kākapakṣeṇa madhyagam /
laṃbamānastadākāro uccāṭanakaraṃ param //
meaning:
युक्त्वा रोचनया नाम काकपक्षेण मध्यगम् /
लंबमानस्तदाकारो उच्चाटनकरं परम् //
text_mt: Joined with yellow pigment, the name in the center, by means of a crow's feather: / hanging down in that form, it is the supreme cause of eradication.

sanskrit_iast:
dugdhalākṣārocanābhirmahānīlīrasena ca /
likhitvā dhārayaṃścakraṃ cāturvarṇyaṃ vaśaṃ nayet //
meaning:
दुग्धलाक्षारोचनाभिर्महानीलीरसेन च /
लिखित्वा धारयंश्चक्रं चातुर्वर्ण्यं वशं नयेत् //
text_mt: Writing [it] with milk, lac, yellow pigment, and the juice of the great indigo, / and wearing the cakra, one brings the four social classes under control.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva vidhānena jalamadhye yadi kṣipet /
saubhāgyamatulaṃ tasya snānapānānna saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
अनेनैव विधानेन जलमध्ये यदि क्षिपेत् /
सौभाग्यमतुलं तस्य स्नानपानान्न संशयः //
text_mt: If by this very procedure one throws it into water, / his good fortune becomes unequaled from bathing [in it] and drinking [it]; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
cakramadhyagataṃ deśaṃ nagarīṃ vā varāṅganām /
jvalantīṃ cintayennityaṃ saptāhātkṣobhayenmune //
meaning:
चक्रमध्यगतं देशं नगरीं वा वराङ्गनाम् /
ज्वलन्तीं चिन्तयेन्नित्यं सप्ताहात्क्षोभयेन्मुने //
text_mt: One should constantly meditate on a region, a city, or an excellent woman situated in the center of the cakra / as blazing; in seven days, O sage, one agitates [them].

sanskrit_iast:
likhitvā pītavarṇaṃ tu cakrametadyadācaret /
pūrvāśābhimukho bhūtvā staṃbhayetsarvavādinaḥ //
meaning:
लिखित्वा पीतवर्णं तु चक्रमेतद्यदाचरेत् /
पूर्वाशाभिमुखो भूत्वा स्तंभयेत्सर्ववादिनः //
text_mt: When one employs this cakra having drawn it in yellow color, / facing the eastern direction, he paralyzes all debaters.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃdūravarṇalikhitaṃ pūjayeduttarāmukhaḥ /
yadā tadā svavaśago loko bhavati nānyathā //
meaning:
सिंदूरवर्णलिखितं पूजयेदुत्तरामुखः /
यदा तदा स्ववशगो लोको भवति नान्यथा //
text_mt: When one worships it, drawn with vermilion, facing north, / then the world comes under his control; it is not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ gaurikayālikhyapūjayetpaścimāmukhaḥ /
yaḥ sasarvāṅganākarṣavaśyakṣobhakaro bhavet //
meaning:
चक्रं गौरिकयालिख्यपूजयेत्पश्चिमामुखः /
यः ससर्वाङ्गनाकर्षवश्यक्षोभकरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Having drawn the cakra with red ochre, he who worships it facing west / becomes an attractor, subjugator, and agitator of all women.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedvindhyadarpāre rahasyekacaro girau /
ajarāmaratāṃ mantrī labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयेद्विन्ध्यदर्पारे रहस्येकचरो गिरौ /
अजरामरतां मन्त्री लभते नात्र संशयः //
text_mt: Worshipping in secret, wandering alone on a mountain, O enemy of the Vindhya's pride, / the mantrin attains freedom from old age and death; of this there is no doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyametatkathitaṃ gopitavyaṃ mahāmune /
gopanātsarvasiddhiḥ syādbhraṃśa eva prakāśanāt //
meaning:
रहस्यमेतत्कथितं गोपितव्यं महामुने /
गोपनात्सर्वसिद्धिः स्याद्भ्रंश एव प्रकाशनात् //
text_mt: This secret has been declared; it must be concealed, O great sage. / From concealment all accomplishment arises; from disclosure comes only ruin.

sanskrit_iast:
avidhāya puraścaryāṃ yaḥ karma kurute mune /
devatāśāpamāpnoti na ca siddhiṃ sa vindati //
meaning:
अविधाय पुरश्चर्यां यः कर्म कुरुते मुने /
देवताशापमाप्नोति न च सिद्धिं स विन्दति //
text_mt: He who performs an application without having done the preliminary ritual, O sage, / incurs the curse of the deity and does not attain success.

sanskrit_iast:
prayogadoṣaśāntyarthaṃ punarlakṣaṃ japedbudhaḥ /
kuryācca vidhivatpūjāṃ punaryogyo bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
प्रयोगदोषशान्त्यर्थं पुनर्लक्षं जपेद्बुधः /
कुर्याच्च विधिवत्पूजां पुनर्योग्यो भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: To pacify the faults of application, the wise man should again recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times / and perform worship according to the rules; the man will become qualified once more.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkāmo devatāṃ nityaṃ yor'cayedbhaktinirbharaḥ //
meaning: निष्कामो देवतां नित्यं योर्ऽचयेद्भक्तिनिर्भरः //
text_mt: He who, free from selfish desire, constantly worships the deity full of devotion,

sanskrit_iast: tāmeva cintayannāste yathāśakti manuṃ japan //
meaning: तामेव चिन्तयन्नास्ते यथाशक्ति मनुं जपन् //
text_mt: meditating only on her, remains reciting the mantra according to his ability—

sanskrit_iast:
saiva tasyaihikaṃ bhāraṃ vahenmuktiṃ ca sādhayet /
sadā saṃnihitā tasya sarvaṃ ca kathayeta sā //
meaning:
सैव तस्यैहिकं भारं वहेन्मुक्तिं च साधयेत् /
सदा संनिहिता तस्य सर्वं च कथयेत सा //
text_mt: she alone bears his burden in this world and accomplishes his liberation; / she is always near to him and tells him everything.

sanskrit_iast:
vātsalyasahitā dhenu yathā vatsamanuvrajet /
tathānugacchetsā devī svabhaktaṃ śaraṇāgatam //
meaning:
वात्सल्यसहिता धेनु यथा वत्समनुव्रजेत् /
तथानुगच्छेत्सा देवी स्वभक्तं शरणागतम् //
text_mt: Just as a cow accompanied by motherly love follows its calf, / so that Goddess follows her devotee who has taken refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
śaraṇāgataśabdasya kor'tho vada hayā nana /
vatsaṃ gauriva yaṃ gaurī dhāvantamanudhāvati //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
शरणागतशब्दस्य कोर्ऽथो वद हया नन /
वत्सं गौरिव यं गौरी धावन्तमनुधावति //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Tell me, O horse-faced one, what is the meaning of the word 'one who has taken refuge,' / whom Gaurī runs after as a cow runs after her running calf?

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
yaḥ pumānakhilaṃ bhāramaihikāmuṣmikātmakam /
śrīdevatāyāṃ nikṣipya sadā tadgatamānasaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
यः पुमानखिलं भारमैहिकामुष्मिकात्मकम् /
श्रीदेवतायां निक्षिप्य सदा तद्गतमानसः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Whatever person casts his entire burden, relating to both this world and the next, / upon the venerable deity, his mind ever focused on her,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvānukūlaḥ sarvatra pratikūlavivarjitaḥ /
ananyaśaraṇo gaurīṃ dṛḍhaṃ samprārthya rakṣaṇe //
meaning:
सर्वानुकूलः सर्वत्र प्रतिकूलविवर्जितः /
अनन्यशरणो गौरीं दृढं सम्प्रार्थ्य रक्षणे //
text_mt: agreeable toward all, everywhere, free from opposition, / with no other refuge, firmly praying to Gaurī for protection,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣiṣyatīti viśvāsastatsevaikaprayojanaḥ /
varivasyātatparaḥ syātsā eva śaraṇāgatiḥ //
meaning:
रक्षिष्यतीति विश्वासस्तत्सेवैकप्रयोजनः /
वरिवस्यातत्परः स्यात्सा एव शरणागतिः //
text_mt: having the conviction, 'She will protect me,' whose sole aim is her service, / and devoted to attendance on her—that alone is taking refuge.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā kadācitstutinindanādau nindantu lokāḥ stuvatāṃ jano vā /
iti svarūpaṃ sudhiyā samīkṣya viṣādakhedau na bhajetprapannaḥ //
meaning:
यदा कदाचित्स्तुतिनिन्दनादौ निन्दन्तु लोकाः स्तुवतां जनो वा /
इति स्वरूपं सुधिया समीक्ष्य विषादखेदौ न भजेत्प्रपन्नः //
text_mt: Whenever in praise or censure people may censure or someone may praise: / examining the nature of things with wise discernment, one who has taken refuge should not feel dejection or grief.

sanskrit_iast:
anukūlasya saṃkalpaḥ pratikūlasya varjanam /
rakṣiṣyatīti viśvāso goptṛtvavaraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
अनुकूलस्य संकल्पः प्रतिकूलस्य वर्जनम् /
रक्षिष्यतीति विश्वासो गोप्तृत्ववरणं तथा //
text_mt: Intending what is agreeable, avoiding what is unfavorable, / faith that 'She will protect,' choosing [her] as protector,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanikṣepakārpaṇye ṣaḍvidhā śaraṇāgatiḥ /
aṅgīkṛtyātmanikṣepaṃ pañcāṅgāni samarpayet /
na hyasya sadṛśaṃ kiñcidbhuktimuktyostu sādhanam //
meaning:
आत्मनिक्षेपकार्पण्ये षड्विधा शरणागतिः /
अङ्गीकृत्यात्मनिक्षेपं पञ्चाङ्गानि समर्पयेत् /
न ह्यस्य सदृशं किञ्चिद्भुक्तिमुक्त्योस्तु साधनम् //
text_mt: self-surrender, and humility—refuge is sixfold. / Having accepted self-surrender, one should offer the five limbs; / for there is nothing comparable to this as a means to enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
amānitvamadaṃbhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam /
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ //
meaning:
अमानित्वमदंभित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् /
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः //
text_mt: Absence of pride, absence of deceit, non-violence, patience, uprightness, / service to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-restraint,

sanskrit_iast:
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṅkāra eva ca /
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam /
asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu //
meaning:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च /
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् /
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु //
text_mt: Dispassion regarding sense objects, absence of egoism as well, / perception of the evil of suffering in birth, death, old age, and sickness, / detachment, absence of clinging to sons, wife, home, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu /
mayi cānanyabhāvena bhaktikhyabhicāriṇī //
meaning:
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु /
मयि चानन्यभावेन भक्तिख्यभिचारिणी //
text_mt: Constant equanimity of mind toward desirable and undesirable occurrences, / and unswerving devotion directed toward me with single-minded focus,

sanskrit_iast:
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi /
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam /
etāni sarvadā jñānasādhanāni samabhyaset //
meaning:
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि /
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् /
एतानि सर्वदा ज्ञानसाधनानि समभ्यसेत् //
text_mt: Resorting to solitary places, distaste for assemblies of men, / constancy in knowledge of the supreme Self, perception of the aim of knowledge of reality— / these means of knowledge one should always practice.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkarmakṛttatparamastadbhaktaḥ saṃgavarjitaḥ /
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa yāti parāṃ śriyam //
meaning:
तत्कर्मकृत्तत्परमस्तद्भक्तः संगवर्जितः /
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स याति परां श्रियम् //
text_mt: One who performs deeds for me, holds me supreme, is devoted to me, free from attachment, / and free from enmity toward all beings—such a person attains the highest glory.

sanskrit_iast:
gurustu mādṛśo dhīmānkhyāto vātāpitāpana /
śiṣyo 'pi tvādṛśaḥ prokto rahasyāmnāyadeśikaḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hayagrīvāgastyasaṃvāde lalitopākhyāne ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
गुरुस्तु मादृशो धीमान्ख्यातो वातापितापन /
शिष्यो ऽपि त्वादृशः प्रोक्तो रहस्याम्नायदेशिकः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे हयग्रीवागस्त्यसंवादे ललितोपाख्याने एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
A wise guru like me is renowned, O tormentor of Vātāpi, / and a disciple like you is declared a teacher of the secret tradition.

Thus ends the forty-first chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
mudrāviracanārītimaśvānana nivedaya /
yābhirviracitābhistu śrīdevī saṃprasīdati //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
मुद्राविरचनारीतिमश्वानन निवेदय /
याभिर्विरचिताभिस्तु श्रीदेवी संप्रसीदति //
text_mt: Agastya said: / Declare, O Horse-faced One, the method of forming the mudrās, / formed through which the glorious Goddess becomes fully pleased.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
āvāhanī mahāmudrā trikhaṇḍeti prakīrtitā /
parivṛtya karau spaṣṭamaṅguṣṭhau kārayetsamau //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
आवाहनी महामुद्रा त्रिखण्डेति प्रकीर्तिता /
परिवृत्य करौ स्पष्टमङ्गुष्ठौ कारयेत्समौ //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / The great mudrā for invocation is celebrated as the Trikhaṇḍā. / Having turned the two hands around clearly, one should make the two thumbs parallel;

sanskrit_iast:
anāmāntargate kṛtvā tarjanyau kuṭilākṛtī /
kaniṣṭhike niyuñjīta nijasthāne tapodhana /
saṃkṣobhiṇyākhyāmudrāṃ tu kathayāmyadhunā śruṇu //
meaning:
अनामान्तर्गते कृत्वा तर्जन्यौ कुटिलाकृती /
कनिष्ठिके नियुञ्जीत निजस्थाने तपोधन /
संक्षोभिण्याख्यामुद्रां तु कथयाम्यधुना श्रुणु //
text_mt: Placing the two index fingers inside the ring fingers, bent in shape, / one should fix the two little fingers in their own place, O rich in austerity. / Now I shall tell the mudrā named Saṃkṣobhiṇī; listen:

sanskrit_iast:
madhyame madhyage kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭarodhite /
tarjanyo daṇḍavatkṛtvā madhyamoparyanāmike //
meaning:
मध्यमे मध्यगे कृत्वा कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्टरोधिते /
तर्जन्यो दण्डवत्कृत्वा मध्यमोपर्यनामिके //
text_mt: Having placed the two middle fingers in the middle, restrained by the little fingers and thumbs, / having made the two index fingers straight like rods, [place] the ring fingers above the middle fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
etasyā eva mudrāyā madhyame sarale yadi /
kriyate vindhyadarpāre mudrā vidrāviṇī tathā //
meaning:
एतस्या एव मुद्राया मध्यमे सरले यदि /
क्रियते विन्ध्यदर्पारे मुद्रा विद्राविणी तथा //
text_mt: If the middle fingers of this very mudrā are made straight, / O foe of the pride of the Vindhya, it is thus the Vidrāviṇī mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamātarjanībhyāṃ tu kaniṣṭhānāmike same /
aṅkuśākārarūpābhyāṃ madhyage kalaśodbhava /
iyamākarṣiṇī mudrā trailokyākarṣaṇe kṣamā //
meaning:
मध्यमातर्जनीभ्यां तु कनिष्ठानामिके समे /
अङ्कुशाकाररूपाभ्यां मध्यगे कलशोद्भव /
इयमाकर्षिणी मुद्रा त्रैलोक्याकर्षणे क्षमा //
text_mt: By the two middle fingers and the two index fingers, the two little fingers and the two ring fingers being equal, / having the shape of elephant goads, placed in the middle, O pot-born one, / this is the Ākarṣiṇī mudrā, capable of attracting the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
puṭākārau karau kṛtvā tarjanyāvaṅkuśākṛtī /
parivartakrameṇaiva madhyame tadadhogate //
meaning:
पुटाकारौ करौ कृत्वा तर्जन्यावङ्कुशाकृती /
परिवर्तक्रमेणैव मध्यमे तदधोगते //
text_mt: Having made the two hands into hollow cups, and the two index fingers like elephant goads, / in the order of turning around, the two middle fingers go beneath them.

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇānena devarṣe madhyamāmadhyage 'nuje /
anāmike tu sarale tadbahistarjanīdvayam //
meaning:
क्रमेणानेन देवर्षे मध्यमामध्यगे ऽनुजे /
अनामिके तु सरले तद्बहिस्तर्जनीद्वयम् //
text_mt: In this order, O divine sage, the younger [fingers] go between the middle fingers; / the ring fingers are straight, and outside them are the two index fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍākārau tatoṃ'guṣṭhau madhyamāvartadeśagau /
mudraiṣonmādinī nāmnā khyātā vātāpitāpana //
meaning:
दण्डाकारौ ततोंऽगुष्ठौ मध्यमावर्तदेशगौ /
मुद्रैषोन्मादिनी नाम्ना ख्याता वातापितापन //
text_mt: Then the two thumbs, shaped like rods, are placed in the curve of the middle fingers. / This mudrā is known by the name Unmādinī, O tormentor of Vātāpi.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāstvanāmikāyugmamadhaḥ kṛtvāṅkuśākṛti /
tarjanyāvapi tenaiva krameṇa viniyojayet //
meaning:
अस्यास्त्वनामिकायुग्ममधः कृत्वाङ्कुशाकृति /
तर्जन्यावपि तेनैव क्रमेण विनियोजयेत् //
text_mt: Having placed the pair of ring fingers of this [mudrā] downward, shaped like elephant goads, / one should also apply the two index fingers in that very order.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ mahāṅkuśā mudrā sarvakāryārthasādhikā //
meaning: इयं महाङ्कुशा मुद्रा सर्वकार्यार्थसाधिका //
text_mt: This is the Mahāṅkuśā mudrā, which accomplishes all purposes and aims.

sanskrit_iast:
savyaṃ dakṣiṇādeśe tu dakṣiṇaṃ savyadeśataḥ /
bāhū kṛtvā tu devarṣe hastau samparivartya ca 42.12 /
kaniṣṭhānāmike yukte krameṇānena tāpasa /
tarjanībhyāṃ samākrānte sarvordhvamapi madhyame //
meaning:
सव्यं दक्षिणादेशे तु दक्षिणं सव्यदेशतः /
बाहू कृत्वा तु देवर्षे हस्तौ सम्परिवर्त्य च 42.12 /
कनिष्ठानामिके युक्ते क्रमेणानेन तापस /
तर्जनीभ्यां समाक्रान्ते सर्वोर्ध्वमपि मध्यमे //
text_mt: Having placed the left [arm] in the place of the right, and the right in the place of the left / [with] arms, O divine sage, and having turned the two hands around, / the little and ring fingers joined in this order, O ascetic, / overcome by the index fingers, and the middle fingers above all—

sanskrit_iast:
lopāmudrāpateṅguṣṭhau kārayetsakalāvapi /
iyaṃ tu khecarī nāma mudrā sarvottamottamā /
etadvijñānamātreṇa yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet //
meaning:
लोपामुद्रापतेङ्गुष्ठौ कारयेत्सकलावपि /
इयं तु खेचरी नाम मुद्रा सर्वोत्तमोत्तमा /
एतद्विज्ञानमात्रेण योगिनीनां प्रियो भवेत् //
text_mt: O husband of Lopāmudrā, one should make both thumbs complete. / This mudrā, named Khecarī, is the highest of all the highest. / Merely by knowing this, one becomes dear to the Yoginīs.

sanskrit_iast:
parivartya karau spṛṣṭāvardhacandrasamākṛtī /
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ yugapadyojayettataḥ //
meaning:
परिवर्त्य करौ स्पृष्टावर्धचन्द्रसमाकृती /
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयुगलं युगपद्योजयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Having turned the hands around so they touch, shaped like half-moons, / one should then join the pair of index fingers and thumbs simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ kaniṣṭhāvaṣṭabdhamadhyame viniyojayet /
athaite kuṭile yuktvā sarvādhastādanāmike /
bījamudreyamācirātsarvasiddhapravartinī //
meaning:
अधः कनिष्ठावष्टब्धमध्यमे विनियोजयेत् /
अथैते कुटिले युक्त्वा सर्वाधस्तादनामिके /
बीजमुद्रेयमाचिरात्सर्वसिद्धप्रवर्तिनी //
text_mt: One should join the middle fingers held down by the little fingers underneath. / Then, having joined these bent [fingers], the ring fingers placed lowest of all: / this is the Bījamudrā, quickly bringing about all accomplishments.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāgre kuṭilākāre tarjanyupari saṃsthite /
anāmikāmadhyagate tathaiva hi kaniṣṭike //
meaning:
मध्याग्रे कुटिलाकारे तर्जन्युपरि संस्थिते /
अनामिकामध्यगते तथैव हि कनिष्टिके //
text_mt: The tips of the middle fingers bent, resting on top of the index fingers, / and likewise the little fingers situated in the middle of the ring fingers;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvā ekatra saṃyojya cāṅguṣṭhaparipīḍitāḥ /
eṣā tu prathamā mudrā yonimudreti saṃjñitā //
meaning:
सर्वा एकत्र संयोज्य चाङ्गुष्ठपरिपीडिताः /
एषा तु प्रथमा मुद्रा योनिमुद्रेति संज्ञिता //
text_mt: Having joined them all together, pressed down by the thumbs— / this is the first mudrā, known as the yoni seal.

sanskrit_iast:
etā mudrāstu devarṣe śrīdevyāḥ prītihetavaḥ /
pūjākāle prayoktavyā yathānukramayogataḥ //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne hayagrīvāgastyasamvāde dvācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एता मुद्रास्तु देवर्षे श्रीदेव्याः प्रीतिहेतवः /
पूजाकाले प्रयोक्तव्या यथानुक्रमयोगतः //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने हयग्रीवागस्त्यसम्वादे द्वाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
These mudrās, O divine sage, are the causes of the glorious Goddess's delight. / They are to be employed at the time of worship according to the proper order.

Thus ends the forty-second chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna, in the dialogue between Hayagrīva and Agastya, in the final part of the glorious Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
agastya uvāca
aśvānana mahāprājña karuṇāmṛtavāridhe /
śrīdevīdarśane dīkṣā yādṛśī tāṃ nivedaya //
meaning:
अगस्त्य उवाच
अश्वानन महाप्राज्ञ करुणामृतवारिधे /
श्रीदेवीदर्शने दीक्षा यादृशी तां निवेदय //
text_mt: Agastya said: / O Horse-faced One, highly wise one, ocean of the nectar of compassion, / declare what kind of initiation exists for the vision of the glorious Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
yadi te devatābhāvo yayā kalmaṣakardamāḥ /
kṣālyante ca tathā pusāṃ dīkṣāmācakṣmahe 'tra tām //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
यदि ते देवताभावो यया कल्मषकर्दमाः /
क्षाल्यन्ते च तथा पुसां दीक्षामाचक्ष्महे ऽत्र ताम् //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / If you have the divine disposition by which the mud of sins / is washed away for men, we shall describe that initiation here.

sanskrit_iast:
haste śivapurandhyātvā japenmūlāṅgamālinīm /
guruḥ spṛśecchiṣyatanuṃ sparśadīkṣeyamīritā //
meaning:
हस्ते शिवपुरन्ध्यात्वा जपेन्मूलाङ्गमालिनीम् /
गुरुः स्पृशेच्छिष्यतनुं स्पर्शदीक्षेयमीरिता //
text_mt: Having meditated on the city of Śiva in the hand, one should recite the garland [mantra] of root and limbs; / the guru should touch the disciple's body: this is declared the initiation by touch.

sanskrit_iast:
nimīlya nayane dhyātvā śrīkāmākṣīṃ prasannadhīḥ /
samyakpaśyedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ dṛgdīkṣā seyamucyate //
meaning:
निमील्य नयने ध्यात्वा श्रीकामाक्षीं प्रसन्नधीः /
सम्यक्पश्येद्गुरुः शिष्यं दृग्दीक्षा सेयमुच्यते //
text_mt: Closing the two eyes and meditating upon the glorious Kāmākṣī with a clear mind, / the guru should look directly at the disciple; that is called the initiation by sight.

sanskrit_iast:
gurorālokamātreṇa bhāṣaṇātsparśanādapi /
sadyaḥ sañjāyate jñānaṃ sā dīkṣā śāmbhavī matā //
meaning:
गुरोरालोकमात्रेण भाषणात्स्पर्शनादपि /
सद्यः सञ्जायते ज्ञानं सा दीक्षा शाम्भवी मता //
text_mt: Merely by the guru's glance, from speech, or even from touch, / knowledge arises instantly: that initiation is considered the Śāmbhavī [initiation].

sanskrit_iast:
devyā deho yathā prokto gurudehastathaiva ca /
tatprasādena śiṣyo 'pi tadrūpaḥ samprakāśate //
meaning:
देव्या देहो यथा प्रोक्तो गुरुदेहस्तथैव च /
तत्प्रसादेन शिष्यो ऽपि तद्रूपः सम्प्रकाशते //
text_mt: Just as the body of the Goddess is described, so also is the guru's body; / by his grace, the disciple too shines forth with that very nature.

sanskrit_iast:
ciraṃ śuśrūṣayā samyaktoṣito deśikeśvaraḥ /
tūṣṇīṃ saṃkalpayecchiṣyaṃ sā dīkṣā mānasī matā //
meaning:
चिरं शुश्रूषया सम्यक्तोषितो देशिकेश्वरः /
तूष्णीं संकल्पयेच्छिष्यं सा दीक्षा मानसी मता //
text_mt: When the sovereign teacher has been fully satisfied for a long time by service, / he mentally consecrates the disciple in silence; that initiation is considered mental.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāṇāmapi sarvāsāmiyamevottamottamā /
ādau kuryātkriyādīkṣāṃ tatprakāraḥ pravakṣyate //
meaning:
दीक्षाणामपि सर्वासामियमेवोत्तमोत्तमा /
आदौ कुर्यात्क्रियादीक्षां तत्प्रकारः प्रवक्ष्यते //
text_mt: Even among all initiations, this one alone is the highest of all. / First one should perform the ritual initiation; its manner will now be explained.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe śubhadine vidhāya śucimānasam /
jihvāsyamalaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā yathāvidhi //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे शुभदिने विधाय शुचिमानसम् /
जिह्वास्यमलशुद्धिं च कृत्वा स्नात्वा यथाविधि //
text_mt: In the bright fortnight, on an auspicious day, having made the mind pure, / having cleansed the tongue and mouth of impurities, and having bathed according to the rules,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃdhyākarma samāpyātha gurudehaṃ paraṃ smaran /
ekānte nivasañchrīmānmaunī ca niyatāśanaḥ //
meaning:
संध्याकर्म समाप्याथ गुरुदेहं परं स्मरन् /
एकान्ते निवसञ्छ्रीमान्मौनी च नियताशनः //
text_mt: Having completed the twilight ritual, then remembering the supreme body of the guru, / dwelling in solitude, fortunate, observing silence, and eating measured food,

sanskrit_iast:
guruśca tādṛśobhūtvā pūjāmandiramāviśet /
devīsūktena saṃyuktaṃ vidyānyāsaṃ samātṛkam //
meaning:
गुरुश्च तादृशोभूत्वा पूजामन्दिरमाविशेत् /
देवीसूक्तेन संयुक्तं विद्यान्यासं समातृकम् //
text_mt: The guru as well, becoming likewise, should enter the worship chamber. / Having performed the ritual placement of the vidyā combined with the Devīsūkta and with the Mātṛkās,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā puruṣasūktena ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ /
āvāhanā sane pādyamardhyamācamanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कृत्वा पुरुषसूक्तेन षोडशैरुपचारकैः /
आवाहना सने पाद्यमर्ध्यमाचमनं तथा //
text_mt: Along with the Puruṣasūkta, through the sixteen offerings: / invocation, seat, water for the feet, arghya, and water for sipping;

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣā ca gandhaḥ puṣpaṃ tathaiva ca /
dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca pradakṣiṇā //
meaning:
स्नानं वस्त्रं च भूषा च गन्धः पुष्पं तथैव च /
धूपदीपौ च नैवेद्यं ताम्बूलं च प्रदक्षिणा //
text_mt: Bath, garment, and ornaments, scent, flower likewise, / incense and lamp, food offering, betel, circumambulation,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmaśceti vikhyātaiḥ prīṇayettripurāṃbikām /
atha puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyātsahasrākṣaravidyayā //
meaning:
प्रणामश्चेति विख्यातैः प्रीणयेत्त्रिपुरांबिकाम् /
अथ पुष्पाञ्जलिं दद्यात्सहस्राक्षरविद्यया //
text_mt: And salutation—by these renowned [offerings] he should gratify the Mother Tripurā; / then he should offer a handful of flowers with the thousand-syllabled vidyā.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ oṃ namastripurasundari hṛdaye devi śirodevi śikhādevi kavacadevi netradevi āsyadevi kāmeśvari bhagamālini nityaklinneṃ bhairuṇḍe vahnivāsini mahāvajreśvari vidyeśvari paraśivadūti tvarite kulasuṃdari nitye nīlapatāke vijaye sarvamaṅgale jvālāmālini citre mahānitye parameśvari mantreśamayi ṣaṣṭhīśamayyudyānamayi lopāmudrāmayyagastyamayi kālatāpanamayi dharmācāramayi muktake śīśvaramayi dīpakalānāthamayi viṣṇudevamayi prabhākaradevamayi tejodevamayi manojadevamayi aṇimasiddhe mahimasiddhe garima siddhe laghimasiddhe īśitvasiddhe vaśitvasiddhe prāptisiddhe prākāmyasiddhe rasasiddhe mokṣasiddhe brāhmi māheśvarī kaumāri vaiṣṇavi vārāhi indrāṇi cāmuṇḍe mahālakṣmi sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇi sarvavidrāviṇi sarvākarṣiṇi sarvavaśaṅkari sarvonmādini sarvamahāṅkuśe sarvakhecari sarvabīje sarvayone sarvāstrakhaṇḍini trailokyamohini cakrasvāmini prāṭayogini bauddhadarśanāṅgi kāmākarṣiṇi buddhyākarṣiṇi ahaṅkārākarṣiṇi śabdākarṣiṇi sparśākarṣiṇi rūpākarṣiṇi rasākarṣiṇi gandhākarṣiṇi cittākarṣiṇi dhairyākarṣiṇi smṛtyākarṣiṇi nāmākarṣiṇi bījākarṣiṇātmākirṣiṇi amṛtākarṣiṇi śarīrākarṣiṇi guptayogini sarvāśāparipūrakacakrasvāmini anaṅgakusume anaṅgamekhale anaṅgamādini anaṅgamadanāture 'naṅgarekhe 'naṅgaveginyanaṅgāṅkuśe 'naṅgamālini guptatarayogini vaidikadarśanāṅgi sarvasaṃkṣobhakāraka cakrasvāmini pūrvāmnāyādhidevate sṛṣṭirūpe sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇi sarvavidrāviṇi sarvākarṣiṇi sarvāhlādini sarvasaṃmohini sarvastaṃbhiṇi sarvajṛṃbhiṇi sarvavaśaṅkari sarvarañjini sarvonmādini sarvārthasādhike sarvasaṃpatprapūriṇi sarvamantramayi sarvadvandvakṣayakari sampradāyayogini sauradarśanāṅgi sarvasaubhāgyadāyakacakre sarvasiddhiprade sarvasampatprade sarvapriyaṅkari
sarvamaṅgalakāriṇi sarvakāmaprade sarvaduḥkhavimocini sarvamṛtyupraśamini sarvavighnanivāriṇi sarvāṅgasundari sarvasaubhāgyadāyini kulottīrṇayogini sarvārthasādhakacakreśi sarvajñe sarvaśakte sarvaiśvaryaphalaprade sarvajñānamayi sarvavyādhinivāriṇi sarvādhārasvarūpe sarvapāpahare sarvānandamayi sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇi sarvepsita phalaprade niyogini vaiṣṇavadarśanāṅgi sarvarakṣākaracakrasthe dakṣiṇāmnāyeśi sthitirūpe vaśini kāmeśi modini vimale aruṇe jayini sarveśvari kaulini rahasyayogini rahasyabhogini rahasyagopini śāktadarśanāṅgi sarvarogaharacakreśi paścimāmnāye dhanurbāṇapāśāṅkuśadevate kāmeśi vajreśi phagamālini atirahasyayogini śaivadarśanāṅgi sarvasiddhipradacakrage uttarāmnāyeśi saṃhārarūpe śuddhapare vindupīṭhagate mahārātripurasundari parāparātirahasyayogini śāṃbhavadarśanāṅgi sarvānandamayacakreśi tripurasuṃdari tripuravāsini tripuraśrīḥ tripuramālini tripurasiddhe tripurāṃba sarvacakrasthe anuttarāmnāyākhyasvarūpe mahātripurabhairavi caturvidhaguṇarūpe kule akule kulākule mahākaulini sarvottare sarvadarśanāṅgi navāsanasthite navākṣari navamithunākṛte maheśamādhavavidhātṛmanmathaskandanandīndramanucandrakuberāgastyadurvāsaḥkrodhabhaṭṭārakavidyātmike kalyāṇatattvatrayarūpe śivaśivātmike pūrmabrahmaśakte mahāparameśvari mahātripurasundari tava śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ /
ka eṃ īla hrīṃ hasa kahala hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ śrīṃ /
devyāḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyātsahasrākṣaravidyāyā /
nocettatpūjanaṃ vyarthamityāhurvedavādinaḥ //
meaning:
ओं ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौः ओं नमस्त्रिपुरसुन्दरि हृदये देवि शिरोदेवि शिखादेवि कवचदेवि नेत्रदेवि आस्यदेवि कामेश्वरि भगमालिनि नित्यक्लिन्नें भैरुण्डे वह्निवासिनि महावज्रेश्वरि विद्येश्वरि परशिवदूति त्वरिते कुलसुंदरि नित्ये नीलपताके विजये सर्वमङ्गले ज्वालामालिनि चित्रे महानित्ये परमेश्वरि मन्त्रेशमयि षष्ठीशमय्युद्यानमयि लोपामुद्रामय्यगस्त्यमयि कालतापनमयि धर्माचारमयि मुक्तके शीश्वरमयि दीपकलानाथमयि विष्णुदेवमयि प्रभाकरदेवमयि तेजोदेवमयि मनोजदेवमयि अणिमसिद्धे महिमसिद्धे गरिम सिद्धे लघिमसिद्धे ईशित्वसिद्धे वशित्वसिद्धे प्राप्तिसिद्धे प्राकाम्यसिद्धे रससिद्धे मोक्षसिद्धे ब्राह्मि माहेश्वरी कौमारि वैष्णवि वाराहि इन्द्राणि चामुण्डे महालक्ष्मि सर्वसंक्षोभिणि सर्वविद्राविणि सर्वाकर्षिणि सर्ववशङ्करि सर्वोन्मादिनि सर्वमहाङ्कुशे सर्वखेचरि सर्वबीजे सर्वयोने सर्वास्त्रखण्डिनि त्रैलोक्यमोहिनि चक्रस्वामिनि प्राटयोगिनि बौद्धदर्शनाङ्गि कामाकर्षिणि बुद्ध्याकर्षिणि अहङ्काराकर्षिणि शब्दाकर्षिणि स्पर्शाकर्षिणि रूपाकर्षिणि रसाकर्षिणि गन्धाकर्षिणि चित्ताकर्षिणि धैर्याकर्षिणि स्मृत्याकर्षिणि नामाकर्षिणि बीजाकर्षिणात्माकिर्षिणि अमृताकर्षिणि शरीराकर्षिणि गुप्तयोगिनि सर्वाशापरिपूरकचक्रस्वामिनि अनङ्गकुसुमे अनङ्गमेखले अनङ्गमादिनि अनङ्गमदनातुरे ऽनङ्गरेखे ऽनङ्गवेगिन्यनङ्गाङ्कुशे ऽनङ्गमालिनि गुप्ततरयोगिनि वैदिकदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसंक्षोभकारक चक्रस्वामिनि पूर्वाम्नायाधिदेवते सृष्टिरूपे सर्वसंक्षोभिणि सर्वविद्राविणि सर्वाकर्षिणि सर्वाह्लादिनि सर्वसंमोहिनि सर्वस्तंभिणि सर्वजृंभिणि सर्ववशङ्करि सर्वरञ्जिनि सर्वोन्मादिनि सर्वार्थसाधिके सर्वसंपत्प्रपूरिणि सर्वमन्त्रमयि सर्वद्वन्द्वक्षयकरि सम्प्रदाययोगिनि सौरदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसौभाग्यदायकचक्रे सर्वसिद्धिप्रदे सर्वसम्पत्प्रदे सर्वप्रियङ्करि
सर्वमङ्गलकारिणि सर्वकामप्रदे सर्वदुःखविमोचिनि सर्वमृत्युप्रशमिनि सर्वविघ्ननिवारिणि सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि सर्वसौभाग्यदायिनि कुलोत्तीर्णयोगिनि सर्वार्थसाधकचक्रेशि सर्वज्ञे सर्वशक्ते सर्वैश्वर्यफलप्रदे सर्वज्ञानमयि सर्वव्याधिनिवारिणि सर्वाधारस्वरूपे सर्वपापहरे सर्वानन्दमयि सर्वरक्षास्वरूपिणि सर्वेप्सित फलप्रदे नियोगिनि वैष्णवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वरक्षाकरचक्रस्थे दक्षिणाम्नायेशि स्थितिरूपे वशिनि कामेशि मोदिनि विमले अरुणे जयिनि सर्वेश्वरि कौलिनि रहस्ययोगिनि रहस्यभोगिनि रहस्यगोपिनि शाक्तदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वरोगहरचक्रेशि पश्चिमाम्नाये धनुर्बाणपाशाङ्कुशदेवते कामेशि वज्रेशि फगमालिनि अतिरहस्ययोगिनि शैवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वसिद्धिप्रदचक्रगे उत्तराम्नायेशि संहाररूपे शुद्धपरे विन्दुपीठगते महारात्रिपुरसुन्दरि परापरातिरहस्ययोगिनि शांभवदर्शनाङ्गि सर्वानन्दमयचक्रेशि त्रिपुरसुंदरि त्रिपुरवासिनि त्रिपुरश्रीः त्रिपुरमालिनि त्रिपुरसिद्धे त्रिपुरांब सर्वचक्रस्थे अनुत्तराम्नायाख्यस्वरूपे महात्रिपुरभैरवि चतुर्विधगुणरूपे कुले अकुले कुलाकुले महाकौलिनि सर्वोत्तरे सर्वदर्शनाङ्गि नवासनस्थिते नवाक्षरि नवमिथुनाकृते महेशमाधवविधातृमन्मथस्कन्दनन्दीन्द्रमनुचन्द्रकुबेरागस्त्यदुर्वासःक्रोधभट्टारकविद्यात्मिके कल्याणतत्त्वत्रयरूपे शिवशिवात्मिके पूर्मब्रह्मशक्ते महापरमेश्वरि महात्रिपुरसुन्दरि तव श्रीपादुकां पूजयामि नमः /
क एं ईल ह्रीं हस कहल ह्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौः सौः क्लीं ऐं श्रीं /
देव्याः पुष्पाञ्जलिं दद्यात्सहस्राक्षरविद्याया /
नोचेत्तत्पूजनं व्यर्थमित्याहुर्वेदवादिनः //
text_mt: "Oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ oṃ. Homage to you, O Tripurasundarī! O heart deity, O head deity, O tuft deity, O armour deity, O eye deity, O face deity, O Kāmeśvarī, O Bhagamālinī, O Nityaklinnā, O Bheruṇḍā, O Vahnivāsinī, O Mahāvajreśvarī, O Vidyeśvarī, O Paraśivadūtī, O Tvaritā, O Kulasundarī, O Nityā, O Nīlapatākā, O Vijayā, O Sarvamaṅgalā, O Jvālāmālinī, O Citrā, O Mahānityā, O Parameśvarī! O you who consist of Mantreśa, who consist of Ṣaṣṭhīśa, who consist of Uḍḍiyāna, who consist of Lopāmudrā, who consist of Agastya, who consist of Kālatāpana, who consist of Dharmācāra, who consist of Muktakeśīśvara, who consist of Dīpakalānātha, who consist of Viṣṇudeva, who consist of Prabhākaradeva, who consist of Tejodeva, who consist of Manojadeva! O siddhi of atomicity, siddhi of magnitude, siddhi of heaviness, siddhi of lightness, siddhi of sovereignty, siddhi of subjugation, siddhi of attainment, siddhi of irresistible will, siddhi of taste, siddhi of liberation! O Brāhmī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, Vārāhī, Indrāṇī, Cāmuṇḍā, Mahālakṣmī! O agitator of all, liquefier of all, attractor of all, subjugator of all, infatuator of all, great goad of all, space-goer of all, seed of all, womb of all, shatterer of all weapons, charmer of the three worlds, sovereign of the cakra, Prākaṭayoginī, limb of the Buddhist doctrine! O attractor of desire, attractor of intellect, attractor of ego, attractor of sound, attractor of touch, attractor of form, attractor of taste, attractor of smell, attractor of thought, attractor of courage, attractor of memory, attractor of name, attractor of seed, attractor of the self, attractor of nectar, attractor of the body, Guptayoginī, sovereign of the cakra that fulfills all hopes! O Anaṅgakusumā, Anaṅgamekhalā, Anaṅgamādanā, Anaṅgamadanāturā, Anaṅgarekhā, Anaṅgaveginī, Anaṅgāṅkuśā, Anaṅgamālinī, Guptatarayoginī, limb of the Vedic doctrine, sovereign of the cakra that causes all agitation, presiding deity of the eastern transmission, having the form of creation! O agitator of all, liquefier of all, attractor of all, delighter of all, deluder of all, paralyzer of all, cause of yawning in all, subjugator of all, pleaser of all, maddener of all, accomplisher of all aims, fulfiller of all prosperity, consisting of all mantras, destroyer of all dualities, Sampradāyayoginī, limb of the Solar doctrine, [abiding] in the cakra that grants all good fortune! O granter of all perfections, granter of all wealth, bringer of affection to all, causer of all auspiciousness, granter of all desires, releaser from all sorrow, subduer of all death, averter of all obstacles, beautiful in all limbs, bestower of all good fortune, Kulottīrṇayoginī, mistress of the cakra that accomplishes all aims! O omniscient one, all-powerful one, granter of the fruit of all sovereignty, consisting of all knowledge, averter of all diseases, having the nature of the foundation of all, remover of all sins, consisting of all bliss, having the form of protection for all, granter of the fruit of all desires, Niyoginī, limb of the Vaiṣṇava doctrine, abiding in the cakra that affords all protection, mistress of the southern transmission, having the form of preservation! O Vaśinī, Kāmeśī, Modinī, Vimalā, Aruṇā, Jayinī, Sarveśvarī, Kaulinī, Rahasyayoginī, enjoyer of secrets, concealer of secrets, limb of the Śākta doctrine, mistress of the cakra that cures all diseases, deity of bow, arrows, noose, and goad in the western transmission! O Kāmeśī, Vajreśī, Bhagamālinī, Atirahasyayoginī, limb of the Śaiva doctrine, abiding in the cakra that grants all perfections, mistress of the northern transmission, having the form of dissolution! O pure transcendent one, seated on the bindu-pīṭha, Mahārātripurasundarī, Parāparātirahasyayoginī, limb of the Śāmbhava doctrine, mistress of the cakra that consists of all bliss, Tripurasundarī, Tripuravāsinī, Tripuraśrī, Tripuramālinī, Tripurasiddhā, Tripurāmbā, abiding in all cakras, having the nature known as the transcendent transmission, Mahātripurabhairavī, having the form of the fourfold qualities, in Kula, Akula, and Kulākula, Mahākaulinī, superior to all, limb of all doctrines, seated on nine seats, nine-syllabled, having the form of nine pairs, whose self is the vidyās of Maheśa, Mādhava, the Creator, Manmatha, Skanda, Nandin, Indra, Manu, Candra, Kubera, Agastya, Durvāsas, and Krodhabhaṭṭāraka, having the form of the three auspicious principles, whose self is Śiva and Śivā, power of the full Brahman, Mahāparameśvarī, Mahātripurasundarī, I worship your holy sandals, homage! / ka e ī la hrīṃ ha sa ka ha la hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sauḥ sauḥ klīṃ aiṃ śrīṃ / One should offer a handful of flowers to the Goddess with the thousand-syllabled vidyā; / otherwise that worship is in vain: so declare the teachers of the Veda."

sanskrit_iast:
tato gomayasaṃlipte bhūtale droṇaśālibhiḥ /
tāvadbhistaṇḍulaiḥ śuddhaiḥ śastārṇaistatra nūtanam //
meaning:
ततो गोमयसंलिप्ते भूतले द्रोणशालिभिः /
तावद्भिस्तण्डुलैः शुद्धैः शस्तार्णैस्तत्र नूतनम् //
text_mt: Then, upon the ground smeared with cow dung, with a droṇa of rice grains / [and] an equal measure of pure husked grains inscribed with auspicious syllables, a new [water jar],

sanskrit_iast:
droṇodapūritaṃ kuṃbhaṃ pañcaratnairnavairyutam /
nyagrodhāśvatthamākandajaṃbūdumbaraśākhinām //
meaning:
द्रोणोदपूरितं कुंभं पञ्चरत्नैर्नवैर्युतम् /
न्यग्रोधाश्वत्थमाकन्दजंबूदुम्बरशाखिनाम् //
text_mt: a jar filled with a droṇa of water and provided with nine new gems, / along with the bark and sprouts of the fig, holy fig, mango,

sanskrit_iast:
tvagbhiśca pallavaiścaiva prakṣiptairadhivāsinam /
kumbhāgre nikṣipetpakvaṃ nārikelaphalaṃ śubham //
meaning:
त्वग्भिश्च पल्लवैश्चैव प्रक्षिप्तैरधिवासिनम् /
कुम्भाग्रे निक्षिपेत्पक्वं नारिकेलफलं शुभम् //
text_mt: rose-apple, and cluster fig trees, / cast in to perfume [the water], should be placed, and upon the mouth of the jar [the guru] should set an auspicious, ripe coconut.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairdhūpadīpādi darśayet /
śrīcintāmaṇimantraṃ tu hṛdi mātṛkamājapet //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य गन्धपुष्पाद्यैर्धूपदीपादि दर्शयेत् /
श्रीचिन्तामणिमन्त्रं तु हृदि मातृकमाजपेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped it with perfumes, flowers, and other offerings, he should display incense, lights, and the rest; / and within his heart he should recite the sacred Cintāmaṇi mantra together with the mātṛkā,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbha spṛśañchrīkāmāptirūpīkṛtakalevaram /
aṣṭottaraśate jāte punardīpaṃ pradarśayet //
meaning:
कुम्भ स्पृशञ्छ्रीकामाप्तिरूपीकृतकलेवरम् /
अष्टोत्तरशते जाते पुनर्दीपं प्रदर्शयेत् //
text_mt: touching the jar, having made his body identical in form with the attainment of holy Kāma; / when one hundred and eight [recitations] are completed, he should again show the lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyamāhūya rahasi vāsasā baddhalocanam /
kārayitvā praṇāmānāṃ sāṣṭāṅgānāṃ trayaṃ guruḥ //
meaning:
शिष्यमाहूय रहसि वाससा बद्धलोचनम् /
कारयित्वा प्रणामानां साष्टाङ्गानां त्रयं गुरुः //
text_mt: Summoning the disciple in secret, his eyes bound with a cloth, / the guru should make him perform / three eight-limbed prostrations.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇi tatkare dattvā kāraye tkusumāñjalim /
śrīnāthakaruṇārāśe parañjyotirmayeśvari //
meaning:
पुष्पाणि तत्करे दत्त्वा कारये त्कुसुमाञ्जलिम् /
श्रीनाथकरुणाराशे परञ्ज्योतिर्मयेश्वरि //
text_mt: Placing flowers in his hand, he should make him offer a handful of flowers: / "O storehouse of compassion of the holy Lord, O supreme Sovereign consisting of light!

sanskrit_iast:
prasūnāñjalireṣā te nikṣiptā caraṇāṃbuje /
paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahma mama tvaṃ paradevatā //
meaning:
प्रसूनाञ्जलिरेषा ते निक्षिप्ता चरणांबुजे /
परं धाम परं ब्रह्म मम त्वं परदेवता //
text_mt: This handful of blossoms is cast at your lotus feet; / you are the supreme abode, the supreme Brahman, and my supreme deity.

sanskrit_iast:
adyaprabhṛti me putrānrakṣa māṃ śāraṇāgatam /
ityuktvā gurupādāvje śiṣyo mūrdhni vidhārayet //
meaning:
अद्यप्रभृति मे पुत्रान्रक्ष मां शारणागतम् /
इत्युक्त्वा गुरुपादाव्जे शिष्यो मूर्ध्नि विधारयेत् //
text_mt: From this day forth protect my sons and me, who have come to you for refuge." / Saying this, the disciple should place the guru's lotus-like sandals on his head.

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntara sukṛtatvaṃ syānnyaste śirasi pāduke /
guruṇā kamalāsanamuraśāsanapuraśāsanasevayā labdhe //
meaning:
जन्मान्तर सुकृतत्वं स्यान्न्यस्ते शिरसि पादुके /
गुरुणा कमलासनमुरशासनपुरशासनसेवया लब्धे //
text_mt: "May it be the merit of other births that these sandals are placed upon my head, / obtained through the service of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva by the guru!"

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā bhaktibharitaḥ punarutthāya śāntimān /
vāmapārśve gurostiṣṭhedamānī vinayānvitaḥ //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा भक्तिभरितः पुनरुत्थाय शान्तिमान् /
वामपार्श्वे गुरोस्तिष्ठेदमानी विनयान्वितः //
text_mt: Saying this, filled with devotion, rising again, tranquil, / free from pride and endowed with modesty, he should stand at the guru's left side.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastuṃbījalaiḥ prokṣya vāmabhāge nivedayet /
vimucya netrabandhaṃ tu darśayedarcanakramam //
meaning:
ततस्तुंबीजलैः प्रोक्ष्य वामभागे निवेदयेत् /
विमुच्य नेत्रबन्धं तु दर्शयेदर्चनक्रमम् //
text_mt: Then, having sprinkled [him] with water from a gourd, [the guru] should make the offering on the left side; / and untying the eye bandage, he should show him the order of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
sitāmadhvājyakadalīphalapāyasarūpakam /
mahātripurasundaryā naivedyamiti cādiśet //
meaning:
सितामध्वाज्यकदलीफलपायसरूपकम् /
महात्रिपुरसुन्दर्या नैवेद्यमिति चादिशेत् //
text_mt: He should direct the food offering of Mahātripurasundarī / consisting of sugar, honey, clarified butter, plantain fruits, and milk-rice pudding.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśarṇamanuṃ tasya vadedvāmaśrutau śanaiḥ /
tato bahirvinirgatya sthāpya dārvāsane śucim //
meaning:
षोडशर्णमनुं तस्य वदेद्वामश्रुतौ शनैः /
ततो बहिर्विनिर्गत्य स्थाप्य दार्वासने शुचिम् //
text_mt: He should softly speak the sixteen-syllabled mantra into his left ear; / then, having gone outside and seated the purified [disciple] upon a wooden seat,

sanskrit_iast:
niveśya prāṅmukhaṃ tatra paṭṭavastrasamāstṛte /
śiṣyaṃ śrīkumbhasalilairabhiṣiñcetsamantrakam //
meaning:
निवेश्य प्राङ्मुखं तत्र पट्टवस्त्रसमास्तृते /
शिष्यं श्रीकुम्भसलिलैरभिषिञ्चेत्समन्त्रकम् //
text_mt: Having seated the disciple there facing east on [a seat] spread with silk cloth, / he should sprinkle him with the waters of the auspicious pot, accompanied by mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ śuddhodakaiḥ snātvā vāsasī parigṛhya ca /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ japtvā nidrāmathāviśet //
meaning:
पुनः शुद्धोदकैः स्नात्वा वाससी परिगृह्य च /
अष्टोत्तरशतं मन्त्रं जप्त्वा निद्रामथाविशेत् //
text_mt: Having bathed again with pure water and put on two garments, / and having recited the mantra one hundred and eight times, he should then go to sleep.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhe dṛṣṭe sati svapne puṇyaṃ yojyaṃ tadottamam /
duḥsvapne tu japaṃ kuryādaṣṭottarasahasrakam //
meaning:
शुभे दृष्टे सति स्वप्ने पुण्यं योज्यं तदोत्तमम् /
दुःस्वप्ने तु जपं कुर्यादष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् //
text_mt: If an auspicious dream is seen, the highest merit is then to be joined [to him]; / but in the case of a bad dream, he should perform a recitation of one thousand and eight [repetitions].

sanskrit_iast:
kārayettripurāṃbāyāḥ saparyāṃ muktamārgataḥ /
yadā na dṛṣṭaḥ svapno 'pi tadā siddhiścirādbhavet //
meaning:
कारयेत्त्रिपुरांबायाः सपर्यां मुक्तमार्गतः /
यदा न दृष्टः स्वप्नो ऽपि तदा सिद्धिश्चिराद्भवेत् //
text_mt: He should have worship of the mother Tripurā performed according to the path of liberation. / When not even a dream is seen, then siddhi will come after a long time.

sanskrit_iast:
svīkuryātparayā bhaktyā devī śeṣa kalādhikam /
sadya eva sa śiṣyaḥ syātpaṅktipāvanapāvanaḥ //
meaning:
स्वीकुर्यात्परया भक्त्या देवी शेष कलाधिकम् /
सद्य एव स शिष्यः स्यात्पङ्क्तिपावनपावनः //
text_mt: With supreme devotion he should accept the remaining portions and offerings of the goddess; / immediately that disciple becomes one who purifies the purifiers of an assembly.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca tasmai śrīgurave diśet /
tadadhīnaśca rennityaṃ tadvākyaṃ naiva laghayet //
meaning:
शरीरमर्थं प्राणं च तस्मै श्रीगुरवे दिशेत् /
तदधीनश्च रेन्नित्यं तद्वाक्यं नैव लघयेत् //
text_mt: He should offer his body, wealth, and life-breath to that holy guru, / and remain ever obedient to him; he should never transgress his word.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prasannaḥ kṣaṇārdhena mokṣalakṣmīṃ prayacchati /
durlabhaṃ taṃ vijānīyādguruṃ saṃsāratārakam //
meaning:
यः प्रसन्नः क्षणार्धेन मोक्षलक्ष्मीं प्रयच्छति /
दुर्लभं तं विजानीयाद्गुरुं संसारतारकम् //
text_mt: One should know that guru to be rare, who, when pleased, in half a moment / grants the fortune of liberation, ferrying across worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
gukārasyāndhakāror'tho rukārastannirodhakaḥ /
andhakāranirodhitvādgururityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
गुकारस्यान्धकारोर्ऽथो रुकारस्तन्निरोधकः /
अन्धकारनिरोधित्वाद्गुरुरित्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: The syllable 'gu' means darkness; the syllable 'ru' is its restrainer. / Because he restrains darkness, he is designated as 'guru'.

sanskrit_iast:
bodharūpaṃ guruṃ prāpya na gurvantaramādiśet /
guruktaṃ paruṣaṃ vākyamāśiṣaṃ paricintayet //
meaning:
बोधरूपं गुरुं प्राप्य न गुर्वन्तरमादिशेत् /
गुरुक्तं परुषं वाक्यमाशिषं परिचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: Having obtained a guru who is the embodiment of consciousness, he should not seek another guru. / A harsh word spoken by the guru he should consider a blessing.

sanskrit_iast:
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vāpi tathādhyātmikameva ca /
ādadīta tato jñānaṃ pūrvaṃ tamabhivādayet //
meaning:
लौकिकं वैदिकं वापि तथाध्यात्मिकमेव च /
आददीत ततो ज्ञानं पूर्वं तमभिवादयेत् //
text_mt: Whether worldly, Vedic, or indeed spiritual, / he should receive knowledge from him; first he should bow down to him.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dīkṣātrayaṃ kṛtvā vidheyaṃ baudhayetpunaḥ /
gurubhaktissadācārastaddrohastatra pātakam //
meaning:
एवं दीक्षात्रयं कृत्वा विधेयं बौधयेत्पुनः /
गुरुभक्तिस्सदाचारस्तद्द्रोहस्तत्र पातकम् //
text_mt: Having thus performed the threefold initiation, he should again instruct the one to be guided: / devotion to the guru is good conduct, and hostility towards him is a sin in this regard.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpadasmaraṇaṃ muktiryāvaddehamayaṃ kramaḥ /
yatpāpaṃ samavāpnoti gurvagre 'nṛtabhāṣaṇat //
meaning:
तत्पदस्मरणं मुक्तिर्यावद्देहमयं क्रमः /
यत्पापं समवाप्नोति गुर्वग्रे ऽनृतभाषणत् //
text_mt: Remembrance of his feet is liberation; this course lasts as long as the body lasts. / Whatever sin one incurs from speaking a falsehood before the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
gobrāhmaṇāvadhaṃ kṛtvā na tatpāpaṃ samāśrayet /
brahmādistaṃba paryataṃ yasya me gurusaṃtatiḥ //
meaning:
गोब्राह्मणावधं कृत्वा न तत्पापं समाश्रयेत् /
ब्रह्मादिस्तंब पर्यतं यस्य मे गुरुसंततिः //
text_mt: even having killed a cow and a brāhmaṇa, one does not contract such sin. / 'He whose lineage of gurus extends from Brahmā down to a clump of grass—

sanskrit_iast:
tasya me sarvapūjyasya ko na pūjyo mahītale /
iti sarvānukūlo yaḥ sa śiṣyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य मे सर्वपूज्यस्य को न पूज्यो महीतले /
इति सर्वानुकूलो यः स शिष्यः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: for me, who revere everyone, who is not worthy of worship on the surface of the earth?' / He who is thus benevolent to all is proclaimed to be a disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
śīlādivimalānekaguṇasaṃpannabhāvanaḥ /
guruśāsanavartitvācchiṣya ityabhidhīyate //
meaning:
शीलादिविमलानेकगुणसंपन्नभावनः /
गुरुशासनवर्तित्वाच्छिष्य इत्यभिधीयते //
text_mt: He whose disposition is endowed with good character and many other spotless virtues, / and who acts in accordance with the guru's instruction, is designated as a 'disciple'.

sanskrit_iast:
japācchrāntaḥ punardhyāyeddhyānācchrāntaḥ punarjapet /
japadhyānādiyuktasya kṣipraṃ mantraḥ prasidhyati //
meaning:
जपाच्छ्रान्तः पुनर्ध्यायेद्ध्यानाच्छ्रान्तः पुनर्जपेत् /
जपध्यानादियुक्तस्य क्षिप्रं मन्त्रः प्रसिध्यति //
text_mt: Wearied from recitation, he should meditate again; wearied from meditation, he should recite again. / For one engaged in recitation, meditation, and the like, the mantra is quickly accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā dhyānasya sāmarthyātkīṭo 'pi bhramarāyate /
tathā samādhisā marthyādbrahmībhūto bhavennaraḥ //
meaning:
यथा ध्यानस्य सामर्थ्यात्कीटो ऽपि भ्रमरायते /
तथा समाधिसा मर्थ्याद्ब्रह्मीभूतो भवेन्नरः //
text_mt: Just as even a worm turns into a black bee through the power of contemplation, / so a man, through the power of samādhi, becomes one with Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā nilīyate kāle prapañco naiva dṛśyate /
tathaiva mīlayennetre etaddhyānasya lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
यथा निलीयते काले प्रपञ्चो नैव दृश्यते /
तथैव मीलयेन्नेत्रे एतद्ध्यानस्य लक्षणम् //
text_mt: Just as the phenomenal world dissolves in time and is not seen at all, / exactly so he should close his eyes: this is the characteristic of meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
vidite tu pare tattve varṇātīte hyavikriye /
kiṅkaratvaṃ ca gacchanti mantrā mantrādhipaiḥ saha //
meaning:
विदिते तु परे तत्त्वे वर्णातीते ह्यविक्रिये /
किङ्करत्वं च गच्छन्ति मन्त्रा मन्त्राधिपैः सह //
text_mt: When the supreme reality beyond phonemes and unchanging is known, / the mantras, along with the lords of the mantras, become servants.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaikyabhāvaniṣṭhasya yā ceṣṭā sā tu darśanam /
yogastapaḥ sa tanmantrastaddhanaṃ yannirīkṣaṇam //
meaning:
आत्मैक्यभावनिष्ठस्य या चेष्टा सा तु दर्शनम् /
योगस्तपः स तन्मन्त्रस्तद्धनं यन्निरीक्षणम् //
text_mt: For one established in the state of oneness with the Self, whatever action [he does] is vision; / that is yoga, that is austerity, that is his mantra, and whatever gazing [he does] is that concentration.

sanskrit_iast:
dehābhimāne galite vijñāte paramātmani /
yatrayatra mano yāti tatratatra samādhayaḥ //
meaning:
देहाभिमाने गलिते विज्ञाते परमात्मनि /
यत्रयत्र मनो याति तत्रतत्र समाधयः //
text_mt: When identification with the body has melted away and the Supreme Self is known, / wherever the mind goes, there are samādhis.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ paśyetsarvagaṃ śāṃmānandātmānamadvayam /
na tasya kiñcidāptavyaṃ jñātavyaṃ vāvaśiṣyate //
meaning:
यः पश्येत्सर्वगं शांमानन्दात्मानमद्वयम् /
न तस्य किञ्चिदाप्तव्यं ज्ञातव्यं वावशिष्यते //
text_mt: He who sees the all-pervading, peaceful, non-dual Self of bliss— / nothing remains for him to be attained or known.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjākoṭisamaṃ stotraṃ stotrakoṭisamojapaḥ /
japakoṭisamaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyānakoṭisamo layaḥ //
meaning:
पूजाकोटिसमं स्तोत्रं स्तोत्रकोटिसमोजपः /
जपकोटिसमं ध्यानं ध्यानकोटिसमो लयः //
text_mt: A hymn of praise equals ten million acts of worship; recitation equals ten million hymns of praise; / meditation equals ten million recitations; dissolution equals ten million meditations.

sanskrit_iast:
deho devālayaḥ prokto jīva eva maheśvaraḥ /
tyajedajñānanirmālyaṃ sohaṃbhāvena yojayet //
meaning:
देहो देवालयः प्रोक्तो जीव एव महेश्वरः /
त्यजेदज्ञाननिर्माल्यं सोहंभावेन योजयेत् //
text_mt: The body is declared to be a temple of God; the individual soul is Maheśvara alone. / He should discard the withered remnants of ignorance; he should unite [himself] with the feeling 'I am He'.

sanskrit_iast:
tuṣeṇa baddho vrīhiḥ syāttuṣābhāve tu taṇḍulaḥ /
pāśabaddhaḥ smṛto jīvaḥ pāśamukto maheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
तुषेण बद्धो व्रीहिः स्यात्तुषाभावे तु तण्डुलः /
पाशबद्धः स्मृतो जीवः पाशमुक्तो महेश्वरः //
text_mt: Bound by the husk, it is unhusked rice; but in the absence of the husk, it is grain. / Bound by bonds, it is called the individual soul; freed from bonds, it is Maheśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśe pakṣijātīnāṃ jaleṣu jalacāriṇām /
yathā gatirna dṛśyeta mahāvṛttaṃ mahātmanām //
meaning:
आकाशे पक्षिजातीनां जलेषु जलचारिणाम् /
यथा गतिर्न दृश्येत महावृत्तं महात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Just as the path of species of birds in the sky or of aquatic creatures in the waters cannot be seen, / [so cannot be seen] the great conduct of great-souled beings.

sanskrit_iast:
nityārcanaṃ divā kuryādrātrau naimittikārcanam /
ubhayoḥ kāmyakarmā syāditi śāstrasya niścayaḥ //
meaning:
नित्यार्चनं दिवा कुर्याद्रात्रौ नैमित्तिकार्चनम् /
उभयोः काम्यकर्मा स्यादिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः //
text_mt: One should perform regular worship by day, and occasional worship at night; / an optional ritual should be done at both [times]—such is the decision of scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭikoṭimahādānātkoṭikoṭimahāvratāt /
koṭikoṭimahāyajñātparā śrīpādukā smṛtiḥ //
meaning:
कोटिकोटिमहादानात्कोटिकोटिमहाव्रतात् /
कोटिकोटिमहायज्ञात्परा श्रीपादुका स्मृतिः //
text_mt: Greater than tens of millions of great gifts, greater than tens of millions of great vows, / greater than tens of millions of great sacrifices is the remembrance of the venerable sandals [of the guru].

sanskrit_iast:
jñānato 'jñānato vāpi yāvaddehasya dhāraṇam /
tāvadvarṇāśramācāraḥ kartavyaḥ karmamuktaye //
meaning:
ज्ञानतो ऽज्ञानतो वापि यावद्देहस्य धारणम् /
तावद्वर्णाश्रमाचारः कर्तव्यः कर्ममुक्तये //
text_mt: Whether knowingly or unknowingly, as long as the body is maintained, / so long must the conduct of one's class and stage of life be observed for the release from action.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgataṃ yadgurorvaktrātsarvaṃ śāstraṃ taducyate /
niṣiddhamapi tatkuryādgurvājñāṃ naiva laṅghayet //
meaning:
निर्गतं यद्गुरोर्वक्त्रात्सर्वं शास्त्रं तदुच्यते /
निषिद्धमपि तत्कुर्याद्गुर्वाज्ञां नैव लङ्घयेत् //
text_mt: Whatever has come from the mouth of the guru is all called scripture; / even if forbidden, he should do it; he should never disobey the guru's command.

sanskrit_iast:
jātividyādhanāḍhyo vā dūre dṛṣṭvā guruṃ mudā /
daṇḍapramāṇaṃ kṛtvaikaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇāmācaret //
meaning:
जातिविद्याधनाढ्यो वा दूरे दृष्ट्वा गुरुं मुदा /
दण्डप्रमाणं कृत्वैकं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणामाचरेत् //
text_mt: Whether rich in birth, learning, or wealth, seeing the guru afar with joy, / having made a single prostration like a staff, he should perform circumambulation three times.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubuddhyā nametsarvaṃ daivataṃ tṛṇameva vā /
praṇameddevabuddhyā tu pratimāṃ lohamṛnmayīm //
meaning:
गुरुबुद्ध्या नमेत्सर्वं दैवतं तृणमेव वा /
प्रणमेद्देवबुद्ध्या तु प्रतिमां लोहमृन्मयीम् //
text_mt: With the thought of the guru, he should bow to everything, whether a deity or even a blade of grass; / but with the thought of God he should bow to an image made of metal or clay.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ huṅkṛtya tuṅkṛtya vipraṃ vādairvijitya ca /
vikāsya guhyaśāstrāṇi bhavanti brahmarākṣasāḥ //
meaning:
गुरुं हुङ्कृत्य तुङ्कृत्य विप्रं वादैर्विजित्य च /
विकास्य गुह्यशास्त्राणि भवन्ति ब्रह्मराक्षसाः //
text_mt: Shouting 'hum' or 'tu' at a guru, defeating a brāhmaṇa in arguments, / and revealing secret scriptures, they become brahmarākṣasas.

sanskrit_iast:
advaitaṃ bhāva yennityaṃ nādvaitaṃ guruṇā saha /
na nindedanyasamayānvedaśāstrāgamādikān //
meaning:
अद्वैतं भाव येन्नित्यं नाद्वैतं गुरुणा सह /
न निन्देदन्यसमयान्वेदशास्त्रागमादिकान् //
text_mt: One should always contemplate non-duality, but never non-duality with the guru; / he should not revile other traditions, such as the Vedas, the śāstras, and the Āgamas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekagrāmasthitaḥ śiṣyastrisaṃdhyaṃ praṇamedgurum /
krośa mātrasthito bhaktyā guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet //
meaning:
एकग्रामस्थितः शिष्यस्त्रिसंध्यं प्रणमेद्गुरुम् /
क्रोश मात्रस्थितो भक्त्या गुरुं प्रतिदिनं नमेत् //
text_mt: A disciple dwelling in the same village should bow down to the guru at the three junctures of the day; / dwelling at a distance of only a krośa, he should bow to the guru every day with devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
arthayojanagaḥ śiṣyaḥ praṇametpañcaparvasu /
ekayojanamārabhya yojanadvādaśāvadhi //
meaning:
अर्थयोजनगः शिष्यः प्रणमेत्पञ्चपर्वसु /
एकयोजनमारभ्य योजनद्वादशावधि //
text_mt: A disciple staying half a yojana away should bow down on the five sacred occasions; / starting from one yojana up to a limit of twelve yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
tattadyojanasaṃkhyātamāseṣu praṇamedgurum /
atidūrasthitaḥ śiṣyo yadecchā syāttadā vrajet //
meaning:
तत्तद्योजनसंख्यातमासेषु प्रणमेद्गुरुम् /
अतिदूरस्थितः शिष्यो यदेच्छा स्यात्तदा व्रजेत् //
text_mt: he should bow down to the guru in the months numbered according to each yojana. / A disciple residing exceedingly far away should go whenever he wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
riktapāṇistu nopeyādrājānaṃ devatāṃ gurum /
phalapuṣpāṃbarādīni yathāśakti samarpayet //
meaning:
रिक्तपाणिस्तु नोपेयाद्राजानं देवतां गुरुम् /
फलपुष्पांबरादीनि यथाशक्ति समर्पयेत् //
text_mt: He should not approach a king, a deity, or a guru empty-handed; / he should present fruits, flowers, clothing, and the like according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyacarmaṇā baddhaḥ sākṣātparaśivaḥ svayam /
sacchiṣyānugrahārthāya gūḍhaṃ paryaṭati kṣitau //
meaning:
मनुष्यचर्मणा बद्धः साक्षात्परशिवः स्वयम् /
सच्छिष्यानुग्रहार्थाय गूढं पर्यटति क्षितौ //
text_mt: Bound by human skin, Paraśiva Himself in person / wanders secretly on earth for the sake of bestowing grace upon good disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhaktarakṣaṇāyaiva nirākāro 'pi sākṛtiḥ /
śivaḥ kṛpānidhirloke saṃsārīva hi ceṣṭate //
meaning:
सद्भक्तरक्षणायैव निराकारो ऽपि साकृतिः /
शिवः कृपानिधिर्लोके संसारीव हि चेष्टते //
text_mt: Solely to protect true devotees, though formless, Śiva, the ocean of compassion, / takes form in the world and acts just like an ordinary worldly man.

sanskrit_iast:
/
atrinetraḥ śivaḥ sākṣādacaturbāhuracyutaḥ /
acaturvadano brahmā śrīguruḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
/
अत्रिनेत्रः शिवः साक्षादचतुर्बाहुरच्युतः /
अचतुर्वदनो ब्रह्मा श्रीगुरुः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: Śiva in person without three eyes, Acyuta without four arms, / Brahmā without four faces—thus the holy guru is celebrated.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ paratattvākhyaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ cakṣuragrataḥ /
bhāgyahīnā na paśyanti sūryamandhā ivoditam //
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं परतत्त्वाख्यं तिष्ठन्तं चक्षुरग्रतः /
भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति सूर्यमन्धा इवोदितम् //
text_mt: The holy guru, known as the supreme reality, standing before their eyes, / those devoid of fortune do not see, just as the blind do not see the risen sun.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamā tattvacintā syājjapacintā tu madhyamā /
adhamā śāstracintā syāllokacintādhamādhamā //
meaning:
उत्तमा तत्त्वचिन्ता स्याज्जपचिन्ता तु मध्यमा /
अधमा शास्त्रचिन्ता स्याल्लोकचिन्ताधमाधमा //
text_mt: Contemplation of reality is the highest; contemplation of recitation is middling; / contemplation of treatises is inferior; contemplation of worldly matters is the lowest of the low.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsthi gurvadhikaṃ tattvaṃ nāsti jñānādhikaṃ sukham /
nāsti bhaktyadhikā pūjā na hi mokṣādhikaṃ phalam //
meaning:
नास्थि गुर्वधिकं तत्त्वं नास्ति ज्ञानाधिकं सुखम् /
नास्ति भक्त्यधिका पूजा न हि मोक्षाधिकं फलम् //
text_mt: There is no reality higher than the guru; there is no happiness higher than knowledge; / there is no worship higher than devotion; indeed, there is no fruit higher than liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavedeṣu śāstreṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādiṣu /
tatra tatrocyate śabdaiḥ śrīkāmākṣī parātparā //
meaning:
सर्ववेदेषु शास्त्रेषु ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिषु /
तत्र तत्रोच्यते शब्दैः श्रीकामाक्षी परात्परा //
text_mt: In all the Vedas, śāstras, and in Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the rest, / in this place and that, the supreme beyond the supreme is spoken of by the names of holy Kāmākṣī.

sanskrit_iast:
śacīndrau svāhāgnī ca prabhāravī /
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vāṇīdhātārau girijāśivau //
meaning:
शचीन्द्रौ स्वाहाग्नी च प्रभारवी /
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ वाणीधातारौ गिरिजाशिवौ //
text_mt: Śacī and Indra, Svāhā and Agni, Prabhā and the Sun, / Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, Vāṇī and the Creator, the Mountain's Daughter and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomau bindunādau tathā prakṛtipūruṣau /
ādhārādheyanāmānau bhogamokṣau tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अग्नीषोमौ बिन्दुनादौ तथा प्रकृतिपूरुषौ /
आधाराधेयनामानौ भोगमोक्षौ तथैव च //
text_mt: Agni and Soma, bindu and nāda, and likewise prakṛti and puruṣa, / named the locus and the located, and likewise enjoyment and liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāpanau ca śabdārthauṃ tathā vidhiniṣedhakau /
sukhaduḥkhādi yaddvandvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate 'pi vā //
meaning:
प्राणापनौ च शब्दार्थौं तथा विधिनिषेधकौ /
सुखदुःखादि यद्द्वन्द्वं दृश्यते श्रूयते ऽपि वा //
text_mt: prāṇa and apāna, word and meaning, and likewise injunction and prohibition, / whatever pair of opposites such as pleasure and pain is seen or heard,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvalokeṣu tatsarvaṃ paraṃ brahma na saṃśayaḥ /
uttīrmamaparaṃ jyotiḥ kāmākṣīnāmakaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
सर्वलोकेषु तत्सर्वं परं ब्रह्म न संशयः /
उत्तीर्ममपरं ज्योतिः कामाक्षीनामकं विदुः //
text_mt: In all the worlds, that all is the supreme Brahman; of this there is no doubt. / The transcendent supreme light they know by the name Kāmākṣī,

sanskrit_iast:
yadeva nityaṃ dhyāyanti brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ /
itthaṃ hi śaktimārge 'sminyaḥ pumāniha vartate //
meaning:
यदेव नित्यं ध्यायन्ति ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः /
इत्थं हि शक्तिमार्गे ऽस्मिन्यः पुमानिह वर्तते //
text_mt: which alone Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others constantly meditate upon. / Thus indeed, whatever man here abides in this path of Śakti,

sanskrit_iast:
prasādabhūmiḥ śrīdevyā bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanam /
amantraṃ vā samatraṃ vā kāmākṣīmarcayanti ye //
meaning:
प्रसादभूमिः श्रीदेव्या भुक्तिमुक्त्योः स भाजनम् /
अमन्त्रं वा समत्रं वा कामाक्षीमर्चयन्ति ये //
text_mt: becomes a recipient of the noble Goddess's grace, a vessel of worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Those who worship Kāmākṣī, whether without mantras or with mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
striyo vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca te yānti paramāṃ gatim /
kiṃ punaḥ kṣattriyā viprā mantrapūrvaṃ yajanti ye //
meaning:
स्त्रियो वैश्याश्च शूद्राश्च ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् /
किं पुनः क्षत्त्रिया विप्रा मन्त्रपूर्वं यजन्ति ये //
text_mt: even women, Vaiśyas, and Śūdras, attain the supreme state; / what then of Kṣatriyas and Brahmins who worship accompanied by mantras?

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāriṇo 'pi te nūnaṃ vimuktā nātra saṃśayaḥ /
sitāmadhvājyakadalīphalapāyasarūpakam //
meaning:
संसारिणो ऽपि ते नूनं विमुक्ता नात्र संशयः /
सितामध्वाज्यकदलीफलपायसरूपकम् //
text_mt: Though living worldly lives, they are surely liberated; of this there is no doubt. / Consisting of white sugar, honey, clarified butter, plantains, and milk-rice,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaparvasu naivedyaṃ sarvadaiva nivedayet /
yonārcayati śakto 'pi sa devīśāpamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
पञ्चपर्वसु नैवेद्यं सर्वदैव निवेदयेत् /
योनार्चयति शक्तो ऽपि स देवीशापमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: one should always present food offerings on the five sacred occasions. / He who, though capable, does not worship, incurs the curse of the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktau bhāvanādravyairarcayennityamaṃbikām /
gṛhasthastu mahādevīṃ maṅgalācārasaṃyutaḥ //
meaning:
अशक्तौ भावनाद्रव्यैरर्चयेन्नित्यमंबिकाम् /
गृहस्थस्तु महादेवीं मङ्गलाचारसंयुतः //
text_mt: If incapable, one should continually worship Ambikā with imagined substances. / But a householder, endowed with auspicious conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
arcayeta mahālakṣmīmanukūlāṅganāsakhaḥ /
gurustrivāramācāraṃ kathayetkalaśodbhava //
meaning:
अर्चयेत महालक्ष्मीमनुकूलाङ्गनासखः /
गुरुस्त्रिवारमाचारं कथयेत्कलशोद्भव //
text_mt: accompanied by a compatible wife, should worship Mahālakṣmī. / The guru should explain this conduct three times, O pot-born [Agastya].

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyo yadi na gṛhṇīyā cchiṣye pāpaṃ gurorna hi /
lakṣmīnārāyaṇau vāṇīdhātārau girijāśivau //
meaning:
शिष्यो यदि न गृह्णीया च्छिष्ये पापं गुरोर्न हि /
लक्ष्मीनारायणौ वाणीधातारौ गिरिजाशिवौ //
text_mt: If the disciple does not accept it, the sin belongs to the disciple, not to the guru. / Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa, Sarasvatī and the Creator [Brahmā], Pārvatī and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīguruṃ gurupatnīṃ ca pitarau cintayeddhiyā /
iti sarvaṃ mayā proktaṃ samāsena ghaṭodbhava //
meaning:
श्रीगुरुं गुरुपत्नीं च पितरौ चिन्तयेद्धिया /
इति सर्वं मया प्रोक्तं समासेन घटोद्भव //
text_mt: the noble guru, and the guru's wife—one should mentally contemplate them as one's parents. / Thus all has been spoken by me in brief, O pot-born [Agastya].

sanskrit_iast:
etāvadavadhānena sarvajño matimānbhavet //
iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lalitopākhyāne tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
एतावदवधानेन सर्वज्ञो मतिमान्भवेत् //
इति श्रीब्रह्माण्डमहापुराणे उत्तरभागे ललितोपाख्याने त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Through this much attentiveness, an intelligent man shall become omniscient.

Thus ends the forty-third chapter in the Lalitopākhyāna of the UttarabGeneric Brahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
praviśya tu japasthānamānīya nijamāsanam /
abhyukṣya vidhivanmantrairgurūktakramayogataḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
प्रविश्य तु जपस्थानमानीय निजमासनम् /
अभ्युक्ष्य विधिवन्मन्त्रैर्गुरूक्तक्रमयोगतः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / Having entered the place of recitation and brought one's own seat, / having sprinkled it according to rule with mantras through the method taught by the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānaṃ devatāmūrtiṃ dhyāyaṃstatrāviśeṣataḥ /
prāṅmukho dṛḍhamābadhya padmāsanamananyadhīḥ //
meaning:
स्वात्मानं देवतामूर्तिं ध्यायंस्तत्राविशेषतः /
प्राङ्मुखो दृढमाबध्य पद्मासनमनन्यधीः //
text_mt: meditating upon oneself as the form of the deity without any distinction there, / facing east, firmly assuming the lotus posture with concentrated mind,

sanskrit_iast:
trikhaṇḍāmanubadhnīyādgurvādīnabhivandya ca /
dviruktabālabījāni madhyādyaṅguliṣu kramāt //
meaning:
त्रिखण्डामनुबध्नीयाद्गुर्वादीनभिवन्द्य च /
द्विरुक्तबालबीजानि मध्याद्यङ्गुलिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: one should bind the trikhaṇḍā mudrā and, having saluted the guru and the rest, / [place] the twice-uttered Bālā seed-syllables on the fingers beginning with the middle finger in sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
talayorapi vinyasya karaśuddhipuraḥsaram /
agniprākāraparyantaṃ kuryātsvāstreṇa mantravit //
meaning:
तलयोरपि विन्यस्य करशुद्धिपुरःसरम् /
अग्निप्राकारपर्यन्तं कुर्यात्स्वास्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् //
text_mt: having placed [them] also on the two palms, preceded by the purification of the hands, / the knower of mantras should make [a protective circle] up to a wall of fire with his weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
pratilomena pādādyamanulomena kādikam /
vyāpa kanyāsamāropya vyāpayanvāgbhavādibhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिलोमेन पादाद्यमनुलोमेन कादिकम् /
व्याप कन्यासमारोप्य व्यापयन्वाग्भवादिभिः //
text_mt: In reverse order starting from the feet, and in direct order starting with 'ka', / having performed the all-pervading ritual placement, pervading [the body] with the seed-syllables beginning with Vāgbhava,

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktaiḥ kāramasūkṣmasthūlaśarīrāṇi kalpayet /
nābhau hṛdi bhruvormadhye bālābījānyatha nyaset //
meaning:
व्यक्तैः कारमसूक्ष्मस्थूलशरीराणि कल्पयेत् /
नाभौ हृदि भ्रुवोर्मध्ये बालाबीजान्यथ न्यसेत् //
text_mt: one should fashion the causal, subtle, and gross bodies with manifest syllables. / Then one should place the Bālā seed-syllables on the navel, the heart, and between the eyebrows.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkāṃ mūlapuṭitāṃ nyasennābhyādiṣu kramāt /
bālābījāni tānyeva dvirāvṛttyātha vinyaset //
meaning:
मातृकां मूलपुटितां न्यसेन्नाभ्यादिषु क्रमात् /
बालाबीजानि तान्येव द्विरावृत्त्याथ विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should place the mātṛkā entwined with the root mantra on the navel and other spots in sequence; / then one should place those very same Bālā seed-syllables with a twofold repetition,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyādikaraśākhāsu talayorapi nānyathā /
nābhyādāvatha vinyasya nyasedatha padadvaye //
meaning:
मध्यादिकरशाखासु तलयोरपि नान्यथा /
नाभ्यादावथ विन्यस्य न्यसेदथ पदद्वये //
text_mt: on the fingers beginning with the middle finger and on the palms—not otherwise; / having placed them then on the navel and elsewhere, one should then place them on the two feet,

sanskrit_iast:
jānūrusphigguhyamūlanābhi hṛnmūrdhasu kramāt /
navāsanāni brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ tatheśvaram //
meaning:
जानूरुस्फिग्गुह्यमूलनाभि हृन्मूर्धसु क्रमात् /
नवासनानि ब्रह्माणं विष्णुं रुद्रं तथेश्वरम् //
text_mt: in sequence on the knees, thighs, buttocks, root of the genitals, navel, heart, and head. / Having placed the nine seats—Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and likewise Īśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaṃ ca pūṣāṇaṃ tūlikāṃ ca prakāśakam /
vidyāsanaṃ ca vinyasya hṛdaye darśayettataḥ //
meaning:
सदाशिवं च पूषाणं तूलिकां च प्रकाशकम् /
विद्यासनं च विन्यस्य हृदये दर्शयेत्ततः //
text_mt: Sadāśiva, Pūṣan, the brush, the illuminator, / and the seat of knowledge—one should then display at the heart

sanskrit_iast:
padmatrikhaṇḍayonyākhyāṃ mudrāmoṣṭhapuṭena ca /
vāyumāpūrya huṃ huṃ huṃ tviti prābīdhya kuṇḍalīm //
meaning:
पद्मत्रिखण्डयोन्याख्यां मुद्रामोष्ठपुटेन च /
वायुमापूर्य हुं हुं हुं त्विति प्राबीध्य कुण्डलीम् //
text_mt: the mudrās called the lotus, the threefold, and the yoni seal; and drawing in the breath / through the pursed lips, having awakened the Kuṇḍalinī with 'huṃ huṃ huṃ',

sanskrit_iast:
mantraśaktyā samunnīya dvādaśānte śivaikatām /
bhāvayitvā punastaṃ ca svasthāne viniveśya ca //
meaning:
मन्त्रशक्त्या समुन्नीय द्वादशान्ते शिवैकताम् /
भावयित्वा पुनस्तं च स्वस्थाने विनिवेश्य च //
text_mt: having raised her up through the power of the mantra, contemplating oneness with Śiva at the dvādaśānta, / and having installed her once more in her own seat,

sanskrit_iast:
vāgbhavādīni bījāni mūlahṛdbāhuṣu nyaset /
samastamūrdhni dormūlamadhyāgreṣu yathākramam //
meaning:
वाग्भवादीनि बीजानि मूलहृद्बाहुषु न्यसेत् /
समस्तमूर्ध्नि दोर्मूलमध्याग्रेषु यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: one should place the seed-syllables beginning with Vāgbhava at the base, the heart, and the arms; / [then] all together upon the head, at the roots of the arms, the middle, and the tips in proper order.

sanskrit_iast:
hastau vinyasya cāṅgeṣu hyaṅguṣṭhāditalāvadhi /
hṛdayādau ca vinyasya kuṅkumaṃ nyāsamācaret //
meaning:
हस्तौ विन्यस्य चाङ्गेषु ह्यङ्गुष्ठादितलावधि /
हृदयादौ च विन्यस्य कुङ्कुमं न्यासमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having placed the two hands on the limbs from the thumbs to the palms, / and having placed them on the heart and other limbs, one should perform the saffron ritual placement.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhā tṛtīyabījena puṭitāṃ mātṛkāṃ punaḥ /
ādyabījadvayaṃ nyasya hyantyabījaṃ nyasediti //
meaning:
शुद्धा तृतीयबीजेन पुटितां मातृकां पुनः /
आद्यबीजद्वयं न्यस्य ह्यन्त्यबीजं न्यसेदिति //
text_mt: Again, [one should place] the pure mātṛkā enclosed by the third seed-syllable; / having placed the first two seed-syllables, one should place the final seed-syllable: thus [it is].

sanskrit_iast:
punarbhūtalavinyāsamācarennātivistaram /
vargāṣṭakaṃ nyasenmūle nābhau hṛdayakaṇṭhayoḥ //
meaning:
पुनर्भूतलविन्यासमाचरेन्नातिविस्तरम् /
वर्गाष्टकं न्यसेन्मूले नाभौ हृदयकण्ठयोः //
text_mt: Again, one should perform the earth-script ritual placement without excessive elaboration: / one should place the eight groups at the base, the navel, the heart, and the throat.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgādhāyaiṣu śaṣasānmūlahṛnmūrddhasu nyaset /
kakṣakaṭyaṃsavāmāṃsakaṭihṛtsu ca vinyaset //
meaning:
प्रागाधायैषु शषसान्मूलहृन्मूर्द्धसु न्यसेत् /
कक्षकट्यंसवामांसकटिहृत्सु च विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: On these beginning in the east, one should place 'śa', 'ṣa', and 'sa' at the base, the heart, and the head; / and one should place them at the armpit, hip, shoulder, left shoulder, hip, and heart.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhūtādhaḥ ṣaḍaṅgāni dādivargaistu vinyaset /
ṛṣistu śabdabrahmasyācchando bhūtalipirmatā //
meaning:
प्रभूताधः षडङ्गानि दादिवर्गैस्तु विन्यसेत् /
ऋषिस्तु शब्दब्रह्मस्याच्छन्दो भूतलिपिर्मता //
text_mt: Below the extensive [limbs], one should place the six limbs with the groups beginning with 'da'. / The seer is Śabdabrahman, the meter is considered to be the earth-script;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmūlaprakṛtistvasya devatā kathitā manoḥ /
akṣasrakpustake cordhve puṣpasāyakakārmuke //
meaning:
श्रीमूलप्रकृतिस्त्वस्य देवता कथिता मनोः /
अक्षस्रक्पुस्तके चोर्ध्वे पुष्पसायककार्मुके //
text_mt: the deity of this mantra is declared to be the noble Mūlaprakṛti. / In her upper [hands] holding a rosary and a book, and [in the others] a bow and flower-arrows,

sanskrit_iast:
varābhītikarābjaiśca dhārayantīmanūpamām /
rakṣaṇākṣamayīṃ mānāṃ vahantī kaṇṭhadeśataḥ //
meaning:
वराभीतिकराब्जैश्च धारयन्तीमनूपमाम् /
रक्षणाक्षमयीं मानां वहन्ती कण्ठदेशतः //
text_mt: and with lotus-hands granting boons and fearlessness, peerless, / wearing a protective garland of beads hanging from the throat region,

sanskrit_iast:
hārakeyūrakaṭakacchannavīravibhūṣaṇām /
divyāṅgarāgasaṃbhinnamaṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitām //
meaning:
हारकेयूरकटकच्छन्नवीरविभूषणाम् /
दिव्याङ्गरागसंभिन्नमणिकुण्डलमण्डिताम् //
text_mt: adorned with necklaces, armlets, and bangles over heroic ornaments, / adorned with gem-set earrings blended with divine body-cosmetics,

sanskrit_iast:
lipikalpadrumasyādho rūpipaṅkajavāsinīm /
sākṣāllipimayīṃ dhyāyedbhairavīṃ bhaktavatsalām //
meaning:
लिपिकल्पद्रुमस्याधो रूपिपङ्कजवासिनीम् /
साक्षाल्लिपिमयीं ध्यायेद्भैरवीं भक्तवत्सलाम् //
text_mt: seated upon a radiant lotus beneath the wish-fulfilling tree of the alphabet, / one should meditate upon the manifest Bhairavī composed of the letters, affectionate to devotees,

sanskrit_iast:
anekakoṭidūtībhiḥ samantātsamalaṅkṛtām /
evaṃ dhyātvā nyasedbhūyo bhūtalepyakṣarānkramāt //
meaning:
अनेककोटिदूतीभिः समन्तात्समलङ्कृताम् /
एवं ध्यात्वा न्यसेद्भूयो भूतलेप्यक्षरान्क्रमात् //
text_mt: adorned all around by many millions of female messengers. / Having meditated thus, one should again place the letters of the earth-script in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
